Place well drained olive in center of dough, bringing edges together to cover olive completely.
Roll gently between palms of hands.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet; chill 10 minutes in refrigerator.
Cook 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Pancakes
steps: Stir together dry ingredients with a whisk.
Beat the eggs slightly and combine with the milk, then add to the dry ingredients.
Stir in oil.
Heat the pan (nonstick), but do not grease it.
Pour batter into the pan by large spoonful.
Cook over medium heat, turning once when bubbles come to the surface and pop and the edges are slightly dry.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Chicken-Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can condensed nacho cheese soup
steps: In small bowl, combine soup and milk; set aside.
In medium bowl, combine chicken, salsa, chilies, chili powder and 2 tablespoons of soup mixture.

recipes.title: Broccoli With Oil And Lemon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. fresh broccoli, cut into spears
steps: Heat 1 inch water (salted if desired) to boiling.
Add broccoli.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover and cook 12 to 15 minutes or just until stems are tender; drain.
Mix remaining ingredients; pour over broccoli.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Black Magic Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly.
Batter will be thin. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Nancy'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.

Cream the margarine, oil, sugars, egg and vanilla. Mix flour, soda and salt and add to creamed mixture. Fold in the oatmeal, chocolate chips, Rice Krispies and pecans. Drop by rounded teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Cook for 10 minutes at 350°.
Makes 10 dozen.

recipes.title: Gingersnaps
steps: Cream shortening, add sugar and mix thoroughly.
Add egg and molasses; mix.
Add dry ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Chill dough.
Roll in small balls.
Roll in sugar.
Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350°.
They crack open nicely.

recipes.title: Italian Ice
ingredients: 1 pkg. berries (frozen mixed berries are the best)
steps: Place all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth and pour into plastic container.
Freeze for several hours or overnight before serving.

recipes.title: Plum Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Rice Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 large bag frozen broccoli, cauliflower and carrot mixture, cooked and drained
1 soup can filled with 1/2 c. milk and 1/2 c. half and half
steps: Mix together, pour into glass baking dish, top with bread crumbs and pats of butter.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Crab Meat-Bacon Rolls
steps: Mix tomato juice and egg.
Add crumbs, seasonings, parsley, celery leaves and crab meat.
Mix and roll into finger lengths. Wrap each roll with 1/2 slice bacon.
Fasten with toothpick. Broil, turning to brown evenly.
Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
steps: Blend together butter and sugar until fluffy.
Add cream cheese and mix lightly.
Add flour and mix well.
Add eggs and vanilla and mix about 1 minute.
Pour into nice size Bundt pan and bake for 1 hour and 5 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Mix thoroughly the shortening, butter, sugars, eggs and vanilla.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
(For a softer, rounder cookie, add 1/2 cup flour.)
Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown.
Cool slightly before removing from baking sheet.
Do not overcook.
Cookies will be done even though they may look undercooked.

recipes.title: Aunty Ann'S Vegetable Chowder
steps: In a five-quart Dutch oven, heat 3 tablespoons of corn oil. Add onion, celery and garlic and saute for five minutes.
Add 1 cup chopped tomatoes and the carrots and cook for five minutes.
Add vegetable broth, can of whole tomatoes (chopped), cabbage, salt and pepper and simmer for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.
Add zucchini and cook 10 minutes.
Add kidney beans and corn and heat.

recipes.title: Macaroons
steps: Mix coconut, sugar, flour and salt in large bowl.
Stir in egg whites and almond extract.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana-Nut Raisin Bread
steps: Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating well.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add bananas, mixing until smooth.
Combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture, stirring just enough to moisten.
Stir in chopped pecans and raisins.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple
steps: Place drained pineapple in greased casserole dish.
Mix remaining ingredients and place over pineapple.
Top with dots of butter and crushed Ritz crackers.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
ingredients: 1 small can fruit cocktail with juice
steps: Beat sugar, oil and eggs together.
Then add flour, salt, soda and fruit cocktail with its juice.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
You can add 1/2 cup coconut, if you like.
Top with Fruit Cocktail Icing.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
steps: Mix all dry
ingredients
in
a
medium size bowl.
Add buttermilk until mixture is
thick and drops off of a spoon in a clump.
Grease
a
6-inch cast-iron skillet and preheat in a 450° oven.
When
skillet
is hot, pour cornbread mixture into skillet. Bake until brown.

recipes.title: Chicken Spectacular
ingredients: 1 hen or fryer, boiled and cut up; take skin off
1 can French style seasoned green beans
10.75 oz. can cream of celery soup
1 small jar of pimientos. cut up
steps: Boil chicken and cut up.
Put rice in 2 1/2 c. plus 2 tablespoons of boiling chicken broth.
Add onion to rice and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir several times while cooking.
Add all ingredients to rice.
Bake for 40 minutes at 350 in a long casserole dish.
Don't cover.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
steps: Drain corn and mix with flour. Add sugar, salt and melted butter.
In a separate bowl, combine milk and egg.
Stir into corn and pour the mixture into greased baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Stir 3 times during baking to keep corn from settling to the bottom.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Corn Muffins
steps: Combine all dry ingredients.
Combine milk, egg and oil.
Add to dry ingredients; stir quickly.
Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full.
Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: 5 Pound Cake
steps: Mix first 2 ingredients together.
Add eggs, one at a time. Then add vanilla and food coloring.
Beat with mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes.
Alternate flour and milk until mixed thoroughly.
Bake in a 350° oven in 3 round 8-inch pans for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 2 bunches broccoli not cooked cut into bite size pieces
steps: Blend all of the above ingredients together.
Mix
one cup of mayonnaise, 1/2 cup of
sugar and 2 Tbsp. of
white vinegar; and pour over broccoli mixture.

recipes.title: Bonnie Butter Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour oblong pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch, or two 9-inch or three 8-inch round layer pans.

recipes.title: Gingerbread Cake
steps: Mix all dry ingredients, cream sugar, shortening, add molasses, blend all together.Pour into greased 13 x 9 inch pan, bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until center springs back. Cool in pan, cut into squares.

recipes.title: Spice Cake
steps: Cream together the shortening and sugar.
Add molasses gradually, beating well.
Add vanilla.
Beat egg yolks and add to first mixture.
Sift together the flour, baking powder, soda, salt and spice.
Add alternately with milk to cream mixture.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Bake in two greased 8-inch layer pans in 375° oven for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Ranch Style beans (black label), drained
1 lb. hamburger meat, browned, seasoned and drained
1 medium onion, chopped fine and cooked with hamburger meat
1 medium block Longhorn style cheese, shredded
steps: Cook spices, onion and hamburger meat together until well browned; drain and add corn, Spanish rice and beans.
Mix well and place in casserole dish with cover.
Heat in a 350° oven just until cheese is
melted thoroughly.
Stir melted cheese into mixture well, then add remaining shredded cheese on top, covering fully.
Heat again until mixture has cheese melted thoroughly on top.
Serve with Mexican-style corn chips.
This can be frozen for future meals.

recipes.title: Hungarian Goulash
steps: Heat oil in large pan.
Add beef cubes, brown them on all sides, stirring every couple of minutes.
Add 1 onion, chopped. Continue browning meat-onion mixture for a minute or so.
Sprinkle flour on mix, stirring constantly, adding water slowly to prevent clumping of flour.
Season with salt, pepper and paprika.
Sauce should be spicy.
Simmer slowly for 1 hour stirring occasionally. Serve over cooked noodles or rice with a salad.
(To ensure tender meat, cover pot during simmering.)

recipes.title: Giant Chocolate Chippers
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Line cookie sheets with foil.
In large bowl, beat sugar, brown sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. Add oil, egg and vanilla.
Beat well.
Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup.
Level off and add flour, baking soda, cream of tartar and salt.
Stir in oats, coconut, cereal and chocolate chips.
Press scant cup of dough into a 6-inch circle on foil-lined cookie sheet.
Repeat with remaining dough, placing cookies at least 2 1/2 inches apart.
Bake at 350° for 18 to 22 minutes, or until light and golden brown.
Cool completely on cookie sheets to prevent breaking.
Makes 8 large cookies, 32 servings.

recipes.title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
steps: Cream margarine
and
Crisco;
add sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.
Add flavoring and beat
well.
Mix
cup
of
flour with nuts. Sift remaining flour
with
baking
powder and add this alternately with milk,
starting
with flour and ending with flour. Fold nuts into
batter.
Do
not
beat.
Bake
in
greased and floured tube pan for 1
hour and 20 minutes or until done in a 325° oven.

recipes.title: Chewy Raisin Walnut Shortbread Bars
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease an 8-inch square pan. Combine flour and sugar.
Using pastry blender or fork, cut in butter until mixture resembles fine meal.
Press into greased pan. Bake for 20 minutes or just until edges are lightly golden. Meanwhile, combine eggs, brown sugar and vanilla; beat well.
Stir in baking soda, walnuts, raisins and coconut.
Spoon over hot crust; spread to cover evenly.
Return to oven; bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes or until top is set.
Cool completely.
Cut into 20 bars.

recipes.title: Fried Corn
ingredients: 8 ears fresh corn, cut and scraped from cob
steps: Mix all ingredients except egg into skillet.
Cook until liquid is nearly all gone.
Stir in beaten egg and stir corn until it is thick.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Beef Roast And Noodles
ingredients: 1 (3 to 3 1/2 lb.) beef chuck pot roast
steps: Trim excess fat from meat; reserve trimmings.
Coat meat with flour.
In a 4 1/2-quart Dutch oven, heat trimmings until about 2 tablespoons of fat accumulate.
Discard trimmings.
Brown meat on both sides in hot fat.
Add bouillon granules and 1 1/4 cups hot water.
Sprinkle with garlic powder.
Add bay leaves.
Place onions atop and around meat.
Cover; bake in 325° oven for 1 1/2 hours. Remove bay leaves; discard.
Stir together catsup, brown sugar and lemon juice.
Pour over meat.
Sprinkle with raisins.
Cover; continue baking 30 to 45 minutes more or until meat is tender. Serve with hot cooked noodles.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Porcupine Meat Balls
steps: Combine meat and other ingredients (except last) in a bowl and make into small balls.
Then after put into pot with tomato sauce poured over them.
Cook slow about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Baked Tortellini With Eggplant And Potato
ingredients: 1/2 lb. (225 g) eggplant, diced into 3/4-inch (2 cm) pieces
1/2 lb. (225 g) tortellini, filled with beef or cheese
1/2 lb. (225 g) potatoes, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch (2 cm) thick slices
1 2/3 c. (415 mL) canned Italian peeled tomatoes
1/2 tsp. (2.5 mL) chopped fresh oregano or 1/4 tsp. (mL) dried
salt and freshly ground black pepper
3 Tbsp. (45 mL) extra chopped fresh oregano or parsley
steps: Preheat oven to 375° (150° C).
Sprinkle eggplant with salt and leave to drain over the sink in a colander or strainer.
Boil tortellini and when cooked, drain and place in a shallow ovenproof dish.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Chiffon Cake
steps: Sift dry ingredients
into bowl.
Separate eggs and egg whites in large
mixing bowl.
In small bowl, blend egg yolks, pumpkin, oil and
water.
Make
well in center of dry ingredients and add liquid
mixture all at once, beat at medium speed for 1 minute. Beat
egg
whites
until
foamy.
Add
cream of tartar and beat until
stiff.
Pour
pumpkin batter gradually over beaten egg whites
and fold in until blended.	Pour into greased tube pan and bake
at
for 55 minutes, 15 to 20 minutes in 350° oven. Cool.
Frost is desired.

recipes.title: Corn Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can black beans, rinsed and drained
1 (11 oz.) can Mexican style corn, drained
steps: Cut thin slice from stem end of each pepper.
Remove seeds and membranes.
Rinse.
Cook peppers in enough boiling water to cover 5 minutes.
Drain.
Season inside peppers with 1 teaspoon salt and pepper.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1 egg or 2 egg yolks, well beaten
steps: Cream butter or margarine.
Beat in 1 cup of sugar, egg and vanilla.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.
Add to butter mixture.
Mix well.
Cover and refrigerate 3 to 4 hours or until dough is firm.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
steps: Mix cinnamon, 1/2 cup sugar and butter.
Add crumbs; save 1/2 cup to sprinkle over top.
Press remainder into a 9-inch spring-form pan, lining the bottom and side.
Beat eggs with remaining 1 cup sugar. Add salt, lemon juice, cheese and flour. Beat thoroughly.
Pour into pan. Add nuts and crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Jack'S Good Tastin' Pinto Beans And Ground Meat
ingredients: 2 c. pinto beans, picked, washed and soaked overnight
steps: Drain water from beans that soaked overnight.
In a large saucepan, combine water, salt pork, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Add beans, tomatoes, onions, bell peppers, garlic and celery.
Cook on medium heat, adding water as needed, until beans are tender or until placing a cooked bean in a spoon and checking tenderness by smashing in the spoon.
Beans are done when they smash with little pressure.
Measure a cup of the liquid from the pot. Add flour to the liquid and mix well.
Return this mixture to the pot and cook an additional 10 to 20 minutes.
This method will bring all the flavors together.
If desired, brown ground meat in skillet and add to beans.
Wow How Good.

recipes.title: Easy Fruit Cobbler
ingredients: 2 c. fruit, sweetened with sugar to taste
steps: Melt butter in 8-inch square pan.
Mix sugar, flour and milk by hand.
Pour batter over melted butter.
Pour fruit into middle of batter in pan.
Bake at 350° until brown on top.
Serve warm with ice cream.
Double this amount to make 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
steps: Saute onion, mushrooms and celery in 1/2 stick butter until onion and celery are done.
Put all ingredients in covered casserole and bake for about 1 hour at 400°.

recipes.title: Christmas Rainbow Cake
ingredients: 1 (2 layer size) pkg. white cake mix
steps: Prepare cake mix as directed on package, baking in 2 well-greased and floured 9-inch layer pans at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool in pans 15 minutes.
Poke with fork at 1/2-inch intervals.
Do not remove from pans.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Beat and bake 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Yeast Rolls
steps: You will need 1 large pan or pot (about 5 or 6-quart size).

recipes.title: Chicken Tarragon En Croutte
steps: Combine butter, lemon juice and spices in a small bowl; set aside.
Separate dough into 2 rectangles; press with fingers to seal seams.
Form 6 x 4-inch rectangles.

recipes.title: Francese Sauce
steps: Put white wine in saucepan.
Squeeze lemon and reduce volume to half its original size.
Swirl in 1/2 pound softened butter to make an emulsion.
If it separates, remove from heat and stir to re-emulsify, or add cold chicken stock.
If too loose, roll small pieces of butter in flour and stir until sauce is desired thickness.
Use as a sauce on chicken or fish.
Top with parsley and sliced blanched mushrooms.

recipes.title: Rice And Broccoli Casserole
steps: Boil broccoli; cook rice and put in casserole.
Saute onions in oleo and pour on rice; put Cheez Whiz on top.
Pour cream of mushroom soup on top and bake in medium oven, 350°.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie Squares
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch pan.
Mix flour, sugar, margarine and salt together.
Mixture will be dry and crumbly.
Press firmly into pan.
Bake for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Sunday Best Pancakes
steps: Combine and beat until smooth.
Bake 1/4 cup batter for each pancake in a nonstick skillet.
Serves 3.

recipes.title: Pescado En Salsa Verde(Fish In Green Sauce)
ingredients: 2 lb. haddock, cod or pollock, cut in 1/2-inch thick steaks
steps: Sprinkle fish with salt, then dip the steaks in 1/2 cup of flour; shake to remove the excess.
In a heavy skillet, heat the olive oil.
Add the fish and cook for about 4 minutes on each side. Transfer oil to a heavy skillet.
Cover fish steaks in the pan to keep them warm while you prepare the sauce.
Heat the oil again and add the onion.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until soft and transparent, but not brown.
Stir 2 tablespoons of flour; mix thoroughly and pour in the water and wine.
Cook over high heat, stirring constantly, until sauce comes to a boil and thickens lightly.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Harvest Corn
steps: Mix ingredients.
Top with grated Cheddar cheese; sprinkle cheese with paprika (for color).
Bake at 375° until golden brown, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Topping For Fish
ingredients: 1/4 c. each: chopped onion, pepper and celery
steps: Combine 2 tablespoons oil and flour with whisk in small skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until light brown.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Apple-Nut Cake
ingredients: 3 c. chopped, peeled and cored apples
steps: Measure all but last 2 ingredients into large bowl.
Mix on low speed of mixer, scraping sides of bowl.
Fold in apples and chopped nuts.
Spread batter in greased, floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 60 to 65 minutes or until toothpick in center comes out clean in a 350° oven.
Cool 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1 can chicken broth or beef broth or ham base
steps: Saute rice and vermicelli until golden brown.
Add chicken broth and bring to full boil.
Reduce to simmer and add other ingredients and spices.
Stir well and cover on low for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Slice apples into a greased 9 x 9-inch pan.
Mix flour, sugar and baking powder.
Stir egg into dry
mixture, until it forms beads.
Pour over apples.
Melt margarine with cinnamon and pour over top.
Bake at 350° about 1/2 hour or until brown on top.
My grandkid's favorite.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. flour, mixed with a little milk to thicken
steps: Mix potatoes, eggs,
relish,
onion
and celery seed in large bowl.
Boil vinegar, sugar, water, margarine and mustard in a small pan.
Add flour and milk mixture.
Stir continuously until mixture boils
again.
Remove from heat and pour over potato mixture; stir well.

recipes.title: Peewee Cookies
steps: Mix well the first 5 ingredients, then add the remaining ingredients.
Drop small spoonfuls of dough on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Pizza Meat Loaf
steps: Mix everything together, except for cheese.
Put 1/3 of meat mixture in bottom of pan (pan that you normally use for a meat loaf).
Spread half of the cheese over it.
Add 1/3 more of meat mixture, rest of cheese and remaining 1/3 of meat mixture.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour (cover, if you wish).
For an interesting top, spread some catsup, more grated cheese, and some small pieces of bacon over the top during the last 20 minutes of cooking, uncovered.

recipes.title: Indian Bread(Ideal When Camping Out.)
steps: Mix dry ingredients together.
Add water to make a workable, sticky dough.
Pull off just enough to make about 1/2 handful. Stretch and pull, then drop into hot grease and fry until golden brown (about 3 minutes).
Repeat until dough is used up.
Drain well.

recipes.title: Ladyfingers
steps: Combine in bowl, margarine, vanilla, salt, sugar and flour. Mix well.
Add pecans and mix again.
Form into small finger shapes or crescent shapes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
steps: In large mixing bowl, combine oil, margarine, water, egg and vanilla.
Beat at medium speed of mixer until well blended.
Add sugar, oats, flour, coconut, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.
Beat at low speed until soft dough forms; stir in raisins and nuts. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls, 2-inches apart, on lightly greased cookie sheets.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Mom'S Angel Biscuits
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Sift dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening.
Add yeast mixture and buttermilk. Knead a few times in a little flour.
Put in refrigerator.
Take out about 20 minutes before baking for best results.
Bake at 450° for approximately 10 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
steps: Preheat oven
to 400°.	Combine first five ingredients; set aside.
Mix bran with milk until moistened; let stand five minutes.
Add egg
and
oil,
beat	until
blended;
add flour mixture, stirring,	do
not
overmix.
Fill greased 2 1/2-inch muffin pan cups 2/3 full.
Bake about 20 minutes.
Makes 12 to 14 muffins.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
steps: Boil water and add oatmeal.
Cream together the rest of the ingredients.
Add cooked oatmeal to this mixture.
Bake at 350° in a greased and floured pan.

recipes.title: Brownies
ingredients: 1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp. butter or margarine
steps: Mix sugar and butter together until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Sift dry ingredients together. Stir in nuts. Bake in greased 8 x 8-inch pan at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool in pan. Cut into squares or bars. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired. Makes 16 squares.

recipes.title: Aunt Ethel'S Old Fashioned Chicken And Dumplings
steps: Stir flour, eggs and oil together.
Then add a little ice water at a time, until mixture forms a ball.
Sprinkle ball with flour for easy handling and divide into 3 balls.
Roll each ball out on well-floured board, real thin.
Cut into 2-inch squares and drop in simmering broth where chicken was cooked.
Should have at least 2 quarts of broth.
Repeat with each ball, rolling thin, cutting into squares and dropping in broth.
Stir well and simmer about 10 minutes.
Add cut-up chicken.
If broth seems too thin, thicken with a little flour dissolved in water.

recipes.title: Broccoli Souffle
ingredients: 2 c. broccoli, cooked and finely chopped
steps: Separate eggs.
Beat egg yolks.
In saucepan, melt butter over low heat; stir in flour.
Add milk. Cook over moderate heat.
Stir constantly until thickened and bubbly.
Remove from heat. Stirring vigorously, gradually add beaten egg yolks.
Mix in salt, pepper and broccoli.
Beat egg whites until peaked.
Fold in broccoli mixture.
Turn into ungreased 2-quart souffle dish. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Dinner Rolls
steps: Combine milk, shortening, sugar and salt.
Cool to lukewarm by adding water.
Add yeast, mix well.
Blend in eggs.
Add flour and mix until dough is well blended.
Place in greased bowl and cover. Store in refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Shape dough on well floured board.
Let rise in warm place (80 to 85°) until light, about 1 1/2 hours.
Bake in hot oven (400°) about 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Friccadilla(Danish Meat Patties)
steps: Mix above ingredients thoroughly and whip until fluffy.
Let stand several hours or overnight. Form balls. Fry in deep layer of real lard.

recipes.title: Dishpan Cookies
steps: Beat the first 5 ingredients until very smooth.
Add the remaining ingredients; mix thoroughly.
Roll in balls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten slightly with glass.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or celery soup
steps: Boil chicken until tender; debone.
Arrange meat in bottom of greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch greased baking pan.
Save 2 cups broth. Mix broth with soup; bring to boil.
Pour over chicken.
Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.
Serves 3 to 4.

recipes.title: Crab Casserole
steps: In
double boiler, melt butter.
Stir in flour, nutmeg, paprika, salt, sherry, cream and herbs.
Add crabmeat and stir until
thickened.
Add mushrooms.
Divide into individual oven plates
Sprinkle
grated
cheese over each.
Place under broiler
until
cheese
melts and mixture bubbles.	Serve over rice or Chinese noodles.

recipes.title: 60 Minute Southern Rolls
steps: Set aside 1 cup flour.
In bowl mix remaining flour, sugar, salt, soda and yeast.
Heat buttermilk, water and margarine to 125° to 130°.
Stir into dry ingredient mixture.
Mix in enough reserved flour to make soft dough.
Knead 3 minutes.
Press evenly in greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Dust top with flour.
With sharp knife, score dough into 16 rolls; cover.
Let rise 20 minutes, then bake 20 to 25 minutes in a 350° oven.
Remove from oven and break into rolls.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Mom'S Rivel Soup
steps: Mix with fork to make very small rivels (pea size).
Chop a small onion into meat broth.
Cook rivels 20 minutes in broth or until done.

recipes.title: Popcorn Balls
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in a pan.
Cook over medium heat until a little of the mixture forms a ball when dropped in cold water (265°) on candy thermometer.
Remove from heat.
Stir in soda, butter and vanilla.
Pour over popcorn.
Mix well.
Wet hands and shape mixture into balls.
Makes about 1 1/2 dozen 3-inch balls.

recipes.title: Quick Dessert
ingredients: fresh or frozen fruit or canned (without sugar)
steps: Slice cake to fit into 13 x 9-inch cake pan.
Mix pudding according to directions on package.
Spoon over cake.
Add your choice of fruit.
Cover with Cool Whip.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
steps: Combine pineapple and gelatin.
Cook until dissolved.
Cool. Add nuts and buttermilk.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Chill 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Pizza Type Fruit Tart
steps: Heat oven to 300°.
Beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Blend in flour.
Press mixture onto bottom and sides of 12-inch pizza pan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool completely.

recipes.title: Crispy Cut-Outs
steps: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat.
Add marshmallows; stir until completely melted.
Remove from heat.
Add Rice Krispies.
(May add mini chocolate chips, M&M's, caramel, ice cream topping, etc.)
Press mixture into a pan coated with cooking spray.
Layer about 1/2-inch thick.
When cool, cut into your favorite shapes with cookie cutter; decorate if you like.

recipes.title: Cheerios Nuggets
steps: Heat oven to 250° and grease 2 cookie sheets.
Mix cereal and peanuts.
Heat brown sugar, margarine, corn syrup and salt in pan until bubbly around edges.
Stir 2 minutes longer.
Remove from heat and stir in soda.
Pour over cereal and spread in pans.
Bake 15 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes.
Loosen mixture.
Let stand until firm, then break into bite size pieces.

recipes.title: The Chewy Brownie Cookie
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
2 c. semi-sweet chocolate chips (12 oz. pkg.)
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Combine Crisco, light brown sugar, water and vanilla in a large mixing bowl.
Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Beat eggs.
Add sugar and oil.
Beat together well. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into 2 greased loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Cream margarine and peanut butter; beat until light and fluffy.
Add sugar substitutes and egg and beat well.
Add dry ingredients and mix into creamed mixture and mix well.
Drop by teaspoons onto lightly greased cookie sheet, flatten with tines of fork dipped in flour.
Bake in preheated oven at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Yield: 20 cookies. Carbohydrate 2.7 g, protein 1.3 g, fat 3.0 g, calories 41.
One cookie = 1/4 bread exchange, 1/2 fat lean meat exchange.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake No. 2
ingredients: 3 c. apples (5 small or 3 large), peeled and chopped
1 c. nuts (more or less as desired)
steps: Mix all ingredients, adding apples and nuts last.
Mixture will be thick.
Pour into Bundt pan.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Powdered sugar glaze is optional.

recipes.title: Best-Ever Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 (3 to 4 lb.) chicken, cooked and cut up
3 qt. chicken broth (can use 6 cans chicken broth)
homemade noodles or similar kind, break into tiny pieces
steps: While chicken is cooking, cut up fresh vegetables into small pieces.
If using broth from Swanson's canned broth, then you can place veggies and spices in immediately.
Be sure to have chicken in very small pieces, also.
Put noodles in and simmer for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Brownie Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. sour milk (make sour by adding 1 tsp. vinegar to milk)
steps: Sift together sugar and flour.
Bring to a boil the oleo, cocoa and water.
Add milk, soda and vanilla.
Add to flour mixture.
Add eggs and beat.
Bake in greased and floured jelly roll pan (16 x 11 x 1 1/2-inch) at 400° for 20 minutes.
While still hot, spread on icing.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada
ingredients: 1/4 c. chopped onion, sauteed in 2 Tbsp. margarine
steps: Mix chicken, cream cheese, milk and onion.
Place 1/3 cup in each flour tortilla and roll.
Place seam side down in greased baking dish.
Mix together sour cream, soup and drained chilies and pour over enchiladas.
Cover with foil.
Bake 35 minutes at 350°.
Top with Cheddar and Monterey cheese.
Bake, uncovered, until melted.

recipes.title: Copper Pennies (Carrots)
steps: Heat vinegar, sugar and oil.
Cook carrots in salted water 8 to 10 minutes.
Combine with onions and pepper.
Stir remaining ingredients into bowl over carrots.
Marinate overnight.
Drain as needed.
Will keep several weeks.

recipes.title: Fruit Squares
steps: Cream margarine, sugar and add vanilla.
Add eggs.
Stir in flour and add nuts.
Mix well.
Spread 3/4 of batter in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Cover with pie filling and add rest of batter. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake #1
steps: Mix flour, sugar, soda, cinnamon and salt.
Add carrots, oil, eggs and vanilla.
Mix well.
Add pineapple, coconut and walnuts. Makes 9 inch square pan (for 9 x 13, double recipe).
Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.
Cool.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
steps: Mix sugar, flour and salt together in a saucepan.
Slowly add milk, stirring until smooth.
Heat to a full boil over medium high heat.
Reduce heat to low and continue.
Beat egg yolks in bowl. Add a little of the mixture to the yolks; stir.
Add yolks to milk mixture gradually.
Continue to cook for 5 minutes more.
Remove from heat and add vanilla.

recipes.title: Baked Beans And Pineapple
steps: Saute onions in oil.
Mix ingredients according to order given; bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Covered Cherry Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 350° (moderate).
Mix butter, sugar, vanilla and chocolate thoroughly.
Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting.
Blend in flour and salt.
If dry, add 1 to 2 tablespoons cream.
Wrap level tablespoonful of dough around well drained maraschino cherry.
Place 1-inch apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Coconut Chess Pies(2 Pies)
steps: Beat eggs.
Add other ingredients.
Pour into pie shells. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes and at 375° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Caramel Brownies
steps: Mix dry ingredients and stir into beaten eggs, melted butter and vanilla. Bake for 30 minutes at 350° in greased 8 x 8 pan. Cool; cut into small squares and roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Lefsa
steps: Boil water and margarine.
Add everything else.
Spread in a cake pan; cool.
Take 1/3 of the mixture and mix with 1 1/4 cups of flour.
Form into a log.
Cut into 16 pieces; roll out thin. Cook on a hot griddle until lightly brown on both sides.
Store in a damp towel.
Refrigerate or freeze.

recipes.title: Mixed Greens
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen collard greens, chopped
1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen turnip greens, chopped
1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen mustard greens, chopped
2 slices bacon, cut in small pieces
2 chicken bouillon cubes, dissolved in 1 1/2 c. hot water
steps: Saute bacon and onion in pot.
Add dissolved bouillon cube, liquid, pepper flakes, salt and pepper.
Let simmer for 10 minutes.
Add greens.
Cook until greens are tender on low heat, from 1/2 hour to 3/4 hour (30 minutes to 45 minutes).

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
steps: Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder, soda, salt and cinnamon; set aside.
Beat together oleo, eggs and sugar until blended. (Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each.)
Stir in vanilla and zucchini.
Add dry ingredients alternately with milk, including nuts, with last addition.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube or Bundt pan or 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake about 1 hour at 350°.
Glaze with confectioners icing.

recipes.title: Depression Casserole
steps: In a saucepan, saute onion in oil until tender.
Stir in ketchup, water, vinegar, mustard and pepper.
Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.
Place franks in a 1-quart baking dish. Pour sauce over.
Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 30 minutes.
Serve over toast points or rice.
Yields 5 servings.

recipes.title: Rum Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour Bundt pan.
In bottom of pan, sprinkle 1/2 cup of chopped pecans.
Mix ingredients together and pour into Bundt pan.
Bake 1 hour.
Remove from oven and while still hot, pour rum glaze over it.
Leave cake in pan for at least 30 minutes to allow glaze to soak in.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pizza
steps: Add together 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 cup oatmeal, 2 teaspoons baking soda and 1/2 teaspoon salt.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Biscuits
steps: Combine and mix well flour, cream of tartar, baking powder and salt.
Combine oil and milk.
Stir into the flour mixture until it forms a ball and pulls away from the sides of the bowl.
Form into biscuits and place on baking sheet.
Bake at 425° for about 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
ingredients: 5 large apples, peeled and sliced as for pie
steps: Cream sugar and eggs.
Add oil and sifted dry ingredients. Blend in sliced apples and raisins.
Pour into greased and floured 10 x 15-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for approximately 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Grated Corn Bread
steps: Cut corn from cob and scrape cob or grate corn.
Mix flour, salt and baking powder.
Add grated corn and bacon drippings.
Add enough milk to make a good batter.
Mix well and pour into a greased iron skillet (hot).
Bake at 425° until golden brown. Good with cow butter.

recipes.title: Diabetic Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream the butter.
Add beaten eggs, sweetener and milk.
Sift and mix dry ingredients and add to first mixture.
Beat in vanilla, raisins and oats.
Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pheasant
ingredients: 1 bird, cut into pieces (as for frying chicken)
steps: Flour bird lightly.
Salt and pepper.
Slice 1/2 stick butter. Cover with thin layer of onions.
Arrange pheasant on onions, then cover pheasant with a thin layer of onions and remaining butter.
Add 1/2 cup water.
Bake at 250° for 4 hours.
Recipe may be used for quail or other small birds.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cornish Hens With Duck Sauce
steps: Bake hens at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Baby Food Spice Pound Cake
ingredients: 2 tsp. each salt, soda, ground cloves and cinnamon
2 cans strained baby fruit (plums and prunes)
steps: Mix together the flour, nuts, sugar, salt, soda, ground cloves and cinnamon. Stir in the oil, eggs and baby fruit.
Do not beat. Bake in greased Bundt pan at 325° for about 1 hour.
Let cool in pan 10 minutes. Invert on plate.

recipes.title: No-Peek Stew
ingredients: 2 lb. stew meat (pork, beef or lamb)
2 beef bouillon cubes or 2 tsp. granules
steps: Place all ingredients in a Dutch oven and cover. Bake at 250° for 5 hours or use a crock-pot. Do not peek! Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Tacorino Dip
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese (you may use the light for less calories and less fat)
shredded Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese (optional)
steps: Blend all ingredients by hand.
Chill and serve with snack crackers, tortilla chips or Fritos.

recipes.title: Black Walnut Cake
steps: Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add egg yolks one at a time, beating thoroughly after each addition.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Add alternately with milk and vanilla, beating after each addition.
Fold in nuts, then stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan or Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes or until done.
Remove from pan to wire rack and drizzle glaze over hot cake.

recipes.title: Pickled Peppers
ingredients: 4 qt. long red, green or yellow peppers
steps: Wash and drain peppers.
Cut 2 small slits in each pepper. Dissolve salt in 1 gallon water.
Pour over peppers and let stand 12 to 18 hours in a cool place.
Drain; rinse again and drain thoroughly.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Simmer 15 minutes. Remove garlic.
Pack peppers into jars, leaving 1/2-inch headspace.
Bring liquid to a boil.
Fill jar to within 1/2-inch of top with boiling liquid.
Remove air bubbles.
Adjust lids. Process 10 minutes in a boiling water bath.
Yields 8 pints.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cookies
steps: Mix together shortening and sugar until creamy.
Add egg, pumpkin and vanilla and blend.
Combine all dry ingredients and blend into batter a little at a time.
Add raisins or nuts.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Colossal Cookies
steps: In large
bowl	beat together butter and sugars.
Blend in eggs and
vanilla.	Add
peanut butter.
Mix well.	Stir in oats, soda
and chocolate chips.	Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet.
Flatten
with
fork.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes a bunch.

recipes.title: Colombian Salad
steps: Mix olive oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper and coriander.
Pour over lettuce, onions, olives and garbanzo beans.
Chill covered 45 minutes.
Place cream cheese in freezer for 30 minutes to help firm it up.
Cut into cubes and refrigerate immediately.
At very last minute, mix into lettuce.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Jam Cake
steps: Mix flour with cocoa powder and spices. Set aside. Beat eggs. Add sugar. Beat in butter, jam, nuts, raisins, apple butter, buttermilk and crushed pineapple. Beat in dry ingredients. Divide batter between three prepared cake pans. Bake at 325° for 25 minutes. Frost with Caramel Frosting.

recipes.title: Herb Chicken Fry
ingredients: Hunt's country herb ready tomato sauce
steps: In skillet with oil, cook chicken breasts with onion.
When chicken is cooked through, add tomato sauce, mushrooms and parsley flakes.
Simmer 5 to 10 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Crab Meat Casserole
steps: Make a cream sauce with butter, flour and cream.
Add salt, pepper and sherry.
Remove from heat and add crab meat.
Pour the mixture into buttered casserole or individual baking dishes. Sprinkle with grated cheese and cook in hot oven until cheese melts.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: "Delightfully Quick Stir-Fry"
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) lobster or crab Louis Kemp Delights
steps: Heat a little olive oil in your wok or pan.
Put the lobster Delights in the hot oil and cook until they are hot (about 2 to 3 minutes).
Add the pasta ready and stir until the sauce is hot. Spoon over cooked rice (or pasta).
If you wish to include other vegetables, cook them 5 to 7 minutes in the oil, then add the Lobster Delights.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. cooked broccoli or 1 c. frozen peas
steps: Cook and drain pasta as per package.

recipes.title: Stuffed Onion Leaves
ingredients: 1/2 c. long grain rice, soaked 1/2 hour in water
steps: Broil onions 20 minutes.
Cut off tops.
Slice down center side; cut off bottom.
Separate the onion circles (leaves).
Mix together beef and next 5 ingredients.
Add tomatoes (helps cook the rice).
Hold the onion circles (leaves) open and add small ball of meat mixture; roll onion around the meat.
Put in frying pan with olive oil; brown bottom 15 minutes.
Add beef broth. Simmer 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Swedish Meat Balls
steps: Combine egg, milk and bread crumbs and let stand for a few minutes.
Saute the onions until brown.
Combine all the other ingredients except the flour.
Shape into balls, then sprinkle with the flour.
Brown in frypan, then cover and cook for 35 minutes. Serve with a gravy.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Bring
milk
with salt to a boil; add rice.
Be careful not to scorch.
Cook slowly about 40 minutes or until rice is done. Beat
eggs,
sugar and vanilla together.
Bring milk to boil again.
Remove from heat and add egg mixture.
Pour into bowl and cool.

recipes.title: Sourdough Bread
steps: Dissolve the yeast in 1/2 cup of warm water.
Add remaining water, sugar and potato flakes.
Leave the mixture out of refrigerator all day and refrigerate that night.
After 3 days, take out and feed again and begin making bread as usual.
Put starter in refrigerator 3 to 5 days.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts Baked In Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 10 oz. (1 can) soup, cream of mushroom
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.

recipes.title: Calico Beans
ingredients: 8 oz. ground beef, browned and drained
1 (16 oz.) can lima beans or 1 (15 1/2 oz.) can butter beans, drained
1 (15 oz.) can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Brown and drain ground beef. Fry bacon and crumble. Mix together with other ingredients. Bake for 35 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Texas Hash
steps: Heat the oven to 350°.
In a large skillet, cook and stir ground beef, onion and green pepper until meat is brown and vegetables are tender.
Drain off fat.
Stir in tomatoes, rice, chili powder, salt and pepper; heat thoroughly.
Pour into an ungreased 2-quart casserole.
Cover and bake 1 hour.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cranberry Bread
steps: Mix dry ingredients, cut in shortening.
Combine juice, rind and egg.
Pour, all at once, into dry ingredients, mixing just enough to dampen.
Fold in nuts and cranberries.
Pour into greased and floured bread pan (9 x 5 x 3-inches).
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Cabbage And Noodles
steps: Saute chopped onion in bacon drippings until golden brown. Shred cabbage and add to mixture.
Cook until tender.
Cook noodles then blanche and drain.
Combine with cabbage.
Add desired amount of cottage cheese and serve.

recipes.title: Banana Bars
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Cream sugars and oleo.
Add eggs and sour cream; mix.
Add bananas and vanilla, then dry ingredients and mix well.
Spread dough in greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.
Cool; spread with creamy frosting.
Cut into bars.
Makes 48 bars.

recipes.title: Zucchini Muffins
steps: Beat eggs until foamy.
Add oil, sugar and vanilla.
Stir in zucchini.
Mix in dry ingredients.
Pour into greased and floured cupcake tin.
Bake at 325° for 1/2 hour.
Makes 1 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
steps: Melt margarine in 9
x
13-inch
pan or Dutch oven pan. Sprinkle rice in the
pan.
Place
fryer
on top of rice.
Mix soup, water and soup
mix.
Pour over chicken.
Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°.
Remove cover and allow chicken to brown.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Cookie Sticks
steps: Mix butter and sugar together.
Add eggs and mix again.
Add flour, salt and baking powder and mix again.
Stir in vanilla and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes in oblong cake pan.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Megan'S Delicious Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream margarine, peanut butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla together.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for about 10 minutes.
Enjoy.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
steps: Mix sugar with flour.
Add eggs.
Beat well.
Add melted butter, buttermilk and vanilla.
Pour into 2 pie shells.
Sprinkle with nutmeg, if desired.
Bake at 400° until firm and crust is brown.
Bake on lower oven rack.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Cook rice until done, about 20 minutes.
Stir in milk and eggs. Put back on stove and cook until it coats a spoon.
Add nutmeg and raisins as desired.
Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hash Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together except the marshmallows and pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Bake at 350°.
Cake is done when toothpick comes out clean. Place marshmallows on hot cake and place into hot oven to melt.
Let cool, then cover with icing.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
steps: Allow cheese and butter to soften.
Mix with the rest of the ingredients, roll out and cut into French fries size strips.
Bake on cookie sheet at 350° for 6 to 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Perfect Apple Pie
ingredients: 6 to 8 tart apples, pared, cored and thinly sliced *
steps: If apples lack tartness, sprinkle with about 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
Combine sugar, flour, spices and dash of salt; mix with apples.
Line 9-inch pie plate with pastry.
Fill with apple mixture; dot with butter.
Adjust top crust, cutting slits for escape of steam; seal.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 400° for 50 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Steak(Hobo Steak)
steps: Mix together hamburger, cracker crumbs, water, salt and pepper.
Spread out on cookie sheet to about 1/2-inch thick; refrigerate.
When set, cut into squares.
Roll in flour and brown.
Pour on top the mushroom soup thinned with 3 or 4 tablespoons water.
Bake in a 250° oven for 1 or 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Cherry Bars
steps: Mix butter, 1 cup flour and 3 tablespoons brown sugar with pastry cutter and spread in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 12 minutes at 350°.
Beat eggs.
Add remaining ingredients.
Spread on crust. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Smoked Fish
steps: Cut fish in length 4 x 6 x 1-inch.
Soak in brine 5 hours. Lay on paper towel to dry.
Put honey on before smoking.

recipes.title: Stuffed Green Peppers
steps: Remove tops and seeds from peppers.
In a large kettle, bring water to a boil; cook peppers for 4 minutes.
Remove and drain. Cook rice according to package directions.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Mix all ingredients together well.
Place in heavy plastic bowl.
Slam against counter a couple of times to remove air. Shape into loaf.
Place in baking dish or waterless cookware for top of the stove.
Bake in oven for 1 hour or until center is cooked.
Cook in waterless cookware on top of stove for 30 minutes in 1 tablespoon of butter.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Raspberry Bar Cookies
ingredients: 3/4 c. fruit only seedless raspberry jam
steps: Heat the oven to 350°.
Butter an 8-inch square pan.
Line it with aluminum foil and then butter the foil.
Mix all the ingredients together, except the jam.
Press 2 cups of the mixture into the bottom of the prepared pan.
Spread the jam to within 1/4-inch of the edge.
Sprinkle the remaining crumb mixture over the top and lightly press it into the jam.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes and allow to cool on a wire rack before cutting.
Makes 24 (2 x 1 1/2-inch) bars.

recipes.title: Crustless Egg Custard
steps: Cream eggs and sugar together.
Add remaining ingredients; beat well.
Pour into a lightly greased 10-inch pan.
Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes, or until done.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Cold Cornbread Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. cornbread mix, prepared as directed
steps: Crumble cornbread; salt and pepper to taste.
Add onions, green pepper, celery and bacon.
Stir in tomatoes just before serving, then add salad dressing.

recipes.title: Finger Paint
steps: Mix flour and water, then add detergent.
Then add food coloring (your choice of color).
Mix well and you're ready for finger painting.

recipes.title: Pistachio Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients in large bowl for 1 minute at low speed, then beat at high speed for 3 minutes.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Bake in 350° oven for 45 to 55 minutes or until done.
Cool in pan about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Nana'S Tea Cakes
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, cream sugar and Crisco until smooth.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Gradually add flour and knead as you would biscuit dough until stiff enough to roll.
On a lightly floured surface, roll dough out into desired thickness. Cut out with cookie cutter or biscuit cutter.
Bake on greased sheet about 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Scallop Pilaf
ingredients: 1 c. uncooked long grain white rice
1 (13 3/4 oz.) can chicken broth plus enough water to measure 2 1/2 c.
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, partially thawed
steps: In large skillet, melt butter over medium heat; stir in turmeric.
Add rice, onion and garlic.
Cook about 3 minutes until onion is translucent, stirring often.
Pour in broth mixture; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Add scallops, shrimp and peas.
Simmer covered 5 minutes longer or until scallops are opaque, shrimp turn pink and peas are Taste and season.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Goofy Cake
steps: Sift dry ingredients directly into ungreased cake pan (8-inch square).
Make 3 holes in dry mixture.
Pour oil into one hole. Pour vanilla into second hole.
Pour vinegar in third hole.
Pour cold water over all.
Stir with fork until evenly blended.
Bake at 350° for 35-40 min.
Invert to cool.
Frost.

recipes.title: Steak In Beer Sauce
steps: Pound steak.
Cut in thin slices.
Blend cornstarch and spices. Coat the meat slices and brown well in hot oil.
Add onion and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the beer, pepper sauce and sugar. Bring to boil and simmer on low heat, covered 15 minutes.
Add carrots and simmer until meat and carrots are tender.
Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Banana-Cherry Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix well, the sugar, butter and eggs until light and fluffy.
Add bananas and beat so that batter is well mixed.
Add flour, baking soda, salt and cherries.
Mix and blend.
Pour into lightly greased muffin tins.
Bake about 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Easy Baked Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 medium green pepper, cut into 6 rings
steps: *One-fourth
teaspoon
each oregano, marjoram and basil leaves and 1/8 teaspoon rubbed sage.

recipes.title: Gingerbread
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients together, then stir in the remaining. Bake in a greased and floured cake pan at 350° for approximately 35 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake
steps: Sift flour.
Blend eggs and sugar; add pumpkin and oil.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Break eggs into a large deep bowl and beat well.
Add the sugar and beat.
Add oil and beat until blended.
Stir in the zucchini and walnuts.

recipes.title: Chunky Chicken Chili
ingredients: 2 c. bite size cooked chicken breasts
2 c. bite size cooked chicken thigh
1 (16 oz.) can Great Northern beans, drained
1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp. plain nonfat yogurt (optional)
steps: Coat Dutch oven with cooking spray; place over medium heat until hot.
Add onion, green pepper, jalapeno peppers and saute 5 minutes.

Add chili powder, cumin and oregano; cook 2 minutes. Add chicken, 1 cup water, red pepper, black pepper, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, stewed tomatoes, chicken broth, and chili sauce and bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Add beans and cook 5 minutes.
Ladle chili into soup bowls; top each with avocado, onion and yogurt.
Yield 9 cups.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cake
steps: Cream sugar and butter well. Add eggs, one at a time. Alternately add flour, sour cream and soda. Add vanilla.
Put in a Bundt cake pan and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Muffins
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. peeled and chopped, tart, green apples
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, mix together oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla; beat with a whisk until creamy smooth. In a separate bowl, combine flours, baking powder and salt.
Add to egg mixture, beating just until well blended.
Fold in apples and nuts.
Fill greased muffin tins about 3/4 full.
Bake about 25 minutes or until inserted toothpick comes out clean.
Turn out on wire rack and cool slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Peach Delight
steps: Mix in 9 x 13 pan and press out crust.
Bake at 350° for 10-15 minutes.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Cream butter, sugar added, mashed bananas, then flour, salt, soda and half pecans.
Bake 1 hour at 300° in ungreased pan.

recipes.title: Yellow Rice
steps: Stir rice and margarine into boiling water in a saucepan.
Add cinnamon stick, turmeric, salt and bay leaf.
Bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer.
Simmer, covered, 20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Discard cinnamon stick and bay leaf.
Stir in raisins.

recipes.title: Sugarless Banana Walnut Cake
steps: In mixing bowl, beat bananas and butter until creamy.
Add eggs and beat well.
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and cinnamon.
Add to banana mixture alternately with water, beating well after each addition.
Stir in nuts.
Spoon into a greased 9-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cake tests done.
Cool.
Makes 9 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Sea Scallops
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Crush crackers to fine crumbs.
In 2 qt bowl, mix together crumbs, parsley flakes, oregano, garlic powder, and red pepper, stir in butter.
Add scallops and cheese, mix well. Turn into individual baking dishes that have been sprayed with non-stick coating, or well buttered.
Sprinkle with paprika. Bake 15 minutes.
Serve with brown rice. Serve 4 - 6 people.

recipes.title: Sausage Pie
ingredients: 16 small fresh link pork sausages (approximately 1 lb.)
4 to 5 medium tomatoes, peeled and chopped
steps: Place sausages on a rack in a baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Cut into 1-inch pieces.
Set aside.
In a skillet, saute peppers in oil for 3 minutes. Place in 3-quart casserole.
Add the sausages and the next 8 ingredients. Combine bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle on top of casserole. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until heated through.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Corn Fritters
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Fry in skillet (make about pancake size).
Serve with syrup.

recipes.title: Frozen Pie Crust
steps: Mix together the first four ingredients with fork or pastry blender until thoroughly mixed.
In a small bowl, beat remaining ingredients.
Combine the two mixtures, stirring with a fork until all is moist.
With your hands, mold into balls.
Chill at least 15 minutes before using.
Dough can be kept in refrigerator for up to 3 days or wrapped tightly in Saran Wrap and frozen until ready to use.
Makes four crusts.

recipes.title: Jelly Roll(Kaaretorttu)
ingredients: 1 c. cream, whipped or may use Cool Whip
steps: Beat eggs until light; add sugar and beat until thick.
Add the vanilla.
Sift flour with baking powder and salt and fold carefully into the egg mixture until well combined.
Line a jelly roll pan with waxed paper.
Butter it very well and sprinkle it generously with granulated sugar.
Spread the batter evenly in the pan and bake in a moderate 350° oven for 20 minutes or until the cake is just set.
Turn out onto a clean tea towel that has been well dusted with confectioners sugar and roll up while still hot. Cool slightly, then unroll and remove from the towel.
When it has cooled, spread the inside of the roll with the jam and whipped cream.
Reroll.
May use fresh strawberries and Cool Whip inside, but make sure jelly roll is cool.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
steps: Add enough water to syrup to make 2 cups and then 2 more cups water.
Put flour, Crisco and salt in large bowl.
Cut together until mixed good.
Add liquids and make into large ball of dough. Makes about 24 single or 12 double pie crusts.

recipes.title: Cherry Bread
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and beat until light.
Add juices alternately with dry ingredients.
Stir in nuts and cherries.
Put in 2 greased loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamed Onions(Makes 8 Servings)
ingredients: 4 c. small white onions, peeled (1 1/2 lb.)
2 Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. reduced calorie margarine
steps: In a medium saucepan of boiling water, cook onion for 15 to 20 minutes, until tender.
Drain.

recipes.title: Corn Creole
steps: Saute onion, garlic and bell pepper in bacon fat.
Add corn. Add egg beaten with milk.
Add corn meal and season to taste. Stir mixture over medium fire until thick.
Pour into a buttered casserole.
Sprinkle top with bread crumbs and dot with butter. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken A La King
ingredients: fresh mushrooms and onion (as much as you want)
milk (1 to 2 cans until you get the thickness you want)
pimento (adds color mostly, as much as you want)
steps: Boil chicken 1 hour; saute mushrooms, onion and celery until tender in butter. When chicken is done, pull off bone and take skin off. Cut in bite size pieces. Mix cream of mushroom soup and milk; heat until warm. Add vegetables, chicken, peas and pimento. Heat until hot. Stir occasionally. Serve over rice or biscuits.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
With pastry blender or fork, cut Crisco, white sugar, brown sugar and eggs.
Add salt, soda, water and vanilla.
Stir until smooth.
Add flour and chocolate chips. Drop spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake until lightly brown.

recipes.title: Cabbage And Rice Jambalaya In Rice Cooker
ingredients: 1/2 lb. lean ground beef, browned and drained
steps: Mix all ingredients and cook in large rice cooker.
Let stand about 15 minutes after bell rings.

recipes.title: Turkey Roll-Ups
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
In large skillet, melt butter.
Add onion and celery and cook until tender.
Add bread cubes, parsley, seasonings and bouillon (adjust seasonings to taste).
Place turkey steaks between layers of wax paper and pound until flattened and doubled in width.
Spoon stuffing onto steaks.
Roll up and secure with toothpicks.
In pie pan, place flour; dip turkey rolls in flour and dip in melted butter.
Place in baking dish.
Sprinkle with paprika and bake 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: "You Name It" Cake
steps: Mix and pour evenly on Cool Whip layer.

recipes.title: Venison Stew
steps: Heat oil in a Dutch oven.
Brown meat.
Add onions, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaf, oregano, salt and pepper.
Simmer, covered, 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat is tender.
Add potatoes and carrots.
Continue to cook until vegetables are tender, about 30 to 45 minutes.
Mix flour and water.
Stir into stew.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Add browning sauce, if desired. Remove bay leaf.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken And Ham
steps: Wrap half of boned chicken breasts with slice of bacon. Secure.
Make a bed of Smithfield ham
or chipped beef.
Mix a can of cream of mushroom soup and
cup
sour
cream.
Place chicken on ham.
Pour sour	cream
mixture	over
chicken
and bake, uncovered, about 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

recipes.title: Brown Rice
steps: Melt margarine and add chopped onion and rice.
Stir constantly until brown.
Put in covered casserole.
Add consomme and bake 1 full hour at 375°.

recipes.title: Turkey Piccaja
ingredients: grated peel of 2 lemons and juice
steps: Dip turkey slices in seasoned flour.
Saute in butter and olive oil two minutes on each side.
Remove.
Add wine, beef broth, chopped parsley, garlic, grated lemon peel and juice.
Let come to a boil and add cornstarch, dissolved in 1 tablespoon water.
Add to thicken.
Simmer gently.
Add lemon slices and simmer two minutes.
Return turkey and serve over noodles.
Can use the lemon slices to decorate.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Soup
steps: Put bouillon cubes in water to dissolve.
In medium size saucepan, cook onion in margarine until tender.
Remove from heat. Add flour; stir until dissolved.
Add milk; cook until thick sauce is formed, stirring constantly.
Add mashed pumpkin, water, chicken, salt, marjoram, thyme, nutmeg and pepper sauce.
Heat soup to serving temperature.

recipes.title: Corn Bread-Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. canned tomatoes or tomato sauce
steps: Simmer hamburger, onion, tomatoes, salt, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder and garlic salt about 15 minutes.
Add cooked pinto beans or kidney beans.
Place in baking dish; cover with 1 cup corn bread batter and bake at 425° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mary'S Chicken Cacciatori
steps: Fry chicken in shortening for 1 hour on low heat.
Use electric skillet.
Do not coat chicken with flour.
Mix mushrooms, green pepper, tomatoes, onion and water.
Pour over chicken.
Simmer 1/2 hour, basting often.
Serve with potatoes or noodles and salad.

recipes.title: Erma'S Sugar Cookies
steps: Put all in a bowl and beat with the electric mixer.
Bake at 400° about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Best-Ever Banana Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix flour, baking powder and salt; set aside.
In a medium bowl, cream the butter, sugar and pumpkin pie spice until fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time; add vanilla.
Add 1/3 of the flour mixture alternately with 1/3 cup of bananas; beat until smooth.
Repeat with remaining flour and bananas.
Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake about 55 minutes or until cake tester inserted into center comes out clean.
Makes one loaf.

recipes.title: Chicken, Artichoke And Spinach Casserole
steps: Cook chicken breasts in seasoned water (celery, salt and pepper).
Remove from bone and skin.
Pull from bone.
In buttered casserole (11 x 7 x 2-inch), layer artichokes, spinach (which has been thawed, drained and squeezed) and chicken pieces evenly distributed in bite size pieces.
Combine soup, lemon juice and curry powder and spread on top.
Sprinkle cheese over and top with bread crumbs.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbles and heats thoroughly. Serve with rice cooked with consomme or bouillon, fruit or tossed salad.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Mississippi Mud Cake
steps: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add eggs and beat by hand.
Sift flour, cocoa and salt.
Add to creamed mixture and mix well.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Pour into greased and floured pan.
Bake for 35 minutes at 300°.
Remove from oven and pour marshmallows over top. Return to oven for 10 minutes at 350°.
Cool cake for 1 hour, then add icing.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Place sugar in a bowl.
Add oil and eggs; beat well.
Sift flour, baking powder, cinnamon, soda and salt.
Add flour mixture to egg mixture and blend.
Add pecans and apples.
Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until it tests done.
Serve warm and top with ice cream or Cool Whip.
Yields 15 servings.

recipes.title: Calories-A-Plenty
steps: Mix together ingredients for crust.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake crust at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Dumplings
steps: Mix together and drop by tablespoonfuls in boiling water or broth.
Cook for about 10 minutes or when dumpling is parted, it is done.

recipes.title: Jambalaya(Microwave)
steps: In 2-quart glass baking dish, combine onion, green peppers, butter or margarine and seasonings.
Cook on High 4 minutes or until tender, stirring one time.
Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and cook 15 minutes or until done, stirring three times. Let stand covered 5 minutes.
Stir before serving.

recipes.title: Fruit-Glazed Easter Ham
steps: Place ham, fat side up, on rack in open roasting pan.
Insert meat thermometer so bulb is centered in thickest part.
Be careful bulb does not rest in fat or on bone.
Do not add water.
Do not cover.
Roast at 325° until meat thermometer registers 130° to 140° for "fully cooked" half ham (18 to 24 minutes per pound) or 160° for a "cook before eating" half ham (22 to 25 minutes per pound).

recipes.title: B.T.L.  Bites
steps: Cut a thin slice off each tomato top; scoop out and discard pulp.
Invert the tomatoes on a paper towel to drain.

recipes.title: Miniature Fruitcakes
ingredients: 3/4 c. chopped mixed candied fruit (about 4 oz.)
steps: In a bowl, combine the first 7 ingredients. Combine egg yolks and vanilla; stir into dry ingredients.

recipes.title: Warm Fudge Filled Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 - 12 oz pack semi sweet mini morsels
steps: Beat butter until creamy.
Add 1/3 c sugar, beat well. Gradually add flour, blend well.
Stir in 1 tsp vanilla.
Press into bottom and 1 1/2 inches up sides of 9-inch spring form pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown.
Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy.
Gradually add 1 1/2 c sugar. Add eggs one at a time beating just until yellow disappears.
Stir in 2 tsp vanilla.
Pour 1/2 of mixture on top of crust in spring form pan.
Sprinkle chocolate chips to within 3/4 of an inch from edge.
Pour in remaining batter starting out and working to middle. Place on baking sheet.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.
Cool 1 hour and serve.

recipes.title: Moo Goo Gai Pan
ingredients: 1 chicken, cooked and cut in 1-inch cubes
steps: Use electric skillet set at 450°.
Cook chicken with oil for 10 minutes.
Add broccoli and cook for 5 minutes.
Add bamboo shoots, water chestnuts and mushrooms and heat thoroughly.
Add chicken broth; sprinkle top with garlic powder.
Add 2 tablespoons cornstarch with 1/2 cup water for thickening.
Heat thoroughly and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Papaya Salsa & Brie With Tortilla Wedges
ingredients: 3 c. Ripe Papaya, peeled and diced
3/4 c. Kiwi Fruit, peeled and diced
4 oz. Round Brie or 8 oz. En Croute
steps: Cut enough tortillas into wedges (like pie) and bake at 350° for 10 minutes, until crisp, then set aside.
Combine the papaya and the next 6 ingredients.
Set aside.
Place the Brie on a baking sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350° until thoroughly heated.
Dip the chips made from the tortillas in the fruity salsa and accompany it with a chunk of warmed cheese.
MMMMMM!!!!!! Serves 16.

recipes.title: Fluffy Banana Cake
steps: Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt.
Mix in a large bowl the shortening, sugar, unbeaten eggs and vanilla.
Beat for 1 1/2 minutes; add buttermilk or sour milk.
Add flour mixture with mashed bananas.
Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Salmon Cakes
steps: Crumble bread; mix with other ingredients.
Heat cooking oil in skillet until hot.
Drop salmon in spoonfuls into skillet. Cook until golden brown.

recipes.title: Turkey And Wild Rice Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. cooked turkey, cut into small pieces
2 Tbsp. white wine or 1 Tbsp. fresh lemon juice
steps: Cover rice with water and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat. Let soak for 1 hour, then drain.
Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a skillet.
Add mushrooms and onion and saute over medium heat until lightly browned.
In a large bowl, combine rice, mushrooms, onion and all remaining ingredients, except butter.
Turn into a buttered 2-quart casserole.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours. Remove cover; dot with remaining butter.
Bake, uncovered, for an additional 20 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Snack
steps: Mix cereals, marshmallows and nuts together.
Melt white chocolate and pour over mixture.
Spoon on wax paper.

recipes.title: Bacon-Cheese Cucumber Slices
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, crisply cooked and crumbled
steps: In medium bowl, combine cream cheese, bacon, green onions and Italian seasoning; blend well.
Cut ends from cucumbers.
Using long, thin serrated knife, hollow out inside of each cucumber, removing all seeds.
Using small spoon, firmly fill each cucumber with cream cheese mixture.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
To serve, cut into 1/4-inch slices.
Makes 64 slices.

recipes.title: Country Captain
ingredients: 1 chicken, cooked in salted water (save 1/2 c. stock)*, cooled, boned and cut in bite-sized pieces
2 (1 lb.) cans tomatoes, cut up and drain partially (save remainder of juice, may need it if too dry)
1/2 c. currants or raisins, soaked in chicken stock *
1 small can or pkg. blanched almonds
steps: Saute onions, garlic and bell pepper in olive oil.
Add tomatoes, cook 5 minutes.
Add rest of ingredients (spices and seasonings).
Cook 10 minutes.
Add chicken.
Transfer to a casserole and bake, uncovered, in 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Add soaked currants and almonds.
Serve with or over rice.
Can freeze.

recipes.title: Twin Sauerbraten Loaves
steps: Add crumbs to 1 cup water and let stand a few minutes.
Add meat and next 4 ingredients and mix well.
Shape into two loaves and brown on both sides in margarine in a skillet.
Combine 1 cup water and remaining ingredients, except flour, and add to loaves in the skillet.
Bring to a boil, cover and simmer, basting several times and turning once, about 1 hour.
Remove the loaves, skim fat from liquid and thicken with flour mixed with a little cold water. Simmer a few minutes, add a little more water, if necessary, strain and serve over sliced meat.
Serve with potato pancakes.

recipes.title: Family Favorite Carrot Cake
ingredients: 2 c. carrots, finely shredded and lightly packed
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cover raisins with boiling water; let stand 5 minutes.
Drain.
Combine flour, baking powder, cinnamon, baking soda and salt.
In large bowl, beat sugar, Crisco and eggs until fluffy.
Add flour mixture and milk; beat on medium speed 2 minutes.
Stir in carrots, raisins and walnuts.
Spread into greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan or two 9-inch round layer cake pans.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until wooden toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely.
Frost with Lemon Cream Cheese frosting.
Store covered in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Karo Pecan Pie
steps: Mix the above ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Cook in preheated oven at 325 until done (approximately 1 hour).

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Use two 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans or 1 large loaf pan. Spray with Pam.
Bake 60 minutes.
Cool for 10 minutes.
Remove from pan.
Place on rack to cool.

recipes.title: Pickled Okra
steps: Pack okra in pint jars.
Add the next 5 ingredients to each jar.
Boil the remaining ingredients and pour over okra, then seal jars.

recipes.title: Cookies To Cut-Out And Frost
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add beaten eggs, milk and mix. Add dry ingredients.
Chill several hours.
Roll out and cut. Bake at 350°.
Makes a lot of cookies.

recipes.title: Broccoli Bisque
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. cornstarch, mixed with 4 Tbsp. water
steps: Saute onion and garlic in pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray plus 2 tablespoons stock.
Put remaining ingredients, except cornstarch mixture and broccoli flowerets, in a food processor fitted with the metal blade and puree.
Return to pan.
Add cornstarch mixture and cook over low heat until thickened, stirring constantly.
Add broccoli flowerets; heat and serve. Makes 5 servings.

recipes.title: Water Chestnuts(Quick And Easy Appetizer.)
steps: Soak water chestnuts in Worcestershire sauce for several hours.
Wrap in bacon with a chunk of pineapple (use decorative, fireproof toothpick to secure); or roll in barbecue sauce.
Place under broiler until bacon is done.

recipes.title: Apple Butter Bread
steps: Grease and flour a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Combine flour, sugar and cinnamon in medium bowl.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Easy Oven Stew
steps: Brown the meat with the oil, salt, pepper and paprika.
When the mixture is browned, add the mixture with the rest of the ingredients in a deep dish (cake pan type).
Bake at 350° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Mocha Cake
steps: Grease 2 (9-inch) round layer pans. Dust with cocoa.
Blend all ingredients at low speed.
Put mixer on high and beat 4 minutes.
Pour batter into prepared pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool layers in pans for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cookies
steps: Mix
all
ingredients in order given. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased
cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes. They will be spongy like a cupcake. Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Acini De Pepe
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained (save juice)
2 small cans mandarin oranges, drained (save juice)
steps: In a pot, cook sugar, eggs, flour and salt; mix well.
Add fruit juices.
Bring to a boil.
Cool well.
Cook and strain acini de pepe.
Stir macaroni into cooked custard juices.
Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken
ingredients: 3 whole chicken breasts or 6 breast filets
steps: Wash chicken.
Coat with flour; brown in oil.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Dirty Rice
steps: Mix all together and pour in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
(Canned mushrooms can be added.)

recipes.title: Layered Oatmeal-Chip Cookie Mix
steps: Layer first 5 ingredients in order listed in a 1-quart wide-mouth glass canning jar.
Press down firmly on each layer before adding the next ingredient.
Combine flour, salt and baking powder together, mixing well.
Add flour mixture on top of chocolate chip layer.
Add a gift card with the following instructions:
Mix jar ingredients with 6 Tbsp. soft margarine, 1 beaten egg and 1 tsp. vanilla.
Roll into 1-inch balls and place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Heat milk in pan.
Add salt and rice.
Bring to a boil and cook 15 minutes.
Add to boiling mixture 1/4 cup of the evaporated milk. Boil 5 minutes longer.
Beat eggs and vanilla slightly.
Add sugar and remaining evaporated milk to egg mixture.
Add some of hot mixture to egg mixture and stir.
Add this egg mixture to boiling rice, stirring until it thickens slightly.
Pour into bowl; stir while cooling.
Add raisins.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine flour, salt, eggs, sugar, strawberries, oil, soda, cinnamon and pecans in bowl; mix well. Pour into 2 greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pans.
Bake for 1 hour. Remove to wire rack to cool.
Cut into thin slices.
Combine cream cheese, confectioners sugar and vanilla in bowl.
Beat until smooth.
Spread between slices of strawberry bread.
Yield:
30 servings.

recipes.title: Cola Baked Ham
steps: You will need an oven bag.

recipes.title: Swedish Meatballs Deluxe
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl and form into balls. Roll in flour and brown in hot oil.
Add remaining ingredients and enough of the tomato juice to cover meatballs.
Simmer about 45 minutes or until sauce thickens.

recipes.title: Peanut Clusters
steps: Melt chocolate chips. Take off heat.
Add milk and peanuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper.
Let harden in cool place.

recipes.title: Peaches 'N Cream Cheesecake
steps: Combine flour, baking powder, salt, dry pudding mix, softened butter, egg and milk.
Beat 2 minutes at medium speed with electric mixer.
Spread in prepared pan.
Drain peaches, reserving juice.
Place peaches over batter.
Combine cream cheese, sugar and 3 tablespoons of reserved juice.
Beat 2 minutes at medium speed.
Spoon to within 1-inch of edge of batter. Combine 1 tablespoon sugar and the cinnamon.
Sprinkle over cream cheese filling.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes until crust is golden brown.
Filling will appear soft.
Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortbread Shortcake
ingredients: 1 c. whipping cream, whipped and sweetened
steps: In mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.
Mix in flour and chocolate.
Form dough into two balls (one slightly larger than the other).
On a floured surface, roll balls into 7-inch circles (one thicker than the other).
Transfer to greased baking sheets. Prick all over with fork.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or just until golden.
Allow to cool 5 minutes; cut thinner circle into eight equal wedges.
Cool on racks.

recipes.title: Giblet Gravy
steps: Melt butter in pan.
Add flour and salt.
Stir until smooth. Add milk gradually and stir constantly until thickened.
(Makes one cup white sauce.)
Bring chicken broth to a boil, add chopped giblets and eggs.
Add white sauce and cook until thick.

recipes.title: Slowly Deviled Beef
ingredients: 2 lb. lean stew beef, cut in 1-inch cubes
1 envelope seasoning mix for Sloppy Joes
steps: Place all ingredients in slow cooker; stir to mix ingredients. Cover and cook about 10 hours on low or 4 to 5 hours on high. Serve with hot cooked noodles or rice.
Has a nice tangy flavor. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Cook and debone chicken.
Place in baking dish.
Cover with vegetables, mushroom and celery soup, also margarine (melted). Top with flour, milk and margarine mixed well.
Place in oven and bake until brown at 350°.

recipes.title: Cherry On Top(Cookies)
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) jar maraschino cherries, cut in half and drained on paper towel
steps: Cream together the Crisco and cream cheese. Add sugar, egg and almond extract. Sift flour, salt and soda together. Add to mixture. Chill 1 hour. Roll into 1-inch balls.
Roll in crushed pecans.
Put cherry half in center of ball and press down lightly. Bake on top rack of oven at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cookie should be white or light color.

recipes.title: Raisin Bran Muffins
steps: Mix all dry ingredients in a huge bowl.
Add the liquids and beaten eggs and mix well.
You can store in a sealed covered container in refrigerator for up to 6 weeks.
Bake in greased muffin tins sprayed with cooking spray.
Fill 2/3 full and bake at 400° for 15 to 18 minutes.
Don't overcook.
These freeze well.
These are very good.

recipes.title: Sausage Pie(Breakfast)
steps: Cook sausage, salt, pepper and onion together (drain fat off). Add potatoes and mushrooms and cook.
Put into pie crust, add top crust and bake at 350° until crust browns.

recipes.title: Five-Star Soup
ingredients: 1 pkg. (1 lb.) dried large white navy beans
1 shank end fully cooked ham (about 3 lb.)
1 (12 oz.) pkg. smoked sausage links, sliced thin
1 c. elbow macaroni (half an 8 oz. pkg.)
steps: Step 1:
Pick over beans, rinse and place in a large bowl. Pour the boiling water over, cover and let stand 1 hour.

recipes.title: Syrup Cookies
steps: In large mixing bowl, mix butter and eggs; add syrup.
Mix good.
Add dry ingredients.
Add raisins.
Put in very hot water and stir well. Drop from a spoon onto a well-greased cookie sheet and bake at 400° until done.

recipes.title: Lemon Dessert
ingredients: 1 pkg. lemon pudding, cooked and cooled
steps: Mix
together margarine, sugar and flour and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan to form a crust.
Bake crust at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.
Cool.
Spread
cooled
pudding on crust, then top with the
last
ingredients, mixed together.
Cut into squares to serve.

recipes.title: Betty'S Dessert
steps: Cream together first 4 ingredients.
Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture; add vanilla.
If desired, add 1/2 cup nuts and 1/2 to 3/4 cup chocolate chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
steps: Saute onion in butter; add broccoli and cook until tender. Blend evaporated milk, soup and cheese.
