recipes.title: Loaded Mashed Potatoes
steps: Boil corn and cut off cob.
Put in hot sterilized quart canning jars.
Add 2 tablespoons of canning or pickling salt to each jar.
Fill to neck of jar with boiling water.
Seal.

recipes.title: Easy Beans
ingredients: 1 can pork and beans (do not drain)
1/4 c. brown sugar (molasses can be used)
steps: Brown bacon until crisp.
Remove from drippings.
Saute onions and garlic in drippings.
Remove from drippings.
Mix all ingredients together except onion rings and pour into casserole. Place onion rings on top.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Carrot Casserole
steps: Cook carrots, onions, water and salt until tender, about 15 minutes.
Blend butter and bread crumbs; set aside.
Drain vegetable stock from carrots and blend together with butter and flour.
Cook until thickened and add cheese.
Stir until cheese is melted.
Pour over carrots and top with bread crumbs.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: French Breakfast Puffs
steps: In a mixing bowl, combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, nutmeg, and salt.
Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients.
In another bowl, Beat egg slightly; stir in milk and 1/3 cup melted butter or margarine, add egg mixture to flour mixture.
Stir just until moistened (the batter may be lumpy). Lightly grease muffin cups.
Fill cups about 2/3 full with batter. Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes or until muffins are golden. Meanwhile, in a shallow bowl combine the 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon.
Immediately dip tops of hot muffins into the 1/4 cup melted butter or margarine, then into the cinnamon-sugar mixture until coated.
Serve warm.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Dam Good Baked Chicken
steps: Combine seasonings.
This is enough to coat 4 chickens.
Shake all those ingredients in a bag.
Wet the chicken; drain it and toss it in the bag.
Arrange the coated chicken on an oven pan; brush with melted butter.
Bake 1 hour at 350° without turning!!

recipes.title: Barbecue Hot Dog Appetizers
steps: Cut hot dogs and bacon pieces into thirds.
Wrap each hot dog piece with 1 piece of bacon and secure with toothpick.
Arrange in single layer on cookie sheets or shallow baking pans; bake at 250° for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Pour barbecue sauce evenly over hot dogs; then drizzle molasses lightly over barbecue sauce. Sprinkle brown sugar over all.
Return to oven and bake an additional 30 minutes.
Serve hot or keep warm in a crock-pot. This will make a crock-pot full of appetizers.
Makes 72 to 90 appetizers.

recipes.title: Louisiana Shrimp
ingredients: 3/4 c. chopped green pepper to taste
2 slices bread, soaked in 1/2 c. milk
steps: Saute onions, green pepper and garlic in butter.
Mix with remaining ingredients.
Put in a casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
steps: Wash eggplant and cut into 1-inch slices.
Sprinkle with salt and allow to sit for 1/2 to 1 hour in colander.
Squeeze water out of slices and pat dry with toweling.
Dip slices in seasoned flour and brown in frying pan.
Place in greased 9-inch square baking dish.
Top each piece with a slice of Mozzarella cheese.
Place a second slice of eggplant on cheese.
Pour Ragu spaghetti sauce over the top.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes, covered for first 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Company Muffins
ingredients: 2 large, tart apples, peeled, cored and shredded
2 eggs, beaten, egg substitute or 4 egg whites
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine flour, oat bran, baking soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon in a large bowl.
Stir in sugar. Add carrots, apples, raisins and nuts.
Stir well.
Make a well in the middle.
Add oil, milk, eggs and vanilla.
Stir until moistened.

recipes.title: Chicken Lindsey
ingredients: 4-6 whole chicken breasts, boned and halved
1 10-3/4 oz. can cream of celery soup
1 10-3/4 oz. can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Rinse chicken breasts and pat dry.
Mix salt, pepper, celery salt and paprika together and sprinkle over chicken pieces.
Next, sprinkle lemon juice over chicken pieces and place in a crock pot or slow cooker.
Mix the two soups together in a bowl.
Pour over chicken and sprinkle with cheese.
Cover and cook on low setting for 6 to 8 hours.
Serve chicken and sauce over hot rice or noodles.
Serves 8-12.

recipes.title: Creamy Rice Pudding
steps: Combine rice, 1 1/2 cups milk, sugar and salt in a heavy saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until thick and creamy, 15 to 20 minutes.
Blend remaining 1/2 cup milk and egg. Stir into rice mixture; add raisins.
Cook 2 minutes longer, stirring constantly.
Add margarine and vanilla.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.

recipes.title: Lobster Bisque
steps: This soup is not suitable for freezing.
In large pot, combine lobster meat and cold water.
Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
In large saucepan, melt butter and blend in the flour.
Gradually add the milk and cook until thickened, stirring frequently.
Add the milk mixture to the lobster mixture.
Stir well and reheat.
Add salt and pepper and cayenne pepper to taste and serve.
Yields 1 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
steps: Cream sugar, eggs, flour, salt and soda with juice from fruit cocktail.
Add fruit cocktail and nuts.
Pour into a flat pan. Bake for 40 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Perfect White Bread
steps: Soften yeast in 1/4 cup warm water; set aside until remaining hot water, shortening, salt and sugar cool to lukewarm.
Stir in 2 cups flour; beat well.
Add remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough.
Turn on floured surface and knead until satiny, 8 to 10 minutes.
Let sit 10 minutes and knead again a few minutes. Place in greased bowl, turning once to grease surface.
Let raise in warm place until double in bulk.
Punch down; raise again 1 hour until double.
Cut dough in two portions.
Place in small ball; set 10 minutes.
Place in loaves; let raise until double about 1 hour. Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Honey Bun Cake
steps: Combine cake mix, oil, eggs, sour cream and vanilla. Pour half of mixture into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle half over batter; swirl with a fork into cake. Pour remaining batter on top and spread. Top with brown sugar and cinnamon; swirl with fork. Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes. When done, pour glaze on top.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Peel apples and slice into a deep baking dish. Sprinkle with spices (if desired) and granulated sugar.
Blend together the oats, flour, brown sugar, cornflake crumbs and oil.
Press this mixture on top of the apple slices. Bake for 30 minutes or until apples are tender when tested with a fork.
Yields 6 servings.
Fat:
None.

recipes.title: Super Lo-Cal, Lo-Fat Creamy Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 4 c. broccoli florets or 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli
chopped, fresh parsley for garnish (if desired)
steps: In saucepan, add broccoli, onion and water; cover and simmer until florets are tender, about 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Pour vegetables and liquid into work bowl of food processor and process until smooth; set aside.
(Blender can be used, but divide mixture in thirds to process.)
In same saucepan, heat margarine until bubbly and hot.
Add flour and cook, stirring constantly for 1 minute.
Stir in broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is smooth and thickened.
Add pureed vegetables and seasonings to saucepan.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thoroughly combined and heated.
Pour into soup bowls and sprinkle with parsley, if desired.
Enjoy!
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Grandma Jackson'S Sorghum Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together except flour.
Add flour gradually, enough to make a stiff batter.
Pour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° until done.
Top will fall.

recipes.title: Olive Cookies (Hors D'Oeuvres)
steps: Mix all ingredients. Take 1 tablespoon and wrap around each olive. You can freeze these, then bake when you need them. Bake in a 400° oven until brown. Grease pan.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Grease a 15X10 inch pan. In a medium bowl, cream together the butter and the sugar. Mix in egg and vanilla. Sift together the flour, baking soda and cinnamon. Stir into the creamed mixture, then stir in 1 cup of the peanuts. Spread the mixture evenly into the prepared baking pan. Sprinkle the remaining peanuts over the top. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes, until edges pull away from the sides of the pan. Cool and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
steps: Sift together dry ingredients; set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, cream butter, sugar and eggs.
Alternately add milk and dry ingredients, beating after each addition.
Stir in zucchini, peel and nuts. Bake at 350° for 1 hour in prepared tube pan or two loaf pans.

recipes.title: Plain Cake
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 Tbsp. hot water
steps: Cream oleo and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time.
Add soda and buttermilk.
Add flour gradually.
Add vanilla.
Bake in Bundt pan 1 hour at 300°.

recipes.title: Chipped Beef Dip
ingredients: 2 oz. jar smoked chipped beef, finely chopped
steps: Blend cheese and milk.
Add beef, onion and pepper to cheese mixture.
Blend in sour cream.
Put in ovenproof dish.
Cover top with crushed pecans.
Serve hot with crackers.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Linda'S Zucchini
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Spread into 13 x 9-inch greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs and beat until light.
Sift flour, baking powder and nutmeg together and add alternately with milk to the sugar mixture.
Gently fold in blueberries.
Pour into buttered pans and bake at 350° until firm in center and lightly browned, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburger Soup
ingredients: 2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of celery soup, undiluted
steps: Brown the beef in microwave oven.
Place in a crock-pot with the other ingredients and cook on low while at work.
Delicious over rice.

recipes.title: Ricotta Snowflake Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients; form into a ball and chill for 1 hour. Roll out the dough to a 1/8-inch thickness.
Use a round cookie cutter or a fluted cookie cutter and cut out shapes.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Do not let them get too brown.

recipes.title: Custard Pie(Makes Own Crust)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Use shortening and heavily grease and flour deep dish pan.
Mix ingredients together.
Pour into pan and bake for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Drop Biscuits
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl.
Combine milk, oil and egg; add to dry ingredients, stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened.
Drop batter by heaping tablespoonfuls onto a baking sheet coated with cooking spray.
Bake at 400° for 12 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Cool on a wire rack. Yields 1 dozen biscuits.

recipes.title: Apple Dumplings
ingredients: 7 1/2 apples, peeled, cored and cut in halves
steps: Bring to a boil and cook until thickened.
Pour over apple dumplings and finish baking.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Bacon Salad
steps: Mix together broccoli, onion, raisins and bacon.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Pour over salad, adding enough to moisten. Stir gently to mix.
Chill.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugars.
Add eggs and mix well.
Mix flour, salt and soda; add to batter.
Add crushed chips and nuts. Shape into small balls, press down on cookie sheet with floured fork.
Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamed Salmon
steps: Melt butter. Add flour and blend.
Add milk, salt and pepper. Cook on medium heat until slightly thick, stirring often. Add dill weed, grated cheese and salmon.
We like this over toast or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Mama'S Tea Cakes
steps: Mix all ingredients adding flour as needed to roll out and cut with cookie cutter.

recipes.title: Bacon Tomato Cups
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Chop bacon, tomato, onion and grated cheese.
Mix all ingredients except biscuits.
Separate each biscuit into 3 thinner biscuits.
Lay each biscuit over a mini muffin pan cup.
Press biscuit into cup. Fill cups with bacon mixture and bake 10 - 12 minutes until golden brown.
Yields 30.

recipes.title: Ma-Mae'S Homemade Rolls
ingredients: 2 pkg. Fleischmann's dry yeast (regular or quick-rise) *
steps: Preparation: About 1 hour, plus rising time.
Cooking Time: 10 to 15 minutes.
Temperature: 350°.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. yellow or white stone ground cornmeal
steps: Sift together flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Add cornmeal.
Beat in a separate bowl the egg.
Beat into it butter and milk.
Combine all ingredients with a few rapid strokes.
Place the batter in the hot pan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes in 9 x 9-inch pan.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Artichoke Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) jar marinated artichokes with liquid, chopped
steps: Cook the first 2 ingredients and add remaining ingredients. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Cream Crisco, vanilla and sugar in a bowl.
Add eggs and mix well.
Add bananas and mix well.
Add flour, soda and salt, alternating with milk.
Add nuts.
Spray Pam in pan.
Bake at 350° for at least 60 minutes.
Should make at least 2 loaves.
Let cool and wrap in foil.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Sour Cream Sugar Cookies
steps: Sift dry ingredients; set aside.
Cream together sugar and shortening; add eggs and lemon extract.
Blend and add sour cream. Combine this mixture with sifted dry ingredients.
Mixture will be stiff.
Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Beat eggs until thick and frothy;
beat in sugar.
Melt chocolate and shortening together over slow heat.
Add to first mixture.
Mix together flour, baking powder and salt.
For better results sift these together.
Add the flour mixture to the first mixture.
Stir in vanilla and nuts.
To prepare the 8 x 12 pan, grease well and line with wax paper.
Then grease the waxed paper. Spread into pan
and bake at 325° for 25 minutes.
Cut into squares and let cool in pan.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
steps: Saute until tender onions in oleo on low heat.
Add chicken soup, cheese, milk, broccoli and rice.
Mix all together, then pour into greased baking dish.
Top with a little grated cheese. Bake in 300° to 325° oven until bubbly hot.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Use large saucepan to combine and cook all ingredients. Combine cocoa and sugar.
Add milk and butter.
Then bring to a rolling boil and cook for 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and peanut butter.
Let the peanut butter melt and then add oats. Mix oats well and drop spoonfuls on a piece of wax paper to cool. Then serve.

recipes.title: Pineapple Raisin Muffins
steps: Beat sugar and margarine until fluffy.
Beat in egg, juice and orange peel.
Combine remaining ingredients; stirring until blended.
Spoon batter into greased muffin pan.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into 9 x 9-inch baking dish.
Dot with butter before baking at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.title: Hungry Boy Casserole
steps: Saute beef, onions, green pepper and garlic until tender. Add tomato paste, water and salt. Mix well.
Add beans and mushrooms.
Simmer until all ingredients are thoroughly heated. Pour into baking dish and cover with canned biscuits.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are golden.

recipes.title: Bacon Fat Cookies
steps: Mix bacon fat, brown sugar, white sugar and eggs until creamy. Add dry ingredients, vanilla and nuts.
Divide and mold into 2 rolls.
Wrap in waxed paper and chill until stiff.
Slice and bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Firecracker Casserole
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
steps: Cook the meat in skillet until it is no longer pink, drain. Add beans, chili pwd., cumin and salt.
Transfer to a 9 by 13 in. baking dish.
Arrange tortillas over the top; combine soup and tomatoes, then pour over the tortillas.
Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered at 350° for 25-30 min. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
steps: Cream shortening, sugar and
eggs.
Make
a
paste with food coloring and cocoa and add
to
mixture.
Add
salt
and flour with buttermilk and
vanilla.
Alternately
add soda and vinegar (mix vinegar and soda together); don't beat hard, just blend. Bake 30 minutes, at 350°,
in
two
8-inch greased and floured cake pans.
Frost with Red Velvet Cake Frosting.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Delight
steps: Mix and press into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Cool.

recipes.title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
steps: Have
all ingredients at room temperature.
Sift flour, baking powder
and salt.
Cream butter and sugar until silvery and light. Add
eggs,
one at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine milk and vanilla, then add to cream mixture alternately with flour mixture.
Be sure to begin and end with dry ingredients.
Beat	only
enough
to blend.
Fold in nuts. Spoon batter
into
greased and floured 9-inch tube pan.	Bake at 350° for
to
60 minutes or until done.
Cool in pan 15 minutes, then remove.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 10 oz. pkg. egg noodles, cooked and drained
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In medium saucepan, melt margarine; blend in flour.
Stir in milk, salt and chicken broth.
Cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
Grease 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix chicken and noodles with sauce.
Pour in pan.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs and cheese.
Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until top is lightly browned.

recipes.title: 1, 2, 3, 4 Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly.
Add eggs and beat well. Add baking powder to flour.
Add alternately with milk to batter. Add vanilla and mix well.
Makes 3 or 4 layers.
Bake in 350° oven about 30 minutes.
Use favorite filling and icing.

recipes.title: Jewel Cookies
ingredients: 1/4 c. light brown sugar, firmly packed
1 c. finely chopped walnuts or pecans
steps: In medium bowl with wooden spoon, beat butter, sugar, egg yolk and vanilla until smooth.
Stir in flour just until combined. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375°.
Using hands, roll dough into balls 1-inch in diameter; dip in egg white, then roll in walnuts.
Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets.
With thimble or thumb, press center of each cookie.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until a delicate golden brown.
Remove to wire rack; cool.
Place 1/4 teaspoon jelly in center of each cookie.

recipes.title: Dirty Rice
steps: Boil giblets in salted water with bay leaf and beef bouillon cubes.
Brown ground beef and drain.
Saute green pepper, onion and celery in saucepan with a little butter.
Chop cooked giblets after they cook and cool a little.
Add giblets, ground beef and sauteed vegetables to rice.
Add a teaspoon of poultry seasoning and 1/2 teaspoon sage to rice mixture.
Cover and cook until rice is done. Serve with baked chicken.

recipes.title: Streusel-Filled Coffee Cake
steps: Mix sugar, shortening and egg.
Stir in milk.
Sift together and stir 1 1/2 cups flour, baking powder and salt.
The mixture for the struedel is the brown sugar, 2 tablespoons flour, cinnamon and butter.
Spread half batter mixture in greased pan.
Sprinkle 1/2 streusel mixture.
Alternate rest.
Bake in greased and floured pan 25 to 35 minutes at 375°.
Double batter for 13 x 11 x 2-inch pan.

recipes.title: Cherry Pie Bars
steps: Mix margarine, sugar, vanilla and eggs.
Add flour, baking powder and salt.
Makes soft dough (sticky).
Spread 3/4 (plus) of dough on greased sheet cake pan, will seem thin (don't have bare spots).
Spread on pie cherries (get red everywhere).
Take a little at a time part of the 1/4 dough left; add flour and pat out real thin between hands.
Place patchy over cherries.
Looks real messy, cherries and red can show.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes (when it starts to brown and is firm, just barely brown).

recipes.title: Mrs. Lynch'S Old Country Cake
ingredients: 1 c. raisins, soaked in boiling water for 1/2 minute, then drained
steps: Mix and sift dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening with 2 knives.
Add beaten eggs.
Stir in raisins and seed.
Add milk; stir.
Spread into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan (or use cooking oil spray).
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 375°.
Can also use 3 small 6-inch round pans and bake for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Puff
steps: Blend all ingredients. Beat 2 minutes. Wash and stem berries and put in 8-inch square glass pan. Spoon mixture over berries. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes. Double recipe for 9 x 13 pan. (Substitute raspberries, blueberries, crushed pineapple or apples can be used.)

recipes.title: Cheese Olive Balls
steps: Blend cheese and margarine (room temperature).
Add flour and other ingredients.
Pinch off dough and form into balls around olives.
Bake on greased cookie sheet at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: White Fruit Cake
steps: Cut fruit in small pieces and mix with nuts and coconut. Combine flour, baking powder and soda.
Add fruit.
Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating after each addition.
Pour over fruit mixture and mix well.
Bake in 2 greased tube pans at 250° for 3 hours.
Yields 10 pounds. (Use a dishpan to mix fruit and flour and pour egg mixture over it.
Makes a big mixture.)

recipes.title: Wiener Schnitzel
steps: Sprinkle veal with lemon juice, salt, pepper and grated cheese.
Let sit for 5 minutes.
Then roll in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry on one side in hot butter.
Turn.
Reduce heat. Place cheese slice on each cutlet.
Slowly fry other side.
Serve with crisp salad.

recipes.title: Sausage Stir-Fry
ingredients: 4 to 5 pieces cooked link sausage (about 1 lb.), sliced in rings
2 c. weak beef broth (made with bouillon cubes)
steps: Heat a wok or large pot until hot.
Add a small amount of oil to coat bottom.
When oil is hot, add cabbage, onion and celery and stir-fry until it is about half done.
Add sausage rings and continue stirring over high heat until sausage is heated through. Add V-8 juice, beef broth, soy sauce and pepper.
Cook until heated.
Thicken with cornstarch and a little of the reserved beef broth.
Heat through.
Add sesame oil just before serving.
Serve over hot, fluffy rice.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained
steps: Saute onion in butter; add rice and broccoli.
Heat soup in double boiler.
Add Cheez Whiz.
Stir into broccoli.

recipes.title: Lemon Chiffon Pudding
steps: Cream
butter,
sugar
and
flour
together and add egg yolks, lemon
juice and milk.
Fold in egg whites.
Pour into buttered casserole.
Place
in
pan of warm water and bake in preheated 375° oven for 45 to 60 minutes, until firm.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Coconut Pound Cake
steps: Separate eggs; let egg whites warm to room temperature.
Beat yolks with shortening until well blended.
Gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
Add vanilla.
Add on low speed and beat in flour alternately with milk.
Add coconut and blend well. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in.
Bake in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: "Berry" Delicious Fruit Shortcake
ingredients: 1/2 c. sliced almonds or chopped nuts
steps: Combine
flour,
baking
powder,
salt	and
sugar. Add combined
milk,
melted margarine and beaten egg, mixing until well
moistened.
Spread
into greased and floured 8-inch cake pan. Bake
at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
ingredients: 1 box prepared Uncle Ben's wild rice
steps: Place the chicken in a glass baking dish.
Make the rice according to the directions on the box.
Add the 2 cans of soup and 1 can of water.
Pour the rice-soup mixture over the chicken and bake at 400° for 1/2 hour.
Add the cooking sherry and bake approximately 1/2 hour longer.

recipes.title: Korean Fried Rice(Bokgeum Bahb)
ingredients: 3 fresh mushrooms, sliced or 4 oz. can mushrooms
1/2 c. small shrimp, canned or frozen, chopped (optional)
steps: Separate cold rice grains with a knife or chopsticks.
Chop ham into small pieces.
Rinse frozen green peas under cold water and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in frypan and make Egg Pancakes.*
Chop Egg Pancakes into thin strips and set aside.

recipes.title: Fudge Fruit And Cream Salad
steps: Mix
pudding and buttermilk.
Fold in
whipping
cream. Break up cookies and fold into salad.
Add oranges and pineapple. Chill.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
ingredients: 1 small can green chili peppers, chopped
steps: Mix together and pour into hot skillet.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Can be made into muffins, also.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Cake
steps: For Cake:
Cream sugar and butter.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Add soda to buttermilk.
Then stir into first mixture, alternately with flour and salt.
Add peaches and nuts.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Good Rice
steps: Mix all together in casserole.
Place margarine on top.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Baked Lamb Chop Casserole
steps: Brown chops on both sides.
Place in greased casserole.
Pour drippings over meat.
Saute onion in butter until golden brown. Mix onion, potatoes, cucumbers, salt and pepper.
Spread over chops.
Add tomatoes.
Cover.
Bake at 400° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 1 lb. round steak, cut in thin strips
steps: Cook meat, onion and pepper in oil until browned.
Stir in remaining ingredients except rice.
Simmer for 45 minutes or 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Garbage Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Stir all ingredients into large bowl in order given.
(Butter should be soft.)
Mix by hand, then beat on medium speed with mixer for 2 minutes.
Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 1 hour and 20 minutes until a toothpick comes out dry.
Cool, then top with cream cheese frosting.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Meat Loaf Ring
steps: Combine buttermilk, bread, onion, egg, salt and pepper.
Mix lightly, just until blended.
Pack firmly into buttered ring mold. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
Allow to stand
for 5 minutes.
Drain off fat.
Turn out onto serving dish and drizzle catsup over meat loaf.

recipes.title: Geneva'S Coffee Bars
steps: In a large bowl, cream together the shortening and sugar. Add the eggs and beat thoroughly.
Add the hot coffee.
Mix well. Sift together the flour, baking powder, baking soda and cinnamon. Stir into the egg mixture, blending well.
Add the chocolate chips and nuts.
Pour into a greased jelly roll pan and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
While still warm, frost with a powdered sugar glaze.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
steps: Cream butter.
Add sugar and mix until well blended.
Add the eggs and beat thoroughly.
Mix soda, salt and cinnamon with flour. Add to first mixture alternately with the milk.
Fold in rolled oats, nutmeats and raisins.
Drop from spoon onto greased baking sheets.
Bake 10 minutes in a hot oven (400°).

recipes.title: Italian Beef
ingredients: 5 lb. sirloin tip roast, sliced thin and tied
steps: Bake in a heavy Dutch oven for 3 1/2 hours at 325°.
The last 30 minutes, cut strings.
Serve on sub buns.

recipes.title: Seasoned Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 lb. dried black-eyed peas, soaked overnight
2 hot pepper pods or 1 tsp. crushed red pepper
steps: Drain peas (if desired, instead of soaking, cover peas with water and bring to boil then let stand 1 hour).
Combine peas, water, bouillon, onion, pepper, garlic, thyme, vegetable oil and salt in Dutch oven or large saucepan.
Bring to boil, then reduce heat and cover.
Simmer gently for 1 hour or until tender.
Add additional water if pea mixture becomes too thick.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Noodle-Pineapple Kugel
ingredients: 6 medium cooking apples, peeled and cored (about 5 oz. each)
steps: Nadine Shirley, one of the volunteers known as Apple Pandowdies, passed away before last Apple Jubilee in Waverly, Missouri.
Her daughter, Pat Maycock, continues Nadine's tradition of baking apple dumplings for the celebration, using local Jonathan apples.
Baking powder lightens the flaky pastry.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Biscuits
steps: In bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Cut in Crisco until mixture is coarse crumbs.
Stir in buttermilk. Knead dough gently.
Roll out to 1/2 inch thick.
Cut with 2 1/2 inch biscuit cutter and place on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 450 degrees for 10 - 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 10 biscuits.

recipes.title: Onion Rings
steps: Peel onion. Cut in 1/2-inch slices. Separate rings.
Combine dry ingredients and stir well. Add eggs, milk and teaspoon oil. Beat until smooth. Dip onion rings into batter and fry in deep hot oil until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Crisp Marshmallow Bars
steps: In a 2-quart saucepan, melt butter and marshmallows over low heat, stirring occasionally until marshmallows are melted.
Remove from heat; blend in vanilla.
In a large bowl, add mixture to cereal.
Stir to coat.
Spread into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool completely.
Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Beefy Jalapeno Cornbread
steps: Combine cornmeal mix, eggs, buttermilk and corn. Saute ground beef; add onion and cook until onion is transparent, then drain. Pour 1/2 of the cornbread mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan that has been greased liberally. Crumble ground beef over cornbread mix and sprinkle cheese over this. Top with peppers, then rest of the cornbread mix.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 2 c. cubed cooked chicken (4 breast pieces)
steps: Melt butter in pan.
Add flour, stirring until smooth and thick.
Cook one minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add broth and milk.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick and bubbly.
Stir in all of the remaining ingredients.
Pour into unbaked pie crust.
Add top crust.
Make several slits in top crust.
Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Candy
steps: Add sugar and vanilla to cold potato.
Roll with rolling pin dusted with flour.
Spread with peanut butter.
Roll up like a pinwheel; place in refrigerator.
Cut into slices.
May be frozen. Wrap in wax paper or plastic wrap so it doesn't dry out.

recipes.title: Chocolate Boiled Cookies
steps: Cook sugar, milk, margarine and cocoa over medium heat until it comes to a full rolling boil, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add nuts, oats, peanut butter and vanilla.
Beat until well blended.
Spoon onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Meringue Cake
steps: Sift flour and baking powder.
Mix in order given.
Pour into 2 layer cake pans.

recipes.title: Biscotti
steps: Mix all ingredients together and knead.
Bake at 350° until firm.
Let cool for 10 minutes.
Slice and rebake on ungreased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Chicken Jerusalem
ingredients: 1 (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) fryer, cut into seving pieces
1/2 lb. fresh mushrooms, cut into pieces
1 (6 oz.) jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained
steps: Heat oil in frying pan.
Dredge chicken pieces in flour and lightly brown in oil.
Place in casserole with mushrooms and artichoke hearts.
Stir in garlic and spices (with tomatoes). Pour over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until tender, adding sherry during last few minutes of cooking time. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Muffins
ingredients: 1 c. pumpkin (half of a 1 lb. can)
steps: Mix dry ingredients: flour, sugar, pumpkin pie spice, soda, powder and salt in one bowl.

recipes.title: Burrito Casserole
steps: Brown meat in skillet.
Drain.
Add can of beans and taco seasoning.
Stuff tortillas and place in casserole dish.
Mix chili and picante sauce in separate bowl.
Pour over tortillas. Top with cheese and bake at 375° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Italian Supper Casserole
steps: Cook the lasagna noodles according to directions.
Drain rinse and separate.
brown the beef and sprinkle the mix over the meat.
Add tomatoes and blend well.
Whip the cream cheese. In a buttered 1 1/2 quart casserole.
Make 2 layers each of noodles, meat & dollops of cream cheese. Bake at 350 degree for 20 minutes or until bubbly.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chinese Goulash
ingredients: 1 c. celery, cut in thick diagonal slices
1 can bean sprouts, rinsed and drained
1 can mushroom soup and/or 1 can cream of chicken soup (no water)
steps: Brown beef; drain fat.
Add onion and celery and continue cooking until tender, but not soft.
Add bean sprouts and soup. Heat thoroughly.
Add canned mushrooms if desired.
Serve over chow mein noodles.

recipes.title: Pizza Crust
steps: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, undissolved yeast and salt. Gradually add water and 2 tablespoons peanut oil to flour mixture. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed of mixer, scraping bowl occasionally. Stir in enough remaining flour to make a soft dough. Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 8 to 10 minutes. Cover and let rest 10 minutes. Roll dough to a 12-inch circle; place on a greased pizza pan. Form a standing rim on crust. Prick dough with fork
randomly. Let rest 10 minutes. Prebake at 450° for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Beat together all ingredients except bananas.
Then mix well. Turn in bananas.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Green Pea Casserole
steps: Mix together peas, onions, soup, bacon and water chestnuts. Place in casserole dish. Top with Stove Top mix and melted butter. Bake at 350° about 20 to 25 minutes until brown.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In small bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt; set aside.
In a large bowl, beat butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla extract until creamy.
Beat in eggs. Gradually beat in flour mixture.
Stir in chocolate and nuts.
Drop by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until golden brown.
Yields 5 dozen cookies (using tablespoons of dough).

recipes.title: James Earl Jones' Chilean Sea Bass
ingredients: 12 pieces Chilean sea bass, 2-inches wide, 2 1/2-inches long
12 seeded, chopped Roma tomatoes or the canned, drained or canned equivalent
steps: Slice and cook onions in a skillet on low heat until caramelized (between 1 and 2 hours).

Puree all ingredients except olive oil and chicken broth. Heat olive oil. Add ingredients and cook on low for 30 minutes. Add chicken broth as necessary. Season bass with salt and white pepper to taste.
Cover bass with onions and bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Each of 6 servings should include one piece of bass over about 1/6 of the sauce.

recipes.title: Hamburger Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh, sliced mushrooms or 1 (8 oz.) can sliced mushrooms (optional)
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
steps: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat.
Stir in meat and brown.
Stir in flour, pepper, salt and soup.

recipes.title: Aunt Beta'S Beer Bread
steps: Blend beer, egg and sugar, then add flour.
Put it in a bread pan and cover with towel.
It rises in an hour or so.
Bake at 350° for an hour.
Cool and slice bread.
Spread real butter on top.
Mmmm!
Good!

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
steps: Cream the sugar and shortening.
Add the egg and vanilla. Then the rest of the ingredients.
Roll in balls and flatten. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Walnut Bread
steps: Chop walnuts.
Beat eggs; gradually beat in sugar, then oil. Combine first mixture, alternating with zucchini.
Stir in raisins, walnuts and vanilla extract.
Turn into 2 greased and lightly floured loaf pans.
Bake at 350° or until loaves test done, approximately 1 hour.
(Bake on lowest rack in oven.)
Let stand about 10 minutes, turn out onto wire racks to cool.
If desired, loaves may be lightly frosted with confectioners sugar, butter and vanilla mixed to a spreading consistency with milk. Makes two loaves.
Freezes well!

recipes.title: Delicious Cabbage
steps: Brown onions.
Remove from pan.
Place 1/3 cabbage in pan followed by 1/2 of bell pepper, one tomato and half the browned onion.
Layer with another 1/3 of cabbage and remaining bell pepper, tomato and onions.
Sprinkle remaining cabbage on top and add salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer about 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Crumble
steps: Combine rhubarb, apples and strawberries; spoon into a greased 8-inch square baking dish.
Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over fruit.
Set aside.
In a bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Cut in oleo until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in brown sugar and oats.
Sprinkle over rhubarb mixture. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes, or until lightly browned. Serve cold or warm with a scoop of ice cream if desired.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
steps: Wash and clean peppers.
Parboil peppers for 5 minutes.
Let cool and drain.
Combine rice, meat, salt, pepper and butter; mix well.
Stuff peppers; place peppers in a pan, uncovered, with a little water in the bottom.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour (check after 45 minutes).
Heat can of tomato sauce and serve with peppers.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Bake in greased iron skillet on 400° to 425° until brown.

recipes.title: Sea Scallops With Lemon Butter Sauce
steps: Coat 1 lb. sea scallops in flour. Season with salt and pepper. Saute scallops in olive oil & butter in a large skillet over high heat for 2 minutes on each side.	Remove scallops.
Add butter, lemon juice, parsley, salt & pepper and heat.
Serve scallops over rice and top with sauce from skillet.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
steps: Mix thoroughly all ingredients. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 12 3/4-inch oblong pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in bottom rack of oven.

recipes.title: Red Cake
ingredients: 2 oz. bottle red food coloring (1/4 c.)
steps: Mix butter, sugar and eggs.
Make a paste of red coloring and cocoa.
Add to creamed mixture.
Add buttermilk, alternating with sifted flour and salt.
Add vanilla.
In small cup, mix soda and vinegar, then add to rest of mixture, blending instead of beating. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350° in 2 (8-inch) greased and floured pans.

recipes.title: Miracle Brownies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Sift first 5 ingredients in a bowl. Add shortening, eggs, vanilla and corn syrup.
Mix for 2 minutes at low speed; scrape bowl.
Stir in nuts; save some nuts to sprinkle on top.
Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cook 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Stuffed Shells
steps: Cook pasta as directed; drain.
Combine curry, yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard and garlic.
Add chicken, red pepper, celery, scallions and sunflower seed.
Toss lightly. Spoon 1 1/2 tablespoons into each shell.
Chill.
Serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: Choc' Gravy
steps: Mix well and cook over medium heat until thick.
Serve over buttered toast or biscuits.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Set oven at 350°.
Combine ingredients, except beef.
Mix well. Add ground beef; mix.
Press into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan.
Bake for 1 hour.
Drain; let stand for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
ingredients: 1 (1 lb. 2 1/2 oz.) pkg. German chocolate cake mix
1 (14 oz.) can sweetened condensed milk, divided
frosting of choice or whipped cream
steps: Combine chocolate cake mix, butter, water, oil and 1/2 can sweetened condensed milk in mixing bowl.
Mix well.
Pour half of batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Kentucky Jam Cake
steps: Combine sugar, oil, buttermilk, eggs, blackberry jam and vanilla in large bowl.
Beat well on low speed.
Add combined ingredients and beat on medium speed to blend well.
Bake at 350° in 2 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans for 40 minutes or until tests done.
Cool completely and frost with Buttermilk Icing.

recipes.title: Polka Dot Cake
steps: Mix dates and hot water.
Let cool.
Cream butter and sugar, then beat in eggs.
Sift dry ingredients and add to cream mixture. Add dates, vanilla and 1/2 cup chocolate chips.
Spread batter in greased pan.
Top with remaining chocolate chips and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pa'S Fruit Bread
steps: Mix sugar, cooking oil and eggs.
Add fruit and nuts; mix well.
Stir in flour; mix well.
Pour in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Mix sugar, eggs, vegetable oil, mashed bananas and vanilla. Then add sifted flour with baking soda and salt.
Add nuts if you like.
Pour mixture into greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sugar Pie
steps: Mix the flour with the sugar.
Add the milk.
Mix and pour into 1 pie crust and cover with the second crust.
Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.
Lower the heat to 300 degrees, and bake for approximately 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Combine ingredients and mix with sauce.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
steps: Place pastry in pie pan.
Arrange rhubarb.
Mix sugar with flour and add beaten egg yolks and butter.
Spoon mixture over rhubarb.
Bake in hot oven at 450° for 12 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and continue baking for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, broken into small pieces
steps: Cook cauliflower in saltwater 10 to 15 minutes; drain.
In saucepan, cook onion in butter until tender.
Blend in flour.
Add chicken broth, milk and Worcestershire sauce.
Cook until slightly thickened.
Add cauliflower.
Bring to boil; add cheese.
Sprinkle chives over each serving.

recipes.title: Scott'S Sour Cream Biscuits
steps: Mix all
ingredients and spoon in miniature muffin pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Mississippi Mud Pie
steps: Melt butter.
Add brown sugar and water (boiled 1 minute to syrup).
In bowl mix egg yolks, flour and milk; slowly add syrup. Return to stove; boil until thick.
Add vanilla; pour into baked pie shell.
Sprinkle top with crushed graham crackers.

recipes.title: Plum Cake(This Is A Surprise!)
steps: Mix sugar, oil, eggs, plums, food coloring and vanilla.
Add flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, cloves and pecans.
Mix well and pour into greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Glaze cake while still warm
after removing from pan.

recipes.title: Lasagna
ingredients: 1 (6 or 8 oz.) thinly sliced Mozzarella cheese
steps: Brown meat slowly.
Spoon off excess fat.
Add next 4 ingredients.
Cover and simmer 40 minutes, stirring occasionally. Salt to taste.
Cook noodles in salted water until tender; drain. Rinse in cold water.
Place half of the noodles in large baking dish.
Cover with 1/3 of the sauce.
Add half of the Mozzarella cheese, then half of the cottage cheese.
Repeat layers, ending with sauce.
Top with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.
Let stand 15 minutes.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Whipped Cream Supreme
steps: Melt butter.
Stir in flour and nuts.
Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Cool.

recipes.title: Old Fashion Pumpkin Pie
steps: Combine pumpkin, sugars and all spices well.
Beat eggs well with 1/4 cup melted oleo or butter.
Add this to the pumpkin mixture and mix well.
Pour into 10-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake 40 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cobbler
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Pour melted butter into a shallow, 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
In a large bowl, combine flour, 1/4 cup sugar and milk.
Pour mixture evenly over butter.
Combine strawberries, remaining 1/2 cup sugar and water in a separate bowl, then spoon evenly over the flour/milk layer.
Do not stir. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Biscuits
steps: Combine dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add yeast and buttermilk to dry mixture.
Mix well.
Roll out desired amount on lightly floured surface to about 1/4-inch thick.
Cut with 2-inch cutter.
Let rise 10 minutes.
Preheat oven to 450°.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes.
Watch carefully until you get the time right for your oven.
Dough will keep in refrigerator a week in covered container or plastic bag.

recipes.title: Chicken Jambalaya
ingredients: 8 pork sausage links or turkey links
steps: Remove skin from chicken.
Place chicken, water, salt and pepper in Dutch oven.
Heat to boiling, reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Remove chicken from broth.
Skim fat from broth.
Strain broth.

recipes.title: Crab Gumbo
ingredients: 2 pkg. (6 oz) frozen Alaska Snow crab meat, thawed, drained or imitation crab
2-2/3 c. cooked rice (without salt or fat)
steps: Heat oil in large kettle on medium heat.
Add flour, stirring constantly until dark brown but not burned.
Add onion and garlic. Cook until tender, stirring occasionally.
Gradually stir in undrained tomatoes.
Add sugar, worcestershire sauce, salt, hot pepper sauce and bay leaf.
Stir to break up tomatoes.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover.
Simmer 10 minutes to blend flavor, stirring occasionally.
Add okra.
Cook 5 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally.
Add crab.
Stir gently and heat through. Discard bay leaf.
Serve gumbo over rice.
(4 servings.)

recipes.title: Vegetarian Chili With Rice
ingredients: 1 (15 1/2 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained
1 (15 1/2 oz.) can Great Northern beans, drained
steps: Combine kidney beans, Northern beans, undrained tomatoes, tomato sauce, pepper, onion, chili powder, sugar, basil, garlic and water in a large saucepan.
Bring to boiling and reduce heat. Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Top each serving with 1/2 cup rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Mushroom-Cheese Souffle("A Favorite From The '76 Cookbook.")
ingredients: 1 (3 or 4 oz.) can sliced mushrooms, drained
steps: Start heating oven to 300°.
With hand beater, beat egg yolks until light and foamy.
Stir milk gradually into flour.
Add to egg yolks and beat well.
Add salt, pepper and cheese and beat until blended.
Gently fold in onion, mushrooms and egg whites, stiffly beaten.
Turn into greased 1-quart casserole.
Bake about 50 minutes or until golden brown on top.
Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Fresh Pear Cake
steps: In large bowl, combine pears, sugar and pecans.
Set aside for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Butter and flour large tube pan. Using wooden spoon, stir into pear mixture the oil, vanilla and eggs.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sin Cake
steps: Mix flour, melted oleo and nuts.
Spread in pan; bake approximately 20 minutes at 350° or until light brown.
Mix cream cheese, sugar and 1/2 cup Cool Whip.
Spread over crust.
Mix pudding and milk until thick; spread over 2nd layer.
Spread cherry pie filling over all.
Cover with the balance of Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Party Chicken Breast Bake
ingredients: 4 to 6 slices chipped beef, ham or crumbled bacon bits
steps: Lightly
grease baking dish.
Flatten breasts and place slice of	chipped
beef
and
shredded cheese on each breast. Roll
up each
breast
with ends down.
Place in baking dish. Combine soup and
sour
cream
and spoon over rolled breasts. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Hero Sandwiches
steps: Saute ground beef and onion in skillet until ground beef is brown.
Stir frequently.
Add chilies, olives, catsup, salt and chili powder and mix well.
Cook for 5 minutes.
Stir occasionally.
Place one slice Colby cheese on bottom half of each loaf.
Spoon ground beef mixture over cheese.
Arrange bacon slice and Muenster cheese slice over ground beef.
Cover with remaining loaf halves.
Wrap loaves with aluminum foil.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cashew Chicken
ingredients: 3 to 4 chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces
steps: Dip chicken pieces in beaten eggs.
Shake chicken in a bag of flour (plus a little cornstarch).
Deep fry until brown.
Place chicken in baking dish, cover with cashews, onion and sauce.
Bake at 250° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Helen'S Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. lemon flavoring or 1 tsp. vanilla
steps: Mix sugar, margarine, eggs and flavorings thoroughly.
Measure flour and sift.
Stir flour, baking powder and salt together. Blend well and chill at least 1 hour.
Heat oven to 400°.
Roll dough 1/8-inch thick on a lightly floured board.
Cut with a 3-inch cookie cutter.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 6 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 4 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
steps: Cut onions, celery, potatoes and add water.
Bring to boil and simmer 15 minutes or until done.
Melt margarine; add flour and make paste.
Remove from pan; put in milk and heat.
Add roux gradually (margarine and flour).
Stir until creamy.
Add potatoes and corn.
Heat and stir.
Don't let boil.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Crunch
steps: Mix until crumbly the first 5 ingredients.
Press 1/2 of crumbs in greased 7 x 9-inch baking pan.
Top with rhubarb.
Then combine in saucepan the next 4 ingredients.
Cook until thick and clear.
Pour over rhubarb.
Top with remaining crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cut in squares and serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Christmas Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs.
Sift flour and cinnamon together and add alternately with milk.
Add sherry, nuts and fruit.
Drop on well-greased cookie sheet and bake 20 minutes at 300°.
Makes about 12 dozen.

recipes.title: Chopped Apple Cake
steps: Sift together flour, soda, salt and spices.
Blend shortening and sugar.
Add eggs; beat well.
Add dry ingredients alternately with coffee.
Fold in chopped apples and raisins.
Nuts may be added if desired.
Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.
Cake may be iced when cool.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
steps: Mix first four ingredients.
Mix in shortening.
Beat together egg, water and vinegar.
Add to flour mixture and work well.
Can leave in sealed Tupperware container in refrigerator for a week.
(I have frozen it.)

recipes.title: Etta'S Pecan Pie
steps: Mix ingredients together and pour into pie shells. Bake at 350° until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Delicious Peach Pie
ingredients: 1/4 c. chilled margarine, cut into 6 pieces
steps: Beat egg white until foamy.
Brush over the bottom and sides of pastry.
In a small bowl combine flour and sugars.
Cut in margarine until mixture resembles fine crumbs.
Sprinkle 2/3 into bottom of pastry.
Top with peaches.
Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture.
Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until filling is bubbly and peaches are tender.

recipes.title: Oven Barbecued Chicken Breasts
steps: Dredge chicken breasts in flour to which salt and pepper is added.
Heat mixture of oil and margarine in skillet.
Place chicken in the hot oil, turning to a light brown.
Arrange pieces in a lightly greased baking dish.
Blend and heat all ingredients for the sauce, pour over chicken.
Cover and bake 325 for about 1 1/2 hour or until chicken is tender.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Brownies From Scratch
steps: Mix with electric mixer, margarine and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla, cocoa and flour.
Blend all together.

recipes.title: Mexican Wedding Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Grease and flour pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Spread cake with icing.

recipes.title: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix together and drop on a greased cookie sheet by spoonfuls. Bake at 400° for about 10 minutes.
Nuts and/or raisins may be added.

recipes.title: Milkless Potato Soup
ingredients: celery, parsley, onion juice and thyme
steps: Boil the potatoes and process them through a colander, then mash them thoroughly.
Add 6 cups of water.
Brown the flour in the butter and add the potatoes and water with the chopped celery, parsley, thyme, salt and white pepper.
Beat in two egg yolks just before serving.
You will never miss the cow.

recipes.title: Cranberry Sauce Cake
steps: Cream together sugars, butter and egg yolks.
Stir in cranberry sauce.
Sift together flour, cinnamon, soda, cloves, salt and allspice; add to creamed mixture.
Stir in pecans and raisins.
Fold in egg whites.
Bake in tube pan (greased) at 375° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Toll House Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Prepare a 9-inch pastry.
Melt butter. Cool.
Beat 2 eggs until foamy.
Add flour, sugar and brown sugar and beat until smooth.
Add melted butter.
Mix well.
Add chocolate chips.
Stir.
Pour batter into pie shell.
Bake for 1 hour.
It's heavenly!

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
steps: Place dry ingredients (except raisins) in large, deep bowl. Gradually add milk and margarine.
Mix until firm enough to form ball; if still crumbly, add more butter or milk, one tablespoon at a time.
Pat down to an 8-inch circle.
Place on oiled cookie sheet.
Cut the dough in the form of a cross to the depth of 1-inch.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken
steps: Cut chicken into nuggets. Batter chicken in egg and then in flour. Fry until golden brown. Dip chicken into teriyaki sauce and place in dish. Cook chicken for 20 to 25 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Kiss Cookies
steps: Cream the butter, sugars, peanut butter, egg and vanilla. Sift flour, soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture.
Form into balls.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Place in oven for 8 minutes. Put chocolate kisses on top.
Push them down on the cookie.
Put back in oven for 2 to 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Skillet Dinner
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. ground chuck, drain fat
steps: Cook until meat is brown; drain.
Add salt and pepper, chili powder, garlic salt, bell pepper and onion.
Put in Dutch oven. Put egg noodles on top.
Don't stir.
Pour water over mixture.

recipes.title: Fallen Fudge Cake
steps: Melt the butter in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Mix the next 5 ingredients and pour over butter.
Mix the next 4 ingredients and pour over the batter.
Do not stir.
Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.
Makes its own sauce.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Dessert
steps: Combine all until crumbly.
Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until brown.
Remove from oven and cool!

recipes.title: Magic Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 1 3/4 c. or more sliced peaches (either fresh or canned)
steps: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix sugar, flour, baking powder and milk together and pour on butter.
Do not stir.
Add peaches on top of this in layers.
Sprinkle with 2 or 3 tablespoons sugar.
Bake 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Gingerbread
steps: Mix soda with sour milk and add to molasses.
Sift together flour, ginger and salt; combine 2 mixtures and add butter.
Bake in greased pan in moderate oven, 350°, for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Koulourakia(Greek Butter Cookies)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cream butter gradually beating in sugar. Beat eggs until light; add to butter mixture and beat thoroughly. Add vanilla extract.
Add lemon rinds.
Sift together flour and baking powder.
Carefully blend into butter-egg mixture to make soft dough.

recipes.title: Hearty Whole Wheat Bread
steps: Soften yeast in lukewarm water with honey.
Melt margarine in saucepan.
Cool slightly.
When yeast is bubbly, add 4 more heaping cups warm water, milk, salt, the melted shortening, bran and wheat germ.
Mix and add flours (the total amount will equal almost 5 pounds of flour).
Knead well.
Place in a warm place in greased bowl.

recipes.title: Rosamarina Salad (Or) Hawaiian Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 2 large cans pineapple chunks or tidbits (not crushed)
steps: Rub a wooden bowl with garlic and mix the dressing right in the bowl.
Use a variety of fresh torn greens such as lettuce, escarole, spinach, endive and watercress.
Toss well until every leaf is coated with the dressing.

recipes.title: Chicken With Bell Pepper
steps: Brown chicken (unfloured) in shortening until golden brown. Remove chicken from skillet and make gravy in small amount of shortening.
In same skillet return chicken and lay peppers and onions over gravy covered chicken.	Simmer for 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Delicious Zucchini And Yellow Squash
steps: Fry bacon; when almost crisp, add onion, squash, salt and pepper.
Cook until tender (about 10 minutes).
Remove from stove; add sour cream and serve.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Real Mashed Potatoes!(From Potatoes, Not A Mix!)
steps: Cut up potatoes and put in a big pot of salted water. Bring to a boil. Put cover on pot and let cook 25 minutes on medium heat. Drain; add butter and milk. Whip using a hand mixer.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Mix together in a baking dish.
Place bacon strips on top. Bake about 30 minutes in a medium oven.

recipes.title: Red Rice
ingredients: 1/2 lb. medium shrimp, cooked and deveined
steps: Fry bacon until brown.
Remove from pan.
Chop onion and green pepper.
Saute onion and green pepper in grease.
Add tomato sauce.
Add one can of water.
Mash stewed tomatoes and add to mixture.
Break bacon into bits and add to mixture.
Add Tabasco sauce and salt to taste.
When mixture starts boiling, add shrimp and turn fire down low.
Stir constantly to keep from sticking. Cook until rice dries out.

recipes.title: Dutch Pot Roast
steps: Dredge beef in flour and brown in Dutch oven.
Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly on low heat for about 3 hours. Thicken gravy if necessary.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Boil chicken.
Pull off bones in bite size pieces.
Add broth and cream of celery soup.
Pour into a greased baking dish.
Sift flour, salt and baking powder.
Gradually add milk, then melted butter.
Pour this over chicken mixture.
Bake at 425° for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
ingredients: juice of 4 oranges or 4 c. canned orange juice
steps: Chop cranberries in processor or food chopper.
Pour 2 cups sugar over cranberries.
Add the raspberry and orange Jell-O to juice.
Add to cranberries.
Mold in pans.

recipes.title: Play Dough
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Cook and stir constantly until dough forms a ball and leaves side of pan.
Store in airtight container.
Great for children!!

recipes.title: Chocolate Cheesecake
steps: 1st Layer:
Mix first 3 ingredients.
Press in an oblong baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cabbage Roll Casserole
steps: Brown beef.
Add salt, pepper, onion, chili powder, rice, soup and water.
Cook gently for 2 or 3 minutes.
Put cabbage in casserole.
Pour meat mixture over cabbage.
Do not stir.
Bake, covered, for 2 hours at 350° or longer, if desired.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
steps: Mix cream cheese, margarine and sugar. Add eggs, vanilla and cake flour. Bake at 325° for 1 hour in a tube pan.

recipes.title: Cream Of Cheese Soup
steps: Cook carrots and celery in boiling water until tender.
Cook onion in margarine until tender, but not brown.
Stir in flour. Add milk and chicken broth.
Cook over low heat until thickened, stirring occasionally.
Makes 6 cups.

recipes.title: Laurene'S Shortbread Cookies
steps: Mix margarine with sugar.
Add vanilla, salt and flour; mix well.
Add chips, nuts and shape into balls and press flat.
Bake at 325° until light brown (approximately 13 minutes).

recipes.title: Steaks Etouffe
ingredients: 7 steaks (or 1 round steak, making 4 lb. total)
2 cans (6 oz. each) mushroom steak sauce
1 tsp. Louisiana hot sauce or 1/2 tsp. Tabasco
steps: Heat the cooking oil in a Dutch oven.
Add the meat and cover with the rest of the ingredients.
Salt and pepper to taste. Cover and let cook over low heat for 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
steps: Sift together in large mixing bowl sugar and flour.
Place in saucepan and bring to a boil butter or oleo, cocoa and water.
Pour butter mixture over flour and sugar; mix well and add buttermilk, eggs, vanilla, baking soda and cinnamon.
Mix and bake on a slightly greased 10 x 15-inch pan at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes. Before cake is done, make icing.

recipes.title: Potato Candy
steps: First, mash potato, then add flour.
Next, add powdered sugar and mix until it makes a ball of dough.
Next, take a sheet of wax paper and spread with dough.
Then spread the peanut butter out on the dough.
Roll up like a burrito.
Chill for a couple of hours, then cut in little strips.

recipes.title: Penne All'Arrabbiata(Penne With Hot Pepper And Tomatoes)
ingredients: 1/2 small red or green hot pepper, chopped
steps: Cut out tomato cores with a sharp knife.
Fill a large saucepan 2/3 full with water.
Bring water to a boil; add tomatoes.
Boil 20 to 25 seconds or until skins begin to split.
Place tomatoes in bowl of cold water.
Peel cooled tomatoes and cut in half horizontally.
Squeeze seeds and juice out of each tomato half. Dice tomatoes.
Heat oil in a large skillet.
Add hot pepper and garlic.
Saute over medium heat about 1 minute.
Before garlic changes color, add diced tomatoes.
Season with salt.
Cook, uncovered, over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in parsley and cook 1 to 2 minutes longer.
Fill a very large saucepan 2/3 full with salted water.
Bring to a boil.
Add penne.
Bring water back to a boil and cook penne, uncovered, until tender but firm to the bite (al dente) 8 to 10 minutes.
Drain penne and place in skillet with sauce.
Toss penne and sauce over medium heat until sauce coats penne, 20 to 30 seconds.
Serve immediately.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Mix peanut butter and powdered sugar together; smooth into bottom of pie shell.
Make hot pudding by mixing remaining ingredients.
Pour over filling.

recipes.title: Pistachio Torte
steps: Mix well and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Raisin Cookies
steps: Boil raisins and water 5 minutes; let cool and add baking soda.
Let stand.
Mix the rest of ingredients together.
Combine with raisins.
Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Very good and stay moist.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Sift and measure flour.
Sift again with soda and salt.
Cream shortening and sugar well.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add flavorings.
Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream.
Bake in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 325° for approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes (time will vary with individual ovens).

recipes.title: Baked Cranberry Dessert
steps: Sift dry ingredients together in mixing bowl.
Add shortening and milk.
Blend other ingredients except cranberries.
Beat 2 minutes.
Stir in cranberries.
Bake in greased 9-inch square pan at 350° for 40 minutes or until tested done.
Serve with hot butter sauce.

recipes.title: Santacafe Chile Pepper Brioche
ingredients: 1/3 c. minced, roasted and peeled fresh poblano chile, at room temperature
1/4 c. ground, minced, roasted and peeled red bell pepper, at room temperature
9 oz. unsalted butter, cut into small pieces and softened (1/2 lb. plus 2 Tbsp.)
steps: In the bowl of an electric mixer with a paddle attachment, combine the flour, sugar, yeast, salt, ground chile and black pepper.
Mix briefly on low speed.

Increase speed to medium and add the water, milk, poblano chile and bell pepper; beat well. Add the eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Change to the dough hook and knead for 3 minutes.
The dough will be very sticky.
Add the butter to the dough, one piece at a time, and continue to knead until dough is smooth and shiny and the butter is completely incorporated, 10 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: Sift together dry ingredients.
Add nuts.
Combine remaining ingredients; add to dry ingredients.
Stir only until flour is moistened.
Pour into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake 1 hour in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Kahlua Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together well with mixer; fold in chocolate chips.
Spray Bundt pan with Pam or grease and flour. Pour mixture into Bundt pan.
Bake in the oven preheated to 350° for approximately 1 hour.
After cake is cooled on serving plate, can poke holes in top with toothpick and brush on extra Kahlua.

recipes.title: Dinner Party Chicken
ingredients: 1 envelope Good Seasons Italian salad dressing mix
1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
steps: Melt margarine in large skillet.
Add salad dressing mix.
Add chicken and brown slowly until golden.
Place contents of skillet in baking dish.
Blend soup (undiluted), cream cheese and wine until smooth.
Spread over chicken.
Bake, uncovered, 1 hour at 325°.
Serve over rice.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Sawdust Salad
steps: Using a large serving bowl or 9 x 13-inch glass dish, prepare the Jell-O with the boiling water and 1 1/4 cups cold water.
Add the drained pineapple. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Pineapple Butterscotch Squares
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can Dole crushed pineapple, well drained
steps: Combine flour, baking powder and salt in small bowl; set aside. Beat together margarine, brown sugar and granulated sugar in large bowl until creamy. Add pineapple, eggs and vanilla; beat until blended. Stir in flour mixture, butterscotch and nuts until blended. Pour in 13 x 9-inch baking pan sprayed with vegetable cooking spray. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Cheese Krispies
steps: Mix all ingredients well with hands.
Roll into balls the size of a walnut.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet and press with the tines of a fork in a criss-cross pattern.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool on a cake rack. Serve at room temperature.
They freeze very well.

recipes.title: Oatmeal M&M'S
steps: Cream butter, sugars and eggs.
Add vanilla, dry ingredients and M&M's.
Bake 12 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Swiss Steak
steps: Flour and brown steaks in a pan.
Put browned steaks in a casserole dish.
Put chopped onions and cut up mushrooms on steak. Mix soups together and pour over tops of steaks.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours at 350° in a covered casserole dish.

recipes.title: Heavenly Coconut Pie
steps: In small bowl, mix flour, melted butter and 1 cup chopped pecans. Press into a 2-quart dish or 10-inch pie pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Cool. Place 1/2 cup chopped nuts in shallow pan and bake in oven with pastry until slightly browned.

recipes.title: Chewy Chocolate Brownies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 9x13 pan.
Bring sugar, butter and water to a boil.
(Microwave works well.)
Add chocolate and stir until melted.
Add eggs, vanilla and mix well.
Add dry ingredients.
Bake 16-20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out sticky.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dream Cake
ingredients: 1 c. fresh or frozen strawberries with juice
steps: Mix well and pour over cake.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Apple Pie
steps: In a large bowl, beat eggs; add sour cream.
Stir in sugar, 2 tablespoons flour, vanilla and salt; mix well.
Stir in apples. Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 375°
for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato-Bean Soup
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, peeled and cut up (about 3 c.)
1 (15 oz.) can cannellini beans or Great Northern beans, drained
1/2 c. sour cream or low-fat yogurt
steps: In a large saucepan, melt the margarine and cook the garlic, celery and carrots on medium heat for 4 minutes.
Carefully stir in broth, potatoes and dill.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 to 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Mash about 1/2 of the potatoes in the broth. Add drained beans to mixture.

recipes.title: Jewish Coffee Cake
steps: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar.
Beat eggs in one at a time. Add flour, sifted together with salt and baking powder.
Alternate with Pet milk.
Add vanilla and nuts last.
Put a thin layer of dough in a greased angel food pan and sprinkle with cinnamon mixture.
Alternate the layers of dough and cinnamon mixture until pan is filled.
Do not put cinnamon mixture on top.
Bake 60 to 70 minutes in a 350° oven or until done.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
ingredients: 1 envelope (from 2.6 oz. box) golden onion soup mix
steps: Bring water to boil in a large, deep skillet.
Stir in 1 envelope golden onion soup mix and skinned chicken thighs.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in white converted rice and vegetables.
Cover again and cook 20 minutes or until rice is tender, the liquid is absorbed and the chicken is no longer pink near the bone.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Delight
steps: Make crust from first 3 ingredients.
Mix and put in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Cool well.
Mix Cool Whip, cream cheese and powdered sugar together.
Spread on crust.
Mix pudding and milk, cook until thick.
Let cool; pour over cream cheese mixture.
Toast coconut, sprinkle over top and let chill.

recipes.title: Ultimate Chip Cookies
steps: Cream first 4 ingredients.
Add eggs.
Mix flour, salt and soda; add gradually.
Blend well.
Stir in 2 cups each chips and pecans.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes for chewy, 11 to 13 minutes for crisp.
Makes 6 dozen (3-inch) cookies.

recipes.title: Saucy Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 c. water or white wine or combination of both
3 1/2 lb. chicken breasts, cut into serving size pieces
steps: In a glass 9 x 13-inch pan, combine soup mix, dressing and liquid.
Mix well.
Place chicken pieces in sauce.
Turn to coat each piece.
Cover.
Microwave 9 1/2 minutes per pound at 70% power.
Rearrange chicken piece halfway through cooking time.
Let stand 3 to 5 minutes, covered.
Serve with rice, buttered noodles or stuffing.

recipes.title: Beef Rounds
steps: Cut round steak into thin strips.
Cut onions into chunks. Wrap round steak around onion chunk, then wrap with a piece of bacon.
Secure with a toothpick.
Brown on all sides.
Make broth with bouillon cube and simmer for 1 hour.
Use tongs to pick up.

recipes.title: Baked Spanish Rice(6 Servings)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In 12-inch skillet, over medium heat, fry bacon crisp; drain on paper towels.
Crumble and set aside.

recipes.title: Peanut Blossoms
steps: Combine all ingredients, except candy, in large bowl.
Mix until dough forms.
Shape dough into balls, using a rounded teaspoonful for each.
Roll balls in sugar.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Top each cookie immediately with a candy kiss; press firmly so cookie cracks around edge.
Return to oven for 4 to 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
steps: Cream sugar and eggs. Add oil and zucchini. Sift and add dry ingredients. Add vanilla. Cook in Bundt pan at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: In a large bowl, combine pancake mix, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, cloves, pumpkin, oil, milk and eggs.
Beat 3 minutes at medium speed.
Stir in walnuts and turn batter into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Remove from pan and cool. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Welsh Rabbit
ingredients: 1 c. grated American or nippy spreading cheese
steps: Melt butter, add flour and blend.
Add milk and cook over low heat until thick, stirring constantly.
Add cheese and stir over low heat until melted.
Add seasonings.
Serve over hot toast or crackers.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Bohemian Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck pot roast (2 to 3 lb.)
1 (14 1/2 oz.) can tomatoes with liquid, chopped
steps: Combine flour and pepper; dredge pot roast.
In a Dutch oven, brown roast in oil.
Drain.
Add water, tomatoes, caraway seed, onion soup mix and bay leaves.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover tightly and simmer for 2 to 3 hours or until roast is tender.
Remove to a warm platter.
Discard bay leaves.

recipes.title: Fried Okra
steps: Slice okra into 1/4-inch slices.
Wash okra in cold water. Mix cornmeal, flour, salt and pepper together.
Roll okra in cornmeal mix.
Fry in hot skillet for 10 minutes until golden brown.
Drain on paper towel.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Pickled Eggs
steps: Bring beet juice, white vinegar and sugar to a boil.
Cool before adding beets and eggs.
Start eggs with cold water.
Bring to a rolling boil.
Turn stove off and let eggs set in water for 20 minutes.
Run cold water over eggs and peel.
Eggs will pickle overnight.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: In bowl, combine dry ingredients.
Stir in eggs and bananas. Add melted shortening and nuts.
Pour into greased loaf pan and bake 45 to 60 minutes in 325° oven.

recipes.title: Mocha Brownies
ingredients: 1 c. coarsely chopped pecans or walnuts
steps: In a small heavy saucepan, melt chocolate with butter or margarine over low heat; cool.
Combine next 3 ingredients; set aside.
Beat eggs and sugar at medium speed until light.
Beat in chocolate mixture and vanilla extract.
Stir in flour mixture, cracker crumbs and nuts.
Pour into a greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in a preheated 350° oven 40 to 45 minutes.
Glaze while hot. When cold, cut into squares using a sharp knife.
Makes 25 brownies.

recipes.title: Good Friday Rice
steps: Saute onions in butter until golden and limp.
Add rice and saute until golden.
Pour in cans of broth and mix well.
Bake in a 2-quart casserole at 350° for approximately 40 to 45 minutes or until liquid is absorbed (microwave approximately 15 minutes).

recipes.title: Cherry Coconut Bars
steps: Combine flour, confectioners sugar and margarine. Press into a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: No-Knead Dinner Rolls
steps: Soften yeast in 1 cup warm water.
Cream sugar and shortening together.
Add boiling water, mixing well, with mixer at medium speed.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Mix salt and flour together and add to the batter alternately with the yeast.
Cover and let rise in a warm place 1 hour.
Turn out on a floured surface and pat into a large rectangle.
Cut into rounds with a biscuit cutter or floured glass; dip both sides in melted butter and place in baking pans.
Cover and let rise an additional hour.
Preheat oven to 425°.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until nicely browned.
Makes about 48 rolls.

recipes.title: Perfect Pie Crust
steps: Mix flour, salt and sugar in a large bowl.
Add shortening and mix until crumbly.
In small bowl, beat together water, vinegar and egg.
Combine the 2 mixtures until all ingredients are moistened.
Divide dough into 5 portions and shape into flat, round patties ready for rolling.
Wrap each patty in plastic wrap and chill at least 1/2 hour.
When ready to roll, lightly flour both sides of patty and roll on lightly floured surface.
For shells, bake at 450°.
Will keep 3 days in refrigerator.
Makes 2 double and 1 single crust or 20 tart shells.

recipes.title: Chicken And Andouille Smoked Sausage Gumbo
ingredients: 1 c. finely chopped green bell peppers
1/2 lb. andouille smoked sausage or any other good sausage
steps: Remove excess fat from chicken.
Rub with salt, garlic powder and red pepper.
Let stand 30 minutes.
Combine onions, bell peppers and celery in a medium bowl; set aside.
Combine flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder and 1/2 teaspoon red pepper in paper or plastic bag.
Add chicken pieces and shake until chicken is coated.
Reserve 1/2 cup of the flour.

recipes.title: Chow Chow
steps: Peel onions and cucumbers.
If cucumbers are large, remove the seeds.
Slice tomatoes thin.
Chop onions, cucumbers and peppers small.
Cut cauliflower into small pieces.
Soak vegetables overnight in brine made of 1 cup salt to 1 quart water. Stir and mix well.
Next day, drain well.

recipes.title: Hamburger-Meat-Rice-Tomato Sauce Pie
steps: Combine ingredients; mix well.
Put into greased 9-inch pie plate.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
steps: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a large greased iron skillet or a 11 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Zesty Sauerkraut
steps: Saute onion and pepper in butter.
Broil bacon and crumble. Rinse sauerkraut and place in baking dish.
Add the beer, molasses and mustard to onions, peppers and bacon.
Cook and stir for 3 minutes.
Pour over sauerkraut and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Ratatouille
ingredients: 1 sweet green pepper, sliced into rings
4 medium fresh or canned tomatoes, peeled and sliced
steps: Heat oil in heavy duty saucepan, add garlic, onion, eggplant, zucchini and green pepper; saute vegetables until they are barely tender.
Add seasoning, mixing well.
Add tomatoes and simmer until tender, about 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: California Blend Casserole
steps: Combine all ingredients and top with onions.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Rum Nut Swirl Brownies
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 8-inch square baking pan.
In medium bowl, stir butter, sugar and cocoa until blended.
Add vanilla and eggs; beat with spoon until blended.
Add flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat with spoon until well blended.
Spread half of batter into prepared pan.
Gently spread Rum Nut Swirl over batter.
Spoon remaining chocolate batter over top.
With spatula or knife, cut through batters to marble.
Bake for 25 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 325°.
Continue to bake for 10 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan.
Cool completely in pan on wire rack.
Cut into 20 bars and serve warm.

recipes.title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
steps: Combine all ingredients. Form into 1 1/2-inch balls. Bake on cookie sheet at 350° for about 10 to 15 minutes until set. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

recipes.title: Lucky Cake 1-2-3
ingredients: 2 pkg. butter pecan instant pudding mix
steps: First Layer:
Mix first 3 ingredients and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Buttermilk Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter and shortening.
Gradually add sugar, beating well at medium speed.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
Dissolve soda in buttermilk.
Combine flour and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture.
Stir in flavorings.
Bake in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Wild Rice With Mushrooms And Onions
steps: In a 3-quart lidded saucepan, bring 6 cups of water to a boil. Add salt and the wild rice.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes.
Add the converted rice, mushrooms and onion to the pot without stirring.
Cover and continue cooking another 5 minutes. Do not remove the lid.
Let the rice sit for 5 minutes after finishing the cooking.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
steps: In a covered skillet, cook cabbage leaves in boiling water. Drain and set aside.
In same skillet, heat margarine over medium heat.
Add onion; cook until tender.
Add tomato sauce, sugar, 1 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper; mix well and set aside.
In large bowl, combine remaining ingredients; divide into 12 equal portions.
Place 1 portion in center of each cabbage leaf.
Fold leaf sides toward center, then from one edge roll up leaf.
Place in sauce in skillet, seam side down.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Filete Steak Salteado
steps: In deep fryer or Dutch oven, heat vegetable oil to 350°.
Fry potatoes in hot oil until brown, about 10 minutes; drain on paper towels.
Cut meat into cubes.
In large skillet, heat olive oil; brown meat on all sides.
Add remaining ingredients except wine. Heat thoroughly; add wine just before serving.
Serve over white or yellow rice.

recipes.title: Brownie Cake
steps: Sift together flour, sugar and salt.
Set aside.
Bring to boil the water and margarine.
Stir liquid ingredients into flour mixture and add eggs, buttermilk, baking soda and vanilla.
