Bake at 350° for 20 minutes on cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Split Seconds
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add vanilla and egg.
Blend well. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level off.
Stir in flour and baking powder.
Mix well. Divide dough int 4 equal parts.
On lightly floured surface, shape each part into 12 x 3/4-inch roll.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.

Using handle of wooden spoon or finger, make a depression about 1/2-inch wide and 1/4-inch deep lengthwise down center of each roll. Fill each roll with 2 tablespoons of jelly. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown. Cool slightly. Cut diagonally into bars.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Manicotti
steps: Cook sausage links in Dutch oven until brown.
Drain in paper toweling and remove fat from pan.
Brown ground beef and onion well; stir in tomato puree, paste, sugar, pepper, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon salt and 1 cup water.
Simmer, covered, for 45 minutes. Cut sausage into bite-size pieces and add to mixture.
Cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In the meantime, cook manicotti as label directs; drain in colander.
Preheat oven to 375°.

recipes.title: Red Beans And Rice
ingredients: lean white bacon or ham bone
steps: Soak beans overnight. Cook rice and set aside. Drain off old water from beans and add fresh water. Add meat and cook until beans are tender. Add seasoning and serve over rice.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
steps: Boil red potatoes with skins on.
Peel after cooked and set aside.
Fry bacon until crisp.
Drain on paper towel.
Reserve 2 to 3 tablespoons drippings of bacon grease.
Crumble the bacon. Saute onion in bacon grease until tender.
Blend in flour slowly, then stir in vinegar and water.
Cook until mixture boils and becomes thicker.
Add sugar, salt and pepper; simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Different Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 (2 1/2 or 3 lb.) chicken, cooked and boned
steps: Put boned chicken in casserole.
Put chopped celery over chicken.
Pour melted oleo over chicken and celery.
Mix flour and dry ingredients with the milk.
Pour flour mixture over chicken. Mix cream of celery soup with 1/4 cup chicken stock.
Pour over chicken.
Bake at 425° for 50 minutes.
Serve with green beans and corn.

recipes.title: "Carolina Housewife" Wedding Cake Of 1850
steps: Add cloves to your taste.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cookies
steps: Place on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Bread
steps: Peel apples and slice thinly.
Add sugar and cinnamon; stir and let sit.
Beat eggs until light and foamy.
Add sugar and beat well until light.
Add oil in 2 parts, beating well.
Add vanilla. Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Add to egg and sugar mixture.
Stir in orange juice.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen spinach, thawed and well drained
steps: Mix all ingredients together and let stand at least one hour before using so that flavors blend together.
Best served by purchasing round loaf of bread of your choice, rye, sourdough, Italian, etc.
Cut out center to form bowl.
Place dip in bread bowl.
Cut bread which was taken from center of loaf into cubes and use to dip along with cut up vegetables of your choice.

recipes.title: Bacon And Cheddar Dip
ingredients: 1 oz. packet original Ranch party dip
steps: Mix packet of dip and sour cream. Add cheese and bacon bits. Mix well. Chill 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Mini Cheese Cakes
steps: Mix cream cheese, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Grease nut tassie tins and flour with graham cracker crumbs.
Fill 3/4 full with cream cheese mixture.
Bake at 350° for approximately 15 minutes. Makes about 3 dozen.
After cheese cakes cool, drop cherry or blueberry filling in center.

recipes.title: Mississippi Mud Cake
steps: Mix together and bake at 350° in an 8 x 12-inch pan (2-quart size) for 30 minutes.
Spread 1 1/2 cups small marshmallows over warm cake until they melt.
Pour chocolate sauce over and let stand 2 hours.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: At medium speed on mixer beat oil and sugar; beat until light and fluffy.
Add eggs and then dry ingredients, mixing well after each addition.
Stir in bananas and nuts.
Bake at 350° in greased loaf pan until done or 35 minutes.
Let cool 20 minutes before turning onto cooling rack.

recipes.title: Supreme Chicken
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1 (8 oz.) can mushroom pieces and stems (undrained)
steps: Bone and skin chicken.
Stir rice, chicken soup, broth and mushrooms together and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with boned chicken and sprinkle with dry onion soup mix. Cover and bake 1 hour at 400°.

recipes.title: New Year'S Cookies
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water; add warmed milk, margarine and cream.
Add salt and beaten eggs, then flour and floured raisins.
Let rise 30 minutes to 1 hour and fry in hot fat. Drop by tablespoons in hot fat.
Drain on paper towels and glaze after they have cooled.
Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Apple Chop Suey
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients and add next 4 ingredients.
Using a 9 x 9-inch pan, bake in 350° oven for about 45 minutes.
Top with Cool Whip.
Serves 9.

recipes.title: Fish And Cheese Chowder
steps: Cut fish in 1-inch cubes.
Melt butter in large saucepan.
Add onion, carrot and celery.
Cook until onion is transparent.
Blend in flour, salt and paprika.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add chicken broth and milk.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add fish; simmer until fish flakes easily (5 minutes for fresh, 10 for frozen).
Add cheese; stir until melted. Serve hot.
Yields 2 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
steps: Drain asparagus, reserving 1/2 cup liquid.
Combine the margarine, flour, salt, asparagus liquid, milk and cheese to make a cheese sauce.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix together flour and sugar.
In pan boil water, cocoa and butter.
Pour this mixture over flour and sugar.
Add eggs, buttermilk and vanilla.
Bake at 350 for 30 minutes in a 13 x 9 pan.

recipes.title: Mom'S Egg Noodles
ingredients: 1/16 tsp. baking powder (I just take a pinch in my fingers)
steps: Beat eggs, salt and baking powder together good.
Then add flour to make a stiff dough.
Flour linen table cloth and sprinkle with flour.
Put dough on floured table cloth and knead until smooth.
Roll out on cloth and let dry.
When dry, fold in half, then in half again until a narrow roll.
Then slice to desired thickness.
Cook in roast or chicken broth.

recipes.title: French Roll Pizzas(Snack Or Meal)
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) block Cheddar cheese or preferred cheese
sourdough bread rolls, cut in half the longway
steps: Mix all ingredients together and let sit to blend.
Spread on sourdough bread halves.
Bake in oven at 325° until cheese is melted and bread is crispy.

recipes.title: Grilled Corn
steps: Strip husks down to the end of the cob, but do not tear off. Remove silk.
If desired, soak in salted ice water to which 1/2 cup milk has been added for about 20 minutes; drain well.
Brush with softened butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bring husks up around the corn.
Wrap each ear securely in a double thickness of aluminum foil.
Twist the ends well.
Barbecue on briquets 10 minutes, turning once.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Mix flour, sugar, salt and baking powder together in a bowl. Add egg, milk and oil.
Mix, then add blueberries.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
(I double the recipe.)

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
steps: Combine cocoa, sugar, flour and boiling water.
Cook until thick, approximately 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add a pinch of salt, butter and vanilla.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Arrange apples in well-greased baking dish.
Blend remaining ingredients to form a coarse texture.
Spread evenly over apples. Sprinkle water over mixture.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients well.
Sift the dry ingredients and stir in.
Roll into balls the size of small walnuts.
Roll into sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
(These cookies puff up at first, then flatten out.)
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Cornbread Salad
ingredients: 1 pan cornbread, baked, cooled and crumbled
steps: Chop vegetables fine and add to crumbled cornbread.
Toss with 1/2 large bottle buttermilk dressing.
Store in refrigerator. (Keeps well up to 1 week.)

recipes.title: Lemon Chess Pie
steps: Combine sugar, flour and meal in a large bowl.
Toss lightly with a fork.
Add remaining ingredients; beat with rotary or electric mixer until smooth and thoroughly blended.
Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell and bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350° or until top is golden brown.

recipes.title: Creamed Tuna On Patty Shells
ingredients: 1 small can mushrooms, drained or fresh ones
steps: Melt margarine; add flour and pour in milk slowly until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper and whisk in cream and egg yolk.
Add tuna, mushrooms and peas and serve over patty shells. Garnish top with parsley.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless breasts, cooked and chopped in bite size pieces
steps: Cook noodles according to package; drain.
In baking dish, stir together (gently) the noodles, broccoli, chicken, onion and mushrooms.
In a bowl, stir together the soup, milk, cheese, salt and pepper (reserve 1/2 cup
cheese).
Stir all into noodle mixture.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 40 minutes.
Sprinkle reserved cheese and paprika over all and return to oven for 10 minutes (or until cheese melts).
Contains 290 calories per serving and 11 grams fat.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 medium size cans pork and beans
steps: Fry bacon and then saute chopped onion in bacon grease.
Add beans, Ro-Tel and brown sugar.
Bake at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish until bubbly, about 45 minutes.
Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
steps: Wipe chicken breasts with paper towels.
Sprinkle each half with a portion of the salt, pepper and Accent.
Place the pancake mix in a paper sack, then coat each piece of chicken with mix by shaking up and down vigorously.
Heat the oil in a suitable skillet; brown each piece of chicken on both sides.
Cook the rice according to directions.
Stir the soup and half and half cream into the cooked rice.
Put soup and rice mixture into a buttered casserole, then put chicken on top.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Potatoes Baked In Cheese Sauce
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan.
Add flour and stir until smooth. Add catsup, paprika and salt.
Add milk gradually; then add grated cheese.
Cut raw or cooked potatoes in thin slices.
Place alternate layer of potatoes and pepper in a baking dish.
Cover with sauce and repeat until all is used.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix the sugar, cocoa, margarine and milk together in a saucepan; bring to a boil.
Boil for 1 minute, then remove from heat.
Add peanut butter and stir until dissolved.
Add flavoring. Next add oatmeal and beat mixture like fudge.
Drop by teaspoon on wax paper and let set.

recipes.title: Broccoli Bake
steps: Thaw broccoli in boiling water, then add remaining ingredients. Mix. Pour in casserole.
Top with 1 stick melted oleo.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Bonnie'S Pound Cake
steps: Cream
butter
and
sugar.
Add
flour alternately with eggs. Bake in loaf pans at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Famous Amos Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Beat softened margarine, brown and white sugars, vanilla, water and eggs in a large bowl with electric mixer until creamy and thoroughly blended.
Preheat oven to moderate 375°.
By hand, stir in flour, baking soda and salt until well mixed.
Stir in chocolate pieces.

recipes.title: Coke Cake
steps: Heat Coca-Cola, butter and cocoa to boiling; mix rest of ingredients and add to mixture; batter will be thin with marshmallows floating. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in 350° oven for 35 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool.

recipes.title: Spinach Roll-Ups
ingredients: 2 pkg. chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
steps: Mix together.
Heat tortillas as directed.
Spread evenly on tortillas and roll up.
Chill 3 hours before serving.
Slice into 1-inch pieces.

recipes.title: Maple Nut Bars
steps: Cream oleo until soft; add powdered sugar gradually and beat until creamy.
Add egg, maple syrup and soda.
Mix in flour.
Add nuts.
Pour into an 8 x 8-inch greased pan.
(I had to use a pan much smaller than this size.)
Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes. Cut into squares while warm and roll in powdered sugar.
I put maple icing and walnuts on mine on top.

recipes.title: Cocoa Mayo Cake
steps: Melt mayonnaise and sugar.
Add part of sifted flour and dry ingredients, then the water.
Mix well.
Add remaining flour and vanilla.
Mix well.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Rice Pudding
steps: Slightly beat eggs with sugar, salt and vanilla.
Gradually add hot milk, to eggs; stir in rice.
Pour into baking dish.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and set dish in pan of hot water.
Bake in 325° oven until set, about 40 minutes.
Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Grape Pie
steps: Pop middle out of grape skins; save skins.
Put pulp (middles) in saucepan and bring to a boil.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Put hot pulp through colander or food mill to remove seeds.
Combine strained pulp with skins.
Add sugar, flour and salt.
Pour into unbaked crust.
Dot with margarine.
Add top crust with slits, lattice or circular cut outs on top of pie.
Bake at 425° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Delight
steps: Combine dry ingredients.
Make center in mixture.
Add vanilla, vinegar and oil.
Gradually stir in water until well blended.
Pour into 8-inch square greased pan.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: King Ranch Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken breasts or 1 chicken boiled, boned and skinned
steps: Cut chicken into bite size pieces and mix all ingredients together, except tortillas, and spices to taste.
Put a bit of the chicken grease from cooking the chicken in the bottom of a large casserole dish.
Start with tortillas, then alternate chicken mixture, then tortillas.
End up with the chicken mixture on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Brownies
steps: Place eggs and sugar in mixer.
Put on slow.
Add butter and melted chocolate.
Scrape down. Remove and mix flour by hand; add vanilla and pecans.
Put into greased sheet pan and bake at 350° until slightly firm to the hand, about 30 to 40 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
steps: Have eggs, butter and milk at room temperature.
Combine sugar, a cup at a time, to the softened butter until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Sift flour four times and add to creamed mixture, 1/2 cup at a time, beating well after each.
Stir in milk and flavorings.
Pour in well-greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Dilly Casserole
steps: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water.
Heat cottage cheese to lukewarm.
Combine cottage cheese, next 7 ingredients and yeast in large bowl; mix well.
Add enough flour to make stiff dough.
Let rise, covered, in warm place for 1 hour or until double in bulk. Stir dough down.

recipes.title: Play Dough Recipe
steps: Do not double or halve this recipe.
Measure flour and salt into a large bowl.
Add only 1 cup of water to the dry ingredients.
Mix thoroughly with your fingers, adding more water if necessary to make the dough the consistency of pie crust. Remove the dough from the bowl and knead for 4 or 5 minutes on wax paper.
Store in tight container until used.

recipes.title: Lazy Daisy Oatmeal Cake
steps: Pour 1 1/4 cups boiling water over oats.
Let set 20 minutes. Cream oleo, brown sugar, white sugar, vanilla and eggs.
Then add oats; mix well.
Pour into 9-inch square greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.
Do not remove from pan until frosting has been put on.

recipes.title: Cheese Sticks
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, pepper and cheese.
Cut in butter and mix until smooth. Roll 1/3-inch thick. Cut 6 x 1/2-inch.
Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.
Makes 24.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Mix all ingredients together except raisins.
Bake in glass dish at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
If desired, add raisins for the last half hour of baking.

recipes.title: French Coconut Pie
steps: Mix all together.
Pour into shell and bake for 35 minutes at 250°.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Loaf
steps: Mix together and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Mix all ingredients. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13 baking dish. Bake at 350° until set.

recipes.title: Shrimp Boats(Appetizer)
steps: Combine shrimp, eggs, celery salt, salt and pepper.
Combine mayonnaise with cream.
Fold into shrimp mixture.
Spread shrimp mixture between bread slices.
Cut into halves, diagonally. Fasten corners with wooden picks.
Place on cookie sheet; broil 4-inches from source of heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until bread is toasted.
Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
steps: In a mixing bowl, blend together the flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add raisins, caraway seeds, egg and buttermilk. Stir until blended. Knead on floured board until smooth. Shape dough into 2 balls and place each in a greased 8-inch round cake pan. Flatten to fill pans. Cut a deep cross in the top of each loaf. Bake at 375° for about 40 minutes or until done. Slice and serve with butter. Yield: 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Ha'Penny Snacks
steps: Let butter and cheese come to room temperature and mix thoroughly.
Add remaining ingredients and blend.
Shape into about 3 rolls, 1-inch in diameter.
Wrap in wax paper and chill. Slice rolls into slices 1/4-inch thick.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until slightly browned on edges.
Keeps well in airtight container.
Yields 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Melt butter and bake chicken breasts in large casserole dish. Remove skin and bones; cut chicken in bite-size pieces.
Combine butter, chicken and remaining ingredients in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Russian Eggs
steps: Beat eggs and season to taste.
Simmer pepper and onion rings until tender-crisp.
Line well-oiled 9 x 12-inch pan with bread slices.
Cover bread with meat and layer vegetables (except tomatoes) over meat.
Pour eggs over all.
Press down.
Let stand overnight.

recipes.title: Cheese Wafer
steps: Combine butter, cheese and nuts. Mix well and add flour. Shape into log and cut into wafers. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. Baker's German's sweet chocolate
steps: Melt chocolate in boiling water.
Cool.
Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.
Add yolks, 1 at a time, beating well after each.
Blend in vanilla and chocolate.
Sift flour with soda and salt; add alternately with buttermilk to chocolate mixture, beating after each addition until smooth.
Fold in beaten whites. Pour into three 9-inch layer pans, lined on bottom with wax paper. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Frosted Orange Pie
steps: In a saucepan, combine sugar, flour and salt; gradually add water.
Cook and stir over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes or until thickened and bubbly.
Remove from heat.
Gradually stir 1/2 C. into egg yolks; return all to pan.
Bring to a gentle boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes.
Remove from the heat; stir in orange and lemon peel.
Gently stir in juices.
Pour into pastry shell. Cool on a wire rack for 1 hour.
Chill at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Banana Energy Bars
steps: Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg, salt and bananas.
Stir in remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Pesto Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast with sugar in 1/4 cup water.
Let set for 5 minutes to proof.
In large bowl, mix 2 cups flour with yeast mixture together; add remaining water and flour as needed.
Mix by hand or electric mixer with dough hook.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Put in greased bowl to rise.
When doubled in size, punch down and divide into 2 balls.
Roll dough into rectangle (12 x 8).
Spread with pesto mixture, roll up and place on baking sheet that has been spread with corn meal.
Let rise again.
Bake at 375° until lightly browned and hollow sounding to touch.
Let cool and feast.

recipes.title: Bacon Cheddar Muffins
steps: Spray muffin pan with Pam.
In a large bowl, mix flour, cheese, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Set aside.
In a small bowl, mix egg, milk and oil.
Add to flour mixture.
Stir until moist.
Batter will be lumpy.
Fold in the crumbled bacon.
Fill the muffin cups even with the top.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until muffins are golden.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Cream Puffs
steps: Combine butter, salt and water.
Heat to boiling.
Add flour to boiling mixture all at once.
Beat vigorously until mixture leaves sides of saucepan and does not cling to spoon.
Remove from heat. Cool slightly.
Add unbeaten one egg at a time.
Beat thoroughly after the addition of each egg until mixture is smooth.
Drop by tablespoon into well oiled muffin tin or onto baking sheet 2-inches apart.
Shape mixture into rounds and pile slightly in the center. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Lower heat to 350° for 10 minutes until firm and dry.
Remove from oven.
Cool.
Cut a slit in the side of each with a sharp knife.
Insert cream filling, sweetened whipped cream or fruit.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Makes 12 average size puffs.

recipes.title: Favorite Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease bottoms and sides of 12 medium muffin tins.
Beat egg; stir in milk and oil.
Mix in remaining ingredients just until flour is moistened.
Batter should be lumpy.
Fill muffin cups
2/3 full.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Immediately remove from pan.
If using self-rising flour, omit baking powder and salt.

recipes.title: Country Ham Butter
ingredients: 1 c. minced baked country ham, firmly packed and free of fat
steps: Combine this and process in food processor until perfectly smooth.
Chill. Serve on biscuits, buttered toast or crackers.

recipes.title: Apple Crisps
steps: Arrange apples in a buttered 8-inch square pan.
Combine oats, sugar, flour and cinnamon.
Cut butter into mixture until crumbly. Sprinkle this mixture evenly over apple slices.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
Yummy.

recipes.title: Batter For Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. cayenne pepper (only if you like spicy)
steps: Shake all ingredients in Ziploc bag.
Batter chicken and fry. Refrigerate leftover batter in Ziploc bag for future use.
This may remind you of the Colonel's chicken (just a little).

recipes.title: Glazed Raisin-Cinnamon Biscuits
steps: Mix all ingredients until dough forms, about 20 strokes.
Turn into a floured board. Shape into a ball and knead 10 times.
Roll to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut with 2 1/2-inch cutter.
Bake on a greased cookie sheet at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Spread with Vanilla Glaze while warm (see Miscellaneous for Vanilla Glaze).

recipes.title: Chocolate Apple Spice Cake
ingredients: 2 apples, peeled, cored and finely chopped
steps: Cream butter with sugar; beat in eggs, then water.
In separate bowl sift flour, cocoa, baking soda, cinnamon and nutmeg. Beat into creamed ingredients along with vanilla, chocolate morsels and apples.
Turn into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.
Cool thoroughly before slicing. May be topped with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. raw rice (Minute rice), cooked and salted
1 lb. Velveeta cheese or any kind you like best
steps: Saute broccoli, onions and celery in butter.
Mix all ingredients, except rice.
Put rice in bottom of buttered casserole dish.
Put mixture on top.
Sprinkle paprika on top (for looks).
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Olive Cheese Balls
steps: Combine all ingredients (except olives).
Put 1 teaspoon around each olive.
Be sure olive is covered.
Cover with Saran Wrap and chill (minimum 1 1/2 hours).
Bake in 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Pie
steps: Boil chicken and pull off bone.
Chop chicken and layer in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour chicken broth over chicken.
Spread chicken soup (undiluted) over chicken and broth.
Melt margarine and combine with flour and milk.
Spread mixture on top of other layers and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 12 (3-inch) muffin pan cups. Cream the butter, shortening and sugar together.
Beat in the eggs, salt and nutmeg.
Stir in the flour alternately with the milk until the mixture is just combined.
Fill the muffin cups full.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
steps: Fry bacon ends.
Saute onion and green pepper in 3 tablespoons of bacon fat in a large skillet until tender.
Add all other ingredients.
Cook slowly, covered, approximately 45 minutes. Sprinkle crumbled bacon ends on top and serve.
Makes
6 servings.

recipes.title: Mama'S Pound Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients by hand until moist.
Beat on medium speed for 5 minutes.
Scrape sides of bowl and beat 5 more minutes.
Put in cold oven.
Do not preheat!
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Sauteed Shrimp And Mushrooms
ingredients: 1.5 lb. or larger jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Slice mushrooms into 2 or 3 pieces each.
Melt butter in a large skillet; add mushrooms.
Cook on low heat or high simmer 30 minutes uncovered (until most of the water has cooked out).
Add garlic, salt and pepper.
Stir and add shrimp.
Cook covered 5 to 7 minutes, until shrimp are done.
Stir occasionally.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Mrs. Tran'S Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 small onion, peeled and finely chopped
steps: Scramble eggs in butter and set aside.
In wok or large frypan over medium heat, saute onion in oil until transparent.
Add vegetables, and cook, stirring for 3 minutes.
Add sugar, fish sauce and soy sauce and mix well.
Add rice and cook about 5 minutes, stirring frequently until all food is hot.
Chop up scrambled eggs; mix in and serve.

recipes.title: Dream Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Beat until fluffy.
Add vanilla and then stir in flour, baking powder, salt and nuts.
Mix until smooth.
Form small balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press down with a fork.
Bake in slow oven at 300° for 20 minutes or until light brown.
Makes about 75.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Cheese Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded processed American cheese
6 medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
steps: In saucepan melt butter.
Add flour, salt and pepper.
Cook and stir until a thick paste forms.
Gradually add milk.
Cook and stir until mixture begins to thicken.
Add cheese.
Cook and stir until melted.
Place potatoes in a greased 13 x 9-inch dish.
Pour sauce over and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken Or Turkey Strudel
steps: In large bowl of electric mixer (or by hand), beat cheese and butter until smooth.
Gradually add flour mixed with salt and herbs.
When dough holds together, form into a ball, wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Carrot And Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 1 lb. carrots, scraped and cut 1/2 thick
1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes with liquid, cut tomatoes up
steps: Put all ingredients in a large pot and start cooking at high heat, then reduce heat to medium-high heat when it begins to boil. Cook, covered, until carrots are tender, but not too soft.
Then serve over rice or plain.

recipes.title: Cake That Won'T Last
steps: Mix by hand in large bowl.
When well blended, pour into greased and floured angel food or Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
Do not open door of oven first hour of baking time.

recipes.title: Chiffon Cake
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Make a well in middle.
Add oil, egg yolks, water, orange and lemon extract; beat. In another bowl, beat egg whites with cream of tartar until whites form stiff peaks.
Pour egg yolk mixture over beaten whites, folding until blended.
(Do not stir).
Pour into pan, bake 55 minutes until light brown.

recipes.title: Coconut Cream Pie
steps: Mix flour and sugar. Pour in milk and stir. Add butter. Cook on low heat. Beat egg yolks. Pour in mixture. Stir while cooking and cook until almost done. Add vanilla and coconut to mixture. Remove from heat. Pour slightly thickened mixture into baked pie crust. Top with beaten egg whites and sugar. Sprinkle coconut on top. Bake for 10 minutes at 450°.

recipes.title: Apple Coffee Cake
ingredients: 4 c. sliced apples, sprinkled with sugar; set aside
steps: Mix eggs, brown sugar, vanilla and oil, then add cinnamon, flour, baking soda and salt.
Add to apples and nut mixture.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Use a 9 x 13-inch glass Pyrex dish.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
ingredients: 1 c. frozen strawberries, thaw and drain
steps: Mix cake mix and Jell-O thoroughly; add oil and water.
Blend well and add eggs, one at a time.
Beat according to package (cake mix) directions.
Fold in coconut, nuts and thawed, drained strawberries.
Pour batter into tube (greased and floured) or 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake according to cake mix directions at 350° (maybe less).

recipes.title: Fried Cheese Balls
steps: Combine the cheese, flour, salt and cayenne pepper.
Using your hands, gently stir in egg whites.
Pat the mixture into small balls and roll them in cracker crumbs.
Heat oil in skillet.
When hot, put the balls in the pan without crowding them.
Cover over medium-high heat, turning so all sides become golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Razorback Burgoo
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 lb. boneless veal, cut into 1-inch cubes
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in large Dutch oven.
Bring to boil; cover and reduce heat.
Simmer 2 hours or until meat is tender.
Remove meat from broth; cool.
Skin, bone and chop chicken.
Skim off and discard fat from broth.
Measure broth and return 3 quarts to Dutch oven.
Add chopped meats and remaining ingredients.
Bring to boil; reduce heat.
Simmer, uncovered 4 hours, stirring frequently.
Add additional broth or water if necessary.
Remove red pepper.
Double for after the game.

recipes.title: Easy Rice Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Coconut Macaroons
steps: Mix together flour, sugar and salt.
Beat till stiff egg whites.
Fold in dry ingredients, vanilla and coconut.
Drop on greased sheet.
Bake at 325° for 20-25 mins.
If doubled, will make approx. 40.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
steps: Mix all at once.
Pour in 10 x 14-inch greased pan.
Bake 30 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Chop washed broccoli and drain on paper towels.
Add onions. Crumble bacon.
Reserve 1/4 cup and add to broccoli.
Add Ranch dressing and mix well.
Top with remaining bacon bits.

recipes.title: White Bread(Quick Method)
steps: Scald milk.
Add sugar and salt; cool to lukewarm.
Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water and add to milk.
Add half of flour and beat until smooth.
Add melted shortening and remaining flour or enough to make easy handled dough.
Knead quickly and lightly until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in greased bowl, cover and set in a warm place.
Let rise until double in bulk, divide into 4 equal portions and shape into loaves.
Place in greased loaf pans. Bake in 425° oven for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° for 30 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Walnut Broccoli
steps: Cook broccoli until barely tender.
Drain and put in casserole dish.
Melt the 1/2 cup butter and add the flour.
Remove from heat and add bouillon.
Gradually add milk.
Return to heat and cook until smooth and boiling.
Pour over broccoli.
Heat the 3/4 cup water and 6 tablespoons butter.
Add the stuffing and walnuts. Sprinkle over broccoli and bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Better Than Sex Cake
ingredients: 1 large and 1 small box instant chocolate pudding
steps: Combine the first 3 ingredients.
Place on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes until lightly browned.
Cool.

recipes.title: No-Mix Blackberry Cobbler
steps: Stir together berries and 1/2 cup sugar.
Melt margarine in casserole dish.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt and rest of sugar. Add milk and mix well.
Pour batter into dish with margarine.
Do not mix.
Put berries and sugar over batter; do not mix.
Bake 50 minutes in preheated 350° oven.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
steps: Mix all together.
Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes in large tube pan, greased and floured, at 350°.

recipes.title: Mother'S Brownies
steps: Melt together the bitter chocolate with the stick of butter. Mix the eggs, sugar, flour, vanilla and coffee.
Blend the mixture with the chocolate and butter.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts or marshmallow bits, M&M's or other small edible bits.
Bake about 20 minutes in a 350° oven in an 8 x 14-inch pan.
Test with toothpick for slight moistness.
Refrigerate immediately.
(This keeps them moist.)
Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Corn Tomato Chowder
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. or 1 (No. 2) can whole grain corn
steps: Cut bacon in small pieces and fry slowly to a golden brown in a large saucepan. Add onion and cook slowly without browning for 5 minutes. Add corn, potatoes and tomatoes in alternate layers. Sprinkle with salt, sugar and pepper, then add water.
Cook slowly until potatoes are tender.
Remove from heat and stir milk in slowly. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Best Ever Brownies
steps: Cream 1 stick of butter and 1 cup of sugar.
Add eggs, flour, chocolate syrup and nuts; mix well.
Pour into greased and floured pan and bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes.
Top with frosting when cool.

recipes.title: Fried Rice
steps: Fry bacon crisp in large skillet.
Pour off drippings.
Cover bottom of skillet with oil.
Saute pepper and onion just until tender.
Meanwhile, cook rice according to directions.
Pour rice over onion and pepper.
Add crumbled bacon and soy sauce.
Stir slightly to mix.
You can add cabbage, carrots, ham, chicken or hamburger meat.

recipes.title: Budget Cake
ingredients: 1 small can crushed pineapple, drained slightly
steps: Combine all ingredients in mixer and beat until mixed well, approximately 2 minutes.
Pour into two 9-inch cake pans that have been greased and floured.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes. Cool before icing with cream cheese frosting.

recipes.title: Strawberry Butter
ingredients: 1/2 c. unsalted butter or margarine (at room temperature)
steps: Cream butter until light and fluffy, then gradually add oil, beating continuously.
Beat in honey, strawberries and orange rind (if desired).
Store in a covered container in the refrigerator for up to one week.
Serve on toast, muffins, biscuits or other warm homemade breads.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Loaves
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.
Mix all dry ingredients thoroughly.
Add remaining ingredients and mix just until blended.
Turn batter into pans.
Bake about 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Clean in pans 10 minutes; remove from pans and cool completely.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Mash bananas until smooth and mush.
Mix in order given.
Pour into greased and floured loaf pan.
Push batter to side (low in center).
Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Jumblet Cookies
ingredients: 1 tsp. soda in 1/2 c. boiling water
steps: Grind dates with a little flour to keep from sticking; walnuts help, too.
Fold in egg whites, stiffly beaten, last.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Indian Chicken Curry
steps: In a large saucepan, melt butter and saute onion, celery and apples for 5 minutes.
Stir in curry and flour.
Gradually stir in chicken broth, cream of coconut and half and half.
Stir over moderate heat until sauce bubbles and thickens.
Stir in chicken and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt chocolate.
Grease and flour 2 large loaf pans.
Sift the dry ingredients and set aside.
Beat eggs; add sugar, oil and chocolate.
Stir.
Add the sifted dry ingredients and zucchini, then add the nuts.
Pour into 2 large loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Applesauce-Spice Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients in large mixer bowl. Blend well, then beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 4 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 8 x 4 inch loaf pans. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 to 55 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean and cake begins to pull away from sides of pan. Do not underbake. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Remove from pan and finish cooling on racks.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
steps: Cream the sugar, shortening, salt and nutmeg.
Add eggs and ice water; work in flour.
Roll out on floured board; cut in desired shape.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.
May be sprinkled with sugar while still warm, if desired.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Mix all ingredients in medium-sized bowl.
Pour into a lightly greased 1-quart casserole and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Beer Bread
steps: By hand
mix dry ingredients and blend into beer.
Pour into well
greased loaf pan.
Bake at 375° (350° if glass) for 1 hour. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. finely chopped pecans or walnuts
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Put in 2 greased and floured cake pans.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 2 large cans chunk pineapple, drained well
steps: Mix together first 5 ingredients.
Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with finely crushed crackers and melted oleo.
Bake at 375° until cheese melts and mixture is bubbly.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Beat butter lightly.
Add part of sugar and mix until smooth. Add remaining sugar and beat until smooth and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Stir in flavoring.
Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream.
Bake at 325° in greased and floured Bundt or tube pan for 1/2 hour. Reduce heat to 300° and cook 45 to 50 minutes or until cake is done.
Cool cake 5 minutes before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Brownies
steps: Lightly oil a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Stir together sugar, oil, margarine and eggs.
Mix in nuts and vanilla.
Stir together flour, baking soda and salt; add to sugar mixture.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake in 350° oven about 25 to 35 minutes (until browned and knife comes out clean).
Cut into 32 pieces.

recipes.title: Moist Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Mix flour and baking soda. Cream butter, sugars, vanilla. Add eggs, gradually add flour mixture then stir in chips and nuts. Batter will be stiff. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375 degrees for 8-10 minutes. For chocolate lovers, use Chocolate flavored instant pudding.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Icing
steps: Cook on medium heat in saucepan until thick.
Pour on cake while hot, then place in oven broiler until brown, 2 to 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, broken in bite size pieces
steps: Mix together the mayonnaise and sugar in a small bowl and set aside.
Layer the first 6 items in order listed, then spread mayonnaise mixture over top, sealing edges.
Sprinkle cheese and bacon bits over the top.
Refrigerate and let sit overnight.

recipes.title: Italian Tortellini Soup
ingredients: 1/2 c. dry red wine or water
2 c. chopped, seeded, peeled tomatoes (4 medium)
8 oz. frozen meat or cheese tortellini (2 c.)
1 medium green pepper, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
2 (1 1/2 lb.) Dungeness crabs or 2 (12 oz.) pkg. Alaskan king crab (frozen), split legs, thawed and cut into chunks
2 lb. striped bass fillets, cut into serving pieces
1 lb. shelled and deveined shrimp (or more)
1/2 to 1 c. Chablis or Sauterne white wine
steps: About 45 minutes before serving time, in a Dutch oven over medium heat in hot oil, cook onion, green pepper and garlic until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and their liquid, wine, parsley, salt, basil and oregano.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Increase heat to medium.
Add crab and clams; cook for 10 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add fillet pieces and shrimp.
Continue cooking for 5 more minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork and shrimp are tender. Serve immediately in soup bowls.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Tortellini And Spinach Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1/2 (10 oz.) bag spinach, stemmed and chopped
steps: On top of stove, combine soup and consomme; bring to a boil. Add soy sauce.
Pour in egg and stir constantly for 2 minutes, until egg separates into shreds.
Pour and serve.

recipes.title: Korean Chicken
ingredients: 1 small bottle or box sesame seeds
steps: Combine all ingredients, except chicken. Mix the night before; let sit out to allow sugar to dissolve. Needs to be at room temperature.

recipes.title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
steps: Peel potatoes; cut in slices 3/4-inch thick.
Place in baking dish (single layer is best).
Mix sugar and flour; spread over potatoes.
Heat water and margarine.
Add vanilla.
Pour over sugar and potatoes.
Bake at 350° until potatoes are tender (about 20 to 30 minutes).

recipes.title: Blueberry Delight
steps: Mix together cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over the baked crust.
Top with blueberry pie filling.

recipes.title: Lemon-Zucchini Cookies
steps: Cream butter; gradually add 3/4 cup sugar, beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer.
Add egg and lemon rind, beating well.
Combine flour, baking powder and salt; stir well. Add to creamed mixture, mixing well.
Stir in zucchini and walnuts.
Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Remove to wire racks. Combine confectioners sugar and lemon juice; stir well.
Drizzle over warm cookies; let cool completely.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb. breakfast sausage, browned and drained
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Place in a lightly greased, large, heavy cast-iron skillet.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until browned.

recipes.title: Biscuits
steps: Blend dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening until coarse like peas.
Make a well in the center.
Pour in 1/2 cup of milk; toss or mix.
Add egg with rest of milk.
Mix lightly with a fork. Roll or pat to 1/2 or 3/4-inch.
Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma Bella'S Cream Cheese Pound Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream the butter, cheese and sugar until fluffy.
Add the eggs, one at a time, beating 3 minutes for each egg.
Combine dry ingredients and beat in alternately with the milk and vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan lined with waxed paper.
Bake for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hunky Pory Cookies
steps: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients.
Chill in refrigerator at least 2 hours.
Roll in balls the size of walnuts.
Roll in mixture of 2 tablespoons cinnamon and 2 tablespoons sugar.
Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Elephant Ears
steps: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water.
Add salt, sugar, water, shortening and egg.
Mix well.
Stir in flour, 1/2 cup at a time until smooth. Break off pieces the size of an egg.
Roll out 1/4 inch thick on floured surface.
Deep-fry in shortening.
When brown and crisp, remove and dust with sugar and cinnamon.
Recipe makes 20.

recipes.title: Miracle Pie Crust
steps: Mix together first 5 ingredients.
In a cup, mix egg, vinegar and water.
Add to flour mixture.
Makes 5 to 7 crusts.
Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
ingredients: strawberry slices, banana slices, pineapple pieces or cherries
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Bring water to boil.
Mix brownie mix, water, oil and egg in large bowl.
Pour into greased and floured 12-inch pizza pan.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Beat cream cheese, sugar, remaining egg and vanilla in small bowl at medium speed until well blended.
Pour over brownies.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Cool.
Top with fruit; drizzle with chocolate.

recipes.title: Chinese Beef And Peppers
ingredients: 3/4 lb. boneless chuck, cut in thin slices
1 c. green and/or red pepper strips
steps: Saute beef, onion and garlic in oil until meat browns.
Add rest of ingredients except rice; bring to a boil.
Stir in rice. Cover; let stand 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. shortening (half butter and half margarine)
steps: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Mix dry ingredients; add to egg and sugar mixture.
Roll in balls and press with a fork.
Bake at 375° to 400° until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Sun-Drop Cake
steps: Cream sugar, margarine and shortening in mixer bowl until light and fluffy.
Add flour and eggs; beat well.
Add flavorings; mix well.
Stir in Sun-Drop.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.
Cool in pan for several minutes. Invert onto serving plate.
Spread frosting over cake.
Yield:
16 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
steps: Defrost strawberries.
Beat eggs in a bowl until fluffy.
Add cooking oil, sugar and defrosted strawberries.
Sift together flour, cinnamon, soda and salt into mixing bowl.
Add strawberry mixture and mix until well blended.
Stir in nuts.
Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done, then turn out of pans and cool on racks.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 large and 1 small can pork and beans
steps: Chop onion and bell pepper very fine and cook in small amount of water in frying pan (large).
Add brown sugar, ketchup, mustard, bacon and beans.
Bring mixture to boil.
Pour mixture in baking pan and cook in oven at 350° for 45 minutes to one hour.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Mix hot rice, Cheez Whiz and margarine together until cheese melts. Add rest of ingredients. Put into casserole dish. Bake 20 minutes at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Salmon Ball
ingredients: 1 lb. can salmon, drain and remove bones
steps: Combine all but nuts and parsley.
Chill.
Shape into ball and roll in nuts and parsley.
Chill again.

recipes.title: Russian Pea Salad
steps: Thaw peas; add all other ingredients.
Chill overnight. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chunky Potato Soup
steps: Peel and dice potatoes and cook until tender.
Drain.
Melt butter in 3-quart pot.
Add carrot and onion.
Cover and cook until tender.
Remove from heat.
Add flour and milk.
Add 1/2 potatoes.
Mash remaining.
Add to soup with seasonings and bouillon.
Heat to steaming hot.

recipes.title: Cranberry Bean Soup
steps: Sort and soak beans with a pinch of baking soda over night. Next day bring to a boil. Rinse and cover with water and add ham or bacon, onion, salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer
1 1/2 to 2 hours or until tender. Add water as needed during cooking time.

recipes.title: Taco Delight
steps: Brown beef and onion in skillet for 5 minutes.
Add salsa, tomato sauce and bouillon cube; bring to a full boil.
Stir in rice; cover and remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Cornstarch Pudding
steps: Put canned milk in a quart jar and fill up with regular milk. Use a double boiler; heat until boiling.
Beat eggs and add to milk.
Add sugar and cornstarch.
Boil until thick, then cool. Strain.
Add vanilla.

recipes.title: Crisp Potato Skins
ingredients: coarse salt, sour cream, chopped chives and/or bacon bits
steps: Bake potatoes at 400° for 45 minutes or until tender. Cool, then cut into quarters lengthwise. Scoop out pulp, leaving 1/8-inch shell. Reserve pulp for use in other recipes. Increase oven temperature to 500°. Combine butter and soy sauce. Brush on both sides of skins. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until crisp. Top with coarse salt, sour cream, chives and/or bacon bits. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cookie Kisses
steps: Beat the margarine, sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add flour and mix well.
Chill the dough.
Shape about 1 tablespoon of dough around each chocolate kiss.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 12 minutes.
The cookie should be set but not brown.
Cool slightly, then roll in confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Southern Stew
ingredients: 8 oz. drained canned chick- peas (Garbanzo beans)
1/4 c. chopped green or red bell peppers
steps: On rack in broiling pan broil steak for 5 minutes on each side; cut into 2- inch pieces and set aside.

recipes.title: Whipping Cream Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, and stir until mixed well.
Add flour and stir until well blended.
Add flavoring.
Stir in whipping cream.
Bake in a Bundt pan at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Dedication Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cooked in salted water until tender
1 (16 oz.) pkg. spaghetti, broken in small pieces
1 onion, cut up in small pieces
1/2 large bell pepper, cut up in small pieces
2 stalks celery, cut up in small pieces
1 can diced Ro-Tel tomatoes with green chilies
2 cans cream of chicken mushroom soup
steps: Reserve stock.
Debone chicken and cut in bite size pieces. Cook spaghetti in reserved stock; drain to just below top of spaghetti.
Saute onion, celery and bell pepper in margarine until tender.
Add cheese to hot spaghetti; stir until melted.
Add all other ingredients together and season with garlic salt.
Stir together well.
Bake in oblong dish or pan at 350° for 30 minutes. Sprinkle parsley flakes on top.
Serves approximately 12 to 15 people.

recipes.title: Mom'S Tomato Soup Cake
steps: Mix baking soda and soup in a bowl; set aside. Cream sugar and Crisco. Add eggs and soup mix; mix well. Sift together dry ingredients; mix all together. Bake in 9 x 9 or 8 x 9 greased and floured pan at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Star Cookies
steps: Mix all together and put in icebox overnight.
When chilled, roll them and cut in star shape.
Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Potato Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 8 oz. shredded American or Cheddar cheese
steps: Combine all ingredients except for oil; mix well.
Pour about 2 inches of oil into frying pan; get oil hot but not smoking, or use Fry Daddy.
Drop batter by tablespoons, 4 to 5 at a time, into hot oil.
Fry 3 to 4 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve immediately.
Makes about 24 puffs.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
steps: Beat eggs on high speed for 5 minutes.
Gradually beat in sugar.
Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice.
Stir together flour, salt, spices and baking powder.
Add to pumpkin mixture.
Spread into greased and floured cookie sheet.
Top with nuts.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Turn out on towel sprinkled with powdered sugar.
Roll towel and cake together.
Cool for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Green Mountain Gingersnaps
steps: Cream shortening in bowl.
Add sugar, molasses and egg.
Mix thoroughly.
Sift remaining ingredients together.
Stir into creamed mixture.
Roll into small balls; dip in additional sugar. Place 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° (preheated) for 10 minutes.
They will still be soft when you take them out.
They firm as they cool.
Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Prune Spice Cake
ingredients: 3/4 c. liquid (1/2 milk and 1/2 prune juice)
steps: Cream the shortening and sugar.
Add eggs.
Sift flour, baking powder, salt and spice, then blend into creamed mixture alternately with liquids.
Pour prunes into two 8-inch pans that have been greased and floured.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. Cool completely; frost if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 chicken, boiled, deboned and chopped in chunks
1 pkg. Uncle Ben's long grain wild rice, cooked
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Bake in covered casserole at 350° until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Mimaw'S Butterscotch Squares
steps: In large saucepan, melt butter.
Remove from heat.
Add brown sugar and mix well.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour into 8-inch square greased pan. Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cheesy Green Beans
ingredients: 2 (16 oz.) pkg. Birds Eye cut green beans
1 (16 oz.) jar Cheez Whiz pasteurized process cheese spread
steps: Cook bacon until crisp.
Drain bacon, reserving 1/4 cup drippings.
Crumble bacon; reserve 2 tablespoons.
Microwave beans as directed on package; drain well.
Add mushrooms and onion to reserved 1/4 cup drippings in skillet.
Cook and stir on medium-high heat 10 minutes; drain.
Add bacon, hot cooked green beans and pepper; mix lightly.
Spoon into 2-quart serving dish. Microwave process cheese spread as directed on label.
Pour over green bean mixture.
Sprinkle with reserved 2 tablespoons crumbled bacon.
Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Raisin Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Drop by spoonful on cookie sheet.
Bake at 375°.

recipes.title: Nut Fingers
steps: Cream butter. Add sugar and other ingredients in order given. When thoroughly mixed, mold and shape into fingers about the size of pecans. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Roll in powdered sugar when cool. Be sure to mix pecans in by hand. Makes about 7 dozen.

recipes.title: Cucumbers With Sesame Seeds
steps: Sprinkle salt over cucumbers and let stand about 15 minutes. Squeeze water from slices and combine with remaining ingredients. Chill.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Sift flour, baking soda, salt, baking powder and cinnamon. Combine eggs, oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla in large mixing bowl.
Beat until well mixed.
Stir in flour mixture until smooth. Stir in raisins and nuts.
Pour mixture into greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until center springs back.
Cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Cream the butter and sugar together. Add banana and egg.
Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture.
Add vanilla and mix well.
Pour into buttered loaf pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Cut butter into dry ingredients.
Add egg.
Pat into bottom and sides of 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan.
Peel, core and slice apples (quantity as necessary) and line up in pan.

recipes.title: Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 c. dry rice, uncooked, wash and drain
steps: Melt butter and add chopped onion, oregano, salt and rice. Stir all the ingredients listed and simmer 10 minutes (can use iron skillet or Teflon).
Turn into large casserole and add beef consomme and water.
Add drained mushrooms; bake, covered at 400° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Eggs Belmar
steps: Add flour to 1/4 cup melted butter in saucepan.
Stir until smooth; cook 1 minute and gradually add milk.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add salt and pepper and set aside. Saute bacon and next 3 ingredients in 3 tablespoons butter until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Drain.
Cook eggs in 1 tablespoon butter without stirring until beginning to set on bottom.
Draw spatula across to form large curds.
Continue until cooked, but moist.
Stir in bacon mixture and white sauce.
Place in greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish (glass).
Combine 2 tablespoons butter and bread crumbs to egg mixture.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Make ahead up to 24 hours and refrigerate.
Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes before baking.
Leftovers reheat well.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Add onion, egg and milk; mix well.
Drop by spoonful into deep fry; fry until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie(Old Family Recipe)
steps: Mix flour and sugar together.
Beat egg yolks.
Mix all together and cook over boiling water until thick.
Put in baked pie shell.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. cinnamon, ginger and baking powder
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cream shortening and sugar.
Add spices and
dry
ingredients.
Drop
by spoonful onto greased baking sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool on rack.
Store in refrigerator.
Each cookie contains 55 calories.

recipes.title: Granddad Bill'S T Cakes
steps: Mix all ingredients well and drop by teaspoonfuls on lightly greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 300°.

recipes.title: Corn Fritters
steps: Sift flour, salt and baking powder into bowl.
Beat eggs with milk; add melted Crisco and whole kernel corn and combine the two mixtures lightly.
Drop from a teaspoon into deep Crisco heated to 365° (or when an inch cube of bread browns in 60 seconds).
Fry until brown and cooked in center (about 4 to 5 minutes).
Drain on absorbent paper.

recipes.title: Grammy'S Brownies
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Beat well. Add melted chocolate.
Then add flour.
Pour into four 8-inch pans.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Oatmeal
steps: Cook oats in water with salt for 5 minutes.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Mix oats, egg yolks, melted butter, honey and raisins.
Fold in egg whites.
Pour into well-greased 8-inch pan and cook at 400° for 15 minutes or until set in the middle and light brown.
Recipe may be doubled.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, cut in small pieces
steps: Boil potatoes; skin and slice into pieces.
Fry bacon; drain off all fat.
Sprinkle flour over bacon; mix it up.
Pour vinegar, sugar and water over bacon.
Simmer until thick.
Pour over potatoes; mix well.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Combine all except bacon.
Pour into a greased 2 quart casserole dish.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 55 minutes.
Sprinkle top with crumbled bacon.
Bake another 5 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Stickies
steps: Combine flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Cut in shortening.
Mix well.
Add milk.
Mix well.
Roll out thin. Spread softened margarine over dough.
Sprinkle sugar over margarine.
Roll up jelly roll fashion.
Slice into 1-inch pieces. Place in pan and cook at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage(Rodkaal)
steps: Melt fat in pan.
Add remaining ingredients in layers and cook until very tender.
If too dry, add water.
Garnish with apple slices.

recipes.title: Red Beans And Rice
steps: Saute onion, bell pepper and sausage in a large skillet.
Add beans and tomato sauce.
Cook on low, until it thickens, for about 45 minutes.
Serve with your favorite rice and cornbread, cooked according to package directions.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well with blender.
Pour batter into two greased and lightly floured loaf pans. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.
May bake muffins instead.
Bake approximately 12 to 15 minutes. Raisins and nuts are optional.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water.
Heat buttermilk to lukewarm.
Add the salt, shortening and sugar to the buttermilk. Add the dissolved yeast, a cup of the flour with the soda and the egg.
Beat vigorously.
Beat and fold in the remaining flour until a soft dough.
Fold lightly (about 5 minutes).
Place in a clean lightly greased bowl.
Cover and let rise 45 minutes to 1 hour until double in bulk.
Shape into desired rolls.
Bake in a 350° to 375° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice; drain.
Cook broccoli and drain.
Mix together. Add Velveeta cheese and soups.
Put in greased casserole dish and top with shredded cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
steps: Combine eggs, celery, green pepper, pickles and chilled macaroni.
Blend mayonnaise, buttermilk and mustard.
Fold into macaroni mixture.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Peach Pie
steps: Combine peaches, lemon juice, almond extract, sugar and salt. Mix together thoroughly and let stand while rolling pastry.

recipes.title: Baked Corn
steps: Spray microwave dish with Pam.
Combine all ingredients and stir to mix egg and flour into mixture.
Microwave on High for 3 minutes.
Remove and stir.
Microwave on High again for 3 minutes. Ready to serve.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and brown sugar first; then add white sugar and cream together.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture.
Add oats and coconut.
Fold in Rice Krispies last, so as not to break them.

recipes.title: Easy Fruit Cobbler(Mrs. W. A. Broadway)
steps: Melt margarine in bottom of casserole dish.
Mix flour, sugar and milk.
Pour this mixture over margarine in dish and top with peaches.
Bake at 350° until brown.
You may substitute any fruit you wish to use and also add cinnamon or other spices.

recipes.title: Molasses Apple Pan Dowdy
steps: Pare, core and slice apples in wedges into a buttered baking dish 8x13x2. Add water and cook in oven a few minutes until soft. In a saucepan mix molasses, sugar, cornstarch, mace and salt. Boil together thoroughly blended.

recipes.title: Grandmother'S Cherry Cobbler
ingredients: 1 c. cherries (canned cherries), drained and save juice
steps: Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Cream butter and 1/2 cup sugar until fluffy.
Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and beating until smooth.
Pour batter into greased baking dish and put fruit on top.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar on top.
Pour on juice over all.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Squares
steps: Combine 1 cup flour and 1/4 cup powdered sugar.
Cut in butter with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Press into a 9-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven-Fried Chicken
steps: Cut chicken into serving pieces.
Combine buttermilk and onion.
Sift flour with salt, pepper, paprika and thyme.
Melt the butter in a baking pan.
Brush each piece of chicken with the buttermilk mixture, then sprinkle with the seasoned mix.
Place pieces skin down in the baking pan.
Bake in oven at 375° for 30 minutes.
Turn each piece and bake 30 minutes longer or until very tender.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
steps: Soften margarine. Add all other ingredients and let the dough sit in the freezer for about 30 minutes.
Pinch off pieces of dough and dip into flour.
Roll into a ball with hands and flatten out on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for about 10 minutes or until edges start turning brown.

recipes.title: Persimmon Pudding
steps: Melt margarine in 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan.
Mix pulp, eggs and sugar together; alternate milk and dry ingredients.
Pour melted margarine from pan into mixture.
Mix well.
Pour mixture into pan.
Bake 1 hour at 300° to 325°.
Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Beat eggs;
add
sugar
oil and flour; add cinnamon and vanilla.
Mix
apples and nuts; stir until mixed.
Pour into a greased tube pan and bake 50 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Chiffon Pie
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. lemon juice (fresh, frozen and canned)
1/2 c. heavy whipped cream (can substitute skim evaporated, chilled until ice crystals form, then whip)
steps: Add sugar to peaches; let stand 30 minutes.
Soften gelatin in cold water, dissolve in hot water and cool.
Add peach mixture, lemon juice and salt.
Chill until partially set.
Fold in whipped cream.
Pour into pie shell (graham cracker); chill thoroughly.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
steps: Add corn to well beaten eggs.
Add melted margarine and remainder of ingredients; mix thoroughly and pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake in a moderate 350° oven until firm and brown, about 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Beriox
ingredients: 1 box hot roll mix (or make your own)
steps: Brown meat in a large skillet or Dutch oven.
Chop onion and brown.
Add salt, pepper and spice. Then add chopped cabbage and flour. Stir about 2 minutes

recipes.title: Apple Delight
steps: Blend sugar, flour, soda, salt and spices.
Add oil and eggs. Stir in nuts and apple pie filling.
Blend by hand.
Bake for 1 hour at 350° in a Bundt pan.

recipes.title: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake
steps: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in a large mixing bowl.
Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 4 minutes.
Stir in coconut and nuts.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Vanilla Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. Jell-O vanilla pudding and pie filling (not instant)
steps: Gradually stir milk and egg into pudding mix in saucepan.
Add rice and raisins.
Stir over medium heat until mixture just comes to a boil.
Cool 5 minutes, stirring twice.
Pour into dessert dishes or serving bowl.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.
Place plastic wrap on surface while cooling.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
ingredients: 1 Cup Shortening, part butter or margarine
steps: Mix shortening, 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs.
Blend in flour, tartar, soda and salt. Shape dough into 1 inch balls.
Roll in mixture of 2 tablespoons of sugar and cinnamon.
Place on ungreased baking sheet.

recipes.title: Grilled Garlic Toast Bruschetta
ingredients: dash of Tabasco or to taste
steps: Slice baguette in 1/4-inch slices.
Combine all ingredients, mixing well.
Using a flat knife, spread mixture thickly on slice baguette.
Arrange on waxed paper covered tray (no spacing necessary; close together is fine).
Place in a 400° preheated oven for 8 minutes or until lightly browned.
Allow to cool on the tray, then transfer to a plate.
These are great the day before needed or the day you intent to serve them.
If made the day before a double batch may be necessary.
Family and friends may want to sample them before you make it to the table! Check after 5 minutes.
Cooking times may vary depending upon your oven.

recipes.title: Sunshine Bars
steps: Combine sugar, oil and sweet potatoes. Add eggs, water and vanilla; blend. Sift dry ingredients and add mix only until blended. Do not overmix. Pour into greased pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Cool and ice with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Sourdough Bread
steps: Add yeast to 1 cup warm water; combine and refrigerate 3 to 5 days (covered jar).

recipes.title: Chicken Yakitori(Skewered Grilled Chicken)
ingredients: 8 Tbsp. sake or dry white wine
Shichimi Togarashi (Japanese red hot powdered pepper mixed with other 6 spices)
steps: You will need 20 to 30 fine metal or bamboo skewers, about 5-inches long.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
ingredients: 2 (20 oz.) cans pineapple chunks, partially drained
steps: Layer pineapple in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Mix together the sugar and flour.
Sprinkle on top of the pineapple.
Layer the cheese and Ritz crackers.
Top with melted butter. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
ingredients: 2 c. frozen strawberries, thawed and sliced
steps: Combine dry ingredients.
Add eggs and oil.
Add strawberries and pecans.
Mix in lightly; do not beat.
Spoon batter into loaf pans.
Makes 3 medium loaves or 5 small ones.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hungarian Pork Chops
steps: Sprinkle chops lightly with salt and pepper; flour on both sides.
Brown in a heavy skillet; then arrange a layer of kraut, then a layer of potatoes with a layer of kraut on top.
Sprinkle with paprika and brown sugar.
Pour tomatoes over top.
Cover and cook slowly on top of stove for 40 to 45 minutes or until chops are very tender.

recipes.title: Marinated Shrimp Kabobs
ingredients: 1 medium-size green pepper, cut into 1-inch cubes
steps: Peel and devein shrimp; set aside.
Drain pineapple chunks, reserving 1/4 cup juice.
Set pineapple aside.

recipes.title: Pineapple Sheet Cake
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple (save juice and 3 Tbsp. pineapple for icing)
steps: Mix cake mix with eggs.
Add oil, milk and flour, then add pineapple.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes in a greased and floured sheet pan.
Pour pineapple juice over cake while still hot.

recipes.title: Pecan Puffs
steps: Whip together pecans, cheese, steak sauce, bacon and mayonnaise until thoroughly blended.
Spread on crackers.
Broil 3 to 4 inches from heat until lightly puffed.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Sourdough Pancakes
steps: *This is the sourdough starter.

recipes.title: Peanut Blossoms
steps: Cream sugars, butter or margarine and peanut butter. Beat in eggs, milk and vanilla. Sift together flour, soda and salt; stir into mixture. Shape into balls; roll in additional sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet; bake in 375 degree oven for 10-12 min. Immediately press a chocolate candy into each cookie. Makes 7 dozen.

recipes.title: Waffles
ingredients: 1/2 lb. (1 stick) butter or 8 Tbsp. oil
steps: Add ingredients in order, saving egg whites to be added last.

recipes.title: Icebox Cookies
steps: Sift the sugar and cream it and butter together; beat eggs and add to creamed mixture.
Sift all other ingredients together and add to first mixture.
Knead with hands when mixture becomes too stiff for a spoon.
Chill well and slice.
Bake in moderate oven.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugars together.
Add egg and vanilla and mix well.
Put in the sifted flour, soda and salt.
Mix well and add 1 package of chips.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Pineapple Salad
steps: Mix sugar and flour.
Beat together eggs and juice, add to dry mixture and cook in double boiler until thick.
Stir constantly. Cool.

recipes.title: Oven Chicken
ingredients: 2 pkg. Italian Good Seasons dressing mix powder
steps: Put together in bag and mix.
Shake.
Chicken should be coated. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Banana Cream Pie
ingredients: whipped cream and additional sliced bananas
steps: In a saucepan, combine sugar, flour and salt.
Stir in milk and mix well.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil.
Boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Stir a small amount into egg yolks.
Return all to saucepan.
Cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add butter and vanilla.
Cool slightly.
Slice the bananas into pastry shell.
Pour filling over.
Cool.
Before serving, garnish with whipped cream and bananas.
Refrigerate any leftovers.
Yield:
6 to 8.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
ingredients: 1 (No. 303) can pineapple chunks, drained (reserve 1/2 c. juice)
steps: Half fill a tall glass with cranberry juice.
Add a big scoop of vanilla ice cream and enough ginger ale to float the ice cream. This is a very good drink to serve at Christmastime.

recipes.title: Kidney Bean Soup
steps: Cook bacon until crisp and crumble.
Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon drippings.
In a 2-quart casserole dish, put bacon drippings, diced onion and crushed garlic.
Cook in a microwave oven, covered, for about 3 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup water and rest of ingredients, including liquid from beans.
Mix until well blended.
Cook, covered, for 10 to 12 minutes.
Place 1/2 soup in a blender for 10 seconds and return to casserole dish.
Repeat with other half of soup.
If soup is too thick, add water to make it the desired consistency.
Cook for another 3 minutes in microwave.
Just before serving, stir in reserved bacon.

recipes.title: Stoecker'S Drum Rolls
steps: Combine 3 cups flour and yeast.
Heat milk, sugar, shortening and salt until warm (115° to 120°).
Stir constantly until shortening almost melts.
Add this to dry mixture.
Add eggs. Beat at low speed with electric mixer for 1/2 minute, scraping bowl.
Beat 3 minutes at high speed.
Stir in by hand the remaining flour to make soft dough.
Shape into ball; place in lightly greased bowl.
Turn once to grease surface.
Cover; let rest in a warm place until it doubles (1 1/2 to 2 hours).
Punch down; turn out on floured surface.
Cover and let rest 10 minutes. Shape into desired rolls.
Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled (30 to 45 minutes).
Bake on greased muffin pans in a 400° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Cornish Hen Delight
steps: Preheat oven to 500° (to sear juices).
Meanwhile, lay hens in pan.
Salt and pepper each hen; rub in good.
After oven is hot, put hens in oven for 30 minutes or until crispy golden brown. Meanwhile on stovetop, saute onions and celery in butter.
Put can of cream of chicken and 1 can of water; heat until creamy and set aside until 30 minutes are up, then pour mixture over hens and cook for about another 20 minutes or until hens are done.
Serve over rice (can substitute chicken if you don't have Cornish hens).

recipes.title: Braised Chuck Beef Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 to 3 1/2 lb. fresh chuck beef pot roast
1 (1 1/4 oz.) envelope dehydrated onion soup mix (Lipton)
steps: Sprinkle both sides of meat with garlic salt.
Place in 3-quart (13 x 9-inch) glass baking dish.
Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on Simmer for 45 minutes.
Turn meat over; re-cover and continue cooking on Simmer for 40 to 45 minutes or until fork-tender.
Remove meat and slice meat approximately 1/4-inch thick.
Dissolve onion soup mix in hot meat juices; place sliced meat in seasoned meat juice (add sliced onions on top of beef, if desired).
Cover with plastic wrap or glass cover.
Microwave on Reheat for 8 to 10 minutes or until heated through.
Let stand, covered, 5 minutes before serving.
Serves about 8.

recipes.title: Rosy Pickled Eggs
ingredients: 1 c. liquid drained from canned pickled beets
1 small onion, sliced and separated into rings
steps: In a large bowl or jar, combine water, beet liquid and vinegar.
Add sugar, pickling spice, salt, garlic and bay leaf; mix well.
Add eggs and onions; cover and refrigerate several days before serving.

recipes.title: Creamed Asparagus
steps: Cook asparagus until tender (steam).
Add milk, flour and water; cook until thick.
Add asparagus and diced hard-boiled eggs.

recipes.title: Apricot Brandy Pound Cake
steps: Cream margarine until light.
Add the sugar in thirds.
Cream again until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one.
Beat for another 3 minutes after the last egg is added. Sift flour, salt and soda together.
Combine the sour cream and extracts.
Add flour mixture and sour cream alternately to the batter.
Blend well.
Fold in apricot brandy. Bake in a well-greased and floured Bundt or tube cake pan at 375° for 70 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Doughnuts
steps: Cream shortening and margarine in bowl.
Add mashed potatoes, potato water, sweetener and egg; beat well.
Sprinkle with yeast. Stir in gently.
Let stand
for 1 1/2 hours in warm place.
Stir in flour gradually.
Knead on floured surface until smooth.
Let rise, covered, in warm place 5 to 6 hours or doubled in bulk. Roll out on floured surface 1/2-inch thick.
Cut to desired size. Place on floured towel.
Let rise in warm place 1 1/2 to 2 inches or until doubled in bulk.
Deep fry in 375°
oil until light brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Yields 50 doughnuts.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Wash the rice about 3 times in cold water.
Put the milk in the pan; add rice and cook long and slow (about 30 minutes).
Mix eggs, sugar and vanilla.
Mix well.
Add to rice and milk very slowly, mixing the milk mixture as you pour in the egg mixture. Bring to a boil again.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
steps: Preheat
oven
to
Grease
and
flour
tube pan. Blend together
oleo
and cream cheese; add sugar, blend until fluffy. Add
eggs, one at a time, blending well.
Add vanilla. Blend in flour
and
salt.
Pour batter into prepared pan and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Cool and dust with powdered sugar if desired.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Sheet Cake
steps: In a mixing bowl, beat pumpkin, sugar and oil. Add eggs; mix well. Combine flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt; add to pumpkin mixture and beat until well blended. Pour into greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool.

recipes.title: Hamburger Skillet Dish
steps: Brown rice in shortening in heavy skillet, stirring frequently.
Add ground round, onion and celery; brown well.
Add tomatoes and other ingredients.
Cover and simmer until rice is tender, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Squares
steps: Mix apples and sugar.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Sift flour, salt, soda and cinnamon together; set aside.
Beat the egg; add oil and blend into apple mixture, then add flour all at once. Beat with wooden spoon until blended.
Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch well-greased pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Mix confectioners sugar and milk and drizzle over squares.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Have ingredients at room temperature.
Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Spoon into a greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 22 minutes, or until it tests done.
Cool and frost, if desired.
Recipe can be doubled for a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
steps: Cut margarine into flour and powdered sugar until crumbly. Pack into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Texas Sheet Cake
steps: In saucepan melt oleo or margarine.
Add water and cocoa.
Add flour, sugar, salt and soda.
Then add eggs, vanilla and sour cream.
Bake in a greased and floured 11 x 17-inch sheet pan for 20 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cookies
steps: Bake in
375° oven for 15 minutes or until done.
Yields 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Green Chile(Soup Or Smothering For Burritos, Chile Rellenos Or Enchiladas)
ingredients: 1 medium onion, cut into large chunks
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
8 to 10 Anaheim chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded and chopped
steps: Heat oil in large stockpot.
Add pork, onion, garlic, salt and pepper.
Saute until pork is browned.
Drain juice from tomatoes into stockpot.
Chop tomatoes and add to pork with chiles and 2 cups water.
Stir well and simmer, covered, for 45 minutes.
Whisk together flour and 1/3 cup water until smooth.
Add to chile mixture and stir constantly until well blended and slightly thickened.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with warm tortillas.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Southern Spoonbread
steps: Pour boiling water over meal.
Let stand until cool.
Add sugar, salt and beaten egg.
Dissolve soda into buttermilk and add to batter; mix well.
Add melted shortening; pour in greased deep dish or skillet.
Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hop'N John And Rice
steps: Boil beans and thyme in 2 quarts of water until peas are tender.
Dry onions and bacon until brown.
Add to peas; add rice. Season with salt and pepper.
Cover tightly over low heat about 3/4 hour.

recipes.title: Cherry Torte
ingredients: 1 can drained sour cherries, drain and save juice
steps: Combine ingredients in order given except use only 1/2 can cherries.
Lastly, fold in last 1/2 of cherries.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Rolls
steps: Soften yeast in lukewarm water.
Cream shortening, sugar and salt.
Add boiling water and cool to lukewarm.
Add well beaten eggs, yeast mixture and flour; mix well.
Place in refrigerator at least 2 hours (overnight is best).
Make into rolls.
Let rise 2 hours in warm place.
Bake for 15 minutes at 425°.

recipes.title: Lynn'S Coconut Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream margarine and brown sugar.
Add beaten eggs.
Mix together flour, soda and baking powder.
Add with coconut flakes and oatmeal to mixture.
Add nuts (optional).

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Combine rice, milk, sugar and salt; cook until creamy (15 to 20 minutes).
