Blend milk and egg and stir into rice mixture.
Add raisins and cook 2 minutes.
Add butter and vanilla; sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon (optional).

recipes.title: Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 3 corn tortillas, cut in strips and fried
steps: Cook chicken in 8 cups water 30 to 40 minutes.
Set aside; cool and debone.
Add tomatoes, bell pepper, onion and cilantro to chicken broth.
Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer 20 to 30 minutes, then cool to room temperature.
Remove tomatoes, bell pepper, onion and cilantro from liquid and puree.
Return pureed mixture and broth to heat.
Bring to boil; reduce heat to simmer and add cooked rice, deboned chicken, cumin, salt and pepper; serve hot.
Garnish with tortilla strips and guacamole.

recipes.title: Gingerbread Man
steps: Thoroughly cream together butter or margarine and sugar.
Add egg; beat until light and fluffy.
Add orange peel and corn syrup; mix well.
Sift together remaining ingredients; stir into creamed mixture.
Chill dough thoroughly.
On lightly floured surface, roll to 1/4-inch thickness.
Cut with gingerbread man cookie cutter. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake in 375° oven for 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool 1 minute; remove from pan.
Cool on rack.
Decorate gingerbread men with decorating icing and raisins, if desired.
Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Bread
steps: Stir
boiling
water,
rolled
oats, molasses, salt and butter together.	Let cool.
Dissolve yeast with 1/4 cup warm water; stir
in oatmeal mixture.
Add 2 cups of flour; beat 2 minutes at medium speed.
Mix in rest of flour.
Cover and let rise
about
4 hours.
With wooden spoon, beat batter about 75 strokes.
Put in two
greased
bread
pans.	Let
rise
again. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Company Chicken Hot Dish
steps: Dust chicken with flour, salt, pepper and paprika.
Brown in butter. Grease pan with butter, large enough to lay chicken in single layer.
Put celery on bottom of pan, then browned chicken. Mix soup, cream, onions, pimentos and cheese.
Pour on top of chicken.
Sprinkle bread crumbs, almonds and a little grated cheese on top. Bake 1 hour at 350° or until chicken is done. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, cut into small pieces
1/2 lb. bacon, fried crispy and broken into small pieces
steps: Combine the broccoli, bacon, walnuts (if desired), onion, salt and pepper to taste.
Blend the mayonnaise, sugar and wine vinegar.
Pour over the broccoli mixture. Stir until all pieces are coated.

recipes.title: Cream Puffs(Yield:  6 Medium Puffs)
steps: In saucepan, melt butter in boiling water.
Add flour and salt all at once; stir vigorously.
Cook and stir until mixture forms a ball that doesn't separate.
Remove from heat; cool slightly and add eggs, one at a time, beating with a spoon after each addition until smooth.
Drop
by heaping tablespoonfuls 3 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 325° and bake 10 minutes.
Remove from oven; cut off tops.
Turn oven off; return cream puffs to oven to dry 20 minutes.
Cool on rack.

recipes.title: Coleslaw
steps: Marinate cabbage, carrots, sugar and milk in refrigerator overnight.
Drain well.
Mix cabbage with mayonnaise, buttermilk or sour cream, Tabasco, onion and celery seed.
Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream (1923)(Over 50 Years Old)
steps: Scald the fresh milk in a double boiler.
Mix the 1/2 cup sugar, flour and salt.
Sift.
Moisten with the 3 tablespoons cold milk.
Add 1 cup of the scalded milk and mix, then add to remaining hot milk.
Cook 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Honey Blueberry Muffins
steps: Mix the milk, honey, blueberries, baking powder, egg and shortening. Combine flour and salt; add to the first ingredients. Stir just to moisten. Fill greased muffin pans 1/2 full. Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 12 to 15 muffins.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Kuchen
steps: Mix and put into a greased and floured 8 x 12 pan. Pat on bottom of pan.

recipes.title: Veal Paprika
steps: Mix salt, pepper and flour.
Roll individual servings of veal cutlets in seasoned flour.
Brown in hot oil in skillet rubbed with garlic.
Add 1 cup hot water; cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Arrange meat on hot platter.
Into gravy left in pan, stir 1 cup cream.
Heat and pour over noodles.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Note:
Omit baking powder and salt if you use self-rising flour.

recipes.title: Skillet Dinner
steps: Drain beans, saving liquid (there should be 1 cup liquid). Mix together meat, milk, rolled oats and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Shape mixture into 16 balls and roll in flour.
Melt shortening in a skillet and brown meatballs on all sides.
Reduce heat and add onion; cook slowly until onion is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add liquid and remaining ingredients, except the beans. Cover and cook slowly for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add drained beans; cover and heat thoroughly.

recipes.title: Frosted Toffee Bars
steps: In medium bowl, combine oats, sugar and margarine; mix well. Spread in greased 9-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° for 13 minutes or until light golden brown; cool.
In small, heavy saucepan over low heat, melt chips.
Spread over oat mixture; sprinkle with nuts.
Refrigerate until chocolate is set.
Cut into bars and store in tightly covered container in refrigerator.
Makes 2 dozen bars.

recipes.title: Aliene'S Sugar Cookies
steps: Blend first 4 ingredients until light and creamy.
Stir together
dry
ingredients.
Gradually
add to creamed mixture and mix
well until blended.
Form dough into balls.
Flatten with glass dipped in sugar or drop by spoon and mash with fork dipped in water.
This recipe may be cut down to one half.

recipes.title: Pineapple Delight
ingredients: 3 large cans pineapple chunks (20 oz. cans)
steps: Place drained pineapple in a dish.
Mix flour and sugar together.
Sprinkle over pineapple.
Cover with a layer of shredded cheese.
Top with melted butter and crumbled Ritz crackers.
Bake at 350° until dish bubbles (about 40 minutes). Serve hot.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Combine prepared apples and sugar in large mixing bowl.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Sift flour and add soda, salt and spices; set aside.
Blend oil and egg into apple/sugar mixture.
Add dry ingredients, stirring just until blended.
Stir in raisins and walnuts.

recipes.title: Hearty Bean Stew
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, peeled and quartered lengthwise
8 oz. Monterey Jack cheese, cut in 1/2-inch cubes
steps: In a Dutch oven combine undrained kidney and garbanzo beans, water, potatoes, carrots, onion, tomato paste, chili powder, salt, basil, garlic powder and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Top each serving with about 1/4 cup of the cheese cubes.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Party Mix
steps: Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan in oven.
Remove and add seasoned salt and the Worcestershire sauce.
Mix the cereal, pretzels and nuts in a large pan (oven broiler pan) and pour the butter and seasoning over it.
Stir until all the cereal and pretzels are covered.
Bake 1 hour at 250°, stirring every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Batter For Deep Frying
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Use for deep frying vegetables when camping.
Use for onions, green pepper rings, zucchini slices, cauliflower, mushrooms and cheese as well as hot dogs.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Salad
steps: Heat pineapple and juice until hot; but not boiling. Remove from heat and add dry gelatin. Mix well. Stir in buttermilk and fold in Cool Whip. Place in 13 x 9 dish and refrigerate until set, congealed.

recipes.title: Pecan Thins
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add flour.
Add egg yolk and vanilla. Batter will be stiff.
Spread as thin as possible on 2 cookie sheets.
Lightly beat egg white.
Spread on top and sprinkle with nuts.
Press in with hand.
Bake 1 hour at 275° or lower.
Remove from oven and cut into squares immediately.
Freeze well.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
steps: In large bowl, cream butter;
add sugar gradually, beating until light.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. Stir flour and soda.
Add to creamed mixture alternately, with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour.
Blend in flavorings. Place batter in greased and floured 10 inch tube pan.
Bake at 300 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes, or until done.
Do not over bake.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup
1/2 c. shredded sharp processed American cheese
steps: Cook broccoli in boiling, salted water until tender; drain. Arrange broccoli in greased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Place cooked chicken on top.
Combine soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice; pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine bread crumbs and butter.
Sprinkle over top.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350° or until thoroughly heated.
This dish can be prepared a day ahead and put in the refrigerator.
It also freezes very well. Dish can also be made substituting asparagus for broccoli.

recipes.title: Quickie Brownies
steps: Stir all ingredients together;	spread into shallow 8 x 8-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Pound Cake
steps: Cream the margarine, Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs; beat well. Sift flour, measure and add baking powder; sift again. Add to the creamed mixture with milk. Add flavoring last and beat well. Pour into well-greased and floured pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Chocolate Chip Cake
steps: Cream sugar, butter and oil together.
Add eggs, vanilla and sour milk.
Mix well.
Mix together dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture.
Beat well.
Stir in zucchini.
Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Sprinkle top with chocolate chips.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Bean Pot
steps: Do not drain beans.
Fry hamburger, onions and bell pepper (green) until brown (drain).
Add beans and other ingredients. Cook in electric fry pan at 350° for 30 minutes or in slow cooker for 2 to 3 hours on low.

recipes.title: Chinese Spice Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. vanilla or 1/2 tsp. almond flavoring
steps: Combine shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and milk. Add powdered ingredients.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Dip or sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Crawfish Puffs
ingredients: 2 c. (8 oz.) crawfish tails, coarsely chopped
steps: Sift together dry ingredients.
Beat egg yolks, milk and vegetable oil until blended.
Add to dry ingredients and beat until blended.
Stir in crawfish, rice and green peppers.
Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry, then fold into batter.
Add Tabasco sauce to taste.
Drop batter by tablespoonfuls into deep, hot fat (375°).
Fry until golden, 3 to 4 minutes, turning once. Drain on paper towel and serve with cocktail sauce or tartar sauce. Makes 24 puffs.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Combine flour, sugar, oil, egg yolks, pineapple cinnamon and nutmeg in large bowl.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Fold into batter.
Fold in pecans.
Pour into a 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes, or until cake tests done. Let cool in pan.

recipes.title: Christmas Mix (Snack)
steps: Melt chocolate and oil in double boiler.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Peas And Spareribs
steps: Saute onion and garlic in oil in 4 or 5-quart pot or skillet. Add spareribs and brown.
Sprinkle with paprika, add peas, water and wine.
Cover and simmer 1 hour, until ribs are tender.
Add tomatoes, green pepper, brown sugar, chili powder, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook slowly for 30 to 45 minutes.
Serves 4. Good over rice.

recipes.title: Hot Water Gingerbread
steps: Put molasses,
shortening
and	sugar
in
mixing bowl. Dissolve baking soda in boiling water and pour into bowl.
Mix well and let cool.	Add
eggs, nuts and raisins.
Mix and sift remaining ingredients.
Add to mixture in bowl, mix well until smooth.
Pour into 8 x 8 x 2-inch cake pan.
Bake in 350° oven for about 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamed Celery
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can water chestnuts, sliced thin
1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
steps: Cook celery in lightly salted water until tender; drain.
Add water chestnuts, soup and pimento.
Top with bread crumbs, almonds and melted butter.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: "Hands-Off" Chicken
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup (do not dilute)
steps: Mix rice and soups together.
Spray dish (long, flat 2-quart dish) with Pam and put soup and rice in the casserole dish.
Place raw chicken on top of rice mixture.
Then sprinkle onion soup mix over everything.
Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°.

recipes.title: White Conch Chowder
steps: Pound and dice conch.
Fry bacon, saute onions, add conch and all other ingredients except the milk.
Simmer for one hour, add milk and heat.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Casserole
steps: Mix together soup, onion, mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Add chicken, rice, celery and eggs; toss lightly.
Put mixture in 9 x 13-inch baking dish; top with bread crumbs.
Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cheese Rolls
steps: Combine dry ingredients in large mixer bowl.
Heat milk and oil in saucepan over low heat until warm.
Add 1 egg and warm liquid to flour mixture; beat 1/2 minute at low speed and 3 minutes at medium speed.
By hand, gradually stir 2 cups flour, Cheddar cheese and 2 to 3 cups more flour until soft dough.
Knead on floured surface until smooth and elastic.
Cover and let rise until doubled in size.
Punch down dough.
Shape into rolls. Place in greased pan.
Cover; let rise 15 to 20 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange-Raisin Fruitcake
steps: Extract orange juice, then put orange pulp, rind, nuts and raisins through food chopper.
Keep 1/4 cup of nut mixture for topping.
Mix remainder with orange juice, sugar and shortening until light and fluffy.
Add eggs. Mix.
Add flour, soda, salt and buttermilk.
Mix well and pour into a tube pan.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Peel potatoes and slice medium thin.
In saucepan, melt butter.
Blend in flour and add milk.
Stir until boiling.
Add cheese, salt and pepper.
Put sliced potatoes and onion in buttered baking dish.
Pour cheese sauce over these and bake at 375°, uncovered, for 1 hour or until potatoes are done.

recipes.title: Squaw Corn
ingredients: 1 (17 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drain and save juice
8 slices bacon, sliced into small pieces
steps: Cut bacon across strip into 1/4-inch pieces. Chop onion and pepper about the same size. Fry bacon; drain. Discard half of the bacon fat.
Add liquid from corn and chopped vegetables.

Cook over medium-high heat until thick syrup forms on bottom of pan, stirring frequently. Add corn, bacon, pimento, salt, pepper and chiles. Stir to mix and continue cooking until corn is heated through.
("Great for company.")

recipes.title: Old-Timey Biscuits
steps: Sift flour and cut lard into mixture.
Add sugar and buttermilk; mix well with hands.
Roll out and place apart on baking sheet that has been greased with margarine.
Bake at 450° for about 18 minutes, or until brown on the bottom, then broil tops until golden brown.
Brush margarine over the tops while hot.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix butter, sugar, cocoa and milk.
Boil hard for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add vanilla and oats.
Drop by spoon on waxed paper.

recipes.title: The Great Pumpkin Cookie
steps: Cream butter.
Gradually add sugars.
Beat until light and fluffy.
Add egg and vanilla.
Mix well.
Add dry ingredients. Mix.
Add pumpkin.
Stir in chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Broccoli Raisin Salad
steps: Rinse broccoli well and cut flowerets into bite-size pieces. Toss with raisins, onion and crisp bacon pieces.
Combine cream cheese and remaining ingredients in blender.
Pour over broccoli. Mix well.
Serve well chilled.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafers
steps: About 1 1/2 hours before serving or up to 1 week ahead: Preheat oven to 350°.
In medium bowl with mixer at low speed, beat all ingredients until blended, occasionally scraping bowl with rubber spatula.
Drop dough by 2 teaspoons about 2 inches apart, onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake cookies 10 to 12 minutes until edges of cookies are browned.
With pancake turner, remove cookies.

recipes.title: Annie'S Pound Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spray Pam on a 10-inch tube pan.
Have all ingredients at room temperature.
Cream together the butter, shortening and sugar.
Add extracts.
Beat in eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Sift flour with baking powder and salt; add to egg mixture alternately with milk.
Blend well after each addition.
Pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Cool 15 minutes before turning gently onto plate.

recipes.title: Georgia Brown Bread
steps: Cut up dates and sprinkle soda over dates.
Pour water over them.
Let stand until cool.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Round Up
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Combine shortening and sugar in mixing bowl.
Beat until light and fluffy.
Add eggs and beat until well blended in peanut butter.
Sift together flour, salt and soda. Combine with peanut butter.
Stir in oats.
Roll dough to form small balls.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet.
With fork, press cookie balls.
If dough sticks to fork, dip in flour. Bake for about 12 minutes.

recipes.title: D-Gumdrop Fruit Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. baking soda dissolved in 1 Tbsp. hot water
steps: Cut gumdrops into small pieces.
Cream butter and sugar together.
Add well beaten eggs.
Add flour and applesauce alternately.
Stir in baking soda and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Fold in nuts, raisins and gumdrops (chopped candied cherries and candied pineapple may be added for variety).
Bake slowly in about 250° oven approximately 3 hours.
Will make 4 small loaves or one large tube pan.
I use all orange slices, 2 pounds.

recipes.title: Chili Chicken
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can Hormel no bean chili
1 (14 to 15 oz.) can Mexican stewed tomatoes
steps: In a large skillet, saute poultry in oil until no longer pink. Set aside.
In same skillet, cook onion, peppers and garlic until tender. Drain. Stir in chili and tomatoes.
Add rice and pepper sauce.
Arrange chicken on top.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Top with shredded cheese.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Pie
steps: Place chicken in a 13 x 9-inch greased baking dish.
Mix soup and broth.
Pour over chicken.
Break eggs over this.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Slowly melt butter being careful not to burn.
Add brown sugar while butter is still warm.
If brown sugar is clumpy, place with butter in microwave until sugar softens.
Add eggs and vanilla and beat until creamy and of a slightly lighter color.
In separate bowl, mix dry ingredients together and add to mixture.
Fold in chips.
Place 2-inch balls on ungreased sheet and bake at 325° for about 12 to 15 minutes.
Take out and cool for one minute.

recipes.title: Carrot Salad
ingredients: 1 onion, sliced very thin and separated into rings
steps: Slice carrots and cook in salted water only until barely tender.
(Do not overcook.)
Drain.
Combine soup, sugar, vinegar and seasonings; blend well and slowly add salad oil while beating until well mixed.
Add to vegetables and let set overnight in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Laplands
steps: Grease muffin tin very thoroughly.
Sift flour and salt together.
Separate
eggs
and
beat
yolks
until
thick
and creamy.
Whip the
cream
until
it
holds its shape.
Now add flour and whipped cream to the egg yolks alternately beginning and ending with the flour.
Whip egg whites until stiff.
Dump egg batter on
top of whites and mix with your hands until all the white patches have disappeared.
Work quickly.
Spoon into muffin tin, filling half full.
Bake in preheated oven at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Bacon, Cheese And Macaroni Bake
steps: Cook bacon until crisp.
Cool and crumble.
Cook macaroni according to directions.
Combine macaroni, crumbled bacon and tomato sauce.
Cut cheese up in pieces and mix in with other ingredients.
Put in a 2-quart casserole dish sprayed with Pam and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes, until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Corn Kalasky Soup
steps: Mix egg, sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt and flour.
Bring water and 1 cup
milk to a boil.
Have batter ready.
Drop into boiling mixture gently.
Turn heat down.
Dumplings go to bottom of pan (cover).
Add butter, corn and 1 cup milk.
Cook until warmed through.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Gingerbread
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°. Beat butter at medium speed of an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually add sugar, beating well. Add eggs and molasses, mixing well. Combine flour and next 4 ingredients. Add to butter mixture alternately with hot water, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix after each addition. Pour batter into a greased and floured 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve with whipped cream. Makes 9 servings.

recipes.title: Crab Bisque Soup
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 oz.) can cream of asparagus soup
1/4 c. dry white wine or sherry
steps: Blend soups.
Stir in milk and cream.
Heat just to boiling. Add crab.
Heat.
Stir in wine just before serving.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Half Moon Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Frost 1/2 chocolate and 1/2 white frosting.

recipes.title: Quick "N" Hearty Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced or 2 cans mushrooms (6 to 8 oz. each)
steps: Saute mushrooms in a little oil; set aside.
Brown hamburger, draining off fat.
Add tomatoes, mushroom mix, broth, water and seasonings.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Stir in rice and cover.
Set aside for 5 minutes. Makes 9 cups.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
steps: Drain pineapple and save juice.
Put pineapple in a butter dish.
Mix sugar and flour and sprinkle over pineapple and add 1 cup pineapple juice.
Pour over.
Put a cup of grated cheese.
Melt 1 stick of butter and 2 tablespoons of brown sugar and stir up crushed crackers (Ritz).
Sprinkle over the ingredients.
Bake 40 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: White Buttermilk Sheet Cake
steps: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add vanilla and then salt.
Add egg whites one at a time, beating after each one.
Beat in 2 tablespoons flour.
Add 3/4 cup buttermilk with baking soda added. Add remaining flour and buttermilk alternately.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes in 10 x 15-inch sheet cake pan that has been greased and floured.
Cool and frost with buttercream frosting.

recipes.title: Oven Barbecue Hamburgers
steps: Mix all ingredients and make medium size patties.
Brown in small amount of cooking oil and set aside.
Make the sauce.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Cream first 3 ingredients together.
Add eggs, one at a time. Beat after each egg.
Add cake flour, 1/2 cup at a time.
Beat each time.
Add lemon or almond extract.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour in greased, floured Bundt pan.

recipes.title: Chicken And Sour Cream Enchiladas
steps: Cook and cube chicken.
Mix together all ingredients, except cheese and tortillas.
Put a little of the mixture in the bottom of pan (so they don't stick).
Put 2 tablespoons of mixture in tortilla and some of the cheese, roll and place in pan.
After all are rolled up, spread rest of sauce and cheese on top.
Bake for about 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: No Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix sugar and cocoa.
Add milk and margarine.
Bring to a boil for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes.
Add vanilla and oatmeal.
Remove from heat.
Spoon out on wax paper.
Let cool.
Cookies will harden while cooling.
Yield: 2
dozen.

recipes.title: Dishpan Cookies
steps: Cream together first 5 ingredients.
Add flour, soda and salt to mixture.
Fold in oats, then corn flakes.
Bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes.
Makes 100 (2 1/2-inch) cookies.
"A dishpan full!"

recipes.title: No Fail Yeast Rolls
steps: Stir yeast, salt and sugar into flour.
Heat milk until hot to touch.
Add milk and oil to dry ingredients, beating until well blended, for about 5 minutes.
Then with a spoon, add as much flour as needed.
Turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth. Place into a greased or oiled bowl and cover with a towel.
Let rise until double.
Punch down and turn out onto a floured surface. Roll out; cut with a biscuit cutter.
Put into oiled pan and let rise until double.
Cook at 400° until brown.

recipes.title: Lime Cookies
steps: Cream margarine and confectioners sugar. Add vanilla, lime juice and zest of limes. Combine flour, cornstarch and salt. Mix into butter mixture. Roll batter onto wax paper. Refrigerate. Slice and bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350°. Coat with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Okra And Tomatoes
steps: Put fat in skillet. Add onions and tomatoes. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and sugar. Add okra and cover; simmer until okra is tender, about 5 minutes. Stir all together. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Very Best Burrito
steps: Combine milk and pudding mix and blend 1 minute.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Fold in 2 cups of Cool Whip.
Add about 1 1/2 cups of strawberries.
In bowl combine sugar and cinnamon.
Butter both sides of tortillas.
Sprinkle one side with the sugar/cinnamon mixture.
Put in 350° oven, sugar/cinnamon side up, only about 2 minutes until bubbly.
Take out of oven and let stand 3 to 4 minutes.
Fill shells with sugar side out.
Top each with Cool Whip and add sliced strawberries.

recipes.title: Rum Cake
steps: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs, one at a time beating and mixing thoroughly.
Sift flour, salt, soda and baking powder; add buttermilk and rum flavoring.
Add vanilla.
Pour into tube pan and bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Small Apple Crisp
steps: Lightly spray 8 x 8 pan; place apple in pan and sprinkle with lemon juice and water.
Combine remaining ingredients and cover apples.
Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until apples are done and brown.

recipes.title: Two-Handed Cookies
steps: Beat eggs; add sugars, peanut butter, oleo, soda and vanilla. Mix well.
Stir in remaining ingredients; mix thoroughly.
Drop dough on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Mixed Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 c. mandarin oranges, canned and drained
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Let stand in refrigerator.

recipes.title: German-Style New Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. sliced green onion with tops
steps: Peel strip around center of each potato.
Cook potatoes in boiling water.
Drain.
Halve any large potatoes.
In bowl, combine cooked potatoes, lettuce, curly endive, eggs, radishes and green onion.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Mix all dry ingredients together; add eggs and butter.
Add milk.
Put in well-greased dish and bake at 350° until thick, about an hour.

recipes.title: Christmas Pumpkin Bread
steps: Combine oil, eggs, 1/2 cup water.
Stir in the rest of ingredients and put in greased loaf pan.
Bake at 250° for one hour.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
steps: Mix egg and milk; dip steak in and then in flour.
Brown lightly in shortening.
Add onions and green peppers to meat in shortening.
Add water and soup; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Banberry Surprise
ingredients: 1 box white or yellow cake mix
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add strawberry soda pop and cool completely.
Mix cake according to package directions (do not use cake mix with pudding in it).
Bake in 13 1/2 x 9 1/2 x 2 inch greased and floured pan.
Let cool completely.
After cake is cooled, using potato peeler, poke lots of holes all the way to the bottom.
Pour gelatin and soda pop mixture over cake.
Cover entire top of cake with thick sliced bananas.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Cut broccoli; do not cook.
Mix in bacon, onion and cheese. Mix together mayo, sugar and vinegar and pour over broccoli. Chill.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
ingredients: 4 large Vidalia or other sweet onions, sliced in rings
1 1/2 pkg. buttery flavored crackers (50 crackers), crushed
steps: Preheat
oven
to
Saute
onion rings in 1/4 cup butter.
Combine
remaining
butter
with
cracker
crumbs. Reserve 1/4
of
crumb mixture for topping and layer remaining crumbs into
bottom
of greased 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Spread sauteed onion rings over crumb layer and sprinkle with cheese, salt and paprika.
Combine eggs and milk and pour over layers. Top with reserved crumb mixture and bake 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Pralines
steps: Cook all ingredients, except pecans and vanilla, to soft ball stage (240°).

recipes.title: Pineapple Crush Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines pineapple cake mix
1 (4 serving size) pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
steps: Cake:
Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour two 13 x 9 x 2-inch pans.
Prepare cake as directed on package.
Divide evenly in pans.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish. Stir together soup, chicken and vegetables in dish.
Combine flour, milk and butter.
Stir until smooth.
Pour over mixture in dish.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Hardee'S Biscuits
steps: Mix all ingredients together and roll out on floured board. Cut out and bake at 350° until light brown on greased cookie sheet, about 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 14 biscuits.

recipes.title: Willie'S Homemade Boiled Chicken And Rice
steps: Boil chicken thighs for 1 hour and 45 minutes.
Stir in 2 cups rice.
Cook, covered, for 20 minutes longer.
Ready to serve.

recipes.title: Apricot Foldovers
steps: Add cut-up margarine to flour.
Make well in flour; add egg yolks and sugar that's been mixed together.
Mix with fingers; sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cold water.
Continue to work with fingers.
Make into a ball, wrap in wax paper and refrigerate until chilled.
Preheat oven to 325°.
Take dough out and divide into 2 balls; refrigerate one.
Roll part of dough to about 1/8-inch thickness on slightly floured surface.
Cut into 2 1/2-inch rounds.
Put rounds on slightly greased cookie sheet.
In center of each, put 1/2 teaspoon of apricot preserves and pinch around edge or use fork.
Brush top with mixture of egg and milk. Sprinkle with nuts.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown. Remove from rack.
Cool.
Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cut-Out Cookies
steps: Blend well with spoon the oleo, cream cheese and sour cream. Gradually add sugar, continuing to beat until light.
Add egg yolks (slightly beaten with vanilla).
Beat until light and fluffy.
Add flour sifted with baking powder and salt and mix

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in lukewarm water. Add the remaining ingredients. This will keep in refrigerator for 1 week. Dip out needed amount in flour; pinch off and place in greased skillet. Bake in 400° oven for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Almond Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix flour, baking soda and salt.
In a blender, grind 1/2 cup blanched almonds to a fine powder, add to flour mixture.
Cream the sugar, shortening, almond extract, egg and water and add to dry mixture.
Mix thoroughly.
Form into 1-inch balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart. Press one of the remaining almonds into the center of each ball while flattening it slightly with fingers.
Brush cookie with beaten egg.
Bake 20 minutes or until light brown.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Angel Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream sugars, margarine and shortening. Beat in egg and vanilla.
Gradually add flour, soda, cream of tartar and salt mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips and nuts (optional).
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until firm to touch.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Pie
steps: Combine 10 caramel candies; cut each into 4 pieces.
Add 1/3 cup flour.
Add 3 cups (cut into 1/2-inch cubes) Jonathan or Rome apples, 2/3 cup caramel ice cream topping and 2 teaspoons lemon juice.
Mix well.
Bake at 375° on a preheated baking sheet for 40 to 45 minutes.
Store at room temperature.

recipes.title: Diced Mcintosh Apple Cake
steps: Add sugar to diced apples and let stand for 10 minutes.
Sift flour and spices.
Blend oil and egg into apple mixture.
Add flour mixture all at once.
Beat with large spoon until well blended.
Pour into a 9-inch well greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits
steps: Grate cheese.
Mix all ingredients.
Roll and pinch off marble size. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes (do not overbake).

recipes.title: Carla'S Five Can Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Place in casserole dish.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Red Beans And Rice
steps: Sort and wash beans.
Combine beans and water in large Dutch oven; bring to a boil.
Cover; reduce heat to medium and cook 40 minutes.
Add next 8 ingredients; cover.
Reduce heat and simmer 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Mash most of beans against side of Dutch oven with back of a spoon; stir well.
Cover and bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium-high and cook, uncovered an additional hour or until desired degree of doneness, stirring occasionally. Discard bay leaves.
Serve over hot cooked rice.

recipes.title: Microwave Chicken Divan
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup
1/4 c. Pepperidge Farm herb bread crumbs
steps: Pierce hole in broccoli package and cook 3 minutes in microwave oven.
In a mixing bowl, mix soup, sour cream, lemon juice, garlic powder and soy sauce.
Set aside.
Put rice and broccoli in greased 2-quart casserole dish and add half of the soup mixture.
Add chicken and remaining soup mixture. Top with Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Cover with plastic wrap. Cook 8 minutes. Turn dish 1/2 turn and cook 6 to 8 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix together.
Add extra flour if needed.
Roll out; cut into shapes.
Bake for 7 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecued Ribs
steps: Cook rack of ribs in Dutch oven or regular 350° oven for about 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until done.
In a bowl, mix together remaining ingredients.
Pour sauce over ribs and bake, uncovered, until brown, about 20 minutes.
Keep basting ribs with sauce.

recipes.title: Onion Patties
steps: Mix together first six ingredients.
Stir in enough cold water for thick batter.
Mix in onion and drop by teaspoons into deep fat.
Flatten patties slightly as you turn them.
Fry to a golden brown.

recipes.title: Creole Pork Chops
steps: Salt and pepper chops; brown well in skillet, then put in baking dish.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chops. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 1 1/2 hours, or until tender.
Turn chops after an hour.
Have a barbecued taste.

recipes.title: Beth'S Cheese And Bacon Quiche
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. grated Swiss or Gruyere cheese
steps: Preheat oven to 425°. Sprinkle bacon over bottom of pastry shell. Combine eggs, cream, salt, nutmeg and cayenne pepper in a bowl and beat until thoroughly mixed. Sprinkle cheese over bacon and ladle egg mixture over top. Bake 15 minutes at 425°, lower the heat to 350° and bake another 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Crawfish Casserole
steps: Saute celery, bell pepper and onion in margarine.
Combine with tomatoes and steam on low fire.
Mix in soup.
Cook rice according to directions.
Mix rice with tomato-soup mixture.
Add grated cheese and crawfish.
Bake at 350° about 40 minutes or until bubbling.
Don't stir.
Enjoy with salad and French bread. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Cheese-Pineapple Casserole
steps: Put pineapple in 2-quart casserole dish.
Mix flour, sugar and cheese and cover pineapple.
Cover this with cracker crumbs. Drizzle margarine over crumbs.
Bake at 350° until bubbly, approximately 20 minutes.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
steps: You will need 2 regular size muffin pans.

recipes.title: Peppered Steak
ingredients: 2 tomatoes, wedges or 1 pt. canned tomatoes
steps: Cut steak in strips.
Mix garlic, soy sauce, salt and 1/4 cup water.
Add steak.
Marinate steaks 1 hour (longer if possible) tossing occasionally.
Drain steak.
Save the marinade.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
steps: Cream margarine and sugar together.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Stir into margarine mixture with milk. Beat until smooth.
Pour into greased baking dish.
On top of the batter, place peach slices close together.
Pour about 1/4 cup of peach juice over the peaches and batter.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°. Serve with milk or ice cream.

recipes.title: Spicy Hillbilly Rice
steps: In a large kettle (4 to 6-quart), place olive oil over heat (medium-low to medium). Add onion, celery, bell pepper, garlic, basil, salt and pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir frequently. Add uncooked rice and stir to blend well. Cook for about 2 minutes. Add tomato juice and chili powder. Stir to blend. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low, cover and cook until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Serve with shredded Cheddar cheese, if desired. Serves about 8.

recipes.title: Southwestern Potatoes
ingredients: 1/4 c. chopped fresh parsley or 4 tsp. dried parsley
steps: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Line 2 large baking sheets with foil.

recipes.title: Favorite Chicken
ingredients: 8 (4 oz.) boneless skinless chicken breast halves
steps: Preheat oven to 325°. Combine cranberry sauce, dressing and soup mix in small mixing bowl and mix well. Spread half the cranberry mixture over bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Arrange chicken in single layer over prepared layer. Top with remaining cranberry mixture. Bake 30 to 45 minutes until chicken is cooked through. Serve over rice. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Chicken
steps: Line bottom of baking dish with 6 slices of Armour dried beef. Top with boneless chicken breasts.

recipes.title: Polly'S Sour Cream Banana Nut Bread
ingredients: 4 eggs, add one at a time
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients in bowl, mixing well after each ingredient is added.
In another bowl, sift together salt, soda, baking powder and flour.
Add alternately with sour cream to first 6 ingredients.
Fold in nuts.
Bake in two large loaf pans at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: My Favorite Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 1 each diced bell peppers (green and red)
steps: Fry onions, bacon and mushrooms together, turning frequently until bacon is sufficiently cooked (not crispy).
In a separate frypan, heat vegetable oil on medium-high temperature for 2 to 3 minutes.
Season sliced potatoes with paprika, pepper and salt as listed in large bowl.
Reduce temperature to low-medium; add sliced potatoes slowly to hot oil; turn potatoes frequently.
Fry until light brown color is achieved.
Combine all ingredients in one frypan and cook an extra 10 to 15 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 4 to 5 potatoes, cut in large cubes
steps: Cook chicken in seasoned water until tender; reserve broth. Debone. Cook potatoes, celery and carrots in broth until tender. Reserve 3 cups broth. Melt butter and flour; stir a few minutes. Add milk, 3 cups chicken broth, salt and pepper. Mix everything together, including peas. Pour in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Shape crusts to fit and put them on top; make a few slits. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Japanese Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 Cup uncooked long grain converted or parboiled rice (not instant or quick white rice)
steps: Cook the rice following the instructions on the package. This should take about 20 minutes.
Pour the rice into a large bowl to let it cool.
Scramble the eggs in a small pan over medium heat.
chop scrambled chunks of egg into small pea-sized bits with your spatula while cooking.
When the rice is cooled, add the peas, carrots, eggs and onion to the bowl. Carefully toss all of the ingredients together. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium/high heat.
When the butter has completely melted, dump the rice mixture into the pan and add the soy sauce plus a dash of salt and pepper.
Cook the rice mixture for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often.

recipes.title: Stroganoff Style Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 boneless butterfly pork chops 1 inch thick
steps: In a large skillet on medium heat brown pork in oil for 5 minutes.
Remove; keep warm.
In the drippings saute onion and mushrooms until tender, stir in water, mustard and salt; bring to boil.
Return chops to pan; reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, until chops are tender.
Remove and keep warm.
Combine flour and sour cream until smooth; add to skillet.
Bring to a boil; cook and stir 1-2 minutes or until thicken.
Serve pork chops and mushroom sauce with noodles.

recipes.title: Twice-Baked Italian Cookies
ingredients: 1/4 c. anisette or other anise liqueur
3 Tbsp. bourbon or 2 tsp. vanilla and 2 Tbsp. water
2 c. coarsely chopped almonds or walnuts
steps: In a bowl, mix sugar, butter, anise seed, liqueur, bourbon, almonds and eggs.
Beat to blend. Stir together flour and baking powder. Add to butter mixture and blend thoroughly. Cover and refrigerate dough until firm, 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: No-Peek Chicken
steps: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle rice on bottom.
Layer chicken, skin side up on rice.
Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken.
Mix water with both cans of soup and heat, then pour over chicken.
Cover with foil and bake 2 hours at 325° to 350°.

recipes.title: Wilted Lettuce
steps: Fry bacon until crispy.
Remove from skillet and set aside. Into bacon drippings stir, vinegar, water, sugar, salt, onion and egg.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Add lettuce to skillet and toss with hot dressing quickly.
Remove to bowl.
Crumble bacon on top.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chunk Bars
ingredients: 3/4 c. (1 1/2 sticks) butter or margarine, softened
steps: Mix flour, baking soda and salt in medium bowl; set aside.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Potato Bread
ingredients: 1/2 c. butter or regular margarine, softened
steps: Make potatoes for 2 servings, as label directs, using liquid, omitting butter and seasoning.
Measure 1 cup.
In large bowl, sprinkle yeast over water; stir until dissolved.
Stir in sugar and salt until dissolved.
Add 1 cup potatoes, butter and 3 1/2 cups flour.
With electric mixer at medium speed, beat until smooth, 2 minutes.
Gradually add 4 cups flour, mixing with hands until smooth and stiff enough to leave bowl.
Add remaining 1/4 cup flour, if needed.
Turn out onto lightly floured board.
Knead until smooth, electric, small blisters appear on surface, 10 minutes.
Place in greased large bowl; turn over.
Cover with towel.
Let rise in warm place (85°), until double, 1 hour.
Turn out dough onto lightly floured pastry cloth or board.
Divide in half.
Roll out one-half into a 16 x 8-inch rectangle; roll up from one end.
Press ends even, pinch to seal and tuck under loaf. Place, seam side down, in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Brush surface lightly with some of the melted butter.
Repeat with other half of dough.
Let loaves rise in warm place, until tops are rounded, 1 hour.
Set oven rack at lowest level.
Preheat oven to 400°.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until deep golden brown and loaves sound hollow when tapped.
If crust becomes too brown, cover with brown paper.
Turn out onto wire racks, brush tops with remaining butter.
Cool.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Five Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) can B & M baked beans
steps: Saute celery, green pepper and onion in sausage drippings until tender.
In large roaster, combine all of the ingredients except bacon.
Put bacon on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Goulash
steps: Combine flour, salt, paprika, and mustard.
Roll meat in flour mixture.
Brown meat slowly in hot oil.
Sprinkle remaining flour mixture over meat.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Then remove vegetables and bay leaf. Pack meat into jars, leaving 1/2 inch headspace.
Cover with sauce, 1 pint 1 hour, 1 quart 1 hour and 15 minutes at 10 pounds pressure.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease bottom only of muffin tin or line with baking cups.
Combine all ingredients except for blueberries. Mix well.
Now add blueberries.
Mix just until blended.
Fill cups and bake 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Cake With Chocolate Icing
steps: Beat egg whites at high speed with an electric mixer until stiff peak forms.
Set aside.
Beat butter and shortening until creamy; gradually add sugar beating well.
Add egg yolks, 1 at a time, beating until blended after each addition.
Combine flour, cocoa and baking soda; add to butter mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture.
Beat at low speed until blended after each addition.
Stir in coconut, chopped pecans and vanilla.
Fold in egg whites.
Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 8 inch cake pans.
Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes our clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes.
Remove cake layers to wire rack and cool completely.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
ingredients: 12 c. cooked rice (6 c. wild rice and 6 c. plain rice)
1 box frozen baby peas, thawed but not cooked
steps: Combine all and add dressing as much as desired.
There may be too much dressing for this recipe.
Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Fried Peach Pies
steps: Combine flour, baking powder and 1 teaspoon of salt; cut in 1/3 cup butter with pastry blender until mixture is crumbly.
Sprinkle cold milk (1 tablespoon at a time) evenly over surface.
Stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened.
Shape into a ball. Chill.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Rice
ingredients: 1 can mushroom soup plus 1/2 c. water
steps: Spread rice on bottom of oblong dish.
Dissolve bouillon in water and pour over rice.
Place pork chops on rice.
Pour mushroom soup and water over chops.
Sprinkle onion soup over all. Cover with foil and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Chicken can be substituted for chops.

recipes.title: Hedge Hogs
steps: Cook first 6 ingredients for 5 minutes.
Stir in Rice Krispies. Roll in balls.
Then roll balls in mixture of coconut and confectioners sugar.
Makes about 24 balls.

recipes.title: Chopstick Tuna
steps: Mix together and bake 20 minutes at 375°.
Inexpensive and very good for tuna.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Stir apples and sugar together and let stand until sugar is dissolved.
Mix in remaining ingredients and bake at 375° for 40 minutes in an 8 x 8-inch pan.

recipes.title: Low Cholesterol Pound Cake
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Sift baking powder and flour together.
Add to sugar mixture with milk.
Fold in egg whites, vanilla and lemon flavoring.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Saute onions in butter.
Add broccoli and cook until soft. Mix with remaining ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Famous Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Beat together the shortening, sugars, egg, water and vanilla until creamy.
Sift together flour, salt and soda; add to creamed mixture.
Blend.
Stir in oats.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Date Balls
steps: Cook over low heat first 4 ingredients for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 1 1/2 cups Rice Crispies.
Add rest of Rice Crispies if needed.
Prepare aluminum foil with part of coconut; spread over to put mixture on adding more coconut as needed.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
steps: Soften butter; don't melt.
Cream softened butter with sugar; beat well.
Add flour, corn meal and eggs.
Pour in buttermilk and vanilla.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream butter, shortening and both sugars.
Add eggs and beat well.
Blend in flour and soda; mix in vanilla.
Roll in small balls.
Sprinkle with sugar and place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with glass or refrigerate until firm (overnight) and roll out and cut with cutters.
Color may be added.
Best when soft (before refrigerating).
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Artichoke, Potato And Bacon Salad With Fennel Flowers
ingredients: 3 or 4 fennel flowers with stalks 6 to 8-inches long
juice of 1/2 lemon or 1/2 c. cider vinegar
1/2 each: large red, yellow and green bell peppers
steps: Wash and cook potatoes just until tender.
Cut onion lengthways into quarters and cut thinly crosswise.
Soak in cold water.
Cut peppers into strips, 1/4 x 1-inch long.
Cut artichokes in half.
Slice artichokes crosswise in 1/4-inch slices.

recipes.title: Carrot Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. herb flavored stuffing mix plus rice
1 (10 oz.) can cream of celery soup
steps: Prepare herb stuffing as directed on package.
Set aside. Melt 3 tablespoons butter. Add onion and saute until glassy.
Add soup and cheese, stirring until heated through and cheese is melted. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Add the cooked carrots. Turn into greased casserole (2-quart). Cover with stuffing mix.
Drizzle 1/3 cup melted butter over top.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole 1
steps: Mix all ingredients.
If bacon drippings are cold, melt them first.
Pour into ungreased dish.
Bake at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: In a bowl, beat eggs and sugar until light and fluffy.
In a double boiler, melt chocolate and butter over hot water.
Add egg mixture to the chocolate mixture.
Combine flour, baking powder and nuts in a bowl.
Add to chocolate batter and stir until smooth.
Put in a greased 8-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.
Let cool and then cut into squares.

recipes.title: Rich Lemon Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a medium bowl combine 1 1/2 cups flour and 1/2 cup confectioners sugar.
Cut in margarine until crumbly.
Press into bottom of lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Bake 15 minutes.
Meanwhile in a large bowl combine eggs, granulated sugar, baking powder, ReaLemon and remaining 3 tablespoons flour.
Mix well.
Pour over baked crust for 20 to 25 minutes, until lightly browned.
Cool.
Cut into bars.
Sprinkle with additional confectioners sugar.
Store, covered, in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cream Puff Dessert
steps: Cook water and oleo until oleo is melted, then stir in flour; beat well.
Let cool, then add eggs, one at a time; beat well. Spread in cake dish and bake at 350° until golden brown (about 25 minutes).

recipes.title: Deer Stew
steps: Cut deer up into small pieces; boil for about 1 hour and a half on medium-high.
Dice onion, potatoes and carrots; add to boiled meat after half hour cooking.
Add all other ingredients and continue cooking for the other hour.
Serves 3 to 6.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 9 slices bacon, fried or use a whole lb.
steps: Mix together dressing, vinegar and sugar.
Pour over other ingredients.
Recipe can easily be doubled.

recipes.title: 7 Layer Salad
ingredients: lettuce, torn in bite size pieces
1 medium onion, chopped or sliced (purple or green)
steps: Layer lettuce, onion, peas and eggs. Sprinkle with bacon.
Ice top with mayonnaise.
Sprinkle top with shredded cheese.

recipes.title: Rice-Con-Queso
steps: Spray a 1 1/2-quart casserole with cooking spray.
Combine all ingredients and pour into casserole.
Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
steps: Microwave 1 pound of frozen bacon at Medium-low for 4 to 6 minutes.

recipes.title: Wild Rice Soup
steps: Saute butter and onion until tender.
Blend in flour. Gradually add chicken broth and cook until it thickens slightly. Stir in wild rice and salt.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Blend in half and half and sherry.
Heat to serving temperature.
Add meat and carrots at this time, if desired.
Mushrooms, water chestnuts or chopped bacon may also be added at this time.
Top with sliced almonds, if desired.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Our Favorite Chocolate No-Bake Cookies(Kids' Stuff)
steps: Form cake in a dragon cake mold with your favorite cake mix and bake.
Get dry ice; place in small container at mouth of dragon.
Decorate with green icing.

recipes.title: Pinakbet
ingredients: 1 medium size bitter-melon (fresh or canned), sliced 1-inch thick
steps: Combine all ingredients except eggplant, bitter-melon and okra.
Bring to a boil.
Lower heat and simmer, covered, until beef is tender.
Add eggplant, bitter-melon and okra; cook for 15 minutes.
If using canned bitter-melon, add last 3 minutes of cooking.

recipes.title: Diet Vegetable Soup
steps: Cut cabbage in small pieces.
Add 2 cans mixed vegetables (Veg-All).
Add 2 cans chicken broth.
Add 1 large can whole tomatoes.
Add large can tomato juice.
Salt to taste.
You can add green beans, peas, carrots or any canned vegetables.

recipes.title: Hearty Potato Soup
steps: In a
large kettle, cook potatoes, carrots and celery in water until tender, about 20 minutes.
Drain, reserving liquid, and setting vegetables aside.
In the same kettle, saute onion in butter until soft.
Stir in flour, salt and pepper; gradually add milk, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Gently stir in cooked vegetables.
Add one cup or more of reserved cooking liquid until soup is desired consistency.
Yield:
8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Marsha'S Dessert
steps: Heat oleo, nuts and flour in 350° oven for 20 minutes.
Press down and let cool.
Mix powdered sugar, cream cheese and Cool Whip on top of cool crust.
Mix puddings with milk and let thicken. Pour over cream cheese topping.
Top with Cool Whip and a few pecans.

recipes.title: Chicken Saltimbocca
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. chicken cutlets, sliced thin
flour, salt and pepper mixture (to coat cutlets)
steps: Coat cutlets with mixture of flour, salt and pepper.
Brown in butter and remove as cooked.
Sprinkle 3 tablespoons flour into pan drippings.
(You may have to add more butter to drippings.) Stir in wine, tomato sauce, chicken broth, lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste.
Cook over low heat until sauce thickens.

recipes.title: Chicken Veronique
steps: Skin and bone chicken breasts lengthwise.
Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces; set aside.

recipes.title: Diabetic'S Cake
steps: Combine applesauce, oil, egg and sugar substitute.
Combine remaining ingredients and add them to applesauce mixture.
Pour into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until it tests done.

recipes.title: Italian Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans (8 3/4 oz.) whole kernel corn, drained
2 cans (2 1/4 oz.) sliced ripe olives, drained
1 (16 oz.) pkg. wide noodles, cooked and drained
8 oz. Cheddar cheese, cut into strips
steps: In a Dutch oven over medium heat, cook sausage, beef, onion and green pepper until meat is browned and vegetables are tender; drain.
Add tomato sauce and paste, water and seasonings; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add corn and olives; cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in noodles. Pour into two greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dishes; top with cheese.
Cover and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through.
Yield: 16 to 20 servings.

recipes.title: Date Bread
steps: Mix dates, butter, sugar and boiling water and add remaining ingredients.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Magic Apple Pie
steps: Combine sugar and egg.
Sift together baking powder and flour, then add to sugar mixture.
Toss together nuts and apple, then add to batter.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
steps: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water; let stand 5 to 10 minutes. Combine sugar, flour and salt; cut in shortening.
Pour 1 cup buttermilk on top of flour mixture; add yeast to buttermilk and mix slightly.
Add other cup of buttermilk and mix well.
Knead on floured board.
Store in covered container in refrigerator.
Will keep 1 week.
Take amount needed; roll or cut biscuits.
Dip in melted butter.
Biscuits are lighter if dough is allowed to double in bulk before baking.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Play Dough
steps: Combine all and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thick.
Turn out onto floured wooden surface.
Knead like bread until no longer sticky.
Add food coloring.

recipes.title: Short Ribs
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb. boneless short ribs (fat trimmed)
steps: Sprinkle salt and pepper on all sides of short ribs and put into Dutch oven or a 3-quart covered casserole dish.
In a small saucepan, combine the tomato soup with the molasses, vinegar, liquid smoke and minced onion; bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour over short ribs; cover and bake in a 275° oven for 3 to 4 hours, or until very tender.
Just before serving, spoon off any excess fat.
(If you prepare this dish ahead, refrigerate it and then lift off the solidified fat before you reheat it.)
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Mix ingredients in order given.
Bake in 8 x 12-inch pan at 350°.
Batter will be thick, depending on how juicy the apples are. If too thick to spread, add 1 or 2 tablespoons water.
No other liquid is necessary.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Make cream sauce of butter, flour, salt, pepper, broth and milk.
This will be thin.
Add chicken and drained peas and carrots.
Put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Make pie crust; roll thin and cut out like biscuits. Place on top of chicken mixture. Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Quiche Casserole
ingredients: 1 (26 oz.) carton frozen quiche filling with ham, thawed
1 medium size sweet red pepper, seeded and cut into rings
steps: Place bread evenly into a lightly greased 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish. Set aside. Stir garlic powder into quiche filling. Pour over bread. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Top with pepper rings and bake 5 additional minutes. Let casserole stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
steps: Mix shortening, sugar and eggs together thoroughly.
Sift flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt together.
Mix together.

recipes.title: Smothered Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 3 lb. chicken, cut up or 4 boneless chicken breasts
steps: Combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika. Coat chicken with flour mixture. Melt margarine in heavy skillet. Brown chicken on both sides. Remove from heat. Brown remaining flour mixture in margarine until golden brown, stirring constantly. Slowly stir in water to make gravy. Return chicken to skillet and add onions. Cover and cook on low heat until done, about 25 or 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix sugar, cocoa and flour.
Add eggs and milk, a little at a time, mixing well.
Cook on medium heat, stirring until thick. Add butter and vanilla.
Pour into baked pie shell.

recipes.title: Chicken And Sausage Gumbo
steps: Place flour in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until caramel colored, stirring flour every 5 minutes. Brown sausage in a Dutch oven or large skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat.
Drain and pat dry with paper towels.
Wipe drippings from Dutch oven.
Brown chicken; drain and pat dry.
Wipe drippings from Dutch oven.
Cook onion, green pepper and celery in Dutch oven (coated with cooking spray) until tender; sprinkle with browned flour.
Gradually stir in water; bring to a boil.
Add sausage (cut into 1/4-inch slices); add chicken, garlic, bay leaves, Worcestershire sauce, hot sauce, thyme, salt and green onions (optional).
Reduce heat and simmer mixture (uncovered) for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Sift flour and salt.
Cream butter.
Blend in sugar and add eggs.
Beat until smooth and fluffy.
Add vanilla and stir in cocoa.
Add flour alternately.
Add nuts.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes in a buttered pan.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. stew beef or top round
steps: Dredge meat with flour.
Saute mushrooms and onion in a little oil until onion is clear.
Add beef and brown.
Add tamari and spices.
Simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Flaky Yellow Pastry
ingredients: 2 egg yolks, beaten with enough cold water to fill scant c.
steps: Cut shortening into dry ingredients.
Very gradually add egg/water mixture while gently mixing with fork.
Don't overwork dough.

recipes.title: Layered Salad(Makes 10 To 12 Servings)
ingredients: 1 small head lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
1 (17 oz.) can tiny peas, drained or 1 (10 oz.) frozen peas, thawed
1/2 lb. bacon, cooked, drained and crumbled
1 bunch fresh spinach, torn into bite-size pieces
1 can water chestnuts, sliced and drained
steps: Place lettuce and spinach in the bottom of a large salad bowl. Top with peas, water chestnuts, onion, crumbled bacon and two sliced hard-boiled eggs.
Sprinkle with salt, then pepper as desired.
Combine mayonnaise and sour cream, stirring well. Spread mayonnaise mixture over salad to seal tightly.
Sprinkle with cheese, then sugar.
Garnish with remaining 2 hard-boiled egg slices.
Chill 8 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Easy Asparagus Au Gratin
steps: Sauce:
Melt margarine in a saucepan.
Stir in flour until well blended.
Slowly stir in 2 cups milk.
When sauce is smooth and hot, reduce heat and stir in cheese.
Season with salt, pepper, Dijon mustard and Worcestershire sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Primavera
ingredients: 2 to 4 c. thinly sliced vegetables (celery, sweet peppers, onions, mushrooms)
steps: Brown chicken. Remove from skillet and blend soups and paprika.
Add chicken and vegetables.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until chicken and vegetables are tender. Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Turtle Cookies
ingredients: 1 (18.5 oz.) box German chocolate cake mix
steps: Empty caramels in saucepan with 1/3 cup of milk.
Melt, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Combine cake mix, 1/3 cup milk, melted butter and nuts.
Press two-thirds of cake mixture in greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake in 350° oven for 10 minutes.
Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked mixture. Spread caramel mixture over top of chips.
Add remaining cake mix by spoonfuls on top of caramels.
Bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes. Cut while warm.
Makes 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Nacho Pizza
steps: Cut tortillas in quarters, making 16 wedges.
Place vegetables evenly on wedges on 2 baking sheets.
Spoon sauce over vegetables and top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until cheese starts to brown.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Hamburg Casserole With Cheesy Buttermilk Biscuits
steps: Fry hamburg, onion and peppers.
Let cool.
Cook potatoes and celery and add milk and flour; cook until creamy.
Place layer of potatoes, then layer of hamburg, ending with potatoes on top.
Mix biscuit mix (buttermilk kind).
Roll biscuit dough out flat and sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.
Roll up like jelly roll and cut; place on top of potatoes.
Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Budapest
ingredients: 6 whole chicken breasts, boned, skinned, halved
steps: Soak raisins in mandarin juice.
Melt butter, brown chicken breasts on both sides.
Cook over low heat 15 to 20 minutes until chicken is done.
Remove chicken from skillet, place on serving platter and keep warm.
Pour off all but 3 tablespoons of pan drippings and stir in flour, paprika, salt and pepper, mix.
Add half and half and cook over low heat until smooth and thick.
Stir in raisin and mandarin juice mixture and heat through.
Pour sauce over chicken.
Serve over wild rice.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: New England Clam Chowder
steps: In large saucepan, cook onion in margarine until tender.
Add potatoes, salt, bacon bits, pepper and 1 cup water.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Stir in clams and milk.
Heat.
Do not boil.
Makes 6 servings, about 130 calories each.

recipes.title: Jamaican Fruit Cake
steps: Presoak fruit in wine or rum.
Combine fruits and nuts.
Sift flour and mix 2 cups with fruit and nuts. Cream butter until soft and blend with sugar.
Add eggs, singly beating well. Add jelly.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines white cake mix
steps: Cut strawberries in half to use in cake (save other half for icing).
Mix all the ingredients.
Pour into 2 layer cake pans; bake in 325° oven until done.

recipes.title: Mama'S Pineapple Salad
steps: Cook beaten egg yolks, pineapple juice, sugar and butter in double boiler until done.
Thicken with flour.
Pour this cooked custard over pineapple, apples and nuts and chill.

recipes.title: Oriental Dish
steps: Cut chicken breasts into strips.
Marinate chicken strips in soy sauce, cherry wine and cornstarch for 20 minutes.
Saute chicken in cooking oil until brown.
Add onion, garlic and bell pepper with carrots.
Cook until vegetables turn a bright color. Add broccoli slaw mix, sesame seed and ginger.
Serve with white rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole(Low-Fat Version)
ingredients: 1/2 c. low-fat Mozzarella or Swiss cheese
steps: Saute onion slightly in Pam-sprayed pan.
Add flour, mustard, salt and pepper.
Gradually add milk and broth, stirring constantly.
Cook until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in sour cream.
Combine with potatoes and top with cheese and corn flakes, if desired.
Bake in 13 x 9-inch Pam-sprayed pan at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Date Pudding
steps: Bake 45 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
ingredients: 3 (12 oz.) cans white Shoe Peg corn
steps: Combine the flour, sugar and baking powder.
Stir in corn, eggs, pimentos, salt, pepper and milk.
Pour in buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Dot top with butter.
Add decorative dashes of paprika.
Bake, uncovered, 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs, flour, buttermilk and vanilla.
Pour in unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Long John Silver Fish Batter
steps: Blend beer, flour, butter, egg yolks and seasoning.
Let stand for 10 minutes.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Fold into batter.
Dip cleaned and deveined shrimp or fish into batter. Deep fry at 375 for 5 to 7 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
steps: Measure raw rice into a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Mix dry onion soup mix, cream of chicken soup and 1 soup can of water. Arrange pieces of chicken on top (legs, thighs and breasts are good).
Sprinkle chicken generously with paprika.
Bake in 350° oven, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Then, if chicken is tender, let it brown, uncovered, for 15 more minutes.
Watch that the rice mixture stays moist.
You might want to add a little hot water. This is good baked in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan covered tightly with foil.
The paprika gives the chicken color.
Also, there is no salt added as the soups give plenty of flavoring.

recipes.title: Microwave Brownies
steps: Mix all ingredients and put in greased 8-inch square dish. Cook at full power for 6 to 7 minutes, rotating dish 1/2 turn after 3 minutes of cooking.

recipes.title: Blueberry Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. each: salt, baking powder, almond flavoring and vanilla
steps: Mix ingredients well.
Put in 2 greased loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to one hour until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

recipes.title: Sausage-Bread Stuffing
ingredients: 2 red skinned apples, cored and diced
1 loaf (1 lb.) firm type white bread, cut in 1-inch cubes
steps: In a large skillet, fry the sausage and bacon until crisp and brown.
Remove sausage and cut into 1-inch pieces.
Replace in skillet and add onion, celery, mushrooms, apples, parsley and herbs.
Saute, stirring occasionally for 5 minutes.
Stir in bread cubes and chicken broth.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Vidalia Onion Casserole
ingredients: 2 beef bouillon cubes, dissolved in 1 c. hot water
steps: Saute onions in margarine until tender.
Remove from skillet and place in a bowl.
Add flour, salt and pepper.
Mix well and while stirring, gradually add beef bouillon.
Fry bread cubes or croutons in margarine in the skillet.
Combine with onion mixture.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Candy
steps: Mix syrup and sugar; bring to a boil.
Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter and then stir in the Rice Krispies.
Pour into a greased pan.
Cut into squares when cool.

recipes.title: Potato Stuffing
ingredients: 1/4 c. salted pork, cut in small pieces
steps: Mix together very good.
May use in any recipe calling for stuffing.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Melt margarine.
Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa.
Beat eggs, then add sugar.
While beating, add vanilla and melted margarine.
Stir in dry ingredients.
Add pecans.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes in a 9 x 9-inch pan.
Makes 12 bars.

recipes.title: Fudge Pie
steps: Mix well and pour into uncooked pie shell.
Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.
If desired, cover top with chopped pecans before baking.

recipes.title: Chocolate Drop Cookies
steps: Cream shortening.
Gradually add sugar, beating at low speed of electric mixer until light and fluffy.
Add egg, chocolate and vanilla; beat well.
Combine flour, soda and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with milk, stirring well.
Stir in pecans or walnuts.
Drop dough by teaspoonfuls, about 1 1/2 inches apart, onto greased cookie sheets.
Bake in a 350° oven for 12 minutes, or until done.
Remove to wire racks.
Frost with Chocolate-Coffee Frosting while still warm.
Yields about 4 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Tea Cookies
steps: Mix softened butter with 1/2 cup sugar, vanilla, flour and baking soda.
Mix in pecans and form balls, about the size of a round tablespoon.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Cool and roll in more powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Calico Beans
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen lima beans, thawed
steps: Drain all beans.
Cook meats and onion in skillet.
Drain. Stir in catsup, mustard and vinegar.
Combine remaining ingredients in 3-quart casserole, stir in meat, cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until bubbly.
Garnish with bacon if you wish.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Apple Bread
ingredients: 2 c. apples, peeled, cored and coarsely chopped
steps: In bowl, combine flour, cinnamon, soda, powder and salt.
Set aside.
In large bowl, place oil, sugar, eggs, vanilla and apples. Stir flour mixture; add walnuts and mix.
Divide mixture between two greased 8 x 4-inch bread pans.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until bread tests done.
Cool for 10 minutes on rack before removing from pans.

recipes.title: Garlic Steak
steps: Dredge steak in flour; pound to 1/2-inch thickness.
Cut steak into serving size pieces.
Brown steaks in hot oil in a Dutch oven.
Remove from skillet and set aside.
Add onion to pan drippings; saute until tender.
Return steak to Dutch oven; add remaining ingredients except noodles.
Cover.
Reduce heat and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until steak is tender.
Serve over noodles.

recipes.title: Applesauce Nut Bread
steps: Sift flour, baking powder, salt, soda and cinnamon together. Stir in walnuts and raisins, tossing to coat well with flour mixture.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Cake
steps: Cream margarine and shortening; add sugar and beat until smooth.
Add egg yolks and beat well.
Combine flour and soda. Add to cream mixture alternating with buttermilk.
Stir in vanilla; add coconut and chopped nuts.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Bake in a 3 (8-inch) pans, greased and floured.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Nothing Cake
steps: Beat eggs and brown sugar in mixer bowl until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Pour into 3-quart glass cake pan.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.
Serve with vanilla ice cream and chocolate or butterscotch sauce.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Cookies
steps: Mix flour, soda, and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs and mix well. Add vanilla and flour mixture and mix well. Shape in round loaf. Wrap in waxed paper and chill over night. Cut in thin slices and bake in 350 oven.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
ingredients: 1 c. milk or a little more
steps: Mix dry goods in a medium bowl.
Soften shortening in the baking pan or iron skillet in oven at 300°.
Pour into the bowl with the dry goods.
Turn oven to 425°.
Add egg and milk.
Stir. Pour into pan/skillet.
Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes until golden on top.
(Clabber Girl recipe.)

recipes.title: Barbecue Burgers
steps: Mix together.
Make patties and brown.
Place patties in baking dish.

recipes.title: Persimmon Pudding
steps: Mix pulp, eggs and sugar together.
Add milk, then flour, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add butter.
Bake for 1 hour at 300°.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
steps: Cook and stir onion, celery, green pepper and garlic in oil until tender, not brown.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and seasoning.
Simmer, uncovered, 45 minutes.
Cook over low heat. Mix cornstarch with 2 teaspoons water.
Stir into sauce.
Add shrimp.
Cover and simmer until tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve over rice.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Picklelets
steps: Beat the egg and sugar until thick and add with the milk to the sifted flour, salt and baking powder.
Lastly, add the melted butter.
Mix until smooth and cook in spoonfuls on a hot grease griddle or frying pan.
Serve with butter, jam or sliced strawberries.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Beat eggs, sugar, oil and sifted dry ingredients.
Add carrots. Stir nuts in last.
Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Aunt Sandy'S No-Bake Cookies
steps: Cook first 4 ingredients together until they boil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove from stove and add the other ingredients all at once.
Mix together quickly.
Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Let harden.
The secret to this recipe is to work quickly and time carefully.

recipes.title: Bacon And Egg Bake
steps: Fry bacon until crisp.
Drain fat, reserving 2 tablespoons. Saute onions in bacon fat.
Stir in soup, milk, eggs, cheese and seasonings.
Bake in an 8 x 8-inch dish for 20 minutes at 350°. Top with crumbled bacon and serve over muffin halves.

recipes.title: Drop Dumplings
steps: Combine until just moistened.
Drop by spoonfuls onto bubbling stew, chicken and gravy, etc.
Cover and simmer 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Japanese Fried Chicken
steps: Blend all ingredients (except chicken).
Add chicken, soak for 20 minutes and deep fry.

recipes.title: Texas Rice
ingredients: 1 single serving size envelope instant creamy chicken soup mix
steps: In 3-quart casserole, combine the water, uncooked rice, soup mix and onion.
Cover, cook on 100% power (High) for 4 to 5 minutes or until boiling.
Let stand, covered, 5 minutes.
Stir before serving.
Garnish with parsley, if desired.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Cornbread
steps: Mix dry ingredients; add milk, oil, eggs and corn. Mix well. Add peppers and onions. Pour 1/2 mixture into greased 9 x 14-inch baking pan or 10-inch iron skillet. Sprinkle 1/2 of Cheddar cheese; add balance of mixture. Top with remainder of cheese. Bake in a 375° oven for 35 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Cornbread Pot Pie
ingredients: 2 c. cut up cooked chicken, ham or beef
3/4 c. (4 oz.) diced process American cheese
1 tall can (12 fluid oz.) Pet evaporated milk, divided
steps: Mix meat, peas, corn, cheese, 1 cup milk, onion and Worcestershire sauce.
Pour into greased 12 x 8-inch baking dish or shallow 2-quart casserole.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes or until bubbly at edges.
Mix well baking mix, cornmeal, sugar, salt, egg and 2/3 cup evaporated milk.
Pour on hot mixture, leaving center uncovered.
Spread to edges.
Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Hot Bacon Dressing
steps: Brown the Sizzlean on both sides and drain on paper towels. Stir together the dry ingredients.
Stir in the egg, vinegar and water.
Add the bacon.
Cook slowly, stirring until thickened.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Put in large mixing bowl and mix as little as possible. The batter will be a
little chunky.
Bake in tube pan in 350° oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pecan Clusters
steps: Melt chocolate in double boiler or microwave.
Stir in nuts; mix well.
Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.
Makes approximately 20 to 25 pieces.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 2/3 c. chopped sauerkraut, rinsed and drained
steps: Cream eggs and butter in bowl until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Sift dry ingredients together. Add to creamed mixture alternately with 1 cup of water, beating well after each addition. Stir in sauerkraut. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8-inch pans. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Frost with favorite frosting.

recipes.title: Seafood Newburg
ingredients: 1 lb. lobster or 2 pkg. (7 oz.) frozen tails
steps: Remove lobster from shell.
Cut meat in bite size chunks and reserve.
Make sauce of butter, flour, salt, pepper, milk and evaporated milk.
Cook one minute.
Beat egg yolks and stir in sherry.
Stir in 1 cup sauce into the egg yolk mixture and then add this to the rest of the sauce.
Cook for one minute or until thickened, stirring constantly.
Add lobster chunks, scallops and shrimp and heat.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Beat eggs well.
Mix in remaining ingredients.
Pour cake into greased round cake pans covered with wax paper.
Cook at 325° for 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Down South Marshmallow Brownies
steps: Melt one stick butter and stir in all other ingredients except the marshmallows. Pour into a greased and floured 8 x 8 inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. After baking, cover the brownies with miniature marshmallows. Put back into oven long enough to melt the marshmallows, but do not let them brown. Cover with icing.

recipes.title: Famous Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Beat shortening, sugars, egg, water and vanilla together until creamy.
Sift flour, salt and soda; add to cream mixture and blend well.
Stir in oats; drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pistachio Cookies
ingredients: 3 3/4 oz. pkg instant pistachio pudding mix
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees: Lightly grease cookie sheets.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chipper Champs
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix brown sugar, margarine, vanilla and eggs in a large bowl until well blended.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls about 3-inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheet.
Press 3 or 4
additional candies in each cookie, if desired. Bake until light brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Cool slightly. Remove to wire rack.
Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: "Buch'Ta"
steps: Warm milk, add yeast and sugar; let melt.
Add the eggs, salt, margarine (melted) and oil.
Add flour and knead dough approximately 20 minutes.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Coca-Cola Cake
steps: Sift sugar and flour together in bowl; set aside.
In saucepan melt butter; add cocoa and Coca-Cola.
Bring to a boil; boil one minute.
Add to dry ingredients.
Mix buttermilk and soda and add. Add eggs and vanilla; stir until smooth.
Last, stir in marshmallows.
Pour into greased pan (9 x 13-inch); bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
steps: Cream oleo and shortening with sugar.
Add eggs one at a time and blend well after each.
Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk.
Add vanilla.
Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Soup With Matzo Balls
steps: Place chicken, water, onions, leek, celery, salt and pepper in 8 to 10-quart Dutch oven.
Bring to boiling; reduce heat and simmer covered for 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours.
Add carrots and parsnips; simmer covered for 30 more minutes.
Remove chicken and refrigerate if you are not planning to use as main meal.
Lift vegetables from broth with slotted spoon, then strain broth. Return vegetables to broth.
