Add parsley and dill if desired. Heat through and serve in bowls with Matzo Balls.
Serves 15.

recipes.title: Italian Love Cake
steps: Grease and flour 11 x 13-inch pan.
Make cake according to box directions; pour into pan.
Mix vanilla, sugar, eggs and cheese. Pour gently over cake mix.
Do not blend.

recipes.title: Chile Rellenos Casserole
ingredients: 2 (4 oz.) cans green chiles, cut in halves crosswise and seeded
steps: Brown meat and onion together. Layer chiles, cheese, meat and chiles in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix together flour, salt, eggs, milk and hot pepper sauce.
Pour over.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
steps: Mix sugar, flour and salt together.
Add milk, beaten egg yolks and margarine.
Cook until it bubbles good and gets thick. Let cool.
Add 3 cups of sliced strawberries.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cottage Cheese Salad
ingredients: 2 c. boiling water or 1 c. water and 1 c. fruit juice
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Mix other ingredients together.
Add to cooled jello and chill.

recipes.title: Cherry Christmas Cake
ingredients: 1/2 lb. (2 sticks) butter, softened (can use margarine)
1 c. pecans or walnuts (leave in large chunks)
steps: Beat butter until softened and light.
Add sugar and beat until fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, and beat after each addition. Stir in almond flavor.
Mix flour and salt together.
Add to butter mixture alternately with milk (about 1/3 each time).
Fold in nuts and cherries.
Bake in greased tube or Bundt pan at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.title: Charlotte Russe(Basic Recipe)
steps: In a double boiler, beat the egg yolks and add 2 tablespoons sugar gradually while beating.
Add salt and milk.
Cook over hot water until mixture coats the spoon, stirring constantly.
Soften gelatin in cold water; add to hot custard and stir until dissolved.
Cool slightly.
Beat egg whites stiff; fold in.
Whip the cream; add remaining 3 tablespoons sugar and vanilla extract. Fold in.
Line sherbet glasses or spring-form mold with the ladyfingers and fill with the custard.
Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Chicken Spectacular
ingredients: 1 box Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice, cooked by directions
steps: Cook chicken.
Chop when cooled.
Add remaining ingredients. Bake in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased pan at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Beat the eggs and sugar together.
Gradually add oil; add vanilla.
Mix flour, soda, salt and cinnamon together.
Gradually add flour mixture to first mixture (will be thick).
Fold in apples.
Add 1 cup nuts or raisins.
Bake in a 375° oven for 45 minutes.
Use greased 9 x 13-inch sheet pan.
Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Orange Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Beat all ingredients at low speed, scraping bowl often, until all ingredients are moistened.
Spoon batter into greased tin.
Bake 17 to 22 minutes.

recipes.title: Delicious And Healthy Pancakes
ingredients: 1 egg white, beaten to soft peaks
2 tsp. olive oil or salad oil
steps: Preheat frypan or griddle.
In medium bowl, combine dry ingredients.
Add buttermilk and skim milk; stir just until combined.
Fold in egg white gently; add olive or salad oil.
Cook on hot griddle which has been sprayed with nonstick spray.
These pancakes contain no cholesterol.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Cream the butter, sugar and sour cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each one.
Add flour and baking soda which have been sifted together.
Add flavoring.
Bake in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan in 325° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until cake tests done in center.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chip Cookies
steps: Cream together oil, shortening and sugars.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Sift in flour, baking soda and powder.
Mix in oatmeal, Post Toasties, chocolate chips, pecans and coconut.
Put 6 scoops on each cookie sheet with an ice cream scoop.
Heat oven to 350°. Cook 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Roasted Salted Pecans
steps: Toss pecans in bowl with oil until well coated.
Spread on cookie sheet; salt to taste.
Cook at 400° for about 10 minutes. Check; should be a little brown.
Remove from oven and cool.
Pack into containers.

recipes.title: Andes Candies Cookies
steps: In small saucepan, combine margarine, sugar and water until sugar has dissolved.
Add chocolate chips till partially melted. Remove from heat and stir until chips are totally dissolved and mixture is smooth.
Let stand 10 minutes.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
steps: Mix cake mix as directed.
Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Put pecans in bottom of cake pan; spread cake mix over pecans.
Melt stick of margarine; mix with cream cheese and powdered sugar.
Pour over cake mix.
Bake at 300° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into unbaked pie crust.
Bake 30-40 minutes at 350 degrees.
Serve with whipped topping or vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Rice Medley
ingredients: 1 (17 oz.) can peas and tiny onions, drained (save juice)
steps: Add enough water to reserved vegetable liquid to measure 1 1/2 cups.
Pour into 2-quart saucepan.
Heat to boiling.
Stir in peas, rice, butter, salt and carrot.
Heat to boiling. Remove from heat.
Cover and let stand until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender, about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pan Fried Liver
steps: You will need an iron frying
pan.

recipes.title: Cheese And Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 c. (8 oz.) shredded extra sharp Cheddar cheese, divided
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Cook and stir onion in margarine in large skillet until tender.
Stir in chicken, 1/4 cup picante sauce and cream cheese; cook until thoroughly heated.
Stir in 1 cup cheese.

recipes.title: Potato Soup(Microwave)
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes (1 lb.), peeled and diced
steps: Combine potatoes, onions and water in a 2-quart microwave-safe dish. Cook, covered, on full power, 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Stir one time. Lightly mash potatoes. Stir in flour. Add milk, salt and pepper. Cover and cook on full power 5 minutes longer, stirring every minute or until soup boils and is thickened.

recipes.title: Miracle Brownies
steps: Mix all together and beat well.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Cut steak into bite size pieces; place in bowl.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Place in refrigerator for 2 hours.
Brown flour with butter; gradually add beef consomme soup.
Add mustard, sour cream and catsup.
Bring to a boil.
Set sauce to one side.

recipes.title: Sausage Swirls
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Blend in vegetable oil.
Add enough milk to make a stiff dough.
Thinly roll out dough (1/4-inch thick) on a lightly floured board into two 10 x 18-inch rectangles.
Spread on sausage; roll up lengthwise.
Chill well and slice 1/4-inch thick.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Brunswick Stew
ingredients: 1 (3 to 4 lb.) chicken, squirrel or beef
steps: Cut chicken as for frying, place with seasonings in a large kettle with enough cold water to cover.
Bring slowly to a boil, simmer until meat comes off bones.
Remove bones, cut chicken in fairly large 1/2-inch pieces.
Return to pot; add onions, potatoes and butter beans.
Cook until done; add tomatoes and corn, cut from cob.
Cook slowly for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Prune Bread
ingredients: 2 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 cup buttermilk
steps: Beat eggs, sugar, cooking oil and prune baby food well and add other ingredients.
Grease and flour pans.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
ingredients: 1 c. candied orange slices, cut up
steps: Mix all together and put in muffin tins. Sprinkle pumpkin seed on top. Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Conga Bar
steps: Melt margarine and add sugar.
Stir and let cool.
Add eggs (one by one), flour and vanilla.
Stir.
Add peanuts and chocolate chips.
Stir again.
Pour mix in greased rectangular pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Swedish Apple Pie
ingredients: 7 to 8 apples, peeled, cored and sliced
steps: Fill a 9 x 9-inch or 9 x 13-inch pan full of apple slices. (Spray pan with vegetable spray first).
Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of cinnamon and sugar.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Mix flour, honey and salt together.
Add milk gradually.
Add beaten eggs and butter.
Beat for 2 minutes.
Add blueberries, sprinkled with flour.

recipes.title: 6 Layer Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) jar Green Goddess dressing, mixed with 1 1/2 jalapeno peppers (fresh or canned), chopped
steps: Layer ingredients in order.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Salad
steps: Combine French dressing, mayonnaise, salt and pepper to make dressing.

recipes.title: Anise Cookies
steps: Add salt to eggs and beat until thick; add sugar gradually. Continue beating until sugar is dissolved.
Add anise and beat until thoroughly blended.
Beat in flour to make a moderately stiff dough.
Chill dough for several hours or overnight; roll into a rectangular sheet 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick on floured board.
Cut cookies in 1 1/2-inch squares; place on greased baking sheet and chill, uncovered, for about 1 hour.
Bake at 325° for 15 minutes. Cool and store in covered container.
These can keep for weeks. Makes 60 cookies.

recipes.title: Simple Shortbread Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Roll out on floured board (1/4 to 1/2-inch thick).
Cut into desired shapes and arrange on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 10 to 15 minutes.
When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: None Such Mincemeat Prize Cookies
steps: Cream together until fluffy the shortening and sugar.
Add eggs; beat
until smooth.
Stir together the flour, soda and salt. Add to first mixture.
Stir crumbled mincemeat into dough.
Drop onto greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart by rounded teaspoonfuls. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375° until lightly browned.
Makes about 6 1/2 dozen.
A tasty, mild, fruity cookie.

recipes.title: Reuben-Wich
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large warm bowl.
Add sugar, salt, margarine and 2 1/2 cups flour; beat until smooth.
Stir in enough more flour to make soft dough.
Knead 6 to 8 minutes.
Place in greased bowl; turn to grease top.
Cover; let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes.
Punch dough down; divide in half.
Roll half to 14 x 10-inch, spread half dressing down center third of dough length.
Layer with half the beef, cheese and sauerkraut. Make cuts from filling to dough edges along sides of filling, 1 inch apart.
Alternating sides, fold strips at an angle across filling; place on greased baking sheet.
Repeat with remaining dough.
Cover; let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with caraway seed.
Bake at 400° about 25 minutes.
Serve warm.
Refrigerate leftovers; reheat to serve. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
steps: Cream together sugar, butter or margarine and eggs; mix well. Sift flour and then measure out three cups; add soda and salt and sift again.
Add flour mixture to butter mixture a little at a time letting your batter blend well between each addition.
Add in bananas and nuts and mix well.
Pour into well greased tube or Bundt pan and bake at 300° for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Rice Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen cut okra, thawed
1/4 lb. andouille or other smoked sausage, sliced
2 whole boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into cubes
1 small green pepper, cut into strips
1 1/2 c. Minute premium long grain rice (uncooked)
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet on medium-high heat. Add sausage; cook and stir until lightly browned. Add chicken, onion, pepper, celery and garlic; cook and stir until chicken is cooked through. Stir in tomatoes, okra, tomato sauce and seasoning. Bring to boil. Stir in rice; cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Stir.

recipes.title: Irish Kisses
steps: Beat up the butter and all the other ingredients.
Sift in enough flour to make a stiff dough.
Drop a teaspoonful at a time on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle with 4x sugar.
Bake in hot oven.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add egg and mix well.
Add all ingredients and blend well.
Drop with teaspoon on a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Savory Upside-Down Pie
steps: Thaw pastry.
Mix ground beef, salt, pepper and onion; bind with egg yolks.
Wash and quarter mushrooms.
Cover the bottom of an 8-inch loose bottomed cake pan with the bacon.
Arrange the cheese, herbs and mushroom quarters on top.
Cover the meat mixture, pressing it down firmly and smoothly on the top.

recipes.title: Never Fail Pie Crust
steps: Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Cut in shortening. Make a well in dry ingredients and add egg, vinegar and cold water.
Prepare as for any pie crust.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
steps: Combine ingredients.
Spread on cake while hot.
Brown under broiler until coconut is brown.

recipes.title: Short'Nin Bread
steps: Combine sugar and flour.
Add butter.
Place on floured board; pat to thickness of 1/2-inch.
Cut into shapes desired.
Bake in a moderate oven (325° to 350°) for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Neiman Marcus Cookies
steps: Cream the butter and both sugars.
Add eggs and vanilla; mix together with the flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and soda. Add chocolate chips, Hershey Bar and nuts.
Roll into balls and place two inches apart on a cookie sheet.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 375°. makes 55-60 cookies.

recipes.title: Pork Chops
steps: Put flour, salt and pepper in a bag.
Put pork chops in and shake until flour covers chops.
Put Crisco in frying pan.
One at a time, put chops in pan.
Cook on medium heat until done.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Mix
steps: Mix dry ingredients together and cut in shortening. Store in an airtight container.
Take the amount that you think you need and add egg and water.
Bake until golden brown.

recipes.title: Gingersnaps
steps: Combine the sugar with flour, salt, soda, cinnamon, ginger and cloves.
Cut in shortening until mixture looks like crumbs. Stir in molasses and egg.
Mix well.
Shape dough into 1 inch balls - no bigger- and roll in sugar.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Remove from cookie sheet immediately because cookies firm quickly as they cool.
Makes about 4 1/2 dozen cookies. These are good and easy to make.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
steps: Put oleo, cocoa and buttermilk in saucepan.
Heat over low heat, do not boil; remove and stir in sugar, pecans and vanilla. Beat, then spread while cake is still hot and serve.
Wonderful!

recipes.title: Texas Cake
steps: Mix flour and sugar.
Bring shortening, water, margarine and cocoa to boil.
Pour over flour and sugar mixture.
Add buttermilk (sour cream can be substituted), eggs, vanilla, baking soda and salt.
Mix thoroughly.
Pour into 12 x 17-inch sheet pan.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Triple Chocolate Bars
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) pkg. chocolate cake mix (do not use kind with pudding in mix)
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In large pan, cook pudding with milk as directed on package.
Blend dry cake mix thoroughly into hot pudding; beat one or two minutes.
(You don't add eggs or other ingredients listed on cake mix.)
Pour into greased, floured pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch.
Sprinkle with nuts and chocolate bits. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.
Cool and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Sixty Minute Rolls
steps: Combine 1 1/2 cups flour with the sugar, salt and undissolved yeast.
Combine milk, water and margarine in a saucepan.
Warm over low heat to 115° to 120°.
(Margarine does not have to be melted.)
Remove from heat and gradually add flour mixture.
Beat 2 minutes at medium speed, scraping sides of bowl occasionally. Add 1/2 cup flour.
Beat on high for 2 minutes.
Stir in additional flour to form soft dough.
Turn out onto lightly floured board.
Knead 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place in greased bowl.
Turn over and grease top.
Let rise 15 minutes. Turn out on a floured board.
Divide dough in half and shape into rolls.
Cover and let rest in a warm place for 15 minutes.
Bake at 425° for 12 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together; pour into a pie shell.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes, or until golden brown and not runny.

recipes.title: Danish Sesame Bran Bread
steps: Combine boiling water and cornmeal.
Combine 1 1/2 cups unbleached flour, 1 cup whole wheat flour, cereal, sesame seed, salt and yeast; blend well.
Heat milk, oil, molasses and honey until very warm.
Add warm liquid, cornmeal mixture and yogurt to flour mixture.
Blend well.
Stir in rest of whole wheat flour until stiff dough forms.
Knead in 1 to 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour about 8 minutes.
Place in greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap and cloth towel.
Let rise in warm place until light and doubled in size, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Ham And White Bean Soup
steps: Dice and saute celery, onion, carrots, zucchini, and ham in dutch oven with
olive oil and seasoning.
Stir in tomatoes, chicken broth, spinach, 1 can beans (smashed), and 2 cups water. Heat to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the rest of beans and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Frosted Coffee Bars
steps: Mix in order.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Bake in a 350° oven. Frost with powdered sugar frosting, flavored with coffee.

recipes.title: Crunchy Broccoli Salad
steps: Combine mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar to make dressing.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Lemon Nut Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar; sift baking powder and flour together and add to butter mixture, alternating with egg yolks. Add lemon extract, fruits and nuts; add stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake at 275° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken Acapulco
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, cut up and cooked
steps: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer chicken.
Melt margarine and add flour until smooth, add sour cream until it just bubbles.
Add soup, chilies and onion salt.
Blend well, pour over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Add cheese and bake until melted.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Banana Bread
steps: Cream together butter and sugar; add eggs.
Mix sour cream and soda in separate bowl and let stand until foamy.
Add sour cream mixture to egg and sugar mixture and mix well.
Pour into four greased and floured loaf pans (or 10 mini loaf pans 2/3 of the way full).
Bake 50 minutes at 350° or until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Rice
ingredients: 4 oz. Kraft natural Cheddar cheese, sliced
steps: Brown meat and onion in a large skillet on medium-high heat. Drain.
Stir in water, catsup and mustard; season with salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Stir in rice; cover.
Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes.
Fluff with fork.
Top with cheese; cover. Let stand until cheese melts.
Makes 4.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients and chill.

recipes.title: Mandarin Chicken
steps: Prepare chicken by removing bones and steaming good size pieces (good idea to buy breasts and thighs).
Dip in tempura batter and fry in hot deep oil.
Slice each piece in 1/2-inch to 1-inch slices.
Arrange on a bed of shredded lettuce.
Cover with sauce.

recipes.title: Trifle Pudding
steps: Mix and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 340° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Cream sugar and butter.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well. Pour mixture into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 325° until golden brown, about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Fried Squid(Calamari Fritti)
steps: Cut
squid
into
rings or 3-inch pieces.
If tentacles are large,
cut
in half.
Toss the squid in flour mixed with salt and
pepper;
coat
as
you
are
frying, to avoid flour getting soggy.
In a skillet, heat enough oil to measure about 1
to
inches
deep.
When
the oil is hot, add squid. Lower
heat just
a
little
and
continue to fry squid until nicely
golden. Drain on paper towels.
The squid should cook in
to 3 minutes. Place fried squid on platter and garnish with lemon wedges. Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Krispies
steps: In a large saucepan, mix together the corn syrup and sugar and heat slowly until it boils, stirring often.
Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter until it melts.
Then stir in Rice Krispies. Pour mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
When cool, melt chips and spread on top.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Pour into a glass pie plate.
Needs no crust.
Bake at 325° until browns on top.

recipes.title: Monster Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix in dishpan in order given.
Drop by large tablespoon or ice cream scoop and flatten.
Place 6 to a cookie sheet.
Recipe does not call for flour.
Bake for 12 minutes.
Do not overbake.
Makes 77 large cookies.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a bowl, combine oil, eggs, water and pumpkin.
Mix well.
In another bowl, sift together flour, salt, baking soda, nutmeg, cinnamon, cloves and sugar.
Gradually add dry mixture to liquids and mix well.
If you wish, stir in 1/2 cup nuts and/or raisins.
Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake for about 1 hour or until it springs back when lightly touched and sides of the loaf have pulled away from the pan.

recipes.title: Cheese Squares
steps: Mix like pie crust.
Add egg yolk and yeast mixture.
Divide into 2 parts and roll out on cookie sheet.
Top with cream cheese mixture.
Top with other crust.
Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Pot Roast (Beef Or Pork)
steps: I add 2 red peppers or 1 fresh jalapeno.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
steps: Mix together.
You may add a little more milk if needed.
Drop by teaspoon into hot, boiling grease.
Fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Heavenly Lemon Dessert
ingredients: 2/3 c. chopped walnuts, plus more for topping
steps: Mix flour and margarine like pie crust, add nuts and press into bottom of a 9 x 13 inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes; cool.
Cream together the cream cheese and powdered sugar; fold in 1 c. Cool Whip then spread over crust.
Mix the pudding mix using only 3 c. milk, and beat until stiff; spread over the cream cheese mixture.
Top with the remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle with chopped walnuts.
Chill well before serving.

recipes.title: Cherry Supreme
steps: Mix butter, flour and chopped pecans.
Press in a casserole dish.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.
Mix the cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip.
Spread on crust.
Add pie filling.
Eat!

recipes.title: Date Nut Bars
steps: Sift flour; add baking soda and salt. Sift again. Combine with brown sugar. Add melted shortening to beaten eggs and combine with dry ingredients. Add nuts and dates. Pour into greased 7 x 11 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cut in bars while hot. Sprinkle or roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Chocolate No Bake Cookies
steps: 1. Have all ingredients measured and ready.
Line a baking sheet with waxed paper or foil; set aside.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: Beat oil and sugar together.
Add eggs and banana.
Beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients, milk and vanilla.
Mix well and stir in nuts.
Pour into a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan.
Bake in a 350° preheated oven for 1 hour.
Cool well and store overnight before cutting. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Hopel-Popel
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. dehydrated hash brown potatoes
1 c. Swiss or Jack cheese, shredded
steps: Place potatoes	in
a
medium bowl.
Cover with boiling water. Let
stand
for
8 minutes or until water is absorbed. Heat skillet
and add bacon.
Cook and stir until bacon begins to crisp.
Add
the
onion
and
mushrooms.
Stir until barely tender.
Add
parsley,
sprinkling	it
evenly
over the bacon mixture and
potatoes.
Toss together lightly.
Adjust heat to low.
In a small mixing bowl, beat eggs with 1/4 cup of water. Add the
salt
and
pepper.
Pour
over vegetables in skillet. Sprinkle with cheese.
Cook
over low heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until eggs are set.
Cover skillet for part of cooking time to help eggs
set on top.
If desired, brown under broiler for 2 to 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Soup
steps: Put water and bouillon cubes in pot; boil until cubes are melted.
Add chopped broccoli, onion and celery (celery is a must).
Let boil until soft.
Melt butter and add flour.
Heat half and half in microwave, then add it to broccoli mixture.
Add butter and flour mixture.
Let simmer until it thickens.
Add parsley and dash of black pepper.
No salt is needed.

recipes.title: Huckleberry Muffins
steps: Combine oats and sour milk. Let stand.
Combine all dry ingredients.
Add egg and melted butter to oat mixture and mix well.
Add dry ingredients and stir only until moistened.
Fold in huckleberries.
Fill muffin cups 3/4 full.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Potato Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. sugar or as sweet as desired
1/2 c. vinegar or equal to amount of sugar used
steps: Boil potatoes in skins. Peel and slice thin. Cook bacon until crisp, then cook onion in bacon fat. Mix in flour, sugar, salt and pepper. Stir water in gradually. Add vinegar gradually. Cook and stir until it boils for 1 minute. Pour over potatoes. Add the bacon. Cover and let stand until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Add sugar to oil.
Add eggs and pumpkin.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Then add water.
Place in greased and floured pan. Add nuts, if desired.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Upside-Down German Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 box German chocolate cake mix, mixed as directed on box
steps: Grease and flour long cake pan.
Sprinkle on bottom the pecans and coconut.
Mix cake mix and pour in pan.
Mix butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar and spoon on top of cake mix.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Oats 'N Pumpkin Pinwheels
ingredients: 1 c. Quaker oats (Quick or old-fashioned), uncooked
steps: Beat 1 cup sugar and margarine until fluffy.
Mix in egg whites.
Stir in combined flour, oats and baking soda.
On wax paper, press into 16 x 12-inch rectangle.
Spread combined pumpkin, 1/2 cup sugar and spice over dough to 1/2 inch from edge. From narrow end, roll up dough.
Sprinkle sesame seed around roll, pressing gently.
Wrap in wax paper; freeze overnight or until firm.

recipes.title: Mexican Green Peppers
steps: Cut off tops of green peppers; remove seed.
Cook peppers 5 minutes in boiling water to cover (salt added).
Drain and set aside.
Combine next 7 ingredients.
Mix well.
Fill peppers with meat mixture.
Place in a 2-quart shallow casserole.
Pour tomato sauce over and around the peppers.
Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, mix eggs, sugar, butter, buttermilk, flour and vanilla until well blended.
Pour into pie shell and bake until golden brown (approximately 50 minutes).
Let cool before slicing.

recipes.title: B L T Salad Toss
steps: Combine tomatoes, celery, salad dressing, green pepper and onion; toss lightly.
Chill.
Add bacon; toss lightly.
Spoon vegetable mixture over shredded lettuce.
Garnish with additional cherry tomato halves and bacon curls.

recipes.title: Drop Dumplings
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Add melted butter and milk. Blend together.
Batter should be moist and stiff.
Drop by teaspoon into boiling liquid.
Cover and cook 18 minutes.
Yields 1 dozen dumplings.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Dish
ingredients: 1 can French-style green beans, drained (medium size can)
salt and pepper to season (if desired)
steps: Cook chicken; save broth.
Remove chicken from bone and cut in chunks.
Saute chicken and mushrooms in butter or oleo. Add the chicken broth
and	green
beans
and
bring this to a boil.
Stir in Minute
rice, then remove from heat.
Cover for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Hungarian Poppy Seed Nut Slices
steps: Cream butter and sugar; add egg.
Beat 2 to 3 minutes; add nuts and poppy seed.
Beat 1 minute.
Stir in flour and salt. Refrigerate until dough is easily shaped into rolls.
Make 2 rolls.
Roll in sugar; wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.
Cut into 1/4-inch slices.
Bake on ungreased pan at 325° for 20 minutes or until slightly brown.
Store in closed tin.

recipes.title: Easy Stroganoff
steps: Put beef, soups, onion, salt and pepper into a large pot. Simmer slowly for several hours.
When the meat is tender, add sour cream and mushroom pieces.
Bring to a boil and immediately serve over hot rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Nantucket Cranberry Pie
steps: Sprinkle 2 cups cranberries into buttered 10-inch pie plate. Combine 1/2 cup sugar and walnuts.
Sprinkle over berries.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chippers
steps: Cream together butter, sugars, egg and vanilla.
Add flour, chocolate chips and pecans.
Bake at 375° about 10 minutes. (Dough does better if chilled.)

recipes.title: Mississippi Mud Cake
steps: Melt margarine with cocoa in saucepan.
Remove from heat and stir into eggs, sugar, flour, salt, nuts and vanilla.
Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 35 minutes. As soon as it is taken out of the oven, sprinkle miniature marshmallows or marshmallow cream on top.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 4 whole chicken breasts, halved, boned and skinned
1 (8 oz.) pkg. fettuccine, cooked according to package
steps: Pound chicken breasts to 1/4-inch thickness between 2 pieces of waxed paper.
Mix salt, pepper, paprika and flour in a plastic bag; add chicken, one piece at a time, and shake to coat.
Place butter and oil in a saute pan or large skillet; heat over medium heat until bubbly.
Add garlic and chicken; saute, turning, about 6 minutes or until chicken is brown and fork can be easily inserted.
Drain on paper towels and keep warm.
Drain all but 2 tablespoons of cooking fat from pan; add wine and deglaze pan, scraping up brown bits.
Add lemon juice and heat 1 minute; return chicken to pan; add lemon slices and heat 2 minutes.
Add capers and pimento.
Sprinkle chives over all.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
steps: Bring all ingredients to room temperature.
Cream the butter; add sugar and beat.
Add eggs, one at a time, and beat.
Add flour and milk.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Korean Salad
steps: Cook bacon; drain and crumble.
In large salad bowl, mix spinach, sprouts, water chestnuts, eggs and bacon.
In a jar, combine oil, sugar, catsup, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and onion; shake well.
Sprinkle dressing on salad and toss.
Serve. Dressing refrigerates well and is good on any salad.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
1 c. Velveeta cheese or Cheez Whiz
steps: Cook chicken (cut into pieces) in water with 1 teaspoon salt. Strain and debone.
Use 2 cups broth to cook rice.
Saute onion and broccoli in oleo.
Mix all together and put in casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly hot.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken And Rice
ingredients: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery or mushroom soup
steps: Cut chicken in serving pieces; set aside.
Sprinkle washed rice in bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Pour 2 cups water over rice.
Place chicken on top of rice.
Place parsnips, cut in chunks, around chicken.
Mix soup and milk.
Pour over chicken. It will look very soupy.
Bake, covered, with foil at 325° for 60 minutes.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Ron'S Biscuits
steps: Dump all in big bowl and mix really good.
Sprinkle pastry cloth well with flour and roll dough out like a cross.
Take left side; fold to center.
Take right side; fold to center.
Take bottom; fold up.
Take top and fold down.
Roll over slightly with rolling pin, then cut biscuits out with top of drinking glass.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
steps: Mix flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, sugar, oil, eggs and undrained pineapple.
Mix only by hand.
Add bananas and nuts and mix again.
Bake in a tube or Bundt pan that has been greased and floured.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 5 minutes.
Let cool in pan 1 hour before removing to serving plate.

recipes.title: Double Cheese Biscuits
steps: Heat oven to 450°.
Lightly grease cookie sheet.
Mix flour, mustard and red pepper.
Cut in margarine with pastry blender until mixture resembles fine crumbs.
Stir in Swiss cheese, buttermilk and egg until dough forms.
Turn dough onto well-floured board; coat with flour.
Knead lightly 10 times. Roll or pat dough 1/2-inch thick; cut with floured 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter.
Place on cookie sheet.
Mix egg yolk and water; brush over biscuits.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden.
Serve warm.
Makes 10 biscuits.

recipes.title: Pie Crust(Low-Fat, Low Cholesterol)
steps: Sift into a bowl flour and salt.
Mix oil and milk.
Add all at once to the flour and stir until mixed,
Using the hands, form the mixture into a smooth ball.
Roll the dough between 2 sheets of wax paper until it is a circle about 11-inches in diameter. Remove one sheet of wax paper.
Turn the crust into a 9-inch pan. Remove wax paper.
Bake in 400° oven for 12 minutes or until browned.
If the crust is to be baked with a filling, follow the cooking directions for the filling.
Double the recipe for a double crusted pie.

recipes.title: True Texas Baked Beans
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Put in a large baking dish sprayed with Pam.
Cover top with crisp, crumbled bacon.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Peaches And Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. non-instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (29 oz.) can sliced peaches, drained (syrup reserved)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease sides and bottom of a 10-inch deep-dish pie pan. In a medium mixing bowl, mix together flour, salt, baking powder and pudding mix. Mix in butter, egg and milk. Beat for 2 minutes. Pour mixture into pie pan. Arrange the peach slices on top of the pudding mixture. In a small mixing bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Add 1/2 cup sugar and 3 tablespoons reserved peach syrup. Beat for 2 minutes. Spoon mixture over peaches to within 1-inch of pan edge.

recipes.title: Spice Nut Cake
steps: In mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, soda, cloves and cinnamon.
Add shortening, brown sugar and buttermilk.
Mix until all flour is moistened.
Beat 2 minutes; add eggs.
Beat 2 minutes more; stir in nuts.
Place in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes. Frost with Orange Butter Frosting.

recipes.title: Chocolate Delight
ingredients: 1 (13 3/4 oz.) pkg. frozen whipped topping, thawed
steps: Combine butter, flour and pecans.
Mix well.
Press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Cool completely.

recipes.title: Chocolate Lush
steps: Mix
flour, margarine and pecans.
Press in bottom of a 9
x 13-inch
pan.
Bake
for 30 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
Mix cream cheese,
powdered
sugar and 8-ounces Cool Whip; spread over crust.
Mix chocolate pudding and milk.
Spread over that layer. Top
with
another	8-ounces of Cool Whip and sprinkle chopped pecans on top; chill thoroughly.

recipes.title: Kayla'S Secret Muffins
steps: Cream butter and sugar until smooth.
Add vanilla and eggs, one at a time.
Add yogurt, mix at medium speed.
Mix in flour, salt, soda and poppy seed.
Put in muffin tins.
Bake at 400° approximately 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 14 muffins.

recipes.title: Blonde Brownies
steps: Melt butter over low heat.
Remove from heat and stir in brown sugar until well blended.
Cool.
Stir in egg.
Sift together and stir in flour, baking powder and salt.
Then stir in vanilla and walnuts.
Spread in well-greased 8-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° about 25 minutes.
Do not overbake!
Cut into bars or squares while still warm.

recipes.title: White Drop Cookies
steps: Beat egg(s), add sugar and shortening and stir well.
Add soda to your sour milk, then add to other ingredients.
Add sifted flour, baking powder and salt, then add vanilla.
Finally add chips and walnuts (optional) and stir together thoroughly.
Drop on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Easy Refrigerator Roll Dough
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl.
Stir in sugar, shortening, beaten egg, salt and 3 cups of the flour.
Beat until smooth.
Stir in enough flour to make dough easy to handle.
Place dough in greased bowl, then turn greased side up.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or until ready to use.
Dough can be kept up to 4 days in refrigerator at 45° or below; keep covered.

recipes.title: Pickled Beets
steps: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Cool and enjoy.
(When storing, keep cloves with beets in juice to keep flavor.
Lasts forever!)

recipes.title: Continental Round Steaks
ingredients: 1 medium green pepper, cut crosswise into 6 rings
steps: About 1 1/2 hours before serving:
In large skillet over medium-high heat, cook bacon until light brown.
Push bacon to one side of skillet.

recipes.title: H And J Pizza
steps: Mix yeast and water together. Set aside.
Mix all the rest of the ingredients together.
Combine both mixtures. Turn dough on floured board.
Knead. Spread on greased pizza pan.
Let stand 15 minutes. Spread spaghetti sauce on dough, then add cooked hamburger meat, mushrooms, cheese, onions, pepper or whatever you like. Preheat oven to 425°.
Cook 15 to 20 minutes. Eat and enjoy.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Tofu And Vegies
ingredients: 1/3 can (2/3 c.) pineapple chunks with juice
1/2 Tbsp. malt or molasses or 1 tsp. honey
1 large carrot, sliced thinly or chopped small
steps: Dissolve cornstarch in 2 tablespoons of water; add 1/4 cup pineapple juice, 1/4 cup water, vinegar, honey, soy sauce, ginger, and pepper; set aside.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet on high heat.
Add onion and stir until strong smell starts to go away. Add carrot and stir a little more.
Add tofu and stir until lightly browned.
Add green pepper and salt.
Stir a minute more, then reduce heat to medium and cook, uncovered.
Colorful, rich and juicy with a Chinese flavor.
A meal in itself with rice or chow mein noodles.

recipes.title: Apple Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 2 jars Dutch baked apples (not pie filling)
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add cheese and flour.
Place apples in a 2-quart dish.
Spread batter over apples.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.title: Monastery Lentil Soup
steps: Saute oil, onions and carrots for 5 minutes.
Add all ingredients to one pot and cook for 45 minutes.
Add sherry at end.
Serve with Swiss cheese.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
steps: Mix and spread on greased and floured jelly roll pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Top with French fried onions last 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Yogurt Pound Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream the butter.
Gradually add sugar, beating until mixture is light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine flour, soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture, mixing well.
Stir lemon rind, vanilla and yogurt into batter. Pour batter into
a greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. (I just spray with Pam, no flour.) Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pan 15 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely on a rack.
Sprinkle cake with powdered sugar, if desired.
Yields one 10-inch cake.

recipes.title: Favorite Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 small onion, sliced and separated into rings
1 (16 oz.) can baked beans in tomato sauce
steps: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble, reserving drippings.
Set bacon aside.
Saute onion, catsup, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce and mustard in a greased 1-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Coating
steps: Brush chicken with oil and coat with this coating.
Bake until done.

recipes.title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
steps: Cream together sugar and shortening, beating in eggs, one at a time.
Sift flours together; add milk and vanilla.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Joyce'S Fruit Cookies
steps: Cream butter and brown sugar.
Add eggs.
Gradually add flour, soda, allspice and milk.
Fold in candied fruit, nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet and bake approximately 15 minutes at 350°.
Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients.
Add salt and soda.
Stir well.
Add flour and chocolate chips.
Bake at 325° for 8 minutes.
Remove from oven when light brown.

recipes.title: Peanut Pie
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. salt (omit if peanuts are salted)
steps: Beat eggs slightly; add sugar, syrup and butter and mix well. Add vanilla; add peanuts.
Bake at 350° for about 45 to 50 minutes or until filling is firm and brown.
Pie may be soft when shaken gently but will firm as it cools.

recipes.title: Spiced Apple Loaf
ingredients: 2 c. finely chopped tart apples (such as Granny Smith or Cortland)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°.
Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
In a medium bowl, mix together flour, pumpkin pie spice, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
In a large bowl, using a wooden spoon or an electric mixer set on medium speed, beat together butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Stir in the apples.
Stir flour mixture into the apple mixture until the dry ingredients are just moistened.
Spoon batter into the prepared pan.
Bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, about 1 hour. Transfer the pan to a wire rack to cool for 10 minutes.
Turn the cake out onto the rack to cool completely.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Custard Pie(My Mother'S Recipe)
steps: Beat egg yolks, butter and sugar.
Add flour and buttermilk. Cook over low heat until thick, stirring constantly.
Add extract. Pour into baked pie shell.
Top with meringue and brown.

recipes.title: Bbq Rice
ingredients: 1 large can mushroom stems and pieces
steps: Pour rice
in
a large baking dish.
Add soup and mushrooms and
stir
to mix.	Place 1 stick of margarine in center of dish. Bake
in
preheated oven at 400° for approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb. beef sirloin, cut in 1/4-inch strips
1 1/4 c. cold beef stock or 1 can (10 1/2-oz.) condensed beef broth
steps: Combine the 1 tablespoon flour and the salt; coat meat.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet; add meat and brown quickly on both sides.
Add mushrooms, onion, and garlic; cook till crisp-tender, 3 or 4 minutes.
Remove meat and mushrooms from pan. Add 2 tablespoons butter to pan drippings.
Blend in the 3 tablespoons flour.
Add tomato paste; stir in beef stock.
Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly.
Return browned meat and mushrooms to skillet.
Stir in sour cream and wine; cook slowly until hot; do not boil.
Serve over noodles. Serves 4 or 5.

recipes.title: Orange Raisin Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Beat egg whites in small bowl; stir in milk, juice, oil and peel. Add to flour mixture.
Stir until moistened.
Stir in cereal. Pour into prepared pans.
Bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: Old-Time Tea Cakes
steps: Break eggs into mixing bowl.
Add margarine, molasses, sugar, nutmeg and baking soda.
Cream thoroughly.
Work in flour. Transfer dough to a well floured board and knead until it is pliable.
Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter.
Bake at 400° until light brown.
Yields 3 dozen tea cakes.

recipes.title: Cocoa Delight Cake
steps: Combine dry ingredients in mixing bowl.
Add Crisco and first amount of milk called for.
Beat with mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Add eggs, rest of milk and vanilla.
Beat 2 minutes. Spread batter in 2 well greased and floured 9 x 1 1/2-inch round layer cake pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes until center springs back when touched lightly.
Cook 10 to 20 minutes, then remove from pans.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Roll
steps: Lightly grease 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Line bottom with waxed paper; set aside.

recipes.title: Cheese Krispies
steps: Sprinkle flour on cheese.
Pour on butter.
Add salt and red pepper.
Add Rice Krispies.
Knead by hand.
Roll into marble sized balls and bake on ungreased sheet.
Flatten with fork and bake at 300° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
steps: Melt 1/2 stick butter in frying pan.
Salt and pepper pork chops.
Brown pork chops in pan until braised on both sides but not until done.
Remove from frypan and put aside.
Melt rest of butter in frypan.
Add rice and brown.
Add consomme, onion soup and mushrooms.
Bring to a slight boil.
Pour into a 2 to 3-quart casserole dish.
Top with pork chops.
Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Quick Potato Salad
steps: Cut slightly cooked potatoes into 1 inch cubes.
In large bowl combine potatoes, onions and salad dressing.
Toss gently. Dust with paprika.
Garnish with chives and bacon bits.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
ingredients: 2 to 4 lb. shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: In large pan, saute onions, bell pepper, shallots, celery and garlic in oil until tender.
In small skillet, make roux of 1/4 cup oil and 1/4 cup flour and brown; add to onion mixture.
Add to onion mixture the tomato sauce, tomato paste, water and all seasonings, except parsley and lemon juice.
Simmer 45 minutes. Add shrimp, lemon juice and parsley.
Simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until shrimp is done.
Serve over rice.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Easy Hamburger Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
steps: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat.
Add meat and brown.
Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms.
Cook 5 minutes.
Add soup and simmer uncovered 10 minutes.
Stir in sour cream.
Heat through.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with noodles. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Parmesan Potatoes
steps: Pare potatoes and cut into squares.
Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in bag.
Soak potatoes in water.
Then shake well in bag, coating well.
Melt margarine in baking dish.
Place potatoes in dish and bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Turn once during baking.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars
steps: Mix all dry ingredients.
Add beaten eggs, pumpkin and oil. Mix all together and bake at 350° for 25 minutes on a large cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Fast Rolls
steps: Beat well; cover and let rise 30 minutes.
Stir and spoon into muffin cups.
Let rise 30 minutes.
Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
steps: Cook spaghetti and celery in chicken broth to package directions.
Drain, add green pepper, onion and diced chicken to spaghetti.
Set aside.
Prepare cheese sauce, milk, flour and margarine in medium sized saucepan.
Cook until thick, stir constantly.
Add grated cheese and mushroom soup.
Mix cheese sauce into spaghetti mixture.
Pour into large oblong baking dish.
Top with margarine and cracker crumbs.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Gingerbread
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Blend in margarine, buttermilk, and molasses.
Put in unbeaten eggs and mix.
Beat by hand 20 strokes. Butter and flour a 9 x 9 x 5-inch glass pan, or 8 x 12-inch aluminum pan.
Pour in mixture and bake at 340° to 350° heat for 45 minutes.
The bigger the dish, the less heat.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
steps: In a saucepan melt butter, oil, cocoa and water and bring to a boil.
Mix with flour and sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Then add buttermilk, eggs, cinnamon and vanilla.
Pour into a greased and floured sheet pan and bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Have butter and eggs at room temperature.
Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan.
Preheat oven to 325°.
Cream butter until soft; beat in sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add flour and sour cream, alternately to creamed mixture, starting and ending with flour. Add flavoring and beat until smooth.
Pour into pan and bake 1 1/2 hours until golden brown, top springs back when touched.
Cool on wire rack before turning out.

recipes.title: Baking Powder Biscuits
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Cut in shortening.
Make a well in dry ingredients. Add milk.
Roll out or pat down on a floured board and cut.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 450°.

recipes.title: Jiffy Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) box one-layer white cake mix
steps: In a large mixing bowl, combine 3 cups flour, cake mix, yeast, salt and warm water.
Mix until smooth, add enough remaining flour to form a soft dough.
Turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth, about 6 to 8 minutes.
Roll dough into a 9 x 18-inch rectangle.
Spread with butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Roll dough jelly-roll style, starting with the long end.
Slice the dough into 1-inch circles, place on greased cookie sheet.
Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 15 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.
Frost, if desired. Makes about 18 rolls.

recipes.title: Mom'S Oatmeal Cake
steps: Pour boiling water over oats; let stand while you cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs.
Mix all together.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Codfish Cakes
steps: Soak codfish overnight.
Drain off water.
Run through meat grinder or chop in food processor with onion and garlic.
When done mix together with eggs, flour and other ingredients.
Drop by spoon into shortening or any cooking oil.
Fry until golden brown.

recipes.title: French Fried Onions
steps: Peel onions. Slice 1/4-inch thick. Separate into rings.
Dip into milk, then into combined flour and salt. Fry until light brown, a few rings at a time, in shallow frying pan.
Drain on paper towel. Sprinkle with salt.
Serve hot.
Great with steak.

recipes.title: Banana-Nut Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease a 12-cup muffin pan or use paper liners.
Beat together softened margarine and sugar at medium speed until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Beat in bananas until smooth.
Mix together flour, salt, baking powder and soda.
Alternately stir in flour mixture and buttermilk into egg mixture until dry ingredients are just moistened.
Stir in nuts and vanilla; do not overmix. Fill cups 2/3 full.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes.

recipes.title: Scottish Timesavers
steps: Measure all ingredients into large bowl.
Mix at low speed of mixer until a dough forms.
Using well floured rolling pin or well floured fingers, roll or pat out dough, half at a time on ungreased cookie sheet to a 12 x 8-inch rectangle.
Cut into 2-inch squares. Do not separate.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.
Immediately cut into squares along lines.
Cool 2 minutes; remove from cookie sheets.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. herb seasoned stuffing mix
steps: Cook sliced squash and chopped onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Drain.
Combine soup and sour cream.
Stir in carrots.

Fold in squash and onion. Combine stuffing mix with melted butter. Spread 1/2 stuffing mixture in bottom of a 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Spoon vegetable mixture on top. Sprinkle with remaining stuffing mixture. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cocoa Apple Cake
steps: Cream together until fluffy eggs, sugar, margarine and water. Add all dry ingredients to the mixture and mix well.
Fold in the nuts, chips, apples and vanilla.
Mix until distributed evenly. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan, bake in 325° oven for 60 to 70 minutes.
Doesn't need frosting.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Blossoms
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients in a bowl.
Mix margarine, peanut butter and 2 sugars in another bowl.
Add flour mixture to the other bowl.
Mix well. Roll into small balls and roll in sugar. Bake at 375° for 8 minutes or until they start browning.
Place a kiss in each and press down so the cookie cracks. Bake 2 to 5 minutes longer until brown.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Cream the butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, and flour alternately at slow speed.
Stir in flavorings.
Pour into a 10-inch greased and floured tube pan.
Bake in a 300° oven for 2 hours or until cake pulls away from side of pan.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
steps: Cook rice in 3 cups water with salt for 20 minutes.
While this is cooking, brown ground beef in skillet; drain and add taco seasoning and 2 cups water and simmer 10 minutes.
Add beans. Spread rice in 9 x 13-inch pan; pour hamburger, bean mixture over rice.
Spread tortilla chips over hamburger; spread cheese over tortilla chips.
Bake in 400° oven for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Loaf Cake
steps: Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt.
Cream the shortening and gradually add 1 1/2 cups of sugar, continuing to cream until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs, beating well.
Add sifted dry ingredients, alternating with milk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.
Blend well after each addition.
Cut cream cheese into 1/4-inch cubes and fold into batter along with orange peel.
Turn batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans or 12 well-greased muffin tins.
Bake at 375° for 50 to 55 minutes for loaves or 20 to 25 minutes for muffins or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Broccoli With Rice
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh or frozen broccoli spears
steps: Cool rice; spread in flat casserole dish.
Parboil broccoli; arrange on top of rice.
Combine mushrooms, mayonnaise and seasonings.
(For thinner sauce, add 1 cup milk.)
Top rice with sauce mixture.
Sprinkle almonds on top.
Bake 20 minutes at 350° or until bubbly.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Cake
steps: Blend together in sifter:
flour, cocoa, sugar and soda. Blend in salad dressing and gradually add water to mixture.
When mixed thoroughly, add vanilla.
Cook 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Coconut Pineapple Pie
steps: Cream sugar, eggs and oleo.
Add flour, meal, vanilla, coconut and pineapple.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake slow.
Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 2 eggs, yolk only (save whites for icing)
steps: Mix all together and cook until thick; pour into baked pie shell.

recipes.title: Grandma Arp'S Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: 1 tsp. soda dissolved in a little water
steps: Mix well.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 10-15 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Honey Cereal Nibble
steps: To prepare syrup, put honey, sugar and butter in saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Mix cereals and nuts in roasting pan; pour on syrup and toss.
Bake at 275° for 45 minutes; stir once 1/2 way through.
Remove from oven immediately and spread out on a cookie sheet or Reynolds Wrap in a thin layer to cool.
Don't leave in pan or it will stick together.
Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Meat Crust Country Pie
steps: Combine beef, crackers, onion, green pepper, 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, seasoning to taste and 1/2 cup of tomato sauce.
Mix well. Pat into bottom and up sides of a greased 9-inch pie plate.

recipes.title: Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. pork sausage (1/2 lb. mild and 1/2 lb. hot)
steps: Toss and brown sausage.
Drain.
Saute pepper, onion and celery in sausage pan.
Drain.
Boil water and add rice and dry soup mix.
Cook until tender.
Mix with first 4 ingredients.
Bake in casserole dish for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Crisp
steps: Mix together the sugar, salt, flour and rhubarb.
Put into an ungreased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Mix together the oats, cinnamon, oleo and brown sugar; sprinkle this mixture over rhubarb mixture. Bake at 350° until topping is browned and rhubarb is tender, about 35 to 45 minutes.
Cool before serving, then top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. cooked rice (1 c. raw equals 3 c. cooked)
1 (4 oz.) can chopped green Ortega chilies
steps: Use buttered flat 8 x 8-inch pan.
Combine rice, sour cream, chilies, salsa, salt and pepper.
Put a layer of rice combination and about 1/2 pound Jack cheese, shredded.
Finish with rice, top with grated Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 325° for 1/2 hour or 300° for 45 minutes.
Can be combined the day before serving and held in refrigerator for baking.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Green Beans
steps: In skillet, brown bacon until crisp.
Break into small pieces. Add onion and stir until almost done.
Add fresh green beans with 1/3 cup water.
Turn to medium heat and cook, stirring constantly. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes. Add more water, if needed.
Cover and turn heat to low.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes longer. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve.

recipes.title: Fresh Spinach Salad
steps: Wash well and thoroughly dry spinach.
Tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and refrigerate.
In a heavy skillet, fry the bacon until crisp.
Drain on paper towel and crumble.
Shake the oil, vinegar, wine, soy sauce, sugar, mustard, curry powder, salt and seasoned pepper together and pour over spinach.
Add bacon and toss lightly.
Top with chopped boiled eggs.

recipes.title: Pearls 'N Chocolate Cookies
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. Premier white Nestle Toll House Treasures baking pieces
steps: Preheat
oven
In bowl, combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt; set aside.
In bowl, beat butter, sugar, brown sugar
and vanilla extract until creamy.
Add eggs, one at
a time,
beating
well
after
each.
Gradually add flour mixture. Stir
in
Treasures.
Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake 9 to 10 minutes.
Allow to stand
2 minutes
before
removing
from
cookie sheets; cool completely. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen 3 inch cookies.

recipes.title: Jackie'S Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1/3 c. sunflower seeds, unsalted, if possible
steps: Wash and cut broccoli flowerets into bite-sized pieces.
Add raisins, sunflower seeds and onions.
Mix mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.
Pour over broccoli mixture.
Mix lightly.
Top with bacon bits.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix dough.
Chill 2 hours.
Roll out and cut.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Coca-Cola Cake
steps: Cake:
Combine flour and sugar in large bowl.
Heat margarine, cocoa and Coca-Cola to boiling.
Pour over flour and sugar; stir well.
Add buttermilk, eggs, soda, vanilla and marshmallows.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 cans undiluted condensed cream of chicken soup
steps: In large saucepan, cook onions in3
tablespoons oil until tender.
Add potatoes; cover with water.
Cook covered 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Blend in soup, milk and salt.
Heat but do not boil.
Serve garnished with bacon and parsley.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Brownies
ingredients: 1 c. chocolate chips or may use peanut butter chips
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease a square 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Blend butter, sugar and vanilla.
Add eggs; beat with a spoon.
Combine dry ingredients.
Add to egg mixture.
Stir in chips.
Spread in pan.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes (slightly less for chewy brownies) or until brownies pull away from the sides of the pan.
Cool completely.
Cut into squares.
Yields 16 servings.

recipes.title: Helen'S Fried Rice
steps: Saute onions in oleo until brown.
Add mushrooms and saute for 5 minutes.
Add rice and saute another 5 minutes.
Dissolve bouillon cubes in water; bring to a boil.
Pour over rice mixture. Cover and shut off heat.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Put everything in bowl.
Beat 20 minutes with electric mixer. Set oven at 350° and put cake in cold oven.
Bake 1 hour.
Do not open oven!
Bake in Bundt pan; do not grease or flour pan.

recipes.title: Corn Custard
steps: Double recipe if using large casserole, using 1 can of whole kernel corn and 1 can of cream-style corn.

recipes.title: Annie'S German Lentil Soup
ingredients: 3 to 4 Tbsp. tomato sauce or 2 whole tomatoes
steps: Wash lentils in cold water.
Drain.
Now add lentils to cold water.
Saute bacon and onions until golden brown.
Stir in tomato sauce or tomatoes, add bacon and onions, potatoes and rest of ingredients, adding more water as needed during cooking.
Simmer 30 to 45 minutes; add parsley.

recipes.title: Fried Do-Nut Holes
steps: Beats eggs; add shortening and sugar and beat well.
Add remaining ingredients and stir in.
Drop by spoonfuls into hot grease and fry until brown on all sides.
Coat hot do-nut holes in cinnamon/sugar mixture.
Dough can be made ahead and refrigerated.

recipes.title: Yellow Split-Pea Soup With Kielbasa(My Favorite Winter Soup - A Meal In Itself)
ingredients: 1 onion, halved lengthwise and sliced thin crosswise
1 lb. dried yellow split-peas, picked over and rinsed
1 lb. kielbasa, cut into 1 1/2-inch lengths (may use turkey kielbasa)
steps: In a heavy kettle, cook the onion in the butter over moderately low heat, stirring until it is softened.
Add the split-peas, the sliced carrot, the celery, the kielbasa, the bay leaf and 2 1/2 quarts water.
Bring the liquid to a boil, skimming the froth and simmer the mixture, covered, stirring occasionally for 3 hours.
Discard the bay leaf and transfer the kielbasa with a slotted spoon to a plate.
In a blender, puree the mixture in batches.
Transfer the puree to the kettle and thin it with hot water to the desired consistency.
Cut the kielbasa into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Quarter the slices and add them to the soup. Season the soup with salt and pepper.
Makes about 9 cups before thinning, serving 6.

recipes.title: Libby'S Great Pumpkin Cookies
ingredients: 2 1/3 cups quick or old fashioned oats
steps: Mix flour, oats, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in medium bowl. Beat butter, sugar, and brown sugar in large bowl until light and fluffy. Add pumpkin, eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Gradually, add flour mixture. Mix well. Stir in nuts and raisins. Drop dough onto greased baking sheet. Spread into 3 inch circle. repeat with remaining dough. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 14 to 16 minutes or until firm and lightly browned. Cool on baking sheets for two minutes. Remove to wire racks to cool completely.

recipes.title: M&M Cookies
steps: Cream
butter;
gradually add sugar, beating well.
Add eggs, peanut
butter,
vanilla, and corn syrup;
beating well. Add oats, soda and salt, stirring well.
Stir in the remaining ingredients. (Dough will be stiff.)

recipes.title: Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 c. shredded Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese (8 oz.)
steps: Rub both sides of each tortilla lightly with oil; place on waxed paper or a paper plate. Microwave each tortilla on 100 %, (high) for 45 seconds. Sprinkle cheese on hot tortilla; fold tortilla in half. Microwave on 100 %, (high) for 35 seconds or until cheese melts. Repeat procedure for each tortilla and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. firm or extra-firm tofu, cut into cubes
1 (15 oz.) can black beans, rinsed and drained
2 (7 oz.) cans diced, mild green chilies
steps: Heat oil over medium high heat in a large saucepan or Dutch oven.
Add garlic and onion and cook until tender but not browned. Add tomatoes and cook for a few minutes more.
Add the tofu cubes and stir gently until heated through, then add the corn, black beans, green chilies, vegetable broth, cilantro, cumin, salt, pepper and lime juice.

recipes.title: Portuguese Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. garlic flavored smoked pork sausage, cut into bite size pieces
1 head cabbage, cored and cut into medium size pieces
10 small new potatoes, scrubbed and quartered
steps: Saute onion and garlic in oil just until transparent. Add sausage and brown lightly. Add beef stock and all other ingredients.
Bring to a boil, stirring often. Reduce heat. Simmer for 45 minutes or more, stirring occasionally.
Makes 1 gallon plus.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
steps: Wash chicken well.
Coat with flour.
Cook in oil until brown.
Remove.
Put in remaining ingredients and mix.
Return chicken to pan.
Cover.
Cook 30 to 40 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Kathy Powers Hudson'S Zucchini Loaf
steps: In a bowl stir together flour, baking powder, sugar, and 2 teaspoons salt.
Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Store in an airtight container for up to 6 weeks at room temperature or for up to 6 months in the freezer.
Use to make Easy Biscuits, Easy Muffins or Easy Pancakes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Combine first five ingredients.
Sift together into first mixture the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and spices. Stir to blend.
Add nuts and raisins.
Beat 4 minutes.
Pour into greased loaf pans and bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Pound Cake(The Best Recipe I Have Ever Tried)
steps: Cream butter.
Add confectioners sugar; add eggs and lemon extract.
Add 1 confectioners sugar box of flour, filled lightly, vanilla and milk.
Mix thoroughly by hand.
Bake in tube pan for 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Cake
steps: Boil raisins in water about 5 minutes.
Let cool slightly. Add sugar.
Add shortening to raisins.
Next, add dry ingredients and mix.
Bake in greased Bundt or tube pan at 400° for 35 or 40 minutes.
If necessary, bake longer and reduce heat to 350°.
Good luck.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Hot Sauce(Canned)
steps: Mix all in large crock.
Bring to a boil slowly.
Then simmer until as thick as you'd like.
Set into clean jars (hot).
Seal in hot bath for 15 minutes, or until pressure cooked 10 minutes at 5 pounds.

recipes.title: Quick Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 (28 oz.) can whole tomatoes, chopped and undrained
steps: Brown the beef in a skillet; crumble.
Drain off fat.
Add remaining ingredients except rice, stir to mix well; bring to a boil.
Add the instant rice; cover and remove from heat.
Let stand for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato And Burger Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. sour cream or yogurt
steps: Cook in iron skillet that can go in the oven.
Brown beef and onion; drain off fat.
Blend in 1/4 cup flour, ketchup, beef broth, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
stir in mushroom soup and sour cream.

recipes.title: Burnt Sugar Cake
steps: Sift flour, measure and add baking powder and salt.
Sift three times.
Cream butter, add sugar gradually and cream until light. Add egg yolks and vanilla and beat.
Add flour mixture alternately with water or milk.
Add caramelized sugar.
Fold in egg whites. Bake in two 9-inch layer cake pans in 350° oven 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Place potatoes in large saucepan; cover with water. Bring to a boil. Cook over medium heat 3 to 4 minutes; drain. Set aside. Heat butter in same saucepan over medium heat. Add onion; cook, stirring occasionally, 1 to 2 minutes or until onion is tender. Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk and water. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Arrange potatoes in prepared baking dish. Pour milk mixture over potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender and cheese is light golden brown.

recipes.title: One Dish Chicken & Rice Bake
ingredients: 1 can Campbell's Healthy Request Cream of Mushroom with Roasted Garlic and Herbs Recipe Soup
steps: In 2-quart shallow baking dish mix soup, water, rice and paprika.
Place chicken on rice mixture.
Sprinkle with additional paprika.
Cover.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Serves 4.
For creamier rice, increase water to 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Cranberry Drops
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Cream butter and sugars together.
Beat in milk, orange juice and egg.
Stir together flour, baking powder, salt and soda; blend well with sugar mixture.
Stir in nuts and cranberries.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 11 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 bag (8 to 10 oz.) frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
steps: Saute onion and celery in
margarine until transparent. Add Cheez
Whiz
and
broccoli and when
cheese
mixture
has melted, add rice, soup and milk.
Mix well.
Put
into
1/2 quart casserole and bake at 325° for 3/4 hour (covered for 1/2 hour
and uncovered for 15 minutes).
Stir
occasionally.
Can use more broccoli or rice if you like.

recipes.title: Mexican Delight
steps: Brown ground beef.
Chop onion and saute with ground beef.
Add remaining ingredients and cook for 30 minutes or until rice is done.
Serve over Fritos corn chips or tortillas.
Top with fresh chopped onions, grated cheese, lettuce, diced avocado, ripe chopped olives, Ranch Style "white cream" dressing and sour cream, taco sauce, etc.

recipes.title: Pork Supreme
steps: Cut meat in thin, narrow strips.
Season with salt and pepper. Brown in oil, using an ovenproof skillet.
Add celery, green onions and peppers.
Saute until tender.
Stir in rice, broth and seasonings.
Bring to a boil, cover and bake at 375° until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff rice with a fork.

recipes.title: Hot Rolls
steps: Put yeast in warm water; add sugar.
Let stand.
Put salt and eggs in warm milk and shortening.
Add yeast mixture.
Stir well. Add flour to make stiff.
Set in warm place; let rise, then make into loaves or rolls.
Let rise and bake at 350° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Quick Buttermilk Rolls
steps: In mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in water.
Add milk, half the flour, sugar and shortening.
Beat with spoon until smooth and batter falls from spoon in sheets.
Using your hands, mix in enough of the remaining flour until dough cleans the bowl.
Turn out onto lightly floured board.
Cover and let rest 10 to 15 minutes.
Knead until smooth and blistered, about 10 minutes. Shape into crescents or any shape.
Let rise 1 1/2 hours or until double in bulk.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pistachio Dream Cheesecake
steps: Mix together first 4 ingredients and pat into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Raisin Pudding Cake
steps: Combine brown sugar, butter, vanilla and boiling water. Pour into
x	8-inch	glass
pan.
Pour
boiling water over raisins. Cover and let set while mixing batter.

recipes.title: Mozzarella In Carrozza(For 6 People)
steps: Cut bread in shape of a triangle.
Place 1 slice of Mozzarella between 2 slices of bread.
Cover them with flour, then dip in egg, then in bread crumbs.
Meanwhile get oil ready and hot so you can fry the bread.

recipes.title: Buttercream Cookies
steps: Cut in butter, shortening and sugar, creaming well.
Blend in almond extract and sifted flour, mixing well.
Roll dough into balls, using 1 level tablespoon of dough for each cookie.
Press and sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Place on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake in a 350° oven.
Cook for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Eszter Hazy(Austrian)
ingredients: 3 lb. veal fillet, trimmed and sliced into strips
steps: Dust veal strips with flour, salt and pepper.
Saute veal in 2 tablespoons butter, sauteeing quickly.
Remove veal from pan.
In skillet, heat remaining butter and add onion.
Cook until lightly glazed.
Add parsley and sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the flour; stir. Add cream and stock, cooking over low heat until sauce is smooth. Add meat and cook until tender.
Stir in last two ingredients when skillet is removed from heat.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Apple Salad
steps: Drain pineapple; set juice aside.
Mix pineapple, apples, pecans and cheese.
Cook pineapple juice, sugar, flour and egg on medium heat, stirring constantly.
Pour over salad.

recipes.title: Drop Cookies
steps: Grease pans.
Sift flour before measuring.
Mix together dry ingredients.
Mix together liquid ingredients.
Add dry to liquid and mix thoroughly.
Drop by teaspoonful on greased pan 2 inches apart.
Bake in a hot oven (350°) for 10 to 15 minutes.
Nuts, raisins or sprinkles can be added on top of cookie before baking.

recipes.title: Spiced Orange Gingerbread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients except orange marmalade and whipped cream.
Beat at low speed 1 to 2 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 9-inch baking pan.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Roll dough out (must add a lot of flour to make dry enough).
Cut cookies with cutters.
Decorate.
Bake in a 400° oven for 6 to 7 minutes, or until brown.
(Also can be used with cookie press.)
Yields approximately 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Potatoes, Cheddar And Ham Casserole
steps: Cook potatoes in saucepan. Cover with water and bring to boil. Remove from heat and drain. Transfer to a greased 2-quart baking dish. While potatoes come to a boil, make a white sauce by melting 3 tablespoons butter in saucepan. Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture begins to bubble. Remove from heat and slowly add milk, stirring constantly. Return to heat and bring to boil, stirring. When sauce is slightly thickened, add cheese and stir until cheese is melted. Pour cheese sauce over potatoes in baking dish. Add ham and mix gently so as not to break up potatoes. If desired, combine 1 cup dry breadcrumbs and 2 tablespoons melted butter in small bowl and sprinkle over casserole. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Fresh Pear Cake
steps: Combine sugar and oil.
Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well. Stir in vanilla.
Sift together dry ingredients; add to sugar-egg mixture, mixing well.
Stir in pears and pecans.
Batter will be stiff.
Pour into a well-greased and floured tube pan.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for about 1 hour or until done.
Cool about 5 minutes and remove from pan.
Freezes well.

recipes.title: Fruit Cobbler
ingredients: 4 c. blackberries or fruit of your choice (1 qt.), sweetened with 1/2 c. sugar
steps: Melt butter in pan, 9 x 14-inch.
Pour batter mixture in melted butter in pan.
Add fruit evenly.
Do not stir, just shake pan a little.
Put in 350° oven.
Bake until brown, approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
steps: Select a deep, wide dish that will hold chicken without crowding and have only one layer.
Melt oleo in dish; salt and pepper lightly.
Roll chicken in oleo and arrange in dish. Sprinkle dry rice over chicken.
Sprinkle soup mix over all.
Add water slowly around and over all.
Cover with foil or lid and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
At 45 minutes, lift chicken up and let rice fall under chicken.

recipes.title: Frosting For Hot Fudge Cake
steps: Cook all together until kinda thick.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Cherry Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. dark chocolate cake mix (Duncan Hines)
steps: Mix gently by hand.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan (greased and floured).
Bake at 350° for approximately 25 to 30 minutes.
Frost with dark chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Quick Fruit Cobbler
steps: Melt oleo in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, milk and melted oleo.
Spread in bottom of pan, then pour fruit over the top (the fruit needs to be cooked long enough to melt sugar and make syrup).
I use blackberries or rhubarb or peaches; use sugar to sweeten as needed.
Bake at 350° until brown on top.

recipes.title: Sicilian Rice Balls
ingredients: 1/4 c. salami, sliced and cut into small pieces
white pepper and salt to taste
steps: Cook rice to tender.
Drain and put aside.
Fry onions to light brown.
Add salami, then bread crumbs to absorb oil.
When cool, mix all ingredients, including eggs, pine nuts and cheese, etc.
Shape into meatball size or smaller.
Fill dish with bread crumbs and roll balls to cover.
Fry in deep oil or fry in pan to golden brown.
Drain.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Toffee Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. (2 sticks) butter or margarine, softened
1 3/4 c. (10 oz. pkg.) Heath Bits 'o Brickle almond toffee bits or Skor English toffee bars
steps: Heat oven to 375°. Lightly grease cookie sheet or use parchment paper. Beat butter, eggs, brown sugar and vanilla extract until well blended. Add flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Beat until blended. Stir in oats and brickle with a spoon. Drop dough by rounded teaspoon about 2-inches apart onto prepared sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Cool 1 minute. Remove to wire rack. Makes about 4 dozen (large) cookies.

recipes.title: Featherbed Rolls
steps: Add shortening to milk while milk is still hot.
When milk has cooled, dissolve yeast in water and add to milk.
Add sugar, salt, eggs and flour.
Mix well and let stand in bowl for 20 minutes. Knead for a minute or two.
Shape into rolls and let rise until doubled in size.
Bake in hot oven, 425°, until golden brown, about 20 minutes.
Brush with butter after removing from oven. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Cook bacon until crispy, then crumble into small pieces.
Cut broccoli into small pieces; mix all ingredients together.
Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Casserole
steps: Place bacon on bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Sprinkle rice over bacon; add chicken, then salt and pepper.
Dilute mushroom soup with milk; pour over chicken.
Bake 1 1/2 hours at
350°. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Melt the butter and chocolate; cool.
Beat eggs with wire whisk; add sugar, chocolate and vanilla.
Mix well.
Add flour and walnuts.
Bake in small coffee cake pan at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Frost or cover with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken And Rice
steps: Prepare a 9 x 13 inch greased baking dish.
Mix 1/4 cup butter, flour, milk, bouillon, seasoned salt, garlic powder and pepper until smooth.
Bring to a boil and cool until thickened.
Reduce heat and add chicken, process cheese and sour cream.
Stir until melted.
Add cooked rice and pour into baking dish.
Take 1/4 cup butter and crushed crackers and brown in skillet.
Use this as the topping.
Bake at 425 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli and rice separately.
Place melted butter in bottom of 2-quart dish.
Mix together cooked broccoli, rice, soup, onion, cheese and milk.
Place on top of butter.
Bake at 300° to 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Dollie'S Soup
ingredients: enough turkey or chicken broth (nonfat) to make soup
steps: Simmer about 1 hour or longer.
If you use broth that you have prepared yourself from turkey, put it in the refrigerator until fat has risen to top.
Skim off fat and use only the broth.

recipes.title: Ranger Cookies
steps: Cream the shortening and sugars together.
Add the eggs and vanilla; mix until smooth.
Sift flour, soda, baking powder and salt together; add to creamed mixture.
Mix well, then add the oatmeal, rice cereal and coconut and mix well.
Dough will be quite crumbly.
Mold with hands into balls the size of a walnut. Place on a cookie sheet and press slightly.
Bake in a 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
Yields 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Seven-Layer Salad
steps: Layer in dish as given, starting with the lettuce.
Chill in refrigerator 6 to 8 hours.
Do not stir.

recipes.title: Real Good Pie
steps: Mix ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Melt In Your Mouth Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 chicken, cooked, boned and cut into pieces
steps: Place deboned chicken in 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bring to boil chicken broth and soup.
Pour over chicken; mix flour, buttermilk and melted margarine.
Pour over first mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Brown at 450° for 5 to 10 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Mousse(Chocolate Or Lemon)
steps: Mix flour, margarine and pecans together and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Mix Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix all dry ingredients in bowl.
Add last 5 ingredients.
Mix well.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Aunt Osie'S Plum Cake
steps: Mix together in a large bowl.
Pour in tube pan.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
