recipes.title: Barbecued Rice Entree
steps: Combine all ingredients except almonds.
Simmer about 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Stir in almonds and serve. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Fried Rice
steps: Combine all ingredients in a wok.
(You may use a large pot but is better to use a wok.)
Stir ingredients to keep from sticking.
Cook until warm throughout.

recipes.title: Molasses Cookies
ingredients: 2 tsp. each: cinnamon, cloves and ginger
steps: Mix shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, then molasses; blend well.
Sift dry ingredients together; add to first mixture. Combine thoroughly.
Roll balls size of walnuts in white sugar. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
Makes about 6 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Dinner Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 to 2 cans chicken and rice soup
steps: Wash and drain pork chops.
Dip each chop in prepared mustard. Roll in flour, salt and pepper.
Fry to a golden brown.
Drain off fat.
Using the cans of soup, spoon the rice on top of pork chops and pour the soup around chops.
Cover and simmer until tender.
If more rice is desired, cook the cup of rice and spoon on the chops.
(Use an electric skillet.)

recipes.title: Pizza Dough
ingredients: 5 c. flour (bread flour or natural bleached)
steps: Sprinkle yeast in warm water; let stand until dissolved.
Add sugar, oils and 2 1/2 cups of the flour, beating well.
Gradually add the remaining 2 1/2 cups of flour to form a soft dough.
Turn out onto a floured board and knead until smooth and elastic, adding flour as needed.
May take 1/2 to 1 cup.
Turn dough into greased bowl.
Cover with plastic wrap.
Let rise in warm place until doubled (2 to 3 hours).
Punch down and let rise again. Punch down and divide into 3 balls.
Roll out dough, adding enough flour to make dough fit pizza pan.
Fold under outer edges. Pierce holes in dough with fork.
Do a "first bake" in a 400° to 450° oven for 5 to 7 minutes.
Ready for your favorite pizza recipe.
Makes three 13-inch pizzas.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. cooked chicken, cut in pieces
steps: Put all ingredients in a casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Butter Nut Cheerios
steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan with Crisco. Beat eggs until light. Beat in sugars, vanilla, butter and Crisco until creamy.
In large bowl, combine flour with baking powder and salt.
Add sugar mixture to flour.
Mix on low and fold in pecans.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Baked Chicken
steps: Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking dish.
Pour in dry rice.
Lay raw chicken on top of rice.
Mix together mushroom soup, soup can of water and onion soup mix.
Pour this over rice and chicken. Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 2 hours.
Yield:
4 to 5 servings.

recipes.title: Layered Summer Salad
ingredients: 3 c. shredded lettuce or fresh greens of choice
2 oz. cubed farmer cheese or other low-fat cheese
8 oz. turkey or chicken, cooked and cubed
steps: In a salad bowl, layer the ingredients as follows: lettuce, 1/4 cup dressing, bacon, tomatoes, cheese, turkey or chicken and remaining 1/4 cup of dressing.
Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Squash Supreme
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1/2 c canned mushrooms, chopped & browned in butter
steps: Put squash in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Drain well. Butter a 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Beginning with a sprinkle of cheese, alternate ingredients by layers. Save a little cheese for topping. Bake in oven at 350 degrees until contents bubble. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top. Brown and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix all together except vanilla in heavy saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, as it thickens turn down. Add vanilla and set aside after it thickens.
Let it cool then spoon into baked pie shell or you can pour in while it is warm.

recipes.title: Warm Springs Apples
steps: Put apples in baking dish.
Sprinkle jello on top.
Mix sugar, flour and margarine well.
Put on top of apples.
Bake 30 minutes until apples are done.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies (3)
steps: Sift flour, salt, baking powder & soda. Cream brown sugar and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Stir in dry ingredients and rolled oats. Chill dough. Form into balls and roll into powdered sugar until heavily coated. Bake in a moderate oven on greased cookie sheet at 375° for 8-10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 c. mashed, cooked or canned pumpkin
steps: Beat egg slightly with fork.
Stir in milk, pumpkin and butter.
Measure flour; blend in dry ingredients.
Fold in raisins.
Fill cups 2/3 full.
May sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon sugar over each muffin.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes in a 400° oven.

recipes.title: Rice For A Crowd
steps: Bring to boil and boil 13 minutes.
Rinse in cold water.
Salt to taste.
Place in large pan.
Cover very tightly with foil. Place in low 150° to 200° oven until needed.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Pie
steps: Mix flour and sugar.
Beat eggs.
Add to flour mixture with milk.
Add chopped rhubarb.
Add to other mixture.
Bake at 300° until brown and crusty on top.
Yields 1 crust pie.
Use big pie pan (do not use nonstick).

recipes.title: Fruit Jello Salad(Makes One Dish)
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can crushed pineapple (in own syrup)
steps: Dissolve jello in 1 1/2 cups of hot water.
Reserve 1/3 cup to mix with mayonnaise.
Add canned pineapple and juice.
Stir in cottage cheese.
Mix the mayonnaise with 1/3 cup hot jello and add to the rest of mixture.
Add nuts last.
Set in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Cream Pie
steps: Mix flour, sugar and salt; slowly add cream and vanilla.
Pour into unbaked shell and sprinkle cinnamon on top.
Bake at 425° for 10 minutes, then at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Mo-Jo Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Wash and brush potatoes.
Cut into wedges.
Mix the seasonings into the flour.
Mix the egg with the milk.
Dip potato wedges into milk.
*Dust with seasoned flour. Place on a pastry sheet.
Drizzle with oil.
Bake in oven 20 to 25 minutes until browned and tender.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars
steps: In bowl, beat together eggs, sugar, oil and pumpkin until light and fluffy.
Stir together the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and soda.
Add to pumpkin mixture; mix thoroughly. Spread batter in an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool.
Frost.

recipes.title: Scalloped Cabbage
steps: Chop
and
cook
the
cabbage
just until crisp-tender; drain. To prepare cream sauce, melt margarine.
Stir in flour until smooth and add
milk.
Cook
over
medium
heat and stir until thick. Saute green pepper and onion in oil until tender. Place layer of cabbage
in
a
lightly
greased
baking
dish. Sprinkle with sauteed
onion,
pepper and grated cheese. Cover with cream sauce and bread crumbs.
Bake about 10 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Salad
steps: Mix mayonnaise and sugar; layer in large bowl first 4 ingredients.
Mix in mayonnaise mixture, top with cheese.
Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Rice Salad
steps: Mix
together; add enough French dressing to cover all. Serve on lettuce leaves if desired.

recipes.title: Prune Cake
steps: Mix all together and bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Purple Hull Pea Casserole
steps: In casserole dish, layer 2 cups peas, tomatoes, onion, bell peppers and salt and pepper to taste. REPEAT LAYERS. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Place 6 slices of bacon on top of cheese and bake until bacon is done and onions are tender. You may need to place under broiler to get bacon crispy.

recipes.title: Cheese Potatoes In Foil
steps: Slice potatoes into a large piece of foil.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Crumble bacon over potatoes.
Add onion and cheese. Dot with butter.
Wrap loosely and seal well with double fold. Cook in 350° oven for about 1 hour or until done, turning occasionally.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chewy Bars
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. chocolate chips (can mix with peanut butter chips)
steps: Mix the softened margarine and sugar well.
Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Gradually add the flour and stir in well.
Add vanilla, chips and nuts.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Mix in large mixing bowl, chicken, potatoes, cream of chicken & cream of celery. Place in 9 x 11 baking pan. Melt butter & combine with milk and flour. Pour over top. Bake at 350 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Cake
steps: Mix ingredients in order given.
Mix well after each.
Grease and flour angel food cake pan.
Spread in cake pan and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350° or when cake springs up when touched.

recipes.title: Zucchini Soup
ingredients: 4 c. chicken broth (this can be canned or fresh)
steps: Slice zucchini and cut into quarters.
Cook in 2-quart pot in 1 cup of broth.
Cook about 6 minutes or until crispy tender.
Add 3 tablespoons chopped scallion greens one more minute.
Drain broth back into remaining broth and set aside in small bowl.
Peel rest of zucchini and chop.
Chop rest of scallions and their tops. Simmer in butter until soft.
Add broth.
Add heaping tablespoonful of chopped pimento to reserved broth.
Add remaining pimento to pot mixture.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Put through blender; add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with croutons.

recipes.title: Chicken And Ham Lasagna
ingredients: 10 oz. pkg. frozen asparagus, thawed and drained
steps: Cook noodles per package directions and drain.
In a saucepan, melt butter.
Blend in flour, onion, garlic powder and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.
Add chicken broth and milk.
Cook and stir until bubbly. Stir in 1/2 cup grated cheese and mushrooms.
In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish layer half the noodles, all the asparagus, chicken, Mozzarella and 1/3 of the milk mixture.
Top with ham, remaining noodles and remaining milk mixture.
Sprinkle with remaining grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until heated through.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Serves 6 to 8 or 10 to 12 on buffet.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Rolls
steps: In a 2-cup container, dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water and 1/2 teaspoon sugar. Let stand 1 hour. Cream shortening and 1/2 cup sugar. Add 1 1/2 cups lukewarm water to shortening mixture; add egg and salt. Add part of the flour and mix well, then add the yeast mixture. Add remaining flour and mix well. May have to add extra flour if dough is sticky.

recipes.title: Texas Sheet Cake
steps: *If you don't have buttermilk, add some vinegar to milk.

recipes.title: War Time Cake
steps: In a saucepan, combine brown sugar, water, shortening, raisins, cinnamon, salt and cloves.
Bring to a boil.
Cool.
Add flour and soda.
Pour into loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for one hour and 15 minutes.
For a flat cake, use a greased 8-inch pan.

recipes.title: Haystacks
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) can chow mix Chinese noodles (2 c.)
steps: In top of double boiler over hot water, melt butterscotch morsels.
Stir in salad oil.
In large bowl, mix noodles, peanuts and butterscotch morsels.
Mix thoroughly with a fork.
Drop mixture onto wax paper by teaspoonful.

recipes.title: Icing
steps: Beat well.
If adding jello, do not add any water.
Add any kind of jello for any color icing.

recipes.title: Shoo-Fly Pie
steps: Mix together to make crumbs.

recipes.title: Marinated Cheese Squares
ingredients: Wheat Thins or other serving cracker
steps: Cut cheeses into 1 inch squares about 1/2 inch thick.
Cover with dressing and pimentos and marinate several hours or overnight. Serve in shallow serving dish with crackers.

recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) can tomatoes, chopped and undrained
2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans beef bouillon or 3 beef bouillon cubes plus 1 1/2 c. hot water
1 (1 lb.) can Great Northern beans, undrained
steps: Slice sausage crosswise, about 1/2-inch thick.
Brown in oil in deep saucepan or Dutch oven.
Add garlic, onion, carrots and basil.
Cook for 5 minutes.
Add zucchini, tomatoes with liquid, bouillon, cabbage, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Date Pudding
steps: Combine dates, water, soda and butter; let cool.
Beat the egg and sugar; add remaining ingredients.
Mix all together.
Bake in moderate oven (325°) for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb. skinned, boned chicken breasts, cut into strips
steps: Saute chicken, onion and garlic in butter until chicken is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Stir in cornstarch and cook 1 minute.
Add broth, carrot, lemon juice, rind and salt.
Bring to a full boil.
Stir in pea pods, parsley and rice.
Cover and remove from heat; let stand 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pickled Eggs
ingredients: 1/3 c. granulated sugar or packed brown sugar
steps: Place peeled eggs in bowl or jar.
Mix vinegar, beet liquid, sugar, salt, onion and cloves.
Pour over eggs.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 days.
Slice eggs and serve on greens.

recipes.title: Tofu Casserole
ingredients: 3 to 4 shiitake (dried mushrooms), soaked and chopped
steps: Cut tofu into quarters and boil in salted water for 20 minutes.
Drain and crumble.
Combine with the other ingredients and bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Potato Soup With Sausage(Yields 6 Servings)
ingredients: 10 oz. pork sausage links, cut in 1/4-inch slices
4 medium potatoes, pared and diced (about 4 c.)
1 c. sliced green beans, partially cooked
steps: In a heavy skillet, brown sausage over medium heat.
Remove sausage and set aside.
Drain all but 1 tablespoon of fat; saute celery, onion, thyme and salt.
Cook until onion is tender.
Stir in flour; cook 1 minute.
Gradually add broth and water, stirring until the mixture comes to a boil.
Add potatoes; cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Allow soup to cool. Puree 2 cups in blender or food processor.
Return to kettle.
Add milk, beans and sausage; heat through.
Garnish with parsely, if desired.

recipes.title: Pear Cake
steps: Mix eggs and sugar.
Add oil.
Stir in dry ingredients.
Add pears.
Bake in tube pan at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sunday Favorite Roast
ingredients: 1 beef roast (large enough to serve your family and guests)
1 envelope beefy onion dry soup mix
steps: Salt and pepper roast.
Coat in flour.
Heat cooking oil in skillet and lightly brown roast.
Wash, peel and cut potatoes into quarters.
Wash and scrape carrots and cut into approximately 1/8-inch slices.
Remove roast after browning and place into a large baking dish.
Arrange potatoes and carrots (and sliced onions, if desired) around the sides of roast.
Sprinkle the soup mix onto roast.
Brown a tablespoon of flour in the oil remaining in skillet after browning the roast.
Pour 1/2 to 1 cup of water over browned flour to make gravy.
Add salt and pepper.
After the gravy has thickened, pour it over and around the roast in the baking dish.
Place the dish into a very hot oven (425°) for about 15 minutes.
Place a piece of aluminum foil very loosely over the dish.
Reduce the heat to 300°.
Cook for about 15 minutes per pound.
(If you have a cooking timer on your oven, you can set it for the estimated cooking time and your lunch will cook while you are away at church.)

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Treats
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. regular marshmallows or 4 c. miniature marshmallows
steps: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat.
Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted.
Remove from heat. Add peanut butter, if desired.
Add Rice Krispies cereal.
Stir until well coated.
Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Cut into squares when cool.

recipes.title: Sourdough Bread
steps: Combine oil, water, sugar and Starter.
Stir well and add flour.
Place in greased bowl and turn to cover all surfaces with oil. Let rise in warm place. Bowl may be covered with towel or cookie sheet.
Turn dough onto floured surface and knead several times. Shape into loaves or rounds.
Place in greased pans.
Let rise for at least 8 hours. Bake at 350° until brown, about 20 minutes for rounds, 30 minutes for loaves.
May add 1 package of Italian seasoning mix for variety.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
steps: Mix all ingredients together except cheese until all is mixed well.
Pour mix in very hot oiled skillet.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
ingredients: 1 small box instant vanilla pudding mix
steps: Mix all ingredients together and blend on medium speed for 3 minutes.
Pour into 3 cake pans that have been greased and floured.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.
Cool and frost.

recipes.title: Creamy Fruit Salad
steps: Drain all canned fruits, reserving 2 cups mixed juices.
Layer drained fruit, strawberries, cherries and bananas in bowl. Combine pudding mix with reserved juices in bowl, beating until thick.
Pour over fruit.
Do not toss.
Chill for 2 hours before serving.
Yields 15 servings.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Scald milk and add shortening, sugar and salt.
Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Beat eggs in 1/2 cup cold water and add to scalded milk.
Cool until just warm and mix with other ingredients.
Add flour and beat until smooth, then add enough flour so dough can be kneaded to make it stiff.
Set in warm place and let rise until dough is light.
Divide dough into two equal parts and roll out into sheets.
Smooth melted butter over each sheet.
Mix 1/2 cup white sugar, 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon and sprinkle over dough.
Roll each sheet into a roll and cut.
Put 1/2 cup melted butter in baking pan and sprinkle lightly with brown sugar.
Put rolls in pan and let rise until light.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Yield:
27 rolls.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Hermits
steps: Mix all together well.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef and onion; drain.
Season to taste.
Combine beans, tomatoes and soup.
Line a greased ovenproof dish (2-quart) with tortillas.
Layer half of ground beef, soup mixture and cheese.
Add another layer of tortillas, meat and soup mixture, ending with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Martha'S Pound Cake
steps: Cream Crisco and sugar until smooth.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
Combine salt and flour.
Add to mixture.
Beat well and stir in vanilla.
Cook in a greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 10 minutes at 300° until brown.

recipes.title: Salmon Steaks With Dill Sauce
steps: Place salmon steaks in 10-inch skillet.
Add enough water to cover.
Top with onion, lemon slices and bay leaf; sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 8 minutes, or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.
Combine milk and flour in a saucepan, stirring well.

Add mustard, dill seed, lemon rind, 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. Gradually stir about 1/4 of hot milk mixture into egg yolk; add to remaining hot milk mixture, stirring constantly.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add lemon juice, mixing well.
Remove salmon steaks from skillet.
Spoon sauce over salmon.
Garnish with reserved lemon slices, if desired.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter And Chocolate Kisses Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In bowl, beat the butter, peanut butter, brown sugar, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, egg, vanilla and salt until fluffy.
Add flour and baking soda; beat until thoroughly blended.
Shape dough into 48 balls using a rounded teaspoonful for each.
Roll balls into 3 tablespoons of granulated sugar.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden.
Immediately top each cookie with a candy kiss, carefully pressing down firmly.
Remove cookies from baking sheets.
Cool on racks.
Makes 48 (1 3/4-inch) cookies.

recipes.title: Sweet And Light Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch).
Measure all of the ingredients into large mixing bowl. Beat on medium speed for 30 seconds.
Pour into prepared pan. Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean when inserted.
Allow to cool.

recipes.title: Holiday Fruitcake
steps: Put package of mincemeat, broken, with 1/2 cup water and boil briskly for 1 minute. Cool. Combine the mincemeat, nuts, candied fruit, sweetened condensed milk and egg. Blend well. Stir in flour and baking soda; pour into a loaf pan that has been greased and floured. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until center comes back when lightly touched.

recipes.title: Apple Muffins
steps: In a large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and baking soda. Set aside. In a small bowl, beat eggs, sour cream and butter. Add all at once to dry ingredients along with apples.
Stir, just until moistened. Fill well-greased muffin tins 2/3 full.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Yields 24 muffins.

recipes.title: Pecan Crispies
steps: Cream butter and sugars until light. Beat in egg and vanilla. Stir together dry ingredients. Blend into creamed mixture.
Stir in nuts. Drop from teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° about 10 minutes. Makes approximately 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Yorkshire Pudding
steps: Pour into an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish and keep hot 1/4 cup roast beef drippings.
Beat until thick and piled softly 2 eggs.
Add to beaten eggs and beat with rotary beater until smooth milk, flour and salt.
Pour mixture over hot meat drippings and bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes or until puffed and browned. Cut into squares and serve immediately with standing rib roast of beef.

recipes.title: Batter
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Mix with water and egg.
Use for onions or vegetables.

recipes.title: Apple Dumplings
steps: Make syrup of sugar, water, cinnamon and nutmeg; add butter. Quarter, peel and core apples.
Sift flour, salt and baking powder, then cut in shortening.
Add milk all at once and stir until flour is moistened.
Roll 1/4-inch thick; cut in 5-inch squares.
Put 4 pieces of apples on each.
Sprinkle generously with additional sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Dot with butter and fold corners to center.
Pinch edges together and place 1 inch apart in greased baking dish or pan.
Pour syrup over dumplings and bake in moderate oven at 375° for 35 minutes.
Serve hot with cream.
(This is also great cold.)

recipes.title: Coconut Jam Cake
steps: Cream butter, sugar and eggs together, then add all other ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Makes 3 layers.

recipes.title: Flour Tortilla Roll-Ups
ingredients: 4 oz. can diced green chilies, drained
steps: Cream the cream cheese and add drained green chilies.
Blend well with mixer.
Spread out tortillas; divide and spread out cream cheese evenly over tortillas.
Roll each one like a jelly roll. Wrap and refrigerate.
When ready to serve, cut in thin slices.

recipes.title: Pennsylvania Dutch Chicken And Dumplings
steps: In large pot, boil chicken and keep stock.
Bone and skin chicken.
Place back in pot.
Add vegetables.
Salt and pepper. Boil until cooked.
Reduce heat to simmer.
Keep water level high. Add water to flour to make slightly sticky dough.
Roll out 1/4-inch thick and cut 1 1/2-inch squares.
Drop squares into water and let cook until dough is done.
Drain water only as needed to keep from overflowing.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
ingredients: 2 c. whole corn or 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen corn
steps: Mix together.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes in 13 x 9-inch pan. Stir from bottom three times while baking.
When knife comes out clean, pudding is done.

recipes.title: Almond Bars
steps: Cream butter,
margarine and sugar thoroughly.	Add egg yolk; add flour,	salt
and
vanilla.
Grease cookie sheet and spread dough with	fingers
dusted with flour.
Beat egg white and brush over cookies.
Sprinkle almonds over dough and press down with hand.
Bake
at
for	45
minutes
or
lightly browned.
Cut within
a
few minutes into desired portions.
A 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet works well.

recipes.title: Yeast Rolls
steps: Soften yeast in water.
Cut cutter into 3 cups flour; blend in eggs milk, sugar, salt and yeast.
Gradually add remaining flour. Mix well after each addition.
Cover and chill 2 to 3 hours. Divide in 4 parts; roll out to 10-inch circle.
Brush with melted butter.
Cut in pie shaped wedges.
Start with wide edge and roll up.
Place on greased baking sheet.
Let rise until double.
Bake at 375° for 15 to 18 minutes.

recipes.title: Raspberry Jam Strips
steps: Mix margarine, sugars, egg and vanilla.
Stir in flour and baking powder.
(If dough is soft, cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.)
Heat oven to 350°.

recipes.title: New England Style Clam Chowder
steps: Cook potatoes, water and salt until tender.
Cut bacon into small pieces and fry until almost cooked.
Add onion and cook slowly until bacon is completely cooked.
Combine all cooked ingredients in one pot and add milk and clams.
Bring to a boil, however do not boil.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. scalded milk with 1 Tbsp. butter
steps: Melt butter and brown sugar in a large fryer.
Beat eggs, sugar and vanilla until thick.
Add scalded milk with butter.
Mix thoroughly with egg mixture; pour over butter, sugar and fruit layer in fryer.
Place over low heat and bake until done, about 35 minutes.
During the last 5 minutes, tilt cover to aid in drying top of cake.
Turn upside-down on a large plate.
Serve plain or with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Party Rolls
ingredients: 2 pkg. Pepperidge Farm party rolls (20 rolls per pkg.)
steps: In medium bowl, combine mustard, onion, margarine and poppy seed.
Do not separate rolls first.
Split entire roll package horizontally and spread each side with mustard mixture.
Cut ham and cheese into squares to fit individual rolls.
Put one of each on each roll, then top with other half of roll package.
Separate rolls and return to original aluminum pan.
Cover with foil and heat at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Can be made ahead and frozen. Do not heat until ready to serve.
Serves 8 to 10 persons.

recipes.title: Pie Of Any Flavor
ingredients: 1 c. sugar (if butterscotch use brown sugar)
1 box of cook and serve pudding (any flavor except lemon)
1/2 tsp. baking powder or cream of tartar
steps: Bake pie shells and set aside.
Place milk into a saucepan and place saucepan of milk into a larger pan of water and turn heat to medium.
Add sugar, salt, Cook & Serve pudding mix, and egg yolks.
Mix with just enough milk to pour and beat into hot milk.
Stir until thick.
Set into a pan of cold water and add butter and vanilla and beat well.
When slightly cool, pour into pie shells.
Take whites of eggs and add baking powder and beat until thick.
Add sugar and vanilla and pour into pie shells spreading well and brown under broil.

recipes.title: Mexican Style Liver
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
steps: In large skillet, cook bacon until crisp.
Drain, reserving 3 tablespoons drippings in skillet.
Crumble bacon; set aside.
Cook onion and garlic in drippings for about 5 minutes or until onion is tender, but not brown.
Combine flour, chili powder and salt. Cut liver into thin strips; toss with flour mixture to coat.
Add liver to onion in skillet; brown quickly on all sides.
Stir in crumbled bacon, undrained tomatoes and whole kernel corn.
Simmer, covered, until mixture is heated through.
Serve with tortillas or over hot, cooked rice.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. butter or 2 Tbsp. bacon fryings and 1 Tbsp. lard
steps: Peel and boil the chopped potatoes.
Heat in skillet the first 4 ingredients until very hot.
In bowl, put the chopped cabbage and the chopped potatoes.
Pour the ingredients over it; mix well. Return to stove until all is hot.
Serve at once.

recipes.title: Low Calorie Apple Pie
steps: Combine brown Sugar Twin, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. Add apples and mix together.
Place in pie shell and dot with 2 tablespoons butter.
Bake for 50 minutes at 350°.
Makes 8 servings at 231 calories per serving.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix sugar and butter until creamy.
Add eggs and peanut butter.
Mix soda and flour in with the rest.
Place small balls on cookie sheet.
Press out with fork.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes, or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: The Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix shortening, butter, sugars, eggs and vanilla.
Blend in remaining ingredients.
(For a softer, rounder cookie, add 1/2 cup flour.)
Drop onto an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes, until light brown.

recipes.title: Ginger Snaps
steps: Mix in order, roll into balls the size of a walnut. Roll in white sugar and bake at 350°. Cookie will flatten and crack.

recipes.title: Filled Kolackys
ingredients: 2 pkg. active dry yeast or 2 cakes compressed yeast
steps: Soften the active dry yeast in warm water, compressed yeast in lukewarm water.

recipes.title: Pot Roast With Vegetables
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed beef broth, undiluted
steps: Wipe roast with paper towels.
Place oil and butter in 5-quart Dutch oven or heavy kettle.
Over medium heat, brown roast with sliced onion, turning roast with 2 wooden spoons until brown on all sides.
Add seasonings to drippings and saute, stirring, 1/2 minute.
Add beef broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce to simmer and cook just below the boiling point, covered, 2 1/2 hours.
Turn meat occasionally.
Add vegetables and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
steps: Beat eggs well.
Add sugar, flour, margarine, corn and milk. Bake in greased casserole dish at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes, until golden brown.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pumpkin Coffeecake
ingredients: 1 3/4 c. or 1 (16 oz.) can Libby's solid pack pumpkin
steps: Cream butter, 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla in mixer bowl.
Add 3 eggs, beating well.
Combine flour, baking powder and baking soda. Add dry ingredients to butter mixture alternately with sour cream.
Combine pumpkin, beaten egg, 1/3 cup sugar and pie spice.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Mix and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Mark and let cool.
Makes about 24 (2-inch) servings.

recipes.title: Quick White Sauce
steps: Melt butter and flour; stir 3 to 4 minutes until blended. Slowly stir in milk.
Cook and stir until thick and smooth.

recipes.title: Savory Pepper Steak
steps: Cut round steak into 1/2-inch strips.
Coat with mixture of flour, salt and pepper.
In a large skillet, brown strips in shortening.

recipes.title: Spinach Salad(If You Like Spinach, You Will Love This Spinach Salad!)
steps: Wash spinach and break into small pieces in a large bowl.
Add bacon, eggs and bean sprouts and lightly toss.
Top with croutons and this dressing:

recipes.title: Mini Quiches
steps: On floured surface, roll half of pastry into a 12-inch circle. Cut 6 (4-inch) circles.
Repeat with second pastry.
Fit into 12 muffin pan cups.
Fill each muffin cup with some shrimp, green onion, black olives and cheese.
Beat remaining ingredients and pour over mixture in muffin cups.
Bake in 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 12 appetizers.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
steps: Mix applesauce, sugar, butter and egg together and set aside. Combine flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and cloves together. Mix well and add raisins and nuts.
Stir in applesauce mixture. Pour batter into well-greased tube pan and bake in preheated 350° oven for 50 minutes or until done.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
steps: Mix sugar, oil and eggs together.
Add strawberries and lemon juice.
Sift together flour, soda, salt and spices.
Gradually stir dry ingredients into strawberry mixture.
Mix and add nuts, if desired.
Pour into 2 greased loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Texas Sheet Cake
steps: Sift flour, soda, salt and cinnamon; set aside.
In saucepan, combine water, margarine, oil and cocoa; bring to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Add sugar; mix well.
Add sifted ingredients, beating well.
Add buttermilk, eggs and vanilla.
Beat well.
Spread in a greased and floured sheet cake pan (10 x 14 x 1-inch).
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread(Makes 2 Loaves)
steps: Combine sugar and shortening; add eggs, water and pumpkin. Sift dry ingredients.
Combine with first mixture.
Add nuts, raisins and dates.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Dressing
steps: Crumble Blue cheese with a fork and mix with mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, chives and pepper.
Add sour cream and buttermilk.
Let stand in refrigerator overnight.
Add additional buttermilk to achieve preferred consistency.
Will keep refrigerated 1 month.

recipes.title: Butterhorn Rolls
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. butter or margarine, softened and divided
steps: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water in a large bowl; let stand 5 minutes.
Add remaining 1 cup of water and next 4 ingredients, stirring well.
Add enough flour to make a soft dough.
Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic (about 4 minutes).
Place in a well-greased bowl, turning to grease top.
Cover and let rise in a warm place (85°) free from drafts for 1 hour or until doubled in bulk.
Punch dough down and divide into thirds.
Roll each portion into a 10-inch circle on a floured surface; spread with 1 tablespoon butter.
Cut each circle in 12 wedges.
Roll up each wedge, beginning at wide end.
Place on greased baking sheets point side down.
Cover and let rise in a warm place free from drafts for 45 minutes or until doubled in bulk.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes or until browned.
Yields 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
steps: Put all together.
Bring to boil for 1 minute.
Set off to cool.
Bake two pie shells.
After mixture cools, add 1 quart of strawberries and put into pie shells.
Top with Cool Whip and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Soft Pretzels
ingredients: 1 egg white, beaten with 1 tsp. each: salt and water
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in water; let stand about 10 minutes. Add 2 cups of the flour, salt and oil; beat until smooth. Gradually stir in more flour (about 1/2 cup) to make a soft dough. Turn dough out onto a floured surface.
Knead until smooth and elastic, adding more flour (up to 1/2 cup) if necessary to prevent dough from being too sticky.
Place dough in a greased bowl. Cover; let raise in warm place until doubled, 45 minutes to 1 hour. Punch dough down; divide into 12 balls.
Roll each out to form 18-inch rope.
Twist into pretzel shape.
Let rise, uncovered, 20 to 25 minutes.
Brush lightly with egg white mixture and sprinkle with salt.
Bake at 425° until well browned, 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Emily'S Fudge Cake
steps: Grease and flour an 8 x 8-inch cake pan; set aside.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix ingredients together in large bowl until well blended.
Put in pan; bake for 25 minutes, until done.
When cool, frost with favorite chocolate frosting (butter frosting suggested).

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Cream margarine, sugar and cream cheese.
Add eggs, one at a time; beat thoroughly.
Add flour a little at a time; beat well. Add flavorings.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake one hour at 350°.
May be cooked 1 hour and 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Wacky Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: salt, soda and baking powder
steps: Preheat oven at 350°.
Sift all dry ingredients into 8-inch square pan.
Make 3 holes with spoon in dry ingredients.
In one hole, put vanilla.
In another, put vinegar and in last hole, melted butter.
Pour lukewarm water over all.
Stir, mixing well. Bake 30 minutes.
Cool in pan; frost with chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Date Nut Cookies
steps: Stir together the flours, wheat germ, cinnamon, salt and soda. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add vanilla and eggs; beat until smooth.
Stir in flour mixture until well blended.
Stir in dates and nuts.
Drop by tablespoon onto greased baking sheet.
Bake in preheated 375° oven for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen cookies.
Very good!

recipes.title: Bacon Curry Coleslaw
steps: Combine raisins and lemon juice; heat gently until hot. Then set
aside until raisins are cool and plump.
Meanwhile, finely shred the cabbage, dice onion, grate apple and cook and crumble bacon.
Combine
apples,
raisins,
lemon
juice
and sugar;
add mayonnaise
and curry powder to apple mixture and blend.
Just before
serving,
combine
cabbage, green onion, crumbled bacon, peanuts and mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Sweet 'N Sour Stew
steps: Brown meat after coating with flour, salt and pepper in hot oil.
Add liquid to meat.
Add chopped onion.
Cover and cook 45 minutes.
Add carrots.
Cook until tender.

recipes.title: Fudge Brownies
steps: Combine butter and chocolates in a small saucepan and melt over medium heat.
In a large mixing bowl, combine beaten eggs, sugar, baking powder, vanilla, flour, nuts and chocolate mixture.
Stir to mix well.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix egg yolks and milk over medium heat.
Add melted and cooled German chocolate.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla, 3/4 of coconut, nuts and softened butter.
Cool and pour into baked crust.

recipes.title: Vivian'S Pumpkin Roll
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into a well-greased sheet cake pan. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Remove cake from pan onto a tea towel covered with powdered sugar.
Roll up towel and cake together.
Put in freezer for 30 minutes.
While cake is cooling, make the filling.

recipes.title: Chopstick Veal Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
1 (3 oz.) can chow mein noodles (2 c.)
steps: Cut meat in 2 1/2-inch strips.
Brown in hot oil.
Add remaining ingredients except noodles.
Turn into 2-quart casserole.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.
Stir occasionally.
Last 5 minutes of baking, uncover and sprinkle with chow mein noodles.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Shrimp Casserole
ingredients: 3/4 lb. cooked, peeled and cleaned shrimp
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Cut large shrimp in half.
Cook vegetables in butter or margarine until tender; blend in flour and salt.
Combine soup and milk; add to vegetable mixture and cook until thick, stirring constantly.
Add shrimp and pour into a well-greased 1-quart casserole.
Combine melted butter or margarine and breadcrumbs; sprinkle over top of casserole.
Bake at 400° about 10 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Texas Dip
ingredients: 1 small jar picante sauce (as hot as you like it)
steps: Brown meats and drain.
Melt cheese in a microwave-proof dish. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot and mix well.
Let crock-pot warm all ingredients and keep the crock-pot on low while serving. Stir occasionally to keep it from sticking to the bottom.
Serve with lightly salted tortilla chips.
Great for tailgating, parties or other social gathering.
May not look very appetizing, but it tastes delicious.

recipes.title: Korean Salad
steps: Break and take the spinach stems out.
Rinse and drain bean sprouts.
Slice water chestnuts.
Chop eggs.
Cook and break up bacon.
Mix the spinach, bean sprouts, water chestnuts, eggs and bacon together.

recipes.title: Pineapple Au Gratin
steps: Mix together the pineapple chunks, Cheddar cheese, sugar and flour.
Put in baking dish.
Crumble Ritz crackers over this mixture.
Pour melted margarine on top of crackers.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
ingredients: 1 c. quick or old fashioned oats (uncooked)
steps: Combine all ingredients except buttermilk, raisins and butter. Gradually stir in buttermilk and raisins; mix until dry ingredients are moistened.
Knead until smooth, about 1 minute. Shape into a ball.
Place on well-greased cookie sheet; flatten to form 7-inch circle.
Cut cross in top 1/4-inch deep.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown.
Brush with 1 tablespoon butter.
Cool on wire rack.
Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Topped Brownies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Prepare brownie mix as directed.
Spread in well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
In small mixing bowl, beat cheese, margarine and cornstarch until fluffy.
Gradually beat in canned milk, egg and vanilla until smooth.
Pour evenly over brownie batter.
Bake 45 minutes or until top is lightly browned. Cool.
Spread with frosting.
Cut in bars.
Store covered in refrigerator.
Makes 40 brownies.

recipes.title: Pumpkin And Streusel Muffins
ingredients: 16.6 oz. pkg. Pillsbury nut quick bread mix
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Grease bottoms only of 12 muffin cups.
In large bowl, combine all muffin ingredients; stir 50 to 75 strokes until dry particles are moistened, breaking up any lumps.
Divide batter evenly among prepared muffin cups.

recipes.title: Strawberry Ice Cream Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines strawberry supreme cake mix
1 (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans.
Prepare, bake and cool cake following package directions. Place cake layer on cooling racks in jelly-roll pan.
Freeze 2 hours or until cake layers are firm.
Place cake layer on serving plate.
Spread softened ice cream to edges.
Place second layer on top of ice cream.
Freeze assembled cake until ice cream is firm. Frost sides and top of cake with whipped topping.
Garnish with fresh strawberries.
Store in freezer until ready to serve.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
steps: Cook margarine, cocoa, sugar and milk until bubbles form around sides of pan; remove from heat.
Add oats, peanut butter and vanilla.
Drop on waxed paper and cool.

recipes.title: Chicken Gumbo Pork Chops
steps: Wash pork chops.
Salt and pepper each side. Smear each side of chop with prepared mustard (about 1 teaspoon).
Dredge in flour.
Brown in oil on each side in skillet.
Empty contents of one can of soup over chops.
Cook for 1 hour at 350°.
All this may be done in electric skillet or you may place chops in covered baking dish and pour soup over them and bake in oven or microwave. Good accompaniments are rice and purple hull peas.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
steps: Sift together flour and sugar.
Combine butter, cocoa and water and bring to a rapid boil.
Pour over sugar and flour.
Mix well.
Add other ingredients and pour into greased 11 x 16-inch pan.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. all-purpose flour (do not use self-rising flour)
1 c. finely chopped walnuts or pecans
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Roll 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured cloth covered board.
Cut into 1 1/2-inch circles.
Place circles on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes.
Yields about 8 dozen cookies.
After baking, you may "paint" the cookies different by using food coloring and tiny paint brushes.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
steps: Cook ham hock until meat pulls apart.
Remove meat from bone. Pour lentils into the ham stock.
Refrigerate overnight.
Dice onion and carrot; add to stock.
Cook until lentils are tender.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Mix chopped broccoli, red onion, cheese and crumbled bacon in bowl.

recipes.title: Houska Christmas Bread
steps: Dissolve
yeast
in lukewarm water.
Scald milk and add butter,
sugar
and
salt.
Cool
to
lukewarm.
Add
to yeast mixture and well beaten eggs, 3 cups flour, raisins, cherries, almonds
and
pecans.
Mix
well.
Add about 2 1/2 cups flour. Place
on
lightly
floured
surface
and knead until dough is smooth.
Place
in a warm bowl.
Cover with towel and let rise for about
hours.
Punch
down
dough and turn out on floured surface.
Divide dough in half.
Divide one half into 3
equal parts.
Roll each piece into a strip about 15 inches long.
Braid and
place on a baking sheet.
Divide 2/3 of the remaining
dough into 3 equal parts and prepare braid like the first.
Place
on top of first braid.
Make a third braid from remaining
dough
and place
on top of second (center) braid. Brush with butter.
Let rise until double in bulk.
Beat 1 egg white
and
tablespoon water; brush loaf.
Bake at 350° for about 35 to 45 minutes, or until done.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 stick Parkay or Blue Bonnet oleo
steps: Cream Crisco, oleo and 1/2 cup sugar until light in color and fluffy, then gradually add the other sugar.
Add room temperature eggs, one at a time.
Beat after each addition.
Add flour and milk alternately.
I put the vanilla in the milk.
Start in a cold oven.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

recipes.title: Brownie Fudge Nut Pie
steps: In a medium saucepan over low heat, stir condensed milk, margarine and cocoa until margarine melts and mixture is warm. Remove from heat.
Stir in eggs, flour, vanilla and chopped nuts. Pour into prepared crust.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until center is firm.
Serve warm or cold, topped with whipped cream, if desired.

recipes.title: Impossible Egg Pie
steps: Beat eggs.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Grease two 9-inch pans or baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Add one can coconut to make coconut pie.

recipes.title: Country Style Chicken Casserole
steps: Cook noodles; drain.
In a large skillet, melt butter, then blend in flour over medium heat.
Gradually add broth, milk, pimentos, salt and pepper.
Bring to boiling point, then simmer, stirring constantly, until sauce is thickened, about 5 minutes. Grease a 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Combine noodles, chicken and sauce.
Top with cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Banana Coffee Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Combine bran, flour, baking soda, light salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and raisins in a bowl.
Mix thoroughly. Beat brown sugar, molasses, oil, egg and milk in a bowl.
Add wet ingredients to dry and stir until ingredients are moist.
Fill muffin tins 2/3 full of batter.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes. Servings equal 1 starch and 1/2 fat.

recipes.title: Peruvian Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 oz. can ripe pitted black olives
steps: Simmer scrubbed potatoes in large pan with 1-inch of boiling, salted water for 25 to 30 minutes, until tender.
Drain, cool and remove skins.
In large saucepan over low heat, stir cream cheese and half and half until smooth.
Add chopped chili peppers, lemon juice, turmeric, comino and salt.
Simmer 1 minute, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Southern Maryland Stuffed Ham
steps: Cut/tear up cleaned greens.
Combine with cabbage, celery and red pepper.
Place ham on clean cheese cloth.
Make small slits all around the ham.
Stuff the green mixture into the slits.
Tie 1 package cheesecloth around the ham and place in a roaster that is half filled with water.
Boil for at least 1 hour or until ham is done.
Remove cheesecloth and serve.

recipes.title: Skillet Dinner
ingredients: 2 (15 oz.) cans Armour Star chili (no beans)
steps: Tear tortillas into bite-size pieces and brown in skillet in small amount of oil.
Brown and cook the onion and green pepper until tender.
Drain oil off all.

recipes.title: Rye Bread
ingredients: 2 pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1/2 c. water
steps: Mix the ingredients.
Bake at 375° just to brown the top, then at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Delight(Diet)
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, separated into flowerets
steps: Cook cauliflower in salted water for 6 to 7 minutes or until tender-crisp.
Drain.
Mix pickle liquid, sweetener, garlic and onion in a small bowl.
Pour over cauliflower, pickles and radishes in bowl.
Toss to marinate.
Cover in refrigerator for 12 hours, stirring occasionally.
Drain before serving.

recipes.title: Blackberry Wine Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix, sifted
steps: Mix together all ingredients on low speed until moistened. Mix on medium for 2 minutes.
Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Shoo-Fly Pie
steps: Bake at 375° for 10 minutes, then at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 5 pies.

recipes.title: Ladson'S Potato Pone
steps: Mix all ingredients
and
cook on top of stove in heavy iron skillet, stirring
frequently.
Must
cook	slowly on low heat. When almost done put in baking pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: No Roll Pie Crust
steps: Bring oil and water to a boil.
Stir in flour.
While mixture is still warm, put into 9-inch pie plate and proceed with filling; bake.

recipes.title: Baked Pigs Trotters(Porco Al Forno)
steps: Boil pigs feet
in
water for 25 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a large baking pan and place cooked pigs feet onto pan, bone
side
down.
Sprinkle tomatoes and the rest of the ingredients on
top of pigs feet in the above order.
Bake for 40 to
minutes,
until skin looks browned and a little crispy. Serve immediately.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad(Serves 16)
ingredients: 6 c. chopped raw broccoli, flower and tender stems
steps: Toss first four ingredients when ready to serve.
Add dressing last.
Serve on bed of lettuce.
Serves 16.

recipes.title: Salad Dressing Cake(Heritage Recipe)
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Sift all dry ingredients together.
Then add others, I use Crisco Oil in pan sparingly. (No flour.)
Bake.

recipes.title: Canned Vinegar Beans
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) bag dried beans (your choice of type)
steps: Boil all ingredients, except beans, for 25 minutes. Fill jars with beans and pour vinegar mixture over beans.
Scald.

recipes.title: Andouille (Sausage) And Potatoes
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. bacon drippings or olive oil
1 to 2 lb. andouille or other heavily smoked sausage
Louisiana hot sauce or ground cayenne pepper to taste
steps: Heat bacon drippings in a large heavy saucepan over medium-high heat.
Saute onions, bell pepper and parsley, stirring occasionally until onions are clear.
Add wine, garlic, soy sauce and andouille (sausage); mix well.
Add salt and soy sauce; stir. Add potatoes and stir.
Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally until potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Boil macaroni.
Melt butter in saucepan; take off heat and add flour.
Blend well; add milk slowly until blended with flour mixture (no lumps).
Return to heat, stirring constantly until thickened.
Heat oven to 250° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Grate cheese mix all together in baking dish.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Crazy Crust Apple Squares
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 13 x 9-inch pan lightly.
Spoon flour into measuring cup; level off.
In large bowl, combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, salt and nutmeg.
Mix well. Add milk and egg and blend well.
Spread in greased pan.
Sprinkle raisins, apples and pecans over batter.

recipes.title: Molly'S Seafood Crepes
steps: Use mixing method of your choice.
Cook 45 to 60 seconds, preferably in crepe iron.
Makes 14 to 16 crepes.
Prepare crepe filling as follows.

recipes.title: Yeast Hot Rolls
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Turn to 325°.
Place rolls in oven.
Mix yeast in water until dissolved.
Mix salt with flour, then mix all together well.
Make rolls on floured board.
Let rise for 3 hours. Bake in a 325° oven.
Heat oven to 400°; then turn down heat to 325° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: 6 Weeks Muffins
steps: In a large bowl, mix the first 5 ingredients together. In a small bowl, mix the next 3 ingredients together and add to dry mixture. Add nuts and raisins gently. Bake in paper cup in muffin tins. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Store leftover dough in tightly covered bowl in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
ingredients: 3/4 c. canned milk (add water to make 1 c.)
steps: Cream oleo, Crisco and add sugar.
Add one egg at a time.
Add flour, salt and milk.
Put in cold oven.
Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes at 325°.
Do not open oven until done.
Bake in well-greased and floured tube pan.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Cheese Crunchies
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine over hot (not boiling) water the butterscotch morsels and butter.
Stir until morsels are melted and mixture is smooth.
Transfer to large bowl.
Stir in graham cracker crumbs and walnuts with a fork until mixture resembles fine crumbs.
Reserve 2 cups for topping.
Press remaining mixture into 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch ungreased baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
steps: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl, mixing well.
Cut in butter until mixture looks like coarse crumbs.
Combine sweet potatoes with buttermilk.
Stir into dry ingredients.
Makes a soft dough. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead 4 to 5 times or just enough to form a soft ball.
Roll dough out and cut out biscuits. Place on lightly oiled baking sheet.
Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Or Peach Cobbler
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Melt oleo in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan. Heat water and sugar in saucepan until sugar melts.
Mix flour and shortening until crumbly.
Add milk and stir with fork.
Turn out on floured board and knead until smooth.
Roll dough out into oblong about 1/4-inch thick.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Add fruit on top.
Roll up like jelly roll.
Dampen edge with water to seal. Slice dough into 16 slices, 1/2 inch thick.
Place in pan with melted butter.
Pour water and sugar syrup carefully around rolls. This looks like too much liquid, but the crust will absorb it. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Holiday Fruitcake
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
2 c. (1 lb. jar) mixed candied fruit
steps: Break mincemeat into pieces in medium size saucepan.
Add water; stir over medium heat until lumps are broken.
Boil 1 minute; stir occasionally.
Cool.

recipes.title: Carrot-Pineapple Loaves
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour four baking pans.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding(Kentucky Style)
ingredients: 2 c. drained cooked or canned whole kernel corn
steps: Combine ingredients; pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Set in a shallow pan filled to 1 inch with hot water.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
Let stand for 10 minutes at room temperature before serving.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Golden Cheddar Broccoli Bake
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded sharp natural Cheddar cheese
1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cooked and drained
steps: Melt 2 tablespoons margarine; stir in flour and salt.
Add milk gradually, mixing until smooth.
Cook until mixture boils, stirring constantly.
Add cheese, stirring until melted.
Mix in 1/4 cup corn flakes and corn.
Arrange broccoli in a 7 1/2 x 11 3/4-inch baking dish.
Pour cheese sauce over broccoli.
Toss remaining 1/2 cup crumbs with 2 tablespoons melted margarine.
Sprinkle crumb mixture over casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Saute bacon.
Add hamburger and onion; drain fat.
Add rest of ingredients.
Bake until it bubbles (approximately 1 hour) at 350°.
Freezes well before baking for later use.

recipes.title: Texas Sheet Cake
steps: Combine flour and sugar in large mixing bowl.
In small saucepan, combine butter, cocoa and water.
Bring to a boil and pour over flour and sugar; mix well.
Add buttermilk with soda, cinnamon, vanilla and eggs.
Mix well and pour into greased and floured 16 x 11-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Peach Jello Salad
steps: Cook until thick.
Be sure and let cool and mix with one package of Dream Whip, prepared as directed.
Fold into cool mixture and spread on jello.

recipes.title: Southwestern Shrimp
ingredients: 1 finely chopped jalapeno (remove seeds for milder dish)
steps: Peel and devein shrimp; cut in half.
Heat oil in nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Saute onion, cilantro and jalapeno for 5 minutes.	Stir in tomato sauce. Add shrimp and stir until shrimp turns pink. Serve over white rice. Serves 2.

recipes.title: Puffed Pancake With Strawberries
steps: Mix eggs, milk, orange juice, sugar, flour and salt until blended (if using a mixer, batter may remain lumpy).
Preheat oven to 450°.
Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish in oven until it sizzles (don't let it brown).
Remove baking dish from oven and pour batter into it immediately.
Bake in middle of oven for 20 minutes or until puffed and brown.
Remove from oven, sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.
Pancake falls quickly so serve immediately with warm Strawberry Sauce and sour cream.

recipes.title: Apple Walnut Ring Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Mix and sift flour, soda, salt and spices.
Add gradually to butter, sugar and egg mixture.
Mix well.
Stir in vanilla, apples and walnuts.
Batter will be stiff. Spoon into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Let cool in pan for 10 minutes, then remove to rack to cool.
Dribble confectioners sugar icing on top and sides, if desired.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sunshine Cake
ingredients: 1 c. hot water with 1 Tbsp. instant coffee or 1 c. coffee
steps: Mix all ingredients together; blend well.
Beat 3 minutes. Batter is very thin.
Bake 30 minutes in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350°. Frost with your favorite white icing.
Serves 20 slices.

recipes.title: Mama'S Homecooking Fried Muskrat
steps: First, trap muskrat.
Then skin muskrat, then cut into 4 pieces.
Once this is completed, dip into egg and milk, then roll into flour, cracker meal, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Bread Machine Bread
steps: Add ingredients to the bread pan in the order listed, measuring carefully and using a knife to scrape off the excess. Bake as directed by the directions on the bread machine. Makes 1 1/2 lb. loaf.
(You may also use the dough setting on your machine and when the dough is ready, form it into dinner rolls. Let them rise until doubled in size, then bake at 375° until brown.)

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
steps: In a 2-quart casserole, add ingredients in order, starting with rice.
Salt, pepper and flour chicken and dip each piece in liquid shortening.
Put chicken into casserole mixture, cover and bake 2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Good Rich Yeast Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast with 1 teaspoon sugar in lukewarm water.
Sift flour with remaining sugar and salt; add eggs, milk, shortening and cooled yeast.
Mix. Turn dough onto floured board and knead.
Pinch off and roll into golf ball size balls; place in greased muffin pans.
Let rise (covered with light cloth).
Bake at 350° until golden brown.
Yields about 36 rolls.

recipes.title: Swedish Nut Cake
steps: Mix by hand.
Pour in greased 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.
Have icing ready when the cake is done.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars(Microwave)
steps: Blend oil, eggs, sugar and pumpkin together in large mixing bowl.
Measure flour, baking powder, soda, salt, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and nutmeg into 1-quart measure.
Mix together lightly with fork.
Stir into pumpkin mixture.
Divide butter equally into two 8 x 8-inch glass pans.
One at a time, cover with plastic wrap. Microwave 5 minutes and 30 seconds to 11 to 13 minutes on High, or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Let stand until thoroughly cooled.
Top with Cream Cheese Frosting.

recipes.title: Oat Bran Muffins
steps: Add all ingredients together in a large bowl.
Put in muffin pans.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Sift together all dry ingredients.
Add remaining ingredients. Mix till smooth.
Pour into 3 loaf pans, greased and floured and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.
Cool.

recipes.title: Ann'S Cabbage Casserole
steps: Brown meat, celery, onion and salt.
In a kettle, cook cabbage for 5 minutes.
After it starts boiling, drain and add meat mixture.
Then add rice and 1/2 of grated cheese.
Put in casserole dish and top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for one hour.
You may substitute bell pepper for celery and chicken soup for mushroom if you desire.

recipes.title: Cheesy Rice And Broccoli
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
1/2 lb. (8 oz.) Velveeta cheese, cut up
steps: Bring broccoli and water to full boil in medium saucepan on medium-high heat. Stir in rice. Cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Add Velveeta. Stir until Velveeta is melted.

recipes.title: Pecan Crispies
steps: Set oven to 375°.
Cream butter and sugars until light.
Beat in egg and vanilla.
Sift together dry ingredients; blend into creamed mixture.
Stir in nuts and drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake about 10 minutes.
Cool slightly before removing from pan.
Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Casserole
steps: Combine chicken and soup.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Place in 9 x 13 covered with foil.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes, uncovered.
Sprinkle with cheese; bake for 10 to 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Squash Pie (Coconut Flavor)(Tastes Just Like Coconut Pie)
steps: Mix ingredients; pour into pie crust. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Cream together butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla. Set aside.
Combine flour, salt and baking soda; blend into creamed mixture.
Stir in chocolate flavored chips.
Drop by teaspoons onto greased baking sheet.
Bake at 370° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Yields 3 to 4 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
steps: Mix flour, sugar and salt. Set aside.
Bring cream, vanilla, butter, cocoa and water to a boil and pour over dry mixture. Add eggs and soda.
Mix well. Bake in a greased and floured sheet at 350° until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

recipes.title: Day Before Salad(Serves 10)
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen English peas, cooked, drained and chilled
steps: Layer lettuce and chopped vegetables, saving enough lettuce for top layer.
Layer the peas and last layer of lettuce.
Cover with mayonnaise.
Add thick layer of Parmesan cheese and refrigerate a day or two. Crumble 1/2 pound of cooked crisp bacon and spread on top.
Looks pretty in deep glass bowl.

recipes.title: Rich Yeast Rolls
steps: Combine scalded milk, shortening, sugar and salt; cool to lukewarm.
Soften yeast in lukewarm water; stir and combine with cooled milk mixture.
Add about half the flour; add the beaten eggs and beat well.
Add enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough; mix thoroughly.
Turn out on lightly floured board and knead about 10 minutes or until smooth and satiny.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Cookies
steps: In mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.
Add vanilla.
Stir in potato chips and chopped nuts.
Add flour.
Blend well.
Form into small balls with hands.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten with floured glass.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Damn Good Pie
steps: Mix sugar, flour, eggs and butter and put in saucepan.
Cook on low heat until butter melts.
Add coconut and pineapple.
Stir all together and pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until pie is golden brown.

recipes.title: Biscuit Dough(Very Light; For Obstorte, Roll, Cakes And Cheesecake.)
steps: Sift flour 4 times.
Beat egg yolks until thick and creamy, lemon colored.
Add water; continue beating until very thick. Gradually beat in sugar, then extract.
Fold in flour, a little at a time.
Beat egg whites until foamy.
Add cream of tartar and beat until they form moist, glossy peaks.
Fold in egg yolk mixture.
Bake in angel food pan in slow oven at 325° for 1 hour. Invert 15 minutes.
Use whatever size pan is needed for: obstorte, cake, cheesecake, etc.
Fill with apricot jam.
Top with cream filling.
Decorate with cake decorator.

recipes.title: Crustless Cheesecake
ingredients: 4 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, at room temperature
steps: Mix until well blended.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Soup
steps: In Dutch oven heat water and bouillon until dissolved.
Add broccoli; cover and cook until broccoli is tender.
Add milk, cheese and dash of pepper.
Cook and stir until cheese is melted. Combine 1/4 cup flour with 1/2 cup cold water.
Stir into broccoli mixture.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: German Kuchen
ingredients: 1 c. shortening (use 1/2 c. Crisco and 1/2 c. butter for flavor)
steps: Cream shortening; add sugar, beaten eggs, flour, salt and vanilla.
Spread into a 9 x 12-inch greased pan.
Reserve 1 cup batter for top.
After spreading the portion of batter in bottom of pan, spoon pie filling on batter.
Drop the rest of the batter on top of filling, not completely covering it.
When baked, fruit will ooze up through batter.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Bake at 325° if using glass dish.

recipes.title: Dried Fruit Pie
steps: Put fruit in bottom of pie shell. Beat egg yolks. Add milk. Mix cornstarch with sugar.
Add sugar mixture and butter to beaten egg
yolks, then add vanilla flavoring.
Pour over fruit. Bake at 325° until set.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 6 large chicken breasts, boiled and deboned
steps: Cook and debone chicken.
Set aside.
Cook wild rice separately; set aside.
Saute onion in butter; add soup, mushrooms, milk and flour and heat until well blended and hot. Make layers of rice, chicken, sauce and cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Harvest Fruit Bars
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. diced, dried mixed fruit
1 tsp. apple pie spice or ground cinnamon
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in medium bowl; set aside, stirring occasionally.
In large bowl beat together margarine and sugar until creamy.
Add flour, oats and 1/2 teaspoon apple pie spice; mix until crumbly.
Save 3/4 cup mixture for topping. Press rest into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Crunchy Chicken "N" Rice Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, cooked and drained
1 small can Durkee French fried onions
steps: Combine rice and cheese.
Mix well. Add chicken, peas and half of the onions. Mix lightly. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Little Smokies In Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients, except Smokies.
Cook on stove top until thick.
Add Smokies.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Pie Dough
steps: Mix the flour and salt.
Cut in the shortening with knives. Combine lightly only until the mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle water over the mixture.
Mix lightly with a fork, using only enough water so that the pastry will hold together when pressed gently into a ball.
Makes enough for a 9-inch 2-crust pie.

recipes.title: Play Dough
steps: Mix all ingredients with little hands.
Store in Ziploc bag. Add food coloring for more fun.

recipes.title: Kool-Aid Play Dough
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients together.
Add 1 cup boiling water. Stir together.
Knead mixture until it forms a soft dough.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup
steps: Cook broccoli and dried onion in salted water. Before totally cooked, add undiluted soup, butter and milk. Simmer a little while. Cut cheese into chunks and let melt in soup. Keep stirring as it tends to stick. Serves about 8.

recipes.title: Chicken Crescents
steps: Cream cheese, softened.
Add butter, chicken, mushrooms and Lawry's seasoning.
Flatten rolls with a rolling pin; put 1/8 of chicken mixture on roll.
Roll to form from narrow end.
Dip in melted butter and roll into walnuts, then in bread crumbs.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes, until done.
Thicken chicken broth and use as a side dish to pour over chicken.

recipes.title: Lemon Chess Pie
steps: Beat the eggs until they are creamy.
Mix sugar, flour and cornmeal.
Add to the eggs, a small amount at a time.
Add liquids slowly in the order they are listed.
Pour into an unbaked pie shell and bake for 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Brown Rice Casserole
steps: Brown rice in butter in skillet.
Mix beef broth bouillon soup, French onion soup and browned rice in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Excellent with smothered quail.
I usually double this recipe.

recipes.title: Vegetable Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients, except oil, until thick.
Shape into balls.
Place into hot oil to fry.
Drain and serve warm.

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Drop Cookies
steps: Melt butter and chocolate in a double boiler.
Cream egg and chocolate mixture with sugar and salt.
Beat until the mixture is light and smooth, then add vanilla.
Sift flour and baking powder. Add the flour and baking powder alternately with the milk into the creamed mixture.
Work in the nuts.
Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 375° for 8 minutes or until done.
Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Luby'S Pan-Grilled Fish(Lo-Fat)
ingredients: 6 (7 oz.) fillets (1 to 1 1/2-inch thick, fresh or frozen; if frozen be sure they are completely thawed before cooking)
steps: Combine water, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl. In a separate bowl, mix flour, paprika and seasoned salt. Preheat electric skillet to 325° of place a heavy skillet on the stove and preheat on medium-high. Dip fish fillets in liquid mixture and then place in flour mixture, covering completely. Shake off excess flour and place fillets, meat side down, in greased preheated pan. Cook 6 to 7 minutes, depending on the thickness, then turn over and cook until firm to touch (about 6 minutes more).
Garnish each with a sprig of parsley and a lemon twist.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Real Holland Pancakes(Eierpannekoeken)
ingredients: 2 large eggs or 3 medium (1/2 c. beaten)
at least 1/4 c. butter or margarine
1 loaf challah or other bread, cut in 3/4-inch slices
steps: Slice bread an hour or two before you make the French toast, if you can, so that it will dry out.
Put oven on low (unless intending to serve as soon as cooked).
Beat eggs with milk and stir in vanilla, honey, cinnamon, nutmeg, optional orange flower water and salt.
Heat butter in a large, heavy frying pan over low heat.
Dip bread slices into batter on both sides.
They should be saturated but not so soggy that they will fall apart.
Place in frying pan and continue dipping slices and adding them to pan (but don't overcrowd the pan).
Saute slowly, until the first side turns golden brown, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Then turn and saute on the other side until golden brown.
Place in oven on a baking sheet to keep warm if you aren't serving at once.
Serve with honey.

recipes.title: Jackie'S Gorditas(Jackie Clotfelter)
steps: Combine masa, flour, baking powder and salt.
Add water slowly and knead to a stiff dough.
Cover dough and let sit for 15 minutes.
Divide dough into 6 portions and roll into balls.
Roll balls out to 1/4-inch thick.
Deep fry until puffed and browned. (They will be hollow.)
Cut off the end and stuff as you would a taco.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
steps: Cream the butter, Crisco and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each one is added.
Sift dry ingredients, including cocoa.
Add alternately with milk and vanilla, ending with dry ingredients.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
(This makes a big cake.)

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix ingredients; roll 1/4-inch thick.
Cut and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake 5
to	9
minutes
at 425° (hot oven); makes about 5 dozen with 2-inch cutter.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Form a ball.
Sprinkle or roll ball in Ranch mix.
Cover with pecans or bacon bits.

recipes.title: Mom'S Crushed Banana Cake
steps: Cream margarine, sugar
and
eggs.
Add bananas, mashed through a sieve.
Add
sour milk, in which you dissolve baking soda.
Lastly, add flour,
baking
powder and salt; beat well. Add nuts, if desired.
Bake in a tube pan in moderate oven for 40 minutes.
May ice or glaze if desired.

recipes.title: Scones
ingredients: milk or egg for shine (if desired)
steps: Scone dough must be handled minimally and quickly.
As soon as the soda makes contact with liquid the rising action has begun. The object is to get the scones into the oven quickly while the dough is still wobbling so the rising is not wasted.

recipes.title: Donna'S Lasagna
ingredients: 8 oz. mild or hot Italian sausage
steps: In a Dutch oven, brown ground beef and sausage; drain excess fat.
Add pureed tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, 1 tablespoon parsley, basil, garlic and 1 teaspoon salt.
Simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Lillie Mae'S Cake
steps: Mix ingredients together adding only enough pineapple or applesauce to make cake.
Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Tangy Salsa Shrimp And Rice
ingredients: 1 jar (4 oz.) chopped green chilies, drained
steps: In bowl, mix shrimp and salsa.
Cover and chill 1 hour.
Cook rice and add chilies, scallions, salt and pepper. Mix well. Skewer salsa-coated shrimp; broil or grill.
Place on rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
steps: Oil bottom of casserole dish.
Mix all the ingredients.
Pour into casserole; top with bacon strips, very thin ones.
Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Ultimate Onion
ingredients: 1 to 2 jumbo Vidalia onions (4-inch diameter or larger)
steps: Mix the cornstarch, flour and seasonings until well blended. Add beer; mix well.
Cut about 3/4-inch off top of onion; peel onion.
Cut onion into 12 to 16 vertical wedges, but do not cut through bottom (root end).
Remove about 1 inch of "petals" from center of onion.
Dip cut onion in Seasoned Flour and remove excess by shaking; dip in batter and remove excess by gently shaking. Separate "petals" to coat thoroughly with batter.
Mix batter after standing to blend ingredients.
Gently place in fryer basket and deep fry at 375° to 400° for 1 1/2 minutes.
Turn over and fry 1 to 1 1/2 minutes longer or until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels. Place onion upright in shallow bowl and remove center core with circular cutter on apple corer.
Serve hot with Creamy Chili Sauce.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350° and grease cookie sheet.
Place shortening, sugars, egg and vanilla in mixing bowl and beat thoroughly.
Sift together salt, flour and soda and add to shortening mixture.
Mix well.
Blend in oats and drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet.
If you wish, you may also add 1/3 cup chopped nuts, raisins or shredded coconut to the batter.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until slightly brown at the edges.
Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients; shape dough into balls.
Place on a greased cookie sheet and press with a fork.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Little Debbie Cookies
steps: Cream oleo, sugar, eggs and spices.
Add rest of ingredients and roll into small balls.
Flatten on a cookie sheet.
Bake at 350°.
Fill with filling.

recipes.title: Bacon Cheese Fries
steps: Cook French fries according to package directions. Place fries on a broiler proof dish or platter. Sprinkle with cheese, onions and bacon. Broil for 1 to 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve with Ranch dressing. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Salad
steps: In large shallow baking pan, put 1 layer corn chips (not too thick, as it dries out), 1 layer rice and 1 layer hamburger mixture (hamburger, onion, tomato sauce and chili seasoning).
Sprinkle with grated cheese (Cheddar).
Put in oven to melt cheese.
On top, put 1 layer shredded lettuce and 1 layer cherry tomatoes (or cut up whole tomatoes).

recipes.title: Chicken 'N Rice
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) bag frozen broccoli, carrots, water chestnuts and red pepper combination
1 (2.8 oz.) can Durkee French fried onions
steps: Place chicken breasts in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish.
Pour salad dressing over chicken.
Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 minutes.
Place rice, vegetables and 1/2 can Durkee French fried onions around and under chicken.
Combine chicken broth and Italian seasoning and pour the mixture over chicken and vegetables.
Bake, uncovered, 25 minutes.
Top with remaining onions and bake another 2 to 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 2 lb. beef (round or sirloin), cut in 1/8 x 2-inch strips
as many onions and peppers as you like
steps: Melt butter and brown steak.
Add onions and peppers to meat and add all other ingredients except cornstarch.
Cook on low heat 10 to 15 minutes and then thicken with cornstarch.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Melrose'S Cheese Ball
steps: Mix all ingredients good.
Roll into a ball, then roll in toasted pecans or almonds.
Can double ingredients for a larger cheese ball.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Pudding
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix into boiling milk.
Cook a few minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
In small saucepan, melt chocolate with milk over low heat; stir occasionally.
Remove from heat; stir in vanilla.
In large bowl, beat butter with peanut butter and sugar until blended.
Stir in flour and oats until combined.
Measure out 1 cup and set aside. Press remaining oat mixture into pan.
Spread chocolate over. Crumble reserved 1 cup of oat mixture over top.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Mrs. Davie'S Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugars.
Add eggs and vanilla; beat well. Add sifted dry ingredients.
Add oatmeal and nuts; mix well. Shape into rolls.
Wrap in waxed paper and chill thoroughly or overnight.
Slice 1/4-inch thick; bake on ungreased sheet at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cookies
steps: Add dry ingredients together.
Mix shortening and sugar.
Add beaten egg and applesauce.
Fold together with dry ingredients. Bake 10 minutes at 375°.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Minestrone
steps: Slice sausage 1/2-inch thick; brown in Dutch oven with olive oil.
Add onion, garlic, carrots and basil; cook 5 minutes.
Add zucchini, tomatoes and beef bouillon.
Simmer 1 hour.
Add Northern beans and cabbage.
Cook 20 to 30 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Chicken With Rice
steps: Salt and pepper fryer.
Mix rice, water, oleo and soup.
Place chicken on top of rice mixture. Bake at 350° for 2 hours, without lifting cover.

recipes.title: Bob Wade Barbecue Brisket
ingredients: 1 pkg. trim brisket (8 to 10 lb., best size select meat with least amount of fat)
steps: You may want to trim some fat from brisket, but leave a good amount for juice.
Soak meat in teriyaki sauce; sprinkle with Tony Chachere's seasoning, using a good amount.
Sprinkle a lot of black pepper on meat.
I do not think you can use too much.
Cover meat and put in fridge for 24 hours.
Take out and let warm up some. Re-season and marinate.
Brown meat on your choice of wood fire.
I prefer mesquite.
Remove from wood fire and wrap in aluminum foil. Put in a pan that you don't mind getting the bottom black from wood smoke and cook in oven like a roast.
When done (not overdone), put back on pit in pan; remove aluminum foil from top of brisket and smoke by using wet mesquites.
Do not have fire other than to produce smoke.
Baste with natural juices while smoking often. Turn meat over and smoke and baste the other side.
Remove from pit when meat is smoked good.

recipes.title: Black Forest Cake
steps: Blend first 4 ingredients in bowl.
Beat until smooth.
Pour into greased and floured 12 cup Bundt pan.
Bake in preheated 350° oven 45 minutes or until cake is done.
Cool in pan 25 minutes, then invert onto cooling rack to finish cooling.
Decorate and serve with 1 can cherry pie filling and Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Play Dough(Do Not Eat)
steps: Mix all and have fun.

recipes.title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cut chicken in bite size pieces.
Combine fat, flour, salt, milk and broth; cook until thickened.
Add mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Cook broccoli; place in bottom of casserole dish.
Combine chicken and sauce.
Pour over broccoli.
Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350° until well heated and brown.
