Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Swirl Brownies
ingredients: 2 oz. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
steps: Heat margarine until melted and remove from heat.
Stir in sugar and eggs.
Beat slightly by hand just until combined; stir in flour.
Remove 3/4 c. of batter and set aside.
Stir melted chocolate into remaining batter.
Spread chocolate batter into a greased 9 x 9 x 2 baking pan; set aside.
Stir peanut butter into reserved batter.
Dollop on top of chocolate batter, then sprinkle with chocolate pieces.
Swirl batter with a knife.
Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.
Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Golden Cheese Grits
ingredients: 1 roll garlic cheese or bacon-flavored cheese
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 2-quart casserole.
Cook grits in boiling water.
When almost done, crumble cheese and butter into grits.
Blend eggs and milk together.
Then mix egg/milk mixture with grits.
Pour into greased casserole and bake at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake, uncovered, 15 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Blossoms
steps: Sift flour, soda and salt; set aside.
Cream Crisco, peanut butter, sugar and brown sugar.
Add milk, egg and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients to mixture.
Shape into balls.
Roll in sugar and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press down with fork.
Bake at 375° for 8 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Curried Tuna Salad(Serves 10 To 12)
ingredients: 1/2 c. each: finely chopped green pepper, salted sunflower seeds, green onions (include the tips)
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, thawed and drained
steps: Cook macaroni; rinse and drain.

recipes.title: Wassail
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen pineapple juice concentrate, undiluted
steps: In large saucepan or Dutch oven, combine juices, lemonade and cinnamon sticks.
Bring to boil; reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour.
Add water if desired.
Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Turkey Meat Balls
steps: Mix together ground turkey, egg, Stove Top seasoning, onion and Stove Top dressing.
Make small meat balls.
Brown slowly in butter.
Drain.
Add flour to drippings.
Stir until smooth. Remove from heat and add milk and water.
Cook and stir slowly until gravy is smooth.
Add meatballs to gravy.
Simmer 10 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Ginger Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines cake mix (devil's food)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Blend cake mix, oil and eggs.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Place by level teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Pineapple Casserole
steps: Mix together flour and sugar; set aside. Grease casserole dish. Pour drained pineapple in dish. Add sugar and flour mixture to top of pineapple. Sprinkle cheese over previous layer, then the Ritz crackers. Slice margarine in small pieces and place on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in milk.
Sift flour and salt.
Cut in shortening.
Add vanilla and yeast mixture.
Add one egg at a time and beat well after each addition.
Place dough in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
steps: Roll chicken livers in flour and saute in shortening until brown.
Arrange asparagus in baking dish.
Top with sauce made from mayonnaise, minced onion and chicken livers.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Brown lightly under the broiler.
The chicken livers and sauce may be prepared in advance, if desired.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Yellow Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. chopped frozen broccoli, cooked
steps: Simmer onion and celery in margarine.
Add mushroom soup, cheese and 1/2 cup water, heat until cheese melts.
Combine all ingredients in a greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken And Rice
steps: Prepare Rice-A-Roni according to directions, adding a handful of brown rice to make more (optional).
While rice is cooking, skin and debone chicken and cut it in small pieces.
After rice is soft and dry, spread chicken over the top of rice along with the corn (drained); cover dish with no heat for 5 minutes.
Mix and serve.
Applesauce and biscuits go well with this dish.

recipes.title: Creme Brule French Toast
steps: In a small, heavy saucepan, melt butter with brown sugar and corn syrup over moderate heat, stirring until smooth. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Cut bread in 1 inch thick slices, arrange slices in one layer in baking dish, squeezing slightly to fit.

recipes.title: Easy Cherry Chocolate Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Beat eggs in large bowl.
Stir in cake mix, cherry pie filling and oil until blended.
Spread in pan.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool.
Prepare pudding pie filling as directed on package.
Let stand for 5 minutes or until thickened.
Spread over cake. Garnish with Cool Whip and chopped nuts.
Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cheese Balls
steps: Melt butter and sharp cheese.
Add flour, cyapepper and Rice Krispies.
Roll into balls and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and beat until fluffy.
Make a paste of vinegar and cocoa and add to mixture.
Sift salt and soda with flour.
Add mixture alternately with buttermilk.
Blend well.
Add vanilla and red coloring.
Mix well.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Favorite Pound Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour tube pan.
Cream butter and sugar thoroughly.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each.
Add flour alternately with 3/4 cup sour cream.
Dissolve baking soda in 1/4 cup sour cream; add to batter and blend well.
Add extract and salt.
Stir.
Bake in pan for 1 hour and 5 minutes.
Cool 20 minutes in pan.
Remove and sift powdered sugar over warm cake.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients. Let stand in refrigerator until cold. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: No Knead Refrigerator Rolls
steps: Add yeast to warm water; let rest for 10 minutes.
Mix scalded milk, butter, sugar and salt.
Stir until dissolved.
Cool to 85°. Beat 1 egg and add to yeast mixture.
Add to milk mixture.
Beat in half of flour (sifted).
Beat 2 minutes.
Add remaining flour and mix the dough until it blisters.
Place in greased bowl; cover, place in refrigerator.
To bake, form into two loaves.
Let rise for 1 hour before baking.

recipes.title: Cherry Cake
steps: Bake at 350°.
Top with cherry pie filling.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Mix first 7 ingredients and place in greased casserole. Combine brown sugar, flour, margarine and pecans and sprinkle on top.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Toll House Pie
ingredients: 1 c. melted butter, cooled to room temperature
1 (6 oz.) pkg. semi-sweet real chocolate morsels
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
In a large bowl, beat eggs until foamy. Beat in flour, sugar and brown sugar until well blended. Blend in melted butter.
Stir in chocolate morsels and walnuts.
Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Remove from oven.
Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Cranberry Muffins
ingredients: 2 c. fresh or frozen cranberries, coarsely chopped
steps: Preheat oven to 400°. Cream together sugar and butter. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
In a bowl, sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Add with milk to the sugar and butter mixture.
Stir by hand just to moisten ingredients. Stir in cranberries.
Spoon into 18 (2 1/2-inch) muffin cups, filling 3/4 full.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 18 muffins.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: 2 lb. cheese (1 each of sharp and extra sharp)
steps: Cook noodles according to directions.
Grate cheese.
In saucepan, melt butter.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add flour, stir to mix.
Add milk, a little at a time, stirring constantly. Continue until you have added all the milk.
Add grated cheese; melt.
Pour over noodles in casserole dish.
Sprinkle with paprika. Cook on 450° until brown.
Let cool about 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: 7-Up Cake
steps: Cream sugar, oleo and Crisco.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating
after
each.
Add
sifted flour and vanilla.
Fold in 7-Up or ginger ale.
Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325° in tube pan.

recipes.title: Honey Oatmeal Drop Cookies(Makes 22 (2-Inch) Cookies)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spray 2 large cookie sheets with Pam. In large mixing bowl, combine oat bran, oatmeal, flour, baking powder and allspice.
In blender or food processor, combine oil, egg whites, vanilla, honey and brown sugar.
Blend these liquids into dry ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon of batter onto the prepared cookie sheets and bake 12 to 14 minutes.

recipes.title: Hoppin Juan Skillet Cakes
ingredients: 1/4 c. Weight Watchers fat-free mayonnaise dressing
2 Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. Weight Watchers ultimate 90 plain nonfat yogurt
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Spray baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.
In medium bowl, coarsely mash black-eyed peas. Add rice, onion, bread crumbs, mayonnaise dressing, chili powder, cumin and red pepper.
Divide mixture into 8 (1/3 cup) portions. Shape each portion into a 1/2-inch thick patty.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Cut up and fry bacon until crisp.
Drain and crumble.

recipes.title: Peach Crunch
steps: Place peaches in baking dish. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine flour, sugar, & egg until lumpy. Spread over peaches. Pour butter over mixture. Bake at 375 degrees for 30-35 minutes, or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. raisins or more if you like raisins
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs.
Add dry ingredients and raisins.
Bake at 350° to 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. rice, cooked (add to soup mix)
steps: Mix celery soup, chicken soup and milk; heat.
Add rice to soup mix.
Put
into
greased
9 x 13-inch pan and top with pork chops or
chicken
with
1	package dried onion soup mix. Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients. Bake in an iron skillet at 350° for 40 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Date Nut Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour loaf pan(s).
Measure all ingredients into a large mixer bowl; beat on medium speed 1/2 minute.
Pour into pan(s).
Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Remove from pan(s).
Cool thoroughly before slicing.

recipes.title: Quick Candy
steps: Melt almond bark.
Add dry ingredients.
Drop by the spoonful on wax paper.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
steps: Cream together shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla. Sift together flour and cream of tartar; add.
Mix together, then roll into small balls. Roll them into cinnamon and sugar mixture. Makes about 5 or 6 dozen.
Bake at 350° for 5 to 7 minutes.

recipes.title: Bonnie Butter Cake
steps: Mix all together well. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Casserole
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of chicken soup
steps: In margarine, saute bell pepper, onion, Worcestershire sauce and hot pepper sauce.
Add soup and water.
Blend shrimp and wild rice into soup mixture.
Add water chestnuts.
Put in large ovenproof casserole dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 2 to 3 medium ripe peaches, peeled and sliced thinly
steps: Mix all ingredients, except peaches.
Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Pour mix over melted butter.
Add sliced peaches; sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with or without vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Jay'S Chili
steps: In Dutch oven, saute the first 4 ingredients in hot oil or until tender.
Add meat, 1 pound at a time, until meat loses redness.
Drain.
Add water.
Add remaining ingredients, stirring after each addition.
Simmer 2 1/2 hours, stirring frequently. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Oven Porcupines
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can tomato sauce or barbecue sauce
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix meat, rice, 1/2 cup water, the onion, salts, garlic powder and pepper.
Shape mixture by rounded tablespoonfuls into balls.
Place meatballs in an ungreased baking dish (8 x 8 x 2-inch).

recipes.title: Pimento Cheese Sandwich Filling
steps: Cream the cheese with mayonnaise and add remaining ingredients; blend together.
Use whole wheat bread for a great tasting treat.

recipes.title: Peach Crunch
steps: Melt oleo in 8-inch square pan.
Stir in flour and pecans and beat in bottom of pan to form crust.
Bake at 350° until lightly brown.

recipes.title: Creamy Cheese Soup(Debbie Loves My Cheese Soup.)
ingredients: 1/2 lb. ham, diced in tiny pieces
steps: Put milk in a double boiler and cook on medium heat.
Melt oleo (this can be done in microwave) and add flour to oleo.
Mix well, then stir into hot milk.
Add cheese, ham and carrots and cook for 20 minutes.
Do not let double boiler boil dry!
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter And Banana Cookies(Diabetic)
ingredients: 1/2 c. mashed ripe banana (about 2 medium bananas)
1/4 c. thawed frozen unsweetened apple juice concentrate
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Beat butter in large bowl until creamy. Add banana and peanut butter; beat until smooth.
Blend in egg, apple juice concentrate and vanilla.
Beat in flour, baking soda and salt.
Stir in chopped peanuts.
Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough, 2 inches apart, onto lightly greased cookie sheets.
Top each with one peanut, if desired.
Bake for 8 minutes, or until set.
Cool completely on wire rack.
Store in tightly covered container.
Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Tri-Level Brownies
ingredients: 1 (1 oz.) sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
steps: For bottom layer, stir together first 4 ingredients and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Stir in 6 tablespoons melted butter.
Pat in a 11 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Peach Salad
steps: Mix and put in greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken And Rice
steps: Heat oil in large skillet on medium high heat.
Add chicken, onion and pepper.
Cook and stir until chicken is cooked through. Add corn, broth and salsa; bring to boil.
Stir in rice and cover. Remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork. Sprinkle with cheese.
Let stand 2 minutes. Serve.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
steps: Saute onion in margarine until tender. Mix all ingredients together and put in casserole dish. Cover tightly with foil.

recipes.title: Cake Donuts
steps: Cream butter, potatoes and sugar.
Add eggs, milk, nutmeg and vanilla.
Sift baking powder with flour.
Stir in mixture and add more flour to make a soft dough.
Roll 1/4-inch thick; cut and deep-fry.
Drain on paper towels.
Roll in confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
steps: Dip chicken in buttermilk.
Combine flour, cornmeal, salt and pepper in a grocery sack.
Place chicken in bag, 3 pieces at a time, and shake until well coated.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Mix first 5
ingredients together.
Mix next 3 ingredients together to make
dressing.
Pour dressing over salad and let set for at least 2 to 3 hours before serving.

recipes.title: California Breakfast
ingredients: 1 c. creamed small curd cottage cheese
1/2 lb. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded (2 c.)
1 (4 oz.) can mild green chilies, drained
steps: Beat eggs until lemon colored.
Add flour, baking powder, salt, cottage cheese, shredded Jack cheese and melted butter.
Blend smoothly and stir in chilies.
Pour mix into well-greased 9-inch square dish.
Bake in 350° preheated oven 35 minutes or until top is lightly brown and center appears firm.
Cut in squares and serve hot.
Serve with coarsely chopped and sauteed red pepper and green onions.
Accompany with bran muffins.

recipes.title: Chocolate Kiss Cookies
steps: Cream together shortening, sugar, brown sugar and peanut butter.
Mix together milk, vanilla and egg.
Sift together plain flour, salt and soda.
Mix all ingredients, gradually adding flour mixture.
Shape into balls about the size of a quarter and roll in white sugar.
Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes. Take out and press a chocolate kiss on top and bake about 1 to 2 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix and bake at 350° for 30 or 35 minutes in loaf pan.

recipes.title: Potato Wedges
steps: Scrub unpeeled potatoes well.
Cut each potato in half lengthwise.
Then cut into even wedges.
Boil potato wedges for 5 minutes in salted water.
Drain.
Pat dry.
Spread wedges in a single layer on a lightly greased baking sheet.
Sprinkle with oil, spices and herbs.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 425° to 450° for another 10 to 12 minutes, or until potatoes are golden brown and cheeses are melted.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread Loaf
steps: Combine all dry ingredients, mixing with a fork.
Beat eggs, oil and berries until well blended, then add flour/ sugar mixture and mix well.
Bake in a greased and floured loaf pan at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Pepparkakor (Swedish Ginger Cookies)
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Beat in molasses, egg and vinegar. Stir flour with spices and salt, then blend with batter.
Chill 3 hours.
Roll out to 1/8-inch and cut with cookie cutters.
Bake at 375° for 5 to 6 minutes.
Frost or leave plain.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: No-Crust Coconut Pie
steps: Combine all ingredients, except coconut; mix well.
Stir in coconut.
Pour into a 9-inch pie plate.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple
steps: In casserole dish, layer pineapple and cream cheese.
In double boiler, mix flour, sugar, egg and juice.
Cook until thick. Pour over pineapple and cream cheese.
Top with marshmallows. Cook in 350° oven for 15 minutes or until it bubbles good.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1 (7 oz.) pkg. spaghetti, cooked and drained
2 c. cubed, cooked chicken or turkey
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Melt butter in large saucepan over low heat.
Blend in flour and seasonings.
Cook over low heat, stirring until mixture is smooth and bubbly.
Remove from heat. Stir in broth and cream.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute.
Stir in wine, spaghetti, chicken and mushrooms.

recipes.title: Crispy Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Form into 1-inch balls on greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pea And Peanut Salad
ingredients: 10 oz. frozen peas, cooked 3 minutes and drained
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Cool and chill.
At serving time, add:

recipes.title: Pumpkin Roll
steps: Use jelly roll pan.
Grease and flour pan.
Whip eggs until thick and foamy.
Add sugar gradually to eggs.
Fold in pumpkin and lemon juice. Sift together all dry ingredients and fold into egg mixture, beating just until batter is smooth (can use electric mixer, low speed).
Pour into pan.
Bake 15 minutes at 375° or until cake springs back when touched lightly.
Immediately loosen cake from edges of pan; invert on towel sprinkled with confectioners sugar.
While hot, roll cake and towel from narrow end.
Cool completely on wire rack.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
ingredients: 1/4 lb. Mozzarella cheese, cut into strips
steps: Coat chicken with flour, salt and pepper; brown well in shortening.
Place chicken in baking dish.
Blend any remaining flour mixture with tomatoes; add Heinz 57 sauce, Parmesan cheese, sugar and oregano.
Pour over chicken.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.
Remove cover; top with cheeses.
Bake, uncovered, 25 minutes longer or until chicken is tender.
Skim excess fat from sauce.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
steps: Preheat oven at 400°.

recipes.title: Lo-Fat Muffins
ingredients: 4 c. grated carrots (spooned, not packed, into cups)
2 c. sugar or 3 or 4 pkg. artificial sweetener or part of each
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Coat 18 (2 3/4-inch) muffin tin cups with vegetable cooking spray; set aside.

recipes.title: Bavarian Goulash
ingredients: 1/2 cup Burgundy or other red wine
steps: Heat oil. Add beef and onion, saute until meat is browned. Add tomatoes. Season to taste with salt, pepper, and paprika. Add bay leaf. Pour in stock, cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until beef is tender.

recipes.title: Blackberry Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Beat in 1 egg at a time until 3 have been used.
Then add some flour.
Add 2 more eggs and rest of flour.
Then add buttermilk and blackberries. Bake in loaf pan at 300° to 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Choco-Caramel Squares
steps: Combine cake mix, oleo, evaporated milk and chopped nuts. Press 1/2 of the mixture into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 6 minutes.
Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips on top.
Pour melted Caramel Sauce over top. Crumble remaining cake mixture over and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Impossible Pie
steps: Mix all the ingredients together.
Pour into a greased 9-inch pie pan and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Dill Fish(Makes 4 Servings.)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Shake flour in oven bag; place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Add water, lemon juice, garlic and dill to bag.
Squeeze bag to blend ingredients.
Add fish fillets to bag. Turn bag to coat fish with sauce.
Arrange fish in an even layer; dot with margarine.
Close bag with nylon tie; cut 6 half-inch slits in top.
Bake until fish is tender, 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Turtle Cookies
steps: Mix and refrigerate until chilled; roll in balls.
Put 4 pecan halves to make legs.
Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice in water with oleo until water is evaporated. Cook broccoli
with
onion, celery and green pepper until half done. Do
not overcook; drain, reserving juice.
Mix together broccoli and
rice,
add mushroom soup and 1 can of juice from cooked broccoli.
Put
in
greased
Pyrex casserole, top with Velveeta cheese
and bake in 350° oven until hot and cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Linda'S Chicken Fingers
ingredients: 4 to 6 chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch strips
1 pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing mix
steps: Mix egg, milk and poultry seasoning in bowl and set aside. Mix flour, dressing mix, salt, pepper and Accent in large bowl with fitted cover (or gallon Ziploc bag).
Heat 2 cups oil on stove in large frying pan.
Dip chicken strips in egg mixture and then in flour mixture and fry until golden brown, turning once.

recipes.title: Western Casserole
steps: Brown beef, onion and bell pepper; drain.
Cook tomatoes, rice and Italian seasoning; let it go to boiling.
Turn down heat; cover and let it simmer until rice is tender.
Mix with beef. Pour into baking pan or dish.
Top with shredded Cheddar cheese and melt in a 350° oven.
Great.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cookies
steps: Cream together margarine and sugar.
Beat in egg, vanilla and pumpkin.
Mix well; add to margarine and sugar mixture.
Mix dry ingredients and add all together.
Drop by teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Frost when cool if desired.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple and juice
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries, partially thawed
steps: Mix gelatin and pineapple in saucepan.
Bring almost to boil; let cool. Add buttermilk, whipped topping, strawberries and nuts. Spread in 9 x 13 pan. Let congeal in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Bread
steps: In small mixing bowl, sprinkle yeast and 1 tablespoon honey into warm water.
Let stand 5 to 10 minutes or until mixture becomes bubbly.
In small saucepan, combine remaining honey with milk, butter and salt.
Cook over low heat until butter melts. Remove from heat.
Cool to lukewarm.
Stir in yeast mixture. Combine wheat germ and whole wheat flour in a large mixing bowl. Add liquid mixture.
Stir until smooth.
Add enough flour to make a soft dough.
Turn out onto a lightly floured surface.
Knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes.
Place dough in a large lightly greased bowl.
Turn dough over to bring greased side up. Cover with greased waxed paper and a towel.
Let rise in warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 (3 to 4 oz.) pkg. cooked yellow rice
1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
steps: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Soften yeast in water. Heat milk and shortening together until melted
(don't
boil).
Measure
sugar
and salt into large bowl. Add
hot
milk
mixture.
Stir until dissolved and cool until lukewarm.
Add
cups
of
flour to milk mixture. Mix for 1 minute
with
electric
mixer
or by hand.	Stir in softened yeast and eggs.
Beat well and add more flour to make thick batter. Beat
thoroughly until smooth and elastic about 2 minutes. Cover and
let
rise
in	warm place until bubbly, about	1 hour.
Stir down.
Place
on
floured
board.
Knead lightly and roll out
to not quite an inch thick and punch out with cookie cutter.
Dip each
piece in 1 stick melted butter and drop in
Bundt
pan. Repeat
process layering in tiers in pan.
Pour remaining
butter on top.
Cover again and let rise 30 minutes. Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Great Aunt Elsie'S Cream Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cream together sugar, oleo and eggs. Add sour cream and vanilla.
Stir well.
Gradually add the remaining dry ingredients.
On a well floured surface, roll out the cookie dough.
Cut with cookie cutters in desired shapes. Bake for approximately 12 minutes or just until lightly brown on bottom.
Cool and then frost and decorate.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Apple Pie
steps: Mix flour and sugar. Add vanilla, sour cream and egg. Beat until smooth. Stir in apples and salt. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 325°. Bake about 30 minutes longer. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with topping crumbs. Return to oven and bake 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Fruit Tarts
steps: Thicken cranberries with cornstarch.
Combine flour, shortening and milk.
Roll out on floured surface.
Cut with 4-inch cutter. Spoon 1 teaspoon of cranberries on each one.
Go around each with milk to seal edges.
Cover and seal with a fork to crimp.
Lightly grease sheet to bake.
Bake at 375° 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Magic Coconut Pie
steps: Put the ingredients in a blender; blend about 1 minute.
Pour into well-greased and floured pie plate.
Bake in a 350° oven for about 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Glass pie plate works well.

recipes.title: Mushroom Ring Italienne
ingredients: 3 (1/8-inch thick) slices chopped fine hot dry Cappicola
steps: Chop mushrooms and onion very fine.
Saute onion and mushrooms in 2 tablespoons butter 5 minutes.
Melt remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and mix in flour.
Gradually pour in milk.
Stir constantly.
Combine with mushrooms.
Cool.
Add egg yolks.
Mix well.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Fold into mushroom mixture with parsley and Cappicola.
Add seasonings.
Pour into greased and floured ring mold.
Place in pan of boiling water.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Bran Muffins
steps: Pour boiling water over 2 cups all-bran, let cool.
Cream margarine, sugar, add eggs.
Sift soda in flour.
Add to cream mixture, buttermilk, also add the all-bran mixture and the remaining 4 cups all-bran.
Stir until well blended; do not beat. Must refrigerate before using, fill well-greased muffin tins and bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Make only what you need as this batter will keep 4 to 6 weeks.

recipes.title: Texas Sheet Cake
steps: Bring oleo, water and cocoa to a boil.
Mix sugar, flour and salt.
Add chocolate mixture to this.
Add eggs, sour cream and soda.
Pour into a greased cookie sheet.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease baking sheet.
Mix butter or margarine and sugar until creamy.
Beat in eggs and flavoring. Mix flour, cornmeal, baking powder, nutmeg and salt thoroughly. Add to creamy mixture.
Stir in raisins.
Mix well.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. dry mustard, mixed with a little water
steps: Cook macaroni in boiling, salted water until tender.
Melt butter in saucepan; stir in flour.
Add milk and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Add macaroni, salt, pepper, onion and mustard. Pour in greased dish.
Sprinkle cheese on top. Dot with butter and cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until brown on top.

recipes.title: Fresh Vegetable Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients in large bowl except sunflower seeds. Toss with dressing and store covered in refrigerator.
Toss in sunflower seeds before serving.

recipes.title: Good Layer Cake
steps: Cream sugar and butter with Crisco and eggs, one at a time. Alternate flour and buttermilk; add vanilla.
Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Easy Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast in a bowl.
Add oil, salt and sugar.
Mix and add 2 cups flour.
Stir well.
Add 3rd cup of flour.
Leave in bowl, cover and let rise until doubled.
Pour out on floured board.
Knead about 10 strokes.
Put in greased pans; let rise again.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Walnut Sensations
ingredients: 1 c. walnuts, chopped (and large pieces for top)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine flour, soda and salt; set aside.
In mixing bowl, beat brown sugar, butter and vanilla until creamy.
Beat in egg.
Gradually add flour.
Stir in 1 1/3 cups chocolate chips (save 2/3 cups chocolate chips for top).
Spread into 9-inch square pan.
Bake 23 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Gingered Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/2 lb. chicken tenders (or breast), sliced diagonally in 1/4-inch slices
steps: Cut chicken.
Drain oranges, reserving 1/4 cup syrup.
Cook ginger in hot oil 30 seconds.
Add chicken and stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Add snow peas, reserved syrup and stir-fry sauce.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat, cover and cook 2 minutes.
Top with orange sections.
Serve over rice.
Makes 2 servings, about 300 calories.

recipes.title: Virginia Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 large can baked beans (30 to 40 oz.)
steps: Fry bacon until crisp.
Chop onion and garlic.
Fry in 2 tablespoons of bacon fat until soft.
Add vinegar, sugar and mustard.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Mix the drained kidney beans and butter beans in a large baking dish with the baked beans.
Crumble bacon and add, then mix in the onion and sugar mix.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lemon Squares
steps: Beat eggs with the salt, sugar and baking powder until very light and fluffy.
Add the lemon juice and rind.
Remove crust from oven.
Pour lemon
mix over it.
Return to oven and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Puffy Fried Bread
steps: Sift flour, measure, and sift again with salt, baking powder, and sugar. Cut in shortening, and add milk to make a soft dough just firm enough to roll. Cover bowl and let dough stand for 30 to 60 min. Roll 1\4 inch thick on lightly floured surface. Cut into diamond shaped pieces.

Heat about 1 inch of oil in frying pan 370° to 380°. Add a few pieces at a time; turn at once, so they will puff evenly. Then turn back to brown on both sides. Drain on paper toweling. Serve with butter or honey. Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Belvie'S Favorite Cake
steps: Combine eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla.
Mix in dry ingredients, beating well.
Then add pineapple, pecans and bananas.
Bake at 350° about 30 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Hershey'S Syrup Cake
steps: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with syrup.
Bake 30 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Cornbread Dressing
steps: Combine cornmeal, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add 2 eggs, buttermilk and bacon drippings. Mix well.
Place a well-greased 10-inch cast-iron skillet in oven at 450° for 4 to 5 minutes or until hot.
Pour batter into skillet. Bake at 450° for 35 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool and crumble cornbread into large bowl.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
steps: In heavy 4-quart kettle, melt 1 tablespoon oleo over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic.
Saute, stirring until onion is transparent and set aside.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake
ingredients: 1/2 lb. each: red and green cherries
steps: Place fruit and nuts in large mixing bowl.
Sprinkle sugar over them.
Mix well.
Beat eggs, melted butter and flour together with flavoring.
Pour over fruit and nuts.
Mix well.
Pour in tube pan. Bake for 2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Separate eggs.
Beat egg whites and set aside.
Beat egg yolks.
Add sugar and Crisco, then add milk, flour, baking powder, vanilla and lemon extract.
Add beaten egg whites.
Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 1 hour; last 15 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Rice Artichoke
ingredients: 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, chopped and drained
1/2 tsp. dry mustard or curry powder
steps: Cook the Rice-A-Roni as directed in large skillet.
Add the green pepper, onions, celery and artichoke hearts to the skillet with the Rice-A-Roni.
Mix the mayonnaise, lemon juice and dry mustard or curry powder.
Mix this into the skillet and serve.

recipes.title: Best Ever Brownies
steps: Mix cake mix, 1/3 cup evaporated milk and melted margarine. Add nuts.
Press 1/2 of mixture into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Melt caramels and blend 1/3 cup evaporated milk into caramels.
Pour over cake mix. Sprinkle chocolate chips over caramel.
Crumble rest of cake mix on top.
Bake another 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Hasty Hobo Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. can white or red beans
1 lb. frozen vegetable mix (broccoli, green beans, red peppers, corn, etc.)
steps: Saute cabbage and onions in butter until slightly soft.
Add drained beans, frozen vegetables, ham and rice.
Cook over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring to coat with butter.

recipes.title: Beefy Baked Beans
steps: Cook ground beef until brown, stirring to crumble meat.
Drain well.
Combine beef and next 6 ingredients; stir well.
Spoon mixture into lightly greased baking dish.
Arrange bacon on top of beans.
Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Stir-Fry With Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 green onions, bias-sliced into 1-inch lengths (1 c.)
steps: Partially freeze beef; cut on the bias into thin bite-size strips.
For marinade, in a medium mixing bowl, stir together water, soy sauce, wine, cornstarch and molasses.
Add beef, stirring to coat well.
Cover and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes or in the refrigerator for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Drain well, reserving marinade.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Blueberry Buckle
steps: Mix thoroughly the sugar, butter and eggs.
Stir in milk. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Add to the batter, stirring well.
Toss the fresh blueberries in a little flour, then add them to the batter.
Pour into greased and floured pan.

recipes.title: Baked Chop Suey
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of celery soup
steps: Brown ground beef and onions; add salt and pepper.
Add other ingredients and mix all together.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
steps: Have all ingredients at room temperature.
Adjust oven racks to divide oven in thirds.
Preheat oven to 325°.
Spray a 5-cup loaf pan, Bundt or tube pan with nonstick cooking spray.

recipes.title: Fried Rice And Cabbage
steps: Fry rice, onions and pepper in small amount of shortening until it is brown, then add cabbage; cover it with water and add beef and salt to taste.
Add tomato paste.
Let simmer for about 30 to 35 minutes, then serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Parisenne
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Place, uncooked, skinned thighs in 13 x 9-inch Pyrex baking dish.
Mix red wine vinegar, water, brown sugar and soup with wire whisk.
Pour over chicken.
Top with mushrooms.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
One half hour before serving,
mix in sour cream with a spoon.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: King'S Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream together the butter, sugars and eggs.
Add all other ingredients.
Bake for 9 minutes at 375°.
Take out before they look done.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
steps: Divide the cauliflower into sprigs.
Soak in salt water for a while and rinse well.
Boil up in slightly salted water.
Make a white sauce with the butter, flour and milk, adding enough cauliflower water to make a soft, smooth dough.
Allow to cool slightly and beat in the egg yolks one by one.
Finally, fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites to which the corn flour has been added.
Season to taste and line the bottom of a ovenproof dish with the gratin mixture.
Add the cauliflower and pour over the remainder of the gratin mixture.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour testing with a knitting needle.
Serve with cold or melted butter.

recipes.title: Potato Leek Soup
steps: In chicken stock, cook 2 cups potatoes, 2 whole carrots, celery, leek or onion and bay leaf.
When cooked, remove bay leaf and carrots.
In blender, puree the potatoes, celery and leeks with chicken stock. Return to pan.

recipes.title: Best-Ever Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients and beat for 1 minute by hand.
Bake in greased, but not floured, 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan at 300° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Let cool.
Chop 1 large jar maraschino cherries (drained) and put on top of cake.

recipes.title: Raisin Bran Muffins
steps: Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Store unused batter in airtight container.
Do not stir when ready to spoon into muffin cups to bake.
Can sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar or nuts before baking.

recipes.title: Spicy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. quick cooking oats (not instant or old fashioned)
1/2 c. nuts may be added if desired
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease baking sheets.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
steps: Drain pineapple reserving 6 Tbsp juice. Mix pineapple, cheese, flour, sugar and juice. Stir well. Pour into dish. Sprinkle on topping.

recipes.title: Mama'S Lap Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream sugar, margarine and shortening together.
Add eggs and cream.
Sift flour and soda together.
Add alternately with milk. Form into small balls the size of walnuts; flatten with fork. Bake for 10 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Party Chicken
steps: Grease one large 8 x 12-inch casserole dish.
Line with chipped beef.
Wrap each chicken breast with a strip of bacon. Place on beef in casserole.
Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken.
Bake at 300° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Fifty Dollar Cake
steps: Cream the butter and sugar.
Add egg yolks and melted chocolate.
Sift in flour and baking powder.
Add milk and fold in egg whites. Add nuts and vanilla.
Bake in a 350° oven. When done, cool and cover with Fifty Dollar Cake Icing.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
steps: Saute onion in butter.
Mix hash browns and milk. Add to onion. Add remaining ingredients and cook slowly until potatoes are tender and cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Weight Watchers Quick Dinner Rolls
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Spoon into muffin pan sprayed with Pam.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 muffins.
A 1 ounce serving equals 1 Bread.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Meatball Soup
ingredients: 1 2/3 c. beef stock or canned broth
steps: Chop onion.
Cut zucchini into 1-inch pieces.
Combine beef, chili powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
In a Dutch oven, heat oil over medium heat. Add meatballs; brown well.
Remove meatballs and reduce heat.
Add onion and zucchini.
Cover and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in cumin, oregano, tomatoes with their juice, stock, hot pepper sauce, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Add meatballs; heat through.
Sprinkle with fresh coriander.

recipes.title: Vegetable Bean Chili
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained
1 (2 1/4 oz.) can sliced ripe olives, drained
steps: In a 4-quart kettle or Dutch oven, saute zucchini, green pepper, onion, carrots, celery and garlic in oil until tender. Stir in tomatoes, picante sauce, bouillon and cumin; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add beans and olives; heat through. Garnish with cheese and alfalfa sprouts, if desired. Yield: 9 servings (2 1/4 quarts).

recipes.title: Quick Casserole
steps: Slice potatoes thin in a long baking dish.
Add sliced onions and then sprinkle rice over this.
Crumble beef over top of potatoes.
Pour tomato soup over all in pan.
Bake at 350° about one hour.

recipes.title: Porcupine Meatballs
steps: Wash rice.
Combine meat, rice, salt, pepper and onion.
Shape into small balls.
Heat tomato soup and water in crock-pot.
Brown meatballs.
Add all to soup mixture; simmer for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
steps: Mix flour and sugar well.
Add egg yolks and milk.
Cook over medium heat until thick, stirring frequently.
When thick, add vanilla and coconut.
Pour into cooked pie crust.
Add meringue and brown.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Squares
steps: Step 1:
Toss apples, sugar and spices together.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
steps: Cream shortening and sugar, adding eggs one at a time. Beat in sifted flour, and pineapple syrup. Mix well. In a 9x13 pan melt butter, pour in brown sugar. Then pour in cake batter. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done. You could place a cherry in the middle of the pineapple rings before baking.

recipes.title: Italian Cheese Pie
steps: Note:
Can top with any topping or sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

recipes.title: Donna Connor'S Pumpkin Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 2 loaf pans.

recipes.title: Crisp Coconut Oaties
steps: Cream together butter, sugars, egg, vanilla and coconut extract.
Combine all other ingredients and add to creamed mixture.
Roll dough into balls.
Place on greased cookie sheet, about 2 inches apart.
Bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Biscuits
steps: Combine dry ingredients; mix well. Add margarine and milk. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until desired thickness. Stir in vanilla. Serve over hot biscuits.

recipes.title: Snickers Bar Cookies
steps: Cream together sugar, brown sugar and peanut butter.
Add vanilla and eggs.
Mix. Add baking powder, baking soda and flour. Mix well.
Cut miniature Snickers in halves.
Wrap around each bar half, forming a ball.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 18 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 400°: spray 8 inch square, 7x11, or 12 cup muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray.
In a large bowl, combine the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and the salt.
In a small bowl, beat the buttermilk over the flour mixture; stir just until blended (do not overmix).
Transfer to the pan.
Bake until golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, 20-25 minutes.
Cool pan on a rack 10 minutes; serve warm. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Turkey Casserole
steps: Blend flour and butter in a large pan.
Add cream, soup, salt and water.
Cook over low heat, stirring to thicken.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Grease a 2-quart casserole.
Top with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Spray cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray.
Mix all ingredients.
If necessary press dough together. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonful 2 inches apart onto cookie sheet.
Bake until tops are dry and edges are light brown, 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool slightly; remove from cookie sheet.
Cool completely.
Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple
steps: Drain pineapple, save juice.
Put pineapple in baking dish. Combine flour, juice, sugar and cheese.
Pour over pineapple. Combine cracker crumbs and margarine.
Sprinkle over top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Louisiana Jambalaya
ingredients: 4 large pork chops or 6 chicken thighs (can substitute wings, breasts or other)
steps: Season meat generously.
In a 4 to 5 quart heavy pot, heat oil.
Brown meat on all sides and remove.
Meat can be cut from bone or cut into smaller servings if desired.

recipes.title: Microwave Diabetic Apple Cake
steps: Melt margarine in an 8-inch round microwave dish (glass preferable).
Set
aside.
Mix
oil,
Equal and eggs together. In another bowl,
mix	remainder of the ingredients and add to egg mixture.
Pour
into
dish	and stir or fold in the margarine. Microwave on
High	10
to	12 minutes, turning every 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice by directions on package.
Put in buttered casserole dish.
Add other ingredients.
Mix well.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Corn And Crab Bisque
steps: In a 2 gallon stockpot, melt butter over medium-high heat.
Add corn, onions, celery, bell pepper and garlic.
Saute five to ten minutes or until vegetables are wilted.

recipes.title: Mississippi Mud Cake
steps: Beat eggs with sugar; add remaining ingredients (except marshmallows) to eggs.
Mix well and pour into greased and floured sheet cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
While hot, cover with marshmallows.
I return cake to oven until marshmallows lose their shape.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Traditional Chex Party Mix
ingredients: 1 c. salted mixed nuts and/or pretzel sticks
steps: Preheat oven to 250°.
Heat margarine in large shallow roasting pan (about 15 x 10 x 2-inch) in oven until melted. Remove.
Stir in seasoned salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Add Chex cereal and nuts.
Mix until all pieces are coated.
Heat in oven for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.
Spread on absorbent paper to cool.

recipes.title: Holiday Cookies(Sugar Cookies)
steps: Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl with hands until smooth. Roll dough, one part at a time, 1/4-inch thick.
Cut into desired shapes and place on cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Let cool; decorate.
Yields 3 to 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Olivia
ingredients: 3 c. cooked chicken, cut in large pieces
steps: Mix all except oleo, corn flakes and almonds in large casserole dish.
In frying pan, frizzle corn flakes and almonds in melted oleo for a few minutes.
Spread over casserole.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: Cream butter and shortening. Add dry ingredients. Add crushed bananas and nuts last. Bake in oiled loaf pan in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Corn Pie
steps: Whip eggs thoroughly in bowl.
Add sugar, flour, milk, margarine, salt and pepper.
Stir in corn.
Pour into buttered casserole.
Set dish in pan of water about 2 inches deep.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until knife blade comes out clean when tested.
You also may use fresh or frozen corn.

recipes.title: Granny'S Chocolate Dessert
steps: Layer #1:
Mix flour, nuts and butter and make crust.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Beat eggs, sugar and oil together.
Add shredded zucchini. Add flour, soda, baking powder, cinnamon and nuts.
Pour all into greased loaf pans.
Bake 1 hour at 375°.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Cook chicken in boiling, salted water to cover in saucepan until tender; drain.
Cool and cut into bite size pieces.
Place chicken in 9 x 12-inch baking dish.
Pour mixture of soup and broth over chicken.
Combine baking mix and milk in a bowl; mix well.
Pour over chicken.
Bake for 35 minutes.
Drizzle melted butter over top.
Bake for 10 minutes longer.
This easy recipe can be prepared ahead and can be frozen.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients in order given.
Pour batter into greased 9 x 5-inch bread pan.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
Test for doneness with toothpick.
Cool on rack.
Chill for easier slicing.

recipes.title: Mary'S Goulash
ingredients: 2 lb. boneless beef chuck or round steak
salt and pepper to taste (about 1 tsp. salt and 1 tsp. pepper)
steps: Cut beef into bite size cubes.

Use a large iron frypan and melt oleo, then add meat, onions, paprika, salt and pepper. Brown until dark brown, stirring often. When meat is brown on all sides of cubes, add water and simmer about 35 minutes, covered with lid. Dissolve cornstarch in milk and add to mixture.
Let simmer 10 minutes longer.
Serve over rice, noodles or hot biscuits.

recipes.title: Chicken Liver Stroganoff
steps: Cook onions in butter until tender, not brown.
Add chicken livers.
Season with salt and pepper also paprika.
Brown livers. Cover; cook over low heat for 10 minutes.
Add sour cream; heat thoroughly.
Serve over rice.
Serve with Sue Tossed Salad in 1988 book, page 19.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Crepes
steps: Beat eggs lightly in medium bowl.
Add remaining ingredients and beat until smooth.
Lightly grease crepe pan or 7 or 8-inch skillet and place over medium-high heat.
Pour about 3 tablespoons of batter into pan.
Tilt pan to spread batter evenly. When crepe is light brown and set, turn to brown other side. Remove and repeat to make 12 crepes.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
ingredients: 6 to 7 c. cooking apples, pared and sliced
steps: Make pastry for 2-crust pie; line pie plate with pastry.
Fill with sliced apples. Mix sugar, flour and cinnamon; sprinkle over apples.
Dot with shortening.
Top with pastry.
Seal edges and flute.
Cover edge with aluminum foil, if desired.
Bake at 425° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. chopped nuts (peanuts, walnuts or pecans)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In small bowl, sift together flour, baking soda and salt.
In large bowl, combine butter, sugars and vanilla extract.
With wooden spoon, beat until creamy.
Beat in eggs.
Gradually add sifted dry ingredients.
Mix well.
Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake in 375° oven for 8 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Sausage-Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice as directed on package.
Rinse and drain.
Brown sausage; add onion, pepper and celery.
Cook vegetables until tender.
Add rice, mushrooms and soups.
Pour in greased 3-quart casserole dish.
Cover and bake for 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Blueberry-Orange Bread
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. grated orange rind
steps: Toss blueberries with 1 tablespoon flour and set aside. Combine remaining flour, 1/4 cup sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Stir well and set aside.
Combine egg, water, orange juice, margarine and 1 tablespoon orange rind.
Add to dry ingredients, stirring well.
Gently fold in berries.

recipes.title: German Split Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 pkg. dried split peas, washed and drained
1 pkg. Lipton golden onion soup mix
steps: Dice salt bacon and saute with onion.
Pour all ingredients into a Dutch oven and cook for 6 hours.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Applesauce Bread
steps: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy; beat in egg. Stir together flour, baking soda and spices.
Gradually add to creamed mixture.
Stir in applesauce, raisins and nuts.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Cool in pan for 10 minutes; remove and cool on wire rack. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Golden Cornbread
steps: Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Makes a 9-inch square pan. Delicious with spaghetti or chili.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pudding
steps: Put sugar and water in 2-quart pan.
Cream shortening and sugar.
Beat in egg.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Add alternately with milk.
Add vanilla.
Pour pudding batter into hot syrup, being careful not to mix with syrup.
Cook, tightly covered, for 1 hour on medium heat.
Do not take cover of kettle off while cooking pudding, or pudding will not cook right.

recipes.title: Seven-Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
3 to 4 stalks celery, sliced or chopped
1 to 2 c. mayonnaise (spread to cover and seal the first four layers)
steps: In a large bowl, layer the following:
lettuce, peas, celery, onion and mayonnaise.
Cover mayonnaise with Parmesan cheese.
Top with bacon.
Cover and refrigerate approximately 8 hours prior to serving.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients; beat well.
Bake in a buttered loaf pan at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Cool and slice.

recipes.title: Cheesecake
steps: Let cream cheese and eggs sit out and get room temperature. Mix cream cheese, eggs, sugar, flour, vanilla and heavy cream for 15 minutes.
Mix graham crackers, sugar and oleo.
Place graham cracker mixture in 10-inch spring-form pan.
Pour cream cheese mixture over graham cracker crust.
Bake at 500° for 12 minutes. Reduce to 250° for 45 minutes.
Turn oven off (do not open oven) and leave in oven 6 hours.
Cool.
Remove from pan.

recipes.title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour 2 (9-inch) baking pans in large bowl. Stir together sugar, flour, cocoa, baking powder, soda and salt. Add eggs, milk, oil and vanilla; beat on medium speed of electric mixer 2 minutes. Stir in boiling. (Batter will be thin.) Pour into prepared pans. Bake 30 to 35 minutes; cool 10 minutes. Frost with One Bowl Buttercream Frosting.

recipes.title: Scallops With Tomatoes(Microwave)
steps: Pat scallops on paper toweling.

Place in a microproof 1-quart casserole with onion, wine, tomato paste, tomatoes and cilantro. Toss together until well mixed. Cover with lid or vented plastic wrap and microwave on High 3 1/2 to 4 minutes or until scallops are opaque, stirring once.
Sprinkle with pepper and Feta cheese. Toss together.
Spoon over rice in deep bowls. Serves 2.

recipes.title: Salt Rising Bread
steps: Peel and slice potatoes. Add remaining ingredients. Let stand overnight in a warm place. In the morning, when it has foam on top, remove the potatoes and discard. Add 1/4 teaspoon of soda and thicken with flour. Let rise. Add 1/2
gallon (8 cups) flour to make a sponge.
Add risen mixture and let rise again. Make out into 4 loaves. Grease pans well. Bake in moderate 350° oven for 45 minutes or more.

recipes.title: Vegetable Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 (14 1/2 oz.) Mexican style tomatoes, cut up
steps: Simmer in covered saucepan the water, lentils and salt for 15 to 20 minutes.
Drain, rinse and set aside.
Stir-fry carrots and chili powder in hot oil for 2 minutes.
Add zucchini; stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Stir in lentils, half the undrained tomatoes and half of the cheese.
Spoon vegetable mixture onto tortillas.
Place, seam side down, in prepared baking dish.
Cover with foil.
Bake in 350° oven for 8 minutes.
Remove foil.
Bake for 7 to 12 minutes.
Heat remaining tomatoes.
Spoon over enchiladas.
Top with cheese.
Bake 1 minute.

recipes.title: Granny'S Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 c. sliced fresh mushrooms (can substitute canned)
steps: Saute mushrooms and onions in 3 tablespoons butter until brown.
Remove mushrooms, etc.
Add 1 tablespoon of butter to pan. Brown meat. Dissolve bouillon cubes in water; pour over meat. Add tomato paste, mustard and salt. Cover and simmer 45 minutes until tender. Combine flour and water.
Slowly stir into meat mixture. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce heat. Add mushrooms, onions and sour cream.
Heat, but don't boil. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
steps: Heat a large pot.
Cook carrots, onion, celery and garlic in 1 cup stock until tender.
Add remaining ingredients, except beans, macaroni, Tabasco and cheese.
Cook until vegetables are tender. In blender or processor, process 1/2 cup garbanzo beans and 1/2 cup kidney beans until pureed.
Set aside.
Add remaining ingredients; simmer 10 minutes.
Serve hot.
Add cooked macaroni and sprinkle cheese on top.

recipes.title: Easy No Crust Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a blender or electric mixer and pour in a 10-inch, buttered Pyrex pie pan.
Bake for 1 hour at 325°.
This will bake to a delicious crust and a toasted coconut top.

recipes.title: Quick Cobbler
steps: Melt margarine in large cake pan.
Mix sugar, flour and milk together.
Pour over melted margarine.
Heat fruit, such as apples, peaches or strawberries; pour over batter and bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Stuffed Jumbo Shells And Tofu
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. each chopped parsley, Parmesan cheese, wheat germ and diced onion
1/2 tsp. each celery seed and basil
steps: Cook, drain and rinse shells.
Combine remaining ingredients except spaghetti sauce and the extra Parmesan cheese.
Spread 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce in bottom of shallow baking dish.
Fill shells with tofu mix and place in single layer in baking dish.
Top with remaining sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Makes 6 servings. Calories 277.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
steps: Cream shortening; add sugar gradually.
Add eggs one at a time, beating each time.
Add vanilla.
Add soda to buttermilk. Add flour and milk alternately to other ingredients.
Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
This cake can be frozen.
It is good plain and/or frosted.

recipes.title: Baked Seafood Rice Salad
steps: Combine first 9 ingredients.
Put in shallow 2 quart casserole and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pineapple Chess Pie
steps: Mix all together and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Cutout Cookies
steps: Combine shortening and butter.
Add sugar, then beat in egg. Add salt, almond and vanilla extract.
Last, add flour 1 cup at a time.
Place cookies on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 9 minutes or until edges brown.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients: 1 lb. Prosciutto (Italian ham or lean bacon)
salt and white pepper to taste
steps: Finely chop Prosciutto and cook in 4 Tbsp. butter.
Cook until crisp (can do ahead and reheat).

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
steps: Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a 9-inch layer pan. Spread butter evenly. Sprinkle brown sugar over butter. Arrange fruits and nuts in sugar mixture.
Mix 1/3 cup butter with granulated sugar until creamy. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well.
Mix flour, baking powder and salt thoroughly. Add to creamy mixture alternately with pineapple liquid. Spread batter over fruit in pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until cake springs back with touched lightly. Cool a few minutes in the pan.
Loosen cake from sides of pan and invert on serving plate.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad(Kartoffelsalat)
ingredients: 12 slices bacon, diced and fried until crisp (reserve 6 Tbsp. drippings)
2 to 3 lb. potatoes, cooked, peeled and cut in 1/4-inch slices*
steps: *The amount of potatoes used for this tangy hot potato salad will determine the number of servings.

recipes.title: Peach Crumble Pie
steps: Line pie shell with plain pastry.
Trim; let rest 10 minutes, then flute edge.
Do not prick.
Combine sugar, flour, salt and cinnamon.
Add butter and work with fingertips until crumbly.
Add 1/2 of this mixture to the peaches.
Mix lightly and turn into pie shell.
Sprinkle the rest of the crumbly mixture over top of peaches.
Bake at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes or until peaches are cooked.
Cool 2 or 3 hours on rack before cutting.
Serves 5.

recipes.title: Apple Nut Cake
steps: Combine apples and sugar.
Beat eggs with vanilla and oil and mix with apples.
Sift flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Combine with apple/egg mixture.
Blend in nuts; spoon into an 11 x 14 x 2-inch pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken And Vegetable Rice Soup
ingredients: 1/2 c. uncooked brown rice (cook rice separately)
steps: Put chicken broth in large pot with vegetable base.
Simmer on low.
Next, add all vegetables and cooked rice.
Stir occasionally and cook, covered, for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Spiced Beef With Dumplings
steps: Trim excess fat from roast and melt the fat in a Dutch oven. Brown roast on all sides in the fat.
Add 1/4 cup water and the remaining ingredients except biscuits, parsley and flour.
Cover and simmer for 2 1/2 hours.
Place biscuits on roast and sprinkle with parsley.
Cover tightly and steam for 15 minutes.
Remove roast and dumplings to platter.
Add flour and 1/4 cup water to pan juices.
Stir until thickened.
Serve with roast.

recipes.title: Cousin Sallie'S Gingerbread
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. vinegar plus sweet milk to make 1/2 cup
steps: Sift flour with baking soda, salt and spices.
Combine shortening, sugar and molasses in mixing bowl and beat to blend. Add eggs; beat until thoroughly blended.
Add dry ingredients, beat until smooth.
All vinegar and milk, and stir until thoroughly blended.
Pour into greased 9 x 9 inch pan.
Bake at 350 degrees 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Slaw Dressing
steps: Mix sugar, flour, mustard, vinegar, sour cream and eggs together.
Cook slightly.
Stir constantly until dressing is creamy.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
steps: Rinse and drain rice, sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Pour 1 c. tomato juice over rice, then sprinkle with the onion, pepper, and celery (if wanted).
Then the meat, water, and 1 1/2 c. tomato juice.
Cut the bacon in 1/2 and put on top.
Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Uncover and bake for another 1/2 hour or until bacon is crisp.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Bubble Loaf
steps: Generously grease one 2 qt. deep casserole dish or two 8 x 4 in. loaf pans.
Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off. In large bowl combine 1 c. bread flour, sugar, salt and yeast - blend well.
In small sauce pan, heat milk and margarine until very warm (120 to 130 degrees).
Add warm liquid and egg to flour mixture.
Blend at low speed until moistened; beat 3 minutes at med. speed.
By hand, stir in whole wheat flour to form a stiff dough.
On floured surface knead in 1 to 1 1/2 c. bread flour until dough is smooth and elastic about 10 minutes.
Place in greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap and cloth towel. Let rise in a warm place until light and doubled in size, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Hash
steps: Combine potatoes and onion.
Sprinkle on flour, salt and pepper.
Add milk and hot dogs.
Put in shallow baking dish.
Dot with butter.
Bake for 30 minutes at 425°.
Top with cheese until melted.

recipes.title: Chocolate Heaven
steps: Combine flour, oleo and nuts and press in thin layer into 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bake at 350° about 15 minutes.
Let cool, then let chill in refrigerator.
Combine softened cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip.
Spread evenly over chilled crust and return to refrigerator.
Mix instant pudding with milk and vanilla.
Beat until thick and spread over cream cheese mixture.
Chill.
Top with remainder of Cool Whip.
Will keep 4 to 5 days in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, boiled, boned and cut up
14 to 16 corn tortillas or flour tortillas, if desired
1 can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.) pkg. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
steps: Dip each tortilla in hot grease just to soften.
On each tortilla put some chicken, onion and cheese.
Roll up and place in 9 x 13-inch pan which has been sprayed with nonstick spray.
Mix the soup, milk and chilies and pour over the enchiladas.
Top with additional onions and cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot.

recipes.title: Green Rice Casserole
steps: Place all ingredients in greased baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sourdough Biscuits
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add sugar, oil and room temperature buttermilk.
Stir together well (be sure oil is well blended when adding flour).
Add 4 cups flour and mix well.
Then add 5 cups flour (more if needed), salt, baking powder and soda; mix well.
Dough is ready to bake.
Seal mixture in an airtight container and refrigerate!

recipes.title: Pickled Cukes
steps: Soak cukes in lime water overnight (cover).
Drain and wash 3 times in cold water.
Soak 2 hours in salt water.
Drain and wash 3 times in cold water.
Dissolve alum in warm water.
Add enough cold water to cover cukes.
Add cukes and bring to a boil.
Drain and wash 3 times in cold water.
Mix sugar, vinegar and spices. Add cukes and bring to a boil, turn down heat and simmer 30 minutes.
Pack in hot jars.
Yield: 12 pints.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Temptations
ingredients: 2 (9 oz.) bags miniature peanut butter cups
steps: Mix all ingredients, but peanut butter cups.
Roll into balls. Place in greased T-cup tins.
Bake 10 minutes at 375°. Take
out of oven; insert peanut butter cups immediately.
Let cool.	Remove from tins.

recipes.title: Italian Pot Roast
ingredients: 2 lb. boneless beef round tip roast
steps: In a 4 1/2-quart Dutch oven, brown roast.
Drain off fat.
Add water, bouillon, oregano, basil, bay leaves, garlic and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat.
Simmer, covered, 25 to 30 minutes or until vegetables are done.

recipes.title: Chow Mein
steps: Brown beef.
Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Pour into casserole.
Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolatetown Pie
steps: Prepare pastry shell; set aside.
Heat oven to 350°.
In small mixer
bowl cream butter; add eggs and vanilla.
Combine sugar and
flour;
add
to creamed mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips and nuts; pour into unbaked pastry shell.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes or
until
golden.
Cool
about
hour.
Serve warm. Garnish with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Oven Apple Pancakes
ingredients: 3 tart medium apples, peeled, cored, and cut in 1/4 inch wedges
steps: With whisk or beater, beat eggs, milk, salt and flour until smooth.
Let the batter rest.
Combine the sugar and cinnamon, and sprinkle over the apples; toss to mix.
Generously butter two 9 inch pie pans, using about 2 Tbsp. for each pan.
Divide apples evenly between the pans.
Stir the batter and pour it over the apples, using 1 c. per pan.
Bake at 375° 30-40 minutes, or until pancakes are fluffed, golden brown, and set.
Serve hot in wedges topped with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Swedish Apple Pie
steps: Place apples in a 10-inch pie plate.
Sprinkle with the mixture of 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
Melt the butter in a pot.
Add the flour, sugar, egg and walnuts.
Spoon over the apples.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. salt and pepper to taste
steps: Combine all ingredients except sour cream.
Stir in sour cream just before serving.
Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Spritz Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
In large bowl, cream the powdered sugar, butter, vanilla and egg until light and fluffy.
Stir in flour and salt; blend well.
Fill cookie press; press dough into desired shapes onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake for 5 to 7 minutes, or until lightly browned on edges.
Immediately remove from cookie sheets.
Makes approximately 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Patties
steps: Cook cauliflower; drain and mash.
Add other ingredients; mix well.
Let stand about 1 hour before cooking.
Drop by tablespoons into hot oil and cook until golden brown on both sides.
Can be frozen and then reheated as you need them.

recipes.title: Alessa'S Cornbread Salad
ingredients: 1 (17 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
steps: Combine salad dressing mix, sour cream and mayonnaise.
Set aside.
Place half of crumbled cornbread in a large bowl.
Top with half of beans.
In a medium bowl, combine tomatoes, pepper and onions; layer half of this mixture over beans.
Layer half of cheese, bacon, corn and reserved salad dressing.
Repeat layers, using remaining ingredients.
Garnish as desired.

recipes.title: German Apple Pudding Cake
steps: Mix apples and sugar together.
Let stand until sugar is thoroughly dissolved.
Add eggs and mix well.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Stir into apple mixture.
Add nuts, raisins, and vanilla.
Pour into 8 X 8 inch pan which is slightly oiled.
Bake at 375° for 40 - 45 minutes.
If preferred use unsweetened can sliced apples instead of fresh apples.

recipes.title: Good N Easy Crawfish Jambalaya
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Put in rice cooker.
After cooker chimes, let jambalaya set on warm for 30 minutes before serving. May use shrimp instead of crawfish.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 2 eggs, beat the whites separately and beat in last
steps: Pour in 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake for 20 minutes at 400°.
Reduce to 350° and finish baking.
When it doesn't wiggle in the center, it is done or when a knife inserted in the center comes out clean (about 20 to 25 minutes).

recipes.title: Italian "S" Cookies
steps: Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Beat eggs.
Add sugar, vanilla, lemon rind and shortening.
Mix into bowl with flour to form a soft dough.

recipes.title: Ella Davis' Russian Tea Cakes
steps: Cream butter and 10x sugar.
Add next 3 ingredients.
Roll into balls.
Bake at 400° for 14 to 17 minutes.
Roll in 10x sugar while warm and again when cool.

recipes.title: Chicken Surprise
ingredients: 4 whole boned chicken breasts, cut in half
steps: Wrap each piece of chicken in a piece of bacon.
Put each piece of chicken on 2 slices of dried beef in a casserole dish. Use one so the chicken fits snug in the dish.
Mix 1 can cream of mushroom soup and 1 cup sour cream together and spread over chicken.
Bake at 250 degrees for 5 hours uncovered.

recipes.title: Bourbon Pecan Chicken
ingredients: 4 double breasts of chicken, boned, trimmed and split into 8 pieces
6 oz. chilled, unsalted butter, cut into pieces
steps: Whisk together mustard, sugar, bourbon, soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Cheezy Bacon Potatoes
steps: Boil potatoes and cut in small pieces; add margarine and milk.
Mix until soupy.
Add onions, green onions and parsley; mix.
Add bacon, salt and pepper.
Bake at 425 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes until perfect consistency.
Melt cheese on top for last 5 to 10 minutes.
Serves 25.

recipes.title: Georgetown Red Rice
steps: Cook bacon, remove from pan and crumble.
Cook onions in bacon fat until tender, then add red tomatoes, rice, broth, catsup, seasonings and crumbled bacon.
Cook on low heat until rice is done.
Stir several times during cooking.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 dashes hot sauce or 1 to 2 chopped small peppers
steps: Heat milk in one pan.
Heat tomatoes, tomato soup, butter, flour (mix first in some of the tomatoes) and salt in another pan. When hot, add pinch of soda.
When both milk and tomato mixture are hot, mix together.

recipes.title: 5 Flavor Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one.
Combine flour and baking powder.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk.
Stir in flavorings.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours in a 10-inch tube pan.

recipes.title: Lazy Cobbler
ingredients: 1 qt. fruit (whatever you desire; sweetened to taste)
steps: Melt margarine in baking dish or pan.
Mix flour, sugar and milk together.
Pour over melted margarine.
Add vanilla to sweetened fruit.
Pour over batter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cheese Fries
steps: Bake French fries as directed on package.
Fry bacon; pinch into small pieces.
When fries are baked, pour Ranch dressing on them, then add cheese and top with bacon pieces.
Place back in oven until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Frijoles Ala Charra
steps: *Add more if desired.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake
steps: Cream sugar with shortening.
Add three eggs, one at a time, beating between each addition.
Add soda, salt, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg and pumpkin.
Add flour and beat well.
Cook in a greased and floured tube or Bundt pan for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: French Chicken
steps: Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with rice; add broth plus water if needed.
Layer chicken over rice.
Mix soup, sour cream and poppy seed.
Pour over chicken.
Top with crushed Ritz crackers.
Pour melted butter over top.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Great Grandma Lockerbie'S Scones
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in skillet on top of stove, slowly, until done.

recipes.title: No Fail Pie Crust
steps: Mix in bowl.
Roll out between 2 sheets wax paper.
Makes 2 crusts.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
steps: Melt butter with 1 cup of milk.
Let sugar and remaining milk come to a boil, then add other ingredients and stir until thick.

recipes.title: Fried Cheese Ball
steps: Mix Cheddar cheese, flour, salt and cayenne pepper.
Add egg whites.
Shape into small balls and roll in fine cracker crumbs. Fry in deep oil at 375° until golden.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Amish Bread Starter
steps: Stir every day for 7 days.

recipes.title: Sausage Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 lb. smoked sausage or andouille, sliced thick
steps: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium-high heat and saute onion, bell pepper and parsley until onion is clear. Stirring, add the tomato sauce, garlic, mint and wine, then add rice, hot sauce, smoked sausage and enough water to cover the rice by about 1 inch.
Cook until most of the water is gone.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour; don't lift the lid until it has been simmering for 45 minutes.
This makes a red jambalaya.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Granola
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Add sweet rice syrup, ice water and olive oil and mix.
Spread in deep, oblong baking dish, sprayed with Pam.
Bake at 225° for 1 1/2 hours.
Add pecans, walnuts and almonds.
Mix and continue to bake 1/2 hour longer.
Add raisins and chopped dates.
Mix and cool.
Store in Ziploc bags.

recipes.title: Oriental Rice Casserole
steps: Brown beef, celery and onions.
Drain off excess fat.
Mix in mushrooms, water chestnuts, bamboo shoots and soy sauce. Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water; stir in mushroom soup.
Add to beef mixture.
Stir in rice.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour at 350°.
Serves 6 to 8.
Delicious.

recipes.title: Meatballs(For Macaroni Sauce)
ingredients: approximately 5 Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley (if you use dry use less)
steps: Mix
ingredients
well	and
roll into small meatballs. Let 1/2
wedge of lard or some Crisco melt in frying pan.
Put in meatballs, let brown on all sides and remove.

recipes.title: Cheddar Cheese Sauce
steps: In a saucepan melt margarine.
Stir in flour and salt.
Add milk. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Cook and stir for one minute more.
Add cheese, stir until melted.
Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Shrimp Cheese Turnovers
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, cut up
1 (6 oz.) pkg. frozen cooked tiny shrimp, thawed
steps: Cut butter and cream cheese into flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Work with hands to form ball.
Cover and chill 1 hour.
On floured surface, roll half into 11-inch circle.
Cut into rounds with 2-inch floured cutter.
Spread each round with about 1/2 teaspoon of cheese spread.
Top with a few shrimp.
Fold in half and seal.

recipes.title: Candied Apple Pie
steps: Prepare pastry of 2-crust 9-inch pie.
Fill bottom shell with apples.
Combine next six ingredients.
Pour over apples.
Cover with top crust.
Bake at 425° for 45 minutes or until crust is brown and apples are tender.
Remove from oven.

recipes.title: Chocolate Filled Bonbons
steps: Cream Crisco, sugar, brown sugar, vanilla and egg in large bowl at medium speed of electric mixer.

recipes.title: Shoo-Fly Cake
steps: Mix with hands, the first 5 ingredients.
Remove 2 cups of crumbs and set aside.
Mix remaining crumbs with boiling water, molasses and baking soda.
Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Grape-Nuts Bread
steps: Soak the Grape-nuts in the buttermilk for 10 minutes.
Combine other ingredients; beat well.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before putting in oven.
Bake 40 minutes at 375° in loaf pan.

recipes.title: Easy Refrigerator Dough
steps: Measure water and yeast into bowl; stir to dissolve.
Stir in sugar, salt, oil and eggs.
Mix until dough is soft.
Do not knead.
Cover with damp cloth; place in refrigerator.
Let set at least 2 hours.
About 1 to 1 1/2 hours before baking, shape into rolls.
Cover; let rise until doubled in size.
Bake at 400° until done.
This dough will keep in the fridge for about 5 days.
Just keep the cloth covering it damp.

recipes.title: Golden Glazed Ham With Cherry Sauce
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) jar apple or guava jelly
1 (1 lb. 15 oz.) can cherry pie filling
steps: Place ham, fat side up, on a rack in shallow pan.
Heat in a 325° oven for time indicated on label.
One-half hour before end of time, remove ham from oven and score fat in diamonds.

recipes.title: 30 Minute Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix flour and sugar.
Put water, cocoa and oleo in pan and bring to boil; pour over flour and sugar.
Mix well.
Add eggs, buttermilk, soda and vanilla.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400° about 20 minutes until done.
Frost while hot.

recipes.title: Maple Flavored Seven Minute Frosting
ingredients: 1 c. unsalted butter, softened at room temperature
1 pkg. Philadlephia cream cheese, softened at room temperature
3 c. all-purpose flour, sifted (if you want a finer texture, use cake flour)
1 pkg. frozen flaked coconut, thawed (6 oz. size)
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease (with extra amount of softened butter) and lightly flour a 10-inch tube pan.
Set aside.
Combine the butter and cream cheese in a large mixing bowl.
Beat mixture with an electric mixer until well blended and creamy for 2 minutes.
Gradually add sugar while continuing to beat on medium speed.
Beat until the mixture is light and fluffy for 6 to 8 minutes.
Add the eggs, one at a time, beating after the addition of each egg until it is thoroughly absorbed.
Sift together the flour, salt and baking powder.
Slowly add this combination to the egg mixture, blending well.
Stir in the coconut flavoring and vanilla flavoring, then the flaked coconut.
Beat well for 1 minute.

recipes.title: Chocolate Bubble Biscuits
steps: In large bowl, combine flour, 1/4 cup sugar, baking powder and salt.
Using pastry blender or 2 knives, cut in 1/3 cup butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in chocolate chips. Add milk; stir until dough holds a shape.
On floured board, knead dough lightly.
Roll dough into 16 balls.

recipes.title: Cranberry Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. raw cranberries, cut in half
steps: Combine flour, sugar, baking soda, ginger and baking powder and sift together.
Mix salt, egg, orange juice, butter and water together.
Add the dry ingredients and mix well.
Add the nuts and cranberries to the mixture.
Pour into a well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until the tester inserted in middle of loaf comes out dry.

recipes.title: Shrimp Provencale
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. large shrimp, shelled and deveined
steps: About 45 minutes before serving in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat in 2 tablespoons of oil, cook shrimp, stirring often about 3 minutes until shrimp turn pink; set aside.
In same skillet, add 1 tablespoon of oil.
Add mushrooms; cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Cook 3 minutes more.
Return shrimp to skillet.
Heat through.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chowder
steps: Cook hen , beef and bacon in 1/2 gallon of water for 2 hours. Then add onions, carrots, cabbage, green beans and tomatoes.
Cook 1 1/2 hours.
Then add potatoes, sugar, salt and pepper.
Cook 1 1/2 hours.
Then add corn and cook at least 15 minutes.
Makes 2 1/2 to 3 gallons.
It sticks very easily, so cook over low heat and stir often.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
