steps: Mix ingredients, adding eggs one at a time.
Bake in loaf pan at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mushrooms And Steak
steps: Cut steak into 4 servings. Melt butter in skillet; add Worcestershire sauce, basil and tarragon.
Place steaks in skillet. Cook 5 minutes on both sides.
Remove to warmed platter.
Cover with foil.
Place mushrooms in skillet.
Add wine, salt and pepper.
Saute until mushrooms are cooked.
In a small bowl, toss cheese with flour and stir in with mushrooms.
Cook until cheese is melted.
Pour over steaks.
Great with potatoes (baked) and salad.
This is so easy and great.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cake
steps: Mix eggs and sugar together.
Beat until smooth.
Add pineapple, juice and all and sprinkle salt and soda over top of pineapple.
Add the flour and mix real good.
Empty into greased baking dish and sprinkle brown sugar and nuts over top of cake. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.
Serve plain or with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: In a bowl, combine oatmeal, flour, sugar and cinnamon.
Mix in butter.
Peel, core and slice apples in a greased 8-inch round pan.
Sprinkle topping mixture on apples.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Bread
ingredients: 1 or 2 lb. unsliced pepperoni (depending on taste)
steps: Slice pepperoni into cubes 1/8-inch thick.
Shred Mozzarella. Preheat oven to 425°.
Using a roller, apply flour on surface. Roll dough into a diamond shape; 6 x 6-inch wide, starting at the smallest point.
Add pepperoni and Mozzarella (small portions at a time).
Roll over and continue adding, then rolling, pinching each end.
After roll is completed spread egg white over roll with paper towel.
Bake on cookie sheet, 15 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Chinese Pepper Steak
steps: Slice steak in narrow strips.
Brown steak in 2 tablespoons oil.
Combine with garlic, salt, pepper, soy sauce and sugar for 6 to 8 hours in crock-pot on low.
Turn to high and add vegetables. Dissolve 1 tablespoon cornstarch in 2 tablespoons cold water. Stir into pot.
Cook on high 15 to 20 minutes or until thickened. Serve over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Almond Potato Puffs
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cooked, mashed or riced potatoes
steps: Combine the water and butter in small saucepan and bring to boil over high heat.
Remove from heat; add flour, all at once, and beat until smooth.
Add egg, blending thoroughly.
Let cool. Add potatoes to flour-egg mixture and blend well.
Season to taste with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Flour hands lightly, shape mixture into tablespoon-size balls.
Roll balls in chopped nuts.
Pour oil into a deep fryer or large saucepan and heat to 375°.
Fry balls in batches until golden, about 5 minutes.
Drain on paper towels. Serve hot.
Yield: 2 servings.

recipes.title: Gingersnaps
steps: Cream the shortening.
Add sugar, egg and molasses.
Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture.
Chill at least 2 hours. (You may chill overnight or longer.)
Roll in balls the size of a small walnut.
Dip the tops of the balls in the 2 tablespoons sugar and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon mixture and place about 3-inches apart on greased (sprayed) cookie sheets.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Crunch Squares(Frozen Dessert)
steps: Combine flour, oats, and sugar.
Cut in butter until mix resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in nuts.
Pat mix into 13 x 9 inch pan and bake in a 400 degree oven for 15 minutes.
Stir while warm to crumble and then cool.

recipes.title: Blond Brownies
steps: Sift dry ingredients and add nuts. Melt butter and mix in brown sugar, egg, and vanilla. Add flour mixture to butter mixture and mix well. Spread in square baking pan and sprinkle chips on top. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
steps: Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese together with mixer.
Blend in brown sugar and Kahlua.
Stir in peanuts and chill.
Serve with fresh fruit: apple and pear wedges, strawberries or banana chunks.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1/4 lb. or 1 (4 oz.) can sliced mushrooms
steps: Brown round steak (cut into thin slices) in hot oil.
Remove meat.
Cook onion and mushrooms until golden.
Stir remaining ingredients except sour cream.
Return meat to pan.
Simmer about 1 hour, or until tender.
Gradually stir in sour cream.
Heat to almost boiling.
Serve over wild rice or noodles.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Spanish Sauce
ingredients: 1 pt. chopped onions or 1/2 box dehydrated onions
steps: Simmer for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: "Sean'S Favorite" Cranberry Pie
steps: Grease a 9-inch pie plate.
Layer with cranberries and apple. Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts.
Beat egg until thick; slowly add 1/2 cup of sugar, flour and melted butter until blended well. Pour egg mixture over cranberry mixture.
Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Serve with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Stew Beef With Gravy
steps: Roll stew beef in flour.
Heat oil and brown stew beef.
When well browned, place in saucepan and add Worcestershire sauce and Texas Pete.
Cover with water.
Cover and simmer until tender. Delicious served with mashed potatoes or rice.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Beat margarine until smooth.
Add sugar and blend well.
Add eggs, one at a time, blending well.
Add vanilla.
Sift flour and soda together.
Slowly add flour until all ingredients are blended well.
Add sour cream and blend.
Pour in well-greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes, then turn down to 300° and bake for 45 minutes.
Let cool in pan for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Green Beans And Potatoes
ingredients: 1 (29 oz.) can Bush's cut green and shelly beans
1 (15 oz.) can Bush's whole white potatoes, drained
steps: Empty beans into crock-pot.
Add drained potatoes, onion and bacon.
Cook on high for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Pumpkin Pie
steps: Combine eggs, sugar, corn syrup, pumpkin and vanilla.
Mix well.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake in preheated 375° oven for 55 to 60 minutes.
Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Gingersnaps
steps: Blend shortening and sugar, then add eggs and molasses.
Mix flour, salt, soda and spices. Add to creamed mixture.
Add raisins and chill 25 to 30 minutes. Roll into balls and dip top into sugar.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Place 1 drop of water on top of sugar on each cookie. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Wilted Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. fresh spinach leaves, torn (about 8 c. total)
steps: In 3-quart casserole snip bacon into 1 inch pieces.
Cover with paper towel.
Microwave at High (10) 2 to 3 minutes, until crisp.
With slotted spoon, place bacon on paper towels to drain. To bacon drippings add vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper and tarragon. Microwave at High (10) 2 to 3 minutes, until mixture boils.
Stir in celery and onion.
Gradually add spinach to hot dressing, tossing to coat each piece.
Add crumbled bacon, orange segments and cashews.
Toss again lightly.
Serve immediately.
Total Microwave Cooking Time:
4 to 6 minutes.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Combine oil, eggs, water and pumpkin; sift together next six ingredients.
Gradually beat into first mixture; stir in cherries and nuts.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
steps: Boil potatoes 15 minutes and drain.
Cool and cube.
Chop onion.
Cut up Velveeta cheese.
Mix with mayonnaise and cubed potatoes.
Spray baking dish with Pam.
Spread mixture into baking dish.
Sprinkle bacon bits on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix the oleo or butter and sugar together until creamy by hand or mixer.
Add the eggs, cream of tartar, vanilla and soda.
Mix until well blended.
Add the flour, one cup at a time, blending well after each addition.
Roll into small balls and press with bottom of glass dipped in sugar.
Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes in a heavy pan or 10 minutes on a cookie sheet.
Make sure the cookie sheets are cool and cleaned before putting more cookies on them. The dough may be chilled for awhile or overnight to make it easier to handle.

recipes.title: Spring Breakfast Strata
ingredients: 1 pkg. (10 oz) frozen cut asparagus, thawed or 2 c. fresh cut asparagus, cooked
steps: In a large bowl, beat eggs; add milk, mustard, basil and salt. Gently stir in remaining ingredients until well mixed.
Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish.
Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or over night.
Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour or until knife inserted near the center comes out clean.
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Russian Teacakes
steps: Mix butter, sugar and vanilla thoroughly.
Measure flour by sifting.
Blend flour and salt; stir into butter mixture. Mix in nuts. Chill at least 2 hours.
Heat oven to 400°.
Roll dough into 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes while still warm.
Roll in powdered sugar.
Cool and roll in sugar again.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 chickens or pieces, boiled and deboned
steps: In large bowl, combine chicken, rice and celery.
Add soup, mayonnaise, onions and water chestnuts.
Put in a large uncovered casserole.
Top with corn flakes that have been mixed with 1/2 stick melted margarine and almonds.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.
Can be frozen.
Freeze unbaked.
Bring to room temperature before baking.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread(Julie'S Favorite)
steps: Beat eggs until
light	and
fluffy.
Add
oil,
sugar, zucchini and vanilla.
Mix	lightly,
but well.
Add remaining ingredients, mix until blended.
Add nuts.	Put in greased and floured loaf pans.	Makes 2.
Bake 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Pie Crust Supreme
steps: Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening. Add water, vinegar and egg all at once to the dry ingredients.
Mix. Roll as usual.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter And Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Mix shortening, sugar, butter, egg and vanilla in a bowl.
Stir in flour, baking soda and salt.
Add chocolate chips and peanut butter chips.
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake about 10 to 13 minutes or until cookies are golden.
Cool.

recipes.title: Bea'S Hot Olive Cheese Puffs
steps: Blend cheese and oleo.
Add flour and paprika.
Take 1 teaspoon of the mixture and wrap around an olive.
Bake in 450° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
May be prepared early and frozen before baking.

recipes.title: Creamy Rice Pudding
steps: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan.
Cover and cook over very low heat for about 30 minutes or until rice is tender and milk is absorbed.
Stir mixture occasionally.
Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl.
Gradually stir about 1/4 of hot rice mixture into egg mixture.
Add remaining egg mixture to remaining rice.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Serve warm or cold with fruit or raisins.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients in saucepan.
Let boil for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat and add next 5 ingredients.
Mix thoroughly. Drop on wax paper.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Sweet Onion Pie
steps: Saute onion in butter until soft.
Mix flour with cold milk until there are no lumps.
Add eggs, salt, pepper and cheese.
Add onion and mix well.
Pour into pie shell and bake for 40 minutes until brown, bake at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Soft Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Sift dry ingredients.
Cream shortening, then add sugar and egg.
Stir in one-half of the flour, then the milk and then the remaining flour.
Stir in oats and raisins.
Drop onto lightly greased cookie sheet and bake 10 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Cut broccoli flowerets into smaller than bite-size pieces. Cut off tough outer layer of stalks and chop the tender part into small pieces.
You need 8 cups of broccoli.
(Do this the day before and store in plastic bag.)
Saute bacon until crisp.
Slice onion lengthwise.
In large bowl, combine the broccoli, onion and raisins and bacon.
In small bowl, mix together mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar and pepper.
Combine dressing with the vegetables; refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
Top with sunflower seeds.

recipes.title: Quick Taco Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. shredded Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese
steps: Step 1:
In a large skillet, brown ground beef and onion. Drain.
Remove from skillet.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream sugar and butter, add egg and vanilla. Mix thoroughly. Sift dry ingredients together and stir into first mixture. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Divide dough in half and roll out on lightly floured pastry sheet.
Roll thin but thick enough to pick up the design in the cookie cutters.
Dip cutter in flour before each cutting.
Cut as many cookies from each rolling as possible.
The least amount of working with the dough gives the best cookie.
Place on lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or until delicately golden.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Mix all ingredients and beat for 3 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pickled Beets
steps: Dissolve all ingredients, except beets; bring to boil.
Add diced or sliced beets until warm.
Put in sterile bottles and seal.
Cold pack 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
steps: Blend all ingredients in bottom of an 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Add chicken. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 8 to 10 hours. Turn at least once in marinade.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.
Baste with pan juices and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Apricot-Blueberry Coffee Cake(A Favorite Of Family And Friends)
steps: Combine cake mix, pudding, eggs, oil and sour cream; beat well by hand; add blueberries and apricots.
Combine sugar, cinnamon and nuts; set aside.
Grease and flour a tube pan.
Pour 1/2 of the cake mixture into pan.
Sprinkle with 1/2 of the sugar-cinnamon mixture.
Add the remaining cake mixture, then the remaining sugar-cinnamon mixture.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour. Yields 12 to 14 servings.

recipes.title: 24-Hour Salad
ingredients: 1 small head or 1/2 large head lettuce
steps: Make 24 hours before serving.
Use large casserole or large glass pan.
Shred or tear lettuce into dish, approximately 1/3 full.
Layer on top of the following (do not stir): green peas, green pepper, celery, red onion.
Frost entire top with the following mixture:
mayonnaise, sour cream and sugar.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Right before serving, sprinkle with bacon.

recipes.title: Kim'S Corned Beef Hash
steps: Wash and peel potatoes, chop into wedges and place in microwave safe dish. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Add butter to potatoes last few minutes in microwave. Cook bacon, remove from grease and brown onions. Add to potatoes along with corned beef, place on top and do not stir. Cook until done.

recipes.title: Play Dough
steps: Put in saucepan the flour, salt, cream of tartar and cooking oil. Add the boiling water. Cook until it sticks together and is doughy.

recipes.title: Cioppino
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh or frozen fish fillets
1 (4 1/2 oz.) can shrimp, rinsed and drained
steps: Thaw fish if frozen.
Cut fish into 1-inch pieces.
In a large saucepan, cook green onion, onion and garlic in hot oil until tender.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, wine, parsley, oregano, basil, salt and pepper.
Bring to boiling, then reduce heat. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Add fish, shrimp and undrained clams.
Bring just to boiling, then reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork.
This stew is delicious on its own or over rice.
Serve with salad and warm bread.

recipes.title: Best-Ever Egg Nog
steps: Beat egg yolks and sugar in medium saucepan.
Slowly beat in two (2) cups of the milk.
Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until thermometer registers 150°F. or mixture coats the back of a metal spoon.
Remove from heat;
strain into pitcher.
Stir in remaining milk, Jim Beam Bourbon, vanilla and nutmeg.
Cover and chill at least 8 hours or overnight.
Sprinkle with additional nutmeg.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
steps: Pare and slice eggplant. Cook in salted water until tender. Drain and mash.
Add other ingredients except cheese slices. Place in a greased 1-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Arrange cheese slices on top and bake an additional 20 minutes.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 2 fresh carrots, cut in small pieces
1 (10 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
steps: Place all
ingredients
in a 9 x 13-inch pan and cover. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hot And Sour Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut in 1-inch cubes
steps: In a 5-quart pot, heat oil.
Add chicken and saute until meat is not pink.
Add water, mushrooms, cabbage, bamboo shoots and bouillon cubes.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 1/2 hour. In small bowl, dissolve cornstarch and stir with fork until smooth.
Stir into soup.
Add vinegar, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Stir soup until slightly thickened and enjoy.
Unused soup can be frozen for a quick meal anytime.

recipes.title: Green Rice
ingredients: 1 c. chopped spinach or parsley or combine both
steps: Heat oven to 325°. Toss rice and spinach together. Add eggs, milk, Worcestershire sauce, salt and onion. Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle butter and cheese over rice. Bake 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Good Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, cut into bite size pieces
steps: Drain green beans.
Mix all ingredients together in casserole dish and bake at 350° for about 20 to 30 minutes until bacon pieces are done.

recipes.title: Spaghetti And Meat Sauce
ingredients: 1 (28 oz.) can tomatoes, cut up and undrained
steps: In Dutch oven, cook beef, sausage, onion and garlic.
Drain. Add next 7 ingredients.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Prepare spaghetti as package directs.
Drain.
Serve sauce over hot spaghetti.
Pass the Parmesan cheese.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Cheesy Green Beans
steps: Brown the butter; add flour, then milk.
Stir and cook until smooth.
Add cheese and mushroom soup and stir until melted.
Pour over beans.
Heat.

recipes.title: Electric Frypan Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 clove garlic, peeled and cut fine
1 1/2 c. cooked tomatoes or 1/2 c. chili sauce
steps: On a breadboard, pound flour into both sides of steak; cut into serving pieces until flour is absorbed.
Preheat frypan to 360°. Add fat and onions; saute until golden in color, about 3 minutes. Remove from fat.
Change frypan setting to 400° and add a tablespoon of fat.
Then brown steak on both sides, about 10 to 20 minutes.
Sprinkle browned meat with salt and pepper; add the sauteed onions, garlic, celery, tomatoes and pepper slices.
Cover and set frypan at 220°.
Simmer until the meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Sprinkle with parsley when serving.

recipes.title: Aunt Lettie'S Pound Cake
steps: Separate eggs.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add 6 tablespoons of sugar gradually.
Put in refrigerator.
Cream butter and add remainder of sugar.
Beat at low speed.
Add 2 egg yolks at a time.
Add milk and flour alternately.
Add flavoring and fold in egg whites.
Pour into greased steeple pan.
Bake 1 3/4 hours in a 300° oven.

recipes.title: Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 chicken, simmered in salted water until tender, then deboned
steps: Cut up chicken and put in casserole.
Combine soup and broth and pour over chicken.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Put in loaf pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Cream shortening, butter, sugar and eggs.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour into a loaf pan, greased and lightly floured.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix sugar, flour, oats, cinnamon, salt and raisins.
Add eggs and mix well.
Add margarine.
Mix soda and vinegar together and add to mixture.
This dough will be stiff, but mix well.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes, depending on how crisp or soft you like them.

recipes.title: Chocolate Buttermilk Pound Cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Grease and flour a Bundt pan or tube pan. In large bowl, cream together the butter, shortening, and sugar.
Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. In another bowl, combine the flour, baking soda, salt, and cocoa. Stir to mix.

Add the flour mixture to the creamed mixture alternately with the buttermilk. Add vanilla and mix well. Stir in walnuts. Pour the batter into the prepared pan. Bake for about 1 hour 10 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of cake. After the cake has cooled slightly in the pan, turn it out onto a cake plate.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. raw rhubarb, cut very fine
steps: Mix all ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with mixture of 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Crisscross Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Thoroughly cream shortening, sugar and vanilla.
Add eggs and beat thoroughly.
Stir in peanut butter.
Sift dry ingredients. Stir into creamed mixture.
Form into tiny balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press with back of fork to make crisscross.
Dough may also be rolled and cut, if desired.
Bake in moderated oven at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes 8 dozen.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake
steps: Mix sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla. Mix together flour, baking powder and salt. Mix dry ingredients into wet ingredients. Spread 1/2 batter into bottom of 9 x 13 greased baking pan. Spoon pie filling over batter. Drizzle remaining batter over pie filling. Before baking, sprinkle with 2 tablespoons white sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon, mixed together. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 2 lb. ground meat (beef, turkey, chicken, venison)
2 (16 oz.) jars salsa (1 mild and 1 medium)
steps: Cook meat and onion until brown; drain fat.
Add taco seasoning mix to meat mixture.
Add chilies.
Cut tortillas into thirds.
In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer salsa, meat, cheese and tortillas in that order.
End with layer of tortillas topped with cheese.
Cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Ladyfingers
steps: Mix all ingredients and roll in powdered sugar.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Serves 5.

recipes.title: Mom'S Dandelion Wine
steps: Gather 1 peck dandelion heads.
Do not collect from an area sprayed with pesticides or herbicides.
Wash to remove bugs. Combine dandelion heads with boiling water in a large container. Let the flower heads steep for 24 hours.
Strain the juice.
To the juice, add sugar, yeast and fruit.
The amount of fruit can vary, depending on the flavor you want.
Set it in a warm, dark area to ferment.
Do not stir.
Keep mixture quiet for about 2 weeks.
When the mixture reaches the desired potency, siphon off and filter through cheesecloth.
Refrigerate.
It's ready!

recipes.title: Southern Sweet Potato Pie
steps: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and sugar.
Add potatoes, eggs, corn syrup, nutmeg, salt, butter and evaporated milk.
Beat well.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Rolls
steps: Blend softened cheese with capers.
Spread on salmon.
Roll, jelly-roll fashion.
Chill.
Cut in 1/2-inch slices.
Serve on cocktail picks.

recipes.title: Icebox Cookies
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. milk (may take a little more)
steps: Mix Crisco or oleo, powdered sweetener, milk, almond, vanilla and eggs together and add flour, baking powder and nuts.
Make into logs and refrigerate overnight.
Slice and bake at 350° until light brown.
They do not brown like cookies with sugar.
Can also add coconut and substitute unsweetened orange juice for the milk.
Keep in refrigerator.
(Thirteen calories per cookie.)

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
steps: Prepare cake batter using first 8 ingredients.
Melt 1/3 cup butter and brown sugar in cake pan (10 to 12-inch) or an iron skillet.
Put the pineapple in the pan and place a cherry in the center of each pineapple slice if you wish.
Then cover with cake batter.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.
Loosen cake from sides of pan and invert on large plate.
Serve warm or cold, plain or with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Quick Chili
steps: Brown beef and onion in skillet; drain off fat.
Add soup, beans, green chilies, chili powder, salt and pepper; simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve over rice or with crackers.

recipes.title: Beatnik Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients well and bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
ingredients: 6 to 8 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
steps: Roll chicken in a mixture of flour, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Brown in oil.
Place chicken in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish; sprinkle with Parmesan and then Mozzarella.
Pour spaghetti sauce over chicken.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes. Serve with spaghetti or vermicelli.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Sauce For Fresh Fruit
ingredients: 1 pkg. Dream Whip or whipping cream
steps: Place beaten egg in top of double boiler and add sugar, flour and salt.
Mix well.
Add butter and pineapple juice.
Cook over water until smooth and thickened.
Cool, then add Dream Whip or whipping cream.

recipes.title: Quick Cobbler
steps: Melt margarine in an 8-inch dish in a preheated 375° oven. Combine sugar, flour and milk.
Stir into melted margarine.
Top with cherries and mix thoroughly.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow or white cake mix (set aside 1 c.)
steps: Mix cake mix, melted butter and 1 egg.
Pour and press into lightly greased cake pan.
Mix pumpkin, 2 eggs, sugar, salt, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and milk.
Pour over crust mix.
Mix remaining ingredients until crumbly; sprinkle over pumpkin mixture.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cool and serve with whipped topping.

recipes.title: 7 Layer Salad
steps: Layer in bowl as listed.
Let sit 8 hours overnight in refrigerator.

recipes.title: North Rim Rolls(Grand Canyon)
ingredients: 1 packet yeast, dissolved in 1/2 c. warm water and 2 tsp. sugar
steps: Mix milk, sugar, salt and shortening.
Cool to lukewarm.
Add eggs and yeast mixture.
Stir in flour.
Refrigerate overnight. Roll out dough.
Cut or shape as desired.
Let rise at least an hour.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cherry Wink Cookies
steps: Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt.
Blend butter and sugar; add eggs.
Beat well.
Stir in milk and vanilla. Add sifted dry ingredients together with nuts, dates and cut cherries.
Mix well.
Crush corn flakes into fine crumbs.
Shape dough into balls using 1 level tablespoon dough each.
Roll balls into crumbs.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Top each with 1/4 cherry.
Bake at 375° for about 12 minutes or until lightly brown. Yield:
6 dozen 2-inch diameter cookies.

recipes.title: Applesauce Raisin Cookies
steps: Cream the butter and sugar.
Stir in egg.
Sift together the flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with applesauce.
Add oats and blend well. Stir in raisins and nuts.
Drop by teaspoons onto well-greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sensational Celery
ingredients: 1/2 c. canned mushroom stems and pieces
steps: Cook celery in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain.
Drain water chestnuts; reserve liquid.
Slice water chestnuts.
Drain mushrooms and reserve liquid.
Mix celery, water chestnuts, almonds and mushrooms.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Add flour and stir until smooth.
Add reserved liquids, milk and broth; cook, stirring until thickened.
Stir in celery mixture; pour into casserole.
Top with crumbs; sprinkle with cheese.
Bake in preheated 375° oven until bubbly and brown.

recipes.title: Imperial Cookies
steps: Cream margarine and sugar; add soda and vinegar, then vanilla and flour.
Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet and bake for about 15 minutes at 300°.

recipes.title: Swedish Pineapple Nut Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together with mixer.
Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Deer Roast
steps: You will also need one oven baking bag.

recipes.title: Cheese And Veggie Crescents
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach or broccoli, thawed and well drained
steps: Combine spinach or broccoli, cheese spread, bread crumbs and bacon in a 1 1/2-quart saucepan.
Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted.
Unroll dough
and separate into 16 triangles.
Cut each triangle in half lengthwise so you'll have 32 triangles.
Spread each triangle with about 1 teaspoon of mixture.
Roll up, starting at wide end.
Place on greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 375° for 11 to 13 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 32 appetizers.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Cookies
steps: Whip Crisco, sugar, eggs and vanilla together.
Mix flour, soda, cream of tartar and pinch of salt.
Combine and drop by spoonful on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Fudge Cookie Cake
steps: Put flour, sugar and salt in large bowl, set aside.
Bring to a boil oleo, water, oil and cocoa, pour over flour mixture and stir until well mixed.
In a small bowl beat the eggs, buttermilk, soda and vanilla.
Stir into mixture and beat well.
Pour into greased and floured jelly roll pan (10 x 15-inch) and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Bran-Apple Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 c. prune puree or baby food
1 c. peeled and grated apple (spooned, not packed into c.)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Coat 12 (2 3/4 inch) muffin tin cups with vegetable cooking spray; set aside.
In small bowl, combine buttermilk, bran and baking soda; set aside.
In mixer bowl, cream sugar, prune puree; beat in egg whites and molasses.
Stir in buttermilk mixture, flour, apple and salt.
Blend thoroughly. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups, dividing equally.
Bake about 20 minutes until pick inserted into center comes out clean. Cool in pan for 15 minutes.
Turn onto rack to cool completely.

recipes.title: Baking Dish Cobbler
ingredients: 4 to 5 fresh ripe peaches, peeled thinly and sliced
steps: Butter a 9 or 10-inch pie dish at least 1 1/2 inches deep. Place peaches in dish.
Spread bread evenly over peaches.
Mix melted butter, sugar, flour and egg together until well blended. Pour evenly over bread, making sure all bread is covered.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Fried Apple Pies
steps: Add water to apples and cook until done.
Add sugar, salt and spices and simmer until jelled.
Refrigerate until used.

recipes.title: Almond Bark Candy
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Turn off and place pan in oven with peanut butter and Candi-Quick.
Mix the next 3 ingredients and drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

recipes.title: Chess Cake
steps: Mix ingredients.
Bake at 350° in oblong pan until cake falls (or about 45 minutes).
Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Garden Green Salad
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl.
Toss well. Combine lemon juice and remaining ingredients in a jar.
Cover tightly and shake vigorously.
Pour over lettuce mixture.
Toss gently.
Yields
4 servings.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
steps: Mix flour, butter, powdered sugar and salt.
Pat in 8 x 8-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes (don't brown).
Beat the eggs, sugar, flour and lemon juice for 3 minutes.
Pour over hot crust and bake 20 to 25 minutes more.
When cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Double the recipe for 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Funny Cake
steps: Cook 1 cup sugar, cocoa and water for a few minutes, then let cool.
In another bowl, mix remaining ingredients together.
Pour first mixture into unbaked pie crust, then drop second mix by spoonfuls.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Belgian Pie
ingredients: 1 ounce compressed yeast or 1-1/2 package dry yeast
1/2 cup cream, scalded and cooled to lukewarm or unscalded evaporated milk
1/2 cup soft butter, lard or vegetable shortening
steps: Dissolve yeast and 1-1/2 teaspoons sugar in warm water; set aside until bubbly.
Beat 2 eggs, 2 tablespoons sugar and salt. Add cream and butter.
Beat.
Add yeast mixture and slowly blend in flour.
Mix well and let stand for 10 minutes.
Divide into 5 or 6 parts.
Form into balls.
Press into greased pans, forming a 1/2 inch ridge around outside of the pan.
Let rise 15 minutes.
Pour rice, prune, poppy seed, apple, cherry or any cake and pastry filling over the center.
Top with Cheese topping.
Bake at 350 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cajun Cabbage
ingredients: salt, pepper and cayenne pepper to taste
steps: Cook the bacon in iron skillet until crisp.
Add the onion and peppers.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Simmer for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients, except nuts, together with mixer until smooth.
Add nuts.
Pour into greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, or until done.

recipes.title: Oriental Grilled Chicken
steps: Cut chicken breasts in half.
Mix remaining ingredients together in a shallow pan large enough to hold breasts in one layer.
Place breasts in marinade, turning to coat and rubbing marinade into breasts.
Marinate at least one hour and as long as overnight.
Grill chicken over hot coals or under broiler.
Strain marinade, bring it to a boil and serve it with chicken.
Yield:
4 servings.
Carbohydrate 5 g, protein 21 g, fat 5 g, calories 186.

recipes.title: Soft Sour Cream Cookies
steps: Cream together sugar and shortening, add eggs and sour cream. Mix well. Add vanilla.
Combine flour, baking powder and soda. Add to creamed mixture slowly. After well mixed, set overnight in refrigerator. Roll out on a floured surface.
Cut into shapes. Bake at 350° for 8-10 minutes. Frost and decorate.

recipes.title: Play Dough
steps: Mix flour and cream of tartar in pan.
Add water, food coloring and oil.
Stir over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes.
Don't worry if globby.
Keep stirring until ball forms in center of pot. Take out and put on floured surface.
Squish and punch a bit (kneading).
Keep in plastic bag or airtight container.
Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
steps: Place pineapple chunks in bottom of glass 10 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Mix sugar and flour together and sprinkle over pineapple.
Then layer cheese and crushed crackers to form top layer.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly hot.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
ingredients: shake of caraway seed or add some raisins (optional)
steps: Bake 35 minutes in cast-iron pot or medium cast-iron frypan at 350°.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Biscuits
steps: Mix thoroughly.
Knead 10 times.
Cut and bake at 450° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Green Rice
steps: Toss rice and spinach together.
Add eggs, milk, worcestershire sauce and salt.
Pour into ungreased casserole.
Sprinkle butter and cheese over rice.
Heat oven to 325°.
Bake uncovered for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Milky Way Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar until mixture is light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add flour and baking soda alternately with milk, stirring until smooth.
Add melted candy, mixing well.
Stir in vanilla and nuts.
Pour into greased 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Cool a few minutes and remove.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix bouillon and water.
Sprinkle rice over bottom of a casserole dish.
Chop onion, green pepper and place on top of rice.
Place butter pats on top of green peppers and onion.
Pour bouillon mixture over casserole.
Put chicken on top of rice mixture.
Pour the mushroom soup over the chicken. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Ovens can vary, so use your own judgement.

recipes.title: Quick Yellow Split Pea Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb. split peas*, add last 10 to 20 minutes of cooking
steps: Bring water with all ingredients to a boil.
Reduce to medium-low.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Add rice or barley during last 10 to 20 minutes of cooking.

recipes.title: Blt Macaroni Salad
steps: Cook macaroni; drain and rinse in cold water. In a large bowl, combine the macaroni, green onions, tomato and celery. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, vinegar, salt and pepper. Pour over macaroni mixture and toss to coat. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours. Just before serving, add bacon. Yield: 12 servings.

recipes.title: Zucchini Muffins
steps: Beat eggs until light and foamy.
Add oil, sugar, vanilla and zucchini.
Into a separate bowl, sift the dry ingredients.
Add dry ingredients to zucchini mixture, along with nuts.
Pour into greased muffin tins or use muffin papers.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Yield:
2 dozen.

recipes.title: Anise Oil Cookies
steps: Mix together butter and sugar.
Add egg, wine, vanilla and anise oil.
Sift flour, baking powder, salt and remaining ingredients and mix together.
Put in refrigerator overnight. Take out and roll out with cookie cutters.
Grease pan and bake at 350° for 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hot Sponge Cake
steps: Beat eggs; beat in sugar.
Beat in flour.
Melt butter in milk and pour over dry ingredients.
Add vanilla.
Bake in 10-inch square pan at 350° for 25 minutes.
May frost or serve plain with fruit, such as strawberries.

recipes.title: Ozark Pudding
steps: Mix sugar, egg, flour, salt, baking powder and vanilla.
Add apples and nuts and mix well.
Bake in greased pie tin at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Vanilla Cookies
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla and beat until mixture is a light lemon color.
Add flour and mix well. Form dough in 1-inch balls and place 2 inches apart on lightly oiled cookie sheet.
Flatten with a fork.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or lightly browned.

recipes.title: Lemon Snowdrops
steps: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar; add extract.
Sift together flour and salt; add to creamed mixture and mix well. Roll level teaspoonfuls into balls.
Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets; flatten slightly.
Bake at 350° for 8-10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
steps: Fry together butter and onion until brown.
Add flour and stir.
Add canned soup, milk and broccoli.
Simmer 15 minutes or until broccoli is cooked.
Add shredded Cheddar cheese and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Fried Corn
steps: Fry bacon; set aside.
Leave fat from bacon in skillet.
Hold ear of corn perpendicular to cutting board.
With sharp knife, slice downward, cutting off tip ends of kernels, then scrape milk out of remaining kernels.
Heat bacon fat in skillet.
Add scraped corn and kernel tips.
Fry lightly for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add enough milk to make creamed corn consistency. Add butter.
Cook another 5 minutes.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Pour in serving dish and sprinkle crushed bacon over all. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Blackberry Cake
steps: Cream butter, sugar and eggs.
Add flour alternately with milk.
Add spices and cocoa.
Fold in blackberries.
Batter will be thick.
Spoon batter into loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Crackle Snappers
steps: Melt chocolate morsels over hot, not boiling, water.
Remove from heat and set aside.
Combine shortening, 1/2 cup sugar and egg and beat until creamy.
Blend in melted chocolate and corn syrup. Sift together flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt and stir in gradually.
Add nuts and mix well.
Shape into balls using 1 level tablespoonful for each.
Roll balls in about 1/4 cup sugar.
Place 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Yields 3 dozen 3-inch cookies.

recipes.title: Apple Or Peach Crisp
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. Fruit Fresh or lemon juice (pour over fruit)
steps: Mix sugar, flour and egg.
Will be dry and crumbly.
Sprinkle over fruit.
Melt 1 stick margarine.
Pour over.
Bake 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs.
Mix soda with sour cream and add to egg mixture.
Add all dry ingredients and orange rind. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pizza
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) jar red maraschino cherries, cut in half
1 (6 oz.) jar green cherries, cut in 1/4
steps: Melt chocolate in microwave on High 3 minutes.
Stir until all is melted.
Stir in marshmallows, cereal and peanuts.
Pour onto greased or Saran Wrap covered 12-inch pizza pan or smaller plates. Top with red cherries and 1 green for leaf.
Sprinkle with coconut. Melt remaining white bark and shortening.
Drizzle over coconut. Chill 15 minutes in freezer.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
ingredients: 1/2 c. Crisco oil or very light olive oil
steps: Put flour, sugar and milk in the middle of the pie pan.
Add oil and mix.
Makes a soft ball of dough.
Press to bottom and sides of pan evenly.

recipes.title: Mother'S Rice Refrigerator Rolls
steps: Scald milk; stir in sugar, salt and shortening.
Cool to lukewarm.
Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add rice to milk, then add the yeast and eggs.
Add about half of the flour and stir until mixed well.
Add enough of remaining flour to make a very stiff dough.
Stir until dough leaves the sides of bowl.
Knead until smooth.
Place dough in large greased bowl.
Brush dough with melted shortening, cover and refrigerate for at least 12 hours. Remove from refrigerator 3 to 4 hours before baking.
Shape, let rise and bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes for rolls.
Can be made into loaves and baked at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.
Makes 2 loaves.
Dough can be kept in refrigerator for 3 to 4 days.

recipes.title: Chocolate Scotcheroos
ingredients: 1 c. (6 oz. pkg.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
steps: Combine sugar and syrup in a 3-quart saucepan.
Cook over moderate heat, stirring frequently, until mixture begins to bubble.
Remove from heat.
Stir in peanut butter; mix well.
Add Rice Krispies; stir until well blended.
Press mixture into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Trout Meuniere
ingredients: 3/4 c. flour, seasoned with salt, pepper and pinch of thyme
steps: Roll trout in seasoned flour.
Heat oil in frypan and add trout which should be gently cooked and browned on both sides. When thoroughly cooked, transfer trout to heated serving platter and keep hot.

recipes.title: Diabetic Cookies
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. brown sugar or Sugar Twin
steps: Combine dates, raisins, apples and water.
Bring to a boil for 3 minutes. Cool and add remaining ingredients. Chill dough.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix well and cook over medium heat until thick.
Pour into cooked pie shell.
Add egg topping which consist of 3 egg whites, 1 Tbsp. sugar, and 1/4 tsp. vanilla flavoring whipped together. Place in oven on 325 degrees until topping browns.

recipes.title: White Bread
steps: Scald milk. Stir in sugar, salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm.
Pour warm water into bowl. Sprinkle yeast and dissolve. Add milk mixture. Stir half the flour into mixture, then add rest of flour and combine.
Turn dough onto floured surface and knead. Put into greased bowl.
Brush with melted shortening.
Cover and let rise 1 hour and 20 minutes. Punch down. Divide into 2 equal parts.
Knead.
Place in loaf pan.
Let rise 55 minutes.
Bake at 400° for 50 minutes.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Sesame Loaf
steps: Saute onions and celery in 1/2 cup water until tender.
Blend sunflower seeds and sesame seed.
In bowl, mix together the oatmeal, blended seed, pecan meal, yeast, onion powder, garlic powder, Soy Supreme, bread crumbs, then add soy sauce, onions and celery.
Add water; mix well.
Bake in sprayed baking dish at 325° for 60 minutes until brown.
Serve with Creamy Cashew Gravy.

recipes.title: Applesauce Nut Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugars.
Add egg and mix thoroughly. Sift flour, cinnamon, salt, soda and baking powder together.
Add to creamed mixture, blending well.
Add applesauce, nuts, raisins and vanilla.
Drop by teaspoon onto a cookie sheet about 1 1/2 inches apart.
Bake in a hot oven (400°) for about 10 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Bake in greased and floured pans, about 1 hour, in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Pumpkin-Pecan Bread
steps: Combine flour, soda, salt, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice in large mixing bowl.
Make a deep well in center.
Add pumpkin, eggs, oil, water, pecans and raisins.
Mix just enough to moisten all ingredients.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Add enough milk to make dough stiff enough to drop from a teaspoon into hot deep fat.
Cook until brown and drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Chicken Jambalaya
steps: Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Brown in oil.
Remove chicken and saute onions and garlic until soft.
Add chicken and 20 cups of water.
Bring to a boil and add salt, pepper and Tabasco.
Add rice.
Bring to a boil and reduce heat to a simmer. Stir twice while cooking.
Cook until water is absorbed and chicken is tender.
Yields 24 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Casserole
steps: Combine cheese, flour, margarine and sugar.
Mix until creamy. Drain apples and pour into baking dish.
Spread cheese mixture over top.
Pour canned milk over the top of this.
Bake approximately 30 minutes at 350° or until well browned.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips
steps: In a skillet, cook chicken, onion, carrot and garlic in butter until chicken is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Slim Jim Chili
steps: Brown meat and onion in Dutch oven; drain.
Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer, covered, 1 to 2 hours.
Remove bay leaf. Serve hot.
Freezes well.
Can use crock-pot.
Makes 8 (1 cup) servings with 156 calories each.

recipes.title: Pinwheel Date Cookies
steps: To prepare filling, cook brown sugar, water and dates for 5 minutes, then add nuts.
Allow to cool.
To prepare dough, cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, then salt and flour, mixing until dough like.
Roll out dough and spread on the filling as for jelly rolls.
Roll up, chill, slice and bake at 400° until done.

recipes.title: Fabulous Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 large box instant vanilla pudding mix
steps: All fruits must be fresh, not canned or frozen.
Prepare and slice all fruit into bite size pieces.
Mix instant pudding mix powder (not prepared) with fruit and refrigerate overnight in sealed bowl.
Before serving the next day, toss lightly, mixing thoroughly.
The juice and pudding mix make a nice fruit pudding.

recipes.title: Newport Seafood Bake
ingredients: 2 c. (8 oz.) shredded Cracker Barrel brand sharp natural Cheddar cheese
1 (10 oz.) pkg. (3 c.) frozen shrimp, cooked
1 (5 oz.) can lobster, drained and cubed
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Make white sauce with margarine, flour, milk and seasonings.
Add cheese, stirring until melted.
Cook fish; skin, bone and cut in pieces.
Add fish, shrimp, lobster and sherry to sauce.
Pour into 2-quart casserole.
Toss crumbs with margarine; sprinkle on top of casserole.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Dream Bars
steps: Combine all ingredients with pastry blender or in food processor until crumbly.
Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pita Bread
ingredients: 5 to 5 1/4 c. whole wheat flour or part whole wheat and part unbleached
2 c. very warm, but not hot, water
steps: Mix ingredients together and add more flour if necessary.
Make into 2 balls.
Knead each ball, then divide into 12 smaller balls. Cover.
Let rise about 30 to 40 minutes.
Flatten balls to about 6 inches in diameter with rolling pin on a lightly floured board. Cover and let rise slightly.
Flip the dough so that the bottom side of the bread dough is on the top side of baking sheets. Preheat oven as hot as it bakes.
Place sheet on lowest rack.
Bake about 2 to 4 minutes.
Makes 24 pita breads.

recipes.title: Country Fair Corn Sticks
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease well 14 corn stick molds.
Place in oven while preparing batter.
In large bowl, mix corn meal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
In small skillet, add oil and cook pepper and onions until tender.
Remove skillet from heat.
Stir in corn and milk, then egg until mixed; stir into dry ingredients until batter is just blended.
Spoon batter into preheated molds.
Bake 15 minutes or until done.
Cool in molds on wire rack 5 minutes.
Remove from molds.

recipes.title: Scallops, Shrimp And Snow Peas
steps: Saute shrimp and scallops in small batches in a wok until done (shrimp first, then scallops; scallops take a few minutes to cook).
Set aside in dish, keeping warm.
Put a bit more oil in wok.
Quickly saute garlic, green onions and peppers, then add snow peas and continue sauteing.
Saute until peas are bright green and are cooked, yet crunchy.
Add scallops and shrimp.
Add broth, soy sauce and spices.
Thicken with a mixture of cornstarch and water (1/2 cup water and 1 tablespoon cornstarch).
Cook for about 7 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Blueberry-Lemon Muffins
steps: Stir together flour, sugar, baking powder and 3/4 teaspoon salt.
Combine egg, milk and oil.
Add all at once to flour mixture.
Stir until moistened.
Fold in blueberries which have been mixed with 2 tablespoons sugar, the peel of 1 lemon and the juice of that lemon.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup margarine (or substitute equal amount of applesauce)
steps: Combine and let stand Bran Buds and boiling water.
Cream sugar, margarine, eggs, then add buttermilk, flour sifted with baking soda, salt and All-Bran cereal.
Add first mixture of bran buds and boiling water and combine with second mixture.

recipes.title: Best Yet Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients by hand. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan (greased only).
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Crawfish Etouffee
ingredients: salt and cayenne pepper to taste
steps: Saute onions and sweet peppers in butter or margarine for 5 minutes.
Add cream of mushroom soup.
Add few tablespoons of water, if necessary.
Add scallions, parsley, salt, pepper and paprika to taste.
Add crawfish tails; cook 5 minutes or until done.
Serve over white rice.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Pork Chops
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large ovenproof skillet, brown chops in oil.
Remove chops from skillet.
Pour off fat.
In skillet, combine ReaLemon and cornstarch.
Mix well.
Add sugar, onion, soy sauce and bouillon.
Let bouillon dissolve.
Add pork chops and carrots.
Cover.
Bake 1 hour or until tender.
Add pineapple chunks.
Cover and bake 10 minutes longer.
Garnish with green pepper.
Serve with rice if desired.
Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix sugar, flour and cocoa and add enough milk to make it like a paste.
Then add the egg yolks and beat well.
Then add the balance of the milk and cook on top of the stove until thick.
Add butter and vanilla.
Pour into baked pie shell.

recipes.title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
steps: Pare and quarter potatoes.
Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in a bag.
Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few at a time in the bag, coating potatoes well with cheese mixture.
Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Place potatoes in pan.
Bake at 375 ° for about 1 hour, turning once during baking when golden brown.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 400°. Grease (12) muffin tin. Beat egg, then stir in milk and oil. Blend dry ingredients, then add the wet ingredients, stirring until moist. Add berries and fold in. Fill tins and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: One Pot Dinner
steps: Brown beef; drain and put in cooker.
Brown bacon and onion; drain.
Add to cooker.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cook on low 4 to 6 hours.

recipes.title: Yummy Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients, except soup; shape into balls and place on a greased baking dish.
Pour the soup, thinned with water over the Yummy Balls and bake for 1 hour at 375°.

recipes.title: Chicken-Rice Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas and carrots, thawed
1 (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) ready to broiler-fryer chicken, cut up
steps: In bowl, stir together mushroom soup, milk, dry onion soup mix and undrained mushrooms.
Reserve 1/2 cup of the soup mixture and set aside.
Stir uncooked rice and thawed vegetables into remaining soup mixture.

recipes.title: Apple Candy Pie
steps: Put apples in baking dish (greased) and sprinkle with cinnamon and 1/2 cup brown sugar.
Add water.
Melt butter and add it to 1/2 cup brown sugar and flour.
Mix well and put on top of apple mixture, patting it down firmly.
Bake 3/4 hour to one hour in 350° oven.
Serve with cream.

recipes.title: Quick Lunch Box Cake
steps: In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except chocolate and nuts.
Blend at low speed until moistened; beat 2 minutes at medium speed, scraping bowl occasionally.
Add chocolate and nuts and mix.
Pour batter into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until cake springs back when touched lightly in center.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Muffins
steps: Mix all dry ingredients thoroughly (do not sift). Add shortening, unbeaten egg and sour milk.
Beat only until smooth. Fill well oiled muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake in hot oven at 425° about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Buster Dessert
steps: Mix together butter and pat 3/4 of the cookie crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cover with 1/2 gallon of vanilla ice cream that has been softened.
Put in freezer until firm.
Before serving, cover with fudge topping (not syrup); sprinkle with peanuts and cover with Cool Whip.
Use the 1/4 cup of Oreo cookies on top.

recipes.title: Blueberry Pie (Low-Fat)
steps: Place first 3 ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a good boil.
Heat oven to 350°.
Melt oleo in a Dutch oven.
Mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, milk and vanilla and pour mixture over oleo.
Using a cup, pour berries over the mixture. Bake at 350° until done, about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Allison'S Peach Crisp
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Put peach slices in square casserole dish.
In separate bowl, work together the sugar, flour, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and margarine until crumbly.
Add the lemon rind and mix.
Sprinkle over top of fruit.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven until the peaches are tender and the top is browned.
This takes about 20 to 30 minutes.
Enjoy!
Serves 6 to 8 people.

recipes.title: Cheese Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 10 oz. pkg. frozen veggies (broccoli mix is good)
steps: Cook veggies to your liking.
Saute onion in margarine. Blend in flour, salt and pepper.
Stir in the milk.
Gradually heat to boiling;
stir constantly. Reduce heat and add remaining ingredients (broth, cheese, mustard).
Heat thoroughly.

recipes.title: Oven-Fried Chicken
steps: Heat oven to 425°.
In oven, melt shortening in baking pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch).
Measure flour, salt, paprika and pepper into paper or plastic bag.
Shake 2 or 3 chicken pieces at a time in bag until thoroughly coated.
Place skin side down in shortening. Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes.
Turn chicken and bake until tender, 20 to 30 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Hoppin' John
steps: In a large skillet, saute onion, celery and garlic in hot olive oil until onion is soft.
Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat to a boil; reduce heat and cover tightly.
Simmer 30 to 40 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Makes about 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Bars
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Grease and flour baking pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch).
Mix sugars, margarine and vanilla.
Beat in egg.
Stir in flour, baking soda and salt.
Mix in nuts and chocolate chips. Spread dough in pan.
Bake until light brown, 12 to 14 minutes. Cool; cut into bars (about 2 x 1 1/2 inches).
Makes 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Pickled Peaches
ingredients: 3 qt. peaches (about 18 whole peaches), peeled (use cling peaches; Indian peaches real red)
steps: Place whole
peeled
peaches in lightly salted water to soak and prevent darkening,
no
more
than 20 minutes.
Bring water and sugar to a
boil
in pot.
Add pickling spice.
Keep boiling. Drop peaches in hot liquid;
they will change color. Spoon peaches into hot
sterilized jars.
Cover with syrup and seal.
Try small pod of hot pepper in a few jars.

recipes.title: Peas And Rice
ingredients: 1/4 lb. salt pork, chopped fine, fat from a baked ham or bacon drippings
1 c. canned tomatoes or 2 Tbsp. tomato paste
1 c. pigeon peas or black-eyed peas
steps: Fry salt pork to get the fat.
Add onion, tomato, salt, pepper and thyme.
Stir all together and continue cooking.
Add peas and 3 cups water.
Let come to a boil and stir in rice.
Cover and cook until rice is tender and water absorbed.
Add another cup of water and cover to swell the rice.
Add more water, if needed. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Raspberry Crisscross Cookies
steps: Sift dry ingredients; cut in shortening as for pie.
Add eggs and milk.
Keep 1/4 of dough out.
Spread rest on 10 x 15-inch cake tin.
Press dough well up along side of pan.
Spread with jam. Sprinkle with nuts.
Pinch off pieces of reserved dough with palms of hands and make 1/2-inch strips.
Place on top for crisscross at 1 1/2 inches apart.
Bake at 350° to 375° for 45 minutes.
Let cool in pan.
Cut with sharp knife in center of each strip so that each piece has dough around.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Bubble Up Pizza
ingredients: 1 c. fresh mushrooms, sliced or small can
steps: Preheat oven to 375°. Chop all ingredients, then add sauce mix. Cut biscuits in half, then in half again. Then mix with spaghetti sauce. Put in 13 x 9 pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 375° for 23 to 28 minutes.

recipes.title: Viennese Brownies
steps: In a bowl, combine softened cream cheese, sugar and 1 egg.
Add almond extract; set aside.
In small saucepan melt chocolate and butter together.
Cool.
Beat 2 eggs.
Add sugar and chocolate mixture.
Beat in sifted and combined flour, baking powder and salt.
Pour half the chocolate mixture into a well-greased and floured square baking pan (8-inches).
Gently spread the cream cheese mixture.
Top with remaining chocolate mixture.
Bake in 350° oven 45 to 50 minutes, until cake tester inserted in center comes away clean.
Cool in pan before cutting into rectangles or squares.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Cake
steps: Mix together the dry ingredients. Add eggs, pumpkin and oil. Blend in nuts. Grease and flour 9-inch cake pans.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
You may use a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Texas Hash
steps: Brown meat, pepper and onion in large skillet.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Stir once or twice during baking.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Apple Dish
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Lightly grease 8-inch glass baking dish.
Place half of apples in dish; top with corn syrup.
Add remaining apples, lemon juice, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and nutmeg. Combine 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, sugar, salt, butter, flour and oatmeal.
Mix well and press firmly over apples.
Bake 50 minutes. Top with ice cream and serve.

recipes.title: Green Bean Roll-Ups
steps: Drain juice from green beans and reserve.
Cut bacon in half. In each slice of bacon, roll up 3 or 4 green beans.
Secure bacon with toothpicks.
Add part of green bean juice to the roll-ups after placing the roll-ups in a baking pan.
Season with salt and pepper.
Bake until bacon browns.

recipes.title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
steps: Cream sugars, butter and peanut butter in bowl with electric mixer.
Beat in eggs, milk and vanilla.
Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Stir into egg batter.
Shape into balls; roll in additional granulated sugar.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove from oven and immediately press a chocolate kiss into each cookie.
Cool on wire racks.
Makes 7 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix in order given and bake at 350° until lightly browned or until done.

recipes.title: Kraut Soup
steps: Boil pork chops and potatoes until cooked.
Saute onion in pan and roll in flour.
Add 1 large can of tomatoes and string kraut.

recipes.title: Gingersnap Cookies
steps: In large bowl, beat together sugar and shortening; add molasses.
Mix well.
Add beaten egg.
Stir together all remaining ingredients.
Mix into molasses mixture until thoroughly combined. Cover and chill at least 1 hour or overnight.
Roll dough into 1-inch balls, then place balls into granulated
sugar.
Place balls 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Frog Eye Salad
ingredients: 8 oz. acini de pepe (a BB size pasta product)
2 (11 oz. each) cans mandarin oranges, drained
steps: Combine sugar, flour and salt; gradually stir in egg and pineapple juice.
Cook over moderate heat, stirring until thickened.
Add lemon juice.
Cool to room temperature.
Bring water to boiling point with salt according to directions on acini de pepe box.
Add oil and cook acini de pepe only until tender but firm.
Drain and rinse well with cold water.
Combine egg mixture with acini de pepe, mixing lightly.
Refrigerate overnight in an airtight container.
The next morning, add remaining ingredients. Mix lightly but thoroughly.
Refrigerate in airtight container until well chilled.
Salad may be refrigerated for a week, if desired.

recipes.title: Key Lime Cake With Frosting
steps: Mix together all ingredients.
Pour into a greased and floured 9x13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Children'S Edible Play Dough
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
If it gets too sticky, put in a little flour.
Feeds six children.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
ingredients: 1 pkg. Royal toasted coconut pudding mix
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Pour into greased and floured 3 loaf pans size 7 1/2 x 3 x 2-inch.
Bake at 325° for 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Very good served with fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Quesidillas(Kay-Sa-De-Ya)
steps: Soften cream cheese; then add olives and enough salsa to make mixture pink.
Place 1 tortilla on plate (or server) and spread cheese mixture; repeat process ending with tortilla on top.
Cut into small slices like pie.
For garnish, fasten stuffed olive on each slice with toothpick.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Melt butter and chocolate in double boiler; cool.
Beat eggs and salt until light and foamy.
Gradually add sugar and vanilla and continue beating until well creamed.
With a few strokes (mix manually), combine chocolate into egg/sugar mixture.
Before mixture becomes uniformly colored, fold in flour.
Again, before mixing is uniformly colored, gently stir in pecans or walnuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
steps: Cream together shortening and peanut butter.
Add sugars and mix well.
Add egg, milk and vanilla.
Add flour, baking soda and salt.
Mix well.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients well and bring to a boil.
Blend to the mixture the remaining ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Malaysian Beef
ingredients: 1 tsp. garlic powder or 2 cloves garlic, crushed
steps: Cut meat into 1/2-inch strips.
Mix together ginger, chili powder, garlic and lemon rind.
Dip meat into mixture and brown in butter.
Combine sugar, jam, lemon juice, salt and 1 1/2 cups water.
Add meat and simmer 30 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Combine milk, margarine, sugar and salt in microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave on High until margarine melts.
When lukewarm, add yeast.
Stir in flour.
Let rise 1 hour and 20 minutes.
Roll into balls.
Dip in melted butter.
Place balls in baking pan. Let rise 45 minutes.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.
Cool in pan for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Elephant Ears
steps: Stir flour, 2 tbsp. sugar, baking soda, and salt. Stir in milk and 3 tbsp. of melted butter. Mix until dough forms.
Sprinkle surface lightly with flour. Knead dough 10 times.
Roll dough, with rolling pin into a rectangle 9x5 inches.

Brush with remaining melted butter. Sprinkle mixture of 3 tbsp. sugar and cinnamon. Roll dough up tightly, beginning at narrow end. Pinch end of dough to seal. Cut into 4 equal pieces. Place cut side up on greased cookie sheet. Pat into circle. Sprinkle with more sugar. Bake at 425° for 8 to 10 min. Remove from cookie sheet immediately. Let cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shake
ingredients: sugar substitute to equal 2 Tbsp. sugar
steps: Combine skim milk, strawberries, orange juice and sugar substitute in container of an electric blender or food processor. Process until strawberries are pureed and mixture is frothy. Transfer mixture to a small pitcher.
Stir in buttermilk.
Pour into individual glasses and serve immediately.
Diabetic Exchange: 1 skim milk.
Each serving amount:
1 cup.
Calories:

recipes.title: Salted Pumpkin Seeds
steps: Boil dry seeds for 5 minutes.
Spray baking sheet with pam. spread seeds on baking sheet.
Sprinkle with salt.
Bake at 350 degrees until dry. Serve warm or cool.

recipes.title: Coca-Cola Cake
steps: Combine flour, sugar and cocoa in mixing bowl.
Heat cola and oleo to boiling point.
Pour over flour mixture.
Add eggs, buttermilk, soda and vanilla.
Mix well.
Add marshmallows and stir with spoon until they are coated.
Pour into greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Pour into two 8-inch pie shells or 1 large pie shell.
Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Bake
steps: Place rice on bottom of casserole dish. Place uncooked chicken on top of rice. Pour onion soup mix over chicken. Mix milk, soup and 1 soup can of water together. Pour over top of all. Bake at 325° for 1 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Sift first 5 ingredients together.
Beat eggs; add sugar, oil and pumpkin.
Mix dry ingredients gradually into liquid mixture. Pour into four (1 pound) coffee cans.
Bake at 350°
for 1 hour. Remove while warm and wrap in foil.

recipes.title: Peachy Cobbler
steps: Arrange drained peaches in a square baking pan.
Pour lemon juice and spread brown sugar over peaches.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
steps: Mix flour, sugar and salt in a bowl; set aside.
Bring the oleo, cocoa and water to a boil and add to the flour mixture.
Mix together the remaining ingredients and add to the other mixture. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes, in a well-greased cookie sheet pan.

recipes.title: Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Cut olives into large pieces.
Cut bacon into 1/4-inch strips and cook slowly until crisp.
When bacon is half done, add onion and cook until soft.
Drain off fat.
Combine bacon and onion with eggs, celery and olives.
Add mayonnaise.
Mix.
Stuff tomatoes and serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: Banana Pound Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
Combine cake mix, pudding, eggs, oil, 3/4 cup water and bananas.
Mix well.
Pour into greased and lightly floured bundt pan.
Bake for 1 hour. Meanwhile, combine sugar, margarine and 1/4 cup water in sauce pan.
Bring to a boil, and remove from heat.
When cake is done, immediately pour sauce slowly over cake, allowing time for it to be absorbed.
Leave cake in pan for 20 minutes before removing.

recipes.title: Savory Fried Chicken
steps: Rinse chicken and pat dry.
In large bag, combine flour and seasonings.
In shallow bowl, beat eggs and water.
Place chicken a few pieces at a time in bag and shake to coat.
Dip in eggs and shake in bag again.
Fry chicken until done.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Biscuit Topped Italian Casserole
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) pkg. Green Giant harvest fresh frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
1 (10 oz.) can Hungry Jack refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Grease 12 x 8-inch (2-quart) baking dish. In large skillet, brown ground beef and onion.
Drain.
Stir in water, pepper, tomato sauce, and tomato paste.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vegetables and 1 1/2 cups cheese.
Spoon mixture into greased baking dish.
Separate dough into 10 biscuits.
Separate each biscuit into 2 layers.
Place biscuits near outer edge of hot meat mixture, overlapping slightly.
Sprinkle remaining cheese in center and around edge. Gently brush biscuits with margarine and sprinkle with oregano. Bake for 22 to 27 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

recipes.title: Rice And Broccoli Dish
steps: Saute chopped onion in melted margarine until tender.
Add the mushroom soup.
Cut up 1/3 of a small box of Velveeta or American cheese.
Add to onion and soup mixture.
Melt cheese with mixture. Add 2 cups cooked rice and 10 ounces of frozen broccoli (thawed and drained).
Pour in buttered casserole dish and top with cracker crumbs.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Crunch
steps: Blend first 5 ingredients like pie dough. Put half in 8 inch square pan. Mix remaining ingredients. Spread on crumbs. Put remaining crumbs on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Drop Sugar Cookies
steps: Drop on greased sheet.
Bake at 375°.

recipes.title: Shrimp Gumbo
ingredients: 3 c. okra, chopped or 1 Tbsp. file
steps: Peel shrimp (uncooked) and devein.
Make roux (dark) of flour and oil.
Add shrimp to this for a few minutes, stirring constantly.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Rachel'S Fruit Cake
ingredients: 1 lb. pitted dates, cut in half
steps: Chop nuts.
Place all nuts, drained cherries and dates in a large bowl.
Sift flour, baking powder, salt and sugar together. Coat the fruit and nuts with dry ingredients.
Add vanilla to eggs and pour over coated fruit and nuts; mix well.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
steps: Mix coconut and pecans and press into a greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan.
Prepare cake mix as directed.
Pour over coconut and pecan mixture.
Melt butter and cream cheese.
Add powdered sugar.
Mix well and drop by tablespoons on top of cake batter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or when cracks form in center of cake.
Do not overcook.
No icing needed.

recipes.title: Surprise Muffins
steps: Sift flour.
Beat eggs in 2 cup measuring cup with wire whisk. Whisk
in	milk and oil. Stir just until moistened. Do not beat. Fill
greased
and floured muffin pan 2/3 full. For Surprise Muffins, fill 1/2 full, then drop 1 teaspoon of jelly or preserves in center. Add more batter to make 2/3 full. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Autumn Pudding
steps: Blend all ingredients together.
Pour into a 13x9 inch pan. Top with topping mix.

recipes.title: Sponge Cake Roll
ingredients: 1/4 Cup Orange Marmalade or Spreadable Fruit
steps: Let egg whites stand at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Sift flour and salt and set aside.
Coat a 15x10x1 baking pan with nonstick cooking spray.
Line with wax paper and coat the paper with spray.
In a mixing bowl, beat yolks until slightly thickened. Gradually add sugar and beating until thick and lemony colored. Add orange peel, lemon juice and vanilla.
Add sifted flour mixture and mix well.
Batter will be thick.
In another bowl beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
Fold into batter.
Spread into prepared pan.
Bake at 350 for 12-15 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched in center.
Cool on wire rack 5 minutes. Turn onto a kitchen towel.
Sprinkle with 1 Tbsp. powdered sugar. Gently pull wax paper off and roll cake up jelly roll style, starting with short side.
Cool completely on wire rack.
Unroll cake- spread marmalade evenly over cake within 1/2 inch of edges. Roll up again, seam side down.
Sprinkle with remaining sugar. Wrap and place in refrigerator one hour.
Servings 8 - 5 Points.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake
steps: Mix flour and brown sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Cut in the Parkay and add the nuts. Mix in egg and soda. Press half of mixture in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Chocolate Dream Bars
steps: Mix until crumbly.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until golden brown and firm.

recipes.title: Fresh Tomato Soup
ingredients: 8 or 9 ripe tomatoes, skinned and coarsely chopped
2 qt. milk or part half and half
steps: Simmer tomatoes in large saucepan for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and add 1/4 cup butter, soda, 1 teaspoon salt and sugar.
Let cool during preparation of next step.
Melt the remaining 1/4 cup butter in large kettle.
Add flour and 2 teaspoons salt.
Add milk; heat and stir to boiling point.
Combine the two mixtures and heat slowly.
Add salt, if needed, and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Chicken Spread
steps: Cook chicken in unsalted water to cover until tender.
Remove from broth, reserving 2 tablespoons broth.
Cool.
Bone chicken; chop fine.
Combine cheese and mayonnaise, beating until smooth. Add onion, pickle juice, celery, curry powder, salt, pepper, pimiento, hot sauce and garlic powder; mix well.
Stir in chicken and broth.
Serve on crackers or lettuce leaves.
Each tablespoon contains about 22 calories.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
steps: Combine cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and egg.
Mix well. Spread on bottom of deep 9-inch unbaked pie shell.
Combine canned or cooked pumpkin, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt.
Mix well.
Blend in beaten egg and evaporated milk.
Carefully pour over cream cheese mixture.
Bake at 350° for 65 to 70 minutes or until done.
Cool.
May be topped with Cool Whip or cream.

recipes.title: Southern Pecan Pie
steps: Refrigerate prepared pie shell.
Preheat oven to 350°.
In bowl, beat eggs well.
Add sugar, syrup, flour, salt and vanilla. Combine well.
Stir in butter and nuts.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake 60 minutes or until filling is set in center.
May cover crimped pie crust edges with foil so edges don't overcook.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
steps: Cube steak and brown in skillet with garlic and pepper and a little oil.
Add soy sauce and water.
Cover and cook 20 minutes. Add sliced bell peppers and onions.
Cook 10 minutes.
Add 1 teaspoon cornstarch and cold water to thicken.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Apple Bars
steps: Sift flour, salt and baking soda together.
Add brown sugar and rolled oats.
Cut in margarine until crumbly.
Spread half the mixture in a greased 7 x 11-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake Or Bread
steps: Mix eggs, oil, sugar together and add pumpkin.
Mix well. Mix flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and baking powder together and add to wet ingredients.
Fold in nuts or raisins.
Bake in floured bundt pan or loaf pans for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Green Bean And Radish Salad In Sour Cream Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 c. thin sliced radishes (red and white)
steps: Bring plenty of lightly salted water to a boil.
Add the beans and cook until just tender, about 6 or 7 minutes.
Drain and run under cold water to stop further cooking.
Transfer the beans to a serving bowl.
Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon vinegar, sour cream and oil.
Whisk the dressing until smooth.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Add the radishes, scallions and dressing to the beans. Toss the salad gently with 2 spoons.
Let the salad marinate at room temperature for 2 hours before serving.
Turn salad to lunch dish by adding smoked turkey, Swiss cheese or smoked ham, cut into julienne strips.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Cut
and
dice	chicken
breasts;
season with seasoned salt, pepper
and
Mrs. Dash.
Cook slowly in slightly greased frying pan; do not brown meat.
Simmer until done; may substitute chicken with
shrimp or beef.
Set aside.	Chop and cook green onions
in slightly greased pan (drain any excess oil); set
aside. Scramble
eggs
with about 1 tablespoon of cooked green
onions; set
aside.
Begin	frying cooked rice (do not boil rice too long) in butter.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
steps: All spices should be dehydrated.
Mix together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Popovers
steps: Put flour and salt in bowl.
Add milk and eggs.
Beat with a rotary beater for 3 minutes.
Add melted butter and stir.
Put in well-greased muffin tins (have tins hot).
Bake in hot oven at 350° for 40 minutes.
Yield will be 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Frozen Lemon Crumb Dessert
steps: Mix flour, brown sugar, margarine and nuts until crumbly. Spread on cookie sheet lined with heavy-duty Reynolds Wrap.
Bake in 350° oven for 13 to 15 minutes.
Cool; break apart into crumbs. Line an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2-inch loaf pan with heavy-duty aluminum foil, leaving a 1 1/2-inch collar around top.
Spread 2/3 of crumb mixture in bottom.
Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon color; blend in condensed milk.
Add lemon juice and rind; stir until thickened.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Fold into lemon mixture.
Pour mixture into prepared pan; sprinkle remaining crumbs on top.
Freeze until firm.
When solid, cover with piece of foil the size of the top.
Lift from pan and return to freezer. Slice in bars to serve.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Cookies
steps: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla, then add potato chips and nuts; mix well.
Stir in flour.
Form into balls and press flat with the bottom of a sugar-coated glass on a cookie sheet.
Bake 12 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
steps: Layer ingredients in 8-inch square pan, starting with rice. Cover and bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 can mushrooms (use half of the juice)
steps: Put the ingredients in a Corning Ware dish in the listed order. Do not stir.
Dot 1/2 stick margarine on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Beat first 5 ingredients together until smooth.
Add apple and nuts.
Mix well.
Pour in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Best (And Easy!) Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and flour.
Beat for 10 minutes.
Pour batter into greased and floured tube cake pan. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 300° until golden brown and toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Great with strawberries and whipped cream or for wedding cakes.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Beat the first 3 ingredients well, then beat in the baking soda, orange peel, salt and flour.
Mix in the apples and walnuts. Bake at 350° in a greased and floured Bundt pan for 50 to 55 minutes. Cake is done when toothpick comes out clean.
Invert onto rack after cooling for 10 minutes.
Serve plain or iced.

recipes.title: Carol'S Pumpkin Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix margarine and sugar thoroughly.
Add eggs, pumpkin and water.
Blend in flour, soda, salt, baking powder, cinnamon and cloves.
Stir in nuts and raisins.
Pour into a well-greased loaf pan, 9 x 5 x 3-inch.
Bake 65 to 70 minutes until toothpick stuck into center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Boiled Tongue
steps: Scrub tongue well.
Cover with boiling water and bring to a boil.
Skim, cover and simmer until tender, 3 to 4 hours.
Add 1/2 teaspoon salt per pound when partially cooked.
Remove skin when tender.
To 2 cups strained water in which tongue has been boiled, add the rest of the ingredients.
Blend together to form sauce.
Place tongue in roasting pan; pour over sauce.
Cover and bake 30 minutes at 350°, turning often.

recipes.title: Dietetic Date Cake
steps: Cream butter; add sweetener, vanilla and egg.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Add to mixture.
Add applesauce, dates and nuts.
Bake 1 hour at 350° in loaf pan.

recipes.title: Veal Cutlets
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. veal or pork, cut into 4 slices
steps: Pound meat.
Sprinkle with salt.
Dip first in flour, then in eggs and then in bread crumbs.
Fry in butter or oil until brown. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken Supreme
ingredients: 4 c. cooked chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
