1 c. undiluted cream of chicken soup
steps: Mix all ingredients in a glass 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate overnight.
(If you use an aluminum pan, store ingredients in a glass bowl and transfer just before baking).
Sprinkle crushed potato chips over top and bake in 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Hamburger Stroganoff
steps: Cook onion in butter until transparent.
Add ground beef. Cook, stirring until beef is light brown.
Add the flour, salt, pepper, mushrooms and soup.
Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the sour cream and simmer for 15 minutes longer.
Serve over cooked rice or cooked egg noodles.
Garnish with paprika.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Easter Lily
steps: Mix all together.
Drop on greased cookie sheet (about 1 teaspoon), six on sheet.
Bake at 350°
for 7 minutes.
Pinch together while hot in the shape of a lily.
Fill open end with Cool Whip and cherry.

recipes.title: Marinated Steak
ingredients: 1 thick flank steak or London broil (about 1 1/2 lb.)
steps: Mix together the wine, soy sauce and seasonings.
Place the steak in a long glass baking dish and pour the marinade over the meat.
Cover and chill at least 12 to 18 hours, turning the meat over once or twice.
Preheat the broiler.
Remove the steak from the marinade.
Pat dry and broil 4-inches from the heat for about 5 minutes on each side.
To serve, cut thin slices diagonally across the grain.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: 6 Weeks Bran Muffins
ingredients: 15 to 20 oz. box Raisin Bran (7 1/2 c.)
steps: Mix in very large bowl Raisin Bran, sugar, flour and salt. Add soda, cinnamon, beaten eggs, oil and 1 quart of buttermilk; mix well.
Stir all the way to the bottom; refrigerate.
Do not stir again.
Fill muffin tins 2/3 full.
Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes.
Keep in refrigerator for 6 weeks.
Use just what you need each time.
Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen mixed vegetables or canned
steps: Mix well.
Place mixture into one pie shell.
Place the other pie shell on top.
Brush top with butter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. (10 oz. pkg.) frozen strawberries, sliced
steps: Mix and blend well.
Bake at 300° to 350° for 30 minutes or longer.

recipes.title: Pineapple Spoon Bread
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb. can (2 1/2 c.) crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Grease 2-quart casserole. Mix sugar, flour and salt. Beat in eggs. Add pineapple. Pour in pan. Tear bread or croissants into pieces and spread over mixture.
Pour melted butter over bread. Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour or until it stops jiggling.

recipes.title: Gingerbread
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. all-purpose flour or cake flour
steps: Heat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour a baking pan 9 x 9 x 2-inches.
Mix all ingredients except whipped cream or applesauce in a large mixer bowl.
Blend 1/2 minute on low speed, scraping the bowl constantly.
Beat 3 minutes on medium speed scraping occasionally.
Pour into the pan.
Bake 50 minutes.
Serve warm with whipped cream or applesauce.

recipes.title: Corn Puddings
ingredients: 1 can yellow whole kernel corn (12 oz.)
steps: Mix flour and sugar together.
Stir in corn and all other ingredients.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Bake until thick, but not too dry (approximately 30 minutes at 350°).

recipes.title: Smoky Sausage Spread
ingredients: 3 large smoked sausage links, fully cooked
1 (8 oz.) jar cheese spread with jalapenos
sliced bread, bagels or English muffins
steps: Cut up cooked sausage links in small, fine pieces; set aside. Combine cheese spread and Monterey Jack cheese; beat with mixer until well combined.
Stir in sausage.
Spread on bread, bagels or English muffins.
Bake at 350° for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Pilau
ingredients: 3 small or 1 large can mushrooms, sliced and browned
steps: Cook hen with celery, bay leaves, salt, pepper and enough water to cover.
When the chicken is ready to fall from the bones, remove from broth; set aside.

recipes.title: A Fall Supper
steps: Brown slices of country ham in ample grease (I use Crisco). Remove ham.
Brown flour very brown, put a lot of black pepper in pan and add tomato juice.
Add water to desired consistency and simmer.
Fry apples in a frying pan, adding sugar and bacon drippings until done (add a bit of salt).
Add a pan full of steaming hot biscuits that contain chunks of cheese in the center. Together with grits and lots of the tasty tomato gravy you will have a feast incomparable.

recipes.title: Lattice Jam Bars
ingredients: 1/4 lb. chopped almonds, crushed is best
1/2 lb. each: sugar, butter and flour
steps: Mix together the almonds and sugar.
Blend in butter and flour.
Mix well.
Add egg yolks.
Roll dough to 1/2-inch thick. Save half for cross bars.
Spread on cookie sheet, then spread 1 pound apricot jam over dough.
Make cross bars by rolling out dough and cutting into strips.
Crisscross strips on top of jam to give lattice effect.
Bake in a 350°
oven about 30 minutes, or until light brown.
Great!

recipes.title: Chicken Or Turkey Strata
ingredients: 2 c. skinned, cooked and cubed turkey or chicken
steps: Place bread cubes in 12 x 18-inch nonstick pan.
Combine chicken, onion, celery, chilies, mayonnaise, salt and pepper in medium bowl and spoon over bread.
Tear tortillas into bite-sized pieces and place on top.
Combine eggs, milk, cottage cheese and soup in a small bowl and pour over top.
Cover and refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to blend.
Preheat oven to 325° and bake 50 to 60 minutes or until the dish is firm and set.
Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes before serving.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of potato soup, undiluted
1 (17 oz.) can reduced sodium whole kernel corn, drained
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat until thoroughly heated, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle each serving with crumbled bacon and green onions.
Makes 1-quart.

recipes.title: Applesauce-Raisin Cookies(Diabetic)
steps: Sift flour, soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon into a bowl.
Add rolled oats and raisins.
Mix applesauce, oil, egg, vanilla and sweetener together.
Add to dry ingredients; mix just until moistened.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes, or until done.
Yields 2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Scalloped Pineapple
ingredients: 2 (20 oz.)( cans chunk pineapple, drained but reserve liquid
steps: Butter a 2-quart casserole.
Put 1 can of pineapple on bottom of dish.
Mix cheeses together and sprinkle half of cheese mixture on top of pineapple.
Mix flour and sugar and sprinkle on cheese. Follow with second can of pineapple and the remaining half of flour-sugar mixture, leaving remaining half of cheese mixture for top.
Pour 1/2 cup pineapple juice over entire dish and dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbly and brown.

recipes.title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Combine Crisco, brown sugar, egg, milk and vanilla in large bowl.
Beat at medium speed until well blended.
Combine oats, flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.
Mix into creamed mixture at a low speed.
Stir in raisins.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Mix all together; drop and bake at 350° to 375°.
Makes lots.

recipes.title: Tortilla Pinwheels
steps: Mix all together.
Spread over tortillas; roll up.
Wrap tightly in plastic.
Refrigerate overnight.
Cut 1/2 to 3/4-inch and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Fried Fish
steps: Cut fillets in 4-inch portions.
Season with salt and pepper. Mix nuts and cayenne.
Dip fillets in egg and water mix; roll in flour.
Fry in butter in skillet or microwave 5 minutes with nut mix sprinkled over fillets.

recipes.title: Brown Rice
steps: Melt margarine.
Add other ingredients and stir together. Pour into a glass casserole dish and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Egg Custard
ingredients: 2 c. sweet milk or 1 large evaporated milk
steps: Melt butter in a pie plate.
Beat eggs with mixer (eggs only); then mix in sugar, flour, sweet milk, vanilla and butter.
Bake at 350° about 30 minutes or until middle is done.

recipes.title: Chili-Cheese Rounds
ingredients: 1 can (4 oz.) whole green chilies, drained, seeded and chopped
1 c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese (about 4 oz.)
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Mix beans, onion and pepper sauce; reserve.
Mix baking mix and sour cream until soft dough forms; beat vigorously 20 strokes.
Gently smooth dough into ball on floured cloth covered board.
Knead 20 times.
Roll dough 1/4 inch thick.
Cut with floured 2-inch cutter.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press a deep indention about 1 1/2 inches in diameter in center of each round with floured hands.
Fill each with generous teaspoon of bean mixture; spread within indention. Top each with chilies and cheese.
Bake until light brown, 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Honey Cornbread
steps: Combine dry ingredients.
Beat eggs, add cream, oil and honey.
Stir into dry ingredients until just moistened.
Pour into 9 inch square pan.
Bake at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Lightly grease a 2-quart casserole. Wash, pare and thinly slice potatoes; measure 8 cups.
Cook potatoes and onions, covered in small amount of boiling water, with 2 teaspoon salt, for about 5 minutes or until slightly tender.
Drain.
Melt butter or margarine in saucepan; remove from heat.
Stir in flour, pepper, paprika and remaining salt until smooth.
Blend in milk.
Cook, stirring, over medium heat to boiling point or until thickened and smooth.
In prepared casserole, layer one-third of potatoes and onions; sprinkle with 1 tablespoon parsley.
Top with one-third of the sauce.
Repeat, then add remaining potatoes and top with remaining sauce.
Bake, uncovered, for 35 minutes, or until top is browned and potatoes are tender when pierced with fork.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Lemon Squares
ingredients: 2 c. sugar, mixed with 1/4 c. flour
steps: Melt margarine with 2 cups flour and 1/2 cup powdered sugar. Put into 13 x 9-inch pan (greased) and press on bottom and sides to form crust.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes.
Beat eggs; add sugar, mixed with 1/4 cup flour and the lemon juice.
Pour this over baked crust.
Return to oven and bake 20 minutes longer.
Remove from oven; sprinkle with powdered sugar while hot.
Let cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Creamy Rice Pudding
steps: Combine rice, sugar, 6 cups milk and water.
Bring to a boil. Cook 1 hour, covered, over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Mix together the eggs, vanilla and 2 cups milk.
Add to the heated rice mixture and heat an additional 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Position rack in center of oven and preheat oven to 350°. Line baking sheets with parchment paper or coat with nonstick cooking spray.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sugar, applesauce, egg white, oil and vanilla until smooth.
Stir in raisins.
In a medium size bowl, stir together the oats, cake flour, whole wheat flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.
Using a wooden spoon, stir the dry ingredients into the wet, mixing just until blended.
Drop the dough by tablespoonfuls onto a prepared baking sheet, spacing cookies about 1 1/2 inches apart.
Bake for about 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Transfer cookies to a wire rack; let cool.
Makes 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
ingredients: 12 slices bacon, crisply fried and crumbled
2 c. light cream or whipping cream
steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Prepare pastry for 9-inch crust.
Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in pastry-lined pie pan.
Blend remaining ingredients with mixer.
Pour into pie pan.
Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300°.
Bake pie 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1 inch from edge comes out clean.
Let pie stand 10 minutes before cutting.
Serve in wedges.

recipes.title: Cottage Herb Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, oregano and salt.
Mix well.
Cut in cold margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Blend in cheese, egg and yeast. Turn out on well floured surface.
Knead.
Shape into ball.
Place in well-greased bowl.
Brush top with melted margarine; cover. Let rise until doubled.
Punch down.
Shape as desired.
Brush with melted margarine; cover.
Let rise again until nearly doubled.
Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Serve warm.
Yield: 1 1/2 to 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
ingredients: chicken parts (8 thighs or legs or 4 breasts)
steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Butter a 9 x 13-inch loaf pan.
Mix rice and both soups and spread into loaf pan.
Lay chicken parts on top of rice.
Mix onion soup, water and lemon juice and pour over each piece of chicken.
Cover with foil and bake at 300° for 3 hours.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Gnocchi
steps: Beat egg before you mix in rest of ingredients.
Flour hands and separate dough into 4 sections.
Roll each section into snakes on a floured surface.
Cut 1-inch pieces out of the snakes and, with thumb, press flat.
Fast freeze (about 10 minutes) on a cookie sheet.
When hard, cook in boiling water (salted) for 5 minutes after they rise to the top of the pot.
Serve with spaghetti sauce.

recipes.title: Whole-Grain Soda Bread
steps: About 4 hours before serving or early in day, preheat oven to 350°.
Grease cookie sheet.
In large bowl, combine first 6 ingredients and 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour.
With pastry blender or two knives used, scissor-fashion, cut in margarine or butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in raisins and caraway seed.
Stir in buttermilk just until flour is moistened (dough will be sticky).

recipes.title: Cuban Black Bean Pie(Yields 24 Servings)
steps: Combine eggs, honey, cilantro, cumin, lime juice, lime zest, cayenne pepper and salt; reserve.
Combine beans, rice and cheese; spread in pie shells.
Top with reserved egg mixture.

recipes.title: Beer Bread
steps: Blend ingredients.
Put in a greased bread pan.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Rice And Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 8 oz. jar cheez whiz with jalapeno
steps: Cook rice and broccoli until tender. Do not salt anything. Saute onions and celery in butter. Combine all ingredients. Pour into 11 x 7 inch casserole dish. Let stand in refrigerator for 12 hours. Bake on 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Apple Nut Pudding
steps: Beat the egg until foamy.
Add sugar and beat again.
Sift together the flour, salt and baking powder and beat into the egg-sugar mixture.	Blend in the apples, nuts and vanilla.	Bake in a pie pan at 350° until the top is crisp, about 30 minutes.
Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Baked Beans Supreme
ingredients: 1 (15 1/2 oz.) can butter beans with molasses sauce and bacon
1 (15 1/2 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained
1 (8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, drained
steps: If using a low watt oven, first check the oven cavity to be sure it will hold a 3-quart microwave-safe casserole.

recipes.title: Candied Ham
steps: Place ham, with pineapple and brown sugar on top in 400° oven wrapped tightly in aluminum foil for about 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Stuffed Sweet Peppers
steps: Mix ground beef, onion, 2/3 cup chopped pepper and cooked rice.
Add crumbled bread and tomato juice; mix well.
Take seeds out of the 8 sweet peppers and drop peppers in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain and fill with ground beef mixture.
Put in a large pot with lid and pour ketchup over top of peppers.
Add 1/2 cup of tomato juice to pot.
Cover and cook 2 hours in oven at 350°. Uncover and cook 30
minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cornish Game Hens
ingredients: 1 pkg. Stove Top long grain and wild rice stuffing mix
1/2 c. orange juice or white wine
steps: Prepare stuffing as directed on package.
Do not stuff hens until ready to roast.
Rinse hens with cold water.
Pat dry.
Rub neck and body cavities with salt and pepper.
Lightly stuff cavities with prepared stuffing.
Roast at 400° for 1 hour.
Place any remaining stuffing in a small baking dish; bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
(Meanwhile, heat orange juice and butter; baste hens frequently during the last 30 minutes of roasting.)

recipes.title: Cabbage Soup
steps: Combine all ingredients (except juice, potatoes and hamburger).
Simmer over medium
heat until tender; then discard bay leaf.
Add juice, diced potatoes and partly fried hamburger. Cook until potatoes are soft.

recipes.title: Artichoke Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 (14 oz.) cans artichoke hearts, drained and quartered
20 to 30 stuffed green olives, sliced once
steps: Marinate artichoke hearts in vinegar and oil for 4 to 6 hours; drain and reserve liquid.

recipes.title: Baked Beans With Pineapple And Bacon
ingredients: 1 (30 oz.) large can pork and beans, drained (remove pork)
steps: Mix all ingredients, except bacon in 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Cook bacon crisp; blot on paper towel.
Crumble up and add to bean mixture before serving.
Very good.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Melt margarine.
Add flour, cream cheese, salt, liquid, chicken, macaroni and pimiento.
Mix well.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes, until slightly browned.

recipes.title: Blueberry Pie
steps: Mix first three ingredients and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Cool.
Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar together and set aside.
Mix Dream Whip together by directions on box.
Fold into cream mixture.
Put in chilled crust and top with blueberry pie filling.
(Can substitute strawberry or cherry pie filling.)

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Pot Roast With Egg Noodles
steps: Brown rump roast in oil in Dutch oven.
Remove meat; drain off fat.
Combine mushrooms, vegetables, garlic, 1 1/4 teaspoons salt, bouillon cubes, pepper, bay leaves, tomato paste and 2 cups water in Dutch oven; heat to boiling point.
Add roast.
Simmer, covered, for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Confetti Rice
steps: Melt butter in a skillet.
Add rice, toss to coat with butter. Heat on low for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Place rice mixture in a 2-quart casserole bowl; add hot chicken broth.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Stir in the remaining ingredients.
Cook 5 additional minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Surprise Cheese Puffs
steps: Blend cheese with butter; add flour, salt and paprika.
Mix well.
Pat olives dry on paper towel.
Mold 1 teaspoon dough around each olive to cover.
At this point you can refrigerate or freeze puffs for up to 10 days.
They hold their shape better if frozen first.
Bake puffs on lightly greased cookie sheet in a 400° oven until lightly golden brown, approximately 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Tasty Carrots
steps: Grate
carrots.
Place	in
8-inch Dutch oven.	Mix the rest of the ingredients and bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Enchilada Bake
steps: Cook meat, mix in refried beans, taco seasoning mix until hot and blended. Mix enchilada sauce and soup together, warm.
Put meat mixture in middle of tortilla, roll and place in greased baking dish. Pour sauce mixture over rolled tortillas, sprinkle with cheese and bake until bubbly.

recipes.title: Pickled Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lb. raw, peeled and deveined shrimp (41 to 50 count or larger)
2 medium white or purple onions, sliced into rings
steps: Place shrimp in boiling salted water; reduce heat and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes.
Shrimp are done when they are pink and tender; drain and rinse with cold water, then chill.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Set oven at 350°.
Mix together sugar, butter, egg and vanilla.
Beat with mixer until creamy.
Add baking powder to flour.
Alternate flour and milk to mixture, beating with mixer until well mixed.
Fold in drained blueberries.
Spoon out into muffin tins.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Crunchy Pickle And Ham Appetizer
ingredients: 1 (24 oz.) jar Claussen kosher dill spears, drained
steps: Pat ham and pickle spears dry with paper towel. Spread 13 ham slices each with about 1 Tbsp. cream cheese. Top each with 1 pickle spear; roll up. Refrigerate 1 hour or overnight. Cut each pickle roll into 4 to 6 pieces to serve. Makes 62 to 78.

recipes.title: Morgan'S Magnificient Obsession
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Combine sugar and flour; set aside.
In a medium saucepan, melt butter or margarine with cocoa and water; bring to a boil. Pour mixture over sugar and flour.
Mix well.
Add buttermilk, eggs, cinnamon, baking soda and vanilla; mix until smooth.
Pour into a greased and floured pan; bake 20 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Ice Cream Pie
ingredients: 2/3 c. chopped dry roasted, unsalted peanuts
steps: Prepare crust.
Cool.
Press half of softened ice cream into crust.
In small bowl, stir corn syrup and peanut butter until blended.
Pour half of mixture over ice cream.
Sprinkle with half of peanuts, repeating layering.
Freeze until firm, about 5 hours. Let pie stand at room temperature for 5 minutes for easy cutting.

recipes.title: Squash Pie
steps: Mix squash, sugar, flour, nutmeg, vanilla and lemon extract together.
Add beaten eggs.
Add milk to squash.
Stir until well blended.
Pour into an unbaked pie shell.
Bake for 10 minutes at 375°.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes or longer.

recipes.title: Mrs. Yoppi'S Nut Roll
steps: Mix oleo with flour, like pie dough.
Add egg yolks, sour cream and vanilla.
Mix together and make 8 balls of dough.
Put in refrigerator for 2 1/2 hours or overnight.
Roll like pies in powdered sugar.
Beat egg whites and 1/2 box powdered sugar together.
Spread egg white mixture over dough; sprinkle with ground nuts.
Cut with pizza cutter like pie in 8 pieces.
Roll outside to center and put on greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
steps: Cream the butter and sugar until light; add the applesauce, raisins, flour, spices, salt, soda and baking powder sifted together twice.
Beat well and bake in a shallow well-greased pan in a moderate oven, 350° to 400°.
Test with toothpick after 40 minutes.

recipes.title: America'S Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 carrots, pared and sliced into 2 inch pieces
steps: Trim all fat from roast, brown and drain.
Combine 1/4 cup flour, salt and pepper.
Coat meat with flour mixture.
Place all vegetables except mushrooms in crock-pot and top with roast. Cover and cook on low setting for 10 to 12 hours.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Elk Or Deer Stew
steps: Cook meat, green peppers and onions in oil until browned.
Add water, salt, black pepper, bouillon cube and bay leaf.
Cover and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours until meat is tender.
Add carrots, potatoes and celery.
Simmer until vegetables are tender, approximately 30 minutes.
Shake cold water and flour until completely mixed; add to stew.
Bring to boil, stirring constantly until thickens like gravy.

recipes.title: Cream Puffs
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Combine water, butter and salt and bring to boil.
Remove from heat and flour all at once.
Stir vigorously until mixture leaves sides of pan and forms ball around spoon.
(If ball does not form immediately, hold saucepan over low heat and beat briskly a few seconds.)
Cool slightly.
Add eggs, one at a time, and beat until smooth and glossy after each addition.
Drop by teaspoonful onto greased baking sheet, leaving 2 inches between puffs.
Bake 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake until no bubbles of fat remain on surface and sides of puffs feel rigid, about 30 minutes.
Cool.
Cut a cap off puff and fill with Pastry Cream.
Replace cap.
Makes 10 large puffs.

recipes.title: Carrot-Dill Soup
ingredients: 5 c. chicken stock or canned broth
steps: Bake the potato and sweet potato 1 hour until soft.
Steam the carrots over boiling water until very tender (8 to 10 minutes).

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cake
steps: Cake:
Mix all together and add 1 cup sour milk.
If you have no sour milk, add 1 teaspoon vinegar.
Add flour and soda.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Gobs
steps: Cream Crisco; add eggs. Add to flour mixture. Mix. Add sour milk. Last add water. Drop by tablespoon and bake 8 minutes at 350°. Cook flour and milk until thickened. Beat in Crisco with powdered sugar until fluffy; add cooled paste and vanilla. Beat until creamy and spread between 2 cookies.

recipes.title: Pound Cake 2
steps: Cream butter, sugar and Crisco.
Add sour cream and blend.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Mix in vanilla.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Add alternately with milk.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes in 10-inch tube pan.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Pie
steps: Remove chicken from bone and place in dish.
Heat celery soup and broth and pour over chicken.
Mix flour, milk and baking powder with margarine and pour over chicken.
Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Basic Pudding Mix
steps: Mix all dry ingredients and store in Tupperware canister. Prepare as directed in individual recipes.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
steps: Stir together flour, sugar, salt and baking powder.
In large mixing bowl, combine all-bran and milk.
Let stand about 5 minutes.
Add flour mixture and raisins.
Stir only until combined.
Spray 12 muffin pan cups with no-stick spray.
Divide mixture into 12 cups.
Bake at 400° for approximately 20 minutes. For reduced calories, use 2 tablespoons sugar instead of above amounts.

recipes.title: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
steps: In small saucepan on low heat, melt butter and chocolate. Take off burner.
Add sugar and mix.
Add one egg at a time, mixing after each.
Add all remaining ingredients and mix.
Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice In Green Vegetable Broth
steps: Remove and discard skin from chicken.
In a large sauce pan, combine chicken broth, water, rice, thyme and pepper.
Add chicken, cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Shred cabbage and spinach.
Remove chicken to a cutting board.
Remove meat from bones and cut into bite size pieces.
Return chicken to broth, add cabbage and spinach, bring to a boil over medium heat.
Boil broth just until cabbage and chicken are wilted and heated through, 1 minute.

recipes.title: Chocolate Caramel Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat eggs, sugars, dressing and vanilla at medium speed with electric mixer; add flour and baking soda. Set aside 1 cup of batter.
Spread remaining batter into lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Wilma'S Salmon Cakes
ingredients: 1 egg, beaten or 1/4 c. Egg Beaters
3 Tbsp. flour (slightly more if needed to hold patties together)
8 or 9 crushed crackers (to roll patties in)
steps: Mix salmon, onion, green pepper (if desired), basil, thyme, salt, pepper, egg, flour and cracker crumbs (if desired).
Form patties and roll in additional cracker crumbs.
Fry in small amount of Crisco.
Makes 5 to 6 patties.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
steps: Cook sugar, Karo and water together in very heavy skillet or Dutch oven on top of stove until it spins threads.
(Pick up spoon and let it run slowly out into hot syrup.
Watch for threads.)
Or if using candy thermometer, cook to hard crack stage.
Add oleo and raw peanuts.
When candy turns color of peanut hulls it is ready. Remove from heat and quickly add vanilla and soda.
Stir and pour into greased cookie sheet.
Spread as thin as possible using 2 greased forks pulling it to the edges of pan.
Cool.
Break into pieces.

recipes.title: Skillet Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, chicken or turkey
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
2 Tbsp. seeded chopped canned green chillies or 1 can diced green chillies
steps: In a 10-inch skillet, brown meat and onion; drain any excess fat (electric skillet at 350°).
Stir in soup, enchilada sauce, milk and chillies.
Reduce heat to 220°.
Cover and cook 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Fried Onion Rings
steps: Slice onions and separate into rings.
Make batter of the beaten eggs and milk.
Stir together flour and seasoning.
Dip onions into flour and then in batter.
Drop onion rings into oil and cook until golden.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Coconut Almond Pudding(Great!!!)
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) bag slivered almonds or sliced almonds
steps: Mix the ingredients together and brown in 325° oven until light brown; stir often.

recipes.title: Easy Garden Vegetable Pie
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease pie plate.
Heat salted water; add broccoli.
Cover and heat to boiling.
Cook until almost tender, about 5 minutes.
Drain.
Mix broccoli, onion, green pepper and cheese in pie plate.
Beat remaining ingredients until smooth, 15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute with hand mixer.
Pour into pie plate.
Bake until golden brown and knife comes out clean at 350° for 40 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Apricot Roasted Pheasant
steps: Place pheasant on aluminum foil in roaster.
Rub interior with butter, then salt, pepper and garlic.
Cover bird with uncooked rice.
Pour apricot juice and apricots over all.
Wrap tightly in the foil.
Bake in 325° oven until pheasant can be easily pierced with a fork.
Serves 2 to 4.

recipes.title: Apple Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Spray 2 loaf pans with vegetable spray. In a large bowl, using an electric mixer, beat together sugar, oil and eggs.
In a separate bowl, stir together dry ingredients. Add dry mixture to batter and mix just until blended.
Stir vanilla, apples and pecans into batter.
Pour batter into prepared loaf pans.
Bake for 1 hour or until inserted knife comes out clean.
Yield: 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Lasagna
steps: Brown meat
with
onions, salt and pepper.
Drain.
Add tomato paste and
sauce,
tomatoes
and garlic.
Bring to boil and let simmer for 1 hour (the longer it simmers the better it is).
It may be
necessary
to
add a little water if sauce is too thick. Cook noodles (put a small amount of cooking oil in water to keep the noodles from sticking.) Drain.

recipes.title: Holly Taters
steps: Wash potatoes (medium or large).
Cut into wedges.
Drop into salted cold water for 1 hour.
Drain, but do not dry.
Put a couple of wedges in Shake 'n Bake bag.
Repeat process until all potatoes are used.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Salt potatoes and drizzle margarine over the top of potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Soup With Rivels
steps: Peel pumpkin and cut into small squares.
Boil until soft. Do not drain water.
Add milk until pumpkin is covered.
Bring to a simmer.
Add salt and pepper.
Beat eggs with fork.
Add flour slowly and keep mixing until it gets a little thick (like dumplings).
Drop this mixture into pumpkin 1/2 teaspoon at a time; let simmer 20 minutes.
Serve.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: 1 small cake yeast, dissolved in 1/2 c. warm water
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Let stand until double in size, about 1 hour.
Knead down and let rise again.
Roll out on floured board until 1/4-inch thick.
Spread with oleo, cinnamon and brown sugar.
Roll up like a jelly roll.
Grease pan with oleo and sprinkle with brown sugar.
Let raise until double in size.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
ingredients: 1 sweet potato or yam, baked or microwaved
steps: Peel and dice baked sweet potato.
Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Cut shortening and potato into flour mixture. Add milk and sugar; stir until well mixed.
Roll out on floured surface 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick.
With knife, cut into squares and bake on greased baking sheet at 400° for 12 minutes.
Makes 12 to 18 biscuits.

recipes.title: Basic White Sauce
steps: In small saucepan, whisk together broth, milk and flour. Insert clove into onion; add to broth mixture along with remaining ingredients.
Bring to just below boiling over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Lower heat to simmer and cook, stirring frequently, for 10 minutes.
Remove onion and bay leaf with slotted spoon.
Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: Pineapple Drop Cookies
steps: Cream together shortening and sugars.
Add eggs and mix thoroughly.
Add flour, soda and baking powder with pineapple and vanilla.
Mix.
Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Zucchini "Crab" Cakes
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients together.
Shape into cakes and roll in crushed cracker crumbs.
Fry in hot oil until brown.

recipes.title: Remp Eyek
steps: Grind coriander, garlic and nuts.
Mix all together into batter, adding 2 packages Spanish peanuts.
Scoop batter with a hostess spoon and fry until brown.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. German chocolate cake mix (2 layer)
steps: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix coconut and pecans. Place in bottom of pan.
Mix cake mix according to package directions.
Pour over coconut mixture.
Mix margarine, cream cheese and powdered sugar.
Pour over chocolate mixture.
Bake in 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cookies
steps: Mix, in order, first 8 ingredients.
Chill 2 hours.
Drop on greased sheet and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.
Bake 10 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Chicken 'N Dumplings
steps: Boil fryer until tender. Remove from broth and set aside to cool. Mix dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening.
Add beaten eggs and enough milk to make a stiff dough. Roll out really thin on heavily floured board.
Cut into pieces (pizza cutter works great!).
Drop into rapidly boiling broth.
Cover and simmer on very low heat for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove skin and bones from chicken and pull into bite size pieces.
Add chicken to pot and season to taste with black pepper.
I pour about a cup of sweet milk in pot just as it's finished cooking.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add eggs and beat well.
Combine flour, soda and salt together and add to mixture.
Add bananas and nuts.
Bake 1 hour in 300° oven.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cookies
steps: Mix ingredients together well, then drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Tropical Fruit Cake
steps: Cut dates into thirds, add coconut, nuts and cherries, sprinkled with flour.
Add milk and mix well.
Butter loaf pan and dust with flour.

recipes.title: Gene'S Hop-N-John
steps: Brown ground beef and drain.
Add the remaining ingredients. Add water to cover 1 inch above ingredients.
Cook for 1 hour on low heat.
Serves 15 to 20.

recipes.title: No Peek Brisket
steps: Lay slices of rye bread in bottom of Dutch oven.
Place brisket, with fat side down, on top of the bread in Dutch oven. Sprinkle garlic powder and pepper on brisket.
Throw onion slices into pan.
Pour beer over the meat.
Spread the chile sauce over the meat.
Cover Dutch oven.

recipes.title: Homemilled Corn Meal Corn Bread
steps: Sift together all the dry ingredients.
Add egg, buttermilk, and oil.
Mix well and pour into hot iron skillet.
Preheat oven to 400°.
Bake 15 minutes.
Flip in pan and brown.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Applesauce Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In large bowl, combine flour, oats, baking soda, cinnamon and cloves; set aside.
With mixer at low speed cream oil and sugar until light and fluffy; beat in egg whites and applesauce.
Stir in dry ingredients until smooth. Spray baking sheet with vegetable spray; drop dough on cookie sheet.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until brown.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Pheasant
ingredients: 1 green pepper, seeded and cut into squares
1 egg, slightly beaten with 1 Tbsp. water
1 (8 oz.) can unsweetened pineapple chunks, drained (reserve 1/2 c. juice)
steps: Place pheasant breasts in a steamer and cover.
Steam only until meat can be removed from bone (meat should be rare).
Cool to room temperature and cube.

recipes.title: Savory Cheese Muffins
ingredients: 1 c. (4 oz.) grated sharp Cheddar cheese
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Grease 24 mini muffin cups.
Stir together flour, cheese, mustard and chili powder in mixing bowl. Beat eggs in separate bowl; stir in milk and oil.
Add liquid mixture to dry ingredients, stirring just until blended.
Batter will be slightly lumpy.
Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups, filling each 2/3 full.
Bake for 13 to 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Cake
steps: Blend ingredients and beat 2 minutes.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 350° in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Sprinkle with sifted confectioners sugar or glaze.
May be baked in loaf pans for banana bread.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cake
steps: Blend together.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Diabetic Chocolate Chip Bars
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Beat 1 1/2 minutes at high speed of mixer.
Add remaining ingredients, except chocolate chips. Chips are added last.
Place in 8 x 8-inch ungreased pan and bake at 375° for 20 to 22 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Rolls
steps: Stir together apples, nuts and sugar.
Let stand, stirring often until juicy, about 1 hour.
Stir together flour, soda, salt and spices.
Add apple mixture and stir well.
Stir in butter and vanilla.
Add eggs.
Turn into two greased and floured one pound coffee cans.
Tie 2-inch wide band of double foil around top.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Biscuits
steps: Sift
flour,
baking
powder, salt and soda into mixing bowl. Stir in milk until all is wet; then add corn oil.
Toss out on floured board.
Sprinkle a little flour on dough.
Then flatten out
and
cut
biscuits.
Grease pan and turn biscuits over in grease and bake at 425°.
Makes 14 large biscuits.

recipes.title: Caramel Brie With Fresh Fruit
steps: Place Brie on large serving plate.
Melt butter and brown sugar in saucepan; add corn syrup and flour, stirring well. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; cool to lukewarm.
Gradually stir in milk.
Pour caramel over Brie.
Sprinkle with pecans.
Combine lemon juice and water.
Toss with fruit wedges.
Drain.
Arrange around fruit.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. sausage or bacon, cooked and drained
steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Layer bread, meat, cheese and onion.
Melt butter and pour over all.
Beat eggs, seasonings and milk.
Pour over.
Chill in refrigerator overnight and bake 1 hour at 350°. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Dessert
steps: Mix together the flour, oleo and nuts.
Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Cool.

recipes.title: Sweet-Sour Cabbage
steps: Shred cabbage and place in
a large pot with 3 tablespoons water and 1 can of stewed tomatoes.
Cook until almost tender.
In a separate pan, melt 1/4 stick margarine.
Mix with 1 teaspoon salt, 2 tablespoons white vinegar and 1 tablespoon flour.
Saute the diced onion in the mixture.
Add this to the cabbage when the cabbage is almost tender.
Heat until desired tenderness is reached.
Add a teaspoon of sugar if needed.

recipes.title: Blueberry Bread
steps: Beat eggs and sugar until blended.
Add milk and butter; mix well.
Combine in separate bowl, 3 cups flour, baking powder and salt.
Stir into egg mixture until moist.
Mix blueberries with 2 teaspoons flour until coated.
Fold into batter.
Spoon into 2 small greased and floured loaf pans and bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
steps: Cream oleo and sugar; add eggs, banana and water and mix well. Then add baking powder and baking soda.
Mix in flour.
Stir well after each addition.
Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
steps: Brown beef in hot oil; add garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Add soy sauce, salt and water.
Cook for 45 minutes.
Add vegetables; cook 10 to 15 minutes longer.
Stir cornstarch and tomato juice together; add to mixture.
Cook, stirring constantly, until it thickens.
Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes more.
Serve over hot fluffy rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Long John'S Batter
steps: Mix all but egg white.
Beat egg white until stiff peaks form. Blend into batter.
Dip fish or chicken and fry.
Enjoy.

recipes.title: Miracle Soup
ingredients: 1 whole tomato, canned or fresh (if canned, 8 oz. size)
season with dry onion soup (1 pkg.) and other herb seasonings
steps: Cut vegetables into medium pieces, cover with water; let come to a boil.
Your soup mix may be added at this time.
After soup has boiled at least 10 minutes, lower heat and simmer until vegetables are soft.
Can be eaten at any time that you feel hungry, as much as you wish, as often as you like, any time of the day.
This soup will not add calories.
The more you eat the more you will lose.

recipes.title: Oven Baked Bourguignonne
ingredients: 2 lb. boneless chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 (16 oz.) can whole tomatoes, drained and chopped (reserve liquid)
steps: In a 2-quart casserole dish, toss beef with flour.
Bake, uncovered, in a 400° oven for 20 minutes.
Add carrots, tomatoes, beefy onion soup mix blended with reserved tomato liquid, wine and bay leaf.
Bake, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Add mushrooms.
Bake, covered, an additional 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
steps: Cream sugars and Crisco.
Add eggs and beat well.
Add vanilla and dry ingredients.
Mix well.
Shape into little balls.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Spectacular Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. Uncle Ben's combination wild and white rice, cooked
steps: Mix all ingredients, except bread crumbs.
Pour into 3-quart greased casserole.
Top with bread crumbs.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
To freeze, do not cook before freezing.

recipes.title: Yellow Squash Casserole
steps: Wash and slice squash; cook in salted water until tender.
(Do not overcook.)
Saute onion and garlic in butter and add to drained squash.
Add 2/3 cup butter, sugar, salt and pepper to squash mixture.
Mix well.
Add milk, 2 eggs and cracker crumbs. Mix gently.
Pour into buttered casserole dish.
Dot top with remaining 1/3 cup butter and crushed crackers.
Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes or until browned.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
steps: Melt butter in a skillet and brown onions and ground beef. Cut tops out of peppers and clean.
Mix rice, ground beef mixture and spaghetti sauce and stuff into peppers.
Top with cheese.
Put some sauce in bottom of pan and place peppers in dish.
Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of sugar in each pepper (optional).
Cover with foil and cook at 350°
for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cans condensed milk (or use 2 cans if you use 2 small cans pumpkin)
steps: Blend beaten eggs, canned pumpkin, sugar, salt, cloves, cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg.
Slowly add condensed milk.
Mix well.
Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then reduce temperature to 375° for about 45 minutes, or until you can cut center with a knife and none of the pie filling clings to it.

recipes.title: Pork Chop And Vegetable Skillet
steps: Fry
pork
chops
until
tender and brown.
Place onion rings and
bell
pepper
over
cooked
chops.
Put rice inside pepper. Pour tomatoes and celery (mixed) over this and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Simmer approximately 1 hour in covered frypan on top of stove.

recipes.title: Saucepan Raisin Bars
steps: Mix
well.
Pour
into	greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 300° to 325°.

recipes.title: Casserole Cheese Bread
steps: Scald milk; add sugar, salt and margarine.
Let cool. Dissolve yeast in water.
Add milk and cheese and flour.
Stir about 2 minutes until well blended.
Cover; let rise until more than double.
Stir down and beat vigorously for 1/2 minute.
Turn in greased 1 1/2 quart casserole or two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 375° for 1 hour (no second rising).

recipes.title: Easy Quiche
ingredients: diced onions, peppers and meats of choice
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato-Bean Soup
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, peeled and cut up (at least 3 c.)
2 Tbsp. snipped fresh dill or 1 tsp. dried dill weed
1 (15 oz.) can Great Northern beans, drained
steps: In large pot, cook and stir celery, carrots and garlic in hot margarine, over medium heat, for 4 minutes, or until tender. Carefully stir in broth, potatoes and dill.
Heat to boiling, then reduce heat.
Simmer, covered, for 20 to 25 minutes, or until potatoes are tender,
With back of large spoon, or masher, lightly mash about 1/2 of potatoes in the broth.
Add drained beans to mixture.

recipes.title: Meatballs
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Cover bowl and let stand in refrigerator a few hours.
Form in balls.
Brown in oil.
Do not overcrowd. Place in crock-pot with your spaghetti sauce and cook on low for at least 8 hours and serve.

recipes.title: Mississippi Potatoes
ingredients: 8 c. potatoes, cooked and diced or 1 pkg. frozen hash browns
1/2 c. ripe or green olives, sliced
steps: Toss together potatoes, mayonnaise, salt, pepper, cheese and onion.
Place mixture in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with crumbled
bacon and sliced olives. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sweet Trash
steps: Melt margarine, syrup and brown sugar until blended. Pour margarine mixture over cereal mixture. Place in large pan and bake 20 to 25 minutes at 325°, stirring 1/2 way through. Immediately spread mixture on wax paper covered cooling rack. Cool completely and store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Creamed Chicken
steps: Cook celery, onion and green pepper in oil until tender. Blend flour into mixture.
Stir in chicken broth and milk; cook to a smooth sauce, stirring constantly.
Add chicken to sauce; season with salt.
Heat mixture thoroughly.
Serve on rice, toast or biscuits.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
steps: Peel, slice and sugar peaches until they make a liquid.
Melt butter in a baking dish.
Mix flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and milk in bowl.
Pour batter in pan with melted butter.
Spoon peaches over batter and bake for about 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Praline Muffins
steps: Place paper liners in a muffin tin, if you use them; otherwise, butter the tin well.
Fill them to 3/4 full and bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes.
Makes 1 dozen 2-inch muffins.

recipes.title: Chicken Nuggets
steps: Roll chicken pieces in flour, then in eggs and finally in bread crumbs, patting it on well.
Using a frying pan, brown in olive oil until done.
It doesn't take long and they are good!

recipes.title: Spicy Pickled Cabbage
steps: Trim cabbage.
Cut heads into small wedges.
Pack into jar, placing tomatoes and pepper about midway.
Pour salt over cabbage and add water.
Fill pint size freezer bag with water and weight mixture down.
Make sure water covers cabbage.
Cover jar with dish towel, held in place with a rubber band.
Store in warm place 10 to 14 days.
Can the same as kraut.

recipes.title: "Ladies Night Out" Jam Cake
ingredients: 1 c. black walnut pieces or other nuts
steps: In large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and beat until creamy.	Mix flour and soda.
Add to creamed mixture and mix well.
Add buttermilk, jam and allspice.
Mix well.
Stir in walnuts, raisins and coconut.
Pour into lightly greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Bake 1 hour in preheated 325° oven. Cool 15 minutes in pan.
Loosen cake and invert onto cooling rack. Serves 12 to 16.

recipes.title: Yeast Bread
steps: Scald
and measure the milk.
Add the yeast cake, sugar and salt;
mix thoroughly.
Add about 1/2 the flour, mix well. Add the
shortening
and
remaining
flour.
Knead
the dough quickly and
lightly, until it is smooth and elastic.
Grease lightly. Allow to rise in a warm place (80°) until doubled in bulk.	This will require about 2 hours.
Punch down.
Let rise about 45 minutes.
Mold into loaves and let rise about 1 hour. Bake at 380° until done.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
steps: Mix together the first 3 ingredients.
Add next 4 ingredients.
Roll in balls the size of a walnut.
If mixture seems too wet, add a little flour at a time until easily handled. Roll these in a mixture of sugar and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Puerto Rico Chicken
steps: Put chicken in cooking oil and cook until brown.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer 1 hour.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Best Ever Pineapple Cake
ingredients: 1 (No. 2) can crushed pineapple, do not drain (20 oz.)
steps: Mix flour, sugar, eggs, baking soda, vanilla and nuts.
Add crushed pineapple.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 45 minutes at 350°.
"Happy eating".

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Broccoli Skillet
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
steps: Completely cook chicken in Miracle Whip about 8 minutes. Stir in broccoli and cheese.
Heat until cheese is melted. Serve over hot cooked rice.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Beat eggs until light and frothy.
Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 2 16 oz. cans Del Monte sliced peaches, drained
steps: Grease a 9 x 13 inch pan.
Place peaches in bottom of pan and sprinkle with nutmeg.
Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt; set aside.

recipes.title: Cecil B. De Mille'S Baked Beans
steps: Fry bacon until crisp. Drain off most of the fat.
Add onion to bacon and saute until onion is soft.
Drain butter beans and kidney beans. Combine all in large 3 quart casserole.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour uncovered.
Serves about 10.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
steps: Cut tortillas into 1-inch pieces.
Combine with meat, soup, salsa, milk and 1/2 cup cheese.
Pour into 9 x 12 pan.
Cover and bake 45 minutes at 400°.
Uncover; sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese.
Return to oven until cheese melts; serve.

recipes.title: Pizza Cookie
ingredients: 3/4 c. firmly packed light or dark brown sugar
steps: Preheat oven to
Grease a 12-inch pizza pan.
In medium bowl with
electric mixer at medium speed, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg.
Stir in flour and baking soda
until
well
blended.
Spread dough into prepared pan.
Bake 20 minutes or until lightly browned.
Sprinkle marshmallows and candies
on
cookie
during
the
last 5 minutes of baking.
Cool 10 minutes in pan on wire rack.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
steps: Dough is crumbly.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake 15 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Kiss Cookies
steps: Mix the sugars and shortening, peanut butter and margarine together.
Stir in flour.
Shape dough into balls.
Roll in granulated sugar.
Place on cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 350° until edges are light brown, 8 to 10 minutes.
As soon as they are removed from the oven, press a chocolate Kiss in center of each cookie.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Grate zucchini and combine with eggs, oil and vanilla.
Mix all dry ingredients together.
Combine all ingredients and put in two loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lemon Delight
steps: First layer:
First 3 ingredients, blend together and press in 9x13 pan.
Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Sally'S Pork Chop Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. ginger ale or uncola (7-Up, etc.)
steps: Saut the onion in butter or margarine. Brown pork chops on both sides in separate pan. Layer sauteed onions, browned pork chops and onions in a 9 x 13 baking dish. In a small bowl, blend chili sauce, flour, salt, pepper and ginger ale. Pour mixture over pork chop/onion mixture. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cookies
ingredients: 2 tsp. baking soda, dissolved in sour cream
steps: Bake in very hot oven (500°) for about 10 minutes.
Turns out nice in kitchen range.
Electric oven not so wise.

recipes.title: Mexican Cabbage
steps: Brown first four ingredients together in Dutch oven; drain. Add soup, Ro-Tel, tomatoes, cabbage, salt and pepper.
Simmer 45 minutes.
Serve with corn bread.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Combine cooked rice, milk, sugar, salt and oleo.
Cook over medium heat.
Stir constantly until thick.
Stir in vanilla.
Add raisins, if desired.
Yields enough for one person.

recipes.title: Air Buns
steps: Mix 1/2 cup warm water and 1 teaspoon sugar in a small bowl. Add dry yeast and let stand 15 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix 3 1/2 cups warm water, 1/2 cup sugar, shortening, vinegar and salt.
Mix well and let cool to lukewarm.
Add flour.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Let rise, then punch down and form into rolls.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until done.
This is a large recipe and can be cut in half.
A full recipe will make 5 to 6 dozen rolls.
I usually make a large pan of rolls plus a pan of cinnamon rolls and some hamburger buns.
It is also a good recipe for hamburger buns for family gatherings.
The extra rolls freeze well.

recipes.title: Ham And Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 potatoes or more if you wish
2 slices cheese or more if you wish
steps: Layer potatoes, cheese and ham in casserole.
Mix flour and milk; pour over potatoes.
Add butter, salt and pepper.
Bake at 375° for 1 1/2 hours (40 to 60 minutes in microwave) or until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Banana-Nut Bread Ii
ingredients: 1/2 c. vegetable oil or butter, softened
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix butter, sugar, and eggs together. Fold in dry ingredients that have been sifted together. Add mashed bananas and nuts. Bake in loaf pan 9 x 5-inch for 40 to 50 minutes. When done, cool 5 minutes in the pan. Then turn out on rack to cool.

recipes.title: Yum Yum Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. canola oil or toasted sesame oil
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients together.
Add remaining ingredients and put the noodles right before serving.

recipes.title: Apricot Pinwheels
ingredients: sugar substitute (Sweet 'N Low) to equal 4 Tbsp. sugar
steps: Combine apricots and boiling water; allow to stand until most of the water is absorbed; drain.
Sift flour and baking powder into bowl.
Beat butter or margarine, brown sugar, sugar substitute and water until well blended.
Add the flour mixture; blend with a fork until the dough forms a ball.
Place the dough on wax paper; flatten slightly.
Wrap in the wax paper; chill in the freezer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Impossible Quiche
ingredients: 1 c. shredded Swiss or Cheddar cheese
chopped green onion or green pepper to taste
1/2 c. ham, diced, or bacon, crumbled
steps: Place all ingredients, except cheese, meat and pepper, in blender and mix.
Pour into 9-inch buttered pie pan.
Sprinkle meat, cheese, green pepper or onion over top and push gently under surface with back of spoon.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Cool for 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Caramelitas
ingredients: 5 Tbsp. light cream or evaporated milk
steps: *Note:
If using coconut, add to crumb mixture before pressing into pan.

recipes.title: Creamy Peach Pudding
ingredients: 1 c. diced fresh peaches or drained canned peaches
steps: Arrange fruit in the bottom of a shallow 1-quart serving dish. Place remaining ingredients in an electric blender.
Cover and blend at medium speed, 10 seconds or until smooth and creamy.
Pour sauce over fruit and stir gently to mix.
Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: People'S Puppy Chow
steps: Melt first 4 ingredients until smooth.
Add Rice Chex and mix gently until coated.
Now put 2 cups of powdered sugar in a brown grocery bag and shake until coated.
Leave in bag until cool.

recipes.title: Unstuffed Cabbage
steps: Place the cabbage in a greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. In a skillet, cook beef and onion until done. Stir in rice, salt and pepper, if desired. Spoon over cabbage. Combine soup and water; pour over beef mixture. Cover and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes or until rice and cabbage are tender. Uncover. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pecan Crunch Cookies
steps: Cream together the margarine, sugar and vanilla.
Add crushed potato chips and pecans.
Stir in flour.
Form small balls with 1 tablespoon of dough.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press balls with flat bottom of glass dipped in sugar.
Bake in oven at 350° for 16 to 18 minutes, or until cookies are light brown.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Chews
steps: Beat eggs.
Add all ingredients to beaten eggs and blend well. Spread in a well-greased and floured jelly roll pan.
Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.
They freeze well.

recipes.title: Good Biscuits(Yield: 1 Batch)
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can refrigerated buttermilk biscuit dough
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Place biscuits 2-inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 8 to 11 minutes or until golden brown. Place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium-high heat until evenly brown. Drain and set aside.

recipes.title: Orange Buttermilk Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
steps: In a saucepan, bring pineapple to a boil.
Remove from heat; add gelatin and stir to dissolve.
Add buttermilk and mix well. Cool to room temperature.
Fold in whipped topping.
Pour into an 11 x 7 x 2-inch dish.
Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Cut into squares.
Yields 12 servings.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
ingredients: 1 can golden cream of mushroom soup
steps: Cut cabbage into wedges; place in saltwater and cook until done. Cabbage should be firm, but tender. Drain well. In saucepan, combine margarine, flour, onion, bell pepper and milk; cook until thick. Remove from heat; add soup, pimento and cheese. Mix well. Combine cabbage with liquid mixture and pour into casserole dish. Bake at 375° until cheese is melted and casserole is bubbly.

recipes.title: Melting Moments Cookies
steps: Sift dry
ingredients together.
Add soft margarine and vanilla.
Beat
on	medium	speed of mixer until well blended. Chill in refrigerator 1 hour.

recipes.title: Snails With Garlic
steps: Rinse snails with cool water and drain.
Melt butter in frying pan and add
garlic.
Saute
lightly
over
medium-high heat.
Add snails and saute.
Remove
from
heat
and
place 1 snail in each shell.
Add the
rest
of the ingredients to pan and mix together. Stuff some
of the garlic mixture into each snail shell. Sprinkle with a little bread crumbs, if desired. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes
or
until
very
bubbly.
Makes 2 servings.
Serve with crusty Italian bread.

recipes.title: Buckeyes
steps: Melt butter with peanut butter on low heat on stove top.
Mix the powdered sugar in very thoroughly; you should have a doughy crumbled mixture.
Then mix the Rice Krispies in with this mixture.
Shape into balls or any shape you like.
In a double boiler, melt the chocolate chips and enough wax for a creamy mixture.
Dip the balls in the chocolate and cool on wax paper.

recipes.title: Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, boiled, deboned and cut up
steps: In long pan, spread chicken over entire bottom.
Slice boiled eggs and place over top of chicken.
Pour mushroom soup over top of this.
In separate bowl, mix flour, sweet milk and margarine. Pour this mixture over chicken, eggs and cream of mushroom.
Put black pepper on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
steps: Sift together the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add applesauce; beat well.
Add flour mixture in several additions.
Beat gently.
Fold in raisins.
Turn into a greased and floured 8 x 8 x 2-inch cake pan. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Let stand on wire rack for 5 minutes.
Turn out.
Turn right side up.
Good warm.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Cream the sugar and oil together.
Add eggs and pumpkin; mix well.
Sift together the dry ingredients.
Add dry ingredients alternately with water.
Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Delicious Potato Rolls
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes (enough for 1 c. mashed potatoes; reserve potato water)
steps: Pour 1 1/3 cups hot potato water over shortening, sugar and salt.
Allow to stand until lukewarm.
Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup lukewarm water.
Add to first mixture.
Then add eggs, mashed potatoes and flour.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Mix Crisco oil and sugar.
Add all other ingredients.
Bake in the oven at 350°.
Bake 3 layer pans for 30 minutes.
Bake a 9 x 13-inch oblong pan for 40 minutes.
Bake a Bundt pan for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage
steps: Use outside leaves; separate and boil until done (about 8 leaves).
Cook rice until done.
Put hamburger in pan and cook until brown; remove and add onion, chili powder, paprika and cooked rice.
Put about 3 tablespoons of mixture into each cabbage leaf.
Put into baking dish.
Pour catsup over cabbage and cook until done.

recipes.title: Salmon Souffle
ingredients: 1 can pink or red salmon (pick out large bones)
green or red pepper, cut fine
steps: Melt butter, add flour and milk and cook until thick.
Add all ingredients above (egg yolks only).
Beat egg whites stiff, and gently fold into mixture.
Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350° until a knife comes out clean, about 45 to 50 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Gingerbread
steps: Mix and pour in greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
steps: Run cheese through meat chopper.
Mix all ingredients thoroughly and put in cookie press or roll thin and cut into narrow strips about 4-inches long and twist.
Bake in oven at 350° for 25 minutes or until light brown.
Makes about 100.

recipes.title: Raw Apple Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: salt, soda, cinnamon and vanilla
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Crispy Cocoa Bars
steps: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan.
In a large saucepan over low heat, melt butter; stir in cocoa and marshmallows.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until marshmallows are melted and mixture is smooth and well blended.
Continue cooking and stirring for one minute.
Remove from heat; add cereal and stir until well coated. Press into buttered pan with a buttered spatula and let cool and then cut into 24 squares.

recipes.title: Weight Watcher Stuffed Peppers
steps: Saute ground turkey, onion and celery in oil in nonstick frypans sprayed with Pam.
Add cooked rice, spices, bouillon, V-8 and Worcestershire.
Mix well.
Spoon into pepper halves.
Garnish with a tomato slice and 1 teaspoon grated cheese.
Bake at 350°, covered, 1 hour.
Four servings (2 halves each) equals 4 protein and 1 bread.

recipes.title: Fruit Leather
ingredients: fresh or canned fruit, well drained
1 Tbsp. lemon juice or ascorbic acid (for each qt. juice)
steps: Preheat oven to 140°.
Prepare pan:
turn baking sheet over, bottom up.
Cover bottom with plastic wrap.
Secure wrap to sheet by taping down edges with masking tape.
(This prevents the edges of wrap pulling up while fruit is drying.)

recipes.title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chips Cake
steps: Pour water over oatmeal and let stand 10 minutes.
Add sugar and margarine.
Add eggs and mix well.
Sift flour, soda, salt and cocoa.
Add to mix.
Add half package of chocolate chips.
Put batter in pan or muffin pans.
Sprinkle top of batter with remaining chips and chopped nuts.
No frosting is needed.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Skillet Corn
steps: Combine corn, salt, pepper, sugar, butter and water in a 10-inch skillet.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Combine flour and milk, blending until smooth.
Stir into corn.
Cook 5 minutes over low heat, stirring constantly.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
steps: Mix flour, salt and shortening together until crumbly.
Add hot water, mix thoroughly.
Divide into thirds.
Roll out on floured board.
Place in pan, crimp edges.
Makes 3 (10-inch) pie crusts.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until desired brown.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls-Yeast Rolls
steps: Mix flour, sugar, salt and yeast.
Heat milk, water and margarine.
Gradually add to dry ingredients.
Beat 2 minutes on medium speed.
Add 1 egg and 1/2 cup flour.
Beat on high speed for 2 minutes.
Stir in 2 1/2 cups to 3 cups flour to make a soft dough.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Place in greased bowl and grease top of dough.
Cover and let rise until double.
Punch down; turn onto floured board.
Divide into two parts, 1/2 for rolls.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Doughnuts
steps: Put enough shortening into deep frying kettle to fry doughnuts. Sift flour, add salt, baking powder, soda and nutmeg.
Beat eggs. Add sugar and beat.
Add sour cream.
Add to dry mixture.
Remove 1/2 of dough to pastry cloth.
Roll about 1/4-inch thick.
Cut with doughnut cutter.
Fry in hot shortening (370°).
Drain.
Roll in powdered sugar or dip in doughnut glaze.

recipes.title: Brownie Pudding
steps: Mix first 9 ingredients together.
Spread mixture in 8 x 8-inch pan.
Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over brownie mixture.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Good either hot or cold.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato, Crunchy Top Casserole
steps: Combine and mix all ingredients. Pour into baking dish.

recipes.title: Chicken 'N' Biscuits
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can peas and carrots, drained
steps: In medium saucepan, saute onion and margarine.
Stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Whisk in 2 1/2 cups milk.
Cook until slightly thickened.
Add next four ingredients.
Divide into 4 (8 ounce) baking dishes.
Preheat oven to 450°.
In medium bowl, combine remaining 3/4 cup milk, the biscuit mix and parsley.
Drop 4 or 5 teaspoons of biscuit mixture on each baking dish.
Bake about 15 minutes until mixture is bubbly and biscuits are browned.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Combine squash (cut to bite size pieces), onion, salt and sugar.
Simmer in 1 cup of water until tender.
Drain well.
Add eggs, oleo, flour, milk and cheese and mix well.
Bake in greased casserole in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pickled Eggs
ingredients: 2 jars or cans beets, drained (reserve juice)
steps: Combine juice from beets, vinegar and brown sugar; heat to boiling.
Put beets in jar, then eggs.
Pour hot juice over top. After cool, refrigerate.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Cut tops off and center out of peppers.
Put peppers in boiling water; cook until tender.
Saute meat and pepper tops with salt.
Drain off excess oil.
Mix well the meat, rice, 1/2 of liquid from tomatoes and soups.
If you want it hotter, add rest of tomato juice.
Place peppers in pan and stuff with mixture. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, or until bubbling hot.

recipes.title: Blt Dip
steps: Let chill about 1 hour.
Serve on crackers or cocktail rye.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
steps: Cream together butter, cream cheese and sugar.
Add and beat well the almond, vanilla and lemon flavor.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Stir in cake flour and mix well.
Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours (check after 1 hour).
Makes a large cake.

recipes.title: Baskin Robbins Cake
steps: Crust:
Mix flour, butter and pecans.
Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 20 minutes at 350°.
Cool.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
steps: Combine butter, shortening and sugar, creaming until light and fluffy.
Add vanilla.
Work in flour and coconut gradually until well blended.
Form into 2 rolls; chill in refrigerator overnight. Heat oven to 275°.
Slice dough 1/4-inch thick.
Slices may be cut in fancy shapes.
Bake for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Dream Pie
ingredients: 1 pkg. Dream Whip, prepared according to directions on pkg.
3/4 tsp. pumpkin pie spice or cinnamon
steps: Prepare Dream Whip as directed on package. Combine 1 cup prepared Dream Whip with pudding mix, pumpkin, 2/3 cup milk and spice.
Beat slowly with eggbeater just until mixed.
Pour into pie shell. Chill in refrigerator until set, about 2 hours. Top with remaining Dream Whip.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake(No Eggs)
steps: Cream oil and sugar.
Add applesauce and flour which has been mixed with spices.
Mix in raisins.
Mix soda with hot water and add last.
Pour batter into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Sprinkle with granulated sugar, making a light coating.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.
No frosting is needed.
Best served warm.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Garlic salt and flour cubes; brown in 2 tablespoons oil. Drain fat; add next 5 ingredients.
Simmer 2 hours.
You may add more water and consomme.
Cool and add sour cream and soup.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Cake
steps: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs, bananas, pecans, buttermilk and vanilla.
Sift dry ingredients.
Gradually add to creamed mix.
Beat well.
Bake at 325° until done when tested.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
steps: In bacon drippings, cook rice, onion and green pepper until onion is tender. Add bacon and other ingredients. Cover and simmer over low heat about 30 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid absorbed. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Parmesan Potatoes
ingredients: 5 medium potatoes, cubed in 1 1/2 inch pieces
steps: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix flour and Parmesan cheese in a plastic bag.
Shake a few potato cubes in bag at a time and put in buttered pan.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.
With a spatula, turn over and bake another 1/2 hour.
Leftover cheese may be put in freezer for next time.

recipes.title: Creme Sherry Wine Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix cake mix, pudding, eggs, salad oil, sherry and walnuts or pecans.
Grease and lightly flour Bundt pan. Pour in pan and bake at least 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Crescents
steps: Cream oleo, sugar and vanilla; add flour then nuts, mix well. Roll and shape into crescents.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Remove and cool slightly.
Put powdered sugar into a zip lock baggie.
When the cookies are cooled a little add a few at a time to the powdered sugar and shake gently.
Shake off any extra powdered sugar.
Set on paper towels to finish cooling.
This makes 4 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Molasses Cookie
steps: Combine sugar, oil and egg; beat well. Add molasses and beat. Combine flour and other ingredients. Stir into sugar mixture. Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Place 1-inch apart on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
steps: Beat egg, brown sugar and oil until smooth.
Beat in yogurt and vanilla.
Add oats, flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Beat until well mixed.
Stir in raisins.
Drop batter by rounded teaspoonfuls, about 2-inches apart on baking sheet lightly sprayed with vegetable oil spray.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until cookies are lightly browned.
Cool on wire rack.
Each cookie contains 59 calories.
Makes 48 cookies.

recipes.title: A-Maze-Ing Cake
ingredients: 1 (17 oz.) can Pride of Illinois sweet corn
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, mix corn, brown sugar and white sugar.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Add oil; beat until well mixed.
Stir in raisins and pecans.
Mix together dry ingredients; add to liquid.
Stir until well blended.
Pour into greased tube pan and bake for 45 minutes or until tests done. Can be used with or without frosting.

recipes.title: Chicken And Biscuits
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Roll chicken in mixture of flour, salt, pepper and paprika.
Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add chicken pieces, skin side down.
Bake 40 minutes; then turn chicken.
Combine soup and milk; pour over chicken.
Place biscuits on top and bake 10 to 12 minutes or until biscuits are brown.

recipes.title: Bean And Bacon Soup
ingredients: 1/4 c. each: diced celery and red bell pepper
1 tsp. olive oil or vegetable oil
1 c. canned Italian tomatoes with liquid, pureed
4 oz. rinsed and drained canned white kidney beans (cannellini beans)
steps: In a 1-quart casserole, combine onion, celery, bell pepper, garlic and oil.
Cover; vent top and microwave on High 3 minutes until softened.
Stir halfway through cooking.
Add remaining ingredients and stir.
Cover and microwave on High 1 minute until thoroughly heated.
Serves two 1-cup servings.
Contains 164 calories, 6 gm fat and 496 mg sodium.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
steps: Mix together by hand.
Grease
and
flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Frost cake while warm.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
steps: Mix everything together.
Pour
into
well-greased pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
steps: Cream margarine and brown sugar.
Add egg and milk alternately with flour and baking powder.
Bake in muffin tin and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Bake in hot oven.

recipes.title: Salmon Patties
steps: Mix all ingredients well, adding milk only if mixture is too dry.
Fry in heated, buttered skillet until done.
Sprinkle lightly with garlic salt on each side of patty while frying.

recipes.title: Great Northern Bean Stew
ingredients: 1 (28 oz.) can whole tomatoes, cut up (undrained)
1 (15.5 oz.) can Green Giant or Joan of Arc Great Northern beans, drained
1/3 c. chopped fresh parsley or 1 Tbsp. dried parsley flakes
steps: In large saucepan or 4-quart Dutch oven, brown sausage and onions; drain.
Stir in all remaining ingredients; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Makes 6 (1 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Party Mix
steps: Melt candy coating in double boiler.
Pour over remaining ingredients and mix well.

recipes.title: Chicken With White Wine
steps: Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper and paprika.
Coat well with flour.
Brown in 1/4 cup butter.
Remove chicken and add remaining butter.
Brown mushrooms, scallions, celery and garlic. Return chicken to pan.
Add wine and simmer slowly for 45 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Squash Balls
steps: Mix cooked squash, finely chopped onion, 1 egg, flour, and baking powder, salt, and pepper. Form small balls and roll in crushed corn flakes. Fry in deep oil until golden brown. Serve hot. Makes 6 to 8 servings. Very Good.

recipes.title: Nicaraguan Fried Rice
steps: Wash and drain rice.
Set aside.
In skillet, heat oil and saute onion, green pepper and carrot.
Add 2 cups water and salt on medium heat until rice is done.
Three minutes before, spread chopped tomato on top.
When rice is done, top with lid.

recipes.title: Elegant Butternut Squash Soup
ingredients: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
about 1/3 c. freshly grated Parmesan cheese
steps: Halve the squash lengthwise; peel, seed and cut into chunks. Place in a soup pot with the broth. Simmer, partially covered, until tender, 20 to 25 minutes. Transfer the squash to a bowl with a slotted spoon; reserve broth. Melt the butter in the oil in a nonstick skillet over very low heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring, until wilted, about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with the mace and ginger. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute more. Add the cooked onion mixture and the brown sugar to the squash and stir well. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Crunchy Surprise Bars
ingredients: 1/3 c. peanut butter (or use 1/3 c. crunchy peanut butter)
steps: Mix sugar, butter, molasses, egg yolk and vanilla with a spoon.
Stir in flour and 1 cup of chocolate bits.
Press dough in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake until golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes, at 350°.

recipes.title: Infallible Rice
steps: Saute onions in butter until transparent.
Combine onions, rice and hot broth.
Bring to boil; turn on low heat.
Cover and cook for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Wash tomatoes and scoop out pulp.
Save caps.
Sprinkle inside of tomatoes with salt substitute.
Pan broil onions in a little oil until soft.
Now mix onions, parsley, dill, raisins or currants, nuts, rice and more of olive oil.
Fill tomatoes with remaining oil and the water.
Weigh down the tomatoes with a heavy plate.
Cover casserole.
Let simmer for 30 minutes or until rice is done.
Let cool.
May be refrigerated.
Serve cold.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 bouquet garni (1 parsley sprig, 1 thyme sprig and 1 bay leaf)
steps: Peel and slice onions.
In a skillet, saute onions in butter over low heat until soft and lightly brown.
Sprinkle with flour; add water, stirring.
Crumble bouillon cubes and add to pan.
Add bouquet garni, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Cover; cook for about 20 minutes.
Add white wine to soup.
Transfer soup to individual ovenproof soup bowls or ovenproof large bowl.
Place sliced bread on top.
Sprinkle generously with grated cheese.
Heat oven to 450° for about 10 minutes until cheese melts and turns golden brown.

recipes.title: Rice
steps: Fry bacon; add celery, onion, green pepper and tomato and saute.
Add rice.
Let brown with bacon and vegetables; add water or chicken broth.
Cover; let come to boil, turn heat to low and simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pizza Batter Bread
steps: In a mixer bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups of flour, yeast, oregano and garlic powder.
In a saucepan, heat water, oleo, sugar and salt just until warm, stirring to melt oleo.
Add to dry ingredients in bowl.
Beat 3 minutes at high speed.
By hand, stir in pepperoni and enough remaining flour to make a moderately soft dough.
Cover; let rise in warm place until doubled in bulk, 45 to 60 minutes.
Stir dough down.
Spread evenly in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Let rise 30 more minutes.
Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly.
Stir in egg yolks, one at a time.
Add soda to flour.
Add flour and sour cream alternately to creamed mixture.
Beat egg whites stiff and fold in.
Bake in large tube pan, greased and floured, at 300° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Leave in pan for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: New England Pumpkin Pie
steps: Thicken boiling milk with flour (mix flour with milk and cook until smooth).
Mix all other ingredients, except egg whites.
When thoroughly mixed, add slightly beaten egg whites.
Bake until brown on top; well done.
Bake in 425° oven first 15 minutes, then 325° for 30 plus minutes.

recipes.title: 60-Minute Cheese Fondue Boat
steps: Set aside 1 cup of flour.
Mix remaining flour, sugar, salt, garlic and yeast.
Stir in water and margarine.
Mix in enough reserved flour to make soft dough.
Knead 4 minutes.
Roll dough 18 x 8 inches.
Spread mayonnaise down center third of length.
Top with cheese and onions.
Seal long edges over filling at 1 inch intervals; seal ends.
Set on greased baking sheet.
Cover.
Place over large shallow pan of boiling water; let rise 15 minutes.
Bake for 20 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Mina'S Old-Fashioned Cookies
steps: Beat sugar and shortening; add egg, milk and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients.
Bake 14 minutes at 350°.
Drop by spoon on ungreased cookie sheet.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Chewy Pecan Squares
steps: Grease and flour an 8-inch square pan.
Stir together egg, brown sugar and vanilla. Quickly stir in flour, soda and salt. Add nuts.
Spread in pan and bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes. Should be soft in center when removed from oven.
Do not overbake. Leave in pan and cut into 2-inch squares.
Makes 16 squares.

recipes.title: Raisin Pie(From The Parsonage Kitchen)
steps: Combine raisins, sugar, flour, vinegar, butter and salt in boiling water.
Roll pie dough and spread bottom crust with margarine; add raisin mixture.
Wet edges of crust with water. Place top crust on top of filling and seal down good.
Bake in hot oven at 425° for 15 minutes, then lower heat and bake until brown.

recipes.title: Chicken Or Turkey Casserole(Serves 12 To 15)
ingredients: 1 small can Pet milk or 1/2 c. milk
steps: Mix and put in 13 x 11-inch casserole.
Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Put buttered crumbs on top of casserole the last 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Crazy Cake
steps: Mix all dry ingredients together.
Add all wet ingredients and mix well.
(Mixture will look like pudding.)
