Bake in 8 x 8-inch pan at 350° for 25 minutes.
Frost with Butter Frosting.

recipes.title: Caramel Nut Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter, brown sugar and shortening. Gradually add white sugar and beat. Add eggs 1 at a time and beat. Combine baking powder, flour and salt. Add alternately with milk. Add vanilla and nuts. Blend well. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Let cool 15 minutes and take out of pan.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Cream together butter, sugar and eggs.
Add sour cream, flour, salt and baking soda.
Mix well.
Can also add walnuts or raisins to this recipe.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Paul'S Favorite Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix margarine, powdered sugar, eggs, vanilla and almond extract until thoroughly mixed up.
Add flour, soda and cream of tartar. Cover and chill overnight.
Set oven to 375°.
Divide dough.
Roll each part of dough to about 3/16-inch thick on a floured cloth covered board.
Cut into desired shapes; sprinkle with sugar.
Put on baking sheet.
Bake about 7 minutes or until they are light brown.

recipes.title: Colleen'S Ultra Fudgy Brownies
steps: Microwave halved chocolate squares and butter in a large glass bowl for 1 minute and 45 seconds or until butter is melted.
Stir until chocolate is melted.
Let this mixture cool.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Add remaining ingredients.
Drop by small spoonfuls into deep, hot fat.
Puppies float when done.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
steps: Dice chicken and and with mix rice and mushroom soup.
Top with cheese.
Heat until the casserole reaches 140 degrees and cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
steps: Cut tomatoes into 1/2-inch slices.
Mix flour, salt, pepper and seasoned salt in one bowl.
Mix eggs and milk in another bowl. Dip tomato slices into egg mixture, then into flour.
Repeat again, coating well.
Fry in hot oil until golden brown; drain on paper towels.
Arrange on platter and enjoy!

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 4 c. chicken breasts, cooked and diced
1 pkg. Uncle Ben's long grain rice with seasoning
1 can French style green beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Mix all together in a bowl. Put in 3-quart casserole dish. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Porcupine Balls
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix rice, 1/2 cup water, onion, salts, garlic powder and pepper.
Shape into balls.
Place in ungreased baking dish.
Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meatballs. Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes.
Uncover and bake 15 minutes more.

recipes.title: Camper'S Fare Skillet Spaghetti
steps: Brown hamburger.
Add salt and pepper.
Pour off fat.
Add all other ingredients to hamburger in a skillet.
Cook until thickened, stirring occasionally, about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Rolls
steps: Let yeast dissolve in 1/4 cup warm water.
Mix flour and liquid to form soft dough.
Knead gently on floured board.
Form dough in 12 small balls and place in muffin pan.
Brush with oleo. Let double in size.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp 2
steps: Slice peeled apples into
a 1-quart buttered baking dish. Sprinkle with spices and lemon juice.
Work together sugar, flour and butter until crumbly.
Spread over the apples.
Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes in a moderate oven (375°), or until apples are tender.
If mixture becomes dry while cooking, add a small amount of water.
Serve cold with whipped cream or hot with plain cream.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Eight Layer Salad
steps: Layer in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with shredded cheese.

recipes.title: Creamy Coleslaw
steps: Mix together and refrigerate.
Reduce 1/3 to 1/4 for family.

recipes.title: Shrimp Jambalaya
steps: Melt margarine in large skillet over medium heat.
Saute onion and pepper until onion is transparent.
Add tomatoes, rice, seasonings and water.
Cook 10 minutes over medium heat.
Cut shrimp in half lengthwise; add to skillet; mix well.
Cook covered, stirring occasionally, until liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook chicken and slice.
Cook broccoli.
Heat soup, mayo and curry powder.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place broccoli on bottom.
Place chicken on top and cover with soup mixture and sprinkle with grated cheese.
Three cups cooked rice can also be used as the first layer.
Bake in 350° oven for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Snowballs
steps: In large bowl combine all ingredients except confectioners sugar.
With hands, mix until thoroughly blended.
Refrigerate dough 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375°.
Form dough into 1 1/4-inch balls. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet; bake 15 to 20 minutes or until set, but not brown.
Let stand 1 minute.
Remove to wire racks; cool partially.
Roll in confectioners sugar while still warm; roll again.
Makes about 20.

recipes.title: Tuna Burgers
steps: Mix all ingredients in medium bowl by hand. Take a small handful and form into patty.
Fry on medium-high with oil just covering bottom of pan. Fry until lightly brown.
Makes 6 burgers.

recipes.title: Waffles
steps: Combine all dry ingredients.
Mix everything but egg whites together.
Beat egg whites and fold into batter.
Makes about 12 waffles.

recipes.title: Cherry Crisp
steps: Mix dry ingredients until crumbly.
Pat half of mixture into an 8 x 8-inch pan.
Spread pie filling over mixture.
Cover with other half of crumb mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Ann Mcgill Erck'S Sour Cream Coffee Cake
steps: Cream
sugar,
butter
and eggs until smooth.
Add sour cream and
vanilla.
Sift
flour,
salt and baking powder and add.
Pour half this batter into greased and floured tube pan. Add half
of topping of cinnamon, brown sugar and pecans.
Add remaining batter and remaining topping.
Bake 1 hour at 350°. Let
stand until
cool
enough
to
handle
and
unmold cake. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Congo Bars
steps: Cream sugar, shortening and eggs.
Add baking powder, salt and flour.
Stir in chips and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in a 10 x 14-inch pan.

recipes.title: Blonde Brownies
steps: Sift dry ingredients; set aside.
Cream together all other ingredients; mix well and add to flour mixture.
Add chocolate chips and nuts (optional).
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cornbread Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, fried and crumbled up
steps: Chop the onions, tomatoes, green peppers and pickles and mix with the cornbread and bacon.
Add pickle juice and mayonnaise to taste for the dressing.

recipes.title: Crunchy Fudge Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. Nestle butterscotch flavored morsels (1 c.)
1 (6 oz.) pkg. Nestle semi-sweet real chocolate morsels (1 c.)
steps: In a large saucepan, melt butterscotch flavored morsels and peanut butter over very low heat, stirring constantly until smooth. Stir in cereal.
Press half of the mixture in buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Chill.
Set remaining mixture aside.
Melt over hot (not boiling) water the chocolate morsels, sugar, margarine and water, stirring constantly until smooth.
Spread over chilled cereal mixture.
Spread remaining cereal mixture evenly over top. Press in gently.
Chill until firm (1 hour).
Yields 25 squares (1 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch).

recipes.title: Boiled Raisin Cake
steps: Boil together 3 minutes the first 8 ingredients.
Cool.
Sift together the remaining ingredients.
Add to first part and bake. Can be used at holiday time for fruit cake.
Improves with time. Can be made ahead to season.

recipes.title: Lemon Krispies Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Stir together dry cake mix, butter and eggs in a mixing bowl.
Stir in cereal.
Roll dough into 1 1/2 inch balls.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
bake 8 to 10 minutes until edges are brown.
Cool on cookie sheet before moving to a cooling rack.

recipes.title: Wacky Cake
steps: Sift together in mixing bowl first 5 ingredients.
Add next 4 and stir until smooth.
Pour into an ungreased 8x8 square pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Use any glaze or icing but must be iced and served from pan.
If quantity is doubled bake in 9x13 pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie(Lo-Cal)
steps: Make and set aside.

recipes.title: Christmas Brunch Sour Cream Coffee Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla.
Sift the dry ingredients together and add to the butter mixture alternately with the sour cream.
Pour half the batter into a buttered tube pan.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
steps: Melt butter (2 tablespoons).
Add flour and seasonings.
Cook over low heat until bubbly.
Slowly stir in milk.
Heat to boiling.
Stir in corn and egg.
Pour into casserole dish; sprinkle with crumbs and butter.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Cobbler
steps: Melt margarine in an 8 x 11-inch Pyrex pan in oven.
Combine apples, water and 1 cup sugar in a saucepan.
Cook 3 to 4 minutes. Pour apples in pan with margarine.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.
Mix flour, baking powder, milk and 1 cup sugar.
Pour over apples.
Sprinkle with brown sugar and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburger Surprise
ingredients: 1 cup of small diced potatoes cooked
1/2 cup of bell peppers diced small
steps: Brown meat, onions and bell peppers in skillet. Drain excess fat. Add rice and diced cooked potatoes. Simmer for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Walnut Crinkles(Croatian)
steps: Chop raisins and walnuts finely.
Melt chocolate.
Blend together butter, sugar and vanilla until fluffy.
Stir in raisins, nuts and chocolate.
Mix until well blended.

recipes.title: Curried Celery And Apples
steps: In a skillet, saute celery and onion in butter until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in apple. Cover and simmer for 3 minutes. Sprinkle with flour, curry powder, salt and pepper. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve immediately. Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Wild Rice Soup
ingredients: 2 c. chicken broth made from chicken bouillon
6 oz. cooked, diced white chicken meat
steps: Saute onions and celery in nonstick skillet sprayed with Pam. Combine flour with 1/2 cup of the broth in a small jar with a lid. Shake until there are no lumps.
Add to kettle and slowly add rest of broth and milk.
Stir over medium heat until thickened. Add cooked wild rice and chicken.
Heat to serving temperature. Makes 6 (1 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Almond Bark Candy
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. white chocolate or almond bark
steps: Melt together over low heat or on 50% power in microwave the almond bark and peanut butter.
In large bowl, mix peanuts, marshmallows and Rice Krispies.
Pour melted mixture over and mix all together.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Refrigerate to set.
These freeze well.

recipes.title: Spider Sandwiches
steps: With a 2 1/2-inch round cutter, cut a circle from each bread slice.
Spread about 2 tablespoons of peanut butter on half of bread rounds; top with remaining bread rounds.
Make 2 small indentations on top of sandwiches for "eyes".
Using peanut butter as glue, push one raisin into each indentation.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Oaties
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine butterscotch morsels and butter; melt over boiling water.
Remove from heat.
Mix boiling water with baking soda and add to butterscotch mixture.
Gradually blend in the remaining ingredients.
Drop by slightly rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
steps: Thaw berries.
Mix undrained berries, eggs and oil.
Sift dry ingredients into strawberry mixture, reserving about 1/2 cup flour to sprinkle over nuts.
Blend thoroughly.
Add flour to nuts, coating well.
Add to batter.
Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
If top browns too quickly, cover with tent-shaped aluminum foil.
Yield: 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
ingredients: 1/2 c. nuts (pecans) or nuts of choice
steps: Cream butter and sugar together. Beat eggs and combine with butter mix. Add bananas, beat well. Mix all dry ingredients together and combine to beaten mixture. Add nuts. Grease and flour two loaf pans. Divide mixture between loaf pans and bake at 350 degree for about 45 minutes or until lightly brown and done.

recipes.title: Chicken-A-La-Can-Can
ingredients: 1 (12 1/2 oz.) can or 2 small cans boned chicken or 1 1/3 c. chicken
steps: Combine soup, water and chicken.
Add dry rice and 1/2 can French fried onions.
Stir to mix.
Pour in buttered casserole. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Sprinkle remaining onions on top; bake 15 minutes more.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can pineapple tidbits, drain and save 3 Tbsp. juice
steps: Combine juice, flour and sugar.
Put in cheese and pineapple. Put mixture into casserole dish.
Mix Ritz crackers and melted butter.
Put on top.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
steps: Mix all ingredients. Pour into casserole dish, top with more cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Grease loaf pans and line bottoms with waxed paper.
Use 2 regular pans (9 5/8 x 5 1/2 x 2 3/4-inch) or 6 mini pans (5 1/2 x 3 x 2 1/4-inch).

recipes.title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients together and let stand until you mix and roll out single pie crust.
Fill pie crust and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 425°; turn down temperature to 350° and continue to bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Prune Cake
steps: Mix ingredients and bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Cake can be baked in Bundt pan or made as cupcakes.

recipes.title: Fireman Hash Casserole
steps: In a large skillet cook ground beef until crumbly.
Drain off fat.
Add onions and green pepper.
Cook until they are tender. Stir in tomatoes, rice, chili powder, salt and pepper.
Mix well. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish.

recipes.title: Creamed Spinach
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, defrosted and drained
steps: Beat eggs in large bowl.
Add cottage cheese, grated Cheddar, butter, spinach, flour, salt and pepper.
Pour into 2-quart buttered casserole.
Bake on low, uncovered, for 1 hour at 350°. Yields 12 to 14 servings.

recipes.title: Elegant Chicken Breast
ingredients: 4 to 6 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, halved
steps: Slightly cook bacon.
Wrap one piece around each breast. Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish.
Mix butter and Worcestershire sauce.
Pour over chicken; sprinkle mushrooms and scallions over top.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, basting once or twice.

recipes.title: Baked Rabbit
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Add seasonings to flour.
Add rabbit. Heat oil.
Add rabbit; brown on both sides.
In casserole dish, add rabbit, mushrooms, milk, butter and onion.
Cover with foil; cook for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Icebox Cookies
steps: Cream sugars and margarine; add eggs and stir well.
Stir in vanilla.
Add all dry ingredients and mix well.
Shape dough into 2 logs.
Refrigerate overnight.
Slice and bake at 325° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: No-Peek Chicken Or Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 cut up chicken or 6 to 8 pork chops
steps: Mix the soup, water and rice and put in a 9 X 13 pan. Put chicken or pork chops on top. Sprinkle with the onion soup mix. Bake at 350° for about 12 hours.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Mix together.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake 1 hour in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Beatrice Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Boil the peppers in water until soft.
Melt margarine in a large saucepan. Add onion, bell pepper, celery, garlic and parsley. Simmer until tender.
Add ground meat to mixture.
Cook ground meat until brown. Add shrimp and crab meat.
Cook for 15 minutes. Add bread crumbs. Add salt and pepper to taste. Stuff cooled peppers. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Serves 4. Contains 375 calories.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken And Rice
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cubed
1 each small onion and green pepper, chopped
1 pkg. frozen sweet corn, thawed (10 oz. pkg.)
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet on medium-high heat. Add chicken, onion and pepper. Cook and stir until chicken is cooked through. Add corn, broth and salsa. Bring to a boil.
Stir in rice. Cover. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheese. Cover.
Let stand 2 minutes or until cheese melts.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Cocoa Cola Cake
steps: Mix in large mixing bowl the sugar, flour and baking soda. Mix the butter, Coca Cola, and cocoa in a saucepan and bring to a full rolling boil.
Add the hot mixture to the dry ingredients and stir.
Add the buttermilk, eggs and marshmallows to the mixture. Mix all well.
Pour into a greased 13 x 9 inch baking pan and bake for 30 - 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Dog Bone Treats
steps: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl until well blended.
Roll the dough out on a floured board.
Cut out treats with a dog bone shaped cookie cutter.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until dry.

recipes.title: Shanghai Chow Mein
ingredients: 2 whole chicken breasts, cut into chunks while still partially frozen
steps: Saute chicken chunks in oil until firm.
Stir in celery and cook 2 minutes.
(Should be crispy.)
Add vegetables, soup and soy sauce.
Stir in onions.
Heat through and serve over rice.
Top with noodles.

recipes.title: Crawfish Etouffee
ingredients: 1 lb. cleaned crawfish tails, including crawfish fat
steps: Saute onions and celery in margarine until soft.
Add everything, including fat which adds much of the flavor, except the crawfish tails and simmer for 10 minutes, sprinkling the flour over the contents of the pan.
This is to give the sauce a little body and you can add more, if you like.
Now, add the crawfish tails and water (2 cups or more, depending on the fact you may need to serve 2 or more additional persons); simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Holiday Cauliflower
steps: Bread cauliflower into medium sized flowerets; cook in boiling water until tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain well; set aside.
In saucepan, saute mushrooms in butter.
Blend in flour gradually. Stir in milk.
Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat until thick.
Stir in salt, cheese and pimento.
Place 1/2 of cauliflower in buttered 2-quart casserole.
Cover with 1/2 the sauce.
Add remaining cauliflower and top with remaining sauce. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Miracle Pie
steps: Put all ingredients in blender; mix, then pour into two 8-inch pie pans (greased and floured).
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.
A crust will form on bottom, pie filling in center and coconut on top.

recipes.title: Apple Goodie
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with remaining ingredients mixed together.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pie Crust For Double Crust
steps: Mix flour and salt together in a bowl. Add the shortening and mix it into the flour and salt with a fork or your fingertips until the mixture has the texture of coarse crumbs. Mix in the water, a little at a time. Refrigerate to chill before rolling out the dough.

recipes.title: Spicy Molasses Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. cinnamon, ginger, cloves and nutmeg
steps: Combine flour, soda and spices.
Beat butter, sugars, egg and molasses.
Then add dry ingredients.
Use a cookie press on cold ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Salmon Corn Chowder
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can salmon, drained, boned and flaked
steps: In large saucepan, combine potatoes, onion, celery, broth, garlic and marjoram.
Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer, covered, about 10 minutes.
Stir in milk and oleo.
Combine flour and corn; stir into soup.
Heat, but do not boil, until slightly thickened.
Gently stir in salmon and heat through.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Broccoli Supreme
ingredients: 1 box Stove Top stuffing bread crumbs
steps: Cook broccoli until tender, 10 to 15 minutes; drain.
Put in bottom of baking dish.
Mix the next 7 ingredients.
Place on top of broccoli.
Melt butter and mix with bread crumbs; put on top of mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes(Old Recipe)
ingredients: flour to make stiff dough (about 2 1/2 c.)
steps: Beat sugar, Crisco and egg together. Add soda and baking powder to buttermilk and stir until it foams. Add to other mixture. Add vanilla and flour.
Roll out and cut cookies.
Bake in a
400° oven.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 10-inch Bundt pan. In a large bowl, mix flour, sugar, brown sugar, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.
In a small bowl, beat eggs slightly; stir in orange juice, salad oil and vanilla.
Stir egg mixture, carrots, raisins, nuts and apples into flour mixture just until flour is moistened.
Pour batter into pan.
Bake 50 to 55 minutes.
Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove cake from pan and cool completely.

recipes.title: Wyoming Whopper Cookies
ingredients: 6 c. old fashion oats (not quick cooking)
steps: Melt butter over low heat.
Blend in sugar, eggs and peanut butter; mix until smooth.
Add oats, soda, raisins and chocolate chips (mixture will be sticky).
Drop on greased baking sheet with large spoon.
Flatten slightly.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes for large cookies.
Remove to cooling rack.
Yields 2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Cornbread
steps: Bake for about 30 to 45 minutes at 425°.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake Cookies
steps: Mix fruit in flour to coat.
Add salt, coconut and pecans. Add Eagle Brand; mix well.
Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 275° for 25 minutes.
Cool completely.
Store in airtight container about 5 days before serving.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped green onions and tops
steps: Melt shortening. Blend in flour and brown, stirring constantly. Add water gradually and cook until thick, stirring constantly. Add remaining ingredients, except rice. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove bay leaves. Serve over rice. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Potatoes Au Gratin
steps: Peel and cube potatoes.
Place in a well-greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with flour and pour milk to cover.
Stir potatoes with a fork so that all are well coated with flour and milk.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Cover with the grated cheese and dot with butter.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Nut Roll
steps: Beat eggs and sugar 5 minutes.
Mix together pumpkin and lemon juice and add to first mixture.
Sift together flour, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt and add.

Spread evenly in a jelly roll pan which has been greased and floured. Line the pan with wax paper. Sprinkle walnuts over the batter. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle a dish towel with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Chicken And Scampi
steps: Boil chicken quickly.
Separate into serving pieces or strips. Cover with spaghetti sauce mix (I use Giant's brand).
Add vegetables.
Simmer on stove or in oven.
Just before time to serve, add prepared shrimp (the amount and size you can afford that week)!
Cook 3 or 4 minutes.
Serve on rice.

recipes.title: Cajun Jambalaya
steps: Brown sausage in large, deep pot.
Remove and add chicken. Cook chicken until done.
Remove.
Throw in vegetables and ham and cook until tender.
Add spices.
Add sausage and debone chicken. Stir thoroughly.
Add water to cover.
Bring to boil; turn down and cover.
Cook about 20 minutes until rice is done.
Stir occasionally to avoid sticking.
Serve with salad and garlic bread.
A Louisiana favorite!

recipes.title: Easy Egg Custard
steps: Mix well with whisk.
Pour in custard cups.
Bake at 325° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Cheese Vegetable Soup
steps: Cook carrots and onion in boiling water until tender.
Stir in soup, milk, cheese and Worcestershire sauce.
Stir over low heat until cheese melts.
Garnish with parsley.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Fluffy Stuffed Potatoes
steps: Bake potatoes
in
a 12-inch Dutch oven for 1 hour with 12 coals on top and 10 coals on bottom.
Cut baked potatoes in half lengthwise.
Scoop	out
potato and mash with milk, sour cream, margarine,	chives,
salt and pepper.
Mound back into shells. Add
grated
cheese
on
top.
Sprinkle with paprika. Place in Dutch oven.
Bake 25 minutes with 14 coals on top and 12 coals on bottom.

recipes.title: Never Fail Chocolate Cake
steps: Blend well.
Place in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Place in oven. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Garlic And Cheese Biscuits
steps: Melt butter and mix into all ingredients.
Stir and drop onto baking sheet.
Bake at 400° until browned on top.
If desired, brush on butter and sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Fruit Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 box Pillsbury white (pudding in the mix) cake mix
1 box Pillsbury vanilla (pudding in the mix) cake mix
3 fresh peaches, sliced and diced (3 c.)
steps: Mix fruit, tapioca and sugar; set aside.
Combine the two cake mixes.
Add oil, eggs and water and mix well by hand.
Add fruit mixture and blend well.
(Mixture will be thick and sticky.) Spoon into greased and floured pans (4 round or 2 rectangular) and spread evenly.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Bean Casserole
steps: Mix the first 5 ingredients together.
Combine crackers and butter, sprinkle over casserole.
Bake at 350° for 20-25 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Melt shortening; mix with oatmeal.
Combine egg with sugar and add oatmeal mixture.
Stir soda into milk.
Add flour to first mixture alternately with milk.
Add flavoring and cinnamon.
Stir in floured nuts or raisins.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets.
Bake in a 375° oven until lightly browned, about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Nut Cake
steps: Blend eggs, butter, margarine, sugar and vanilla flavoring. Add flour. Blend in applesauce. Roll nuts in flour. Blend in nuts and coconut. Cook at 250° for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Ham Loaf
steps: Shape in loaf and bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Creamy Corn Chowder
steps: In medium saucepot, saute bacon until lightly brown.
Remove bacon and drain.
Saute onion and red pepper.
Cook 3 to 5 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in flour.
Gradually stir in milk, corn, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.
Bring just to boiling point over low heat; simmer one minute, stirring constantly.
Sprinkle chowder with sauteed bacon pieces.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Peel your eggplant and slice about 1/4 inch thick.
Lightly flour and fry in oil (not a lot).
Drain on paper towels and set aside.

recipes.title: Okra Fritters
steps: Combine all ingredients and stir well.
Drop by tablespoon into hot oil.
Turn once.
Drain and serve at once.

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits
steps: Combine all ingredients and roll 1/2 inch thick.
Cut with 2 inch cutter.
Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Margie'S Brown Rounds
steps: Cream margarine, sugar and egg.
Add remaining ingredients. Drop and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped onion, cook in bacon fat
steps: Add beans and brown sugar to onion cooked in bacon fat.
Mix all and place slices of bacon on top.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour (approximately).

recipes.title: Butterballs
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add vanilla.
Blend in flour and nuts until like pie crust, crumbly.
Chill 1 hour.
Roll in balls. Bake 15 minutes or until light brown at 325°.
Roll in powdered sugar when cool.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler No. 1
steps: Mix sugar, flour, milk, baking powder and salt together.
Melt stick of margarine in a pan.
Pour sugar and flour mixture in pan. Add peaches.
Bake at 375° until mixture forms a cake and browns, approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Garlic Cheese Bread
steps: Shake Molly McButter on bread.
Add both cheeses and garlic powder.
Broil until brown.

recipes.title: Blueberry Griddle Cakes
steps: Beat egg well.
Add salt and milk.
Stir baking powder with flour and stir in other mixture. Beat until smooth.
Add blueberries. Drop from spoon and brown both sides.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Mom'S Hot Cake
ingredients: 1 c. buttermilk or half and half
steps: Cream shortening and sugar together.
Add eggs and dry ingredients alternately with milk.
Stir in vanilla.
Bake at 350° until straw comes clean.
Serve with a hot caramel sauce.

recipes.title: Chow Chow
ingredients: 30 onions, cut up or 1 to 2 lb. pickling onions, very small ones
4 c. vinegar (definitely not Heinz, too strong)
steps: Cut up vegetables coarsely and put in large container.
Put in pickling salt.
Add 2 trays of ice cubes, mix through.
Cover with cloth and let stand overnight in a very large canner (15 1/2-quart or larger).
In morning, make syrup of vinegar, sugar, turmeric and mustard.
Cook down until mixed throughly.
Mix flour in some syrup and then add to the syrup in pot (canner).
Cook until clear by boiling.
Turn heat down.
Fill a colander with vegetables and then add to syrup.
Do this until all vegetables are in canner.
Cook until it comes to a boil.
Boil slowly for 5 minutes, no longer. Fill clean, sterilized jars and seal.
Yields 16 to 20 pints.

recipes.title: Bread Sticks
ingredients: milk (enough to make a good consistency)
steps: In mixing bowl, combine flour and butter, stirring butter into flour and then add milk to desired consistency.
Batter should not be thin but have a texture that will hold its shape when out on flour surface (wax paper).

recipes.title: Mrs. Field'S Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream the ingredients.
Recipe can be divided in sections for making different kinds.
Can add chocolate chips, grated chocolate, raisins, nuts, etc.
Bake at 375° for 6 to 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Rolled Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Chill for 2 hours.
Roll out, cut and bake at 350° until golden brown.
Cool.

recipes.title: Albondigas(Meatball Soup)
steps: Put 1/2 of first 8 ingredients in a large bowl and other 1/2 of same ingredients in a large soup pot.
To pot, add approximately 4 quarts of water and 1 heaping tablespoonful of flour.
Boil.

recipes.title: Hot Crab Dip
steps: Melt butter and cream cheese in top of double boiler.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Serve in a chafing dish. Serve with dip size Fritos or Wheat Thins.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 can reduced fat cream of mushroom soup
steps: Pour rice into buttered casserole dish; sprinkle with soup mix.
Add water.
Place chicken pieces on top.
Pour soup over chicken.
Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: "A B C" Sandwich
steps: In a bowl, combine cheese, apple, salad dressing and walnuts. Spread on 6 slices of bread and place 2 slices of bacon on each. Cover with egg slices.
Top with tomatoes, if desired, and remaining slices of bread.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 1 or 2 envelopes Lipton's beefy onion soup
cornstarch and water (as needed to thicken)
steps: Trim fat from round steak on all edges; cut meat in lengthwise strips; coat meat in flour, salt and pepper mixture.
Brown meat in oil.
Add soup mix and 4 cups of water.
Simmer for at least 1 hour; until meat is tender.
Add extra water as needed.
Add bell peppers cut into strips, cook until peppers turn color, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Thicken with cornstarch and water.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Clo'S Pound Cake
steps: In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, alternately with flour until all are well mixed.
Add salt.
Pour into tube pan.
Begin baking in cold oven. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.title: Self-Crust Coconut Custard Pie
steps: Put ingredients into blender and blend about 20 seconds.
Pour into 10-inch pie pan.
Bake until golden brown in a 350° oven for about 30 minutes or until knife inserted in middle comes out clean.
Crust forms at the bottom, custard in the middle and the coconut on top.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients together.
Bet eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla until creamy.
Add zucchini and stir in dry ingredients, just until moist.
Bake in two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans at 350° for 1 hour.
Can omit nuts.
Freezes well.

recipes.title: Lydia'S Corn Chowder
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, peeled and coarsely chopped
steps: In a large saucepan combine potatoes, water, bouillon, red pepper and black pepper.
Bring to boil, reduce heat.
Cover and simmer about 10 minutes or until potatoes are just tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in 2 1/2 cups of the milk and corn.

recipes.title: Christmas Cutout Cookies
steps: Cream butter well; add white and brown sugar slowly and cream well.
Beat eggs, cold water and vanilla.
Mix and sift dry ingredients and add alternately with liquid ingredients to cream mixture.
Chill at least 1/2 hour.
(Can be wrapped in wax paper and left overnight.)
Roll to desired thickness (about 1/8 or 1/4-inch) and bake for 12 to 15 minutes in a 350° oven.
Frost with colored frosting or brush with slightly beaten egg white and sprinkle with colored sugars.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: In a bowl, cream the sugars and shortening. Add eggs, beating one in at a time.
In second small bowl, add vanilla to the water and add to sugar mixture alternately with sifted dry ingredients. Stir in apples and nuts.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured cake pan.
Mix up caramel topping and spread on batter before baking. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili
ingredients: 18 oz. tomato paste or canned tomatoes *
steps: *Or whatever you want to use, as long as it is 18 ounces of "something."

recipes.title: Apple Crisps
ingredients: 4 c. sliced, pared tart apples (about 4 medium apples)
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Place apples into buttered pan.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Sprinkle over apples.
Bake until brown.

recipes.title: Pistachio Pudding Dessert
steps: Mix all ingredients and press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Sweet And Easy Corn Pudding
steps: Blend all ingredients.
Conventional oven bake 45 minutes at 375°.
In microwave oven, microwave on High 4 minutes, stir; 4 minutes more, stir; 4 minutes more.
Should be like pudding.

recipes.title: Fruitcake
ingredients: 6 eggs, whites and yolks separated into two bowls
1 cup rum (or 1/2 cup rum & 1/2 cup water; Non-rum option: use 4 tsp. rum extract & 1 cup water)
steps: (You can substitute other candied fruit.)

recipes.title: Nancy Luthy'S Festive Chowder
steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Stir in celery and chopped onion; cook until tender.
Stir in flour, salt and pepper, if desired. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly.
Add potatoes.
Bring to boil; simmer 15 minutes, until potatoes are tender.
Add bacon and Crab Delights.
Heat 3 to 5 minutes more.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Jam Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar; add jam.
Beat eggs and add milk. Sift flour in.
Add other ingredients.
Bake at 325°.

recipes.title: Coconut Island Cookies
steps: In large mixer bowl combine chocolate, coffee, butter, brown sugar, egg, sour cream, flour, soda, salt and 1/3 cup coconut. Mix on lowest speed until a dough forms.
Drop by rounded teaspoon onto greased cookie sheets 12 to 15 minutes.
Frost warm. Sprinkle with remaining coconut.

recipes.title: Chop Suey
steps: In a Dutch oven, bring water to a boil.
After rinsing off sprouts, simmer for ten minutes.
Bias cut celery and onions into semi-large pieces.
Add to sprouts and simmer another five minutes.
While you are cooking the vegetables, cut meat into whatever size pieces you desire.

recipes.title: Pecan Tarts
steps: Do not prebake pastry.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cake
steps: Pour water over oatmeal; let stand 10 minutes.
Add sugar and margarine; stir well.
Add eggs.
Sift and add dry ingredients. Add 6 ounces chocolate chips.
Put in greased cake pan.
Sprinkle on top 3/4 cup nuts and 6 ounces chocolate chips.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix all together.
Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Best if mixed the day before.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chinese Pepper Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. round steak, cut into thin strips
steps: Brown meat in a small amount of oil.
Add chopped onions, water and salt.
Cover and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Add green peppers and cook 5 minutes.
Blend cornstarch with a little water and add to meat mixture.
Cook, stirring, until thick.
Just before serving, add tomatoes and soy sauce; heat. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Fudge Pie
steps: Combine all ingredients; pour into an unbaked pie shell.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream or whipped topping.

recipes.title: Beef And Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh yellow or zucchini squash, sliced
1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
steps: Cook squash and onion in salted water, about 5 minutes.
Drain well.
Cook green pepper and meat until meat is no longer pink. Stir in rice.
Blend eggs, soup, sour cream and seasonings; stirring into meat mixture.
Fold in squash mixture.
Turn into a greased 11 1/2 X 7 1/2 X 1 1/2 baking dish.
Top with cheese. Sprinkle with paprika, if desired.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chinese Hamburg Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. dry rice or Minute rice
steps: Do not salt anything.
Brown hamburger in 2 to 3 tablespoons butter, add pepper.
Remove meat from frypan, put in vegetables and cook until tender.
Add 2 to 3 tablespoons of water to keep from burning.
Cook rice, when done add soy sauce and canned soups.
Add meat and rice mixture to vegetables.
Mix ingredients well and put into covered dish and bake 30 to 40 minutes.
A half cup water may be added, if needed.
Can be frozen before baking.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
steps: Bring to a boil in 2-quart saucepan in 1 1/4 quarts of water. Add ingredients.
After 3 or 4 minutes, add rice; cut down heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until rice is cooked.
Use bigger pan if needed.

recipes.title: Grammy'S Oatmeal Crispies Cookies
steps: Optional:
Add raisins or chocolate chips if you drop cookies.

recipes.title: Wild Rice Rose(Serve With Lamb Or Chicken)
steps: Soak rice overnight; drain.
Wash and drain.
Mix with remaining ingredients.
Place in buttered 2-quart casserole dish. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Beer-Battered Bass
steps: Combine pancake mix, flour, baking powder and salt in bowl. Add egg and beer; mix until smooth.
Dip fish in batter, coating well.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown; drain.
Yield:
6 servings.

recipes.title: Spicy Orange Chicken
ingredients: pepper and garlic powder to taste
steps: Combine flour, salt, pepper and garlic powder in a bag.
Shake the chicken pieces individually until coated.
Brown in the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat, pour off fat.
In a bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
Add to skillet and simmer, covered, 25 minutes or until chicken is tender.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Butter Cookies
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix with a mixer until dough forms and color lightens.
Shape into small balls.
Bake at 325° until just done, not brown.
Roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Grandmother Fowler'S Rolls
steps: Place warm water in a mixing bowl. Stir in yeast until dissolved. Add shortening, salt, sugar, egg and 1/2 of flour. Mix well with electric mixer. Mix in remainder of flour well with a spoon or dough hooks.
Turn out into a well greased large mixing bowl. Grease top of dough (I spray it with Pam). Cover and let rise in a warm place until double.

recipes.title: Shortbread Salad
steps: Mix pudding and buttermilk.
Add oranges (I drain 1 can), Cool Whip (I use 16 ounces) and shortbread cookies.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Boil first three ingredients 3 minutes.
Then add peanut butter and oats.
Drop on wax paper.

recipes.title: Rolled Oats Cake
steps: Cook oats in water.
Add butter.
Let cool.
Add sugars, coconut and eggs.
Mix in dry ingredients.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 35 to 45
minutes, until light brown.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
steps: Trim fat from meat and bones.
Cut meat into 4-6 serving pieces.
Grease large skillet, season meat on both sides with salt, brown meat thoroughly.
Set meat to the side;
add onion; cook and stir until tender.
Stir in broth, soy sauce and garlic. Cover; simmer for 10 minutes or until meat is tender.
Add green peppers.
Cover; simmer for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Rolled Up Nut Cookies
steps: Dissolve yeast in milk.
Mix all ingredients together and roll up to 90 balls.
Cover and set it in the refrigerator overnight until next day.
The next day, roll the balls on powdered sugar, but don't roll too thin.
Put the filling in the center of the cookie; fold one side of the cookie and then overlap the other side on top.
Slightly greased a cookie sheet using two cookie pans. Place 6 or 7 cookies across and 6 rolls down.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Use apricot or nut filling.

recipes.title: Veal Marsala
ingredients: salt, pepper and flour as needed
steps: Season veal with salt and pepper, then dip in flour, vigorously shaking off the excess.
In a heavy skillet, melt 2 tablespoons margarine with olive oil over moderate heat.
When the foam subsides, add the veal, 3 or 4 at a time, and brown for about 3 minutes on each side.
When done, transfer them to plate.
Pour most of the fat out of the skillet, leaving only a thin film at the bottom.
Add the Marsala and 1/4 cup of broth and boil briskly over high heat for 1 to 2 minutes.
Scrape in any brown fragments clinging to pan.
Return veal to pan; cover and simmer over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes, basting with pan juices until tender. Transfer veal to a heated platter.
Add 1/4 cup broth to sauce in pan and boil briskly, scraping in brown bits.
When sauce has reduced and is syrupy, taste it for seasoning and season as necessary.
Remove the pan from the heat; stir in 2 tablespoons of softened margarine and pour the sauce over the veal.

recipes.title: Soy-Flavored Chicken
steps: Skin chicken breasts (optional for low-fat).
Place into a baking dish the breasts.
Add 1/3 cup water and place into a preheated oven at 325°.
After 30 minutes, add soy sauce.
Continue to cook for another 30 minutes, then add chopped pepper and sliced mushrooms.
Continue to cook an additional 20 to 30 minutes.
Turn breasts several times to allow the soy sauce to penetrate the meat. Brown lightly.
Serve with wild, brown or white rice.
A low-fat dish and low-salt.

recipes.title: Spicy Spanish Rice
steps: Brown beef.
Add onion, green pepper, salt, brown sugar, chili powder, bay leaf and rest of the ingredients.
Cook, covered, until rice and vegetables are done.
Stir often.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Chicken Baked In Soy Sauce
ingredients: 3 large fryers, cut up and put in a large roasting pan
steps: Mix the onions, soy sauce and water and put into roasting pan. Put fryer in roaster, skin side down.
Cook 40 minutes and turn; cook 40 minutes.
Serve with Uncle Ben's seasoned long grain and wild rice.
Serves 15.

recipes.title: Quick Kolacky
steps: Cream the margarine.
Add cream cheese and beat until fluffy. Add flour.
Chill 15 minutes.
Roll out and cut into 2-inch rounds. Make depressions in center of rounds.
Place 1 teaspoon of filling in the center.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Green Beans
steps: Cut bacon into pieces and fry with onion.
Drain off fat.
Add vinegar, sugar, beans and salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Easy As 1-2-3 Microwave Brownies
steps: In a medium bowl, beat together butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla with an electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy, 1 to 2 minutes.
Beat in cocoa.
Add flour and beat until well blended.
By hand, stir in pecans.
Spread evenly in a wax paper-lined 8-inch square glass dish.
Cook in a microwave oven on High for 3 minutes. Turn dish a quarter turn and cook 2 1/2 to 3 minutes longer.
Let cool.
Sift powdered sugar over top.
Cut into 16 or 25 squares.

recipes.title: Oatmeal-Raisin Muffins
steps: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Cut in shortening until mixture is like coarse crumbs.
Stir in rolled oats.
Combine egg, milk and brown sugar; beat well.
Stir into dry ingredients; add raisins.
Spoon into paper baking cups in muffin pans.
Combine granulated sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over batter.
Bake in a 425° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
ingredients: 12 Kellogg's Frosted Mini-Wheats biscuits crushed to equal 3/4 c.
steps: Combined crushed frosted mini-wheats with flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and brown sugar.
Mix well.
Add margarine mixing until crumbly.
Set aside for topping.
Place apples in ungreased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Sprinkle topping evenly over apples.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until apples are tender and topping is browned.
Serve warm with ice cream.

recipes.title: Pineapple Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 boxes Dream Whip or 1 (8 oz.) Cool Whip
steps: Cooked cup of rice is added to all other ingredients.
Mix well.
Serve.

recipes.title: Company Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Layer 13 x 9-inch baking pan with dried beef.
Place chicken breasts on top.
Cut bacon in smaller pieces, putting a small strip on each breast.
Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes.
Mix soup and sour cream.
Remove pan from oven and cover chicken well with soup mixture.
Cover chicken and return to oven for 30 minutes more.
(By covering chicken with tinfoil, your gravy will not cook away.)
Remove and serve with rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Molasses Crinkles
steps: Mix shortening, sugar, egg and molasses very well.
Either stir or sift flour before measuring.
Blend all dry ingredients and stir into wet mixture and chill.
Heat oven to 375°.
Roll dough into 1 1/4-inch ball.
Dip tops in granulated sugar.
Place balls, sugar side up, 3-inches apart on greased baking sheet.
Sprinkle each with 2 to 3 drops water.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes or just until set, but not hard.
Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Krum-Kaka
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. vanilla (almond flavoring may be used)
steps: Melt butter and cool.
Beat eggs; add sugar and mix.
Whip the cream.
Add melted butter to eggs and sugar; add whipped cream. Add vanilla and flour.
Use 1 scant teaspoon for each one on Krum-KaKa iron.
Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Heart-Smart Wacky Cake
steps: In ungreased 8-inch cake pan, mix together flour, sugar, soda and cocoa.
Make 3 wells in flour mixture.
Put vinegar in one, vanilla in one and corn oil in 3rd.
Pour water over all and mix with fork until entirely moist.
Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes until just done.
Ice as desired.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Nut Loaf
steps: Stir together in order given.
Pour into 2 loaf pans, well-greased.

recipes.title: Three Layer Coconut Cake
steps: Cream margarine and Crisco until fluffy.
Add sugar gradually. Cream for 10 minutes.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add flour and milk alternately.
Add vanilla; beat for 1 minute after last addition.
Bake at 325° until brown.
Cool; frost with White Cake Icing.

recipes.title: Frosted Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Combine 2 cups baking mix and milk in a bowl.
Mix well.
Beat vigorously for 30 seconds, adding enough remaining baking mix to make moderate dough. Knead 10 times on floured surface. Roll into 1/2-inch thick rectangle.
Spread with butter.
Mix sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over butter.

Top with raisins and nuts. Roll as for jelly roll to enclose filling; cut into 1-inch slices. Place on baking sheet. Bake at 450° for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Blend confectioners sugar with a small amount of water.
Drizzle over rolls. Cool for 5 minutes.
Yields 1 dozen.

recipes.title: Banana Bread(Low-Fat)
steps: Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Rolled Cheese Appetizers
steps: Mix filling together.
Spread onto tortillas.
Let refrigerate about 1 hour.
Slice into pinwheels and serve.
Great to make ahead and serve.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: Cream the butter and sugar together.
Beat eggs. Add the bananas.
Sift the flour.
Add the salt and sift together again, then add alternately with the banana mixture. Add the nuts.
Add last the soda with a little warm water.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes in an angel food pan.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 medium onion (purple) or 1 small bunch fresh onions and tops, chopped
10 pieces bacon, cooked and crumbled, or bacon bits
1 c. cubed sharp Cheddar cheese (optional), or shredded
steps: Cook corn bread to package directions. Cool. It's better if kept for 24 hours, then crumbled. Add all vegetables. Cool in refrigerator about 1 hour. Stir in Miracle Whip. Add cheese.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Apple Raisin Muffins
steps: Beat egg; stir in remaining ingredients, mixing just to moisten.
Pour into 12 greased muffin cups until 3/4 full.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Serve cool or hot with butter.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 2 c. diced cooked chicken or turkey
steps: Cook bacon, crumble and set aside.
In bacon fat, cook onion, pepper and mushrooms until tender.
Stir in flour, chicken broth, cream and pimento.
Simmer until sauce thickens.
Add salt, pepper, bacon, chicken or turkey and cooked spaghetti.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Health Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a bowl, sift together the flour, salt and baking soda.
In a second bowl, place all the other ingredients.
Add the flour mixture to bowl 2 and beat until well mixed.
Batter will be lumpy.
Place in tube pan and bake for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
Do not open oven.
When cooled, remove from pan and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Zucchini Bread
steps: Cream sugar, oil and baking chocolate; add eggs and mix.
Add remaining ingredients and mix.
Spray 3 small loaf pans with Pam; pour batter in and fill halfway.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Brown steak with green pepper and onion and cut into small bite-size pieces.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Pour over egg noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Honey Bun Cake
steps: Mix and put half of mixture in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan.
Mix brown sugar and cinnamon.
Sprinkle 1/2 brown sugar mixture on batter and swirl in.
Pour rest of batter in and use rest of brown sugar mixture.
Bake at 325° for about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Melt butter; set aside to cool.
Mix flour and sugar.
Add milk and eggs.
Stir in vanilla and vinegar.
Add butter and nuts.
Put in crust and bake at 300° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mostaccioli With Bacon And Mushrooms
steps: In a medium skillet, cook bacon until crisp. Remove from fat and set aside.
Add mushrooms to bacon fat. Cook until golden; drain and set aside.
Prepare mostaccioli according to package directions. Drain.
In same saucepan, combine half and half, butter, parsley flakes, salt, garlic and hot pepper sauce.
Heat just until butter melts, stirring frequently. Combine bacon, mushrooms, hot mostaccioli, half and half mixture and Parmesan cheese. Toss to coat.
Place on warm serving platter. Garnish with green onions.
Serve immediately.
Refrigerate leftovers.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Biscuits
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large bowl; cut in shortening with a pastry blender until shortening is the size of peas.
Add buttermilk and stir with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened.
Turn dough out onto a heavily floured surface and knead lightly 4 or 5 times.

recipes.title: Microwave Rice
steps: Use 1 part rice to 2 parts water.
Wash rice and drain.
Add water and salt.
Cover microwave dish or Pyrex dish with paper towel.
Place in microwave and cook on High for 18 minutes.
Let set for 4 to 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Love Feast Pumpkin Bread(Makes 4 Loaves)
ingredients: 2 c. yellow raisins or dates, chopped
steps: Combine sugar, pumpkin and eggs in large bowl.
Blend well. Add oil.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake 1 hour or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Grease baking pans well. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Two Cheese Fettuccine Primavera
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. each: dried oregano leaves and coarse ground pepper
1 c. Kraft light part skim Mozzarella cheese
1 red pepper, cut into julienne strips
steps: Saute onion and garlic in oil in medium saucepan.
Blend in flour and seasonings.
Gradually add milk.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Toss hot pasta with sauce and remaining ingredients.
Serve immediately.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Duffy'S Poppy Seed Cake
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. sugar mixed with 1 tsp. cinnamon
steps: Grease and flour a 10-inch tube or Bundt pan.
Stir together the poppy seed and buttermilk; cover and refrigerate overnight. Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt.
Cream the butter and sugar.
Beat in eggs one at a time.
Beat in vanilla and grated orange rind.
Stir in flour mixture alternately with poppy seed mixture, mixing until just smooth each time.
Turn half the batter in prepared pan; sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon mixture; add remaining batter.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour or until inserted toothpick comes out clean.
Place cake on wire rack to cool 10 minutes.
Remove cake from pan to cool completely.
The cake becomes moist when stored in a tightly covered container for several days.

recipes.title: Asparagus Supreme
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. asparagus, cooked and drained and cut into pieces
3/4 c. herb seasoned bread crumbs (or stuffing mix)
steps: Blend ingredients together and add asparagus pieces last. Mix and pour into casserole dish.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix together and refrigerate. Form into walnut size balls and roll in sugar. Place on cookie sheet and press out with the bottom of a glass. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Seasons Green Beans
steps: Cook beans as directed, then add all ingredients until done. Cook bacon; crumble on top of beans.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef; add salt and pepper.
Add vegetables in layers without mixing.
Last, sprinkle rice on top (do not stir). Simmer until done (about 30 to 40 minutes).
Mix before serving. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Veal Piccata
steps: With meat mallet, pound cutlets to 1/8-inch thickness.
On waxed paper, sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper.
Add flour and coat cutlets.
In a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot olive oil and butter, cook veal a few pieces at a time until lightly browned on both sides.
Add more olive oil if necessary.
Reduce heat to low.
Into drippings in skillet, stir water, wine, bouillon and 1/2 teaspoon of salt, scraping to loosen brown bits.
Return veal to skillet; cover and simmer 15 minutes until cutlets are tender.
Cut 1 lemon and squeeze out juice.
Thinly slice the other.
Remove cutlets to platter; keep warm.
Stir lemon juice in pan.
Heat until boiling over high heat.
Spoon over cutlets.
Garnish with parsley. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Melt butter in microwave on High; stir in flour until smooth. Microwave 30 to 45
seconds until heated.
Blend in milk smoothly. Microwave 4 1/2 to 5 1/2 minutes until thickened, stirring every minute.
Stir in cheese until melted, 15 to 20 seconds.
Mix in macaroni well.
Microwave 5 to 6 minutes, stirring once.

recipes.title: Sweet Chocolate Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 c. butter or margarine, at room temperature
4 oz. sweet chocolate, melted and cooled
steps: Mix flour with sugar, salt, cream of tartar, soda and cinnamon.
Cream butter until softened.
Add flour mixture, milk and vanilla. Mix until all flour is moistened; then beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer, scraping bowl occasionally. Add eggs and chocolate.
Beat 1 minute longer.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp Pudding
steps: Butter casserole dish, add apples and pour water mixed with cinnamon over them.
Mix together sugar, flour and butter until crumbly.
Spread mixture over apples and bake 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Out-Of-This-World Rolls
steps: Soften yeast in 1/4 cup warm water.
In large bowl, combine shortening, sugar, beaten eggs, 1 cup warm
water and salt.
Stir in softened yeast and 2 1/2 cups flour.
Beat until smooth and blended.
Add remaining flour to make a soft dough and mix well. Cover and allow to rise
in a warm place until double in bulk. This takes about 1 hour.
Punch down and place in refrigerator overnight.
Divide dough in half and roll each portion into a rectangle 1/2-inch thick.
Spread with softened butter.
Roll each rectangle jelly roll style and cut into 1-inch slices.
Place cut side down in greased muffin tins.
Cover and let rise 2 hours. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Makes 2 dozen large rolls.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: Sift flour, baking powder, soda, dry milk, salt and sugar. Add pecans; mix well.
Combine beaten eggs, butter, bananas and lemon juice.
Add dry ingredients; mix only until flour is moistened.
Divide into 6 well-greased loaf pans (3 1/2 x 8 x 2 1/2-inch).
Bake in a 325° oven for 40 to 45 minutes, or until done.
Cool thoroughly.
Wrap in foil; store overnight.
Good for freezing.

recipes.title: Hamburger Soup
steps: Boil hamburger meat, potatoes and onion in water until tender. Add Spanish rice, tomatoes, salt and pepper.
Cook for 20 minutes over medium heat.

recipes.title: Texas Sheet Cake
steps: Sift together first 4 ingredients.
Bring to boil in saucepan margarine, shortening, cocoa and water.
Remove from heat; add dry ingredients, then add buttermilk, vanilla, baking soda and eggs. Beat and pour into greased and floured large cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
During last 5 minutes of baking time, make frosting as follows.

recipes.title: Pickled Beets
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. pickling spice (wrapped in a piece of old hose)
steps: Bring beets to a slow boil; cook until tender and skins peel off easily.
At this stage, you just boil the beets in water and then discard this water.
Boil remaining ingredients together and add beets.
Bring back to a boil.
Pack and seal in jars.

recipes.title: Peaches N' Cheese Cream Pie
steps: Beat the first 7 ingredients 2 minutes. Pour into greased 10-inch pie pan. Drain the peaches and save juice.
Lay peaches on top of batter. Beat the cream cheese, sugar and peach juice for 2 minutes.
Spoon on top of peaches.
Leave a 1-inch margin. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Prune Cake
ingredients: 1 c. prunes (1 large jar baby food prunes)
steps: Beat the first 4 ingredients well and set aside.
Sift together the flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice.
Gradually add dry ingredients to egg mixture.
Add prunes, vanilla and walnuts. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Glaze while hot.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Remove caps from mushrooms and chop the stems.
Cut up bacon and fry with mushroom stems.
Add onion, pepper and bread crumbs. Stuff mushroom caps with first mixture.
Place in buttered shallow baking dish.
Salt, cover and refrigerate.
Before baking, sprinkle with the Parmesan and basil.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Longhorn Baked Eggs
steps: Grease 6 custard cups or other microwave-safe dishes; set aside.
Place equal amounts of bacon and cheese in each cup.
Break 1 egg into each cup.
In small bowl, mix sour cream, milk and hot sauce until well blended.
Spoon 3 tablespoons sour cream mixture around each egg.
Gently break egg yolks with fork.
Place egg cups in microwave and cover with paper towel.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes on Medium power until eggs are set as desired.
Garnish with chopped green onions or diced tomatoes.

recipes.title: No Roll Pie Crust
steps: Put all these ingredients in a bowl and stir together.
Pat dough on sides and bottom of pie pan same as a graham cracker crust.
Bake in 400° oven for about 7 to 10 minutes (not too brown).

recipes.title: Potato And Cabbage Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. American or Cheddar cheese, shredded
steps: In large pan, heat butter and saute cabbage and onions until wilted.
Place half of the cabbage, onions and potatoes in a 3-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese.
Put remaining cabbage, potato and onion on top.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in same pan cabbage was cooked in.
Add 1/4 cup flour.
Cook 1 minute.
Add can of broth.
Cook until thickened.
Pour over top of cabbage.
Sprinkle remaining cheese over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork Chops Sweet 'N Sour
steps: Mix first five ingredients. Melt shortening in skillet. Dredge pork chops in flour mixture and brown in hot fat, slowly.

recipes.title: Sugar Free Cake
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened applesauce (or other unsweetened fruit)
1/2 tsp each: cinnamon, nutmeg OR cloves, vanilla, baking soda
steps: Cook raisins in water until dry.
Let cool.
Then mix all ingredients well by hand.
Bake in lightly greased bundt pan or 9 x 13 x 2 inch pan for 55 - 60 minutes at 350.

recipes.title: Ginger Cookies
steps: Cream shortening.
Add sugar gradually.
Add egg and molasses. Add sifted flour, baking soda, salt and ginger.
Roll into balls in sugar.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Beef Casserole
steps: Cook sausage; drain.
Brown beef; drain.
Cook onion and celery in meat fat until tender.
Cook rice and drain.
Mix all ingredients together except cheese and bake at 350° for 1 hour, adding cheese to top during last 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Carrot Muffins
ingredients: 3 medium size carrots, finely shredded (1 1/2 c.)
1/2 c. thawed, frozen, no-fat, no-cholesterol egg substitute
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spray muffin pan cups with grease.
In medium bowl, combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar, cinnamon, salt, baking powder and ginger.
In a large bowl with whisk or fork, mix carrots, yogurt, egg substitute, applesauce, raisins, brown sugar and vanilla until well blended.
With spoon, stir together the 2 mixtures until moistened.
Spoon batter into muffin pans.
Bake 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.
Cool muffins in pans 10 minutes and remove.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Makes 8 muffins.

recipes.title: Pork And Beans
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cooked and cut up
steps: Mix all together and bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours in a casserole dish, removing cover last 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease a 4 1/2 x 6 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Mix flour and sugar.
Stir in pecans.
Blend eggs, potatoes, milk and shortening.
Add liquid mixture to flour mixture.
Stir until blended.
Pour into pan.
Press pecan halves in top of batter. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Soppin Chocolate
steps: Mix and cook sugar, cocoa, flour and milk in saucepan until thick.
Add vanilla and butter.
Pour over hot biscuits.

recipes.title: Chinese Fried Rice
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped green onions with tops
steps: In heavy skillet or wok, saute onion in oil until transparent, but not browned.
Add rice, water, bouillon cubes, salt and pepper.
Bring to a vigorous boil.
Cover and cook over low heat until all water is absorbed, about 25 minutes.
Stir in eggs and green onions.
Cook until eggs are set.
Stir in soy sauce.

recipes.title: Granny Little'S Pound Cake(In Loving Memory)
steps: Cream margarine, Crisco and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time. Add flour (presifted with baking powder) alternately with flavoring.
Bake at 325° to 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Shipwreck Stew
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) pkg. frozen green beans, thawed
1 (16 oz.) can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
steps: In a skillet, brown ground beef with onion over medium heat. Drain fat.
In a 3-quart casserole, combine beef mixture with all remaining ingredients.
Cover and bake at 350° for about 2 hours or until rice and potatoes are tender.

recipes.title: Hungarian Goulash
ingredients: 2 lb. beef chuck or round, cut into 1-inch cubes
steps: Melt shortening in a large skillet.
Add beef, onion and garlic.
Cook and stir until meat is brown and onion is tender. Stir in catsup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, sugar, salt, paprika and 1 1/2 cups water.
Cover, simmer for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.
Blend flour and 1/4 cup water; stir gradually into meat mixture.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Boil and stir one minute.
Serve over buttered noodles.
Yield:
6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 small pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb dressing
steps: Cook first three ingredients in a small amount of salted water and drain.
Mix sour cream and soup with vegetables.
Add butter to dressing.
Layer dressing, then squash in buttered casserole dish and finish with dressing.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange-Date-Nut Cake
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. grated orange rind (can substitute 1 tsp. orange extract)
steps: Pour into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
While hot, punch many holes with ice pick.
Pour glaze over cake.
Let stand several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Golden Cream Soup
steps: In large saucepan, combine potatoes, water, celery, carrots, onion, parsley flakes, bouillon and seasonings; mix well.
Cover; simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. Gradually add milk to flour, mixing until well blended.
Add milk mixture to vegetables; cook until thickened.
Add Velveeta; stir until melted.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
steps: Have all ingredients at room temperature.
Cream shortening and butter.
Add sugar and beat at medium speed for 5 minutes.
Add egg yolks and beat until the yolks disappear.
Stir flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa together.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour.
Add vanilla.
Fold in the beaten egg whites.
Pour into a 10-inch tube pan that has been greased and floured.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Let cool in pan for 30 minutes.
Remove from pan.
May be iced with your favorite chocolate icing.

recipes.title: Pigs In Blankets
steps: Take each frank.
Wrap 1/2 slice cheese around it.
Take 1 piece bacon and wrap over the frank and cheese.
Wrap 1 biscuit around frank.
Continue until ingredients are used up.
Place on cookie sheet and bake at 450° until golden brown.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Cherry Nut Bread
steps: Combine all ingredients except cherries in a mixing bowl. Blend on low speed of electric mixer 15 seconds; increase to medium speed and blend 30 additional seconds.
Stir in cherries. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350°
for 1 hour and 10 to 15 minutes, or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes in pan; remove to wire rack and cool completely.
Yields 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
steps: Boil potatoes, peel and mash while hot.
Add butter, beat eggs with half of sugar.
Add to potatoes and butter mixture.
Add milk and rest of sugar.
Mix in spices (should be creamy).
Pour into pie shells, bake in oven at 350° for one hour or until custard is set and a toothpick comes out clean.
Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

recipes.title: One Step Pie Crust
steps: Mix together all ingredients.
With hands, form dough to fit pie pan.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Au Gratin
steps: Cook butter and onion until tender.
Add flour until mixed well.
Add milk, salt and pepper and cook until thickens a little. Add sherry and crab meat.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Spread sliced apples in 9 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle with water, cinnamon and salt.
Work remaining ingredients together until crumbly.
Use pastry blender, fork or fingers.
Spread over apples.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Cake With Anise Hyssop
steps: Combine and set aside buttermilk, poppy seed, almond extract and anise hyssop flowers.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add egg yolks and beat.
Sift together flour, soda, baking powder and salt. Alternately add with buttermilk mixture.
Fold in beaten egg whites.
Pour half the batter in a greased tube or bundt pan. Sprinkle half of the sugar-cinnamon mixture on batter and add the remaining batter and the remaining sugar mixture.
Cut through batter with knife for marble effect.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Peach Frostee
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can peach slices in juice
steps: In a blender, combine canned sliced peaches, dry milk powder, vanilla and cinnamon.
Cover and blend until smooth.
Add five ice cubes, one at a time with the motor running.
Blend until smooth. Makes 4 servings.
Calories per serving:
Diabetic exchanges per serving:
milk 1, vegetable 0, fruit 1/2, bread 0, meat 0 and fat 0.

recipes.title: German'S Sweet Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. Baker's German's sweet chocolate
2 1/4 c. sifted cake flour (or regular flour)
1 c. butter or margarine (I use butter)
steps: Melt chocolate in boiling water; cool.
Sift flour, soda and salt.
Cream butter and sugar well.
Add egg yolks one at a time, beating after each.
Blend in vanilla and melted chocolate.
Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk, beating after each addition.
Fold in beaten egg whites.
Pour into 3 (9-inch) greased and floured layer pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Cool in pans 15 minutes.
Remove and cool on rack.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
ingredients: 2 c. whipping cream or half and half
steps: Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in unbaked 9-inch pie shell. In a bowl, add the rest of the ingredients and mix well.
Pour over the bacon and cheese mixture.
Bake in a 400° oven for 15 minutes.
Reduce temperature to 300° and bake 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean.
Let stand 10 minutes; cut into wedges and serve.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Pie
steps: Combine sugar, cornstarch, flour, cocoa and salt.
Add eggs, butter and milk, then coconut, nuts and vanilla.
Pour into unbaked pastry shell and bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Top should be crusty and firm.
The center should become more firm as it cools.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Filet Mignon
steps: Combine first 8 ingredients and 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce. Form into 12 thick patties.

Wrap bacon slice around the sides of each patty and secure with a toothpick. Bake on a rack at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Baste frequently with barbecue sauce the last 30 minutes. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix flour and soda.
Combine butter, sugar and pudding mix in large bowl.
Beat until smooth. Beat in eggs.
Gradually add flour mixture.
Stir in oats and raisins.
Batter will be stiff.
Drop by rounded teaspoon about 2 inches apart.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Ala Carbonara*
ingredients: 1/2 lb. bacon, cooked crisp, drained and diced
1 lb. spaghetti, cooked tender according to pkg. directions
1/4 c. cream, light cream or milk
steps: Mix cream, egg, Parmesan cheese and bacon together.
Toss with cooked spaghetti.
Sprinkle with salt, Parmesan cheese and plenty of freshly ground black pepper.
Serve immediately!

recipes.title: Italian Chocolate Cookies(A Very Old Recipe)
steps: Make enough perked coffee to cover raisins.
Pour over raisins and let cool.

recipes.title: Chilled Summer Squash Soup
ingredients: 4 medium zucchini, washed and cut into 1-inch slices
1 large yellow crookneck squash, washed and cut into 1-inch slices
salt and freshly ground white pepper to taste
steps: In a large saucepan, place all the squash.
Add the onion, garlic, broth, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes or until the vegetables are very tender.
Allow to cool slightly; puree in a food processor or blender with basil, parsley and lemon juice until smooth.
Place in a container, cover and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight.
When ready to serve, add the buttermilk.
Whisk until smooth and adjust the seasonings with salt and pepper.
Serve chilled and garnished with chopped basil and parsley.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Golden Cheesy Potatoes
steps: Peel and quarter potatoes.
Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in plastic bag.
Moisten potatoes.
Drop in bag and shake well.
Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Arrange potatoes in one layer.
Bake at 425°.
Turn once.

recipes.title: Wilted Lettuce Salad(Microwave)
steps: Cook
bacon
loosely covered with paper towel in microwave oven
for
to 3 1/2 minutes or until crisp.
Reserve 2 tablespoons
of drippings.
Tear lettuce into small pieces and combine
with onion in salad bowl.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Combine
vinegar,
reserved
bacon
drippings,
sugar, water, salt,
mustard and pepper in 1 cup glass measuring cup. Cook uncovered
in
a
microwave for 1 minute or until mixture boils,
stirring
to
dissolve sugar.
Pour over salad greens, tossing
to coat well.
Garnish with crumbled bacon and radish slices.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Pound Cake
steps: Grease a 10-inch tube pan.
Set aside.
Preheat oven to 325°. In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar until smooth.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Combine flour, baking powder, 1/2 teaspoon soda, cocoa and cinnamon; add alternately with sour cream, beating after each addition.
Stir in vanilla.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake for 75 minutes, or until done.
Cool in pan 10 minutes.
Take off wire rack; cool completely.

recipes.title: Creamy Squash Casserole
steps: Wash squash. Slice in rounds, fairly thin. Salt, pepper and roll in flour.
Have cooking oil medium-hot and fry until crisp and golden brown. Serve while hot.

recipes.title: Granny'S Kitchen
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl.
Cut in shortening.
Add buttermilk, then yeast mixture.
Stir until thoroughly moistened.
Turn out onto floured board and knead a minute or two.
Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness and cut with a biscuit cutter.
Place on greased baking sheet. Let rise for 30 minutes.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until brown.
Brush tops with melted butter.
Yield:
60 (2-inch) biscuits.

recipes.title: Lima Bean Soup
steps: Soak dried beans overnight.
Wash thoroughly and put in pot of boiling water.
Add chopped onion and cubed potatoes.
Add seasonings to taste.
Bring to a boil, then cook on low until beans are done and soup is thick.
Mash beans with wooden spoon while in the pot.
Remove hot pepper.
Add olive oil and sherry and simmer another 15 minutes.
If sausage is added, omit olive oil and add sausage along with potatoes and onion, but boil sausage separately first to remove fat.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Set aside in bowl the nuts, cinnamon and sugar.
Cream butter. Add white sugar.
Add the eggs and beat fast.
Measure flour, baking powder and salt.
Grease and flour Bundt pan.
Add dry ingredients to egg mixture alternately with sour cream and vanilla.
Mix thoroughly.
Put 1/2 batter in cake pan.
Spread filling over the rest of batter.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes. Cool in pan on rack for 1/2 hour.
Freezes nicely.
Thaw covered. Better the older it gets.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 1 can (1 lb. 12 oz.) whole tomatoes, undrained
steps: Wash chicken, pat dry with paper towels.
Heat oil and butter in 6-quart Dutch oven.
Add chicken, a few pieces at a time, and brown well on all sides. Remove as browned.
Return chicken to Dutch oven; add tomato sauce, tomatoes, wine, basil, oregano, garlic, parsley, salt and pepper.
Simmer, covered for 45 to 50 minutes, or until chicken is tender.
Combine flour with 3 tablespoons water; stir into sauce.
Add mushrooms; cook 10 minutes longer or until sauce is thickened.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sausage And Salsa Skillet Dinner
ingredients: 1 can (8 oz.) dark red kidney beans, rinsed and drained
steps: Cut sausage in half lengthwise, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices.
In 10-inch skillet, combine rice, sausage, tomatoes, water, salsa and beans.
Mix well, breaking tomatoes with large spoon.
Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove from heat, let stand, covered, about 5 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Hot German Potato Salad
steps: Cut bacon in 1-inch pieces and fry.
Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon grease.
Blend sugar, onion, flour and seasonings into grease in large frying pan. Gradually add water and vinegar. Boil 1 minute. Add potatoes and bacon. Cook 5 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Egg Custard
steps: 1st Layer:
Mix 1 cup plain flour, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 1/2 cups pecan pieces and 1 stick melted butter.
Press in bottom of 12-inch rectangular Pyrex (or 10-inch round).
Bake for 10 minutes at 375° or until light brown.
Chill or allow to cool completely.

recipes.title: Starlight Mint Surprise Cookies
steps: Sift flour, baking soda and salt.
In separate bowl, cream butter, sugar and brown sugar.
Blend in eggs, water and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.
Put about 1 tablespoon of dough around each mint.
Place on greased baking sheet, about 3 inches apart.
Top with walnut half.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloin
steps: Mix marinade ingredients together and marinate meat overnight. Bake at 350° for 1 hour (uncovered).

recipes.title: Food, Facts And Fancy Cream Of Potato-Vegetable Chicken Soup
steps: Dice bacon and place in heavy saucepan.
Cook, but do not brown. Remove extra fat. Add diced onion and diced celery.
Saute 2 to 3 minutes.
Add potato, broth and bouillon.
Cook until potato is almost (soft) tender.
Add frozen carrots and peas, celery slices, mushroom slices, diced chicken, milk, chicken broth and herb blend.

recipes.title: Cheese Broccoli
steps: Melt butter. Add flour to make gravy. Add milk to thicken. Once thickened, add cheese. Arrange broccoli stems facing in the middle. Pour cheese sauce over the broccoli.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
steps: Cut peeled eggplant into 1-inch cubes and soak in salt water in refrigerator 6 hours.
Drain eggplant.
Place in pan.
Cover with water and simmer until soft.
Soak cornbread in milk.
Saute onions, green pepper and celery in butter until all are tender. Combine cooked eggplant, bread crumbs and sauteed vegetables.
Add eggs, pimento and seasoning.
Thoroughly blend and place in greased baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, then top with grated cheese and return to oven until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
steps: In large bowl, mix Bisquick, cheese and sausage meat; add salt and pepper.
Mix well and roll in small ball.
Place in refrigerator half a day or night.
Cut bacon in three strips and wrap each ball with a strip of bacon.
Lap ends and stick toothpick in to hold in place.
Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
ingredients: 1/2 c. butter or margarine (at room temperature)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix together cinnamon and sugar in a small bowl.
In a medium bowl, beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg and vanilla until blended.
Sift flour, baking soda, baking powder or salt over sugar mixture.
Stir with wooden spoon to make a stiff dough.
Shape dough into walnut-size balls.
Roll in cinnamon/sugar mixture to coat.
Place balls about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Cool on wire racks.

recipes.title: Custard Pie
steps: Keep half of egg whites to put in last.
Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes, then to 375° to finish.
For 2 pies.

recipes.title: Meal-In-A-Dish
steps: Combine all ingredients in covered pan or casserole dish or Dutch oven.
Cook in 300° oven for 3 1/2 to 4 hours.
