If it gets too dry, add water to make right consistency.
Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake
steps: Melt chocolate in boiling water.
Cool.
Cream margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add egg yolks one at a time.
Beat after each addition.
Add chocolate, vanilla, buttermilk and flour to the egg mixture, beating slowly until smooth.
Add the soda mixture and fold in the egg whites.
Bake in layers or in a long, flat pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Peel, core and slice apples.
Mix with cinnamon and sugar. Arrange in 9 x 13-inch dish.
Melt oleo and add to remaining dry ingredients.
Spoon over apple mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Keep covered with foil and last 15 minutes, uncover to crisp up the topping.

recipes.title: Estofado
ingredients: 1 lb. beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch cubes
steps: In 10-inch skillet, brown beef cubes in hot oil.
Stir in wine, undrained tomatoes, onion, green pepper, raisins, apricots, salt, pepper and garlic.
In a cheesecloth bag, combine basil, thyme, tarragon and bay leaf.
Add to meat mixture and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Stir mushrooms and olives into stew. Simmer, covered, 30 minutes more.
Discard herb bag.
Blend cold water with flour; stir into stew.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Serve over rice.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Nuts
steps: Mix cinnamon into sugar; add cream and mix well.
Cook on medium-low heat, stirring constantly; cook to 240°.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Stir until syrup coats nuts.
Spread on wax paper to cool.
Break into pieces.

recipes.title: Fruit Cobbler
steps: Mix fruit, tapioca and sugar.
Pour in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix other ingredients and drop by spoonfuls on top of fruit. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Gloria'S Fried Pie Dough
steps: Sift dry ingredients together and cut in shortening.
Add liquid ingredients and refrigerate.
This can be stored several days and used as needed.
For fried pies, I roll out a thin saucer-sized circle of dough.
Fill with desired fruit and fold in half.
Press edges with fork and fry in skillet with a little bit of shortening.
This dough is very easy to work with and tastes great.

recipes.title: Cauliflower With Cheese
steps: Let cauliflower stand in salted water 20 to 30 minutes and rinse. Cover with water. Add the salt and garlic (if desired). Bring to a boil. Simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until tests done. Drain and place on serving dish. Top with Cheese Sauce and Buttered Bread Crumbs.

recipes.title: Raspberry Crumb Bars
steps: Position rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 375 degrees. Butter a 9 x 9 pan.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. cooked and diced chicken breasts
steps: Cook rice according to directions.
Combine all ingredients and put in a buttered casserole dish.
Top with crushed potato chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Blend in eggs; add bananas and mix well.
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Add to creamed mixture with buttermilk.
Bake for 50 minutes at 350° in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Old Fashion "Peach" Cake
steps: Mix together cake mix, pie filling, eggs, vanilla and nuts. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Mix together flour, sugar, butter and flavoring (will be crumbly).
Sprinkle over batter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. celery and parsley flakes (or any seasoning desired)
steps: Before you go to church Sunday morning, cut up and remove the skin from fryer; salt and flour lightly.
Arrange in single layer in slow cooker.
Slice onion; spread over chicken.
Sprinkle over this the seasoning, thyme and celery
and parsley flakes.
Place lid on cooker; turn on.
Come home from church and eat!

recipes.title: Wild Rice Soup
ingredients: 2 (14 1/2 oz.) cans (ready to serve) chicken broth
3 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
steps: Wash wild rice.
Boil rice for 15 minutes and drain; set aside.
Fry bacon until crisp.
Remove bacon and discard all but 3 tablespoons bacon drippings.
Saute celery, onion and green pepper in drippings, until onion is transparent.
Put in a large kettle and add rice, broth, mushrooms, soup and diced bacon.
Cook on low heat for 1 hour or more.
Do not add salt.

recipes.title: Crepes
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients until smooth.
Add flour and milk. Mix in slowly.
Put on a small frying pan with Crisco, 1/4 cup crepe batter.
Flip and fry both sides until golden brown.

recipes.title: Italian Cookie Anise Toast
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour cookie sheet.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat sugar and eggs for 5 minutes. Add anise and beat well.
Add dry ingredients and mix at low speed.
Make 3 separate long loaves on cookie sheet, 3-inches wide.
Bake 15 minutes, until lightly baked.
Remove from oven and cut into 1-inch cookies.
Put back on cookie sheet, cut side down, and bake 10 more minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Best Yet Banana Bread
ingredients: 1 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 Tbsp. water
steps: Mix in order given and pour in loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
steps: Mix all together.
Put in 2 (5 x 9-inch) greased and floured pans.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Rocky Mt. Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 c. cream or half and half
steps: Mix flour and sugar.
Spread 1/2 mixture evenly in bottom of pie pan.
Line pan with quartered or halved apples, cut side up. Spread remaining sugar mixture on apples.
Drizzle cream over apples.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Mix eggs, sugar and oil.
Beat into the wet mixture flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, baking powder and vanilla.
Add nuts, dates and zucchini to mixture.

recipes.title: Swedish Coffee Bread
steps: Beat together with enough cream to make it smooth.

recipes.title: Cheese-Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 whole boneless chicken breasts, pounded to 1/8-inch thickness
1/2 c. seasoned fine dry bread crumbs
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In small mixing bowl, combine green onions, parsley flakes, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Set aside.
Place 1 piece of cheese in center of each chicken breast. Top with 1/4 of onion mixture.
Starting at narrow edge, roll each breast tightly, tucking in sides to enclose cheese and onion mixture.
Dredge with flour.
In small bowl, combine bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Dip each rolled breast in beaten egg, then in crumb mixture to coat.

recipes.title: The Cake That Won'T Last
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple and juice (1 c.)
steps: Mash
bananas
in
mixing bowl.
Add remaining ingredients. Stir until blended by hand.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Broccoli Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb. pasta (rotini, penne or other kinds)
steps: Cut broccoli into flowerets.
Peel and slice stems.
Cook pasta.
When pasta has about 13 minutes left to cook, heat olive oil and add garlic and red pepper.
Stir one minute.
Add broccoli.
Mix well.
Add salt and 1/2 cup water or defatted broth.
Use less salt if using canned all chicken broth.
Cover with a tight lid.
Cook 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain pasta and mix with broccoli and its liquid.
Serve at once.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Mix and pour into a casserole dish and top with crushed Ritz crackers.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Date Bread
steps: Combine egg, milk, shortening, pineapple, nuts and dates. Sift together dry ingredients. Add to first mixture and stir just to moisten. Grease baking pan. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.
A nice holiday bread.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
ingredients: parts of 2 chickens, less the backs
steps: Grease baking dish and sprinkle bottom evenly with onion gravy mix.
Spread rice evenly over the mix.
Cut up chickens; salt and pepper.
Place pieces on rice.
Mix soup with 1 1/2 cans of water and pour over the chicken.
Cover with heavy foil and bake for 2 1/2 hours at 300°.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Candy
steps: Melt, stirring constantly over low heat, the first three ingredients.
Add Rice Krispies and peanuts.
Drop by the teaspoon on waxed paper and enjoy.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
steps: Melt butter in a baking dish.
Sift flour, salt and baking powder together.
Mix with sugar; stir in milk.
Pour batter over melted butter.
Do not stir.
Sweeten fruit to taste and pour over batter.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Enjoy.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Cut broccoli flowers in small pieces.
Cook bacon and crumble. Mix mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.
Pour over all other ingredients.
Mix well and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
steps: Cook rice (unsalted).
Melt butter.
Mix all ingredients together. Cook at 350° for approximately 1 hour.
May also be put in microwave for approximately 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Granny'S Chicken And Dumplings
steps: Mix dry ingredients together, then add shortening. Mix until it's a cornmeal type texture.
Add egg and enough water to make it "a little wetter than pie crust dough." Roll out onto floured board and cut into squares.
Drop into boiling chicken and broth. Add salt and black pepper to taste and thicken broth with more flour.
Dumplings should be ready in 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pinylata Or Sausage Rolls
steps: Mix flour with hot roll mix flour.
Use yeast from mix plus extra yeast, dissolved in the warm water.
Mix yeast water into flour and mix until dough comes away from side of bowl.
Add maybe 1/2 cup flour more and knead 1 minute.
Cover and let rise 1/2 hour.
Roll 1/3 of dough to size of 10-inch pie shell.
Spread 1/3 of cooked and drained sausage on top with some Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese, garlic powder and bread crumbs sprinkled on.
Roll up like jelly roll.
Cut into 3-inch pieces or smaller.
Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for about 30 minutes.
Do 3 times.

recipes.title: Cathy'S Crab Brunch Casserole
steps: Drain crabmeat.
Spread layer of croutons in buttered 9-inch square casserole.
Sprinkle with crabmeat, then cheese.
Layer 2 times, ending with cheese layer.
Beat eggs; add milk and seasonings.
Pour over casserole.
Bake in oven preheated to 325° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Check for doneness by inserting knife in center.
Will come out clean when finished.
Sprinkle bacon on top about 10 minutes before finished baking.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad
steps: Mix salt, sugar and mayonnaise and pour over the vegetables. Sprinkle with cheese and crumbled bacon.
Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge Cake
steps: Cream
sugars
and margarine;
add eggs, one at a time, beating
well
after each.
Measure cocoa in measuring cup and fill
to
the
3/4 mark with boiling water.
Stir to dissolve. Stir
into
creamed mixture.
Mix soda with buttermilk and add to the
creamed
mixture alternately with flour, mixing well. Pour into
two greased and floured 9-inch cake pans.
Bake in preheated 350° oven 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Rolls
steps: Bring 2 cups water to a boil.
Pour over oil, sugar and salt. Cook
until
only
lukewarm.
Dissolve
yeast in 1/3 c. warm water.
Add
to
cooled mixture along with the eggs and 3 cups flour.
Stir
until
smooth.
Add
remaining 3 cups flour and blend in.
Turn out onto a lightly floured board and knead lightly.
Shape
into rolls and place on greased pans (I use 9 x 13-inch pans).
Let rise until doubled.
Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Sugared Popcorn
steps: Combine sugar, butter and water in large, heavy pot. Bring to boiling over medium heat, stirring constantly. Continue to cook until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture becomes syrupy, 4 to 5 minutes. Remove pot from heat. Add the popcorn to the pot. Stir to coat popcorn evenly with sugar mixture. Turn coated popcorn out in thin layer onto sheet of wax paper or parchment paper. Let popcorn cool for about 10 minutes. Serve in a basket or for a festive touch, in individual paper cones.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
steps: Fry onion and bell peppers in oil until tender.
Cook over low to medium heat.
Add tomatoes, water, onions, peppers, rice, salt and black pepper.
Stir constantly until done.
Serve with crumbled cornbread or cooked cabbage, if desired.

recipes.title: Healthy Supper
ingredients: 1 lb. ground turkey or super lean ground beef
steps: Cook meat in large pot.
Add rice, bouillon (dissolved in hot water) and seasoned salt and stir.
Add cabbage, onions and carrots.
Cover and cook slowly until cabbage cooks down and carrots are tender.
Can be simmered for an hour and left unattended.
Serve with soy sauce, if desired.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Chilled Summer Soup
steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Add the lettuce, watercress and spring onions and fry for 8 minutes.
Stir in all but 3 tablespoons of the chicken stock and simmer for 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Blend the flour to a paste with the remaining stock and stir into the soup.
Add salt and pepper to taste and continue cooking until soup has thickened.
Puree in an electric blender. Cool, then stir in cream.
Sprinkle top with parsley.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Tempting Drop Sugar Cookies
steps: Have all ingredients at room temperature; sift together flour, soda and salt.
Cream together margarine, shortening, sugar and vanilla.
Add the egg; cream until mixture is fluffy. Stir in dry ingredients until mixture is smooth; blend in milk.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet; flatten the dough with the bottom of a glass which has been dipped in sugar.
Bake at 400° for about 12 minutes.
Makes 5 1/2 dozen 2-inch cookies.

recipes.title: Chicken Pie
steps: Mix together chicken, broth, soup and vegetables.
Spread into oblong baking dish.
Mix flour, margarine and milk; spread over chicken.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Sift together the first 4 ingredients, then add next 5 ingredients.
Combine water, oil and eggs.
Mix together dry and wet mixtures well.
Add raisins and/or pecans to taste.
Bake at 350° for one hour in loaf pans.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas (can be cooked gently or just thawed)
steps: Put sliced lettuce in bottom of bowl or container you are using (glass allows you to see the layers).
Put the other layers of vegetables you are using; try to vary colors for a nice look. The choice is yours, except that you need to finish with the peas on top.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise and sugar in small bowl; spread over entire top of salad, on top of peas.
Cover; refrigerate for at least 8 hours.
To serve, go down to bottom of bowl with salad fork and spoon to get all the layers and dressing.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
steps: Cream together margarine, Crisco and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each.
Add vanilla.
Sift together dry ingredients and add alternately with milk, until well blended. Pour into large greased tube pan or two loaf pans.
Bake at 300° to 325° for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours or until done.

recipes.title: Ginger Bread
steps: Mix together sugar, shortening, molasses and water.
Sift dry ingredients into mixture and blend well.
Stir in eggs.
Pour in greased 9 x 13 pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Fudge Brownies
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease bottom of an 8-inch square pan. Melt in a 2-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, the butter and chocolate chips.
Beat in the remaining ingredients; mix well.
Spread in greased pan.
Bake for about 30 minutes. Cool; cut into squares.
Makes 14 or 16.

recipes.title: Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 2 envelopes dry chicken noodle soup mix
steps: Brown sausage; pour off grease.
Bring water to boil.
Add soup; boil for 7 minutes.
Add to sausage and vegetables.
Pour into greased casserole pan; sprinkle sliced almonds on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pancake Mix
steps: Sift flour and baking powder into bowl.
Add milk, melted shortening and egg.
Beat well. Pour onto sprayed pan.
(For thinner pancakes, add more milk.)
Makes 12 to 15 (5-inch) pancakes.

recipes.title: Bean Soup
ingredients: pepper, basil and oregano to taste
1/2 lb. cubed ham or your choice of meat (smoked sausage is good)
steps: Saute together garlic, pepper, and onion.
Add remaining ingredients.
Add 1 or 2 cans water.
Simmer until peppers are done.

recipes.title: Fresh Blueberry Cake
steps: Cream the butter and then add sugar a little at a time, creaming again.
Add eggs and some flour, sifted with the salt and baking powder.
Blend slowly, adding milk and the rest of the flour. Wash blueberries; dry with paper towel and dust with flour. Add to batter just before baking.
Pour batter into greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar, nutmeg, cloves or whatever appeals to you.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Popovers
steps: Sift flour; measure.
Add salt and sift again.
Beat eggs with rotary or electric beater until light and thick.
Add flour and 1/3 cup of the milk; continue to beat slowly until all the flour is moistened, about 30 seconds.
Gradually add remaining milk and melted shortening.
Beat until free from lumps, 1 to 2 minutes. Fill greased muffin pan.
Divide in 6 to 8 large popovers.
Bake at 425° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Pintos And Sausage
steps: Cook beans as directed on bag (I use more water, to give some juice), around 2 1/2 hours.
Cut up sausage.
Add to beans.
Cook about 15 minutes more.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Great with cornbread and onions.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Carrot Cake
steps: Mix the first eight ingredients.
Heat to boil and then simmer 5 minutes.
Cool to warm and add flour, soda and salt.
Mix well. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan 45 to 60 minutes at 325° or until done.

recipes.title: Oriental Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh or frozen Brussels sprouts
steps: Cook bacon until crisp.
Remove from pan and drain on paper towel.
Stir soy sauce into the bacon drippings.
Add chestnuts, garlic and broth.
Bring to a boil and add Brussels sprouts. Return to a boil; cover and reduce heat, cooking about 8 minutes or until sprouts are just tender.
Combine cornstarch and water and add to the pan liquid.
Cook, stirring, until thickened. Sprinkle reserved bacon over the top to serve.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Crunchies Cookies
steps: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt.
Add brown sugar, shortening, egg and vanilla; beat well.
Stir in oats and nuts.
Form dough into small balls.
Dip tops in a little additional granulated sugar.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Scotch-A-Roos
steps: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil.
Boil maybe 1 or 2 minutes, no longer or they will get too hard.
Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter and stir together.
Add Rice Krispies.
Put in bar pan, greased with butter or margarine.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cake
steps: Cream
the shortening and sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Combine dry ingredients.
Add to creamed mixture alternately
with
milk.
Stir thoroughly after each addition. Pour batter in two 9-inch greased and floured pans and bake at 350° for approximately 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chinese Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix all together and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
steps: Boil potatoes with skins on.
Fry bacon until crisp; drain. Cook and stir onion in bacon drippings until tender and gold. Stir in flour, sugar, salt, celery seed and pepper.
Cook over low heat.
Stir until bubbly.
Remove from heat.
Stir in water and vinegar.
Heat to boil; stir constantly.
Boil and stir 1 minute. Crumble bacon.
Dice potatoes.
Carefully stir bacon and potatoes in hot mixture.
Heat through.
Stir to coat potatoes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Cookies
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. orange juice or apple cider
2 1/2 c. fresh cranberries, coarsely chopped (about 8 oz.)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease cookie sheets.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
steps: Break spaghetti in half.
Cook in boiling salted water until done; drain.
While still warm, combine spaghetti with eggs and Parmesan.
Pour into a well greased 10-inch pie plate and pat mixture up and around sides with a spoon.

recipes.title: Orange-Kissed Pancakes
steps: Combine the flour, sugar, baking soda and salt in a medium bowl.

recipes.title: Fix Ahead Mashed Potatoes
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water.
Drain and mash with the rest of the ingredients except for the melted butter.
Spoon into a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Collards And Cornbread
ingredients: 2 ham hocks or 1 c. ham chunks
steps: Wash greens thoroughly (2 to 3 times) to remove sand.
Take out and discard tough stems.
Put ham hocks or ham chunks in pot.
Add greens and fill half full with water.
Let greens come to a boil, then turn fire down and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until seasoned and tender.
Add salt according to taste when serving.
Lift greens out of water into a flat bowl and cut into bite size pieces with a sharp knife.
We like to sprinkle pepper sauce or vinegar on our plates.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. beef round, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 pkg. extra wide egg noodles, uncooked
steps: In large skillet, heat oil and cook beef and onion until meat is browned.
Drain fat off, then add bouillon and Worcestershire sauce.
Bring to boil, then reduce heat.
Simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Add mushrooms with liquid.
Combine sour cream and flour; blend into meat mixture.
Continue cooking about 5 minutes or until thickened.
Cook noodles to package directions.
Drain; serve stroganoff over hot cooked noodles.

recipes.title: *Sweet And Sour Carrots
ingredients: 1 medium green pepper, cut in 1-inch squares
steps: Cook carrots in slightly salted water for 15 minutes.
Add pepper and cook for 3 minutes more; drain.
Drain pineapple and save juice.
Add water to juice to make 1/3 cup.
Combine sugar, cornstarch, salt, liquid, vinegar and soy sauce.
Cook and stir until bubbly.
Add vegetables and pineapple.
Heat through. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Skillet Cabbage
ingredients: 1 c. drained tomatoes or 2 c. chopped fresh ones
steps: Combine ingredients in large skillet.
Cover and cook 3 minutes.
Stir and cook 3 more minutes.
Yields about 6 servings.

recipes.title: Ole Settlers Baked Beans
steps: Brown beef, bacon and onion, then add the rest of the ingredients and mix well.
Pour all ingredients into a large baking dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Easy Combination In A Pastry Shell
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 c. any of the following: cooked shrimp, lump crabmeat, crawfish tails, scallops, chicken or 1 to 1 1/2 c. mushrooms, broccoli, etc.
steps: Make the white sauce by melting butter in a large skillet. Take off the heat and add flour to make a paste.
Add milk, return to heat and stir constantly until thick and smooth.

recipes.title: Crisp Candy Bars
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. peanut butter or butterscotch chips
steps: Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
In saucepan, mix syrup and sugar, stirring
frequently
to boil over medium heat.
Remove from heat. Stir
in peanut butter, then cereal and press into pan.
Melt your chips and spread while hot.

recipes.title: Lemony Torte Squares
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add flour.
Batter will be stiff. Pack in 9 x9-inch ungreased pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini And Rice Casserole
steps: Saute onion in oil.
Add zucchini, garlic, salt and pepper. Cook 5 minutes until zucchini is bright green.
Beat eggs in a large bowl.
Add cheese, parsley, rice and thyme.
Add to zucchini mixture and place in a greased casserole.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup bread crumbs and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. buttermilk (or sweet milk if not available)
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Mash bananas and add last so that they will not turn dark.
Bake at 300 degrees in a muffin tin or loaf pan.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
steps: Grease baking dish.
Mix uncooked rice, mushroom soup and dry onion soup together.
Add water.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
May need to add water.

recipes.title: Monterey Beans And Cheese
steps: Fry the first 3 ingredients. Add the remaining ingredients. Cook, slowly, stirring until blended, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle 1/4 to 1/2 pound Cheddar cheese on top.
Put lid on for 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve on top of rice or mix with rice. Serve with carrots.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
steps: Melt margarine in large casserole dish.
Stir in rice, water and soup.
Add green pepper, onion and pimentos, all chopped. Bake at 350°, covered, for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Dilly Bread
steps: Drain cottage cheese in sieve.
Dissolve yeast in water.
Mix all ingredients well and let rise in same bowl until doubled. Work down with spoon and transfer to 2 oiled loaf pans.
Let rise again.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheath Cake
steps: In a large bowl, sift flour and sugar together. Mix margarine, cocoa and water in a saucepan. Bring to a rapid boil. Pour over flour and sugar mixture and stir until well mixed. Add eggs, soda, cinnamon and vanilla. Mix well and pour into well-greased 11 x 16-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Plan Ahead Pinto Beans
ingredients: 3 large green chiles, roasted, peeled and seeded or canned green chiles
steps: Note:
Sprouting the beans helps to remove some of the gas and also brings in extra nutrients.

recipes.title: Salad Dressing Cake
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Mix water and salad dressing.
Mix the two together gradually and beat.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. May make 1 layer or a 2-layer cake.

recipes.title: 3 Layer Pie
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients until crumbly; put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Hamburger With Baked Beans
steps: Cut bacon strips in small pieces.
Add onion and saute.
Brown ground beef with the onion and bacon.
Add remaining ingredients and pour into casserole or baking dish.
Bake at 375° for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken Pilaf
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts, halved or other chicken parts
steps: Mix rice, soup mix, soup, water and wine in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Put chicken parts on top. Brush with butter.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour until chicken is done.

recipes.title: Homemade Muenster Cheese
steps: Don't let new small potatoes go to waste.
Scrape them or if you want to do a basketful or more, fill your washing machine with cold water and let it run to clean them.
Pack them in jars; add water and 1 teaspoon salt to each quart.
Cold pack 3 hours.

recipes.title: Rigatoni And Cheese Sauce
steps: Prepare rigatoni according to package directions. Melt margarine.
Add flour and cook, stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Do not brown.
Stir in milk, salt, pepper and cheese.
Cook until smooth and thickened.
Pour sauce over hot rigatoni and mix gently.
Sprinkle peas on top and place in oven at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Green Chili Fritters
steps: Mix salt, masa and flour into bowl. Add beaten egg, milk and shortening. Drop chili into batter, then drop chili in hot oil.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Deluxe
steps: After
topping	has been added, bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Potatoes	may be prepared several days ahead and refrigerated.
Topping should not be added until you are ready to bake them.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Yeast Rolls
steps: Soften yeast in water; let stand while combining sour cream, sugar and baking soda in large bowl.
Add 2 cups biscuit mix, then yeast mixture.
Mix well.
Stir in 3 more cups biscuit mix.
Turn dough onto board dusted with 1/2 cup biscuit mix; knead to form smooth ball.
Shape dough into small rounds the size of a walnut. Place close together in buttered 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Let rise until doubled in bulk.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Bake rolls 15 minutes, or until done.
Makes 72 bite size rolls.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
steps: Preheat oven at 200°.
Grease and flour tube cake pan.
Mix ingredients and pour into pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cocoa Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Bring margarine, sugar, cocoa and milk to a boil for about 3 minutes.
Add peanut butter and oats.
Then drop on waxed paper and allow to cool.

recipes.title: Zucchini-Carrot Bread
ingredients: 1 c. zucchini, grated medium and drained
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease pans (three 5 1/2 x 9 1/2 x 3-inch if double).
In large bowl, beat eggs with oil.
Stir in sugar, zucchini, carrots and vanilla.
Mix flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon.
Blend into egg and oil, etc. and add raisins.
Bake 1 hour or until tested with toothpick. Remove from pan and cool.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Cookies
steps: Blend Crisco with salt and sugars.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing thoroughly.
Add flour, baking soda and nuts to mixture. Shape into roll about 2 1/2 inches in diameter or 2 smaller rolls. Roll in wax paper and chill in refrigerator.
When ready to bake, slice thinly and place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes, or when delicately brown.

recipes.title: Quaker Choc Oat-Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. (2 sticks) margarine or butter, softened
2 1/2 c. Quaker oats (Quick or old fashioned; uncooked)
1 (12 oz.) pkg. Nestle Toll House semi-sweet chocolate morsels (2 c.)
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well.
Add combined flour, baking soda and salt; mix well.
Stir in oats, chocolate morsels and nuts; mix well.
Drop by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 9 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie or 12 to 13 minutes for a crisp cookie.
Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet; remove to wire rack.
Cool completely.
Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Baby Ruth Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. Baby Ruth candy bar, cut into small pieces
steps: Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Cream together margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg.
Stir in Baby Ruth pieces and dry ingredients.
Add vanilla and blend well. Chill dough for 30 minutes.
Drop by 1/2 teaspoon onto greased baking sheet.
Bake in oven at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until done.
Remove from baking sheet onto wire racks to cool.
To enhance flavoring, add caramel flavoring.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
ingredients: 2 pkg. yeast, dissolved in 4 Tbsp. warm water and 2 c. buttermilk
steps: Sift together first 5 ingredients.
Cut in shortening.
Add yeast mixture.
Add to dry ingredients.
Dough should be soft and pliable; work 5 minutes.
Roll out; cut with biscuit cutter.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
May refrigerate dough overnight.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Bread
steps: Combine whole wheat flour and yeast.
Heat buttermilk, molasses, honey, salt and butter until warm.
Add oats, whole wheat flour, yeast mixture and eggs.
Bake at low speed for 3 minutes at medium.

recipes.title: Stew
steps: Fry bacon in a large stew pot.
Remove bacon.
Add stew meat and sear.
Lower heat and add tomatoes, beef broth, water, celery, onion, garlic, Worcestershire sauce and chili powder.
Cover and simmer 2 hours.
Remove 1/4 cup broth from stew.
Cool and mix with flour.
Add flour mixture to stew.
Season.
Add carrots and potatoes and cook 30 minutes.
Add corn and bacon.
Cook another 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Saute onion in butter until tender.
Put beans in a baking dish and add onions, mustard, brown sugar and bacon.
Stir to mix. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 1 hour until bubbly and set.

recipes.title: Parmesan Potatoes
steps: Cut potatoes into large pieces.
Combine all ingredients, except butter; shake in a large bag.
Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Put potatoes in one layer.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour. Turn once during baking.

recipes.title: Tammy'S Chicken Fingers
steps: Beat the eggs in a large bowl and add enough buttermilk to cover the chicken strips. Stir. Coat chicken strips and refrigerate overnight.
Remove chicken strips from mixture and shake off excess.
Dip in a mixture of flour, salt, pepper and the seasoned salt. Deep fry until chicken strips are golden brown and drain on a paper towel.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased and floured tube pan or make three 9-inch layers. Bake for 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Milk Chocolate Brownies
steps: Melt butter over low heat and remove from stove. Add 2 cups sugar. Beat well. Mix in eggs and vanilla; blend well. Sift together flour, cocoa and salt. Add to sugar mixture. Mix well. Stir in coconut. Spread into greased 9 x 13 baking pan.

recipes.title: Baked Rice Dressing
steps: Mix all in large bowl.
Bake in covered 9 x 13-inch bowl at 350°
for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
ingredients: 2 large or 3 small very ripe bananas, mashed
steps: Cream Crisco and sugar well. Add eggs and beat. Sift dry ingredients together. Add this a little at a time while beating the egg mixture.
Add bananas and nuts. Bake in greased, slightly floured loaf pan at 350° for about 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean. Makes one loaf.

recipes.title: *No Crust Coconut Pie*
steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients.
Add vanilla, then add milk and coconut.
Grease two 9-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Macaroni Cheese Salad With Dill Weed
ingredients: 1/3 c. sweet pickle salad cubes, drained
steps: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain.
Turn, while still hot, into a bowl that contains butter and Parmesan cheese; toss to coat.
Add celery, cheese, salad cubes, mayonnaise to moisten, salt, pepper, seasoned salt and mustard;
mix well and chill.
Turn out on salad greens, and if desired, 2 cups of slivered ham or 1/4 cup of real bacon crumbs may be added to recipe.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Squash Balls
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients and form into small balls.
Roll in cornflakes.
Drop in hot grease and fry.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Mix together the first 3 ingredients; let stand a while, preparing other ingredients.
Add the flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, dates and nuts; mix.
Add the oil and vanilla; mix well.
Cook in tube pan or loaf pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Berniece Thurn'S Pancake
steps: Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside.
Mix together yolks and the rest of ingredients; fold in egg whites.
Cook on hot griddle or heavy frying pan until bubbly on top; turn once.
Cook until golden brown.
Serve with hot syrup and butter.

recipes.title: Meatball Casserole
steps: Mix ingredients; form into small meatballs.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes uncovered in baking dish.
Add tomatoes and peas. Return to oven for 15 to 20 minutes with cover on.
Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Mix together beans, brown sugar, barbecue sauce and bacon. Saute onion and pepper; add to other mixture.
Put in baking dish; bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Honey Drop Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well.
Sift together dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture.
Add vanilla and honey.
Bake on greased cookie sheets at 350°.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Mix well, pour into greased and floured tube pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Pie
ingredients: 2 c. cooked chicken or turkey, cut up in bite size
steps: Place chicken in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Mix soup and broth and pour over chicken.
Place sliced boiled eggs over soup mixture.
Mix flour, margarine and milk.
Pour over chicken mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Spudnuts
steps: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup water.
Mix potatoes and milk.
Add flour salt, shortening and sugar.
Add 3 more cups flour and knead.
If needed, add 1 more cup flour.
Let dough double itself, then roll out and cut with regular doughnut cutter.
Let rise until twice their regular size.
Cook in deep oil at 390°.
Makes 4 dozen plus holes.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Combine all ingredients thoroughly, except only add 1/2 cup of tomato ketchup at this time.
Mix with hands.
Pack firmly into ungreased baking dish.
Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
At the last 15 minutes of baking time, take the meat loaf out and brush the other 1/2 cup of tomato ketchup over the top.
Put back in oven for rest of baking time.
Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before slicing.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: "Momma'S Chili"
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes (whole; slice the tomatoes and add juice also)
1 pack French's brand Chili-O mix with onion
2 cans Bush's brand light kidney beans
1 (16 oz.) can water (use the tomato sauce can)
steps: Cook in at least a 4-quart Dutch oven.
Brown the ground chuck and chopped onion until the meat is thoroughly cooked.
Add the salt and pepper for seasoning.
Then add the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil over low heat for 30 to 35 minutes.
Stir often to avoid burning.
No lid is necessary.
Serve hot.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Salmon Croquettes
ingredients: 1 large can pink or red salmon
steps: Melt Crisco in small pan; blend in flour.
Add milk.
Cook and stir until very thick and smooth.
Remove from heat.
Pour into bowl and add onion, lemon juice and seasonings.
Stir in salmon. Shape into balls.
Roll in bread crumbs.
Combine egg with water. Dip balls in mixture.
Roll in bread crumbs.
Deep fry until browned, about 3 minutes.
Serve plain or with cream gravy with peas.

recipes.title: Pizza Dough
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. all-purpose * or whole wheat flour
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Stir in remaining ingredients; beat vigorously 20 strokes.
Let rest about 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Southern Okra
ingredients: 3 medium sized tomatoes, peeled and quartered
steps: Cook okra in boiling salted water 10 minutes; drain.
Brown onion and green pepper in salad oil.
Add tomatoes and cook slowly for 5 minutes.
Add okra and remaining ingredients.
Cook over low heat until vegetables are just tender, stirring as little as possible.
One cup canned tomatoes may be used in place of fresh tomatoes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Wet Chicken
steps: Wash and cut chicken.
Lightly salt and pepper, then place in flour.
Place shortening into frypan on medium heat.
Brown chicken and then place into a large pot with a lid.
After all chicken has been browned, pour remaining drippings over chicken and cover chicken with water.
Bring to a boil and then simmer 1 hour. Remove chicken.
It should have made its own gravy.
Pour over rice or potatoes.

recipes.title: Dirty Rice
steps: Cook sausage and drain.
Cut up celery, onion and bell pepper; add to sausage.
Pour in chicken broth.
Add uncooked rice.
Mix well.
Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°.
When cooked, fluff with fork.

recipes.title: Custard Pie
steps: Combine sugar, flour and salt. Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Slowly add scalded milk and stir until well blended. Pour into unbaked, deep, 9-inch pie shell. Bake 50 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Salmonettes Heloise
steps: Pour salmon juice into measuring cup and set aside.
Put salmon in mixing bowl and 1 egg.
Break up salmon and mix the egg real good.
Fork in 1/2 cup flour.
Mixture is thick.
Add a little pepper, 1/4 salmon juice and add 1 teaspoon baking powder. Beat with a fork.
It must foam.
Pour into salmon mixture.
Mix with fork.
Scoop with small spoons into hot oil.
Makes brown tidbits.
Stick with toothpick and serve with dip or put a hot sauce over them.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients, except vanilla, in saucepan and cook until it thickens.
Add vanilla.
This will get thicker as it cools.

recipes.title: Double Quick Rolls(Makes 1 Dozen Rolls)
steps: Mix flour, sugar, salt and yeast in a large bowl.
Add water, shortening and egg.
Beat until smooth.
Cover and let rise in a warm place until double in bulk, about 30 minutes.
Stir down batter by beating about 25 strokes.
Spoon into 12 greased muffin tins.
Let rise until batter rounds over tops of cups, about 20 to 30 minutes.
Heat oven to 400°.
Bake until golden brown (15 to 20 minutes).

recipes.title: Pumpkin Roll
steps: Beat eggs on high speed for 5 minutes, gradually adding the sugar.
Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice.
Mix together dry ingredients and add to pumpkin mixture.
Spread onto jelly roll pan; bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Unroll onto toweling sprinkled with powdered sugar; spread filling mixture thick over roll.
Roll up and allow to cool; slice.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Pork With Garlic
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless pork tenderloin, trimmed of fat, cut into 2 x 1/8-inch strips
steps: In a bowl, combine pork, sherry, soy sauce, vinegar, cornstarch, ginger, sugar and chili paste.
Toss to mix.
Marinate 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Cream the sugar and shortening. Add eggs and bananas. Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Add to mixture.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Mandarin Pork Chops With Wild Rice
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops (3/4-inch thick; about 3/4 lb.)
1 pkg. Lipton long grain and wild rice with sauce (original recipe)
1 (11 oz.) can Mandarin orange segments in light syrup, drained (reserve 1/2 c. syrup)
steps: In large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil and brown chops.
Add water, long grain and wild rice with sauce (original recipe), reserved syrup and green onions.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, 13 minutes or until pork is done.
Stir in oranges; heat through.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Raisin Cookies
steps: Combine flour, salt, baking powder and soda; set aside.
In mixer bowl thoroughly combine sugar, brown sugar and margarine. Add eggs and vanilla; beat well.
Add Rice Krispies and raisins, mixing until it combines.
Drop cookies on greased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for about 16 minutes or until light golden brown.

recipes.title: Lemon Bread
steps: Beat egg in large bowl until thickened.
Add marmalade and butter until well blended.
Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Combine buttermilk and lemon juice. Alternately add dry and liquid ingredients in thirds to egg mixture, stirring until well mixed.
Fold in walnuts.
Pour batter into greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool in pan 5 minutes.
Invert onto wire rack.

recipes.title: Cherry Crumb Cake
ingredients: 1 (1 lb. 6 oz.) can cherry pie filling or other prepared fruits
steps: Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Mix with sugar.
Cut in butter; add beaten egg and mix to make crumbs.
Place 1/2 of crumbs in bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Distribute cherries evenly and top with remaining crumbs.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 30 minutes.
Serve with ice cream or other topping. Sprinkle crumbs lightly with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese And Apple Pancakes
steps: Beat egg whites until stiff. Combine all other ingredients in a medium size bowl and mix well. Fold in egg whites.
Heat oil or melt butter in a skillet.
When it is hot enough to sizzle a drop of batter on contact, add spoonfuls of batter.
Fry on both sides until firm and lightly browned. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Sift together first 7 ingredients, all into a large mixing bowl.
Add next 4 ingredients.
Beat together until smooth.
Add last 2 ingredients.

recipes.title: Hot Cross Buns(A Family Tradition On Good Friday)
steps: Combine sugar, salt, yeast and flour in large bowl.
In 1-quart saucepan, over low heat, heat milk and butter until very warm (120° to 130°).
With mixer at low speed, beat liquid into dry ingredients until blended.
Increase speed to medium; beat 2 minutes.
Beat in egg and 1 cup flour to make a thick batter; continue beating 2 minutes, scraping bowl often.
Stir in raisins and flour to make a soft dough.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Beat egg; add sugar and salt. Mix baking powder in the flour. Mix soda in buttermilk. Then pour into egg and sugar. Add butter and stir until mixed well. Add all to flour. Mix well; add flour until stiff dough. Roll real thin and sprinkle with sugar. Cut and cook in moderate oven until brown through. Makes 150 cookies.

recipes.title: White Greek Cookies
steps: Cream butter well, then add sugar gradually.
Add egg yolks and vanilla, continuing to mix.
Fold in almonds and whiskey.

Add flour and baking powder and mix by hand until dough is formed. Then make small shaped cookies (round balls, flat half moons). Bake at 350° for 20 minutes (almost light gold) on ungreased cookie sheet.
Cool cookies before sifting confectioners sugar on top and bottom.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
steps: Sift flour in a large bowl.
Make hole in center of flour and put in all ingredients in the hole.
Work up as you would for biscuits.
When all is mixed together, roll out on floured paper and cut.
Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Ricotta Cheese Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. lemon cake mix with pudding
steps: Follow directions on cake package mix.
In a separate bowl, mix remainder of ingredients.
Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Pour cake mix into pan.
Pour Ricotta mixture over the batter.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or 325° if oven is too hot.
Let cool completely before cutting.

recipes.title: Cherry Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch green onions, including tops, chopped
steps: Cook bacon until crisp.
Drain and crumble.
Combine bacon with tomatoes, cucumber and onions.
Sprinkle with garlic salt, sweet basil and pepper.
Mix well and chill.
Combine vinegar and salad oil; shake well.
Just before serving, pour over salad and toss.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Seedless Raisin Tarts
steps: Beat all ingredients together and fill unbaked tart shells. Sprinkle with grated cheese.
Makes about 15.
Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake
steps: Melt butter and sugar; add eggs and flavoring.
Sift flour, cinnamon and nutmeg and add a little at a time.
Beat well; add nuts and fruit.
Bake 2 1/2 hours at 275°.
Take out of oven.
Put cherries, pineapple and pecans on top.
Cook 1/2 hour longer.

recipes.title: Peanut Logs
steps: Mix
well peanut butter, Rice Krispies, oleo and sugar. Melt chocolate chips and wax.
Roll by teaspoon size in hands. Keep your
fingers
wet
and
then
dip the logs in chocolate mixture. Put on wax paper.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bar Cookies
steps: Melt together corn syrup and white sugar.
Remove from heat; stir in peanut butter until smooth.
Add 7 cups cereal (corn flakes, Rice Krispies, Cheerios, etc.).
Mix well.
Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Pecan Dainties
steps: Mix butter, brown sugar and 1/2 cup confectioners sugar. Blend in flour and vanilla. Stir in nuts.
Using about 1 teaspoon of dough, shape into crescents or balls.
Place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350° until lightly browned. Cool. Roll in confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Pistachio Torte
steps: Mix nuts, sugar, flour and butter; press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Layered Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) pkg. refrigerated uncooked cheese tortellini
steps: Cook tortellini to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain; rinse with cold water.
In large clear glass bowl with straight sides or 13 x 9-inch baking dish, layer cabbage, spinach, tortellini, tomatoes and green onions.
Pour dressing evenly over top; sprinkle with bacon.
Cover; refrigerate until serving time. Makes 8 (1/2-cup) servings.

recipes.title: Boston Brown Bread
steps: Heat raisins and water just until the mixture comes to a boil. Cool.
Add soda and set aside.
Mix sugar, oleo and eggs and beat until smooth.
Add flour, salt, raisins and water.
Beat until smooth.
Bake in loaf pan at 350° until, when tested, the toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Mother'S Cornbread Dressing
ingredients: large pan cornbread, crumbled (made with about 3 c. meal)
2 pieces white bread, toasted and crumbled
about 1 c. broth from small turkey
steps: Cook onion and celery in part of broth until tender, then puree.
Crumble cornbread and toasted bread.
Mix with rice, pureed onion mixture and enough broth to make a fairly soupy mixture.
Heat bacon grease in shallow baking pan and add dressing mixture and bake at 400° until brown on top and crusty on edges.

recipes.title: Pie
ingredients: 2 c. milk (1 1/2 c. to heat, 1/2 c. to mix with egg yolks)
1 c. coconut or 2 bananas or 2 Tbsp. cocoa
steps: Mix flour, sugar, salt together. Then add to egg yolk and milk mixture. stir into heated milk. Cook over medium heat until thick stirring constantly. Add butter, vanilla and coconut, banana or cocoa. Pour into baked 9 inch pie shell.

recipes.title: Crispy Chocolate Log
steps: Line a 15 x 10 x 2-inch jelly roll pan with waxed paper; grease the paper and set aside.
In a large microwave-safe bowl, combine marshmallows, butter and peanut butter.
Cover and microwave on High for 2 minutes; stir until well blended.
Stir in cereal until well coated.
Spread into prepared pan.
In a microwave-safe bowl, combine chocolate and butterscotch chips. Microwave, uncovered, on High for 2 minutes.
Stir; spread over cereal to within 1-inch of edges.
Roll up jelly roll style, starting with a short side, peeling away waxed paper while rolling.
Place, seam side down, on a serving plate.
Refrigerate for 1 hour or until set.
Cut into 1-inch slices.
Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Shakertown Corn Pudding
steps: In a large bowl, blend butter, sugar, flour and salt.
Add the eggs and beat well with a rotary beater or mixer on low.
Stir in the corn and milk.
(If using frozen corn, chop it up a little first to release the milky juices.)

recipes.title: Chicken Continental
ingredients: 2 boneless chicken breasts, cut in strips
1 pkg. Birds Eye Bavarian style beans and spaetzle
steps: Saute chicken in oil.
Sprinkle with salt; add vegetables and broth.
Bring to full boil over medium heat.
Separate vegetables with fork, stirring frequently.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 3 minutes.
Combine sour cream, flour, and paprika.
Stir into vegetables and heat gently.

recipes.title: Potato And Ham Chowder
steps: Potatoes may be red skinned or other thin skinned; cut in 1/2-inch chunks.
Ham is fully cooked, smoked and cut in small chunks.
Corn may be fresh, canned or frozen.

recipes.title: Carrot Pineapple Bread
steps: Beat first 3 ingredients.
Add next 3 ingredients; add remaining ingredients and blend.
It's much easier to use Cusinart or blender for carrots.
Lightly grease 2 loaf pans and bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sausage Snack Wraps
steps: Separate dough into 8 triangles.
Cut each triangle lengthwise into thirds.
Place sausages on shortest side of each triangle. Roll up from shortest side to the opposite point.
Bake at 375° on ungreased cookie sheet for 12 to 15 minutes.
May be prepared ahead and refrigerated up to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Heat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan or 12 cup Bundt pan.
In large mixer bowl, cream butter.
Gradually add sugar, beat until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, and flavorings.
Sift together flour, salt and soda.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream.
Pour batter into prepared pan and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in cake comes out clean.
Cool about 15 minutes in pan.

recipes.title: Cowboy Soup
steps: Melt shortening in a large kettle.
Add meat and onion.
Brown slowly, stirring with a fork to break up meat.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Bring to a boil.
Cover.
Reduce heat. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients, except apples and pecans, mix well. Fold in fruit and nuts. Bake in well greased tube or bundt pan at 350 degrees for approximately 55 minutes.
Cool in pan. May serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Turkey Alfredo Casserole
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. cubed cooked turkey or chicken
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Drain and set aside.
Run water over broccoli to thaw.

recipes.title: Cracked Wheat Cereal(Diabetic Approved)
steps: Toast cracked wheat and coconut by stirring constantly in a dry pan over medium heat for several minutes, until lightly browned.
Place in a saucepan andd remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes.
Sprinkle with chopped nut, if desired.

recipes.title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
steps: Layer peeled and sliced potatoes in a 9-inch pan. Mix margarine, flour, brown sugar and water.
Make a hot syrup and pour over potatoes.
Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Squares
ingredients: 1 large bag chocolate chips or 1 (7 oz.) pkg.
steps: Mix thoroughly and bake 16 to 20 minutes at 375° in a 10 x 14-inch pan.
When cool, cut into squares.

recipes.title: Pear Butter
ingredients: 10 large ripe pears (5 lb.), quartered and cored
steps: Combine pears and water in a large Dutch oven.
Cover and cook over medium-low heat 40 minutes or until pears are soft, stirring occasionally.
Drain.
Press pears through a sieve or food mill; measure 1 quart of puree.
Combine 1 quart puree with remaining ingredients in a Dutch oven.
Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, 15 minutes or until mixture thickens.
Remove from heat; skim off foam.
Quickly pour hot pear mixture into hot sterilized jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace; wipe jar rims.
Cover at once with metal lids and screw on bands.
Process in boiling water bath 10 minutes.
Yield:
2 pints.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
steps: Mix oleo, sugar, flour and meal.
Add beaten eggs, add other ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350 degrees until it does not shake.

recipes.title: Chocolate Meringue Pie
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Mix flour, sugar and cocoa.
Add enough hot water to dry ingredients to wet it.
Add egg yolks, milk, margarine (melted) and flavoring.
Pour into uncooked pie crust and cook until firm, approximately 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Tank'S Taco Grande(Mom Or Dad Will Help With Hard Parts.)
ingredients: 1 lb. ground turkey or ground beef
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.

Spray Pam on bottom and sides of 9 x 13 baking dish. Cook turkey or beef until no longer pink, breaking up chunks to small crumbs. Add taco mix and water (see mix directions). Remove from heat. Add 1 cup of salsa.

recipes.title: Hearty Lentil Soup
ingredients: 1 32 oz. can Italian plum tomatoes (whole, in tomato puree)
steps: Wash lentils and let soak overnight; drain. Saute onions, celery and garlic in olive oil. Put soaked lentils in large pot and fill with 2 quarts water. Add sauteed vegetables, carrots, tomatoes (chopped very coarsely) along with all the puree, oregano, salt, pepper, parsley and bay leaf.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Walnut Raisin Cookies
steps: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs together until light and fluffy.
Sift together flour, soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Stir into creamed mixture.
Stir in oats, raisins and walnuts.
Drop from a tablespoon 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for about 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool slightly and remove from pan.

recipes.title: Cherry Confetti Cake
ingredients: 1 c. shortening (1/2 butter can be used)
4 eggs, added one at a time
1 c. maraschino cherries, drained and finely cut
steps: Sift or mix together the flour, baking powder and salt.
Cream the shortening and confectioners sugar.
Blend in the almond extract and eggs.
Measure milk and add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture.
(Begin and end with dry.)
Fold in walnuts and cherries.
Pour into well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Cut gently through batter to break air bubbles. Bake at 350° for 60 to 65 minutes.
Remove from oven and while still warm spread on top with butter and sprinkle with a mixture of cinnamon and sugar.

recipes.title: Cheese Crispies
steps: Combine seasonings with flour.
Let margarine soften, mix in cheese and flour.
If using an electric mixer, blend in flour on mixing speed.
Mix the Rice Krispies in by hand.
Place ball the size of marble on ungreased baking sheet and press with a fork (dipped in flour) to flatten.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove and let cool.
Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Harvard Beets
steps: Mix sugar and cornstarch; add vinegar and water from beets. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes.
Add beets and simmer 30 minutes.
When ready to serve, bring to a boil and add butter. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Mix sugar and butter.
Add eggs one at a time.
Add flour and milk, starting and ending with flour.
Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Summer Succotash
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. fresh corn, cut from cob
steps: Cook corn and lima beans in a small amount of boiling water for 12 minutes or until tender; drain and set aside.
Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon, reserving drippings in skillet.
Crumble bacon and set aside.
Saute chopped onion in bacon drippings until onion is tender; remove onion and set aside. Add flour to bacon drippings, stirring until smooth.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add tomatoes and rest of ingredients.
Heat through.

recipes.title: Nut Cups
steps: Mix flour, margarine and cream cheese and refrigerate.
Mix brown sugar, eggs, vanilla, salt and margarine.
Cook over low heat.
Watch closely as it burns easily.
Add walnuts.
Roll out dough 1/8-inch thick.
Cut with a scalloped cookie cutter.
Press into 1-inch muffin tin.
Drop 1 teaspoon of filling into each cup about 3/4 full.
They will swell.
Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Avoid overbrowning.

recipes.title: Gail'S Quiche Lorraine
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into pie crust.
Cook in 375° oven for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mile A Minute Cupcakes(1942 Recipe)
steps: Thoroughly cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs; beat well. Add flour, sifted with salt, baking powder, soda and cocoa alternately with milk and vanilla.
Add coffee; mix well.
Fill greased cupcake pans 2/3 full.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mississippi Mud Cake
steps: Cream sugar and oleo.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Sift flour, cocoa and salt.
Add sugar.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven and spread with Marshmallow Creme while hot.
Cool 30 minutes and ice.

recipes.title: Chewy Chocolate Cookies
ingredients: 6 cooking apples (golden Delicious are a good choice)
steps: Core the apples and peel them if you like.
(We prefer the added texture of the peels, but peeled apples look more sophisticated.)
Cut the apples crosswise into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Melt about 2 tablespoons of the butter in a skillet and add a single layer of apple slices.
Raise the heat and saute the slices, turning occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes. With a slotted spoon, transfer apples to a bowl.
Repeat with more butter and another batch of apples until all have been cooked.

recipes.title: Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 c. ham or other meat, chopped
steps: Cook rice as directed.
Set aside to drain.
Put veggies in skillet with small amount of oil.
Stir fry.
Add 3 tablespoons soy sauce.
Add rice.
Stir fry until hot.
Ready to eat.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Pie
steps: Mix 1 cup of flour, baking powder and butter; add egg and milk.
Mix.
Press into greased pie pan.
Arrange rhubarb in pie shell
Sprinkle with Jell-O.

recipes.title: Rolls With Gold Medal Flour
steps: Mix
all with flour.
May have to add a little more flour but make a soft dough.
Knead real good.
Put in a greased bowl.
Let rise until double in bulk, about
1 hour.
Work down and make into rolls.
Makes 1 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Lasagna
ingredients: 1 large can tomato puree (1 lb. 15 oz.)
1 bag frozen, chopped onions (12 to 16 oz.)
1 (8 oz.) pkg. Neufchatel or cream cheese
spices: plenty of garlic powder, parsley, oregano, basil, etc.
steps: Two days before using, make sauce:
Brown onions in bottom of a large Dutch oven.
Add meat and brown.
Stir occasionally to break it up well.
Add salt, pepper, lots of oregano, garlic powder, 3 cans of tomato paste and can of puree.
Add 1 teaspoon of sugar.
Cover.
Simmer 2 to 3 hours, stirring every 30 minutes or so and taste to season.
When done, put in a large airtight container.
Store in refrigerator at least 24 hours before using.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. pumpkin (canned solid pack; not pumpkin pie filling)
steps: Blend margarine, sugar and egg. Then add pumpkin and vanilla. Sift flour, cinnamon, baking powder, soda and salt. Add walnuts. Drop with spoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for almost 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Egg Dumplings
steps: Sift and measure the flour.
Cut the butter into the flour. Break the egg into a measuring cup, then add enough water to come up to the 3/4 cup line.
Add to the flour; mix lightly with a fork. Drop by tablespoonfuls over boiling meat and broth or into well-greased steamer placed over boiling water.
Cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until dumplings are tender.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Pound Cake
ingredients: 1/4 c. or so water (if dough gets too thick for mixer)
steps: Combine oil, sugar and eggs; beat at medium speed for 3 minutes.
Combine dry ingredients and add to mixture.
Fold in pecans and apples.
Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes, or until cake is done.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Dust apples, raisins and nuts with some of the flour; set aside.
Blend oil, sugar and slightly beaten eggs; set aside. Sift together flour, salt and soda; add to egg mixture and add vanilla.
Fold in coated apples, nuts and raisins; pour into a 10-inch greased tube pan.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheerios Nuggets
steps: Heat oven to 250°.
Grease two 9 x 13-inch pan.
Heat brown sugar, margarine, corn syrup and salt in a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly until bubbly around edges.
Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally for 2 minutes longer.
Remove from heat; stir in baking soda until foamy and light colored. Pour over cereal, peanuts and raisins in greased 4-quart bowl. Stir until mixture is coated.
Spread evenly in pans.
Bake 15 minutes.
Stir.
Let stand just until cool, about 10 minutes. Loosen mixture with metal spatula.
Let stand until firm, about 30 minutes.
Break into bite size pieces.
Makes about 10 cups of snack.

recipes.title: Cake That Won'T Last
ingredients: 8 oz. can crushed pineapple and juice
steps: Beat eggs and mix with flour, salt, cinnamon, soda, vanilla, nuts, sugar, oil, bananas (not mashed) and pineapple.
Do not beat.
Stir until blended.
Pour into greased and floured pan (9 x 13-inch).
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: St. Timothy'S Coffee Cake
steps: Cream together margarine and sugar.
Sift together, flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon.
Add nuts and raisins to dry ingredients.
Add eggs, sour cream and vanilla.
Mix well.
Bake in bundt pan at 350° for 1 hour.
Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon mixture on top before baking.
Sprinkle on bottom after baking.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Sift flour, spices, salt, baking powder, and soda together. Cream sugar and oil together while adding one egg at a time. Begin to add flour mixture, zucchini, apple sauce, pineapple, raisins, and nuts.
Bake at 350 degrees for one hour.
Makes three loaves. Really, really good!

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
steps: In a saucepan, make a roux with flour and butter.
Add mustard.
Lower heat and add one-half of the milk, stirring so as not to scald.
In a pot, cook pasta until it's half done.
Saute onion and add to roux mixture along with cheeses and rest of milk.

recipes.title: Hershey Bar Cake
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Blend well and add Hershey's syrup.
Mix together flour, soda and salt. Melt Hershey bars; alternately add buttermilk, Hershey bars and vanilla.
Bake in stem pan at 350° for one hour.

recipes.title: Baked Beans With Green Pepper And Carrots
steps: Wash beans, cover with water and cook until soft.
Drain, not too dry.
Add salt and bacon drippings.
Mix in baking dish the beans, brown sugar, onions, green pepper and grated carrots.
Add catsup.
Bake in 325° oven for one hour or until as dry as desired.

recipes.title: Corn Dogs
steps: Mix together until smooth. Dip hot dogs into mix and deep fry. Yields 8 to 10 corn dogs.

recipes.title: Unleavened Communion Bread
steps: Mix flour, Crisco, salt and sugar until like coarse cornmeal. Add cold water.
Roll as for pie dough, approximately 1/8-inch thick onto an ungreased cookie sheet.
Prick with a fork.
Cut into bite size pieces (1/4-inch squares) with a knife before baking.
Bake in 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until very light brown.

recipes.title: Shirley'S Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken and rice
steps: Cook first 4 ingredients.
Add all other ingredients and bake.

recipes.title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Cream together butter, shortening and sugars.
Add vanilla and eggs.
Sift flour, salt, soda and cocoa together.
Add to creamed mixture; mix until blended.
Add chocolate chips, coconut and nuts.
Bake on greased cookie sheet until just set, about 6 to 8 minutes at 325° to 350°.
Do not overbake.
They will look a little raw until cool.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. tenderloin tips, cut in 2-inch strips
1/4 lb. fresh mushrooms or small can
steps: Saute tips in butter; add flour and brown.
Add hot beef stock and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Reduce wine and vinegar to 1/2 and add to above.

recipes.title: Zucchini Carrot Cake
steps: Beat eggs and sugar until frothy.
Gradually beat in oil; add dry ingredients.
Beat at high speed 4 minutes.
Add carrots, zucchini, nuts and currants or raisins.
Pour in greased pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Fudge Oat Cake
steps: Pour water over oats and let stand 20 minutes.
Mix remaining ingredients and add cooled oats.
Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Bread Machine Buttermilk Wheat Bread
steps: In bread machine pan, place all ingredients in order given. Select "white bread" setting.
Bake according to bread machine directions.
Makes 1 medium loaf (16 slices).

recipes.title: Vegetarian Spaghetti Sauce
steps: Crush garlic and chop onion and brown in oil.
Add canned tomatoes and tomato sauce, mushrooms, salt, chopped squash (optional) and spices.
Bring to boil; simmer for at least 2 hours.
Good for weight watchers.
Serve over spaghetti.

recipes.title: Sweet Sour Green Beans
steps: Cook beans until crisp and tender (6 to 8 minutes). Drain. Plunge into ice water; drain.
Set aside. Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble.
Keep 2 tablespoons bacon drippings.
Stir in flour. Cook until bubbly.
Stir in water, vinegar and sugar. Heat to boiling and slightly thickened.
Add beans and toss occasionally. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and bacon.

recipes.title: Quick Mix Pepperoni Batter Bread
ingredients: 1/2 c. grated sharp or Cheddar cheese
steps: Set aside 1 cup flour.
Mix together remaining ingredients, including yeast, in a large bowl.
Stir in margarine and water into dry mixture.
Mix in only enough flour to make very thick batter. Cover; let rest 10 minutes.
Turn batter into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Cover.
Let rise in warm draft-free place until double in size, about 35 to 40 minutes.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes. Check for doneness.
Remove and cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Casserole
steps: Saute onions, green pepper and celery in oil.
Cook a few minutes.
Brown meat in Dutch oven.
Add onions, celery, green pepper, tomatoes, puree and seasonings.
Simmer for about an hour. Add mushrooms last 15 minutes.
Set off heat and add 1/2 grated cheese.
Stir.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake(Easy)
steps: Put egg in measuring cup and add milk to make one cup.
Mix all dry ingredients.
Add shortening and mix with pastry blender (or two knives) until like cornmeal.
Add egg and milk and put into greased pan.
Sprinkle sugar, nuts or chocolate chips and cinnamon.
Cut dough with knife like you would marble cake.
Add some sugar on top with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Opossum Pie
steps: Wash opossum inside and out and salt.
Heat lard in roasting pan.
Stir-fry garlic, onions and ginger.
Heat until starts to smoke.
Shake flour over opossum and brown in lard for two minutes.
Place opossum in roasting pan with paws crossed over chest, adding carrots, onions, potatoes and celery.
Add stock and sherry and cook at 325° for 2 hours.
Add peas.
Recover and heat 8 more minutes.
Best served with rice, turnip greens and corn bread.
Serves 8 to 12 or whoever you can get to eat it!

recipes.title: Oatmeal Apple Cookies
steps: Cream Crisco, brown sugar, egg, milk and vanilla on medium speed.
Combine flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, soda and salt.
Beat into creamed mixture at low speed until well blended.
Stir in oats. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 13 minutes.
Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet. Remove to cooling rack.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Peter Paul Mound Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs.
Sift flour, soda and cocoa and add alternately with buttermilk and flavoring.
Bake in 4 nine-inch greased and floured cake pans at 325° for 20 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Cloud Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Keep marshmallows frozen until ready to use (they thaw quickly).
Combine flour, cocoa and soda.
Set aside.
Combine sugars; blend in butter.
Add eggs and vanilla. Beat until light and fluffy.
Add flour mixture and chocolate chips.
Blend at low speed.
Batter will be stiff.
Gather 4 to 5 frozen marshmallows in your hand.
Cover with heaping teaspoonful of dough.
Wrap marshmallows in dough, making a 2 inch ball.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn And Sausage Soup
steps: Slice sausage and brown in heavy soup pot. Add onions and saute until tender. Stir in potatoes, water, salt, basil, pepper and parsley. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in corn and milk. Heat to a boil, but do not boil. Serve with a tossed salad and crusty bread. Makes 8 bowls.

recipes.title: Crazy Cake
steps: Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Soft Drop Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream sugar and margarine.
Add eggs, milk and vanilla; mix well.
Blend in flour, baking soda and baking powder.
Drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. Frost or sprinkle with sugar just before you put in oven.

recipes.title: Minnesota Wild Rice Soup
steps: Brown beef.
Add next nine ingredients and simmer 30 minutes. Add soup and water.
Stir and simmer 30 minutes.
Can be put in crock pot until ready to serve.

recipes.title: One Hour Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add buttermilk.
Add dry ingredients and knead 5 minutes.
Roll 1/4-inch.
Cut and place on greased pan.
Let rise 1 hour.
Bake at 425° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesy Scalloped Cabbage
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage, cut into small wedges
steps: Cook cabbage in small amount of water until tender; drain well.
Melt butter over low heat; add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick and bubbly.
Stir in spices.

recipes.title: Mississippi Pound Cake
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. each: almond, coconut and rum extract
steps: Cream butter and shortening.
Gradually add sugar.
Blend in about 1/2 of the flour and all baking powder.
Stir in milks and extracts.
Then blend in remaining flour.
Beat a short while until fluffy.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Grease and flour Bundt pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Let sit in Bundt pan 10 minutes, then turn over on cake plate.
When cool,
sprinkle powdered sugar lightly.
Then add fresh fruit to the plate.

recipes.title: Fudge Brownies
steps: Combine flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, salt and nuts.
Set aside; combine oil, eggs and vanilla and add to dry ingredients. Do not overmix.
Spread in 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Yields about 24 brownies.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Lentil Soup
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Cover and simmer 1 hour or until lentils are tender (1/2 hour in pressure cooker).
Take out ham bone.
Strip off bits of meat and return to soup.
Remove bay leaf.
Serve with 2 tablespoons vinegar on top.
Croutons may also be served with soup.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Green Pepper Steak
steps: Cut beef across the grain into thin strips, 1/8-inch thick. Combine soy sauce, garlic and ginger.
Add beef.
Toss and set aside while preparing vegetables.
Heat oil in large frying pan. Add beef and toss over high heat until browned. If beef is not tender, cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes over low heat.
Turn heat up and add vegetables.
Toss until vegetables are tender. Mix cornstarch with water.
Add to pan.
Stir and cook until thickened.
Add tomatoes and heat through.
Serve with cooked rice.

recipes.title: Texas Hash
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large skillet, cook and stir meat, onion and green pepper.
Drain off fat.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Heat thoroughly and pour into ungreased 2-quart casserole dish.
Cover and bake 1 hour.
Serve with salad for complete meal.

recipes.title: Castle Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) jar strained beef or veal baby food
steps: Mix and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Make into patties and fry. Put holes in burgers to cook evenly.

recipes.title: Harvard Beets
steps: Drain liquid from beets into saucepan.
Boil down to half. Shake together vinegar and flour.
Stir into boiling mixture.
Add sugar and salt; bring to boil.
Add beets and butter; heat through.

recipes.title: Black Bean And Rice Soup
steps: Place beans with liquid in blender; blend until smooth.
Pour into large saucepan.
Stir in water, oregano and garlic powder and bring to boil.
Stir in rice.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Serve with chopped onions if desired.

recipes.title: Cocoa Fudge Brownies
steps: Heat shortening and cocoa in saucepan until melted.
Stir in sugar and milk; bring to a boil.
Add beaten eggs and all dry ingredients.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Wait 5 minutes before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: German Apple Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together with spoon (no mixer).
Batter will be stiff.
Spread into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.
Serve with whipped cream, ice cream or cream cheese frosting.

recipes.title: Cranberry Oatmeal Square
steps: Mix 2nd mixture well and put half into a 7 x 11-inch pan; press firmly.
Pour in cranberry mixture and cool with remaining dry mixture.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Cheese Fritters
steps: In a medium bowl, beat the cottage cheese and egg together. Stir in the half and half, flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and nutmeg. Mix until just combined. Fill a deep pot to the 2-inch mark with oil. Heat to 375°F (190°C). Drop batter by rounded tablespoonfuls into the hot oil. Fry until golden brown on all sides, about 3 to 4 minutes. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Serve hot!

recipes.title: Snack Bars
ingredients: 2 bags (one 16 oz., one 10 oz.) large marshmallows
1 1/2 c. chocolate chips, mini M&M's or raisins (optional)
steps: In a very large bowl, combine the first five ingredients.
In a saucepan over low heat, cook and stir marshmallows and butter until marshmallows are melted.
Add honey and mix well.
Pour over cereal mixture; mix well.
Add chips, M&M's or raisins if desired. Pat two-thirds into a greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan and the remaining third into a 9-inch square pan.
Cool.
Yield:
4 to 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Rice And Chicken Almondine
steps: Saute almonds and onion in butter for 10 minutes.
Stir in flour.
Add bouillon and cream, stirring until thickened.
Add chicken and remaining ingredients.
Pour into casserole.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Grandma Brasch'S Molasses Cookies
steps: Dissolve baking soda in boiling water.
Blend together sugar, shortening and egg.
Add molasses; blend.
Carefully add water. Mix in spices (according to your taste).
Gradually add in flour until a soft dough.
Scoop tablespoon size balls and roll in sugar.
Place on greased cookie sheet and flatten slightly.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Cook Frosting
steps: Cook until thick the flour and milk.
Cream the butter, granulated sugar and vanilla.
Add both mixtures together and beat for 16 minutes.
Frost cake and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Budget Shrimp Creole
steps: Saute first 4 ingredients in oleo.
Remove from heat, stir in tomato sauce, water and seasonings.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in shrimp.
Heat to boiling.
Cover and cook 15 minutes.
Serve over hot rice.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Bean And Sausage Soup
steps: Pick through and rinse beans.
Place in a 4 quart pot and cover with at least 2 inches of water.
Bring to a boil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Cover, and let stand in the refrigerator overnight. Drain and rinse beans.
Place beans in crockpot with canned tomatoes, broth, wine, and vegetables.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours.
In a skillet, cook the sausage over medium heat until done.
Slice links into 1/2 inch pieces.
Add meat to the crockpot and cook another 30 to 60 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: In large mixing bowl, beat eggs and sugar.
Add oil, salt and flour.
Mix well.
Add vanilla, cinnamon, baking soda, apples and nuts.
Bake 1 hour or more at 350° to 375° in well greased tube pan.

recipes.title: Oyster Cracker Snack
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch buttermilk dressing
steps: Mix dressing and oil; add seasonings.
Pour over crackers.
Put in warm oven, 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Texas-Style Beans And Rice
ingredients: 1 (16 to 18 oz.) jar or can baked beans
1/4 c. diced or slivered red or sweet white onion
steps: Combine beans, tomatoes, picante sauce, beer and brown sugar in large saucepan.
Simmer uncovered 20 minutes.
Stir in rice and salt; heat through.
Sprinkle with onion and cilantro.

recipes.title: Vidalia Onion Seafood Casserole
steps: Saute onions, celery and green pepper in margarine.
Add pimento, cream of celery soup, milk and cream cheese.
Heat slowly until blended.
Add rice and shrimp; mix well.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Place crushed crackers on top the last 10 minutes of baking.
(Cover top of casserole with crumbs.)

recipes.title: Shoo-Fly Pie
steps: Mix until crumbs in a bowl.

recipes.title: Salted Pecans
steps: Coat pecans with melted margarine; sprinkle with salt.
Bake 20 minutes at 275°.
Cool on paper towels.

recipes.title: Pot Roast
steps: Dredge roast in flour.
Brown slowly on all sides in hot fat. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Add onions.
Mix remaining ingredients except mushrooms and add to roast.
Cover and cook slowly at 300° for 2 1/2 hours.
Then add mushrooms. Blend 2 tablespoons flour to thicken gravy.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Health Bread
steps: In medium bowl, stir flour, oats, baking powder, and salt.
In large bowl with mixer at medium speed, beat peanut butter and sugar until smooth.
Beat in egg.
Gradually add milk.
