With mixer on low, beat in dry ingredients until smooth.
Stir in raisins.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Bake 1 hour at 350° to 375°.
The last 15 minutes of baking, add crushed potato chips on top.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Combine cocoa, flour, cornstarch, sugar and salt in a saucepan.
Add egg yolks, butter and milk.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add vanilla and peanut butter.
Stir.
Cool and pour into baked pie shell.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Within an hour of serving, spread whipped cream over top.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Combine sweet potatoes, sugar, salt, eggs, margarine, milk and vanilla and pour into casserole dish.
Combine brown sugar, flour, pecans and margarine in a medium bowl and sprinkle over potatoes mixture. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Wayne'S Hush Puppies(For Large Gatherings)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. Aunt Jemima self-rising white corn meal
steps: Mix all ingredients well; drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Submerge, if possible, until brown.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Beginner'S Pie Crust
steps: Mix flour and salt together in bowl.
Cut in shortening with fork until mixture looks like corn meal.
Add water a little at a time.
Let set a few minutes.
Knead on floured surface and shape into pie shell.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Mix together 1 hour over low heat until thick.
When thick, remove from heat.
Add 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and vanilla extract.
Stir.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cookies
steps: Cream butter and cream cheese together.
Slowly add sugar, beating until fluffy.
Beat in egg yolk.
Add flour and vanilla and mix well.
Chill dough at least 1 hour.
Shape into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Gently press a cherry half or pecan half into each cookie.
Bake at 350° until bottom of cookies start to brown, 6 to 10 minutes.
Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Corn Custard
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Stir in eggs.
Scald milk and 2 tablespoons butter; add to corn mixture.
Pour into a greased casserole and bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Mix crumbs in 1 tablespoon butter and sprinkle on top.
Bake until browned.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Bread
steps: Beat eggs, brown sugar, oil and vanilla until thick and foamy. Stir in rhubarb and nuts.
Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and spices.
Add to the rhubarb mixture and stir until just blended.

recipes.title: Hungarian Rhapsody
ingredients: 8 breast of turkey cutlets (about 1 lb.), flattened
1 clove garlic, minced finely or put through garlic press
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet.
Over high heat, brown the cutlets briefly on both sides; do not overcook.
Reserve browned cutlets on a warmed platter.
In the same skillet over medium heat, saute chopped onion and garlic in the remaining olive oil until lightly browned, 6 to 8 minutes.
Stir in paprika and cook 2 minutes longer.
Blend in sour cream until just heated through.
Do not allow the mixture to boil!
Season with salt and pepper.
Remove from
heat.
Spoon the sauce over the cutlets; serve with boiled rice.

recipes.title: Honey Bun Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 325°.
Mix cake mix, oil, eggs and sour cream by hand.
Pour 1/2 of batter in cake pan (greased and floured). Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Pour remaining batter on top.
Swirl.
Bake for 40 minutes.
Ice.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Heat oven to 325°.
Generously grease bottoms only of 2 baking pans, 9 x 5 x 3-inches. Beat all ingredients on low speed, scraping bowl constantly for 1 minute.
Beat on medium speed for 1 minute.
Pour into pans.
Bake until wooden toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, about 1 hour.
Cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool completely before slicing.
Yields 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Fudge Pudding Cake
steps: Combine first 5 dry ingredients.
Add milk, vanilla and butter and beat until smooth.
Stir in the walnuts and spread the batter in a buttered 6 cup casserole.
Over the batter, sprinkle the mixture of the brown sugar and cocoa.
Over this, pour 1 1/2 cups boiling water.
Bake in a 350° oven for 50 minutes.
Do not attempt to turn out this cake.
The bottom is full of fudge sauce.
Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Shoo-Fly Pie
steps: Beat all together with mixer.
Makes one 9-inch pie.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Chili
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Spiced Sesame Seed Crescents
steps: Sift together flour, baking powder, mace and salt. Gradually stir sugar into softened butter. Beat in egg. Add flour mixture gradually, mixing after each addition. Let dough stand 30 minutes at room temperature. With fingers, on waxed paper, shape a rounded teaspoonful of dough at a time into a roll 2-inches long. Taper ends. Roll in lightly toasted sesame seed. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Curve ends to form crescents. Bake in a 375° oven 18 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned around the bottom. Cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Disgustingly Rich Brownies
steps: You will also need measuring cups and spoons, a bowl, an 8 or 9-inch square baking pan and an oven.
Preheat oven to 350°, then smear the inside of the pan with shortening.

recipes.title: Easy Pie Crust
steps: Put all ingredients in pie plate.
Mix well and press into shape, partially covering rim of plate.
Pinch dough into fluting for edge. Prick bottom and bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Burrito
steps: Lay tortilla on flat surface; spread evenly with peanut butter and raspberry spread.
Sprinkle with coconut, if desired.
Place banana on edge of tortilla; roll up to enclose.
Wrap loosely in paper towel.
Microwave on High for 35 seconds.

recipes.title: Plain Jane Cake
ingredients: 2 tsp. your choice flavoring (may be 2 different flavors)
steps: Mix butter, Crisco and sugar together until smooth.
Add eggs, one at a time, until they are mixed in well.
Gradually add milk and flour.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Croquettes
ingredients: 1 c. ground meat (chicken, beef or ham)
steps: Stir onion in melted butter until brown.
Blend in dry ingredients.
Add water and stir until thick.
Add meat and cook 2 minutes.
Break in egg.
Stir until mixed.
Chill.
To mold, dip in cracker meal, seasoned beaten eggs, then cracker meal again. Chill.
Roll in melted butter; cook on baking sheet at 350°
for one-half hour.
Serve with tomato or mushroom sauce.
Makes 6 regular size.

recipes.title: Nadine Krall'S Pork Chops And Rice
steps: Brown chops in frypan.
Pour onion soup mix and enough water over chops to keep chops covered.
Cook for 1/2 hour.
Add Minute rice and simmer.
For two people, use 1/2 cup rice.

recipes.title: Honey Buttermilk Rolls
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. sweet butter or margarine, softened
steps: Place all ingredients into bread machine pan in the order listed. Use "dough" setting to make dough. Remove when dough setting is done. Use margarine to coat hands for easy removal and roll shaping.

recipes.title: Persimmon Pudding
steps: Bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pancakes
steps: Combine egg, milk and oil.
Add sifted dry ingredients.
Beat until smooth.
Bake on ungreased griddle.
Pour batter from 1/4 cup measuring cup.
Makes 12 small cakes.

recipes.title: Corn Salad With Mesquite Turkey Breast
ingredients: 1 pkg. Healthy Choice mesquite flavored smoked turkey breast
steps: Toss together corn, celery, bell pepper, olives and cilantro in large bowl. Combine dressing and cumin in measuring cup and pour over corn mixture. Toss to coat. Line 4 plates with spinach leaves and place 1 cup corn salad in center of each plate. Fold 4 to 5 slices turkey into fourths and tuck around corn salad or cut turkey into strips and arrange strips around corn.

recipes.title: Diabetic'S Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 large can pineapple chunks in own juice
1 c. mixed fruit in own juice
3 Tbsp. lemon juice or orange juice
steps: Mix juice from pineapple, lemon juice and enough orange juice to make 1 cup.
Add sweetener.
Dissolve cornstarch in water and add to juice.
Boil and stir until thick.
Cool.
Combine canned fruit and fresh fruit.
Mix in fruit dressing; allow to stand to let flavors blend.
Makes 1 cup dressing.
Leftover will keep or double recipe.

recipes.title: Pineapple Shortcake
steps: Just dip canned biscuits in vegetable oil. Turn in granulated sugar and place on cookie sheet. Flatten each with bottom of glass dipped in sugar. Bake 10 minutes in preheated 425° oven, then on with the golden crushed pineapple and a topping of whipped cream. Garnish with a cherry.

recipes.title: Sausage Muffins
steps: Cook sausage and drain well.
Mix flour, corn meal, egg, milk and oil.
Add sausage.
Place in greased muffin pan and bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Caramel-Peanut Pie
steps: Place
cup
sugar in heavy skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sugar melts and forms a light brown syrup.
Reduce heat to low;
gradually add boiling water in
a slow
stream,
stirring
constantly
with a wire whisk. Remove from heat.

recipes.title: Sad Cake
steps: Mix ingredients; beat well.
Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake in 350° oven.
Cake is done when it falls in middle.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lace Cookies
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Pour melted butter over and stir.
Add beaten egg and vanilla.
Drop by 1/4 teaspoon onto aluminum foil on cookie sheet, leaving lots of room in between.
Bake in a 350° oven for 8 minutes.
Let cookies cool on foil before peeling off. Use new foil for each sheet of cookies.
Makes 7 dozen.

recipes.title: Homemade White Bread
steps: Heat 4 cups water to 110°; use 3/4 cup of the water and dissolve yeast and 3/4 teaspoon regular sugar.
Stir in flour, Sweet 'N Low, salt, pepper and Crisco.

recipes.title: Bacon-N-Eggs
steps: Cut hard-boiled eggs in half and remove yolks.
Mix with mayonnaise, salt, pepper and crumbled bacon.
Put mixture back into eggs and serve.
Kids love them.
Serve for breakfast with toast.

recipes.title: New England Blueberry Muffins
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 c. fresh or frozen drained blueberries
steps: Beat together the sugar and butter.
Add eggs and milk.
Add dry ingredients and beat for 1 minute.
Fold in blueberries.

recipes.title: Scotch Shortbread
steps: Sift flour, measure, add salt and sift again.
Cream butter, gradually add confectioners sugar and beat until light.
Combine dry ingredients and creamed mixture.
Blend thoroughly.
Put dough in 8 x 8-inch pan and bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut in squares before completely cool.

recipes.title: Tea Tarts
steps: Soak yeast in water until dissolved.
Mix dry ingredients and shortening as for pie crust.
Combine everything as for pie crust. Combine everything just until blended and chill for several hours or overnight.
Roll on sugared board 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick.
Cut in squares.
Put spoon of jam on center of square and fold three cornered.
Press edges together.
Place on pans and let raise 30 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Corinne'S Famous Pea Salad
steps: Place 1/2 head of lettuce on bottom of bowl.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and sugar.
Layer eggs atop lettuce in bowl.
Add more salt.
Layer as follows:
Peas, remaining lettuce, bacon and Swiss cheese.
Spread mayonnaise over top, sealing to edge of bowl.
Cover and chill 24 hours.
Toss before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
steps: Flatten chicken breasts; sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Add ham and a slice of cheese to breast and fold over.
Secure with long toothpicks.
Coat with flour.
In a large skillet, add 2 tablespoons butter.
Cook about 4 minutes on each side.
Melt remaining butter in skillet.
Add mushrooms and onion; saute.
Add water, chicken bouillon, parsley, and chives.
Bring to a boil. Return chicken to sauce.
Lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Bring sauce to boil again and stir in heavy cream.
Cook on low heat until sauce thickens slightly.
Pour sauce over chicken to serve.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sunflower Seed Cookies
steps: Cream sugars, shortening and eggs. Add water and vanilla. Add remaining ingredients. Drop on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes about 120.

recipes.title: Mrs. Fields Cookies
steps: *Put small amount into blender until it turns to powder. Measure first, then blend.

recipes.title: Texas Hash
steps: Cook ground beef in skillet.
Add onions and green pepper; saute.
Add other ingredients.
Put in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Apple Kuchen
ingredients: 6 to 8 medium apples, peeled and sliced
steps: Mix buttermilk baking mix, milk, sugar and eggs together and spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Arrange apple slices evenly over the top.
Drizzle apples with melted butter.
Stir sugar and cinnamon together and sprinkle over all.
Drizzle with cream.
Bake in preheated 350°
oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Wonderful served still warm.
Scoop out with a large spoon to serve.

recipes.title: Hungarian Coffee Cake
steps: Crumble brown sugar, butter and flour together like pie dough. Reserve 1 cup for topping.
Mix together by hand the beaten eggs and sour cream.
Mix soda, salt and vanilla with flour mixture. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Crumble on reserved topping. Bake at 350°
for 40 minutes.
Check at 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Fruit Cobbler
steps: Melt butter in casserole dish in microwave. In separate container, mix together flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and milk. Pour this mixture over melted butter in casserole dish. Heat berries through. Pour over mixture. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix cocoa, sugar, flour, salt and milk in top of double boiler.
Cook until mixture begins to thicken.
Add a little of the mixture to egg yolks.
Then add to mixture and cook about 3 minutes longer.
Remove from heat.
Add butter and vanilla.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Top with meringue.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
ingredients: 1/3 c. sugar (more if apples are tart)
steps: Heap sliced apples in pie plate; add lemon juice and sugar. Add cinnamon as desired.
Crumble brown sugar, butter, flour and salt on top.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Mix together oil and sugar.
Add eggs.
Sift dry ingredients. Blend into first mixture.
Add carrots and nuts.
Grease and flour 2 (10-inch) pans.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
When cool, ice with cream cheese frosting.

recipes.title: Blonde Brownies
steps: Mix together all ingredients, except chocolate chips.
Place chocolate chips on top before baking.
Bake in cake pan for 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Spicy Pecans
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in deep Dutch oven pan. Cook until soft. (Boil at 232°.) Add pecans and stir until coated. Spread and separate with fork; cool completely. Store in tin box.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar; then mix with applesauce.
Add sifted dry ingredients, raisins and nuts.
Beat and pour into buttered, floured loaf pan.
Bake slowly 1 1/4 hours at 325°.
Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Italian Cookies
steps: Beat eggs well.
Add sugar and beat.
Add melted shortening and juice.
Mix well.
Add salt, baking powder, flour and mix until smooth and easy to handle.
Make into different shapes. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Decorate with colored sugar or frosting.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Melt the butter; pour over the dry ingredients.
Mix until crumbly.
Spread over 1 can of apple pie filling.
Bake until brown at 325°.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Pour sugar over chopped apples; let set 10 minutes.
Mix eggs and shortening.
Add dry ingredients, raisins and nuts.
Stir in apple mixture.
Batter is stiff.
Bake in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan at 375° for 50 minutes.
Needs no frosting.
Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Polo Star Candy
steps: Melt the almond bark and peanut butter. Remove from heat. Stir in peanuts, rice krispies and marshmallows. Stir until well coated and drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookie Cheesecake
ingredients: 4 (8 oz. each) pkg. cream cheese, cut into chunks
steps: In a food processor, whirl 1/2 package of the cookies, including filling, until they form fine crumbs; mix in butter. Scoop crumbs into a 9-inch cheesecake pan with removable bottom and press crumbs evenly over bottom of pan and about 1/2-inch up sides. Chill crust to firm, about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Boil macaroni in salted water 6 minutes. Drain and rinse well to remove starch.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Mauna Loa Muffins(Third Place Winner Of 1992 Mauna Loa Contest)
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Spray muffin
tins
with cooking spray. In
large
bowl,	beat milk, oil and
egg.
Blend
in remaining ingredients until flour is just
moistened.
Fill in muffin cups 3/4 full;
sprinkle with sugar.
Bake
until
tops are browned, for 15 to 18 minutes.
Makes 10 to 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Eggless Spice Cake
steps: Sift all
ingredients.
Place
in
bowl and add 1/2 cup melted shortening,
cups water and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Mix well and bake
in
layers in a moderate oven for 30 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
steps: Mix well and serve with fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Pasta With Broccoli Di Rape And Sausage
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. olive oil or vegetable oil
1 lb. medium pasta shells or any small size pasta of choice
steps: Remove the long stems and tough outer leaves from the Broccoli di Rape.
Keep florets and small leaves, cut up, place in colander and wash several times.
Pour oil into pan on medium heat.
Lightly crush garlic, place in heated oil and allow to turn golden, then remove garlic if you wish.
Remove casing from sausage, place meat in pan and cook thoroughly, breaking the pieces of meat apart as they continue to cook.
If you still have not removed the garlic, do so now.
Drain all but 1 tablespoon oil from pan; add Broccoli di Rape to pan and mix with cooked sausage.
Keep mixing together, add your broth, mix and cook for approximately 5 minutes.
Mix flour and butter together to form a roux and stir into your mixture.
Cook approximately 5 minutes more until sauce thickens. Serve over pasta and add the grated Italian cheese of choice.

recipes.title: Three Layer Pie
steps: Combine ingredients and bake
in
a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350°.
Cool.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake at 300° for about 1 hour and 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Healthy Sloppy Joes
steps: Brown sirloin with onion.
Add other ingredients.
Simmer 15 minutes or so.
Serve open-faced on bread of choice.

recipes.title: Tortilla Pinwheels
ingredients: 7 to 10 flour tortillas (will need less if large size used)
steps: Drain chilies and olives.
In mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except tortillas.
Spread mixture onto tortillas and roll up jelly roll fashion.
Cover with damp paper towel and plastic wrap to prevent drying out.
Chill for several hours.
To serve, slice tortillas into 1-inch segments.
Serve with salsa for dipping.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
steps: Cut Crisco and flour together.
Mix in salt.
Gently mix in ice water with hands.
Roll out for pie.

recipes.title: Florentine Lasagna Roll-Ups
ingredients: 2 (10 oz. each) pkg. frozen spinach, thawed and well drained
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook lasagna noodles.
Cool in large bowl of cold water; set aside.
Saute onions in 2 tablespoons butter until tender.

recipes.title: Great Pheasant Or Partridge
steps: Do not thicken!
Pour over meat and bake for 2 hours on low. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Apple Dumplings
steps: Combine sugar, water, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Bring to a boil and add oleo.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Cut in shortening.
Add milk, all at once.
Stir until flour is moistened.

recipes.title: Green Beans Supreme
steps: Cook green beans; drain.
Cook onion and parsley in butter until onion is tender.
Blend in flour, lemon peel, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper.
Add milk, cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Stir in sour cream and cooked beans; heat until just bubbly.
Spoon into 1-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Melt the remaining butter; toss with bread crumbs and sprinkle over beans.
Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat until cheese melts and crumbs brown, 1 to 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Combine corn, eggs and salt.
Alternate layers of corn mixture and crumbs in greased baking dish.
Dot with butter on each layer. Pour in milk.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Custard Pie
steps: Pour into pie plate (lined), then layer after mixing ingredients well together.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes to set the rim.
Reduce heat to 325° and continue baking for thirty minutes or until custard is set.
Sprinkle a little grated coconut on top when removed from the oven.

recipes.title: Rice-Broccoli Casserole
steps: Saute celery and onion in butter or margarine.
Cook broccoli and drain.
Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Cake
steps: Cream sugar and shortening; add egg yolks.
Sift flour and soda together; add alternately with buttermilk.
Add vanilla, coconut and chopped nuts.
Fold in beaten egg whites.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Aunt Minnie'S Eggs
steps: Cut bacon into small pieces (or crumble sausage into small pieces); fry.
When meat is browned, add bell pepper and onion. Cook until onion starts to clear.
Beat eggs with milk.
Add egg mixture to meat and vegetables.
Top with cheese and cover.

recipes.title: Boston Brown Bread
steps: Put water and raisins in large pan; boil for 5 minutes (cool).
While still warm, add all other ingredients.
Mix together well.
Add nuts last.
Grease cans fully to top.
Half fill them.
Bake
until well brown in 350° oven for 45 to 60 minutes.
Cool for short time.
While still warm, tip out of can on wax paper.
(Use 3 or 4 No. 2 cans, vegetable or fruit.)

recipes.title: Applesauce Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar together until mixture is light and fluffy.
Add egg, raisins, nuts and applesauce and mix together thoroughly.
Sift all the dry ingredients together 3 times.
Add to the creamed mixture and blend thoroughly.
Drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake in moderate oven for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
steps: Sift dry ingredients together in large mixing bowl; add pecans and mix.
Make a well in the center.
Mix the remaining ingredients.
Pour into well.
Stir enough to dampen all ingredients and then pour into two greased loaf pans.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: bread crumbs or crumbled potato chips
steps: In a bowl mix all ingredients together except the crumbs or chips and put into refrigerator for 8 to 24 hours before serving time.
In a baking dish, a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole, put ingredients and top with crumbled chips or bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° uncovered.

recipes.title: Blond Brownies
steps: Cream butter and brown sugar.
Add beaten egg and then dry ingredients.
Add nuts and chocolate bits last.
Bake in a square pan, 8 x 8-inch.
Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: South Of The Border Salad
ingredients: 1 c. shredded Jack or Cheddar cheese
chopped tomatoes, green pepper and avocado to garnish
steps: Cook meats, onion and garlic until meat is browned and onion tender.
Stir in flour, tomato sauce, undrained tomatoes, chilies and chili powder.
Cook and stir until thickened.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 or 2 cans cream of mushroom soup
steps: Cook chicken until tender; remove from bones and cut into bite size pieces.
Save broth.
Fry bacon until crisp.
Break into small pieces.
Saute onions and celery in bacon fat.
Add tomatoes, soup, drained olives, chicken and bacon.
Cook spaghetti in broth and add to chicken mixture.
Salt and pepper to taste; mix well.
Cover with grated cheese.
May use two 9 x 9-inch casseroles or one 3-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

recipes.title: Crawfish Stew
ingredients: 1 c. each: chopped onions and celery
1 jalapeno pepper, seeded, deveined and diced
1 medium red or green pepper, chopped
steps: Melt butter in a large heavy pot (iron preferred).
Blend flour and stir over medium-low heat until roux is dark brown.
Add onions, celery and jalapeno pepper; cook until tender and crisp. Stir in water, tomatoes, crawfish and seasonings. Simmer over medium heat 15 minutes.
Add okra, pepper and parsley.
Simmer until tender-crisp, about 10 minutes.
Stir in file powder.
Ladle stew into soup bowls.
Top each serving with 1/2 cup fluffy rice. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fudge Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Boil until soft ball stage the cocoa, sugar, butter and milk. Remove from heat.
Immediately stir in the vanilla, oats and nuts. Drop on waxed paper by spoonfuls; ready to eat when cool (about 15 minutes).

recipes.title: The Best Snickerdoodles
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Mix together thoroughly the shortening, sugar and eggs.
Sift together the next 4 ingredients and stir into creamed mixture.
Chill dough.

recipes.title: Apple Nut Squares
steps: Combine eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla.
Sift dry ingredients. Then add to egg mixture and mix well.
Fold in apples and nuts. Bake at 325° for 1 hour in a slightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pan Cookie
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In large bowl mix margarine, sugars, vanilla and eggs with mixer.
Gradually add flour until well blended.
Stir in chips and nuts.
Spread in greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.
(Check after 30 minutes.)
Cool, then cut into squares.

recipes.title: Banana Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix all ingredients except flour. Gradually add flour, stirring lightly.
Pour into muffin cup inserts in muffin pans.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Yield: 2 dozen muffins.

recipes.title: Scones(Recipe From Ireland, 100 Years Old)
steps: Mix all ingredients together with pastry blender.
Drop by big spoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake 20 minutes at 400°.
Makes 6 to 8 scones.
Serve warm with jam, jelly or honey.
Quick, easy and good.
They freeze well.
Heat in microwave a few seconds.

recipes.title: Rice And Beef Porcupines
steps: Combine all ingredients, form into small balls.
Brown lightly in oil.
Drain off excess.
Add tomato sauce and water.
Cover tightly.
Simmer for 45 to 50 minutes, until rice is done.

recipes.title: Chicken Wreath
ingredients: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded colby jack cheese
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix all ingredients except crescent rolls. Arrange crescent rolls in a circle with the bases overlapping in the middle and the pointed ends outward. Put the mixture in the base part and fold the points inward. Bake about 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. You can substitute boiled, cut up chicken and slivered almonds for canned chicken and water chestnuts.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
steps: Mix together first 5 ingredients and put in buttered dish. Salt and pepper one side of chicken and put seasoning salt on the other side.
Stand breast up in dish over rice and soup.
Melt 1 stick of butter and pour over top of chicken.
Bake for 2 hours at 275°.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower (1 lb.), broken into flowerets
3 tsp. instant chicken bouillon in 3 c. water or 3 c. chicken broth
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in large saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Simmer on reduce heat for 20 minutes or until tender.
Melt butter in small pan.
Add flour, salt and pepper; blend.
Add milk, stirring until mixture boils.
Add cheese and cook until cheese melts.
Stir cheese sauce into vegetable mixture.
Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Rich Loaf Bread
steps: Sift flour before measuring.
Scald milk.
Add sugar, salt and shortening.
Cool to lukewarm.
Add yeast and beaten eggs.
Add half of the flour and beat 3 minutes.
Add rest of flour, half a cup at a time, and stir after each addition.
Knead.
Shape.
Allow to rise until light and bake.

recipes.title: Wild Rice And Mushrooms
steps: Saute onion slowly in butter.
Smooth in flour and brown.
Add bouillon cube dissolved in boiling water and juice from can of mushrooms.
Let simmer for about 5 minutes.
Stir in mushrooms and cook until heated through.
Serve over wild rice.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Apple Muffins
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients and set aside.
Mix eggs, pumpkin and oil.
Stir into dry ingredients to moisten.
Stir in apples and other fruit.
Fill muffin pans 3/4 full.
Grease pans or use paper holders.
Sprinkle topping on each muffin.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Put over batter; then put rest of batter on top of apple mixture.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Ham And Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. pasta bows (or other small pasta), cooked and drained
1 lb. fully cooked smoked ham, cut into julienne strips
1 small green bell pepper, chopped (about 1/2 c.)
steps: Gently	toss ingredients together.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge Upside-Down Cake
steps: Cream 3/4 cup sugar with 2 tablespoons butter.
Stir in milk. Sift flour, 2 tablespoons cocoa, baking powder and salt together. Add sifted ingredients to the creamed mixture and mix until smooth.
Add chopped walnuts and spread in a buttered 9-inch pan. Mix well 1/2 cup sugar, brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa.
Sprinkle over the batter.
Pour boiling water over the top and bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Doughnuts
steps: Cream sugar with shortening.
Add eggs, unbeaten.
Add vanilla. Add sifted dry ingredients alternating with milk to which baking soda has been added.
Roll on floured board.
Cut and fry in hot, deep fat.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Homemade Biscuits
steps: Combine all ingredients, form
a
ball	and knead until smooth.
Pat out dough and cut out biscuits.
Bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes or until
golden brown.
Makes about 10 large biscuits or more smaller ones.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cookies
ingredients: 1 can (approximately 9 oz.) crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Mix shortening, sugar
and
egg
well (will look sour). Blend flour, soda,
salt and nutmeg.
Mix all together.
Chill 1 hour or longer.
Drop
by
rounded teaspoon approximately 2 inches apart on
lightly
greased
baking sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400°. Makes approximately 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Pineapple Burgers
steps: Set oven at broil and/or 550°.
Shape meat into 8 thin patties; sprinkle with salt.
Place pineapple slice on each of 4 patties. Top with remaining patties and press edges together to seal.
Place patties on rack in broiler pan.
Broil with tops 4-inches from heat until brown, 3 to 5 minutes.
Mix brown sugar, ketchup and mustard. Turn patties.
Spoon mixture on patties and broil until desired doneness, 3 to 5 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Syrup Tea Cakes
steps: Roll 1/4 inch thick.
Cut into whatever shape you choose. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Company Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. 4 oz. canned crushed pineapple, drained (save juice)
steps: Mix Jell-O and hot water; cool.
When partially set, add pineapple, marshmallows and bananas.
Chill to set in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Cream the butter.
Add Crisco, milk and eggs; blend.
Add flour, salt, baking powder and sugar; beat well with mixer 2 to 3 minutes.
Pour into well-greased and floured cake pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour, then at 275° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Sour Milk Cookies
steps: Mix together and bake.
Cookies are very good and moist.

recipes.title: Sausage Quiche
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Fully cook sausage and drain well.
Mix sausage, onions, cheese and flour.
Beat eggs and milk; pour over the sausage mixture.
Mix all well and pour into pie shell.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, washed, dried and torn into small pieces
4 strips crisp bacon, cooked and crumbled
steps: Layer the first 5 ingredients in order given.
Top with mayonnaise, bacon and cheese.
Garnish with tomato wedges and cucumber slices. Refrigerate at least 6 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Broccoli Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients together (except fried onions).
Place in 9 x 13-inch pan, which has been sprayed with Pam.
Bake for 60 minutes, covered.
Uncover and sprinkle with fried onions.
Bake for additional 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Peach Crisp
ingredients: 1 (29 oz.) can sliced peaches, well drained
steps: Arrange peaches in an 8 x 8-inch pan.
In a small bowl, combine oats, sugar, flour and spices. Cut in butter until coarse crumbs form. Sprinkle over peaches. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm with cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Cherry Nut Icing For Banana Nut Cake
steps: Cook
the
sugar,
milk and Karo until soft ball stage. Add dates, cherries, pecans, butter and vanilla.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Raisin Pie
steps: Soak raisins in hot water for 10 minutes; drain.
Mix the flour with sugar.
Add beaten egg yolks.
Cream together and add cream and raisins.
Cook over low heat, stirring until thick. Cool and add vanilla.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Make meringue from egg whites and bake until nicely browned.

recipes.title: Rich Waffles
steps: Mix dry ingredients in mixer bowl.
Add buttermilk, margarine and eggs.
Mix well and beat at medium speed for 2 to 3 minutes. Bake in heated waffle iron.

recipes.title: Cloud Biscuits
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Cut in Crisco like coarse crumbs.
Combine egg and milk.
Add to flour mixture.
Turn out on lightly floured board.
Knead gently with heel of hand 20 strokes. Roll to 3/4-inch thickness.
Cut and place on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake in a 425° oven for 10 to 14 minutes or until light brown.
Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Mike'S Pork Chop Casserole
steps: Brown pork in oil and set aside.
Saute celery and onion in pork juices until limp.

recipes.title: Spicy Zucchini Bars
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch rectangular pan. Mix brown sugar, margarine, eggs and vanilla in large bowl.
Stir in flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves.
Stir in zucchini and raisins.
Spread in pan.
Bake 25 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean; cool.
Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.
Cut into 2 x 1 1/2-inch bars. Refrigerate any remaining bars.
Makes 32 bars.

recipes.title: Fortune Cookies
steps: In a bowl mix flour, sugar, cornstarch and salt.
Add cooking oil and add white; stir until smooth.
Add water and mix well. Make one cookie at a time.
Pour 1 tablespoon of the batter on a greased skillet.
Spread into a circle.
Cook 4 minutes on one side and 1 minute on the other at low temperature.
Working quickly, put a message in the cookie.
Fold in half and in half again.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
steps: Cream sugar, margarine and eggs.
Mix flour, powdered sugar and salt.
Then mix slowly together.
Roll into balls (size of walnuts).
Roll in mixture of sugar and cinnamon.
Place 2 1/2-inches apart on ungreased sheet.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Mix all together and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup water to beans and top with bacon strips before cooking.

recipes.title: Vienna Torte
steps: Beat egg yolks until lemon colored.
Add sugar; beat well. Add flour, salt and vanilla.
Beat egg whites until frothy.
Add cream of tartar and beat until very stiff.
Add egg yolk mixture to whites, folding carefully.
Pour into large ungreased angel food pan.
Bake 1 hour at 300°.

recipes.title: Kim'S Ham And Hash Brown Omelet
ingredients: 4 thin slices ham, cut in pieces
steps: Cook bacon until crisp; crumble.
Cook ham; crumble.
Add potatoes, onion and pepper to skillet and cook until brown and crisp.
Blend eggs and milk; pour over potatoes.
Top with cheese, bacon and ham.
Cover and cook at low temperature for 10 minutes. Serve in 4 wedges.

recipes.title: Reese Cookies
steps: Mix all top 4 ingredients together real good. Make into small balls and press 1 Kiss in each.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake 5 minutes in a 350° oven.
Yields 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
ingredients: 4 c. peeled and sliced baking apples
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Arrange apples in pan.
Mix remaining ingredients with fork. Sprinkle over apples.
Bake until apples are tender and topping is golden brown.
Serve with cream, Dream Whip or ice cream.

recipes.title: Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 2 lb. stew beef, cut into small pieces
1/2 c. Burgundy or other red wine
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine first five ingredients in a Dutch oven or covered baking dish and bake 1 1/2 hours.
Serve over cooked noodles.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken
steps: Place rice on bottom of oblong pan.
Arrange chicken parts on top of rice. Sprinkle onion soup mix over chicken.
Spread mushroom soup over the soup mix.
Pour in water and bake, covered, for 1 hour at 350°.
Uncover and bake another 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 can small green peas, drain 1/2 juice off (do not cook)
steps: Mix all ingredients well and serve.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
steps: Blend butter, sugar, flour and salt.
Add eggs; beat well. Stir in corn and bake for 1 hour in 325° oven in a greased casserole dish.

recipes.title: Snicker Cake
ingredients: 1 German chocolate cake mix with pudding
steps: Mix cake mix according to directions on box.
Pour half of batter into greased pan (no flour).
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 lb. round steak, cut in finger strips
steps: Brown meat.
Add salt, mustard, butter, onion, pepper and one cup of water.
Pressure cook 10 to 12 minutes.
Make thickening of 2 tablespoons of flour and water.
Stir into cooked meat.
Add mushrooms, simmer until thickened.
Add sour cream.
Serve over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (8 oz.) pkg. herb seasoned stuffing mix
steps: In saucepan, cook sliced squash and chopped onion in boiling salted water for 5 minutes.
Drain.
Combine soup and sour cream. Stir in shredded carrots.
Fold in drained squash and onion. Combine stuffing mix and butter or margarine.
Spread half of stuffing mixture in bottom of 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon vegetable mixture atop.
Sprinkle remaining stuffing over vegetables.
Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Dice in apples and add nuts.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour in Bundt pan or two 8 x 8-inch pans.

recipes.title: Hickory Nut Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar in large mixing bowl until light.
Add egg, mixing well.
Stir in flour until well combined.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Shape dough into 2 long rolls; wrap each roll in waxed paper.
Chill several hours.
Slice rolls into 1/4-inch slices and place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Cream sugar and oil.
Beat eggs and add to sugar/oil with flour, salt, soda and cinnamon.
Stir in carrots and nuts.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan
at 300° for 45 minutes or in layer pans at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
steps: Melt butter in a 4-quart Dutch oven.
Slowly cook onions in butter until lightly browned.
Add bouillon cubes and water to onions.
Cover and simmer 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Add Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper to soup; stir.
When serving soup, place a thin slice of French bread into the bottom of the bowl (must be able to go into the oven).
Ladle soup into bowls; top with layer of shredded cheese.
Place under broiler until cheese melts.
Serve at once.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken Wings
steps: Combine ingredients (first seven) and rub on chicken wings. Let stand for 15 minutes.
Saute wings in oil and butter until lightly browned.
Drain excess fat.
Add garlic, jalapeno and beer and simmer until liquid has turned to a glaze.

recipes.title: Porcupine Balls
steps: Combine the preceding and shape into balls.
Place in roaster with 1 can tomato soup and 1 can tomato sauce well blended.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or longer.

recipes.title: Oven Bag Chicken Supreme
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken soup
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients except chicken. Dust inside of large oven bag with flour and lay bag inside oblong baking pan.
Arrange chicken, cavity side up, in a single layer in bag, spooning mixture evenly over top.
Tie bag; pierce top with 2 to 3 small slits.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Nut Balls
steps: Blend shortening, butter, salt, sugar and vanilla.
Add flour and nuts.
Place in refrigerator for about 1 hour.
Place balls of dough on slightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 325°.
Sift on powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pizza
steps: Mix.
Pat in an 8 x 11-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool.

recipes.title: Diabetic Date Nut Cake
steps: Cream the butter, egg, sweetener and vanilla.
Add applesauce; mix well.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Stir in dates and nuts. Add to first mixture.
Mix by beating at medium speed for several minutes.
Turn into buttered loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: English Muffin Loaf
steps: Mix together yeast, flour, sugar, salt and soda.
Warm to 120° milk and water.
Mix milk and water into the dry ingredients.
Add enough of 1 cup flour to make a stiff batter.
Grease a loaf pan and sprinkle with corn meal.
Put dough into pan.
Let rise to double in size.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 25 minutes (golden top).

recipes.title: Christmas Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix shortening, sugar and vanilla real good.
Add 1 egg to sugar mixture.
Beat until light and fluffy.
Stir in 4 teaspoons milk.
Mix flour and baking powder, then add to liquid mixture. Put in refrigerator for
1 hour.
Then roll out thin and cut into shapes.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes at 375°.
Frost and decorate.

recipes.title: Chicken Marengo
ingredients: 3 lb. chicken parts, skinned and boned (if desired)
steps: Pierce sausages; simmer in water to cover for 15 minutes. Drain.
Brown sausages in Pam sprayed pot.
Remove and brown chicken pieces in pot.
Spray again if needed.
Remove meat and cook onions until tender, stirring frequently.
Do not brown onions.

recipes.title: Oriental Chicken
ingredients: 1 clove garlic, crushed or chopped fine
steps: *Can omit m.s.g. if desired.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Casserole Breakfast
steps: Dot peaches with 2 tablespoons butter.
Sprinkle lemon juice and cinnamon over peaches.
Sift flour, salt and baking soda together and mix oats into mixture.
Add brown sugar to margarine. Place peaches in bottom of 9 x 12-inch Pyrex baking dish. Combine flour-oats and margarine-sugar mixtures and spread over peaches.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Double Decadence Chocolate Chip Brownies
ingredients: 2/3 c. (1 stick, 3 Tbsp.) margarine or butter, softened
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Beat sugar, margarine, eggs and vanilla until smooth.
Add 1 cup chips, melted*; mix well.
Add flour, oats, baking powder, remaining cup of chips and the nuts, mixing well.
Spread into prepared pan.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until brownies pull away from sides of pan.
Cool completely.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar, if desired.
Cut into bars.
Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
ingredients: 1 3/8 oz. envelope dry onion soup mix
1 (10 oz.) jar apricot or guava preserves
steps: Combine Italian dressing, dry onion soup mix and apricot or guava preserves.
Pour over chicken thighs which have been placed in a large shallow baking dish.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350° and baste occasionally with pan drippings.
Serve hot with rice and sweet and sour sauce.

recipes.title: Sausage And Apple Stuffing
ingredients: 8 c. cubed French or Italian bread (day old or oven dried)
1 tsp. dried sage (or 1 Tbsp. fresh, chopped)
steps: Place bread cubes in a large bowl and set aside.
In a medium size skillet over medium heat, saute sausage until well browned, about 10 minutes.
Transfer sausage to paper towels to drain and discard drippings.
In same skillet, melt butter.
Add onion; saute until soft but not brown.
Stir in stock, apples and raisins; bring to a boil.
Pour over bread cubes and mix in sausage, salt and sage.
(Makes approximately 10 cups).
Great for light or dark poultry dishes.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, flavorings and salt. Make paste of cocoa and food coloring.
Add to first mixture. Alternately add flour and buttermilk.
Mix soda and vinegar in small bowl; add to batter.
Blend.
Bake at 350° in three 9 or 10-inch pans for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Orange Bread
steps: Combine egg, orange juice and salad oil.
Combine dry ingredients plus cranberries and nuts.
Stir juice mixture into dry mixture, stirring just until moistened.
Bake in greased 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan at 350° for 50 minutes or until tests done. Remove from pan and cool.

recipes.title: Forgotten Chicken And Rice
ingredients: 1 c. raw rice, mixed with 1/2 pkg. dry onion soup
1 can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
steps: Put rice mixed with onion soup and mushrooms in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cut up chicken; salt and pepper the pieces and place on top of rice mixture.
Mix cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup with 2 1/2 cans water.
Pour over chicken on rice.
Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Irish Potato Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add potatoes, extracts and spices. Mix well.
Add milk.
Combine flour, soda and cocoa.
Add the creamed mixtures.
Add well beaten eggs.
Dredge nuts and raisins with 1/4 cup flour; add to batter.
Pour into a greased 10-inch tube pan and bake at 300° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Couple'S Club Delight
ingredients: 3 c. milk (1 1/2 c. per pkg. pudding)
steps: Mix together nuts, flour and oleo; spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Puffs
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Shape into ball and roll into flour.
Cook in hot oil (360°) until brown, about 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Nut Burgers
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Roll into meat balls.
Roll in a little bread crumbs.
Bake 30 minutes at 325° or can be fried.
Can be used with spaghetti.

recipes.title: Party Mix
steps: Melt butter and add all salts.
Mix first 7 ingredients together, pour butter and salt mixture with Worcestershire sauce. Put in oven at 200° for 1 1/2 hours.
Drain on paper towel.

recipes.title: "You Won'T Believe This" Cornbread Stuffing
ingredients: 2 loaves coarse grain whole wheat bread (2 or 3 days old), diced or cubed
steps: Put chicken broth in heavy saucepan.
Bring to simmer.
Pour corn meal into chicken broth slowly, stirring constantly until thick, about 10 minutes.
Cover and set aside.

recipes.title: Quick Peach Cobbler
steps: Mix sugar, flour, milk and peaches together.
Put into bowl. Slice 1 stick of butter over top.
Bake at 375° until top rises and is golden brown.

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits
steps: Cream margarine and cheese together.
Add flour, paprika and salt.
Work together into a roll and slice.
Press sliced green olive into center of each circle.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes on greased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Cake #2
steps: Cream Crisco and margarine.
Add sugar and vanilla.
Add egg yolks, one at a time.
Sift flour and soda together; add to creamed mixture, alternating with milk.
Add nuts and coconut. Beat egg whites until stiff; fold into the batter.
Pour into 3 (9-inch) greased pans; bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken A La King
steps: Cook peppers in melted butter until tender.
Remove peppers and add flour to butter; blend.
Add warm milk and cook until thickened.
Remove from heat and add well beaten yolks.
Place over low flame and cook one minute, stirring constantly.
Add lemon juice and salt; blend with ingredients.

recipes.title: Easy Country Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb. of sausage (hot or mild) ground
steps: Fry your sausage in a large skillet until brown. Add flour to sausage and in skillet and mix together. Brown flour and add milk. on medium high, stir mixture often to keep from burning. Add sage, salt and pepper. As gravy comes to a boil it will thicken. If it is too thick, add 1/4 cup of more milk. Reduce heat after bringing to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. This is excellent served over chicken fried steak, biscuits, or potatoes.

recipes.title: Chinese Beef-N-Rice
steps: In large skillet cook and stir rice in oil over medium heat until golden brown.
Add salt, water, bouillon cubes and soy sauce. Cover tightly; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in onions, celery, green peppers and meat.
Cover tightly; simmer 10 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice tender.

recipes.title: Chicken And Wild Rice Dressing
steps: Prepare wild rice according to directions on the box.
Cut chicken in cubes; brown sausage, chicken and onion together. Drain the fat; mix all ingredients together.
Bake 1 hour at 350° or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Ranch Biscuits
steps: Mix yeast with warm water.
Mix all other ingredients.
Leave in refrigerator and use as needed.

recipes.title: Salmonettes Heloise
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can pink salmon (cheaper than red)
steps: Open can of salmon, pour the juice into a measuring cup and set aside.
Dump the drained salmon in a mixing bowl.
Drop in egg.
Use a fork to break up salmon and mix the egg real good. When it is gummy, add flour.
Stir in flour thoroughly with fork. Mixture will be real thick.

recipes.title: Butter Crisp Cookies
steps: Cream the margarine, sugar and vanilla. Beat in eggs. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Shape in balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes in a 375° oven.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Or Mexican Corn Bread
steps: Mix the dry ingredients.
Beat eggs. Add milk and stir into dry mixture.
Add the Crisco and mix thoroughly.
Pour into "hot" cast-iron skillet or corn bread stick pan with about 1 tablespoon oil. Bake in preheated oven at 450° or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
steps: Cut tomatoes into 1/4-inch slices.
Combine cornmeal, flour, salt and pepper.
Dip tomato slices into cornmeal mixture.
Heat bacon drippings until melted.
Add tomato slices; cook, turning once, until golden brown.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
steps: Combine broccoli with onion and cook as directed on broccoli package; drain.
Combine vegetables with margarine, rice, cheese spread and mushroom soup.
Pour mixture into a greased shallow 2-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cookie Salad
ingredients: 2 small instant vanilla or white chocolate pudding mix
steps: Crumble 3/4 package cookies into bite-size pieces; set aside. Combine pudding and buttermilk thoroughly. Fold in whipped topping and then add the mandarin oranges. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
When ready to serve, mix in the crumbled cookie pieces and then place the remaining whole cookies on top for decoration.

recipes.title: Chicken Orleans
ingredients: 1 (2 to 3 lb.) fryer chicken, cut up
steps: Roll chicken in seasoned flour (flour, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper).
Brown in vegetable oil in heavy frypan; remove.
Cook onion, garlic, celery and green pepper until they begin to brown, stirring occasionally.
Stir in tomatoes, rice, Worcestershire sauce, remaining salt and water.
Arrange browned chicken over the top.
Cover tightly.
Let simmer 20 to 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Swedish Heirloom Cookies
steps: Cream butter; add sugar gradually, then salt and nuts.
Blend in flour and mix thoroughly.
Add water and vanilla.
Mix thoroughly with fork.
Shape into balls or crescents.
Bake in greased sheet.
Flatten slightly.
Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Rosebud'S Biscuits
ingredients: medium to large bowl of self-rising flour, sifted
extra oil (for pan and top of biscuits)
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Make a well in flour, patting flour down lightly.
Pour milk into the well.
Add oil to milk.
With hands, gradually add flour to make soft dough.
Flour hands.
Pinch off dough; roll between hands forming biscuits.
Place biscuits on pan greased with oil.
(I place biscuits touching.)
Dab oil onto top of each biscuit.
Bake at 450° for approximately 5 to 6 minutes or until done.
Place on broil to slightly brown tops.

recipes.title: Amish Sugar Cookies
steps: Combine sugars, oleo and oil.
Add eggs and beat well.
Add the flour, soda, cream of tartar and vanilla.
Make into balls and roll in sugar.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Beginner'S Blueberry Cobbler
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt butter and pour in baking dish. Mix flour, sugar and milk together.
Fold in berries and pour over butter.
Do not stir.
Bake until golden brown.

recipes.title: Choc-Oat Chip Cookies
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. Quaker oats (quick or old fashioned)
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Beat butter or margarine and sugar until creamy.
Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well.
Add flour, baking soda and salt.
Mix well.
Stir in oats, chocolate morsels and nuts.
Mix well.
Drop by rounded teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 9 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie or 12 to 13 minutes for a crisp cookie.
Cool 1 minute on pan, then remove and cool completely.
Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Texas Hash
ingredients: 1 c. cooked tomatoes and tomato sauce
1/4 c. washed, uncooked rice or 1 c. uncooked noodles
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Saute onions and green pepper in hot fat until yellow.
Add ground beef and fry until mixture falls apart. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Cover and bake 1 hour.
Remove cover last 15 minutes.
Serve hot.
Makes 3 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
steps: Mix oil, sugar and eggs; add strawberries. Combine and sift dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients gradually; mix well. Stir in nuts. Pour into 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour. Great with cream cheese.

recipes.title: Fish Patties
steps: Combine all ingredients except cheese in a bowl. Form into patties.
Fry until crisp in hot olive oil.
Top with a slice of cheese.
Serve with mustard or salsa sauce. Also makes a great burger sandwich.
Serve on a bun with lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Crumb Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine rhubarb, egg, vanilla, 4 tablespoons flour and sugar together.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Blend 3/4 cup flour, brown sugar and margarine together until crumbly.
Sprinkle over rhubarb mixture.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Extra Rich Cake
steps: Grease and flour tube pan.
Combine and bake at 325° for 55 to 60 minutes.
You may use any flavor that you prefer, i.e. lemon cake mix and lemon pudding mix or white cake mix and vanilla pudding mix, etc.

recipes.title: Baked Chop Suey
steps: Brown beef, onion, salt and pepper. Put into baking dish; add celery, salt, soups and rice. Add water and soy sauce; stir all together and bake 1 hour, covered, and 1/2 hour more, uncovered, at 350°.

recipes.title: Country Hash
steps: Combine meats in one boiler.
Cook until done.
Cool for 15 to 20 minutes, then chop.
Add vinegar, butter and onion.
Reheat for 15 minutes.
Serve over rice.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: L-H Dressing
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix in blender.
Serve on greens and top with bacon.

recipes.title: Ten-Minute Turkey Casserole
steps: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.
Cover and let simmer about 30 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Dorothy'S Rhubarb Pie
steps: Beat eggs.
Add sugar and flour.
Mix together with wooden spoon and stir in soft butter and salt.
Pour this over rhubarb in unbaked shell.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes and then at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Stollen
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped candied red and green cherries
steps: Sprinkle the yeast over the warm water in a small bowl; add a pinch of sugar, stir to dissolve and let stand for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecue Burgers
steps: Fry ground chuck, onion, celery and mushrooms in shortening. Add ketchup, tomatoes, water and seasoning.
Cover, simmer 15 minutes.
Add flour, cook until slightly thick.
Serve over round buns.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix together sugar, cocoa, flour, cornstarch and salt in saucepan.
Add milk; mix well.
Cook, stirring constantly until mixture boils.
Boil one minute.
Add part of cooked mixture to beaten egg yolks, stirring to keep from lumping.
Put all back into saucepan and cook one minute. Cool. Put in cooked pie crust.
Top with meringue.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Pound Cake
steps: Cream sugar, vanilla and shortening until fluffy.
Add eggs alternately with flour.
Beat until well blended.
Pour into well-greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until center is done.
Cool about 10 minutes on wire rack.
Remove from pan and cool completely. (Lemon flavoring or other flavoring may be substituted.)

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. chopped, cooked chicken, seasoned to taste
steps: Combine all ingredients except corn flakes.
Press into casserole dish and top with corn flakes.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes until bubbly hot.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Cake
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) can crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Sift dry ingredients and place in mixing bowl.
Add cooking oil, vanilla and can of pineapple.
Mix well.
Add eggs, mixing well after each addition.
Add grated sweet potatoes and pecans. Stir well.
Pour in tube pan.
Bake at 350° for about 1 1/4 hours. Test with toothpick.

recipes.title: Apple Nut Cake
steps: Mix all liquids together.
Mix all dry ingredients together, then mix together.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes in 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Low Fat Blueberry Coffee Cake
ingredients: 1/4 c. skim or evaporated non fat milk
1 1/2 c. fresh or frozen, thawed blueberries
steps: Preheat oven to 325° F. Spray a 9 inch tube pan well with cooking spray and set aside. In a large bowl, mix together flour, baking powder, salt, malted milk powder and nutmeg then set aside. In a separate bowl, cream sugar together with butter and sour cream until light and fluffy. Add egg then egg whites, beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla, and milk. Fold liquid mixture into flour mixture until just combined. Gently fold blueberries into batter. Pour batter into pan and gently even out top with spatula or spoon. Bake cake until well
browned on

top and long skewer inserted in thickest part of cake comes out clean, 50 minutes to 60 minutes. Let cake stand in pan for 5 minutes, loosen edges and invert onto a serving plate. Sprinkle warm cake with confectioners sugar. Serve cake warm or at room
temperature. Before serving refresh cake with a dusting of confectioners sugar if desired. Yield 16 servings, 176 calories.

recipes.title: Hungarian Goulash(Crock-Pot)
ingredients: 2 lb. round steak, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
steps: Put steak cubes, onions and garlic in crock-pot.
Stir in flour and mix to coat steak cubes.
Add all remaining ingredients except sour cream.
Stir well.
Cover and cook on low for 7 to 10 hours.
Add sour cream 30 minutes before serving and stir in thoroughly.
"May cook on high for 5 to 6 hours, stirring occasionally."
Serve over hot buttered noodles.

recipes.title: Chili Chicken Dish
ingredients: 1 lb. skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
3/4 c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese with peppers
steps: In large skillet, saute poultry in oil until no longer pink; set aside.
In same skillet, cook onion, peppers and garlic until tender.
Drain.
Stir in chili and stewed tomatoes.
Add rice and pepper sauce.
Arrange chicken on top of mixture.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Top with shredded cheese.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Maritime Seafood Casserole
steps: Saute onion and celery in 3 tablespoons butter.
In a large saucepan, melt 1/2 cup of butter.
Blend in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Remove from heat and add onion, celery and cheese. Stir until cheese is melted, then add seafoods.
Pour into a large casserole or individual dishes.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for about 30 minutes or until browned and bubbly.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Prepare apples; set aside and cover.
Measure oil in large mixing bowl, add sugar and eggs and mix well at low speed until creamy smooth.
Sift flour and measure.
Then sift again with salt, soda and baking powder.
Add flour mixture to creamed mixture in small amounts.
Beat well after each addition.
When batter becomes stiff, remove beater and finish mixing by hand. Fold in chopped nuts and apples last.
Mix well.
Spread evenly in a 9 x 13-inch pan lined with greased wax paper.
Bake at 350°
for about 55 minutes to 1 hour.
Turn out on cake rack to cool, or ice and serve from the pan.

recipes.title: Rum Cake
steps: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs, one at a time.
Sift flour alternately with milk and flavoring.
Bake in Bundt pan at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Fluff
ingredients: 1 c. prepared Dream Whip or Cool Whip
steps: Combine flour, oleo, brown sugar and nuts; mix well.
Spread on cookie sheet and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°, stirring occasionally.
Cool, then crumble, reserving 1 cup.
Spread remaining crumbs in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Blushing Bunny Sauce
steps: Put salt, pepper and flour with butter in double boiler.
When melted, add cheese (which has been broken into small pieces) and stir until cheese melts.
Then add tomato sauce and beaten egg; stir until smooth.
Serve on toast.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Mix together first 5 ingredients in a heavy saucepan.
Bring to a
boil.
Let cool for 2 minutes.
Take 4 cans of biscuits and cut each one into fourths.
Roll in some sugar and place in a greased Bundt pan.
Pour sauce over the top.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Let cool.
Turn over on plate and serve.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Mix all the ingredients as you do for a cake and mix well. Bake in preheated 325° oven for one hour and 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Kentucky Hot Brown Sandwiches
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
steps: Melt margarine in pan over low heat.
Add flour, stirring until smooth.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add milk and bouillon cubes.
Cover over medium heat, stirring until thickened and bubbly.
Set aside.
Place toast in buttered 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
Top each with turkey and ham.
Spoon white sauce over meat.
Layer cheese, tomato and bacon over sauce.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
(Can use thinly sliced country ham or regular ham slices.)

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
steps: Mix all together and chill for several hours.
Serve with fresh vegetables.

recipes.title: Harvard Beet Cake
ingredients: 1 c. (8 oz. can) crushed pineapple, undrained
steps: Mix flour, salt and baking soda together and set aside.
In a bowl combine rest of ingredients except nuts and coconut and mix together.
If beets are sliced, not diced, then cut them into smaller pieces.

Beat mixture until well combined, about 3 minutes; add flour mixture and beat in, then stir in nuts and coconut. Batter will be reddish in color but will turn brown when baked. Spoon into greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan and bake at 350° for 50 or 60 minutes, testing with a toothpick to see if it comes out clean.
For a glass pan, reduce oven heat to 325°.
Cool and cut into squares.
Keeps well in covered container.

recipes.title: Roast Pheasant
steps: Cut off necks of birds close to bodies, leaving neck skin on to help hold the stuffing.
Remove pin feathers; singe if needed. Rinse inside and out in warm water; drain and pat dry.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies
ingredients: 1 scant c. lard or other shortening
2 tsp. baking soda, dissolved in 2/3 c. hot coffee (instant coffee is fine)
steps: Cream together in a large bowl the sugar, lard or other shortening, molasses and eggs.
Sift the flour, ginger and salt. Dissolve the baking soda in the coffee.
Stir dry ingredients into molasses mixture, adding coffee alternately.
Chill.
Roll out dough to a thick layer, 1/2-inch or so.
Cut with round cutter. Dip into sugar.
Place on greased baking sheet, leaving room to spread.
Bake at 375° for about 10 minutes but do not let brown as they will be too hard.
They are a good big soft cookie which keep well. Cool on rack and enjoy with a glass of milk.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
steps: Cream margarine and shortening.
Gradually add sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Sift flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa. Add milk and flour alternately.
Add vanilla.
Place in greased and floured tube pan.
Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes in 325° oven.

recipes.title: Pickled Eggs
ingredients: 1 pt. pickled jalapenos or chili peppers
steps: Heat
peppers,
water, vinegar, salt and sugar to boiling. Add eggs and simmer for 5 minutes.
Store in covered jar in refrigerator
for
one
week.
Cut
in half and serve as an appetizer.

recipes.title: Texas Golden Chicken Breasts
steps: In a large, heavy skillet, heat butter and olive oil over low heat.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, rosemary and cheese; mix well.
Dampen chicken breasts.
Roll in flour mixture, then eggs, then croutons.
Cook in butter, 4 minutes per side.
Serve with white sauce or milk gravy.

recipes.title: Red Beans
steps: Soak beans overnight. Brown salt pork in shortening. Brown onions. Add flour, browning to form a roux.
Add beans and enough water to cover well. Simmer 2 hours.
Serve with rice. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. round steak, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Combine flour and steak in plastic bag.
Saute onion and garlic in hot oil in Dutch oven until tender.
Add steak; cook over medium heat, stirring often until browned.
Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Delight
steps: Blend flour and margarine.
Add nuts.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Chocolate Bonbons
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a medium saucepan, combine chocolate chips and margarine.
Cook and stir over low heat until chips are melted and smooth.
Add sweetened condensed milk; mix well.
In a medium bowl, combine flour, nuts, chocolate mixture and vanilla. Mix well.
Shape 1 tablespoon of dough around each candy kiss, covering completely.
Place 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 6 to 8 minutes.
Do not overcook. Cookies will be soft and appear shiny but become firm as they cool.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
ingredients: 1 3/4 to 2 c. unsalted dry roasted peanuts
steps: Generously grease large baking sheet and set aside. Combine sugar and corn syrup in 2 quart glass measure bowl. Cook on high for 4 minutes. Stir in peanuts with wooden spoon and cook on high for 4 minutes. Stir in butter and vanilla and cook on high for 2 minutes. Add baking soda and stir until mixture is light and foamy. Pour on prepared baking sheet. Spread quickly to edges using back of wooden spoon. As candy cools stretch to a thin sheet using palms of hands. Cool completely before breaking into pieces. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Cheese Treats(Tom'S Grandmother'S)
ingredients: cayenne pepper to taste (1/2 to 1 tsp.)
steps: Mix flour with corn flakes.
Add cayenne pepper.
Grate into this sharp	cheese.
Mix
well.
Pour in melted butter or margarine (a little
more butter makes them easier to handle). Put in small balls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press down flat with fork
tines.
Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.	Cut off oven and
let them
stay 10 minutes longer.
Makes 2 cookie sheets full.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni in salted water and drain.
Add egg yolks. Alternate layers of macaroni and cheese in greased baking dish. Place butter, flour, salt and pepper in double boiler; mix well. Add milk and cook until thickened.
Pour over macaroni and cheese mixture.
Fold in egg whites.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Bootjie Bredie(Green Bean Stew)
ingredients: 1 lb. green beans, cut into 1-inch pieces (about 4 c.)
steps: Trim fat from lamb.
Cut lamb into 3/4-inch cubes.
Heat oil in Dutch oven or large, heavy pan until hot.
Cook and stir lamb in oil over medium heat until brown, about 10 minutes.
Add water, garlic and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Jeff'S New Potato Salad
ingredients: 16 medium red new potatoes, boiled and cubed
steps: Combine all ingredients and adjust mayonnaise for desired creaminess.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Sticky Rhubarb Muffins
steps: With pastry blender, mix 1/4 cup cold butter and the brown sugar.
Add rhubarb and mix well.
Spoon into bottom of 12 greased muffin cups.
Cream remaining 1/3 cup butter, white sugar and egg. Sift flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk, mixing just enough to blend.
Spoon into muffin cups.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Gravy
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Heat small skillet of milk on medium heat.
Pour a little warm milk in mixture, then mix until smooth.
Pour back into hot milk and stir until thick, but not too thick.
Serve over hot biscuits.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Banana Bread
steps: Mix everything well.
Then add 2 cups flour.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Green Pea Casserole
steps: Preheat
oven
to
Cook	peas per package directions, unseasoned	and
drained.
Set aside.
Saute onion and celery in the 1/2 cup margarine.
Add drained chestnuts, soup, flour	and peas.
Mix	together
well and cook slightly.
Add salt
and pepper
to	taste.	Melt
the
1/4 cup margarine in skillet
and add
the
herb
dressing.
Set
aside.
Pour all (except the dressing) into a medium casserole dish and bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until bubbly and hot.
Add dressing and brown slightly.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bonbons
ingredients: 2 c. creamy or chunky peanut butter
1 lb. melted milk or compound chocolate coating
steps: Combine all ingredients except chocolate in large bowl.
Stir and knead until well blended.
Chill 30 minutes.
Roll into 1-inch balls.
Chill balls on baking sheets until firm.
Melt chocolate in glass measuring cup, stirring at least once.
Dip each ball into melted chocolate.
Chill until firm on wax paper.
Store in refrigerator.
Makes approximately 72 balls.

recipes.title: Raggedy Ann Salad
steps: Place peach in center of salad plate.
Position egg for head, celery sticks for arms and legs and lettuce for skirt.
Add cheese for hair, cherry for mouth and raisins for eyes, nose, buttons and shoes.
Yields 1 serving.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Place in deep dish pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
steps: Melt oleo; mix with flour and sugar.
Pat into pie plate. Bake at 375° for approximately 10 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Cheesy Spicy Spinach
ingredients: 1/2 c. spinach liquid, reserved from cooking spinach
1 (6 oz.) roll hot pepper cheese, cubed
steps: Cook spinach according to directions on package; drain well, reserving 1/2 cup spinach liquid.
Set aside.
In pan coated with nonstick cooking spray, melt margarine and saute onion until tender.
Add flour; stir.
Gradually add milk and spinach liquid to make sauce.
Cook until mixture thickens.
Add cheese and seasonings; cook until cheese is melted.
Add spinach to pan, combining well.
Yields 10 servings.
A favorite of spinach lovers.

recipes.title: Congo Bars
steps: Combine dry ingredients.
Then add oil and other ingredients. Bake in a large square pan for 15 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Yum Yum Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger and add other ingredients.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Han'S Sauerbraten
ingredients: 3 lb. boned chuck pot roast (or bottom roast)
steps: Step 1:
In a large bowl, combine vinegar, wine, onions, celery, spices, salt and pepper.
Wash meat with a damp cloth, put in marinade, cover and refrigerate for 3 days.
Turn meat occasionally.

recipes.title: Hot Cheese Bubble
steps: Mix together and cook at 425° for 10 minutes, approximately. Serve with Wheat Thins.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Muffins
steps: Let all-bran cereal and boiling water set in bowl.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Bake in 400° oven for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Playmate Pizzas
ingredients: 3 English muffins or hamburger buns, split
4 to 5 slices pepperoni or Canadian style bacon
2 1/2 oz. jar sliced mushrooms or 1/2 c. pitted olives
steps: Toast
muffins	or buns.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Spread tomato sauce on.
Cut bacon or pepperoni to make 12 triangular eyes and 6 half
moon mouths.
Arrange the eyes and mouths on muffins. Place
the mushrooms and/or olives to resemble hair. Place pizza faces
on
baking
sheet.
Bake
at
450° about 5 minutes or until hot.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Oven Stew
ingredients: 2 lb. cubed stew beef, trimmed of fat
2 (8 oz.) cans mushrooms (pieces and stems), drained and rinsed
steps: In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika. Add a few pieces of meat at a time and shake bag, coating well on all sides.
Repeat until all meat has been floured.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Squares
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease 8 or 9-inch baking pan.
Combine dry ingredients.
Stir in milk, oil and egg, mixing just until dry ingredients are moistened.
Pour batter into pan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm.
Makes 9 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits
steps: Soften butter and cheese.
Gradually add flour and paprika. Roll out and cut with cookie cutter or cookie gun.
Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Coconut Cream Pound Cake
steps: Cream margarine and shortening; gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well. Combine flour and baking powder; add to creamed mixture alternately with cream of coconut.
(Begin and end with flour.) Stir in lemon rind and vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes.
Remove and cool completely on wire rack.

recipes.title: Caramel Turtles
steps: Melt caramels and cream in double boiler.
Combine oat mixture without chocolate chips. Spread 1/2 mixture into 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup(Microwave)
steps: Melt the butter in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Add onions and cook for ten minutes.
Stir in beef bouillon, salt, flour and pepper.
Cover and cook another 10 minutes.
Spoon into individual bowls.
Toast bread and add to soup.
Cover with Mozzarella cheese. Heat on High for 1 minute and 15 seconds.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 2 lb. beef, sliced thin and cut into 2 x 1/8-inch strips
steps: Fry beef in the butter and sprinkle with garlic powder.
Cook, stirring slightly, until browned.
Remove meat from pan. Add onion and green pepper.
Saute about 2 minutes.
Return meat to skillet along with tomatoes and bouillon cube.
Simmer about 5 minutes. Blend together the next 5 ingredients.
Stir into the meat mixture and simmer until tender, stirring once in awhile.
Add drained mushrooms a few minutes before serving.
Serve with hot rice and/or chow mein noodles.

recipes.title: Layered Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 1 medium sweet onion, diced or green onion
steps: Tear lettuce into small pieces.
Place in a 9 x 12-inch glass dish.
Layer next 6 ingredients in order given.
Add sugar to mayonnaise and spread over top as you would frosting.
Top with grated cheese.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 to 12 hours. Garnish with bacon bits and parsley.

recipes.title: Apple Dumplings
steps: Make syrup and bring to a hard boil. Add 8 finely chopped apples. Roll dough as for pie crust. Cut into squares. Add a small amount of syrup in bottom of a pan. Peel and core apples. Wrap each apple in a square of dough.
Place in pan.
Pour half of the syrup over dumplings.
Make sure that the top of the dough is secured around apple.
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes or until done. Ten minutes before removing from oven, pour remaining syrup on top of dumplings.

recipes.title: Applesauce Raisin Spice Cake
steps: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients.
Pour batter into greased Bundt pan or tube pan.
Bake at 350° until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Derby'S Easy Chicken
ingredients: 1 (3 to 3 1/2 lb.) chicken, cut into eighths
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet. Season the chicken with salt and pepper.

Brown on both sides in the heated oil. Remove chicken from pan and set aside. Add green pepper, onion and garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, about 5 minutes. Return chicken to pan. Cover and cook on medium-low for about 45 to 50 minutes, stirring often. Gently stir in frozen peas and cook for another 5 minutes. Serve with potatoes, rice or noodles. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Nuggets
steps: Cut up chicken breasts into cubes.
Add salt, pepper and seasoned salt into flour.
Dip chicken into flour, then in milk and egg mix, then back in flour.
Drop into hot grease, about 350°, until golden brown.

recipes.title: Baked Spinach Cheese Squares
steps: Thaw spinach. Blend all ingredients and put in an 11 x 7-inch buttered casserole.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Cut in squares to serve.

recipes.title: Fruit Punch Bar
steps: Beat first 3 ingredients on high.
Add next 4 ingredients and beat on medium.
Spread in a greased 13 x 10 x 2-inch pan.
Top with coconut and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Molasses Cookies
steps: Melt shortening then let cool.
Ad sugar, molasses and egg. Mix well with mixer.
Sift dry ingredients together; add to first mixture.
Chill well.
Form into balls and roll in sugar.
Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350 degrees until they start to crack. About 6 - 8 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Leave on cookie sheets for a few minutes.
Makes about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
ingredients: 1 yeast cake, dissolved in 2 Tbsp. hot water
steps: Mix dry ingredients thoroughly and blend into liquids.
Mix in a large bowl and refrigerate.
Use amount as needed to bake. Biscuits do not have to rise.

recipes.title: Sunny Jim Peanut Butter Swirls
steps: Mix shortening, sugar, peanut butter, eggs and milk.
Add flour, salt and soda.
Melt chocolate chips.
Divide dough and roll each out into oblong.
Spread melted chocolate and roll. Refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Slice and cook for 8 to 10 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Turkey Pie
ingredients: water or mixture of water and broth to cook vegetables
1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
steps: *If making your own crust, add a dash of thyme or poultry seasoning to flour.
If using prepared crust, just cut strips to fit whatever pan you use.

recipes.title: Swedish Pancakes
steps: Add eggs to the milk.
Add to flour, salt and sugar; beat until smooth.
Add butter.
Pour on hot griddle as thin as possible to make pancakes.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled
steps: Mix together in a bowl.
