Add dressing.

recipes.title: Almond Crescents
ingredients: 1/2 c. finely chopped nuts or 1/2 c. mini chocolate chips
steps: Blend together first 6 ingredients; add finely chopped nuts or mini chocolate chips.
Shape into crescents and bake on ungreased cookie sheet 15 to 18 minutes until light golden brown.
Sift powdered sugar over crescents while still warm.
Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Sift together
flour,
soda,
salt and cream of tartar. Set aside.
Cream
together
shortening,
sugar and eggs; beat until fluffy.
Add
flour mixture in small amounts alternately with bananas
to
egg
mixture.
Beat
until smooth after each addition.
Place
in
well-greased
loaf
pan and bake in 350° oven for about
hour or until bread is done.
Makes 1 loaf. (This Banana Bread has cake like texture and flavor and can be served as cake.)
One
may
also add 1/4 cup chopped pecans to dough before baking.
When Banana Bread is baked and hot, pour the glaze over it.

recipes.title: Vegetable-Cheese Bake
steps: In a saucepan, combine frozen vegetables and boiling water. Bring to boil again.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan.
Blend in flour.
Cook 1 minute. Gradually stir in milk.
Simmer, stirring until smooth and thickened.
Add cheese and seasonings.
Mix in vegetables, onions and pimentos.
Spread into buttered 1-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly and browned.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Make four small rolls and wrap in wax paper.
Place
in refrigerator.
When ready to bake, slice and place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° about seven minutes.

recipes.title: County Fair Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Sift flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg onto wax paper.
Combine raisins and water in small saucepan; bring to boiling; remove from heat.
Cover; cool to room temperature.
Beat shortening and sugar well; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Blend flour mixture into shortening mixture until smooth.
Add cooled raisins and liquid and oats.
Mix well.
Cover bowl; chill at least 1 hour.
Drop cookies from teaspoons onto lightly greased cookie sheets, about 2 inches apart.
Bake in oven at 350° for 10 minutes or until evenly brown.
Transfer at once to wire racks to cool. Store in container with tight fitting lid.

recipes.title: Linguine Al Pesto
ingredients: 2 c. fresh basil, cleaned and stems removed
steps: Method 1:
Drain 1 can of pinto beans.
Mash.
Cook in bacon grease or lard.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Combine the first 7 ingredients listed in a mixing bowl.
Pour the mixture into a pie shell.
Bake at 300° for 45 minutes, or until done.

recipes.title: Peter Paul Mound Cake
steps: Cream Crisco; add sugar and beat until fluffy.
Add whole eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add vanilla to milk; sift flour together and add part of the flour mixture.
Add milk and then remaining flour to batter.
Beat until smooth and thoroughly mixed, but do not overbeat.
Pour batter into 3 greased and lightly floured cake pans.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated 350° oven.

recipes.title: Zucchini Nut Bread
steps: Beat eggs; gradually add sugar and oil.
Combine dry ingredients.
Add to first mixture and alternate with zucchini. Stir in raisins, walnuts and vanilla.
Use 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Twist
ingredients: 1 dry yeast- let rise in 1/2 cup warm water for 15 minutes
steps: Mix and put on a board and roll to an oblong shape.
Melt butter and spread over dough.
Sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon over half of the dough.
Fold over other half and pat thin.
Cut into 1/2 inch strips and twist. Let rise 1 hour and bake in 375 degrees till light brown, This makes 24 twist.
May be frosted with powdered sugar frosting.

recipes.title: Choco-Scotch Pound Cake
steps: Melt chocolate and butterscotch bits over hot water or in microwave.
Cool.
Cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and buttermilk.
Sift dry ingredients and add to egg mixture and cooled chocolate mixture and stir well.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours. Cool on rack.
Remove from pan.
Dust with powdered sugar or glaze, if desired.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: salt or garlic salt and pepper
steps: Peel and cut onions into very thin slices.
Cook onion slices in butter over very low heat.
Add salt and pepper according to taste.
Sprinkle in flour, stirring constantly to thicken butter/onion mixture.
Slowly add beef broth and water, then bring to boil.
Simmer with pan covered for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jello Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. strawberry jello, dissolved in 1/2 c. water (at room temperature)
steps: Empty cake mix in a large mixing bowl.
Add all other ingredients and beat 3 minutes.
Grease and flour 2 round pans or 1 sheath cake pan. Bake at 350° until done (usually about 30 minutes).

recipes.title: Baked Fish Loaf
ingredients: 2 c. canned tuna fish or salmon or 1 lb. filleted fish, cooked
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Drain and flake fish.
Add onion and capers to fish.
In separate dish, combine mayonnaise, water, cream, salt, paprika and stir until smooth.
Add 1/2 of this cream sauce to fish and mix well.
Place fish mixture in buttered loaf pan or baking dish.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Use the remaining sauce, after the curry is mixed into it, to spread over the fish loaf slices.
It can be cut into six slices while it is still hot and the sauce spooned over the slices.
This is a good one for dieters.

recipes.title: Party Crunch Mix
ingredients: 4 c. square wheat or rice cereal
1 (5 oz.) can La Choy chow mein noodles
steps: Heat oven to 250°.
Combine both cereals and noodles in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Set aside.
Combine the remaining ingredients in small bowl and pour over cereal mixture.
Stir to cool evenly. Bake 1 hour, stirring every 20 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Marinated Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 pt. Brussels sprouts (2 c.) or 2 (10 oz. each) pkg. frozen Brussels sprouts
1/2 c. thinly sliced celery (1 large rib)
1 (14 1/2 oz.) can sliced tomatoes, well drained*
steps: Cook sprouts in 2-inches boiling, salted water for 4 to 6 minutes or until just tender; drain.
Place in shallow bowl with celery and tomatoes.
Pour on dressing; cover and chill at least 2 hours.
Drain before serving.
Spoon into lettuce-lined bowl. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Fluffy Fruit Salad
steps: Drain pineapple, reserving 1 c. juice in small saucepan.
Set pineapple aside.
To saucepan, add sugar, flour, eggs, orange juice, lemon juice and oil.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute, remove from heat and chill.
In salad bowl, combine pineapple, fruit cocktail, oranges and bananas.
Fold in Cool Whip and chilled sauce.
Chill several hours.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs.
Mix and stir in dry ingredients and raisins.
Drop by spoon onto cookie sheet or roll into 4 logs.
Chill and slice.
Bake 9 to 10 minutes at 325° on greased pan.
I steam the raisins for a few minutes.

recipes.title: Lynn'S Lionel Cake
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients together and cool.
Mix next 4 ingredients with beaters.
Combine last 4 ingredients and add to mixture by hand.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Mix in order as listed.
Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fabulous Beef Fajitas
ingredients: 1/2 c. prepared Italian salad dressing, divided
1 lb. boneless sirloin steak, cut into 1/4 inch strips
1 medium onion, sliced and separated into rings
steps: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine 1/4 cup salad dressing and chili powder; add steak.
Seal and turn to coat; refrigerate for 30 minutes.
In a skillet, saute peppers and onion in remaining salad dressing until crisp and tender.
Remove and keep warm.	Drain steak, discarding marinade in skillet, saute steak for 6-10 minutes or until no longer pink.
Return vegetables to pan.
Heat through and spoon meat and vegetables down center of tortillas; fold in sides.
Yield:
4-6 servings.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. baking powder, mixed with soup
steps: Cream butter and sugar well.
Sift flour; measure and resift 3 times with spices and salt.
Alternately add dry ingredients with soda mixture.
Pour into greased loaf or cake pan.
Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.
Top with cream icing.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 to 3 Tbsp. margarine or butter, melted
steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Combine cookie crumbs and margarine; press firmly on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake Cookies
ingredients: 1 small carton each candied red and green cherries
steps: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and vanilla and beat well. Mix flour with soda and cinnamon; add to creamed mixture and mix together. Cut up the candied fruits; add nut pieces and mix with the cookie dough. Spoon onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Makes about 4 to 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
steps: Thinly slice steak diagonally.
Brown with onion in oil.
Stir in gravy mix, water and soy sauce.
Stir until thickened.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Add bell peppers, cut in thin strips, and tomato, cut in wedges.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Honey Cakes
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients; add remaining ingredients.
Mix and pat out into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pizza
steps: Mix together and press into pizza pan.
Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Basic Pasta(Noodle Dough)
steps: Put flour and salt in mixing bowl.
Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and in it put the eggs and oil.
Mix together with your fingers.
Knead the dough until smooth, adding more flour or a few drops of water as necessary.
Dough may also be made using a mixer with a dough hook or in a food processor.

recipes.title: Texan Pecan Pie
steps: Mix well.
Put in 9-inch pastry.
Cook for 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Jonna'S Baked Quail
steps: Salt and pepper birds.
Brown quail in oil.
Place in Dutch oven.
Saute onion, parsley and celery.
Add broth and mushrooms and stir well.
Pour over quail.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender.

recipes.title: Homemade Chicken Dumplings
ingredients: chicken flavored soup base to taste
steps: Boil chicken, onion, carrots and parsley until done.
Add soup base enough to taste.
Remove chicken to cool, then pick meat off bones.

recipes.title: Blueberry Dumplings
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) pkg. frozen blueberries or 2 1/2 c. fresh blueberries
steps: In saucepan bring blueberries, 1/2 cup sugar, dash of salt, lemon and water to a boil.
Reduce to low heat.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Cut in butter, stir in milk and drop batter by spoonfuls on berries.
Don't overlap.
Cover.
Cook 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesy Ham Potato Casserole
steps: Saute onion in butter in a large saucepan until tender.
Add flour and seasonings. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add milk.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thick.
Add 1/2 cup cheese, stirring until cheese melts. Add ham and potatoes. Spoon into greased 2-quart shallow baking dish. Bake uncovered at 350° for 25 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Brownies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt shortening.
Remove from heat and blend in sugar.
Cool.
Stir in egg, then sifted dry ingredients. Add vanilla and nuts.
Spread in greased 8-inch square pan.
Bake 25 minutes.
Do not overbake.
Makes 16 (2-inch) squares.

recipes.title: Creamy Sausage Stew
ingredients: 8 to 10 medium red potatoes, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
2 large white onions, cut in quarters
1 large green pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 large red pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
2 lb. smoked sausage, cut into 1-inch pieces
steps: Place potatoes in a 5-quart roasting pan.
Add onions, peppers and sausage.
Toss gently.
Combine oil, basil, salt and pepper. Pour over the meat and vegetables; toss well.
Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes; stir.
Add the cream; cover and bake 30 to 40 minutes longer, or until potatoes are tender.
Combine cornstarch and water; stir into stew.
Place on stove top and bring to a boil, stirring constantly, until thickened.

recipes.title: Pilaf
ingredients: 1/2 c. fine egg noodles (uncooked), broken in pieces
steps: In saucepan, brown noodles in butter; stir often.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil; stir.
Cover; cook over low heat 20 to 25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Makes about
2 cups.

recipes.title: Crunchy Fried Chicken
steps: Cut chicken up and remove skin. Mix flour salt and pepper in a paper bag. Put chicken in and coat well. Combine buttermilk and soda in a bowl, dip chicken in milk then reflour and fry.

recipes.title: Orange Muffins
steps: Cream margarine and sugar; add yogurt.
Add dry ingredients and then raisins and nuts.
Spray a muffin pan with Pam and fill cups.
Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes.
Makes 12 large muffins.

recipes.title: Maple Apple Muffins
steps: Spray 12 muffin cups with vegetable spray.
Combine first 5 ingredients.
Mix well.
Add milk, margarine, syrup and egg whites, mixing until just moist.
Fold in apples.
Fill muffin cups 3/4 full.
Top with pecan halves.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°.
Cool slightly.
Glaze.

recipes.title: Peach Bread
ingredients: 2 c. fresh peaches, peeled and sliced
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs; beat well.
Combine flour, baking powder, salt, soda and cinnamon.
Add to creamed mixture. Stir in orange juice concentrate, vanilla and peaches.

recipes.title: Chicken Fanfare
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. chicken flavored stuffing mix
grated rind from 2 oranges or 2 Tbsp. dried orange peel
steps: Remove skin from chicken.
Pound between 2 pieces of waxed paper to 1/4-inch thick. Remove waxed paper.
In a large bowl, combine stuffing ingredients, the mix, water, butter and raisins. Mix thoroughly.
Place 1/3 cup stuffing mix on each chicken breast.
Fold ends of chicken over the stuffing. Wrap chicken bundle with 3 slices of bacon.
Combine topping ingredients of nuts, orange rind and sugar in pie plate. Roll chicken in nut mixture.
Place on baking sheet. Sprinkle with remaining nut mixture. Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Breakfast
ingredients: 1/4 c. finely chopped green onion (stems only)
steps: Whisk sour cream, soup, green chilies, salsa, cumin and coriander together
in a mixing bowl.
Saute sausage; drain on a paper
towel
and crumble.
Melt butter in skillet; add eggs and cottage
cheese and blend.
Add parsley and onion and cook lightly until
set.
Add
tablespoon
sauce mixture and the sausage. Remove from heat when set.
Preheat oven to 325°.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Cream together margarine, Crisco and sugar.
Add 5 eggs (one at	a time).
Add alternately dry and liquid ingredients. Add vanilla and lemon flavorings.

recipes.title: Taco Roll-Ups
steps: Mix and spread on tortillas.
Roll up tortilla and wrap in Saran Wrap overnight or at least 6 hours.
Cut off in 3/4-inch slices.
Serve with salsa sauce.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Cookies
steps: Cream together all but flour and nuts.
Mix in flour and nuts. Form into logs about 1 1/2-inches in diamater; wrap in wax paper and freeze.
Slice 1/4-inch thick.
Cook at 350° for 7 to 10 minutes.
Watch color carefully, after 7 minutes they go from white to burned.
Remove from cookie sheet immediately.

recipes.title: Magic Biscuits
steps: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water.
Sift flour, soda, salt, baking powder and sugar together.
Cut in shortening with blender or fork.
Add yeast and milk to dry mixture.
Mix to stiff dough. Knead; pinch off biscuits or roll out.
Allow to rise for 10 minutes.
Bake at 425°.

recipes.title: Chewies
steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients well.
Add remaining ingredients; mix until well blended.
Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes at 325°.
Sprinkle top with powdered sugar while warm.
When center sinks and pulls away from sides of pan, Chewies are done.

recipes.title: Mud Cake Chocolate Sheet
steps: Mix all dry ingredients and set aside.
Bring all liquid to a boil in a small saucepan.
Pour into dry ingredients and mix. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350°.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Mix together eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla. Sift together flour, soda, cinnamon, salt and baking powder. Add to the batter, mixing thoroughly. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake in preheated 350° oven for
1 hour. Wrap the warm bread in foil.

recipes.title: Chicken And Cucumbers
steps: Bone chicken; remove skin and chop into half-inch pieces. Clean scallions; cut crosswise into quarter-inch pieces.
Add to chicken.
Add sugar, salt, soy sauce, wine, egg white and cornstarch to chicken.
Marinate for 30 minutes.
Peel cukes.
Cut in half lengthwise; scoop out seeds.
Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon salt on cukes.
Let sit for 15 to 20 minutes; drain.
Cut into half-inch cubes.
Smash garlic; chop into rice-size bits.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok.
Stir-fry cukes for about 1 1/2 minutes; remove.
Add 1 tablespoon water to chicken; stir well.
Heat 1/4 cup oil and cook garlic for 15 seconds.
Add chicken; cook for 1 minute.
Add 2 tablespoons soy sauce and stir-fry for 15 to 20 seconds.
Return cukes to pan.
Stir-fry for 1 to 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Coquilles St. Jacques(This Is A Classic)
steps: Wash scallops and drain.
In medium saucepan, cook and stir onion in butter until onion is tender.
Add scallops, mushrooms, lemon juice, salt, marjoram, paprika and sherry; simmer, uncovered, exactly 2 minutes.
Drain liquid from scallop mixture; set aside.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Crackles
steps: In small bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt.
In large bowl, beat margarine and peanut butter until well blended.
Beat in sugars until blended.
Beat in egg and vanilla.
Gradually beat in flour mixture until well mixed.
Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Roll in granulated sugar.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake in preheated 375° oven for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Remove from oven and quickly press star firmly into top of each cookie (cookies will crack around edges).
Remove to wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
steps: Mix filling ingredients in order.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake in a preheated 425° oven for 15 minutes; then reduce heat to 350° and continue baking for 45 minutes or until a knife blade comes out clean.
Double this recipe for 2 pies.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: When thoroughly mixed, place into prepared pan.
On top of mixture, add 1 tablespoon butter in small pats or 2 bacon slices cut in half.
Bake around 1 hour or until brown.
Serve hot or cold.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Rich Dinner Rolls
steps: Scald milk.
Stir in sugar, salt and margarine; cool to lukewarm.
Sprinkle yeast into warm water.
Add cooled milk mixture, eggs and 2 cups of flour; beat until smooth.
Stir in enough remaining flour to make dough.

recipes.title: Hungarian Keiffels
steps: Crumble yeast in sour cream.
Beat the egg yolks.
Add cream, then mix with flour mixture.
Knead ingredients to form a ball. Roll out in circles; fill with a nut filling.
Bake 8 minutes in 350° oven.
Brush with egg yolk and return to oven to bake 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of chicken soup
1 (6.2 oz.) pkg. long grain and wild rice mix, cooked
steps: Chop up cooked chicken. Stir together with remaining ingredients. Spoon mixture evenly into 2 lightly greased 8-inch square baking dishes. Wrap one dish in heavy-duty foil and freeze. Bake remaining casserole at 350° for 55 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Yield: 4 servings per casserole.

recipes.title: Date Pudding
steps: Cut up dates.
Dissolve soda in a little of the hot water, then pour all of hot water over dates.
Add butter and stir well. Add sugar, flour, nuts and last, add egg, slightly beaten.
Pour in greased tin and bake.
This batter will be thin.
Bake in a 350° oven for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Alice'S Butter Cake
steps: Cream sugar, oleo, and Crisco.
Add eggs; beat well.
Add flour, milk (3/4 cup milk and 1/4 cup water to make 1 cup) and flavoring; add nuts and cherries.
Grease and flour tube pan. Start in cold oven.
Turn temperature to 300°.
Bake 1 hour and 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed or 3 c. fresh sliced strawberries
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.
In medium bowl, mix strawberries, eggs and oil.
In large bowl, mix remaining ingredients.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix just until blended.
Pour into pans.
Bake 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Frosted Oatmeal Cake
steps: Combine butter, oats and boiling water in large mixing bowl. Let stand 20 minutes.
Add brown sugar, white sugar and 2 unbeaten eggs.
Mix well.

recipes.title: Chow Mein Noodle Candy
steps: Melt butterscotch chips in bowl in microwave.
Stir in noodles.
Add peanuts.
Drop by teaspoon on wax paper.
Let stand until cool, about 20 minutes.
Yields 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Mama'S Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix sugars, vegetable oil, and peanut butter.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Sift in flour, salt and baking soda.
Mix until well blended.
Form into 1-inch balls.
Press with thumb.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 15 minutes.
(All ovens are different)

recipes.title: Cabbage On The Grill
steps: Cut cabbage in 4 pieces.
Wrap 1 bacon strip around each quarter or a pat of butter.
Season and wrap in foil.
Place on grill about 10 minutes.
Turn over and cook about 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Mom'S Double-Crispy Chicken
ingredients: 7 c. corn flakes cereal, crushed to 1 3/4 c.
3 lb. frying chicken pieces, rinsed and drained
steps: Put crushed corn flakes cereal into shallow dish or pan.
Set aside.
In a small mixing bowl, beat egg and milk slightly.
Add flour, salt and pepper.
Mix until smooth.

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits
ingredients: 1 c. self-rising flour plus 1 tsp. baking flour
steps: Combine dry ingredients.
Cut in butter and cheese.
Add pimentos, milk; drop dough the size of an egg on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Garlic powder can be used.

recipes.title: Apple Pudding
steps: Mix and sift dry ingredients; add apples, eggs and melted butter.
Stir until well blended.
Bake in an 8-inch greased pan for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Yeast Bread
steps: Combine 2
cups flour, the sugar, salt, baking soda and yeast in	large
bowl.
Heat
buttermilk,
water and margarine until warm and add to the dry ingredients.
Beat with electric mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes.
Add 1 cup flour and beat on high speed
for	another
2 minutes.
Add 3 or more cups of flour to make
a
soft
dough.
Knead about 5 minutes.
Put in greased bowl; cover and let rise until double.
Punch down and shape into 2 loaves.
Cover and let rise.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Speedy Apple Crisp
ingredients: 5 to 6 c. sliced and peeled cooking apples
steps: Spread apples in a 9 x 9-inch baking pan.
Cut butter into remaining ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Sprinkle over apples.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes or until apples are tender and topping is golden.
Serve warm.
Yields 5 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chili Cheese Quiche(Appetizer)
steps: Beat eggs 4 to 5 minutes.
Stir flour, salt and baking powder together.
Add to eggs and mix well.
Fold in Jack cheese, cottage cheese and chilies.
Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.
Can be served warm or cold.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
steps: Beat sugar and eggs.
Add 1/2 cup of buttermilk and 1 cup coconut.
Melt 3/4 stick butter.
Add flavoring last.
Pour into pie crust.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until brown.
Makes 1 pie.

recipes.title: Yellow Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice following package directions.
When done, stir in margarine and soup (do not add water to soup).
In casserole dish, layer rice, corn and cheese.
Repeat, ending with cheese on top. Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes or in microwave on High for 7 minutes and allow to stand for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Stuffed Green Peppers
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
steps: Saute onion; add ground beef and cook until color changes; drain off fat.
Stir in 1/2 can tomato sauce and remaining ingredients and set aside.
Cut green peppers in half lengthwise; remove core and seeds.
Place peppers, hollow side up, in shallow casserole dish.
Spoon beef mixture into pepper halves.
Spoon remaining tomato sauce over peppers.
Heat, covered loosely, with wax paper for 19 to 22 minutes or until peppers change color and become tender.
Cover stuffed peppers with cheese (optional). Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Tried And True Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream margarine and sugars.
Add oil, eggs and vanilla; mix. Mix dry ingredients and stir into sugar mixture.
Chill at least 2 hours.
Place 1-inch balls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten with glass dipped in sugar.
(I color my sugar with food coloring.)
Bake at 350° for 9 to 12 minutes until bottom is golden brown.

recipes.title: Hearty Potato Soup
steps: In a large kettle, cook the potatoes, carrots and celery in water until tender (approximately 20 minutes).
Drain, reserving liquid.
Set vegetables aside.
In the same kettle, saute onion in butter until transparent.
Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Gently stir in cooked vegetables.
Add 1 cup or more of reserved liquid until soup is desired consistency.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Crumb Cake
steps: In large bowl, add the brown sugar, butter and flour. Mix as you would for pie dough. Take out 3/4 cup and set aside. To the large bowl, add the egg, cottage cheese, milk and baking soda. Beat on high speed. Stir in your favorite flavoring such as rum or vanilla. Pour into a 7 x 10 loaf pan and sprinkle the saved 3/4 cup of crumb mixture on top. Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 35 minutes. Fast and easy.

recipes.title: French-Style Green Beans
steps: Fry and drain bacon.
Mix the chopped onions, bacon and A.1. sauce into the green beans.
Heat 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Bogus Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. oatmeal, grind until it is powdery
steps: Cream all ingredients except chocolate chips.
Add chocolate chips.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 6 minutes.

recipes.title: Walnut Tassies
steps: Cream the cream cheese, flour and margarine together.
Shape into little balls.
Press in very small muffin tins.
Mix together brown sugar, egg, butter, salt, vanilla and nuts.
Fill the crust with this mixture.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Mix together flour, sugar and cinnamon. Mix together eggs, oil, vanilla and orange juice and add to flour mixture. Add remaining ingredients to mixture. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours in a well-greased and floured tube pan. When cool, remove and punch holes with a drinking straw in top of cake. Pour Buttermilk Sauce over cake slowly.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients; set aside.
Beat margarine and peanut butter until smooth.
Beat in sugars until blended, then eggs and vanilla.
Add flour mixture.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets.
Flatten slightly with fork.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potato Soup
steps: Peel potatoes and cut in cubes; slice celery and carrots.
Chop onion and put all in cooking pot.
Add water, parsley, bouillon, salt and pepper.
Cook until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes.
Mix together milk and flour.
Add to pot and cook until thick.
Cut cheese into cubes and add to soup mixture.
Cook until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Raisin Or Currant Buns
ingredients: 1/4 c. raisins or currants, finely chopped
steps: Sift flour once; measure. Add baking soda, salt and sugar; sift again. Cut in shortening. Add enough milk to make a stiff dough. Turn onto floured board. Knead slightly. Roll into a rectangle 1/4-inch thick. Spread with soft butter. Sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon and raisins or currants. Roll as for jelly roll. Cut in slices 3/4-inch thick. Place cut side down on baking sheet. Bake at 475° for 20 minutes. Makes 12 buns.

recipes.title: Hoppin Black-Eyed Peas
steps: Saute onions in butter.
Mix together with remaining ingredients and simmer until liquid is gone.
Stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Taco Bell Tacos
steps: Brown ground beef in skillet.
Add 1 teaspoon salt, chili sauce and pepper.
Simmer 5 to 10 minutes.
Combine flour, cornmeal and 1 teaspoon salt in mixing bowl.
Cut in shortening until particles are fine.
Combine egg and water; sprinkle over flour mixture while stirring with fork until dough holds together.
If dough is sticky, toss on well floured surface.
Divide into 12 portions.
Roll each portion on floured surface to a 6-inch circle.
Fry in hot deep fat at 375° until golden brown, about 1 minute.
Turn and brown other side.
Remove from fat and immediately fill each with 1 to 2 tablespoons warm ground beef, cheese and lettuce.
Fold in half. Makes 12 tacos.

recipes.title: Pizza Crust
steps: Mix yeast and water; stir well.
Mix flour, salt and sugar, then add oil.
Stir in liquid; mix well.
Let rise double.
Spread on buttered cookie sheet and top with sauce and your favorite toppings.
Bake at 425° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Makes two.

recipes.title: My Favorite Brownies
steps: Mix well the eggs, sugar and salt.
Blend in vanilla.
Add mixed flour and cocoa.
Stir in melted margarine and pecans.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Cool in pan.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: St. John Banana Bread
steps: Cream
butter
and
sugar.
Beat in eggs one at a time. Mix in	sifted dry ingredients.
Beat in mashed bananas.
Add nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan.
Bake at	350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
While cake is still warm, pour melted butter
over top and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Turkey Tetrazzini
ingredients: 6 c. leftover turkey or chicken, cut in 1 1/2-inch pieces
steps: Melt 3/4 cup of butter in a large saucepan.
Remove from heat and stir in flour, salt and nutmeg.
Gradually add 4 cups of milk and stock and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil 2 minutes or until slightly thickened.
In a small bowl, beat egg yolks with remaining milk; pour 2 tablespoons of hot mixture into yolks and then pour yolk mixture into saucepan, beating constantly until sauce is hot.
Do not boil.
Remove from heat and stir in sherry or wine.

recipes.title: Cream Of Carrot Soup (Creme Crecy)
ingredients: 1 qt. plus 2 c. chicken or beef bouillon
steps: In a large saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter.
Add carrots and onion and cook slowly for 15 minutes.
Add rice and 1 quart bouillon.
Cook slowly for 45 minutes or until carrots are soft.
Puree the soup in a blender a half cup at a time.
Return to pan and add 2 cups more bouillon.
Bring to a boil and add milk and 1 tablespoon of butter.
Serves 4 to 5 big eaters.

recipes.title: Farmhouse Pork And Apple Pie
steps: Cook bacon in an ovenproof 12-inch skillet until crisp. Remove to paper towel to drain.
Saute onions until tender; remove and set aside.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Cut butter into flour, salt and soda until well mixed.
Set aside.
Beat eggs; add sugar and vanilla and mix well.
Combine both mixtures, mixing well.
Divide dough into 3 balls and chill for at least 15 minutes.
Roll; cut into shapes and bake at 350° until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Broccoli Rice Whiz
steps: Cook rice in a large saucepan and drain.
Saute onion, bell pepper and celery in margarine.
Add onion, bell pepper and celery to the rice while still hot.
Fold in Cheez Whiz, chicken soup and milk.
Heat on low burner just until cheese and soup are well blended.
Fold in chopped broccoli.
Pour into a greased casserole and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Canned Green Beans
steps: Boil for 40 minutes. The beans need to be placed in a large pan covered with water. After your 40 minutes are
up, place in quart jars and seal.

recipes.title: German Hot Potato Salad
steps: Cook potatoes in skin until tender.
Cool, peel and thinly slice.
Fry bacon until crisp.
Add onion and cook one minute. Blend in flour, salt, sugar and pepper.
Add vinegar and water. Cook 10 minutes, stirring well.
Pour over sliced potatoes.
Add celery seed and parsley.
Toss gently.
Serve
warm.
Yields 6 portions.
Great served with roast beef or baked ham.

recipes.title: Dove And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 3 boxes long grain rice-brown rice/wild rice mixture
steps: Clean doves and pat dry.
Salt and pepper.
Use an 8 to 12-quart covered cooking pot.
Melt butter.
Add doves to pot equally distributed on bottom.
Cook slowly on low heat for 45 minutes.
Turn doves once.
Cover.
Add chicken broth and water to total the amount of liquid needed to cook 3 boxes of rice.
Do not cook rice before adding to doves.
Bring broth and water to a boil with doves still in butter, broth and water.
Add boxes of wild long-grain rice and spices without any more liquid.
Cook doves and rice for 45 to 55 minutes, or until rice is tender.
Gently fold in Chinese vegetables.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Banana Muffins
ingredients: 1/4 c. sugar plus 5 tsp. Sweet 'N Low or 1 1/2 c. sugar
1/2 c. liquid Butter Buds or 1/2 c. oil, margarine or butter
steps: Cream sugar, Sweet 'N Low and Butter Buds.
Mix dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture.
Add sour cream, bananas, vanilla and nuts.
Mix gently.
Pour into muffin tins.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Water Chestnut Salad
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, washed, drained and sliced thinly
1 pkg. (small) frozen English peas (still frozen), rinse
steps: Place first 5 ingredients in order in a big plastic bowl.
Mix together mayonnaise and sugar and spread over the top of salad. Sprinkle Romano cheese on top.
May use bacon bits and/or hard-boiled egg slices as garnishes.
Refrigerate for 8 hours or more before serving.
Toss just before serving.

recipes.title: Summer Sausage
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Keep covered 3 days, mixing every day.
On fourth day, roll out in logs.
Bake at 175° for 8 hours. Turn after 4 hours.

recipes.title: Dutch Carrots
steps: Fry bacon until crisp and remove from pan. Cook onion in drippings. Add carrots. Season with salt and pepper. Turn carrots into hot vegetable dish and garnish with bacon.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Creamy Crab Chowder
ingredients: 1 (6 or 8 oz.) pkg. frozen Alaska King crab
steps: Defrost, drain and slice frozen crab.
Partially fry bacon. Add onion, green pepper and garlic and saute lightly.
Add potatoes, water and seasonings.
Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Add crab, corn, milk and evaporated milk.
Heat slowly to simmer.
Combine flour and soft butter. Stir into chowder and heat gently to thicken.
Garnish with chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken Etouffee
ingredients: 1 (3 lb.) frying chicken, cut into pieces and skin and fat removed
steps: Lightly season chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in heavy pot and saute chicken until brown.
Remove chicken from pot.
Add 1 tablespoon oil.
Saute the onion, celery and sweet pepper; cook 15 minutes.
Add 1/4 cup water; cook for another 15 minutes.
Add chicken and 2 1/2 cups water; cook partially covered for about 1 hour.
Sprinkle parsley.
Turn off heat.
Let stand tightly covered for 10 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Sausage-Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
steps: Combine first 7 ingredients, stirring well.
Spoon into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Combine margarine and stuffing mix.
Sprinkle over casserole.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Deep-Dish Brownie
steps: Blend melted butter or margarine, sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl.
Add eggs and beat well with a spoon.
Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt.
Gradually add to egg mixture until well blended.
Spread in greased 8-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until brownie begins to pull away from edges of pan.
Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Brown Bread
steps: Mix chopped dates, soda and boiling water and allow to cool. Add butter, sugar and unbeaten eggs (one at a time).
Mix date mixture with flour, salt, vanilla and nuts.
Grease and flour 5 (No. 2) gold-lined cans.
Fill half full.
Bake at 350° until done, 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Take bread out of cans when still warm.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: Beat eggs.
Add melted butter and sugar.
Add mashed bananas. Mix together.
Add flour and soda.
Add nuts last.
Pour into greased loaf pan.
Bake for 1 hour at 300°.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) boneless chuck steak (1/2 inch thick)
steps: Cut steak into thin strips.
Sprinkle with meat tenderizer. Brown in oil in skillet.
Cut green peppers into thin strips.
Add onion, garlic, green peppers and celery to steak.
Saute for about 2 minutes or until vegetables are partially tender.
Combine cornstarch, beef stock and soy sauce; add to steak mixture.
Cook, stirring, until liquid is slightly thickened and begins to simmer. Add salt and pepper.
Serve immediately over rice.

recipes.title: Rhabarber Kuchen(Rhubarb Cake)
steps: Combine butter, 1/2 cup sugar, eggs and salt.
Gradually beat until frothy.
Add lemon zest.
Sift flour and baking powder; fold into egg mixture alternately with milk.
Batter drops heavily from the spoon.

recipes.title: Sausage Swirls
steps: Sift dry ingredients. Blend in oil. Add enough milk to make a stiff dough.
Roll thin on floured board into 10 x 18-inch rectangle.
Spread uncooked sausage on top and roll lengthwise. Chill. Slice and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Party Chicken
ingredients: 8 halves chicken breasts, boned and skinned
1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup (can also use celery soup)
steps: Line bottom of baking dish with dried beef.
Wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon and place on top of dried beef. Cover with a mixture of the soup and sour cream.
Bake at 250° for 3 hours.
No watching!

recipes.title: Pizza Crust
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients.
Stir in 2 more cups flour.
Knead until smooth and elastic, about 12 minutes.
Let rise in warm place until more than double, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Bake at 425°.

recipes.title: No Eggs Chocolate Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Scotch Chocolate Cake
steps: Into large mixing bowl, put 2 cups sugar and 2 cups flour.
In a saucepan put oleo, water and cocoa; bring to a boil.
Pour over dry ingredients and mix well.
Add eggs and buttermilk to which soda has been added.
Add vanilla and mix well.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in large pan (cookie sheet size).
Ice while cake is still hot.

recipes.title: Easy Peach Cobbler
steps: Mix milk, sugar, flour and butter.
Place batter in deep baking dish.
Pour canned peaches in center of batter.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Date And Nut Loaf
steps: In a bowl, sprinkle the soda over the boiling water. Cool. Add the sugar and egg; beat well. Add the flour, baking powder, dates, vanilla, salt and walnuts.
Pour in greased pan. Bake 1 1/4 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Spritz Cookies
steps: Cream the butter with vanilla extract; gradually add the sugar until fluffy.
Add the egg yolk and beat thoroughly.
Sift the flour, baking powder and salt together and add to the creamed mixture in fourths.
Mix until blended after each addition.
Fill mixture into cookie press and form cookies onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
Yield:
5 dozen.

recipes.title: Fresh Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 10 to 12 strips bacon, crisp and crumbled
steps: Mix ingredients together and chill 4 to 5 hours or overnight. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat eggs and add sugar and oil, mixing well.
Combine flour, salt and baking powder; add to egg mixture alternately with orange juice.
Add vanilla extract.
In a separate bowl, toss peaches with sugar and cinnamon.
Pour 1/3 batter into a greased, lightly floured tube pan.
Layer 1/2 peach mixture over it.
Cover with 1/3 batter and the remaining peach mixture.
Spread remaining batter over all.
Bake one hour.
Cool cake 10 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack.
Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Herb Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf sourdough or French bread, sliced
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients in a bowl.
Spread on one side of each bread slice.
Wrap loaf in foil.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh broccoli, washed, drained, and broken into bite size pieces
1/2 red onion, chopped in bite size pieces
Small pkg. roasted and salted sun flower seeds
1 can water chestnuts, drained and sliced in half
steps: Mix all together and let stand several hours in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Banana Surprise Muffins
ingredients: 2 Egg Beaters or 4 egg whites (1/2 c.)
steps: Spray 14 to 16 muffin cups with a nonfat cooking spray.
In a medium-sized bowl combine flour oats, sugar, baking power, baking soda and cinnamon.
In a large bowl whisk Egg Beaters.
Stir in mashed bananas, milk and corn syrup.
Add flour mixture; stir until blended.
Spoon into muffin cups.
Top each with about 1/2 teaspoon of jam each.
Bake at 400° for 22 to 24 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes in pan.

recipes.title: Hobo Stew
steps: Fry hamburger with onion and green pepper.
Drain off the grease and set aside.
Boil the potatoes, carrots and celery together until they are soft but not soggy.
Drain off the water. In a large pot, put it all together, folding it in carefully, and then add tomatoes and gravy, stirring carefully.
Season with salt and pepper.
Keep on low heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve over rice, mashed potatoes, noodles, toast or biscuits.

recipes.title: Pork And Bean Bread
steps: Add raisins to boiling water and set aside.
Mash beans with a fork in a large bowl until very smooth.
Add sugar, eggs, oil and vanilla.
Mix well.
Sift together dry ingredients and fold in.
Drain raisins and fold in with chopped nuts.
Spoon batter into three greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake in a 325° oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger and onion; drain.
Cut cabbage and place in bottom of casserole dish.
Pour cooked hamburger over cabbage. Mix tomatoes, salt and pepper together; pour over cabbage.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 325° to 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 or 12 oz.) pkg. broccoli pieces, cut
1/2 c. chopped celery, onion, green peppers, mushrooms
steps: Melt butter in greased casserole.
Mix with rice. Add other ingredients together with rice and cut up ham, chicken or turkey. Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
steps: In saucepan, combine sugar, milk, margarine and cocoa.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Boil 2 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in peanut butter, vanilla and oats until well blended. Drop onto wax paper.
Cool until firm.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
steps: Beat eggs first.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake in preheated oven at 425° for 15 minutes and then at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

recipes.title: Smoked Shrimp
steps: You will also need a 1 gallon Ziploc bag.

recipes.title: Easy Marinated Carrots
steps: Scrape carrots and slice into 1/4-inch slices.
Boil until cooked; add chopped onion and bell pepper last 10 minutes of cooking.
Drain and toss with dressing.
Chill.
Serves 4.
Goes well with grilled chicken, rice and bread.

recipes.title: Melting Moments
steps: In bowl, cream butter and sugar.
Beat in egg yolk and vanilla.
Sift together flour, cornstarch, salt and baking powder; stir in butter-sugar mixture.
Shape into marble-size balls and turn in rolled oats to coat.
Arrange cookies on greased jelly roll pan and bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes about 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Spectacular Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 (5.2 oz.) pkg. wild rice with herbs
1 (16 oz.) can French-style green beans, drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of celery soup
1 (8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, drained
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Prepare a 2-quart baking dish with Pam.
Cook rice for 5 minutes less than package directions. Mix remaining ingredients with rice; sprinkle with paprika. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes.
Makes 10 to 13 servings.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
steps: Stir dry ingredients together.
Add other ingredients in order and mix thoroughly.
Bake in a layer cake pan at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini-Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. zucchini, scrubbed and shredded coarse (not peeled)
1/2 c. uncooked long grain white rice
steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Grease a shallow 1 1/2 to 2-quart baking dish.
In a large skillet, heat butter and oil.
Add onion; cook until tender.
Add garlic and zucchini; increase heat to medium-high and stir 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with flour and stir 1 minute longer until flour is absorbed.
Stir in half and half, rice, 3/4 cup cheese and the salt and pepper.
Pour into prepared dish; sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup cheese over top.
Bake, uncovered, 30 to 35 minutes until golden and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let stand 10 to 20 minutes so custard has time to set before serving.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: 3 to 4 c. diced cooked chicken or turkey
1/2 of 1 lb. pkg. uncooked Creamette egg noodles
steps: Cook and stir celery and onion in melted butter in Dutch oven over medium-high heat until vegetables are tender.
Meanwhile, heat water in medium saucepan over high heat to a simmer.
Stir water, chicken, carrots, bouillon, basil, pepper and bay leaf into Dutch oven.
Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Remove bay leaf.
Add noodles and parsley.
Cook, covered, 10 to 15 minutes or until noodles are tender, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
steps: Mix first 7 ingredients together.
Spread 1/2 mixture into a greased 8 x 11-inch casserole dish. Layer chilies evenly over mixture and sprinkle both cheeses over chilies.
Cover with other half of mixture.
Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes. This recipe may be doubled.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Raisin Bread
steps: Sprinkle yeast over warm water.
In separate bowl, combine sugar, salt, cinnamon and butter.
Stir in mixed yeast.
Beat in 1 1/2 cups flour.
Add raisins.
Stir in remaining flour; knead, sprinkling flour on hands, and work surface until dough no longer sticks.
Knead about 10 minutes.
Form into ball and place in a greased bowl, turning to grease.
Cover and place in warm spot for 1 hour, until double in size.
Punch down and shape into loaf. Place in greased bread pan.
Cover; let rise 30 to 40 minutes. Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Icebox Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Form into 2 rolls; wrap in wax paper and chill overnight or until needed.
Slice to 1/4 to 1/2-inch each and place on pan.
Bake at 350° until light brown.

recipes.title: Beef Porcupines
steps: Mix beef, rice, onion and seasonings.
Form into small balls. Cook in hot oil in skillet turning frequently until light brown on all sides, but not crusty.
Add tomato sauce and water.
Mix well. Cover and simmer about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese And Onion Bread
ingredients: 1 egg yolk beaten with 2 tsp. water (for glaze)
steps: Saute onion in butter until soft.
Do not overcook.
Remove from heat.
Cool.
Dissolve yeast in a large bowl.
Add honey, beaten eggs and salt.
Mix well.
Add two cups of flour; beat well until sponge is smooth.
Add onion and butter; mix.
Add cheese. Mix in well.
Stir in 1 1/2 cups flour and 1 cup whole wheat flour.
Knead on floured board for five minutes or more.
Return to greased bowl.
Turn kneaded ball over in bowl to grease all surfaces.
Cover.
Let rise in warm place until double in size. Form into 2 loaves.
Brush with glaze.

recipes.title: Chicken Baba
steps: Clarify butter.
Flatten chicken breasts between waxed paper. Brown chicken on both sides in butter over medium-high heat.
Add mushrooms; cook about 10 minutes on medium heat.
Add Marsala; cook about 5 minutes.
Place Mozzarella on top.
It will melt quickly and chicken is ready to serve.
Goes well with steamed rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Fried Apple Pie Crusts
steps: Mix ingredients together and set aside.
Beat eggs and cream together.
Cut shortening into dry ingredients.
Add eggs and cream mixture to the flour and shortening. Cover and place overnight in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Drop Rolls
steps: Mix sugar and melted butter.
Add beaten egg and dry yeast dissolved in the warm water.
Add flour.
Drop by spoonfuls in muffin tins.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Spicy Shrimp Louisiana
steps: Cook shrimp about 3 minutes.
Set aside.
Combine spices*, set aside.
Slowly add water to flour; mix into paste, set aside.
Heat oil in wok or large skillet until hot.
Stir in onion, pepper, celery, garlic and cook until soft.
Mix in spices.
Stir in broth and tomato paste.
Stir in flour mixture.
Cook until sauce thickens.
Add shrimp, green onions.
Stir until blended.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Harvest Bread
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
steps: Combine sugar, shortening and eggs in mixer bowl.
Beat until smooth.
Add yams and orange juice concentrate; mix well.
Mix flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, cloves and salt together.
Add to batter, 1/3 at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Stir in pecans.
Spoon into 4 greased and floured coffee cans.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until loaves test done.
Remove to wire rack to cool.

recipes.title: Vegie Pizza
steps: Whip slowly with mixer until fluffy.
Butter on slices of sourdough French bread.
Toast under broiler.

recipes.title: Boston Brown Bread
ingredients: 1/2 c. rye flour or all-purpose flour
steps: You will need a 1 or 1 1/2-quart mold or 3 soup cans.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
steps: In small bowl, combine walnuts, cinnamon and 1/2 cup sugar; set aside.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 9-inch tube pan with removable sides.

recipes.title: Three Meat Goulash
ingredients: 3 medium size onions, peeled, halved and sliced
1 c. beef or chicken stock or broth (low salt) (this can be either self-made or canned)
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Heat butter in a deep pot that has a well fitting cover available that is oven proof.
Saute onions in pot and butter until transparent.
Add a third of the meat and stir on almost high heat for about 2 minutes.
You are not trying to brown the meat, just change its surface from red to white.
Add half the remaining meat to the meat in the pot and repeat process until all the meat is cooking in the pan and then stir and cook about 4 more minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie Bars
steps: In a mixing bowl, combine flour and sugar.
Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Press firmly into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
In a bowl beat milk, egg, vanilla and salt.
Stir in toffee chips and pecans; spread evenly over baked crust.
Bake for another 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool, then refrigerate.
When thoroughly chilled, cut into bars.
Store in refrigerator.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Curried Butternut Squash Bisque(A Spicy First Course Soup)
ingredients: 3 lb. butternut squash, peeled, seeded and cubed
salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
steps: In a heavy soup pot, heat oil over medium heat.
Add onions and garlic; saute for 2 to 3 minutes or until slightly softened.
Stir in curry and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken stock, cider, rice and squash; bring to a boil.
Reduce to low heat and cover, then simmer for 30 to 40 minutes, or until squash is tender. Pour mixture through a strainer set over a large bowl.
Puree the solids in a food processor or blender until very smooth.
Return the puree and liquid to the saucepan.
(May be prepared to this point and stored, covered, in refrigerator for up to 2 days.)
To serve, heat gently and season with salt and pepper.
In small bowl, stir together yogurt and milk and add a tablespoon to each serving, drawing a knife through to make swirls.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Cut broccoli in flowerets, discarding the thick stems. Toss together broccoli, green onions, bacon and sunflower seeds. Mix together remaining ingredients and stir into broccoli mixture. Refrigerate until serving.

recipes.title: Best Ever Banana Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mash bananas with potato masher; set aside.
Cream shortening and sugar well.
Add eggs and beat well. Sift flour with salt, baking powder and baking soda.
Add flour mixture alternately with bananas to sugar mixture.
Mix until well blended.
Stir in walnuts.
Pour batter into 1 large or 2 small well-greased loaf pans.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Crunchy Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 c. chopped cauliflower or 1 c. chopped carrots (optional)
steps: Rinse peas in hot water and drain.
Combine vegetables, nuts and bacon with sour cream.
Mix dressing and mustard; pour over salad.
Toss gently and chill.
Can make the day ahead and refrigerate.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
steps: In saucepan, combine soup and milk.
Cook as directed according to can.
When soup is just about done cooking, add bacon pieces and chives.
Stir until well blended.
When soup is hot, add shredded cheese and stir until all the cheese has melted.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Beat the cooking oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla well.
Add apples, then flour, soda, salt and pecans last.
Bake in a loaf or tube pan for 1 hour at 300°.

recipes.title: Quick, Easy Baby Food Cake
steps: In large bowl, mix sugar with flour, cinnamon, cloves, salt and soda.
In a separate bowl, mix eggs, vegetable oil and apricot and prune baby food.
Mix all together with dry ingredients.
Pam or grease tube pan and bake at 350° about 50 minutes or until light brown.

recipes.title: Seafood Gumbo
ingredients: season to taste (I use Nature's Seasoning)
steps: In a large pot over medium heat brown flour in oil until dark brown (not burned), stirring constantly.
Add onions, peppers and celery and saute until tender.
In a large bowl add tomatoes crushed up and water.
Season to taste.
Add to roux-vegetable mixture.
Add consomme and okra and bring to a boil.
Then reduce heat to simmer for 30 minutes.
Add shrimp; bring back to a boil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Reduce back to medium heat for 15 minutes. Then add crabmeat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring gently.
Turn off burner and cover with lid.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Carrot Crumb Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Combine first 9 ingredients in large bowl, stirring well.
Pour into greased and floured 8-inch square pan. Combine coconut, pecans, 1/4 cup baking mix, brown sugar and 2 tablespoons softened butter.
Sprinkle over batter.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes.
Combine powdered sugar and 2 to 3 teaspoons milk; drizzle over warm cake.
Cool completely before serving.

recipes.title: Pasta And Beans
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can Campbell's pork and beans
steps: Mix all ingredients together, except flour.
Mix flour in slowly, maintaining a smooth consistency.
Knead for 6 minutes.

recipes.title: Delicious Sweet Rolls Or Doughnuts
steps: Add butter and sugar to milk.
Add yeast, eggs, salt and flour; beat well.
Let rise until double in bulk.
Roll out to oblong shape.
Spread with melted butter; sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Add raisins, if desired.
Fold in half; cut into strips.
Roll into rolls, twisting as you go.
Let rise until very light.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham N' Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 c. grated medium sharp Cheddar cheese
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Place in greased casserole dish and cover.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Lemon Chess Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into 9-inch pie crust.
Bake 45 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Filled Star Cookies
steps: Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla extract.
Beat in egg yolks and orange juice.
Combine flour and salt; mix in 2 cups at a time until dough is soft.
Add flour if needed.
Wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight.
Roll out chilled dough to 1/4-inch thickness.
Use a star cutter to cut out shapes.
Use thimble to cut out 5/8-inch centers (these are the top cookies). Gather dough scraps and roll out to 1/4-inch thickness.
Cut out stars and put onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool and fill with jam.
Sift confectioners sugar on top.

recipes.title: Layered Cabbage Casserole
steps: Cut cabbage into small wedges; cook in boiling salted water until tender.
Drain.
Place wedges in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Set aside.
Melt butter in a small saucepan; stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Gradually stir in milk; cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly.
Pour sauce over cabbage wedges.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
steps: Cream together butter, Crisco, sugar and add eggs, one at a time.
Beat after each.
Add salt and flour.
Beat again.
Add water, cream and vanilla.
Mix well.
Then add walnuts.
Pour in greased tube pan.

recipes.title: Chicken "N" Rice
steps: Grease bottom and sides of large baking dish with butter. Cover bottom of dish with 1 cup uncooked rice.
Place several dabs of butter on rice.
Salt and pepper fryer pieces and place on top of rice.
Spoon 1 can cream of mushroom soup over chicken. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top.
Add water to almost cover chicken, approximately 2 cups.
Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake 3 hours at 250°.

recipes.title: Potato Pancakes
steps: Grate 2 cups raw potatoes into 1/4 cup milk.
Drain off milk; add egg and flour.
Season with salt and pepper.
Add minced onion.
Drop by spoonfuls onto well greased pan.
Brown on both sides.

recipes.title: Apricot Nut Cake
steps: Preheat oven
to 325°.	Soak dried apricots in the baby food apricots while you assemble other ingredients and grease a 10-inch tube
pan,
lining the bottom with wax paper cut to fit.
Mix all
at once the sifted flour, sugar, eggs, oil and flavoring, beating
until
smooth.
Add
apricots and pecans, mixing well. Bake
about 1 hour or until light brown and firm to touch.	Cool in pan before removing.

recipes.title: Grandpa'S Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs.
Sift remaining ingredients; add to creamed mixture.
Refrigerate dough and roll 1/8-inch thick.
Cut to desired shapes.
Bake on greased sheet at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Yield: 2 1/2 to 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Seven-Up Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar; add egg gradually.
Mix salt with flour and add Seven-Up with flour.
Use a large pan with hole in it. Bake 2 hours at 325°.

recipes.title: Apple Dumplins
steps: Mix all ingredients to make dough.
Roll out dough, fill with apple, sugar, cinnamon and butter; freeze.
When ready to use, thaw and make syrup.
Pour over dumpling.

recipes.title: Popcorn Salad
steps: In bowl, combine the ingredients.
Chill.
Top with grated cheese and crumbled bacon, reserved from mixture.
Rest should go into salad.
Use within three hours.

recipes.title: Jennies Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream shortening.
Add sugar gradually.
Mix well.
Add beaten eggs and vanilla.
Stir in sifted flour, soda and oats.
Form into small balls.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Boil chicken (when done, pull meat off bones), onions, celery, salt and pepper.
(Reserve liquid.)
Cook rice in 2 cups of liquid you reserved.
Put rice in casserole dish.
Pour English peas over rice.
Mix remaining liquid with soup mixture.
Put chicken on top of peas; pour soup mixture over that, then put a layer of cheese on top.
Bake at 425° until hot.

recipes.title: Enchilada Pie
ingredients: 2 or 3 bell peppers (red or green or combination)
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Slice onions and bell peppers.
Mince garlic.
Drain tomatoes.
Cook beef in a large frying pan until no longer pink.
Remove with a slotted spoon.
Add onions, bell peppers, garlic, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
Cook until soft, about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream the shortening and sugar thoroughly.
Add sour cream, egg yolk and vanilla.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Add to cream, blending well.
Chill and shape into balls, working with small portions at a time, keeping remaining dough chilled.
Roll out 1/8-inch thick on lightly floured surface.
Cut with floured 2 1/2-inch cutter.
Sprinkle cut out with sugar.
Bake on greased baking sheet in moderate oven at 375° about 15 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Mexican Wedding Cakes
steps: In large mixing bowl, cream butter, confectioners sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy.
Add flour, salt and pecans; mix well.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

recipes.title: Lady Fingers
steps: Mix sour cream, 1 Cup margarine and enough flour to form soft dough, approximately 1/2 Cup.

recipes.title: Boston Brown Bread *
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Spoon into three greased coffee cans or loaf pans.
Let stand for one-half hour. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Molly'S Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix sugar, flour and cocoa in saucepan.
Beat egg yolks with milk.
Gradually add water to dry ingredients; stir to blend. Stir some of the hot mixture into eggs, then mix all together. Cook until thick.
Add vanilla and butter.
Top with meringue.

recipes.title: Pizza Horns
ingredients: 2 loaves (1 lb. each) frozen bread dough
1 jar or can (14 oz.) pizza sauce
2 to 3 oz. pepperoni, minced or chopped
additional dried oregano leaves and Parmesan cheese
steps: Thaw frozen bread in refrigerator overnight or at room temperature 2 to 3 hours.
On lightly floured surface, roll out each loaf into a circle, about 10 inches in diameter.
If dough is difficult to roll, pat or stretch dough with your hands until 1/4-inch thick.
Brush surface with oil.
With pizza cutter or sharp knife, cut each circle into 8 triangles or wedges. Generously spread surface with pizza sauce to which oregano and garlic powder are added.
Leave about 1/4-inch margin on each side. Sprinkle with cheeses, green pepper and pepperoni.
Roll up each triangle beginning from the wide end.
Curve ends to form crescents.
Place on lightly oiled baking sheets.
Brush tops with egg white.
Sprinkle with additional oregano or Parmesan cheese. Bake at 450° for about 15 minutes, or until crescents are golden brown.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 4 1-pound coffee cans. Roll dates and nuts in flour. Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Fill can 1/2 full. Bake 1 hour. Cool in can 10 to 15 minutes. Turn out on rack.

recipes.title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Bake at 375° for 8 minutes.
Do not grease cookie sheet for baking cookies.
Very tender cookies after baking.
Leave cookies on tray a minute or two before removing.
Drop by teaspoonful on tray.
Makes 60 cookies.

recipes.title: Zesta Cracker Candy
steps: Mix milk
and
sugar.
Put in small pot.
Come to rapid boil. Stir
constantly
for 3 minutes.
Take off burner.	Add crackers, peanut butter and vanilla flavoring; mix well.
Pour in small square pan or glass with margarine (grease it lightly).
Let cool and cut in squares.

recipes.title: Hot Crab Dip
steps: Blend all ingredients together. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Mix ingredients well and bake for 1 hour or until done at 350°.

recipes.title: Vegetable-Lentil Chowder
steps: Combine lentils, water and salt in large saucepan.
Cook, covered, over medium heat for 30 minutes.
Cook onion and green pepper until tender.
Combine all ingredients.
Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Makes 6 large servings.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pound Cake
steps: Combine sugar, butter and buttermilk.
Beat until light and fluffy.
Add eggs.
Beat.
Add flour, then almond flavoring.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
steps: Separate eggs.
Beat egg whites.
Cream the cream cheese and sugar; add egg yolks, sour cream, lemon juice and vanilla.
Fold in egg whites.
Add flour.

recipes.title: Old Fashion Jumbles
steps: Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Cream butter or Crisco with sugar, egg, milk and vanilla.
Mix all ingredients together. Roll thin.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Place on slightly oiled sheet. Bake at 375° approximately 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Microwave potatoes.
Slice each potato lengthwise on the top. With a teaspoon, remove the center of potatoes to a bowl, leaving the potato shells intact.
Add 2 tablespoons of butter, 2 tablespoons of sour cream, salt and pepper to the potatoes in the bowl. Mix until smooth.
Divide the potato mixture evenly among the potato shells, mounding.
Sprinkle with cheese, if desired. Microwave at High for 1
minute per potato.
If more than 2 potatoes are microwaved at one time arrange in a circle.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 2 bunches broccoli (use only florets or tops)
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients.
In small bowl, mix mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar until smooth.
Add to salad, mixing well.
Put salad in airtight container and place in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Paper Mache
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients together in large bowl and allow to sit 24 hours.
Then add water and flour.
Mix thoroughly.
Can form over balloon or use in molds.	Allow to air dry.
Depending on the weather, sometimes takes 3 days.
Sometimes use clear acrylic spray depending on the project.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Fried Cauliflower
steps: Wash cauliflower; cut in small pieces with stems.
Boil in small amount of water until about half done and still somewhat crisp.
Remove from heat; drain and cool just until it can be handled.
Dip cauliflower pieces, one at a time, into mixture made of the egg and milk.
Coat generously with flour to which desired amount of salt has been added.
Fry in hot oil.
(May use deep fryer or skillet with 1/2 inch of oil.)
Brown lightly on both sides for approximately 5 minutes.
Ready to eat as finger food!

recipes.title: Potato Soup
steps: Wash, peel and cube potatoes.
Combine potatoes, water, bouillon, celery, carrot, onion, parsley and dash of salt and pepper.
Boil and reduce heat to a simmer until tender.
Add 3 1/2 cups milk, flour and butter; heat until hot and serve.

recipes.title: Peppery Hush Puppies
ingredients: 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and finely chopped
steps: Combine dry ingredients; add buttermilk, water, margarine and eggs. Mix well. Stir in onion and peppers. Carefully drop batter by teaspoon into hot oil (375°). Fry 3 to 5 minutes, turning once, until hush puppies are golden brown.
Drain well on paper towels. Yields about 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Artichoke And Shrimp Soup
ingredients: 2 cups grated American cheese (Velveeta may be used)
3 cans artichoke hearts (cauliflower or broccoli may be substituted)
steps: Melt butter; saute onion.
Add flour and blend.
Stir milk in slowly, stirring until smooth.
Add broth and seasonings.
Cook until slightly thickened on low heat.
Add cheese, parsley and artichokes along with shrimp.
Cook about 30-45 minutes.
(If fresh cauliflower or broccoli are used, parboil until almost tender before adding to soup.)

recipes.title: Fruit Cobbler
steps: Melt margarine in baking dish.
Mix flour, sugar and buttermilk together in medium size bowl.
Pour mixture over melted margarine. Pour fruit on top; do not stir.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Cook rice until rice is very tender; cool slightly. Prepare pudding with milk. Mix together rice, pudding and Cool Whip.
Add cinnamon to taste.

recipes.title: New England Clam Chowder
steps: Drain clams; reserve 1 cup liquid.
Fry bacon in skillet until almost crisp.
Add onion and celery.
Saute until tender; drain. Combine bacon mixture, potatoes, clam liquid, salt, pepper and thyme in large saucepan.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Add milk and clams. Heat thoroughly.
Do not boil.
Top each serving with 1 teaspoon butter.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pickled Beets
steps: Wash
beets and trim tops leaving 1/4-inch of tops.
Do not break
the
skin.
Boil until tender, peel beets and pour off juice.
Do
not
reuse.
In large pot mix vinegar, water, sugar and pickling spices.
When sugar is dissolved, add beets and bring to a boil.
Put beets in clean jars.
Bring juice to a boil and fill jars.
Seal while hot.

recipes.title: Cabbage And Tomato Skillet(Serves 4)
steps: Cook bacon in skillet (large) until crisp; remove bacon, reserving drippings in skillet.
Crumble bacon; set aside.
Add remaining ingredients in skillet; cook over medium heat, uncovered, for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in bacon.

recipes.title: Nanny'S Gingersnaps
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add egg and remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet.
Wet bottom of glass and flatten cookies.
Bake at 350° for 10 or 15 minutes or less.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
steps: Combine flour, sugar and salt in heavy saucepan.
Beat egg yolks; combine egg yolks and milk, mixing well.
Stir into dry ingredients; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and thickened.
Remove from heat; stir in vanilla.
Layer 1/3 of wafers in 3-quart baking dish.
Slice bananas and layer over wafers.
Pour 1/3 of custard over bananas.
Repeat layers twice.

recipes.title: Texas Hash
steps: Saute onion and green pepper in oil.
Add ground beef.
Cook until browned.
Add tomatoes, rice and chili powder.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, covered, in casserole and 15 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease a 9-inch square baking pan.
Mix together first 5 ingredients.
Set aside.
Combine milk, sour cream, vegetable oil, egg, chilies, cheese and corn.
Stir into dry ingredients.
Spoon into prepared pan and bake 30 minutes. Serve warm.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Nanie'S Banana Bread
steps: Cream the shortening, eggs, flour, soda, sugar, salt, then mashed bananas and chopped nuts.
Grease loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 70 to 80 minutes.

recipes.title: Pigs In A Blanket
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon (slice bacon strips in half)
steps: You will need several toothpicks (broken in half).

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
steps: Cream shortening, margarine and sugar. Mix until well blended. Beat in eggs; add flour with all dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add vanilla.

recipes.title: Whole-Wheat Irish Soda Bread
steps: Note:
Bake bread the same day you plan to serve it.

recipes.title: Play Dough
steps: Mix
and stir over low heat.
Slowly continue to stir until it kneads like dough.
The salt base allows mixture to crumble when dry, not gummy.
Store in 20-ounce canister.

recipes.title: Health Bread
steps: Put dates and raisins in a bowl with hot water; let set 5 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix together and bake in a 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
Makes 2 small loaves. Delicious.

recipes.title: Chocolate Delight
steps: Blend the first 3 ingredients together. Spread into a 9 x 13-inch buttered dish.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pizza
steps: Using a round pizza pan or a cookie sheet, lay crescent rolls out in pan and press edges together to form crust.
Brown sausage and cook bacon.
Crumble both on crust.
Beat eggs; add salt and pepper to eggs to taste.
Pour over meat and crust.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° until eggs are cooked in the middle.

recipes.title: Chicken Supreme
ingredients: about 4 chicken breast halves (2 c. cooked)
1 c. sour cream or 1 c. plain yogurt
steps: Cook chicken in water to cover with carrot, onion, celery seed and bay leaf.
Reserve broth and cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Sprinkle with lemon juice and curry powder.
Bring 2 cups chicken broth to boil.
Add rice and cook 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini With Meatballs
steps: Blend together broth and cornstarch.
Stir into zucchini and tomato mixture.
Pour over meatballs.
Continue baking 10 to 20 minutes longer.
Serve over cooked rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Lemon Fluff
ingredients: 4 c. pulled pieces angel food cake
steps: Mix gelatin, sugar and salt in top of double boiler.
Add eggs and beat.
Stir in undiluted lemonade and water.
Cook this custard until it coats a spoon (about 5 minutes).
Cool.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 to 5 large onions (4 to 5 c. minced)
3 (10 1/2 oz. each) cans condensed beef broth
steps: Cook minced onions and peppercorns in butter or margarine over medium heat, stirring frequently, until onions are light brown. Sprinkle onions with flour.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add beef broth, water and bay leaf.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes.
Discard bay leaf.
Put soup in ovenproof soup tureen or large casserole.
Place toast slices on top.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Place under broiler or in a 400° oven until cheese melts.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
steps: Mix pumpkin
and
dry ingredients thoroughly.
Add eggs and milk.
Pour
into 9-inch pie pan with unbaked crust.
Bake in 425° oven for 45 minutes.
Makes 1 (9-inch) pie.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
steps: Cream the margarine and sugar in a mixing bowl.
Add eggs, sour cream and vanilla.
Mix. Combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Beat until combined.
Pour half of the mixture into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle with half of the topping mix. Add remaining batter and topping. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Snowflake Square
steps: Cream shortening. Add sugar slowly while creaming mix.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Combine milk and almond extract. Add flour and milk alternately to creamed mixture.
Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry. Fold in. Pour into 10-inch square shallow cake pan. Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 30 minutes. Cool.
Frost as desired. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
steps: Cook noodles in boiling salted water until tender.
Drain off water, add ham, cheese, green pepper and cream of mushroom soup. Mix just enough to blend.
Put in greased casserole dish and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Hunter'S Delight
ingredients: 8 lb. meat, veal and pork or pork alone, cut in 1-inch squares, browned and salted
1 small can pimiento or 1 red pepper, chopped
2 (12 oz.) pkg. noodles, cooked and drained
steps: After meat is browned, add onions and peppers.
Add a little water and simmer a few minutes; add rest of the ingredients and simmer until hot.
Serves about 40 people.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Cake
steps: Mix eggs, sugar and oil together. Add flour, vanilla and nuts. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes in an oblong pan.

recipes.title: Pastry
steps: Pour boiling water over shortening.
Stir well.
Sift in dry ingredients and stir until nothing sticks to bowl.
May be chilled in a large ball or divided into smaller ones.
Wrap in foil before chilling.
Keeps well in refrigerator.
Roll to desired size for pie.

recipes.title: Aunt Mollie'S Salmon Loaf
ingredients: 1 can salmon with juices, skin and bones removed
steps: Mix all ingredients together (except parsley flakes).
Bake in greased loaf pan at 350° for 30 minutes.
Use parsley to garnish top of casserole.
Serves 2 "oink-oinks" or 3 normals.

recipes.title: Savory Spaghetti Sauce
steps: In a Dutch oven cook ground beef and onion until meat is browned and onion is tender.
Drain.
Add the next 8 ingredients. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Remove the bay leaf.
Serve over spaghetti.
Yield:
4 to 6 servings (about 1 quart).

recipes.title: Chili Rellenos Casserole
steps: Place chilies under broiler after washing; make a small slit in each pepper.
Blister on all sides.
Place in plastic bag for 15 minutes.
Put in cold water; peel and seed.
Cut Monterey cheese in strips and stuff chilies.
Put in casserole dish; sprinkle with Cheddar.
Beat egg, salt, milk and flour until smooth.
Pour over and bake 35 to 45 minutes, until knife blade comes out clean.

recipes.title: Spinach Bisque
ingredients: 1 pkg. (10 oz.) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
steps: In 3 quart saucepan, saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in flour, salt and nutmeg until smooth.
Gradually whisk in milk and water.
Add cheese; cook and stir over medium heat until melted.
Add spinach; cover and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes or until heated through.
Serve with oyster crackers if desired.
Yield: 5 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Johnnycakes
steps: In large bowl, put flour, corn meal, baking powder and salt in bowl; set aside.
Beat shortening, sugar and eggs; beat well.
Add the milk, then the flour mixture.
Drop a spoonful of batter onto the frying pan with a large spoon.
Brown the cakes on both sides by turning them with the spatula.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sauerkraut Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and lightly flour two 8-inch layer pans.
Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Add vanilla.
Sift flour, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Add to creamed mixture alternating with water.
Stir in sauerkraut.
Bake in preheated pans at 350° for about 30 minutes or until cake tests done.
Frost with your favorite icing.

recipes.title: Oven Steamed Rice
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In 2-quart ungreased casserole dish with a tight fitting lid, mix rice, salt and pepper.
Dot with butter.
Pour boiling water over rice.
Stir to melt butter. Bake, covered, 45 minutes (do not lift lid).
Add green onions. Mix lightly.
To serve, fluff up rice lightly with fork.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Cut and brown bacon with onion and ground beef.
Pour in casserole dish and bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Saucepan Cookies
steps: Pour melted shortening over brown sugar and add remaining ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes in a 17 x 12 x 2-inch pan.
Let cool 10 minutes.
Cut into squares and remove from pan when cold.

recipes.title: "The Best" Yeast Bread
steps: Have ingredients at room temperature.
Heat milk to lukewarm. Add yeast, stirring to dissolve.
Cream 1 stick butter, sugar and salt.
Add milk and yeast to butter mixture.
Beat eggs and add. Beat together.
Add 1 1/2 cups flour, mixing well.
Cover and let rise 1 hour.
Add 1 1/2 cups flour and mix well.
Refrigerate several hours or overnight.
Drop by spoonfuls into greased Bundt or tube pan.
Pour 1 stick melted butter over mix.
Let rise 3 hours.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Slice to serve.

recipes.title: Bacon-Onion Cheese Balls
steps: Fry bacon; cool and crumble.
Mix softened cream cheese, salad dressing, cheese, bacon bits and onion.
