When well mixed, form into ball and chill.
Ball may be rolled in finely chopped walnuts or pecans or parsley flakes.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Beat sugar and shortening together.
Then add eggs one at a time and beat.
Add rest of ingredients and beat good.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Ranch Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. butterscotch and chocolate chips (1 c. each)
steps: Cream together shortening, brown sugar and eggs.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix together and drop by tablespoons on greased cookie sheet (for smaller cookie, use teaspoon).
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Campfire Macaroni
steps: Brown and drain meat; add onion.
Cook until clear.
Add remaining ingredients except beans and cheese.
Cook until macaroni is tender.
Add beans and cheese.
Cook until heated through and serve warm.

recipes.title: Granola
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Mix first 5 ingredients.
Spread in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, turning and mixing every 10 to 15 minutes.
Let cool slightly, then add raisins and any other dry fruit you like.
Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Beat eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla until thick; sift the remaining dry ingredients together. Fold in the dates or raisins and nuts; pour into 2 greased loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until wood pick comes out clean.
Makes two loaves.

recipes.title: Special Potato Dish
steps: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, mix all ingredients together.
Chill overnight.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
ingredients: flour as needed to make soft dough
steps: Mix all ingredients well together.
Use enough flour to make a soft dough.
Roll out on floured bread board and cut with biscuit cutter.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° until brown. Will be soft.

recipes.title: Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 medium onion, fried in 2 Tbsp. oil
steps: Cook rice until tender in salted water.
Mix all ingredients. Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup diced Cheddar cheese.
Pour into flat bakeware.
Top with cooking cheese.
Brown cheese in hot oven.
Serve.

recipes.title: Snowball Cookies
steps: Cream
oleo,
powdered sugar and vanilla together.
Add flour, salt and nuts.
Put in refrigerator to chill;
roll in balls. Bake
at 400° until done.
While hot, roll in powdered sugar. Cool.
Roll in plain sugar.

recipes.title: N.D. Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream together all moist ingredients.
Sift together and add all dry ingredients.
Shape into small balls.
Dip in sugar. Flatten with fork.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake 15 minutes or until very light brown.
Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Gingersnaps
steps: Cream shortening with sugar.
Add beaten egg, then molasses, vinegar and cold water.
Sift flour, soda and ginger and add to first mixture.
Stir in as much of the flour as you can and knead in remainder.
Roll out.
Cut in desired shapes.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Dumplings
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Cut in butter.
Add milk to make a soft dough.
Turn onto floured board and roll 1/2 inch thick.
Cut into small squares.
Drop into hot liquid.
Cover closely and cook 20 minutes.
Makes 12.

recipes.title: Soft Pretzels
steps: Mix hot water and yeast until dissolved.
Stir warm water and brown sugar.
Slowly add flour.
Mix until smooth.
Roll dough until smooth and 16-inches for each pretzel.
Twist into shape.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Asparagus Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. (10 oz.) frozen asparagus or 1 1/2 lb. fresh, cooked tender-crisp and drained well
3/4 c. light cream or half and half
1/4 c. white wine or 1/4 c. more cream or chicken broth
1 lb. small shrimp or large shrimp, cut in pieces
steps: Blanch asparagus for three minutes in small saucepan.
Melt butter and stir in flour.
Cook, stirring, for one minute. Gradually add cream or half and half and milk.
Cook until thick. Stir in white wine, cream or chicken broth.
Season with salt and pepper.
Stir in egg yolk, cheese and shrimp.
Put in buttered casserole dish layered: one half asparagus, then one half shrimp. Repeat layer and top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. confectioners sugar (1 1/2 c. for not as sweet, if preferred)
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Work in butter until it disappears.
Add eggs and vanilla and knead until soft and pliable.
Pinch off piece of dough and roll into length of about 4 to 5-inches, twist and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Calico Beans
steps: Brown lamb and onion.
Add beans, ketchup, brown sugar, vinegar and mustard in a large casserole.
Top with bacon.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Biscuits For Your Dog
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well, roll out and cut with "bone" shaped cookie cutter.
Bake at 300° until very hard.
Fido will love these!

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Steaks
steps: Combine the first 3 ingredients; sprinkle on both sides of steaks.
Combine egg and milk in a shallow bowl.
Dip steaks in egg mixture, then dredge in cracker crumbs.
Pour oil to depth of 1/2 inch into large, heavy skillet.
Fry steaks in hot oil over medium heat until brown, turning once.
Remove steaks; drain off drippings, reserving 3 tablespoons.
In skillet, add flour, stirring until smooth.
Cook 1 minute.
Add broth and 1/2 cup milk; stir constantly until thick.
Add Worcestershire sauce; stir.
Serve gravy with steaks and cooked rice or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread With Ground Beef
steps: Combine cornmeal, milk, salt, bacon drippings, eggs, soda and corn in mixing bowl. Set aside. Saute ground beef in skillet. Drain on paper towels. Grease a large black iron skillet and heat. Sprinkle bottom with a thin layer of cornmeal and brown slightly. Pour half of the batter in hot skillet.
Sprinkle cheese evenly over batter, then sprinkle on the meat, onion and peppers.
Pour remaining batter on top. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.
Serve with a tossed green salad, iced tea and fruit dessert for a complete meal.

recipes.title: Sarah Matt'S Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless stew meat, cut in bite size pieces
oil, sugar, flour, salt, crushed red pepper and Mozzarella cheese
steps: Place butter and one "plop" of oil in a large kettle.
Cut up onions and saute in kettle.
Add salt as desired and 1 spoon sugar for flavor and browning.
When onions are soft and brown, sprinkle 2 spoonfuls (1 at a time) of flour and mix into onions.
It will be pasty.
Add meat and brown, about 30 minutes.
Add 4 cans of broth and 4 cans of water.
Add 3 to 4 bay leaves and a few sprinkles of red pepper.
Bring mix to a boil.
Cover and reduce heat to simmer for as long as you would like.
Serve in bowls with torn pieces of bread and cheese, letting the cheese melt.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Special White Rolls
steps: Mix
1 1/2 cups flour, salt, sugar, sour cream and milk in mixer
at
medium
speed until blended.
Dissolve yeast in warm water
and add it along with the melted margarine to the flour mixture; beat until smooth.
Remove from mixer and beat with spoon, gradually adding the remaining flour.
If dough is too sticky
to
handle, add a little more flour and knead for several minutes.
Place
dough in a large pan in a warm place and let rise until doubled in size.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: In a large bowl, combine broccoli, cauliflower, bacon, onion, tomatoes and eggs; set aside.
In another bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.
Mix until smooth.
Just before serving, pour dressing over salad and toss.
Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Irish Champ
ingredients: 6-8 potatoes, preferably Yukon Gold or Yellow Fins
steps: Peel and slice potatoes.
Just cover with salted water and boil until tender.

recipes.title: Banana Oatmeal Drops
ingredients: 1 c. mashed bananas (3 small to medium)
steps: *Use less sugar if using sweetened coconut.

recipes.title: Chestnut And Cranberry Dressing
ingredients: 1 lb loaf country bread, crusts removed, bread cut into 1/2-inch pieces and toasted
salt & freshly ground pepper to taste
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Butter a 2 1/4-3 qt. baking dish.
In a small saucepan over medium heat, warm stock until steam begins to rise, 3-5 minutes.
Remove from heat, and add cranberries; set aside.
In a large fry pan over medium heat, melt butter.
Add onion, celery, and carrot; saute, stirring , until tender and translucent, 2-3 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a bowl.
In the same pan, saute sausage, stirring and crumbling with a fork, until lightly browned and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Transfer sausage to bowl with vegetables.
In a large bowl, stir egg white slowly pouring in stock and cranberries.
Add bread and stir until well blended.
Let stand, stirring occasionally, until stock is absorbed, 6-8 minutes.
Add vegetable-sausage mixture, chestnuts, sage, thyme, and parsley.
Season with salt and pepper and stir to mix well.
Transfer to prepared baking dish.
Bake until brown and crispy, 45-50 minutes.
Serves 10-12.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Peel and slice potatoes; layer in baking dish with flour and salt and pepper.
Cover with canned milk.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Blend flour, cinnamon and butter with pastry blender. Sprinkle over apples in a 2-quart baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Serve with ice cream.

recipes.title: Banana Loaf
steps: Crush bananas in large bowl.
Mix in all other ingredients. Pour into lightly greased loaf pan.
Bake 1 hour at 350° or until knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Quick Spanish Rice
steps: Brown hamburger in
1 tablespoon fat.
Add other ingredients. Cover and
simmer
for
30	minutes.
Add more tomato juice if it is too dry.

recipes.title: Self Crust Egg Custard
steps: Mix flour and sugar.
Add to well-beaten eggs.
Add milk, evaporated milk, melted butter, salt and vanilla flavoring and mix well.
Grease a 9-inch pie pan with butter; pour mixture in pan and sprinkle with nutmeg if desired.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 fryer chicken, cut up (2 1/2 to 3 lb.)
steps: Combine the first 5 ingredients together.
After combined, place uncooked chicken on top of rice mixture.
Spoon soup over the top of the chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours, or until rice is cooked.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans pineapple tidbits, drained (1 lb. size)
steps: Place drained pineapple in baking dish.
Mix flour with sugar and sprinkle over pineapple.
Cover with cheese and top with crushed Ritz crackers.
Cut margarine into small pieces and place on top of crackers.
Bake at 325° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Add sugar to oil, then add eggs, pumpkin, spices (sifted together with flour), water and nuts.
Bake one hour at 350°. Makes 1 large or two small loaves.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Bean Salad
steps: Prepare rice and limas as labels direct. Drain black-eyed peas. Dice red pepper. In large bowl, mix peas, red pepper, parsley, lemon juice, oil, mustard, sugar and salt. Add rice and limas. Chill.

recipes.title: Company Chicken
ingredients: 3 whole chicken breasts, cut in halves
steps: Sprinkle chicken with salt.
Spread rice on bottom of greased 3-quart casserole.
Layer with mushrooms, then chicken.
Mix undiluted soups with savory and dry soup mix.
Pour over mixture in casserole.
Pour broth around sides to moisten rice.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° about 1 1/2 hours.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Sassy Cinnamon Muffins
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Combine egg, milk and oil. Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients.
Fill greased muffin pan 2/3 full.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Yields 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken
steps: Coat chicken with flour and salt.
Brown in oil for 10 minutes; remove from pan.
Reserve 1/4 cup pan juice.
In pan, stir honey, teriyaki sauce, chives, pepper and juice; heat to boiling.
Boil for 30 seconds.
Add pineapple; heat again.
Pour sauce over chicken.

recipes.title: Meatball Porcupines
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix thoroughly meat, rice, 1/3 cup water, onion, salts, garlic powder and pepper.
Shape into well rounded tablespoon sized meatballs; place in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Stir together remaining ingredients and pour over meatballs.
Cover pan with foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 15 minutes longer.
Serve with pasta if desired.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls "Ready In The Morning"
steps: At 4 p.m., boil first 4 ingredients together.
Set in sink in water to cool.
In a big bowl, dissolve the yeast in water.
Stir in cooled mixture, 2 beaten eggs and enough flour to handle easily.
Put in a greased bowl and let rise.
At 9 to 10 p.m., punch down.
Roll out in rectangle; spread with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon (3 tablespoons cinnamon, 1 cup sugar and 1 cup brown sugar).
Roll up and cut.
Makes about 40 if cut about 1-inch.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cocoa Cake
steps: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla in a large mixer bowl.
Add eggs and food color; blend.
Combine flour, cocoa and salt; add alternately with buttermilk to creamed mixture.
Stir baking soda into vinegar; fold carefully into batter (do not beat).
Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes.
Remove from pans.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar until light.
Beat in egg yolks.
Sift together dry ingredients and add to butter, sugar, egg mixture alternately with the milk and flavoring.
Beat well.
Carefully fold in egg whites.
Bake in a tube pan or
in 2 loaf pans.
Pans should be greased and floured.
Bake in a 375° oven until done.

recipes.title: Snickers Cake
steps: Mix cake according to directions.
Pour half
of batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Melt caramels with milk and butter over low heat.
Pour caramel mixture over baked cake.
Sprinkle 1/2 of the nuts and all of chocolate chips over mixture.
Pour remaining batter over this. Sprinkle with rest of the nuts and bake 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Beat sugar and Karo well.
Add eggs, one at a time and beat well.
Add butter, vanilla and pecans.
Pour in a 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. sirloin steak, cut up
steps: Brown meat in 1 teaspoon oil.
Add onions and garlic.
Cook until tender.
Add bouillon cube with 1 cup hot water, then add stewed tomatoes and green pepper.
Cook 30 minutes, then add cornstarch and soya sauce.
Cook 5 minutes longer.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage
steps: Mix all together and cook over medium heat until tender.
If cabbage seems to be quite moist, cut water by 1/2 cup.

recipes.title: Jollof Rice
steps: Brown beef in 12-inch skillet or Dutch oven.
Drain.
Add chicken, broth, mushrooms, rice, onion, green pepper, barbecue sauce and seasoning; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until rice is tender.
Add tomatoes; mix lightly.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice(Club Member: Kristi Mayfield)
steps: Cook rice in boiling salted water until tender. Fry 1/2 cup bacon until crisp. Add onion and green pepper; simmer until onion is soft and yellow. Add tomatoes, sugar, salt and pepper. Pour rice into strainer and rinse with hot running water. Add rice to onions, bacon and green pepper mixture. Mix well and pour into greased casserole dish.
Bake about 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Praline Pumpkin Bars
steps: Mix flour, oatmeal, brown sugar and butter; pat into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Ma Hettie'S Pound Cake
steps: Crem the butter, Crisco and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Alternately add 1 cup milk and flour mixture.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
steps: Heat oil over medium heat, add onion and cook until soft, about 6 minutes.
Stir garlic and bell pepper and saute 2 minutes. Blend in flour; add tomato sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in water, thyme, parsley and shrimp.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Turkey Goulash
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can mushroom pieces with liquid
artificial sweetener to equal 4 tsp. sugar
steps: Combine turkey, seasonings, tomatoes, juice, green pepper, onion flakes, sweetener and mushrooms with liquid.
Bring to a boil.
Add macaroni and continue to boil, uncovered, until macaroni absorbs all of the juice and is tender, about 20 minutes. Divide evenly.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Skillet Sausage And Sauerkraut
steps: Melt butter in heavy pan; add sliced meats.
Cook 2 to 4 minutes, stirring until brown.
Add broth and stir 30 seconds. Add remaining ingredients and toss lightly to mix.
Cover and simmer over moderately low heat 10 minutes, until hot and flavors blend.
Makes 3 to 4 servings.
Contains 311 calories.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
steps: Cut cabbage in wedges or shred and cook in boiling water until tender.
Drain and place in casserole dish.
For sauce, melt butter in saucepan; blend in flour, salt and pepper.
Cook over low heat; stir until smooth.
Stir in milk; boil for 1 minute until thick.
Spread sauce over cabbage.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sundae Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Measure flour, sugar, 2 tablespoons cocoa, the baking powder and salt into bowl.
Blend in milk and shortening; stir in nuts.
Pour into ungreased square 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Stir together brown sugar and 1/4 cup cocoa; sprinkle over batter.
Pour hot water over batter.

recipes.title: Mexican Hash
steps: Cook and stir beef, onion, garlic and crushed red pepper in 10-inch skillet until beef is light brown. Drain. Add tomatoes, green pepper, raisins, salt, chili powder, cumin, cloves and cinnamon. Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
In separate pan, cook and stir almonds over medium heat until golden, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir almonds and olives into beef mixture. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake
ingredients: 1 small pkg. vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
steps: Blend cake mix, water, pudding mix, eggs and oil in large mixer bowl.
Beat at medium speed of electric mixer 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and walnuts.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Cool in pan 15 minutes.
Remove and cool on rack.
Fill and frost with Coconut-Cream Cheese Frosting.

recipes.title: Best Homemade Chili
ingredients: 2 cans (one 15 oz. and one 29 oz.) tomato sauce
steps: In a large Dutch oven or soup kettle, brown beef with onions; drain. Stir in spices and tomato sauce. Simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Combine flour and vinegar. Stir into chili. Simmer another 15 minutes or until thickened.

recipes.title: Hot Dog And Potato Casserole
ingredients: 5 c. raw potatoes, sliced 1/4 inch thick
steps: Place layer of half potatoes and onions and half of the hot dogs over bottom of 2-quart baking dish.
Drizzle half the margarine.
Season with salt and pepper.
Repeat, using remaining ingredients.
Pour warm milk over casserole.

recipes.title: Shortbread
steps: Cream butter, soda and sugar. Add as much flour as can be rolled in. Knead well. Cut in squares. Bake at 350 until done.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies(Early 1900'S Recipe)
steps: Sift together all dry ingredients.
Add liquids and mix well. Roll out dough 1/8 inch thick and cut in desired shape.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 450° for 7 minutes.
Makes about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Quick Cobbler
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Place margarine in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Heat in oven until melted.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
steps: Sift dry ingredients.
Add all but brown sugar and nuts.
Mix well.
Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle on top the brown sugar and nuts.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Hamburger Chop Suey
ingredients: 1 3/4 c. beef broth or 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in 1 3/4 c. boiling water
1 (10 oz.) pkg. Birds Eye Chinese style vegetables with seasoned sauce
steps: Brown beef and onion in skillet; add broth, soy sauce and sugar.
Add vegetables; bring to a full boil, separating vegetables with fork, stirring frequently until sauce and cubes are blended.
Cover and simmer 2 minutes.
Bring to a boil again. Stir in rice and remove from heat; let stand for 5 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
ingredients: 16 oz. can fruit cocktail with juice
steps: Mix all ingredients except coconut together.
Grease 9 x 13-inch pan (or may use small cookie sheet that has deep sides). Sprinkle 1/2 cup coconut on bottom of pan.
Then pour batter over the coconut.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Done when pick comes out clean.
Cool, then frost with thin icing (drizzle on).

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge(Microwave)
steps: Combine sugar, butter and evaporated milk in a 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Microwave on High for 9 to 10 1/2 minutes.
Add chocolate bits and marshmallow cream.
Microwave on High for 30 seconds.
Add chopped nuts and vanilla.
Stir until chocolate pieces are melted.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch dish.
Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Franklin Pecan Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add beaten eggs.
Sift flour, salt and baking powder.
Add 3 cups of flour mixture.
Pour last cup of flour over fruits and pecans.
Add this to other ingredients.
Add flavoring, mix well.
Grease and flour a tube pan.
Pour cake in pan.
Bake in 300° oven for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Fruit Bread
steps: Blend together the butter and sugar and beat.
Mix flour, baking powder and soda and add to butter mixture.
Add beaten egg and gradually add buttermilk.
Fold in raisins.
Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Aunt Gin'S Pound Cake
steps: Cream together sugar, Crisco and butter and add eggs, one at a time.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Add the creamed mixture to the flour mixture.
Add milk and vanilla.
Bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes, depending on oven.

recipes.title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Spray 2-quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray; set aside.
In small saucepan over medium heat, melt butter.
Stir in flour and salt until smooth.
Gradually stir in milk.
Bring to a boil, stirring frequently.
Boil 2 minutes until thickened, stirring constantly.
Add cheese and chives; stir until cheese is melted.
Arrange potato slices in prepared baking dish. Spoon cheese-chive mixture over potato slices.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake 45 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 30 minutes more until potatoes are tender and top is golden brown.
Garnish with fresh chives.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Gourmet Deer Chili
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can Ro-Tel tomatoes with green chilies, diced
3 hot jalapeno peppers, diced with seeds
steps: Cube meat and
grind
with
hamburger plate of electric grinder.
In a large
pot, heat olive oil and saute garlic for 1 minute.
Add onion
and
ground
meat.
Cook
until
meat is done. Add next 17
ingredients;
bring
to a boil.
Cover and simmer 1 hour,
stirring occasionally.
Slowly stir in cracker meal.
Let simmer 10 more minutes, stirring frequently.
Serve hot with crackers, Fritos or French-style garlic bread.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Grease
two
x 11-inch or 9 x 9-inch pans.
Pour
the batter into the baking pans and spread evenly with a rubber scraper or spoon.
Bake in the oven until the bread tests
done;
a
wooden
toothpick
or
metal skewer inserted in the center comes out clean.
Remove bread from the oven.
Let the pans
cool
somewhat
on
metal
racks
before cutting into serving pieces.

recipes.title: Grandma Mary Ann'S Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream shortenings and sugars.
Mix in honey, eggs and vanilla. Stir in cinnamon, salt, flour, baking soda, oatmeal, nuts and raisins.
Drop teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheets.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Queen Elizabeth Cake
steps: Mix together sugar, shortening, egg and vanilla.
Add flour, baking powder and soda.
Next, add remaining ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tests done.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dessert
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple (in its own juice)
steps: Mix pineapple and jello in bowl and heat in microwave for 4 minutes.
In another bowl, mix buttermilk and Cool Whip.
Combine with other ingredients and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Spice Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and applesauce.
Sift flour, soda and spices together and gradually add to cake mixture.
Melt chocolate over hot water and add to cake for a lovely rich color. Makes 3 large 9-inch layers.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Ice.

recipes.title: Spinach-Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh spinach, washed and chopped
4 Tbsp. finely grated fresh Parmesan cheese
1/2 c. fresh whole wheat bread crumbs
steps: Cook for 40 minutes the brown rice and vegetable broth. Prepare the Cheddar cheese, parsley and fresh spinach while rice is cooking.
After rice has cooked 30 minutes, preheat oven to 350°. Mix cooked rice with the Cheddar cheese mixture adding garlic powder, black pepper and eggs.
Spoon mixture into greased casserole dish.
Top with mixture of Parmesan cheese, melted butter and bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Date Bread
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Stir in egg.
Mix well.
Combine dates, juice, rind, 1 teaspoon soda and hot water.
Cool.
Add to sugar and butter mixture.
Combine flour, 1 teaspoon soda and salt.
Add to first mixture.
Stir in nuts.
Pour into standard sized, oiled loaf pan.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Maryland She-Crab Soup
steps: Melt butter in pan.
Add celery and onions.
Saute until tender.
Blend in flour and seasonings.
Gradually add chicken broth, stirring constantly.
Heat to boiling.
Add cream and crabmeat.
Season with nutmeg to taste.
Do not boil!

recipes.title: Microwave Cabbage Rolls Italian Style
steps: In 3-quart casserole, place cabbage and water.
Cover and microwave on High for 7 to 9 minutes until leaves are pliable. While cabbage is cooking, mix together ground beef, egg, rice, onion and salt.
Divide meat mixture into 8 equal portions.
Place one portion on each partially cooked cabbage leaf and roll meat into leaf, securing with toothpick if necessary.
Return to 3-quart casserole, placing rolls seam side down.
Blend tomato sauce, sugar and oregano.
Pour over cabbage rolls.
Cover and microwave on High 15 to 17 minutes, rotating dish half turn and basting with sauce after 9 minutes.

recipes.title: Irish Potato Cakes
ingredients: 4 raw medium potatoes, grated very fine
steps: Mix all together and form into little cakes.
Fry in butter until brown.
Serve hot with syrup or butter.

recipes.title: Granny'S Lazy Daisy Cake
steps: Beat first 4 ingredients together.
Boil last 2 ingredients, add to egg mixture and mix well.
Bake in a 350° oven until done.

recipes.title: Super Seafood Supper
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. salt and dash of pepper
steps: Cook
celery,
green pepper and onion
in
butter
until partially cooked.
Combine these with seafood and pimento.	Mix sour cream, light cream, lemon juice and
seasonings
in
small bowl.
Combine 3/4 cup cream mixture, rice	and
drained mushrooms.	 Spread rice mixture evenly in well greased 15	x
9 x 2-inch
baking
dish.
Place seafood mixture on	top
of
rice mixture.
Pour remaining 1/4 cup of cream mixture over seafood. Combine
bread
crumbs
with remaining
butter.
Sprinkle
over casserole and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
May be prepared a day
ahead	and
refrigerated.
Allow
30	minutes
additional cooking time if refrigerated.

recipes.title: Prune Cake
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cooked and drained prunes, chopped (save juice)
1 box yellow cake mix, mix as directed
steps: Beat prunes, cake mix, cinnamon and nutmeg real hard.
Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.
While cake is hot, poke holes in cake layer. Mix buttermilk, sugar and melted margarine together; pour over the cake.
Heat and stir until all sugar is melted.
Bake in pan that the cake can stay in until all is eaten.

recipes.title: Yeast Biscuits
steps: Sift dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening until fine.
Heat milk, lukewarm only.
Dissolve yeast in milk.
Mix with dry ingredients and knead well. Roll out 1/4-inch thick.
Cut in rounds or squares.
(I prefer squares.)
Brush with butter and top with another round or square and butter top.
Let rise a few minutes before baking at 350°.

recipes.title: Pilaf Rice
steps: Saute onion in butter in large skillet until tender, but not brown, about 5 minutes.
Add rice and saute for 3 minutes.
Add bouillon
and salt.
Bring to boil.
Remove from heat.
Cover and let stand for 5 minutes.
Stir in almonds and parsley; fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Cherry Coffee Cake
steps: Cream the sugar with the oil. Add eggs, one at a time, beating until well blended.
Add flour sifted with the baking powder. Pour 1/2 into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

Spread the cherry pie filling over the dough. Sprinkle lightly with sugar and cinnamon. Add remaining dough and sprinkle with more cinnamon and sugar. Bake at 325° for 50 minutes. Drizzle with powdered sugar glaze when still slightly warm.

recipes.title: Oatmeal, Coconut And Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 box brown sugar, add white sugar to make 4 c. total sugar
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla; mix.
Add the flour, a little at a time, mixing well.
In 1 cup of the flour, mix the baking soda, baking powder and salt; add to dough. After mixing all the dry ingredients, add and mix the chocolate chips, pecans and coconut.
Then add the oats.
(The mixture may be so thick that you will have to mix by hand.)
Bake at 400° on top shelf of oven.
Bake until they are light, light brown.
Take out and let cool 5 minutes on pan, then remove to rack to cool. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Pecan Balls
steps: Mix well.
Roll to size of walnut or smaller.
Put on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 275° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: N.Y.  Cheesecake
steps: Mix all ingredients in order given, beating well after each. Pour in well-greased 10-inch spring-form pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Shut off oven.
Leave in oven for 2 hours.
(Total:
3 hours; do not open oven door from start to end!!)

recipes.title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh spinach, washed, cleaned and torn into bite size pieces
1 can drained and sliced water chestnuts
steps: Combine ingredients in a salad bowl.
Pour dressing over and coat well to mix.
Serve at once.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Mix oil and sugar.
Add one egg at a time.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Mix together, then add carrots and nuts. Blend with mixer.
Pour in pan and bake (flour pans) at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Don't look until 30 minutes are up.
Cool and frost; add nuts on top.

recipes.title: Eggless Milkless Butterless Cake
steps: Mix together and let come to a boil the first four ingredients.
When cool add the rest of the ingredients.
Mix well and pour into layer pans.
Bake in moderately hot oven at 350 degrees until done.
Put layers together with Powdered Sugar Icing.
Can also be baked in a loaf pan.

recipes.title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch pan.
In large bowl, combine dry ingredients.
Add eggs, milk, oil and vanilla; beat medium speed 2 minutes.
Stir in boiling water (batter will be thin).
Pour in prepared pan.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Southern Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 egg plus 2 Tbsp. milk or water, beaten
steps: Wash chicken; drain on paper towel.
Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Dip in egg mixture.
Add spices to flour; coat chicken.
Fry slowly in hot oil until browned on both sides (about 35 minutes), turning as needed.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
steps: Peel and slice apples.
Melt butter.
Add sugar and flour. Pour over apples.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake in oven at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Deviled Ham And Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 pkg. dry Ranch style dressing mix
1/2 c. roasted, unsalted sunflower seeds or chopped pecans
steps: Combine all ingredients, except sunflower seeds or nuts. Refrigerate until firm enough to handle.
Form into ball and roll in sunflower seeds or nuts.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Eggplant Moussaka
ingredients: 1 large or 2 medium eggplants, cut into large chunks and unpeeled
steps: Steam eggplants for 2 to 3 minutes.
Saute onion, green pepper, garlic and celery in vegetable oil.
Add tomatoes and cook briefly (5 to 10 minutes).
Add to mixture the cracked wheat cereal and simmer 20 minutes or so until cereal is cooked.
(Add tomatoes or tomato sauce, if liquid evaporates).

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
ingredients: 4 pods hot pepper, cut up fine
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into lightly greased pan and bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Brownies
steps: Cream together the 1/3 cup sugar and cream cheese.
Add the 1 egg and mix.
Set aside.
Heat together the baking chocolate, butter and water until boiling.
Remove from heat.
Combine the 2 cups sugar and flour.
Stir into chocolate mixture.
Mix the 2 eggs, sour cream, salt and baking soda.
Add to chocolate mixture. Pour chocolate batter into a greased and floured oblong cake pan. Spoon cream cheese mixture across top and cut in with a knife to create a marbling effect.
Sprinkle top with the chocolate chips. Bake at 355° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Quiche
ingredients: 1 c. crabmeat or 1 (7 1/2 oz.) can crabmeat, drained
steps: Combine mayonnaise, flour, milk and beaten eggs; stir until well blended.
Then add remaining ingredients.
Pour into the pie shell and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix all the ingredients, except chicken, and put in a large oblong pan.
Put cut up chicken pieces on top of soup mixture.
Sprinkle 1/2 package of dry onion soup mix over all of the chicken.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Oven Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 c. Italian salad dressing (mixed, not dry)
steps: Place chicken in baking pan.
Combine all other ingredients and pour over chicken.
Add sliced mushrooms and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 325° to 350° for 1 hour.
Serve with Rice-A-Roni pilaf rice.

recipes.title: Yeast Dough For Sweet Buns And Cherry Bread
ingredients: 3 whole eggs or 1 whole egg and 4 yolks
1 c. sugar (3/4 c. for less sweet dough)
steps: Mix together yeast, milk and flour.
Let stand until spongy (20 to 30 minutes).
In a large bowl, put eggs, salt and sugar. Mix well, then add 4 cups flour.

You'll have a very soft dough. Next, add your first mixture. Beat with a spoon. Add 1/2 cup melted butter. Work butter into the dough mixture until smooth. Knead on floured surface, adding 1 more cup flour until smooth and elastic. Dough is kneaded enough when it becomes shiny and has little air pockets or bubbles in the surface.
Put dough in greased bowl and turn, leaving greased side up. Cover and let rise in warm place until double in size (approximately 1 1/2 hours). Punch down and make cinnamon buns or Cherry Bread.

recipes.title: Snowballs
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Heat oven to 350.
Roll dough into balls and bake on a cookie sheet or 20 minutes.
Roll in powdered sugar while hot and again when cold.

recipes.title: Strawberry Nut Bread
ingredients: 2 10 oz. pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed and chopped in blender or Cuisinart
steps: Combine first five ingredients in large mixing bowl. Make a well in the center of mixture.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
steps: Place butter/margarine in baking dish, and melt in oven. Mix sugar, flour & milk. Add peaches to mixture. Pour over melted butter. Bake at 350 degrees until light brown on top. Best to eat while warm.

recipes.title: Trail Side Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients and drop by spoonful on cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 350°. Makes large batch of cookies.

recipes.title: Grandmothers Tea Cakes
steps: Sift dry ingredients then cut in shortening.
Add eggs, milk, and vanilla.
Roll out dough and cut as desired.
Bake at 350 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients; cut in butter with knife or pastry cutter.
Add buttermilk, unbeaten egg and vanilla; also nutmeg and cinnamon.
Pour into greased 9-inch cake pan (round).
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Mix ingredients in order given. Grease and flour an angel food cake pan or a bundt pan. Pour batter in pan and put in cold oven. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach Quiche
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1/2 c. grated Swiss cheese or Monterey Jack cheese
steps: Melt butter in a large skillet.
Saute onions over medium heat until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add spinach and continue to cook, stirring often, until no liquid is left.
Add salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Stir well and allow to cool.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Beat eggs and cream together; gradually add to spinach mixture.
Stir until smooth.
Add cheese and combine.
Pour mixture into pie shells.
Place shells on cookie sheet and bake 30 to 35 minutes or until a knife inserted into pie comes out clean.
Serve hot or room temperature.

recipes.title: Gingerbread People
steps: Mix shortening, honey, egg and molasses.
In another bowl, sift soda, salt, ginger, cinnamon, cloves and flour.
Mix wet and dry ingredients to form dough. Roll 1/4-inch thick on floured surface.
Cut with cookie cutter. Decorate with raisins, nuts, licorice and tiny candies. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Angel Hair Pasta And Tomato Vinaigrette
steps: Cook pasta in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Combine tomatoes, garlic, basil, oil, vinegar and red pepper flakes in skillet.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cook until tomatoes are barely heated through and still firm, about 3 minutes.
Pour over drained pasta.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Granola
steps: Stir flours together.
Toast in heavy frying pan (no oil is needed) until well browned. Do not burn.
Place in large mixing bowl.
Add wheat germ, coconut, sesame seed and sunflower seeds which have been toasted individually.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake
steps: Mix together in a large bowl eggs and sugar.
Add salad oil, flour, soda, cinnamon, salt, pumpkin and vanilla.
Put mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased and floured pan and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Veal With Rosemary
steps: Cut the meat into cubes and lightly brown in hot oil, stirring frequently.
Add the onions and cook until golden.
Add tomatoes and seasonings.
Cover and simmer about 25 minutes.
Combine the flour and water and stir into the meat to thicken; stir.
Continue cooking until the meat is tender and the gravy thickened.
Serve over noodles or rice.
Yield:
4 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) pkg. raw bacon, cut up
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 325° for 3 hours.

recipes.title: No Bake Coconut Cake
steps: Sprinkle gelatine over	cold water to soften.
Cook egg yolks, sugar and
flour
until smooth.
Add salt and gradually add milk. Cook
slowly
until coats spoon.
Stir in gelatine. Refrigerate 1 hour
until
cool.	Beat
egg
whites;
fold
in cooled custard. Tear
cake	into
small
pieces.
Use half to cover bottom of sheet
cake
pan.
Pour
half
of custard over cake pieces. Sprinkle half of coconut over that.
Put rest of cake, then rest of	custard,
then	coconut.
Put Dream Whip, that has been
made by directions.
(May substitute with Cool Whip.)

recipes.title: Mamaw'S Yeast Rolls
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. shortening (add to hot water and let melt)
steps: Take sugar, salt and yeast, mix with flour; add the water. Mix until it gets like bread dough.
Keep adding flour until it is thick enough to knead.
Put in greased bowl and let rise until double.
Roll out and cut into biscuits.
Bake at 350° until golden brown; brush with butter.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Toast Cake
steps: Sift together flour, 1 cup sugar, baking powder and salt. Blend milk, shortening and vanilla.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes on 11 x 17-inch baking sheet.
Drizzle 1/2 cup melted butter over cake.

recipes.title: Two-Layer Cake
steps: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Fold in flour alternately with milk.
Add salt, lemon and vanilla.
Bake in 2 greased and floured cake pans at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake 2
steps: Sift together flour, sugar, soda, salt and cinnamon, then add eggs, oil, carrots and nuts.
Mix all together well.
Pour into angel food cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Carrot Bars
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pillsbury carrot and spice cake mix
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 15 x 10-inch pan (jelly roll pan) or two 8 or 9-inch square pans.
In a large bowl, blend oil, eggs and applesauce 1 minute on low speed.
Add cake mix; blend until moistened. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Stir in raisins. Pour into prepared pan; spread evenly. Bake for 25 to 35 minutes. Cool completely.
Frost with cream cheese frosting. Sprinkle with nuts.
Makes 36 bars.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Bread For Bread Machine
ingredients: 3/4 c. rolled oats (old-fashioned or quick oats)
1/8 c. molasses (light or dark corn syrup may be used)
steps: Measure ingredients carefully.
Place all ingredients in bread machine pan in the order recommended by the manufacturer.
Select basic cycle.
When cycle has been completed, remove loaf from pan and cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cookies
steps: Melt chocolate in microwave or in double boiler.
Cream shortening and sugar.
Add egg and beat well.
Add melted chocolate and vanilla and mix well.
Stir in broken nutmeats.
Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with sour milk.
Shape into rolls on waxed paper; wrap.
Chill thoroughly or overnight.
Slice thin (1/4-inch or less).
Bake slices on greased cookie sheet in 400° oven for 10 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Light Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup lukewarm water.
Put sugar, shortening and salt in container you are making rolls in.
Add 1 cup boiling water to mixture.
Stir until dissolved.
Add 1 cup cold water.
Stir in yeast mixture.
Beat egg and add to mixture. Add flour, 1 cup at a time, stirring.
Cover and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Salted Spiced Walnuts
ingredients: 1 lb. bag walnut halves or pieces
steps: Wash chicken wings and pat dry.
In a bowl combine the crumbled crackers or bread crumbs, herbs and Parmesan cheese. Add seasonings and mix well to blend.
Melt butter.
Dip chicken wings, first in melted butter, then into crumb coating.
Arrange chicken wings in lightly oiled ovenproof baking dish.
Bake chicken wings at 375° for about 30 minutes or until lightly brown and done.
Chicken wings should be tender.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Cornbread
steps: Mix well all ingredients.
Pour into greased and hot iron skillets.
Bake at 325° to 350°.
May be frozen for later use.

recipes.title: 4 Layer Coconut Dessert
ingredients: 2 small boxes coconut or vanilla pudding
steps: 1st Layer:
Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan; dump in flour and coconut and spread mixture in bottom of pan.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.
Cool completely.

recipes.title: Pickled Eggs
ingredients: liquid (from Pickled Beets; recipe in this book)
steps: Hard-boil the eggs.
Put eggs in cold water.
Keep changing the water to keep it cold.
Shell the eggs.
Put eggs in a container and place in the refrigerator next to the pickled beet liquid.
Next day, cover eggs with the liquid.
Put back in refrigerator for 3 or 4 days.
Stir or shake occasionally so eggs color evenly.
Serve cold.

recipes.title: Chicken A La King
steps: Melt butter in a heavy 2-quart saucepan; stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Remove from heat; stir in chicken broth gradually. Add cream.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add chicken and pimento.
Heat to serving temperature.
Serve immediately over toast or in patty shells.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
steps: Cut shortening into flour and salt.
Combine egg, water and vinegar.
Pour liquid into flour mixture all at once.
Blend with a spoon just until all is moistened.
This is an easy crust to make.
I roll the crust between wax paper and fold,
Put into pan. On the top crust I brush canned cream, then cut holes, sprinkle sugar on top and put little pieces of oleo on the holes.
I like to mix in a large tupperwear container and shape into balls.

recipes.title: Cheesies Potatoes
steps: Melt margarine in pan.
Quarter 6 potatoes.
In a bag, shake potatoes, cheese and flour until potatoes are coated.
Place in pan and bake until brown.
Bake at 450° for 30 minutes in 10 x 12-inch pan.

recipes.title: Honeyed French Green Beans
steps: Pour undrained green beans into a 1-quart casserole dish. Drizzle honey and Worcestershire sauce over beans. Place bacon strips on top. Bake at 350° until bacon is crisp, approximately 30 minutes. Serves 3 to 4.

recipes.title: Fruit And Nut Pies(Christmas Pie)
ingredients: 1 small can crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Combine cherries and pineapple in a saucepan.
Add sugar and flour.
Cook until thickened.
Sprinkle orange jello over mixture and stir until dissolved.
Cool mixture slightly.
Add bananas and pecans or walnuts.
Pour into the pie shells.
Refrigerate for several hours.
Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Sausage And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. long grain and wild rice
steps: Brown sausage and drain fat.
Cook rice as directed on package.
Add mushrooms and onions.
Serve.
Good warmed over with a little water added to moisten.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Cook ingredients over medium heat about 1 1/2 hours or until rice is done.
Beat 2 eggs and 3/4 cup sugar together.
Add this plus 1 teaspoon vanilla to rice mixture.
Cook together.
Add raisins and cinnamon as desired.

recipes.title: Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 (5 oz.) can water chestnuts, drained and thinly sliced
steps: In large skillet, cook and stir onion and green pepper in oil until onion is tender.
Stir in rice, water chestnuts, mushrooms and soy sauce.
Cook over low heat 10 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in beaten eggs.
Cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes longer.
Makes 4 to 5 servings (about 1/2 cup each).

recipes.title: Chop Suey Cookies
ingredients: 2 small or 1 large pkg. chocolate chips
steps: Combine
the
oleo,
sugars,
eggs
and
vanilla; cream together.
Mix the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Add the remaining ingredients; mix all together.
Drop mixture by spoonfuls
onto an ungreased cookie sheet.	Bake in a 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Crullers
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened
steps: Combine cream cheese and margarine, mixing until well greased. Add flour and salt; mix well.
Shape dough into ball; chill 1 hour.
On lightly floured surface, roll dough to 12 x 6-inch strips.
Fry in deep hot oil, 375° for 1 to 2 minutes or golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Roll in sugar.
Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Place broccoli in baking dish.
In a medium bowl, combine rice, soups, cheese, celery, onion, water chestnuts, egg and margarine.
Pour over broccoli and add 1/4 cup crumbled Ritz crackers on top.
Bake 30 minutes at 350° or until bubbly hot.

recipes.title: Orange Slice Cookie
steps: Dice the pound of orange slices and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of flour.
Beat eggs until light and fluffy.
Add brown sugar and flour and salt.
Mix well and add chopped nuts. Turn batter into a greased and floured jelly roll pan or 9 x 15-inch pan.
Bake at 340° for 35 minutes.
Cut while still warm and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Tropical Fruit Sherbet
ingredients: 3 medium kiwi fruit, peeled and quartered
1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed (undiluted)
steps: Mix all ingredients in electric blender or food processor until smooth (make sure the
top is on the blender or food processor).
Pour into 1
gallon
ice cream freezer and freeze according to
manufacturer's
instructions.
Serve immediately when ready.
Makes 7 (1/2-cup) servings.

recipes.title: Play Dough
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Add liquids.
Cook in medium size pot on medium heat until dough pulls away from sides of pot.
Add flavoring for smell and cake coloring for color.
Do not use Teflon.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
steps: Fry bacon until crisp in a wide 6-quart saucepot.
Remove bacon and all but 2 tablespoons of fat.
Save both bacon and extra fat.
Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon and cook until brown, stirring occasionally.
Stir in onion, green pepper and garlic and cook for 10 minutes.
Add more bacon fat if needed. Mash plum tomatoes with a spoon.
Stir the tomatoes and tomato paste, bacon, 1 cup of wine and 4 teaspoons each of oregano and basil; add all remaining ingredients into the sauce.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Taste after an hour of cooking and correct seasoning; herbs vary and so do personal notions of flavor.
If you make the sauce early, cool and refrigerate it until an hour or two before dinner.
Let it warm to room temperature before you reheat it.
Ten or 15 minutes before serving, blend in 1 teaspoon each of oregano and basil and 1/2 cup of wine.
Any leftover can be frozen for later use.

recipes.title: Bluebery Crunch
steps: Cut in 1/3 cup Butter. Sprinkle over the filling and bake for 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1 c. sharp or mild grated Cheddar cheese
steps: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Acorn Squash
steps: Cut squash in half, remove seeds and bake cut-side down at 350° for 50 minutes.
In skillet, cook pork, celery and onion until meat is no longer pink and vegetables are tender.
Drain fat.
Stir in salt, curry powder and cinnamon.
Cook 1 minute more.
Stir in applesauce and bread cubes.
Place stuffing in squash halves; bake uncovered 20 minutes more.
Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Blend the first 8 ingredients.
Blend in small amounts the flour and milk.
Bake in cold oven at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pie
steps: Mix all together; pour into unbaked pie shell and sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.
Bake at 350° until set, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Avocado Corn Quiche
ingredients: 3 ears fresh or frozen corn on the cob, scraped of kernels
3/4 c. grated Havarti cheese (or any white cheese)
steps: *Using your favorite pie crust recipe fit the dough into a 10-inch false-bottom quiche pan.
Line with foil and fill with rice.
Bake 10 minutes in a preheated 400° oven.
Remove foil and rice and bake 5 minutes longer or until lightly colored.

recipes.title: Quiche
ingredients: 1 c. meat, cooked and crumbled (bacon, ham, sausage or seafood)
steps: Pour into deep dish Pet Ritz pie crust.
Bake as directed on pie crust at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until firm in middle. Let set for a few minutes.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Mix shortening, sugar and salt in second bowl.
Add boiling water and mix well.
Add eggs; stir well.
Add flour and yeast.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and pack firmly into loaf pan or pan of similar shape.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for about 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Wacky Cake
steps: Mix all dry ingredients right in 9 x 12-inch cake pan.
Make 3 holes.
Put vinegar into one hole, vanilla into second hole and liquid shortening into third hole. Pour one cup water over everything.
Stir and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Valentine Cookies
steps: Cream butter or margarine and sugar.
Add egg and vanilla and beat well.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture with milk to form a dough.
Chill.
Roll out to 1/2-inch thickness.
Cut with heart shaped cookie cutter.
Place half of the cookies on a lightly greased baking sheet; brush each with water.
Cut smaller heart shaped centers from remaining cookies and place the heart frames on top of cookies.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool; fill center heart space with cherry filling.

recipes.title: 7-Up Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines lemon supreme cake mix
steps: Mix all ingredients in large mixing bowl.
Mix 3 minutes; bake in two 9-inch buttered and floured cake pans for 20 to 25 minutes or until done.
Cool.
Frost and fill with Pineapple Coconut Cream Frosting.

recipes.title: Banana Pound Cake
steps: Cream together crisco, margarine sugar and add eggs one at a time, beating well after each.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Mix together the bananas, milk, and vanilla, add alternately with flour mixture.
Bake in greased and floured pan for 1 hour and 40 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Butter Balls
steps: Cream Crisco and 1/2 cup of the sugar.
Stir in flour, salt, vanilla and nuts.
Mix well.
Make into 1-inch balls.
Place on cookie sheet, which has been rubbed with Crisco.
Bake in oven, 375°, for 12 to 15 minutes.
Roll in sifted confectioners sugar immediately after baking.
Cookies may be re-rolled in sugar after cooling, if desired.

recipes.title: Fudge Brownies
steps: Melt butter and margarine.
Add to the sugar, salt and cocoa and cream 4 minutes.
Add eggs and vanilla two at a time.
Mix in flour (do not overmix).
Add nuts.
Spread evenly on greased cookie sheet.
Brush lightly with milk or water.
Bake 23 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple
steps: Beat eggs, sugar and flour.
Add pineapple; mix well.
Place in greased casserole.
Sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Chow Mein
steps: Brown beef, onions and celery (I usually begin beef in a small amount of water and after awhile, pour away drippings).
To the beef, add onions and celery; continue browning.
Mix in casserole dish the soups, water, rice and soy sauce.
Add the browned beef mixture and stir.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Place topping of dry chow mein noodles on each serving.

recipes.title: Brown Bread
steps: In a large bowl, sift together dry ingredients.
Add beaten egg and buttermilk and stir into a soft dough.
With floured hands, knead dough lightly and quickly into a ball.
Shape dough into approximately a 7-inch round and place in a 9-inch pie plate. Cut a deep cross into the dough.
Bake in a preheated oven at 400° for 25 minutes and then lower the oven temperature to 350° for an additional 25 minutes.
Test for doneness as above.
Let bread sit for one hour before serving.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Chocolate Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla in large mixer bowl.
Beat on high speed for 3 minutes.
In separate bowl, combine flour, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Add alternately with water to creamed mixture.
Blend just until combined.
Pour into 2 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes, or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes; remove from pans.
Cool completely.
Frost with your favorite frosting.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Pie
steps: Cook chicken.
Debone and cut into small pieces.
Reserve 2 cups broth.
Place chicken in 9 x 12-inch pan.
In saucepan, mix broth and cream of chicken soup.
Bring to boil.
Pour over chicken.
In a bowl, mix margarine, flour, pepper and buttermilk to form batter.
Spoon over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Meatballs
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients together and form into balls.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Dinner
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned or 1 1/2 lb. sausage patties
1 can tomatoes or 1 can condensed tomato soup
steps: Put one layer of each ingredient, in order, in a large casserole dish.
Bake, covered, in casserole at 375° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Microwave Pralines
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in a 4-quart casserole, stirring well.
Microwave at High 12 to 13 minutes, stirring every 4 minutes.
Stir in soda.
Microwave at High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in vanilla.
Beat with a wooden spoon just until mixture begins to thicken.
Working rapidly, drop by tablespoons onto greased wax paper.
Let stand until firm.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
steps: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients except cheese and peppers.
Add grated cheese and jalapeno peppers.
Pour into two 9 x 12-inch pans or one 12 x 18-inch pan. Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Brownies
steps: Use a 9 x 13-inch pan to bake brownies.
Mix eggs, butter and sugar.
Ad flour, baking powder, salt and nuts.
Melt chocolate and add to mixture.
Pour in pan and bake at 350°
for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Salad Dressing Cake
steps: Sprinkle 1 teaspoon soda over the dates.
Pour 1 cup of boiling water over the dates and soda.
Let stand.
Mix together salad dressing, sugar, vanilla, salt, flour and nut meats.
Beat well.
Add the date mixture.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Spicy Apple Nut Squares
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped walnuts or raisins or both
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients by hand.
Sift together flour, salt, baking powder and cinnamon.
Add to mixture.
Then add apples and walnuts and/or raisins.
Mix thoroughly.
Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Spread mixture well into pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.
While still warm, sprinkle with powdered sugar and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Crab Soup
steps: Melt butter in top of double boiler; blend in flour until smooth.
Gradually add milk, stirring constantly.
Add crab meat and seasonings.
Cook slowly over hot water for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley or paprika.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Crunchy Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 c. Hidden Valley Ranch original salad dressing (prepared)
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Chill.
Garnish with bacon just before serving.

recipes.title: Texas Brownies
ingredients: 1 c. strong brewed coffee or water
steps: In a large
mixing bowl, combine the flour and sugar.
In a heavy saucepan, combine butter, shortening, coffee or water and cocoa.
Stir and heat to boiling.
Pour boiling mixture over the flour and sugar in the bowl.
Add the buttermilk, eggs, baking soda and vanilla.
Mix well using a wooden spoon or high speed of an electric mixer.
Pour into a well-buttered 17 1/2 x 11-inch jelly roll pan.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until brownies test done in the center.

recipes.title: South Of Border Dip
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
steps: Cook and stir on low heat the cheese, tomato soup, taco seasoning and Ro-Tel.
Add ground beef and rice.
Put over chips.

recipes.title: Cheese Snacks
steps: Add red pepper to sifted flour.
Work margarine and cheese together.
Work in flour and Rice Krispies.
Form into very small balls.
Place on a cookie sheet.
Press each ball flat with the tines of a fork that has been dipped in flour.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Cool just slightly before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 2 medium green peppers, cut in 1/4-inch strips
steps: Partially freeze steak.
Slic across grain in 2 x 1/4-inch strips.
Brown steak in oil in a skillet over medium-high heat for 4 to 6 minutes.
Add beef broth and next 4 ingredients.
Simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Combine cornstarch, sugar and soy sauce, stirring well.
Add to beef mixture.
Bring to a boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat, add tomato wedges and toss gently.
Serve over hot cooked rice.

recipes.title: Cherry Delectibles(May Be Prepared Ahead Of Time)
steps: Blend cheese and butter; work in flour until stiff dough is formed; chill overnight.
Drain cherries, reserving 1/4 cup liquid.
Combine cherries, reserved liquid and brandy; chill overnight.

recipes.title: Chitterling Fritters(For Bill Colgan)
steps: Mix all ingredients with enough milk to give a pancake batter consistency.
Drop by large spoonfuls into hot oil.
Cook until browned.
Bon Appetit, Bill.

recipes.title: Holiday Ham Balls
steps: Boiling fish is a favorite way
of preparing and serving fish in Denmark.
Usually only large fish are cooked this way, but slices of large fish, such as salmon, pike, halibut or carp are also excellent.
You should have a rack with 2 handles so the fish can be lifted out of the water without breaking it.
You can tie a cloth around it before it cooks.
Wash the fish well; sprinkle with salt and let stand a few minutes.
Lay on rack or tie it in a cloth, then drop it in cold water to which has been added salt and 2 tablespoons vinegar; bring to quick boil, then simmer slowly until done.
Test it with a toothpick for tenderness.
Serve with lemon sauce and parsley potatoes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Crunch Brownies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine sugar and butter in large mixing bowl. Beat at high speed until creamy, scraping bowl occasionally. Add eggs, beating until blended. Stir in flour, cocoa powder, vanilla and salt.
Spoon into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

Bake for 25 minutes or until edges pull from sides of pan. Cool in pan on wire rack. Spread with Marshmallow Creme. Combine chocolate chips and peanut butter in a 2-quart pan. Cook over low heat until blended, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in cereal. Spread over prepared layer. Chill, covered, until set. Cut into 36 bars. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Sand Tarts
steps: Cream together sugar and butter; add remaining ingredients. Roll in shape of a pecan. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes. When cooled, roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Okra Gumbo
steps: In the early
the Labor Day celebration on the "green" was a
festive
affair on St. Helena Island.
Visitors joined the crowd
of local islanders for a gala celebration at the picnic ground,
known
as the "bay or "green".
Tables and concession stands, set
up	by
individuals from Lady's Island and St.
Helena
Island, featured delicacies such as red rice, Hoppin' John (or
peas
cooked with rice), fish, crab, shrimp, fried chicken and ham.

recipes.title: Homemade Cheese Dip
steps: At room temperature, cream onion, cheese and canned cream together.
Add more cream, if too thick.
Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Almond Cake
steps: Grease pans well, then	flour.	Cream butter, margarine and Crisco; add sugar, then eggs.
After
this	is well mixed, add baking powder, almond extract,
flour and then milk.
Bake at 325°.
Bake until golden
brown
(toothpick
inserted comes out clean).

recipes.title: Mincemeat Cake
steps: If you want to frost cake before baking, whip one white of egg stiff.
Add 1/2 cup brown sugar.
Turn over cake and bake.

recipes.title: Vanilla Pudding
steps: Heat milk.
Mix sugar, flour and egg yolks.
Add from warm milk to make pourable.
Pour into hot milk; keep stirred.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla.
Cool.

recipes.title: Butternut Balls
steps: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly.
Stir in flour and salt. Add nuts; mix well.
Form stiff dough into 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.
Roll in powdered sugar while warm.

recipes.title: Sweet 'N' Sour Cabbage Casserole
steps: Cook the cabbage in 1 cup water and 1 teaspoon salt for 7 minutes.
Remove from heat, drain well and place in a 1-quart casserole.
Fry the chopped onion until crisp, remove from pan and set aside.
Blend the flour and brown sugar into the bacon drippings in the pan.
Stir in the beer and vinegar.
Add pepper, 1/4 teaspoon salt and the onion; cook lightly until onion is limp.
Return the chopped bacon to the mixture.
Pour this sweet-sour mixture over the cabbage and cook about 10 minutes in a 350° oven.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Macadamia Nut Brittle
steps: Lightly grease a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish.
Equally distribute Macadamia nuts over bottom of dish.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Apple Pound Cake
steps: Cut 5 or 6 peeled apples into small pieces.
Sprinkle with 5 teaspoons cinnamon (or to your taste) and set aside.
In a large bowl mix ingredients (except apples) until smooth.
Pour 1/2 cake mixture into a 10-inch greased and floured tube pan; add 1/2 apple mixture.
Add remaining cake mixture to pan and top with remaining apple mixture.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Cake will be golden brown when done.
Remove from pan immediately and cool.
Best served cool or cold.

recipes.title: Jagerschnitzel(Veal In Brown Gravy And Mushrooms)
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless pork or veal cutlets
steps: Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat.
Pound cutlets with a meat tenderizer to flatten them.
Season cutlets with salt and pepper, dredge them in beaten eggs and then coat evenly with bread crumbs.
Place cutlets into skillet and fry until golden brown (1-2 minutes in each side).
Remove the meat from the skillet and drain on paper towels.
Keep the meat warm in the oven while you make the gravy.

recipes.title: Cheese Grits Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. quick grits, cook about 2 to 3 minutes
steps: Cook grits in boiling salted water.
Meanwhile, melt 1 1/2 rolls of garlic cheese and 1 stick of margarine.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Waffles
steps: Sift together pumpkin, eggs, milk and butter.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and nutmeg.
Add dry ingredients to pumpkin mixture.
Stir until thoroughly combined.
Bake in waffle iron.

recipes.title: Summer Chicken
steps: Mix all the wet* ingredients with ginger and mix well.
Cut vegetables and put them all in the marinating dish with the chicken and marinade.
Place dish in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours. Mix the marinade every once in a while.
Place vegetables and sauce in a tin pan or tin foil.
Place it on the top rack or on the side of grill.
Grill chicken until done.
Serve with white or wheat rice.
It's good.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla.
Add egg and milk; beat until light and fluffy.
Sift dry ingredients together and blend into creamed mixture.
Divide dough in half.
Cover and chill at least one hour.
On lightly floured surface, roll to 1/8-inch thickness.
Chill other half of dough until ready to use.
Cut in desired shapes with cutters.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool slightly and remove.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Pat'S Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can green chili peppers, drained and seeded
steps: Place tomatoes, chili peppers, coriander and salt in blender; blend until smooth.
Add sour cream and blend.
Set aside.
Mix chicken, cream cheese and onion, also salt to taste, if desired.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Apple Hill Cake
steps: Mix apples and sugar (let stand).
Mix eggs, oil and vanilla. Stir in apples and sugar.
Sift flour, soda, salt and cinnamon. Add to mixture.
Mix well, adding nuts.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Forgotten Short Ribs
ingredients: 1 can tomato sauce or 1 bottle tomato catsup
steps: Salt and pepper ribs.
Put in Dutch oven.
In small pan combine remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour over short ribs.
Cover and bake at 275° for 4 hours or until tender.
Spoon off excess fat prior to serving.

recipes.title: Dutch Cookies
steps: Cream butter/margarine. Add sugar and cinnamon; beat well. Add egg yolk; beat well. Sift and add flour. Mix well. Press dough evenly unto greased cookie sheets or 12
x 15-inch pan. Brush with slightly beaten egg white. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and pecans. Bake 30-35 minutes at 300°. Cut into squares while warm.

recipes.title: Black-Bottom Goodies
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. semi-sweet chocolate mini morsels
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Make a well in center of mixture. Combine water, oil, vinegar and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients, stirring well. Spoon batter into paper-lined miniature muffin pans, filling 2/3 full. Combine cream cheese and next 3 ingredients, stirring well. Stir in chocolate morsels. Spoon about 1 teaspoon cream cheese mixture over chocolate batter. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Yield: 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Beet Wine(5 Gallons)
steps: *Used in flower and root wines because natural yeast is absent in these crops and it helps to carry fermentation further.

recipes.title: No Salt Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add shortening, sugar and 1 1/2 cups flour.
Beat 2 minutes at medium speed.
Gradually add, by hand, rest of flour.
Makes a soft batter.
Let rise about 30 minutes.
Punch down.
Beat 25 strokes.
Knead lightly.
Spread in greased pan; let rise again.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Baked Corn
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Butter a 2-quart casserole dish.
Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside.
In casserole dish, beat egg yolks with cream.
Stir in flour, sugar, salt and pepper.
Add corn and butter and mix.
Fold in egg whites.
Pour into prepared pan and sprinkle top with paprika; bake for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Onion Pretzel Snacks
steps: Break pretzels into bite size pieces.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt butter and add onion soup mix.
Stir well.
Pour over pretzels and mix well.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.
Let cool completely.
Store in tightly closed container.

recipes.title: Mock Lemon Pie
steps: Mix and cook together the first 5 ingredients.
Add eggs and lemon extract; cook a little bit more.
Cool and pour into baked pie crust.
Beat egg whites; add 2 tablespoons sugar.
Put on top and brown in hot oven.

recipes.title: Beer Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients and place in 2 greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.
Start in cold oven.
Bake 60 to 70 minutes.
Butter top 15 to 20 minutes before done.

recipes.title: Too Easy Peach Cobbler
steps: Butter 8 x 8-inch pan.
Slice peaches and put in the bottom of the pan.
Cut bread into 5 finger slices and put on top of the peaches.
Mix butter, flour, sugar and egg.
Pour over bread. Sprinkle with a little cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Six Week Muffins
steps: Mix together all dry ingredients.
Add other ingredients, mix thoroughly and store in covered bowl in refrigerator.
Do not mix second time.
Fill muffin cups and bake at 400° for 20 minutes. May add any fruit variation.
Will keep well in refrigerator for up to 6 weeks.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
steps: Break cauliflower into sections.
Cook for 10 minutes in boiling water, which has been salted.
Drain well.
Combine cauliflower with 2 tablespoons margarine, onion, cheese, sour cream and salt.
Spoon into a 1 1/2 quart casserole.
Melt remaining margarine and toss with bread crumbs.
Sprinkle over the cauliflower mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.
Yield:
10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Oven-Buttered Corn Chunks
steps: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt into a bowl.
Add milk and corn.
Stir until soft dough is formed.
Turn out on a well floured board or pastry cloth. Knead about 15 times.
Roll out in a rectangle 1/2-inch thick.
Cut into 1-inch strips and then into 24 pieces.
Roll in the melted butter and arrange in the pan.
Bake at 450° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Newburg
steps: Melt butter in a large pot.
Add onion and celery; saute about 10 minutes.
Add peppers and shrimp; saute 15 minutes more until shrimp are done.
Remove from heat.
Add flour and sauce mixes; stir well to get out the lumps.
Add 1 quart of milk.
Return to low heat and bring to a simmer slowly, until it thickens.
Add more milk; thin out if necessary.
Add parsley at the end of cooking.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Brownies
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped walnuts or 1 c. flaked coconut
steps: Melt shortening in saucepan; add sugar and stir until dissolved.
Cool 2 to 3 minutes.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.
Sift flour with salt and baking powder.
Add to first mixture.
Add vanilla, water and nuts or coconut.
Turn into greased 8 x 12-inch pan.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes or less in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: County Kitchen Chicken Pie
ingredients: 1 can undiluted cream of chicken soup
steps: Cook chicken until tender.
Remove meat from bones.
Reserve broth; cut chicken into small pieces and place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
In a saucepan, mix and bring to a boil the reserved broth and soup.
In another bowl, combine margarine, pepper, salt, flour and buttermilk.
Mix thoroughly to form batter.
Pour broth mixture over chicken.
Spoon batter over top.
Bake at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chinese Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cooked shrimp, hen or chicken
steps: Fry bacon. Remove from fat. Add onions and green pepper. Fry until slightly browned. Pour in soy sauce. Stir. Combine rice and meat. Add to onion mixture. Salt and pepper to taste. Heat. Add unbeaten egg and stir until blended well with rice. Crumble bacon over top.

recipes.title: Cordon Bleau
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts, skinned, boned and split
6 oz. Swiss cheese, cut into 6 sticks
steps: Pound chicken.
Season with salt.
Place ham and cheese on each.
Tuck in sides and roll, pressing to seal.
Coat with flour. Lightly brown in butter; place in a baking dish.
Stir mushrooms, water, wine and Heinz 57 sauce in butter in skillet.
Heat and pour over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender. Thicken sauce and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Honey Whole Wheat Bread
steps: Combine water, honey and oil in saucepan and heat to lukewarm. Pour into a large mixing bowl and re-check temperature.
Stir in the powdered milk, salt, yeast and 3 cups
whole wheat flour.

Mix well. Add the rest of the whole wheat flour and enough unbleached flour to make a nice springy dough. Turn out onto a floured board and knead until smooth, about 10 to 15 minutes. Put dough into an oiled bowl, turning to coat all sides. Cover and let rise until double, about 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Mix well and bake in unbaked crust in 375° oven for about 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Black Walnut Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter, shortening and sugar, then add eggs, one at a time.
Add rum and vanilla.
Add alternately flour, baking powder and milk, then add nuts.
Bake in a 350° oven about 80 minutes.

recipes.title: Sue Siegel'S Stew
ingredients: 2 lb. stew meat, cut into small pieces
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Put into ovenproof casserole and cover tightly.
Bake at 325° for 2 hours.
Do not remove cover until ready to serve.
Serve over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Taco Lasagna
steps: Brown hamburger and stir in the seasoning. In large round casserole, layer meat, then cheese, then tortilla. Repeat until all is used. Put beans and sauce on top. Cover with more cheese. Bake in oven until bubbly and hot, for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with sauce and sour cream.

recipes.title: Roasted Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 c. quartered, unpeeled small red potatoes
steps: Bake small red potatoes.
Fry bacon crisp, drain.
Chop potatoes, bacon, eggs and onions.
Add remaining ingredients. Mix well.
May be served warm or cold.

recipes.title: Zucchini Carrot Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan or 2 1/2 x 3 1/2 x 2-inch loaf pan.

recipes.title: Leek, Potato And Sausage Soup
ingredients: White part of 2 medium leeks (about 2 1/2 c.)
1/2 c. thinly sliced fresh spinach leaves
steps: In a dry, heavy saucepan, toast the cumin and caraway seeds over moderate heat, stirring for 2 or 3 minutes.
Transfer to a plate.
In the pan, cook the leeks in the butter, stirring occasionally for 5 minutes.
Stir in the broth and the potatoes (cut into 1/2 inch cubes).
Bring the liquid to a boil.
Simmer the mixture for 10 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the toasted seeds, Kielbasa, cream, and salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer the soup for 5 minutes.
Just before serving, stir in the spinach.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Corn Fritters
steps: Measure water into large mixing bowl.
Add yeast.
Stir until dissolved.
Stir in sugar, shortening, salt and egg.
Add flour and beat until smooth.
Cover.
Let rise in warm place for 40 minutes.
Stir down.
Stir in corn.

recipes.title: Canjica(Corn Pudding)
steps: Cook the corn as you would dried beans or peas until tender (20 minutes in the pressure cooker is one way).
Don't use a lot of water.
After the corn is done, add other ingredients.
(You may need more milk, coconut and sugar, depending on how the corn comes out.)
Before serving, sprinkle with cinnamon.
The texture should be creamy, but lumpy and not too thick.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Sausage Roll
steps: Make dough with flour and margarine.
Roll into a rectangle. Spread raw sausage over dough.
Roll as for a jelly roll.
Chill, slice and bake at 400° until sausage is done and dough is brown. Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Good Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients except oats and chips. Stir in oats and chips. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 100 cookies.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Melt butter in large skillet and saute chopped onion over medium heat.
Add meat and saute 5 minutes or until browned.
Add remaining ingredients except sour cream in order listed.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and cook just until heated through.
Serve over mashed potatoes, rice or egg noodles.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken And Rice
steps: Place rice in a buttered 13 x 9-inch Pyrex.
Add soup and water; mix well.
Place chicken on rice.
Bake 3 hours at 250°.

recipes.title: Easy Italian Cream Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. white cake mix (not the pudding in mix type)
steps: Mix all together.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 8-inch cake pans.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Sherry Cake
ingredients: 1 (1 lb. 2 1/2 oz.) pkg. yellow cake mix
1 (about 3 3/4 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
3/4 c. The Christian Brothers cream sherry
steps: Combine cake mix, pudding mix and nutmeg in large bowl.
Add all remaining ingredients.
Mix at low speed until moistened, then beat at medium speed 3 minutes, or beat by hand 150 strokes per minute!
Turn batter into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Bake, below oven center, in moderate oven at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes, until cake tests done.
Remove from oven and let stand in pan 10 to 15 minutes.
Turn onto wire rack and glass, if desired.

recipes.title: Pineapple Zucchini Bread
steps: Beat eggs well, add sugar. Blend in oil and vanilla. Add zucchini. Add dry ingredients, then pineapple, raisins, nut, and coconut. Mix well. Pour into 2 well-greased loaf pans (don't fill too full). Bake 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecued Chicken Wings
steps: Place wings in single layer on baking pan.
Combine all ingredients in a sauce pan and bring to a simmer.
Pour over wings and bake at 350° 1 hour.
Pan may be covered for first 20 minutes of baking.

recipes.title: Fruitcake Cookies
steps: Chop cherries, pineapple, dates and pecans in a large pan. Add soda and salt to flour; add to fruit.
Mix until fruit is well coated.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Loaf
ingredients: 2 c. sifted Martha White self-rising flour
steps: Hat oven to 350°.
Grease an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Mix together thoroughly sugar, shortening and eggs.
