Stir in buttermilk, mashed bananas and flour, then soda and fold in chopped nuts.
Turn batter into prepared pan.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes.
Cool in pans for 10 minutes.
Remove and cool completely.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup (do not dilute)
steps: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat.
Add meat and brown.
Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms.
Cook about 5 minutes.
Add soup and simmer, uncovered, about 10 minutes.
Stir in sour cream.
Heat through.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with noodles.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Bars
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In medium bowl, combine flour and sugar. Cut in margarine until crumbly.
Stir in 1/2 cup chips; press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Bake 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Special Mashed Potatoes
steps: Make mashed potatoes.
Add cream cheese, eggs, flour and minced onion.
Put in baking dish.
Top with French fried onion rings. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pasta With Artichokes
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen artichoke hearts or 12 tiny fresh artichokes
8 oz. fresh fettuccine (white, green or mixed)
1/3 c. toasted cashews, pine nuts or almonds, chopped
steps: Trim artichokes and prepare as for hearts, cutting in halves or quarters.
Or, if using frozen artichokes, thaw and use as they come in the package.
Saute onion in butter until translucent.
Add garlic, wine, lemon juice and artichokes.
Cover and cook over medium heat 1 to 2 minutes.
Add heavy cream and cook, uncovered, 2 to 3 minutes longer until mixture thickens slightly.
Add fresh fettuccine, cooked, chopped nuts and Parmesan cheese.
Toss, then add salt and freshly ground pepper to taste.
Serve with warm soup, sourdough French bread and Chardonnay wine for a Monterey Bay, California experience.

recipes.title: Almond Bark Candy
steps: Melt almond bark in 200° oven.
Stir in peanut butter; add remaining ingredients.
Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper.
Cool until hardened.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Mix
first
five
ingredients
together.
After this is well blended, add flour, cinnamon and nuts.
Pour in 2 greased and floured
loaf
pans
or 1 (13 x 9-inch) cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown.

recipes.title: Hearty Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 3 med. red potatoes, scrubbed and diced (about 1 1/2 c.)
steps: Combine broth, 1 c. water, carrots, and potatoes in a medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer over low heat 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pickled Okra
steps: Divide the okra evenly between 3 (1 pint) jars.
Place one dried chile and one tsp. of dill into each jar.
In a small saucepan, combine the water, vinegar and salt.
Bring to a rolling boil.
Pour over the ingredients in the jars, and seal in a hot water bath for 10 minutes.
Refrigerate jars after opening.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut And Noodle Dough
steps: Place sauerkraut and water in 4-quart size saucepan.
Begin heating.

recipes.title: Basic Crepes
steps: In mixer bowl, beat eggs lightly.
Add melted margarine or butter and mix.
Add remaining ingredients and beat until smooth. (Batter will be thin.)
Pour scant 1/4 cup butter into lightly greased and heated 8-inch crepe pan or skillet.
Tilt pan to coat bottom evenly with batter.
Cook over medium heat until brown; turn crepe to brown second side.
Cool pan slightly between crepes.
Spoon filling onto center of crepe and roll.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 small can sliced mushrooms with liquid
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in 325°
oven, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Parmesan Cheese Potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Place butter into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan and melt in oven.
Mix Parmesan cheese, flour, salt and pepper in a bowl with a cover.
Place potatoes into the mixture.
Shake until well coated.
Place in pan and sprinkle leftover mixture over the top.
Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Pudding Cake
steps: Combine together 1 cup sugar, flour, butter, baking powder and milk; pour into 9-inch square pan.
Over this batter put rhubarb, 1 cup sugar and boiling water.
Bake at 350° until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Oatmeal-Raisin Cookies
steps: Beat margarine at medium speed with an electric mixer. Gradually add sugars, beating well.
Add egg substitute and vanilla; mix well.
Combine flour and next 3 ingredients. Gradually add to margarine mixture, mixing well.
Stir in raisins. Drop dough by 2 teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet coated with cooking spray.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown.
Remove to wire racks to cool.
Yield:
3 dozen cookies (60 calories per cookie), 1.5 g fat, 00 mg cholesterol.

recipes.title: Green Rice
steps: Saute onion and pepper in olive oil.
In casserole dish, combine the rest of ingredients.
Add the onions and pepper. Cover and bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes or until rice is done. Stir to mix the rice and vegetables.

recipes.title: Jam Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into 3 layer pans and bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven.
Let layers completely cool.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
steps: Layer in Tupperware bowl the lettuce, cauliflower and peas. Sprinkle Italian seasoning mix on top.
Cover with mayonnaise and seal around edges.
Sprinkle cheese and bacon crumbs on top. Cover and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Coconut Dessert
steps: Beat together egg yolks, sugar and salt. Add to milk that has been scalded and cooled. Cook over hot water in double boiler until custard coats spoon.

recipes.title: Easy Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients thoroughly in a 9 x 13-inch rectangular cake pan.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cake
steps: Cream together first 3 ingredients, then add the remaining ingredients.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Grease and flour pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Scala
steps: Flour chicken breasts and brown in oil. Drain fat from pan and add consomme to chicken; simmer 25 to 30 minutes.
Add 1/2 to 1 cup sour cream to make a creamy sauce. Add several shakes of black pepper.
Put chicken and sauce in baking dish. Sprinkle with cheese and brown under broiler.

recipes.title: Raspberry Brownies
steps: Melt chocolate.
Cream margarine, eggs and sugar, then add chocolate.
Stir in flour and walnuts.
Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
Drop jam by teaspoonfuls over surface of batter. Swirl with fork to mix into batter.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
steps: Cream sugar and butter.
Add flour and eggs; beat well.
Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until brown on top.

recipes.title: Pizza Dough
ingredients: 3/4 c. plus 1 Tbsp. warm water (105~ to 115~)
steps: Dissolve yeast in measuring cup with warm water.
Stir together flour and salt in large mixing bowl.
Cut shortening into flour with pastry blender or two knives until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in dissolved yeast.
Turn out onto lightly floured board or pastry cloth and knead just until smooth.
Place dough in large greased bowl; turn once to grease top.
Cover and let rise in warm draft-free area until doubled in size, about 1 hour.
Punch dough down.
Divide dough in half.
On floured surface, roll each half into an 11-inch circle.
Place rounds on greased 12-inch pizza pans.
Make pizza as desired. Bake at 400°. Makes 2 pizzas.

recipes.title: Consomme Rice
steps: Mix all ingredients together and cover.
Cook in oven at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Sausage Bake
ingredients: 1 c. (16 oz.) tomatoes, diced or squeezed
steps: Braise sausage and drain grease off.
Add flour to sausage and add all ingredients.
Place in casserole dish.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Tea Cakes
steps: Cream the oleo, Crisco and sugar until smooth.
Beat in eggs. Sift together the flour and soda; add to creamed mixture.
Form into a ball.
Roll out on floured board to the thickness you desire and cut out.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes about 3 dozen, according to thickness.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Cream butter, beat in sugar and other ingredients.
Add enough flour (about 1/2 cup) to make mixture stiff enough for drop cookies (on a greased sheet) with floured fork, crisscross.
Bake at 350°. Makes 60.

recipes.title: French Eggs
steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Lay bread in 2 layers in pan. Cover each layer with grated cheese; sprinkle with bacon.
Mix eggs, milk and salt together; pour over top.
Let stand overnight in the refrigerator.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Baskets
steps: Crush shredded wheat biscuits until fine.
Melt chocolate in double boiler until soft.
Stir in peanut butter and add mixture to shredded wheat.
Drop by tablespoons onto waxed paper.
Shape into birds nest and place jelly beans in each one.
Chill.

recipes.title: Nut Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar in mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add eggs 2 at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add self-rising flour; mix well.
Stir in vanilla.
Combine pecans, walnuts and all-purpose flour in bowl; toss to coat.
Fold into batter.
Stir in apples.
Pour into ungreased tube pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/4 hours.
Cool in pan for several minutes.
Invert onto serving plate.
Yield:
16 servings.

recipes.title: Green Beans And New Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb. fresh green beans, strung and snapped
12 small new potatoes, washed and scrubbed
steps: Place beans, pork, onion, salt, sugar and water in Dutch oven. Cover and cook 1 hour. Add potatoes and cook 30 minutes longer or until tender.

recipes.title: Baked Potato Salad
ingredients: 5 lb. red potatoes, cooked, peeled and cut
1 lb. bacon, cut into small pieces, fried and drained
6 to 10 oz. medium sharp cheese, shredded
steps: Combine all ingredients except cheese.
Put in baking dish, sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Green Beans And Ground Beef
ingredients: 1 lb. green beans or 1 qt. can
steps: Brown onion and garlic lightly in fat. Add beef and cook stirring with fork 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce and 3 cups of water. Heat to boiling.
Add beans and cook 10 minutes.
Thicken with cornstarch blended with a little water.
Cook slowly 10 minutes longer, stirring often.
Serve on
hot rice.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dumplings
steps: Mix flour, oil and enough water to mix dough well.
Let set and rise about 2 hours or longer.
Roll out thin; cut in strips. Break into small pieces, about 2-inches or shorter.
Cook chicken; add bouillon to taste.
Add salt if needed.
Cook dumplings in broth; add chicken after they are cooked.
Add a little yellow food coloring for color.

recipes.title: Cabbage And Beef Soup
steps: In Dutch oven, brown beef.
Add all remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Yield: 3 quarts.

recipes.title: Party Mix
steps: Melt butter in large pan and add Worcestershire sauce.
Mix cereals and seasonings and add to pan.
Bake at 350° for one hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesy Macaroni Bake
ingredients: 2 c. fresh or thawed, frozen broccoli florets
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Spray a 6-cup shallow baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.
Cut the Cheddar-flavor cheese and the Mozzarella into 1/4-inch cubes.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water, enough to dissolve it, for a few minutes.
In mixing bowl, combine oil, brown sugar and salt and add milk.
Stir until cool.
Add egg.
Add about 2 1/2 cups flour and mix well.
Add flour until dough makes a soft mixture.
Turn onto floured surface.
Cover with greased foil and let rest 10 minutes; knead about 2 to 3 minutes.
Put in greased bowl and cover with foil and cloth.
Keep in refrigerator overnight; roll out dough to about 1/2-inch.
Cut into squares and dip in melted butter and put in pan in layers.
Let rise about 3 hours until double in size.
Cook in oven at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Heat 1 stick margarine and pour over when it comes out of oven.

recipes.title: Lemon Cream Cheese Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 2 baking dishes.

recipes.title: Wacky Cake
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in a bowl and mix well.
Combine flour and next 4 ingredients and mix well; add to the first mixture and beat 1 minute.
Pour into 9-inch baking pan coated with cooking spray.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Piggy Wraps
ingredients: 2 cans crescent dinner rolls or 1 can Pillsbury cornbread twists
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Separate rolls into 8 triangles; cut each triangle lengthwise into thirds.
Flatten a little or cut corn twists strips into 48 pieces to fit the sausages.
Flatten a little.
Bake until brown.

recipes.title: Zucchini Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 2 loaf pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla.
Add flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon.
Lastly, add zucchini, raisins and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Golden Lamb'S Sauerkraut Balls
steps: Grind ham and pork together and saute until brown.
Add flour, milk and dry mustard and cook until thick.
Cook sauerkraut separately.
Grind the sauerkraut and meat mixture together. Return to stove and cook until thick.
Cool.
Shape.
Roll in flour.
Dip in milk.
Roll in cracker or bread crumbs.
Fry in deep fat at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Alexandra'S Favorite Drumsticks
ingredients: 1/4 c. margarine or butter, melted and cooled
steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Mix flour, salt, paprika and pepper in bowl.
Dip drumsticks
in margarine.
Roll in flour mixture to coat.
Arrange in ungreased square pan and bake, uncovered, until done, about 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Driskill Hotel'S Cheese Soup
steps: Saute carrots, celery and onion in butter.
Add flour and cornstarch.
Put vegetables in top half of double boiler.
Add milk and chicken stock.
Heat.
Add soda and cheese.
Stir until cheese has melted. Add seasonings.
Serve hot, topped with paprika.

recipes.title: Easy Cream Pie
steps: Mix together dry ingredients. Gradually add milk and Milnot. Cook on very low heat until thick. Add butter.
Pour in baked pie shell. Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Makes 1 pie.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cake
steps: Rub flour, shortening, sugar and salt to fine crumbs, saving 1/2 cup crumbs to sprinkle on top. Add baking powder, soda, nutmeg, cinnamon, sour milk and eggs to batter. Mix well. Bake in a square cake pan. Sprinkle crumbs on top before baking. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Tunnel Of Fudge
steps: Cream butter in large bowl at high speed.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.
Gradually add sugar.
Beat until light and fluffy.
By hand, stir in flour, frosting mix and nuts until well-blended.

recipes.title: Friendship Bread
ingredients: 1 c. chopped nuts, 1 c. crushed pineapple or 1 c. chocolate chips (optional)
steps: Do not use metal spoons or bowls for mixing.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Mix oil, sugar, and eggs together and then all other ingredients.
Bake at 350 degrees in a 9 x 13 inch pan.
Cook for about 35 to 40 minutes.
The trick to a good carrot cake is to not overcook.
Frost when cool.

recipes.title: Gooey Butter Cake
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients in a large mixing bowl, beat at medium speed until blended.
Pour batter into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan, set aside.
Beat cream cheese until creamy.
Gradually add sifted powdered sugar, beat well.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
Pour cream cheese mixture evenly over batter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden.
Let cool completely in pan or wire rack.
Sprinkle with additional powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Fudge Bars
steps: Mix all ingredients, except marshmallows.
Spread on a 10 x 15-inch greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Remove from oven; cover with marshmallows.
Return to oven for 3 minutes, or until marshmallows are soft.
Cool.
Frost with your favorite chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Pie
steps: Combine 1 cup sugar, flour, cornstarch and salt in double boiler; add boiling water, stirring constantly.
Cover and cook 15 minutes.
Beat egg yolks with 1/2 cup sugar and gradually pour hot mixture over this, while stirring.
Return to double boiler and cook 5 minutes longer.
Just before removing from heat, add lemon juice and rind.
Mix well.
Cool.
Pour into pie shell.
Top with meringue.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Peach Pie
steps: Beat crust ingredients 2 minutes.
Pour into 10-inch pie pan.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
ingredients: 6 pork chops, browned in small amount of vegetable oil
l each bell pepper, onion, tomato, in thick slices
steps: Stir spices into rice on bottom of casserole.
Top with browned pork chops.
Add consomme Top chops with sliced onion, tomato and bell pepper.
Bake covered 350° for 1 hour or until liquid is absorbed.

recipes.title: Pineapple Orange Salad
steps: Place pineapple in saucepan, bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat, add gelatin, stirring until dissolved.
Stir in buttermilk and nuts.
Cool.
Fold in Cool Whip. Pour in dish.
Chill.

recipes.title: Persimmon Pudding
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Add all others.
Pour into buttered pan. Bake at 350° until firm.
Serve warm with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Squirrel With Rice
steps: Dice salt pork; saute until brown.
Add squirrel pieces; brown lightly.
Add water.
Simmer until tender.
Add rice, catsup, onion and seasonings.
Cook over low heat.
Cook until rice is tender.

recipes.title: Streusel Coffee Cake
steps: Stir together the 1 1/2 cups flour, granulated sugar, baking powder and salt.
Combine egg, milk and oil.
Add to flour mixture; mix well.
Stir in raisins.
Turn into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Combine nuts, brown sugar, 1 Tbsp. flour, butter and cinnamon; sprinkle over batter.
Bake at 375 for about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Thoroughly cream the shortening and sugar; add eggs and vanilla and beat well.
In separate bowl, sift together the flour, soda and salt.
Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk.
Pour batter into loaf pan.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Apricot-Filled Pear Cake
steps: Drain pears.
Save 1/2 cup juice.
Blend pears in blender until smooth.
In large bowl, combine cake mix, pureed pears, 1/2 cup pear juice and eggs at slow speed until smooth and moistened. Beat 2 minutes on high.
Pour batter in a lightly greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.
Grease a piece of wax paper and fit in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes, remove from pan and cool completely. Slice cake in half, spread apricot jam over cut half.
Replace top cake layer.
Spread with topping.
Chill well.

recipes.title: Jewish Apple Cake
steps: Mix in bowl pared and sliced apples, cinnamon and sugar.
Mix in another bowl flour, baking powder, salt, oil, orange juice, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Beat until smooth.
Pour 1/2 batter in ungreased Bundt pan.
Spread 1/2 the apple mixture.
Add remaining batter and top with remaining apple slices.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Cool 15 minutes before removing.

recipes.title: Budapest Tea Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a large Bundt pan and set aside.
In a small bowl, combine brown sugar, cocoa, cinnamon, raisins and nuts.
Set aside.
In large mixing bowl, cream together margarine and sugar.
Add vanilla and eggs, mixing to blend.
In a separate bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Add dry ingredients to the large mixing bowl.
Mix well. Add sour cream and mix to blend.
By hand, fold in brown sugar-nut mixture.
Pour batter into prepared Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes, until done.

recipes.title: Jam Cake
ingredients: 2 tsp. soda dissolved in 2 1/2 c. buttermilk
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs.
Alternate with flour and milk.
Add spices to flour.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili Corn Muffins
steps: In mixing bowl, combine the flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, chili powder and salt.
Chop scallion.
Beat milk, applesauce and egg until just combined and stir in scallion and corn.
Stir flour mixture into milk mixture until just combined but still lumpy.
Spoon into prepared muffin pans.
Bake until edges start to brown.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
They are great with chili and soups.

recipes.title: Spider Corn Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Melt shortening in frypan placed in oven.
Beat egg; add 1 cup milk.
Stir in cornmeal, flour, sugar, salt and baking powder.
Turn into frypan with melted shortening. Pour over remaining milk.
Do not stir.
Bake 25 minutes at 425°.

recipes.title: Herman Cake
steps: Beat eggs, sugar and oil with mixer.
Stir Herman, soda, salt, flour, baking powder, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, raisins and 1/2 cup nuts or walnut flavoring together with a spoon.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan or two loaf pans.

recipes.title: Baked Brie With Crudites
steps: Melt 2 tablespoons unsalted butter in a heavy medium skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; saute until onion is golden brown, about 10 minutes.
Set aside.
Place Brie and cream cheese (cut in large pieces) in a large microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on Medium just until melted, about 2 minutes.
Whisk in onion mixture, sour cream, fresh lemon juice, brown sugar and Worcestershire sauce.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Chicken Paprikas
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. chicken parts, skin removed
steps: In a Dutch oven over low heat, cook onions in butter until soft but not brown.
Add paprika and rub into onions with wooden spoon. Add chicken, meaty side down, and stock.
Bring to a boil, then cover and gently simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Chicken should be very tender and onions mushy.
Remove chicken to a platter and debone.
Cut larger pieces into serving chunks, if you wish.
Add 2 tablespoons of cooking liquid to cornstarch and mix well.
Add this mixture to liquid in pot.
Bring to a boil and stir until thickened.
Reduce heat and stir in sour cream, heating just to simmer point.
Add chicken, cover and simmer a few minutes until heated through.
Holds well at low heat.

recipes.title: Shoo-Fly Cake
steps: Do not use mixer.
Pour liquid into crumb mixture and mix with spoon.
Pour into greased oblong pan.
Place 1 cup crumbs on top and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Peach Tart
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Mix eggs, sugar, flour and cream.
Pour the mixture over peach slices which have been arranged in the bottom of the pie shell.
Dot the top of the tart with butter. Bake for 10 minutes at 425°; reduce heat to 350° and bake for 30 minutes more.

recipes.title: Applesauce Diabetic Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Sift flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and baking soda.
In a large bowl mix margarine, sweetener and egg.
Mix in dry ingredients, alternating with applesauce.
Fold in raisins, cereal and nuts; mix thoroughly.
Drop onto greased cookie sheet by tablespoon.
Lightly flatten with a fork dipped in milk.
Bake for 7 to 8 minutes.
Makes 36 cookies.

recipes.title: Spinach Madeline
steps: Cook spinach according to directions. Drain and reserve liquid.
Melt butter or oleo in saucepan over low heat. Add flour and stir until well blended, but not brown. Add onion and cook until soft and clear.
Add liquid slowly, stirring constantly, until smooth and thick. Continue stirring. Add seasoning and cheese which has been cut into small pieces.
Stir until melted. Combine spinach. Pour into casserole and top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Chicken N' Rice
steps: Spread
rice on bottom of small roasting pan.
Sprinkle mushrooms and pepper over rice.
Lay chicken pieces over this. Dilute
mushroom
soup
and
onion soup with water.
Pour over chicken.
Bake covered at 350° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Rum Duff
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. rum or 1 tsp. rum extract
steps: Combine applesauce, sugar, rum, grated orange rind and gingersnaps.
Stir until well mixed.
Chill.
Just before serving, fold in whipped cream and pile into sherbet dishes.
If desired, top with additional cream and nuts.

recipes.title: Double-Corn Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Grease 12 muffin pan cups.
In large bowl, combine flour, corn meal, sugar, baking powder, salt and red pepper.
In medium bowl, whisk milk, butter and egg.
Stir into dry ingredients just until combined.
Stir in corn.
Spoon into prepared pans.
Bake 20 minutes.
Unmold and serve warm.
Makes 1 dozen.

recipes.title: Cajun Hush Puppies
ingredients: 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and chopped fine
steps: Combine dry ingredients.
Add buttermilk, water, oleo and egg. Mix well.
Stir in onion and peppers.
Carefully drop batter by teaspoonful into hot oil.
Fry 3 to 5 minutes until golden brown, turning once.
Yield:
2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Pecan Delight
steps: To prepare pan, line 9 x 13-inch pan with wax paper.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Mix together oil, eggs, sugar and vanilla in a large bowl. Sift together the flour, salt and soda.
Add oil mixture and blend well.
Add chopped pecans and apples.
Stir until well mixed. Preheat oven to 350°.
Pour cake mixture into a large tube or Bundt pan and bake for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Crescents
steps: Beat butter at medium speed of an electric mixer until creamy.
Add 1/2 cup powdered sugar; beat well.
Combine flour and salt; gradually add flour mixture to butter mixture, beating at low speed just until blended after each addition.
Stir in vanilla and pecans.
Divide dough into fourths; cover and chill at least 2 hours.
Work with 1 portion of dough at a time, storing remainder in refrigerator.
Divide each portion into 12 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a 2 1/2 inch log; curve ends of each log to form a crescent.
Place crescents 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes or until very lightly browned.
Cool on cookie sheets 1 minute.
Carefully roll warm cookies in 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar; cool completely on a wire rack.
Roll cooled cookies in remaining 1 cup powdered sugar. Store up to 1 week in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
steps: Bake 45 minutes at 425° or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Crazy Chocolate Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into buttered casserole dish. Sprinkle 1/4 cup stuffing mix on top and dot with 1/2 stick margarine.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Golden Apple Pie
steps: Peel apples; core and slice thinly to measure 7 cups.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Crisscrosses
steps: Preheat
oven
to
Thoroughly
cream shortening, sugars and
vanilla.
Add	eggs and beat well.
Stir in peanut butter. Sift
dry
ingredients and stir into creamed mixture. Form	into tiny
balls
and
place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press with back of fork to make crisscross.
Dough may also be rolled and cut, if desired.
Bake 10 minutes.	Makes 8 dozen.

recipes.title: Apricot Chicken
steps: Pound chicken breasts and put in baking dish.
Puree apricots in blender and add lemon juice.
Pour mixture evenly over chicken. Sprinkle with oregano and garlic powder.
Heat Marsala and butter in saucepan until butter is melted.
Pour over chicken.
Place under broiler approximately 30 minutes until glaze is brown. Serve with rice or rice pilaf and green veggie.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Buttermilk Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter and shortening; gradually add sugar, beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Combine flour and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture.
Mix just until blended after each addition.
Stir in flavorings.
Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 5 to 10 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pan 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from pan and let cool completely on a wire rack.
Yield: one 10-inch cake.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Preheat oven to 400°. Warm pie crust in oven about 10 minutes while the oven heats.
Shred cheese and place in mixing bowl. Crumble bacon into bits and add to bowl.
Whip eggs with fork and add to mixture.
Add milk, chives, salt and pepper to cheese mixture.
Stir to mix thoroughly.
Pour into crust.
Sprinkle surface with nutmeg.
Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 30 to 35 minutes.
Let cool 10 minutes before serving. Makes one (9-inch) pie.

recipes.title: Pork Chop And Rice Casserole (Or Chicken)
ingredients: 4 pork chops (3/4-inch thick) or 6 pieces chicken
steps: Dredge meat in flour.
Cook in a little shortening until brown. Put in 2-quart or larger baking dish.
Brown pepper, celery and onion.
Put in dish with meat.
Add rice on top, then tomatoes. Bake in 350° oven until tender, about 45 minutes.
Might have to add 1/2 cup water when gets dry.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: In large bowl, mix oil, eggs and sugar.
In separate bowl, sift dry ingredients.
Add to mixture.
Stir in apples and nuts. Spread into well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Distribute chips onto top of cake.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
For best results, bake at least 2 to 3 days before serving.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1/2 c. brewed coffee or 3/4 tsp. instant coffee
steps: Mix (except onion and bacon) and put in baking casserole. Slice onion and put on top.
Put chopped bacon on top.
Bake for 1 hour at 400° to cook bacon and onion.
Reduce heat to 275° and bake, covered, for 2 to 3 hours more.

recipes.title: Blend Of The Bayou
steps: Melt cream cheese and butter.
Saute shrimp, onion, pepper and celery in 2 tablespoons butter and add to first mixture.
Add soup, mushrooms, seasonings, crab meat and rice.
Mix well.
Place in a 2-quart casserole dish and top with grated cheese and cracker crumbs.
Bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 350°, or until bubbly. Serves 8 and leftovers freeze well.

recipes.title: Cider Stew
ingredients: 1 to 2 1/2 lb. chuck pot roast (2-inch thick)
steps: To cut roast into 1-inch cubes, first trim excess fat from roast. Cut roast into 1-inch slices. Cut each slice in half lengthwise, then cut into 1-inch pieces.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pumpkin Coffeecake
steps: Cream butter, 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla in mixer bowl.
Add 3 eggs, beating well.
Combine flour, baking powder and baking soda. Add dry ingredients to butter mixture alternately with sour cream.
Combine pumpkin, beaten egg, 1/3 cup sugar and pie spice. Spoon half of batter into 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Spread to corners.
Sprinkle half of Streusel over batter.
Spread pumpkin mixture over Streusel.
Carefully spread remaining batter over pumpkin mixture.
Sprinkle remaining Streusel over top.
Bake in slow oven at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Turkey Tetrazzini
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Saute onion and garlic in butter in a large saucepan.
Add flour and seasonings and blend.
Gradually add stock and cook until thickened.
Stir in turkey, mushrooms and cheese.
Fold in cooked spaghetti noodles.
Turn into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish; top with crumbs and bake 30 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Rice And Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of celery soup
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix chicken soup and milk; reserve half of the mixture.
Mix remaining soup, rice and 1/4 of the onion soup mix.
Pour into ungreased baking dish.
Place chicken breasts on top. Pour reserved soup mixture over chicken breasts.
Sprinkle with remaining onion soup mix.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour.
Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Favorite Peach Pie
steps: Peel and halve peaches.
Lay face down in unbaked pie shell.
Mix coffee cream, sugar, cinnamon and flour together.
Pour over peaches.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until lightly brown.

recipes.title: Spinach Squares
ingredients: 1 lb. Monterey Jack or Mozzarella cheese, grated
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook spinach and drain well.
Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix ingredients in any order.
Pour into pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Let stand for 45 minutes. Cut into squares.
Makes a "hit" served cold at receptions. Serves approximately 35.

recipes.title: Cal'S Delicious Chili
steps: Fry meats, celery, garlic and onion.
Add other ingredients. Salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
steps: In saucepan, melt margarine; stir in flour and gradually add milk and some of the cheese to make cheese sauce.
May need to use more flour before milk is added or more milk.
Put cooked macaroni in baking dish; stir in cheese sauce mixture.
Add more cheese to taste.

recipes.title: Famous Pretzels
steps: Dissolve yeast in milk or water.
Add sugar, salt, margarine and flour.
Mix all ingredients with a wooden spoon.
Cover and let rise in warm place for 30 minutes.
Form pretzels; brush with slightly beaten egg or a little egg white with a few drops of water.
Sprinkle with coarse salt and bake at 425° for 15 to 25 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Combine flour, salt and pepper.
Trim meat.
Cut in strips 1 1/2 x 1-inch.
Coat with flour.
Melt butter in heavy skillet. Brown meat on all sides.
Add onion and garlic.
Dissolve bouillon cube in water.
Add to meat.
Add liquid from mushrooms, Worcestershire sauce and catsup.
Cover.
Simmer until meat is tender and sauce is thick (about 1 1/2 hours).
Add mushrooms. Just before serving, combine vinegar with evaporated milk and stir in.
Heat, but do not boil.
Serve over hot rice or noodles.
Top with chopped parsley.

recipes.title: World'S Best Cookies
steps: Cream together butter and sugars, add egg and mix well.
Add remaining ingredients one at a time except pecans.
Mix until combined; stir in pecans.
Form into balls the size of walnuts; place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork.
Bake at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown; do not overcook. Allow to cool a few minutes before removing from pan.
Yield: 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Egg Custard
ingredients: 1 tsp. flavoring (vanilla or any kind you want)
steps: Mix all in top of double boiler. Cook until thick and pour into a baked pie shell.

recipes.title: Blender Banana Bread
steps: Put egg, butter, bananas, sugar and granola into blender. Whirl on low until smooth.
Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Add blender mixture and stir until moistened.
Turn into a greased loaf pan.
Bake at 325° for 60 minutes.
Yields one loaf.

recipes.title: Best Ever Deer And Gravy
ingredients: 1 pkg. deer steak or any deer, cut in small pieces to fry
steps: Flour deer after salting and
peppering.
Fry
in oil to brown.
Meanwhile place a large
skillet
or
pot
on
another burner.
Depending on amount you
cook,
put water in pot.
For one package of deer to feed 4, use about 2 cups of water.
When meat is browned, drop directly
into
water
that is simmering. Do not drain on paper.
Continue
until
all
meat
is browned. Cook onions in oil until tender.
Drain off most of oil.
Brown small amount of flour and brown.
Add
all
this to water.
Add soup. Simmer, adding water if necessary.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
steps: Mix together.
Pour into a greased floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Spread icing on hot cake.

recipes.title: Mother In Law Cake
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. butter or margarine, very soft
steps: In
large
mixing
bowl
stir together dry ingredients. Make well
in
center;
drain pineapple, pressing out liquid. Reserve 1/3 cup syrup.
Add remaining ingredients.	Beat with wooden spoon.
Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan, greased. Sprinkle with walnuts and brown sugar.
Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers
ingredients: 1 small Hidden Valley Ranch buttermilk recipe original Ranch salad dressing mix
steps: Combine salad dressing mix, oil, dill weed and garlic.
Pour over oyster crackers; stir to coat.
Place in warm oven 15 to 20 minutes.
Store in tight container.

recipes.title: Best Ever Cookies
steps: Cream together the sugars and margarine.
Combine with remaining ingredients and mix well.
Roll in balls the size of a small walnut.
Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Press with the bottom of a glass, dipped in sugar.
Sprinkle sugar generously on top of each cookie.
Bake at 350° about 10 minutes. Makes 100 cookies.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Kiss Cookies
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) bag Hershey's Kisses with almonds
steps: Remove foil from Kisses.
In a large bowl, combine butter, sugars and vanilla. Beat well. Add flour; blend until smooth. Stir in chips. Mold scant tablespoon of dough around each Kiss, covering completely.
Shape into ball and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set.
Cool.
Remove from cookie sheet.
Makes 6 to 7 dozen cookies.
Drizzle topping over each cookie (optional).

recipes.title: Hobo Bread
steps: Mix; put in loaf pan.
Bake for about 40 minutes at 300°. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Butter Cookies
steps: Cream together oleo and sugar. Add salt, vanilla and flour. Mix until blended. Mixture will be stiff. Stir in chocolate chips. Roll into balls (3/4 inch) and flatten with a fork. Bake at 350° about 12 to 13 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Biscuits
steps: Mix all together.
Do not overmix.
Drop in greased muffin tins.
Bake at 450° until brown, approximately 20 minutes.
An especially good recipe for weight watchers.

recipes.title: Banana Walnut Cake
steps: Cream sugar and butter together.
Add remaining ingredients. Mix together thoroughly.
Add egg whites which are beaten.
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.

recipes.title: White Monkey
ingredients: 1-inch cube Cheddar cheese or 2 Tbsp. Cheez Whiz
steps: Melt margarine over low heat; stir in flour and cook for one minute.
Slowly add milk; cook until thick, stirring constantly. Add cheese and stir until melted.
Salt and pepper to taste. Serve over toast.

recipes.title: Flank Steak Fix-Up
steps: Rub steak with garlic; sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper.
Cut meat crosswise into 4 to 6 serving pieces.
In large skillet, cook bacon.
Drain bacon; reserve 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet.
Place slice of bacon on each piece of meat, roll up and secure with wooden picks.
Coat rolls with flour.
Brown rolls in the reserved bacon drippings over medium heat.

recipes.title: Diabetic Persimmon Pudding
steps: Mix pulp, sweetener and egg.
Add dry ingredients and a little of the milk.
Blend well.
Add rest of milk and butter.
Bake 55 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Homemade Ice Cream
steps: Mix all the ingredients in a large pot.
Boil it on the stove until the mixture becomes thick and the egg yolks have evaporated and there is no lumps.
Let this mixture cool for approximately 30 minutes.
Put mixture into a ice cream maker until it freezes.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Spice Cake
steps: Mix baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and olive spice in small bowl; set aside.
Mix remaining ingredients in large bowl; pour in baking dish.
Sprinkle cinnamon, baking soda, nutmeg, cloves and olive spice over top of cake.
Bake at 350° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Zucchini Cake Squares
steps: Blend together.
Cut like pie dough.
Press 1/2 on bottom of lightly greased pan (cookie sheet).
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes (on bottom rack).

recipes.title: Cinnamon Buttermilk Biscuits
steps: Heat oven to 450 degrees.
Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off.
In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, cinnamon and baking soda.
Using pastry blender or fork, cut in shortening until mixture resembles course crumbs; stir in raisins.
Stirring with fork, add buttermilk until mixture leaves sides of bowl and soft dough forms.
Turn dough onto floured surface and knead lightly until no longer sticky.
Roll out 1/2
inch thick and cut with floured 2 1/2 inch cutter.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet with sides touching.
Bake at 450 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes or until light golden brown.
Cool 5 minutes on wire rack and frost. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Savory Italian Rice Bake
steps: Prepare Rice-A-Roni mix as package directs.
Remove sausage from casing and crumble.
In 12-inch skillet, brown sausage and onion; drain, reserving 1 tablespoon drippings in skillet.
Set aside.
Add zucchini and garlic; saute over medium-high heat 1 minute.
Cover, continue cooking over low heat about 2 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Combine prepared Rice-A-Roni, sausage mixture, 1 1/2 cups spaghetti sauce and basil; spread into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, or until heated through.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 canned chicken or whole cooked chicken (save the broth)
steps: Pick meat from chicken (no skin).
Mix all ingredients, then tear up the bread like for dressing.
Stir all together.
Add enough broth to make all real moist, a cup or more if needed. Pour in large casserole dish or pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: 7 Layer Salad
ingredients: 6 pieces crumbled bacon or bacon bits
steps: Layer the first 5 ingredients.
Sprinkle with sugar, cheese, salt and garlic powder.
Just before serving, add bacon or bacon bits.
Cover with plastic wrap.
Can be made the day before needed.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Melt butter in large skillet; add broccoli and onion.
Cook until broccoli is thawed.
Cut cheese into 1 square.
Mix cheese, soup, milk and rice in large bowl.
Add broccoli.
Mix and bake in oven at 350° for about 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and rice is done.

recipes.title: Molasses Pecan Cookies
steps: Cream together margarine, sugar, egg and molasses until mixture is smooth.
Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture; mix well.
Stir in chopped pecans.

recipes.title: Scalloped Cabbage
ingredients: 6 c. cabbage, cut in bite size pieces
steps: Cover the cabbage with 1-quart boiling water.
Add the salt; boil 5 minutes, drain dry.
In the melted oleo, add flour and stir well.
Add milk and cook until thickens a little.
Put cabbage in baking dish.
Add cheese to sauce and stir until melted.
Pour over the cabbage and cover with buttered crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
ingredients: 2 tsp. each: celery seed and turmeric
steps: Soak sliced cucumbers in lime water for 24 hours, stirring often.
Rinse in cold water until cucumbers are lime free.
Water will be clear.
Combine cucumbers and onions in salted water.
Let stand for 3 hours and then drain.
In a large kettle, combine vinegar and remaining ingredients; bring to a boil.
Add vegetables and heat to simmering.
Avoid boiling the vegetables for this will make them soft.
Pack while hot in sterilized jars and seal.
Makes 3 quarts.

recipes.title: Coq Au Vin
ingredients: 1 c. canned condensed chicken broth, undiluted
3 whole chicken breasts, boned, halved and skinned
steps: Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper and garlic.
Dredge chicken in flour.
Reserve remaining flour. Saute chicken in 3 tablespoons of butter to brown.
Transfer to a 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: Cream together butter and sugar.
Combine dry ingredients and add to butter mixture; mix well.
Add eggs, bananas and pecans. Add 1 tablespoon vanilla (optional).
Grease a loaf pan.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°, then 30 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Dillicious Pot Roast
steps: In heavy saucepan, cook bacon until crisp.
Drain off all but 2 tablespoons bacon drippings from pan.
Crumble bacon; set aside. Sprinkle both sides of beef with lemon pepper marinade.
Brown beef in bacon drippings.
Combine mushroom soup, dill pickle and Worcestershire sauce; pour over browned meat.
Cover; simmer for about 2 1/2 hours, or until meat is tender.
Remove to warm platter.
Sprinkle with crumbled bacon.
Skim fat from gravy; serve with roast.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes And Pork Chops
steps: Season pork chops and brown.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Add flour and mix well.
Slowly add milk.
Cook until thick, stirring constantly.
Alternately place potatoes, onions, pork chops and cream sauce in greased casserole.
Cover.
Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350° for 1 hour.
Uncover last 15 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Maple Nut Chiffon Cake
steps: Heat oven to 325°.
Sift the first 5 ingredients together in a mixing bowl.
Make a well; add Wesson oil, egg yolks, water and maple flavoring.
Beat until smooth with spoon or mixer on medium speed.

Add cream of tartar to egg whites in large mixing bowl. Beat until whites are very stiff, then pour egg yolk mixture gradually over beaten egg whites, gently folding with rubber scraper, just until blended.
Pour into ungreased 10 x 14-inch tube pan.
Bake at 325° for 55 minutes, then at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Turn pan upside down on bottle until cold.

recipes.title: Cioppino
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. Dungeness crab or 2 (12 oz.) pkg. frozen Alaska king crab split legs, thawed and cut into chunks
1 lb. fresh or 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen shelled and deveined shrimp, thawed and drained
1 lb. fresh or 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen sea scallops, thawed and drained
1 lb. fresh or 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen cod fillets, slightly thawed and cut into 2-inch chunks
steps: About 45 minutes before serving, in 8-quart Dutch oven or saucepot over medium heat, in hot olive or salad oil, cook onion, green pepper and garlic until tender, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add tomatoes and their liquid, wine, parsley, salt, basil, pepper and bay leaf.
Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Savory Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 1/2 to 4 lb. beef round or chuck pot roast
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can Campbell's cream of mushroom soup
steps: In a 6-quart saucepan, in hot oil, brown roast on all sides. Spoon off fat.
Stir in mushroom soup, onion soup mix and 1 cup water.
Reduce heat to low; cover and cook for 2 hours.
Add vegetables.
Cover; cook for 45 minutes, or until roast and vegetables are fork-tender.
Remove roast and vegetables.
Stir together flour and remaining 1/4 cup water until smooth. Gradually stir into soup mixture.
Cook until mixture boils and thickens, stirring constantly.
Garnish with fresh parsley, if desired.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Shortbread
steps: Mix confectioners sugar and granulated sugar together.
Heat oven to 325°.
Cream butter and sugars together.
Gradually add the rice and unbleached flour.
Mix with hands until smooth; do not overmix.
Press into baking pan or shortbread mold.
Bake for 45 minutes.
Cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Polish Cheese Cake
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. finely crushed zwieback crumbs (dry toast; if you get the toast with cinnamon, omit the 1 teaspoon cinnamon)
steps: Mix crumbs with 1/2 cup sugar, cinnamon and melted butter. Reserve 3/4 cup of mixture for topping.
Press remainder into a 9-inch spring-form pan or a 9 x 13-inch cake pan, lining bottom and sides.

recipes.title: Pastitso-Greek Lasagna
steps: Boil macaroni according to package directions.
Melt 3/4 stick of butter until slightly burned.
Put in macaroni; mix with some Romano cheese.

recipes.title: All-In-One Muffin
steps: Beat brown sugar, oil or applesauce, egg, milk and banana until well blended.
Stir in flour, baking powder and salt all at once.
Fold in cereal, dates and nuts.
Spoon batter into paper-lined 4-inch muffin tins until 2/3 full.
Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 375°.
Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Chews
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) pkg. red hot cinnamon candies
steps: Combine all ingredients but cereal and melt in top of double boiler.
Add cereal, mixing quickly.
Spread in buttered 8-inch square pan.
Chill; cut in 1/2-inch squares.
Dust with powdered sugar.
Wrap individually in waxed paper.

recipes.title: Western Hash
steps: Brown onions, bell pepper and beef in large skillet.
Add tomatoes, basil, rice, salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
Pour into casserole dish and cover with slices of American cheese.
Heat in oven at 350° until cheese melts.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Spiced Peaches
steps: Combine the vinegar, the juice from the peaches, sugar, cinnamon and cloves.
Boil until reduced by about half.
Remove the spices.
Stick the cloves into the peach halves and pour the syrup over peaches.
Let stand overnight in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Picnic Cake(Very Rich)
steps: Mix dates in hot water.
Set aside.
Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs; beat until fluffy.
Sift flour, salt and soda.
Add alternately with date mixture to egg mixture.
Mix well each time. Stir in vanilla and 1/2 cup chocolate chips.
Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with remaining chips and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanutty Chewy Bars
ingredients: 1/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In bowl, stir together flour, sugar, cocoa, brown sugar, baking soda and salt.
Cut in margarine until crumbly; add eggs.
Mix well.
Spread in greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Bake 8 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Top evenly with chips, then sweetened condensed milk and coconut.
Return to oven; bake 20 minutes or until lightly brown.
Remove from oven.
Let cool.
Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Banana Drop Cookies
steps: Cream
sugar
and
shortening.	Beat in eggs.
Dissolve soda in	sour milk; add alternately with the flour and baking powder that
has
been sifted together. Stir in vanilla, nuts and	mashed bananas.
Drop
by
spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake in 350° oven 10 to 15 minutes.
Yield: 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Bread
steps: Sift flour, soda, salt, cream, 1 cup sugar and shortening. Add eggs; mix well.
Add apples, milk and vanilla.
Mix well. Pour into greased loaf pan.
Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over batter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Moist Chewy Chocolate Cake
steps: Note:
Buttermilk can be replaced with 1/2 cup whole milk mixed with 1 tablespoon vinegar.

recipes.title: Parker House Rolls
ingredients: 1 cake yeast or 1 pkg. granular yeast
steps: Combine the milk, shortening, sugar and salt.
Cool to lukewarm.
Add yeast which has been dissolved in lukewarm water; add about 2/3 of the flour and beat thoroughly.
Let rise until double; add remaining flour.
Knead well.
Let rise again until double.
Roll dough 1/4 inch thick.
Cut with a 3-inch biscuit cutter.
Brush rounds with melted butter.
Grease thoroughly center with dull edge of knife.
Fold double, pinch edges together and place on well-greased pan, one inch apart.
Allow to rise until double in size.
Brush tops with melted butter.
Bake in hot oven (425°) for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 30 rolls.

recipes.title: Black Bean Soup
steps: Soak the beans overnight; drain.
Add the water.
Add the cloves, bay leaf, garlic, celery, carrot and onion.
Cook slowly for 3 hours.
Mash beans.
Add the beef broth.
Combine the flour and melted butter; add to soup.
Add the sherry wine to taste. Adjust seasoning.
Serve with slice of lemon.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Makes a sticky dough.
Refrigerate one hour or overnight. Use a lot of flour to roll out.
Makes four 9-inch pies.

recipes.title: Turkey Bacon Club Sandwich
steps: Cut each roll lengthwise into 2 halves.
Spread mayonnaise on 1/2 of each roll.
Place 3 slices of cooked turkey bacon over the mayonnaise.
Place tomato slices and lettuce over the turkey bacon. Serve open-faced or as a closed sandwich.
Enjoy!!

recipes.title: Red Cake
steps: Mix vinegar and soda and set aside.
Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs.
Add a little food coloring to cocoa to make a paste.
Add to creamed mixture with rest of coloring.
Add flour and salt, alternating with milk.
Add vanilla, then vinegar and soda.
Beat well.
Use 2 (8-inch) round pans (greased and floured).
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
When cooked, split to make 4 layers.

recipes.title: Batter Rolls
ingredients: 3/4 c. melted butter or salad oil
steps: Dissolve yeast in water.
Melt butter.
Mix all ingredients together.
Leave in refrigerator for 2 hours.
Fill muffin pan 1/2 full.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Soft Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream oleo, Crisco and sugar; add eggs and mix.
Add buttermilk.
Add vanilla, baking soda and salt; mix well.
Stir in flour until mixed well.
Heat oven to 350°.
Drop mixture by using a tablespoon on a greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 13 minutes. Makes 3 to 4 dozen cookies.
May ice with lemon frosting.

recipes.title: Quick Microwaved Streuseled Apples
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients and place in 8-inch glass dish.
Then mix last of ingredients until crumbly.
Sprinkle crumb mixture over top of apples.
Microwave on High for 12 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Can serve with ice cream or whipped topping.

recipes.title: Just Delicious Cookie
steps: Mix ingredients in order given. Shape into balls on cookie sheet.
Dip a fork or glass in sugar and flatten each cookie. Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 100 cookies.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Mix ingredients and top with dressing.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage
steps: Parboil cabbage to loosen leaves.
Mix meat, rice, onion, egg, salt and pepper.
Roll balls in cabbage leaves.
Place in pan and pour mixture of soup, sauce, vinegar and sugar over.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Goulash
ingredients: 1 lb. sirloin steak, chopped into 1/2-inch cubes
1 Tbsp. vegetable oil (olive oil can be used)
steps: In a skillet, brown beef in the vegetable oil.
When browned, add the flour and stir until flour starts to brown.
Add water and stir.
Add the hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Stir well.
Bring to a boil.
Now add the carrots, onions, peppers and tomatoes if desired.
If the sauce seems too thin at this point, you can thicken it with a bit of rue which is flour that you have heated in just a slight bit of vegetable oil or you can add just a touch of cornstarch.
Once the vegetables have been added, bring to a boil once again, then cover and simmer until vegetables are tender.
The longer it simmers the better it will taste.
It is great served over noodles or over rice.

recipes.title: Rosamarina Salad
ingredients: 1 box rosamarina macaroni, cooked and drained
steps: In saucepan, mix sugar and flour; whip eggs and add to juices. Cook until it thickens.
Add the macaroni and all the fruit to 3/4 container Cool Whip.
Cool 2 hour.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender (45 minutes to 1 hour).
Let cool, peel and mash.
Add 1/2 cup sugar, eggs, vanilla, milk and 1/2 cup butter to potatoes.
Beat at medium speed with electric mixer until smooth.
Spoon into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish.
Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle over potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili Rice
steps: Saute onion in oil in 2-quart boiler.
Add rice, salt and chili powder.
Pour in broth plus enough water to make 16 ounces liquid.
Bring to
boil and then cover and simmer until rice is done.

recipes.title: Aunt Janet'S Hamburger Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger, onion and celery in skillet; drain fat.
Pour hamburger into baking dish, 2 1/2-quart dish.
Add 3 cups boiling water, rice and dry vegetable soup.
Cook 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Hot Olive Cheese Puffs
steps: Blend cheese with margarine.
Stir flour with salt and paprika and mix well.
Wrap 1 tablespoon of mix around each olive. Completely cover the olive.
Freeze in a plastic bag.
To serve, place frozen puffs on ungreased cookie sheet and bake in 400° oven for 10 to 15 minutes until golden.
Olives will be quite hot. Serve on toothpicks.

recipes.title: Chicken And Sausage Jambalaya
ingredients: 2 lb. smoked sausage, cut in rounds
steps: Saute onion, green pepper and celery in oil over low heat. Add garlic and parsley.
Remove from pot.
Brown chicken slowly in remaining oil.
Add bouillon, vegetables, rice, salt, cayenne pepper, Worcestershire and water.
Cook over low heat 1 hour.
Add sausage.
Add more water, if necessary, and correct salt.

recipes.title: Brownies #2
steps: Cream sugar and margarine.
Add eggs one at a time.
Add chocolate syrup, nuts and flour.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Bars
steps: Mix together cake mix, oleo, egg and vanilla.
Put into a greased
and
floured 9 x 13-inch metal pan.
Cream together cream cheese, powdered sugar, eggs, pecans and vanilla.	Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Hidden Valley Ranch Quiche
ingredients: 1 (8 inch) baked and cooled pie shell
1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch milk recipe mix (original)
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Sprinkle cheese in pie crust.
Whisk eggs until frothy.
Add other ingredients and mix.
Pour over cheese.
Bake at 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes or until center is set.

recipes.title: Lemon Lush
steps: Mix.
Spread over mix.
Top with remainder of Cool Whip before serving.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Onion Mushroom Rice
steps: In a 2-quart saucepan over high heat, bring to boiling soup mix, rice and water.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 25 minutes until tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in green onions, if used.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Baneberry Tarts
steps: Combine butter and sugar. Mix in egg yolks, flour, and vanilla. Roll balls the size of marbles. Indent with your thumb and fill with a dab of jelly. Bake at 350 for 10 - 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Doughnuts
steps: Heat 3 to 4-inches of oil to 375° in deep fryer.
Measure 1 1/2 cups flour and the remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Blend 1/2 minute on low speed, scraping bowl occasionally.
Stir in remaining flour. Turn dough onto well floured surface. Roll around lightly to coat with flour.
Gently roll dough 3/8-inch thick.
Cut with floured doughnut cutter. With wide spatula, slide doughnuts into hot fryer. Turn doughnuts as they rise to surface. Fry 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown. Carefully remove from oil.
Drain.
Serve plain, sugared or frosted. Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Zucchini Squares
ingredients: 1 c. Bisquick or Jiffy mix (self-rising flour)
steps: Mix all together.
Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes, until brown.
Let cool, cut into squares.

recipes.title: Dirty Rice
steps: Place chicken parts in large saucepan with water to cover. Cook over medium-high until tender.
Remove from saucepan and dice meat, reserving cooking liquid.
Fry sausage.
Dice or chop.
In 2 teaspoons of sausage fat, saute chopped onion, pepper and celery until almost tender; then add scallion.
Cook few minutes more. Add ham, sausage, chopped chicken, butter and parsley to pan.
Add the reserved liquid from cooking to chicken; season with salt and pepper.
Simmer 15 minutes before blending into rice.
Serves 4 to 5 people.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Muffins
steps: Have all ingredients at room temperature.
Cream butter, sugar and pumpkin until smooth.
Add eggs.
Blend well.
Sift flour, baking powder and spices together and add alternately with milk to egg batter.
Do not overmix.
Fold in nuts and raisins.
Sprinkle a little cinnamon sugar on top before baking.
Bake in greased muffin tins at 375° for 25 minutes or until done.
Do not open oven door while baking or muffins will have a tendency to fall. Equal amount of mashed sweet potatoes may be substituted for the pumpkin.
May be frozen and reheated.
Yield:
2 dozen.

recipes.title: Fried Zucchini
ingredients: 1 1/4 tsp. Old Bay seasoning (more or less to taste)
steps: Slice zucchini.
Roll in flour, then roll in milk/egg mixture. Roll in bread crumb/Bay seasoning mixture.
Let set 1 hour before frying in canola oil.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
steps: Layer ingredients, starting with lettuce and ending with bacon.

recipes.title: Mini Morsel Cookies
steps: In a medium bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt.
In a large bowl, combine 1 cup sugar and vegetable oil.

Mix well. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Gradually stir in flour mixture. Stir in mini morsels (do not use whole bag, it will be more than you need). Shape into balls. Roll in remaining 1/4 cup sugar. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Fried Catfish
steps: Mix together flour, salt, pepper and other seasonings with corn meal.
Fry in hot oil until brown.

recipes.title: Rolls
steps: Add dry yeast to warm water.
Add sugar and egg to yeast and water; add Crisco and flour.
Mix until smooth.
Turn into large bowl.
Cover tightly.
Refrigerate 12 hours.
Take out and knead lightly.
Pat out 1-inch thick and cut out.
Place on buttered pan and butter top.
Let rise at room temperature about 1 hour.
Bake at 500° for 12 to 15 minutes until brown.

recipes.title: Apricot Bread
steps: Mix cream cheese, 1/3 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon flour and 1 egg with orange flavoring and rind and set aside.
Cover apricots in warm water and soak for 30 minutes.
Drain apricots and cut them in small pieces.
Cream sugar and butter.
Add egg.
Add water and juice.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon into hot cooking oil. Cook until golden brown, about 3 minutes.
Makes 24.

recipes.title: Cream Puffs(With Cream Filling)
steps: Combine butter or margarine, salt and water. Heat to boiling. Sift flour and measure. Add to boiling mixture. Beat vigorously until mixture leaves sides of saucepan and does not cling to spoon.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Mix as for drop cookies.
Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes or until done. Frost with chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Oriental Salad
steps: Tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
Dice bacon and fry crisp.
Remove bacon from pan and lightly brown almonds in the bacon fat.
Drain on paper towels; blot excess fat away.
Combine sugar, vinegar, lemon juice, paprika, celery seed, honey, onion, mustard and salt in saucepan.
Heat until sugar is dissolved, stirring constantly.
Cool slightly and pour into a jar with tight lid.
Add oil and shake well.
Combine lettuce, oranges, bacon and almonds in serving bowl.
Pour warm dressing over salad just before serving.

recipes.title: Honey Butter Chicken
steps: Toss chicken in your favorite coating.
Melt 1/2 cup butter in roasting pan.
Roll chicken in butter.
Arrange in pan skin side down.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Melt 1/4 cup butter with honey and lemon juice.
Turn chicken skin side up and drizzle with honey mixture.
Bake another 30 to 40 minutes, basting occasionally.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Biscotti Di Prato
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. almond extract or 2 tsp. anise extract
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place almonds in shallow pan and bake until golden brown (8 to 10 minutes).
Let cool.
Reduce oven to 300°.
In small bowl, whisk together the eggs, vanilla and extract. In mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, baking soda and salt. Add egg mixture and mix until blended, about 1 minute.
Cut almonds in half and mix in.
Divide dough in half.
On greased and floured baking sheet, pat out dough into 2 logs, about 1/2-inch high, 1 1/2-inches wide and 12-inches long, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
Bake at 300° for 40 to 50 minutes or until golden brown. Transfer to wire rack.
Cool 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Mix margarine, sugar and vanilla.
Add flour gradually and mix well.
Chill dough.
Form into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until set, not brown.
Roll in confectioners sugar while warm.

recipes.title: Shells, Cheese And Tomato Macaroni
steps: Cook shells for 14 minutes; drain.
Mix everything else together and add to drained shells.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Bake about 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
steps: Bring water to a boil.
Add cubes, garlic powder and pepper. Next, add onion, celery, carrots and cabbage.
Boil gently until vegetables are tender.
Add tomatoes; boil gently until all is heated and serve.

recipes.title: Mixed Cut Green Bean Casserole
steps: Cook cauliflower in salted water according to package.
Drain. Arrange in a buttered 1-quart casserole.
Drain beans, reserving 1/2 cup liquid.
Add drained beans to casserole.
Melt butter in small saucepan.
Stir in flour.
Add reserved 1/2 cup liquid, milk, onion, salt and hot sauce.
Cook and stir over medium-low heat until sauce thickens.
Pour over vegetables in casserole. Garnish with pimento.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs; beat.
Add remaining ingredients except nutmeats.
Beat thoroughly.
Fold in nutmeats. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Great Pumpkin Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. quick or old fashioned oats (uncooked)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine flour, oats, baking soda, cinnamon and salt; set aside.
Cream butter; gradually add sugars, beating until light and fluffy.
Add egg and vanilla; mix well. Alternate additions of dry ingredients and pumpkin, mixing well after each addition.
Stir in morsels.

recipes.title: Mel'S Beer Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 can beer (cooking takes the alcohol out of but no alcohol beer works just as well)
steps: In a large heavy Dutch oven, melt the butter. Mix in flour until smooth.
Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly, over medium heat.
Blend in the hot chicken broth with wire whip.
Add the cheese and stir until blended.
Pour in whipping cream. Incorporate well.
Add Worcestershire and beer.
Cook over low heat, stirring until thick and smooth, 15 to 20 minutes.
Serve with croutons, bits of ham, freeze dried chives or a sprinkling of parsley.

recipes.title: Cranberry Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Spread cranberries over 10-inch greased pie plate.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar and nuts over cranberries. In bowl beat eggs well.
Add remaining 1 cup sugar; beat until thoroughly mixed.
Add flour and melted butter.
Beat well.
Pour batter over cranberries.
Bake 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Rice
steps: Combine juice and water in medium saucepan; bring to a boil. Add rice and cinnamon stick.
Cover.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Yields 3 cups.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cream Pie
steps: In top of double boiler, blend together sugar, flour, salt and milk.
Beat eggs and vanilla.
Place over boiling water and stir until thick.
Set aside until cold.
Cover crust with a layer of sliced strawberries.
Top with filling and refrigerate to chill. Spoon whipped cream around edge of filling.
In center, put whole berries.

recipes.title: Spicy Oatmeal Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In small saucepan, add water and 1 stick margarine; bring to boil.
Add oatmeal; turn off with lid on.
In large bowl, add sugars and eggs; mix.
Add oatmeal mixture.
Mix. Add flour, baking soda, spices and salt; mix.
Put in dripping pan; bake at 350° for about 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Tassies
steps: Blend first four ingredients thoroughly.
Divide into 24 equal parts and form into balls.
Place a ball into each of 24 miniature muffin pans.
Press thumb into each ball to make a shell.
Beat with a fork the next 4 ingredients until blended.
Place a few ground nuts in each shell and pour filling over each.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Candy Store Cake
ingredients: 6 Hershey bars, melted over hot water
steps: Cream together sugar and butter. Blend in remaining ingredients.
Pour batter into a buttered and floured angel food tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine all ingredients and pour into baking dish.
Cook for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 250°; continue baking for 2 to 3 hours.
Remove from oven long enough to sprinkle top with 6 strips of bacon cut in strips.
Allow to cook 1 hour or until bacon curls and is crisp.

recipes.title: Pineapple Layered Salad
steps: Beat
egg
yolks; add 1 cup syrup from pineapple, sugar and flour.
Cook until thick.
Arrange in layers in bowl with a
layer of pineapple, a layer of marshmallows, grated cheese, then sauce. Repeat.
Serve at room temperature.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cry Babies (Cookies)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add molasses and egg.
Beat until smooth.
Stir together flour, baking soda and ginger.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk.
Drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake until lightly browned, about 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Green Bean Dish
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well in casserole dish.
Put grated cheese on top or you can use canned onions.
Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake Delight
steps: Roll the zwieback into fine crumbs and mix with the melted butter or margarine and 1/2 cup of the sugar.
Pack all but 1/2 cup of this mixture on the bottom and sides of a well-greased 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: German Pfannkuchen
steps: Beat eggs.
Add 1 cup milk and continue beating.
Then add flour sifted with the salt, sugar and then rest of the milk.
This will be a thin batter.
Heat iron frying pan fairly hot with a tablespoon of melted butter in the bottom.
Pour 2 or 3 tablespoons of the batter into the pan and roll it from side to side until bottom is covered.
When top is set, dot with a teaspoon of butter and flip it over with a pancake turner to finish cooking.
It is good served with butter and sugar rolled up and eaten with a fork. Applesauce, thick, is also good on these pancakes.

recipes.title: Wesley'S Biscuits
steps: Melt shortening in pan which biscuits will be baked.
Leave enough melted shortening in the pan to turn the biscuits.
Add remaining melted shortening with other ingredients and mix well.

recipes.title: Grammie'S Banana Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix well by hand, you don't have to be afraid of overmixing.
Pour into loaf pan and let set 1 minute. Bake at 350° for 60 to 75 minutes.
Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Pronto Hominy
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. each: salt, onion salt, pepper and dry mustard
steps: Make cream sauce with the first 8 ingredients; when thick add cheese.
Mix in well-drained hominy and undrained chilies.
Pour into buttered casserole.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Crispies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Sift flour, baking soda and salt onto waxed paper. Cream margarine and brown sugar with electric mixer at medium speed in large bowl until fluffy. Beat in eggs, 1 at a time, until fluffy. Stir in vanilla. Add flour mixture, 1/3 at a time, until well blended. Stir in rolled oats, rice cereal and walnuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls, about 1-inch apart, onto large cookie sheets, lightly sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. Bake 10 minutes or until cookies are firm and lightly golden. Remove to wire racks; cool.

recipes.title: Parmesan Vegetables
steps: In large bowl, break broccoli and cauliflower into bite size pieces.
Combine with onion.
In small bowl, combine sugar, cheese, salt, basil and mayonnaise.
Mix well.
Toss vegetables and dressing.
Refrigerate overnight.
Just before serving, add remaining ingredients.
Toss lightly.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato And Banana Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Peel potatoes; cut crosswise into 1-inch slices.
Place in pot; cover with water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat slightly; cook for 15 to 20 minutes, or until tender.
Drain.
Peel bananas; cut in half once lengthwise and cut twice crosswise.
Toss with lemon juice.
Place cooked potatoes and bananas in a shallow roasting pan.
Sprinkle with brown sugar, nutmeg and salt.
Drizzle with rum and melted butter.
Cover and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven and puree potatoes, bananas and liquid in a food processor until fairly smooth, leaving a bit of texture.
Pour into an ovenproof casserole and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake in a 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Mom'S Peach Pie
ingredients: 6 large fresh peaches, peeled and sliced
1/4 c. chilled butter, cut into 6 pieces
steps: Beat egg white until foamy; brush over bottom and side of pastry.
In small bowl, combine flour and sugars; cut butter into mixture until it resembles fine crumbs.
Sprinkle 2/3 of mixture in bottom of crust; top with peaches.
Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture.
Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until filling is bubbly and peaches are tender.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Black Chocolate Cake
steps: Sift sugar, cocoa, flour and salt together.
Add eggs, vanilla and margarine.
Boil 2 cups water; remove from heat.
Add 2 teaspoons baking soda.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Giant Crisp Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Mix flour, baking soda and salt and set aside.
Cream butter until fluffy and beat in sugar, egg and vanilla.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Shape into 2-inch balls.
Place 3 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly brown.
Let cookies remain on sheet until they are firm.
Makes 21 (4-inch) cookies.
(For softer cookies, add an additional 1/2 cup flour.)

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cake
steps: Cook margarine, water, peanut butter and vegetable oil until it comes to a boil, then add flour, sugar, milk, eggs, vanilla and soda.
Grease and flour pans.
Bake on 18 x 13-inch cookie sheets. Makes 2.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Brownie Pudding Cake
steps: Stir together flour, 1/4 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon cocoa powder and baking powder.
Add milk, oil and vanilla. Stir until smooth. Stir in nuts. Transfer batter to a 1-quart casserole. Combine the 1/3 cup sugar and remaining cocoa powder. Gradually stir in boiling water.
Pour evenly over batter.
Bake in a 350° oven about 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean. Serve warm.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Cranberry-Apple Cobbler
ingredients: 3 c. peeled, coarsely chopped Rome apples
1 (16 oz.) can jellied whole-berry cranberry sauce
steps: Place chopped apple in an 8-inch square pan coated with cooking spray.
Combine cranberry sauce and orange juice, stirring well.
Spoon cranberry sauce mixture evenly over apple.
Combine oats, flour and brown sugar; cut in margarine with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Sprinkle oat mixture evenly over cranberry mixture.
Coat oat mixture with cooking spray.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes or until apple is tender.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Mile High Biscuits
steps: Sift all ingredients together.
Blend in shortening.
Add milk and egg (one at a time).
Stir to mix.
Turn out on floured board and knead.
Roll out and cut biscuits.
Bake at 375° until light brown.

recipes.title: Preserved Children
steps: Mix the children and dogs together.
Sprinkle the field with flowers.
Spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in sun.
When brown, set away to cool in the bathtub.

recipes.title: Pineapple Delight
ingredients: 1 large pkg. instant pudding mix or 2 small boxes
steps: Bottom:
Mix together flour, oleo and nuts.
Pat firmly in bottom of pan and bake at 375° until slightly brown.

recipes.title: Caramel Peanut Butter Cake
steps: Blend margarine and peanut butter.
Stir in brown sugar.
Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and granulated sugar into mixture.
Add 3/4 cup milk and vanilla extract.
Mix until flour is dampened.
Then beat two minutes on electric mixer or 300 strokes by hand.
Add eggs and remaining milk.
Mix, then beat one minute longer or 150 strokes by hand. Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 25 to 30 minutes before removing.

recipes.title: Overnight Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. each: celery and red and green pepper, diced
1 pkg. frozen tiny peas, thawed and dried (uncooked)
steps: In a shallow baking dish, layer the lettuce, celery, peppers, peas, eggs and onion. Mix mayonnaise, oil, sugar and Parmesan; smooth over salad. Distribute cheese and bacon over top. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: German-Style Red Cabbage
steps: Cut cabbage into 6 wedges, removing core; place in large saucepan.
Add onion, sugar, salt, bay leaf and water.
Bring to boil.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.
Add vinegar and apple; cover and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until apple is tender.

recipes.title: Canadian Doughnuts
ingredients: shortening or vegetable oil for frying
steps: In a large bowl, cream butter or margarine and sugar together until light. Add egg and milk. Stir until well blended. Sift flour a second time with baking powder, salt and nutmeg.
Add enough of the flour mixture to the butter-sugar mixture to make a soft dough. Cover and refrigerate for 1/2 hour.
Turn onto a lightly floured surface and roll into 1/3-inch thick and cut with doughnut cutter.
In a deep skillet or deep fryer, heat vegetable oil or Crisco to 365°.
Fry doughnuts until golden brown on both sides, do not crowd.
Drain on absorbent paper and dust with powdered sugar or granulated sugar.
Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Texas Jambalaya
steps: Use a heavy pan with cover, heat oil and add uncooked rice. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until rice is browned. Add onion, bell peppers, garlic and ground beef.
Cook and stir frequently until meat is brown.
Add seasoning, soup and water. Cover tightly and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for about 40 minutes or until rice and meat are tender and liquid is absorbed.
If needed, add more water during cooking.

recipes.title: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Jell-O brand vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
steps: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in bowl. Beat for 4 minutes.
Stir in coconut and nuts.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Cool in pans 15 minutes.
Remove and cool on rack.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix shortening, brown sugar and eggs.
Stir in milk. Sift together and stir in dry ingredients. Chill at least one hour. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake in preheated 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until set.
Makes about 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

recipes.title: Mums Indian Relish
steps: Grind all of vegetables after washing.
Measure all of the vegetables putting them in a stainless steel large kettle. Sprinkle 1 cup of non-iodized salt over the vegetables.
Let stand overnight.
Drain off all the juice on the vegetables.
Add 2 quarts vinegar and bring to a
boil; cook until tender.
Mix the sugar, turmeric, mustard and flour and make a thin paste with a small amount of water.
Pour the paste over the ground vegetables. Mix well.
Let stand 5 minutes and ladle into clean hot jars and seal. Makes 10-12 pints.
Cover and let cool before storing in cool place.

recipes.title: Chicken Artichoke Casserole
ingredients: 1 (3 lb.) chicken, cut into serving pieces
steps: Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper and paprika.
In skillet, brown chicken in 4 tablespoons of the butter and transfer to a 2-quart casserole.
Arrange artichoke hearts between chicken pieces.

recipes.title: Favorite Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugars.
Blend in eggs and vanilla.
Sift flour, salt and soda.
Fold into creamed mixture along with the oats, nuts and raisins.
Roll into small balls and place on cookie sheet.
Flatten with a fork.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden.
Yields approximately 10 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. diced ham or cooked, crumbled bacon or sausage
steps: Layer the first 4 ingredients in order in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
