Beat remaining ingredients together and pour over bread in pan.
Cover in refrigerator overnight.
In the morning, make a topping of 2 cups crushed cornflakes and 1/2 cup melted butter. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cherokee Dinner
ingredients: 1/8 tsp. each: garlic powder, thyme and oregano
steps: Brown meat and onion in olive oil.
Stir in ingredients except olives and cheese.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Spoon into baking dish; top with cheese.
Broil until cheese is melted.
Garnish with sliced olives.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Green Beans
steps: Brown bacon, add onion and simmer until tender.
Drain 1 can of beans, add to bacon and onion.
Then add second can with most of the liquid.
Add mushroom soup and simmer until hot.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: 1 whole egg or 1/4 c. egg substitute
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Lightly spray cookie sheet with cooking spray.
In a large bowl mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
In a separate bowl whisk together shortening, applesauce, granulated sugar, egg and vanilla until shortening breaks into pea-sized pieces.
Add flour mixture to applesauce mixture.
Mix well.
Fold in oats and raisins.
Drop rounded teaspoonfuls onto a cookie sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove from oven and cool on a cookie sheet for 5 minutes.
Remove and put on cooling rack.
Makes 36 cookies.

recipes.title: Fruitcake
steps: Line angel food tube pan with heavy brown paper (a grocery sack will do). Spray with vegetable cooking spray.

recipes.title: Veggie Bars
ingredients: 1 c. shredded yellow cheese (Cheddar, Colby, or to your taste)
steps: Unroll the crescent rolls and spread on a large greased cookie sheet.
Pat them together into a single piece and bake 10 minutes at 350° so they are brown on top.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Bake in greased 9 x 9-inch pan at 350° until top browns and sides pull away from pan.
Serve hot or cold, with whipped cream or plain.

recipes.title: Potato Souffle
steps: Brown onion in butter.
Add flour and then milk.
Add egg yolks and sauce to potatoes; mix well, then fold in beaten egg whites.
Bake in a greased dish in oven about 25 or 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Apple And Cheese Casserole
steps: Place apples in shallow casserole dish.
Cream butter with sugar.
Gradually work in cheese and flour.
Spread over apples and bake at 350° about 30 minutes until top begins to brown.

recipes.title: Mock Pound Cake
steps: Blend margarine and cream cheese.
Add sugar, beat well until mixed.
Add eggs 1 at a time, blending until smooth; add vanilla. Sift flour, salt and baking powder 3 times.
Add flour alternately with milk.
Mix smooth after each addition.
Pour into greased and floured 10 x 4-inch tube pan.
Bake at 350° about 1 hour and 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 1/4 lb. fresh shrimp or canned (but fresh is better)
steps: Melt together cream cheese and soup.
(Do not add water to soup.
Put in as is and melt with cheese over medium heat until smooth.)
Mix gelatine with 3 tablespoonfuls of water.
Add to soup mixture.
Add soup mixture with the rest of the ingredients in a bowl.
Refrigerate overnight (or at least a few hours).

recipes.title: "Very Very Cake"
steps: Stir well and bake about 40 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Pancakes
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Add milk to beaten eggs and combine. Mix the liquids with the flour mixture and blend.
Stir in melted butter.
Pour into pan sprayed with Pam.
Turn when it browns around edges

recipes.title: Excellent Cheese Biscuits
steps: Mix baking mix, milk and cheese together and drop by tablespoonfuls onto a lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes at 450°.
Melt butter and add garlic powder.
Brush over warm biscuits.

recipes.title: Sehr Gut Potato Salad
steps: Fry bacon until almost crisp.
Add celery and fry until bacon is crisp.
Stir in flour, sugar, salt and dill.
Gradually stir in water and vinegar.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add potatoes and peas; heat through.
Garnish with egg quarters.
May make ahead and refrigerate.
Then bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
steps: Combine the cake mix, cocoa, sugar, oil and cake coloring. Add the eggs and buttermilk.
Mix as any other cake mix in 3 thin layers.
Cook the flour and milk to a thick pudding.
Place in box to cool.
Cream the oleo, Crisco, 1 cup sugar and vanilla. Beat in the pudding mixture and spread on cake. Sprinkle with coconut.

recipes.title: Cream Of Asparagus Soup
steps: Cook asparagus in water until tender.
Whip asparagus in blender until smooth.
Saute onions in margarine.
Stir in flour and cook until bubbly.
Add milk gradually, stirring until thickened.
Stir in asparagus puree.
Add chopped parsley and salt to taste.
Do not boil.

recipes.title: Angel Rolls
steps: Let rise for 30 minutes and knead; cut out with biscuit cutter.
Dip in melted butter; let rise.
Bake at 450° until brown.

recipes.title: Ham, Potato And Cheese Chowder
steps: Put potatoes, onion, water and oleo in covered dish and microwave 10 to 12 minutes, stir occasionally.
In large bowl, combine milk, flour and pepper (shake flour and little milk to dissolve).
Microwave 6 to 7 minutes, stir often.
Pour over potatoes.
Add ham and cheese, microwave 2 to 3 minutes to melt cheese.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: Sift flour with soda and salt; cream butter.
Gradually add sugar; mix well.
Add eggs and bananas.
Blend; add milk and lemon juice.
Add flour mixture and nuts.
Put in a bread pan and cook at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pineapple Pudding
steps: Drain pineapple and set juice side.
Mix flour and sugar.
Add reserved juice, stirring well.
Beat egg and add to mixture.
Stir in pineapple.
Pour into casserole dish.
Top with bread cube. Pour melted oleo over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
steps: Mix ingredients as listed.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350° in 9-inch pans.

recipes.title: Mom'S Baked Chicken And Prunes
ingredients: 3 medium size carrots, cut into bite size chunks
steps: About 1 1/2 hours before serving or day ahead:
Preheat oven to 400°.
In large open roasting pan, arrange chicken pieces, skin side up.
Place carrots and prunes around chicken.
In small bowl, mix brown sugar, lemon juice, white wine vinegar, salt, flour, oregano and pepper until blended.
Pour over chicken.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes, basting chicken frequently with liquid in pan, until chicken is fork-tender.
Arrange chicken, carrots and prunes on large platter or in bowl.
Skim fat from juice in roasting pan; pour pan juices over chicken mixture.
Serve warm or cover and refrigerate to reheat later.
Makes 8 main dish servings, about 335 calories per serving.

recipes.title: Moravian Christmas Cookies
steps: Cream butter and shortening with sugar.
Add molasses.
Add soda to boiling water and add to creamed mixture.
Sift flour with spices and salt.
Add small amount at a time to creamed mixture and work in well.
Work well with hands and knead dough well.
Cover and store in a cold place overnight and longer if you don't want to bake all at one time.
Roll to infinite thinness on board.
(Board should be covered with cloth stretched tight and tacked on edges of board.)
Flour board (cloth) evenly before rolling out cookies. Bake on a greased cookie sheet in 375° oven for a few minutes or just until they begin to brown.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, fried crisp and broken
steps: Place flower tips from broccoli and cauliflower in large bowl. Add cheese, bacon and onion.
Stir up.
In separate bowl, mix Miracle Whip, Green Goddess dressing, sugar and vinegar.
Mix until smooth.
Pour over vegetables.
Stir until fully mixed and coated.

recipes.title: Zucchini Loaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. shredded yellow squash or zucchini
steps: Combine dry ingredients and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla.
Beat well in mixer.
Stir in squash.
Add dry ingredients, stirring only until moistened. Optional nuts and/or raisins may be stirred in.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until done.
Test with toothpick.
Let remain in pan 10 minutes, then remove to cool.

recipes.title: Fried Rice
steps: Melt butter in a skillet; add onion and rice.
Brown, stirring continuously.
Dissolve bouillon cubes in water.
Combine all in a baking dish; add mushrooms, salt and pepper.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Crisps
ingredients: 3/4 lb. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded (3 c.)
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
In a large bowl with hand, knead all ingredients until blended.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
ingredients: 1 stick butter, melted in the oven in a Bundt pan
steps: Mix meal, flour, egg, buttermilk and sugar. Pour over butter in Bundt pan. Bake at 425° for 35 to 40 minutes (until crisp and brown on top).

recipes.title: Sand Tarts
steps: Cream
butter
and powdered sugar.
Work flour, vanilla and nuts
into creamed mixture.
Form into small crescents or balls. Bake on ungreased sheet in oven at 350° for 30 minutes or
until lightly browned.
Roll tarts in powdered sugar while still warm.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Cream together eggs and oil.
Add dry ingredients.
Blend in vanilla, butter extract, pineapple, carrots and pecans.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Carrot Casserole
steps: Puree together carrots, melted margarine and milk.
Mix together sugar, eggs, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and baking powder. Add pureed carrot mixture to rest of ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 to 1 hour until crispy.

recipes.title: Cheese-Stuffed Squash
steps: Cook whole squash in boiling water until tender; drain.
Cut in half lengthwise; scoop out pulp. Reserve pulp and shell.
Mash pulp.
Melt butter over low heat and blend in flour, 1/4 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper.
Remove from heat.
Stir in milk gradually.
Return to heat. Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce is thick.

recipes.title: Bacon Tossed Brussel Sprouts
ingredients: 3 pt. Brussel sprouts, cleaned and halved
8 strips thick sliced bacon, cut crosswise into thin strips
steps: Fill 6 quart Dutch oven with water. Add 1 Tbsp. salt. Bring water to a boil; add Brussels sprouts. Reduce heat to medium. Cook 12 minutes, until crisp and tender. Drain and rinse under cold water to stop cooking. In large non-stick pan, over medium heat, cook bacon for 5 minutes until slightly crisp. Pour off fat. Add onion to bacon in skillet and cook for 5 minutes or until tender. Add sprouts, remaining salt and pepper. Heat thoroughly. Add vinegar and butter, stirring to melt butter.

recipes.title: Stuffed Eggplant
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. shrimp, cleaned and coarsely chopped
steps: Parboil the eggplant whole.
Let cool and cut in half lengthwise.
Scoop inside out, leaving about 1/2-inch around side and bottom.
Chop the pulp.
Saute onion, butter, parsley flakes and garlic powder until wilted.
Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes more.
Add eggplant pulp and 3/4 cup bread crumbs and shrimp and ingredients.
Cook on low heat until done, 5 to 10 minutes.
Fill hull and sprinkle rest of bread crumbs on top.
Add a strip of bacon on each one.
Bake in oven until bacon is done and bread crumbs are toasted.

recipes.title: Pineapple Carrot Bread
ingredients: 1 c. grated carrots (or I use canned carrots)
steps: Combine flour, salt, soda and cinnamon; set aside.
Combine eggs, sugar and oil in mixing bowl.
Mix well.
Stir in carrots and pineapple.
Add dry ingredients and mix well.
Pour batter into 2 greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.
Yields 2 loaves or makes 5 miniature loaves.

recipes.title: Hamburger Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh mushrooms or 1 (8 oz.) can mushrooms, sliced
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
steps: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat. Add meat and brown. Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes. Add soup and simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Heat through.
Serve with noodles or macaroni.

recipes.title: Herbed Lentils And Rice
steps: Combine broth and lentils, onion, uncooked rice, wine and seasonings.
Shred 1/2 ounce cheese and stir into ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish and bake, covered, at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until lentils and rice are done, stirring twice.
Cut remaining cheese into strips and uncover casserole.
Top with cheese strips.
Bake an additional 2 to 3 minutes more until cheese melts.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Mother'S Jam Cake
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. each: cinnamon, allspice and cloves
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time and beat well.
Put soda in buttermilk and sift together flour, cocoa and spices.
Add alternately with buttermilk and soda, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.
Then add jam and preserves, nuts and raisins.
Pour into tube pan lined with greased brown paper.
Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
Makes a large cake.
I just grease and flour the pan.
Top with Caramel Frosting.

recipes.title: Tomato Beef Stew
steps: Shake meat with seasoned flour in plastic bag.
Brown meat in shortening in Dutch oven or stew pot.
Add soup and water; cover. Simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover.
Cook 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.
Stir occasionally to thicken.
Uncover and cook to desired consistency.
Serves 5.

recipes.title: Lemon Squares
steps: Mix flour, sugar and butter until the size of small peas.
Pat gently into a 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bake crust in a 325° oven for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 chicken, cut in pieces and salted
steps: Place chicken pieces in greased casserole and pour taco sauce over chicken according to taste.
Cover casserole and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, uncovered.
Sprinkle cheese over top of chicken and cover with broken tortilla chips.
Bake, uncovered, until cheese is melted and chips are hot.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Pork Chops New Orleans
ingredients: 2 large tomatoes or 1 can stewed tomatoes
1 green pepper, chopped or sliced thin
1 c. chicken broth or bouillon cube
1/2 c. white wine (a drop extra is good)
steps: Brown chops on both sides and place in buttered casserole. Arrange tomatoes, onion and green pepper on top of chops.
Heat broth and wine together in separate pan; add thyme, sage, salt and pepper to broth after heating.
Sprinkle raw rice over casserole and pour hot broth over all; mix (might add a little extra rice and broth).
Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour; be sure rice is thoroughly cooked.
Liquid will be absorbed.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf And Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 c. soda cracker crumbs or rolled oats
steps: Arrange evenly in greased 2-quart baking dish the potatoes, salt, pepper and some of the onions. Mix ground beef, milk, crackers or oats, catsup, rest of onions and some more salt and pepper. Spread evenly over potatoes. Bake in 350° oven 1 hour until potatoes are tender. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Squash-Potato-Onion Casserole
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. shortening (bacon drippings may be used)
steps: Mix all ingredients and place in baking dish.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
Stir about 3 times.

recipes.title: Chocolate Vinegar Cake
steps: Mix in order.
Grease and flour a 13 1/2 x 9 1/2-inch cake pan.
Pour mixture in and bake at 300° for about 1 hour until top springs back at touch.

recipes.title: Orange Slice Cake
steps: Cut nuts, dates and orange candy into small pieces.
Add coconut.
Melt butter and pour over nut mixture.
In another bowl, mix eggs, sugar, flour, soda and milk.
Pour over the nut mixture and mix well in a large bowl.
Bake in tube pan 2 hours at 300°. Let cool in pan.

recipes.title: Walnut Cake
steps: Cream together Crisco, sugar and margarine.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Mix well.
Add flour and milk alternately.
Add vanilla. Mix all ingredients well.
Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 300°.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
steps: Blend the flour, baking powder and baking soda with the butter.
Add raisins, sugar and caraway seeds.

recipes.title: Never Fail Rolls
steps: Mix shortening, sugar, salt and boiling water.
Add yeast to lukewarm water.
When dissolved, add eggs and flour; combine all. Let rise 1 hour.
Make into rolls and let rise, bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Mongolian Beef(Spicy)
ingredients: 2 to 3 green onions, sliced into 2-inch diagonal slices
steps: Deep fry beef in oil.
In wok, stir-fry beef, red peppers and onion in sesame oil. Add approximately 2 tablespoons each of soy sauce, oyster sauce and wine sauce.
(All can be found in any Asian grocery store.)
Season with black pepper and pinch of sugar.
Stir-fry quickly to blend flavors.
Place crisp fried rice noodles on serving dish.
Cover with beef mixture and serve.

recipes.title: Shrimp Etouffee
ingredients: 3/4 c. green onion or regular onion
2 Tbsp. flour mixed with 1/2 c. V-8 juice or Bloody Mary mix
2 heaping Tbsp. cream of celery soup (undiluted)
garlic powder to taste or chopped fresh garlic
steps: Saute onion, celery and bell pepper in oleo.
Add other ingredients, adding shrimp last.
Cook until shrimp are done. Serve over rice.
Adjust thickness by adding more flour or chicken broth, according to your taste.
Use more shrimp, if desired.

recipes.title: Strudel
steps: Put fruit, sugar and salt in greased baking dish; dot with butter.
Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and egg.
Spread over top of fruit; cover with foil and bake at 375° for 20 minutes, or until fruit bubbles.
Uncover; bake 25 minutes longer.
Serve warm with topping, custard or ice cream.

recipes.title: Gingernut Cookies
steps: Melt butter in a pan and remove from heat; add sugar, syrup and beaten egg.
Mix until well combined.
Sift flour and ginger into bowl and pour in butter mixture.
Mix until combined.
Allow to cool a little.
Roll teaspoons of mixture into balls.
Place well apart on lightly greased cookie sheets.
Bake in moderate oven for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes about 45.

recipes.title: Wheat Rolls
steps: Mix flours
and
salt
with
tablespoons sugar.
Mix yeast with water and remaining sugar.
Stir in oil.
Mix yeast mixture with flour.
Cover and set for 1 hour at room temperature.
Spray baking
pan.
Form rolls and place in pan.
Rise 1/2 hour.
Cook at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes, until done.

recipes.title: Gourmet Stew
ingredients: 2 lb. stew meat, cut into small bite-size pieces
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a casserole dish. Cover and bake at 250° for about 3 to 4 hours. Serve with noodles, rice or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. Baker's German's sweet chocolate
steps: Melt chocolate in boiling water; cool.
Sift flour, soda and salt.
Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating after each.
Blend in vanilla and melted chocolate.
Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk, beating after each addition.
Fold in egg whites. Pour into three 9-inch layer pans, lined on bottom with waxed paper and greased.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed in center.
Cool in pans for 15 minutes.
Remove and cool on rack.
Spread coconut-pecan frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake.

recipes.title: Pudding Dessert(12 To 15 People)
ingredients: 2 small pkg. instant lemon pudding (approximately 3.5 oz. size)
steps: Beat the ingredients together and spread over cream cheese. Refrigerate until firm.
One-half hour before serving, spread whipped cream over the top.

recipes.title: Breakfast Tacos(Eggs With Chile)
steps: Scramble the eggs with 1/4 cup of milk.
Saute onions in bacon grease.
Pour mixture into bacon grease in skillet.
Add chopped bacon.
In blender, mix jalapeno peppers with tomato sauce.
Add 1 cup of water to this mixture; dump into scrambled eggs.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with tortillas.
Serves at least 4 persons.

recipes.title: Down Home Pound Cake
steps: Separate
eggs.
Whip
whites;
add 6 level tablespoons of sugar
and refrigerate until rest of cake is mixed.
Cream butter and remaining sugar, beating until very light (this is important). Add
egg
yolks,
2 at a time, beating well after each addition. Add flour and cream alternately, beating until mixture
is light. Add vanilla.
Fold in egg whites.
Bake in greased
and
floured tube pan at 300° for about 1 hour and 25 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Special Cheese Cake
steps: Soften
margarine
and blend with graham cracker crumbs. Spread evenly
on
bottom
and sides of 9-inch spring-form pan. Blend remaining
ingredients, one at a time and mix well.
Pour into spring pan.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.
Leave oven door closed for 1
hour to let set and cool.
Next open and cool, 30 minutes more.

recipes.title: Light And Creamy Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 pkg. (6 serving size) instant vanilla pudding
steps: Combine pumpkin, milk, pudding mix and pie spice in a small bowl.
Beat at low speed until blended, about 1 minute.
Fold in 2 1/2 cups of Cool Whip.
Spoon into crust.
Refrigerate until firm, about 4 hours.
Use remaining Cool Whip on top, if desired.

recipes.title: Porcupine Meatballs
steps: Combine meat, rice, egg, parsley, onion, salt, pepper and 1/4 cup soup; mix well.
Shape into 20 small meatballs and place in large saucepan.
Mix remaining soup, water and Worcestershire sauce.
Pour over meatballs.
Bring to boil; reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 40 minutes, stirring often.

recipes.title: Lemon Rice
steps: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Deluxe Refrigerator Rolls
steps: In large bowl, sprinkle yeast over warm water.
Stir in butter, shortening, sugar and potatoes.
Add cold water and salt; stir in flour.
Use immediately, or store in refrigerator.
Pat on table; cut into squares.
Makes about 3 dozen.
Place in pan, not touching.
Let rise 1 hour, until double in size.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Casserole Burgers
ingredients: small green pepper, cut in strips
steps: Mix beef, onion, egg, bread crumbs, salt, pepper and tomato sauce.
Make into patties.
Melt butter in pan.
Add patties and green pepper strips.
Brown slowly until done.
Serve with rice or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
ingredients: 1 medium onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings
steps: In large saucepan, cook bacon until crisp.
Remove, crumble and set aside.
Reserve 3 tablespoons bacon drippings in saucepan; discard remainder.
Add onion slices to saucepan and cook until lightly brown.
Add potatoes and water and cook until potatoes are tender.
Add corn, milk, salt and pepper.
Cook until it starts to boil.
Serve with crackers.
Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Carrot Cake
ingredients: 3 c. grated carrots (California are best, sweeter)
steps: *Mazola oil work best in recipe.

recipes.title: Scalloped Pineapple
ingredients: 1 large can chunk pineapple, drained (save juice)
steps: Toss drained pineapple and cheese together.
Combine sugar and flour and mix with pineapple juice; pour over pineapple and cheese mixture.
Take 4 or 5 slices of white bread, cut in cubes and butter well with melted butter.
Put bread mixture over pineapple. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown.

recipes.title: Simple Strawberry Cake
steps: Combine butter or margarine and confectioners sugar; add strawberry juice until desired spreading consistency.
Beat until creamy.

recipes.title: Pecan Buns
steps: In a large bowl, blend egg, sugar and warm water.
Stir in yeast until dissolved.
Add roll mix gradually.
Add extra flour and knead until dough is not sticky.
Put in a warm place and let rise about one hour.

recipes.title: Tom'S Navy Bean Soup
steps: Wash and look through beans.
Combine beans and water in large dutch oven, bring to boil, cover and remove from heat.
Let stand for one hour.
Add ham hocks, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 3 hours.
Remove meat from bone, chop into pieces and add back to soup.
Stir in salt and pepper.
Saute onion in butter and add to soup, stirring in well.
Serve while hot with cornbread or crackers.
Yields about 5 quarts.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour cake pan.
Cream sugar, shortening and eggs.
Add mashed bananas and vanilla.
Mix well. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk.
Stir in nuts.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes.
Cool and frost with Caramel Icing (page 90).

recipes.title: "Date Ball" Cookies
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients together and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until it boils hard.
Cool slightly; add 1 teaspoon vanilla and Rice Krispies.
You may substitute 1 cup nuts for 1 cup Rice Krispies.
Cool.
Form into balls (1 teaspoon each) and roll in coconut.
(Good frozen.)

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Combine all ingredients in order given.
Mix well.
Pour into loaf pan and bake at 350°.
Bread is done when top springs back when touched.

recipes.title: Beignets From Togo
steps: Grind dry black-eyed peas into a flour.
Mix this with chili pepper, minced onion and salt.
Add small amount of water to make small rolls.
Fry in hot oil.

recipes.title: Biscuits
steps: With fingers, crumble butter and enough flour (mix flour and salt first) to make a coarse, meal-like texture.
Add enough milk to stick it all together.
Turn onto floured surface, roll and cut. Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 8 to 10 biscuits.

recipes.title: M&M Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine first 3 ingredients in a small bowl. Cream butter with sugars. Add vanilla and eggs to creamed mixture. Then add dry ingredients and mix until well blended. Add M&M's and mix again.
Drop by the teaspoon on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 11 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
steps: Mix together first three ingredients.
In 1-cup measure, put the vinegar and egg; beat slightly.
Fill cup with ice water. Pour over first mixture and blend to make a soft dough.
Makes 4 double crusts.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Crispies
steps: Cream shortening and sugars. Add beaten eggs and vanilla. Add flour, salt and soda or baking powder. Mix well. Add oatmeal and nuts or raisins or both. Roll in rolls about inches in diameter. Chill. Slice 1/4-inch tick. Bake on ungreased sheet 10 to 15 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Nan'S Hershey Chocolate Cake
steps: Soften butter.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add flour, syrup and vanilla.
Bake in a well-greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Six-Layer Casserole
steps: In a greased casserole, make a layer of each ingredient in the order listed.
Season each layer.
Bake for 2 hours at 350°. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Braised Cabbage
steps: In a large pot saut onions and bacon until tender.
Add cabbage, water, salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer until done.
Mix cornstarch with water and add to cabbage.
Cook until liquid is slightly thick.

recipes.title: Loaf Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Grease and flour a loaf pan. Bake at 350° for about 10 or 12 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Sourdough Culture
steps: Allow milk to stand in a warm place for 24 hours.
Using a wooden spoon, stir in flour.
Allow to stand in a warm place until it forms bubbles and becomes very sour.
When ready, place in a large, loosely covered bowl and place in refrigerator.
Never use metal bowls or utensils when working with sourdough.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
steps: Hand mix:
Melt butter and add sugar, then eggs and mix well. Mix flour and all other dry ingredients.
Alternately add flour mixture and applesauce to butter, sugar and egg mixture.
Add nuts, raisins and water last.
Pour batter into a well greased and floured lg. tube pan or 3 sm. loaf pans.
(It only takes the small ones about an hour to bake at the same temp.)
Bake at 350 on middle rack.
Do not open oven door any more than necessary.
Check the large one after an hour, sticking a toothpick in to see if it is done.
Cool in pan for 25 min. then remove to cake rack.

recipes.title: Mississippi Mud
steps: Combine walnuts, flour and butter until crumbly, Sprinkle into the bottom of an ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350 degrees.
Cool.
Mix 2 instant chocolate puddings with 2 c. milk.
Spread over cream cheese layer.
Mix 2 instant vanilla puddings with 2 c. milk.
Spread over chocolate layer.
Top with 1-12 oz.
Cool whip, Sprinkle with chocolate jimmies.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Beat eggs until light and foamy, then add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla.
Mix well.
Add flour mixture slowly.
Blend well. Makes 2 loaves.
Bake at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage
steps: Fry together onion, garlic, salt, pepper, hamburger and sausage.
Combine meat mixture into rice.
Put a large spoonful in each cabbage leaf that has been partly boiled.
Fold leaf into square.
Lay in pan.
Pour tomato mixture over top and sprinkle caraway seed over top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dog Biscuits
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine wheat flour, powdered milk, salt and garlic powder.
Cut in shortening or meat drippings until mixture resembles corn meal.
Mix in egg and add enough ice water until mixture forms a dough.
Roll out 1/2-inch thick and cut. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until done.

recipes.title: Fried Chicken
steps: Mix flour, meal, salt and pepper in a dish.
Melt shortening in an electric skillet.
Roll chicken in batter and fry in electric skillet for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Layered Spinach Salad
steps: In a greased 8x10 inch casserole, layer each ingredient as listed.
Add a Tbsp. or so of mayonnaise to peas to keep them together.
Refrigerate overnight.
Cut into squares and serve.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Lasagna(Makes 8 Servings)
ingredients: 2 c. tomato sauce, canned tomatoes or thinned paste
3/4 lb. sliced mushrooms, sauteed in olive oil
3/4 c. dry, small, red beans, cooked tender
steps: Rinse the cooked noodles in cold water.
Set them aside. Saute the onions and garlic in the olive oil until soft and transparent, but not browned.
Stir in the tomato, oregano, basil, parsley and salt.
Cook sauce about 1/2 hour, simmering it and stirring often until it has thickened.
Stir in the sauteed mushrooms and cooked beans.

recipes.title: Zucchini Nut Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients together, adding nuts last.
Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Cola Barbecued Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Dust chicken with flour, shaking off excess.
In a 10-inch skillet, heat oil over high heat.
Add chicken and brown about 3 minutes on each side.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Beat eggs.
Add oil and sugar.
Mix dry ingredients together, then add the egg mixture with milk.
Apples and nuts go in last. Blend well with electric mixer. Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Shrimp Linguine
steps: Peel and devein shrimp but leave tails intact.
Prepare linguini according to package directions.
Drain.
Keep warm.
In a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat, heat 2 tablespoons oil; add shrimp.
Cook 4 minutes, stirring frequently, until shrimp are tender and just pink.
Using a slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to a plate.

recipes.title: North Carolina Bishops Bread
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) jar maraschino cherries, drained and cut up (1 c.)
steps: Combine eggs and sugar.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Add to egg mixture.
Stir in dates, cherries, chocolate pieces and nuts.
Bake in 325° oven for 1 1/4 hours.
Let stand overnight before slicing.

recipes.title: Louise'S Cornbread
steps: Mix cornmeal, sugar, and oil.
Add 3/4 boiling water.
Mix well.
Beat egg yolk and add to mixture along with the buttermilk. Whip egg white and fold in.
Pour into muffin tins sprayed with Pam.
Bake at 400° for 12-15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sesame Toffee Bars(Delicious)
steps: Toast sesame seed under broiler until brown.
Cream butter and brown sugar.
Add egg and vanilla; mix well.
Sift flour with spices; add to creamed mixture and blend.
Stir in nuts.
Spread 1/4 inch thick in 13 x 15-inch greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Spread melted chocolate over while still hot.
Sprinkle with sesame seed and cut while warm.

recipes.title: Fried Alligator Fingers
steps: Soak the fingers in buttermilk for several hours; drain and salt and pepper to taste.
Heat about 1-inch of oil in frying pan. Shake the fingers in flour.
Place in frypan in hot oil on medium heat for several minutes, turning until all sides are brown.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Combine oil and sugar blend.
Add eggs one at a time.
Add vanilla.
Combine flour, soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and sift. Add to previous mixture.
Fold in apples, nuts and dates.
Bake in 325° oven for 1 1/2 hours.
Cool in pan for 15 minutes before you remove from pan.

recipes.title: Outrageous Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Beat sugars, margarine, peanut butter, vanilla and egg in bowl until creamy and well blended. Mix in flour, oats, baking soda and salt.
Stir in chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Nut Muffins
steps: In a medium bowl combine brown sugar, pecans, flour and salt. Stir in eggs and vanilla just until blended.
Batter will be lumpy.
Spray the muffin cups with cooking spray or line them with paper cups.
Fill cups about 2/3 full.
Place muffin cups in cold oven.
Set oven on 300° and bake for 25 minutes.
Cool on a wire rack, run a knife round the edge of each muffin cup to loosen muffins.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

recipes.title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and well drained
steps: Melt butter, add onions and saute until light golden.
Blend in flour, salt, pepper and stir constantly about 2 minutes.
Gradually add broth, then broccoli and bring to boil.
Stir frequently, cover and simmer until broccoli is tender.
Puree in batches.
Return to saucepan, add milk and bring to simmer.
Ladle into bowl and sprinkle with grated cheese; run under preheated broiler until cheese is browned.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Rice
steps: Salt and pepper pork chops. Flour and brown on both sides. Put rice in bottom of baking dish. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top of rice. Place pork chops on top of rice and onion mix. Pour water over all. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken  Broccoli And Rice
steps: Add rice to boiling water; set aside.
Melt butter and fry onion until soft.
Add Cheez Whiz to onion and butter to soften. Add soup, milk, salt, pepper, rice and broccoli.
Mix well.
Add chicken; mix again.
Place in 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 350°, covered, for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.
This freezes well. Mix ingredients and freeze.
To use, thaw and add bread crumbs. Bake according to directions.

recipes.title: Smoked Sausage And Apple-Kraut
steps: Mix sauerkraut, apples and thyme in a Dutch oven.
Put the smoked sausage on top.
Poke the sausage several times with a fork.
Pour the apple juice in the Dutch oven. Simmer in covered pan for 1/2 hour.
If there is too much liquid, continue to simmer, uncovered, until the liquid is reduced.

recipes.title: Chicken Marinade
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Stir or mix well.
Wash chicken pieces.
Place chicken in large flat baking pan.
Pour or spoon marinade over chicken and let it marinate several hours.
Place in oven at 375° for 1 hour or until done.
Make gravy with juices. Serve with rice, mixed vegetables and butternut squash baked.

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. Buttermilk or 1/2 c. Milk with 1/2 tsp. Vinegar
steps: 1. Combine sugar, magarine, and oil in large bowl and beat until fluffy.
Add eggs, beating after each one. 2. Add vanilla and buttermilk and beat until smooth.
Mix dry ingredients.
Gradually add to first mixture beating until smooth. 3. Fold in zucchini, chocolate chips, and nuts.
Pour into greased 9 x 13 pan. 4. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes to one hour or till cake tests done.

recipes.title: Cookie Cake
steps: Beat well.
Bake in a cookie sheet for 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Wacky Cake
steps: Sift all the dry ingredients together into the pan you are going to bake the cake in.
Make a well in dry ingredients and add wet ingredients.
Add water slowly and mix thoroughly with a spoon.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve from pan.
Use any frosting.

recipes.title: Hidden Valley Ranch Pinwheels
ingredients: 1 (1 oz.) pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch original dressing mix
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients. Spread on tortillas. Drain vegetables and blot dry on paper towel. Sprinkle equal amounts of remaining ingredients on top of cream cheese. Roll tortillas tightly. Chill for at least 2 hours, then cut the rolls into 1-inch pieces. Discard ends. Serve with spirals facing up. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Cranapple Crunch
steps: Line a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish, which has been buttered, with the apples.
Spread with cranberries.
Mix oatmeal, flour, brown sugar and butter.
Crumble over apples and cranberries.
Bake at 300° until done.

recipes.title: Wacky Cake
steps: In ungreased 8-inch square pan, combine flour, cocoa, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Make 3 holes in mixture. Pour oil into one, vanilla into another and vinegar into the third.
Add water and mix with fork until well blended.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Navy Bean Soup(Crock-Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb. ham or smoked pork butt
steps: Soak beans in water overnight.
Combine all ingredients in cooker. Add water to cover. Cook on low 10 to 12 hours or on high 5 to 6 hours. Remove ham or pork from soup; cut into pieces and return to pot.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Beat sugar, oil and eggs together.
Mix remaining ingredients into sugar mixture.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Cake(Serves 15 To 18)
steps: Bring water and butter to boil (melted). All at once, add flour and salt. Beat until mixture forms ball and leaves sides of saucepan. Cool slightly. Add eggs, one at a time. Beat after each one (it will be like play dough). Spread into lightly greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 400° for 35 minutes. Remove. Pierce bubbles with fork while hot. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Christmas Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. sour milk (add 1 tsp. vinegar to milk to make it sour)
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix together sugar, oleo, eggs, sour milk and vanilla.
Add flour, soda, baking powder and salt.
Stir well.
Refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours.
Roll out on floured board. Cut into Christmas shapes.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Dessert Cake
steps: Place the egg in a bowl and beat.
Add the fruit cocktail, then add dry ingredients (except brown sugar).
Mix well.
Put in ungreased pan.
Sprinkle with the brown sugar.
Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.
Broken pecans can be added on top of brown sugar before baking.

recipes.title: Mock Chopped Liver
steps: Saute the onion until brown.
Blend all ingredients in food processor.
Serve chilled with crackers.

recipes.title: Rocky Road Cake
steps: Sift together flour, sugar and salt.
Add eggs and vanilla. Add walnuts.
Fold in melted margarine.
Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 40 minutes at 350°.
Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle with marshmallows.

recipes.title: Muffins
steps: Mix and sift dry ingredients. Add milk and eggs; mix well. Add oil; mix thoroughly. Fill buttered muffin tins 1/2 to 2/3 full. Bake in hot oven (400° to 425°) for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Paella
ingredients: 3 c. Goya Blue Rose rice (a short grain rice)
6 packets Herb-Ox instant chicken broth (1.5 oz. box)
1 (4 oz.) jar pimentos or roasted red peppers
steps: Debone pork.
Cut up chicken and pork into mouth-sized pieces. Preheat a large skillet or paella pan with 1/4-inch coating of olive oil (medium flame).
Toss in chicken and pork; cook evenly. Chop onion into small pieces and add to meat.
Cook with cover on for 20 to 30 minutes (low flame).

recipes.title: Krispy Cheese Crackers
steps: Mix cheese and margarine; add flour, salt and pepper, mix well.
Shape into small balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork.
Bake at 375° about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato & Sausage Chowder
steps: Melt butter and cook onion until soft.
Stir in flour.
Add potatoes, milk, salt & pepper.
Cook 25-30 minutes.
Add cheese and kielbasa and cook another 2-3 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Combine all ingredients in a loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or longer.

recipes.title: Icebox Rolls
ingredients: 1 yeast cake, dissolved in lukewarm water
steps: Sift flour 4 times.
Pour boiling water over shortening, sugar and salt.
When cooled, add 2 well beaten eggs and yeast.
Last add the flour.
Mix well; let rise until double.
Knead and shape into rolls and let rise again.
Bake at 375° until done.

recipes.title: Chicken In Green Sauce-Guatemala(Jocon)
ingredients: 1 cup green onions chopped, green part only
steps: Cook chicken in the water with 1 tsp. of salt in a covered pot, about 30 minutes, or until chicken is soft.
Remove chicken and set aside.
Save broth and soak tortillas in in it.
Toast sesame seeds and squash seeds in a skillet until they lightly brown.
In a food processor, grind the seeds. add the cilantro, green onions, hot chiles, tomatillos and 1 cup of the broth.
Add the tortillas and process into a smooth paste.
Brown the chicken in a lightly oiled pan for 5 minutes over medium heat.
Add the paste mixture and the remaining broth, about 2 cups.
Simmer over low heat for 15 minutes until the sauce is reduced to a thick, rich, green consistency. Serve over rice if desired.
Makes 4-6 servings.

recipes.title: Lemon Pudding Cake
steps: Mix together flour, sugar and salt.
Stir in lemon rind, juice, well beaten egg yolks and milk.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole or 6 custard cups.
Set in pan of water (1-inch deep).
Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°. Serve warm or cold.
Good with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Kahlua Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 3/4 c. chopped hazelnuts or pecans, toasted then divide
steps: Beat butter at medium speed of electric mixer; gradually add sugar, beat well.
Add eggs, one at a time; beat well after each one.
Add the Kahlua and chocolate; beat until blended.
Combine flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt; add to the mixture in mixing bowl; alternate with the milk until all is used (begin and end with flour).
Mix well after each addition.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans.
Bake at 350° for 18 to 23 minutes or until cake tests done.
Cool on wire racks for 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool.
Stir 1/2 cup nuts into 1 cup of the frosting; spread between layers.
Frost rest of cake. Sprinkle with reserved nuts.

recipes.title: Sweet Nut Braid
steps: Soften yeast in water.
Combine 1/3 cup butter, sugar, salt and milk.
Stir to melt butter.
Cool to lukewarm.
Stir in eggs and yeast.
Gradually add flour to form stiff dough.
Knead 5 to 8 minutes.
Cover; let rise about 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Italian Anise Slices
ingredients: 1 c. thinly sliced blanched almonds, coarsely broken
1 tsp. anise flavoring or 1/4 tsp. oil of anise
steps: Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt.
In a large mixing bowl, cream butter, sugar and anise flavoring; beat in eggs, one at a time.
Add flour mixture and almonds.
Turn out on a floured pastry cloth and knead gently until smooth.
Divide dough in half.
Shape each half into a roll about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place on lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven until firm to the touch, about 30 to 35 minutes.
Remove from oven and let cool slightly.
While still warm.
Cut rolls into crosswise slices about 1/2-inch thick.
Place cut side down on cookie sheet.
Return to oven and bake until toasted and dried out, about 10 to 20 minutes, longer if necessary. Turn once to toast and brown both sides.
Cool completely.
Store in a tightly covered tin box.
Makes 3 to 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Fricasse
ingredients: 1 carrot, peeled, quartered and cut in 1-inch lengths
steps: Fry chicken in butter (use heavy skillet) for 5 minutes; add onion, garlic and tarragon sprigs.
Sprinkle with flour, stirring to distribute flour evenly.
Add water and carrots.
Cover and cook for 20 minutes.
Remove chicken and keep warm.
Let the sauce cook down, stirring often, for about 5 minutes.
Remove tarragon; add cream, salt and pepper.
Simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in chopped tarragon and serve with rice.
Serves four.

recipes.title: Pat'S Hungarian Goulash
ingredients: 6 Tbsp. catsup or 1 can tomato sauce
steps: Brown meat;
add
onions.
Combine
first 4 ingredients and add.
Combine next	3
ingredients	and add.
Add 1 cup of the water.
Cook 2
to	2 1/2 hours (until tender).
Mix flour with remaining water
and
add and let thicken.	I add carrots or green beans for variety.	Serves 4.

recipes.title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
steps: Combine ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Veggie Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
steps: Unroll crescent rolls and press on a cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 12 minutes.
Gently press, if puffy.
Cool completely.

recipes.title: Gourmet Potatoes
steps: Cook potatoes in skins.
Let cool.
Peel and shred coarsely. Over low heat, cook onion in butter.
Add cheese and stir until almost melted. Remove from heat and blend in sour cream, salt and pepper.
Fold in potatoes.
Put in greased 2-quart casserole. Dot with butter and bacon.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Hearty Steak And Kidney Pie
ingredients: 2 lb. chuck, cut into 2 x 1-inch strips
1 pt. fresh oysters or 1 (8 oz.) can oysters (optional)
1 lb. fresh mushrooms, washed and halved or 2 (8 oz.) cans mushrooms, whole or sliced
steps: Cover kidneys with cold water.
Add 1 teaspoon salt; let stand for 1 hour.
Prepare pie crust mix according to package directions.
Refrigerate until ready to use.
Roll (beef) chuck strips in 1/4 cup flour on waxed paper, coating evenly; shake off excess flour.
In large skillet, melt butter.
Add strips of chuck and brown well on all sides.
Brown only enough at one time to cover bottom of skillet.
Takes about 25 minutes.
Arrange around sides of 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: Fudge Pie
steps: Beat sugar and oleo together.
Add eggs; mix well.
Add flour, chocolate and vanilla.
Blend well.
Pour into greased Pyrex (9-inch) pie plate.
Bake 25 minutes at 325°.
Serve warm with ice cream.

recipes.title: Frosty Dessert
steps: Mix cream cheese with powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip; stir until smooth.
Spread on cooled crust.
Mix pudding with milk. Spread on top of cream cheese.
Spread Cool Whip on top of cream cheese.
Sprinkle with whatever you have.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Banana Bread
steps: Sift together dry ingredients; set aside.
Combine bananas, sugar, eggs and butter; blend well.
Alternately blend in flour and milk.
Stir in pecans and butterscotch morsels.
Pour in greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Sprinkle 1/3 cup finely chopped pecan pieces on top.
Bake at 350° about 1 hour.
Cool 30 minutes. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Apple Fritters
steps: Combine egg and milk.
Stir in sugar and salt.
Sift and mix together the flour and baking powder.

recipes.title: Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 (16 oz.) cans pork and beans (any brand)
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for about 1 hour.
Serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Country Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 frying chicken (2 1/2 to 3 lb.), cut up
steps: Blend milk and egg.
Combine flour and seasoning in plastic bag.
Shake chicken in seasoned flour.
Dip chicken pieces in milk-egg mixture.
Shake chicken a second time in seasoning mixture to coat thoroughly and evenly.

recipes.title: Slush Cake
steps: Mix together and press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Rolls
steps: Combine in a large bowl 1 1/2 cups flour and yeast.
Heat buttermilk, butter, sugar and salt until warm and butter is almost melted (120° to 130°).
Add to flour mixture along with eggs. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes after blending with electric mixer.
Stir in remaining flour with mixing spoon and as much flour as needed to form soft dough.
Knead 6 to 8 minutes on floured surface.
Let rise until double.
Make into desired rolls. Makes 1 1/2 dozen cloverleaf rolls.
Let dough again.
Bake for 15 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Fried Rabbit
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. rabbit, dressed, cleaned and cut into serving pieces
steps: Roll rabbit in mixture of flour, salt and pepper.
Heat fat or oil, about 1/4 inch deep, in heavy frypan, large enough to hold the pieces without crowding.
Use moderate temperature.

recipes.title: Roast Turkey With Wild Rice Stuffing
steps: Preheat oven to 325°. Remove giblets from turkey; set aside for gravy. Wash and dry turkey inside and out. Wash and drain wild rice. Cook and stir celery and onions in butter in a large sauce pan until tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in mushrooms and green pepper, cook and stir 3 minutes. Stir in rice, add 2 cans of chicken broth and remaining ingredients, except egg. Heat to boiling, reduce heat and cover. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, one hour or more. Remove from heat and let stand covered about 20 minutes, stir in egg. Spoon stuffing into neck cavity, bring skin of neck back over and fasten with a poultry pin. Spoon stuffing into body cavity, do not pack. Most turkeys have a band of skin or metal to push legs through. Place turkey in roaster and roast according to package directions for pounds of turkey. Thermometer should register 195° if used. When turkey is done, remove from pan and use pan drippings to make gravy. Let stand 20 minutes before carving.

recipes.title: Italian Salad
steps: Combine the dressing, sugar, onion and Parmesan cheese in a large Ziploc bag; refrigerate and let marinate for 8 to 12 hours. Mix remaining ingredients and toss just before serving.

recipes.title: Bible Cake
steps: Beat (third word in Proverbs 23:14).
Bake in loaf pans at 325° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Rhubarb Crisp
ingredients: 1/2 c. light brown sugar, firmly packed
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine 1 tablespoon margarine, 3 tablespoons flour, the brown sugar and nutmeg. Stir in water. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until thickened. Add rhubarb and cook until tender. Remove from heat. Stir in pineapple and pour into ungreased, shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish (12 x 7 x 2-inch works well). Combine 1/2 cup sugar, 3/4 cup flour and remaining margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle over fruit mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve warm. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.

Dissolve soda in vinegar; set aside. Cream the shortening. Add sugar and beat well with electric mixer. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Beat in soda mixture. Sift together flour, cocoa and salt. Combine buttermilk, vanilla and food coloring.

Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk mixture, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Bake 25 to 35 minutes. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool on racks. Spread Custard Frosting between layers, top and sides. Sprinkle with coconut flakes, if desired.

recipes.title: Arroz Con Pollo(Rice With Chicken)
ingredients: 1/4 lb. lean ham or Canadian bacon, diced
1 small can pimentos, drained and diced
steps: Separate breasts, wings, drumsticks and liver.
Place remaining parts of chicken in saucepan with 3 cups water, peeled onion, saffron and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt.
Boil 30 minutes; strain to make 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Christmas Cookies
steps: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt.
Mix well. Add shortening and cut into flour mixture with a pastry blender. Break eggs in a cup and fill with milk to make 1 cup; add vanilla. Add to flour mixture and mix well.
Chill if desired for easier handling.
Roll out on pastry cloth and cut out cookies.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool and decorate as desired.

recipes.title: Doughnuts
steps: Beat the one egg; add sugar and beat until very light and white.
Add the milk without stirring.
Then sift 1 pint flour to which has been added the baking powder and salt and nutmeg.
Beat this thoroughly; then add quickly enough flour to make a firm but soft dough.
Roll out 1/2-inch thick; cut into rings.

recipes.title: Date Nut Bread
steps: Pour boiling water over dates and nuts.
Let them stand until cool.
Mix shortening and sugar.
Add the eggs, without heating. Sift salt with flour.
Now add soda to dates and nuts.
Add alternately to the sugar mixture with flour.
Lastly, stir in 2 to 3 cups cold water.
Bake in two loaf pans at 350° for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Naomi Currey'S Mincemeat Cake
steps: Mix brown sugar, white sugar, Crisco and eggs in bowl.
Add mincemeat and milk.
Stir, then add soda, baking powder, flour, salt and spices.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Test with toothpick.

recipes.title: Cream Caramel Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time.
Sift flour, baking soda and salt together.
Alternating, add flour and sour cream to butter mixture.
Add vanilla.

recipes.title: Mexican Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 can cream of cheddar cheese soup
steps: Prepare rice according to directions on bag.
Saute onions and ground beef.
Add chili mix, canned tomatoes, salt and pepper to beef mixture.
Add rice.
Mix milk and cheddar cheese soup together and beat until creamy.
Pour over meat mixture.
Top with cubed fresh tomatoes, shredded lettuce, shredded cheese and Fritos.

recipes.title: Cheesy Broccoli Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli, cooked according to pkg. directions and drained
2 c. ham, cut in small pieces
steps: In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, combine soup and sour cream. Stir in broccoli, ham and rice.
Mix well. In a cup, combine bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over casserole.
Heat oven to 350°. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve.

recipes.title: B J'S Baked Ham Omelette
ingredients: 1 lb. Muenster or Jack cheese, shredded
steps: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
Sift flour with baking powder; beat eggs and season lightly.
Add 5 to 6 drops Tabasco sauce.
Stir in flour, ham, cheese, cottage cheese and most of the melted margarine.
Swirl rest of margarine around in dish to coat evenly.
Pour in egg mixture.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer until puffed and golden brown.
Cut into squares and serve.

recipes.title: Spinach Quiche
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Prepare spinach according to package and drain well. Combine eggs, cheese, milk and onions. Add salt, celery salt, basil and garlic. Combine with spinach.
Pour into unbaked pie crust. Top by overlapping sliced tomatoes and crumbled bacon strips.
Cover edge of crust with tinfoil to prevent it from getting too brown.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 25 to 30 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Spicy Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen mixed vegetables or canned Veg-All
steps: Combine beef and garlic in a Dutch oven.
Cook over medium heat until browned, stirring to crumble meat.
Drain meat in colander, pat with paper towel.
Wipe pan drippings from skillet with paper towel.
Return meat to Dutch oven, add tomato juice and next 9 ingredients.
Bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat.
Simmer 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in mixed vegetables.
Cover and cook 25 minutes.
Yields 10 cups, 177 calories per cup.

recipes.title: Southwestern Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can tomatoes and green chilies
steps: Cut meat into 3 or 4 portions. Mix flour and salt; dredge meat in flour mixture. Set aside remaining flour. Brown meat in small amount of hot oil, about 3 tablespoons. Place meat in shallow baking dish. Blend reserved flour mixture into drippings in skillet. Add tomatoes and green chilies, celery, carrot and onion. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture boils. Pour over meat. Cover and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour or until meat is tender. Sprinkle cheese over meat.

recipes.title: Dutch Apple Bread
steps: Sift flour. Add baking powder, salt and sugar. Sift again. Cut softened butter into dry ingredients as for pastry. Add beaten eggs and milk. Beat. Spread in 8 x 12 pan (greased). Press apple slices over top and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 1/2 to 4 lb. beef round or chuck roast
steps: In a 6-quart saucepan, put oil and heat.
Brown roast on both sides.
Spoon off fat.
Stir in mushroom soup, onion soup mix and 1 cup water.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover; cook 2 hours.
Add vegetables.
Cook 45 minutes.
Remove roast and vegetables.
Stir in flour and 1/2 cup water.
Gradually stir into pot.
Cook until it boils and thickens.

recipes.title: Mum'S Rice Pudding
ingredients: 2 c. white rice (old fashioned or 5 minute)
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Cook rice and raisins together.
Beat egg yolks and add sugar, pinch of salt, milk, nutmeg and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Cran-Apple Bake
steps: Combine fruit and sugar in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.
Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over top.
Bake at 350° for one hour or until brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Christmas Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. milk, with Tbsp. sherry flavoring
steps: Drop on greased cookie sheet and bake at 300° for 30 minutes; 275° may be better.
Makes 100 cookies.

recipes.title: Linden Lea Banana Chip Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 c. buttermilk (add 2 tsp. lemon juice to milk to equal 1/2 c.)
steps: Combine sugar, margarine and eggs.
Mix well.
Stir in bananas, buttermilk and vanilla.
Stir in remaining dry ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Jo'S Quick Spanish Rice
steps: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil until very hot.
Stir in Sofrito and stir for 20 seconds.
Add rice; stir until all ingredients are well mixed.
Add black beans, water, salt, garlic powder, pepper and envelopes of Sazon; stir and bring to a boil. Add olives and/or Vienna sausages (optional).
Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes (until all water is absorbed).
Stir rice once with a large fork after 10 to 15 minutes.
When rice is done, turn off heat and let stand for 5 minutes.
Stir rice once again after 5 minutes and enjoy!

recipes.title: Chocolate Thing
steps: Melt butter in a 6 x 9-inch glass baking dish.
Mix in flour and pecans.
Press into pan to form crust.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 small jar Cheez Whiz or 1 can Cheddar soup
steps: Cook rice.
In a large frying pan, heat oil; toss in broccoli and onion.
Cook for 5 minutes.
Add cream of chicken soup. Reduce heat.
Stir in cheese, milk and salt; cook until bubbly. Place rice in bottom of 2-quart casserole and add broccoli sauce. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Angel Food Pie
steps: Put water, sugar and pineapple in top of double boiler and bring just to boiling point.
Mix flour and cornstarch and add to pineapple mixture.
Cook until it thickens.
Remove from heat and add vanilla.
When cool, fold in egg whites.
Pour into 2 baked pie shells.
Top with 1/2 pint whipped topping for each pie. Sprinkle with coconut.
Let stand in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar-Bourbon Glazed Ham
ingredients: 1 (11 to 14 lb.) whole bone-in smoked ham with rind
steps: Place unwrapped ham on rack in large roasting pan. Let stand at room temperature 2 hours.

recipes.title: Gelatin Easter Baskets
ingredients: 1 pkg. (4 serving size) Jell-O brand gelatin (any flavor)
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add cold water.
Pour into individual ring molds or 6 ounce custard cups.
Chill until firm, about 2 hours.

recipes.title: Roux
steps: Mix the flour and oil in
a
heavy pot; stir constantly over a medium fire.
As you
stir,
the
roux
browns
slowly. Don't cook the roux fast, because
as
it
reaches
the
done point, it will burn.	When the roux is a rich dark brown, turn fire
off while continuing to
stir
until
it
cools.
Makes enough roux for stew with one hen or 2 pounds shrimp.

recipes.title: Midwestern Scalloped Corn And Sausage Casserole
steps: Brown sausage; drain off all fat except about 2 tablespoons. Add flour and stir until blended, then add milk and stir until mixture boils and thickens.
Add corn, salt and pepper to mixture. Place into shallow casserole.
Arrange thick slices of tomato over the top of sausage and corn mixture.
Top with grated cheese. Place under broiler for 4 to 5 minutes, until tomatoes are cooked and cheese is melted.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Blend Crisco, salt and sugars.
Stir in eggs; add peanut butter and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients to first mixture, blending well.
Roll into small balls the size of a walnut. Place on greased baking sheet and mark with fork to form "X" on cookies.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Corn Pudding
steps: Beat eggs; add butter, milk, sugar and flour all together. Add corn. Bake at 350° until firm, approximately 45 minutes or more. Sprinkle small jar chopped pimentos on top (option).

recipes.title: Apricot Cookies
steps: Cream the butter with sugar.
Mix in egg yolks, then flour, then nuts.
Use hands.
Grease an 8-inch square pan.
Put half of the dough in pan.
Top with 2 tablespoons of apricot preserves. Put the rest of the dough on top of the apricot preserves.
Spread remaining preserves on top.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pork Chops With Scalloped Potatoes
steps: In a saucepan, melt butter. Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Add chicken broth; cook and stir until mixture boils. Cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat and set aside.
In a skillet, brown chops in oil. Season more if desired.
In a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish, layer potatoes and onion. Pour broth mixture over. Place chops on top.
Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with parsley and paprika if desired.

recipes.title: Party Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 lb. new potatoes, cooked and sliced
1 lb. small cooked shrimp or cubed cooked ham (optional)
steps: In large bowl, mix buttermilk, mayonnaise, horseradish, sugar, bouillon and dill.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover and chill.
Garnish.
Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
ingredients: enough milk to make dough stiff
steps: Mix oleo and sugar; mix flour, salt and baking powder.
Add 2 mixtures together and add vanilla.
Add enough milk to make stiff dough.
Roll out on floured sheet and cut like biscuits.
Bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange And Cashew Chicken
ingredients: 2 whole chicken breasts, skinned, boned and cut into strips
steps: Drain oranges, reserving 2 tablespoons syrup.
Blend syrup with stir-fry sauce.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok or skillet (high heat).
Add chicken, cashews and garlic; stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Remove from pan.
Heat remaining oil in same pan.
Add onion and snow peas.
Stir-fry for 3 minutes and then add chicken, cashews and stir-fry sauce mixture.
Cook and stir to coat all ingredients.
Remove from heat and stir in oranges.
Serve on rice.

recipes.title: Orange Nut Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl. Stir in nuts and orange peel.
Mix egg, orange juice and salad oil in a small bowl.
Add liquid mixture to dry mix and blend well.
Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool in pan on rack for 10 minutes before removing from pan. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Ham And Onion Quiche
steps: Bake pie shells at 450° for 6 minutes.	Always prick bottom and sides of crusts with a	fork before baking.
Remove shells from oven; reduce heat to 350°.
Toss ham in 1 tablespoon flour, then sprinkle ham over bottom of pie shells.
Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over ham.
Beat remaining ingredients together and pour mixture into shells.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

recipes.title: Potato Pudding
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Using a large bowl, beat eggs well. Add flour, salt, baking powder and butter to eggs and beat well until all is dissolved.
Add potatoes and onions and mix well. Don't be afraid to use your hands!
Pour into brownie pan and bake for 1 hour.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Monster Chip Cookies
steps: In large mixing bowl, cream shortening, butter and sugar until light and fluffy (about 5 minutes).
Add eggs one at a time, beating each well.
Add vanilla and lemon juice. Combine flour, oats, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.
Add to creamed mixture. Mix well.
Stir in chips and nuts.
Drop by 1/4 c. three inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 14-16 minutes or until lightly browned and set in center.
Cool two minutes before removing to wire rack.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream oleo, vegetable oil, sugar, powdered sugar, vanilla and eggs. Add flour, salt and soda. Roll a teaspoon of dough into a ball. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press lightly with floured fork. Works best if dough is chilled. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Chicken
steps: Melt 1 stick of butter in a flat casserole dish.
Salt, pepper and flour chicken pieces.
Place in dish and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Turn over and bake for 15 minutes more.
Mix cream of chicken soup with buttermilk and pour over chicken.
Cover and bake for 15 minutes longer.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb. round steak, sliced into bite size (2 to 3-inches long by 1-inch wide)
1 (3 oz.) can boiled and sliced mushrooms
steps: Tenderize meat; brown steak quickly in 3 tablespoons oil.
Add mushrooms, onion soup and water.
Bring to boil.
Mix sour cream and flour.
Add to meat and simmer until sauce is thick.

recipes.title: Devil'S Food Sour Cream Cake
ingredients: 2 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1/4 c. hot water
steps: Combine all ingredients; bake at 350° for about 30 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Beat all ingredients together with a spoon.
Cook quickly on a hot griddle.
Yields 12 to 15 pancakes.

recipes.title: Creole Black-Eyed Peas
steps: Sort and wash peas.
Place in Dutch oven.
Cover with water. Soak overnight.
Drain peas.
Add pork.
Cover with water.
Cover and cook 45 minutes.
Add all other ingredients except sausage. Cover and cook
1 1/2 hours.
Stir occasionally.
Add sausage. Cook, uncovered, over low heat 45 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Quick Vegetable Bread
ingredients: 1 c. (about 2 oz. untrimmed) spinach leaves (1/2 c. chopped)
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Butter an 8 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Chop the spinach.
Grate the carrot.
Chop the scallion.
In a large bowl, combine flour, 2 tablespoons Parmesan, sugar, baking powder, salt, thyme and nutmeg.
In a separate bowl, combine the milk, oil and egg.
Stir the milk mixture, chopped vegetables and pimento into the flour mixture until all ingredients are just moistened.
Spoon batter into the prepared pan.
Sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons Parmesan.
Bake until a toothpick stuck into the center comes out clean, 55 to 60 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes. Remove from the pan; cool completely.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole Microwave
steps: Place butter in 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Heat full power 20 to 30 seconds or until melted.
Stir in green pepper, onion and celery. Cook full power 6 to 8 minutes until vegetables are tender. Stir halfway through. Sprinkle vegetables with flour and stir to blend.
Mix in tomatoes. Cook full power until heated, 4 to 6 minutes. Stir halfway through cooking time. Blend in remaining ingredients. Cook full power about 6 minutes, or until shrimp are fully cooked.
Stir twice during time.
Remove bay leaf.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chunkies Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. (1 stick) unsalted butter (at room temperature)
steps: Combine flour, baking soda and salt.
Beat butter and brown sugar in a large bowl at medium speed until creamy.
Beat in egg until light and fluffy.
Beat in melted chocolate and vanilla.
At low speed, beat in flour mixture.
Fold in nuts, chocolate and candies.
Grease baking sheets.
Drop dough by tablespoons, 2 inches apart on prepared pans.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool cookies on rack.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: S'More Cookie Bars
ingredients: 4 Hershey milk chocolate bars (1.55 oz. each)
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 8-inch square baking pan.
In large mixing bowl, beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add egg and vanilla; beat well.
Stir together flour, crumbs, baking powder and salt.
Add to the butter mixture and beat until well blended.
Press 1/2 dough into pan.
Arrange bars over dough, breaking as needed to fit.
Spread with Marshmallow Creme. Scatter bits of remaining dough over Marshmallow Creme; carefully press to form a layer.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.
Cool completely and cut.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Pie (Has No Bottom Crust)
ingredients: 8 or more tart apples (McIntosh are good)
1/4 lb. (1 stick) softened butter or margarine
steps: You will need 1 greased casserole dish.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread(2 Loaves)
steps: Beat eggs until fluffy and slowly add remaining ingredients. Pour into 2 well-greased and floured loaf pans and bake in 325° oven for 60 minutes or until done.
Invert and cool loaves on racks.

recipes.title: Play Clay
steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Mix all ingredients together in bowl. Work the mixture with your hands until it feels well mixed.
Shape the dough into decorations like stars or snowmen or cut with cookie cutters.
Be sure to make small hole in the top or push a paper clip into the dough.

recipes.title: Easy 1 Hour Rolls
steps: Heat milk to lukewarm.
Add oil.
Mix yeast and sugar into a small amount of warm water to dissolve yeast.
Add to milk mixture and then dry ingredients. Roll out on floured board and knead well. Cut out biscuits and place in oiled pan.
Let rise 45 minutes or until doubled in size.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until browned.

recipes.title: Cheddar Cheese Soup
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in a covered pan and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add cheese, stirring over low heat until cheese is melted.
Whisk in beer and stir until well blended.

recipes.title: Fortune Cookies
steps: Write fortunes on strips of paper.
Mix sugar into egg whites and blend until fluffy.
Melt butter and let cool until warm.
Add flour, salt, vanilla and butter to the sugar mixture.
Beat until the batter is smooth.
Pour batter from a spoon to form circles on a well-greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° about 8 minutes.
Lay a message on each cookie; fold in thirds, then bend it gently in the center.
If cookies get too hard to bend, return to oven for about 1 minute.

recipes.title: Oh-So Easy Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour the bottom only of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Reserve 1/4 cup of the M&M's.
Mix remaining ingredients together.
Spread in pan.
Sprinkle with reserved candies.
Bake about 30 minutes, until light golden brown; cool. Cut into bars.
Makes about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Lemon Chiffon Cake
steps: Separate eggs.
In egg whites, add 1/2 tsp. cream of tartar and beat well until very stiff.
In yolks, add flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, oil, extract, rind and water.
Beat well until creamy.
Fold into egg whites, do not beat.
Pour into 10 inch tube pan.
Do not grease.
Bake at 325° for 50 minutes and 375° for 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Pecan Pralines
steps: Combine sugar, buttermilk, soda, oleo and Karo.
Cook over low heat until candy makes hard ball in cold water, about 45 to 55 minutes.
Add pecans and vanilla.
Start beating by hand until it gets thick and loses its sheen.
Drop on wax paper and cool.

recipes.title: Manicotti(Jean Stapleton'S Recipe)
steps: Grease griddle lightly.
Wipe away excess grease with paper towel.
Put one teaspoonful batter on griddle.
These do not need to brown.
Do not turn.
They are done when top appears dry.

recipes.title: Before Breakfast
steps: Fry sausage and
drain
off fat.
Beat eggs.
Add milk, salt and mustard.
Layer in 9
x 13-inch baking dish or pan:
bread, sausage and cheese.
Pour egg mixture over all.
Put in cold oven. Set temperature at 350°.
Bake 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Spanish Cabbage
steps: Fry bacon; break in pieces.
Saute onion and green pepper. Chop cabbage.
Add tomatoes, salt and pepper and vinegar.
Put all in one pot and boil until cabbage is done.

recipes.title: 8 Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 head shredded lettuce, sprinkled with salt and pepper
1 lb. bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
1 c. Hellmann's mayonnaise and 1 c. Miracle Whip, mixed together
steps: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer as follows:
1/2 head shredded lettuce, bacon, eggs, peas, onion, mixed dressing, ham and Swiss cheese.
Press down after each layer.
The dressings will spread thickly over entire surface and top with ham and cheese.
Cover with Glad Wrap and refrigerate at least 12 hours.

recipes.title: Smothered Deer Tips
steps: Cut stew meat into small pieces and brown in cooking oil. Remove meat and saute onion and garlic in the oil.
When onion is tender, put the meat back into oil with onion and garlic.
Add flour and toss until blended.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Lower heat and slowly add water until sauce is not too thick.
Add Kitchen Bouquet to darken and simmer on low flame until meat is tender, about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie(Makes Its Own Crust)
steps: Mix eggs, sugar, flour, oleo, milk, coconut and vanilla.
Pour into 10-inch pie pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Golden Chicken
steps: Place chicken parts in a single layer in large baking pan. Cover with soup, onion and Chablis wine.
Cover dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serve with rice and vegetable.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Chocolate Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Measure all ingredients into a large bowl. Mix 1/2 minute on low speed, scraping bowl constantly.
Beat 3 minutes at high speed, scraping bowl occasionally.
Pour into prepared pans.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
steps: In a mixing bowl beat margarine with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds.
Add about half of the flour, the 1 cup sugar, the egg, vanilla, baking soda, and cream of tartar.
Beat until thoroughly combined.
Beat in remaining flour. Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Combine the 2 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon.
Roll balls in sugar cinnamon.
Place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 11 minutes or until edges are golden.
Makes about 36.

recipes.title: President Clinton'S Lemon Chess Pie
steps: In a large bowl, toss sugar, flour and cornmeal with a fork. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour into pie shell and bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 30 minutes.
Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled.

recipes.title: Crispy Oven Fried Chicken
ingredients: 6 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (or 2 1/2 - 3 pounds chicken pieces with skin removed)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Lightly spray cookie sheet with nonstick spray.
Roll chicken pieces in flour to evenly cover all sides.
Dip chicken in egg white and roll in cornflake crumbs. Place on prepared cookie sheet.
Bake 20 - 30 minutes for boneless breast halves or 45 - 55 minutes for chicken pieces.

recipes.title: Hamburger And Rice Casserole
steps: Add garlic, onion flakes, basil flakes and mushrooms to olive oil; mix well.
Add tomatoes and cook for 1/2 hour.
Brown crumbled hamburger.
Add eggs to cool rice.
Add hamburger and rice mixture to the tomato mixture.
Put in 2 or 3-quart casserole.
Add salt
to taste (optional).
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese before serving.

recipes.title: Sausage Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice as directed on package.
Chop onion, pepper and celery.
Brown sausage and drain, then add vegetables.
Cook until vegetables are limp.
Add rice and soup and pour into greased 3-quart casserole dish.
Cover and bake for 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Alkali Bars
steps: Bring to a boil the raisins and water.
Turn off heat.
Stir in salad oil; cool to lukewarm.
Stir in sugar and egg.
Sift together flour and spices.
Beat dry ingredients into raisin mixture.
Stir in the walnuts.
Pour into a greased baking pan. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Dust with powdered sugar while still warm.

recipes.title: Quail Our Favorite Way
ingredients: enough flour in a large sack to coat quail
cooking oil 2 1/2 inches deep in heavy cooking utensil (should be enough oil to cover quail)
steps: Shake salt over each quail, covering all parts.
Put quail in sack with flour and shake well.
Oil should be hot enough that it bubbles when quail are placed in it.
Put quail in oil with breast side down.
Turn when browned with total cooking time not over 10 minutes.
Remove quail to drain on paper towel.
Pour off oil into container, reserving enough oil and drippings to make gravy.

recipes.title: Hungry Jack'S Pancakes
steps: Break eggs into a bowl and beat with a fork.
Add buttermilk and mix well.
Add remaining ingredients and mix just long enough to blend well.
Pour onto hot griddle and brown lightly on both sides.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
steps: Blend 3/4 cup sugar, flour and salt in top of double boiler. Add milk slowly and cook until thick, stirring constantly.
Cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Beat egg yolks; combine with custard. Cook 2 minutes longer.
Add vanilla.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Simmer raisins and water in saucepan over low heat until raisins are plump, 20 to 30 minutes.
Drain water into measuring cup.
Add water to make 1/2 cup.
Heat oven to 400°.
Cream shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Stir in raisin liquid. Blend flour, baking powder, soda, salt and spices.
Stir in.
Add rolled oats, nuts and raisins.
Drop rounded teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Fudge Brownies
steps: Combine flour, cocoa, sugar and salt.
Stir to mix well.
Stir in applesauce, egg whites and vanilla.
Fold in nuts, if desired. Coat an 8-inch square pan with nonstick cooking spray.
Spread batter evenly in pan and bake at 325° for 23 to 25 minutes or until the edges are firm and the center is almost set.
Cool to room temperature.
Cut into squares and serve.
Yields 16 servings. Contains 80 calories and 4 grams fat.

recipes.title: Cheese Broccoli Soup
steps: In large saucepan, boil/steam broccoli in 1/2 cup water. Remove about 1/4 of the broccoli and set aside.
Put remaining broccoli in blender and puree until smooth.
In large saucepan over medium heat, combine flour, butter and 1 cup of water until creamy.
Pour mixture from blender into flour mixture.
Rinse blender with 1/2 water and cream or evaporated milk and pour in flour-broccoli.
Stir and season with spices.
Microwave Cheez Whiz and stir into soup.
Chop broccoli that was set aside and add to soup.
Heat thoroughly.

recipes.title: Chow Mein Casserole
steps: Lightly brown beef, onions and celery; add remaining ingredients and stir well.
