Pour into greased casserole dish. Bake for 1 1/2 hours in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Quick Cherry Dessert
steps: In large bowl, cream together oleo and sugar.
Add eggs; beat until light and fluffy.
Add almond extract.
Stir in flour and baking powder.
Mix until smooth.
Butter a 13 x 9-inch cake pan. Pour batter in pan.
Spoon pie filling with the cake mixture in different places.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes, or until golden and cake tests done.
Filling will sink into the cake while baking.
Serve warm with sweetened whipping cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Spring Rolls(Goi)
steps: *Or 1 pound large, cleaned and deveined shrimp or 8 ounces boiled breast of chicken, minced.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Cream sugar and oil together.
Add eggs and pumpkin; mix well. Sift together dry ingredients, add alternately with water to pumpkin mixture.
Pour into 2 well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until tests done.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Remove from pan to cool.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Add oil and vanilla.
Beat until smooth.
Beat eggs until foamy.
Add sugar and blend together.
Fold into batter.
Add nuts and apples.
Pour into greased tube pan.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 large green tomatoes, cut into 1/4-inch slices (about 1 1/2 lb.)
steps: In a bowl, whisk together buttermilk, 1 tablespoon flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon pepper.
Immerse tomato slices in mixture.
In a heavy skillet, heat over moderate heat until candy thermometer registers 350°.
While oil is heating, whisk together the remaining flour, salt and pepper.
Dredge tomatoes (1 at a time) in seasoned flour, shaking off excess and fry in batches of 6 (do not crowd in skillet) until golden brown on both sides. Transfer slices to paper towel to drain.
Sprinkle with salt.

recipes.title: Chuckwagon Stew
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 tsp. dry crushed red pepper
steps: Coat beef in mixture of flour, paprika, 1 teaspoon chili powder and salt.
Brown in hot fat in large Dutch oven.
Add onion and garlic; cooking until soft.

recipes.title: Ham And Egg Pasta
ingredients: 8 oz. uncooked whole wheat or regular fettuccini
1 1/2 c. julienne cut turkey ham or cooked ham
4 eggs, hard-cooked and cut into wedges
steps: Cook fettuccini to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain; rinse with hot water.
Keep warm.
In large skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil.
Saute onions for 1 to 2 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Reduce heat to medium.
Stir in sour cream, milk, parsley, salt and pepper.
Cook, stirring constantly, until hot.
Do not boil.
Stir in turkey ham, egg wedges and fettuccini; toss gently.
Makes 4 (1 1/2 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Prepare apples.
Put a little lemon juice over them; set aside and cover.
Add sugar and
eggs
to
oil; mix well at low speed until creamy and
smooth.
Sift
flour and measure.
Sift again with salt, soda and
baking powder.
Add flour mixture to creamed mixture a little at
a
time.
Fold
in well after each addition; add vanilla.
When
batter
is stiff, remove beaters and finish mixing by hand.
Fold in apples and nuts.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 55 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Saucy Apple Swirl
steps: Grease and flour tube pan. Put 1/2 batter in pan. Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle most over batter.
Also, sprinkle most of nuts.
Add rest of batter and sprinkle rest of nuts and sugar-cinnamon.
Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 45 minutes, sometimes longer.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Heat oven to 375° and grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. Place applesauce in the bottom of the pan.
Mix remaining ingredients in mixing bowl and sprinkle on top of the applesauce. Bake until golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes and serve warm.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Holiday Hermit Cookies
steps: Beat shortening and sugars together until creamy.
Beat in eggs.
Sift dry ingredients.
Add to cream mixture along with buttermilk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.
Stir in the remaining ingredients.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Rolls
steps: Combine 2 cups flour and yeast.
In saucepan, heat milk, shortening, sugar and salt until warm.
Add to dry mixture.
Add egg and pumpkin.
Beat at low speed 1/2 minute.
Beat 3 minutes on high.
Stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. light cream or half and half
steps: Mix sugar and flour; add cream, egg, vanilla and nutmeg.
Mix well with eggbeater or wire whisk.
Put rhubarb in pie shell; pour cream mixture over rhubarb.
Push the rhubarb pieces down so they will be well coated with the cream mixture.
Flute edge of pie crust.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and continue baking 40 to 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Communion Bread
steps: Mix dry ingredients thoroughly, sifting 3 times.
Add cream and milk to make a medium dough ball.
Divide into 4 equal parts and knead 25 to 30 minutes.

When dough is smooth and free from bubbles, roll out with rolling pin onto metal baking sheets. Measure with ruler 1-inch (prick with fork) the width of cooking sheet, all the way across (1-inch prick, 1-inch prick).
Bake in slow oven 12 to 15 minutes at 375° until light brown.
Cut apart lengthwise with sharp knife.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fried Pies
ingredients: cooking oil (Crisco preferred) for deep fat frying
steps: In a saucepan, combine granulated sugar, flour and cocoa powder.
Stir in the 1/2 cup milk and butter.
Stir until blended thoroughly.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly until it thickens. Remove from heat.
Add vanilla.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Molasses Cookies
steps: Into a medium mixing bowl, sift together flour, soda, cloves, ginger and sugar.
Add margarine, egg and molasses.
Beat until smooth and stir in oats.
Drop by level tablespoon 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake in a 375° oven, until lightly browned; let stand a minute before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Ham & Cheese Omelet Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 c. green onions (with tops) thinly sliced
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
In a bowl combine cream cheese and milk, whisk until smooth.
Add flour and salt, mix well.
In a separate bowl gently whisk eggs then add cream cheese mixture, mix well.
Pour in a long cookie sheet (parchment paper may be used). Bake for 30 to 33 minutes or until eggs are puffy and golden. Meanwhile, finely chop ham.
Remove omelet from oven, immediately spread dijon mustard, and sprinkle 1/2 of cheese, ham and green onions.
Sprinkle the rest of the cheese and roll up, (like a jelly roll).
Let stand 5 minutes allowing cheese to melt.
Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Applesauce-Raisin Cookies
steps: Cream the oil and sugar together.
Add the egg and beat until light.
Blend in the vanilla and applesauce.
Stir the flours, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves, oats and raisins into the creamed mixture.
Blend well.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a lightly oiled baking sheet.
Bake in a 375° oven for 10 minutes. Cool on a wire rack.
Makes 24 cookies.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Cream together butter, sugar, and eggs. Sift together all dry ingredients. Add dry ingredients and pumpkin to creamed mixture. Add pecans and vanilla. Mix well. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes in greased and floured 9 x 13 pan
at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Cake
steps: Combine ingredients and beat until smooth.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake in greased 8 x 8-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Apricot Nectar Cake
steps: Pour into bowl the cake mix and jello.
Add oil, nectar and well beaten eggs.
Mix at low speed, then beat for 2 minutes at number 4 speed.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.
Cool in pan.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
steps: Layer lettuce and then onions in large bowl.
Mix mayonnaise with sugar and stir in peas (drained).
Add cheese and top with bacon bits.

recipes.title: Pickled Eggs
steps: Hard-boil eggs and peel.
Boil all ingredients, except eggs, in a saucepan.
Simmer for several minutes.
Cool until just warm and add shelled, boiled eggs.
Keep refrigerated a day or so to blend spices.

recipes.title: Chocolate Delight Dessert
steps: Mix together the first 3 ingredients in
9 x 13 baking dish; spread out for crust. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and cool.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Rice
steps: Cook shrimp in boiling water with a little salt about 10 minutes and peel.
Cook the rice in shrimp water.
Saute onions and bell pepper (chopped) in margarine.
Add rice and stir.
Add Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper to taste, then shrimp. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Sauce
steps: Melt margarine in saucepan; remove from heat.
Stir in lemon peel, flour, dill weed and salt.
Blend in half and half; cook and stir over medium heat until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Remove from heat.
Blend a small amount of hot mixture with egg yolk; blend back into hot mixture.
Stir well; cook for 1 minute longer.
Serve over cooked vegetables.

recipes.title: Light Bread
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Mix all ingredients together; as you do for biscuit dough.
Put wax paper and then a towel over bowl.
Let stand and rise for 1 1/2 hours.
Knead dough until stiff, using 1/2 cup flour.
Place in a greased loaf pan.
Brush with melted butter and let rise for 2 hours.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Enchiladas
steps: Brown the ground beef in a skillet and pour off excess fat. Add taco seasoning and water.
Simmer until reduced.
Place equal amounts of taco meat on each tortilla.
Add some refried beans, if desired.
Put some salsa in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Roll up tortillas and place seam down in pan.
Top with more salsa and the cheese.
Put in oven at 300° for 20 minutes or microwave 6 to 8 minutes until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Holiday Fruit Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. chopped red and green cherries
steps: Mix well shortening, brown sugar and eggs.
Add buttermilk and stir in flour.
It will be easier to work with if you chill dough overnight.
Drop by teaspoon on baking sheet and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, or until done.
Yields 7 dozen.

recipes.title: Apricot Nut Supreme Brownies
ingredients: 1 c. dried apricots, quartered and divided
steps: Preheat
oven
In small saucepan, melt chocolate and
margarine
over
low
heat.
Stir
constantly until mixture becomes a curdling consistency; remove from heat.
Add sugar, eggs and extract; stir quickly to blend.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
steps: In a microwave-safe glass bowl mix first 3 ingredients together and cook on High for 7 to 9 minutes, until mixture bubbles and peanuts are brown.
Quickly stir in margarine and vanilla.
Cook on High for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add baking soda, stirring quickly until mixture is foamy.
Pour onto a greased cookie sheet.
Let cool for 15 minutes, until firm.
Break into pieces or cut.
Makes 1 1/4 pounds.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf(From Ann Landers)
ingredients: 2 lb. ground round or extra lean hamburger
steps: Mix together thoroughly.
Put into loaf pan and cover with two strips of bacon.
Pour one can (8 ounce) tomato sauce and bake at 350° about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mary Ann Cake
steps: Cream sugar
and
shortening.
Add
beaten eggs, cocoa, soda and salt.
Gradually
sift	in
flour and sour milk.
Add hot water and
banana flavoring; mix well.
Bake at 350° until done. This cake is best when mixed by hand instead of using a mixer.

recipes.title: Basil Chicken With Rice
steps: In 3-quart saucepan over high heat, heat broth, tomatoes, garlic and basil to boiling.
Add chicken, rice, peas and hot pepper sauce.
Return to boiling; remove from heat.
Cover.
Let stand 5 minutes or until most of the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff rice with fork before serving.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Dumplings
steps: Beat egg until smooth.
Add milk and shortening.
Mix thoroughly.
Pour this in flour.
Mix to a very smooth dough. Drop by spoonfuls into broth.
Cover tightly and cook 10 to 14 minutes or until done, depending on size of dumplings.

recipes.title: Chicken Delight
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients and set aside.
Saute celery and onions.
Cook rice by directions, adding water chestnuts, celery and onions.
Into a large buttered Corning casserole, put layer of rice, then layer of chicken mixture and then sprinkle with cheese. Alternate layers until all is used.
A little Tabasco sauce can be added.
Garnish with small pieces of chicken, cheese and paprika.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Chocolate Chewy Brownies
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in bowl.
Mix at low speed until smooth.
Combine baking soda and flour in sifter.
Sift in dry ingredients.
Pour into 13 x 9 baking dish and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 5 medium potatoes, peeled, if desired, and sliced thin
steps: In a saucepan over medium heat, melt butter; blend in flour and add milk, all at once.
Stir until thickened.
Add grated cheese, salt and pepper.
Continue to cook and stir until cheese is melted.
Remove from heat and spread 1/2 of the cheese sauce on the bottom of a shallow 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Place potatoes on top of cheese sauce, sprinkle with onions and bacon. Add remaining sauce over potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, until potatoes are tender.

recipes.title: Beer Batter Bread
steps: Mix dry ingredients in bowl.
Add beer and beat 60 strokes with spoon.
Fill a lightly greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and drizzle top with melted butter.
Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes or golden and tests clean.
Remove from pan and cool on rack.

recipes.title: Pork Chops In Apple Juice
steps: Brown
chops
in
a
12-inch
Dutch
oven in margarine. Remove chops
and
saute apples and onion slices in drippings until tender.
Set
aside
in
a	bowl.
Return chops to Dutch oven. Add
apple juice, bouillon, sage and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add apples and onions to	Dutch
oven
and
cook	for 5 minutes.	Remove chops, apples and
onions.
Stir	in the half and half.
Cook and stir
until sauce boils and thickens.
Pour over chops and serve.

recipes.title: White Cake
steps: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together three times. Cream sugar and shortening; add milk, stiffly beaten egg whites and vanilla. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Frost with your favorite frosting.

recipes.title: Oriental Skewers
steps: Wash and cut chicken into 1-inch chunks.
Also cut sirloin into chunks.
Marinate chicken in teriyaki sauce for 1 hour.
Marinate steak in Worcestershire sauce for 1 hour.
Cut and wash peppers and onion into large chunks.
Put peppers and meat on skewer alternating.
Cook on grill until done.
Serve over rice with extra sauces, sauteed mushrooms and pineapple chunks.
Do not use the sauce that the meat marinated in.
Use fresh sauces.

recipes.title: Christmas Crunch
steps: Boil syrup, butter, sugar and salt together for 5 minutes at medium-high.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and soda; return to heat and cook 2 more minutes.
Pour over Rice Chex, almonds and coconut; mix well.
Pour out onto greased cookie sheet (large). Cool, cut and eat.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Cherry Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: In large bowl stir together flour, cocoa, salt, baking powder and soda.
In mixer bowl beat together butter and sugar on low speed of electric mixer until fluffy.
Add egg and vanilla; beat well.
Gradually add dry ingredients to cream mixture; beat until well blended.
Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press down center of dough with thumb.
Drain cherries and reserve juice.
Place a cherry in center of each cookie.
In saucepan, combine chocolate chips and condensed milk. Heat until chocolate is melted.
Stir in 4 teaspoons of cherry juice.
Spoon about 1 teaspoon frosting over each cherry, spreading to cover cherry.
Bake at 350° about 10 minutes.
Remove to wire rack and cool.

recipes.title: Zelma'S Never Fail Dumplings
steps: Beat eggs and shortening.
Add dry ingredients and enough milk to make a stiff dough.
Knead dough on floured surface.
Roll out very thin, cut in strips and drop into boiling broth with a teaspoon of Accent seasoning. When dumplings are almost done, add a few drops yellow food coloring and 1 cup of cream.

recipes.title: Easy Grilled Chicken
ingredients: your favorite barbecue sauce (we like Heinz 57)
steps: Layer chicken pieces in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle salt, pepper, garlic and onion powder to your taste.
Place in microwave oven and cook chicken until done (around 30 to 40 minutes depending on your oven).
Remove chicken and place on heated outdoor grill.
Baste barbecue sauce over it and put lid down.
It only has to stay on the grill for a few minutes to get the smoked flavor without all of the time and trouble of regular grilled chicken.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Fudge
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in a buttered Dutch oven.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture reaches soft ball stage or candy thermometer registers 243°; remove from heat. Cool to 180°.
Stir in vanilla.
Beat at high speed with an electric mixer until mixture thickens and begins to lose its gloss.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into a buttered 8-inch square pan or baking dish; cool.
Yield:
1 1/4 pounds.

recipes.title: Goulash
ingredients: 2 lb. chuck, blade or boneless pot roast, cut in cubes
steps: Brown bacon in heavy 3-quart pot with a tight fitting lid. Remove bacon and brown onions in drippings until transparent. Remove pot from heat and add paprika, beef, salt, caraway, bacon and half green pepper and tomato.
Return to heat and cover tightly.
Simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, and add small amounts of water as needed.
Cook 1 1/2 to 2 hours until meat is tender.
Add garlic, potatoes, the rest of peppers and tomatoes.
Add enough water to completely cover meat and vegetables.
Bring to a boil; simmer 30 minutes.
Serve with very small bow tie egg noodles.

recipes.title: Quick Rolls
steps: Dissolve yeast in sugar, salt and warm water solution.
Add melted shortening and enough flour to make a medium stiff dough. Grease dough and cover and let rise until double in size.
Make rolls; let rise again and bake in a 400° oven for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Momma'S String Bean Dish
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Drain green beans and chestnuts.
Mix together the soup, sherry, oregano, salt and pepper.
Toss in green beans and chestnuts.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Nice if topped with "canned" onion rings or slivered almonds.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cake
steps: Cream sugar, shortening, eggs and milk.
Add flour and spices; mix well.
Stir in rhubarb.
Pour into greased pan; add topping.

recipes.title: Easy Cobbler Pie Topping
steps: Prepare fruit or berries and sugar to taste (can use fresh or canned).
Mix flour and sugar.
Add beaten egg and mix until mixture is like coarse cornmeal.
(I do this with my fingers; if preferred you can use a fork.)
Sprinkle mixture over fruit or berry cobbler filling in a pie plate or glass long dish.

recipes.title: Sweet Pastry Pockets
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Cream brown sugar with cream cheese. Add 1/8 teaspoon salt and vanilla extract; beat well.
Stir in coconut.
Chill while preparing dough.
Combine flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Cream butter with confectioners sugar and egg yolk.
Blend in orange rind and dry ingredients; mix well.
Add orange juice; mix until a stiff dough forms.
Roll out, half at a time, on well floured surface to 1/8-inch thickness.
Cut with floured 2 1/2 or 3-inch cutter.
Place 1/2 teaspoon filling in center of each; moisten edge with water.
Fold in half; seal edges.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Repeat with remaining dough.
Make 1/2-inch cut in top of each for escape of steam. Brush with slightly beaten egg white.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes until light golden brown.
Makes 36 cookies.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Mold(Easy)
ingredients: 1 can squeeze cheese (Cheddar and bacon flavor)
steps: Peel and cook onions in salted boiling water until tender. Drain.
Add butter and sprinkle with white sugar.
Heat and toss onions over low heat until browned and glazed.

recipes.title: Corn And Rice Casserole
steps: Mix all together.
Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mission Artichoke And Spinach Frittata
ingredients: 1 tsp. seasoned salt or onion powder
6 oz. jar marinated artichokes, cut in small pieces
4 c. fresh spinach or chard, chopped into small pieces
steps: Melt 1/4 cup or less margarine in 9 x 13-inch glass pan.
Beat the eggs, then gradually mix in the remaining ingredients one at a time in order.
Pour in the 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for approximately 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Peanut Dessert
ingredients: 3 to 4 Tbsp. chocolate syrup or grated chocolate
steps: In a bowl, combine cracker crumbs and peanuts.
Stir in 1/4 cup butter and 2 tablespoons peanut butter; mix well.
Set aside 1/2 cup for topping.
Press the remaining crumb mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, in a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and 1/2 cup peanut butter until smooth.
Beat in sugar and vanilla.
Fold in Cool Whip; spoon over crust.
Drizzle with chocolate; sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture.
Cover and freeze for up to 3 months. Remove from the freezer 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake With Lemon Glaze
steps: Combine flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg; set aside.
Cream shortening with sugar.
Add eggs and applesauce. Gradually stir in flour mixture.
Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 2 minutes.
Fold in raisins.
Spoon batter into a nonstick 12-cup fluted pan.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes, or until wooden pick inserted into center of cake comes clean.
Cool 10 minutes.
Invert onto a wire rack for cooling. Drizzle sugar and lemon juice over cake.
Makes 16 servings.

recipes.title: Chambord Brownies
steps: Mix together above ingredients and place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Allow to cool.

recipes.title: Six-Week Refrigerator Bran Muffins
steps: In large bowl, add 2 cups bran, Crisco oil and raisins.
Pour boiling water over the mixture and let stand.
Mix remaining bran, sugar, eggs and buttermilk.
Sift flour, soda and salt.
Combine, cover and store in refrigerator.
May use as desired.

recipes.title: Namak Paaray
steps: Mix together all ingredients and add small amounts of water, enough to make a smooth, binding dough.
Divide dough into 3 parts.
Set aside for 10-15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Burritos
ingredients: 2 lg. Green Peppers, halved and cut into 1/2 inch strips
6 to 8 Jalapeno Peppers, sliced into 1/8 inch strips
steps: In a large stock pot add 4 quarts of water and all of the ingredients except the tomatoes and bring to a boil for 40 minutes.
Remove the chicken with a large spoon and remove the chicken bones and skin.
Skim fat oils from the top of the broth, put the chicken meat back into the pot, add tomatoes and boil for 15 minutes.
Serve on flour tortillas, with salsa or hot sauce, rice or beans optional.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Creme De Menthe Brownies
steps: Cream butter and sugar, then add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool thoroughly.

recipes.title: Prize Winning Meat Loaf
ingredients: 3/4 c. Quaker oats (quick or old fashioned)
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients and mix lightly, but thoroughly.
Press into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan.
Bake for 1 hour or until meat is no longer pink.
Drain and let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Corn Dodgers(Hush Puppies)
steps: Mix all ingredients together, drop by rounded teaspoon into hot grease.
Fry until golden, turning once.

recipes.title: Italian Squares
steps: Saute beef,
onions
and
garlic
until
meat loses red color. Add spinach,
rice and cheese; mix well.
Mix milk and eggs, salt and
pepper
and
add
to
rice
mixture.
Place in shallow casserole.
Bake
at 350° for 30 minutes or until set. Meanwhile, blend
sauce
and
seasonings and simmer 5 minutes. Cut spinach meat mixture into squares.
Top with tomato sauce and grated Italian cheese.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Mix eggs, sugar and oil together.
Add dry ingredients.
Mix together. Add carrots and nuts. Bake at 300° for 35 to 45 minutes in a greased 10 x 13-inch pan or 3 layers.

recipes.title: Continental Frosting
steps: Cook milk and flour until thick; take off heat (cool).
Cream sugar and butter with mixer until fluffy, 4 to 5 minutes.
Add flour and milk mixture.
Beat another 4 to 5 minutes.
Add vanilla. Keep cake cool after frosting (refrigerate).
Add crushed pieces of pineapple and flavoring if you want it (just a little).
Very good over chiffon cake, angel cake or any other kind of cake.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
steps: Sift dry ingredients together.
Add yeast to warm water and let dissolve.
Mix milk, yeast and shortening with dry ingredients until slightly sticky.
Form into rolls and place on ungreased baking pan.
Bake at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Bake immediately or cover and store in refrigerator up to one week.

recipes.title: Sourdough Bread
steps: For whole wheat bread, use 3 cups whole-wheat flour and 3 cups bread flour.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Cream shortening and butter; add sugar.
Cream until smooth. Add eggs, one at a time.
Add baking powder to flour.
Add to mixture alternately with milk and flavoring.
Bake in tube pan 1 hour and 15 minutes at 315°.

recipes.title: Swiss Potato Pancakes
steps: Measure flour, sugar and salt into large bowl.
Mix well with fork.
Add shortening, mix with fork until crumbly.
In small bowl beat together egg, water and vinegar (using fork to blend well). Combine dry ingredients with liquid.
Divide dough into 5 equal portions and shape into round flattened patties, ready for rolling. Wrap each patty in plastic wrap, chill 1/2 hour before using.
When ready to roll, lightly flour both sides of patty and roll out on lightly floured board.
Makes 5 (9-inch) pie crusts or 20 tart shells.
Can be frozen after shaping into round flattened patties.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
ingredients: 2 c. finely diced (2 large or 2 medium) apples
1 tsp. cinnamon mixed with 1/2 c. sugar
steps: Sift flour, sugar and baking powder together into a large bowl.
Combine oil, orange juice, flavoring and eggs; add it to the dry ingredients, a little at a time.
Mix until smooth (don't overmix).
Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan.
Pour half the batter into the pan.
Spread half the apples evenly over the batter and sprinkle with half the cinnamon-sugar.
Repeat with other half.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 1 and 1/4 hours. Remove from oven, place on a rack and let stand about 10 minutes before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Apple Squares
steps: Mix salt with flour; cut in shortening.
Separate egg; save the white.
Add yolk to 2/3 cup water and beat.
Add to flour mixture.
Mix into soft ball stage.
Divide dough in half.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Soft Ginger Cookies
steps: Stir flour, salt, baking powder and spices together.
Cream sugar, margarine and egg until light.
Add prunes, buttermilk, molasses and vinegar and beat to combine.
Dissolve soda in boiling water.
Stir in flour mixture and soda water.
Drop onto greased baking sheet and bake for 15 to 17 minutes at 350°.
Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Slice And Bake Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Cream margarine and sugars.
Beat in vanilla and eggs. Combine flour, salt and soda.
Gradually stir in dry ingredients. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.

recipes.title: Ranch-Style Baked Lentils
steps: Rinse the lentils.

In a heavy saucepan, bring lentils, salt and 4 cups water to a boil. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the lentils are tender. Meanwhile, brown beef in a skillet. Drain excess fat. Stir in soup mix, catsup, mustard, vinegar and remaining water. Gently stir in lentils. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole. Bake, covered, at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes. Yield: 4 to
6 servings.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Chop apples and set aside.
Measure oil into large bowl; add sugar, egg and vanilla.
Beat until creamy.
Sift flour, salt, soda and baking powder together.
Add small amounts at a time to creamed mixture.
Fold in pecans and apples.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan for 55 to 60 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
steps: Layer chopped lettuce, onions and bell peppers.
Into mayonnaise, stir the 3 tablespoons sugar.
Spread over lettuce, onions and peppers.
Spread cheese and bacon bits over top of mayonnaise.
Chill and serve.
Other veggies such as green peas, broccoli or cauliflower may be layered in.

recipes.title: Banana Muffins
steps: Cream the butter and sugar together.
Add egg, well beaten, and the mashed pulp of the bananas.
Add dry ingredients alternately with milk.
Mix well.
Drop into greased tins and bake in a medium oven about 12 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Western Bean Casserole
ingredients: 17 oz. can baby limas, drained and rinsed
16 oz. can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Cook and drain excess bacon grease.
Cook, drain and rinse ground beef.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour into a casserole dish prepared with Pam.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cheese Wafers
ingredients: 2 c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese (room temperature)
steps: Cream the cheese and margarine. Mix in flour. Stir in Rice Krispies. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with back of spoon. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time.
Mix well. Add milk and flour.
Blend well.
Add coconut. Pour into 9-inch pie pan, greased with butter.
(This pie makes its own crust.)
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until it sets in the center.
Let cool before cutting to serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Delight
ingredients: chopped pecans and grated chocolate (to decorate)
steps: Combine butter, flour and pecans.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Cool.
Combine cream cheese, confectioners sugar and 1 1/2 cups whipped topping.
Spread over the cool crust and chill.
Combine pudding mixes and milk.
Beat 2 minutes with rotary mixer.
Spread on top.
Top with remaining whipped topping.
Sprinkle with pecans and grated chocolate. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cherry Delight
ingredients: whipping cream and/or Cool Whip (as desired)
steps: Mix flour, pecans and margarine.
Pat in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for approximately 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and cool.
Combine cream cheese and powdered sugar.
Fold in Cool Whip and/or whipping cream as desired.
Spread over cooled crust.
Add one can cherry topping/filling.
Top with whipping cream or Cool Whip as desired.

recipes.title: Low Calorie Instant Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream together brown sugar, sugar substitute, margarine and wheat germ.
Sift together flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon. Stir into creamed mixture and add remaining ingredients.
Mix thoroughly.
Drop by level teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
Makes 68 small cookies, 37 calories per cookie.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
steps: In a mixing bowl beat margarine with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds.
Add about half of the flour, the 1 cup sugar, the egg, vanilla, baking soda, and cream of tartar.
Beat till thoroughly combined.
Beat in remaining flour. Cover and chill 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dutch Baby Pancakes
steps: You will need casserole dish, 2-quart size.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
steps: Cream shortening, sugar and eggs.
Make a paste with food coloring and cocoa and add mixture.

Add salt and flour together. Add to creamed mixture, adding buttermilk a little at a time, alternately with soda and vinegar (do not beat hard), just blend. Bake 30 minutes at 350° in 2 (8-inch) round pans, greased and floured.

recipes.title: Great Gerts
steps: Cream margarine and cheese.
Add seasonings, flour and Rice Krispies.
Pinch off small bits with your fingers and press flat with a fork dipped in cold water.
The smaller these are the better they are.
Bake on a cookie sheet for about 12 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Glorified (Heavenly) Rice
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Chill very thoroughly before serving. Serves 6 to 8.
If you choose to use Cool Whip, add just before serving instead of whipping cream.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal Drops
steps: Put the sugar, milk and butter in boiler; boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Add the cocoa, quick oats and nuts.
Stir and mix in the vanilla and pinch of salt.
Spoon out by drops on dish sprayed with Pam or greased with butter.

recipes.title: Squash Cookies
ingredients: chocolate bits, peanuts, butterscotch bits or dates (may be added)
steps: Combine squash, sugar, oil and egg.
Sift together flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt.
Add to squash mixture.
Add soda, dissolved in milk.
Add vanilla.
Drop on greased baking sheet.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes in 375° oven.

recipes.title: Oven Stew
ingredients: 4 medium size potatoes, cut in pieces
steps: Cut stew meat into small pieces.
Salt, pepper and roll in flour.
Brown in skillet.
Put stew meat, carrots, tomato sauce and cabbage in a long pan or Dutch oven.
Cover and bake 2 to 3 hours or until tender-done at 300° to 350°.

recipes.title: Diabetic Orange Cookies
steps: Cream first three ingredients, then add the rest of the ingredients and form into 1-inch balls.
Chill.
Press a pecan half in the center.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Frozen Strawberry Yummy
ingredients: 10 oz. pkg. frozen strawberries, partially thawed
steps: Cut first 3 ingredients as for a crust.
Add nuts.
Spread out crumbs onto cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Spread a little more than half of the crumbs into bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: "Jack'S" Crock-Pot Beans
steps: *Read Jack and the Bean Stalk.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
steps: In mixing bowl, add meat, rice, garlic powder, chopped onion and 1/2 can of tomato sauce.
Mix all together.
Set aside.
Cut tops off green peppers and hollow.
Boil all peppers for 5 minutes, then fill each pepper with meat mixture in round, deep dish.
Pour over leftover tomato sauce.
Cook at 400° for 45 minutes.
Pour juice over if desired.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix together first 5 ingredients.
Cut in margarine.
Add milk to make a soft dough.
Knead lightly on floured board for 2 minutes.
Shape into a round loaf.
Place on greased cookie sheet, cut an `X' across the top.
Bake for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Meatballs
steps: Combine ingredients; form into balls.
Brown.
Add sauce. Simmer for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake Mix Cookies
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pillsbury Plus German chocolate cake mix
1 (6 oz.) pkg. (1 c.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients. Blend well.
Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until set.
Cool 1 minute; remove from cookie sheets.
Makes 4 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Peppered Steak
ingredients: 2 beef bouillon cubes, melted in 2 c. water
steps: Flour, salt and pepper steak.
Brown in frying pan in oil. Place bell pepper and onion over steak.
Pour bouillon over steak and simmer for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lasagne(Lite Cooking)
ingredients: 2 (14 1/2 oz. each) cans stewed tomatoes (no salt)
1 c. (4 oz.) shredded low moisture part skim Mozzarella cheese
steps: Cook and stir onions and garlic in Crisco until tender.
Add ground beef and drain if necessary.
Add tomatoes and tomato paste, basil, oregano, sugar and pepper.
Stir until well blended. Simmer 30 minutes.
Combine cottage cheese, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and parsley; set aside.
Cook noodles 7 minutes in unsalted boiling water.
Drain.
Heat oven to 350°.
Layer all ingredients in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Top with sauce and Mozzarella cheese. Bake 45 minutes.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Lipton Pepper Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. boneless chuck steak, cut off all fat
2 medium green peppers, cut in strips
water (optional), 2 small cans tomato sauce and 2 c. water *
steps: Cut meat into thin strips, 2-inches long.
In a large skillet, heat shortening and brown meat trimmings.
Stir in onion soup mix and *2 cups water.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes (until meat is tender).
Stir in peppers and simmer, covered, 10 minutes.
Blend cornstarch with 1/2 cup water.
Stir into skillet mixture. Cook until thickened.

recipes.title: 1-2-3-4 Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Butter & flour a 10-inch tube pan.
Sift flour, baking powder, & salt.
In a cup stir milk & vanilla.
In a large bowl mix butter and sugar until yellow and fluffy.
Add 2 eggs and beat well.
Repeat and add last 2 eggs. Beat well.
With a wooden spoon stir in flour mixture.
Add milk mixture.
Spoon into pan.
Bake 1 hour.
Cool cake in pan 10 minutes.
Turn onto cake plate and dust with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Potato Pancakes
steps: Mix well.
Drop by spoonful into hot skillet.
Fry until crisp.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbages
ingredients: 1 large onion (1/2 grated and 1/2 sauteed in butter)
steps: Core and steam cabbage until leaves can be peeled off in whole pieces.
In a large bowl, mix together meats, rice, onion, salt and pepper.
Add water to meat/rice mixture until "sloppy" to the touch; more is better than not enough.
Line bottom of roast pan with outer, torn cabbage leaves (reserve enough to cover casserole, also).
Pour 1/2 can of sauerkraut over leaves.
Roll small amount of meat/rice mixture in individual cabbage leaves, starting from stem side and tucking in edges.
Place rolls in layers on top of sauerkruat.
Add remaining sauerkraut with juice, tomatoes
with juice and 1/2 can water.
Top with remaining torn leaves which will burn while cooking and will be discarded. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serve with mashed potatoes and crusty bread.

recipes.title: Turtle Cookies
steps: Melt first two ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and mix together. Drop by teaspoonful on waffle iron and cook 1 minute. Frosting is enough for a double recipe of cookies.

recipes.title: Healthy Banana-Nut Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 400° (200°C).
Mix both flours with sugar and walnuts.
Stir in baking powder, cinnamon and salt.
Place mashed bananas in separate bowl.
Add eggs, milk and oil and mix well. Add wet ingredients to dry, mixing just until moistened.
Spoon into lightly greased muffin tins and bake 15 to 20 minutes, depending on size.
Cool on wire racks.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Cherry Pound Cake
steps: Grease tube pan and dust with flour.
Combine margarine and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add flour, vanilla and salt; mix well.
Fold in walnuts and halved maraschino cherries.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Remove from pan after 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Twice-Baked Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 6 Tbsp. cold butter or margarine, divided
steps: Pierce potatoes with a fork. Bake at 375° for 40 to 60 minutes or until tender. Allow potatoes to cool to the touch. Cut them in half lengthwise; carefully scoop out pulp, leaving a 1/4-inch shell. Place pulp in a large bowl. Add orange juice. Melt 3 tablespoons butter; add to pulp and beat until smooth. Stuff the potato shells; place in an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.

recipes.title: Loaf Pound Cake
steps: In one bowl combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Blend in butter, vanilla, egg yolks and milk.
Beat vigorously for 3 minutes.
Pour batter into a greased 9-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 60 to 70 minutes.
Yields one 9-inch cake.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Banana Nut Bread
steps: Mix together flour, soda, cinnamon, sugar, cloves, salt and nuts and set aside.

recipes.title: Spinach Souffle
steps: Thaw and squeeze out spinach.
Mix with other ingredients. Put in greased casserole.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes (for
a 7 x 11-inch dish).
I use a 9 x 13-inch dish and bake a little less time.

recipes.title: Easy Crust Chicken Pie
steps: Cook and debone fryer.
Cut up chicken and place in a large baking dish.
Mix soup and broth; heat until creamy.
Add salt and pepper; pour over chicken.
Mix flour, milk and melted margarine. Spoon over chicken.
Bake at 450° until brown and bubbly, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
steps: Cut lettuce into bite size pieces and place in bottom of 13 x 9-inch dish.
Mix celery, onion, pepper, carrots and water chestnuts together; spread evenly over lettuce.
Spread Hellmann's mayonnaise over top of mixture.
Make sure you use sufficient mayonnaise, because this will become your dressing when served. Sprinkle 3 tablespoons sugar over mayonnaise.
Cover with plastic wrap; let stand overnight in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Possum Stew
steps: Paw 'n the chillun' allus worked so hard a' catchin' little fish outta the creek that they just had to be cooked! ... but they iz sweet 'n gud eatin'.
Scales, take insides out'n the haid off ... clean in cold watah ... salt 'n roll in 1/2 meal 'n 1/2 flour ... drop in hot fat 'n brown on both sides.

To eat small bream ... furst pull fins off ... then start at the tail 'n ease meat up with a fork along backbone all the way up to whair the haid wuz ... hit'll cum off in one piece widout bones iffn you're careful.

recipes.title: Apple Pie Delight(Diabetic)
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. Equal Measure or 20 pkg. Equal
6 c. thinly sliced pared tart apples (4 to 6 Granny Smith)
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
In a mixing bowl combine Equal Measure, flour, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt.	Add dry mixture to apples; toss gently to coat fruit.	Fill a pastry lined 9-inch pie plate with apple mixture.
Dot with margarine.
Cover with top crust, that has slits in it.
Seal and flute edge.	Bake 15 minutes at 425° and turn oven down to 350° and bake an additional 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Nut Glazed Raisin Bread
steps: Scald milk, pour over salt, sugar and butter.
Blend and cool to lukewarm.
Sprinkle yeast on warm water, stir to dissolve.
Add to milk mixture with 2 1/2 cups flour.
Beat 2 minutes with electric mixer, then beat in eggs, orange peel, ginger, raisins and 1/2 cup flour.
Then mix in enough remaining flour, a little at a time with spoon.
Then use hands knead until smooth into a ball. Grease and let rise in warm place until doubled.
Punch down.
Let rise 15 minutes.
Make into 2 loaves.
Make 3 slashes in top.
Let raise not more than double.
Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 40 to 50 minutes.
Cover with sheet of foil after 20 minutes if it browns too fast.
Remove loaves from pan.
Place on wire rack, spread Orange Glaze over them, then cool.

recipes.title: Fancy Green Beans
steps: Chop bacon in pieces,
fry in skillet.	Saute onion and pimiento in bacon grease;
add
the green beans, juice and all to mixture.
Add garlic
salt	and
Nature's
Season to taste. Simmer.

recipes.title: Wild Turkey Salsa And Rice
ingredients: 2 lb. wild turkey breast or chicken
1 c. chopped red or green peppers
garlic salt and pepper to taste
steps: Cut up turkey in chunks and cook in a crock-pot with water on low for 4 hours or until tender.
Saute oleo, garlic, onion and green peppers in a Dutch oven.
Add all vegetables in a Dutch oven on top of stove and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add cooked turkey and simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Raisin Bars
steps: Combine raisins and water in saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in salad dressing. Cool to lukewarm. Stir in sugar and egg. Add dry ingredients and beat.
Stir in nuts.
Pour into greased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Dust with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pecan Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Sift together flour, soda, salt and cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add sugar and stir to mix thoroughly.
Make a well in center of dry ingredients and add all at once, the oil, eggs and water and pumpkin.
Mix well and add nuts.
Pour batter into 3 (8 x 4-inch) loaf pans.
Fill only half full.
Bake for 1 hour or until wooden toothpick comes out clean.
One loaf equals 16 slices; each slice contains 85 calories.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Drain and rinse beans.
Let stand in ice water while making roux.

recipes.title: Campfire Bean Dinner
steps: In large skillet, brown meat well.
Stir in soup mix, beans, chili sauce and water.
Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally for 20 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Light Bread
steps: In a large mixer bowl, combine 3 cups flour and yeast.

In saucepan, heat milk, shortening, sugar and salt just until warm and shortening is almost melted; stir constantly. Add to flour mixture. Beat at low speed 1/2 minute, scraping sides of bowl. Beat 3 minutes at high speed. Gradually stir in as much flour as you can mix with a spoon.
Turn out onto lightly floured surface. Knead in enough of the remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough that is smooth and elastic. Shape into a ball.
Place in a lightly greased bowl at least twice as
large as the ball of dough.
Turn dough over once to grease surface. Cover with slightly damp cloth. Allow to rise in warm place until double in size (about 1 hour).

recipes.title: Merk'S Coffee Cake
steps: Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla thoroughly.
Add eggs, singly, beating well after each addition.
Sift flour, baking powder and soda together.
Add to creamed mixture, alternating with sour cream, blending after each addition.
Spread half of batter in 10-inch tube pan, that has been greased and lined on the bottom with waxed paper.
Cream butter, brown sugar and cinnamon together.
Add nuts; mix well.
Dot batter in pan evenly with half of nut mixture.
Cover with remaining batter. Dot with remaining mixture.
Bake at 350°, about 50 minutes.
Cool cake for 10 minutes.
Remove from pan.

recipes.title: Texas Meatballs And Rice
ingredients: 1 large onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings
steps: Mix ground beef, egg, chili powder, salt and pepper; shape into 1 1/2 to 2-inch balls.
Place in 2-quart casserole.
Microwave at High (100%) until meatballs are set and lose pink color, 4 to 7 minutes, rearranging meatballs after half the cooking time.
Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover.
Microwave at High (100%) until mixture is bubbly and onion is tender, 4 to 7 minutes.
If using an oven without a carousel, stir after half the cooking time. Let stand until rice is tender, 2 to 3 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Cherry Winks
ingredients: 2 2/3 c. Kellogg's Corn Flakes, crushed to 1 1/3 c.
steps: Sift together
dry ingredients; set aside.
Beat butter or margarine and sugar
until	light
and
fluffy;
add
eggs. Beat well.
Stir in
milk
and
vanilla.
Add flour; mix well. Stir in nuts, dates and chopped cherries.
Shape tablespoon of dough into ball and
roll
in	Corn
Flakes.
Place on greased cookie sheet and put a quartered cherry in the middle of each. Bake at 350° for 10 to 14 minutes.

recipes.title: Texas Hash
steps: Brown hamburger.
Add pepper and ringed onions.
Mix in chili powder, tomatoes and rice.
Bake in covered dish at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Crispies
ingredients: nuts, raisins, chocolate chips or dried fruit (as desired)
steps: Cream together first 5 ingredients. Sift together flour, salt and baking soda.
Add flour mixture to creamed mixture.
Add oatmeal and mix well. Add desired nuts, raisins, chocolate chips or dried fruit. Bake until brown in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Coconut Pound Cake
steps: Cream shortening and sugar together.
Add eggs, one at a time. Beat well after each.
Sift dry ingredients.
Add alternately with the buttermilk, coconut flavoring and coconut.
Bake in a greased and floured stem pan for 50 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Sex In A Pan
steps: Combine butter, flour and chopped pecans; press in bottom of 13x9x2 inch pan and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Let totally cool.
Mix powdered sugar and cream cheese; layer on crust. Spread 1 c. of cool whip on cream cheese.
Combine 1 1/2 c. of milk with each pudding and layer on top of cream cheese.
Top with 12 oz. of cool whip.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Rhubarb And Strawberry Pie
steps: Mix sugar and flour.
Add 3/4 of mixture to fruits.
Put remaining and sugar mixture in unbaked pie shell.
Add fruit.
Dot with butter.
Add top crust.
Bake in 420° oven for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350° and bake 35 minutes more.

recipes.title: Indian Corn
steps: Cut bacon into small pieces; fry until crisp, drain, reserving 2 tablespoons fat.
In reserved fat, saute green pepper and onion until tender.
Add corn, salt and pepper; heat thoroughly over medium heat.
Add cream; cook 1 minute, stirring.
Stir in bacon. Serve immediately.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Mix butter and sugar, add egg yolks.
Mix soda into sour cream.
Add flour and sour cream alternately to butter/sugar mixture.
Add vanilla and almond extract.

recipes.title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (2 oz.) slice boiled ham or corned beef, cut into strips (about 1/2 c.)
1 (9 oz.) pkg. frozen green beans, thawed
steps: Melt margarine in large skillet.
Add chicken and ham; cook and stir for 5 to 8 minutes until chicken is browned.
Stir in soup, water, beans and mustard.
Bring to boil.
Stir in rice and cheese; cover.
Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes until liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with fork and serve.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Egg Noodles
steps: If eggs are small, use a little less flour; if eggs are large use a little more flour.

recipes.title: Harvest Apple Cake
steps: Grease and lightly flour a 9-inch tube pan.
Sift together flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.
Chop and peel apples.
Set them aside.
Stir together eggs and vanilla, then beat 2 minutes, until light.
Gradually add oil, beating until thick.
Gradually beat in sugar.
Add dry ingredients, apples and nuts a little at a time; beat well after each addition.
Beat 3 minutes at medium speed.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.
Use cream cheese frosting.

recipes.title: June'S Jiffy Peach Cobbler
steps: Melt butter in large pan.
Mix batter of flour, sugar and juice.
Pour over butter.
Lay peaches over batter.
Bake at 350° to 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
steps: Cut onion into thin slices; saute in margarine.
Add flour and pepper; cook for 10 minutes.
Add stock and Worcestershire sauce until onion is tender.

recipes.title: Waffle Cookie
steps: Cream margarine.
Add eggs, sugar and vanilla.
Add flour, then chocolate chips.
Heat up waffle iron.
Put 2 to 4 small teaspoons of batter,
separately, in waffle iron, making 2 to 4 cookies.
Close iron, then take out with fork.
"Great!"

recipes.title: Grandmother'S Gingerbread
steps: Blend sugar, shortening and eggs.
Stir in molasses.
Combine dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk.
Beat well.
Pour into greased and floured pan (13 x 9 x 2-inch).
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes until done.

recipes.title: Chili Cheese Squares
steps: Grate cheese and mix together. Beat eggs lightly. Add canned milk to eggs and blend with cheeses. In a 9 x 13 buttered pan, cover bottom with chopped green chilies. Pour cheese mixture over chilies. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Remove, cool. Cut in 1 inch squares.

recipes.title: Spaghetti(With Homemade Pastas Of Course!)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. lean beef, cut into bite size pieces (if bone is removed, cook with meat and throw away later)
1 (6 oz.) can tomato paste or 6 medium size tomatoes
1 large bunch celery (leaves and tops only), chopped
1/2 green and 1/2 red bell pepper, cube chopped medium fine
steps: In a large Dutch oven, lightly brown the meat in oil and garlic at medium-low heat.

Slowly mix in water and tomato paste. Add onions, celery and bell peppers. Simmer, covered, 3 to 5 hours until meat is very tender. Check often and add water as needed, making certain there is about a quart of thin sauce when ready to add the pasta.
Add salt, pepper and homemade pasta.
Simmer, uncovered, 20 minutes to 1/2 hour, stirring often, until broth is absorbed.
Stir in parsley. Serves 6.

recipes.title: German Apple Cake
steps: Sift together flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.
Combine eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients.
Beat together.
Add sliced apples and walnuts.
Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dan'S Double Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. chopped shelled Brazil nuts or almonds
steps: Beat the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy. Beat in the eggs, one at a time. Beat in the brandy.
Melt the chocolate in dish over hot water. Stir the melted chocolate and sour cream into the creamed mixture. Sift together the flour, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Stir the dry ingredients gradually into the melted chocolate mixture to form a batter.
Stir in the white chocolate chips and nuts. Drop the batter by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Pot Roast Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1/3 c. Progresso Italian style bread crumbs
steps: Mix first 8 and shape into a loaf in center of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Peel and slice potatoes, onions and carrots (sliced lengthwise).
Mix parsley flakes, salt and pepper.
Place vegetables in layers around meat.
Sprinkle each layer with part of salt mixture.
Cover pan tightly with foil.
Bake in 375° oven for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.
Uncover and bake 10 minutes more to brown meat.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Butter Balls
steps: Mix together all ingredients; chill.
Roll into balls.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.
Roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Easy French Bread
steps: Sift flour, sugar, salt and yeast in large mixing bowl.
Add hot tap water and oil at one time.
Stir until dough leaves sides of bowl.
Turn out on floured surface and knead 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Put in greased bowl.
Turn cover and let rise until doubled.
Turn out.
Divide in half.
Roll each half to 12 x 15-inch.
Roll tightly from long side.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Slash top 3 to 4 times diagonally.
Let rise.

recipes.title: Bean And Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 16 or 20 oz. pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
steps: Cook frozen vegetables as directed; drain and cool.
Add drained red beans.
Add diced vegetables and mix.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper and mix.
Mix sugar, vinegar, flour and mustard in a small saucepan.
Cook, stirring until clear.
Cool and pour over vegetables.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Rice Casserole
steps: Flour pork chops and lightly brown in oil in a heavy skillet. Remove from skillet and drain.
In a large casserole dish, stir together chicken and rice soup, water and instant rice.
Add pork chops.
Cook for 1 hour in a 375° oven.

recipes.title: Brandy'S Chicken
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
steps: Open Rice-A-Roni and sprinkle in baking dish.
Put chicken breasts on top of rice.
Mix seasoning packet in 3 cups of water in which you have dissolved the 2 chicken bouillon cubes.
Add soup to water with seasoning and mix well.
Pour over chicken and rice.
Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Cover when bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
steps: Mix dry ingredients; add milk.
Cook and stir.
Add vanilla and margarine.
Heat in microwave.
Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Italian Chicken
ingredients: 4 bone-in chicken breast halves, skin removed
1 (8 oz.) pkg. your favorite pasta, cooked
1 (14 oz.) jar your favorite spaghetti sauce
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Shake flour in bag; place in 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan.
Add spaghetti sauce to bag.
Squeeze bag to blend ingredients.
Add chicken and green peppers to bag.
Turn bag to coat chicken with sauce.
Arrange chicken in even layer. Close bag with provided tie; cut 6 half-inch slits in top of bag. Bake until tender, 35 to 40 minutes.
Serve over hot pasta.

recipes.title: Egg Drop Soup
ingredients: 4 tsp. finely chopped chives or scallion tops
steps: Bring the chicken stock to boil.
With a wire whisk, mix together egg whites, flour and water until smooth.
Pour a thin stream into boiling chicken stock.
Do not stir until egg mixture is cooked.
Add the soy sauce and mix well.
Ladle into consomme cups and top each serving with 1 teaspoon chopped chives or scallion tops.
Makes 3 cups.
Each 3/4 cup serving contains approximately 42 calories, 0 mg cholesterol and 167 mg sodium.

recipes.title: Salad Dressing Cake
steps: Pour batter in greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 fryer, cut-up or your favorite pieces of chicken
steps: Wash and
clean
chicken.
Salt
and pepper chicken and soak in milk overnight in refrigerator.	Flour and deep fry in Crisco until done.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
steps: Cream butter and sugar.
Add flour and nuts.
Pat on bottom of pan and bake until brown in 350° oven for about 15 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Soupe 'A Loignon(Onion Soup)
steps: In heavy pot, melt butter.
Add onions and cook slowly, stirring occasionally, until golden.
Sprinkle on the flour and stir for a few minutes, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Add broth and wine, stirring constantly.
Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and let the soup simmer for 30 minutes, partly covered.

recipes.title: Pear Pie
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in mixer bowl.
Beat until smooth. Pour half of the mixture into pie shell.
Arrange pears in pie shell.
Pour remaining sour cream mixture over pears.
Combine remaining ingredients in bowl and mix until crumbly.
Sprinkle over pie.
Preheat oven at 350°.
Bake for 1 hour.
Yields 6 servings. Pan size is 9-inch.

recipes.title: Fruit  Dip
steps: Gradually beat orange juice into Cool Whip until the mixture is creamy, but not thin.
Add sugar to taste.
Serve with fresh or canned fruits.

recipes.title: Wild Rice Casserole
steps: Saute celery and onion in margarine until onion is transparent. Add the rest of the ingredients.
Pour into large casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Skillet Chicken And Rice
steps: Saute celery, onion and green pepper in small amount of oil or butter until tender. Add chicken, salt and poultry seasoning. Continue stirring until chicken is heated.
Cook rice according to package using chicken broth instead of water. Add to sauteed ingredients and cook until dry and beginning to stick to skillet.

recipes.title: Fiesta Salad
steps: Separate onion slices into rings.
Place in salad bowl with green pepper and tomato.
Fry bacon until crisp; remove and drain. Pour off bacon drippings.
Reserve 2 tablespoons in skillet. Stir vinegar, chili powder, salt and red pepper sauce into drippings; heat to boiling.
Pour over vegetables and toss lightly.
Crumble bacon; sprinkle on top.
Serve with a slotted spoon.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Delicious Drumsticks
steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Mix flour, salt, paprika and pepper in a bowl.
Dip chicken into butter.
Roll in flour mixture to coat. Arrange in an ungreased square pan 8 x 8 x 2-inch.
Bake uncovered until done, about 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix all dry ingredients together. Add beaten egg yolks, then add milk gradually. Place over medium heat; stir constantly until mixture thickens. Remove from heat, then add vanilla. Stir well. Place into baked pie shell.

recipes.title: Jam Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients and blend well.
Bake at 325° until done. Makes 3 layers.

recipes.title: Venison Roast In Gravy
steps: Soak venison roast for 4 hours in mixture of baking soda, vinegar, salt and water.
Rinse; soak in clear water 1 hour. Remove roast from water and pat dry.
Remove as much fat as possible before cooking to eliminate any gamey flavor.
Combine seasoned salt, garlic powder and pepper.
Sprinkle on both sides of roast.
Sprinkle with soy sauce.
Place onion slices on top of roast and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons flour.
Place thin slices of oleo on onion.
Wrap roast twice in heavy-duty aluminum foil. Place in roasting pan.
Add 1 quart water.
Cover and bake at 350° for 4 to 5 hours.
Add water, if necessary, to roasting pan but do not open foil.
Remove roast from pan.
Carefully open foil and measure liquid.
Combine 1 1/2 tablespoons flour and 2 tablespoons water to each cup of liquid.
Stir well.
Stir into roast broth. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened.
Serve gravy with roast.

recipes.title: Louisiana Gumbo
ingredients: garlic powder, salt, black pepper and red pepper to taste
steps: Brown okra in bacon drippings until okra is no longer gooey, stirring constantly (use 2 packages frozen okra and don't give up) Add onion and pepper, chopped; saute.
Add a lot of water and a little tomato sauce; let boil gently for at least 2 hours.
Add seafood, parsley, green onion tips and seasonings; cook until seafood is completely done (about 30 minutes).
Turn off fire and add file.
I use shrimp and 1 can of crabmeat; when I feel rich, I add oysters.

recipes.title: Date Nut Loaf
steps: Combine nuts and dates. Add boiling water and stir in soda. Combine egg, vanilla and cooking oil.
Add date mixture. Combine sugar, cocoa, salt and flour. Add to date mixture and mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Annie'S Old Fashioned Fudge
steps: Mix sugar, flour, cocoa, milk and syrup over low heat until mixture forms a soft ball.
Stir only until sugar is thoroughly dissolved.
Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla.
Let stand.
Beat until thick and creamy.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. Cheddar cheese, shredded, or more if desired
steps: Brown hamburger.
Mix in tomato paste, water, salsa and taco seasoning.
Add more water if sauce is too thick.
Spread small amount over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place a layer of tortillas over sauce, tearing in half to cover sides and corners.
Layer remaining as follows:
cheese, tortillas, sauce and cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Greens With Hot Dressing
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cut into small pieces
steps: Wash, drain and dry lettuce and greens.
Add chopped green onions; set aside.
Fry bacon in a large skillet until crisp; drain.
Set aside skillet with the hot bacon fat still in it. Combine the vinegar, water, sugar, salt and pepper in a bowl. From the reserved skillet, pour off all but about 3 tablespoons of hot fat.
Pour the vinegar mixture into the skillet.
Place skillet over the hot coals; bring mixture to a boil.
Remove from heat and pour over the lettuce and spinach greens.

recipes.title: Swedish Pancakes
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Pour on hot griddle, spreading out thinly in a circle.
Use thin spatula and loosen edges.
Turn over when batter begins to bubble.
Remove and serve.
Spread with butter and sugar or jelly.
They are like crepes.

recipes.title: Blender Pear Salad
steps: Drain juice from pears and boil 1 cup of juice to dissolve gelatin.
Put remaining ingredients in blender, including gelatin. Blend; add nuts.
Pour into serving dish and garnish with shredded cheese, chopped peanuts, sliced canned pears, etc. Chill.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pound Cake
steps: Blend well the cake mix, jello and flour.
Add salad oil and eggs, one at a time, also well drained strawberries.
Beat well. Bake 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Creamy Joes
steps: Brown ground beef, drain off fat.
Mix in a bowl canned milk and canned mushroom soup.
Add to ground beef and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve on roll like Sloppy Joes.

recipes.title: Pizza
ingredients: 6 oz. can mushrooms, sauteed in butter
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Break up beef and cook until no longer pink.
Stir in onion and cook until tender.
Add sauce, mushrooms, water, olives, herbs and salt.
Simmer about 10 minutes.
Spoon into prepared pan.
(Grease a 9 x 15 x 2-inch baking pan.) Top with slices of cheese.
Place in preheated oven.
In a large bowl, beat eggs, milk and oil with electric mixer until foamy.
Beat in flour and salt until batter is smooth.
Spoon batter over hot beef mixture, spreading to cover completely; sprinkle with grated cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Eggnog Kringla
steps: Sift powdered sugar and nutmeg.
Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl.
In another large bowl, beat butter until softened. Add flour mixture and egg nog alternately; mix well.
Chill 4 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 350° when ready.
Roll golf ball-size balls of dough into long ropes on floured surface, then shape in figure 8's on a cookie sheet, pinching edges together. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown around edges.
Cool on wire racks and dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Oregano Rice
ingredients: 8 green onions, sliced with stock and bulb used
steps: Saute rice in margarine until light brown (rice).
Place in 3-quart casserole.
Add remaining ingredients; cover.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or a little longer.

recipes.title: Caramel Chews(Unbaked)
steps: Melt caramels in the water in double boiler.
Remove from heat and stir in coconut, oats and nuts.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Shape into 2 (12-inch) rolls.
Frosted with melted chips.
Refrigerate. Cut into 1/4-inch slices.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooked Pepper Steak
ingredients: 4 tomatoes, cut into eighths or 1 (16oz.) can tomatoes with liquid, cut up
2 large green peppers, cut into strips
steps: Cut beef into 3 x 1-inch strips; brown in oil in a skillet. Transfer to a slow cooker.
Combine next 7 ingredients; pour over beef.
Cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours or until meat is tender.
Add tomatoes and green peppers; cook on low for 1 hour longer.
Combine water and cornstarch to make a paste.
Stir into liquid in slow cooker and cook on high until thickened.
Serve over noodles or rice.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cauliflower Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pizza
steps: To make crust, mix all ingredients to form dough.
Spread in pizza pan.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Quiche
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, sausage or turkey
steps: Brown meat and drain. Saute onion and pepper in a small amount of fat. Mix meat, sauteed vegetables, cheese, mushrooms, flour, and put into piecrust. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over meat mixture. Bake at 350° for 45-55 minutes or until firm. May be frozen. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Powdered Sugar Angel Food Cake
steps: Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff.
Fold in 1 tablespoon at a time the granulated sugar.
Sift together the powdered sugar, flour and salt.
Fold into egg mixture.
Add vanilla.
Bake in tube pan at 375° for 45 minutes.
Invert the cake while cooling.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge Cake
steps: Combine cream cheese, 1 egg and 1/4 cup sugar in a medium mixing bowl; beat on high with mixer until smooth.
Gradually add 3 tablespoons milk, 2 tablespoons margarine, cornstarch and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla, beating well.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Catalina Beans
steps: Wrap several beans in a strip of bacon; repeat until all beans are used. Place in baking dish and cover with Catalina dressing. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
steps: Cream butter and both sugars, add eggs and vanilla.
Mix together with flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and baking soda. Add chips, candy and nuts.
Form into patties and place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet.
Bake for 6 minutes at 375°.
The dough is very stiff and the cookies don't spread very much.
They also seem to get darker as they cool, so they are real easy to burn.

recipes.title: Puppy Chow
steps: Melt together margarine, peanut butter and chocolate chips over low heat, stirring constantly.
Add Chex to mixture and mix well.

recipes.title: Potato Fudge Cake
ingredients: 1 c. white potatoes, boiled and put through strainer
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream the butter and sugar, then add potatoes; beat well.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk.
Add melted chocolate and vanilla; beat well.
Bake in 3 layers until sides of layers leave pan.

recipes.title: Infallible Rice
ingredients: 1 c. long grain raw white rice
steps: Saute onion in butter until transparent.
Combine onion, rice and hot broth; bring to a boil on top of the stove.
Cover; place in a 325° oven for 20 minutes.
Serve.

recipes.title: Brown Rice
steps: Saute 1 teaspoon margarine and chopped onions.
Pour rice, soups, sauteed onions and margarine in casserole dish.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet 'N Sour Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 can pork and beans/molasses or brown sugar
steps: Drain butter, lima and kidney beans; add pork and beans and set aside.
Fry bacon; reserve drippings and drain bacon.
In small skillet, add drippings, brown sugar, vinegar, salt, mustard and chopped onion.
Cook until onion is transparent.
Add to bean mixture; add crumbled bacon.
Bake at 250° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken Cashew
ingredients: 1/3 c. white wine or chicken broth
1 1/2 c. chopped broccoli or 1 pkg. frozen chopped, thawed in warm water
steps: Fresh mushrooms may be added.

recipes.title: Monmouth County Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Place chicken and ham in 2-quart casserole.
Combine butter or margarine and flour; stir until smooth.
Slowly stir in broth and cream.
Cook (200°), stirring constantly until thickened.
Add salt, pepper, onion, mushrooms and sherry.
Pour over chicken and ham.
Drop sweet potato biscuit dough by tablespoons around edge of hot mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb. sweet or hot Italian sausage
steps: Cut sausage into 1-inch pieces; saute in oil in large skillet until lightly browned.
Remove from heat.
Saute cut up peppers and onions until tender.
Add sausage and other ingredients. Stir; cook 15 to 20 minutes on low heat.
Serve over noodles, rice or rolls.

recipes.title: Salmon Patties
steps: Mix all the ingredients together.
Roll into small balls. Flatten and deep fry in oil.
Cook until brown.

recipes.title: Fresh Tofu Loaf
steps: Beat eggs slightly.
Add mushroom soup; beat and blend with milk and soy sauce.
Mash tofu coarsely, and combine all ingredients; mix well.
Bake in oiled loaf pan, set in a pan of hot water, at 350° about 45 minutes, or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let stand 10 minutes before unmolding.

recipes.title: Battle Bread
steps: Mix all together and put in a covered bowl in icebox.
Let set for 1 hour.
Grease bread pan.
Put dough in pan.
Cook about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Rolled Round Steak, Jelly Roll
ingredients: 1 round steak (top or bottom, 10 or 12-inches long and 6 or 7-inches wide; meat should be 1/2 to 3/4-inches thick)
steps: You will need a 3 to 4-quart pot (Dutch oven) and 1 empty Coke bottle.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
steps: Combine flour, Crisco and salt.
Cut shortening in flour until it is gravel size.
Put vinegar, egg and water in another bowl and beat, then add to flour mixture.
Flour your hands and form crust into a ball.
Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate for 2 hours before rolling into pie crust.

recipes.title: Lemon Things
steps: Preheat
oven
to

bowl.
Press
evenly in bottom and about 5/8-inch up sides of square	pan,
8 x 8 x 2-inches.
If dough is sticky, flour

Bake
minutes.
Beat remaining ingredients in a medium
bowl
on medium speed until light and fluffy.
Pour over hot
crust.
Bake	about
25 minutes.
Let stand until cool and cut into small pieces.

recipes.title: Hearty Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. sweet Italian turkey sausage, cut into 1-inch slices
2 (16 oz.) cans white kidney beans, drained and rinsed
steps: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown sausage; drain.
Add onions, carrot and green pepper; cook until tender. Stir in flour until smooth.
Gradually stir in milk; cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and begins to boil. Stir in Worcestershire sauce and sage.
In 3-quart baking dish, combine beans and sausage mixture.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Serve hot with crackers. Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Amish Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients thoroughly and make a well in center. To well in flour mix and add remaining ingredients.
Mix until no lumps remain.
Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Doesn't need to be greased.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Frost with Peanut Butter Frosting.

recipes.title: Corn Custard With Tomatoes
steps: Grate
corn
from
cobs into a bowl and measure correct amount.
Beat
eggs
vigorously
and
stir
in onion, salt and cayenne.
Heat
milk
until
a
film forms; skim and stir into corn mixture.
Pour
into 6 buttered custard cups and place in a shallow
pan containing about 1 inch of boiling water.
Bake in a preheated 325° oven for 50 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted in center of custard comes out clean.

recipes.title: Homemade Butter
steps: Mix thoroughly with mixer until it turns to butter.

recipes.title: Jewish Coffee Cake
steps: Cream sugar, butter or oleo and eggs (one at a time).
Add flour, baking powder, soda, vanilla and sour cream or buttermilk. In small bowl, mix cinnamon, chopped nuts and sugar.
Pour half of batter in cake pan; put half of topping onto cake, then add remaining cake batter and top with remaining topping.
Bake in greased 13 x 9-inch pan in 350° oven for for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Grease 3 loaf pans. Preheat oven to 350°.
Place all ingredients in bowl, except for nuts, and beat with electric beater until creamy.
Add nuts and pour into greased loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Yields 3 loaves.

recipes.title: Company Rice
ingredients: 1 cube butter or margarine, cut up
1 to 3 Tbsp. cooking sherry or other wine (this is optional)
steps: Mix together all ingredients.
Bake in covered 2-quart casserole dish 1 hour or until done.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Cream butter, brown sugar, milk and vanilla in large bowl.
Blend until creamy.
Blend in egg. Combine flour, salt and baking soda.
Add to creamed mixture gradually.
Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.
Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Christmas Gingersnaps
steps: Sift flour, measure 7 cups and sift with soda, salt and spices.
Sift 1/2 cup flour and set aside to use only if needed. Measure sugar, butter and molasses.
Turn molasses into small pan and warm slightly; add brown sugar and stir until melted.
Add butter, blending in well.
Stir in eggs, one at a time.
Batter is smooth.
Add orange peel.
Stir in dry ingredients.
Gradually add sufficient flour to make a soft dough that can be kneaded.
Knead until smooth.
Keep tightly covered and refrigerate overnight. Roll out and cut in desired shapes.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice Puffs
ingredients: 1 c. cooked brown or white rice
steps: Beat egg.
Stir in poultry seasoning, salt and cheese; mix with rice.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Shape by rounded teaspoonfuls into 1-inch balls.
Roll in bread crumbs.
Heat 2 to 3 inches of oil.
Fry rice balls until golden brown; drain.
Makes about 15 rice balls.

recipes.title: Veal Shank, Milanese-Style(Ossobuco Ala Milanese)
ingredients: salt and white pepper to taste
2 tomatoes, peeled, seeded and finely chopped
steps: Melt 6 tablespoons of butter in a skillet large enough to hold the veal pieces without crowding.
Roll the meat in the flour and put in the skillet over moderate heat to brown both sides.
Add carrot, onion, celery, half the garlic, the marjoram and the piece of lemon peel, then season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Apple-Nut Kuchen
steps: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and cinnamon. Mix one egg, 1/2 cup milk and 3 tablespoons oil; stir into flour mixture.
Turn into well-oiled 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Quiche Appetizer
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour in a greased pie plate (use a bigger pan and make thinner for an appetizer).
Bake at 400° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Brandied Sweet Potatoes
steps: One and one-fourth hours before serving, cook yams in boiling, salted water for 25 minutes or until tender.
Drain and cool.
In a 1-quart saucepan, mix cornstarch, nutmeg or cinnamon, salt and granulated sugar.
Stir in water.
Cook over low heat until sauce is clear.
Stir in lemon juice and brandy.
Heat oven to 375°. Peel potatoes; slice crosswise, 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick.
Put into buttered shallow baking dish.
Pour on sauce, then bake 30 minutes or until glazed, basting occasionally.
When glazed, sprinkle with miniature marshmallows and broil until golden, if desired.

recipes.title: Salted Peanut Crisps
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix shortening, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Measure flour by dipping method or by sifting.
Blend together flour, soda and salt; stir in.
Mix in peanuts.
Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough about 2-inches apart on lightly greased sheet.
Flatten with tumbler dipped in sugar.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen (2-inch) cookies.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Banana Nut Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
In a medium bowl, stir flour, baking soda and salt.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce, broken into bite size pieces
steps: Using large glass or plastic bowl that has flared top, layer vegetables in order named; do not mix.
Spread mayonnaise over top to seal.
Sprinkle sugar, then cheese over this.
Seal with covering of plastic wrap or tight fitting lid.
Refrigerate 8 to 12 hours.
When ready to serve, sprinkle top with crumbled fresh fried bacon or artificial bacon bits.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Bacon And Chive Potato Salad
ingredients: 6 c. quartered, unpeeled small red potatoes
8 slices bacon, crisply cooked and crumbled
1/4 c. chopped chives or sliced green onions
steps: Cook potatoes in boiling water for 14 minutes or until tender. Drain.
Mix mayonnaise and mustard in a large bowl.
Add potatoes, bacon and chives.
Mix lightly.
Refrigerate until serving (at least 1 to 2 hours).
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake And Icing
ingredients: 1 c. coconut milk or 1/2 coconut milk and 1/2 regular milk
steps: Cream eggs, sugar and Crisco.
Add milk, baking powder, flour, vanilla and coconut.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Mocha Walnut Brownies
steps: Heat the brown sugar and butter in a medium-size saucepan over medium-low heat until the butter has melted.
Dissolve the coffee in the hot water and stir into the butter mixture.
Let cool to room temperature.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Butter an 8 x 11-inch baking pan.
When the butter mixture is cool, beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Sift the flour, baking powder and salt together.
Stir into the butter mixture with a wooden spoon.
Stir in the walnuts and chocolate.
Spread evenly in the pan with a rubber spatula. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until light brown.
Cool and cut into bars. Frost and sprinkle with nuts, if desired.
Makes 20 brownies.

recipes.title: Carrot Cheese Log
