ingredients: 1/2 (8 oz.) container reduced calorie, soft-style cream cheese
1/4 c. wheat and barley nugget cereal, crushed
steps: Mix together carrots, cream cheese, Parmesan cheese and fines herbes.
Cover and chill for at least 1 hour or overnight.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bars
steps: Cream
together margarine, brown
and
white
sugar
and peanut butter.
Then add rest of the ingredients.
Bake
at
350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Put 1 cup chocolate chips
over top and let melt.
Frost with the following:
1/2 cup 10x sugar, 1/4
cup peanut
butter
and 2 to 4 tablespoons milk.

recipes.title: Family Reunion Rolls(Makes 2 Dozen)
steps: Scald milk.
Stir in sugar, salt and margarine; cool to lukewarm.
Sprinkle yeast into warm water; stir until dissolved. Add lukewarm milk mixture.
Add beaten eggs and 3 cups flour.
Beat until smooth.
Add and stir in remaining flour.

recipes.title: Lemon Oat Lacies(Cookies)
ingredients: 2 c. (4 sticks) butter or margarine, softened
3 c. Quaker oats (Quick or old fashioned), uncooked
steps: Beat margarine and sugar until creamy.
Add remaining ingredients, except powdered sugar; mix well.
Cover.
Chill 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Cake
steps: Cream together butter and oil.
Add sugar and beat until mixture is smooth.
Add egg yolks and beat well.
Combine flour and soda and add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk. Stir in vanilla.
Add coconut and nuts.
Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture.
Pour batter into three greased and floured 8-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool and frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

recipes.title: Waikiki Meatballs
ingredients: 1 (13 1/2 oz.) can pineapple tidbits, drained (reserve syrup)
steps: Mix thoroughly beef, crumbs, onion, egg, salt, ginger and milk. Shape mixture by tablespoon into balls.
Melt shortening in large skillet; brown and cook meatballs.
Remove meatballs.
Pour fat from skillet.
Mix cornstarch and sugar.
Stir in reserved pineapple syrup, vinegar and soy sauce until smooth.
Pour in skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture boils and thickens.
Boil 1 minute.
Add meatballs and pineapple tidbits; heat thoroughly.
Serve over bed of rice.

recipes.title: Mexican Fiesta
ingredients: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies
steps: Brown meat; drain.
Add seasoning and water.
Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.
Prepare rice.
Melt cheese and Ro-Tel tomatoes; mix well.
Combine meat, rice and cheese dip.
Top with chips.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Jello Delight
steps: Dilute Jell-O in hot water and let set slightly.
Add crushed pineapple; let set until firm.
Mix Dream Whip according to package; add cream cheese.
Whip together and put over set Jell-O. Cook until thick the eggs, sugar, flour and juices.
Cool, then spread over Jell-O and cheese topping.

recipes.title: Christmas Plum Pudding
steps: Combine raisins, currants, nutmeats and 1/2 cup flour. Combine eggs, molasses, buttermilk, suet and fruit juice.
Combine remaining flour, bread crumbs, soda, spice and salt.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart mold.
Cover mold; set in deep kettle.
Add water to 1-inch below cover of mold.
Cover and steam 2 hours.

recipes.title: Homemade Chicken Soup(The Kind That Cures The Flu)
steps: Cook chicken in large stockpot; cool, debone and cut up into small pieces.
Return to pot in which broth from chicken was cooked.
If more broth is needed, you may use clear, canned broth. Add clean, cut up carrots and celery.
Add onions which have been chopped and chopped fresh parsley tops and stems.
Cook in broth until tender.
You will need to salt and pepper to taste.
May serve over cooked rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Ground Meat & Rice
steps: Brown meat in butter.
Add: soup, rice and water.
Cover and cook for about 5 minutes or until rice is done.

recipes.title: Red Cake
steps: Cream shortening, sugar and eggs until smooth.
Then combine food coloring, cocoa and salt to make a paste.
Add this to shortening mixture.
Then add flour, milk and vanilla; beat until smooth.
Remove from mixer and fold in vinegar and soda.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Hearty Potato Soup
steps: In a large kettle, cook potatoes, carrots and celery in water with bouillon cubes until tender. Saute onions in butter until soft. Stir in flour and salt and pepper, gradually add sour cream, stirring constantly until desired consistency. If too thick, add plain milk.
Yield: 2 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
Beat eggs in a large bowl on high until foamy.
Beat in flour, sugar and brown sugar.
Beat in butter.
Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.
Pour into pie shell and bake for 55-60 minutes.
Serve warm with ice cream or cool whip.

recipes.title: Never Fail Dumplings
steps: Boil a whole chicken in a Dutch oven pot with water.
(Cover chicken over half way with water) after chicken is done, take out of broth to cool.
Mix flour and shortening in together first. Then add all other ingredients.
(I beat my egg in with the 5 tablespoons of chicken broth.) After mixing all ingredients, mixture should be a soft dough.
Roll out dough very thin and let stand for about 10 minutes.
Then cut into strips and drop into boiling broth.
Simmer about 15 minutes, then add deboned chicken to dumplings.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Fudge Bar
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Melt butter and chocolate in saucepan. Remove from heat and stir in sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour, baking powder and salt. Add morsels. Spread mixture in a 9-inch square pan. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Crunch Cake
steps: Mix sugar and shortening until light and creamy.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Add milk and flour alternately.
Stir in flavorings.
Start baking in cold oven at 275° in tube pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
steps: Cream butter, sugar, salt and flour together.
Add beaten eggs, buttermilk and nutmeg.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Nutmeg may be sprinkled on top of pie, if desired.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
steps: Place the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, cream the shortening and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat the eggs and add to the creamed mixture.
Mash the bananas (3/4 cup banana pulp) and mix with the sour milk and vanilla.
Add the banana mixture alternately with the dry ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour the batter into 2 greased 9-inch round layer pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 1/2 hour at 375° for the round pans and 40 minutes at 350° for the 9 x 13-inch oblong pan.

recipes.title: Zucchini Brownies
steps: Mix together flour, sugar, cocoa, salt and baking soda. Combine shredded zucchini, vanilla and oil.
Mix with dry ingredients.
Add nuts.
Spread into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
May frost or serve as is.
Very good!

recipes.title: Carrot Ring With Peas
steps: Combine all ingredients, mixing well.
Place in a greased 5 1/2 cup ring mold.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes. Unmold and serve on platter with cooked peas in the center.
This makes a very pretty vegetable to serve with chicken, fish or beef. You may make the ring and freeze.
Reheat, fill with peas and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Wyoming Cowboy Cookies
steps: Cream the margarine and sugar together.
Add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients.
Drop onto cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Yields 8 dozen.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
ingredients: 3 small jars strained baby food carrots
steps: Cream together eggs, sugar and oil.
Sift together flour, baking soda, baking powder, and cinnamon.
Add alternately with baby food.
Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes.
For icing, combine cream cheese, powdered sugar, vanilla and butter or oleo.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Place dry beef in
bottom
of
dish.
Wrap bacon around chicken.
Spread soup over top of all.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 300° for 2 hours, then 350° for 1/2 hour, uncovered.

recipes.title: Twin Mountain Muffins
steps: Sift flour; measure and resift 3 times with baking powder and salt. Cream butter and shortening; blend in sugar gradually. Add beaten egg and beat until smooth and fluffy. Add flour mixture alternately with milk, beating well after each addition. Spoon into buttered muffin pans, filling about 2/3 full. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes. Makes 24 muffins.

recipes.title: Drop Sugar Cookies
steps: Sift together the flour, soda and salt.
In separate bowl, cream together the butter, shortening, sugar and vanilla.
Add egg to creamed mixture and beat until fluffy.
Add dry ingredients plus milk to creamed mixture and stir until smooth.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Flatten with bottom of glass which has been dipped into sugar.
Bake in a preheated 350° to 400° oven for about 12 minutes.
Cool.
Yields 5 1/2 dozen 2-inch cookies.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cream Pie
steps: Combine dry ingredients.
Add cold milk to egg yolk.
Add this mixture to scalded milk (total 2 1/2 cups milk includes all).
Cook very slowly until thick and creamy.
Add vanilla.
Cool.
Pour into unbaked cooled pie crust, 8 or 9-inch.
Add meringue by beating 3 egg whites (room temperature) with 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar until foamy.
Gradually add 3 tablespoons sugar and beat until stands in peaks.
Put on pie.
Brown in 350° oven 12 minutes.
Cool out of draft.

recipes.title: Brennan Potatoes
steps: Bake potato.
Grill bacon until crisp.
Drain, leaving 3 tablespoons grease.
Add onion and saute slowly.
Remove from heat.
Cut shallow lengthwise strip from potatoes and scoop out inside and add to skillet.
Add cheese, crumbled bacon, sour cream and seasonings.
Mix and mash with spoon to blend.
Return to low heat and heat through.
Stuff into potatoes.
Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Lightly grease cookie sheets.
Cream the butter with sugars in a large bowl until blended.
Add egg and vanilla.
Beat until fluffy.
Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder and baking soda in a small bowl.
Stir into creamed mixture with oats, chocolate chips, raisins and nuts.
Drop dough by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto prepared cookie sheets.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned around edges.
Remove to wire racks to cool.
Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Let margarine get to room temperature.
Add Crisco and sugar, beat well.
Add eggs one at a time, beating 1 minute after each, alternately with milk.
Add other ingredients.
Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Grilled Fajitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. chicken or steak, cut into small strips
2 medium onions, sliced into rings (keep intact)
1 large, red, green or yellow pepper, cut into strips
1 pkg. fajita marinade, mixed according to pkg. directions
sour cream and salsa to taste
steps: Marinate the meat according to directions. Grill the vegetables until tender-crisp.
Remove and keep warm.
Grill meat until preferred doneness.

recipes.title: Broccoli 'N Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli (thawed and drained)
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix together soup, broccoli, rice, process cheese spread, half the onions and water. Spoon into 1 quart casserole dish. Bake 35 minutes. Top with remaining onions. Bake 5 minutes more.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole In A Rice Cooker
steps: Brown ground meat and sausage together.
Drain oil when cooked.
Mix all ingredients in a large bowl; then transfer into rice cooker.
When cooked, leave in cooker for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients, then bring to a boil.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter, vanilla and oats.
Stir well. Drop on wax paper.

recipes.title: Spanish Pork Chops
steps: Roll pork chops in flour and onion mixture.
Brown pork chops in oiled skillet.
Add whole tomatoes, salt and pepper.
Cover with tomato sauce and simmer until tender.

recipes.title: Caramel-Peach Crunch Dessert
ingredients: 1 (29 oz.) can cling peach slices, drained
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
In a bowl, combine flour, oats, sugar, cinnamon and salt.
Add butter.
Mix well.

recipes.title: Persimmon Date Nut Bread
steps: Cream butter.
Add sugar and beat well.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
Dissolve soda in persimmon pulp.
Mix into creamed ingredients.
Combine flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves.
Stir into creamed mixture.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
steps: Combine cream cheese and margarine.
Add sugar, beating until light and fluffy.
Add eggs slowly until well mixed.
Gradually add flour.
Then add vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: One Bowl Banana Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. milk, soured with 1 1/2 tsp. vinegar
steps: In large mixing bowl, add all ingredients and beat until mixed well.
Pour into greased and floured pan.
Bake at 350° for at least 40 minutes.
Test with toothpick to see if done.
Cool and frost with butter powdered sugar frosting.

recipes.title: Chewies
steps: Melt oleo; add sugar.
Add eggs one at a time; add flour and vanilla.
Spread thinly on greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Cut while hot.

recipes.title: Baked Cheesecake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Combine crumb with next 3 ingredients. Reserve 3/4 cup with spoon.
Press the rest to bottom and sides of 9-inch spring-form.
Beat eggs light, slowly beat in 1 cup sugar. Add next 5 ingredients and beat with hand or beater until blended.
Sieve.
Stir in lemon rind.
Pour into pan.
Sprinkle with reserved crumbs.
Bake at 350°
for 1 hour.
Turn off heat, open oven door.
Cool cake in oven for 1 hour.
Don't fret, it will settle.
Chill.
Remove pan sides.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Chili Cheese Puff
steps: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Kentucky Chess Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into unbaked deep dish pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until solid.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pineapple Bread
steps: Beat eggs until fluffy.
Add oil, sugar, vanilla and zucchini. Mix well.
Add dry ingredients and mix well.
Add raisins, pineapple and nuts.
Blend.

recipes.title: Fried Eggplant Or Summer Squash
steps: Wash eggplant; pare and cut in 1/2-inch slices.
Or wash squash and cut crosswise in slices.
Dip slices in well seasoned flour.
Saute slowly in butter for 10 to 15 minutes, or until crisp and browned, turning occasionally.
Serve hot.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Blend dry ingredients and 1/2 sour cream.
Mix well all remaining sour cream.
Beat well.
Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake(This Cake Is So Tasty It Doesn'T Need Frosting)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients together and beat well.
Bake in tube or Bundt pan for 1 hour.
May sprinkle with confectioners sugar, if desired.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie Muffins
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients together in large bowl. Make a well in center. In another bowl, mix eggs until foamy. Mix butter into eggs. Put egg mixture into dry ingredients. Mix well. Pour into foil cupcake liners. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. You must use foil cupcake liners.

recipes.title: Ham, Egg And Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 5 c. plain bread cubes or croutons
steps: Place ham, cheese and croutons in the bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix remaining ingredients; pour this mixture over crouton mixture and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
steps: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in large mixer bowl; beat for 4 minutes.
Stir in coconut and walnuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Cool in pans for 15 minutes.
Remove and cool on racks.

recipes.title: The Zucchini Bread
steps: This is so easy and so great to have on hand in the freezer. Toasts like a dream or serve with cream cheese.

recipes.title: Coca-Cola Cake
steps: Mix flour, sugar and salt in a bowl.
Heat margarine, Coke and cocoa in pan to boiling.
Pour over mixture. Add eggs, buttermilk, soda and vanilla. Stir in marshmallows.
Batter will be thin; marshmallows will float.
Cook in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Frost cake while hot.

recipes.title: Beet Top Greens
steps: Beet greens may be prepared in the same ways that you prepare spinach or Swiss chard, but they must be young and small to be tasty.
Try cooking the greens in boiling salted water for 5 to 8 minutes.
Drain, chop and add the butter or margarine.
Toss with a fork until butter is melted.
Add the horseradish and lemon juice; mix well.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Peaches-N-Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 small box regular vanilla pudding mix
steps: Blend first seven ingredients for two minutes.
Put into greased 9 or 10-inch pie plate.
Arrange peach slices on top. Blend cream cheese, juice and 1/2 cup sugar together.
Beat until creamy and place in center of peaches; spread out to about 1 inch from edge of pie plate.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Can be served warm or cold.

recipes.title: Orange-Nut Muffins
steps: Sift dry ingredients into mixing bowl. Stir in orange rind and nuts. Beat eggs in small bowl. Add orange juice and oil.
Mix well. Add to flour mixture.
Mix until moistened.
Fill greased tins 2/3 full. Bake at 425° for 18 to 20 minutes. Makes 18 muffins.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb. sharp or mild Cheddar cheese, grated
steps: Saute
shrimp in oil
until
pink.
Remove
shrimp
and saute onion, celery and bell
pepper.
Add
rice to shrimp and eggplant mixture.
Pour into
buttered 2 1/2 quart dish.
Pour soup over top.
Top with grated cheese and then buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Boiled Cookies
steps: Cook sugar, milk, cocoa, and margarine for 1 1/2 minutes. Start timing when it has reached a full boil. Remove from heat; add oats, nuts, and vanilla. Then add peanut butter.
Mix well then drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Mushroom Croustades
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Cut a 3-inch round from each slice of bread.
Brush inside of 2 miniature muffin tins generously with butter.
Gently fit bread rounds into each mold to form a cup. Bake 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Sift together flour, soda, salt and cinnamon; set aside. Cream shortening and sugars; add eggs and beat. Add flour mixture and oats. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10.75 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. To cook chicken, you can either boil for 20 to 25 minutes or place in a microwave-safe dish; cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes on High. Turn and cook another 2 to 3 minutes or until cooked through and no longer pink inside. Let cool. Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, combine chicken, salt, pepper, rice and soup. Mix well. Top with cheese, then with bread cubes. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until bubbly and golden brown.

recipes.title: Clam Dip
ingredients: 1 round sourdough or other style bread
steps: Combine all ingredients, except the bread.
Use some of the reserved clam fluid to thin it.
Cut the top off the bread.
Break out the insides and set aside.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Put 4 to 6 slices of bacon on top and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until juice cooks down.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter And Oat Cookies
steps: Bring first three ingredients to a boil. Take off heat and add peanut butter, vanilla and oats.
Drop by spoonful onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Green Apple Cake
ingredients: 3 c. raw Granny Smith chopped apples
steps: Mix sugar and eggs.
Beat.
Mix all dry ingredients.
Add to eggs and sugar mixture alternately with oil and coffee.
Beat well. Add raisins, apples and nuts.
Cook at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Let cool.
Add Cream Cheese Icing.

recipes.title: Chili
steps: Simmer onion and drippings.
Add beef and simmer until brown. Mix all other ingredients.
Add beans last so they will not be mushy.
Add all ingredients to meat and bring to a boil.
Simmer 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Treats
ingredients: 1 (10 oz., about 40) pkg. regular marshmallows or 4 c. miniature marshmallows
steps: Melt margarine in large saucepan over low heat.
Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted.
Remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies cereal.
Stir until well coated.
Using buttered spatula or waxed paper, press mixture evenly into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Cut into squares when cool.
Yield:
24 squares, 2 x 2-inches.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 large head broccoli, rinse and let dry
steps: In a large bowl, cut broccoli into bite-size pieces.
Crumble bacon into broccoli and add chopped onion.
In a small bowl, mix mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar.
Stir well.
Stir into broccoli gently until broccoli and bacon are well coated.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 small bunch green onions, chopped (use some of chive end)
steps: Use meat mixture to fill and roll about 12 to 15 flour tortillas.
Place rolled tortillas in cooking dish.

recipes.title: Sopaipillas
steps: Combine dry ingredients in a bowl.
Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mealy.
Add water, a tablespoon at a time, and toss with a fork to blend.
Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth.
Roll out as thin as possible. Cut into 2 or 3-inch squares and fry in hot oil, 370°, until puffed and browned.
Makes 20 to 30, depending on size.
Serve warm with cinnamon sugar or syrup, if desired.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Banana Nut Bread
steps: Combine first five ingredients.
Stir in pecans.
Combine remaining ingredients and add to flour mixture, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened.
Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Cool in pan 10 minutes and remove and leave on wire racks.

recipes.title: Dutch Rusk
ingredients: 2 pkg. dry yeast, prepared in water-sugar mix
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients, then add flour to thicken slightly. Add the next 3 ingredients and mix.
Add flour until right for punching.
Lard sides of pan.
Knead a few minutes more.
Let rise 2 times.
Make into large 3-inch buns.
Let raise.
Bake at 350° and let cool.
Slice each bun in 2 or 3 slices.
Dry in low oven until crisp.

recipes.title: Garden Salad
steps: Drain all canned vegetables. Mix oil, vinegar, sugar and pepper. Pour over vegetables and mix well. Best if refrigerated overnight.

recipes.title: Hot Milk Cake
steps: Boil together margarine or butter and milk.
Cream together eggs and sugar with a pinch of salt.
Beat well.
Add flavoring. Add flour.
Beat in warm milk.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Vanilla Pudding
steps: Mix together sugar, flour, salt and milk; cook over medium heat to a boil.
Separate eggs; beat yolks.
Mix with small amount of pudding mix.
Then add to entire mixture.
Put back on fire and cook for one minute.
Remove from heat.
Add 1 stick of oleo and vanilla.

recipes.title: Baked Apple And Carrot Casserole(Low-Fat!)
steps: Place half of the sliced apples in a buttered casserole dish. Cover with half of the carrot slices.
Combine dry ingredients; sprinkle half of the mix over carrots.
Repeat the layers; pour orange juice over the top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: whipped cream for garnish if desired
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Bake pie crust 7 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Reduce oven temperature to 325°.
In medium bowl, combine milk, light brown sugar, cognac, light corn syrup, pumpkin pie spice and salt.
Add canned pumpkin and beaten eggs.
Blend well. Slowly pour pumpkin mixture into prepared pie shell.
Bake in a 325° oven until filling is barely set in the center, about 40 minutes.
Cool.
Garnish with whipped cream, if desired.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Chowder
ingredients: 2/3 c. long grain or converted rice
steps: Wash cauliflower and
separate into flowerets; set aside.
In a large saucepan, melt butter.
Saute onion until soft and transparent.
Stir in garlic.
Saute briefly, being careful not to burn.
Stir in rice and coat with butter.
Add pepper to broth; bring to a boil.
Lower heat to simmer.
Leave uncovered and cook 20 minutes.
Add cauliflower; cover.
Simmer 5 to 10 minutes until cauliflower is just tender.
Sprinkle with cheese and parsley. Serve hot from the pot.
Serve in wide rimmed soup bowls.
Add extra cheese, if desired.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: No Sugar Apricot Cookies(Diabetic)
steps: Sift flour and salt.
Put cream cheese and butter in a bowl and blend.
Add sifted ingredients; blend and cover.
Chill.
Heat oven to 350°.
Divide dough into small portions.
Roll on floured board about 1/8 inch thick and 3 inches square.
Place a scant tablespoonful of preserves in center of dough and fold 2 opposite corners to center.
Pinch and seal.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart.
Bake 20 minutes until edges are lightly browned.

recipes.title: Sarah Circle Christmas Shrimp Casserole
ingredients: 8 slices slightly dry bread, crusts trimmed and cubed
1/2 lb. sharp American cheese (2 c. shredded)
steps: Put 1/2 crumbs in casserole.
Add shrimp, mushrooms and 1/2 cheese.
Top with remainder of bread and cheese.
Beat eggs slightly.
Add seasonings and milk; mix.
Pour over the casserole. Bake at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Makes 5 to 6 servings.
(May be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated.)

recipes.title: Hawaiian-Style Chicken
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. Birds Eye Hawaiian-style vegetable with pineapple and a seasoned sauce
steps: Combine flour, salt and pepper; dredge chicken pieces.
Heat oil in large skillet; add chicken and brown well on both sides. Turn chicken skin side up and add water.
Bring to a boil; cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Place chicken on platter and keep warm. Add vegetables to skillet.
Bring to a full boil over medium heat, separating vegetables with fork.
Stir until sauce cubes are blended.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in catsup and serve over chicken.
Makes 3 servings.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water; let stand 5 minutes.
Combine flour and next 4 ingredients; make a well in center of mixture. Add yeast mixture, oil and buttermilk; stir until dry ingredients are moistened.
Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; roll to 1/2-inch thickness.
Cut with a 2-inch biscuit cutter; place on ungreased baking sheets.
Cover; let rise in a warm place (85°) free from drafts, 1 hour.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.
Yields 24 (100 calories per biscuit).

recipes.title: Cowboy Potatoes
steps: Bake potatoes.
Let cool.
Peel and cube.
In large skillet, fry bacon.
Remove bacon and allow to cool, then crumble.
Saute onions and peppers in bacon drippings.
Add potatoes and stir, heating thoroughly.
Add bacon last.
Serve while hot.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
steps: Mix and pour into a tube pan and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Never Fail Dumplings
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Roll out; cut.
Cook gently in boiling broth.

recipes.title: Quick Butter Cookies
steps: Mix oleo and other ingredients with a fork or fingers.
Roll into balls about 1-inch.
Place on cookie sheet and press with fork crisscross.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Sauce
steps: Cut onion, celery and carrots finely.
Fry in oil until lightly brown.
Add small amount of grated cheese, garlic and parsley.
Add clean shrimp, tomatoes, tomato paste and 1/2 cup water.
Cook until done.
Use more water, if needed.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Serve over spaghetti.

recipes.title: A Popular Zucchini Bread
steps: Beat eggs until light and foamy.
Add sugar, oil, zucchini and vanilla to eggs and mix lightly but well.
Combine flour, salt, soda, baking powder and cinnamon, then add to the egg/zucchini mixture.
Stir all until well blended, then add nuts and pour into two 9 x 5 x 3-inch greased loaf pans.
Bake 1 hour in 350° oven. Remove pans from oven and cool on a rack.

recipes.title: Perfect Pie Crust
steps: Sift together flour, salt and baking soda. Cut in shortening until mixture looks like meal. Add buttermilk, mixing with a knife until dough cleans bowl of all flour. Chill.

recipes.title: Banana Fluff Cake
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 c. nuts (save some nuts for top of cake)
steps: Mix eggs, sugar and shortening together.
Add vanilla, bananas, buttermilk and baking soda.
Mix well.
Add baking powder, flour, salt and nuts.
Beat until fluffy.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cool.
Mix 1 package of banana instant pudding according to box directions.
Spread over cake. Spread Cool Whip over this.
Sprinkle with nuts.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Combine sweet potatoes, sugar, eggs, vanilla, milk, margarine and marshmallow cream with electric mixer until smooth.
Spoon into a greased 2-quart shallow dish.
Combine brown sugar, flour, 1/3 cup margarine and pecans.
Sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Old Fashion Pound Cake
steps: Cream Crisco and sugar well. Beat in eggs. Add flour, vanilla and coconut. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Christmas Morning Breakfast Casserole
steps: Scramble eggs and set
aside.
Fry bacon and set aside. Fry hash browns and set aside.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
steps: Stir peanuts, sugar, syrup and salt together in a deep bowl. Cook on High 4 minutes.
Stir candy so all sugar is mixed and continue cooking on High for 3 more minutes.
Add butter and vanilla to syrup, blending well.
Cook on High 1 to 2 minutes.
Add soda and stir well until light and foamy.
Pour immediately onto lightly buttered surface.
Spread, cool and break into pieces. Store in an airtight container.
Can use roasted, salted peanuts. Omit salt and add peanuts after the first 4 minutes of cooking.

recipes.title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 c. diced pears, fresh or canned
steps: Drain pineapple thoroughly; reserve syrup.
Add enough water to make 1 cup syrup.
Combine with sugar and cranberries and bring to full boil.
Remove from heat.
Drain cranberries and reserve syrup. Combine drained cranberries, pineapple, banana, pears and lemon juice and chill.
Melt butter and blend in cornstarch.
Add cranberry syrup and stir over medium heat until it boils and thickens.
Reduce heat and stir a little hot mixture into egg. Return to hot mixture, stirring constantly.
Cook over low heat 3 minutes.
Cool to lukewarm.
Fold fruit, marshmallows and whipped cream into cool mixture.
Freeze.
Can be frozen in muffin tins and used as needed.
Will thaw quickly for eating.

recipes.title: Barbecue Buns
ingredients: 1/3 c. instant nonfat dry milk solids
2 c. very warm tap water (120~ to 130~)
steps: In a large bowl, thoroughly mix 2 cups flour, dry milk solids, sugar, salt and yeast.
Add oleo.
Gradually add tap water to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed of electric mixer, scraping bowl occasionally.
Add 3/4 cup flour.
Beat at high speed 2 minutes, scraping bowl occasionally.
Stir in enough additional flour to make a stiff dough.
Turn out onto lightly floured board; knead until smooth and elastic (8 to 10 minutes).
Place in greased bowl, turning to grease top.
Cover; let rise in warm place, free from draft, until doubled in bulk, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sherry'S Soft And Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Sift together flour, baking soda and salt and set aside.
Combine butter or shortening, sugar, brown sugar, vanilla and water.
Beat until creamy.
Beat in eggs.
Add flour mixture; mix well.
Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.
Drop by well rounded teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Tasty Cake
steps: Mix all ingredient together and pour into a greased and floured jelly roll pan.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Spread peanut butter immediately from the oven; cool in refrigerator.
Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler.
Spread over cooled cake. Cool in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Raisin Cookies
steps: Boil raisins and water for 2 minutes.
Cool and add soda to raisin mixture.
Add remaining ingredients to raisin mixture.
Drop on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 7 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Ham Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli according to package directions.
Drain.
Chop into 1 1/2-inch pieces.
Melt 1 1/2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan.
Add flour and salt; cook 1 minute.
Add milk.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Place broccoli in a 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole.
Combine remaining ingredients except the bread crumbs.
Pour over broccoli.
Pour white sauce over all.
Combine 2 tablespoons melted butter with bread crumbs. Put crumbs on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Green beans or asparagus may be substituted for broccoli.

recipes.title: Alsatian Pork With Sauerkraut
ingredients: 5 slices bacon, cut into 1 inch pieces
2 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
4 pieces smoked kielbasa, cut diagonally into 2 inch long pieces
steps: Cook bacon and onion in a skillet until bacon is crisp, stir constantly.
Stir in sauerkraut and brown sugar, add potatoes and apples.
In a cheese cloth bag tie peppercorns, juniper berries, cloves, parsley and bay leaves; add to sauerkraut.
Add pork chops and smoked kielbasa pieces, pour chicken broth in, stir well.
Heat to boiling, then reduce heat, cover and simmer until meat is done, potatoes are tender for about 45 minutes.
When done remove spice bag.
With a slotted spoon remove sauerkraut, potatoes and apples to a large platter.
Arrange meat and kielbasa in the center of the platter.
Serve with fresh sourdough bread.

recipes.title: Methodist Baked Beans
steps: Brown
ground
beef and onion;	drain good.
Mix ground beef, onion,
sugar
and pork and beans.	Put in a long Pyrex dish.
Put bacon
on top of beans and top with ketchup.
Cook until bacon is cooked.
Bake in oven at 400°.

recipes.title: Stir-Fry Lemon-Honey Pork
steps: Cut pork into thin strips.
Dredge in the flour.
Cook quickly but thoroughly in the hot oil.
Remove meat from skillet.
Add remaining ingredients to drippings and cook 2 minutes until crisp but tender.
Stir pork strips in and serve.

recipes.title: Stuffed Green Peppers
steps: Put ground beef, rice and peppers in green peppers in 2 inches of water and cook covered for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Beef Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 tsp. ground comino (same as ground cumin)
steps: Brown ground meat with chopped onions, chili powder, ground comino and salt.
Drain.
On the side, pour about 1/2 can Wolfe's chili into a bowl or Pyrex pie dish; add small amount of water (make it a little runny); stir and warm in a microwave.

Dip flour or corn tortillas into warm chili; add a couple of spoons of meat, onions and cheese, then roll it up and place into an oblong pan. When all are rolled up, pour any remaining chili on top; add cheese and onions.
Cook at 400° to 425° until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Sift flour, soda, salt and cinnamon together; set aside. Cream the sugar, shortening, molasses and eggs together.
Add flour mixture; mix well.
Stir in oats, nuts and raisins.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Apple Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine apples and sugar in mixing bowl.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Blend oil, vanilla and egg with the apples, then combine the dry ingredients and mix in well.
Stir in the raisins.
Pour into greased 8-inch square cake pan.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes.
Yields 9 servings.

recipes.title: Party Mix
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. pretzel sticks, twist or nuggets
steps: In a small saucepan, melt margarine; stir in Worcestershire sauce and seasoned nuts, cereals and pretzels.
Pour margarine, sauce over mixture.
Mix lightly about every 20 minutes.
Spread out on absorbent paper or heavy brown paper to cool.
Keep crisp by storing in airtight container.

recipes.title: Scorcher
steps: In a large kettle, fry meat in oil until dark brown.
Then add 1-quart of water. Cover and simmer two hours.
Add remaining ingredients, except flour and cornmeal.
Cook at gentle simmer for 30 minutes, removing bay leaves after 15 minutes.
Make a paste of flour, cornmeal and water.
Stir into mixture, cooking another five minutes at simmer while stirring often.
Serve immediately with a fire extinguisher at your right elbow.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
steps: Mix oil, sugar, eggs, apples, nuts and vanilla.
Combine dry ingredients and add to oil mixture.
Put in greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake at 325° for
1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Lemon Sponge Pie
steps: Mix in order given and our into unbaked pie crust. Bake in moderate oven 25 minutes.
You may use an orange instead of lemon; it's very good.

recipes.title: Stuffed Clams
ingredients: 12 giant chowder clams or 24 large Cherrystone clams, opened, drained and chopped
steps: Mix together bread crumbs, celery, green pepper and onion. Add lemon juice and clam juice and mix well.
Season with garlic salt, oregano and pepper and mix.
Add this mixture to the chopped clams.
Spoon into cleaned clam shells and top with bacon pieces. Bake at 350° until bacon is crisp.
Serve with lemon wedges. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Herbed Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. long grain and wild rice mix
3 large chicken breasts, boned and halved
1 (10 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup
steps: Prepare rice mix using package directions.
Season chicken with salt and pepper in skillet.
Brown slowly in butter.
Spoon rice into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with chicken, skin side up.
Add soup to skillet.
Slowly add Sauterne, stirring until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bring to boil.
Pour over chicken.
Cover and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Uncover and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Zucchini Muffins
ingredients: 2 c. shredded, unpeeled zucchini (about 2 medium size)
steps: Combine eggs, oil, vanilla and zucchini. Add and stir until moistened sugar, flour, cinnamon, soda, salt, baking powder and chopped nuts. Grease muffin tins. Fill 2/3 full. Bake in preheated 400° oven for 18 minutes.

recipes.title: Chinese Icicles(Cookies)
steps: Using high speed of the electric mixer, cream butter, sugar and vanilla until soft and creamy.
Sift together salt and flour; add gradually to butter mixture.
Blend well on low speed.
Add noodles, stirring in by hand.
Chill until firm.
Pinch off small pieces of dough and shape into fingers.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cool; dust with powdered sugar.
Yield:
5 to 6 dozen icicles.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
steps: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and reserve 1/4 cup fat from bacon.
Cook onion in the fat until tender.
Blend flour, sugar, salt and celery seed; add vinegar and 1 cup water and cook until thickened.
Add bacon, potatoes and eggs.

recipes.title: 3 Bean Salad
steps: Fry together bacon and hamburger; drain.
Add 3 cans of beans and juice.
Mix with onion, catsup, brown sugar, prepared mustard and vinegar.
Mix together in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pecan Tarts
steps: Boil together the brown sugar and hot water for 10 minutes. Cool and add the butter, flour, milk, salt and eggs.
Cook all together in a double boiler until thick and smooth, stirring constantly.
Cool and add 1 teaspoon vanilla extract and 1/2 cup pecan meats, chopped.
Put 2 tablespoons of mixture in prepared (baked) tart shells.
Garnish with 1/2 cup whipped cream, sweetened with 1 tablespoon of powdered sugar and put a whole pecan on top.
Fills about 1 dozen shells.
Delicious!

recipes.title: Microwave Fudge
steps: Microwave until butter melts; take out and stir fast!
Put into pan.
Let cool, then cut.

recipes.title: Spoon Rolls
steps: Mix in order listed.
Fill section of a greased muffin pan half full.
Bake at 450°.
Dough will keep in refrigerator for 5 days.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
steps: Mix shortening with brown sugar cream.
Add egg.
Sift together soda, salt, flour, milk rolled oats.
Finally add raisins, nuts, vanilla.
Bake at 375 till golden brown.

recipes.title: Popover Tacos
steps: Brown ground beef with onion in skillet, stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain.
Stir in taco seasoning mix, tomato sauce and water; mix well.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.

recipes.title: Pineapple Nut Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. Rice Chex cereal, crushed to 3/4 c.
1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple in unsweetened pineapple juice, undrained
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
ingredients: 1 small can whole kernel corn, drained
1/2 (8 oz.) pkg. Monterey Jack cheese (with jalapeno peppers), grated
1 (10 oz.) pkg. Cracker Barrel cheese, grated
steps: Brown meat with salt, pepper and onion.
Drain.
Add taco mix and 2 cups water.
Cook on medium heat until mixture is hot.
Let simmer on very low heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture is thick.
Add drained corn and olives (if desired); heat.
Grate each kind of cheese separately.
Spray baking dish with vegetable spray. Fill each separated shell with small amount of pepper, cheese and meat.
Roll shells and lay in dish (side by side) and pour rest of meat sauce over rolled shells.
Cover the tops of shells with grated cheese (Cracker Barrel).
Bake at 400° for 5 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Mill Road Acres Beer Bread
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Best when just baked.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender and mix for 10 seconds at high speed.
Pour into a greased 1-quart baking dish.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry Winks
steps: Measure and sift dry ingredients.
Beat until light and fluffy the sugar, shortening, eggs, milk and vanilla.
Blend in the dry ingredients.
Add nuts, dates and cherries.
Blend well and chill. Shape into small balls.
Roll in crushed corn flakes.
Place on greased baking sheet.
Press 1/4 maraschino cherry in each.
Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: 7-Up Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into 2 well-greased and floured cake pans.
Frost with 7-Up frosting.

recipes.title: Oil Pie Crust
steps: Mix flour, wheat germ and salt.
Pour water and oil in all at once.
Stir with a fork.
Roll dough between sheets of waxed paper.
Bake 15 minutes at 450° (prick with fork before baking).

recipes.title: Next Best Thing To Robert Redford Cake
steps: Mix together flour, nuts and butter and put in 13 x 9 x 2 pan. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: My Best Fruit Cake
steps: Mix all together and let stand overnight before baking. Bake at 250° for
hours.
Makes	5
pounds.
This
was copied from an original recipe sheet of Mother Reeves.

recipes.title: Beef Burgundy
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb. beef round tip steak, cut into 1-inch chunks
1/4 tsp. each: marjoram, salt and pepper
steps: Heat oven to 325°.
Grease baking dish.
Place beef in baking dish.
Toss with gravy and flour.
Set aside.
Spray 12-inch skillet and cook mushrooms, celery, onion and garlic about 6 minutes or until tender, but crisp.
Transfer to baking dish along with carrots, wine, beef broth, thyme, marjoram, salt and pepper. Bake, covered, about 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Uncover to stir occasionally until beef is tender and vegetables are cooked through.
Replace cover after each stirring.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Calico Beans
steps: Mix all ingredients except bacon in casserole.
Top with bacon slices and bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Cheddar Cheese Bread
steps: Mix
dry
ingredients.
Combine egg, milk and water and stir into
dry
ingredients
until they are moistened.
Spoon batter into
a
greased loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inches).
Bake at 350°
for 55
to 60 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Jello
ingredients: 2 small pkg. jello (any flavor; do not mix flavors)
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients in saucepan and heat until jello is dissolved.
Set off and cool.
Beat in Cool Whip and pour in dish.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 c. original Minute rice or Minute premium long grain rice
1 (4 serving size) pkg. Jell-O vanilla and coconut flavor pudding and pie filling
steps: Combine milk, rice, pudding mix, raisins and egg in saucepan. Stir over medium heat until mixture just comes to a boil.
Cool 5 minutes, stirring twice.
Pour into dessert dishes or serving bowl.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.
Serve warm.
Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Oven-Fried "Chicken" Chimichangas
ingredients: frozen chicken-like slices (amount depends on how much you wish to make)
1 (4 oz.) can chopped green chilies, drained
steps: Grind or chop "chicken"; add cheese and green chilies, set aside.
Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels; microwave at High 15 seconds or until hot.
Brush both sides of tortillas, one at a time, with vegetable oil (keep remaining tortillas warm).
Place a scant 1/2 cup of "chicken" mixture just below center of each tortilla.
Fold in left and right sides of tortilla to partially enclose filling.
Fold up bottom edge of tortilla; fold into a rectangle and secure with a wooden pick.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and "chicken" mixture.
Place on a lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake at 425° for 10 minutes or until crisp and lightly browned.
Serve with shredded lettuce, salsa and sour cream. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Blackfoot Potato Soup With Sausage
ingredients: 4 large Idaho potatoes, pared and diced
1 (10 oz.) pkg. cut frozen green beans, cooked, or 2 c. fresh green beans, cooked
steps: Slice sausage into 1/4-inch thick; brown over medium heat in Dutch oven or heavy kettle.
Remove sausage with slotted spoon and reserve.
Drain away excess fat.
Add celery, onion, thyme and salt.
Cook until onion is tender.
Stir in flour.
Cook 1 minute.

recipes.title: Kool-Aid Modeling Dough
steps: Mix flour, salt, cream of tartar, Kool-Aid and water in medium saucepan.
Stir in oil.
Adult should stir the mixture over medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes until mixture forms a ball in the center of the pan.
Remove to a floured surface and knead for 1 minute. Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Corn Dogs(Makes 8)
steps: Mix corn meal, flour, milk, egg and oil.
Beat with fork. Roll hot dogs in flour, then roll in batter.
Deep fry in oil until brown.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Mix together and bake at 375° for 5 minutes only.

recipes.title: Wintertime Corn Pudding
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into buttered casserole dish; sprinkle paprika on top.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs.
Sift flour; measure and sift with salt, baking powder and soda.
Add to first mixture.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into greased 5 x 10 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Bacon Cheddar Grilled Sourdough Bread
ingredients: 6 oz. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese (1 1/2 c.)
4 slices bacon, crisply cooked, drained and crumbled (bacon bits may be substituted)
steps: Heat grill.
Cut loaf into 1-inch slices.
Lightly spread one side of each slice of bread with margarine.
Place, margarine side down, on ungreased cookie sheet.
Sprinkle cheese, bacon and parsley evenly on bread slices.
When ready to barbecue, place slices, margarine side down, directly on gas grill over medium-high heat or on charcoal grill 4 to 6-inches from coals.
Cook 4 to 6 minutes or until bottom of bread is toasted and cheese is melted. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Party Cucumber Spread
steps: Press shredded cucumber between paper towels to remove excess moisture.
Beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Stir in cucumber and other ingredients.
Spread between party rye or wheat bread, or as a spread for open-faced sandwiches.

recipes.title: Date Nut Bread
steps: Pour boiling water over dates, soda, salt and butter.
Cool. Add eggs to sugar and then add other ingredients.
Combine the 2 mixtures.
Bake at 350° in greased and floured loaf pan for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Chocolate Town Special Cake
steps: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add eggs and vanilla, beating well.
Sift together salt, flour, soda and cocoa.
Add to creamed mixture with buttermilk.
Mix well.
Add boiling water; mix.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Peach Alexander
ingredients: 1 medium fresh peach (canned or frozen may be used)
steps: Mix in blender and serve.
This will make 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chess Pie Bars
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients and mix well.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.
Combine the last ingredients and beat well.
Pour over crust in pan.
Bake in 375° oven 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool, then cut into squares.
Makes about 2 dozen.

recipes.title: "Fried" Pie Crust
steps: Mix well with pastry cutter; divide into balls large enough for 4-inch fried pie.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
steps: Cook broccoli according to package directions, then drain well. In saucepan, melt margarine.
Add a few onion flakes, flour and water.
Blend and let boil a bit.
Add Cheez Whiz, broccoli and eggs.
Mix gently.
Turn into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Dot with cracker crumbs and/or crumbled croutons and 2 tablespoons margarine.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Almond Brownies
steps: Melt chocolate; set aside.
Cream margarine and sugar.
Beat in eggs and blend in chocolate, vanilla and flour.
Add 1/2 almonds and spread in 8-inch pan.
Sprinkle remaining almonds and bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pressure Cooker Swiss Steak
steps: Have butcher run meat through tenderizer. Cut steak in eight pieces.
Coat with flour.
Brown in cooker (uncovered)
with small amount of hot oil.
When completely brown on both sides, add a little salt and pepper.
Add 1 1/4 cups water for 4-quart cooker (1 1/2 cups for 6 to 8-quart cooker).
Set pressure control for 10 pounds (both sizes).
After control starts to jiggle, cook for 35 minutes.
Adjust heat for control to jiggle 1 to 3 times a minute. Cool cooker normally 5 minutes and then place under cold running water to reduce pressure.
Recipe makes its own gravy.
Serve with mashed potatoes and vegetables.

recipes.title: Meatless Mexican Cornbread
steps: Mix all ingredients except bacon. Pour half of batter into a greased 9 x 13 inch glass dish. Crumble bacon and cheese on top of first layer. Cover with remaining half of batter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Peel and cut apples; arrange in an oblong baking dish.
Mix remaining ingredients in bowl; sprinkle over apples.
Bake in 375° oven for 30 minutes.
Cool before serving.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Mushroom Veal
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless veal, pounded to 1/4-inch thickness, cut into pieces
steps: Arrange veal in 12
x
8-inch
baking
dish.
Top
with sliced mushrooms.
Cover
with
wax
paper.
Microwave
at 50% (Medium) 7 to 10 minutes or until veal is tender and no longer pink; rearrange once,
leaving
mushrooms on top.
Set aside. In small bowl
blend remaining ingredients.
Increase power to High. Microwave 2 to
minutes or until thickened, stirring with wire whip once
or
twice.
Pour
sauce over veal;
cover with wax paper.
Reduce power to 50% (Medium).
Microwave 2 to 4 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Mickey Mouse Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 1/2 c. margarine or butter (chicken fat can also be used)
steps: Melt margarine in a large skillet and saute garlic, onion, celery and mushrooms until tender, not browned.
Add rice and stir until each grain is coated.
Add chicken broth, bay leaf, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Transfer to buttered 2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until rice is tender and all liquid absorbed.
Remove bay leaf before serving.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
steps: *Add 1 tablespoon vinegar to milk and let stand 1 minute.

recipes.title: San Antonio Skillet Supper
ingredients: 2/3 c. thick and chunky salsa or picante sauce
1 (8 oz.) can dark red kidney beans, rinsed and drained
avocado slices, sour cream and chopped cilantro (optional toppings)
steps: Cook sausage in half lengthwise.
Cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices.
In a 10-inch skillet, combine rice, sausage and remaining ingredients except optional toppings.
Mix well, breaking up tomatoes with large spoon.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Remove from heat; let stand covered 5 minutes.
Top as desired and serve with additional salsa or picante sauce.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Bushel Of Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Mix well sugars, oil and margarine.
Add eggs, vanilla, salt and soda; mix well.
Add flour; mix well.
Add oatmeal or cereal and chocolate chips.
Blend well.
Bake at 350° on ungreased cookie sheet for 10 minutes until light brown.

recipes.title: Heath Bar Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix first 5 ingredients.
Set aside. Mix buttermilk, egg and vanilla together.
Add to dry mix and mix well.
Add nuts and broken Heath bars.
Stir just enough to mix. Pour into 8 x 10-inch or 2 bread loaf pans (greased well or wax paper lined makes easier clean up).
If greased, also flour well. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.
Turn out while warm (after cooling about 1/2 hour).

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked slightly
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients and pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Super Easy, Super Quick Supper
ingredients: 1 box frozen chopped chicken or 1 lb. chicken, chopped and cooked
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon cooking oil (any variety) in large frying pan.
Add onion and cook until clear.
Add chicken and cook until thawed.
Add broccoli and mushrooms and cook about 5 minutes until heated through.
Add bean sprouts and water chestnuts.
Mix stir-fry seasoning according to package directions and pour over stir-fry.
Add soy sauce to taste.
Be careful not to cook too long, bean sprouts will become soggy.
Serve immediately over hot cooked rice.

recipes.title: Pound Cake (5 Flavor)
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: vanilla, orange, pineapple, coconut and lemon flavors
steps: Cream the Crisco and margarine, adding gradually the sugar. Add eggs, one at a time; beat well 1 1/2 minutes after each egg. Sift baking powder with flour; add alternately with milk and flavorings. Mix well. Bake in a large tube pan. Grease and flour pan. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Let cool in pan for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
steps: Cut cabbage into wedges.
Cook in salted water until tender; drain.
Mix soup and milk together and set aside.
Grease casserole dish. Layer alternately the cabbage, soup and cheese. Top with bread crumbs.
Dot with butter.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Lemon Cake Pie
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Add lemon juice and beaten egg yolks; mix.
Stir in flour and milk.
Fold in egg whites that have been beaten stiff.
Pour in unbaked pie shell and bake at 450° for first 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 325° and bake until set as custard, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix all together.
Roll into acorn-size balls.
Roll in sugar. Press with glass.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Dreams
steps: Cream sugar and oleo.
Add vanilla.
Mix in flour and pecans, then roll in small balls and place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 8 to 10 minutes, then roll in powdered sugar twice.

recipes.title: Bacon Wraps
ingredients: 2 boxes Waverly Wafers or other rectangular crackers
steps: Cut strips of bacon into 3 parts.
Wrap each part around the center of a cracker.
Place on a rack over a baking pan so that grease will drain away from crackers.
Bake at 250 to 300 degrees until crisp.
Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Spoon Hot Rolls
steps: Mix warm water and yeast. Melt margarine.
Add margarine, sugar, egg and flour to yeast.
Mix well.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
steps: Pour boiling water over bran.
Stir well and let cool.
Mix all ingredients.
This will keep in refrigerator 6-8 weeks.
Bake 20 min. at 400 degrees in greased muffin pan.

recipes.title: Fancy Chicken Puff Pie
ingredients: 1/4 lb. ham, cut in 2 x 1/4-inch strips
3 c. cooked chicken, cut in 2 x 1/4-inch strips
1 1/2 c. fresh asparagus or 10 oz. pkg. frozen
chilled pie crust for 1 crust pie or frozen puff pastry
steps: In medium saucepan over medium heat, melt butter and saute shallots lightly. Stir in flour and cook for 3 minutes. Add broth and sherry.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Season to taste with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in ham, chicken, asparagus and cream.
Pour chicken mixture into an ungreased 9-inch pie pan.
Preheat oven to 425°. Cut an 8-inch circle from crust.
Cut hearts out of extra dough with a cookie cutter, if desired.
Place circle on a cookie sheet and moisten with cold water.
Pierce with a fork and brush with egg.
Decorate with hearts which are also brushed with egg.
Bake crust and full pie plate for 10 minutes, reduce heat to 350° and bake another 10 to 15 minutes or until pastry is golden brown and filling is hot and set.
With a spatula, place pastry over hot filling and serve.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Praline Pound Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Sprinkle 1/2 cup chopped pecans in pan.
Set aside.
Cream the butter or margarine and cream cheese.
Add brown sugar and cream until light and fluffy (about 5 minutes).
Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Fold in flour just until combined.
Do not overmix.
Stir in vanilla and remaining 1 cup chopped pecans.
Spoon batter into prepared pan and place on baking sheet in oven.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until wooden toothpick inserted near center comes out clean.
Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove to rack to cool completely.
Yields 16 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) jar plain or jalapeno Cheez Whiz
steps: Saute onion and celery in oleo.
Cook rice and broccoli according to package directions.
Combine celery, onion, soup and cheese.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Stir in cooked rice.
Add broccoli.
Pour into a 3-quart dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Okra Gumbo
ingredients: 2 lb. frozen okra, chopped or sliced
1 c. green onions with tops, chopped
1 lb. smoked sausage, cut in small chunks
1 lb. white chicken meat, cut in small chunks and browned
steps: In a large skillet, heat oil and brown okra until tender (about 10 minutes).
Add onions and tomatoes to mix.
Cook until onions are translucent.
Put all remaining ingredients in large pot along with mixture in skillet.
Bring to boil, then simmer for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Chip Bake
steps: Use 1/2 bag of chips mixed in with all the ingredients.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Put rest of chips over all.
Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top and bake at 400° for 20 minutes. (Put in cake pan or casserole.)
You can use canned chicken or cook a whole one and use it.

recipes.title: Golden Sugar Cookies
steps: Sift flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt together. Put aside. Cream butter and flavoring together until butter is soft and smooth. Add sugar, gradually creaming until fluffy. Add egg yolks one at a time. Next, add dry ingredients to creamed mixture, beating until well-blended. Form dough into 1-inch balls and place about 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Corn Dogs
steps: Mix first 7 ingredients together to form batter.
Roll or dip frankfurters in mixture and fry in deep fat.

recipes.title: Christmas Cookies
ingredients: 1 lb. each: candied dates, cherries and pineapple
steps: Mix all ingredients; will be stiff (better to mix with hand). Bake at 350° on a well-greased cookie sheet about 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
steps: Add boiling water to All-Bran; set aside.
Mix sugar, oil and beaten eggs.
Add buttermilk and flour mixed with soda and salt. Mix in over All-Bran, then fold in 40% Bran Flakes.
Bake in greased muffin pan at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes.
Mix keeps up to 6 weeks in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter, margarine, cream cheese and sugar until thoroughly creamed. Add vanilla and salt; alternate eggs and flour. Beat until well blended. Bake in a lightly greased and floured tube pan at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Meat Ball Stew
ingredients: 1 lb. ground meat (beef, elk, deer, etc.)
steps: Chop onion fine.
Combine ground meat, chopped onion and rice in a large bowl.
Form into medium size meat balls and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: German Fruit Cake
ingredients: 2/3 c. each: cherry, apricot and pineapple preserves
steps: Cream together butter, sugar and eggs.
Sift together flour and spices.
Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk to which the soda has been added.
Fold in gently the preserves, vanilla and nuts.
Pour into a greased and floured angel food cake pan.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until done at 325°.
Cool for 15 minutes after it is removed from oven.

recipes.title: Zucchini Drop Cookies
steps: Beat well the zucchini, pulp, soda, sugar and shortening.
Add egg and beat well.
Sift flour and spices.
Add dry ingredients with nuts and raisins.
Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: French Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, undrained
steps: Combine soup and margarine; stir well.
Drain mushrooms and water chestnuts, reserving liquid.
Add enough water to reserved liquid to equal 1 1/3 cups.
Add all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a lightly greased baking dish.
Cover and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: French Toast With Bananas 'N Brandy Coulis
steps: Slice baguettes diagonally into 3/4-inch thick slices. Mix buttermilk, milk, eggs, vanilla and cinnamon thoroughly. Soak slices in mixture for 10 minutes or so. Lightly spray griddle with nonstick vegetable coating. Over medium heat, cook slices on griddle until golden brown. Keep in warming oven (covered with a sheet of aluminum foil) at 200° until just ready to serve.

recipes.title: Pecan Balls
steps: Cream butter; gradually add sugar.
Mix well; add flour mixed with pecans and vanilla.
Shape into small balls.
Bake at 350° about 15 minutes or until light brown.
Cool, then roll in powdered sugar.
Makes about 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Southern Pound Cake
steps: Cream the butter and sugar well.
Break the eggs, one at a time, in a small bowl.
Combine all ingredients and beat for about 5 minutes. Grease a large pound cake pan and bake for 2 hours at 275°.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Ginger Cookies
steps: Cream together egg, sugar, shortening and molasses.
Add rest of ingredients.
Roll in small balls, then roll in sugar.
Bake at 375° for about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Sauteed Corn With Bacon
steps: Remove husks and silks from corn. Cut corn from cob, scraping cob to remove pulp; set aside. Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon, reserving drippings. Crumble bacon and set aside. Saute corn in bacon drippings until golden brown. Add water to cover, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil; reduce heat, cover and simmer 30 to 45 minutes. Stir in crumbled bacon.

recipes.title: Beef Kabobs
ingredients: 2 lbs. Boneless sirloin, cut into 2-inch pieces
2 sweet green peppers cut into 1-inch pieces
2 boxes (6.9 oz. Each) rice pilaf mix, prepared
steps: In small bowl, whisk oil, garlic, rind and juice, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper. Pour half into large storage bag; add beef. Seal; refrigerate 1 to 2 hours. Divide steak, peppers, onion and mushrooms into 6 equal portions. Thread each portion onto large metal skewers. Heat broiler. Place skewers on large broiler-pan rack. Brush with some of remaining marinade. Broil 5 minutes. Turn over; brush with remaining marinade. Broil 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafers
steps: In a medium bowl, beat all ingredients at low speed until well blended. Drop dough by 2 teaspoons about 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until edges are brown. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Saute onions in butter, then blend in salt and flour.
Add sour cream until smooth.
Bring to boil, add corn and cook until heated through.
Add 1/2 bacon.
Pour in greased dish and top with parsley and bacon.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Quick-N-Easy Cherry Cobbler
steps: Combine fruit and 3/4 cup sugar.
Let stand for 20 minutes. Melt margarine to pour over cobbler at the end.
Sift together flour and sugar.
Add milk.
Stir briskly (lumps will remain). Pour butter over top.
Top with fruit.
Bake for 45 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Fresh Fruit Cobbler
steps: Arrange in square or round pan the cut fruit.
Sprinkle with mixture of flour, sugar and cinnamon.
Dot with butter or margarine.
Sift together into bowl the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Add oil, milk and egg.
Stir with fork until blended.
Drop by spoonful over fruit.
If desired, dough may be spread with spatula.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated oven at 350°.
Cook until bubbly and light brown.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Fettucini
ingredients: 8 oz. bacon, cooked and cut up
steps: Let butter or margarine, eggs and cream stand at room temperature for 2 to 3 hours.
Cook bacon in skillet until browned.
Remove and drain on paper toweling.
Beat together eggs and cream just until blended.
Cook pasta until al dente (tender), about 15 minutes.
Drain thoroughly; do not rinse.
Toss pasta with butter.
Pour egg mixture over and toss until pasta is well coated.
Add bacon, cheese, pepper and parsley; toss to mix. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Salt Dough
steps: Mix with your hands, adding more flour if dough is sticky and more water if crumbly.
Wet the surface to add bits of decorative dough to cut-outs.
After shaping, bake at 200° until thoroughly dry (about 1 hour).
You may glaze with egg yolk/water for brown color.
Varnish cooled ornament.

recipes.title: Chicken Gumbo
ingredients: 10 oz. pkg. okra, frozen, cut up
steps: Add tomatoes, celery, green pepper, onion, parsley and bouillon cubes to chicken broth.
Simmer 24 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Add chicken and okra; cook for 6 minutes longer.
Add rice and corn.
Heat and serve.
Makes 6 servings, 1 cup each; 155 calories per serving.

recipes.title: Dilly Bread
ingredients: 1 c. creamed cottage cheese, heated to lukewarm
steps: You will need an 8-inch round, 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole.

recipes.title: Country Chicken Soup(8 Servings)
steps: Place all ingredients, except rice, in slow cooker in order listed.
Cover; cook for 1 hour on high, then on low for 8 to 9 hours.
One hour before serving, remove chicken and cook slightly. Remove meat from bones; return meat to slow cooker.
Add rice; cover and cook for 1 hour on high.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
steps: In a bowl, combine cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda.
Add egg, milk and corn; stir just until mixed.

recipes.title: Mushroom Tomato Quiche
steps: Beat eggs and egg white until creamy.
Add milk and cream. Sprinkle in salt and pepper.
Stir in meats and cheese.
Pour into an unbaked pie shell.
Add mushrooms; layer tomatoes.
Sprinkle with additional cheese, if desired.
Bake for 10 minutes at 425°, then for 10 additional minutes at 350°.
(You can also add 1/4 cup sauteed onions for more flavor.)
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Secret Kiss Cookies
steps: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla in large bowl. Gradually add flour. Beat on low until well blended. Chill 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mary Imus' Favorite Cake
steps: Blend dry ingredients.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into large rectangular pan or two 8-inch round layer pans. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
May add chopped walnuts and/or raisins.
Sprinkle top with powdered sugar after baking or frost with light chocolate frosting.
Stores well.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
steps: Dissolve flour in the milk.
Add salt, sugar and eggs. Combine with corn and mix well.
Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
When done, knife will come out clean.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
steps: In large bowl, cream butter and 2 cups sugar until fluffy. Add vanilla, then eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
In separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt.
Add sour cream to butter and egg mixture; mix well. Slowly stir in flour mixture until batter is smooth.
Spoon 1/2 of batter into a greased 10-inch tube pan.
Combine cinnamon, nuts and remaining sugar; sprinkle 1/2 over batter in pan.
Spoon in remaining batter and top with cinnamon/nuts mixture.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes until tested done.
Cool 15 minutes before removing from pan.
Makes 16 to 20 servings.

recipes.title: Pastel Cookies
steps: Mix together the shortening, margarine and sugar.
Add gelatin, eggs and vanilla.
Blend in dry ingredients.
Roll into small balls; place on cookie sheet.
Flatten with bottom of a glass that has been dipped in sugar.
Make sure glass has a bottom design on it that goes on cookie when pressed.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry Cobbler Pie
steps: Line an 8-inch square pan with cherry pie filling.
Mix margarine, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder, flour, salt and milk. Pour 1 cup sugar and 1/2 cup water over the batter.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple Dessert
steps: Beat eggs.
Add flour and sugar.
Mix well.
Add pineapple. Pour into greased casserole and cover with white bread (cubed). Pour melted butter or margarine over all.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.
Delicious!

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake
steps: Beat together with a fork and press into the bottom of greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Kentucky Pound Cake
steps: Beat egg whites stiff.
Combine all ingredients in large bowl (including egg whites and yolks).
Mix thoroughly.
Use round deep pan.
Start in cold oven; bake at 300° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Porcupine Balls
steps: Mix beef, rice, salt, pepper and onion together.
Form into 1-inch balls.
In large skillet, mix soup and water; bring to a boil.
Add meatballs gently.
Cover; simmer for 25 minutes, turning once.

recipes.title: Favorite Banana Nut Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, cream together milk, shortening and sugar.
Add eggs and beat well.

recipes.title: Cream Of Broccoli
ingredients: 1 envelope Lipton chicken noodle soup mix
steps: In medium saucepan, bring 3 cups milk and broccoli to the boiling point, then simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Stir in Lipton chicken noodle soup mix and flour blended with remaining milk.
Bring to the boiling point, then simmer 10 minutes or until soup is lightly thickened and broccoli is tender. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Pinwheels
steps: Blend together cream cheese, green onions, black olives, pimentos and jalapenos.
Spread on 10 flour tortillas.
Roll jelly roll.
Sash wrap and chill.
Slice.
Serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Italian Cheese Sticks
steps: Bring butter and cheese to room temperature.
Beat together the butter and cheese until well blended.
Combine flour, oregano, salt and cayenne; add to cheese mixture, gradually.
Add water; mix until well blended.
Form dough into a ball.
Roll out on floured surface to 1/4-inch thickness.
Cut into 3 x 3/4-inch strips or cut into shapes with small cookie cutters.
Bake on ungreased baking sheet in 400° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Serve warm or cold.
Makes about 40.

recipes.title: Low Cholesterol Pie Dough
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Roll between wax paper.
Makes enough for a double crust pie or two pie shells.

recipes.title: Sour Green Beans
steps: Fry bacon until crisp; drain and crumble.
Saute onion in bacon fat until transparent.
Drain beans, reserving liquid. Combine vinegar, sugar and bean liquid and pour over beans and onion in baking dish.
Microwave or heat in medium oven, covered.
Sprinkle bacon over beans prior to serving.

recipes.title: Stuffed Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. herb-flavored stuffing mix, divided use
steps: Combine 1 cup stuffing mix with the tomatoes, ground chuck, and egg, mixing well with your hands.
Prepare remaining stuffing mix as directed on package, following directions as if you were using all the bread.
Divide the meat mixture in half.
Drop chunks of half of the meat into 8 x 8-inch pan.
Top with the prepared stuffing and press down gently.
Layer the rest of the meat mixture on top.
Again in chunks.
Bake at 350°
for 45 minutes to 1 hour, depending upon the amount of meat used.
Makes 9 servings.

recipes.title: Roseanne'S Shipboard Stroganoff
steps: Heat the gravy.
Add the canned roast beef.
Just before serving, add the yogurt and mix.
Serve immediately over cooked egg noodles.

recipes.title: Triple Chocolate Cake
steps: Cook pudding as per directions.
Add to cake mix and mix well. Batter will be shiny.
Pour mixture into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle chocolate bits on top of cake.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
One-half cup of chopped nuts can also be sprinkled on top of bits before baking.
This is a most cake that keeps fresh for days.

recipes.title: Stir-Fry Fajitas
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, stir-fry beef or chicken
1 large green pepper or 2 Ortega peppers
steps: In a large skillet, fry meat in salad oil until tender.
Add garlic, onion and rest of ingredients.
Cook until desired tenderness.
Serve mixture on warm tortillas topped with salsa and sour cream to your taste.

recipes.title: Sausage-Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice.
Add chopped onion and pepper.
Cook sausage until done.
Add with remaining ingredients to rice mixture.
Place in casserole and bake until bubbly at 350°.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
steps: Mix together all ingredients; place in layer pans that have been greased and floured.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Steak
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
steps: In a large bowl, combine water, cracker crumbs and salt.
Add beef and mix well.
Press into a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan lined with waxed paper.
Cover and refrigerate overnight. Cut the meat into 12 squares. Coat each square lightly with flour. Brown in oil in skillet, a few pieces at a time. Drain. Remove waxed paper from the baking pan.
Spread the soup in bottom of pan. Place meat squares in a single layer over soup. Bake, uncovered, at 300° for 35 to 40 minutes.
To serve, spoon some soup over each meat square.
Yields 12 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Pineapple Salad
steps: Combine chicken, celery, pineapple, salt, lemon juice and mayonnaise.
Stir in salted almonds.
Chill in refrigerator. Serve on lettuce or endive.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight
ingredients: 1/2 pt. whipping cream or Cool Whip
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries or 1 1/2 c. sliced fresh strawberries
steps: Combine flour, brown sugar, pecans and margarine.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, stirring often.
Let cool.
Combine strawberries, sugar, lemon juice and egg whites; beat at high speed about 20 minutes or until fluffy.
Fold whipped cream into strawberry mixture.
Remove 1/3 of crumb mixture from pan.
Pat remaining crumbs into smooth layer.
Pour strawberry mixture over crumbs in pan and sprinkle reserved crumbs over top.
Freeze. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Cinnamon-Frosted Zucchini Bars
steps: Grease 13
x
x
2-inch
pan.
In a small bowl, beat butter for
seconds.	Add sugars; beat until fluffy.	Add eggs and vanilla; beat well.
Stir in flour.
Stir in zucchini, coconut and
nuts.	Spread	in
pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.	Cool completely in pan.	Drizzle with frosting; cut into bars.

recipes.title: Bacon Wrapped Chestnuts
steps: Cut bacon in half
and wrap each chestnut.
Secure with a toothpick.
Bake 1 hour at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place chestnuts in an ovensafe dish
(but
the one you want to serve them in).
Mix ketchup, sugar
and
soy
sauce
and
pour over chestnuts.
Make sure they're all coated.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.
Great crowd pleaser!

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip And Raisin Cookies
steps: Combine flour and baking powder in medium bowl and set aside. Blend sugars in a large bowl, using an electric mixer set at medium speed.

recipes.title: Impossible Coconut Pie
ingredients: 3 1/2 oz. coconut (1 can or 1 pkg. frozen)
steps: Beat eggs; add sugar and milk, then flour.
Mix all remaining ingredients.
Pour into 9-inch pie pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
This makes filling and crust.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Buttercream Frosting
steps: In small saucepan, stir flour and milk smooth.
Cook over low heat until thickened, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; let cool.
In bowl, cream butter, Crisco, sugar and vanilla.
Add milk/flour mixture to butter mixture and beat with electric mixer until smooth.

recipes.title: Salted Nut Roll
steps: Butter a 9 x 13-inch pan and sprinkle 1/2 of the jar of peanuts
on
bottom.
Melt	margarine and peanut butter chips. Add Eagle
Brand milk and stir, then add marshmallows and stir until coated.
Pour marshmallow mixture over peanuts and press down. Sprinkle
rest of nuts on top and press down.
Cool and cut into small pieces.

recipes.title: Almond Puffs
ingredients: 2 lb. Skippy super chunk peanut butter
steps: Mix margarine and peanut butter.
Add vanilla.
Gradually add sugar, working in as much sugar as possible.
Dough will be stiff. Make nickel size balls.
Line up on wax paper placed on cookie sheet and place on level surface in freezer for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ham Loaf
steps: Combine
ham, pork, ground beef, cracker crumbs, pepper, eggs and milk.
Shape into 2 loaves and place in greased baking dish. Combine
brown
sugar,
mustard
and
vinegar; pour over loaves. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Grami Hurd'S Larded Grouse
steps: Grouse are rather dry birds and need to be larded to be palatable.
Clean and wash quickly under running water.
Cover bird entirely with thin slices of bacon, tying them in place with a crossing of soft string or toothpicks.
Place the birds in a roasting pan and baste them with enough boiling water to use again and again.
Roast in an oven (350°) for 45 minutes, basting frequently.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chex Mix
steps: Combine all cereals, nuts and pretzels.
Melt chocolate in microwave.
Pour over mixture.
Mix well.
Dry on wax paper. Break into pieces and enjoy.

recipes.title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom or chicken soup
steps: Roll up chicken cutlets with 1 slice ham and 1 piece Swiss cheese.
Put in toothpicks to hold together.
Flour and brown cutlets (optional).
Put cutlets in casserole with 1 can cream of mushroom or chicken soup, diluted with about 1/2 can any white wine.
Cook in oven for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
