steps: Mix ground beef, rice, onion, salt and pepper well.
Form into good size balls and wrap in cabbage leaves.
Fasten with toothpicks.
Place in large pot; cover with canned tomato soup. Simmer for 45 minutes to an hour.
Shredded cabbage may be placed between layers of rolls to give more flavor to the sauce.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Divan
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli or peas
2 (10 1/2 oz.) cans condensed cream of chicken soup
2 oz. medium or sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded (1/2 c.)
2 c. sliced cooked chicken or 3 chicken breasts, cooked and boned
steps: Cook broccoli or peas according to package directions in salted water until tender.
Drain.
Arrange peas or broccoli in greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish.
Layer chicken on top. Combine next 3 ingredients and pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine crumbs and butter.
Sprinkle over all.
Bake at 350° about 35 minutes or until heated.
Trim with pimento strips, if desired.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Jumbo Raisin Cookies
steps: Add water to raisins and boil 5 minutes; cool.
Cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs and beat well.
Add vanilla and cooled raisins.
Sift together the flour, baking powder, soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add to raisin mixture and blend well. Add chopped nuts.
Chill.
Drop by teaspoon on greased baking sheet.
Bake in a 400° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Bear Claws
ingredients: 3 c. Captain Crunch peanut butter cereal
steps: Melt candy wafers and Crisco together.
Mix all other ingredients in a large bowl.
Pour melted candy over cereal and cool well.
Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper.
When firm, store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
steps: Add sugar gradually to shortening.
Beat in lemon flavoring, vanilla, eggs and bananas.
Sift flour, soda and salt.
Beat in dry ingredients.
Bake at 350° in two 9-inch round pans or 9 x 12-inch pan.
Test at 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
steps: Cream margarine, cream cheese and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time.
Add vanilla.
Slowly add cake flour.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan or Bundt pan.
Do not preheat oven.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Chewy Turtle Cake
steps: Pour boiling water over chocolate and stir until melted. Cool. Beat sugar and margarine until fluffy.
Beat in egg yolks. Beat in chocolate mixture and vanilla on low speed.

recipes.title: Irresistible Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Combine the first 5 ingredients in large bowl.
Beat at medium speed until blended.
Add egg and beat until blended.
Combine flour, salt and baking soda.
Add to creamed mixture at low speed.
Drop by heaping teaspoonful 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or until brown.
Cool 2 minutes before removing from sheet.

recipes.title: Cheaters Jam Cake
steps: Mix cake by directions on the box and add flour.
Fold in jam, raisins and nuts.
Do not beat or mix with mixer.
Flour and grease three 9-inch cake pans.
Spoon batter equally into pans. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes, depending on your oven.

recipes.title: Chicken And Homemade Noodles
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. cream or half and half
steps: Place chicken (without skin) in large kettle of water, along with celery and celery salt.
Cook for approximately 1 hour. Remove chicken and strip meat from bone.
Return meat to water and add noodles.
Cook for half an hour.

recipes.title: Beefy Rice
steps: Saute onion and mushrooms in butter.
Mix rice, soup, salt and pepper.
Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until rice is tender.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Artichoke Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. salt and pepper to taste
1 (20 oz.) can artichoke hearts, well drained
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Butter an oblong baking dish.
Melt 4 1/2 teaspoons of the butter; blend in flour.
Add milk and cream; cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add salt and pepper to taste; set aside.
In remaining 2 teaspoons of butter, saute mushrooms gently for about 5 minutes.
Arrange artichokes in a single layer on the bottom of prepared baking dish.
Scatter shrimp over artichokes.
Cover shrimp with a layer of mushrooms.
Stir sherry and Worcestershire sauce into cream sauce; pour over contents of baking dish.
Sprinkle with cheese and paprika.
Bake for 20 to 30 minutes, or until bubbly (or refrigerate several hours and bake for 45 minutes).
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chocolate Souffl
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients in a sauce pan.
Gradually add milk, stirring constantly, and heat to boiling.
Remove from heat. Gradually add the beaten egg yolks to this mixture, and then stir in the melted butter.
Set aside.
Beat the next three ingredients with an electric mixer until foamy.
Gradually beat in sugar until meringue forms stiff and glossy peaks.
Gently combine the two mixtures and carefully pour into a well greased 6 cup souffl dish. Bake on lowest oven rack at 350 degrees for 1 hour.
Serve immediately with fat free cool whip.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
steps: Mix 1 cup cornmeal, 1 heaping tablespoonful of flour, a little baking powder, salt to taste and a little grease.
Add enough hot water to make soft mix.
Have griddle hot and pour batter onto hot griddle.
Turn over with spatula when brown on bottom.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
ingredients: 3 cans (7.5 oz.) Pillsbury refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease 12-cup fluted tube pan.
Mix sugar and cinnamon in plastic food storage bag.
Separate dough into 30 biscuits.
Cut into quarters.
Shake in bag to coat. Arrange in pan.
Mix brown sugar and margarine.
Pour over biscuit pieces.
Bake 28 to 32 minutes or until golden brown and no longer doughy in center.
Cool in pan 10 minutes.
Turn upside down onto serving plate.
Pull apart to serve.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Roast Lamb
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: marjoram, thyme and rosemary
steps: Crush garlic with salt and pepper.
Mix with oil; spread on lamb.
Sprinkle with marjoram, thyme, rosemary and flour.
Pour wine and 1 cup water into pan.
Roast in a 325° oven for 2 1/2 hours, basting frequently.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Yeast Bread
steps: Add oats, molasses, salt and oil to boiling water.
Let cool. Dissolve yeast cakes
in
water.
Add to first mixture. Mix in flour, sifted.
Let
rise
in greased bowl until double in size. Shape into loaves or
rolls.
Let
rise 1 hour.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Makes 2 loaves or 2 dozen rolls.

recipes.title: Cheese Sauce
steps: Melt margarine in a pan.
Mix in flour and salt. Add milk slowly, stirring until smooth. Cook and stir until sauce thickens. Add mustard and cheese. Stir over low heat until cheese melts. Makes 2 2/3 cups sauce.

recipes.title: Beef Roast Cooked In Crock-Pot
steps: Put roast in crock-pot.
On top of roast, put can of soup and the envelope soup mix.
Cook on low.
You will have gravy to serve on rice or noodles.
You can cook on low overnight.

recipes.title: Chocolate Square Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Add sugars, shortening, egg and vanilla.
Beat until smooth (about 2 minutes).
Stir in oats and nuts.
Shape dough into a roll; wrap and chill thoroughly.
Slice and put on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove from oven and immediately place small square of milk chocolate bar on each.
Remove from sheets and press pecan or walnut half into chocolate square.

recipes.title: Frosted Molasses Creams
steps: Thoroughly cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs and molasses. Mix well.
Add coffee, then sifted dry ingredients.
Beat until smooth.
Pour into greased pan (12 x 18-inch).
Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 25 minutes or until done.
While still warm, frost with confectioners sugar and butter or confectioners sugar with a little spoon of milk.
Cool and cut in squares.

recipes.title: Summertime Salad
steps: Break cauliflower and broccoli in small pieces; dice onion. Crumble bacon.
Mix together rest of ingredients, then add all together and stir well.
Put in refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Autumn Medley Stew
steps: In a large soup kettle, simmer chicken breasts in the broth. Add the onion as the chicken simmers.
When chicken is fully cooked, remove and set aside.

recipes.title: Dumplings
steps: Mix well.
Drop by small spoonfuls into hot soup.
Cook 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Filled Sugar Cookies
steps: Prepare the filling using raisins, sugar, water and flour. Cook until thick.
Set aside to cool.

recipes.title: Batter
steps: Beat ingredients until smooth.
Cover onion, mushrooms, fish, etc., with batter and deep-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Russian Borscht
ingredients: McKay's chicken seasoning or G. Washington broth or beef flavored seasoning
tomatoes (canned or stewed or tomato juice)
steps: Make vegetable soup with first five ingredients, including beets (if using raw ones).
Add canned beets (if using canned) when soup is almost done.
Add tomatoes and generous amount of dill weed (to your own taste of course).
Serve with dollop of sour cream or cottage cheese.

recipes.title: English Scones
steps: Rub the butter and flour until they resemble fine bread crumbs. Stir in the baking powder, sugar and sultanas.
Add the milk to make a sticky dough and turn onto a floured surface.
Knead gently, then roll flat (about 1-inch thick) and cut out circles.
Place on floured baking tray.
Brush with milk.
Bake at 220°C for 10 to 20 minutes.
Spread with butter and jam to taste.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed (not drained)
steps: Combine flour, sugar, cinnamon, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
Add oil and eggs; mix well.
Stir in strawberries, pineapple, raisins and pecans.
Pour batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
Remove from pans; cool.
Wrap loaves in foil tightly overnight to mellow.

recipes.title: Hot Sandwich Supreme
ingredients: 1 can (10 1/2 oz.) cream of mushroom soup
steps: In small saucepan blend soup, flour and onions and 3/4 cup Milnot.
Cook over low heat until mixture comes to a boil (stir constantly to prevent scorching).
Remove from heat, stir in chicken and pimento.
Spread in 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch pan. Chill until thick.
Cut in 4 squares and place on each of 4 slices of bread, top with other bread.
Cut in halves or quarters.
Beat eggs and remaining Milnot together.
Dip sandwiches in egg mixture, then in potato chips.
Sprinkle with almonds.
Place on greased cookie sheet, bake at 350° about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Pie
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, boiled and chopped into bite size pieces
1 (10 oz.) can cream of celery or mushroom soup
steps: Place chicken in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Cook diced potatoes and carrots until tender.
Drain and add along with peas, covering the chicken pieces.
Pour soup over all.
Mix melted oleo, flour and milk together.
Pour over soup and spread evenly.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. garlic or use garlic powder
1/2 c. chopped scallions or green onions
2 lemons (juice and grated rind of one; can use concentrated lemon juice)
steps: Melt margarine and add garlic, salt, pepper, parsley, scallions and lemons.
Grease a large shallow pan and place shrimp in single layer on bottom of pan.
Pour butter mixture over shrimp.
Place under broiler for 5 minutes, until pink.
Remove. Serve on bed of rice.
Can pour butter sauce over rice.

recipes.title: Pastor'S Delight
steps: Liberally spread cheese on Spam; frost like cake.
Decorate with whole cloves.
Give to pastor with our delight.

recipes.title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
steps: Peel potatoes.
Cut into large pieces.
Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in a bag.
Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few at a time in bag, coating pieces with cheese mixture.
Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Place potatoes in a layer in pan.
Bake at 375° for about 1 hour, turning once during baking. When golden brown, sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Toll House Kookie Brittle
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. (1 c.) semi-sweet chocolate morsels
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine butter, vanilla and salt in bowl and blend well.
Gradually beat in sugar.
Add flour, chocolate morsels and 3/4 cup walnuts.
Mix well.
Press evenly into an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.
Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup walnuts
over top and press in lightly.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes until golden brown.
Cool.
Break into irregular pieces. Can cut into bars when warm, if desired.
Makes about 1 3/4 pounds.

recipes.title: Vidalia Onion Classic Casserole
steps: Saut sweet onions in butter until transparent. Add chicken broth, sherry and flour. Cook and stir. When slightly thickened, transfer to medium casserole. Top with bread crumbs and both cheeses.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly.

recipes.title: Cranberry Crunch
steps: Grease 10-inch quiche or pie plate.
Spread cranberries over bottom of dish.
Sprinkle with 1 cup sugar and pecans.
In small bowl at high speed, beat eggs until frothy.
Add 1 cup sugar; beat well at low speed.
Add flour, shortening and margarine.
Pour batter over berries and nuts.
Bake 1 hour or until golden at 325°.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Bars
ingredients: 1 lg. can fruit cocktail, with juice
steps: Mix together fruit cocktail, vanilla, eggs and sugar.
Add flour, soda, salt and brown sugar.
Mix and pour into greased and floured cookie sheet.
Bake 30 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: East India Chicken(Serves 6)
steps: Combine flour, curry powder, salt and pepper in paper bag. Add chicken pieces and shake until lightly coated.
Brown chicken in butter.
Sprinkle onion, raisins and rice over chicken. Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water and add to chicken. Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, 1 at a time, until you have all eggs beaten with sugar and butter. Add sour cream, 1/3 at a time, then 1 cup flour. Continue with the sour cream and flour. Add vanilla and lemon. Beat until smooth. Grease tube cake pan. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Salad
steps: Put eggs in pan.
Drain pineapple and add to eggs. Beat together. Add sugar and flour to juice and cook until thick. Pour over pineapple, marshmallows and cheese in a bowl. Stir and chill.

recipes.title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Boil sugar, milk and butter at a hard boil for one minute.
Put into a bowl and add cocoa, peanut butter and vanilla.
Last, add your oats and mix well.
Spoon onto foil or wax paper until firm.

recipes.title: Pickled Onions
steps: Drop onions in boiling water.
Boil 3 minutes.
Drain.
Place in cold water.
Cut root end; squeeze stem end to remove onion skin.
Combine 2 cups water and pickling salt; pour over onions. Let stand 12 hours.
Drain; rinse thoroughly.
Combine vinegar, sugar and pickling spices; bring to boiling.
Pack onions into hot jars, leaving 1/2-inch headspace.
Cover with pickling liquid, leaving 1/2-inch headspace.
Adjust lids and process in boiling water bath (half-pints) for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Golden Puffs
steps: Mix all ingredients together and drop by teaspoon into hot oil.
Fry until golden brown on each side.
Drain and shake in brown bag containing cinnamon and sugar or powdered sugar.
Makes a great after school snack.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Mix sugar, oleo, eggs, vanilla and cocoa until smooth.
Add flour and salt.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanuts Candy
steps: Melt chocolate chips on stove at low heat until completely melted.
Add peanuts and Chinese noodles.
Mix well.
Drop by tablespoon into cupcake wrappers.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Let chill in refrigerator until you're ready to serve.

recipes.title: Creole Muffins
steps: Sift flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and corn meal together. Combine eggs and milk and add to dry ingredients, stirring only enough to moisten.
Add oil, butter, peppers, onion, pimiento and cheese.
Combine, stirring only enough to moisten.
Do not overstir.
Place in greased muffin tins. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes 3 1/2 to 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Dr. Bird Cake
steps: Measure and mix dry ingredients in large mixing bowl.
Add eggs, oil, pineapple with juice and bananas.
Stir to blend; do not beat.
Pour into 9-inch tube pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Scotch Raisin Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. uncooked oatmeal (regular or quick type)
steps: Beat eggs until light.
Add sugar gradually while beating; stir in milk and molasses.
Beat well.
Sift dry ingredients (except oatmeal and nuts) together.

recipes.title: Mint Surprise Cookies
ingredients: 5 oz. pkg. Andes mint wafers, cut in half
steps: Sift flour, soda and salt; set aside.
Cream butter and shortening.
Add sugars gradually; mix well.
Add eggs, water and vanilla; beat well.
Blend in dry ingredients; mix well.
Dough may be chilled.

recipes.title: Cheese Wedges
steps: In a bowl, mix flour, corn meal and chili powder.
Add butter, milk and egg.
Stir until just moistened.
Press mixture into nine-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° until mixture is lightly browned and begins to pull away from sides of pan (about 25 minutes).
Mix cheese, chilies and green onions; spread over hot mixture.
Return to oven and bake until cheese melts (about 15 to 20 minutes).
Serve either hot or cold.
Makes 12 pieces.

recipes.title: Baked Round Steak
ingredients: 2 or 4 cans cream of chicken soup
1 to 2 pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
steps: Preheat oven to 350°; place round steak in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Spread cream of chicken soup over steak.
Shake Lipton onion soup mix over other soup.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Logs
steps: Cream margarine and peanut butter in mixing bowl until light. Add confectioners sugar gradually, beating until fluffy.
Stir in cereal.
Shape by level tablespoonfuls into logs.
Roll in peanuts.
Place on waxed paper.
Melt chocolate chips and paraffin wax in double boiler over hot water, stirring.
Drizzle over logs.
Chill until serving.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. crushed potato chips (use regular potato chips)
steps: Mix butter or margarine with sugar; add flour, crushed potato chips, vanilla and chopped (finely) pecans.
Drop by teaspoon on oiled cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until light brown.
Sprinkle with confectioners sugar while warm.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. chopped broccoli (8 to 10 oz. each)
steps: Melt butter in skillet.
Saute onion and broccoli until tender (about 20 minutes).
Combine rest of ingredients.
Combine all ingredients.
Pour into lightly greased loaf-baking dish.
Bake about one hour at 350°.
Serves about 20.

recipes.title: Mousse
steps: Stir well, but do not use electric mixer.
For variety, add desired amount of one or more of the following ingredients: apples, nuts, raisins, dates, chocolate chips, cocoa or drained fruit cocktail, or up to 4 bananas (overripe).
Bake in a floured and greased Bundt pan at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
Cool on a rack for about an hour.
Turn over onto serving plate.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Crunch
steps: In a bowl, mix together 1 cup sugar, 2 tablespoons flour and diced rhubarb.
Pour into an 8 or 9-inch baking dish and dot with butter.

recipes.title: Raisin Molasses Gems
steps: Beat shortening and 1 cup sugar until light and fluffy.
Add molasses and egg; beat well.
Combine flour, soda, cinnamon, cloves, ginger and salt.
Add to molasses mixture; mix well.
Stir in raisins.
Cover.
Refrigerate until chilled.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Roll each in sugar.
Place 2 inches apart on oiled cookie sheet.
Bake in upper third of preheated 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Emergency Lasagna
steps: Brown ground chuck in a skillet; drain. Add spaghetti sauce and oregano; heat until warm. Put 8 ounces of sauce on bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2 or equal size pan. Layer uncooked lasagna, sauce, cottage cheese, Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese. Repeat layers until ingredients run out; end with cheeses. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 15 minutes before serving. Good with garlic bread and tossed salad.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Tea Bread
ingredients: 1/2 c. (1 stick) unsalted butter (at room temperature) plus additional for the pan
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Position rack in center of oven. Generously butter a 9 x 5-inch metal loaf pan and set aside. Sift flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg into a medium bowl or onto a large sheet of waxed paper spread on work surface. Set aside.

recipes.title: Banana Quick Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat shortening until creamy and glossy.
Gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy after each addition.
Add eggs and beat until thick and pale lemon color.
Sift dry ingredients; add alternately with bananas.
Blend thoroughly after each addition.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Sprinkle apples with cinnamon, salt and water.
Rub together flour, sugar and butter.
Drop mixture over apples.
Bake in buttered 10 x 6 x 2-inch dish.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Crunchy Snack Mix
steps: Combine pretzels, cereals and nuts in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cook and stir brown sugar, oleo and corn syrup in a medium saucepan over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil.
Let the mixture boil without stirring for 4 minutes.
Remove heat.

recipes.title: Chicken With Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, boned and skinned
steps: Combine flour, salt, paprika and pepper.
Roll chicken in flour mixture to coat very lightly, shaking off excess.
Spoon 2 tablespoons oil from top of artichokes into skillet and heat. Place chicken in pan and saute, browning slowly over moderate heat. Turn to brown on all sides.
Add onion when chicken is almost browned.
Spoon off any excess fat.
Add wine, heat to boiling, then cover.
Simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Saute nuts in butter until lightly browned.
Set aside.
Add artichokes to chicken.
Mix cornstarch with remaining marinade, then gently stir liquid into skillet.
Simmer 1 minute, until slightly thickened.
Remove chicken and artichokes to serving dish. Spoon liquid over chicken and sprinkle with toasted nuts.

recipes.title: Japanese Cookies
steps: Cream the sugar with the butter.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Shape into two rolls; chill until firm.
Cut 1/4-inch thick and bake 30 minutes at 300°.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar while warm.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, two at a time; beat well after each.
Add flour and sour cream alternately, beginning and ending with flour.
Add soda and extract last.
Bake in greased and floured large tube pan for 1 1/4 hours at 325°.

recipes.title: Shrimp Jambalaya
steps: Spray saucepan with nonstick cooking oil.
Place onion over medium heat.
Saute onion until clear.
Add all ingredients, except shrimp.
Stir well.
Add shrimp; cover and cook on very low heat for 35 minutes.
Uncover and toss rice.
Cover again and cook very slowly until rice is done.
Yields 2 servings.

recipes.title: Italian Meat Loaf
ingredients: canned tomato sauce or spaghetti sauce
steps: Combine bread and milk in a small bowl.
Beat egg in large bowl; add oregano, salt, pepper and garlic.
Add beef and cheese; mix well.
Bake at 350° for one hour.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Salad
steps: Cook 3 or 4 pieces of bacon until crisp.
Crumble cool bread and crumble; add remaining ingredients.
Toss lightly and moisten with Miracle Whip.
Cheese is good in this.
Mix all but bacon in with Miracle Whip, then pour over bread and bacon.
Toss.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Chicken Saute
steps: Pound chicken to 1/2-inch thickness.
Place flour in plastic bag.
Beat eggs in shallow bowl or pie plate.
Combine cornmeal, cumin, salt and cayenne pepper in another pie plate.
Place chicken, 2 pieces at a time, in bag with flour and shake to coat. Remove chicken and dip in egg.
Roll in cornmeal mixture, pressing to coat.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until brown and cooked through.
Place on platter; top with sour cream and picante sauce.

recipes.title: Club Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. (10 oz.) ready to serve salad
1 pkg. (6 oz.) fully cooked chicken breast strips, cubed
steps: In a large bowl, combine the salad, chicken, tomatoes, and bacon. Drizzle with dressing and toss to coat. Serve immediately. Yield: 6 servings, ready in 15 minutes or less.

recipes.title: Chew Bread
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan.
Pour in light brown sugar.
Mix together.
Add eggs, flour and flavoring.
Add as many pecans as you like.
Pour in a 9 x 13 pan and bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.
When middle of bread falls, take out of oven.
If you don't take out of oven when it falls, it won't be as moist.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
steps: Mix flour, 1 cup sugar and milk.
Melt butter in a 2-quart baking dish.
Pour batter over butter.
Toss 2 cups of peaches with 1 cup sugar and pour over batter.
Do not stir.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Southern Gizzards
steps: Heat oil in iron skillet on medium-high heat.
Dip gizzards in whipped eggs and roll in flour or pancake mix.
Put as many as you can get in the skillet.
Turn every 5 minutes for about 20 minutes or dark brown.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients together and put into greased casserole. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Cream Sticks
steps: Put yeast in warm water; scald milk, then add your oleo in hot milk to melt.
Put together when cool, then add yeast, well beaten eggs, vanilla and sugar.
Add flour.
Put in warm place until double in bulk.
Roll out and cut in pieces, about 1/2 x 3 1/2-inches long.
Let rise again.
Fry in deep vegetable oil. Cut top of stick open and fill with filling.
Ice with brown sugar frosting.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple chunks, drain and reserve juice
steps: Place pineapple in a Pyrex baking dish.
Mix flour, sugar, pineapple juice (the 3 tablespoons) and margarine or butter.
Pour over pineapple chunks.
Top with cheese, then cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Walnut Pie
steps: Melt together chocolate chips, evaporated milk and butter or margarine.
Remove from heat and add flour, salt, sugar, eggs (mixed well) and walnuts.

recipes.title: Yeast Biscuits
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water with 1 tablespoon sugar.
Add shortening, salt, 1 tablespoon sugar and flour.
Mix well.
Pour out on floured board and knead a few times, then cut out and place in a pan.
Grease top and let rise in a warm place until double in size, about 1/2 to 1 hour.
Bake at 400° until brown.
Makes about 1 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Butterscotch-Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugars.
Add beaten eggs and hot water; mix well.
Add flour and soda.
Add vanilla and oats; mix well. Add chips and nuts.
Drop by teaspoon onto baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Mix sugar, oil and eggs; add rest of ingredients and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Martha Odom'S Cookies
steps: Cream sugar, margarine and Crisco.
Add egg and beat well.
Add vanilla with sifted flour to which soda and salt have been added. Pinch off pieces the size of walnuts and place one inch apart on cookie sheet; flatten with hand or glass which has been floured.

recipes.title: Stuffed Green Peppers
steps: Wash peppers, cut a thin slice from stem end and remove seeds. Cover with boiling salted water and simmer 5 minutes.
Drain.

recipes.title: Calico Beans
steps: Fry hamburger, bacon and onion.
Drain off fat.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Javanese Pork Sate
steps: Cut tenderloin(s) in half.
Blend remaining ingredients together.
Marinate pork in mixture for 10 minutes.
Grill or broil for 10 to 12 minutes, turning when needed.
Serve with hot cooked rice, if desired.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Oreo Spider Cookies
steps: Scrape filling out of Oreo cookies.
Cut red licorice into thin strips (to look like spider legs).
Put frosting on an Oreo piece; drape red licorice over frosting so that the licorice hangs out both sides.
(Use however many red strips you want for however many legs you want.)
Put an Oreo piece on top to form cookie. Put little dots of frosting on top for eyes.
Enjoy this fun treat!

recipes.title: Hungarian Goulash
ingredients: paprika (2 tsp. or more for color)
steps: Cut beef cubes in pieces about one-inch square or smaller. Cut up onions medium fine.
Fry onions in oil until brown.
Add paprika and stir.
Add water, about 4 cups.
Simmer until beef is nearly tender.
Add potatoes (cubed pieces).
Cook until potatoes are done.
Eat as is or pour over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Bacon And Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 (5 oz.) can cooked white meat chicken, drained
3 slices Armour lower salt bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled
steps: Combine chicken, celery, onion, yogurt and pepper in small bowl.
If desired, place lettuce leaf on bottom of each bun; place pineapple ring on lettuce.
Top each with one third of the chicken mixture and bacon.
Makes 3 servings.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Cake
steps: Combine.
Stir with a spoon, putting into 3 greased and floured pans.
Cook at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Sift flour and salt.
Melt butter with cocoa.
Put sugar, eggs and vanilla into a large bowl; beat for 2 minutes.
Add butter and cocoa mixture; then add flour mixture.
Mix well.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix together flour, sugar, and cocoa.
Add egg yolks and milk.
Cook over medium heat until thick.
Remove from heat and add margarine and vanilla.
Pour into baked pie crust.
Top with meringue and brown.

recipes.title: Foolproof Pie Crust
ingredients: 1 3/4 c. solid vegetable shortening (not lard, oil or oleo)
steps: Put first 3 ingredients in a large bowl and mix well with a fork.
Add shortening and mix with a fork until ingredients are crumbly.
In a small bowl, beat together with a fork the water, vinegar and egg.
Combine the two mixtures, stirring with a fork until the ingredients are moistened.
Divide the dough into 5 parts and with hands shape each portion into a flat, round patty ready for rolling.
Wrap each in plastic or waxed paper and chill at least 1/2 hour.
Dough may be left in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or frozen, until ready to use.

recipes.title: Holiday Ham Balls
ingredients: 3 c. Bisquick original or reduced fat baking mix
1 1/2 c. finely chopped, fully cooked smoked ham
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan.
Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Shape mixture into 1-inch balls.
Place about 2 inches apart in pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.
Immediately remove from pan.
Serve warm.
Yields about 7 dozen appetizers.

recipes.title: Cheese Rounds
steps: Combine flour, salt, pepper and paprika; stir well.
Cut in butter until mixture looks like coarse meal.
Add cheese; stir well.
Roll dough to 1/3-inch thick on floured surface.
Cut with a 1 3/4-inch biscuit cutter.
Place on greased baking sheet.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.
Yields about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients.
Stir in milk.
Add egg yolks and butter.
Cook until thick.
Pour into baked pie crust (add vanilla before you put in crust).
Top with egg whites, beaten until stiff.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Brownies
steps: Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch square pan. Blend together butter, sugar and vanilla.
Ad eggs. Beat well with spoon.
Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt. Gradually add to egg mixture, beating until well blended. Stir in chips.
Spread into pan. Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.
Cool and cut into squares. Makes 16 brownies.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Mix all together.
Spread it evenly over bottom of 8 x 8-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Devil'S Food Cake
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. sifted Swans Down cake flour
3 sq. Baker's unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
steps: Sift flour with sugar,
soda and salt.
Stir shortening to soften.
Add flour mixture, 1
cup
milk
and vanilla.
Mix until flour is dampened.
Beat 2
minutes
at
medium speed of electric mixer.
Add eggs,
melted chocolate and remaining 1/3 cup milk. Beat 1 minute longer.
Pour
into
two
greased and floured 9-inch layer pans.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Japanese Fruit Cake
steps: Sift flour 3 times before measuring. Add baking powder and salt and sift again. Cream butter and sugar thoroughly. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add 1/3 flour and blend well. Add 1/2 milk and blend well. Add another 1/3 flour and blend, then the other 1/2 milk and finally, the last 1/3 flour and blend well. Pour 2/3 batter into 2 pans which have been lined with wax paper. To remaining 1/3 batter, add 3/4 teaspoon each cinnamon and allspice, 1/4 tsp. cloves and 1/4 pound of raisins, chopped fine. Pour into cake pan which has been lined with wax paper. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Combine flour, salt, baking powder and sugar.
Add eggs, milk and oil.
Add cinnamon and blueberries.
Pour into greased muffin pans.
Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Mix well.
Bake in 350° oven until done.

recipes.title: Pam'S Stuffed Peppers(Serves 3)
steps: Cut stem ends from peppers; remove seeds and cut peppers in half.
Cook peppers in a small amount of water; cover.
Cook in microwave oven on High power for 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove from microwave and water.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Mix well. Stuff peppers with mixture.
Place in baking dish.
Pour tomato sauce over mixture in peppers.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Miracle Cake
steps: Mix flour, soda, cocoa and sugar.
Add Miracle Whip, warm water and vanilla.
Beat until smooth.
Pour batter into greased and lightly floured 8-inch layer or 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until done.
Frost with icing when cool.
Also makes 18 cupcakes.
Buttercream frosting is very good on this cake or use your favorite icing, also.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Mix oil, sugar, pumpkin, eggs and vanilla well. Mix all ingredients together. Spray 3 (1 pound) coffee cans and pour mix equally in each can. Bake for approximately 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Combine dry ingredients.
Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Stir in nuts.
Layer half the apples and dry mixture into an 8-inch square baking pan.
Repeat layers. Bake at 350° until apples are tender, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Carrot Cake
steps: Mix dry ingredients together.
Add oil and blend.
Add eggs and mix.
Add carrots, nuts and pineapple.
Mix well.
Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Mounds Bars
steps: Cream butter and brown sugar.
Add flour and press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Layer Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg Duncan Hines Moist Deluxe Pineapple Supreme cake mix
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour two 9 inch round cake pans.
Prepare, bake and cool cake mix according to directions on box.
Place one cake layer on serving plate.
Spread with 1/2 of pineapple preserves.
Spread about 4 oz. of Cool Whip on top. Place second cake layer on top.
Frost top and sides of cake with remaining Cool Whip.
Coat top of cake with remaining pineapple preserves.
Garnish sides with shredded coconut.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
steps: Cook shrimp according to directions but reserve 1 cup liquid. Fry bacon until crisp.
Saute onions, peppers, celery, garlic and parsley in skillet until tender.
(Do not add bacon at this time; drain and reserve until later.)
Add tomato sauce, tomato paste, reserved shrimp liquid, red pepper, black pepper, salt, sugar and bay leaf to ingredients that are sauteed.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered 30 minutes.
Add shrimp and bacon (crumbled).
Bring to a boil; simmer 5 minutes.
Serve over rice. Serves 4 to 5 adults.

recipes.title: Sweet Jammies(Muffins)
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Grease muffin tins.
Mix dry ingredients. Melt margarine.
Off heat, stir in milk and yogurt.
Beat in egg and vanilla. Add mixture to dry ingredients. Stir well.
Spoon half of the batter into 12 muffin tins. Place 1 teaspoon of jam over batter in each cup and top with remaining batter. Bake 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.
Let stand 5 minutes before removing from tins. Sprinkle confectioners sugar over top.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Mix well the eggs, salad oil and sugar.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Grease and flour 2 loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Mix in the order given and bake in 2 greased loaf pans for 50 to 60 minutes at 325°.
When done, bread freezes very well.

recipes.title: Kahlua Pecan Pie
steps: Cream butter, sugar, vanilla and flour.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Stir in kahlua, corn syrup, evaporated milk and pecans; mix well.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then bake at 325° for about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour loaf pan. Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.
Beat sugar, shortening and eggs for 3 minutes at medium speed on mixer.
Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with bananas, beginning and ending with flour mixture.
Blend well after each addition.
Stir in nuts. Put in pan.
Bake for 60 to 70 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can Mexicorn with red and green peppers
1 medium size pkg. mild cheese, grated
steps: Saute onion and garlic in small amount of oil.
Add hamburger; cook until browned well.
Add chili powder, Mexicorn, tomatoes and tomato sauce.
Cook in Dutch oven about 35 minutes with lid on. Cook shells until tender; drain.
Add layers of shells, sauce and grated cheese and repeat until all is used.
Good also with small can of mushrooms.
Cook in 350° oven until cheese has melted well.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
steps: Mix eggs, flour, sugar, soda and fruit cocktail in large bowl. Bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan for 30 minutes at 350°.
Leave in pan.

recipes.title: Favorite Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: In
bowl mix flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and sugar.
In another bowl, beat eggs about 1 minute on high speed until light and fluffy.
Pour eggs over flour mixture.
Pour in buttermilk.
Add
butter.
Fold
together
entire mixture until flour is just moistened.
Bake pancakes on greased, hot griddle using about 1/4 cup of mixture to make a 4 to 5-inch pancake.

recipes.title: Squash Patties
ingredients: 2 to 3 tsp. crushed sweet red pepper
steps: Combine the first 6 ingredients.
Beat with electric mixer until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients; stir well.
Drop mixture by tablespoons into a hot, greased skillet.
Cook until golden brown, turning once.
Drain on paper towels.
Yields about 2 dozen patties.

recipes.title: Ham, Cheese And Mushroom Calzones
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. minced fresh or 2 tsp. crumbled dried basil leaves
1 (1 lb.) loaf frozen white or whole wheat bread dough, thawed
1 large egg yolk, beaten with 1 Tbsp. water
steps: Combine mushrooms, onion, garlic and basil with half the broth in a 10 to 12-inch frying pan over medium-high heat.
Stir often until vegetables are browned and begin to stick in pan, about 8 minutes. Add remaining broth. Stir to scrape browned bits from pan; cook until liquid evaporates.
Stir in flour and ham.
Remove from heat.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add separately beaten eggs.
Add mashed bananas, flour, baking soda and salt to cream mixture. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken In Wine(Serves 6)
steps: Place chicken pieces in flat baking dish.
Combine flour and 1/4 cup sour cream.
Blend until smooth; add remaining sour cream, salt, soup and wine.
Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with almonds, pimientos and paprika.
Bake at 325° about 1 1/2 hours or until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Stuffed Baked Orange With Yams
steps: Cook yam until tender, peel and beat smooth.
Add margarine. Mix other dry ingredients together and set aside.
Squeeze the juice from oranges.
Cut oranges in half and set aside.
Add dry ingredients to yams.
Add milk and vanilla.
Mix well.
In each orange half stuff yam mix to top.
Bake at 350° until light brown on top of yams.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: In mixing bowl combine dry ingredients.
Add eggs, oil, carrots and vanilla.
Beat until combined.
Stir in pineapple, coconut and nuts.
Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes.
Cool and frost.

recipes.title: Cheese Puffs
steps: Cream margarine and cheese.
Add cayenne pepper and Worcestershire sauce.
Add flour.
Mix well.
Shape into 2 balls and wrap in waxed paper to let chill for one hour.
Shape dough into marble-size balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake in preheated 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies (Recipe 1)
ingredients: 1 c. melted shortening (chicken, turkey or ham fat may be used)
steps: Add oats, sugar, raisins, shortening, eggs and milk in order listed.
Mix together flour, soda, cloves and cinnamon.
Add first mixture to dry ingredients.
Spread very thin on cookie sheets. Bake in 325° oven about 15 minutes.
Cut in squares in cookie sheet while still warm.
Makes 48 squares.

recipes.title: Broccoli Quiche
ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen broccoli, prepared according to pkg. directions, then drained well
1 c. cooked bacon, ham or turkey (optional)
steps: Beat eggs well, then add broccoli.
Add milk, then fold in mayonnaise.
Add minced onion.
Fold in the cheeses; mix all ingredients well.
(If any of the optional ingredients are used, this recipe will make at least 2 quiches.)
Pour ingredients into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for approximately 40 minutes, or until set and beginning to brown on top.
Make sure that the pie shell does not burn.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake
steps: Make up cake mix using the water and egg whites called for on the box.
Melt chocolate and butter on low heat and add salt.
Add chocolate mixture to cake batter.
Gently fold in beaten egg whites.
Bake in two greased and floured 9-inch cake pans at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Drop Cookies
steps: Cream together sugars and Crisco.
Beat in eggs and pineapple. Add dry ingredients to pineapple mixture.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Sponge Pie
steps: Cream butter. Add sugar and egg yolks. Beat well. Add milk. Add flour, salt, lemon juice, grated rind and milk. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes or at 450° for 10 minutes and at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes more.

recipes.title: Grandma Hansen'S Icebox Cookies
steps: Combine ingredients as for cake.
Make as stiff as bread dough. Set in cool place.
Next morning, roll like a sausage, about size of half dollar.
Cut about 1/4 inch thick.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven Burgers
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in medium saucepan. Simmer 15 minutes.
Combine next 6 ingredients; mix well.
Shape into 10 patties about 3/4 inch thick.
Cook patties over medium heat in a large skillet until browned, turning once.
Arrange patties in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Pour ketchup mixture over patties.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Serve on buns.

recipes.title: Crab Casserole
steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Add flour; stir until smooth and blend in milk.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well; put in greased casserole and sprinkle with buttered crumbs.
Bake 30 minutes at 400°.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Old-Time German Potato Salad
steps: Cook potatoes; cool, peel and slice.
Fry bacon until golden brown.
Take bacon out of pan; add butter to bacon grease.
Stir in flour until smooth.
Mix vinegar and water together in a bowl, then slowly add to flour mixture.
Add sugar, stirring all the time.
Pour over potatoes with chopped onions and crumbled bacon. Stir gently until all mixed together.
Serve.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Cream butter thoroughly; add sugar and cream together until light and fluffy.
Add egg yolks, well beaten.
Beat for several minutes.
Add flour, a small amount at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add flavoring and beat for several minutes.
Fold in slightly beaten egg whites.
Bake in paper-lined pan in a slow oven from 275° to 300° for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Banana Bran Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Spray 12 muffin pan cups with nonstick cooking spray.
Mix first 3 ingredients.
In separate bowl, blend egg, milk, margarine and sugar substitute.
Stir in bran cereal. Let stand for 5 minutes.
Mix mashed banana with honey until well mixed.
Add to bran mixture.
Stir in flour mixture just until well blended; do not overmix.
Fill muffin cups 2/3 full.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.
Let stand for 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove to wire rack to cool.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines butter golden cake mix
steps: Put 1/2 cup sugar in cake mix.
Soften cream cheese with warm water.
Put Mazola oil and butter in this and then add in cake mix.
Put one egg at a time.
Beat.
Pour in greased and floured pan.
Put in 350° oven for about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Golden Corn Muffins
steps: Combine dry ingredients. Add eggs, butter and milk, stirring until moistened. Spoon into greased muffin tins. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Hearty Sausage And Rice
steps: Crumble sausage into 2-quart casserole.
Add onion and green pepper.
Cover.
Microwave at High 4 1/2 to 7 1/2 minutes or until sausage is set and vegetables are tender, stirring once.
Drain. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover.
Microwave at High 6 1/2 to 9 minutes or until heated through (140° to 150°), stirring once. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: 7 Layer Salad
steps: Layer the washed lettuce (drained well and torn), chopped celery to cover lettuce and chopped sweet onions to cover celery. Mix the sour cream and sugar.
Pour over onions.
Mix the mayonnaise and vinegar.
Pour over cream.
Grate sharp cheese over top.
Crumble the bacon over top.
Chill 3 hours, uncovered.

recipes.title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
steps: Combine all ingredients (except Kisses) in large mixer bowl; blend well at low speed.
Shape into balls, using a rounded teaspoonful for each.
Roll balls in additional granulated sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Top each cookie immediately with a candy Kiss, pressing down firmly so cookie cracks around the edge.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cookies
steps: Beat sugar, pumpkin, oil and vanilla.
Stir in dry ingredients.
Blend in raisins and nuts.
Drop onto oiled sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 7 dozen.

recipes.title: Diet Chicken
steps: Combine mushrooms, tomatoes, pepper, onion, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Place chicken on top.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 25 minutes.
Remove chicken.
Combine cornstarch and water and stir in tomato mixture.
Cook until thickened.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. flank or round steak, cut 1-inch thick
steps: Mix together dry mustard, flour and salt.
Pound mixture into the steak, covering both sides thoroughly.
Brown on both sides in roasting pan.
Cover meat with onions, carrots and tomatoes. Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce and brown sugar over all.
Cover and bake in a 325° oven for 2 hours.
Makes very tender steak.

recipes.title: Diet Cake
steps: Place all in bowl except flour and wheat germ.
Pour 1 c boiling water over all and stir well.
Add the flour and wheat germ and mix well.
Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Crispies
steps: Combine the brown sugar, white sugar and shortening. Add the well beaten eggs, dry ingredients, raisins and nuts.
Roll in balls.
Flatten with fork and bake for 12 minutes, until golden brown in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Brunswick Stew
steps: In kettle, cook vegetables until partly done.
Drain.
In a large kettle, melt butter. Stir in flour to make paste. Gradually add chicken broth, stirring constantly, as you add. Cook until thickened.
Stir in vegetables.
Blend in chicken, being careful not to overstir.
Heat on low heat for 2 hours or until hot.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
steps: Cook brown sugar, margarine, corn syrup and salt over medium heat, stirring occasionally until bubbly around edges.
Continue cooking 5 minutes; remove from heat.
Stir in baking soda until foamy.
Pour over popcorn.
Toss until well coated.
Do not use plastic pans, containers or utensils.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Sauce
steps: Cook 1 1/2 hours, then add 1 cup flour to water and add to other ingredients.
Cook another 1/2 hour.
Freeze or can.

recipes.title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
steps: Cook noodles in salted water for 8 minutes.
Heat Crisco.
Add ham and brown lightly.
Sprinkle flour over ham; stir until coated. Add milk slowly and cook thick.
Add salt, noodles and corn.
Mix and pour in a 2-quart casserole dish.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 (28 oz.) cans tomatoes or fresh tomatoes
steps: Cook beef and 1 onion with 4 quarts of water for 2 hours. After cooked, skim off fat on beef.
Then chop beef.
Add all ingredients and simmer for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cheep Cake
steps: Mix together the flour, sugar, soda, salt and cocoa. Add remaining ingredients and beat for 2 minutes. Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9 pan. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Cobbler
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Let butter melt in a 9 x 12-inch pan while oven is heating.
Mix dry ingredients and combine with milk to make a thin batter.
Put batter into pan, then add your favorite fruit.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Raspberry Truffle Brownies
ingredients: 1 tsp. instant coffee dissolved in 2 Tbsp. water (optional)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt chocolate chips with butter, cool slightly.
In a large mixing bowl at medium speed, beat brown sugar and eggs until blended.
Add chocolate mixture and dissolved coffee; beat well.
Stir in flour and baking powder.
Spread evenly in baking pan.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean; cool on a wire rack.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Souffle
steps: Mix sugar, flour and pineapple, then add other ingredients. Put in baking dish.

recipes.title: Betty'S Chocolate Pound Cake
steps: Cream oleo, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Sift flour, baking powder and cocoa together 3 times.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk and vanilla.
Mix well, scraping sides of bowl often.
Pour batter in large, oiled tube pan and bake at 300° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Magic Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 2 c. (16 to 17 oz. can) canned pumpkin
1 1/3 c. (15 oz. can) Eagle Brand milk
steps: In large mixing bowl, blend together all ingredients.
Turn mixture into pie shell.
Bake in 375° oven until sharp bladed knife inserted near center comes out clean, 50 to 55 minutes. Cool.
Refrigerate at least one hour.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Rolls
steps: Combine sugar, salt and oil.
Add hot water and beat. Sprinkle yeast over and set.
Mix in and add egg (use wire whip). Gradually add 3 cups flour (use wooden spoon).
Knead.
Pour 1 tablespoon oil in bowl and cover dough.
Set for 1 1/2 hours. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick 'N Easy Casserole(My Favorite)
ingredients: 1 (10 1/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
steps: Place vegetables in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 7 minutes to partially thaw.
Stir in rice, soup, chicken, milk, half the cheese and the onion.
Then sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Makes 5 cups or 3 servings.
Can be prepared in skillet.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Pudding
steps: Scald milk.
Combine flour, brown sugar and salt.
Add 2 cups of scalded milk to dry ingredients; mix well.
Return to pan of scalded milk.
Cook and stir until thick.
Remove from stove.
Add the beaten eggs, vanilla and chunk of butter.
Mix until smooth. When cool, stir in graham cracker crumbs and whipped topping.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
steps: Pour boiling water over oats, let stand 20 minutes.
Add margarine, brown and white sugars and mix well.
Add beaten eggs and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients to mixture.
Place in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cry Babies
ingredients: 2 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 c. coffee
steps: Combine ingredients in order given, adding flour last and very gradually. Drop on greased cookie sheets; bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Very old recipe, but very good.

recipes.title: No Bake Cherry Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: In a medium bowl beat cheese until light and fluffy.
Add the sweetened condensed milk and blend thoroughly.
Stir in lemon juice and vanilla.
Pour into crust.
Chill 3 hours or until set. Top with the amount of desired topping of pie filling before serving.
Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Meatball Chowder(Makes 6 To 7 Quarts)
steps: Mix first 7 ingredients together and form into meatballs the size of walnuts.
Bake in the oven.
Put into a large kettle all the other ingredients except the corn.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and cook on low-medium and simmer 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Stir on occasion.
Add corn and heat 5 to 10 more minutes.

recipes.title: Super Bowl Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Ranch Style beans with juice
1 can whole kernel corn with juice
steps: In Dutch oven, brown ground beef or sausage with onion.
Drain grease.
Pour in beans, corn, stewed tomatoes and one can Ro-Tel tomatoes.
Take 20 flour tortillas, broken up, put half in 14 x 10-inch pan.
Layer meat, cheeses, tortillas, meat and cheeses. Pour 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes over top.
Let sit for two hours, covered with foil.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Fried Green Plantains
steps: Peel plantains and cut diagonally to 1-inch thick pieces. Heat oil to about 350°, medium to high heat.
Fry them for about 7 to 8 minutes, turning them occasionally.
Remove them and squash them flat.
Fry them again for another 3 or 4 minutes until they brown.
Remove onto a plate with an absorbent paper towel.
Serve with a little salt on top (optional).
Serve with rice and chicken.

recipes.title: Granny Deturck'S Corn Fritters
steps: Combine first three ingredients.
In a separate bowl, beat eggs and milk.
Add oil.
Combine with dry ingredients and stir just until all ingredients are mixed.
Fold in corn.

recipes.title: Favorite Chocolate Brownies(Microwave)
ingredients: 1/2 c. chocolate flavored ice cream syrup
steps: Microwave (High) butter in uncovered 1-quart dish 15 to 20 seconds or until softened.
Blend in sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.
Blend in vanilla.
Add flour, ice cream syrup and salt; mix well.
Grease bottom only of 8-inch square dish.
Spread batter in dish.
Cover loosely with plastic wrap.

recipes.title: Granny'S Strawberry Pie
steps: Mix flour, sugar and salt.
Add egg yolks and butter. Gradually add milk.
Pour into unbaked pie crust.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until brown.
Add strawberries on top and top with meringue and brown about 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Sourdough Biscuits
steps: Add all ingredients together.
Roll small balls together and pat.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 425° for 20 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
steps: Cream the shortening, eggs, brown sugar, white sugar and vanilla.
Sift the flour, salt, soda and baking powder and add to the creamed mixture.
Stir until all is well mixed.
Add oats, nuts and chips.
Drop on cookie sheet and bake at 350°.
Makes about 12 dozen.
Keeps well.
Everyone loves them.

recipes.title: Apple Cider Stew
ingredients: 3 large potatoes, peeled and cut in chunks
4 carrots, peeled and cut in chunks
1 small (7 oz.) can whole kernel corn (optional)
steps: Brown onions in hot oil; push aside and brown meat.
Combine flour, salt, pepper and thyme; add to pan and stir.
Stir in cider and ketchup.
(Add water to thin if necessary.)
Cover and cook slowly until meat is almost tender, about 2 hours.
Add potatoes, carrots and corn; simmer 30 minutes or until vegetables are done.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Japanese Fruit Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar together and add eggs one at a time. Then add flour, baking powder and milk; stir until all is wet. Fold in nuts.
Pour half the batter into two pans.
The other half, add cocoa, allspice and raisins and pour into remaining pans.
Bake.

recipes.title: Garlic Broiled Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 lb. chicken (whole frying, cut in half or separate pieces)
steps: In small bowl stir together butter, pepper, garlic and soy sauce.
Heat broiler.
Place chicken on greased broiler pan.
Broil chicken 6 to 8 inches from heat, turning every 10 minutes and brushing with butter mixture during last 10 minutes, for 30 to 35 minutes or until fork-tender.
Just before serving, brush with butter mixture and sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with cooked rice.

recipes.title: Martha'S Chinese Cookies
steps: Mash some dough together with your hands.
Then you smash it. Cook it in a pan on the stove 5 minutes.
Then you smash them to decorate them.
Then you eat them.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mint Dessert
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
In large bowl, beat flour, sugar, butter, eggs and syrup until smooth. Pour into prepared pan.
Bake 30 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched.
Cool completely.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Cookies
steps: Cream the butter (oleo) and brown sugar.
With a fork, blend in the flour.
Stir in walnuts.
Reserve 1 cup of this for topping.
Press remaining into an 8-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Beat sugar and cream cheese.
Add egg, vanilla, lemon and milk.
Beat.
Pour over baked crust and sprinkle evenly with remaining crumb mixture.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Let cool, then refrigerate.

recipes.title: Beaufort Stew
steps: Will need large stock pot 3/4 full of water.

recipes.title: Swedish Nut Wafers
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Lightly butter a cookie sheet or jellyroll pan.
Cream butter, then gradually beat in the sugar until well blended.
Add egg, milk and vanilla; beat well.
Mix together flour, baking powder and salt; mix into first mixture. Spread dough onto the cookie sheet as thin as possible, just enough to cover pan.
Sprinkle with nuts and press them into dough gently.
Mark with sharp knife into rectangle (cookie size), bake about 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Fudge Brownies
steps: In medium saucepan melt butter and chocolate Remove from heat, stir in sugar. Blend eggs one at a time; add flour and vanilla. Pour into baking pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Banana Blueberry Bran Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place liners in 12 (1/2-cup) muffin cups or lightly grease.

recipes.title: Chili Verde
ingredients: 3 pork steaks (lean meat), cut into 1/2-inch strips
2 small cans whole green chilies, chopped or sliced
steps: Fry meat until golden brown.
Pour unwanted grease out.
Saute onions and garlic with the meat. Add chilies, jalapeno, cumin, salt, water and tomatoes. Bring to a boil.
Lower heat and simmer until pork is done.
It's delicious with beans, rice and tortillas.

recipes.title: Macaroni Fruit Salad
steps: Drain fruit real well; save juices and set aside.
Cook and cool macaroni.
Cook fruit juices, sugar, eggs, flour and vanilla. Cool cooked sauce mixture.
When cool, mix with fruits and macaroni.
Refrigerate overnight.
Before serving, mix Cool Whip with salad.

recipes.title: Hot Fries
steps: Mix and deep-fry 4 to 6 minutes.

recipes.title: Patsy'S Foreign Mission Curried Chicken
steps: Salt the chicken and brown in hot oil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the carrots, celery, mushrooms, onion, bouillon, curry powder and ginger; cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Make a smooth paste of the cornstarch, soy sauce and 1/4 cup cold water. Add to the vegetable mixture, stirring and simmering until it thickens.
Serve with rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sausage Gravy
steps: Brown sausage until it crumbles.
Drain, reserving 1 tablespoon of drippings.
Add oleo to drippings.
Add flour and cook 1 minute.
Add milk and cook until thickened.
Stir in sausage and seasonings.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Cookies
ingredients: 1 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1/4 c. hot water
steps: Beat well the brown sugar, white sugar and shortening.
Add remaining ingredients.
Divide in four parts.
Roll in stick shape.
Cover with foil and freeze.
Slice and bake as needed for 8 to 10 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon
steps: Lay fillet of salmon in baking pan; put onion slices over fish and layer bacon strip over onions.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Last 10 minutes, pour whole tomatoes over fish.

recipes.title: Frosted Brownies
steps: Combine first three ingredients in bowl and set aside.
Bring butter, cocoa and water to boil and pour over flour mixture.
Add remaining ingredients; add to cocoa and flour mixture, beating until smooth.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 small green pepper, cut into strips
1/2 lb. pork, cut into thin strips or canned tuna or any meat desired, cooked
steps: Heat oil in skillet.
Add onion, green pepper and garlic; cook until tender-crisp.
Add tomatoes, okra and cooked meat.
Bring to a boil.
Stir in rice.
Cover.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Add oil, sugar and vanilla to eggs and beat until light and fluffy.
Mix dry ingredients.
Mix all ingredients in order given. Add 1 cup (or much less) raisins and walnuts.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour in 2 well-greased loaf pans plus 1 baking powder can, greased and filled 1/2 full.
Cool before removing from pans.

recipes.title: Kolaches
steps: Filling variations recipes follow.

recipes.title: Unbaked Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix together margarine, milk and sugar in a heavy 2-quart pan. Bring to a boil and boil for 2 1/2 minutes.
Remove from heat, add peanut butter and mix thoroughly.
Stir in oats.
Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Dumplings
steps: Boil chicken breasts in enough water to cover them completely.
Add 1 tsp. salt and either 1 stalk of celery diced or a couple dashes of celery salt and a couple slices of onion, diced up (optional).
You can also add one hot banana pepper to be taken out later (optional).
We like our food spicy.

recipes.title: Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 lb. dried pinto or pink beans
1/2 to 1 c. hot bacon drippings or butter or lard
steps: Combine beans in a pan with water and onions.
Bring to a boil, cover and remove from heat for 2 hours (or soak beans in cold water overnight).
Return to heat, bring to boil and simmer slowly until beans are very tender, about 3 hours.
Mash beans with a potato masher and add bacon drippings, butter or lard.
Mix well and continue cooking, stirring frequently until beans are thickened and fat is absorbed.
Salt to taste.
Serve or reheat.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: French Fried Chicken Bites
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Sprinkle chicken breasts with salt and set aside.
Combine egg, flour and milk, stirring until smooth.
Dip chicken in egg mixture. Roll in cracker crumbs.
Fry chicken in 1-inch hot oil until brown. Drain on paper towel.
Yields about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Starlight Sugar Crisps
steps: Soften 1 package dry yeast in 1/4 cup very warm water.
Cut butter and Crisco into flour and salt mixture until particles are the size of small peas.
Blend in the beaten eggs, sour thick or commercial cream, vanilla and the softened yeast.
Mix thoroughly. Cover; chill at least 2 hours.
Dough may be stored in refrigerator up to 4 days and baked as needed.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies (No-Bake)
steps: Mix sugar, cocoa, margarine, milk and salt.
Bring to a quick boil, stirring constantly.
Boil 1 1/2 minutes.
Remove from heat. Add oats, peanut butter and flavoring.
Mix well and spoon onto wax paper to cool.

recipes.title: Apple Custard Pie
steps: Beat all ingredients together. Bake in unbaked pie shell like a custard pie until knife comes out clean (450° for 10 minutes; reduce heat to 300° and bake 50 minutes or until done).

recipes.title: Bushel O' Cookies
steps: Mix together until you have mixture stiff enough to use as a rolled dough.
Chill dough for 2 hours or overnight.
Excellent!! Have for Christmas cut-outs.

recipes.title: Strawberry Fluff
steps: Melt butter, add flour, brown sugar, and nuts.
Spread in a 9 by 12 inch pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.
(Stir 3 or 4 times.)
Cool.
Set aside 1/2 for top.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chews
ingredients: 1/2 c. plus 1 Tbsp. self-rising flour, sifted
steps: Melt margarine.
Combine eggs, sugar and vanilla flavoring with margarine. Gradually add flour and cocoa. Add 1/2 cup pecans to mixture. Pour mixture into 9 x 11-inch greased pan.
Add remaining pecans, sprinkling on top. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
They are done when it rises and falls back down.

recipes.title: Barbecued Pork
steps: Cook pork in lightly salted water over low heat 2 to 2 1/2 hours.
Drain, reserving 1 cup broth.
Cut pork into thin slices and place in a large shallow baking pan.
Combine salt, reserved broth and remaining ingredients.
Mix well and pour over pork slices.
Bake at 325° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheddar-Dill Popovers
steps: Heat oven to 450°.
Generously grease 6-ounce custard cups or 8 medium muffin cups (2 1/2 x 1 1/4-inch).
Beat eggs slightly in medium bowl; stir in remaining ingredients with fork or wire whisk just until smooth (do not overbeat).
Fill custard cups half full or muffin cups 3/4 full.
Bake 25 minutes.
Decrease oven temperature to 325°.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes longer or until deep golden brown.
Immediately remove from cups.
Serve hot.
Yields 6 to 8 popovers.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
steps: Combine sugar and oil, beating until smooth. Beat eggs slightly.
Add to sugar and oil, beating until creamy.
Add vanilla, soda and salt.
Alternate, adding flour and milk.
Add poppy seed and nuts.
Bake in well greased pan at 325° for approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Easy Pumpkin Swirl
ingredients: 3/4 c. Pioneer or Bisquick buttermilk baking mix
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Grease a 15x10x1 inch jelly roll pan.
Line top and sides with waxed paper.
Grease waxed paper.
Beat eggs and sugar until fluffy.
Beat in pumpkin, stir in dry ingredients. Pour into pan, spread evenly, sprinkle with nuts.
Bake for 13-15 minutes.
Invert onto towel dusted with powdered sugar.
Peel off waxed paper, roll up cake and towel together from short side. Place seam side down on wire rack.
Cool completely, unroll cake.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake Cookies
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: allspice, cinnamon, mace, cloves and nutmeg
1 lb. each: white raisins, candied pineapple and fruit
steps: Sift flour, spices and soda.
Dredge fruit and nuts in additional flour.
Mix dry ingredients to creamed mixture.
Add eggs and milk.
Fold in fruit and pecans.
Bake on greased cookie sheet for 15 minutes at 300°.

recipes.title: Pinecone Cheese Balls
steps: Spread almonds in single layer in shallow pan.
Bake at 300° for 15 minutes, stirring often until almonds are toasted. Split each nut in half when cool.
Combine softened cream cheese and mayonnaise.
Mix well.
Add bacon, onion, dill and pepper.
Mix well.
Cover and chill overnight.
Form cheese mixture into shapes of two pinecones on serving platter. Beginning at narrow end, press almonds at slight angle into cheese mixture in rows.
Continue overlapping rows until all cheese is covered.
Garnish with clean, washed pine sprigs.
Serve with crackers.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Yankee Pot Roast
steps: About 4 hours before serving, in Dutch oven over medium heat, in hot salad oil, brown the meat well on all sides.
Add remaining ingredients with 1 1/2 cups water and heat until boiling.
Reduce heat; cook until fork-tender.
Serve meat with pan liquid.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: English Popovers
steps: Put all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Fill 8 well-greased muffin tins or custard cups.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then lower oven temperature to 350° for 20 minutes longer.
Serve warm with butter and jam.

recipes.title: Grayce'S Krazy Cake
steps: Sift dry above ingredients into an ungreased 9 x 14-inch cake pan.
Make 2 holes or depressions in flour mixture in pan.
In one hole, put 2 tablespoons vinegar, in one put 3/4 cup oil.
Mix with a fork until well blended.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 50 minutes.
A toothpick may be inserted to test doneness or the cake should raise from small pressure from fingertips.
The mixture will stick to the toothpick if not done.

recipes.title: All In One Quiche
ingredients: 1 c. diced ham, turkey, shrimp, chicken, bacon or vegetables
steps: Combine first
5 ingredients in blender and mix well.
Turn into ungreased deep dish 9-inch or regular 10-inch pan.
Add meat, shellfish or vegetables, poking into batter.
Top with onions, mushrooms and cheese.
Bake until top is golden brown, about 45 minutes at 350°.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cornbread Salad
ingredients: 1 box Jiffy cornbread, baked as directed and crumbled
1 lb. bacon, fried and cut into small strips
steps: Mix in a bowl the bell pepper, onion, tomatoes, green onion and bacon.
Mix in a separate bowl the sweet pickles, pickle juice, mayonnaise and Miracle Whip salad dressing.
Layer cornbread, vegetables and dressing alternately.
Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Yorkshire Pudding
steps: Sift flour and salt into bowl.
Drop eggs into a well in center of flour and pour in milk.
Beat until smooth.
When roast is done, remove from oven
and keep warm.
Increase oven heat to 450°.
Pour beef drippings into 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan and heat until sizzling hot.
Pour batter over hot drippings.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until puffy and golden.
Serve in slices with roast beef.

recipes.title: Summer Potato Salad(Serves 8)
steps: Peel the potatoes and slice about 1/4 inch thick.
Bring to a boil for 10 minutes in salted water.
Drain.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb. beef sirloin, cut into 2-inch x 1/4-inch strips
2 (2 1/2 oz.) jars sliced drained mushrooms or 1 lb. fresh, sauteed
steps: Coat the beef strips in 1 tablespoon flour and salt. Brown beef in butter; add mushrooms, onion and garlic. Cook until onion is crisp and tender. Remove mixture from pan and blend in 2 tablespoons flour and beef broth. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly. Stir in dairy sour cream and dry white wine. Return beef mixture to pan and mix. Spoon about 3 tablespoons of mixture into center of unbrowned side of crepe. Fold over; place seam down into 13 x 9 x 2 pan. Cover and bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
steps: Mix ingredients together in bowl.
Add enough water to form a paste mixture.
Deep fry in oil at 350°.
Remove from oil when brown.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients and pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix next 3 ingredients well and pour over other mixture in pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Yeast Rolls
steps: Combine 1st 5 ingredients in small mixing bowl and beat 3 minutes with heavy duty mixer at medium speed.
In large mixing bowl, combine flour, shortening, sugar and water and mix thoroughly.
Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Cover and let dough rise in warm place, 85° free from drafts for 3 hours or until doubled in bulk.
Punch dough down; cover; refrigerate overnight.
With lightly floured hands, shape dough into 1 1/2-inch balls; place in 3 greased 9-inch cake pans.
Let rise in warm, draft free (85°) place approximately 2 hours or until doubled in bulk.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Yields 2 1/2 dozen large rolls.
Dough can be stored in refrigerator in greased and covered bowl 5 to 6 days.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Sift dry ingredients.
Cream together butter, shortening and sugar.
Beat until light and fluffy.
Beat in vanilla and egg.
Add flour mixture; beat until smooth.
Blend in milk.
Drop by teaspoon onto lightly greased baking sheet.
Flatten with glass dipped in sugar.
Bake in a 400° oven for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Set oven to 350°. Peel, core and slice 12 to 15 apples in a 9 x 13 cake pan. Use good cooking apple (Jonathan, Ida Red or Yellow Delicious).
Sprinkle with 3/4 cup of white sugar and lightly sprinkle with cinnamon. Add 1/3 cup flour.

recipes.title: Basic Macaroni And Cheese - Low-Fat
ingredients: 1/2 c. crushed Pepperidge Farm seasoned cubed style stuffing
steps: Prepare white sauce while combining Butter Buds, flour, salt and pepper and slowly add skim milk.
Stir with wire whisk until smooth and thickened.
Set aside.
Place 1/2 cooked macaroni in the bottom of a 2-quart casserole dish that has been sprayed with nonfat cooking spray.
Sprinkle with 1/2 onion, salt, pepper and cheese.
Repeat.
Pour sauce over casserole.
Drizzle liquid Butter Buds over top.
Sprinkle remaining cheese over top. Sprinkle stuffing over top.
Cover and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Rice Krispy Treats
steps: Mix together the sugar and Karo syrup.
Bring to a boil. Stir in the peanut butter and cereal.
Press into 9 x 13 inch pan. Cool and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Hobo Stew
ingredients: 1 large canning kettle full of potatoes, cut up
steps: Brown cubed steak in large skillet.
Saute onions and bell pepper.
Put all in iron wash pot on campfire.
Add meat, onions and all the ingredients.
Cover with water and let cook in wash pot approximately 3 hours.
Will feed about 100 people.
Serve with cornbread.
May need to add more water as it cooks.

recipes.title: Three Bean Bake
ingredients: 1 (28 oz.) B & M baked beans (not drained)
6 slices bacon, chopped and cooked, then drained
steps: Mix together in bean pot or casserole. Bake at 300° for 2 hours. Serves 10 to 12. It may be necessary to add a little water if cooked in casserole.

recipes.title: Granola
steps: Combine oats, wheat germ and cinnamon. Mix oil and honey and add to first mixture.
Mix well.
Spread in shallow pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes, stirring once or twice.
Watch carefully so it does not scorch.
Remove from oven and add raisins.
Makes 3 cups.

recipes.title: Picadillo
steps: Saute onions, peppers and garlic in hot oil in skillet until tender.
Add beef.
Cook until browned; stir to crumble.
Drain. Add salt and next 8 ingredients; stir well.
Cover.
Simmer 30 minutes; stir occasionally.
Serve over yellow or white rice.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
steps: Cream together butter and sugar.
Mix all ingredients.
Butter a cookie pan.
Roll out real thin; cook at 350° or until brown.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water; mixture will be thick.
Sift together flour and sugar in large bowl; cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Add buttermilk and yeast mixture; stir well.
Turn dough onto well floured surface.
Roll out to desired biscuit thickness.
Cut out with biscuit cutter and place on baking sheet.
Brush tops with melted butter.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes until golden brown.
Makes about 2 dozen biscuits. Dough can be stored in an airtight container in refrigerator for 1 week.

recipes.title: Hamburger-Cheese Dip
steps: Thicken the flour and milk.
Add cheese and melt.
Add the rest of the ingredients; simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Fig Preserve Cake
steps: Combine first 8 ingredients in a large mixing bowl.
Add oil and eggs, beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer.
Add buttermilk and vanilla, beating well.
Stir in preserves and pecans.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Stir Fry
steps: Slice or julienne all vegetables.
Stir-fry vegetables in olive oil for 5 minutes; remove from heat.
Cover with lid for 2 minutes.
The heat and steam will make vegetables tender.
Can be served over rice or pasta.
Optional:
A can of crushed tomatoes may be added for a heartier meal.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chili Con Cornbread
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz.) chili or 4 c. homemade chili
1 pkg. Martha White buttermilk or Cottin' Pickin' cornbread mix
1 c. (4 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
steps: Pour chili into greased 8-inch square baking pan.
Combine remaining ingredients in order listed; blend well.
Pour batter over chili.
Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes or until done. Cool 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Frontier Beans
steps: Brown hamburger and bacon.
Add to beans and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Butter Rings
steps: Combine first four ingredients.
Scald milk.
Cool to lukewarm. Crumble yeast into milk.
Add sugar.
When bubbling, add to cream in which the egg yolks have been beaten.
Mix well.
Add to flour mixture.
Mix thoroughly and refrigerate overnight.
Next morning, divide into 6 equal parts.
Roll each into a thin roll and twist two together (makes 3 rings).
Place each in greased pie pan and let rise for about 2 hours.
Bake in moderate oven at 350° for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Winter Guacamole
ingredients: 2 small jalapeno chiles, stemmed, seeded and minced
4 sun dried tomatoes (packed in oil), drained and minced
5 slices bacon, cooked crisp and coarsely crumbled
steps: Pit and peel avocados; mash pulp in medium bowl to chunky consistency.
Add lime juice, scallions, jalapeno chiles and tomatoes, then fold in cheese, bacon and coriander.
Season to taste with salt.
Serve as soon as possible to keep bacon crisp. Use your favorite chips for dipping.

recipes.title: Fettucini With Creamy Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken breast, skinned and boned
steps: Rinse chicken.
Pat dry.
Cut into thin strips.
In a skillet saute chicken in half the butter until lightly browned on all sides.
Remove from pan.
Sprinkle with flour, stir to combine. Add half and half, a little a time, until sauce is smooth and creamy.
Cook, stirring from time to time, for 10 minutes.
Add sherry; season to taste with mustard, salt and pepper.
Cook fettucini in salt water according to directions on package.
Drain well.
Place fettucini in hot individual serving bowls.
Ladle chicken with sauce over noodles.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and parsley.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Bake pie shell for 5 minutes and set aside.
Mix flour, sugar and salt.
Beat eggs and add to flour mixture.
Add all other ingredients, saving margarine for last.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise
steps: Cook all ingredients together until thick, then thin with sweet cream when ready to use.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. (2 sticks) unsalted butter or margarine, softened
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Lightly grease 2 large baking sheets. In a medium size bowl, resift flour with baking powder and salt. Set aside.
`In a large bowl, cream the sugar, butter and vanilla until light and fluffy.
