Decorate with baking candy. Bake at 300° for 20 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.
Shape of cookie does not change during baking.

recipes.title: George'S Favorite Banana Pudding
steps: Mix first four ingredients and put into microwave.
Rub margarine around top of bowl so mixture won't boil over.
Cook until thickened; add egg yolks and return to microwave for a minute.
Take out and add vanilla and margarine.
Do not overcook.
Mixture needs to be able to pour so it will soak into the layers of bananas and wafers.
Layer bananas and wafers in a bowl, then pour pudding mixture over the layers.

recipes.title: Burrito Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger meat and drain.
Then add taco seasoning and water according to package and bring to a boil.
Then add the beans.
Take shells and fill with meat and roll up.
Place rolled tortilla in a pan and make one layer of tortillas, then add some juice from meat over the layer.
Make another layer of tortillas and then pour the rest of the juice over the layers.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Cook at 350° until cheese has melted.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
ingredients: 1 c. sugar (may substitute Equal 3/4 c. and 1/4 c. sugar)
steps: Mix flour and sugar well.
Add eggs and melted margarine. Add milk and flavoring.
Cook until it starts to get thick.
Add coconut to your taste.
(I like 1 cup coconut).

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and vanilla and beat well.
Add rolled oats.
Let stand while mixing flour with soda. Add flour to first mixture.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake in a 350° oven until light brown, approximately 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Steak With Lobster Tail
ingredients: 4 beef top loin steaks, cut 1-inch thick
steps: Slash fat edge of steaks at 1-inch intervals.
In skillet, cook steaks over medium-high heat to desired doneness; turn occasionally.
Allow 9 to 10 minutes total time for rare or 11 to 12 minutes for medium. Season with salt and pepper.
Drop lobster tails in boiling salted water to cover.
Return to boiling; reduce heat.
Simmer 8 minutes; drain.

recipes.title: Best Ever Potato Salad
steps: Cut bacon into 1-inch pieces.
Cook in skillet on medium heat until crisp.
Drain bacon.
Reserve 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet.
Mix mayonnaise, mustard, sugar and salt.
Combine potatoes, chopped eggs, celery, onion and green peppers in bowl. Mix mayonnaise mixture into potato mixture.
Stir in bacon.
Chill several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Fluff
steps: Mix like pie crust in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Line pan and bake in 350° oven about 20 minutes, or until light brown.
Set aside to cool.

recipes.title: Crescent Cookies
steps: Combine all
ingredients and mix well.
Make into small balls. Roll
slightly by hand and shape into crescents.
Bake on a lightly
greased cookie tin in a 325° oven for about 8 to 10 minutes.
When cool, roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Bake pie shell for 7 minutes at 450°.
Remove and reduce heat to 325°.
Fry bacon until crisp, drain and cut.
Save 2 tablespoons bacon for trim.
Place remaining bacon in pie shell; add cheese.
Combine remaining ingredients, pour over bacon and cheese.
Sprinkle remaining bacon on top.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until center is almost set.
Let cool 25 minutes and serve. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow butter cake mix
1 large box chocolate instant pudding mix
steps: Combine cake mix and instant pudding mix.
Mix according to instructions on cake mix package.
Add chocolate chips.
Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Let cool 10 minutes. Glaze or dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
steps: Cut tomatoes into 1/2-inch slices.
Mix cornmeal, flour, salt and pepper; dip both sides of tomato slices into mixture.
Heat oil in a skillet until sizzling hot.
Put in tomatoes and cook quickly until browned on underside.
Turn tomatoes carefully; reduce heat and cook until thoroughly hot and soft through center. Remove to paper towels to drain.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Nane Shirini(Persian Cookies)
steps: Mix all ingredients and roll dough into small balls. Flatten with teaspoon. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in slow oven at 250° to 300° for 19 to 20 minutes. (After flattening, tops can be brushed with egg white if desired.)

recipes.title: Orange Slice Cake
ingredients: 1 c. orange juice (to pour over top)
steps: Cream
margarine
and
sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time. Add buttermilk	and flour alternately.	Fold in nuts, coconut and fruit, that has been chopped fine and dusted with 1/2 cup of the flour.
Cook at 325° for 2 hours and 15 minutes.
Take out of
the oven and while hot, pour 1 cup of orange juice and 1/2
cup
sugar (which has been heated) over top of the cake. Let stand in pan until it is cold.

recipes.title: Biscotti
ingredients: 1 c. (1/2 lb.) butter or melted margarine
2 c. coarsely chopped almonds or walnuts
steps: Mix sugar with butter, anise liqueur, vanilla, water and nuts (optional).
Beat in the
eggs.
Mix flour with baking powder and stir into sugar mixture; blend thoroughly.
Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours.
Directly on greased baking sheets, shape dough with your hands to form flat loaves (1/2 inch thick by 2 inches wide by length of baking sheet).
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Sour Milk Cookies
ingredients: 2 tsp. soda in 1 c. sour milk
steps: Blend sugar and oleo, then add eggs, 1 cup flour and soda in sour milk.
Add rest of flour, baking powder, salt and vanilla. Drop by tablespoon; flatten with wet fork.
Bake at 350° for 5 to 7 minutes.
Sprinkle several times when baking.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Chop onion and brown in oleo.
Add milk, cheese and cream of chicken soup.
Boil rice in water according to instructions on package.
Add rice and broccoli to cheese mixture.
Put in casserole dish and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Rolls
ingredients: 1 c. warm milk or 1/2 c. warm milk and 1/2 c. warm water
steps: Combine first three ingredients in small bowl.
Mix well to dissolve yeast.
Set aside; mixture will rise to top of bowl.

recipes.title: Manhattan Potatoes(Different)
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of celery soup
steps: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water.
Drain.
Dilute celery soup with milk and fold in potatoes and other ingredients, except bread crumbs.
Place in greased casserole and sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cranberry Muffins
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. fresh cranberries, sliced in half
steps: Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and allspice. Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease or fill 20 muffin cups.
Mix oil and sugars; add egg and pumpkin.
Stir in dry ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Last, add cranberries, stirring only to mix.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes in oven.
These may be frozen for future use.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
steps: Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. chicken breasts, baked and cut up
2 small cans cream of chicken soup
steps: Put rice in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add broccoli and then chicken. Cover with soup, mayonnaise, milk and curry powder mixture. Sprinkle on cheese.
Bake at 350° until heated, about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Roll box of wafers into crumbs. Then add to creamed mixture. Add milk, coconut and pecans. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours in a greased and floured tube pan.

recipes.title: Apple Cottage Pudding
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. each: cloves, nutmeg and allspice
steps: Mix together flour, baking powder and salt.
Set aside.
Cream butter, vanilla, lemon rind and 1/2 cup sugar until well blended. Add egg and beat until fluffy.
Add flour mixture to the creamed mixture and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Pare, core and quarter the apples.
Arrange in the bottom of an 8-inch quiche pan, shallow casserole or pie pan.
Mix the 1/4 cup sugar with the cloves, nutmeg and allspice.
Sprinkle half the mixture over apples in the pan.
Pour batter over apples.
Sprinkle with remaining spiced sugar.
Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean.
Serve hot with whipped cream and a sprinkling of cinnamon.
Also can sprinkle with sifted confectioners sugar.
Good as coffee cake the next day.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 300° for about 15 minutes or until golden brown. There is no flour or baking powder in these cookies.
Very good.

recipes.title: Drop Dumplings
steps: Mix all ingredients, except broth.
Drop from a teaspoon into simmering broth or onto a pot roast with broth.
Cover and cook for 12 to 15 minutes.
Do not lift cover until time is up.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetable Mornay
steps: Steam vegetables in covered pan using 1/4 cup water.
Cook until tender and drain.
Save liquid for mornay sauce.
Add salts and butter to vegetables, mixing gently.
Set aside.
Prepare mornay sauce with 1/4 cup butter, 1/3 cup flour and 2 cups liquid from vegetables.
Add 2 cups half and half, Parmesan cheese, nutmeg, thyme, garlic salt and salt.
Cook like any white sauce. Spread half of the vegetables in casserole; add half of sauce and spread remaining vegetables and top with sauce.
Cover top with bread crumbs; drizzle entire surface with 1/4 stick butter, melted.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Muffins
steps: Sift flour with sugar, baking powder and salt.
Add oats. Pour in egg, milk and oil; stir just enough to moisten.
Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Yield:
12 muffins.

recipes.title: Italian Wine Cookies
steps: Bring all of the ingredients, except for the flour, to a boil and simmer for 5 to 8 minutes.
Cool.
Add enough flour until liquid is absorbed and easy to handle.
Blend/knead until thoroughly smooth.
Cut pieces and roll out like strufoli.
Should be as thick as your thumb.
Shape like a shell by curling on the side of a grater.
Place on a lightly greased cooking sheet and bake at 400° until lightly browned.
When cooled, place in a bowl and mix with honey.
Place on a platter.
Can be decorated with colored confetti and finely chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Porcupine Balls
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can tomato juice or sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients, except tomato sauce.
Form into balls. Place in greased casserole dish.
Pour tomato sauce over balls. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Super Treat Bars
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
In large bowl, beat brown sugar, sugar, margarine and shortening until light and fluffy.
Add vanilla and egg; beat well.
Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup; level off.
Add flour, baking soda and salt; mix well.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Spread dough in ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with 1 cup M&M's and 12 caramels, quartered.
Press lightly into dough.
Bake at 375° for 15 to 25 minutes or until light golden brown.
Cool completely.
Cut into bars.
Makes 24 bars.

recipes.title: Rice With Artichoke Hearts
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
2 Tbsp. fresh basil, chopped (3/4 tsp. dried)
2 whole tomatoes, chopped, peel if desired
steps: Heat oil.
Saute mushrooms until their liquid evaporates.
Add onion and saute 2 minutes.
Add garlic, basil, tomatoes and 1/2 cup stock.
Bring to boil.
Simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix shortening and sugar together until creamy.
Add unbeaten eggs, one at a time.
Mix dry ingredients and add alternating with sour milk.
(Do not beat too much, it will make cake dry.)
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: 7 Layer Salad
steps: Layer the first 5
ingredients in an oblong pan.
Blend mayonnaise and sugar.
Pour over salad and sprinkle with bacon and cheese.
Decorate
with sliced hard-boiled eggs.
Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Mildred Booe'S Corn Bread
steps: Heat oven to 375° to 400°.
Put shortening in a large cake pan and melt it.
(Put in oven to melt.)
In a mixing bowl, mix all the remaining ingredients by hand.
Beat about a minute, then pour into pan and bake in hot oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, about 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
steps: Cut shortening into flour until well mixed.
In another bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water; add sugar.
Let stand 2 or 3 minutes.
Add
milk
and
stir
well.
Add this to flour and shortening mixture.
Stir until ingredients are moistened.

recipes.title: Pound Cake Cookies
steps: Cream the butter and sugar. Add beaten egg, then flour and vanilla. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Good crisp cookie, like the crust on a pound cake.

recipes.title: Hominy Ole
ingredients: liquid from drained hominy and milk to measure 1 c.
steps: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat.
Blend in flour and salt.
(Drain liquid from hominy and add enough milk to make a cup).
Add to previous ingredients.
Cook until thick, then blend in shredded cheese and chili.
Pour over hominy in casserole bowl and heat in microwave 6 minutes.

recipes.title: Paralee'S Zucchini Bread
steps: Beat the egg yolks.
Add the oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla. Mix well, then add the flour, soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon.
Stir in the nuts.
At last, fold in the beaten egg whites.
Spoon gently into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Cool slightly.
Turn out of pans; cool on a rack.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Vinegar Rolls
steps: Combine vinegar, water, 1 cup of the sugar and 2 teaspoons of the cinnamon.
Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves.
Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Crisp Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Beat well. Sift dry ingredients.
Add to creamed mixture together with oats and walnuts; mix well.
Chill and drop on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350°.
Yields 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Olive Rice Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch pieces
13 large pimento-stuffed green olives, halved crosswise
steps: Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic, onion and bell pepper. Cook 2 minutes. Add the chicken and cook 3 minutes. Stir in the rice, turmeric and cumin and cook 1 minute. Add the broth, olives and capers and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat. Simmer until broth has evaporated, about 17 minutes. Remove from heat and add cilantro.

recipes.title: Meatball Pasta Soup
steps: Make small 1-inch meatballs with your favorite recipe.
Cook meatballs in Dutch oven.
Cook vegetables in drippings; add tomatoes, paste and seasonings.
Add meatballs.
Bring to boil. Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Stir in macaroni.
Cook 10 minutes.
Stir in spinach.
Cook 5 minutes. Remove bay leaves.
Garnish with cheese.

recipes.title: Italian Chicken Stew
steps: Place all ingredients in the machine, program for Knead and First Rise, Dough or Manual, and press Start.
Remove dough from the machine and let it rest for 10 minutes at room temperature.

recipes.title: Sunday Best Meatballs In Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 10 oz. frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed
steps: Mix all ingredients, except soup.
Divide into fourths, making 10 balls out of each fourth.
Bake on shallow pan at 350° for 40 minutes.
Drain grease.
Mix soup and 1/2 cup water; pour over meatballs.
Return to oven; bake 20 minutes.
Serve over buttered noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Bread
steps: Soften active dry yeast in warm water.
In large pan, combine boiling water, rolled oats, honey, shortening and salt.
Cool to lukewarm.
Stir in 2 cups of the flour; add eggs and beat well. Add remaining flour 2 cups at a time, mixing vigorously after each addition to make moderately stiff dough.
Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic.
Place in lightly greased bowl, turning once to grease surface.
Cover.
Let rise in warm place until double.
Punch down; knead.
Shape into loaves.
Place in greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans.
Cover.
Let double in warm place.
Bake at 375° about 40 minutes.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar, beating until light and fluffy.
Add flour, potato chips and vanilla; beat well.
Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges are lightly browned.
Cool 5 minutes on cookie sheets; remove to wire racks.
When cool, roll in powdered sugar.
Yields 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Midwestern Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/2 lb. smoked sausage, cut into 1/4-inch slices and halved
1/2 c. green or red pepper strips
steps: Mix together salad dressing, mustard and milk until well blended; set aside.
Combine sausage, peppers and onions in a medium bowl.
Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Stir in squash. Continue microwaving on High for 2 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Add salad dressing mixture; mix lightly.
Microwave on Medium (50%) for 2 to 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated, stirring after 2 minutes (do not overcook).
Serve over rice. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
steps: Place torn tortillas in greased pan.
Top with diced chicken. mix tomatoes and chicken soup.
Pour over chicken and top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Date Pudding
steps: Dissolve brown sugar in hot water and let cool in oblong dish. Sift flour, white sugar and baking powder together.
Add milk and vanilla.
Stir in dates and nuts.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Raisin Oat Triangles
steps: Mix to make a thin icing.

recipes.title: Broccoli Delight Salad
ingredients: 10 bacon slices, fried crisp and crumbled
steps: Combine broccoli, raisins, onion and pecans in large salad bowl.
Mix well.
In small bowl, combine sugar, vinegar and mayonnaise.
Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Pour over broccoli mixture until coated.
Chill until ready to serve.
Just before serving, sprinkle crumbled bacon on top of broccoli salad.
If preferred, bacon may be mixed in salad.

recipes.title: Miniature Brownies
steps: Line 72 mini muffin tins with baking cups or arrange baking cups on cookie sheets.
Melt butter in a 3-quart saucepan over medium heat.
Add chocolate chips; stir until melted.
Remove from heat.
Stir in sugar and vanilla.
Add eggs; stir briskly. Gradually stir in flour, then nuts.
Fill baking cups 3/4 full. Bake for 22 to 24 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chutney Spread
steps: Mix cream cheese, Cheddar cheese, sherry, Worcestershire sauce, curry and salt. Blend well.
Line loaf pan with wax paper. Smooth mixture into pan.
Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. Remove from pan. Layer chutney, green onion, cashews and coconut.
Serve at room temperature with Bagel Chips or Wheat Thins.

recipes.title: Yeast Rolls
steps: Heat together milk, sugar and shortening.
When cool, add yeast cake that has been dissolved in 1/4 cup warm water.
Add enough flour to make a thin cake dough.
Let rise 1 hour.
Add soda, baking powder and salt.
Sift flour and add to mixture. Work well.
Put in refrigerator and use as needed.
When making rolls, let rise 3 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
steps: Sift flour with sugar and cocoa.
Combine margarine, water and oil in saucepan; bring to a boil and pour over flour mixture. Combine buttermilk in which soda has been dissolved with eggs and vanilla.
Add to mixture; beat well.
Pour into 11 x 16-inch baking pan.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Zelma'S Sugar Cookies
steps: Cream fat; blend in sugar, eggs and flavoring.
Sift dry ingredients.
Add to chilled dough; roll and cut to desired shapes.

recipes.title: Butter Nut Cookies
steps: Cream
the
butter;
add
sugar
and mix.
Add nuts and flour. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 325° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole With Cheese Crescents
steps: Chicken:
Heat oven to 425°.
Arrange celery, eggs, and chicken (cut up) in ungreased 8x8x2 inch baking pan.
Melt butter over low heat.
Blend in flour, salt, and black pepper.
Cook over low heat stirring until mixture is smooth and bubbly.
Remove from heat.
Stir in milk and heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Stir boiling mixture one minute.
Stir in onion and green pepper. Pour milk over mixture and place in oven.

recipes.title: Chicken Saute With Vinegar
ingredients: 4 shallots, chopped or 1 small to medium onion (depending on how fond you are of onions)
steps: Heat 7 tablespoons of the butter in a skillet big enough to hold the pieces of chicken.
Season the pieces with salt and pepper; brown them lightly.
The butter should remain light in color.
Cover the skillet and continue cooking the chicken for about 10 minutes or until tender.
When tender, place the pieces of chicken on a platter.
Cover and keep warm.

recipes.title: Italian Creme Cake
steps: Combine buttermilk and soda and let stand for a few minutes. Cream together sugar, margarine, and shortening.
Add egg yolks one at a time.
Add flour alternately with buttermilk mixture.
Fold in vanilla, eggs whites, pecans and coconut.
Bake at 325 degrees for approximately 25-30 in 3 greased pans.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
steps: Break broccoli and cauliflower into small florets.
Place in a large bowl and layer with remaining ingredients in order given. Pour dressing over salad and refrigerate overnight.
Toss just before serving.

recipes.title: Sara'S Meat Loaf
steps: Mix all together and shape in loaf.
Bake in oven at 350° for 45 minutes or microwave on High for 15 to 20 minutes.
Put catsup all over top.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Cream brown sugar, white sugar and shortening together.
Add eggs and cream well.
Sift dry ingredients and add to creamy mixture.
Drop by spoonfuls onto greased baking sheet.
Add extras.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Brown beef and onion; drain and remove.
In same skillet, prepare Rice-A-Roni.
Stir in meat, salsa and chili powder. Continue cooking 3 to 4 minutes.
Arrange lettuce on dish.
Top with mixture of tomato, cheese and chips.

recipes.title: Beef Macaroni Italiano
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can stewed tomatoes, cut up
steps: Cook macaroni and drain.
In saucepan, melt butter; blend in flour.
Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato sauce, onion soup mix, oregano, salt and pepper.
Cook until bubbly.
Brown ground beef; drain.
Stir in sauce.
Add macaroni.
Spoon mixture into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with cheese.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 minutes.
Makes 5 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Wacky Cake
steps: In an 8 x 8 pan, sift together sugar, flour, cocoa, salt and soda.
Make 3 holes in sifted ingredients.
In 1 hole, put vanilla; in another hole, put vinegar and in last hole, put oil.
Pour water over all ingredients.
Mix with fork until all lumps are gone. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fried Dill Pickles
steps: Mix egg, milk, Lea & Perrins, Tabasco and 1 tablespoon of flour.
Mix 2 cups of flour, salt and pepper in separate bowl.
Dip pickles in egg mixture, then flour mixture, then back in egg mixture and back in the flour.
Fry to a golden brown.

recipes.title: Crunchy Caramel Chocolate Chews
ingredients: 2 c. crushed bite size crispy rice squares cereal
1 (6 oz.) pkg. Nestle Toll House semi-sweet chocolate morsels (1 c.)
steps: Melt margarine with molasses over low heat. Stir in rice squares.
Press into greased 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Melt caramels with milk in heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring frequently, until smooth.
Pour over crust. Sprinkle with chocolate morsels and nuts.
Cool.
Cut into squares.
Makes 16 squares.

recipes.title: Consomme Rice
steps: Put all ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart covered casserole.
In conventional oven, bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
In microwave oven, cook 15 minutes on High, then sit for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Sunday Chicken
steps: Skin and flour chicken. Add bouillon dissolved in water, onions, carrots and seasonings. Cover and simmer 45 minutes.
Add mushrooms and tomatoes. Cook 15 minutes longer. Remove chicken and place on bed of noodles or rice.
Mix flour with sour cream. Stir into vegetable sauce and cook 3 minutes. Spoon over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Sunflour Biscuits
steps: Cut shortening into flour.
Add milk gradually to make a soft dough.
Turn out on floured board and knead lightly, about 30 seconds.
Roll 1/3-inch thick.
Cut with biscuit cutter.
Bake on greased biscuit pan at 450° for about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a loaf pan.
Mix 1 cup sugar, shortening, eggs and vanilla.
Stir in flour until smooth. Stir in apple and nuts.
Spread in pan.
Mix 1 tablespoon sugar with cinnamon; sprinkle over batter.
Bake until toothpick put in center comes out clean, approximately 50 to 60 minutes. Immediately remove from pan; cool bread before slicing.

recipes.title: Icebox Cake
steps: Crush vanilla wafers fine; put all ingredients together and mix well.
Pour milk in and mix well.
Put in a bowl lined with wax paper.
Cover; put in icebox for 24 hours before cutting.

recipes.title: Grace Haley'S War Cake
steps: Note:
The addition of 1 cup walnuts and a tub of candied fruits makes an excellent fruit cake.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Stir-Fry
steps: Add Fri Chik, pineapple and garlic powder into sauteed carrot and onions.
Mix pineapple juice, soy sauce, cornstarch, lemon juice and brown sugar.
Stir into hot mixture.
Cook until thickened.
Add water chestnuts and snow peas.
Serve onto rice.

recipes.title: Veal Broccoli
steps: Pound veal on one side and set aside.
In a large skillet over medium heat, melt butter and saute onion until tender.
Cut mushrooms in half or drain canned mushrooms.
Add to onion with parsley, salt, pepper, basil and garlic, stirring to combine.
Add bread crumbs and 1/4 cup chicken stock.

recipes.title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: several slices bacon, fried and crumbled
steps: Combine the first 3 ingredients.
In skillet, cook until thickened slightly the remaining ingredients.
Pour dressing over salad and toss well.
May add hard-cooked eggs and extra bacon for garnish, if desired.

recipes.title: Jewish Apple Cake
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. sugar or 1/2 c. sugar + 1/3 c. orange juice
steps: Mix apples, cinnamon, 5 tablespoons sugar and nuts and set aside.
Grease and flour pan.
Beat flour, remaining sugar, oil, eggs, salt, orange juice, vanilla and baking powder.
Beat 5 to 8 minutes.
Layer dough and apples.
Start in cold oven at 350°; bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice Casserole
steps: Mix ground beef, salt and pepper.
Form into small balls. Heat in a large skillet the margarine and meat balls.
Brown slightly.
Remove meat balls.
Add to skillet the rice, onion and green pepper.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until lightly browned.
Add 1 cup of water, tomatoes and mushrooms; mix well.
Add meat balls and bring to a boil.
Cover and reduce heat. Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Gumbo
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery or mushroom soup
steps: Mix all in a cake pan.
Top with minced onion, onion rings or chow mein noodles.
Bake at 300° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Vegetable Bake
steps: Mix the last 4 ingredients.
Pour mixture over vegetables. Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes or more.

recipes.title: Ame'S Potluck Rice
steps: In very large container (roaster pan), heat oil; add meat, stir-fry until done and push meat to one side of pan.
Add celery; stir until clear.
Push aside with meat.
Add onion; cook until golden and push aside with meat mixture.
Add carrots, stir carefully all ingredients together.
Add rice and stir carefully with wooden spoon.
Add water chestnuts, peppers and green onion. Mix carefully.
Add soy sauce mix carefully with wooden spoon and cover until ready to eat.

recipes.title: Green Rice
steps: In large mixing bowl, combine broccoli, celery, onion and rice.
In small mixing bowl, combine soup, margarine and Cheez Whiz.
Mix until smooth and add broccoli mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburger-Country Style Steak
steps: Mix meat, 3 to 4 tablespoons flour and salt; shape into patties.
Roll each patty with rolling pin on floured board (about 1/4-inch thick).
Brown on both sides in shortening.
Remove meat and pour off all but 2 to 3 tablespoons fat in pan.
Add 1/4 cup flour and allow to brown.
Stir occasionally.
Add water and cook until thickened.
Layer meat and gravy in casserole dish.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Serves 5 or 6.

recipes.title: Sugarless Cookies
steps: Boil raisins, dates and apples in water 3 minutes.
Add shortening to melt, then cool.
Add rest of ingredients, adding nuts last.
Drop on ungreased sheet.
Bake at 375° for 12-15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cornbread
ingredients: 1 heaping Tbsp. Miracle Whip salad dressing
steps: Heat oven to 450°.
Heat oil in cast-iron skillet.
Beat egg and Miracle Whip together in mixing bowl.
Add all other ingredients, plus hot oil.
Pour into hot skillet.
Bake until golden brown

recipes.title: Chinese Fried Rice
steps: Brown meat in hot oil; add mushrooms, rice, onion and soy sauce.
Fry over low heat 10 minutes.
Stir-fry 5 minutes.
Add more soy sauce if desired.

recipes.title: Maye'S Venison And Gravy
steps: Slice venison and
pork into pieces about the size of the palm of your hand.
Remove all fat and sinew.

Wash meat well. Salt and pepper each slice and roll in flour. Fry in skillet in very hot oil until golden brown. Remove from skillet and put in large roasting pan with lid. Spread chopped onion on top of meat.
Pour excess oil out of skillet and use remaining drippings to make brown gravy.
Add a jar of gravy, if needed. Bake in a 300° oven for 6 to 8 hours. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Combine peanut butter, Crisco, brown sugar, milk and vanilla in a large bowl.
Beat.
Add egg.
Beat until blended.
Combine flour, salt and baking soda.
Drop on ungreased baking sheet. Bake.

recipes.title: Onion Soup
steps: Cook onion in butter and oil for 15 minutes, covered. Uncover and add salt; cook on medium-high for 40 minutes, until golden brown. Stir in flour and stir for 3 minutes. Add bouillon and wine and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Grate cheese.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken
ingredients: 2 (3 lb.) broiler-fryers, skinned and cut into quarters
steps: In a large roasting pan in 425° oven, melt butter.
Meanwhile, in pie plate combine flour, salt, paprika and pepper.
Coat the chicken quarters evenly with mixture.
Place in roasting pan in melted butter.
Bake 30 minutes.
Turn the chicken pieces and bake 15 minutes more or until fork-tender.

recipes.title: Ukranian "Holubtsi"(Stuffed Cabbage Rolls)
ingredients: 2 c. cooked rice (white or brown), cooked according to pkg. directions
steps: You will need a large casserole dish.

recipes.title: Portuguese Soup
ingredients: 2 lb. linguica or chouricio or 1 lb. each
steps: Place all ingredients into stockpot. When potatoes are ready (tender), soup is done.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. each: onions, celery and green peppers
steps: Mix sour cream, salad dressing and sugar then layer.

recipes.title: Surprise Rhubarb Pie
steps: Sift together 1 cup flour, baking powder and salt.
Cut in butter.
Add egg and milk; mix.
Press into a greased 9-inch pie plate.
Arrange rhubarb in pie shell; sprinkle with jello. Combine remaining ingredients; sprinkle on top of pie.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Light As A Feather Muffins
steps: Mix together sugar and shortening.
Blend in egg.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Stir in alternately with 1/2 cup milk.
Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Baked Brown Bread
steps: In large bowl, stir all ingredients together, mixing well. Batter makes enough to fill 8 (10 3/4 ounce) soup cans.
Oil containers well and fill not quite 2/3 full.
Bake in 350° oven for approximately 45 to 50 minutes.
Test with a straw for doneness.
Cool in containers for ten minutes before removing to cake rack.
Serve warm or cool with butter or margarine.
This bread freezes well.
This loaf is ideal for slicing and spreading with cream cheese or your choice of spread.

recipes.title: Afternoon Soda
steps: Place all ingredients in blender.
Blend until ice cubes are crushed.
Makes a blender full.
For low calories, use Sweet 'N Low and diet cream soda.

recipes.title: Aunt Frances'S White Brownies
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients together.
Put in greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
(Double recipe to use 9 x 13-inch pan.)
Sprinkle sugar and pecan pieces on top.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 box frozen peas or green beans
steps: Parboil first 6 ingredients.
Add chicken and soups.
Heat. If too thick, add more water.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Mix sugar and oil; cream until fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Sift flour, baking powder, soda, salt and cinnamon together.
Stir into first mixture; mix well.
Add carrots and nuts.
Pour into 2 well oiled and floured pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Cool and frost.

recipes.title: Scallop Saute
steps: Melt butter in large skillet.
Saute mushrooms, green peppers, onions and garlic over medium-high heat until soft.
Remove with slotted spoon.
Add scallops to skillet and saute over high heat. As scallops begin to shrink, return vegetables to skillet; salt and pepper to taste.
Stir in wine.
Serve immediately over hot rice. Serve with your best white wine.

recipes.title: Banana All-Bran Nut Bread
steps: Cream shortening and sugar well.
Add egg and All-Bran.
Sift flour with baking powder, salt and soda.
Mix nuts with flour and add alternately with mashed bananas to which the water has been added.
Stir in vanilla.
Pour into a greased loaf tin (8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch).
Let stand 30 minutes.
Bake in moderate oven (375°) for 1 hour.
Let cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 boxes Uncle Ben's rice with seasoning
1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
steps: Stew chicken until tender.
Debone and cut up.
Cook rice according to package directions, substituting chicken broth for water.
Fold all ingredients together.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Put into a casserole dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
(Note:
turkey can be substituted for chicken.)

recipes.title: Traditional Southern Fried Okra
steps: Combine cornmeal, salt and pepper in plastic bag.
Add okra and shake well to blend and coat 1 cup of okra at at time to cornmeal mix.
Put 1/4 cup oil into a cast iron frying pan and heat until hot.
Add coated okra a little at a time until brown.
Yield about 10 servings.
(Add additional oil as needed.)

recipes.title: Date Sandwich Cake
steps: Mix oatmeal, flour, sugar, baking soda, and salt.
Add softened butter and rub together until crumbly.
Spread 1/2 of crumbs in a 9 x 11 pan.
Cook dates with water and sugar until thickened.
Add vanilla.
Spread date mixture on crumbs; then top with remaining crumbs and press in gently. Bake in a 325 to 350° oven until lightly browned.
Suggestion:
You may delete the sugar cooked with dates if you wish to lessen the sweetness.
Better to bake 2 days before using so crumbs get moist and don't fall off.

recipes.title: 7 Layer Salad
steps: Layer in a 9 x 13 container the lettuce, celery, spinach, onion, eggs and peas.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
steps: Sift together flour, salt and baking powder 3 times.
Break lard into small pieces (the smaller the better).
Pour 1/2 cup boiling water over this and mix until creamy.
Add dry ingredients until you can mix it into a mass (with your hands, of course). Makes 2 crusts.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients and pour 1/2 of mixture over rice. Place chicken on top and pour rest of soup mix on top of chicken. Sprinkle onion soup on top.
Seal tight with foil.
Bake 2 1/2 hours at 325°.
Use 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients together.
Top with Cheddar cheese, then with chow mein noodles.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, uncovered.

recipes.title: Oatburgers
steps: Bring water, soy sauce and seasoning to a boil.
Turn down heat.
Add onion and oats.
Form into patties.
Bake until nicely browned at 350° for about 45 minutes.
Turn after 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Never-Fail Pie Crust
steps: Add sugar and salt to flour.
Then blend in butter flavored Crisco until crumbly.
Mix together vinegar, water and egg and blend with a fork.
Add to crumbly flour and mix together until it holds together.
Divide into four equal parts.
This dough refrigerates and freezes well.

recipes.title: Honey Crunch Cookies (Cereal)
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix sugar, butter, vanilla and eggs in 4-quart bowl.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls about 2 inches apart on cookie sheet.
Flatten each ball to 2 1/2 to 3 inch diameter.
Bake 6 minutes; rotate cookie sheet 1/2 turn.
Bake until golden brown, 5 to 6 minutes longer. Cool 1 minute.
Remove from cookie sheet.
Can add 1 cup raisins or 1 cup chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Fritter Batter
steps: Sift the 4 dry ingredients in bowl.
Add remaining ingredients; stir until smooth.
Heat oil to 350°, then cover bananas, pears or apples and fry.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Mix well together all ingredients and pour into pie shell. Preheat oven to 375° for 10 minutes; then bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Skillet Meal
steps: Brown hamburger in skillet; drain off fat.
Add mixed vegetables, water and onions.
Simmer until vegetables are tender. Add soup.
Stir and heat to boiling.
Turn off heat.
Let set for 5 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Cut broccoli into bite size pieces.
Mix Miracle Whip, sugar and red wine vinegar together and pour over broccoli.
Add onion, bacon bits and shredded cheese.
Mix together well.

recipes.title: Magic Fruit Cake
steps: Break up mincemeat; add water.
Boil 1 minute.
Butter 9-inch tube pan.
Bake 2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Sylvia'S Chopped Apple Cake
steps: Slice apples into a large bowl.
Break eggs over them; stir a little.
Blend the dry ingredients; sift over the apple mixture. Stir well.
Add oil, vanilla and nuts; stir well.
Bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Neiman-Marcus Dip
ingredients: 1 bunch chopped green onions with tops
steps: Must be made at least 48 hours ahead.
Mix and serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie(Great Grandmother Sanderson'S)
steps: Mix
all
ingredients
together.
Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350° until set, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Asparagus Risotto
ingredients: 1/2 lb. fresh asparagus, cut into 2-inch pieces
steps: In large saucepan, melt butter; add onion and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
In medium saucepan, boil chicken broth. Reduce heat; simmer.
When onion is tender, add rice.
Stirring, ladle in 1 cup broth.
Cook, stirring; add another cup.
When rice is near done, add asparagus; 5 to 7 minutes later add shrimp.
When almost done, add 1/2 cup wine.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Mix in order given.
Bake in 1-quart baking dish at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Waikiki Meatballs
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can beef or mushroom gravy
steps: Combine beef, onion and salt; shape into 20 meatballs.
In skillet, brown meatballs and cook celery in shortening until tender; pour off fat.
Add gravy, pineapple and juice.
Cover; cook over low heat 10 minutes.
Stir now and then.
Uncover; cook 5 more minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Vegetable Tortilla Stacks
ingredients: 16 oz. pkg. Green Giant frozen broccoli and cauliflower supreme
16 oz. can black beans, drain half of juice
8 oz. (2 c.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
green and red bell pepper rings
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Heat oil in medium skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chopped green and red peppers and onion.
Cook and stir until crisp and tender.
Drain.
Stir in 1/2 cup picante sauce.

recipes.title: John Wayne Casserole
steps: Bake in a 13 x 9 baking dish. Spread chilies in bottom of dish, then put cheeses on top of chilies. Separate eggs and combine egg yolks, milk, flour, salt and pepper. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into egg yolk mixture. Pour over cheese and chilies. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Busy Day Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. stew meat, cut in small pieces
steps: Add bit of diced onion and green pepper.
Mix and bake about 2 hours in hot oven.

recipes.title: Salad Or Dessert
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. apricot or peach jello
steps: Bring to boil the crushed pineapple.
Add apricot or peach jello.
Stir until dissolved.
Let cool.
Add Cool Whip and buttermilk.
Refrigerate.
A taste sensation.

recipes.title: Pork Fried Rice
steps: Cook instant rice; set aside.
Cut green onions and saute in skillet with small amount of shortening.
Scramble eggs in same skillet with sauteed green onions; mix together.
In large bowl, mix and add as follows:
layer of rice, sprinkle pepper and salt lightly, sprinkle La Choy soy sauce evenly.
Pour lightly
the La Choy gravy darkener.
Add scrambled eggs with onion (part of it). Repeat steps until all ingredients are in bowl.
Mix together; ready to serve.

recipes.title: Creole Black-Eyed Peas And Rice
ingredients: 1 lb. fully cooked smoked sausage, sliced
few dashes hot pepper sauce or Louisiana hot sauce
steps: Rinse the black-eyed peas and place them in a 4 1/2-quart Dutch oven.
Add 4 cups cold water.
Bring them to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Cover and let stand for 1 hour.
Drain and rinse the peas.
Return the peas to the Dutch oven.
Add the salt pork.
Add 3 cups water, or enough to cover the peas.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
Stir in the sausage, onion, green onion, green sweet pepper, parsley, tomato sauce, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, pepper, oregano, thyme and hot pepper sauce.
Bring the mixture to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, covered, over low heat for 45 minutes.
Serve over hot cooked rice.

recipes.title: Chili Cheese Casserole
steps: Layer the
cheeses in a greased quiche dish.
In quiche shaker mix
together
the
remaining
ingredients.
Pour over cheese and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Carrot Bread
steps: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, soda, salt and cinnamon.
In another bowl, beat eggs; add carrots, oil, pineapple, nuts and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients and stir until moistened.
Spoon into two greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 60 to 75 minutes, until loaves test done.
Cool for 10 minutes in pans before removing to wire racks.
Cool.
Combine confectioners sugar and milk.
Drizzle over loaves.

recipes.title: Party Pink Punch
steps: Blend first 4 ingredients.
Freeze.
Take out of freezer for 2 hours before serving.
Break into mush.
Add chilled ginger ale at last minute so that it does not get flat.

recipes.title: Baked Cheese Sandwiches
steps: Make 4 cheese sandwiches (with 2 slices of American cheese in each sandwich).
Remove crusts and arrange in baking dish.
Mix eggs, milk and dry mustard and pour over sandwiches.
Bake in 400° oven for 20 minutes or until brown on top.

recipes.title: Shirley Temple(Nonalcoholic Mixed Drink)
ingredients: 6 oz. ginger ale, or to fill
steps: Fill a Collins or highball glass with ice.
Add grenadine and fill with ginger ale.
Garnish with a maraschino cherry and an orange slice.
Makes 1 serving.
Preparation time:
2 minutes.

recipes.title: Fettucini With Lemon Vegetables
ingredients: 4 c. bite size pieces green vegies
steps: Cook noodles; cook vegies in butter over medium heat for about 7 minutes and toss with lemon peel.
Heat milk and cream cheese in skillet until smooth; stir in Parmesan and toss with noodles. Serve with vegies on top.

recipes.title: Finger Jello
steps: Mix together and add 5 c. boiling water. Dissolve completely. Let set in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix
steps: Combine salad dressing mix and oil.
Add dill weed, garlic powder and lemon pepper.
Pour over crackers; stir to coat.
Place in warm oven.
Use very low temperature for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Hamburgers
steps: Prepare hamburg for patties with salt and a little pepper. Make individual patties.
Place a slice of dill pickle and a thin slice of onion.
Fold patty over and seal.
Brown in a little oleo or shortening.
Pour the tomato sauce over the patties. Simmer 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Party Punch
steps: Mix all liquids together.
Top punch by adding scoops of sherbet to the bowl.
This also helps to keep it chilled.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
steps: Cook until thickened.
Mix well.
Allow to cool.
Slice 1 1/2 quarts strawberries in pie shells.
Pour cooled mixture over strawberries.
Chill at least 3 hours before serving.
If you want only 1 pie, use small box of Jell-O and half of each of the other items.

recipes.title: 3 Cheese Chicken Bake
steps: Cook and drain noodles.
Cook onions and peppers in margarine until tender.
Stir in soup, mushrooms, pimento, milk and basil. Layer half of noodles in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with 1/2 of sauce, 1/2 of cottage cheese, 1/2 of chicken and half of both cheeses. Repeat layers.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
If casserole comes from "fridge" add 15 minutes to baking time.

recipes.title: Hobo Stew
steps: Brown ground beef and drain.
Place in large pot with all remaining ingredients.
Cook over medium heat, 45 minutes, stirring periodically.
Reduce heat sooner if necessary.
If desire to simmer longer, add more water.

recipes.title: Carrot Casserole
steps: Mix together well.
Bake in buttered casserole dish at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: 1, 2, 3 Onion Soup
ingredients: 2 qt. beef stock or McKay's beef broth or George Washington broth
steps: Saute onions until tender with the garlic.
Add remaining ingredients and cook for 1 hour in crock-pot on high or simmer on stove until done.

recipes.title: Rancho De Chili
steps: Brown meat with onion and pepper.
Add rest of ingredients in large kettle.
Bring to slow bowl and simmer for 2 hours.

recipes.title: El'S Cole Slaw
steps: Shred cabbage, carrots and peppers.
(Can use large package of shredded cole slaw, but add peppers to it.) Salt to taste.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Waldorf Salad
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Toss gently to coat and chill 1 to 2 hours.
Spoon salad into a lettuce lined serving bowl. Garnish with apple wedges and pecan nuts.
Yields 10 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi(Makes 4 Servings)
ingredients: salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
steps: Preheat broiler to high.
Peel shrimp, rinse, drain well and pat dry.
Mix the remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Add shrimp and mix to coat well.

recipes.title: Simple Stir-Fry
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake chicken in foil.
Salt and pepper to taste, dot with margarine and bake for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut chicken in bite size pieces.
Pour water into skillet.
Heat on medium high.
Add frozen vegetables and sliced chestnuts.
Add wine and soy sauce; gently stir in chicken.
Continue to stir until all food items are well coated.
Cover with lid; cook until all liquid has evaporated.
Stir occasionally.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Quick Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Mix well the hash browns, 1 cup flakes, sour cream, onion and mushroom soup.
Place in greased baking dish.
Top with 1/2 cup crushed corn flakes, then 1/2 cup melted butter poured over, then 1/2 to 1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Lasagna
steps: Cook noodles, then drain them.
Layer with all ingredients, starting with small amount of sauce.
Put cheese on top of each layer.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Sandwiches
steps: Mix oleo with grated onion and mustard.
Stir until smooth and spread on both sides of onion buns.
Add 1 slice of cheese and lots of ham.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until warm.
Can be frozen. (Wrap each bun in foil.
Do not put in microwave.)

recipes.title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
steps: Grease a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Sprinkle coconut in first, then the nuts.
Mix cake according to package and gently pour over nuts.
Mix together margarine, cream cheese and powdered sugar. Pour over cake batter.
Bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 2 large zucchini, pared and thick diced
steps: Cook zucchini in salted water until tender; drain well. Cook onion
and	carrots in melted oleo.
Mix all ingredients together. Add
zucchini
last.
Bake in casserole dish for 45 minutes in
oven or microwave for about 20 minutes on high setting.

recipes.title: Upside-Down Pizza
steps: Brown hamburger with onion and green pepper.
Drain.
Mix mushrooms and pepperoni with meat mixture.
Spread in pan.
Pour spaghetti sauce over hamburger mixture.
Sprinkle cheese on top. Spread crescent rolls over that.
Bake in oven until rolls are done.

recipes.title: Chili Cornbread Bake
steps: Brown ground beef in skillet, stirring until crumbly; drain. Add onion and pepper.
Cook for several minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in salt, seasoning mix and tomato sauce.
Spoon into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Combine muffin mix and evaporated milk.
Spread evenly over casserole.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Cherry Cake
steps: Mix cake mix and bake in Bundt pan. Let cool and slice in 2 layers. Spread 1/2 Cool Whip on bottom layer and 1/2 jar pie filling on this. Lay top layer of cake on this. Spread with remaining Cool Whip and top with remaining pie filling.

recipes.title: Pink Lemonade Pops
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
steps: Pour into large pitcher and mix together.
Pour mixture into 7 paper cups.
Freeze about 1 hour or until the mixture is thick and slushy.
Place a wooden stick in the center of each pop.
Freeze about 7 hours longer or until pops are solid.
Peel the paper cups from the frozen pops before eating.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Pie
steps: Melt chocolate and margarine in a pan.
Add sugar, cornstarch and salt.
Beat eggs slightly.
Add to chocolate mixture.
Add milk and remaining ingredients.
Pour into a 9-inch pie shell and bake for 20 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing mix
steps: Combine all ingredients except nuts and parsley.
Chill until firm.
Roll on wax paper (amount of size ball wanted) in chopped nuts and parsley.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 (9-inch) graham cracker crumb crust or baked pastry shell
1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1 (21 oz.) can Comstock cherry filling or topping
steps: In large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Stir in ReaLemon brand and vanilla. Pour into prepared crust. Chill 3 hours or until set. Top with cherry filling before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Irish Cream
steps: In another bowl, blend 1/2 pint heavy cream or half and half with a dash of sugar.
Fold whipped cream into base liquid and blend just for a minute.
(Refrigerate 24 hours.)

recipes.title: Cheese Soup
steps: Cut cheese up and add milk.
Add mushrooms and mixed vegetables (liquid too).
Cook in crock-pot.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 (No. 2) can ripe olives or green olives
steps: Wash and chop broccoli and cauliflower.
Slice onion, olives and water chestnuts.
Blend mayonnaise and sour cream.
Pour over vegetables and toss to mix.
Chill.
Best if allowed to marinate in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours before serving.
(Good.)

recipes.title: Heavenly Potatoes
ingredients: 1 (24 oz.) pkg. frozen hash browns, thaw to use
steps: Mix all together and place in a casserole dish.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Surprise Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Beat cream cheese, egg yolk, 1/8 cup sugar and vanilla together until smooth.
Mix sugar and cinnamon together to roll bread in. Trim crust from bread.
Flatten each slice with a rolling pin. Spread with cream cheese mixture and roll each tightly.
When all are rolled, dip each roll in butter, then roll in cinnamon-sugar mixture.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cut each roll in half.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
May be made ahead and frozen.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
steps: Mix well and store in refrigerator for 4 hours before serving. Will keep 3 weeks in sealed container.

recipes.title: Cherry Salad
steps: Mix Eagle Brand milk and pineapple together, then add remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Preacher Cookies
steps: Mix sugar, milk, cocoa and butter.
Cook until boiling. Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter, oatmeal and vanilla.
Drop by teaspoon on aluminum foil.
Let harden.

recipes.title: Macaroni Pea Salad
ingredients: 2 to 3 c. cooked macaroni or other small pasta
Miracle Whip or mayonnaise (enough to coat all vegetables)
steps: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients except dressing. Gradually add enough dressing to properly coat vegetables.

recipes.title: Strawberry Charlotte Russe
steps: Put gelatin in a large bowl; add boiling water and stir until dissolved.
Combine strawberries, lemon juice, sugar and salt; stir until sugar is dissolved.
Combine with gelatin mixture. Chill to consistency of beaten egg whites.
Fold in whipped cream. Line side of spring-form pan with ladyfingers.
Carefully spoon mixture into pan and chill for 4 to 5 hours.
Decorate top with additional strawberries and whipped cream, if desired.

recipes.title: French Bread Spread
steps: Mix ingredients together and spread over French bread.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn
steps: Melt butter and cream cheese.
Mix all ingredients and bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Paprika Chicken
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
1/3 c. sour cream or plain yogurt
steps: In skillet, in hot margarine, cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned.
Remove; set aside.
Spoon off fat.
In skillet, combine soup, paprika and pepper.
Heat to boiling.
Return chicken to skillet.
Cover; cook over low heat 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink, stirring often.
Stir in sour cream.
Heat through.
Serve over noodles.
Sprinkle with additional paprika and garnish with fresh parsley, if desired.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Mini Cheese Balls
steps: Beat cream cheese and milk in a small bowl until smooth. Add cheese and green onions. Mix well. Cover and chill 1 hr. Shape into 1 inch balls. Place pretzel stick in them and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Ala King
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
steps: Put salted turkey in roaster.
Pour over turkey 1 cup boiling water with 1 stick of melted margarine.
Cover airtight with lid or tent made of heavy-duty Reynolds Wrap.
Place in a 450° preheated oven.
Bake for 1 hour.
Do not open oven door.
Leave in oven overnight, or until oven is cold.
(I cook mine last thing before going to bed.)
This time is for a 12-pound turkey.
Add about 5 minutes per pound for larger turkey.

recipes.title: Joyce'S Salad
steps: Dissolve the gelatin in the hot water and add the cold water. Cool slightly. Add the remaining ingredients.
Mix well and chill in mold. Serve.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken
steps: Split whole fryer down breast (for chicken breasts, just lay flat in roaster).
Blot chicken with margarine.
Add about 1/2 cup water, vinegar and bouillon cubes.
Bake at 300° to 325° for about 2 hours.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Mix cream cheese, sugar and peanut butter well. Fold in Cool Whip and pour into baked pie shell. Chill for approximately 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Cornbread Dressing
steps: Heat oven to 425°.
Grease and heat in oven a small No. 5 skillet.
Break 1 egg in bowl; beat with fork until frothy.
Add corn meal and sweet milk.
Bake for 25 minutes, crumble when cool. Brown lightly chopped onions and celery in butter.
Add crumbled cornbread, 2 eggs (beaten) and pepper.
Moisten with 1 1/4 cups chicken broth.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mini-Cheesecakes
steps: Place 1 wafer in each foil-lined muffin pan.
Combine cream cheese, sugar and vanilla.
Beat well and add eggs.
Mix well. Fill muffin cups 3/4 full.
Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.
Let cool.
Chill.
Top with pie filling.
Makes 1 dozen.

recipes.title: Ritz Cracker Pie
steps: Spray pan with Pam.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Gradually add sugar and vanilla.
Fold in nuts and crackers.
Put in pie plate.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
When cool, top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken Breasts
steps: Marinate chicken in soy sauce.
Place chicken in baking dish. Sprinkle with brown sugar substitute.
Pour remaining soy sauce over chicken.
Bake uncovered for 1/2 hour at 350°.
Uncover and add bell pepper and pineapple.
Bake 1/2 hour longer.
Serves 1.

recipes.title: Easy-Cheesy Lemon Bars
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pillsbury Plus lemon cake mix
1 pkg. Pillsbury Rich 'N Easy lemon frosting mix
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease bottom only of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Combine cake mix, butter and 1 egg.
Stir until moist.
Pat into pan.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Cocoa Fudge
steps: Butter a 9 x 13 pan.
Set aside.
Mix cocoa, sugar, and salt in a large, heavy pan.
Stir in both milks.
Cook over med heat, stirring constantly until mixture comes to full boil.
Boil without stirring until mixture reaches a soft ball stage (234° on candy thermometer).
Remove from heat, add vanilla, and butter, but DO NOT STIR.
Allow to cool until lukewarm (about 110°).
Beat with wooden spoon until fudge thickens.
Spread quickly into buttered pan. Cool completely.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Dream
ingredients: 3 boxes instant pudding (chocolate or whatever you like)
steps: Crush crackers; add melted margarine with crackers and refrigerate for 1/2 hour.
Stir ice cream, pudding and milk together; pour over crackers.
Spread Cool Whip over ice cream. Place in refrigerator or freezer.
Use 9 x 12 cake pan.

recipes.title: Swedish Cider
ingredients: 1 qt. (32 oz.) apple cider (apple juice okay)
2 c. cranberry juice cocktail or cranapple
steps: Put cinnamon sticks, whole cloves, allspice and brown sugar in basket in top of an electric 8 to 10-cup percolator.
Mix juices in bottom and perk like coffee.
Double recipe if necessary.
May substitute apple cider with orange Hawaiian Punch.

recipes.title: Double Delicious Bars
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt margarine in oven.
Sprinkle crumbs evenly over margarine.
Pour condensed milk evenly over crumbs.
Top with chips; press down firmly.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned at 350°.
Cool and cut into bars.
Makes 34 to 36 bars.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Grind cranberries and orange with peeling, very fine.
Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Chow Mein Cookies
steps: Melt butterscotch chips in saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and stir in noodles and nuts until well coated.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Cranberry Sauce
steps: Wash the cranberries and discard the few that are too soft or too hard.

In a large saucepan, bring to a boil water and sugar. Boil 5 minutes. Put the cranberries in the boiling water. Bring to a rapid boil so they will pop. When they begin to pop, reduce heat to medium and cook 5 minutes, stirring a few times. Remove from heat. When cool, refrigerate. Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
ingredients: end pieces of sandwich bread, cut up
steps: Cream sugar and butter.
Add eggs, vanilla and milk.
Stir. Add pieces of sandwich bread, enough to absorb the moisture but not enough to make dry.
Add raisins and coconut if desired.
Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Easy Green Chili(Dieter'S Recipe)
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can hominy or 1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (4 oz.) can diced green chili peppers, drained
1 (16 oz.) can red kidney beans or pintos, heated and drained
steps: Preparation Time: 15 minutes.
Cooking Time: 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
steps: Cook macaroni until tender.
Put aside.
In a saucepan, melt the butter.
Saute the onion and pepper in butter until tender. Set aside.
In a bowl, place the tuna fish, onion, pepper, butter and macaroni.
Add the mushroom soup; mix well.
Add grated cheese. Add finally the sugar and pepper.
Mix well.
Pour milk over top and mix slightly.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hungry Boy Casserole
steps: Saute beef, onions, green pepper and garlic until tender. Add tomato paste, water and salt. Mix well.
Add beans and mushrooms.
Simmer until all ingredients are thoroughly heated. Pour into baking dish and cover with canned biscuits.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until biscuits are golden.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Candy
steps: Add sugar and vanilla to cold potato.
Roll with rolling pin dusted with flour.
Spread with peanut butter.
Roll up like a pinwheel; place in refrigerator.
Cut into slices.
May be frozen. Wrap in wax paper or plastic wrap so it doesn't dry out.

recipes.title: Applesauce Salad
ingredients: 1 8 oz. can crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Heat applesauce in pan. Stir in gelatin until dissolved. Add orange juice and pineapple. Stir until smooth. Pour into mold and chill.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Marble-Top Fudge
ingredients: 3 c. (1 1/2 pkg.) Hershey's semi-sweet chocolate chips
1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
steps: Line an 8 or 9-inch square pan with foil and set aside.
In a heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt chocolate chips and 2 tablespoons butter with sweetened condensed milk, vanilla and salt.
Remove from heat and stir in nuts.
Spread evenly into prepared pan.

recipes.title: Turkey Loaf
steps: Mix and put in greased casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. sugar (more or less to taste)
steps: Soak bread in milk and water.
Add sugar and eggs.
Mix well. Add vanilla and raisins.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle nutmeg on top.
Pat pieces of margarine over the pudding. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Spicy Tomato Juice
steps: Wash tomatoes.
Remove cores and chop.
Combine tomatoes, onions and celery and bring to a boil.
Continue cooking and stirring for 20 minutes.
Press through a food mill.
Heat almost until boiling.
Stir in other ingredients.
Adjust seasonings to taste.
Process in pints or quarts for 35 minutes.
Makes 6 quarts.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken In Wine
ingredients: 3 or 4 whole chicken breasts, cut in halves
steps: Place chicken breasts in one layer in a shallow baking pan. Mix together all other ingredients.
Pour sauce over chicken. Cover with foil. Refrigerate. Spoon sauce over chicken a couple of times.

recipes.title: Cucumber And Green Onion Dip
steps: Wash and dry cucumber and onions.
Chop very fine.
For each package of cream cheese you use, add cucumber and green onions.

recipes.title: Nancy'S Chili
ingredients: 1 lb. Jimmy Dean pork sausage (regular or hot)
1 (28 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained
steps: In frying pan, cook sausage well and drain off excess fat; set aside. Brown ground beef in frying pan and drain off excess fat; set aside. Brown onions in olive oil in large heavy pot. Add cooked sausage, ground beef and remainder of ingredients except green pepper. Stir well and simmer covered for 45 minutes. Add chopped green pepper and simmer 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Yellow Cake
steps: Mix ingredients together except cinnamon.
Pour 1/2 batter into Bundt pan.
Sprinkle 2 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon over batter, then pour rest of batter in pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup
1/2 c. shredded sharp processed American cheese
steps: Cook broccoli in boiling, salted water until tender; drain. Arrange broccoli in greased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Place cooked chicken on top.
Combine soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice; pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine bread crumbs and butter.
Sprinkle over top.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350° or until thoroughly heated.
This dish can be prepared a day ahead and put in the refrigerator.
It also freezes very well. Dish can also be made substituting asparagus for broccoli.

recipes.title: Bean Dip
steps: Spread beans on serving platter. Mix sour cream with taco seasoning and spread over beans. Cover with shredded cheese and sprinkle with remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Frozen Orange Dessert
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted
steps: Combine the first 3 ingredients. Set aside 3/4 cup.
Press remaining crumb mixture into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Set aside.
Combine condensed milk and orange juice concentrate. Fold in whipped topping and oranges.
Spoon mixture over crust and sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Cover and freeze until firm. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: One Dish Supper
steps: Fry turkey burger in large skillet.
Bring tomatoes to boil in turkey (cooked).
Add dry rotini to boiling mixture.
Cook about 7 or 8 minutes or until tender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Serve with green peas, tossed salad and garlic toast.

recipes.title: Cheese Whiz
steps: Melt cheese and milk.
Add mustard and vinegar.
Put in container and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into a loaf pan or dish and freeze.

recipes.title: Baked Grits
steps: Cook grits as directed on box.
Add ingredients as listed. Beat hard after each addition.
Bake in a moderate 400° oven until firm and slightly brown (about 1 hour).
Serve at once.
Good with barbecue.

recipes.title: Monkey Cake
steps: Roll
biscuit
in sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Put in a well greased tube or loaf pan.
Cream together 1/4 cup margarine and 1 cup brown sugar.
Pour over cake.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Edith'S Gourmet Pork Chops
steps: Brown chops and arrange in baking dish.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Combine soup, water and thyme.
Heat.
Then add parsley, sour cream and 1/2 can of onions.
Blend and spread over the chops. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Remove cover, put remaining onions on top and bake 5 minutes more.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Drain Veg-All and mix with other ingredients.
Top with oleo and crackers.
Bake 15 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Chicken Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In large saucepan combine chicken, 1/2 cup of the milk, all the soup and sour cream.
Bring to boil over medium heat.
Remove from heat, spoon into ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
In large bowl, beat remaining 3/4 cup milk, Bisquick, corn meal and butter.
Pour over hot chicken, sprinkle top with cheese.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Very fast and easy.
Plus its good.
Feeds about 4 to 5 people.

recipes.title: Cherry Swish
steps: Mix together Cool Whip, cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla.
Pour 1/2 of mixture into each pie shell.
Pour 1/2 pie filling on top of each mixture and swish around until white shows through, making swirls.
Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
steps: Put tater tots in bottom of pan. Brown ground chuck, drain. Put over
tots. Pour soup in layers over ground chuck in any order. Spread cheese and put over soup. Bake at 350 degrees, until bubbly about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Carrot Dip
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Beat all ingredients until smooth and even color.
Sprinkle paprika or cut chives on top.
Serve with carrots.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch thick slices
1 (8 oz.) pkg. shredded Mozzarella cheese, divided
steps: Whisk together eggs and 3 tablespoons water until well blended.
Combine bread

crumbs and 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Dip the sliced eggplant into the egg mixture, then dredge in the bread crumb mixture. Cook the eggplant in 3 batches in 1 tablespoon hot olive oil (per batch) in a large skillet over medium heat 4 minutes on each side or until tender. Arrange 1/3 of eggplant in a single layer in a lightly greased 11 x 7 baking dish. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers twice. Spoon 3 cups pasta sauce over top. Bake, covered, at 375° for 35 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon Parmesan cheese and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Bake 10 more minutes or until cheese melts. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
ingredients: 1-10 3/4 oz can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
steps: Combine all ingredients except potato chips and cheese; blend well together.
Spoon into a lightly greased 3 quart shallow casserole.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Put sprinkling of potato chips over surface during last 10 minutes of baking.

recipes.title: Glazed Carrots
steps: You will need a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen broccoli (10 oz. each) or fresh bunch
steps: Cook broccoli as directed on package; drain.
Add 1/2 stick butter and 1/2 pound Velveeta cheese.
Stir until cheese dissolves. Put into greased casserole dish.
Crush 1/4 pound Ritz crackers. Mix with 1/2 stick melted butter.
Spread over top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Brown ground beef; drain.
Add beans with liquid.
Add salt and taco seasoning to taste.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Drain off all liquids and cool.
Chill before serving.
Gently toss the lettuce, tomatoes, dressing, cheese and chips together.
Stir in meat and bean mixture.

recipes.title: Diet Refrigerator Pickles
steps: Put your sliced cucumbers or any cut up vegetables in mixture. Cover and store in refrigerator.
Eat whenever hungry.

recipes.title: Christmas Morning Rolls
steps: Arrange rolls in well-greased, fluted tube pan.
Sprinkle pudding (dry) over rolls.
Cook butter and remaining ingredients over low heat until sugar is dissolved and mixture bubbles.
Pour over rolls.
Cover tightly with foil.
Let stand overnight on counter.
Next morning, bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes, then invert carefully onto serving dish.

recipes.title: Shrimp-Corn Chowder Soup
steps: Cook onions with butter until tender.
Add rest of the ingredients and heat to boiling.
Put pat of butter or oleo in each bowl and fill with chowder.
Sprinkle with parsley and paprika.

recipes.title: Simple Super Fudge
ingredients: 1 can sweetened condensed milk (Borden's Eagle Brand)
steps: Use a double boiler; heat chocolate chips until melted.
Add can of condensed milk and vanilla.
(Also peanut butter if desired.)
Add nuts.
Pour into a lightly buttered 8-inch or 9-inch square pan.
Cool for 1 or more hours and then cut into squares.

recipes.title: Dipsy Devil Dip
ingredients: 1 (5 oz.) jar cream cheese with pimiento (or add pimientos)
steps: Combine all ingredients, except vegetables.
Beat until creamy.
Makes about 1 cup.
Use as a vegetable dip.

recipes.title: Special French Toast
steps: Beat eggs and cream together.
Add Triple Sec, granulated sugar, orange zest and cinnamon; whisk until well blended.
Pour into shallow bowl.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Pea Dip
steps: Combine ingredients.
Microwave until melted. Serve with corn chips.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Cheese Strata
ingredients: 6 slices firm white bread, crusts removed
steps: Cut each slice of bread in half on the diagonal or cut into cubes.
Dip in melted butter.
Arrange half the bread slices or cubes in an unbuttered 8-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with half the cheese, onions, parsley and shrimp.
Add remaining bread and repeat process.
Beat eggs, salt, mustard, milk and sour cream together.
Pour over casserole.
Cover and chill overnight.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until puffed and golden.
Cut into squares and serve.

recipes.title: Cheesy Mashed Potatoes
steps: Add water to unpeeled potatoes just to cover.
Sprinkle with salt.
Bring to boiling for 30 to 35 minutes.
Drain.
Peel and shred potatoes with a grater.
In a large mixing bowl combine potatoes, cheese and butter; stir until butter is melted.
Stir in sour cream, green onion, salt and the pepper.
Transfer to a greased pan.
Bake, uncovered, in a 325° oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Divinity
steps: Stir sugar, corn syrup and water over low heat until sugar is dissolved.
Cook, without stirring, to 260° on candy thermometer (or until small amount of mixture dropped into very cold water forms a hard ball).

recipes.title: Home Baked Beans
steps: Wash beans; cover with water and soak overnight.
Next morning, cook slowly until skins burst or until just tender. Drain, reserving liquid.
Place half the beans in the bean pot or casserole.
Bury part of pork in the beans and half of combined remaining ingredients.
Add remaining beans and seasonings.
Place remaining salt pork over top.
Cover with bean liquid and bake in 250° to 300° oven between 6 to 8 hours.
Serves 6 to 8 people.

recipes.title: Garlic Potato Casserole
steps: Boil potatoes in skins.
Cool and shred coarsely.
In greased casserole dish, alternate layers of potatoes, butter, cheese, onion, sour cream, salt, pepper and parsley.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pretzel Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 pt. frozen strawberries with syrup, thawed
steps: Beat together cream cheese and sugar, then add Cool Whip.
Mix well and then spoon over crust.
Mix jello with boiling water. Add strawberries with syrup.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Pour over cheese mixture and refrigerate.
When set, garnish with nuts.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 1 (4 1/2 oz.) can tiny shrimp, well drained
steps: Combine cream cheese with mayonnaise until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients and chill.
Serve with Toast Squares.

recipes.title: Apple-Peanut Butter Dream
steps: Mix all ingredients and serve on lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Creamy Lo-Cal Dressing
steps: Blend all ingredients with hand beater until very smooth. Store in covered jar in refrigerator.
Makes 1 3/4 cups.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened to room temperature
steps: Beat together cream cheese and sugar.
Add peanut butter and beat in well.
Fold in 2 cups Cool Whip and spoon into pie shell. Top to taste with more Cool Whip.
Refrigerate several hours before serving.
Makes one 9-inch pie.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Coconut Dessert
steps: Beat together egg yolks, sugar and salt. Add to milk that has been scalded and cooled. Cook over hot water in double boiler until custard coats spoon.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Relish
steps: Weigh 7 pounds pickles and put them in salt water that will float an egg.
Let them stand 3 days, then 4th day change to clear water for 3 days, changing the water daily.
Cut pickles in chunks, put them in weak vinegar.
Add a teaspoon of alum to every quart of water to cover them, and let them stand a day.
Make a syrup out of 3 parts water and 3 parts vinegar, 1 tablespoon each cinnamon, cloves and allspice, 1 teaspoon celery seed and 1 tablespoon mustard seed.
Put all spices in a thin cloth and boil it in your syrup for a while.
Then fill your cans and pour the syrup over them and seal cans.

recipes.title: Cream Candy
steps: Cook in open kettle or heavy pan. Put sugar, salt and boiling water in pan; stir over low heat until dissolved. (Don't let boil at this time.) Add cream; stir only one time. When candy starts boiling, cut butter in slices and drop into candy. Cook until it says crack on the thermometer (290 degrees). Pour on buttered marble or dish. Pour 2 tsp. vanilla on candy. Pull candy when cool.

recipes.title: Cucumbers In Sour Cream
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. lemon juice or apple cider vinegar
steps: In a large bowl, combine sour cream, minced chives, lemon juice, salt, pepper and hot sauce.
Peel and thinly slice cucumbers.
Add and mix well.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb. or more large fresh mushrooms
steps: Remove stems from mushrooms and wash carefully.
Save stems for another dish.
Combine drained crab meat and grated sharp cheese.
Add mayonnaise and mix well with a fork.
Stuff this mixture into each mushroom cap.
Sprinkle each with crushed crackers.
Bake for 10 minutes in 350° oven.
Then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and run under the broiler until they bubble. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Bean Salad
steps: Drain all vegetables before adding to liquid.
Cut onion and bell pepper. Dice small.
Mix vinegar, oil and sugar.
Put in covered bowl and keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Easy Rotini Salad
steps: Mix vinegar and sugar; slowly add oil.
Add cooked rotini and green pepper.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peppermint Pie
steps: Combine cocoa and sugar.
Add to pudding mix and prepare as directed on package.
Cool; add vanilla.
Whip cream and fold into chocolate mixture.
Pour into peppermint stick ice cream shells. Freeze.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Pizza
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can tomatoes, drained and cut up
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Meanwhile, press biscuits into 12-inch round greased baking sheet or 12-inch pizza pan, pinching edges of biscuits together to seal.
Bake 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Chocolate Fudge
steps: In 2-quart saucepan, melt oleo.
Do not get too hot.
Add cocoa and milk; mix well.
Stir in powdered sugar; bring to a bubbling boil stirring constantly.
Cook 2 or 3 minutes more. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and peanut butter.
Stir until cooled slightly and begins to firm.
Pour into greased (oleo) 8 x 8-inch dish.
Cut into squares when cool.

recipes.title: Cherry Flip
ingredients: 1 can cherry or blueberry pie filling
steps: Mix together crackers and oleo and pat into a small oblong dish.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cream together cream cheese, sugar and milk.
Spread on top of cooled crust.
Sprinkle nuts on cream cheese mixture.
Spread Cool Whip atop nuts.
Then spread pie filling atop the Cool Whip.
Very good!

recipes.title: Broccoli Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 red pepper, cut in half rings
steps: Put oil in pot, add garlic, onion, mushrooms and red peppers. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add florets and stir-fry 5 to 8 minutes, until tender.
Add salt and lemon rind.
Toss and serve.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Zucchini Dish
ingredients: 1 nice size zucchini or 3 small, chopped
steps: Spread rolls on 9 x 13-inch pan.
Saute onion and zucchini in oleo until soft.
Pour over rolls.
Pour eggs over zucchini and onions.
Sprinkle cheese over all.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour to 45 minutes.
Cut in squares.

recipes.title: Frosty Orange Nog Without Ice Cream
steps: Place ingredients in blender and blend until smooth.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese And Sausage Biscuits
ingredients: 1 pkg. can biscuit, cut in half
steps: Grease muffin pan and press biscuit half in pan cups up the side as far as you can.
Divide sausage and place on dough.
Mix cheese cottage cheese eggs and pepper; pour over sausage and dough.
Bake 375° 15 to 20 minutes.
Wipe muffin pan, grease and make the rest of the muffins.

recipes.title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
