steps: Brown meat real well; add onions and brown.
Add all ingredients except sugar and herbs.
Cook for 1 1/2 hours; add herbs and cook another 1 1/2 hours.
Add sugar at very end.
Serve over spaghetti and sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients together until well blended.
Roll into balls.
Cook at 350° for ten to twelve minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Marvelous Meat Loaf
steps: Combine all ingredients except brown sugar and ketchup. Mix well. Press evenly in loaf pan. Combine ketchup and brown sugar in a small bowl. Mix well and spread over meat mixture. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Texas Hot Fudge Frosting
steps: In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add cocoa and bring to a quick boil.
Remove from heat.
Add milk and bring to a boil again.
Remove from heat.
Add powdered sugar, about a third at a time and stir vigorously after each addition, until mixed thoroughly (it will be thick).
Spread immediately on cake.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Bisque
steps: In large saucepan, combine soup, cream, milk and nutmeg; stir to combine.
Heat slowly just to boiling, about 10 minutes.
Add sherry and crabmeat, stirring; heat until thoroughly hot.
Do not boil.
Serve in individual soup cups.
Sprinkle top of each with a little nutmeg.
Makes 24 (1/2-cup) servings.

recipes.title: Baked Fries
ingredients: seasoned salt, Parmesan cheese or packaged salad dressing mix
crushed cornflakes, bread crumbs or sesame seed
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Cut potatoes lengthwise into eighths. Brush wedges with egg white.
Sprinkle on seasonings and crumbs. Bake on a baking sheet 30 to 35 minutes.
Makes 6 servings, 50 calories per serving.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Mix well and bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Yum-A-Setta
steps: Brown ground beef with salt, pepper, brown sugar and onion. Add tomato soup.
Cook noodles; drain.
Add chicken soup.
Layer ground beef mixture and noodle mixture in a casserole dish with the processed cheese between the layers.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Salad
steps: Combine pineapple, bananas, maraschino cherries and pecans in bowl; mix well.
Combine mayonnaise and lemon juice in mixer bowl; mix well.
Add sugar; beat well.
Blend in cream cheese.
Fold in whipped cream.
Add to fruit; toss to mix.
Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Freeze until firm.
Yield:
10 servings.

recipes.title: Nicole'S Pizza Bread
steps: Make one or as many as you want!

recipes.title: Tuna Pot Pie(Serves 6)
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas and carrots
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of potato or cream of mushroom soup
1/2 tsp. poultry seasoning or dried thyme
steps: Line 9-inch pie pan with one crust.
Set aside.
Combine remaining ingredients; salt and pepper to taste.
Pour filling into pie pan.
Top with second crust.
Seal and crimp edges.
Slit top of crust to vent.
Bake at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Pizza Bread
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen bread dough (Riches) or can use 2 cans pizza crust dough
steps: Let bread dough thaw and rise or use ready pizza crust dough. Roll dough on floured pastry cloth or countertop until size of cookie sheet.
Spread out cheeses and pepperoni on dough.
Roll like a jelly roll.
Bake 35 minutes at 350° or until loaf sounds hollow when tapped.
Brush with beaten egg before baking, if desired.

recipes.title: Delicious Coconut Cake
ingredients: yellow cake mix, cooked according to directions
steps: Prepare cake. Let cool completely in cake pan. Bake in an oblong pan.

recipes.title: Broiled Tomatoes
steps: Slice tomatoes 1/4-inch thick.
Place on a cookie sheet. Garlic salt and pepper the tomatoes.
Top with shredded Mozzarella cheese.
Broil in oven until cheese is completely melted.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
steps: Melt soup and cream cheese together.
Add remaining ingredients and chill 6 to 8 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Nana Mccann'S Chocolate Sauce
steps: Simmer together butter, milk and sugar for 10 minutes.
Add chocolate, vanilla and salt to milk mixture.
Simmer half hour three or more times (raising and lowering temperature to keep from boiling but bringing to boil 3 times).
Test consistency by dropping a little in cold water.

recipes.title: Strawberry Punch
steps: In a large mixing bowl, dissolve sugar in boiling water.
Add juices and strawberries.
Pour mixture into a large plastic container and freeze until firm.
Remove from freezer 1 hour before serving.
Place in punch bowl and break into chunks.
Add Sprite. Stir until slushy.
Garnish with 1 pint fresh strawberries.
Makes 6 quarts.

recipes.title: Oven Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: salt and pepper on top to taste
steps: Boil potatoes and mash with sour cream, cream cheese, butter, salt and pepper.
Add milk to right consistency.
Put in greased casserole (2-quart) and dot with butter.
Sprinkle with paprika. When ready to serve, bake at 350°, uncovered, for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Skillet Steak
ingredients: 10 small new potatoes, cut into quarters (about 1 lb.)
1 1/2 c. green and red pepper chunks
1 lb. trimmed boneless sirloin steak, cut in chunks
steps: In 2-quart casserole, combine potatoes, peppers and water. Cover and microwave on High for 8 to 12 minutes, or until potatoes are tender, stirring twice.
Drain; set aside.
Spray 12-inch nonstick skillet with vegetable cooking spray.
Heat skillet over medium heat.
Add beef chunks.
Cook 4 to 6 minutes until meat is pink; stir frequently.
Add potato mixture and remaining ingredients.
Cook 4 to 5 minutes or until potatoes brown and mixture is hot.
Stir frequently.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup
steps: Blend green peppers, celery and onions to a pulp in blender; add to the tomato juice.
Add everything together; bring to a boil.
Simmer for 30 minutes.
Put in bottles to process for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cracklin' Bread
steps: Scald corn meal with boiling water.
Add shortening and cool slightly.
Beat eggs thoroughly.
Add milk and salt.
Combine the two mixtures.
Add baking powder and cracklings and blend thoroughly.
Turn into well-greased pan and bake in a moderately hot oven at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Meatballs
steps: Mix ground beef, bread crumbs, onion, salt and pepper.
Shape into balls.
Brown slightly.
Combine catsup, mustard, vinegar and sugar.
Pour over browned meatballs and bake in a covered dish at 350° for 1 hour.
Check and add water, if necessary.

recipes.title: Holiday Punch
ingredients: 1 large can pineapple juice plus equal can water
steps: Combine
all
ingredients.
If so desired, add sugar to taste. Best if let set overnight.

recipes.title: Onion Soup
ingredients: Italian or French bread, sliced thin
steps: Slice onion.
Saute with oil until cooked and light brown. Add water, broth powder and soup bones.
After cooking a while, add salt to suit your taste.
Add white wine.
Simmer very slowly 2 to 3 hours.
Butter slices of bread and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Place slices on cookie sheet and bake to delicate brown. Put slice of bread in each bowl and pour soup over.
Top with grated Swiss Gruyere cheese.

recipes.title: Pizzaburgers
steps: In skillet, brown beef and cook onion until tender, but not brown.
Add tomato paste and seasonings.
Simmer, uncovered, about 15 minutes.
Spoon hot meat mixture between or over bun halves. If you like, slip onion rings and/or Mozzarella cheese into each bun.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Mix and drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheets.
Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Low-Budget Goulash(Quick And Easy)
steps: Brown ground beef.
Boil macaroni noodles.
Add macaroni, tomatoes, cheese sauce mix, chili seasoning and beans to cooked meat.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve with green beans and garlic bread.

recipes.title: "Skordalia" Garlic Sauce
steps: Pound the garlic with the salt and walnuts until well blended and creamy.
If you like the taste of chopped nuts, just mix the chopped nuts with the salt and garlic, which you put through a garlic press.
Add the bread crumbs with oil, a little at a time, then the vinegar and finally the cold water.
Put enough water to make the mixture soft like a paste.

recipes.title: Hot Cheese And Sausage Dip
ingredients: 1 pkg. Good Seasons garlic salad dressing mix
steps: Brown sausage slowly on range top.
Melt cheese on low burner. Crumble cooked sausage and mix with cheese and the rest of the ingredients.
Serve with Doritos, Tostados or fresh vegetables.

recipes.title: Lasagne
ingredients: 1 pkg. American cheese and Parmesan cheese
steps: Cook noodles in salted water until tender.
Brown beef and minced onion and garlic in salad oil (about 2 tablespoons).
Add tomato sauce, tomatoes, salt, pepper and oregano; let simmer 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cream Cake
ingredients: 2 small pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
steps: Bake the cake in a 10 x 12-inch pan as directed.
Mix the pudding mix, 8 ounces cream cheese and 4 cups milk; spread mixture over loaf cake.
Drain the pineapple slightly; spread over pudding.
Whip the Dream Whip in 1 cup milk.
Add 4 ounces cream cheese (small chunks at a time).
Spread over pineapple.
(Drop by tablespoon until covered.)
Keeps 3 days refrigerated.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge
steps: Bring to boil for 2 minutes.
Let cool to lukewarm.
Add vanilla.
Beat until ready to drop.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 (2 lb.) pkg. frozen hash browns, diced
steps: Put frozen potatoes in buttered dish.
Pour the following mixture on it:
Combine sour cream, onion, 3/4 cup melted butter, salt, pepper, grated cheese and soup.
Cover with corn flake crumbs. Drizzle 1/4 cup butter on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Frozen Pops
steps: Dissolve Jell-O, Kool-Aid and sugar in boiling water.
Add cold water; stir well.
Pour into ice cube trays, small paper cups or frozen pop molds.

recipes.title: Autumn Skillet Dinner
ingredients: 1 medium red onion, sliced thin (or chopped)
steps: Trim fat from chops, then brown both sides.
Remove from skillet.
Add onions and garlic, cooking until tender.
Add cabbage, apple, apple juice, vinegar, bay leaf and pepper.
Toss well.
Add the browned chops, arranging over the top.
Cover skillet and cook 20 to 30 minutes on low heat.

recipes.title: Seafoam
steps: Cook sugar, water and vinegar until it forms a thread or a ball in a glass of cold water.
Add mixture to beaten stiff egg white (add slowly so you don't cook the egg whites).
Beat real well by hand or electric mixer.
When the mixture starts to get stiff add vanilla.
Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls on waxed paper, Saran Wrap or large plate greased with oleo.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 jar dried roast beef, shredded or chopped
steps: Combine first five ingredients until evenly mixed.
Shape into ball and roll in chopped pecans.

recipes.title: Glazed Meat Loaf
steps: Stir together eggs, milk, slat, pepper and bread.
Beat until bread is broken up.
Add onion, carrot, cheese and beef.
Mix well.
Form into a large loaf in center of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake in a moderate oven at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Combine sugar, ketchup and mustard.
Spread over meat loaf and continue baking 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Whipped Cream Salad
ingredients: 1 c. whipping cream, Dream Whip or Cool Whip
steps: Drain pineapple, reserving syrup.
Add enough boiling water to syrup to make 1 cup.
Dissolve jello in hot liquid.
Stir in cranberry sauce and orange peel.
Chill until partially set.
Fold in oranges and pineapple.
Whip the cream and fold into fruit mixture.
Pour into a 6 cup mold and chill until set.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Stir gelatin and sugar together; add boiling water.
Mix until dissolved.
Add marshmallows; stir until melted.
Cool.
Add cranberries and nuts.
Pour into 8 x 12 x 2-inch pan to set. Spread salad with sour cream and sprinkle with chopped nuts (optional) before serving.

recipes.title: Caramel Popcorn
steps: Boil butter, sugar, syrup and salt for 5 minutes.
Remove from burner.
Add baking soda.
Stir (mixture will foam up). Add vanilla and pour over popped corn.
Bake in a 250° oven for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Mix and chill.
Stir before it thickens good.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. olive oil or polyunsaturated vegetable oil
1 (28 oz.) can tomatoes, undrained and chopped
2 c. (8 oz.) part skim milk Mozzarella cheese, grated
fresh coriander (cilantro) or parsley for garnish
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Heat oil in a nonstick skillet and saute the green chiles and onion over low heat for 2 minutes. Stir in tomatoes, garlic powder and oregano.
Add salt if desired. Simmer uncovered about 30 minutes or until thick.
Combine chicken and yogurt.
Place in shallow 3-quart baking dish.

recipes.title: Peach Pie
steps: Mix water, syrup and cornstarch.
Cook and stir until thick and clear.
Add sugar and bring to boil.
Pour over peaches.
Cool while making crust.
Make double crust for 9-inch pie.
Pour peaches in pie pan lined with crust.
Put on top crust.
Bake at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff Casserole(Serves 4)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. stew beef, cut into 1 inch cubes
1 can cream soup (use either mushroom or celery)
steps: Combine stew beef and all ingredients except sour cream in covered casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 2 1/2 hours.
Add sour cream and bake 30 minutes longer.
Serve with rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Layered Avocado Salad
steps: Mix together the bean dip, avocados, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Spread onto large platter, spreading to edges.
Mix together the sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning.
Spread over bean mixture.
Layer remaining ingredients in the order given.
Chill for 3 to 4 hours.
Serve with tortilla style chips.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Mix soup, mayonnaise, onion, eggs and cheese.
Add thawed, uncooked broccoli.
Mix stuffing mix with melted margarine.
Pour over casserole.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Yum Yum Salad
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients.
Chill until consistency of thick syrup.
Fold in cream (into which can go some grated cheese). Pour into mold and chill. When set, serve on lettuce leaf with or without dressing.

recipes.title: Saucepan Brownies
steps: In a large saucepan, melt chocolate chips and butter over low heat.
Stir until well blended; remove from the heat.
Add biscuit mix, milk and egg; stir well until all lumps are gone.
Add nuts. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Yields 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Dirt Dessert
steps: Cream together the margarine, confectioners sugar and cream cheese.
Mix together the pudding, milk and Cool Whip.
Add to the cream cheese mixture.

recipes.title: Egg White Cookies
steps: Beat eggs until stiff.
Gradually beat in sugar and salt.
Add vanilla.
Fold in chocolate morsels and nuts.
Drop by teaspoon onto buttered cookie sheet.
Place in preheated oven at 350° and turn off oven.
Leave in oven until oven is cool.

recipes.title: Layered Banana Pineapple Dessert
steps: Mix graham cracker crumbs, sugar and margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Press evenly onto bottom of pan. Arrange bananas, sliced, on crust.

recipes.title: Fried Apple Pies
ingredients: 2 c. dried apples or fresh apples, cut and diced
steps: Place apples in a saucepan.
Add water just to cover.
Simmer 6 to 8 minutes, until tender.
Remove from heat.
Stir in sugar and cinnamon and set aside.
Separate biscuits and roll each to 1/2-inch thickness.
Place 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons of cooked apples on each round.
Fold dough over apple mixture and crimp edges with a fork to seal.
Heat 1-inch of oil in skillet on medium-high. Cook pie for about 2 minutes.
Drain pies.
Enjoy.

recipes.title: Chicken Divine
steps: Cook broccoli and drain.
Place butter in an 8 x 12-inch baking pan and let melt in oven (or microwave).
Put broccoli in dish.
Top with layer of chicken.
Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder.
Pour over meat.
Top with shredded cheese and bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Can be made ahead and reheated.
Serves about 6.

recipes.title: Beef And Cornbread Casserole
steps: Brown meat and drain; add pork and beans, barbecue sauce, onion, salt and tomato sauce.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Pour into large (9 x 13-inch) baking dish.
Top with cornbread mixture (use 2 small packages cornbread mix).
Bake 25 minutes.
Spread soft margarine over top of cornbread before serving.

recipes.title: Mom'S Potatoes
ingredients: 1 pkg. Lipton dry onion soup mix (one envelope)
steps: Wash and chop potatoes into bite size pieces, with skins on. Place in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Pour melted butter over potatoes.
Sprinkle onion soup mix over potatoes.
Cover with foil and bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: 7 Layer Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan in oven.
Sprinkle graham crackers over butter.
Sprinkle on chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coconut and nuts.
Pour sweetened condensed milk on top.
Bake for about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Salad
ingredients: turkey breast (6 1/2 lb.), baked and cut into chunks
steps: Bake turkey breast at 350° in a covered roaster (water in the bottom).
Cool.
Cut in chunks.
Mix turkey breast, celery, lemon juice, salt, pepper and mayonnaise.
Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Haystacks
steps: Melt butterscotch over low heat, stirring.
Pour in noodles and mix.
Spoon out noodles onto cookie sheet lined with wax paper.
Refrigerate to cool and harden together.
(Optional:
Use 1/2 package each of butterscotch and peanut butter chips.)

recipes.title: Pepsi Jello
steps: Bring water and sugar to boil.
Remove from heat.
Stir in cherry pie filling.
Return to boil.
Remove from heat. Thoroughly stir in cherry jello.
Add pineapple, lemon juice and Pepsi.
Chill until set in 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Ham And Swiss Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1/4 c. finely chopped pimento stuffed olives
steps: Combine dip, cream cheese and olives. Mix well; chill 1 hour. Spread half of cream cheese mixture evenly on ham slices, top with cheese slices.
Spread remaining mix on top of cheese.
Line up whole olives along one long side of each slab of ham/dip/cheese; roll up jelly roll fashion, starting at end of lined up olives. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, cut each roll into 1/2-inch slices.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Dressing
steps: Place ingredients in blender and blend until smooth.
Keep refrigerated. Pour over fruit when serving.

recipes.title: Zesty Submarine
steps: Cut bread horizontally in half.
Spread bottom half with butter.
Stir together vinegar, oil and garlic salt; dip lettuce into mixture.
Layer lettuce, salami and tomatoes on buttered bread.
Season with salt and pepper.
Layer remaining ingredients or tomatoes.
Place top half of bread on filling; secure loaf with picks.

recipes.title: Microwave Lasagna
steps: Place noodles in 2-quart baking dish, cover with water and sprinkle with salt.
Cook, uncovered, 15 minutes.
Remove and let noodles stand in water while preparing meat sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
steps: Boil chicken until tender.
Cool and break into bite-sized pieces.
Place broccoli in baking dish.
Cook in microwave about 5 minutes.
Arrange chicken on top.
Pour on melted oleo, then half of the grated cheese.
Mix together sour cream and soup (will be thick).
Spoon over chicken and top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Pecan Cream Cheese Pie
steps: In mixing, beat cream cheese until smooth. Add 1/2 c sugar, salt, 1 egg, and 1 tsp vanilla. Beat just to combine. Spread mixture on bottom of pastry. Sprinkle pecans over cream cheese mixture. Lightly beat 3 eggs. Add 3 tbsp sugar, syrup, melted butter, and 1 tsp vanilla. Place pie on a baking sheet on oven rack. Slowly and carefully pour syrup mixture over pecans. Cover edge of pie crust with foil. Bake at 375° for 20 min. Remove foil. Bake at 325° for 20 min. Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 min. more, till knife inserted in center comes out clean. Cool before serving. Refrigerate leftovers. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Pizza Casserole
steps: Cook ground beef until browned, stirring to crumble.
Drain. Spoon beef into an 8-inch baking dish.
Top with pizza sauce and cheese.
Combine biscuit mix, milk and eggs; beat until smooth. Pour mixture over casserole, covering evenly.
Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Yield:
6 servings.

recipes.title: B-B-Q Sauce
steps: Place the meat of your choice in the bottom of a pan.
Mix dry ingredients and pour over meat.
Then mix liquids and pour over meat and dry seasonings.
Marinate at least two hours.
This is better if you marinate your meat overnight or at least for several hours.
Turn once when marinating. Now, grill!

recipes.title: Honey Nut Spread
steps: Combine cream cheese and honey, mixing until well blended. Stir in nuts.
Chill.
Great for topping pumpkin muffins!

recipes.title: Crispy Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Do not peel cucumbers.
Slice thin.
Add onions, peppers, garlic and salt.
Cover with ice.
Mix thoroughly.
Let stand 3 hours.
Drain.

recipes.title: Lobster-Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 6 to 8 Tbsp. hot milk or light cream
1 c. sharp process American cheese, shredded
steps: Scrub potatoes, rub skins with shortening, and prick with fork. Bake at 375° till done, 70 to 80 minutes.
Cut slice from top of each.
Scoop out insides; reserve shells.
Mash potatoes.
Add butter, salt, pepper and enough milk or cream to moisten.
Beat till fluffy.
Stir in lobster, 3/4 cup cheese, and onion.
Pile filling into potato shells.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes longer. Sprinkle remaining cheese over tops of potatoes; bake 3 minutes more.

recipes.title: Fried Cornmeal
steps: Put hot cornmeal mush in a loaf pan; cut into slices.
Put slices of mush in heated greased frying pan and fry both sides.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
steps: Mix crumbs and margarine together and form into crust in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix sugar, margarine and eggs together for at least 15 minutes.
Smooth mixture over crust.
Cut bananas lengthwise and place on mixture.
Drain pineapple and pour over bananas.
Top with Cool Whip, nuts and cherries.
Chill.
When firm, cut into squares and serve.

recipes.title: Marinated Orange And Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 medium purple onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings
steps: Combine orange and onion in a large shallow dish.
Pour vinegar over mixture and toss.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Cover and refrigerate 4 hours; stir occasionally.
Toss gently.
Serve over mixed greens using slotted spoon.
Makes 3 servings.

recipes.title: Company Cabbage
steps: In large saucepan, heat bouillon in 1/4 cup water until dissolved.
Add cabbage, carrots, onion, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper; toss to mix.
Cook, covered, 5 to 10 minutes or until tender.
Combine butter, mustard and pecans and pour over vegetables; toss to mix.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
steps: Butter 10-inch pie plate.
In a saucepan melt 3 tablespoons of butter; add onion and green pepper.
Saute until tender.
Stir in meat; brown.
Drain excess fat.
Stir in spaghetti sauce.
Add 2 tablespoons butter to cooked spaghetti.

recipes.title: Spiced Pecan Halves
steps: Beat
egg white and cold water until frothy.
Add pecan halves and
stir to coat evenly.
Mix sugar, salt and cinnamon in a large bowl.
Add coated nuts and stir to coat thoroughly with sugar
mixture.
Place on buttered cookie sheet and bake at 225° for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Saute the sausage and mushroom stems, garlic and parsley. Drain well.
Add cheese.
Stuff the mushroom caps.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole(Prep Time:  10 Minutes; Cook Time:  30 Minutes)
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can Campbell's condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (2.8 oz.) can Durkee French fried onions
steps: In 1 1/2-quart casserole, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper.
Stir in beans and 1/2 can of onions.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbling; stir.
Top with remaining onions.
Bake 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Crab Casserole
ingredients: 1 small jar chopped and drained pimento
steps: Saute vegetables until tender.
Add soup, cheese, pimento, salt and pepper.
Stir in crab meat and shrimp.
Add Ritz crackers.
Bake at 350° until brown, about 20 to 25 minutes.
Dot with butter before baking.

recipes.title: Lemonade Pie
steps: Mix milk and lemonade; fold in Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust. Top with additional Cool Whip. Refrigerate before serving.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Lemonade
steps: Combine sugar and 1 cup water in a pan.
Heat, stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved.
Bring to a full boil. Remove from heat and cool.	Add lemon juice and 4 cups water. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Blender Chocolate Fudge Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Put first 6 ingredients in blender and mix well.
Pour into pie shells and bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven while center is still shaky.

recipes.title: Chinese Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 2 whole chicken breasts, halved, skinned and boned
steps: Combine dry jello, garlic salt and mustard.
Add melted margarine.
Mix well.
Place mixture in oblong baking dish. Arrange chicken in single layer, turning to coat both sides. Sprinkle with almond slices; cover.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes, basting once.
Remove cover; baste again and bake 15 more minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
ingredients: 1 c. butter or 1/2 butter and 1/2 margarine
steps: Mix sugar, butter, corn syrup and salt in pan.
Boil and cook 5 minutes (candy thermometer, 250°) and add vanilla.
Pour over popcorn and mix well. Bake in a 225° oven for 1 hour, stirring at 15 minute intervals.

recipes.title: Cold Bean Dip
steps: Start with beans and layer each item in a glass dish.
Serve cold.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
steps: In a 2-quart casserole dish, line the bottom with the tortillas, then layer the chicken pieces, onion and the remaining liquid mixture combined with the seasoning.
Cover with cheese and bake in a moderate oven for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Three Layer Strawberry Jello Salad
steps: Mix and spread in 9 x 13-inch greased baking dish.
Bake in 350° oven 7 minutes; cool.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. diced peppers, red and green
3/4 c. salad dressing, diluted with sweet pickle juice
steps: Cook macaroni as directed, drain and rinse with cold water. Combine macaroni and other ingredients.
Mix salad dressing and pour over salad.

recipes.title: Gail'S Vegetable Pizza
steps: Make a crust with rolls by unfolding and laying them in the bottom of a cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 5 to 7 minutes.
Watch carefully!
Cool.
Mix cream cheese, dressing and mayonnaise; spread on crust.
Put vegetables over this layer.
Sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.title: Delicious Custard
steps: Melt butter. Blend in cornstarch, sugar and salt.
Gradually add milk.
Heat to boiling over direct heat.
Stir into slightly beaten egg yolks.
Return to heat and cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Add vanilla. Cool thoroughly.
Makes 2 cups.
Serve plain or with cream.
(Excellent for banana cream pie.)

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole
steps: Prepare broccoli by boiling only 5 minutes, then drain. Combine eggs, mayo, soup and cheese. Stir in broccoli. Cover with crushed crackers. Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Supreme
steps: Combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar and margarine.
Mix well and press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Cheesy Meat Snacks
steps: Mix ingredients together and form into balls.
Place on a jelly roll pan about 1/2-inch apart.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 36 meatballs.

recipes.title: Baked Corn
steps: Beat eggs; add remaining ingredients to eggs and mix well. Bake in 1 1/2 quart baking bowl in 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tortellini Salad
steps: Dice peppers, onion, tomatoes and artichokes.
In a large bowl, mix vegetables, tortellini and Parmesan cheese.
Add Italian dressing.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Ribbon Fantasy Fudge
steps: Combine 1 1/2 cups sugar, 6 tablespoons margarine and 1/3 cup milk in heavy, 2-quart saucepan.
Bring to a full rolling boil, stirring constantly.
Continue boiling for 4 minutes over medium heat, stirring constantly, to prevent scorching.
Remove from heat.
Stir in chocolate pieces until melted.
Add 1 cup (1/2 jar) Marshmallow Creme and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla.
Beat until well blended.

recipes.title: Egg Rolls
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can chicken, crab or shrimp, drained
steps: Stir-fry cabbage, carrots and onions in 2 tablespoons oil and soy sauce for one minute.
Remove from wok and set aside.
Add meat and salt and pepper to vegetables.
Heat 2 cups oil in a skillet.
Spoon 2 to 3 tablespoons of mixture on each egg roll wrapper, fold sides and roll diagonally.
Brush with water to seal.
Fry in hot oil until golden brown.
Drain on paper towel.

recipes.title: Quick Berry Punch
steps: Combine Kool-Aid and cranberry juice cocktail.
Just before serving, add 7-Up.

recipes.title: Frozen Daiquiris Drink
steps: Mix all
together;
put in freezer.
If you wish to put in fresh
strawberries, put strawberries into blender; strain and add juice to the mixture.

recipes.title: Orange Apricot Salad
ingredients: 1 large can apricots, drained and mashed
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients. Let set. Once congealed top with cool whip and marshmallows. Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over marshmallows.

recipes.title: Chicken Mini-Drumsticks
steps: Remove tips from chicken wings.
Combine pineapple juice, beer, soy sauce, brown sugar, onion, ginger and garlic.
Stir together until sugar is dissolved.
Add chicken, stirring to coat well.
Cover and marinate at room temperature for about 1 hour. Drain chicken; reserve marinade.
Melt margarine in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Add chicken and cook, browning on all sides.
add 1/2 cup reserved marinade to chicken.
Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, over low heat for about 15 minutes or until fork can be inserted into chicken with ease.
Keep chicken moist by using additional marinade as needed.

recipes.title: Drop Fast Cookies
steps: Add sugar, chocolate and milk together and bring to a boil. Add peanut butter and stir until melted.
Remove from heat and add oatmeal.
If mixture seems too dry add a little more milk.
Drop by spoonful on wax paper and refrigerate until cookies have hardened.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
steps: Brown meat and drain. Add all ingredients. Simmer for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with tostado chips or corn bread.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained
steps: Cook and drain broccoli.
Add Velveeta cheese and 1/2 stick butter or margarine.
Bake covered at 350° for 25 minutes. Prepare Crumb Mixture.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Cook squash until tender; saute onions and bell pepper in small amount of margarine.
Mix all ingredients, reserving 1/2 of cheese for top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Lime Jello Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in hot water.
In bowl, beat cream cheese; stir in vanilla, oranges, pineapple, soda and nuts.
Let it set.
Then stir in Cool Whip.
Place in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
To serve:
Cut in squares and place whipped cream on top.

recipes.title: Punch
steps: Mix all but last ingredient.
I put it in a plastic Ziploc bag (make sure it is locked) and freeze.
Take out of freezer a couple of hours before serving, put into your punch bowl and add the ginger ale.

recipes.title: Leona'S Caramels
steps: Melt butter in heavy 3-quart saucepan. Add sugar and salt. Stir in syrup.

Mix well. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly. Cook on medium heat until firm ball stage (245°) or for about 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and pour into well buttered 9 x 9-inch pan. Cool for 4 to 5 hours.
Flip on board and cut with sharp knife and wrap each piece in wax paper.

recipes.title: Lasagna
steps: Cook the first 4 ingredients in 3 tablespoons oil until soft, but not brown.
Add meat and stir until meat loses red color.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and tomato paste.
Cook for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Cream the softened cream cheese and sugar.
Add peanut butter; mix well.
Add Cool Whip.
Pour into pie shell; chill.
Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Hot Crab Dip
steps: Mix all together, except crabmeat.
This mixture can be made several days in advance and kept in the refrigerator.
Add the crabmeat last.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve with Melba toast rounds or matzos, etc.
A party hit!

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Roll the biscuits in a mixture of the 3/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon and place in Bundt or loaf pan.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts, if desired.
Mix the 1 teaspoon cinnamon, 1 cup sugar and margarine together over heat until margarine melts and pour over biscuits.
Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Turn over onto platter.
Allow to cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Good Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together and beat well. Bake at 350° until done. This makes three 9-inch layers. Let completely cool before icing.

recipes.title: Cherry Salad Supreme
steps: Dissolve raspberry Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water.
Stir in cherry filling.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan.
Chill until partly set.
Dissolve lemon Jell-O in the other cup of boiling water. Beat cream cheese and mayonnaise together; gradually add lemon Jell-O.
Stir in undrained pineapple.
Chill until partly set. Fold Cool Whip and marshmallows into lemon mixture.
Spread on top of cherry mixture.
Top with nuts; chill until set.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
ingredients: 3/4 lb. cooked, cubed chicken (about 1 3/4 c., breast meat)
steps: In a large bowl with fork, combine mayonnaise, mustard and pepper. Add remaining ingredients except lettuce. Toss well. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours. Serve over lettuce. Makes 4 servings, 1/2 cup each.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken
steps: Wash and dry chicken.
Put in shallow baking dish, skin up. Simmer remaining ingredients for 5 minutes.
Pour over chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
steps: Mix cornbread mix and oleo together and set aside.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Mix together cornbread mix with all ingredients and bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
ingredients: 3/4 c. fresh or frozen blueberries, thawed and drained
steps: Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin cups (2 1/2 x 1 1/4-inch) or
line	with paper baking cups.
Beat egg slightly in medium
bowl;
stir in remaining ingredients, except blueberries, just until moistened.
Fold blueberries into batter. Divide batter evenly
among
cups.
Bake
15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Boil chicken in salted water; debone.
Pour chicken broth over Doritos to wet.
Layer Doritos in casserole.
Place chicken, except 1 cup, over Doritos.
Saute onion in margarine until tender.
Add soups and cup of chicken.
Pour on top of chicken. Add cheese.
Bake at 350° until cheese melts.
Sliced boiled potatoes may be used for Doritos.

recipes.title: Layer Cookies
steps: Melt butter in pan to be cooked in, approximately 12 x 8 x 2-inch.
Add graham cracker crumbs, coconut, chocolate and butterscotch chips and nuts.
Drizzle condensed milk over top of all.
Bake in 350° oven for 25 minutes.
Cut into squares.
Makes approximately 24 squares.

recipes.title: Easy Italian Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 1 qt. Ragu Chunky Garden spaghetti sauce
steps: Cook macaroni.
Mix in casserole with chopped onion and spaghetti sauce.
Top with Cashew Cheese and sprinkle with sesame seed.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham Finger Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 pkg. rolls, sliced (ready to eat rolls)
steps: Melt margarine with chopped onion. Add poppy seed and mustard. Mix and pour on top of rolls.
Spread evenly.
Lay 3 slices of ham and cheese on top and put top rolls on.
Cover with foil and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
steps: Mix together and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ham And Potato Casserole
steps: In casserole dish place a layer of potatoes (cut into pieces). Then add chopped onion, salt and pepper to taste.
Then add melted butter.
Chop the ham and add to this.
Pour mushroom soup on top of ingredients and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Nacho Dip
steps: Melt cheese
with
milk.
Add taco sauce.
Brown ground beef and drain.
Add ground beef to cheese mixture.
Keep warm and serve with nacho chips.

recipes.title: Chris' Tomato Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can tomato sauce (no added salt)
steps: Brown meat in a large pot, then add garlic and saute.
Add next 6 ingredients and add enough water to cover.
Simmer until the meat is tender.
Peel and cut the raw vegetables, then add to stew with drained beans.
Cook until vegetables are also tender. Remove the bay leaves before serving.

recipes.title: Icebox Treat
ingredients: 2 c. crushed pineapple or any fruit, crushed
steps: Put a layer of wafers in baking dish.
Add a layer of fruit to which sugar has been added, then add nuts to which margarine has been added.
Make another layer of each.
Chill 4 hours.
Unmold on cold platter.
Top with whipped topping and cherries.

recipes.title: Swiss Coffee
ingredients: 6 sq. Baker's sweet chocolate, broken in pieces
peel from 1 orange, cut in strips
steps: Place chocolate in empty coffeepot.
Place coffee and orange peel in brew basket.
Prepare coffee using 3 cups water.
Serve hot with whipped topping.
Makes 4 cups.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Grind cranberries and oranges (whole oranges with rinds) after the seeds have been removed.
Mix ground oranges and cranberries, sugar, pineapple and pecans.
Place in a closed container and let set overnight.
Will keep for several days.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Fill pot halfway with water.
Put on stove until water bubbles.
Pour macaroni in and stir. Cook 10 to 15 minutes or until soft.
Strain water out of macaroni.
Put in bowl and mix in butter, milk and cheese. Eat up!

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
steps: Boil potatoes until tender; drain.
Mix with remaining ingredients and place in casserole dish.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes, uncovered.
Sprinkle with paprika, if desired.

recipes.title: Chocaroons
steps: Start the oven at 300°. Add salt to egg whites. Beat until eggs are frothy. Beat in sugar, about 2 tablespoons at a time. Add vanilla. Gently stir in coconut, corn flakes and chocolate. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 20 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 1 small bottle Kraft Zesty Italian dressing
steps: Break spaghetti into 1-inch pieces.
Boil until tender in salted water.
Drain and wash in cold water.
Drain well.
Put in large bowl and add remaining ingredients.
Mix well and let marinate at least 4 hours or overnight (or longer).
Keeps well up to a week or more in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Mustard Baked Chicken
steps: Mix mustard, garlic powder, white wine (optional) and pepper in bowl.
Rub chicken with mixture.
Put on flat pan (I use a pizza pan) and bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour.
Serve with rice and veggie or your favorite side dish.

recipes.title: Candied Grapefruit Peel
steps: Cut the peeling into strips and cover with cold water. Parboil, changing the water often, until the peel is tender and not bitter. Drain. Place 1 1/2 cups water, sugar and salt in a pan with the peel. Cook until the syrup is absorbed. Roll in granulated sugar and let dry before putting into a tin.

recipes.title: Freezer Coleslaw
steps: Bring sugar, vinegar, water and celery to a boil, stirring occasionally.
Boil 1 minute.
Cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, toss together cabbage and remaining ingredients.
Set aside.
Drain cabbage mixture.
Stir cooled vinegar mixture into cabbage mixture until well mixed.
Pack coleslaw in three one-pint freezer safe containers.
Leave 1/2-inch space on top.
Cover and freeze.
Store in freezer up to 6 months.
Thaw coleslaw about 3 hours at room temperature before serving.
Makes 3 pints.

recipes.title: Cheesy Pork Chops And Potatoes
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) jar pasteurized processed cheese spread
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli spears, thawed and drained
steps: One small head fresh broccoli (about 1/2 pound) may be substituted for frozen spears.
Divide into spears and cook 3 to 4 minutes before using.

recipes.title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) pkg. frozen French-style green beans
1/2 c. shredded Provolone or Mozzarella cheese (2 oz.)
steps: Cook pasta according to directions, drain well.
Meanwhile, for sauce, in a medium saucepan, combine water, mushrooms, frozen beans, green pepper, garlic, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
Bring to boiling, reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 4 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Do not drain.
Stir together milk and cornstarch; stir into vegetable mixture.
Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly.
Cook and stir for 1 minute more.
Stir in cheese until melted.
To serve, pour over pasta.
Garnish with tomato wedges.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Greek Spaghetti
steps: Meat
Sauce:
Thin
tomato
paste
with
water.
Brown ground beef
and onion in butter about 10 minutes.
Add tomato paste, cinnamon
and garlic.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Add 1 cup of water and cook over low heat for 45 minutes until sauce is thick.

recipes.title: Bagel Chips
steps: Heat oven to 325°. Mix oil, margarine and garlic; brush onto bagel slices.
Bake slices on cookie sheet for 10 to 12 minutes or until bagels are crisp.
Store in tightly covered container.

recipes.title: Strawberries And Cream Shortcake
ingredients: 1 (18 1/4 or 18 1/2 oz.) pkg. pound cake mix
1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1 (4 serving size) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (4 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 qt. fresh strawberries, cleaned, hulled and halved
steps: Prepare pound cake mix as package directs; pour into prepared 9-inch round pans. Bake according to package directions; remove from oven and cool.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 8 oz. pkg. hash brown potatoes, frozen
steps: Mix all ingredients together but corn flakes and butter.
Pour in a 13 x 10-inch pan.
Stir together corn flakes and butter. Spread topping over potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until potatoes are done.

recipes.title: Marinated Carrots
ingredients: 5 c. carrots, peeled, cooked until almost tender, then sliced
steps: Arrange first 3 ingredients in layers.
Combine the rest and bring to boil.
Pour over carrots, etc.
Chill at least 12 hours. When serving, remove carrots, etc. with a slotted spoon, from the marinade which can be used again.
Can be made days ahead of time.

recipes.title: Grandpa Steck'S Cabbage Noodles
steps: Boil noodles in salted water until tender; drain.
Set aside. Melt butter or margarine in a Dutch oven or heavy pot.
Fry coarsely chopped cabbage in butter until lightly browned.
Cut Spam into 1/2 inch cubes and add to cooked cabbage.
Cook 5 minutes longer.
Mix in boiled noodles and add pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
steps: Mix
syrup,
oleo
and sugar;
bring to a boil.
Boil 6 minutes
(until thread forms when dropped from spoon).
Remove from
heat.
Add
cream
of tartar, soda and salt.	Stir until well mixed.
Pour over popped corn; stir until all kernels are coated.
Place
in container that can be placed in oven.
Bake 1 hour at 200°, stirring often.
Keep in airtight container.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. cubed cooked chicken or turkey
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup
steps: Cook broccoli in water in a covered saucepan or microwave until crisp-tender; drain. Place broccoli in a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch (2-quart) baking dish; set aside. Combine chicken, soup, mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese and curry powder; spoon over broccoli. Top with bread cubes and butter. Bake chicken casserole, uncovered, at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through. Chicken casserole serves 4.

recipes.title: Seven Up Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients putting seven up in last.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
steps: Melt butter with corn syrup in a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat.
Add brown sugar and stir to dissolve.
Cook syrup to hard ball stage.
To check, drop some syrup into cup of cold water and when it forms a firm ball it is done.
Takes about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and add baking soda, stirring to blend.
Pour over popcorn; stir to coat evenly.

recipes.title: Spinach With Crab Meat
ingredients: 1 c. flaked crab meat or 6 oz. can tuna
steps: In a small saucepan, cook spinach over low heat without adding water.
In a skillet heat oil.
Add onion and chilies.
Fry for 3 or 4 minutes until lightly browned.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Stir in crab meat and turmeric.
Cook 1 minute.
Stir in spinach and cook 5 minutes over low heat.
Add salt.
Sprinkle with lime juice and serve immediately with rice.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Easy White Sauce
steps: Forget all that butter and flour and beating to get rid of lumps!
This is the easy low-fat way.
Mix dry ingredients together thoroughly.
Add water slowly.
Heat over slow heat (or higher heat for the brave, but stir constantly).
Cook until it bubbles.
Add salt, pepper or other spices of your choice.
Add cubes of yellow cheese to make a cheese sauce.
I sometimes add the cheese, a dab of mustard and serve over macaroni.

recipes.title: Log Cabin Dessert
steps: Dissolve gelatin in a little cold water and mix into hot milk. Let set until cool.
Stir in whipped cream and pecans.
Pour into dish lined with vanilla wafer crumbs.
Top with a few crumbs. Chill thoroughly.
Cut into squares to serve.

recipes.title: Cabbage And Potatoes
steps: Wash and separate cabbage.
Wash and peel potatoes.
Slice very thin.
Slice onion.
In large pot, add all ingredients and cook over low heat until potatoes are done.
Serve with corned beef.

recipes.title: Hot Onion Dip
steps: Mix and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. Reese's peanut butter chips
steps: Combine marshmallow cream, sugar, milk, butter and salt in
a 2-quart saucepan.
Bring to a full, rolling boil, stirring constantly.
Continue
to boil over moderate heat, stirring constantly,
for
minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in chocolate and
vanilla.
Beat
until
smooth.
Spread
into a greased
pan. Sprinkle
with a few peanut butter chips.	Melt the rest of the peanut butter chips and spread over the fudge. Chill in refrigerator until firm.

recipes.title: Marinated Salad
steps: Stir and mix well.
Cover and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cookies While You Sleep
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat until stiff the egg whites, salt and cream of tartar.
Gradually add sugar.
Add vanilla and almond extract.
When mixture peaks, fold in chocolate chips and nuts. Grease cookie sheet.
Drop meringue by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Place in oven, close door, turn off the heat and leave until morning.
Do not peek!
Makes approximately 4 dozen.
Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Bev'S Vegetable Spread
steps: After grating and chopping vegetables, use paper towels to press out excess liquid.
Mix all ingredients.
Spread on white sandwich bread with crusts trimmed.
Cut into quarters or triangles.
(Bread may need a thin spread of mayonnaise.)

recipes.title: Orange French Toast
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. crushed vanilla wafer or graham cracker crumbs
steps: Combine eggs and orange juice.
Dip bread in egg mixture, then into crumbs.
Pan-fry in butter until lightly brown.
Serve with your favorite syrup or honey.

recipes.title: Oragail'S Easy Mountain Dew Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Grease 9-inch round cake pans.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Dorito Delight
steps: Brown ground beef.
Once beef is brown, mix all other ingredients in a skillet.
Bring to a boil.
Cover the bottom of a casserole dish with the Doritos.
Pour in other ingredients.
Top with the Cheddar cheese.
Put in oven at 350° until cheese melts. If you wish, you may top with salsa and sour cream.
Serves 8 to 10 people.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients well.
Add 1 1/2 cups of the Cheddar cheese and hash browns.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for another 5 minutes or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Sweet 'N Sour Pork
steps: Brown pork.
Add water.
Cover, simmer until tender.
Drain pineapple.
Reserve liquid.
Combine sugar and cornstarch.
Add pineapple syrup, vinegar, soy sauce and salt.
Add to pork.
Cook and stir until thick.
Add pineapple, green pepper and onion. Cook 2 or 3 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Deviled Pecan Balls
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients, then add the rest except for pecans.
Pat chopped nuts onto the outside of the balls.
Makes 2 balls.

recipes.title: Spanish Noodles
steps: In frying pan with cover, melt shortening.
Add meat and cook until brown.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover and steam until noodles are tender.
Takes about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Country Style Cabbage
ingredients: 3 ham hocks or hunk of ham
steps: Cook ham with some water until tender.
Put cabbage and potatoes with the ham; cook for 30 minutes.
Take up and drain. Cut cabbage as small as you want.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) box twists or shells, cooked and drained
1 lb. County Line cheese, cut up
steps: Mix all together; put in crock-pot.
Cook for 2 or 3 hours. Great to take for carry-ins.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 4 packs crackers, mixed with melted margarine
steps: In a 2-quart casserole, place 1/2 of crackers in bottom.
Mix chicken, sour cream, cream of chicken soup and broth together. Salt and pepper to taste.
Pour over crackers.
Then top with remaining crackers.
Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Cranberry Punch
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Stir in lemonade.
Add cold water and cranberry juice cocktail, chilled.
Pour over ice in punch bowl.
Slowly pour in ginger ale, chilled.
Makes 12 cups.

recipes.title: Pear Honey
steps: Peel pears and crush enough to make 8 cups.
Combine crushed pears with the other ingredients.
Simmer until thickened.
Put in hot jars and seal.

recipes.title: Twice Baked Cheese Potatoes
steps: Bake potatoes in microwave or oven until soft.
Carefully split potatoes lengthwise.
Scoop out contents leaving about 1/8-inch of potatoes in skins all around.

recipes.title: Zucchini Squash Casserole
ingredients: (7-8 oz.) pkg. Pepperidge Farm Herb Stuffing Mix
steps: Boil zucchini for 5 minutes along with the onion.
Drain water off and remove onion.
Mix soup and sour cream together. Add to zucchini.
Mix stuffing in a bowl with melted margarine. Put half of the stuffing mixture into a rectangular 13 x 9 baking dish.
Press into pan.
Pour zucchini mixture on top.
Sprinkle with remainder of stuffing mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Superb Sausage Dressing
ingredients: 12 oz. can whole kernel corn, drained
steps: In large skillet, crumble sausage.
Cook sausage, onion and celery until sausage is no longer pink.
Stir in pecans; cook until sausage is lightly brown.
Pour mixture into large roasting pan to mix.
Add corn, mushrooms, butter, sage and fruit.
Stir well until blended.
Stir in eggs, then mix in the cornbread.
Add broth and stir to mix.
Beat the eggs and add to mixture.
Let set for 15 to 20 minutes to absorb the liquid.
If moister dressing is desired, add more broth.
Bake in same roasting pan or transfer to two 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pans.
Bake in 400° oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until crusty brown on top.

recipes.title: Light Summer Casserole
steps: Brown meat in salt (no oil or shortening).
Drain on paper towel.
Spray casserole with Pam.
Layer zucchini slices (unpeeled), 1/2 of meat, onion slices, tomato chunks and croutons. Repeat layers.
Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Bake, covered, at 375° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Crawfish Fettucine
steps: Cook fettucine according to directions.
Melt margarine in a large pan; saute onion, bell pepper and celery until golden.
Stir in soups, garlic and sherry.
Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and crawfish.
Simmer 20 to 25 minutes.
Serve over cooked fettucine.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Pretty Holiday Divinity
steps: Butter sides of 2-quart saucepan and place first 4 ingredients in.
Cook; stir constantly until sugar dissolves and mix comes to a boil.
Cook to hard ball stage (250°) without stirring.
Beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
Gradually beat in gelatin until stiff peaks form.
Pour hot syrup slowly over egg white mixture. Beat constantly at high speed until soft peaks form and mixture starts to lose its gloss.
Stir in nuts and coconut.
Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Poultry Dressing
steps: In a skillet, brown sausage.
Drain and discard the drippings. In a large mixing bowl, combine sausage and remaining ingredients; mix well.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Salad
steps: Put dry Jell-O in bottom of bowl.
Add fruit cocktail; stir. Add mini marshmallows, any amount you want.
Add cottage cheese and Cool Whip.
Mix and let stand to set.
Mix before serving.

recipes.title: Chichi Dango(Microwave)
steps: Mix mochiko and sugar.
Add milk and water.
Stir until well mixed.
Add extract and food coloring.
Mix well.
Spray a 5 cup microwave Bundt or ring pan with Pam.
Pour mixture into pan. Cover with plastic wrap.
Microwave on High for 5 minutes.
Remove and cool (be careful, the mochi will be very hot and sticky). When completely cooled, cut with plastic knife and roll in potato starch or kinako.

recipes.title: Cranberry Casserole
steps: Put in casserole dish.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken Salad
steps: Place the first 5 ingredients in mixing bowl.
In smaller bowl, make dressing with mayo, sour cream, curry powder, lemon juice and salt; pour over chicken mixture and toss.
Chill 30 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Big Batch Fudge
steps: In a large heavy saucepan, put the sugar and evaporated milk. Bring slowly to a rolling boil.
Let boil for no longer than 8 minutes, stirring constantly, to keep from scorching.
Remove from heat and add the marshmallows, chocolate chips and butter or margarine. Stir until melted and well blended.
Add broken nutmeats and vanilla. Spread in large ungreased (at least 9 x 13-inches) pan.
When cool, cut into squares.
Makes a huge batch, about 4 to 5 pounds of fudge.

recipes.title: Butterflies
ingredients: 1 c. powdered sugar or Karo or light corn syrup
steps: Put 2 egg roll skins together.
Cut into thirds.
(Each third makes one butterfly or bow.)
Seal both ends together with water. Cut a 1 1/2-inch slit in the center of each egg roll skin.
Fold skin back and around through the slit to form loose "bow" or "butterfly" shape.
Heat oil to 375°.
Deep fry skins to a golden brown color.
Drain on paper towel. Sift powdered sugar or drizzle Karo syrup or light corn syrup over skins.

recipes.title: Nutty Cracker Delights
steps: Place crackers in a single layer in a foil-lined 15 x 10-inch baking pan.
In a saucepan over medium heat, melt butter.
Add sugar; bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil 2 minutes. Remove from the heat. Add vanilla.
Pour evenly over crackers; sprinkle with nuts.

recipes.title: Basic Loaf Recipe
ingredients: 1 c. chopped vegetables (onion, celery and green pepper)
steps: Saute
vegetables
in
3 tablespoons water with garlic. Mix together
all
ingredients.
Loaf
should be moist but not runny. Bake in sprayed pan at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Gooey Cake
steps: Mix with electric mixer until creamy.
Pour on top of cake. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Sprinkle with xxx when cool.

recipes.title: Salsa
ingredients: 1 (No. 2) can tomatoes or fresh tomatoes, chopped, diced or crushed *
4 (more if you like it hot) hot peppers (jalapeno or hot banana peppers)
1 bunch green peppers (for color), cut fine
steps: *Stewed tomatoes or diced are really the best.

recipes.title: Easy Fruit Mix
steps: Drain the juice from the oranges.
Add pineapples and juice and pudding mix.
Stir.
Add sliced bananas.
Chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Fiesta Sandwich
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) round loaf sour dough bread
1/2 c. prepared refried black bean dip
4 oz. sweet red pepper, in strips
4 oz. Monterey Jack cheese with jalapeno, cubed
steps: Cut off top 1/3 of loaf of bread and set aside, then hollow out; leaving 1/2-inch thick crust all around.
Spread cut surfaces with bean dip.
Layer as follows: Colby Jack, half the red pepper, Monterey Jack with jalapeno, olive slices, tomato cubes, Cheddar and avocado.
Top with remainder of red pepper.
Combine shredded taco cheese with salad dressing and spoon on top.
Replace top of bread loaf.
Wrap tightly in foil and keep cool until ready to serve.
If desired, heat in oven or over coals to warm and melt cheese.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Freezer Peach Jam
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Cook peaches to soften and crush with spoon.
Add pineapple. Add sugar.
Boil for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and add jello. Stir until dissolved.
Pour into jars with lids.
Let cool to room temperature and store in freezer until ready to use.
Makes 5 to 6 pints.

recipes.title: Raisin Pie
ingredients: 16 saltine crackers rolled into coarse crumbs
steps: Mix all ingredients and cook over medium heat until thickened.	Pour into pie crusts; top with crust.
Cut slits in top crusts.
Bake at 350° for 35-45 minutes or until crust is done.
Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Poppy Cox
steps: Mix together popped corn and pecans.
Combine sugar, Karo, butter or margarine and salt in saucepan and stir until it boils. Cook syrup, stirring occasionally for 10 to 12 minutes, until it turns caramel color.
Remove from fire and add vanilla.
Pour over popcorn mix and stir until covered.
Spread on waxed paper until cool.
Break in pieces and store in a closed container.

recipes.title: Triple Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 jar hot fudge ice cream topping, warmed in microwave to make it more spreadable
steps: Bake chocolate cake according to directions.
Immediately after taking cake from the oven, use a fork to poke holes in the cake.
Pour the can of sweetened condensed milk over the hot cake. Next, pour a jar of hot fudge topping over the cake.
Cool cake in refrigerator. Before serving, top with chocolate Dream Whip.

recipes.title: Garam Masala(Indian Spice Mix)
ingredients: 1 tsp. whole cardamom seed, pods removed
steps: In 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan, combine and roast in 350° oven for 15 minutes.
In blender, place roasted spices.
Cover tightly; blend until fine.
Cool and store in covered container.

recipes.title: Tomato Pie
steps: Put sliced tomatoes into baked pie shell. Mix cheese, mayonnaise and basil. Pour over tomatoes. Bake at 450° until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Mock Cheese Cake
ingredients: 12 oz. softened cream cheese (1 large, 1 small)
steps: Blend first 3 ingredients.
Press into 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Bake at 350° for 6 to 10 minutes.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
steps: Boil chicken until tender; debone and cube.
Cook onion, celery and green pepper in 1 cup chicken stock.
Cook spaghetti in remaining broth; drain.
Mix all ingredients together and turn into casserole dish.
Bake at 350° until hot and cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Cheese Pudding
ingredients: 9 slices white bread in small pieces
steps: Soak bread in margarine. Add grated cheese, milk, pepper, salt, mustard and egg yolks. Mix together. Fold in egg whites into mixture. Pour into buttered dish. Chill 12 to 24 hours. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Chili(Meatless)
ingredients: 1 can (15 to 16 oz.) Great Northern beans, rinsed and drained
1 can (15 oz.) navy beans, rinsed and drained
steps: In large saucepan, cook the onion and green pepper in 1/2 cup water until tender.
Add beans, tomato paste and tomatoes.
Stir in chili powder, salt, pepper and remaining water; bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter And Pork Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 medium red or green pepper, cut in 1-inch pieces (1 c.)
1 medium onion, sliced and separated into rings (1/2 c.)
steps: In wok or large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil.
Stir-fry pork 3 minutes or until pink is gone.
Remove from pan.
Add rest of oil, carrots, pepper, celery and onion; stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add beans; stir-fry for 1 minute or until veggies are tender-crisp.

recipes.title: Slam Enchilada Casserole
steps: Layer with shells on bottom of 10 x 13-inch dish.
Spread beans, meat and cheeses.
Repeat and pour can of sauce over entire dish.
Top with remaining cheese, olives and peppers.
Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Dinner
steps: In skillet, brown meat.
Season with pepper and garlic powder. In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, thinly layer the beef, potatoes and onion slices.
Pour soup over all.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Swedish Meat Balls
steps: Mix meat and the next 4 ingredients to make meat balls.
Form into balls and saute in butter.
Heat pizza sauce and jelly in pot until jelly melts and sauce is hot.
Add meat balls; cook and serve.
Makes 40 meat balls.

recipes.title: Pancakes
steps: Mix Master Mix and sugar together.
Blend slightly beaten egg with fork to water.
Stir water/egg mixture into dry ingredients. Drop onto preheated skillet that has been sprayed with Pam. Skillet should be on medium-high.
Yields 8 to 10 pancakes.

recipes.title: Sheryl Stuff
steps: Spray pan with pam and add all stuff.
Cook until tender.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Olive Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients, adding milk slowly to achieve dipping consistency. Chill and serve with potato chips or Ritz crackers.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 lb. loaf bread or equivalent, coarsely broken
steps: Pour hot milk over bread in large bowl.
Blend eggs, sugar and vanilla together; add to bread and mix well.
Add raisins.
Pour mixture into baking dish.
Bake 40 minutes in 350° oven until firm and golden brown.
Makes 24 servings.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Pie
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated quick crescent dinner rolls
steps: Brown ground beef in skillet.
Drain off fat.
Add onions, salt, pepper, 1/2 tsp.
Italian seasoning and 1 can tomato paste. Blend well.
Unroll and separate dough into 8 triangles.
Place in ungreased 9-inch pie pan, pressing pieces together to form crust. Turn meat mixture into unbaked crust and top with cheese slices. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with sauce made from combined remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: One Dish Meal
steps: Brown hamburger and drain.
Spray skillet with Pam and add carrots, bread crumbs, eggs, salt, pepper and onion; brown on both sides.
Place all in baking dish and cover with potatoes.
Cover dish with foil and bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
ingredients: 2 small boxes sugar-free instant vanilla pudding
steps: Mix pudding with milk as directed on box.
Mix in about 1/2 of Cool Whip. Layer cookies, bananas and pudding.
Spread remaining Cool Whip on top.

recipes.title: Delicious Fruit Dip
steps: Beat together until very creamy.
Refrigerate.
Delicious with cantaloupe, honeydew, grapes, pineapple, strawberries, etc.

recipes.title: Quick Heavenly Hash
steps: Combine all ingredients in bowl; mix well.
Chill 30 minutes or more before serving.
Double recipe, if need to.

recipes.title: Easy Cocoa Pudding
steps: Mix first four ingredients.
Mix until smooth with 1 cup milk. In a large iron skillet, scald the rest of the milk.
Add the cornstarch mixture.
Stir constantly until it boils and thickens. Stir in margarine.

recipes.title: Broken Glass Dessert
steps: Dissolve each of the first three Jell-Os separately in 1 cup boiling water.
Add 1/2 cup cold water.
Pour in separate pans (9 x 9-inch or such).
Refrigerate until solid.

recipes.title: Garden Salad
ingredients: 3 tsp. sugar or artificial sweetener (1 to 2 packets)
steps: Stir and refrigerate for later use.

recipes.title: Yum Yum Cake
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple in its own juice (not heavy syrup)
steps: Make cake as directed. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together pineapple and sugar; bring to a boil.
Pour over warm cake.
Cook pudding according to package directions.
While still warm, pour over pineapple mixture.
Cool and top with Cool Whip. Must be kept in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cottage cheese or Ricotta cheese
1 lb. lean ground beef or raw ground turkey
steps: Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain. Stir margarine, Parmesan cheese and eggs into cooked spaghetti.
Spoon mixture into a buttered 9-inch pie plate, pressing to form a "crust". Spread cottage cheese over crust.

recipes.title: Hot Spinach Balls
steps: Cook spinach and drain, squeezing out all liquid. Mix all ingredients. Chill 2 hours or more. Roll into 1-inch balls. Freeze or refrigerate until ready to use. Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 cans Carnation evaporated milk and 1/2 c. homogenized milk
steps: Use a pan 10 inches long, 6 inches wide and 2 inches deep. Grease pan with margarine.
Butter the bread and cut into squares. Put 1 layer of buttered bread into greased pan.
Shake raisins in flour and place some on the first layer of bread.
Put second layer of buttered bread.
Put raisins on second layer of buttered bread, then pour the mixture of eggs, milk, sugar and vanilla over the bread and bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour or until brown.
Let cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Amaretto Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines butter recipe golden cake mix
1 (3.4 oz.) pkg. pistachio instant pudding mix
steps: Grease and flour bundt pan. Sprinkle almonds in bottom and slightly up sides of pan. Mix remaining ingredients together and beat 2 minutes with mixer. Pour batter in pan. Bake at 325° for 55 minutes. As soon as cake comes out of oven, punch as many holes as you can in it with an ice pick. Slowly pour on about 1/2 of glaze. Invert cake on plate and spoon on remaining glaze.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Thaw the potatoes.
Mix all the ingredients.
Take 2 cups corn flakes and mix with 1/4 cup butter.
Put it on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped Eggplant
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
steps: Cook diced eggplant in boiling, salted water until tender, 6 to 7 minutes; drain.
Gradually stir milk into soup, blend in egg. Add drained eggplant, onion and 1/4 cup stuffing; toss lightly to mix.
Turn into greased 10 x 6 x 1/2-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: Barbecued Ribs
ingredients: 4 to 6 lb. spareribs, split and cut into serving pieces
steps: Place ribs in 4 quarts boiling water; boil 20 minutes.
Drain.

recipes.title: Boston Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 c. navy beans, small white or Great Northern beans
steps: Wash beans.
Soak overnight.
Add salt; stir and drain, reserving liquid.
Preheat oven to 300°.
Cut off the third of the salt pork and place the piece on the bottom of bean pot.
Add beans to pot.

recipes.title: Tostada Platter
steps: Mix refried beans and salsa.
Spread on a platter.
Mix sour cream, green onions, avocado and olives.
Spread over beans. Sprinkle lettuce, tomatoes and cheeses over sour cream.
Place chips around edges and in separate bowl.

recipes.title: Andi'S Spicy Enchilada Casserole(Easyee)
ingredients: 1 family size can cream of chicken
1 lb. boneless skinless chicken breast or 1 lb. ground beef*
1 pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese or Three Cheese mix (your preference)
steps: You will need one large bowl, one large spoon and one medium sized glass dish.

recipes.title: Pacific Lime Mold
steps: Dissolve jello in water.
Add juice from pineapple.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Beat until frothy.
Fold into remaining ingredients.
Chill until set.

recipes.title: Mexican Beef Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. uncooked elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes, cut up and drained
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large skillet, brown meat and pour off fat.
Add green pepper, onion and garlic.
Cook and stir until tender. Stir in cooked macaroni, water, tomatoes, tomato paste, corn and olives.
Pour into a 3-quart shallow baking dish (13 x 9-inch).
Stir together tomato sauce and seasonings.
Pour over macaroni mixture.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until hot.
Top with corn chips and cheese.
Bake 5 minutes longer or until cheese melts.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Lime Salad
ingredients: 2 medium size cans crushed pineapple, drained
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients; cool, but do not set.
Mix next 2 ingredients together, then stir or fold into first 3 ingredients. Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan.
Refrigerate until molded. Serves 12 to 15.

recipes.title: Zucchini With Garlic And Onion
steps: Wash and dry zucchini; shred each into a bowl, then put into an absorbent towel to remove as much moisture as possible.
Heat butter until bubbly.
Chop garlic finely; add to butter along with onion.
Cook garlic and onion until soft.
Add zucchini and cook, stirring, for 3 to 4 minutes.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Salsa
ingredients: 1 fresh jalepeno pepper, diced very fine
1 bunch green onions chopped end to end
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Turtle Brownies
steps: Combine caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk in top of double boiler on low heat and stir until mixture is melted.

recipes.title: Spring Delight Cake
steps: Mix and pour in a greased and floured pan.
Bake at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Icing For Sponge Cake Or Angel Food Cake
steps: Blend and bring to a boil.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Chill 2 hours. Whip the cream and fold into jello mixture.
Cut cake in half and use some for filling.
Place other half of cake on top and use remaining icing to cover whole cake.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
steps: Brown ground beef with onion.
Drain.
Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer 1/2 hour.
Use for spaghetti.
May leave out water or cook longer to make thicker to use with lasagna noodles.

recipes.title: Shrimp Mold
steps: Soak gelatin in clam juice.
Blend cream cheese and mayonnaise. Add celery, onion and rest of seasonings.
Add gelatin mixture; blend well.
Fold in shrimp and clams.
Pour into a 6-cup oiled mold.
I use a fish mold.
Chill overnight.
Unmold on large serving dish.
May be decorated to resemble a fish or sprinkled with paprika.
Serve with crackers.
Will serve a large party.

recipes.title: Fern'S No Trouble Pickles
steps: Slice medium size cucumbers lengthwise; pack cold in quart jars.
Add 1 tsp. salt and pinch of alum in each jar.
Dissolve sugar in vinegar and water; boil rapidly.
Pour over cucumbers in jars and seal.
Process in boiling water bath for about 10 minutes, or until they begin to change color.

recipes.title: Corn-Potato Chowder
ingredients: 1 pkg. Betty Crocker sour cream and chive potatoes
steps: Heat margarine in saucepan until melted.
Stir in onion and cook until tender.
Stir in package potatoes with sauce mix, water and milk.
Heat to boiling, stir frequently.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer, stirring frequently, until potatoes are tender (20 to 25 minutes).
Stir in corn with liquid, salt, pepper and red pepper sauce.
Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes more.
Recipe can be doubled, just as good the next day reheated.

recipes.title: Marinated Salad
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) cans chopped sauerkraut, washed well and drained
1/2 c. chopped fine green bell pepper
steps: Bring to boil the sugar, oil, vinegar and water.
Cool to lukewarm and pour over sauerkraut, pepper, onion and carrot. Chill; keep in covered bowl.
Will keep 2 or more weeks.

recipes.title: Summer Casserole
steps: Cut wieners into thin slices.
Saute green pepper and onion in butter.
Stir in bread crumbs, beans, wieners and cheese.
Place in a 4-quart casserole dish.
Cover.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Soak onions and cucumbers in salt water overnight.
In the morning, pour off salt water.
Heat vinegar, sugar and spices to boiling.
Add pickles and heat to boiling point.
Fill jars and seal tight.
Makes 6 pints.

recipes.title: Italian Meat Balls And Sauce
steps: Simmer together for some time.

recipes.title: Camper'S Cocoa
steps: Mix together all ingredients.
To make cocoa, put 1/3 cup of mix in cup.
Add hot water.
Will keep forever.

recipes.title: Barbecued Shrimp
steps: Melt butter in a large baking dish.
Add all other ingredients except shrimp and mix well.
Add shrimp and mix well. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Dogs In Sauce
steps: Place hot dogs in a baking dish.
Mix all other ingredients together.
Pour over hot dogs.
Bake in covered dish for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
steps: Beat pudding and milk until thick.
Add sour cream and Cool Whip.
Alternate layers of bananas and wafers.
Spread pudding on each layer.
Put Cool Whip and sour cream on top.
Sprinkle with graham crackers or vanilla wafers.

recipes.title: Cherry Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together until well blended.
Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Chop all ingredients in blender. Add cream cheese and Accent to mixture.
Shape into large ball.
Wrap and refrigerate.
Let set for several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Peach Pie-Fresh
steps: Boil sugar, water, and cornstarch until thickened.
Add lemon gelatin (mix with a little water first), butter and coloring. Pour some into baked pie shell.
Slice fresh peaches into it.
Add more mix.
Top with whipped whipping cream.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Place confectioners sugar in a bowl.
Cut in the peanut butter with a pastry blender until crumbly.
Set aside 2 teaspoons for garnish.
Sprinkle remaining crumbs into a pie shell.
Combine 2/3 cup sugar, 1/3 cup cornstarch, egg yolks and milk.
Cook over medium heat until mixture thickens. Remove from the heat; add butter and vanilla, stirring until butter melts.
Pour into pie shell.

recipes.title: Dried Beef Dip
ingredients: 1 jar dried beef, snipped, rinsed and drained
steps: Mix ingredients, except walnuts; top with walnuts. Put in casserole or baking dish.
Heat in oven at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Simple "Strawberry Pie"
steps: Mix milk and Cool Whip together, adding just enough lemon juice to thicken mixture.
Pour into pie shells; garnish with strawberries.

recipes.title: Pink Salad
steps: Combine cottage cheese and jello.
Then add Cool Whip. Refrigerate, then serve as dessert.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
steps: Combine and cook over low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Gone!!!
steps: Line jelly roll pan with aluminum foil.
Line pan with saltine crackers, salt side up.
Melt margarine with sugar and bring to a boil.
Pour over saltines; spread evenly.
Bake at 400° for 8 minutes.
Take out of oven and sprinkle with chocolate chips. Spread with a knife as chips melt.
Sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate for several hours.
Break into pieces for serving. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Pink Lemonade Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together and pour into pie crust.

recipes.title: Pepper And Cabbage Relish
steps: Put tomatoes, cabbage and salt through food chopper.
Place in a cloth bag and drain overnight.
Next morning, put peppers and onions through chopper.
Mix vinegar, brown sugar, cinnamon, black pepper and celery seed in large pot, then add all chopped vegetables and bring to a boil.
Cook slowly for 30 minutes.
Put in hot jars and seal.

recipes.title: Lobster Cakes With Corn Chowder
ingredients: Salt, pepper and hot sauce to taste
steps: Mix together first 10 ingredients.
Fold in lobster meat and season to taste.
Add enough cracker crumbs until all blends together.
Form 8 small cakes.
Preheat oven to 357 degrees.
Place cakes on lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes.
To serve, place lobster cake in soup plate.
Pour chowder around. Enjoy!

recipes.title: African Stew
ingredients: 3 large sweet potatoes cut in chunks
1 (12 oz.) can condensed low fat milk
steps: Brown beef in skillet then place in stew pot.
Add vegetables, tomatoes and spices.
Cook until tender. Add warm stew juice to the peanut butter.
Add mixture to stew pot.
Before serving, add condensed milk.
1/2 hour prep time.
1 1/4 hours cooking time.

recipes.title: Baked Stuffed Shrimp
steps: Melt butter in saucepan.
Add garlic and saute on low heat until soft.
Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients. Stuff each shrimp.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Party Dip
ingredients: 1 (2 oz.) pkg. dry light or reduced calorie Ranch dip mix
steps: Mix and serve.
Store in refrigerator.
Makes 16 tablespoons. Per tablespoon:
18 calories, 0.5 mg cholesterol, 0.03 g fat, 247 mg Na.

recipes.title: Marbled Cheesecake Bars
ingredients: 2 c. finely crushed Oreo cookies (approximately 24 cookies)
steps: Preheat oven to 300°.
Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch baking pan in oven.
After margarine is melted, remove from oven.
Press crushed Oreo cookies firmly and evenly.
In large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.
Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.
Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.
Pour half of the batter evenly over prepared crust.
Stir melted chocolate into remaining batter; spoon over vanilla batter.
With table knife or spatula, gently swirl through batter to marble.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until set.
Cool.
Chill.
Cut into bars.
Store covered in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cake Cookies
steps: *Lemon cake mix and strawberry work well for these cookies.

recipes.title: Forgotten Cookies
steps: Beat egg whites and salt until stiff.
Add sugar slowly.
Fold in nuts and chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet covered with aluminum foil.
Place in 350° preheated oven.
Turn off and leave overnight.

recipes.title: Buttercream Frosting
steps: Whip egg whites. Add sugar, one tablespoon at a time, and continue to whip until egg whites form peaks. Scald milk and add to egg whites while beating. Add butter or oleo, 1 teaspoon at a time. Then add shortening and vanilla. Beat for a long time until desired consistency.

recipes.title: Fruited Blue Cheese Dressing
steps: In tightly covered jar, shake Blue cheese dressing, orange juice and lemon juice together.
Refrigerate at least 3 hours to blend flavors.
Shake well.

recipes.title: Magic Cookie Bars(Makes 24 To 36 Bars.)
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
steps: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish). In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine; pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients; press down firmly.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Cut into bars. Store loosely covered at room temperature.

recipes.title: Summer Strawberry Soup
ingredients: 1 or 2 Tbsp. raspberry vinegar or white wine vinegar
sliced fresh strawberries or fresh mint (optional)
steps: In a 1-quart saucepan bring wine and ginger to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
Add heavy cream.
