Return to boiling and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.

recipes.title: Bruschetta
ingredients: 1/2 c. sun-dried tomatoes, packed in oil
steps: Preheat the oven on broiler setting.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the roma tomatoes, sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, vinegar, basil, salt and pepper. Allow the mixture to sit for 10 minutes.
Cut the baguette into 3/4 inch slices.

On a baking sheet, arrange the baguette slices in a single layer. Broil for 1 to 2 minutes, until slightly brown. Divide the tomato mixture evenly over the baguette slices. Top the slices with mozzarella cheese.
Broil for 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook the broccoli as directed, then add the mayonnaise, onion, grated cheese, eggs, soup and salt and pepper to taste.
Bake at 375° for 35 to 45 minutes.
Mix the stuffing mix with the melted butter.
Put over top of broccoli and bake another 2 to 3 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Cheese Bars
steps: Slightly beat first 5 ingredients.
Cook in microwave until thick, then add remaining ingredients.
Cool.
Pour into your baked pie crust.
Add meringue.
Bake.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
steps: Cook the sweet potatoes and then mash them. Combine all of the ingredients together in a mixing bowl and then pour into the unbaked pie crusts. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pop Cake #2(Sugar-Free)
steps: Bake the cake mix in an oblong 9 x 13 pan.
When done, punch full of holes and pour the strawberry pop over this while cake is hot.
Mix up the Jell-O with 1 cup of water and also pour over cake.
Put in the refrigerator to cool.
When cool, ice.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Soften cream cheese; then add rest of ingredients and mix well.
Chill until firm enough to handle.
Shape with hands into large ball (or smaller individual ones).
Roll in cracker crumbs or finely chopped nuts.
Refrigerate.
Serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Butter Rolls
ingredients: 1 can biscuits or make your own
steps: Roll each biscuit until thin.
Add 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 pats margarine and a little cinnamon to each biscuit.
Roll up and pinch ends.
Put in single layer.
Sprinkle sugar on top (about 1/2 cup for 5 biscuits) and a little cinnamon.
Pour milk to just cover biscuits.
Bake at 350° until biscuits are done.
Baste with juice while cooking.
Juice will be just a little thick.

recipes.title: Crystallized Slice Tomatoes
steps: Soak tomatoes
overnight in water in which the lime has been added. Drain;
rinse and soak in clear water for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Linda'S Refrigerator Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 medium onions, chopped very fine (use food processor if you have one)
1/2 (14 oz.) jar Clemente Jacque jalapenos, chopped very fine
2 Tbsp. vinegar (optional; will help sauce last longer. I don't use)
steps: Drain all but 1 can of the tomatoes.
Put in blender, one can at a time.
Be careful not to blend too long.
Just process until tomatoes are fine cut/not mushy.
Pour into large bowl.
Add the onions to the tomato mixture.
Add the Serrano peppers to the tomato mixture (will find these in produce section).
Add the jalapenos to the mixture.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Stir all until well mixed.
Spoon into containers, 7 to 8 pint jars.
Must refrigerate.
This is not a "canned" recipe.

recipes.title: Banana Freezer Pops
ingredients: 1 can (6-oz) frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
steps: Peel bananas; break into chunks.
Place in food processor or blender container.
Add orange juice concentrate, water, honey and vanilla; process until smooth.
Pour banana mixture evenly into cups.
Cover top of each cup with small piece of aluminum foil. Insert wooden stick through center of foil into banana mixture. Place cups on tray; freeze until firm, about 3 hours.
To serve; remove foil; tear off paper cups (or slide out of plastic cups). Serves 8.

recipes.title: Chili Bean Dip
steps: Place drained beans, vinegar, chili powder and cumin in blender.
Blend until smooth.
Remove mixture from blender.
Stir in onion and parsley.
Serve with raw vegetables sticks.

recipes.title: Baked Bologna
ingredients: 1 large bologna (according to how many you serve)
steps: With sharp knife, cut skin of bologna. Cut into 1/2-inch or more diamond shapes.
Punch holes all the way through so the basting gets in all the meat. Baste generously with brown sugar and pineapple or use any kind of jelly to suit taste.

Bake in oven until piping hot all the way through, or if you prefer, put on rotisserie and use barbecue sauce instead of brown sugar. Baste every 15 minutes for a barbecue flavor. Delicious either way.

recipes.title: Famous Johnnycakes
steps: Combine sugar and salt with meal in a large mixing bowl. Scald with boiling water and stir well.
Thin immediately with milk so mixture will drop easily from spoon (additional milk may be necessary).

recipes.title: Caramel Fudge Cake
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare cake mix as package directs.
Pour 2 cups batter into pan and bake 15 minutes.
Melt caramels and margarine in saucepan and remove from heat.
Add milk and mix well.
Spread caramel mixture evenly over cake.
Spread remaining cake batter over caramel mixture.
Top with nuts.
Return cake to oven and bake 30 to 35 minutes or until cake springs back.
Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Waldorf Salad
steps: Mix all together until well blended.

recipes.title: Spinach Balls
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. garlic salt or garlic powder
8 oz. pkg. Pepperidge Farm bread cubes
steps: Mix all together and refrigerate overnight.
Form into balls. Put on a baking sheet with sides.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped Pineapple
ingredients: 4 c. bread cubes or bread pieces
steps: Mix together the oleo, eggs and sugars.
Blend in pineapple and bread pieces.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.
Superb with ham.
(Use Pyrex casserole dish.)

recipes.title: Pumpkin Upside-Down Cake
steps: Mix and pour in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Party Cheese Ball
steps: Mix ingredients together thoroughly.
Chill for several hours. Shape into a ball.
Roll in finely chopped pecans, dried beef or toasted almonds.

recipes.title: Skillet Beef Ole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can kidney beans, drained (reserve liquid)
1 (7 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
steps: Brown meat in a large, heavy skillet over medium heat.
Stir with a wooden spoon to break into small pieces.
Add onion, green pepper and red pepper.
Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp. Gently stir in salt, chili powder, basil, garlic, beans and corn. Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes to blend flavors.
Stir in some of the reserved bean liquid if you want to increase moistness.
Gently stir in the olives and parsley.
Heat through and serve with a green salad and French bread.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts And Stuffing
steps: Boil chicken.
Throw away skin and bones.
Break up meat.
Mix stuffing mix with seasoning packet and 2 cups chicken broth from boiled chicken pot.
Add 1/2 can of soup plus eggs.
Mix well. Put in greased baking dish.
Combine chicken meat and other 1/2 can of soup plus 1/2 cup milk and spread over stuffing mixture. Bake for 45 minutes at 350°, uncovered.

recipes.title: Salmon Bake
steps: Place salmon fillets in aluminum foil (skin side down).
Baste with Wish Bone salad dressing.
Place thin slices of tomatoes and lemons on top of fish.
Roll in foil and broil slowly on grill 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines sugar cookie mix
steps: Mix cookie mix, egg and water.
Spread on lightly greased pizza pan.
Bake at 300° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken
ingredients: 1 (5.2 oz.) pkg. Uncle Ben's Country Inn Recipes homestyle chicken and vegetables
4 small chicken breast halves, boned and skinned
3/4 c. sugar snap peas or pea pods, cut in half if large, thawed if frozen
steps: Prepare rice according to package directions, adding snap peas after 18 minutes of cooking.
While rice is cooking, pound chicken to 1/2-inch thickness.
Place on rack of broiler pan.
Combine honey, soy sauce, ginger, garlic and red pepper.
Spoon half of mixture over chicken; let stand 5 to 10 minutes.
Broil 4-inches from heat for 6 minutes; turn and baste with remaining honey mixture.
Continue broiling until chicken is cooked through, about 4 minutes.
Serve chicken along side rice; sprinkle rice with black pepper to taste.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Puddin
ingredients: 1 large pkg. instant vanilla pudding, mixed per pkg. directions
steps: After mixing vanilla pudding as directed by the box (wire whisk works great), add Eagle Brand milk; whisk. Then add the Cool Whip; whisk. Lay vanilla wafers on the bottom of the pan you plan to use; top each wafer with a slice of banana. Next pour pudding mixture over bananas. Slide wafers down along the sides of the pan.

recipes.title: Touch O Spice Cider
steps: In a saucepan, simmer cider, water and spices together for 10 minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with an orange slice.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
steps: Follow directions on package for cooking macaroni, then drain and wash with cold water.

recipes.title: Pizza Bread
steps: Thaw bread dough.
When thawed, roll on floured board until rectangular in shape.
Add pepperoni and shredded Mozzarella cheese, leaving about 1 inch of dough on edges with no cheese. Roll up dough, jelly roll fashion, and place, seam side down, in a ring on greased cookie sheet.
Bake according to bread recipe, or until brown on top.
Great!

recipes.title: Catfish Stew
steps: Cook in pressure cooker for 15 minutes the fish, onions, potatoes and celery.
Then
add tomatoes and margarine.
Simmer until done.

recipes.title: Bean Dip
steps: Put small amount of oil in frying pan. Smash beans and cumin together and simmer until well blended.
Put in 9-inch pie pan. Layer picante sauce, then cheese. Top with lettuce, tomato and onion. Dip with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Pistachio Salad
steps: Mix together pistachio pudding and crushed pineapple.
Add marshmallows, pecans and Cool Whip.
Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Cranberry Shrub
steps: When ready to serve combine juices well; pour in punch bowl. Top with scoops of sherbet.
Yields 3 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Fresh Lemonade
steps: Thinly slice lemons crosswise.
Discard end slices and seeds. Put lemon slices in a sturdy pitcher.
Add sugar.
Stir with wooden spoon until sugar is dissolved; let set 10 minutes.
Add 1 tray of ice cubes and 6 cups of cold water.
Stir well.
Makes 8 tall glasses.

recipes.title: Aunt Alma'S Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 bag Doritos taco chips, crushed in bag
steps: In memory of Aunt Alma Bunch.

recipes.title: Carrots
steps: Slice carrots and cook; do not overcook.
Drain, then add thin sliced green pepper and onion.
Mix soup, sugar, oil and vinegar; bring to a boil.
Pour over vegetables.
Let stand for 24 hours. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
steps: Butter bottom and sides of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place layer of whole graham crackers in bottom of pan.
Beat pudding and milk. Add the container of Cool Whip and mix well.
Pour half the pudding mixture over the layer of crackers.
Top with another layer of crackers.
Pour remaining half of pudding over the crackers and top with another layer of crackers.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese And Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 1 can (20 oz.) crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Dissolve jellos in boiling water.
Add cold water and pineapple.
Stir Miracle Whip into cottage cheese and add to jello-pineapple mixture.
Stir in chopped nuts.
Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Banana Daiquiri
ingredients: 1 heaping ice cream scoop frozen limeade
2 small ice cream scoops of vanilla ice cream
steps: In blender, put banana broken into chunks.
Add lots of ice, frozen limeade, ice cream and rum.
Blend, adding cold water to thin while blending.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Pecan Goodies
steps: Mix egg whites, sugar, vanilla and salt together.
Stir in pecans until pecans are coated.
Lay on cookie sheet.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 275°.

recipes.title: Chicken In A Crock-Pot
steps: Put carrots and onions in bottom of crock-pot.
Add whole chicken.
Top with salt and pepper and liquid.
Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 hours, using 1 cup of water.

recipes.title: Cool Whip Jello Salad
steps: Heat pineapple; add Jell-O and dissolve.
Add creamed cottage cheese.
When it jells, add the Cool Whip.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Oven Omelet
ingredients: 2 c. frozen shredded hash brown potatoes
steps: In a large bowl, beat the eggs, milk and salt.
Stir in the remaining ingredients.
Pour into a greased 8 inch square baking dish.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 45 - 50 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Oven Stew
steps: Mix well and bake in tightly covered baking pan at 350° for 3 hours.
Serve over noodles or rice.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Crab Pate
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
1 (6 1/2 oz.) can crab meat, drained and flaked
steps: Heat soup over low heat.
Remove.
Dissolve gelatin in cold water; add to soup.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Spoon into 4-cup mold.
Chill until firm. Serve with assorted crackers. Simply scrumptious!

recipes.title: Plain Cake
ingredients: 1 box lemon supreme cake mix or pineapple
1 (3.4 oz.) box lemon instant pudding mix
steps: Place cake mix, pudding, sugar, margarine and water in bowl and blend well.
Stir in eggs and mix.
Add oil, gradually beating all the while.
Beat for 3 minutes.
Bake in a tube pan that has been greased and floured at 325° for 1 hour.
Let cool and frost with confectioners sugar and milk mixture.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: You make up at home and for Thanksgiving dinner.
Get a brown potato that is white inside.
Carve it out and throw away the peelings.
Smash it good and put some milk in it.
(I think that's how you make it.)

recipes.title: Vanilla Butter Frosting
steps: Mix powdered sugar and oleo; stir in vanilla and milk.
Beat until frosting is smooth and of spreading consistency.

recipes.title: Eggplant Bake
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Mix crumbs, oregano and garlic salt.
Dip eggplant slices in butter, then in crumb mixture.
Place in single layer in greased jelly roll pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch. Spread evenly with tomato sauce.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake until tender, 20 to 30 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Spaghetti And Meat Sauce
steps: In skillet, saute the onion and bell pepper until soft. Add the other ingredients.
Simmer for 1 hour
or
until
all ingredients are done.
Cook 1 package of
spaghetti in boiling salted
water until tender.
Drain in a
colander.	Serve
the meat sauce over the spaghetti.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight
steps: Boil water and dissolve Jell-O in it.
Add Cool Whip and strawberries.
Whip until frothy.
Break cake into bite-size pieces and spread over bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour strawberry mixture over cake.
Chill until set.
Makes 24 servings.

recipes.title: Hostess Twinkie Cake
steps: Make yellow cake and cut into 2 layers. Blend at high speed remaining ingredients, then add 1/4 cup powdered sugar and blend.

recipes.title: Cherry Supreme Jello
ingredients: 1 (21 oz.) can Thank You cherry pie filling
1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add cherry pie filling; stir well.
Add pineapple with juice; mix well.
Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Chill until set.

recipes.title: Cucumber And Noodle Salad
steps: Cook noodles as directed on box.
Combine sliced, peeled cucumbers (thin), chopped onion, pepper and tomato.
Add vinegar and mayonnaise in large bowl.
Add cooked noodles.
Mix well. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Add cheese and mix before serving.

recipes.title: Pepper Relish
steps: Chop peppers and onions; cover with boiling water.
Drain immediately.
Cover with cold water; bring to boil.
Drain and add remaining ingredients.
Cook for 10 minutes.
Put in hot, sterile jars and seal.
No processing necessary.

recipes.title: Cajun Cole Slaw
steps: Slice cabbage.
Mix all ingredients together and add to the cabbage.
Thin the mayonnaise with the beaten egg white and add to the slaw.
(A little vinegar and/or sugar may be added according to your personal taste.)

recipes.title: Taco Dip
steps: Brown hamburger; add taco powder. In baking dish, spread refried beans and hamburger in layers. Heat until warm. Remove from oven; spread sour cream, cheese, tomatoes, lettuce and taco sauce (in layers). Ready to serve.

recipes.title: Candied Pickles
steps: Drain off alum water.
Cover with apple cider vinegar and let stand
24 hours.
Add to this 3 cups sugar for 3 mornings.
Put in jars and seal.
Do not heat anything.

recipes.title: Lucille'S Fancy Chicken
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can cut or slice mushrooms
steps: Remove skin from chicken except wings.
Do not batter.
Brown in butter both sides.
Pour off juices.
Add wine, mushrooms, garlic and water.
Cook slowly until liquid is down and meat is done.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sweet Hot Pickles
steps: Drain pickles; discard juice.
Place all ingredients in a large crock or Pyrex bowl.
Stir until sugar dissolves.
Let sit 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Return to jar.
Turn jar upside down every day for 5 days.
Good for gift giving.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Fruit Salad
steps: Drain pineapple; add to cottage cheese along with the whip cream and pudding.
Garnish with cherries.

recipes.title: Cranberry Orange Mold
ingredients: 2 pkg. (3 oz. each) or 1 (6 oz.) pkg. Jell-O brand gelatin (red)
1 c. (16 oz.) whole berry or jellied cranberry sauce
steps: Or use 1 cup each diced orange sections and chopped apple.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Cook potatoes. Peel and mash. Add butter, milk and salt. Place in a buttered casserole. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Push marshmallows down into mixture. Bake in a 350° oven until marshmallows are brown, about 15 minutes. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Beans
steps: All cans of beans should be 16 ounce size.

recipes.title: Cajun Rush'S Chargrilled Shrimp
ingredients: jumbo shrimp (15 to 20 count; 6 per person)
steps: Peel shrimp, except for final tail section (provides a handle for eating).
Mix all other ingredients in a flat casserole or baking dish and marinate shrimp in resulting sauce for a few minutes.
When chargrill is good and hot, place shrimp on grill. Watch carefully, shrimp cook quickly (2 to 3 minutes).
Turn shrimp after a minute or so and baste with marinade.
Remove from grill as soon as they lose their translucency and turn whitish. Don't overcook! Baste again and serve immediately.
Shrimp should be juicy and full of flavor.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
steps: Cook hamburger meat; drain.
Mix meat with spaghetti sauce; cook until hot.
Pour into casserole dish.
Layer with sour cream, then Cheddar cheese.
Put rolls on top and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Mint Sauce
ingredients: 1 c. fresh mint, chopped very fine
4 Tbsp. white wine or white wine vinegar
steps: Place the mint in a pitcher or gravy boat and pour the boiling water over it.
Wait 20 minutes so that the mint has time to infuse the water.
Add sugar and wine or vinegar.
Stir well and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
steps: Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place slices of cheese over chicken.
Mix soup and water together; pour over top.
Spread crumbs on top, then pour melted butter over all.
Bake at 325° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Buggy Wheels
steps: Wash vegetables.
Cut carrots into circles and celery into sticks.
Attach carrots with toothpicks to front and back sides of celery to make wheels.
Spread peanut butter inside celery sticks. Add raisins on top of peanut butter.
Eat.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Ice Cream
steps: Beat 2 egg whites until stiff and set aside.
Beat rest of eggs with sugar and salt.
Add milks and vanilla.
Fold in egg whites and make in a gallon freezer.
May add fresh or canned fruits.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
steps: Make ground beef and egg into 18 balls.
Brown in oil.
Drain off oil.
Add pineapple juice.
Cook slowly for 5 minutes.
Add mixture of cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar, water and sugar.
Cook until it begins to thicken, stirring constantly.
Add meatballs and chunky pineapple.
Cut green peppers into thin slices lengthwise and put on top.
Heat thoroughly and serve.

recipes.title: Bean Dip
steps: Brown the beef and season with salt and pepper.
In a large saucepan, warm the refried beans, taco seasoning mix and water. Add salsa and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
Scoop mixture into an ovenproof glass pan.
Sprinkle with onion, tomato and cheeses. Bake at 400° until cheese melts.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Chili Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 large green pepper, cut into thin rings
steps: Layer tomato slices and green pepper rings in shallow glass dish.
Shake remaining ingredients, except lettuce, in tightly covered jar.
Pour onto vegetables.
Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours.

recipes.title: Mexican Finger Rolls
ingredients: 4 oz. American or Cheddar cheese, cut into 20 strips (3 x 1/4 inch)
steps: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.
Grease an 11x7-inch baking pan.
Separate biscuits and pat each one to a 3 1/2 inch oval shape.
Place a strip of cheese on each.
Wrap the dough around the cheese strip.
Press all edges to seal.
Place the rolls into prepared pan, making 2 rows.
Combine the margarine and taco seasoning mix.
Brush over top of rolls.
Press the corn chips onto top of rolls.

Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until golden brown. Serve warm. Inside these crunchy rolls is a surprise tunnel of melted cheese. These can be reheated by wrapping them in aluminum foil and placing them in a 400 degree oven for about 8 minutes. They can also be made ahead, covered and refrigerated for up to 2 hours before baking. Makes 20 rolls.

recipes.title: Mexican Meat Loaf
steps: Combine beef, bread crumbs, egg, chilies, cheese and taco seasoning mix.
Mix well and pat into 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake uncovered.
Remove and let stand 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Ziti A La Nancy
steps: Cook ziti and drain.
Brown meat; stir in sauce and parsley. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
Combine Ricotta, Mozzarella, egg, salt and pepper; mix well.
In a large deep casserole or crock-pot, put a layer of sauce first, then alternate layers of ziti, cheese and sauce, ending with sauce. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake in oven at 350° for 40 minutes or in a crock-pot at medium setting for about 4 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Boil chicken until tender.
Cut into bite size pieces.
Mix with soups, sour cream and almonds.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dip
steps: Beat all ingredients together well.
Dip with fresh strawberries.

recipes.title: Ten Vegetable Beef Soup
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. boiling beef with bone
1 small to medium head cabbage, chopped
2 c. lima beans or great Northern beans
steps: Boil
beef
until
done
and remove from broth.
If you want to	remove	grease,
you
need
to let broth get cold and grease will
be
on
top for easy removal.
Put broth in large kettle (10 quart)
to
make soup.
Add cabbage , green beans, potatoes, celery,
carrots,
onions
and lima beans.	Add V-8 juice and cook
hour
or
until vegetables begin to seem done.
Add corn,
peas
and tomatoes last.
Add water or beef bouillon as needed for flavor.	Cook another 1/2 hour and let stand for flavor.
Add beef back in soup, if desired.

recipes.title: Quick Potato Soup
steps: Bring hash browns, onions, chicken broth and water to a boil; heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in soups and milk and heat thoroughly.
Garnish with cheddar cheese or cooked ham or bacon. Makes a crock pot full.

recipes.title: It'S A Mad Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour pineapple with juice in pan, then sprinkle dry cake mix over pineapple.
Sprinkle pecans over cake mixture.
Melt butter or margarine and pour over pecans.
Bake for 50 minutes.
Cherry pie filling or apple pie filling may be substituted for crushed pineapple.

recipes.title: Blender Pecan Pie
steps: Put eggs, sugar, salt, corn syrup, butter and vanilla extract in blender and blend well.
Add 1 c. pecans and blend just enough to chop nuts coarsely.
Pour into pie shells and place pecan halves on top.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake an additional 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hawaii Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into lined pie shell.

recipes.title: Hot Cider Punch
ingredients: 1 1/2 qt. each: water and apple cider
steps: Mix all ingredients together and heat to boiling point.
Makes 3 quarts or 24 punch cups.
Garnish with orange slices, if desired.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding(Side Dish)
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes, or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

recipes.title: Marinated Vegetables
steps: Add 1 large sliced mild onion and lots of chopped celery.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
steps: In a 2-quart saucepan, bring first 4 ingredients to a boil for 1 minute and remove from heat.
Then add the remaining ingredients.
Drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Hot Chili Dip
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can Hormel hot chili (with beans)
steps: Spread cream cheese in a 9 x 9-inch pan. Cover with chili and top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until bubbles.
Swirl after baking until you see cream cheese. Serve with king size corn chips.

recipes.title: 7-Up Salad
steps: Heat 2 cups of water to boiling.
Pour in oblong cake pan. Dissolve Jell-O.
Add 7-Up; stir.
Drain pineapple and oranges (keep only pineapple juice).
Add to Jell-O with sliced bananas. Stir.
Cover with mini marshmallows; set until firm.

recipes.title: Gingerbread Sauce
steps: Heat butter and brown sugar until brown.
Beat yolks of 2 eggs and cream; add to sugar and butter mixture.
Cook on low until thick.

recipes.title: Pineapple Fluff
steps: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, put the cracker crumbs.
Dissolve the marshmallows in the milk on low heat.
Let cool, then add to the pineapple and Cool Whip.
Pour over the graham cracker crumbs, sprinkle cracker crumbs on top.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Russian Chicken
ingredients: chicken breasts (as many as you need)
steps: Mix Russian dressing, preserves and onion soup.
Pour over chicken and refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Grandmom'S Green Tomato Relish
steps: Cut tomatoes and onions into thin slices.
Stew until tender. Jar while hot.

recipes.title: Italian Wedding Soup
steps: Heat chicken broth, cut up chicken, spinach and cooked meat balls.
Cook until spinach is done.
Add pasta and bring to boil. Boil 5 minutes.
Turn off heat.
Beat eggs and Parmesan cheese. Pour on top of soup.
Cover with lid.
Let sit for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Favorite Salad
steps: Drain tomatoes.
Save juice. Add water to make 2 cups.
Heat 1 cup to boiling. Stir in Jell-O. Add the other cup when cool. Mix tomatoes and cottage cheese. Add to gelatin mixture.

recipes.title: Savory Sauerkraut
steps: Mix all ingredients and heat well.
Serve.

recipes.title: Shrimp Spaghetti
steps: Peel and
devein
shrimp
or
you may use thawed frozen shrimp.
Have
ready
cooked spaghetti; set aside.
In heavy 3 quart saucepan, melt butter over medium heat (5 to 7 minutes). Add remaining
ingredients,
except
spaghetti,
tomatoes and cheese. Stir to blend.
Cook
over
medium
heat until shrimp turn pink (5 to 7
minutes).
Add
cooked spaghetti.
Continue cooking until spaghetti
is heated through. Stir occasionally. Remove from heat and add
tomatoes.
Cover and let stand until tomatoes are heated through.
To serve:
Sprinkle with cheese. Serve with salad and garlic bread.
Serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Potato Dish
ingredients: 1 Can Cream of Mushroom or Cream of Chicken Soup
steps: Place potatoes in large bowl, let thaw a little bit.
Add melted oleo and mix well.
Add cheese, mix through.
Mix sour cream and soup together.
Blend it together with onions and potatoes and cheese.
Spread into 9x12 baking dish.
Sprinkle corn flakes over top.
Bake at 350 for 50-60 minutes.

recipes.title: Rocky Road
steps: Melt
chocolate and peanut butter chips together.
Stir in marshmallows
and
melt.
Add
walnuts.
Pour into tinfoil-lined 9 x
13-inch pan.
Refrigerate until hard.
Remove from pan, pull off tin foil and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Vegetable And Cheese Omelette
steps: Heat pan to medium temperature.
Saute vegetables in oil until soft.
In a bowl, whip whole egg, egg white and milk until fluffy. Remove vegetables from pan and begin cooking egg on low heat. After about 2 minutes, add vegetables and shredded cheese.
Season to taste.
Cover and continue to cook until egg is firm and cheese is melted.
Slip spatula under half of firm omelette and fold over.
Slide out of pan onto plate.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
steps: Chop shrimp coarsely.
Add all remaining ingredients, except bread, and mix well.
Pinch out the center of bread in chunks. Reserve chunks until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Northern Potatoes Salad
steps: Cut up potatoes. Put in bowl. Cut celery and put in bowl. Cut radishes up. Put in bowl. Dice onion up. Put in bowl. Dice the eggs up. Put in bowl. Mix Miracle Whip, mustard, milk and sugar together. Pour over salad. Mix and slice eggs on top.

recipes.title: Mound Cake
ingredients: 1- 6 oz. pkg. frozen cream of coconut
steps: Bake cake as directed on box in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Combine condensed milk and cream of coconut. Punch holes in cake while warm and pour mixture over cake. When cake is completely cool spread whipped topping over top of cake and sprinkle coconut over cool whip. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

recipes.title: U.S. 31 Barbecues
steps: Cook meat slowly until tender and falls apart.
Mix all ingredients and cook in slow cooker for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.
This is better if you can slow cook overnight.

recipes.title: Hot Mulled Cider
steps: Simmer all over low heat 30 to 40 minutes.
Serve hot or warm. Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Phillippine Flank Steak
steps: Mix all ingredients, except steak.
Add steak and marinate 12 hours or overnight, turning occasionally.
Broil a few minutes on each side until medium or medium-rare.
Do not overcook.
Slice diagonally across the grain in very thin slices.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Spicy Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb. fresh green beans, cut in half or 1 (14 1/2 oz.) can green beans, drained
16 oz. can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
16 oz. can butter beans, drained and rinsed
1/8 to 1/4 tsp. red chili pepper flakes
steps: Cook fresh beans in boiling water for 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Remove from boiling water and plunge into ice water until cold.
Drain.
In large bowl, combine green beans, pinto beans, butter beans and red onion rings.
In jar with tight fitting lid, combine vinegar, oil, garlic, sugar and red chili pepper flakes.
Shake well.
Pour dressing over salad.
Stir and cover.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour or until chilled.
Serve on lettuce-lined plates, if desired.

recipes.title: 7-Up Salad
steps: Coat bottom and sides of 9 x 13-inch pan with mayonnaise. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water and add remaining ingredients. Mix together well and pour into pan.
Refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Eggs And Cheese
steps: Place eggs, cheese, salt and pepper in a covered jar and shake well.
Heat butter in skillet until melted over medium heat.
Coat skillet with butter.
Pour egg-cheese mixture into hot skillet. Cook over medium heat without stirring.
Turn with spatula when eggs begin to firm on bottom.
Cook 5 to 8 minutes or until eggs are firm.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Homemade Sloppy Joes
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. liquid Butter Buds (you can purchase these at Marsh's Market in Troy)
2 Tbsp. sugar or 1/4 tsp. Sweet 'N Low (brown)
1 lb. ground lean white turkey meat (skinless)
steps: Simmer ingredients in a large, nonstick skillet for 1 hour. You can cook this in a crock-pot for 4 to 5 hours while you are away from the house.
Calories per serving: 121.
Fat per serving: 1 gram.
Protein per serving: 16 grams.

recipes.title: Mock Strawberry Pie
steps: Mix boiling water and jello together and let cool.
Mix in strawberries and pour into a cooked pie crust.
Place in refrigerator to jell.
Top with cool-whip or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Kahlua Dip
steps: Combine marshmallow cream and cream cheese; blend well. Stir in	 Kahlua.
Chill,
covered,
overnight.	Serve
with sliced, fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Chili
steps: Brown hamburger in skillet.
Drain fat.
Add tomato sauce. Stir in all ingredients except red pepper and mesa.
Add red pepper.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Stir occasionally.
Stir mesa flour into 1/4 cup warm water to make a thick, but flowable, mixture.
Add mesa mixture.
Simmer 15 to 20 minutes more.

recipes.title: Squash Relish
steps: Chop first 6 vegetables fine.
Mix well and add 2 tablespoons salt.
Let stand for 1 hour.
Mix salt with vegetables.
Bring sugar, vinegar, water and mustard and celery seed in cloth and let stand alone while vegetables are sitting.
Drain vegetables and add to liquid.
Boil 25 to 30 minutes.
Put in jars and seal.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In a large bowl, beat milk and peanut butter until smooth.
Add Bisquick mix and vanilla; mix well. Shape into balls.
Place on ungreased baking sheet; flatten with fork.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool.
Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Mom'S Style Beenie Weenies
steps: Slice hot dogs and fry with onions.
Do not brown.
Add pork and beans, brown sugar, ketchup, mustard and Worcestershire sauce and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: 5 Can Chicken Casserole
steps: Cut chicken into small pieces.
Mix with noodles, milk, celery, undiluted soup and celery (if used).
Pour into casserole and top with buttered bread crumbs or crushed potato chips.
Bake 1 hour at 325° to 350°.
(May be prepared a day ahead of serving; refrigerate until cooked.)

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli
steps: Layer uncooked chicken in bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Place frozen broccoli on top.
Add undiluted soup mix.
Place on top of broccoli.
Sprinkle shredded cheese on top.
Crumb crackers and sprinkle all over pan.
Melt butter and pour over entire pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Barbecue Beef
steps: Brown beef until crumbly, but not dry.
Before beef is done, push to one side of pan and saute onion, green pepper and celery. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat.
Cover pan tightly and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve hot over toasted buns. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Cook squash and onion in salt water.
Drain well and mash squash. Add rest of the ingredients.
Bake in greased casserole dish at 350° for about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
steps: Cut eggs in half; remove yolks.
Mash yolks with a fork.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Refill whites with mixture.

recipes.title: Boiled Icing
steps: Let sugar, water and vinegar cook to soft ball.
Pour 1/2 of syrup slowly over stiffly beaten egg whites.
Continue beating. Return remaining half of syrup to stove.
Cook until hard ball stage.
Pour slowly over other mixture, beating continuously until proper thickness to spread.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Brown ground beef; drain.
Add taco seasoning mix according to package directions.
Add can of drained chili hot beans.
Cook for 15 minutes on low.
On plate layer tortilla chips, lettuce, bean and beef mixture, cheese, sour cream, salsa, onion and olives. Enjoy!
Serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: New England Clam Chowder
steps: Saute onion and celery in butter until "tender."
Add water, the juice from the clams, diced potatoes and carrots.
Simmer on medium heat 15 to 20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in the mushroom soup and evaporated milk and simmer until hot.
Add the clams and corn; heat and serve.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
steps: Put all ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil. Let cool and store in the refrigerator until ready to use.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea Mix
steps: Mix well and store in jar.

recipes.title: Snowball Treats
steps: Thoroughly mix the first 3 ingredients together.
Add corn flakes.
Shape into small balls.
Roll in powdered sugar and coconut.
Chill or serve immediately.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese & Chicken
steps: Mix cream cheese and soups, then add chicken. Put in a 8 x 8 dish and cover with crumbled Ritz crackers and butter mixture. Bake at 350 for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Crab A La Lorraine
steps: Blend ingredients well. Spread on 16 muffin halves. Freeze slightly and cut each into 6 wedges. Bake in a 350° oven until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Karen'S Chili
ingredients: 1 pkg. Lil Smokies sausages, cut into sections
1 lb. sausage (Jimmy Dean or Bass Farm "hot")
steps: Cook beef and sausage. Add all ingredients to crock-pot and cook 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 c. diced cooked chicken or turkey
steps: Mix and let stand overnight.

recipes.title: Frozen Caramel Cheesecake
steps: Beat cream cheese and Eagle Brand together.
Add Cool Whip to mixture.
Pour 1/4 of this mixture into each pie crust.
Drizzle 1/4 of caramel on top of each pie.
Melt margarine in skillet, add coconut and pecan pieces, stirring until toasted.
Sprinkle 1/4 of this mixture on top of caramel on each pie.
Repeat each step, using remainder of cream cheese, caramel, coconut and toasted nuts.
Freeze and serve frozen.

recipes.title: Puppy Chow For People
steps: Melt peanut butter, chocolate chips and margarine in microwave.
Pour onto cereal.
Coat with sugar.

recipes.title: Broccoli Soup
ingredients: a few potatoes, cut in small cubes (a can of potato soup can be used instead)
1 can chicken noodle soup or cream of chicken
steps: Boil a few potatoes and set aside.
Also, have ready a can of celery soup and can of chicken noodle soup or cream of chicken. Cut broccoli in small pieces; cook in boiling, salted water until well done.
Drain water from broccoli and add other ingredients. If this isn't thick enough, thicken accordingly.
Just before serving, add about 5 slices of American cheese and melt.
Does well in crock-pot after ingredients are mixed.

recipes.title: Mama'S Peanut Butter Candy
steps: Cook syrup, sugar and water until it makes a hard ball. Pour over egg whites that have been stiffly beaten.
Beat this mixture until stiff
enough
to
spread on buttered wax paper. Spread peanut butter on
top
of
mixture	and
roll up like a jelly roll.
Wrap
wax
paper
around roll and cool completely before cutting into slices.

recipes.title: Salmon Croquettes
ingredients: crushed corn flakes or cracker crumbs
steps: Drain the salmon, reserving the liquid.
Flake the salmon and remove the skin and bones.
In a large bowl, combine the salmon, reserved liquid, eggs, salt and corn flake crumbs to make a firm mixture.
Blend in the baking powder.
Shape into croquettes and fry until lightly browned.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
steps: Saute onion in butter until soft, but not brown.
Add 5 cups thinly chopped potatoes.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Barely cover with water.
Cook until potatoes fall apart and become thickened. Remove from heat.
Mash with potato masher or fork.
Add vinegar and condensed milk.
Reheat to serving temperature, but do not allow to boil.
Serve with crackers, cornbread or cornsticks. Serves 4 or 5.

recipes.title: Icebox Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can cut green beans, drained
steps: Combine all ingredients in a large glass bowl; set aside.

recipes.title: Tamale Pie
ingredients: 2 c. whole kernel corn or 1 large can
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
In a 10-inch skillet over medium heat, cook beef and chili powder until well done, stirring to separate meat.
Remove from heat and drain off fat.
Stir in remaining ingredients except corn muffin mix.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat to low, cover and cook 5 minutes.
Pour into 2-quart casserole.

recipes.title: Low Calorie Custard
steps: Beat eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla; stir in milk.
Bake in a 350° oven for about 35 minutes.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Contains 79 calories per 1/6 recipe.

recipes.title: Wassail Drink
steps: Boil water and steep tea bags for 10 minutes.
Discard tea bags and combine remaining ingredients.
Boil and serve warm. Very nice at Christmastime.

recipes.title: Broccoli Soup 1
steps: Cook frozen broccoli in water until tender.
Add soups.
Mix together and warm until desired temperature.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pizza
steps: Spread crescent rolls into round pizza pan, overlapping edges and press down to seal, this forming the crust.
Cook sausage scrambled and drain.
Pour over crust.
Sprinkle with hash browns. Mix eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Beat well and pour over hash browns.
Sprinkle shredded cheese on top and garnish with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Triple Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 1 c. frozen cranberry juice cocktail concentrate, thawed
1 (12 oz.) pkg. cranberries (fresh or frozen), rinsed and drained
1/2 c. dried cranberries (about 2 oz.) can use craisins
steps: Combine juice concentrate and sugar in heavy saucepan. Bring to boil, stirring until sugar dissolves. Add fresh and dried berries and cook until dried berries begin to soften and fresh berries begin to pop, stirring often, about 7 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in marmalade, juice and peel and allspice. Cool completely. Cover; chill until cold. Can be made 3 days ahead. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Fruit Freeze
steps: Blend cream cheese, mayonnaise and sugar.
Add drained fruit and nuts, mixing carefully.
Add whipped cream.
Put in ice tray and freeze approximately 4 hours.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Caroline'S Manicotti
ingredients: all ingredients required for your favorite meat loaf
steps: You will need 2 (12 x 9-inch) casserole dishes and 2 (14 x 12-inch) sheets of foil.

recipes.title: Dressing For Potato Salad
steps: Mix well and pour over potatoes.
Then mix again until potatoes are covered.

recipes.title: Cherry Delight
ingredients: 2 envelopes Dream Whip, prepared as directed on pkg.
steps: Blend cream cheese and confectioners sugar.
Fold in prepared Dream Whip.
Spread this on chilled crumb mixture.
Chill several hours more.
Before serving, add pie filling.

recipes.title: Banana Mallow Pie
steps: Toast coconut with margarine

in a skillet on low heat until golden brown. Pat into pie plate to form crust. Cool in refrigerator. Mix pudding mix with milk. Add marshmallows and 1/2 Cool Whip. Slice bananas in cooled coconut shell. Cover with pudding, then top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken And Mushrooms
steps: In skillet, in 1 tablespoon margarine, cook chicken 10 minutes or until browned on both sides.
Remove.

recipes.title: "Strawberry Preserves Or Jam"
steps: Combine strawberries and sugar and let set for 20 minutes. Boil for 1 minute the water and Penjell.
Pour into strawberries and continue stirring for 2 or 3 minutes.
Pour in jars and let stand until firm.

recipes.title: Oven Scrambled Eggs
steps: Melt margarine into the bottom of a sheet cake pan or oven roaster.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Crack and beat eggs.
Add hot milk and salt and pour into prepared pan.
Bake 25 minutes, then stir gently to loosen edges.
Bake an additional 15 minutes or until eggs are set to your liking.
Serves 25.
Easy way to feed a crowd; we use this at camp a lot.

recipes.title: Burgers Florentine
steps: Prepare spinach as label directs; drain well.
Toast English muffins; keep warm.
Preheat broiler.
Into bowl, tear bread into small pieces; add spinach, ground beef, egg, salt and onion; mix well.
Shape mixture into four 1-inch thick round patties.
Place patties on rack in broiling pan.
Broil patties about 5 minutes on each side for medium or until desired doneness.
Just before patties are done, cut Mozzarella cheese into 4 slices.
Top each meat patty with cheese; broil 1 minute or until cheese melts.
To serve, place a patty on bottom half of each muffin; replace top half of muffin.

recipes.title: Creamy Dijon Dressing
steps: Combine all ingredients, stir until smooth. Cover & chill. Makes 1 1/4 cups.

recipes.title: Easy Toffee(Servings:  4)
steps: Line jelly roll pan with saltines.
Bring brown sugar and butter to a boil.
Pour over saltines.
Bake in 375° to 400° oven for 7 to 9 minutes.
Sprinkle chips over hot candy.
Spread when melted.
Freeze 30 minutes.
Break like peanut brittle.

recipes.title: Chicken Chow Mein
steps: Brown butter in pan slightly. Add onion and mushrooms.
After all are browned, add and simmer for 15 minutes the chicken, celery, broth, soy sauce and sugar.
(Cut down on the sugar.) Blend in the cornstarch and water that have been mixed together until smooth.
Cook the chow mein mixture until slightly thickened and clear looking.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Health Salad
steps: Mix jello with boiling and cold water.
Refrigerate jello until set.
Add pineapple.
Fold in sour cream and pecans.
Add cherries for color.
Let set overnight before serving.

recipes.title: Garden Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 c. sliced celery with some of the leafy green tops
9 medium size tomatoes or 2 cans (17 oz. each) tomatoes (undrained), strained to remove seeds
1/4 lb. green beans, washed, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces (1 c.)
1/2 lb. zucchini, cut in half lengthwise and thinly sliced (2 c.)
steps: Heat butter and oil in Dutch oven; saute carrots, celery, onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Peel tomatoes; cut in half crosswise.
Place strainer over large bowl; remove seeds by squeezing gently.
Chop pulp and add to join in large bowl.
Add tomatoes and juice to Dutch oven.
Add oregano, basil, salt and pepper; cook 15 minutes.
Add beef broth and green beans; cook 30 minutes longer, adding zucchini and parsley after 20 minutes. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
ingredients: 1 box frozen broccoli, drained and cooked
steps: Melt butter. Add onions to soften. Add rest of ingredients. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes (iron skillet is best). Yummy with beans.

recipes.title: Lite Fruit Salad
steps: Drain all fruit well.
Mix Cool Whip, condensed milk and lemon juice together.
Add nuts, coconut and apples.
Add all the rest of the ingredients. Chill 1 hour.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Chicken
steps: In small bowl, combine beaten
eggs,
cream,
salt
and pepper to form
batter.
Preheat oven to 400°.
Dip chicken in batter, then
in
flour
(or crumbled corn flakes).
Drop onto cookie sheet.
Spray
cookie sheet with Pam or cover with oil. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until done.
Turn once so can brown on both sides.

recipes.title: Corn Salad
ingredients: mayonnaise (use amount to your own taste)
Thousand Island dressing (use amount to your own taste)
steps: Mix 1st four ingredients and place in refrigerator. Toss with mayonnaise and dressing before serving.

recipes.title: Nicole Keeling'S Chess Cake
steps: Mix together; pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
steps: Butter bottom of pan.
Layer ingredients in order listed.
Do not mix.
Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Remove foil and bake another 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Cook squash until tender and then cream them.
Add all other ingredients and mix well.
Bake in ungreased casserole dish at 350° for 30 or 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili
steps: Brown meat and onion.
Drain fat.
Pour in a large saucepan and add remaining ingredients.
Cook on low for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Layered Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 mashed avocado (add lemon juice to prevent browning)
shredded Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese
steps: Layer ingredients in order given in an 8 x 8-inch dish.
Can prepare 2 to 3 hours in advance.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Don'S Lasagna
ingredients: 6 intact lasagna noodles, cooked to pkg. directions (cook 8 just in case)
steps: Grease bottom of a 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Place 3 lasagna noodles on the bottom of the dish.
Spread ground meat over noodles.
Spread tomato paste over ground meat.
Spread Mozzarella cheese over the tomato paste. Spread Cheddar cheese over the Mozzarella cheese.
Spread cottage cheese over the Cheddar cheese.
Sprinkle with garlic salt to taste. Top with 3 more lasagna noodles.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.
Remove and enjoy.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
steps: Combine pork and beans, brown sugar, Worcestershire, chili powder, molasses, chili sauce and vinegar in bean pot or crock-pot with a lid.
Mix well.
Cover and bake at 400° for 1 hour for thin bean mixture or 1 1/2 hours for thicker bean mixture.
The longer it bakes the thicker the bean mixture becomes.
If desired, add crumbled bacon bits to serve.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Zucchini Jam
ingredients: 6 c. zucchini, peeled, grated and seeded
steps: Boil zucchini 6 minutes or until clear and drain.
May have to squeeze.
Add sugar, lemon juice and pineapple.
Boil hard for 6 minutes.
Remove form heat and add jello.

recipes.title: Baked Apple
steps: Bring sugar, water, cinnamon and butter to a boil.
Peel and core apples.
Pour sugar and cinnamon mixture in center.
Dot with butter.
Wrap each apple in pie crust dough.
Bake at 400° about 40 minutes.
Pour remainder of mixture over and around apples during last 10 minutes of baking.

recipes.title: Zucchini Squash
steps: Cook in skillet.
Get oil hot and then add the squash.
Cook fast and keep stirred.
It will brown a little.
When cooked, the cheese may be added.
Add salt and black pepper.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 6 oz. jar Kraft Old English Cheddar cheese spread
6 oz. jar Kraft Roka spread (may substitute another flavor if this one not available)
1 Tbsp. minced onion, fresh or dried
steps: Have cheeses at room temperature.
Mix all ingredients until smoothly blended.
If too soft, refrigerate until semi-firm.
Form a ball on cheese plate or tray, using spoon and/or knife to create symmetrical shape.
You may decorate with parsley flakes or chopped pecans.

recipes.title: Sherbet Punch
steps: Soften sherbet; add 7-Up and blend until slushy.
Needs no additional ice.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pudding
steps: Mix Jell-O and strawberries in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Let cool. Beat together cream cheese, cold milk, pudding and sour cream. Line 9 x 12-inch container with vanilla wafers. Cover with half strawberry mixture, half pudding mixture and half Cool Whip. Repeat.

recipes.title: Easy Sweet Treats
steps: Mix butter and sugar.
Boil for 3 minutes.
Pour over graham crackers, which have been sprinkled with chopped pecans.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Immediately cut each cracker into squares.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 1 large can of Italian style plum tomatoes in puree
steps: Wash chicken and brown lightly in olive oil using a large saucepan. Add onions, garlic and basil;

saute until onions are tender. Add tomatoes and all of puree to chicken mixture. Cover and simmer gently for two hours. Stir chicken a few times during the two hours, being sure to push the chicken down under the sauce before covering the pan and leaving it to simmer. Serve over linguine.

recipes.title: Party Biscuits
steps: Mix all together and shape into balls about 1-inch in diameter.
Bake at 400° until brown.

recipes.title: Calico Pickles
ingredients: 2 c. cubed sweet red pepper (1-inch cubes)
1 medium head cauliflower, broken into florets (6 c.)
steps: Combine vegetables in a large bowl. Dissolve salt in water and pour over vegetables.
Soak for 15 to 18 hours in a cool place. Drain.
In a large pot, mix sugar, spices and vinegar.
Bring to a boil and boil for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add vegetables and simmer 5 to 7 minutes.
Pack hot into jars.
Process 15 minutes in water bath. Yields 8 pints.

recipes.title: Chicken Encore
ingredients: 2 cans cream of mushroom soup or cream of celery soup
1/2 lb. mild cheese, cubed or shredded
steps: Combine all ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Mix well.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 1 hour.
Preparation time:
20 to 25 minutes.
Cooking time 1 hour.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Orange Sherbet Salad
steps: Dissolve orange gelatin in 3/4 cup boiling water. Add sherbet (which has just been removed from the freezer) and
stir until sherbet is completely blended with the gelatin. Pour mixture into a 2-quart mold and spread sour cream over the top. Chill for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together, pour into pie shells and bake for 45 minutes at 300°.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Bread
steps: Thaw and let rise 1 loaf of frozen bread dough (follow package directions).
On a slightly greased (oil) cookie sheet, spread dough into a rectangle.
Press pepperoni onto dough.
Spread Mozzarella cheese over pepperoni and then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Roll lengthwise and pinch all edges.
Bake on cookie sheet at 350° for 10 to 20 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes And Ham
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery or mushroom soup
steps: Combine soup, milk and pepper.
In a 1 1/2-quart casserole, arrange alternate layers of potatoes, meat, onion and sauce. Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Uncover; sprinkle with cheese and paprika.
Bake 15 minutes more, or until potatoes are tender. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Philly Cheese Ball
ingredients: 8 oz. Cracker Barrel Cheddar cold pack cheese, softened
steps: Combine cheese, cream cheese and margarine until well blended. Add everything else except pecans.
Refrigerate until chilled. Shape into a ball.
Roll in chopped pecans.

recipes.title: Pink Delite
steps: Fold together; chill for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Deer Hunter'S Pie
ingredients: 4 large boiled potatoes, peeled and sliced 1/8-inch thick
2 large onions, peeled and sliced 1/8-inch thick
3 large apples (preferably tart baking variety), sliced 1/8 inch thick
1 c. beef stock or 1 c. water with 3 bouillon cubes dissolved in it
steps: Saute the hamburger in a skillet until it is lightly browned and completely separated.
Arrange a layer of potatoes over the bottom of a 1 1/2-quart greased casserole.
Follow with a layer of meat, a layer of onions and a layer of apples.
Repeat until you have used up all of the ingredients.
Heat the beef stock, add the nutmeg, pepper and salt.
Stir well so that all of the salt is dissolved.
Pour this over the casserole.
Sprinkle the bread crumbs over the top and add little dabs of butter if you like. Bake in a 350° oven for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Taco Squares
steps: Mix 2-3 lb. raw hamburger as you would normally for meatloaf. Flatten the meatloaf out on a cookie sheet in the shape of a rectangle.
Take 1 pkg. frozen broccoli, thawed and drained, and lay it down the middle 1/3 of the rectangle the long way.
Roll up rectangle from both sides to the middle.
Turn the roll so the seam is on the bottom.
Pinch the ends closed and cook as you would regular meatloaf.
You can use any vegetable and you can add cheese to the middle.

recipes.title: Corn Dog Twists
ingredients: 1 (11.5 oz.) can Pillsbury refrigerated cornbread twists
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Unroll dough into 1 long sheet.
Seal crosswise center perforations.
Separate dough into 8 long strips (2 cornbread twists each).
Wrap each strip around a wiener. Place on ungreased cookie sheet with ends of dough tucked under wieners.
Brush each with margarine; sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 375° for 12 to 16 minutes, or until light brown.
Remove from cookie sheet.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Peanut Clusters
steps: Melt bark and chips until smooth.
Stir in peanuts.
Drop by spoon on wax paper.

recipes.title: Inside Out Sandwiches
ingredients: thinly sliced deli meat of your choice
thinly sliced cheese of your choice
steps: Bake bread sticks as directed. When cooled, cut in half to make 2 short bread sticks. Place lettuce on counter.
Next place cheese, then meat. Brush the bread sticks with your choice of dressing. Roll up with lettuce on the outside.
Secure with a toothpick.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Cream all ingredients together.
Then form into ball.
Roll cheese ball in nuts or press nuts on outside of cheese ball.

recipes.title: Tomato Juice Cocktail
ingredients: 1 c. chopped celery, pureed in blender
1/2 c. chopped onion, pureed in blender
steps: Combine tomato juice, celery, and onion.
Stir often.
Heat gently for 30 minutes.
Add lemon juice, sugar, salt, horseradish, Worcestershire sauce and hot pepper sauce.
Simmer 10 minutes. This can be served hot or chilled.
Makes 5 pints.

recipes.title: Cranberry Relish
steps: Chop cranberries and oranges (with peel on) in food processor. Add pecans and sugar.
Make Jell-O according to package, using less water.
Add Jell-O to mixture and stir well.
Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Orange Julius
steps: Combine all ingredients into blender.
Blend on high for 1 minute.
Pour into tall glass and enjoy.

recipes.title: Asparagus Luncheon Platter
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
steps: Cook asparagus in boiling salted water 10 minutes. Mix mushroom soup, cream, lemon juice and egg yolk; season. Heat thoroughly. Pour over drained asparagus arranged on toast. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Solyanka(A Russian Fish Soup With Capers And Onions)
steps: In a large soup pot, heat the wine.
Add the onion and cook until softened.
Add the celery, carrots and the tomatoes and continue to cook for 5 minutes.
Peel, seed and slice the cucumber (about 1 1/2 cups); cut the fish in large chunks.
Add both to the soup and cook 3 minutes longer.
Add the water; bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer until the fish flakes easily (about 10 minutes).
Turn off the heat.
Add remaining ingredients and serve immediately.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Homestyle Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. meaty ham bone or ham pieces
steps: Put all ingredients in crock-pot.
Cover and cook on low 10 to 12 hours (high 5 to 6 hours).
Remove bones, bay leaf, peppercorns and celery sprigs before serving.
Taste for salt adjustment. Trim meat from ham bone and return cut-up pieces to soup.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 2 to 3 c. grated American or Cheddar cheese
2 large bags nacho cheese chips, crushed
3 to 4 large bottles Russian salad dressing
steps: Brown hamburger and drain.
Set aside to cool.
When it is fully cooled, add grated cheese, kidney beans and tomatoes.
Add just before serving the crushed nacho chips and salad dressing. That way it won't get soggy.
Mix well.

recipes.title: Shortcut Spaghetti Sauce
steps: Brown ground beef, along with chopped small onion; drain.
In crock-pot, put spaghetti sauce, tomatoes and ground beef.
Add remaining ingredients; stir well.
Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Serve over 1 pound cooked spaghetti or vermicelli or 1 pound of your favorite pasta, cooked and drained.

recipes.title: Easy Buffalo Wings
steps: Put your dressing in shallow dessert bowls (good for dipping) and put it in the refrigerator.
(It's got to be cold.) Cut your chicken wings into the two main pieces and throw the third little piece away.
Fry these (no batter).

recipes.title: Beverage
steps: Mix all together and freeze.
One-half recipe makes plenty. Fill glass 1/2 with slush and add Sprite.

recipes.title: Fudge Mud Slide
steps: Place brownie in a large bowl.
Add ice cream and top with hot fudge sauce and crushed cookie.
Add whipped cream and drizzle with chocolate syrup.
Sprinkle with almonds and top with a cherry.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Mix ingredients together.
(Do not overmix.)
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes (or until done).

recipes.title: Oysters Rockefeller
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen spinach, cooked, drained and cooled
1 bunch green onions, cut into small pieces
1 bunch parsley, washed, drained and snipped in sections
1 head lettuce, washed and drained and broken into bite size pieces
4 oz. Absinthe or 1 tsp. anise or 4 oz. Pernod
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Place the first 4 ingredients in a blender or food processor and chop finely.
Add the rest of the ingredients to the blender.
Puree until all ingredients are smoothly blended into a sauce.

recipes.title: Chocolate Layer Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines chocolate cake mix
1 small pkg. chocolate instant pudding mix
steps: Beat all together about 5 minutes.
Bake in tube pan at 350° for
about	1
hour.
Grease
and
flour pan bottom only. When cool, cut cake in 4 layers.

recipes.title: Chicken Ole
ingredients: 1/2 c. medium or hot chunky taco sauce
3 whole chicken breasts, split, skinned and boned
steps: Combine taco sauce, mustard and lime juice in large bowl.
Add chicken, turning to coat.
Cover; marinate in refrigerator at least 30 minutes.
Melt margarine in large skillet over medium heat until foamy.
Remove chicken; reserve marinade.
Add chicken to skillet; cook about 10 minutes or until brown on both sides. Add marinade; cook about 5 minutes or until chicken is tender and marinade glazes chicken.
Remove chicken to serving platter.
Boil marinade over high heat 1 minute.
Pour over chicken.
Garnish with parsley.
Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Russian Tea
steps: Mix the ingredients.
Make tea as desired.

recipes.title: Bean Dip For Tortilla Chips
steps: Bring to boil.
Remove and add 1 (8 ounce) package of shredded cheese.
Let melt and stir.

recipes.title: Sweet Tater Casserole
steps: Mash sweet taters; stir in 1/2 cup of brown sugar.
Beat egg and add milk and orange juice.
Stir in sweet tater; mix gradually and add cinnamon.
Put in casserole; dot butter.
Sprinkle the remaining brown sugar and top with nuts.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Peach Angel Food Cake
ingredients: 1 (18.25 oz.) pkg. angel food cake mix
steps: In a large bowl, combine cake mix, peaches and juice (do not add water).
Mix well.
Pour into tube pan or 2 loaf pans.
Bake according to directions on cake package.
If desired, top with whipped topping.
This is a great tasting super easy low fat/calorie dessert.

recipes.title: Penny'S Kugel (Noodle Pudding)(Served Hot, As Sweet Vegetable, Or Dessert)
steps: Cook noodles according to package directions and drain.
Beat eggs; add rest of ingredients (room temperature).
Mix together and add noodles.
Mix well.
Pour into large rectangular pan or glass casserole, either greased or sprayed with Pam.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Delicious Frozen Cole Slaw
steps: Boil 3 to 4 minutes and let cool.

recipes.title: Kielbasi Bourbon Hors D'Oeuvres
ingredients: 1 lb. kielbasi, cut into bite size slices
steps: Mix ketchup, brown sugar and bourbon together and let simmer over medium heat together until it comes to a boil.
Turn heat down and simmer on low for 5 minutes.
Toss kielbasi into mixture and let simmer for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve with toothpicks.

recipes.title: Polynesian Chicken
steps: Melt butter.
Add mushrooms, onion and pepper.
Saute until tender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cook until thoroughly heated. Serve over rice.
Serves about six.

recipes.title: Orange Tapioca Salad
steps: Combine jello, pudding and water in pan.
Bring to full boil. Let set.
Add Cool Whip and fold in oranges.
May change to strawberry jello and strawberries.

recipes.title: Gretchen Fayhey'S Quick Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 6 slices Italian bread, butter both sides
steps: Line buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish with buttered bread. Spread sausage over bread. Add cheese and spread evenly.
Beat eggs and half and half together.
Pour over sausage and cheese layers. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 40 minutes.
Serve hot.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Harvard Beets
steps: Drain beets. Save liquid. Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt. Add vinegar and beet liquid. Cook, stirring constantly, until thick and clear. Add beets and oleo. Heat.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix well. Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven until hot and bubbly (about 25 to 30 minutes). Top with 1 can onion rings. Heat until brown.

recipes.title: Easter Fruit Salad
steps: Combine Eagle Brand milk, Cool Whip and vanilla. Add canned fruit (drained), cherries and nuts.
Chill overnight.
A nice salad to serve for Christmas or Easter with ham.

recipes.title: Pepsi Roast
steps: Place roast in pan which can be tightly covered.
Spread can of soup over roast.
Sprinkle dry onion soup mixture over the top. Pour Pepsi into pan and cover tightly.
Put into oven at 325° and roast for 3 1/2 to 4 hours.
Makes its own gravy.
Yield:
4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fudge
steps: Mix milk and chips in pyrex dish.
Microwave on high 1 1/2 minutes.
Remove and stir.
Return to microwave and cook high for 1 1/2 minutes more.
Stir thoroughly.
Add vanilla and nuts stirring well.
Line 8 or 9 inch pan with foil.
Spread mixture in pan and chill for 2 hours.
Remove from pan and cut into squares. Store in plastic container with lid ajar until firm.

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
steps: Combine pretzels, butter and 6 tablespoons sugar and spread in a 9 1/2 x 13 1/2 glass dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 250° or until browned. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza(Everyone'S Favorite)
steps: Cut sugar cookie roll and press into a pizza pan. Bake and let cool. Top with Cool Whip and fruit, starting with less expensive fruit around edges. (I normally use cantaloupe.)
Next, circle around your fruits using the most expensive in the middle (uses less and saves money when fruit is not on sale).
Cut like a pizza and enjoy!

recipes.title: One Minute Chocolate Icing
steps: Mix all ingredients, except vanilla, in saucepan.
Cook, stirring frequently, until mixtures comes to a full rolling boil. Boil 1 minute and remove from heat.
Cool.

recipes.title: Millie'S Picnic Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Sweeten to taste.
Serve over crushed ice.

recipes.title: Swedish Apple Pie
ingredients: 3 or 4 c. raw apples, peeled and sliced
steps: Butter pie plate.
Fill with apples; sprinkle on cinnamon, nutmeg and sugar.

recipes.title: Ritz Cracker Pie
steps: Crumble crackers and mix with nuts and half the sugar. Beat egg whites until stiff and add to the remaining sugar. Pour egg whites into dry ingredients; add vanilla. Mix well and pour into a buttered pie plate. Bake at 325° for 25 minutes. Allow pie to cool. Beat whipping cream and 1 teaspoon sugar. When stiff, pour over top of pie.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Dessert
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can strawberry or cherry pie filling
1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple, don't drain
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Place in an oblong baking dish and freeze overnight.
Take out 30 to 60 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Swiss Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 loaf French bread, cut into 1-inch cubes
steps: Add cornstarch, nutmeg, pepper and salt to cheese. Toss lightly with fork to combine. Add wine to 3-quart saucepan (or earthenware to keep heat longer). Cook over low heat until it begins to bubble gently.
Add cheese, a handful at a time, stirring rigorously with a wooden spoon until cheese melts and mixture is thoroughly blended. Serve immediately with bread cubes.

recipes.title: Tangy Brown Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) or 1 (15 oz.) can tomato sauce
steps: Place meat in baking dish.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake 45 minutes at 375°; drain fat off.
Combine onion, vinegar, sugar and mustard.
Spread on meat.
Pour on tomato sauce.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done, basting occasionally with sauce.

recipes.title: Ginger'S Onion And Potato Soup
steps: Peel and chop approximately 12 potatoes.
Put them in a large pot with enough water to barely cover them.
Slice onions in large sections no smaller than quarters.
Put them on top of the potatoes.
Do not add water to the pot.
Bring to a boil.
Add 2 teaspoons salt and pepper, 1 teaspoon of chopped red pepper and 1 teaspoon of garlic powder.
Once the onions are cooked until they are clear, smash the potatoes.
Reduce to low heat.
Do not drain the water.
Add butter, 1 to 2 cups milk and 4 to 8 ounces sour cream.
Top with shredded cheese.
Serve.

recipes.title: Breakfast Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb. bulk sausage, browned and drained
steps: Mix all ingredients together and pour into an ungreased loaf pan. Refrigerate overnight. Bake 1 hour at 325°. Let set 10 to 15 minutes after removing from oven. Excellent with blueberry muffins.

recipes.title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Clean mushrooms and remove stems.
Finely chop stems and saute in butter with onions.
In a mixing bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
Adding bread crumbs to make mixture stiff enough to stay together.
Fill mushrooms to heaping.	Place in a baking dish and drizzle with melted butter.
Bake at 400 degrees until light brown.

recipes.title: Texas Potatoes
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients and put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Crumble corn flakes on top and pour melted butter over flakes. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Puffs
ingredients: 1/4 lb. very sharp cheese (New York sharp Cheddar)
steps: Remove crusts and slice bread into 1-inch cubes.
Melt cheese and butter in top of double boiler.
Stir vigorously after melted. Remove from heat and fold in egg whites.
Spear bread cubes with a 2 pronged fork or long wooden pick and dip mixture.
Shake gently to remove excess.
Chill overnight or freeze on cookie sheet.
Defrost if frozen for 30 minutes.
Put in 400° preheated oven.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 50.

recipes.title: 7-Cup Salad
steps: Combine fruit, coconut and marshmallows with sour cream.
Toss lightly and chill.

recipes.title: Calico Country Soup
ingredients: ham bone and 1 lb. ham pieces
steps: Wash beans and cover with water.
Add salt and soak overnight. Drain beans and put in 2 quarts fresh water.
Add a ham bone and ham pieces.
Cook approximately 1 hour.
Add tomatoes and chilies, sugar, oregano, sage and chili powder.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer all together for another hour or until beans are done.
Serve with hot cornbread or corn muffins.

recipes.title: Chilly Willy Chili(Microwave)
steps: Crumble beef into a 2-quart casserole dish.
Add onion and cover with wax paper.
Microwave on High for 3 to 4 minutes or until cooked through.
Remove dish from oven.
Stir.
Drain excess grease.
Add beans with juice, stewed tomatoes, chili powder and ketchup.
Cover with lid and microwave on Medium-high for 20 minutes.
Good!

recipes.title: Chewy Cheese Bars
steps: Mix the first 3 items together and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Imperial Crabs
steps: Simmer vegetables in butter.
Put crabmeat in bowl.
Add simmered vegetables and all other ingredients.
Mix gently and fill cleaned crab shells.
Cover with buttered crumbs.
Bake 20 minutes at 450°.
Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Heavenly Salad
steps: Drain all fruit.
Mix fruit well together.
Stir lightly so as not to mash fruit.
Add sliced bananas and chopped nuts.
Blend gently together.
Add marshmallows and blend in Cool Whip. Refrigerate overnight and serve.
Will fill a 9 x 13-inch glass cake dish.
Serves 12 to 16.

recipes.title: Oven Potatoes
steps: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl.
Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 325° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Dill Dip For Veggies
steps: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Vena'S Meatballs
ingredients: 1 c. grated Italian cheese (domestic Romano best)
tomato paste or tomato puree (remember 2 cans water for paste; 1 can water for puree)
steps: In frying pan, saute vegetable oil, garlic and onion.
Add tomato paste or tomato puree and simmer.
Add meatballs and simmer about 1/2 hour more.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Breast
steps: Melt butter.
Dip chicken in the melted butter and then roll in the cracker crumbs.
Line baking dish with aluminum foil. Place chicken in pan.
Cover with foil.
Bake for about 45 minutes or an hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Pink Cloud Salad
ingredients: 1 medium can crushed pineapple, well drained
1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: Chill:
milk, pineapple, cherry pie filling and Cool Whip. Chill well.
Mix all ingredients and refrigerate overnight or at least 2 hours.

recipes.title: Shrimp Relish
steps: Mix parsley, oil, vinegar, garlic, salt and pepper.
Combine cooked, clean shrimp and onion.
Refrigerate in dressing overnight, stirring occasionally.
Serve.

recipes.title: Orange Blossom Balls
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice, undiluted
steps: Thaw orange juice to room temperature.
Mix all ingredients together, except coconut.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Roll in coconut.
Refrigerate until served.

recipes.title: Angel Hair Pasta With Chicken
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves cut into 1 inch cubes
1 carrot sliced diagonally into 1/4 inch pieces
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli florets, thawed
steps: Heat 1 Tbsp. oil in a skillet over medium heat;
add chicken. Cook, stirring, until chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from skillet and drain on paper towels.
Heat remaining oil in same skillet; add carrot to skillet; cook stirring for 4 minutes.
Add broccoli and garlic to skillet; cook stirring for 2 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Twinkie Pudding
steps: Split Twinkies in half lengthwise.
Line a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread pudding, then layer remaining ingredients.
Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Easy Meatballs And Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 or 2 cans Campbell's cream of mushroom soup
steps: Mix ground beef and stuffing and make into meatballs (any size).
Bake or fry meatballs until done.

recipes.title: Zucchini Squash Casserole
steps: In a pan or baking dish, cook onion slightly in oil, salt and pepper.
Cut up squash in this.
Pour tomato sauce and 1 can water over this.
Put oregano on top.
Cook on stove eye with lid on pan or dish until tender.

recipes.title: Macaroni Loaf
steps: Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Dressing For Large Family
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Add enough chicken broth for desired consistency.
Bake at 350° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Breakfast Andies
steps: Use soft stale bread, not brittle. Or use fresh bread left to stand out overnight. Slice bread into cubes, 6 per slice (like drawing tic, tac, toe). Mix batter until smooth. Soak cubes in batter. Fry in hot oil, 1/2-inch deep. Serve on warm dishes with hot syrup, honey, jam (recommend never use toppings cold).

recipes.title: Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 (6 1/8 oz.) can tuna in spring water
steps: Mix all ingredients in small bowl and chill.
Serve on crackers or bread.

recipes.title: 3 Bean Salad
steps: Drain beans and mix.
Add pepper and onion.
Mix oil and vinegar with the rest and pour over bean mixture and toss. Refrigerate covered until served.
Keeps hours ahead.
Serves:

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Breasts With Cheese
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup or cream of mushroom
steps: Place chicken in greased baking dish. Cover with cheese.
Mix soup and milk.
Pour over cheese. Sprinkle croutons on top. Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 can Old El Paso refried beans
1 1/2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese (softened in microwave; easier to spread)
1 (6 oz.) can ripe black olives (in water), sliced
steps: In a 9 x 13-inch pan layer the 6 ingredients in the order given above. Bake 20 minutes in a 350° oven. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Ambrosia Pie
steps: Mix milk and lemon juice together and let set.
Mix the remaining ingredients; fold in milk mixture.
This makes two 9-inch pies.
Good with graham cracker crusts.
May be frozen.

recipes.title: Quick Chocolate Fudge(Microwave)
ingredients: 1/2 c. half and half light cream
steps: Lightly grease an 8 x 11-inch pan and set aside.
In a 1-quart bowl, combine sugar and cocoa.
Cut butter into small pieces and dot over sugar mixture.
Stir in half and half and vanilla.
Cover with wax paper.
Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Add butter; using a wooden spoon stir hot mixture until butter melts.
Beat vigorously for 1 minute until mixture loses its gloss.
Stir in 1/2 cup nuts.
Pour fudge into prepared greased dish and spread it evenly.
Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup nuts, lightly pressing them into fudge.
Refrigerate, uncovered, for 1 to 2 hours or until firm.
Cut into squares.
Store in tins or covered dish in refrigerator.
Makes about 1 pound.

recipes.title: * Sauerkraut Salad *
steps: This keeps in refrigerator for weeks.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
steps: Cook and debone chicken and chop.
Chop pickles, celery and add Miracle Whip salad dressing.
Add salt and pepper.
If it's dry you can add pickle juice or chicken broth.
Makes about 1 1/2 quarts.
You can freeze it.

recipes.title: Crunch Pineapple Cranberry Mold
ingredients: 2 pkg. (3 oz. each) lemon flavored gelatin
3 Tbsp. shredded or chopped orange peel
2 c. whole cranberry sauce (two No. 2 cans)
steps: Drain syrup from pineapple and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups liquid.
Heat to boiling; pour over gelatin.
Stir until completely dissolved.
Stir in pineapple and remaining ingredients.
Turn into a 10-inch ring mold and chill until firm. Unmold and garnish with pineapple slices and salad greens as desired.
Serves 10.
Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Irish Italian Spaghetti Sauce
steps: Working a cattle drive down the canyon to market in Bakersfield when I was 14 years old, and bringing all the horses back, just me alone.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad Bowl
ingredients: 1/4 lb. whole fresh snow pea pods (ends trimmed)
steps: In jar with tight fitting lid, combine oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, red peppers, garlic, chives, basil and dill.
Shake well until combined.
Cook pasta.
Drain and turn into a large salad bowl.
Add dressing and toss.
Meanwhile, prepare vegetables.

recipes.title: Hot Tuna Supreme
steps: Put tuna, peas and mushroom soup in microwave dish; microwave 5 minutes.
Place slice of bread, covered with slice of cheese, in plate.
Pour tuna, peas and soup over it.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Broiled Dinner
ingredients: 1 c. fine dry bread or cracker crumbs
2 cans (16 oz.) whole potatoes, well drained
2 medium tomatoes, halved and seasoned with salt and pepper
steps: Set oven to broil.
Mix ground beef, crumbs, salt, steak sauce and tomato juice.
Lightly form into 4 thick patties; place on broiler pan rack.
Arrange potatoes beside meat; dot with butter and sprinkle with pepper and seasoned salt.
Broil about 4 inches from heat until patties are browned (3 to 5 minutes); turn.
Again dot potatoes with butter; place tomato halves on rack beside potatoes.
Broil 3 to 5 minutes longer, until meat is browned. Cover each pattie with an onion slice; top with a slice of cheese. Broil until cheese melts.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
steps: Brown ground beef with chopped onion.
Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Serve with cornbread or chips.

recipes.title: Shortcake("Want-Ta-Be")
steps: In 9 x 13-inch pan spread vanilla wafer cookies.
Crush and spread strawberries.
Slice kiwis and cover strawberries.
Add thick layer of whipped cream (from scratch) and top with sliced bananas.
One slice is enough.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb ground chuck, browned and drained
steps: Add to cooked beef, soups, water and pasta. Heat to a boil. Cook over medium heat 10 minutes or until done, stirring often.

recipes.title: Madrigal Marinated Carrots(Serves 50)
ingredients: 1 (51 oz.) can cream of tomato soup
