steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients.
Add onions and green peppers. Heat remaining ingredients; pour over vegetables.
Marinate 12 hours or more.
Drain to serve.
Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
steps: Mix together sour cream, cream cheese and taco mix.
Spread in pan or bowl.
Spread Cheddar cheese on top. Then spread lettuce, tomatoes and olives on top.

recipes.title: Fettuccine Salad
steps: Boil fettuccine as directed on package.
Slice carrot, green and red peppers (1 of each or as many as you'd like) thin.
Dice the onion.
Crumble Feta cheese.
Mix all together.
You may also throw in sliced black olives, if you'd like.
About 1/2 hour before serving, mix up dressing and mix with all the ingredients. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Icebox Fruit Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together; pack firmly back into vanilla wafer box and store in refrigerator until ready to eat.

recipes.title: Brown Bag Baked Turkey
steps: You will need a brown grocery bag.
Rinse and dry turkey with paper towels.
Rub cavity with small amount of salt.
Stuff with stuffing.
On outside of turkey, rub with Crisco.
Do not use any shortening with salt.
Bag in brown grocery bag.
Be sure there's not any holes or tears in bag; print side of bag should be on bottom.
Bag should not touch breast of turkey.
Fold over end and seal with paper clips or staple.
Put on roaster rack oven pan. Bake at 325°.
Bake 20 minutes per pound if under 12 pounds; bake 25 minutes per pound if over 12 pounds.
No peeking.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
steps: Mix together first 5 ingredients; stir in next 4 ingredients. Mix well, place over boiling water and cook about 10 minutes or until mixture bubbles.
Remove from heat and cover completely. Must not be warm at all.
Can be chilled in refrigerator.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Beat in sugar.
Fold into pumpkin mixture.
Blend well.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Serve with whipped cream or honey.

recipes.title: Baked Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 (2 1/4 oz.) can sliced ripe olives, drained
1 lb. ground beef, cooked and drained
steps: In a large skillet, saut onion and green pepper in butter until tender. Add tomatoes, mushrooms, olives and oregano. Add cooked ground beef. Simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Place half of spaghetti in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish sprayed with Pam. Top with half of the

meat mixture. Sprinkle with 1 cup of Cheddar cheese. Repeat layers. Mix the soup with water until smooth and pour over the casserole. Sprinkle with the Parmesan cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry Delight Cake
steps: Mix all the ingredients well and bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Hamburger Soup
steps: Brown beef and add onion and garlic.
Cook until tender. Drain, then add other ingredients.
Cook for 3 hours or 7 hours in a crock-pot.
Add other vegetables, if desired.

recipes.title: Pasta With Shrimp And Peas
steps: Bring large pot of water to boil.
Heat butter in large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and shrimp; sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon salt and cook, stirring until shrimp are pink, 2 minutes.
With slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to bowl.
Add clam juice to skillet and bring to boil; boil 3 minutes.
Stir in cream, peas, 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper; return to boil and boil for 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, add 1 tablespoon salt and pasta to boiling water.
Cook just until pasta is tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain.
Stir shrimp and lemon peel into sauce.
Toss with pasta.

recipes.title: Ginger Candied Carrots(Serves 6)
ingredients: 12 medium-sized carrots, peeled and cut into 1-inch lengths
steps: Cook carrots in cold water until tender, 25 to 30 minutes. Melt butter in saucepan; add brown sugar, ginger and caraway seed. Drain carrots; return to pot and add butter mixture.
Cook over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Helen'S Oven Roast
ingredients: 1 pkg. Lipton onion soup mix (do not add water)
1 can cream of mushroom soup (do not add water)
steps: Will also need 2 sheets of aluminum foil (enough to cover roast).
Crisscross the foil.
It should look like a plus sign.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
steps: Cook onion, celery and garlic in oil until light and yellow. Add tomatoes and seasonings.
Simmer 40 minutes.
Add shrimp. Cook 10 minutes longer. Serve on hot steamed rice.

recipes.title: Lemon Icebox Pie
steps: Stir together milk, egg yolks and lemon juice and place in graham cracker crust.
You may top this with whip cream or Cool Whip or you may make a meringue out of the egg whites. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Drain pineapple.
Mix pineapple juice with water according to directions on Jello.
Let cool.
Grind cranberries and add one cup of sugar and mix.
Combine all ingredients with Jello liquid and place in a mold (or tube pan). Refrigerate to jell.
To remove from mold, dip in hot water.

recipes.title: Seafood Salad
ingredients: 2 lb. imitation crab meat, chopped into bite-sized pieces
steps: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Snowball
steps: Soften gelatine in cold water for 10 minutes.
Add boiling water and stir until gelatine is dissolved.
Add salt, sugar and juices and cool until set.
In meantime, remove crust from cake and pull cake in small pieces.
Line mold or round bowl with wax paper. Whip one cup of cream, fold in gelatin mixture and pour layer of gelatine in mold.
Add layer of cake and alternate, ending with gelatine.
Refrigerate.
Unmold, frost with remaining cup of whipped cream; sprinkle with coconut.

recipes.title: Best Ever Meat Loaf
steps: Pour over meat loaf (may halve sauce ingredients).
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Pralines
steps: Mix brown sugar and nuts together and store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Easy Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 packet dry cheese powder from any brand macaroni and cheese box mix
steps: Mix all ingredients together until smooth.
Add any of the following to taste:
onion powder, garlic powder, dried parsley flakes, dried green pepper, bacon bits, sunflower seeds, dill seed, celery seed, onion flakes, chopped nuts, paprika
and red pepper.

recipes.title: Caesar Pasta Salad
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Drain and cool. Add broccoli, cauliflower, cucumber, tomato and red pepper.
Toss salad with Caesar salad dressing and Parmesan cheese.
Chill.
To serve, squeeze lemon juice over salad; garnish with fresh parsley. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Better Than Anything Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 12 oz. carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan.
Prepare cake mix as directed on package.
Pour into prepared pan.
After 10 minutes of baking, sprinkle with chocolate chips.
Continue baking until cake is done.
While cake is still hot, poke holes in it about 1-inch apart with handle of wooden spoon.
Pour sweetened condensed milk over cake.
Then pour caramel sauce over cake and especially into holes.
Let cool.
(Can put in refrigerator for 1 hour.)
Top with whipped cream and crushed Heath bars.
Makes 12 to 16 servings.
Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Three Step Cake
steps: Bake cake according to directions in 9 x 13-inch pan.
While hot, poke cake top with holes and spread the condensed milk over the top, filling holes.
Then spread butterscotch topping.
Cool completely.
Frost with Cool Whip and crushed Heath bars. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Egg Cups
steps: Spread bread with margairne and press, spread side down, into muffin cups.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Melt 3 tablespoons margarine in skillet and add eggs, ham and onions.
Cook slowly, stirring occasionally, until eggs are almost set.
Add cheese; continue cooking until cheese melts and eggs are done.
Fill toast cups.

recipes.title: Tuna Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients
together
and
serve as a dip with crackers.
(Tastes like crab dip, a good fooler.)

recipes.title: Butter Bean Pie
ingredients: 1 large can Luck's big white butter beans
steps: Brown ground beef and drain.
In large Pyrex dish, put in one pie crust, like you would for a deep dish pie.
Add a layer of ground beef, a layer of butter beans and a layer of sliced onions. Cover this with ketchup.
Repeat this to the top of the dish. With the last layer, add water with ketchup to fill completely to the top of bowl.
Put top layer of crust and crimp crust together on sides.
Cook at 350° until crust is brown.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: chicken (I use the boneless, skinless breast pieces; have the chicken boiled)
egg noodles, that have been cooked in the broth where you boiled the chicken pieces
Stove Top stuffing, made up from directions on pkg.
steps: Alternate layers of chicken, noodles and stuffing.
Place the chicken in a large casserole dish.
Put sauce (a combination of soups plus the leftover broth from the cooked noodles).
Manage to have enough sauce to cover each layer.
When all is used, sprinkle grated cheese over the top of the dish.
Put in the oven and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
"Very good and tasty!
A big casserole!"

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1 can mixed Chinese vegetables (La Choy chop suey)
steps: Drain vegetables; add soup, sliced
eggs,
pimentos and cheese.
Mix and pour into greased pan.
Sprinkle
with
bread or cracker crumbs.
Bake 25 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Bourbon Balls
ingredients: 60 each vanilla wafer cookies, pulverized into crumbs
steps: In a small heavy saucepan, melt the chopped chocolate over low heat, stirring almost constantly to prevent the bottom from scorching.
Remove the pan from the heat and let the chocolate cool to lukewarm.
Combine the vanilla wafer crumbs, pecans and 2/3 cup of sugar in a deep bowl.
Pour in the chocolate, bourbon and corn syrup.
Stir vigorously with a wooden spoon until the ingredients are well combined.
Shape mixture into balls about 1-inch in diameter.
Roll the balls in the remaining sugar and place them in a wide mouthed 1-quart jar with a secure lid.

recipes.title: Olive Crostini
steps: Chop olives coarsely in food processor.
Transfer to medium bowl.
With machine running, drop garlic through feed tube and mince.
Add Parmesan, butter and olive oil.
Process to a paste. Add butter mixture to bowl with olives.
Fold in Monterey Jack and parsley.
Mix well.

recipes.title: Best Ever Meat Loaf
steps: Mix together soup mix, mushroom soup, mustard, onions, salt, pepper, egg and sage.
Add bread crumbs and let set 10 minutes. Add meat and cheese.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken Bake(Lo-Cal)
ingredients: 1/4 c. dry seasoned bread crumbs (example: Pepperidge Farm)
3 chicken breasts, split and skinned (6 halves)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine bread crumbs, cheese and seasonings in shallow dish.
Dip chicken in crumb mixture.
Coat both sides.
Melt margarine in baking dish in oven.
Add chicken, turning to coat both sides with margarine.
Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour.
Has 219 calories per 2 halves.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli until tender but firm (either on stove or in microwave).
Put cooked broccoli in casserole.
Add soup, milk, bread crumbs or croutons and mix well.
Rip or cut up the cheese slices and arrange on top.
Put in oven at 350° and heat until bubbly.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
ingredients: 1 cup whipped cream (I use Cool Whip)
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water and add frozen berries.
Chill until it begins to get solid.
Add pineapple, nuts and mix well. Put 1/2 of the mixture into 8-inch square pan and chill.
Fold whipped cream into remaining mixture and pour on top of the first jello mixture.
Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Sante Fe Soup
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
steps: Simmer 30 minutes. Can be made ahead of time.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
ingredients: 2 slices lite bread, made into crumbs
1/2 c. finely diced celery and onions
steps: Mix all ingredients together until well blended.
Form into individual balls.
Place balls on cookie sheet that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
Freeze.

recipes.title: French Dressing(Salad)
steps: Place ingredients in jar and mix.
Can be put in blender to chop onion.
Keep in refrigerator.
Makes 1 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Prepare bouillon broth.
Beat eggs well.
When broth is hot, but not boiling, pour beaten eggs very slowly into broth, stirring with a fork so eggs string.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Hot Potato Salad
steps: Boil potatoes with jackets on.
Let cool and peel.
Grate on cheese grater.
Mix sour cream, margarine and potatoes.
Add onions, salt, pepper and half the grated cheese.
Mix all ingredients and place in a casserole dish with cover and refrigerate overnight.
Cover with 1 cup (remaining) grated cheese and bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: New England Fish Chowder
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. haddock fillets, cut in half
1 c. potato, cut up into bite-size pieces
steps: Cook and stir onions in butter in a 2-quart saucepan until onion is tender (not browned).
Remove from heat.
Add haddock, potato, salt and pepper with enough water to cover.
Cover and cook until potato is tender and fish is flaky (about 15 minutes). Stir in milk and heat.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Pie
steps: Put frozen broccoli in water to thaw.
Grease deep pie pan. Put broccoli, chicken, onion and 2/3 cheese in pan.
Mix eggs, milk, Bisquick and seasonings; beat 1 minute.
Pour over mix in pan.
Bake 30-40 minutes in 400° oven, until knife comes out clean.
Spread rest of cheese on top.
Return to oven to melt.

recipes.title: Dilly Cheese Ring
ingredients: 2 cans Hungry Jack flaky biscuits (10 oz.)
steps: Cheddar cheese or Colby/Jack mixture can be substituted for Parmesan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge
steps: Boil butter, sugar and milk together for 9 minutes.
Remove from heat and add Marshmallow Creme, vanilla and chocolate chips. Beat until it thickens.
Pour in 2 large buttered pans.
Makes 4 pounds.

recipes.title: Rocky Road Fudge Candy
steps: Melt chocolate candy over double boiler.
Remove from heat and pour over nuts and marshmallows.
Stir and pour into a buttered 8-inch pan and chill.
Cut into squares before too cold.

recipes.title: Spiced Pecans
steps: Mix sugar, cinnamon, cream of tartar and water.
Boil until soft ball stage.
Remove from heat.
Add pecans and vanilla flavoring.
Stir until mixture begins to sugar.
Pour out on wax paper and separate pecans.
Let cool and store in tin.

recipes.title: Roman Beans Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. bag pink Roman beans (goya section) *
steps: *Recipe for 1/2 a bag.

recipes.title: Chinese Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, sliced and drained
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients and chopped onions.
Mix well. Combine sugar and vinegar in bowl and mix well.
Pour over veggies.
Toss to mix.
Chill overnight, stirring every once in a while.
Yield: 15 servings.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pizza
ingredients: 1 c. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
steps: On floured board, roll out dough to fit a 12-inch greased round pizza pan.
Press dough against bottom and sides of pan.
Roll down edge and push seams together to form crust.
Top with sausage, cooked and drained and potatoes, thawed.
In bowl, beat eggs and milk.
Spoon over pizza.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Refrigerator Cake
steps: Drain pineapple.
Reserve 1 cup juice.
Dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup of cold juice.
Place sugar, butter and beaten eggs in top of double boiler with remaining cup of juice.
Cook at simmering heat about 8 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in gelatin and crushed pineapple.
Arrange vanilla wafers on bottom and sides of low casserole.
Pour in sugar pineapple mixture.
Chill. Decorate with whole pineapple slices and whipped cream.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Canning Beets
steps: Wash beets.
Leave about 4 inches of stem.
Cook until tender. Drain.
Peel.
Peelings come off when run under cold water. (Wear plastic gloves to avoid staining hands.)
Cut into slices or wedges.

recipes.title: Dilly Beans
steps: After beans have been thoroughly cleaned, pack into jars lengthwise, leaving 1-inch headspace to each pint. Add 1/4 teaspoon pepper, 1 clove garlic and 1 dill head. Combine remaining ingredients; bring to boiling point. Pour over beans while boiling hot and seal. Process for 10 minutes in hot bath. Let beans sit for 2 to 4 weeks to allow flavor to develop. Makes 4 pints.

recipes.title: Mustard Salad Dressing
steps: Put all ingredients in mixing bowl; beat with mixer until blended and thick.
Store in a tight jar in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Congealed Cranberry Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in hot water.
Dissolve Knox gelatine in 1 or 2 tablespoons of cold water.
Mix all ingredients and chill in a 9 x 13 dish.

recipes.title: Cheese Log
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch-style dressing mix
steps: Soften cream cheese and Cheddar cheese until room temperature. Mix in Hidden Valley.
Shape into log and roll in parsley flakes or chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Never Fail Egg White Meringue
steps: Blend cornstarch and cold water.
Add boiling water.
Cook until thick and clear.
Let it get cold and then add to egg whites.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
steps: Mix all together and roll into balls.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
steps: Mix well.
Put in a greased 8 x 8-inch Pyrex dish or pan. Cook approximately 30 minutes in 400° preheated oven.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
steps: Stir asparagus, boiled eggs, soup and milk together and put in casserole dish.
Place cracker crumbs on top.
Pour oleo over crumbs.
Bake at 325° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Margarita Pie
ingredients: 1/4 c. whipping cream, whipped and sweetened to taste
steps: Combine gelatin, 1/2 cup sugar and salt in saucepan.
Beat egg yolks and lime juice until foamy.
Stir into gelatin mixture.
Cook over low heat until gelatin is dissolved.
Stir in tequila, liqueur and lime peel.
Chill until thick, but not set.

recipes.title: Armenian Tossed Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients into large salad bowl (except last two).
Sprinkle with lemon juice combined with vegetable seasoning or with your favorite tomato dressing.
Then toss.

recipes.title: Guacamole
ingredients: 3 hot green chilies, seeded and chopped
steps: Peel; mash avocados.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Squeeze lime juice over dip to prevent turning brown.
Decorate with fresh coriander to serve.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Turkey Tetrazzini(6 To 8 Servings)
steps: Cook spaghetti in 1 1/2 quarts of water until tender; drain and rinse.
Melt butter; saute onion.
Add liquid from can of mushrooms; blend in can of chicken soup and evaporated milk, mushrooms, marjoram, pimento, meat and Cheddar cheese, cut in chunks.
Pour into buttered oblong casserole.
Pour sauce over top.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes. Can be prepared ahead and kept in refrigerator until baking.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
steps: In large mixing bowl, combine 1 stick soft butter, hash browns, sour cream, cheese soup and onion.
Pour contents into casserole dish.
Sprinkle top with crushed corn flakes mixed with 1/2 stick butter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pizza Hot Dish
steps: Mix together. Spread Mozzarella or Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 350° until cheese melts and is brown.

recipes.title: Cherry Salad
steps: Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups boiling water.
Cool.
Add sugar to sour cherries and bring to boil.
Cool.
Combine mixtures and add pineapple and almond extract.
Pour into mold and congeal.

recipes.title: Broiled Scallops
steps: Combine mustard, honey, curry and lemon juice.
Brush onto scallops.
Broil under low heat for 8 to 10 minutes.
Turn, and brush scallops again.
Cook until lightly brown.

recipes.title: Chili Dip
steps: Brown meat with onion.
Add ketchup, cumin, chili powder and salt.
Mash kidney beans with fork; add to meat mixture.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Remove from heat; set aside for 2 1/2 hours (covered).
Reheat in chafing dish.
To serve, sprinkle grated cheese, more chopped onion and chopped olives.
Serve with tortilla chips.
Replenish cheese and onion on top, as needed.

recipes.title: Pear Preserves
steps: Wash, pare and core pears.
Run through grinder or processor until fine.
Measure out 4 1/2 cups.
Mix with 1 box of Sure-Jell. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring constantly.
Add all at once, 5 cups sugar and teaspoon of allspice or cinnamon.
Bring to full rolling boil again and time 1 minute, stirring constantly. Cool 5 minutes.
Skim foam and seal into sterile jars.
Can process 10 minutes in boiling water bath for safety.
Makes 4 pints.

recipes.title: Bailey'S Fudge Sauce
steps: Slowly melt butter and chocolate in medium saucepan.
Remove from heat and add sugar and evaporated milk alternately.
Stir until smooth.
Return to heat; simmer 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Potato Topper
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can Campbell's condensed Cheddar cheese soup
steps: In a 1 1/2-quart saucepan, stir soup, sour cream and mustard. Heat good, stirring occasionally.
Stir in broccoli flowerets. Heat and spoon in baked potatoes.

recipes.title: Not Your Ordinary Meat Loaf
ingredients: brown sugar and ketchup for topping
steps: Combine ground beef, onion, pepper, ketchup and eggs.
Add enough crackers to make mixture dry, yet moist enough to hold together.
Form into a loaf; place into a baking dish.
Pour 1 1/2 cups of water around base.
Mix ketchup and brown sugar together to form a paste; spread over top of meat loaf.
Cover with foil and bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Remove foil; bake 30 minutes more. Drain off excess water.
Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Cape Cod Fish Chowder
ingredients: 1 bay leaf, crumbled (remove after chowder is done)
1 tsp. salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
steps: Simmer fish in 2 cups water for 15 minutes.
Drain off and reserve broth. Remove skin and bones from fish.
Saute the diced pork in a large pot until crisp. Saute onions and pork fat until golden brown. Add fish, celery, potatoes and bay leaf.
Measure reserved fish broth, plus enough boiling water to make 3 cups liquid.
Add to pot and simmer 30 minutes. Add milk and butter and simmer for an additional 5 minutes or until well heated.
Season with salt and pepper.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Easy Black Forest Cake
steps: Bake cake mix by directions on box in sheet cake pan.
Punch holes in cake with fork.
Pour pie filling over cake.
Cool completely.
Spread Cool Whip over cherries.
Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Company Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes, boiled, peeled and shredded
1/3 c. chopped green onions (green part only)
steps: Heat soup and butter until melted.
Stir in sour cream and pour over potatoes.
Add green onions and stir in cheese.
Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan.
Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Can be made ahead and refrigerated until ready to heat.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
steps: Cook eggplant and onion in boiling water for 10 minutes, covered.
Drain and mash.
Add margarine, eggs, milk and seasoning; mix.
Pour into slightly greased casserole dish.
Combine cheese and bread crumbs as a topping.
Bake for 25 minutes at 375° or until light brown.

recipes.title: Southern Cornbread Dressing
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour in a large roasting pan. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
Makes enough to serve large family gatherings.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Relish
ingredients: 4 c. red and green bell peppers
steps: Sprinkle vegetables with 1/2 cup salt.
Let stand overnight. Rinse and drain.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Pour over vegetable mixture.
Heat to boiling; simmer 3 minutes.
Seal in hot sterile jars.
Makes 8 pints.

recipes.title: Gazpacho(Cold Soup)
steps: Mix all together and chill overnight.

recipes.title: Low-Calorie Chicken
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Roll chicken in tomato juice mix. Place, skin side down, in baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Turn chicken and pour remaining tomato juice over it.
Continue baking for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Delight
ingredients: enough milk to soak cookies with
steps: In coffee cup or similar size container, fill with enough milk to cover size of cookie.
Dip each cookie with just enough to "bubble" a second or two.
If you hold it in too long, it will fall to pieces.
After cookie is wet with milk, layer in a flat square covered container.
When a layer is completed, spread Cool Whip on top of cookies, being sure not to "mix" with cookies.
Continue with process until cookies are gone, or container is full.
End with Cool Whip.
Keep refrigerated until time to serve.
Kids love it so much, they call it "ice cream".

recipes.title: Chow Mein Noodle Candy
ingredients: 2 (6 oz.) pkg. or 1 (12 oz.) pkg. butterscotch morsels
steps: Melt butterscorch morsels over low heat.
Mix in noodles and peanuts and stir until well coated.
Spoon out on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Summer Sausage
steps: Mix ingredients; divide in half.
Wrap in Saran Wrap.
Let sit 8 hours (in refrigerator).
Bake for 1 hour in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Deluxe Bars
steps: Cook together the brown sugar, milk, butter and graham cracker crumbs for 7 minutes; remove from heat.
Add coconut and vanilla. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with layer of Club soda crackers.
Put 1/2 filling on crackers, then another layer of Club crackers.
Add the rest of filling.
Cool in refrigerator.
Top all with melted butter and chips.
Cool overnight.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
steps: Mix sugar, milk, cocoa and margarine together and bring to a rolling boil over medium heat.
Boil for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and add oatmeal, peanut butter and vanilla.
Mix well and drop by spoon onto wax paper.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Mocha Cappuccino
steps: Combine coffee and cocoa, stirring until cocoa is dissolved; pour into 2 cappuccino or coffee cups.
Add 1/4 cup skim milk to each cup and stir.
Top each with 1 tablespoon Cool Whip and sprinkle with grated chocolate.
Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Mix all ingredients except pecans.
Form into a ball and roll in pecans.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Tirami-Su
ingredients: 2 oz. grated chocolate or semi-sweet cocoa
steps: Beat egg yolks and sugar together.
Add Mascarpone cheese; blend well.
Beat egg whites until peaks form; fold into cheese mixture.

recipes.title: Garbage Plates
steps: Combine all ingredients except soup and cheese in a cast-iron pan.
Cook until done.
Add soup and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes. Smother with cheese and place under broiler for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Mini Cheesecakes
steps: You will need 18 paper muffin cups.

recipes.title: Linda'S Lasagna
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic, minced (may substitute garlic powder or salt)
1/2 lb. Mozzarella cheese, sliced or shredded
steps: Cook noodles in salted water about 15 minutes.
Drain.
Heat oil in skillet; cook garlic and onion until soft.
Add beef and seasonings and cook until crumbly.
Add tomato paste and water. Simmer 5 minutes.
Set aside.
In a baking dish 9x13x2 inches, put a thin layer of meat sauce, half the noodles, all of the Ricotta cheese, and half of the Mozzarella cheese.
Repeat with half of the remaining meat sauce, the rest of the noodles, remainder of sauce, and Mozzarella.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Pintos
steps: Slice onions and separate in rings.
Soak in sweet milk for 1 hour or overnight, if you like.
Make batter of Aunt Jemima pancake mix, as it says on box.
Have the batter pretty thick. Dip onion rings one at a time in the batter and drop in hot deep fry grease.
Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Light Southern Pecan Pie
steps: Cream butter; add brown sugar gradually and cream, mixing well.
Blend in syrup and vanilla thoroughly.
Add eggs and pecans.
Turn into pie shell.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°; bake for 25 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Mini Cheese-Cakes
steps: Line muffin tin with foil liners.
Place one vanilla wafer on each liner.
Mix cream cheese, vanilla and sugar on medium speed until well-blended.
Add eggs.
Mix well.
Pour over wafers, filling 3/4 full.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow or white cake mix
1/2 to 1 c. chopped pecans or walnuts
steps: Grease a tube pan (not the two piece kind).
Place pineapple in bottom of pan. Cover with pie filling, cake mix and then nuts. Cut butter into pieces and place over cake.
Do not mix.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serve warm or cold by dipping or dumping out with a spoon. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Buffet Casserole
ingredients: 1 (7 oz.) pkg. (2 c.) shell macaroni (medium), cooked
4 oz. sharp process American cheese, shredded
steps: Brown beef, onion and garlic in 1 tablespoon oil.
Cook spinach and drain, reserving liquid.
Add water to make 1 cup. Stir liquid, tomato and spaghetti sauces, salt and pepper into meat mixture and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Whipples
ingredients: 1 box any flavor cake mix (I use chocolate and yellow)
steps: Grease a cookie sheet. Combine cake mix, Cool Whip and egg in a large bowl. This will be sticky. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls into a small bowl filled with powdered sugar. Roll into a ball to coat. Place balls on the cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes. Edges should be just slightly browned.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 c. half and half (milk and cream)
steps: Mix softened cream cheese, half and half and sugar.
Beat until smooth.
Fold in other ingredients.

recipes.title: Margarita Pie
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) pkg. no-bake lemon pie mix
pie shell mix or frozen pie shell
steps: Prepare pie shell using ingredients in package and following label directions.

recipes.title: El Dorado Casserole
ingredients: 3 to 4 chopped chilies or small can diced chilies
steps: Using taco seasoning, prepare meat following package directions.
Add tomato sauce.
Combine sour cream, cottage cheese, chilies and olives in a bowl.
Crush 1/2 package of chips and put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Add 1/2 meat mixture, 1/2 cheese mixture and 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese.
Repeat layers, finishing with Monterey Jack cheese.
Top with crushed chips and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Pour wine over chicken and return to oven for 30 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pink Punch
ingredients: 1 pkg. cherry or strawberry Kool-Aid, prepared as directed for 1/2 gal.
6 oz. can frozen orange juice concentrate (do not add water)
steps: Mix these 3 ingredients and chill. Before serving, add 1 liter chilled ginger ale.

recipes.title: Italian Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chops (1-inch thick), seasoned with salt and pepper
steps: Trim pork chops.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Saute until browned. Place chops in a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Place mushrooms on chops.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (9 oz.) container frozen nondairy dessert topping
steps: Blend all ingredients, except pie crusts, together.
Spoon into crusts.
Chill until cold.
Keeps in refrigerator for a week.

recipes.title: Homemade Lasagna
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook noodles in 6 quarts boiling water to which has been added 2 tablespoons salt.
Cook rapidly for 15 minutes.
Stir gently.
Remove from heat and drain.
Pour cold water over to cool.
Cook hamburger in heavy saucepan until color changes.
Add onions, garlic, tomato paste, water and salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch pan.
Start with a layer of noodles, then Mozzarella cheese, then cottage cheese, then meat sauce.
Continue layering in that order until all is used up.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: "The Dream"
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli or 1 large family size bag
2 c. cooked chicken or 1 pkg. chicken breasts, diced
1/2 tsp. curry powder or to taste (we like a lot of curry)
3/4 c. shredded Cheddar cheese or favorite hard cheese
1 c. soft bread crumbs or use seasoned crumbs (we like a lot of crumbs, 2 to 3 c.)
3 tsp. melted butter or margarine (more crumbs means more butter, 1/2 stick)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease an 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch baking dish or spray with Pam or whatever.
Cook broccoli and drain.
Arrange broccoli in baking dish (I nuke my broccoli just to thaw it out).
Place cooked chicken on top of broccoli. Combine soup, lemon juice, mayonnaise and curry powder.
Pour this mixture over the chicken and broccoli.
Sprinkle with the shredded cheese.
Combine bread crumbs with butter or margarine and garlic powder.
Sprinkle over all.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until bubbling and crumbs are brown.
Enjoy!!!!

recipes.title: Easy Marshmallow Strawberry Pie
ingredients: 1 c. frozen or sweetened fresh strawberries
1 cooked pie crust or crumb crust
steps: Melt marshmallows with milk in top of double boiler.
Let cool.
Fold in whipped cream and strawberries.
Pour into cool cooked pie crust or crumb crust.
Cool for several hours.
Serve with whipped cream and top each slice with a strawberry.
Can make a day ahead.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad Supreme
steps: The night before, cook linguine and refrigerate.
Mix Salad Supreme and Italian dressing; refrigerate overnight.
Chop veggies; add to both linguine and salad dressing.

recipes.title: Orange Jello Salad
steps: Mix first 3 and let boil 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add 2 cups of cold water.
Mix; put in refrigerator until begins to jell good.
Add 2 cups shredded cheese and 1 (8 ounce) carton of Cool Whip.
Mix well and put back in refrigerator to jell.

recipes.title: Marinade For Chicken
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour over chicken and marinate for two hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Denver Omelet(Serves 2)
ingredients: 2 oz. each: Cheddar cheese, Mozzarella cheese and Monterey Jack cheese
steps: Melt margarine in large skillet.
Add onions, pepper and mushrooms.
In medium bowl, mix eggs and milk.
When onions become translucent, add egg mixture to skillet.
As eggs cook, shred cheese.
Add cheese immediately before serving.

recipes.title: Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. Monterey Jack cheese (jalapeno peppers)
steps: Brown the hamburger and drain well.
Mix with the refried beans and taco sauce.
Set this aside, then shred the cheese and dice the onion.
In separate bowl, mix cheese and onion together.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
steps: Combine ingredients in bowl, mix until creamy, smooth and all lumps are removed.
Serve with fresh strawberries, melons or grapes on fruit tray.

recipes.title: Kristi'S Chicken Wings
steps: Use one bag cut up chicken wings. Fry chicken wings in grease for 10 to 12 minutes or until done. Cook all ingredients until well blended.
Place chicken wings in sauce and cook 2 to 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Cook at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour, uncovered.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookies
steps: Mix together.
Make into balls (1 teaspoon).
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Bananas Flambe
steps: Cut bananas in half lengthwise.
Toss in lemon juice.
Set aside.
Combine sugar and margarine in a large skillet.
Cook over low heat 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until sugar melts.
Add bananas.
Stir gently and cook 1 to 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
Remove from heat.
Pour brandy over banana mixture and ignite.
Let flames die down and serve immediately.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Microwave Fudge
ingredients: 3 c. semi-sweet or milk chocolate chips
steps: Place all ingredients except nuts in large bowl.
Microwave at Medium (50%) until chips are melted, 3 to 5 minutes, stirring once or twice during cooking.
Stir in nuts.
Pour into well-greased square baking dish, 8 x 8-inches.
Refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Easy To Do Beef Stew
steps: Melt butter.
Put beef and potatoes in butter.
Boil carrots in beef broth for 10 minutes.
Spray baking dish with pan spray.
Pour meat, potatoes, carrots and broth into pan.
Add stewed tomatoes and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Clusters
steps: Melt chips in microwave bowl on medium.
Stir to blend.
Pour in peanuts and stir.
Drop by tablespoonfuls onto wax paper and cool.

recipes.title: Dreamsicle Punch
ingredients: 1 ginger ale or any lemon-lime soda
steps: Place vanilla ice cream and frozen orange juice concentrate in punch bowl.
Add pineapple juice and ginger ale.
Stir and serve.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb. fillet of beef, cut in julienne strips (round steak or sirloin can be used)
salt and fresh ground pepper to taste
1/2 c. sour pickles (cornichons), cut into thin strips (optional)
steps: Sprinkle meat with paprika, salt and pepper.
Heat the butter in a very hot skillet.
Add meat, stirring to separate the pieces to cook evenly, about 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove the meat with slotted spoon.
Add onion; saute for 1 minute.
Add the wine; cook down to reduce by half.
Lower the heat.
Add the sour cream, stirring (do not allow cream to boil, or it will curdle).
Return meat to pan.
Serve with noodles.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Ornaments
steps: Mix ingredients in a bowl.
Turn mixture out into a ball and roll out to 1/4-inch thickness.
Add cinnamon while rolling out mixture to prevent it from sticking.
Use holiday shaped cookie cutters to make ornaments.
Use tip of pencil to make small holes in tops of ornaments to hang them up later.
Let ornaments dry on tray for several days, turning them over with a spatula twice daily.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shake
steps: Combine all ingredients in blender.
Blend at high speed about 1 minute.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Pig Pickin' Cake
steps: Beat well.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Salad
steps: Cut cauliflower into bite-size pieces and mix with broccoli and onion.
Mix vinegar, sugar, oil and mayonnaise.
Pour over cauliflower and broccoli and let stand overnight.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Mix onion, mayonnaise and vegetables and place in casserole dish.
Cover mixture with cheese then crushed crackers.
Melt butter and pour over top.
Bake at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Mix all together and sprinkle crackers over top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 1 large head fresh broccoli, stems removed
1 1/2 c. extra sharp grated Cheddar cheese
steps: Place broccoli in large saucepan with 1 inch of water.
Bring to a boil, cover and steam for 5 minutes.
Drain and chop coarsely. Heat 3 tablespoons butter in skillet, add mushrooms and saute for 5 minutes, stirring.
Preheat oven to 350°.
In large mixing bowl, combine 8 tablespoons butter, onion, mushrooms, half and half, salt, pepper, mayonnaise and eggs.
Mix all.
Add 1 cup cheese and 1 1/2 cups Ritz crackers.
Mix well and scrape mixture into baking dish.
Sprinkle remaining cheese and crackers on top.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean. Let stand for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Sauerbraten
steps: Put all ingredients in crock-pot.
Add enough water to cover meat.
Cook slow 6 to 8 hours.
Remove meat; slice.
Put gravy through food mill.
Put meat back into gravy.

recipes.title: Creamy Egg Nog
steps: Beat egg yolks and sugar in large bowl until light and fluffy. Blend in remaining ingredients; chill.
Top each serving with whipped cream.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.

recipes.title: Cheese Wafers
ingredients: 1 small jar Old English sharp cheese spread
steps: Combine the cheese spread and the Bisquick.
Shape into a roll and roll in the sesame seed.
Chill for 2 hours. Slice 1/4-inch thick slices and place on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Hominy
steps: Place hominy in baking dish; add chili which has been heated. Add chopped onions, then cheese.
Top with chips.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. grated cheese (Cheddar or Monterey Jack)
steps: Cook meat and onion in skillet until meat is browned.
Add enchilada sauce and soup.
Blend well.
Break corn tortillas (either soft or crisp) into several pieces and line casserole dish.

Add layer of meat mixture and cheese; continue to layer tortilla, meat and cheese until you end with cheese on top. Either bake in 350° oven for about 25 minutes or cook in microwave for 5 minutes; turn and cook for 5 more minutes.

recipes.title: Zesty Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Grate all
three
cheese
blocks.
Boil
macaroni until soft. Drain and rinse macaroni with hot water and pour into a large pan. Melt butter
in pan, then gradually add the cheese until all of the
cheeses
have
melted.
Pour milk, stirring consistently. Add
stewed
tomatoes,
salt
and black pepper. Pour macaroni into a
large
baking
dish,
spreading evenly. Lightly sprinkle paprika
and parsley flakes.
Preheat oven at 350° and bake for 30
to 45 minutes.
Serves approximately 12 to 15.

recipes.title: Pear Under The Sea Salad
ingredients: 16 oz. pear halves, drained (reserve 3/4 c. syrup)
steps: Dice pears; set aside.
Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water.
Add reserved syrup and lemon juice.
Pour 1 1/4 cups into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan.
Chill until set, but not firm, about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Crinkle Cookies
ingredients: 1 pkg. moist devil's food cake mix
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Grease cookie sheet.
Mix together cake mix, eggs, oil and milk.
Place confectioners sugar in a small bowl.
Drop rounded teaspoonful of dough into the confectioners sugar.
Roll to coat and form into balls.
Place 2 inches apart on the cookie sheets.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 9 minutes or until set. (If you want them chewy like Laura likes them, don't overbake.) Cool 1 minute, then remove from pans.

recipes.title: Stuffed Pasta Shells
ingredients: 1 c. fresh spinach, chopped or 1 pkg. frozen spinach
1 pkg. cottage cheese (can also use ricotta cheese)
steps: Combine cottage cheese, spinach, 8 ounces Mozzarella cheese in a large bowl.
Cook pasta shells until tender.
Stuff pasta shells with cottage cheese mixture.
Pour 8 ounces of pasta sauce in baking pan.
Place stuffed shells in baking pan.
Pour remainder of pasta sauce on top of shells.
Sprinkle remainder of Mozzarella cheese on top.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Bittersweet Sauce
steps: Melt the butter or oleo and chocolate in a saucepan until smooth over low heat.
Stir in the cocoa, sugar, cream and salt. Bring slowly to just a boil; do not stir.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and serve warm.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
steps: Mix mayonnaise, Dream Whip and cream cheese with beater.
Add sugar and cranberries and pour into 9 x 13-inch pan; freeze.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Cake
steps: Prepare cake mix as directed on package.
Pour batter into 9 x 11 x 2-inch pan (approximately).
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until cake tests done.
Cool in pan.
When thoroughly cooled, blend pudding mix with milk and beat in cream cheese.
Fold Cool Whip into pudding-cheese mixture.
Spread over cooled cake. Sprinkle with pineapple, pecans, coconut and cherries.
Refrigerate until serving time.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Layered Dip(Cold)
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) grated taco cheese or Cheddar
1 (4 oz.) can sliced black olives, drained
steps: In a large flat 2-quart casserole, spread refried beans.
Mix sour cream with taco mix.
Spread on top of beans.
Layer picante and other ingredients in order, ending with olives.
Cover and refrigerate.
Serve chilled with Tostitos.
Serves 20 as an appetizer.

recipes.title: Tri-Color Tortellini Salad
ingredients: blanched broccoli florets (1/2 head or bunch)
10 sun-dried tomatoes, blanched and cut in matchstick pieces
steps: Boil tortellini according to instructions on package.
While the tortellini are cooking, mix the oil, vinegar, garlic and mustard together well.
Strain tortellini and add the oil mixture and all other ingredients and toss.
Let set for 15 minutes before serving.
It may be refrigerated and served the following day.

recipes.title: Microwave Potato Wedges
steps: Cut each potato into 8 wedges.
Combine water and next 4 ingredients in an 8-inch square baking dish.
Add potato wedges, tossing to coat.
Cover with wax paper.
Microwave at high 8 minutes of until tender, stirring after 4 minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley flakes and salt.
Yield:
4 servings.
Low fat recipe.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 medium sized zucchini, cut into cubes, boiled and drained
1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
steps: In bowl, manually stir together cooled zucchini, soup, cheese, sour cream, carrot and onion.
In pan, melt butter; add stuffing mix.
In greased casserole dish, put one layer zucchini mix and half of stuffing mix.
Add rest of zucchini mix and top with stuffing mix.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
steps: Mix well and add a few drops of lemon juice.
Place in a shallow dish and cover with Chathoms Seafood sauce.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
steps: Stir peanuts, corn syrup, sugar and salt together in 1 1/2-quart bowl.
Cook 7 to 8 minutes, uncovered.
Stir after 4 minutes.
Add oleo and vanilla; stir and cook 2 minutes more. Stir in baking soda until light and foamy.
Pour on greased cookie sheet and cool 1 hour.
Break into pieces.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: 1 medium size eggplant, peeled and sliced
steps: Cook eggplant in small amount of water for 10 minutes; drain. Add grated onion, bell pepper, beaten egg, Ro-Tel tomatoes, mushroom soup, garlic salt and salt and pepper to taste.
Grate cheese.
Melt butter and pour over cracker crumbs; mix.
Butter baking dish well.
Add in layers the eggplant, cheese and crumbs, making 2 layers.
Bake for 30 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Microwave Pralines
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
2/3 c. half and half or whipping cream
steps: Combine sugar, half and half and salt in deep 3-quart casserole.
Mix well.
Stir in butter.
Microwave at High for 7 to 9 1/2 minutes or until mixture reaches soft-ball stage (235°), stirring once.
Stir in pecans and cool about 1 minute.
Beat by hand until mixture is creamy and begins to thicken (about 3 minutes).
Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Pink Dessert
steps: Mix together the first 3 ingredients.
Fold in the Cool Whip and nuts and/or coconut.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Venison Jerky
steps: Trim all fat from meat; cut into very thin strips.
Mix and soak overnight.
Arrange strips on cookie sheet.
Set oven at 200°.
Leave oven door cracked to let moisture escape (put a spoon in the door).
Bake 4 to 7 hours.

recipes.title: Country Ham And Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb. fully cooked sliced ham (about 1/2-inch thick)
1 1/2 lb. potatoes, peeled, quartered and cooked
steps: In a large heavy skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat. Brown ham on both sides.
Move ham to one side of the skillet; brown potatoes in the drippings.
Sprinkle potatoes with parsley. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: 5 Bean Salad
steps: Drain beans. Add celery, onions and green pepper in bowl. Mix vinegar, sugar and salad oil; pour over beans. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: 5 Cup Salad
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin orange sections, drained
steps: Mix after each addition.
Chill for several hours or overnight.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Gooey Butter Cake
steps: Mix cake mix, butter, pecans and 1 egg with hands if necessary.
Press into a 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Mix all ingredients except the catsup thoroughly.
Shape into loaf and put into loaf pan.
Spread catsup on top of meat loaf. Bake at 400° for approximately one hour.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Mix the ingredients together.
Mix with already prepared boxed mix and several tablespoons of margarine.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Jan'S Quick Trifle
steps: Make pudding as directed on box.
Add sherry extract.
Let stand while breaking cake into crumbs.
Stir whipped cream through the pudding.
Add cake to mixture and garnish with maraschino cherries (cut up).
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
steps: Blend Eagle Brand and Cool Whip well, then add the rest of ingredients.
Makes 2 graham cracker crusts.
Sprinkle small amount of sugar on crusts and warm in oven.
Pour pie filling into crusts and chill.
Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
steps: Brown ground round.
Add chopped green pepper; stir.
Add chopped onion; stir.
Cover until softened, 5 minutes.
Add sauce and paste.
Add water until desired thickness.
Add garlic, oregano and pepper.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over pasta. Freezes well.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
steps: Butter a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix coconut and nuts and pour into pan.
Mix cake mix according to directions, using milk instead of water.
Pour on top of coconut and nuts.
Melt margarine and cream cheese.
Add 1 box confectioners sugar and mix well.
Pour this on top of cake mix.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Ice Cream
steps: Add sugar gradually to beaten eggs.
Beat until mixture is very stiff.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix together.
Put in ice cream freezer and freeze.
This recipe will serve 8 people.

recipes.title: Chocolate Rum Balls
steps: In large bowl, stir cookie crumbs and pecans and 1 cup powdered sugar and cocoa.
Stir in rum and syrup.
Stir until well blended.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Roll in 1/2 cup powdered sugar.
Store in tightly covered container.

recipes.title: Spicy Szechuan Noodles
steps: Soba (buckwheat) noodles can be purchased at Skagit Valley Co-op.
They are best because they absorb other flavors.
Cook soba according to directions on package.
Drain and rinse.
Mix sauce ingredients and toss with noodles and vegetables.
Garnish with toasted sesame seed if desired.
Can be served hot or cold. Make as spicy as you want with additional chili oil.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Bake Apples
steps: Wash apples but do not peel them.
Core by taking out center from top to bottom.
Cut thin slice off apple bottoms so they will sit upright in skillet.
Melt butter in heavy skillet over moderate flame.
Place apples in pan.
Fill core cavities with maple syrup.
Dust apples with cinnamon and pinch of nutmeg.
Add water to pan.
Cover and simmer over low flame for about 20 minutes.
Apples may be served as is or with dab of whipped cream. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Skillet Spaghetti
steps: In Dutch oven or a large pot, brown first 4 ingredients.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Stir in spaghetti.
Reduce heat and cook, uncovered, 10 to 15 minutes or until spaghetti is tender. Add the tomatoes and ketchup.
Add salt and pepper to taste. Simmer for a while on low heat to blend the flavors.
Serves 8. This is very good and may be doubled to serve larger groups.

recipes.title: Chewie Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. graham cracker pie crust mix
steps: Mix and place in large greased cookie sheet.
Pat flat and bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.
Cut into convenient squares while still warm.

recipes.title: Dirt Dessert
steps: Crumble Oreos in blender.
Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese. Prepare pudding.
In a flowerpot (or cake pan), layer ingredients (Oreos, Cool Whip and pudding).
Repeat; end with Oreos on top. Top with a plastic flower!!
Looks real cute made in a sand pail and served with a sand shovel or flowers served with a gardening trowel.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
steps: Break spaghetti in thirds.
Cook as directed on package. Rinse in cold water.
Chop the following ingredients together: cucumbers, green pepper, purple onion and tomatoes.
Mix spaghetti with vegetables.
Add McCormick's salad seasoning.
Stir well. Add about 8 to 12 ounces Zesty Italian dressing.
Refrigerate overnight.
Good for weeks.

recipes.title: Italian Beef
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb. chuck or shoulder roast
1/2 pkg. dry Italian salad dressing mix
1 small jar pepperoncini peppers and juice
steps: Place meat in crock-pot and cover with other ingredients. Cook on low overnight or 8 to 10 hours.

recipes.title: One Banana Drink Delight
steps: Place chopped banana into small bowl.
Stir in vanilla, honey, skimmed milk, brown sugar and Coffee-mate.
Beat for one minute with electric mixer or blender.
Put into cup with ice.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pizza
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
1 c. (4 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
steps: Cook sausage in a medium skillet until browned and then drain. Set aside.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Cook squash, potatoes and onion until tender.
Mix with cream of chicken and margarine.
Pour stuffing mix on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Mini Cheese And Onion Pastries
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) cans Pillsbury refrigerated quick crescent dinner rolls
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
In a small bowl, combine cheese and onions. Separate dough into 16 triangles; cut each in half diagonally to make 32 triangles.
Place rounded teaspoon of cheese mixture on center of each triangle.
Bring corners to center over filling overlapping ends; press gently to seal.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Brush each lightly with oil; sprinkle with dillweed.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 13 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: "Poke" Chops
steps: Sprinkle chops with meat tenderizer and "poke" into meat with fork.
Combine soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, oil and garlic salt in a shallow pan or casserole dish.
Put the pork chops in the marinade and place in refrigerator for at least 2 hours (overnight is best).
"Poke" and turn occasionally.
Cook on a grill for about 10 minutes on each side (can be broiled in oven). Baste with leftover marinade while meat cooks.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken
steps: Boil and debone chicken.
Put chicken in a greased casserole dish.
Mix mushroom soup and sour cream together.
Pour over chicken.
Melt margarine and mix with poppy seed.
Spread on top of casserole.
Bake for 20 to 30 minutes at 400 degrees.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Cake
ingredients: 1 box toasted coconut instant pudding (Royal brand)
steps: Mix above ingredients adding poppy seed last. Bake in Bundt pan at 325° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Heath Bar Cake
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) jar caramel topping (ice cream topping)
steps: Mix and bake cake as directed.
When cake comes out of oven, while warm, punch holes in cake (I use the end of a wooden spoon), about 1 1/2-inches apart.
Pour caramel topping over cake, making sure to fill holes.
Pour canned Eagle Brand sweetened milk all over top of cake.
Let this cool COMPLETELY.
When cake is completely cooled, spread Cool Whip on evenly just as you would frosting.
Top this with crushed Heath bars.
Refrigerate. Yuuuuuuuuuuuuum Good.

recipes.title: Strawberry Nut Cake
steps: Mix together and bake in tube pan for 45 minutes at 325° or 3 layers for 25 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Casserole
steps: Prepare instant mashed potatoes (serving for 12) as on box. Blend in rest of ingredients.
Top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Ben Getti
steps: Brown meat and onions lightly.
Cook noodles in salt water. Add all together.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients except Cool Whip.
Let stand overnight in refrigerator, then add 1 medium size tub Cool Whip.
Freeze in square freezable container.
Cut into squares and serve.

recipes.title: Macaroon Torte
steps: Boil 1/2 of the pineapple juice.
Add Knox gelatine until thick.
Line a 9 x 11-inch glass pan with cookies standing along sides, crushed on bottom (save some crushed cookies for top).

recipes.title: Cheese Squares
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into 8-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Jimmy Dean Country Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. Jimmy Dean sausage, cooked, crumbled and drained
steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan well.
Place bread in pan.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine rest of ingredients together and mix well. Pour over bread; refrigerate overnight.
Bake for 1 hour at 350° or until golden brown.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Tabitha'S Icing
steps: Melt butter; stir in brown sugar.
Bring to boil, stirring constantly.
Cook 2 minutes.
Stir in cream.
Bring to boil again. Take off heat.
Cool until lukewarm.
Stir in confectioners sugar.
Beat until spreading consistency.

recipes.title: Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 c mix yellow and white shoe peg whole kernel corn
1 small can french style green bean
steps: Mix all ingredients in large bowl pour all dressing.
Mix well.
Let stand about 30 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Mrs. Smith'S Pineapple Dessert
steps: Bake white cake mix as directed in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan. Cool.
Mix vanilla instant pudding as directed.
Blend in cream cheese with mixer.
Chill and then pour over cake, spreading evenly.
Place drained crushed pineapple on top.
Mix Dream Whip (which is fat-free) and cover cake with it.
Refrigerate.
Can be made ahead of time, even the day before.

recipes.title: Soft Drink Dairy Slush
ingredients: 4 or 5 oz. Dr. Pepper or other soft drink
steps: Mix equal parts of Dr. Pepper (or other soft drink) and milk. Pour mixture into an 8 or 9-ounce cup.
Freeze for 1 hour.
Serve with a spoon.

recipes.title: Shoyu Chicken
steps: Remove skin from chicken thighs.
Mix the ingredients in a pot.
Add chicken and boil for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Finger Jello
steps: In a bowl, mix all gelatin together.
Add boiling water.
Stir until dissolved.
Pour into a 13 x 9-inch cake pan.
Chill until firm.
Cut into squares or use your favorite cookie cutter.
Kids love this.

recipes.title: N C Barbecued Pork
steps: Pierce pork roast.
Marinate in vinegar, pepper and salt overnight, or at least for a few hours.
Drain marinade from meat and use as basting sauce during roasting time.

When roast is done, chop into bite size pieces and place in 3-quart casserole. Boil another cup of cider vinegar, to which you may add more pepper and salt, if needed, and pour over meat in casserole.
Put in a 300° oven for 30 to 45 minutes before serving.
Pass bottled hot sauce.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Burrito Bake
steps: Mix Bisquick, water and beans in greased casserole dish. Layer in rest and bake 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Lasagna
ingredients: 8 oz. pkg. Mozzarella cheese, coarsely grated (about 2 c.)
1 c. Parmesan cheese, grated (preferably freshly grated)
steps: Cook noodles according to package directions and drain. Meanwhile mix meat sauce and tomato sauce in a medium-sized bowl. In another bowl, mix Ricotta cheese, egg, onion, parsley, salt and pepper.
In each of 2 (11 x 7-inch) baking dishes, spread 1/2 cup tomato sauce mixture.
Top with a layer of noodles.
Spread each with 1/4 of Ricotta mixture and sprinkle with 1/4 of the Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses.
Spoon on 1 1/2 cups tomato sauce mixture.
Repeat layers, ending with a final layer of noodles and topping with remaining tomato sauce mixture.
Dishes now may be wrapped and frozen.
Thaw before baking.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
steps: In a large bowl, stir eggs, corn syrup, sugar, chocolate chips, butter and vanilla until well blended.
Stir in pecans. Pour into pastry shell.
Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.
Cool on wire rack.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Sassy Onion Dip
steps: In small mixing bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Cover and chill.
Stir before serving.

recipes.title: Apricot Nectar Cake
steps: Bake 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Steamed Squash, Onion And Zucchini
steps: Wash vegetables and chop into bite sized pieces.
Place in 2 to 3-quart microwave dish with lid.
Pour in water.
Microwave for about 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender, but not mushy! Season to taste and serve.

recipes.title: Snicker Pie(Fat-Free Or Sugar-Free)
ingredients: 1 large or 2 small pkg. instant sugar-free chocolate pudding
steps: Soften ice cream in a "large" bowl.
Sprinkle instant pudding out of box over ice cream and mix.
Add peanut butter and Cool Whip.
Stir until well blended.
Spray an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch dish or two 8-inch pie plates with Pam.
Pour mixture into desired dish and freeze.
Cut oblong dish into 16 squares.
Cut pie plate into 8 slices.
Cover and store in freezer.

recipes.title: Banana Pineapple Pie
steps: At room temperature, mix cream cheese and sugar until creamy. Pour into pie crusts.
Layer pineapple and then bananas.
Top with Cool Whip.
Refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Pina Colada Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
steps: Cook cake mix by directions on box in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool, leaving in pan.
Punch holes in cake with fork.
Mix next 2 ingredients and pour over cake.
Mix last 2 items and spread over top.
Chill.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pineapple Biscuits
steps: Press fingers into the center of each biscuit, making a deep indentation about 1 3/4-inches wide.
Fill indentations with cream cheese.
Arrange well drained crushed pineapple around outside edge of cream cheese.
Sprinkle with ground cinnamon.
Bake as directed on biscuit package.

recipes.title: Warm Beet Salad
ingredients: 1/2 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded and diced
steps: In a saucepan, melt margarine.
Add peppers, cucumber and onion.
Cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Arrange beets on 4 individual plates and drizzle with vegetable mixture.
Serve warm.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Mix Veg-All, onion, mayonnaise, celery, water chestnuts and cheese.
Pour into a casserole dish.
Top with cracker crumbs, mixed with a little melted butter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Biscuits
steps: Mix.
Roll into balls.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach Balls
steps: Cook spinach and drain. Cream the eggs and butter. Add spinach and rest of dry ingredients.
Mix and chill 1/2 hour. Shape into balls. Grease cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.
Makes 4 small loaves.

recipes.title: Baked Clams
ingredients: 2 doz. clams or 3 cans minced clams
steps: Chop 2 dozen clams and simmer 5 minutes or use 3 cans minced clams in their own juice.
Chop stalks of celery, peppers and onions and simmer in 1/4 pound of butter for 5 minutes.
In a bowl, mix 1/4 box of bread crumbs, drained clams and vegetables. Add more bread crumbs and juice of clams until is like wet stuffing.
Pile into clam shell and bake at 375° to 400° for 10 minutes.
Top with paprika.

recipes.title: Sharon'S Ice Cream
steps: Vanilla:
Beat eggs in large bowl with fork.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Pour into ice cream freezer and freeze.

recipes.title: Lemon Cheese Bars
steps: Mix dry cake mix with 1 egg and 1/3 cup of oil until crumbly, reserving 1 cup for later use.
Pat remaining mixture lightly in an ungreased 13x9x2 pan.
Bake 15 mins.

recipes.title: Baked Vidalia Onions
steps: Peel and wash onions.
Quarter the onions without cutting all the way through.
Put generous amount of margarine into split. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, garlic and Worcestershire sauce.
Bake in 350° to 400° oven until tender.
(Cover with foil to prevent dark ends on onions.)
Can be cooked in microwave.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1/2 to 1 can French fried onion rings
steps: Mix hash brown potatoes, sour cream, chopped onion, salt, pepper and soup.
Spread in 11 x 13-inch baking dish and sprinkle grated cheese on top.
Top with onion rings.
Cover with foil and bake 1 hour at 300°.

recipes.title: Butternut (Or Hubbard) Squash Casserole
ingredients: 4 c. cooked squash, stew squash until tender, drain well and mash, or use 3 pkg. frozen squash, drained
2 c. sugar (1 c. brown and 1 c. white)
steps: Mix ingredients and bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until a knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Dip
steps: Mix cream cheese and seasonings well; add crabmeat.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Tomato Relish
steps: Grind vegetables in food chopper.
Mix well.
Add sugar, salt and spices.
Pour vinegar over mixture and cook slowly for 30 minutes.
Pack into hot jars and seal.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
steps: Lay crescent rolls out flat on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes; cool.
Mix the other ingredients, then spread on cool rolls.
Top with small chopped or shredded vegetables, such as broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, radishes, etc.
Refrigerate.
Cut into squares to serve.

recipes.title: Sugar Free Apple Pieroswell, New Mexico
steps: Soak Tapioca in thawed apple juice.
Prepare apples and crust. Sprinkle cinnamon over apples and add juice.

recipes.title: English Toffee
steps: Combine butter and water in a 4-quart Dutch oven; cook over medium heat until butter melts.
Add sugar and salt, mixing well. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil gently until mixture begins to lighten in color.
Add 1 cup walnuts; continue cooking, stirring constantly, until candy thermometer registers 298°.
Pour syrup mixture into a buttered 15 x 10-inch jellyroll pan, spreading to edges of pan.
Cool slightly; mark into 1-inch squares with the sharp edge of a knife.
Cool thoroughly.
Melt chocolate in top of a double boiler over boiling water.
Spread chocolate over fudge; sprinkle with remaining walnuts. Let stand until chocolate is firm.
Break into squares.
Yield:
About 3 pounds.

recipes.title: Mexican Salad
steps: Put dressing over salad and mix good just before serving. Stir in Fritos last.
Serve with Mexican casserole.

recipes.title: Lemon Berry Pie
ingredients: 2 (4 serving size) pkg. instant vanilla or lemon pudding mix
steps: Beat the cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in medium bowl using wire whisk until smooth. Stir in lemon peel and juice. Stir in 1 1/2 cups of the Cool Whip. Spread evenly in bottom of crust.
Press strawberry halves into cream cheese layer, reserving enough for garnish.
Pour 2
cups milk into a large bowl. Add pudding mixes.
Beat with wire whisk 1 minute.
Let stand 1 minute or until thickened.
Gently stir in 1 cup Cool Whip. Spoon over strawberries in crust. Refrigerate 4 hours. Garnish with remaining Cool Whip and strawberry halves.

recipes.title: Mom'S Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 lb. ground chuck, browned and drained
1/2 c. green pepper, diced and sauteed
1 c. fresh mushrooms, diced and sauteed
pinch of pepper, basil and oregano
steps: Saute onion, green pepper and mushrooms in 1 tablespoon butter; drain.
Add to browned ground beef.
Add spices.
Add tomato puree and simmer over low heat one hour.
Cook and drain spaghetti. Blend meat sauce with spaghetti.
Add 1 tablespoon butter and cook until tastes blend, approximately 20 minutes.
Great the next day. Serve with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Brandied Peaches
steps: Sprinkle with light brown sugar.
Add 2 Tbsp. brandy.

recipes.title: Cheesy Broccoli-N-Mushroom Bake
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli spears, thawed
1 (10 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 c. (4 oz.) Kraft natural shredded Cheddar cheese
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Arrange broccoli in 12 x 8-inch baking dish.
Whisk together soup, salad dressing and milk.
Pour over broccoli.
Sprinkle with cheese and croutons.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until heated through.
Garnish as desired.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Ginger Soy Dressing
steps: Shake all ingredients in tightly covered container.
Great on spinach salad.

recipes.title: Sock-It-To-Me Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines butter recipe cake mix (yellow)
steps: Thoroughly mix all ingredients, except cake mix, then add cake mix and blend. Mix 1 tablespoon cinnamon and 3 tablespoons brown sugar. Grease and flour a tube pan. Pour a thin layer of the cake mixture into pan and sprinkle with a layer of sugar-cinnamon mixture. Repeat this twice, ending with a layer of cake mixture. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Let cake cool before taking out of pan.

recipes.title: Mushroom Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 chicken, cut in pieces or chicken breast
steps: Place chicken in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish.
Pour dressing over chicken.
Sprinkle with pepper and 1/4 teaspoon paprika. Bake at 350°, covered, 30 minutes.
Turn chicken, add mushrooms, cheese and 1/4 teaspoon paprika.
Bake 30 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Southern Chess Pie
steps: Heat butter in pan until melted.
Add sugar.
Stir; do not boil.
Cool slightly.
Beat eggs in bowl until frothy.
Add vinegar, vanilla and butter/sugar mixture.
Mix well.
Pour into shell.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Baked Beef And Noodle Casserole
steps: Chop onion and brown with ground beef.
Season to taste.
Add cream of mushroom soup, milk and water.
Cook noodles.
Add all this together.
Pour in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry Berries On A Cloud
steps: Beat egg whites, sugar and cream of tartar well and put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Turn oven off and leave cake in oven for 12 hours.
Then mix whipping cream, marshmallows and cream cheese.
Spread on cake and chill for 12 hours.
Then mix cherry pie filling and strawberries and spoon over cake.

recipes.title: Reuben Casserole
ingredients: 6 oz. wide noodles, cooked and drained
steps: Toss noodles with butter.
Place noodles in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
Layer sauerkraut, corned beef and tomatoes.
Dot with salad dressing; sprinkle cheese and top with crumbs and caraway seed.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes, covered.
Uncover and bake for 10 to 15 minutes.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Crush Ritz crackers into fine bits.
Melt 1/2 stick of margarine and mix with crackers.
Place 1/2 of the crackers in bottom of casserole dish; cook broccoli according to directions. Melt cheese along with the other 1/2 margarine.
After broccoli is cooked, pour water off and stir in pan with cheese.
Pour in casserole dish and put remaining crackers on top.
Bake until brown.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
steps: Put all ingredients in large pot.
Add one tomato juice can full of water.
Liquid should cover vegetables and bones.
If it doesn't, add little more water.
Put soup pot over high heat and bring to a boil, then immediately turn down heat.
Take a spoon and carefully scoop foam off top of soup and throw away.
Cook soup, uncovered, at a simmer.
Don't let it boil.
Simmer for about 3 1/2 hours so flavors have a chance to mingle.
Stir once or twice during cooking.
Makes about 3 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Strawberry Onion Salad
steps: Mix sugar, mustard, salt, onion juice and vinegar together. Slowly add oil to blend.
Add poppy seeds.	Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Red Beet Eggs
steps: Dissolve sugar and salt in beet juice and vinegar.
Bring to boil.
Pour this hot solution over the beets and eggs.
Let stand overnight.
Then refrigerate.

recipes.title: Classic Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 c. Karo light or dark corn syrup
steps: In large bowl, combine first 5 ingredients until well blended. Stir in pecans.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake in 350° oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.
Cool.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Apple Pancakes
steps: Serves up to 4 people.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
steps: Brown ground beef, then add tomatoes and water.
Then add all other ingredients and cook for 45 minutes hard.
Then simmer for 30 minutes on a lower heat.

recipes.title: Strawberry Kiwi Mock Margarita
ingredients: 1 tub CRYSTAL LIGHT TROPICAL PASSIONS Strawberry Kiwi Flavor Low Calorie Soft Drink Mix
steps: PLACE water, orange juice, lime juice and drink mix in blender container; cover. Blend until drink mix is dissolved.
ADD ice; cover. Blend on high speed until smooth.

recipes.title: Cherry Coke Salad
steps: Heat
12 ounces Coke to boiling point.	Dissolve jello. Stir. Add
remaining Coke, plus the cold water.
Chill.
When mixture is	soft
set
add cherries, pecans and marshmallows. Mix gently. Garnish with whipped cream if desired.

recipes.title: Inedible Cornstarch Dough
steps: Combine ingredients over low heat and stir until consistency of stiff mashed potatoes. Remove from heat and cover with wet towel. Allow pan to cool enough to touch.
Remove mixture from pan and knead until smooth and dough-like.
On surface covered with wax paper, roll to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with cookie cutters. Re-work excess, roll and cut.
Set ornaments on rack to air dry 4 to 5 hours.
Thin acrylic paint with water and paint; air dry. Paint, polyurethane or varnish; let dry. Ready to hang on tree, etc.
Makes 18 to 24 ornaments.

recipes.title: Onion Soup A Al Parmesan
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Saute onions in 4 tablespoons butter or margarine until golden.
Stir often.
Add the stock and boil 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
steps: Mix croutons, water, salad dressing and oleo.
Beat eggs slightly with one cup of milk.
Add to stuffing mixture.
Stir in chicken, vegetables and salt.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Blend soup and remaining 1/2 cup of milk; pour over the top.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
Makes 12 to 15 servings.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
steps: Cook spaghetti as directed on box and rinse with cold water. Add chopped cucumbers and onions, vinegar, sugar and Marzetti slaw dressing.
Mix well.
Make day before used.

recipes.title: Opakapaka Mediterranean
ingredients: 1 each small green and red pepper, cut into thin strips
2 large tomatoes, cut into thin wedges
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Cook and stir onions and peppers in oil in large skillet on medium-high for 5 minutes or until tender, but crisp.
Add tomatoes and garlic; mix lightly.

recipes.title: Coconut Sour Cream Cake
steps: Cook cake mix in 2 layers.
When cool, split in 4 layers. Combine sugar, sour cream and coconut.
Set aside 1 cup of this mixture to use later.
Spread on top of each layer.
Mix the 1 1/2 cups of thawed whipped topping with the cup of mixture.
Ice top and sides of cake.
Put cake in airtight container for 3 days in refrigerator before serving.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
steps: Melt chocolate in double boiler or similar.
Drain cherries. Dip cherries, holding by stem or, if they don't have a stem, use a toothpick.
Place dipped cherries in small candy paper cups or a piece of foil or wax paper.

recipes.title: Garlic Loaf
steps: Cut each biscuit in half.
Mix garlic, parsley and margarine. Dip biscuits in mixture and place in 9-inch pie plate.
Bake 15 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Strawberry Marshmallow Salad
steps: Add fruit cocktail to jello and top with marshmallows.
Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Plaki (Greek Fish)
steps: Saute onions and garlic in small amount olive oil.
Clean fish and rub with lemon juice and salt.
Add to pot.
Pour crushed tomatoes over and small amount of water.
Sprinkle generously with mint flakes, parsley and raisins.
Bring to boil; cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: One Bowl Fudge
ingredients: 2 (8 sq. each) pkg. Baker's semi-sweet chocolate
steps: In medium saucepan, melt chocolate with milk, stirring constantly.
Stir in vanilla and nuts.
Spread in greased 8-inch square pan.
Refrigerate until firm.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: More And More
steps: Cook noodles in salted water.
Drain.
Saute onions until soft. Add meat.
Cook until brown; add green pepper, corn, chili powder and salt.
Combine with noodles and top with cheese in a 2 to 3-quart baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Good frozen in meal size containers.

recipes.title: Seven Minute Frosting
steps: Mix in
double boiler, cook over heat for seven minutes. Beat with mixer while cooking.

recipes.title: 20 Minute Chicken Parmesan
steps: Dip chicken into egg and then coat with bread crumbs.
Melt margarine in large frying pan on medium heat.
Place chicken in frypan and brown on each side for 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low setting.

recipes.title: Jeanie'S Salmon Ball
steps: Drain salmon, remove bones and flake.
In small bowl of electric mixer
put the cream cheese and blend in lemon juice, onion,
horseradish,
salt, Worcestershire, cayenne and liquid smoke.
When
well
blended,
gently
stir
in
flaked salmon. Shape into
a
ball.
Combine pecans and parsley and spread on sheet of
waxed
paper.
Turn
salmon
ball
into this mixture until well coated.
Wrap in waxed paper and chill.

recipes.title: Sausage Sauerkraut Casserole
ingredients: 8 oz. Healthy Choice 97% fat-free Kielbasa sausage
1 can Healthy Request cream of mushroom soup
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Noodles Parmesan
ingredients: 8 oz. (about 6 c.) noodles, cooked and drained
steps: Cut broccoli into bite size pieces.
In a covered 4-quart pan over medium heat, in 1-inch of boiling water, cook broccoli 6 minutes.
Drain well.
In same saucepan over medium heat, in hot margarine, cook onion and garlic until tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in soup and tarragon, mixing well.
Add cheese and Parmesan, stirring until melted.
Stir in sour cream, broccoli and cooked noodles.
Pour into 2-quart casserole.
Cover, bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chop Suey
steps: Brown meat in 2 tablespoons oil.
Simmer until soft.
Cut up celery and onions.
Add to meat and cook until meat is soft.
Add 1/2 cup soy sauce and cook for 10 minutes.
Add bean sprouts with juices (2 tablespoons of flour and water to thicken).
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped, frozen spinach, thawed
steps: Prepare spinach per package directions. Drain.
Mix rest of ingredients together.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.
Great with Ruffles and vegetables.

recipes.title: Tomato Juice Cocktail
steps: Combine ingredients.
Chill 1 hour.
Strain and serve in cocktail glass.

recipes.title: Easy Lemon Pie
steps: Mix milk, eggs and lemon juice.
Pour into pie crust and bake at 350° for 8 minutes.
Chill and top with Cool Whip.
Makes 1 pie.

recipes.title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
steps: Boil sweet potatoes until done.
Cool and peel.
Slice in half and arrange in baking dish.
Pour sugar over potatoes.
Drizzle syrup on top.
Cover with pats of butter.
Sprinkle very lightly with salt.
Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Wassail
steps: Combine and bring to a boil.
Keep warm in crock-pot or on stove.

recipes.title: Chess Brownies
ingredients: 1 yellow cake mix (with pudding in the mix)
steps: Mix together cake mix, margarine and 1 egg and then pat out onto an 8 x 11-inch glass pan.
Beat eggs; add cream cheese and confectioners sugar.
Pour over cake mix in glass pan.
Bake at 300° for 50 minutes to 1 hour, depending on oven.

recipes.title: Speedy Little Devils
steps: Combine margarine and cake mix.
Reserve 1 1/2 cups of this for topping.
Pat crumb mixture into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Top with peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme and spread evenly.
Crumble remaining mixture over top.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Makes 3 dozen bars.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pies
