ingredients: 1 c. Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained well
steps: Combine Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice.
Mix well.
Add pineapple and pecans and blend.
Fold in Cool Whip and spoon into crusts.
Chill 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Strawberry Punch
steps: Bring water and sugar to a boil.
Boil 3 minutes.
Remove from heat. While hot, add Jell-O, stir until dissolved.
Cool 30 minutes. Add pineapple and orange juice.
Freeze Mixture.
Allow punch to partially thaw several hours before needed.
Add one 2 liter ginger ale.
Mix punch and ginger ale to form a delicious slush.

recipes.title: Oyster Stew
steps: Melt butter.
Add onion and cook until soft.
Add oysters, cooking about 1 1/2 minutes or until edges begin to curl.
Add milk and cook until hot (do not boil).
Add salt and pepper and stir.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: New Potato Casserole
steps: Scrub
new potatoes; place in 2-inch deep casserole; add chopped
garlic,
olive oil, salt and pepper.
Mix well;
cover and bake at 450° for 45 minutes.
Turn over after 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Sliced Baked Potatoes(Makes 4 Servings.)
steps: Peel potatoes if the skin is tough, otherwise, just rinse and pat dry.
Cut potatoes into thin slices, but not all the way through.
Use a handle of a spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way.
Place potatoes in a microsafe dish or pan.
Sprinkle with melted butter and chopped herbs.
Microwave at High power for 10 minutes, rearranging the potatoes after 5 minutes.
Let rest for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and Parmesan cheese. Microwave for another 4 to 6 minutes at High power until cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft.
Sprinkle with salt.
Serve potatoes as a side dish or as a main dish with just a salad.

recipes.title: Meatballs
steps: Mix all of ingredients together and make into balls.
Place into deep baking dish.

recipes.title: Apple-Raisin Slaw
steps: Sprinkle lemon juice over apples; toss well.
Mix in raisins and cabbage.
Add mayonnaise.
Toss and arrange lettuce lined bowl.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Warm Artichoke Dip Or Spread
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Put into ovenproof dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Crab Crostini
ingredients: 4 oz. party-size Italian bread, cut in 16 slices*
steps: * Could also use 4 large slices of Italian bread and make it a main dish.

recipes.title: Seaside Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. Kraft macaroni and cheese dinner
1 can English peas or frozen fresh peas
steps: Prepare macaroni dinner according to directions on the box. Set aside to cool.
In a large bowl, mix together chopped eggs, peas, pimento, tuna and relish.
Add macaroni mix.
Then add salt, pepper and salad dressing.
Mix well and chill at least 2 hours. Serves 8 (2/3 cup) per lettuce cup.
Celery and onions may be added, if desired.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Bars
ingredients: 6 oz. chocolate chips or peanut butter chips
steps: Cut together sugar and 1 cup peanut butter.
Crush graham crackers and combine with sugar mixture.
Melt butter and add to mixture.
Press into an 8 x 8-inch baking pan.
Melt 1/3 cup peanut butter and baking chips.
Pour over top of bars and refrigerate. When set, cut into squares.

recipes.title: Layered Pudding Cake
steps: Bake cake mix as directed.
Fix pudding as directed.
When cake has cooled, slice in pieces.
Layer in big container cake, pudding, pie filling until you stop with pie filling.
Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cheesy Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 c red or green apple, cubed
3/4 c bottled fat free honey salad dressing
steps: Combine cabbage apple and cheese in a bowl.
Pour dressing over and toss.
Refrigerate 1/2 hours for flavor to blend.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
steps: Soften cheese at 350° for 25 minutes.
Blend.

recipes.title: Taco Salad Dip
steps: Mix beef, beans, tomato sauce, taco seasoning, onion, bell pepper and pepper sauce.
Cover tightly and microwave 3 minutes. Spread in microwavable pie plate.
Cover and microwave 5 minutes. Top with sour cream, cheese and green onions.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 large can tomatoes (I also add 1/2 can Ro-Tel tomatoes with juice)
steps: Cook chicken in water.
Reserve broth!
Cut chicken into bite-size pieces.
Melt margarine and saute onion and green pepper until soft.
Add chicken, chili powder, tomatoes, salt and pepper. Meanwhile, cook spaghetti in broth (add water, if needed). Drain.
Mix spaghetti into sauce and simmer for 15 minutes.
Layer spaghetti and cheese in an 8 x 11-inch baking dish.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or so.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Chili
steps: Brown beef in hot oil in skillet; discard excess fat. Put all ingredients into slow cooker. Stir once. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Discard bay leaf. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Cousin Donnie'S Cheese Balls
steps: Bring cheese to room temperature.
Add all ingredients, mix well.
Roll into 3 balls.
The balls can be rolled in nuts or decorated with black olives and pimentos.

recipes.title: Smothered Cajun Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in soy sauce, salt and hot sauce for 2 or 3 hours.
In a large skillet or Dutch oven, put oil, onion, pepper and garlic and saute until tender.
Add parsley and white wine to chicken.
Marinate and add water.
Cover and cook slow 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until done.

recipes.title: Garden Club Turkey Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients the night before using, except pineapple. Use deli style turkey (buy in chunk and cut up or use leftover turkey).
Canned pineapple can be used.
Be sure to drain very well!!!
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Candy(Brown Stuff)
steps: Put into saucepan, butter, milk and brown sugar; cook for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter and melt.
Add powdered sugar.
Stir until mixed well.
Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Cool and cut.
Nuts are optional.

recipes.title: Glazed Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can sliced pineapple in juice
1 pkg. Jell-O vanilla pudding (or use pudding included in cake and reduce water to 3/4 c.)
10 walnut halves or maraschino cherry halves
steps: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.
Combine pudding mix and pineapple juice.
Set aside.
Arrange pineapple slices in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Place walnut or cherry half in center of each. Pour pudding mixture over pineapple.
Sprinkle with brown sugar. Combine cake mix, instant pudding, eggs, water and oil in large mixer bowl.
Blend.
Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 4 minutes.
Pour over pineapple mixture in pan.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean and cake begins to pull from sides of pan.
Cool in pan 5 minutes.
Invert onto serving platter and let stand 1 minute.
Then remove from pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix stuffing with water and margarine cut into water.
First layer, in 13 x 9-inch pan, the dressing mix.

recipes.title: Barbecued Brisket
steps: Place brisket in seasoned (Pam) pan.
Sprinkle with seasonings and pour liquid smoke over brisket.
Cover pan with foil. Marinate overnight.

recipes.title: Buerre Blanc Sauce
steps: In pan, combine wine, vinegar and onions; reduce to 2 tablespoons over high heat.
Cool slightly, then gradually add butter, whisking until well blended.
Add salt and pepper.
Serve warm with any type of fish.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cheese Balls
steps: Blend all ingredients together.
Form into a ball or roll. Refrigerate for a few hours.
Serve.

recipes.title: Cherry Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. each: allspice, cloves and nutmeg (ground)
steps: In skillet brown chicken in margarine for 10 minutes on each side.
Season with a little salt and pepper.
Drain off excess margarine.
Combine pie filling, wine, orange juice, brown sugar, salt and spices.
Pour over browned chicken.
Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Cheese Ball
steps: Chop onions and 1 package of beef and combine with spices and cream cheese.
Line a plastic bowl with waxed paper or Saran Wrap; mold cream cheese mixture or roll into a log and wrap beef around cheese.
Serve with a variety of crackers.

recipes.title: Cocktail Meatballs (300)
steps: Mix meats and spices together. Add salt, pepper and parsley flakes. Shape into tiny meatballs and bake for 20 minutes at 350°, shaking occasionally. Remove balls and put drippings in pan on low heat. Add V-8 juice, broths and bouillon cubes. Heat until juice is reduced slightly. Serve with sauce in chafing dish.

recipes.title: Hot And Sour Soup
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. cornstarch, dissolved in 1/2 c. cold water
1 pkg. fresh tofu or bean curd, cut into thin strips
steps: Rehydrate mushrooms and fungus as directed on the package labels.
Separately cut mushrooms, fungus, pork and bamboo shoots to fine julienne.
Stir-fry pork with salt in heated oil.
Bring chicken broth to boil in pot.
Add dried peppers, mushrooms, fungus, pork and bamboo shoots.
Stir frequently.
Add soy sauce, pepper and vinegar.
Thicken with dissolved cornstarch, stirring constantly, over moderate heat.
Add bean curd.
Bring to boil. Turn off heat.
Add beaten eggs and stir.
Add sesame seed oil. Garnish with scallions.
Use additional vinegar for sourness and hot oil for hotness if desired.

recipes.title: Blueberry Salad
steps: Drain blueberries and pineapple; reserve liquid.
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add enough cold water to reserved blueberry and pineapple liquid equal to 1 3/4 cups.
Add to gelatin.
When gelatin is slightly thickened, fold in fruit.
Pour into a 13 x 9-inch dish and chill until firm.
In a separate dish, combine cream cheese, sour cream, sugar and vanilla.
Spread over gelatin; top with pecans and chill.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
steps: Combine cracker crumbs, cheese, salt and pepper.
Dip chicken in melted butter and then in cracker crumbs.
Place in baking dish and bake at 375° for one hour, uncovered.
Do not turn chicken.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. grated American or Cheddar cheese
steps: Layer in casserole dish:
cooked broccoli, chips, sliced eggs and cheese; repeat layers.
Top with cream of mushroom soup thinned with a little milk.
Top with cheese and chips.
Bake for 3 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Tortilla Soup
steps: Saute in oil the onion and jalapeno pepper.
Add tomatoes, chili powder, beef broth, sugar, chicken broth, cumin, tomato soup, Tabasco sauce, water and Worcestershire sauce.
Simmer 1 hour.
Add corn tortillas, cut in pieces; simmer 5 minutes.
Chop 4 or 5 avocados.
Put in bowls and then add hot soup.

recipes.title: Lasagna(Homemade Sauce)
steps: Add oil, onion, celery stalks to hamburger and cook until brown, then add tomato juice, tomato soup, sugar, salt, pepper, mushrooms, Italian seasoning and oregano.
Simmer for 3/4 hour. Cook lasagna, then drain.

recipes.title: Manicotti
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients; mix well.
Stuff shells with mixture.
Dilute spaghetti sauce with 10 ounces water.
Simmer in pan over low heat.
Cover bottom of large baking dish with spaghetti sauce.
Layer filled shells and cover with spaghetti sauce.
Cover dish and bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
Remove cover; sprinkle with grated Mozzarella cheese; bake 10 minutes more. Cool 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
steps: Cook macaroni.
Drain.
Add diced tomatoes and diced peppers. Add remaining ingredients and mix all together.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bars(Microwave)
steps: Place butter and peanut butter in 1-quart glass bowl. Microwave on High for 45 to 60 seconds.
Stir; add cracker crumbs and sugar and mix well.
Press in 8-inch square pan.
Place chips and oil in 1-cup glass container.
Microwave on High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes.
Mix and spread on top of crumb mixture.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Then cut in 1-inch squares.

recipes.title: Lasagna With Uncooked Noodles
steps: Brown hamburger and onion and add spaghetti sauce combined with remaining ingredients.
Simmer 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Salad
steps: Combine chicken, celery, almonds, salt, onion, green pepper, mayonnaise, lemon juice and chicken soup.
Mix well and spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Spread cheese and potato chips on top. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes, or until heated through and browned.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix Pepperidge Farm corn meal stuffing, butter and broth.
Put 1/2 of this mixture in a baking dish.
Over this, add 1/2 cup onion and chopped celery.

recipes.title: Kansas Cranberry Salad
steps: Follow directions on package of gelatin.
Add crushed pineapple and chill until partially set.
Fold in cranberry sauce, marshmallows, walnuts and Cool Whip.
Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Classic Cole Slaw
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Stir in remaining ingredients and cover; chill.
Makes about 6 cups.

recipes.title: Ranch Buffalo Wings
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Dip chicken in mixture of hot sauce and vinegar.
Put in baking dish.
Sprinkle with 1 package of dry dressing mix.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with celery sticks and other Ranch dressing mix, prepared as a dip.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Mix all ingredients together, except broccoli.
Put cooked broccoli in buttered casserole dish and pour mixture over all. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sugar Coated Pecans
steps: Mix nuts with egg white, water and nuts; add sugar, salt and cinnamon.
Spread on cookie sheet.
Bake at 300° for 45 minutes; stir occasionally!

recipes.title: Cranberry Relish
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water; add sugar and juices. Prepare rest of veggies and fruit; then add to jello and refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup(Low-Fat Recipe)
steps: Cook the first 11 ingredients 1 hour.
Skim foam.
Refrigerate chicken.
Skim fat.
Bring broth to a boil and add the remaining ingredients plus cubed chicken.
Simmer until vegetables are tender.
Yields 16 cups.
Contains 70 calories per cup and 2 fat grams per serving.

recipes.title: Noodle Casserole
steps: Cook macaroni according to directions for 7 minutes; drain. Add all ingredients.
Save some cheese for top.
Cover and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheese Pie
steps: Blend room temperature cream cheese, condensed milk, lemon juice and vanilla until smooth.
Pour into crust.
Top with cherry pie filling.
Chill.

recipes.title: Strip And Go Naked(Sheraton-Biloxi)
steps: Shake and pour over ice. Top with beer.

recipes.title: Lasagna
steps: Fry hamburger with onion and seasonings until hamburger is brown and onion cooked.
Add tomato paste and water.
Simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Company Brisket
ingredients: Bavarian paprika, salt and pepper (may be added)
1 c. water (may be mixed with catsup)
steps: Pour all ingredients over meat.
Use a large enameled roaster if possible.
Cover pan with foil.
Bake at 300° for 4 hours.
Remove the foil and bake an additional 35 to 40 minutes.
Baste meat during cooking time.
Remove meat from sauce.
Cook all of the drippings until thick.
Slice on the grain thinly for sandwich buns.
Put meat back into sauce and bake for an additional 30 minutes at 350°.
Watch so sauce does not burn.
Serve on buns.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
steps: Brown beef.
Drain.
Mix soup and milk.
Layer in baking dish the chips, beef, half of onions, half of cheese and pour half of soup mixture over all.
Repeat layering.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Grape-Raisin Blush
ingredients: 1/2 c. raisins, soaked in enough pineapple juice to cover
steps: Place all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth. Serve immediately.
Yield: 4 cups.

recipes.title: Cuban Black Bean Soup
steps: Soak beans overnight or add 1 teaspoon salt to 6 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Crush together garlic, salt, cumin, oregano and dry mustard.
Heat oil and saute onions about 5 minutes in a large skillet.
Add green peppers and continue to cook until onions are tender.
Stir in seasoning, lemon juice and 1/2 cup bean liquid.
Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Add to beans.
Cook until flavors blend, about 1 hour.
Serve over rice.
Yield:
6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler Quickie
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. In medium size Pyrex dish, empty peaches (with juice).
Place pecans over peaches. Take cake mix from box and sprinkle over peaches and pecans.
Top with patties of margarine.
Cook in a 350° oven until golden brown (approximately) 35 to 40 minutes.
Makes a delicious dessert.
Can be made without pecans.

recipes.title: Twice Baked Potatoes
steps: Cook and mash potatoes.
Add sour cream, cream cheese, salt and onions.
Beat until fluffy.
Place in buttered casserole dish. (Don't fill too full because it raises.) Dot with butter and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
steps: Tear up bread slices and place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Brown and drain sausage.
Spoon sausage over bread crumbs.
Sprinkle cheese over sausage.
Beat together the eggs, milk, salt, pepper and mustard.
Pour egg mixture over the bread, sausage and cheese.
Chill overnight in refrigerator.
Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cheese will rise to top during baking.
(Excellent for company breakfast.)

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate
steps: Make a batch of your favorite brownies.
Let cool, then layer brownies, chocolate Cool Whip, pudding that has been prepared according to directions on box, crushed candy bars and white Cool Whip.
Continue layering.
Should have about 3 layers.
Sprinkle top with a few crushed candy bars.

recipes.title: Carnival Casserole
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes, save 1/2 can juice
steps: Brown ground beef with onions and green peppers.
Drain.
Add tomatoes, spices, syrup and salsa.
Cook macaroni and add cubed Velveeta.
Add ground beef mixture to this.
Bake at 375°, covered, for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: "Chess Bars"
steps: Mix together and press into 9 x 13 pan. (I use my food processor.)

recipes.title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Cake
ingredients: 1 box pineapple cream instant pudding mix
steps: Mix cake mix per directions on box.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Richard'S Famous German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
steps: Smear 1/2 stick margarine (softened) over bottom and sides of 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan.
Spread all the pecans and coconut on the bottom.
Prepare the German chocolate cake mix according to instructions on the box and pour on top.
Now, here's the good part!
Add a mixture of 1 stick margarine, powdered sugar and cream cheese.
Spoon evenly on top of the cake batter and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Test with toothpick.

recipes.title: Mildew Remover
steps: Mix equal parts of nonsudsing household ammonia, dishwashing liquid and water.
Put in spray bottle.
Wash clothes immediately after spraying.

recipes.title: Chicken Crescents
steps: In a medium bowl, mix the cream cheese and butter until smooth.
Add milk, salt, pepper, onion, chives and mushrooms. Stir in chicken.
Mix well and set aside.

recipes.title: Slime Cake
ingredients: 1 large (6 serving) box vanilla instant pudding
steps: Make the cake according to box.
You need to make two 8 or 9-inch layers.
Make vanilla pudding according to box.
Put in 8 to o12 drops green food coloring.
Blend ingredients.
Cover mixture and chill for at least 1 hour or until you are ready to use it.

recipes.title: Chicken Taco Casserole
steps: Mix soups and milk together.
Layer in 9 x 13-inch greased pan: tortillas, 1/2 chicken, 1/2 soup mixture, 1/2 onion and 1/2 cheeses.
Will make 2 layers.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Vegetable Salad
steps: In large bowl, combine all ingredients.
Marinate at least 24 hours.
Excellent for large group dinners.

recipes.title: Frozen Pickles
ingredients: 1 lb. unwaxed cucumbers (4 c. packed) sliced thin
3/4 lb. yellow onions (2 c. packed) sliced thin
1 tsp. dried dill or sprig of fresh dill
steps: Mix cucumber, onion, salt and water in large bowl and let stand 2 hours.
Drain.
Return vegetables to bowl.	Add sugar, vinegar and dill.
Let stand, stir until sugar dissolves and covers vegetables.	Pack in Ziploc Freezer bags and freeze.
Serve thawed but ice cold.
Yield 1 quart.

recipes.title: Potato And Egg Casserole
steps: Mix eggs and milk. Place frozen potatoes in 9 x 13-inch dish. Add layer of sausage. Pour egg mixture over top. Cover with grated cheese. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Luscious Potato Soup
steps: Heat oil in large soup pot.
Saute onions, carrots, celery and potatoes until onions are transparent.
Pour in stock, spices and salt.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for about 1 hour until the potatoes are tender, but won't fall apart.

recipes.title: Best Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 c. firmly packed dark brown sugar
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Prepare the pie crust.
In large bowl combine corn syrup, sugar, eggs, butter, salt and vanilla.
Mix well.
Pour filling into unbaked pie crust.
Sprinkle with pecan halves.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until center is set.
(Can also add 1/2 to 1 cup crushed pecans to mixture.)

recipes.title: Club Soda Pancakes(Oooh, So Light!)
steps: Mix all ingredients together and cook pancakes in the regular way.
Keep pan cakes hot in a serving dish until served.
This batter can not be saved like regular mix due to the club soda. Pancakes left over can be refrigerated or frozen.
Delicious!

recipes.title: Cranberry Fluff
steps: Combine cranberries, marshmallows and sugar.
Cover and chill overnight.
Add apples, grapes, walnuts and salt.
Fold in whipped cream.
Chill.
(Freeze cranberries and they will grind better.)

recipes.title: Chinese-Style Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. roast pork, cut into thin, small strips
steps: In a skillet, heat the oil.
Add the onion and cook until transparent.
Add the pork, chicken broth, celery, mushrooms and bean sprouts; simmer five minutes.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
steps: Melt cheese in milk.
Add soup, eggs and pimentos.
Pour over well drained asparagus in casserole.
Cover with cracker crumbs and dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Scalloped Onions
steps: Drain onions.
Add cheese with a small amount of milk. Thicken with thin white sauce.
Put in casserole and top with bread crumbs.
Put in oven until bread crumbs are a golden brown.

recipes.title: Sunday Supper Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Cook noodles as package directs; drain. Place sausages in shallow baking pan.
Bake 25 minutes, turning once.
Lower heat to 350°.
Combine sausage drippings and noodles. Arrange 1/2 noodles in 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with combined applesauce, lemon juice and nutmeg.
Cover with rest of noodles; top with sausage.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake 20 minutes or until hot.

recipes.title: Chippies
steps: Crush graham crackers in plastic Ziploc Baggie and then mix in bowl with Eagle Brand milk.
Add in chocolate chips.
Put in greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes in 375° oven.
Yields 10 to 20 bars, depending upon size.

recipes.title: Apple Squares
ingredients: 4 cooking apples, peeled, cored and cut up
steps: Put apples in a saucepan with sugar, cinnamon and salt.
Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the consistency of chunky applesauce. Cool to room temperature.
Makes two cups.

recipes.title: Three Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Mix everything together and let stand in refrigerator at least 6 hours (overnight is best).

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
steps: Cook spinach according to package directions and drain.
Add sour cream and onion soup mix.
Put in greased casserole.
Sprinkle with a mixture of bread crumbs, margarine and cheese.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients: 3/4 lb. chicken breasts, boned, skinned and cut into strips
3/4 c. oil packed sun-dried tomatoes, drained and sliced thin
steps: In a skillet or saucepan, saute the garlic in oil until golden. Now add the strips of chicken and saute until cooked.
Push the chicken to one side of the pan and add the broccoli florets.
Saute the broccoli until they are crisply tender.
Now, add the sun-dried tomatoes, the seasonings, white wine and the chicken broth.
To complete the sauce, add the butter, cover and simmer for 5 minutes over low flame.
Remove from heat.
Now add the cooked pasta and toss.
Serve with grated Parmesan cheese, if desired.
Serves 4. Recipe can be doubled, if necessary.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
steps: Grease oblong cake pan.
Put in crushed pineapple.
Add cherry pie filling.
Dump the box of cake mix.
(Do not mix up.)
Add pecans.
Dot the butter on top of this.
Do not mix any, just put each article on top of each other.
Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
steps: Mix together pretzels, margarine and sugar. Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Cool completely; bring to boil pineapple juice. Add jello and strawberries. Chill until slightly set; set aside. Cream the cream cheese and powdered sugar until fluffy. Add Cool Whip and spread over. Top with strawberry mixture. Chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Cheesy Mixed Vegetable Bake
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen mixed broccoli, cauliflower, and carrots
1 (4 oz.) can chopped pimento (drained and divided)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.

Grease a large casserole dish. Combine vegetables, half of pimento, soup, sour cream, pepper, half of fried onions, and half of the cheese into a bowl and mix. Spoon mixture into prepared casserole dish and bake for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle remaining fried onions and cheese on top of casserole.
Bake additional 5 minutes.
Remove casserole from oven and sprinkle with remaining pimento.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Casserole For The Crowd
steps: Brown ground beef and onion; drain.
Add cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, corn, pimento, sour cream, salt and pepper.
Simmer for 30 to 45 minutes.
Cook egg noodles per package;
place noodles in large casserole dish and pour mixture over noodles.
Stir well.
Sprinkle top with grated cheese and bread crumbs mixed together.
Bake in a 350° oven until cheese melts and casserole begins to brown.
Time is about 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Parmesan Potatoes
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
Place first 6 ingredients in blender or food processor container. Cover and process to make fine crumbs.
Transfer crumb mixture to plastic bag.
Set aside.
Place butter in an 8-inch round microproof baking dish. Cook at 100% for 1 1/2 minutes.
Remove from oven; add potatoes and stir to coat.
Drain and reserve any remaining butter.
Add potatoes, a few t a time, to crumb mixture in plastic bag. Shake to coat evenly.
Arrange potatoes in single layer in shallow microproof baking dish or pie plate just large enough to accomodate.
Cover with plastic wrap and place in oven.
Cook at 100% power for 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Stir in reserved butter. Do not cover.
Return to oven and cook at 100% power for 4 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon cheese and garnish with parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Swiss Chicken
ingredients: 1 can cream chicken soup diluted with milk (1/2 can of milk to 1 can soup)
steps: Place chicken in baking dish.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place cheese over chicken.
Pour soup over cheese.
Sprinkle stuffing over cheese.
Pour butter over stuffing.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serve with rice pilaf.

recipes.title: Becky'S Mock Key Lime Pie
steps: Blend first 3 ingredients together and pour into crust.
Chill for 3 to 4 hours.
Garnish and serve.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Manhattan Meatballs
ingredients: 1 small bottle Kraft original barbecue sauce
steps: Mix apricot preserves and barbecue sauce in crock-pot and heat until bubbly.
Defrost frozen prepared meatballs (1/2 bag at a time).
Add 1/2 bag of thawed meatballs to bubbling sauce.
Heat on high setting for 1 hour and turn down heat setting to low; keep warm until ready to serve.
Transfer to chafing dish when needed.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Barbecue Beef
ingredients: 3 lb. boneless tip roast, cut in chunks
steps: Place beef in a 5-quart slow cooker. Add celery, onion and green pepper. In a bowl, combine the ketchup, tomato paste, brown sugar, vinegar, chili powder, lemon juice, molasses, salt, Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Pour over beef mixture. Cover and cook 8 to 9 hours or until meat is tender. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Shoe Peg Corn Salad
steps: Mix all vegetables together except tomatoes.
Wait 2 hours before serving and add tomatoes.
Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, vinegar and celery seed and pour over vegetables.
Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Beef Burgundy
steps: Brown beef.
Pour all ingredients on top of beef.
Use roasting pan with tight lid.
Place in oven for 3 hours at 350°. Serve with wild rice.

recipes.title: Carrot Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. carrots, cooked and pureed (about 2 c.)
steps: Mix and add 1 stick of melted margarine.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until set.
This recipe is a delightful surprise to family and guests.

recipes.title: Coconut Cream Cake
steps: Make cake mix as directed on cake box.
While cake is still warm, poke holes into top of cake.
(Suggestion:
Use a wooden spoon handle.)
Pour coconut cream into each hole slowly.
Add Eagle Brand milk to each hole also.
Let cake cool.
Then add Cool Whip over top of cake.
Sprinkle some coconut and pecans over top of cake.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Mix ingredients together; pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Yellow Squash
ingredients: 4 to 5 medium yellow squash, halved lengthwise
steps: Pour melted butter into a 9-inch pan or baking dish.
Add lemon juice, thyme, salt and pepper to the butter.
Stir with fork until mixed.
Place squash in pan, cut side down.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until squash is tender or microwave in a Pyrex dish for about 8 minutes.
Turn once.

recipes.title: Italian Zucchini Pie
steps: Press dinner rolls into 10-inch pan.
Spread with 2 teaspoons mustard.
Simmer 10 minutes in frying pan margarine, onions and zucchini.
Add parsley, salt, pepper, garlic powder and oregano. Beat 2 eggs and mix with Mozzarella cheese.
Pour into shell and bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Napa Cabbage Salad
steps: Chop cabbage and onions and refrigerate.
Melt margarine in 9 x 15-inch baking pan.
Add crushed noodles, sesame seed and almonds.
Toss and toast until brown in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Ribbon Salad
steps: Prepare lime Jell-O as directed on package.
Pour into a long, clear 2 quart glass dish and let set in refrigerator.
Bring water to a boil and add lemon Jell-O and dissolve.
Add marshmallows and let melt. Add cream cheese; stir until smooth and remove from heat.
Add pineapple and evaporated milk.
Pour over the "set" lime Jell-O and chill.
Prepare cherry Jell-O; pour over pineapple layer and let set.
Cut into squares after last layer sets.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
steps: Brown meat, garlic and onion.
Add tomato, chili powder, salt and pepper.
Spray 9 x 13 inch pan with Pam (cooking spray). Line bottom with 6 tortillas.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
ingredients: 1 (small to medium) bag frozen Tater Tots or hash browns
steps: Brown ground beef and chopped onion; drain and put in 9 x 13 casserole dish. Mix cream of celery soup with milk; pour over meat mixture. Top with Tater Tots (or hash browns), enough to cover ground beef mixture. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes. Uncover and bake another 10 to 15 minutes to brown potatoes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Beef-Tater Tots Casserole
steps: Brown meat, pepper and onion.
Add Tater Tots, corn, peas and pimento.
Pour into greased casserole.
Cover with grated cheese. Pour undiluted soup over all.
Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
steps: Cook spaghetti, drain and rinse with cold water and then hot water, drain well and mix with oleo, parmesan and well beaten eggs, form into bottom and up sides of a 10-inch pie pan.
Spread cottage cheese on top.

recipes.title: Veg-All Casserole
steps: Drain Veg-All.
Drain and slice or chop water chestnuts. Place vegetables and chestnuts into a 3-quart mixing bowl.
Add chicken soup, onion, celery and mayonnaise; mix well.
Pour into a 2 or 3-quart casserole.
Top with buttered cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until bubbly and cracker crumbs are medium brown.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
steps: Mix together.
Save 1/4 cup to sprinkle on top.
Line a large cake pan (9 x 13-inch).

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add cranberry sauce, pineapple and walnuts.
Chill in your favorite mold.

recipes.title: Smothered Chops
ingredients: 1 or 2 green peppers, sliced in rings
steps: Place chops in covered skillet.
Top with lemon slices, onion, green pepper rings and salt.
Pour tomato juice over all.
Simmer until done.
Serve with rice or mashed potatoes and tossed salad. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Ribs
ingredients: 4 lb. pork spareribs or back ribs, cut into serving pieces
steps: Place ribs, meaty side up, on rack in foil lined shallow pan. Mix remaining ingredients.
Pour 1/3 of sauce on ribs.
Bake, uncovered, in 350° until until done, for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, basting 3 or 4 times with remaining sauce.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
ingredients: 1 large box instant pudding (chocolate or vanilla)
steps: Mix graham cracker crumbs, sugar and melted margarine.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 5 minutes.
Mix pudding as directed.
Pour 1/2 of pudding on crust.
Put 1/2 of Cool Whip on top of pudding.
Put layer of crushed cookies on top of Cool Whip. Repeat.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 16 oz. sausage, browned, drained and crumbled
steps: Beat eggs, milk, mustard and salt.
Add bread, sausage and cheese.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili Beans
steps: Cook ground beef and onion together until brown. Simmer all ingredients together. Add pintos and kidney beans.

recipes.title: All-Purpose Low Salt Seasoning Mix
steps: Combine all ingredients in a small jar with a tight fitting lid.
Shake to mix well.

recipes.title: Kraut Salad
steps: Drain all ingredients and mix well.
Place in refrigerator and let set for 2 days, stirring twice a day.
It is cool and crunchy; great with ham or dried beans.
Will keep in refrigerator for 1 or 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Crab Ball
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Shape into ball.
Roll in chopped nuts, if desired, or serve plain.
Serve with cocktail sauce.

recipes.title: Crispy Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. each: dried basil, thyme and oregano leaves
steps: Combine olive oil and seasonings in a bowl.
Scrub unpeeled potatoes well.
Cut each potato in half lengthwise, then in thirds.
Coat each slice in the seasoned oil.
Spread in a single layer on a greased baking sheet.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 lb. Velveeta cheese, chopped or shredded
1 c. cream of mushroom or celery soup
steps: Mix ingredients.
Pour in shallow casserole pan.
Top with 1/2 cup buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 1 large bottle of your favorite barbecue sauce
steps: You will need 1 glass baking dish.

recipes.title: Poppy Cock
steps: In a large, heavy saucepan, combine brown sugar, butter and corn syrup.
Bring to a boil; boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add baking soda, vanilla and salt; mix well.
Mixture will foam up.
Pour over popcorn and nuts, which have been put in 2 baking pans.
Stir well to coat.
Place in a 250° oven for 40 minutes.
Stir every 15 minutes.
Keep in airtight container.

recipes.title: Heavenly Frozen Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (1 lb. 4 oz.) can crushed pineapple or 1 (1 lb.) can fruit cocktail
steps: Turn temperature control of refrigerator to coldest setting. Sprinkle gelatin over lemon juice in glass measuring cup to soften. Stir over hot water until dissolved. Add to combined cheese, mayonnaise, salt and sugar. Fold in rest of ingredients. Pour into ice cube tray kept just for this purpose; freeze just until firm. Then reset temperature control. Serve sliced on greens. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Golden Cheese Spread
steps: Mix all together.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: No Bake Oatmeal Drops
steps: Boil sugar, oleo, milk and cocoa for 2 minutes.
Start time when it comes to a rolling boil and oleo is melted.
Do not cook any longer than 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and add oatmeal.
Mix until well blended.
Drop by teaspoon on wax paper or counter top. Cool.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Delight
steps: Drain juice from pineapple.
Cut marshmallows in small pieces. Combine with pineapple and set in refrigerator or cool place for several hours.
Just before serving, add whipped cream.

recipes.title: Dump It Cake
ingredients: 1 can blueberry or cherry pie filling
1 c. chopped nuts or 1/2 c. nuts and 1/2 c. coconut
steps: Place fruit in oblong ungreased pan.
Spread dry cake mix over filling.
Crumble sticks of margarine over this.
Top with nuts or nuts/coconut mixture.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Serve warm or cold!!
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Shaker Lemon Pie
steps: Slice lemons, discard seed, toss with sugar and refrigerate overnight.
Preheat oven to 450°.
Beat eggs until frothy.
Stir lemons into eggs and place mixture into unbaked pie shell.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 375° and bake until done.

recipes.title: Chili
steps: Melt butter in large skillet.
Add onions and garlic and saute until tender.
Add beef and brown gradually; add remaining ingredients, mixing thoroughly.
Cover skillet and cook on low heat until ready to serve.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Golden Shrimp Shells
ingredients: 6 oz. pkg. frozen shrimp, thawed, rinsed and drained, or 24 large cooked shrimp, rinsed and drained
1 tsp. olive oil or vegetable oil
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
In medium skillet over medium-high heat, stir-fry shrimp, garlic, parsley and hot pepper sauce in oil for 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Remove dough from can in rolled sections; do not unroll.
Cut each roll into 12 slices.
Place, cut side down, 1 inch apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Press half of each dough slice to flatten.
Place about 1 teaspoon shrimp mixture (or 1 large shrimp) on flattened half of each slice.
Fold remaining half of dough over shrimp; do not seal dough.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 13 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve with cocktail sauce.
Makes 24 appetizers.

recipes.title: Biscuit Coffee Cake
steps: Place nuts and cherries in round cake pan.
Melt butter.
Roll biscuits in butter then in cinnamon and sugar mixture.
Lay biscuits on side in pan.
Dribble pancake syrup over biscuits. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Rounders
steps: Combine all ingredients, except peanuts and powdered sugar. Bring to a full boil, add peanuts and cook until it forms a soft ball in cold water.
Remove from heat and add 1 cup powdered sugar.
Pour into greased muffin tins or drop onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Saute celery, onions and green pepper lightly.
Mix all ingredients together.
Place in casserole.
Add the following topping:

recipes.title: Beef Pot Pie
steps: Softly cook onion, then add rest of ingredients.
Stir constantly until bubbling.
Put in casserole and cover with pie crust.
Bake at 425° for about 20 minutes or until crust is done.

recipes.title: Dipped Oreos
steps: Melt almond bark according to directions.
Dip Oreos into almond bark.
Transfer dipped cookies onto waxed paper and sprinkle with sprinkles.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Dressing For Turkey
ingredients: 4 c. biscuit or white bread crumbs
steps: Mix together; fill turkey cavities and bake as any turkey.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Barbecue Ribs
steps: Salt and pepper ribs and broil to brown and remove excess fat. Put sliced onion in crock-pot.
Place ribs on onion and pour barbecue sauce over them.
Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours or on high 4 to 5 hours.
Serve with corn on cob and tossed salad.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Relish
steps: Grind together peppers tomatoes and onions. Boil for 15 minutes and drain through a cloth bag.
Put into another cloth bag cinnamon and cloves, boil in the vinegar for a few minutes, remove spice bag.
Add to the vinegar, the salt, mustard seed, sugar and vegetable mixture, which has been drained.
Bring to a good boil and seal in hot sterilized jars while relish is still hot.
Very good.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Casserole
steps: Cook potatoes without salt.
Mash with a little milk and butter. Mix all other ingredients (except Velveeta cheese) with the mashed potatoes.
In a 9 x 13-inch pan, spread half of the potato mixture.
Layer Velveeta cheese slices.
Top with remaining potato mixture. Dot with butter and cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Talerine
steps: Saute beef and onion until brown.
Cook macaroni.
Drain.
Add rest of ingredients to beef and onion.
Heat in oven at 325° for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Old English Eggnog
steps: Beat egg yolks in mixer bowl until thick.
Add sugar gradually, beating until light.
Add cream; beat well.
Chill, covered, in refrigerator.
Beat egg whites until foamy.
Add confectioners sugar gradually, beating well after each addition. Beat until soft peaks form.
Fold gently into chilled mixture. Chill, covered, for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cool Whip Salad
steps: Mix and sprinkle one box of any flavor jello over all and stir.

recipes.title: Stuffed Beef Tenderloin
steps: Defat tenderloin and cut lengthwise about halfway through. Open; salt and pepper.
Rub the inside with garlic.
Saute vegetables in butter.
Stuff inside the meat.
Tie the meat closed with string.
Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.
Add the cheese on top. Bake for 5 more minutes or until the cheese has melted.
The meat should be rare to medium-rare.
Garnish with cooked baby carrots and asparagus.
Yields 8 generous portions.

recipes.title: Biscuit Tamale Pie
steps: Brown hamburger meat and onion. Drain.
Mix all other ingredients except biscuits and cheese with drained hamburger meat. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Press biscuits in baking dish for a crust.
Pour hamburger mixture over uncooked biscuits. Top with as much cheese as desired. Bake at 425° for 35 to 40 minutes or until biscuits look browned.
Temperatures may vary.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
steps: Stir until dissolved.
Put strawberries in, stir, place on top of Cool Whip.
Chill in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Jim Bennett'S Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 c. sliced green or black olives
steps: In a saucepan, mix Lawry's sauce mix, tomatoes, olives and salad oil. Mix thoroughly.
Bring to boil. Then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring often.
Brown the meat while stirring in all of the seasonings, onion and bell pepper.
Cook spaghetti and drain.
Add the drained noodles and sauce to the meat mixture. Mix thoroughly.
Simmer until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Fluffy Vanilla Walnut Pie
steps: Mix the cream cheese, pudding mix, sweet milk and Cool Whip together with mixer.
Add some walnuts.
Pour mixture into graham cracker crust; sprinkle with walnuts.
Chill.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
ingredients: 1/2 c. hot peppers (sauce with juice), chopped
steps: In a mixing bowl, combine all ingredients except 1/4 cup of cheese.
Mix well.
Place in a hot greased skillet; sprinkle remaining cheese over the top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Tortilla Pinwheels
steps: Combine all ingredients. Cover 5 (10-inch) flour tortillas; roll up. Refrigerate until set. Slice in 1/2-inch pieces. Dip in your favorite salsa. Great for parties/showers.

recipes.title: Dill Pickles
steps: Slice cucumbers into spears.
Bring liquids and salt to boil. Pack jars with cucumbers.
Add dill blossoms, garlic cloves and 1/2 teaspoon dill weed to each jar.
Pour liquid into jars.
Seal and let set.

recipes.title: No Bake Fruit Cake
ingredients: 2 bottles maraschino cherries, cut in half
steps: Crumble crackers into crumbs (food processor works well).
Put cherries and pecans in crumbs.
Melt butter and marshmallows.
As soon as melted, stir all ingredients together.
Pack into wax paper lined box.
Freeze.
Slice to serve.

recipes.title: Diabetic Shake
ingredients: 6 to 8 ice cubes (or more for thick shake)
1/2 banana or 1/2 c. fruit of your choice, optional
steps: Place all ingredients in blender and mix at high speed. Result will be a 12 oz. shake.
Less than 100 calories.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Combine all ingredients, place in loaf pan.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Skinny Soup
steps: Place all ingredients in a big pot and simmer over low heat until vegetables are tender, 1 hour or more. Add more broth if needed.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Dinner
steps: Cook and drain macaroni.
Chop beef and cube cheese.
Combine all ingredients, except buttered crumbs, and put into casserole dish.
Top with buttered crumbs.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chop Suey
steps: Cut pork and beef fine and brown slightly.
Add celery and onion.
Cover with water.
Season with salt and simmer for about 45 minutes.
Add soy sauce, Fuji sauce and molasses.
Cook until meat is fork-tender.
Then add bean sprouts just before thickening with 2 tablespoons cornstarch moistened in cold water.

recipes.title: Italian Spaghetti And Meat Sauce
steps: Cook beef, onion, green pepper and celery until beef is brown. Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer, stirring occasionally.
Serve over cooked spaghetti.

recipes.title: Cherry Cool Whip Freeze
ingredients: 1 can Thank You cherry pie filling
steps: Mix in order given.
Freeze until ready to use.

recipes.title: Party Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. family size lemon or orange Jell-O, dissolved in 4 c. hot water
steps: When Jell-O has set up and firmed, layer the top of Jell-O with marshmallows, bananas and pineapple.

recipes.title: Microwave Cheese Dip
steps: Mix together and microwave until bubbly.

recipes.title: Johns Favorite Bbq Sauce
steps: Cook on stove until simmering. Cover meat or chicken with sauce and bake or grill as usual.

recipes.title: French Fried Onion Rings
steps: Peel onion and cut into 1/4-inch slices.
Separate to form rings.
Place in bowl and cover with milk.
Let stand at least 15 minutes.
Drain, keeping 3/4 cup of the milk.
Place pancake mix, paprika and milk (3/4 cup) into bowl.
Beat with rotary beater for 2 minutes.
Dip onion rings into batter; drain.
Fry in hot deep fat (375°) for 2 to 3 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.
If batter becomes too thick, add a little more milk.

recipes.title: Happy Home
ingredients: equal parts: mutual love, respect and admiration
1/4 c. laughing at your own mistakes
season with hugs and kisses generously
being easy to please and hard to take offense
steps: Mix altogether.
Keeping Christ as the head, place into a safe, peaceful harbor and pray, pray, pray.

recipes.title: Chipped Beef Dip(From Estill'S Baby Girl)
steps: Mix all ingredients together and sprinkle pecans on top.
Bake in 350° oven for 15-20 minutes.
Best served on Ritz crackers.

recipes.title: Baked Mustard Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
steps: Brush chicken with mustard and dredge in bread crumbs.
Place in a baking dish.
Combine butter, lemon juice and water; drizzle 1 tablespoon over each piece of chicken and pour remainder in dish.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Remove cover, sprinkle with paprika and bake an additional 10 minutes.
Serves 2 or 4.

recipes.title: Lime Jello Salad
steps: First Layer:
Dissolve 1 package jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add pear juice, plus enough cold water to make 1 cup.
Place pears in the bottom of a mold or bowl.
Place in freezer until set.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli in water for 10 minutes.
Pour water off.
Chop broccoli.
Pour mixture over broccoli.
Bake 20 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Grandma Church'S Wonderful Fudge
steps: Stir together in a large heavy pot or Dutch oven, over moderate heat, the butter, canned milk and sugar.
Bring to a boil.
Cover. Boil 5 minutes and turn off heat.
Add marshmallows and stir until melted.
Add the chocolate, one kind at a time, stirring as it melts.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Blend.
Pour into a buttered 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan and smooth evenly. Let stand until firm, then cut into 1-inch squares.

recipes.title: Caviar Pie
steps: Mix eggs, mayonnaise and onion.
Spread in glass pie plate. Mix cream cheese and sour cream.
Spread over egg mixture.
Chill 4 hours or overnight.
Spread with 2 3/4 ounce jar black caviar. Garnish with lemon slices.
Serve with unsalted crackers (Matzos?).

recipes.title: Scalloped Eggplant
steps: Pare eggplant, cut in 1/4-inch slices.
Cook in salted water until tender, drain. Into 1-quart baking dish put a layer of eggplant, then a layer of white sauce, then a layer of buttered bread crumbs.
Do this until ingredients are used up.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
steps: Cook broccoli according to package.
Drain and arrange in oblong dish.
Layer chicken on top of broccoli.
Combine soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine bread crumbs and margarine; sprinkle over all.
Bake 35 minutes at 350°. Garnish with pimento strips.

recipes.title: Salsa
steps: Mix 1 pound cut up Velveeta and 1 cup salsa in large microwavable bowl.
Microwave on High for 5 minutes or until Velveeta is melted, stirring after 3 minutes.
Makes 24 servings. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Meat Balls
steps: Form into balls; brown.
Add to sauce.
Cook on low heat until thickened.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
steps: Crust 1 cup strawberries.
Add water and bring to boil; simmer for
minutes.
Combine	dry ingredients, add to hot liquid, and
return
to
heat.
Stir
until mixture thickens. Cool and pour over berries in baked pie shell.

recipes.title: Mexi-Chili Casserole
ingredients: 2 (15 oz.) cans enchilada sauce (1 hot, 1 mild)
1 lb. ground beef, fried with seasonings to taste
steps: Set aside 1 cup chips and 1/2 cup cheese.
Combine everything else in 1 1/2-quart casserole and bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
Sprinkle top with remaining chips and some more cheese.
Bake 5 more minutes.
Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Fruit Ice Drink
ingredients: 2 large cans frozen orange juice concentrate
steps: Boil sugar and water until it makes a thin syrup.
Cool.

recipes.title: Everyday Meat Loaf
steps: In a large bowl combine eggs and milk; stir in bread crumbs, onion, parsley, salt, sage and pepper.
Add ground meat. Thoroughly mix meat and seasonings.
Spoon meat mixture into 5 1/2 cup ring mold or a loaf pan.
Firmly pat meat into mold.
Unmold mixture in a shallow baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Spoon off the drippings and fat.

recipes.title: Serbian Eggs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. Monterey Jack, Swiss or Cheddar cheese, shredded
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Melt 1-inch cube of butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour ingredients into pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until done.
Serves 6 to 10 people.
Perfect for brunch or supper!

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix well.
Roll into balls (about 1 teaspoonful).
Place balls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press tops with fork.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Sweetheart Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pkg. whipping cream or Dream Whip
steps: Heat crushed pineapple with sugar.
Add gelatine which has been soaked in cold water for 5 minutes.
Stir until melted; add lemon gelatin and cherry juice and cool.
Mix cream cheese with cherries (cut fine).
Then add to pineapple mixture.
Chill until slightly thick.
Fold whipped cream into mixture.
Mold and chill.

recipes.title: Love Cake
steps: Set your heart at warm temperature.
Mix ingredients smoothly with complete faith in God. Scrape the bowl thoroughly, because the great joy of life is often found at the bottom.
Spread with tenderness and sprinkle with sympathy and Christian loving-kindness.
Cut in large, generous slices.
More goodness may be found underneath than is shown on the surface.
Serve a smile, love and hospitality on a large platter of compassion and understanding.

recipes.title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: fresh broccoli, steamed, or frozen broccoli, thawed
steps: Mix the ingredients together.
In a casserole dish, put chicken on the bottom and top with broccoli.
Pour mixture over chicken and broccoli.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Makes 2 casserole dishes.

recipes.title: Boiled Dinner
steps: Combine all ingredients into a large pan; cover and let boil until all ingredients are tender (3 hours or maybe 4).

recipes.title: 1961 Pepper Relish
steps: Chop peppers, onions and cabbage.
Pour boiling water over them and let stand in water for 20 minutes.
Drain well.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients well. Then mix the 1/4 cup melted margarine with the corn flakes.
Cover the other ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 50 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Lady Cabbage
steps: Saute onion in margarine in large pan for 2 minutes.
Add cabbage, water and salt.
Cover pan, cook quickly for 10 minutes or just until cabbage is crispy tender.
Stir in milk; serve hot.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potato Casserole
steps: Melt cheese and mayonnaise; mix in hash browns with onion. Place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.

recipes.title: Maui Ribs
steps: Combine all ingredients except ribs over low heat. Add ribs and marinate for 24 to 48 hours. Barbecue.

recipes.title: Cherries In Snow
steps: Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar and vanilla until fluffy with an electric mixer.
Add the Cool Whip, then the milk and mix well.
Take your sponge cake and cut in half, cutting from side to side.
Put bottom half of sponge cake on a platter and add half the mixture onto the top of angel cake.
Then put the top half of the angel cake on top of the mixture.
With the other 1/2 of the mixture cover the top part of the angel food cake.
Then pour the can of cherries over top the whole cake.
If you don't like cherries, use some other fruit topping you desire.

recipes.title: Stuffing By Golly
ingredients: 8 pieces crumbled bread slices (white), dampened but not soaked
2 skinless breakfast sausages, precooked and chopped
1 1/2 apples, cored, skinned and cut into small pieces
steps: In a large frypan, melt butter. Slow fry chopped onion (don't burn). Add the raisins when onion is soft. Add the bread (small pieces, dampened but not soaked).
Add the celery. Add the small pieces of apple.
Mix all ingredients in frypan. Add pinch of salt, thyme and basil. Cover and warm over very low temperature for approximately 15 minutes.
Add the small pieces of sausage (degrease on paper towel first).
Add parsley.
Stuff into entree and cook as directed.
Warm is name of game.

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
steps: Boil chicken until done.
Remove bones and skin (save broth for soup).
Grease baking dish (9 x 13-inch) and place defrosted broccoli on bottom.
Place chicken on top of broccoli.
Mix soup, mayo and curry powder together.
Spoon over top of chicken. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and dot with butter.
Sprinkle then with cheese.
Bake 45 minutes at 370°, covered, then uncovered for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Garlic Dill Pickles
steps: Will also need quart jars.

recipes.title: Dilled Vegetable Salad
steps: Place first 3 ingredients in a bowl.
Combine dill, oil, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.
Pour over vegetables and toss. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Can be prepared the day before, if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Ball
steps: Mix well; form into ball and chill.
Serve with Ritz crackers.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Bread Pudding
steps: Combine all ingredients and stir well.
Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole or baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
Small pineapple bits are good.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
steps: Grate the cheese.
Prepare biscuit mix as box directs.
Mix sausage and cheese into biscuit dough (hands work better than spoon).
Shape into balls the size of quarters.
Place on baking sheet and flatten slightly with a fork.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Arkansas Shrimp
steps: Cut chicken breasts in 1/2-inch strips.
Place in bowl; add salt and seasoned pepper and let stand for 15 minutes.
Mix corn oil and cornstarch; pour over chicken and let stand for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle paprika over chicken; add unbeaten egg whites. Mix a little and let stand 15 minutes.
Put 2 or 3 tablespoons of oil in skillet.
Add chicken.
Turn every few minutes until brown as you desire.

recipes.title: Cheesecake
ingredients: 6 oz. whipped cream or Cool Whip
steps: Blend cream cheese and sugar.
Add Cool Whip.
Pour into baked graham cracker crumb crust and top with favorite topping. Cool, then serve.

recipes.title: Mushroom Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. stew beef, cut into small cubes
8 c. beef broth (soup base or mix)
steps: Place all ingredients in a large soup pot and bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Pie
steps: Mix milk, lemon juice and vanilla.
Mix until blended well. Fold in remaining ingredients, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Pour mix in crust.
Freeze until firm, approximately 2 to 3 hours.
Let stand 20 to 30 minutes at room temperature before serving.

recipes.title: Devilish Crab Eggs
steps: Peel the hard-cooked eggs and cut in half lengthwise.
Remove yolks.
Put in bowl and mash well.
Add celery, mayonnaise and seasonings.
Add the crab meat and mix well.
Stuff the egg whites with the yolk mixture.
Chill before serving.
Makes 1 dozen.

recipes.title: Hot Mexican Dish
steps: Brown hamburger, onion and bell pepper.
Add corn, barbecue sauce and Cheez Whiz.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add chili powder. Put some Fritos on top.
Heat in 350° oven for 5 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Caramel Corn
steps: Melt butter; stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt.
Bring to boil, stirring constantly.
Boil, without stirring, 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Stir in soda and vanilla.
Gradually pour over popped corn, mixing well.

recipes.title: Chicken Orange Salad Bowl
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Cover and refrigerate.
Garnish with orange and apple wedges.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Casserole
steps: Wash cauliflower.
Separate head; cook in salted water until done, but not mushy.
Put cauliflower in buttered 9 x 12-inch baking dish.
While cauliflower is cooking, soak white bread (that the brown edges have been trimmed) in 3 cups of milk.
Break up bread after soaking; add onion and celery.
Cook in heavy skillet milk, bread, celery and onion until thick and creamy.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Pour over cauliflower.
Cover with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Roll
steps: Combine sugar, syrup and water.
Cook to soft ball stage.
Pour 1/2 of cooked syrups over egg whites that have been beaten. Continue beating while cooking rest of syrup to hard ball stage. Pour over whites.
Continue beating until very stiff and loses its gloss.
Pat out on pastry cloth that has been sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
Have a jar of peanut butter soft in pan of hot water.
Spread quickly over candy mixture.
Roll up like jelly roll.
Slice.

recipes.title: Lemon Onions
steps: Halve the onions and steam until tender.
Place in pan.
Pour the remaining ingredients over the onions.
Sprinkle with sesame seed.
Broil until slightly brown and warm.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pasta Pedro
steps: Melt margarine, picante sauce and Parmesan cheese until hot. Remove from heat and add sour cream.
Salt optional.
Mix well and pour over pasta and serve.

recipes.title: Glazed Pecans
steps: Boil sugar and coffee 3 to 4 minutes.
Remove from heat and add cinnamon and vanilla.
Stir well; add nuts.
Stir until coated.

recipes.title: Peach Fizz
steps: Soften peach skins for easy peeling.
Use a small amount of water in the bottom of a bowl.
Add peaches.
Cover and steam for 1 to 2 minutes on Medium to High setting.

recipes.title: Turkey Loaf
steps: In a bowl, place the ground turkey. Season with Mrs. Dash seasoning. Add bread crumbs and egg; mix together. Shape into a loaf.
Place in a pan and bake 1/2 hour at 350°.
Take out and pour the tomatoes over the loaf.
Put back in the oven for another 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Dawnay'S Peanut Clusters
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. dry roasted peanuts with salt
steps: Melt both chocolates together, then stir in peanuts.
Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Polish Potato Casserole
steps: Simply alternate layers of sliced potato and onion; season each layer.
Top with butter, dill and parsley.
Pour milk over top.
Bake 45 minutes in oven or 20 minutes in microwave.
May be served with sour cream and extra dill.

recipes.title: Lemon And Vanilla Ice Cream
steps: Combine half and half, 1/3 cup sugar and vanilla bean in medium saucepan. Scald. Scrape in vanilla bean seeds. Discard bean. In bowl, whisk egg yolks with remaining 1/3 cup sugar until doubled in volume. Gradually whisk in half and half mixture. Return to heat in saucepan and stir over medium heat until custard thickens, about 3 to 4 minutes. Do not boil. Transfer to bowl and chill. Before freezing, add lemon juice and pinch of salt. Process in ice cream freezer.

recipes.title: Lemon Cheese Cake
steps: Chill evaporated milk in freezer tray until crystals form around edge.
Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup boiling water; chill until partially thickened.
Beat cheese well with a fork; add sugar, lemon juice and vanilla.
Whip chilled milk until stiff.
Fold in gelatin and then cheese mixture.
Mix butter with graham cracker crumbs; spread in a 9 x 12-inch pan and pour mixture over this. Yield:
12 servings.

recipes.title: Autumn Cheese Soup
steps: Place vegetables in water and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients except parsley. Heat and stir for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Garnish with parsley.
Serves 5.

recipes.title: Quick Saucy Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 3 chicken breast halves, skinned, boned, cut into 1-inch pieces
steps: In large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium-high heat. Stir-fry vegetables 4 to 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Remove.
Add remaining oil to skillet.
Stir-fry chicken 4 minutes or until tender.
Return vegetables.
Remove from heat.
Add combined remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Serve over hot cooked rice.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Special K Crumb No-Bake Bar Cookies
steps: In saucepan, bring syrup and sugar to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Stir in peanut butter.
Pour over cereal and mix until coated.
Put in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
Do not press down.
Melt chocolate (double boiler or microwave) and frost.
Cut into bars. Yield:
3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
steps: Cook together the hamburger meat and onion; drain once done. Mix the soups, enchilada sauce and taco sauce with hamburger and onion. In large casserole dish, alternate Doritos and sauce mixture. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
steps: In skillet lightly cook beef, onion and pepper.
Drain fat. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Simmer about 5 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cashews
steps: Cook broccoli according to package directions; do not overcook.
Place drained broccoli in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish and set aside.
Saute onion in butter until tender.
Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream, sugar, vinegar, poppy seed, salt and paprika. Pour over top of broccoli.
Sprinkle with cashew nuts.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until heated through.
Serve at once.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: New York Style Cheesecake
steps: Melt margarine and mix with crushed graham crackers and sugar. Press into bottom of spring-form pan base.

recipes.title: Veggie Dip
steps: Mix well and chill.
Serve with carrots, celery, cauliflower, radishes, onions, broccoli, cucumbers and peppers.

recipes.title: Baked Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 16 soda crackers, rolled into fine crumbs
steps: Scald tomatoes, peel and scoop out insides, leaving a thick shell.
Turn upside down to drain.
Chop removed pulp and set aside.
Saute green pepper, green onions and celery in butter until tender but not browned.
Add reserved tomato pulp and cracker crumbs.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Fill tomatoes with mixture.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and paprika.
Dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Tamale, Corn, Beans And Frito Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. chopped black olives (optional) on top of cheese
steps: Put medium size package of corn chips in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Then put can of pork and beans and same size can of cream-style corn on top of tamales.
Sprinkle grated Cheddar cheese on top and bake at 350° or 400° until all heated throughout (approximately 30 minutes).

recipes.title: California Gold Cheese Ball
ingredients: sunflower seeds or any toasted nuts
steps: Place cream cheese in food processor; blend until smooth.
Add next 4 ingredients.
Blend until very smooth and golden in color. Form ball; roll in sunflower seeds.
Wrap in Saran and refrigerate.
May be frozen.

recipes.title: Tracy'S Fruit Dip
ingredients: 1 large pkg. soft Philadelphia cream cheese
3 Tbsp. milk (less if you want it thick, more if you want it thinner)
steps: Mix all ingredients together and dip your favorite fruit. Tastes great with apples, bananas, oranges and grapes.
Enjoy.

recipes.title: Monster Cookies
steps: In large bowl, mix first 7 ingredients together until well blended.
Cream together next 5 ingredients thoroughly in extra large bowl.
Gradually mix dry ingredients into creamed mixture until mixed well.
Roll into cookie balls and flatten with hands. Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for approximately 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Soup
steps: Saute onion in margarine.
Process onion, ground peanuts and potatoes in processor.
Add broth gradually.
Heat to serve, adding cream or milk.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chives.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
steps: Mix pudding mix as directed on package.
When thick, fold in Cool Whip.
Line bottom of an 8-inch dish with graham crackers. Spread filling on top.
Alternate crackers and filling, ending with pudding on top.
Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top.
Heat the frosting until thin enough to drizzle over top of cake.
Chill several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Honey Barbecued Chicken
steps: In bowl, stir together vinegar, corn oil, flavor enhancer, garlic salt, cayenne pepper, paprika and hot pepper sauce.
Place chicken on grill, skin side up.
Cook, turning and basting with sauce mixture about 1 hour.
Spread barbecue sauce and honey over chicken.
Turn and baste all sides.
Cook 5 minutes after adding honey.
Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Preserves
steps: Place rhubarb, pineapple and sugar in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil and boil for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add gelatin.
Stir until gelatin is completely dissolved.
Pour into hot jars.
Seal.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
steps: Thaw and drain spinach by squeezing excess water out of spinach.
Mix first 5 ingredients until creamy.
Add spinach and mix thoroughly.
Chill in the fridge for an hour.
Serve with chunks of bread, vegetables or crackers.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pretzel Dessert
steps: Melt milk chocolate flavored disks, the white chocolate flavored disks and the peanut butter in the microwave.
Melt on Defrost for 1 minute, then check every 10 seconds until melted. Stir in 2 cups of crushed pretzels (I used pretzel sticks, which I put in a sealed plastic bag and crushed with a rolling pin.
I left some chunks for crunch.)
Spread on cookie sheet really thin; refrigerate.
When set, break up in small pieces to serve.

recipes.title: Frosted Fruit Salad
steps: The day before serving, in a large bowl, combine gelatin and boiling water.
Stir to dissolve gelatin.
Stir in strawberries until they are thawed.
Stir bananas and pineapple into gelatin. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Refrigerate until set.
Just before serving, spread with sour cream.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Microwave Caramel Popcorn
steps: Mix all ingredients except popcorn and soda in bowl.
Microwave on High 2 minutes and stir, 1 minute and stir, 1 minute and stir. Add soda, it will foam.
Pour over popcorn in brown paper grocery bag and shake.
Place folded bag in microwave for 1 minute and shake 2 times and for 30 seconds and shake 2 times.
Pour on baking sheet to dry.
When dry, store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Salsa Sauce
steps: Mix first 7 ingredients, bring to boil.
Add peppers and garlic.
Cook until thick.
Put in jars.
Yields 10 or 12 pints.

recipes.title: Fruity French Dressing
steps: Combine ingredients in screw-top jar or small bowl.
Shake well or whip with wire whisk until ingredients are well blended and of a thick and creamy consistency.
Chill.
Refrigerate in tightly covered container.
Shake well before using.
Makes 1 cup dressing.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. nutmeg (some on top of pudding)
steps: Beat eggs.
Add sugar, creamed corn, vanilla and nutmeg.
Melt butter and mix it in.
Sprinkle nutmeg on top.
Cook 1 hour or until knife is clean at 325°.
Serve hot.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
steps: Layer chicken breasts (that have been torn apart).
Next, layer onions, bell peppers, cubed cheese and 3/4 crushed chips. Then layer mushroom soup, chicken soup, Ro-Tel and broth.
Put rest of chips over all.
Cook 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pizza Rounds
steps: Brown hamburger meat and sausage together.
Drain grease. Melt Velveeta into meat.
Season to taste.
Put about 1 tablespoon of mixture on each rye round.
Broil in oven until brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Antipasto Salad
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. pickling spice (break in small pieces)
2 c. anchovies or sardines in tomato sauce or 2 c. tuna fish
steps: Cook cauliflower and carrots until partly cooked.
Add all ingredients and boil until completely heated.
Put in pint jars and seal.
Makes 15 pints.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Mix together. Bake at 300° for 30 minutes or until light brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Samilson Double Fudge
steps: Mix sugar and milk thoroughly with spoon in large saucepan (3-quart or larger).
Add salt, corn syrup and chocolate.
Stir carefully.
Butter inside rim of pot to prevent overflow when cooking.
Cook slowly on top of stove until soft ball stage, about 230° on candy thermometer, while stirring occasionally. Remove from stove, add butter and vanilla.
Cool to 160°, then beat in pot with mixer.
Add a few drops of milk if mixture becomes too thick to pour.
Beat extremely well.
Pour into buttered 9 x 9-inch pan.
Cut when just about cool.

recipes.title: Zucchini Patties
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Drop into skillet with 1-inch or less hot oil.
Brown each side.
Makes 8 to 10 patties.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix (reserve 1 c. dry mix)
steps: Mix dry cake mix, butter and 1 egg.
Mix by hand.
Do not use cake mix directions.
Spread in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix the rest of the ingredients and put all of it over your first mixture.

recipes.title: Lemon Icebox Pie
ingredients: 1 tsp. grated lemon rind or 1/2 tsp. lemon extract
steps: Fold together egg yolks, milk, lemon rind and juice.
Pour in a graham cracker crust.
Beat egg whites with cream of tartar, gradually add sugar.
Top pie with meringue and brown in a 450° oven.
Refrigerate for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pistachio Salad
steps: In large bowl, put Cool Whip.
Sprinkle instant pudding and add pineapple, marshmallows, nuts and coconut.
Mix well and set in refrigerator to chill.

recipes.title: Steak Sauce
steps: Heat all together and serve over steak.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained
steps: In a very large bowl, break up lettuce.
Put the potatoes, onion, kidney beans and cheese on top of lettuce.
Pour dressing on top.
Toss well.
Top with nacho chips.
Makes lots!

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a greased casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Italian Dip
steps: Combine process cheese spread and Italian dressing in a 1-quart bowl.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 box Loven Lites low-fat Pillsbury cake mix
steps: Place pie filling and pineapple in a 9 1/2 x 11-inch pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix over top of fruit.
Pour liquid Butter Buds on top.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown.
Serves 16 to 18.

recipes.title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 to 2 lb. stewing beef, cut into bite sized pieces
steps: Mix all together and cook 5 hours in 250° oven or cook in crock-pot all day.
Thicken sauce and serve over noodles.

recipes.title: Puffy Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 8 oz. Kraft natural Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese
10 oz. can Hungry Jack refrigerated big flaky biscuits
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Grease cookie sheet.
Cut chilies lengthwise to make 10 pieces.
Remove seeds and ribs.
Rinse and drain.
Cut cheese into ten 3 x 1/2 x 1/2-inch pieces.
Wrap each piece of cheese with a chili.
Separate dough into 10 biscuits; press or roll each to a 5-inch circle.
Place 1 chile-wrapped cheese piece on each biscuit.
Fold dough over piece of cheese; pinch to seal.
Form each into a finger-shaped roll; place seam-side up on prepared sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until light golden brown.

recipes.title: Pizza Cups
ingredients: 1 jar (24 oz.) your favorite spaghetti sauce
steps: Cook and drain hamburger with onion and pepper.
Season to taste.
Mix 1 1/2 cups of your favorite spaghetti sauce and 1 cup of shredded pizza cheese with cooked and drained hamburger.
Place 1 biscuit in each muffin cup and mold around the cup.
Place a full tablespoon of meat mixture in each cup and top with a teaspoon of sauce and a sprinkle of cheese.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Very good snack or for dinner with a salad.
Can be frozen and reheated in microwave.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
steps: Break lettuce into bite-size pieces and place in a large salad bowl.
Add a layer of each one of the ingredients.
Mix 1 1/2 cups salad dressing with 2 tablespoons sugar and spread on top. Sprinkle 1 cup shredded sharp Cheddar cheese on top of dressing mixture.
Add 8 strips of crisp bacon crumbled on top of cheese.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Muffins(Low-Fat, Low Sugar)
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Mix the milk, bananas, egg whites and oil in a bowl or blender.
Add to dry ingredients and mix.

recipes.title: Hamburger And Potato Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger meat.
Cut potatoes in small chunks.
Boil until barely tender.
Don't overcook them.
Add to hamburger meat. Add green beans and butter.
Heat for 10 minutes.
Serve.

recipes.title: Buttered Vegetables
steps: Cut carrots and celery into bite size pieces. Cook 10 minutes. Cut cabbage and add to mixture. Cook another 10 minutes. Add tomatoes, onion, limas and peas.
Cook until done. Add yellow and green string beans and butter.
Start with 2 quarts of water and add more, if necessary.

recipes.title: Strawberry Punch Bowl Cake
steps: Mix jello.
Let set until starting to get thick.
Mix sweetened strawberries with jello.
Fold Cool Whip and Eagle Brand milk together.
Pinch up cake.
Put one layer of angel food cake in bottom of punch bowl.
Cover with strawberries and jello, layer of Cool Whip and milk, then a layer of cake and layer of strawberries; Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 1 green pepper, cut into thin rings
steps: Probably the most famous of all composed salads is this one of tuna and vegetables.
It is a perfect luncheon dish, or it may be served in small portions as a first course.

recipes.title: Brownie Banana Split Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 c. frozen pineapple or orange juice concentrate, thawed
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Prepare brownie mix as package directs. On greased pizza pan or cookie sheet, press batter into 12-inch circle.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.
Cool.
Beat cheese until fluffy; gradually beat in condensed milk until smooth.
Stir in juice concentrate and vanilla.
Chill thoroughly.
Spoon onto cookie circle.
Dip banana slices in lemon juice; drain well. Arrange bananas, strawberries and nuts on top.
Melt chocolate with margarine over low heat.
Drizzle over top.
Chill until set, about 1 hour.
Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
steps: Brown sausage and drain.
Beat eggs; add milk, salt and pepper.
Mix well.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Put bread crumbs, sausage and cheese in dish.
Pour egg mixture over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Can be mixed the night before, stored in the refrigerator and baked in the morning.

recipes.title: Chicken-Spaghetti Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. cooked cut up chicken or turkey
1/4 c. diced pimento and 1/4 c. chopped green pepper
1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1 c. grated Cheddar or Velveeta or American cheese
steps: Cook spaghetti the usual way; drain.
Pour into a 1 1/2 or 2-quart greased casserole.
Add remaining ingredients, reserving 1/2 cup cheese for topping.
Mix well.
(May be prepared
a day ahead and refrigerated overnight.)
Cheese can be mixed with bread crumbs for topping. Set oven at 350° and bake, uncovered, 30 to 35 minutes or heat in microwave.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Colcannon
ingredients: 4 or more large Idaho baking potatoes
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into small pieces. Cover with boiling water and cook until tender.
Drain and dry over low heat.
Mash and add 2 to 3 tablespoons of butter and the warm milk.
Beat until light and fluffy.

recipes.title: Vegetable Beef And Biscuit Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Campbell's condensed golden corn soup
steps: In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat, brown beef.
Drain off fat.
Stir in soups, water, vegetables and Worcestershire. Mix well.
Spoon into 3-quart baking dish.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Cut biscuits into fourths. Remove dish from oven; stir.
Arrange biscuits on top; top with cheese.
Bake 10 more minutes or until biscuits are brown. Serves 6.
Prep time:
15 minutes.
Cook time:
20 minutes.

recipes.title: Southern Baked Pork Chops
steps: Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper.
Brown in oil in skillet. Place in a shallow baking dish.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the chops.
Cover.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, basting occasionally.

recipes.title: Hernandez Cider
steps: Stuff orange with cloves.
Place all ingredients in crock-pot and when liquid begins to simmer turn to low.

recipes.title: Company'S Coming Meat Loaf
steps: Mix all ingredients, except ketchup.
Form into a loaf.
Cover bottom of the baking dish with ketchup (about 1/2-inch deep). Place in preheated 350° oven, covered, and bake approximately 1 hour.
The ketchup and juices from the meat blend and make a great tomato sauce to serve over the meat loaf.
