recipes.title: Easy Onion Baked Potatoes
steps: Cut potatoes and onions into 1/4-inch slices.
Alternate slices, slightly overlapping in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines butter cake mix
2 cans cherry or strawberry pie filling
steps: Bake cake in oblong pan according to directions on box.
After cake cools, crumble half of cake in punch bowl or large bowl.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Hamburger Pie
ingredients: 1 can tomato soup or tomato sauce
steps: Brown the hamburg. Add all other ingredients. Put in baking pan. Slice 8 ounces cheese over it. Top with biscuits. Bake at 400°.

recipes.title: Marilyn Mcconnell'S Beef Casserole
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. lean ground beef, browned, drained and crumbled
8 oz. pkg. noodles, cooked and drained
steps: Mix the browned hamburger, spices, onion and tomato sauce in a large pot and simmer 15 minutes.
Mix the cooked noodles, cream cheese and sour cream; stir into the meat sauce.
Turn into a deep, greased casserole.
Top with mushrooms and grated cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 300°.

recipes.title: The Three Little Bears Porridge
steps: Get a bowl and put the bag of porridge in it.
Get a measuring cup and put in 5 inches of water.
Put the raisins in, then stir it up until it gets all watery and that's all.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Cook and drain squash.
Drain and chop pimento.
Melt margarine and stir in stuffing.
Line a 2-quart dish with 1/2 of mixture.
Mix other ingredients and spoon on top of stuffing in dish.
Cover with balance of stuffing and bake 1 hour in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Mom'S Corn
steps: Put corn in an oil covered dish.
Add salt, pepper and eggs; mix.
Add milk and mix well.
Add 3/4 of crumbs; mix and let stand.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter to rest of crumbs.
Put over top and put in oven at 350° for 45 minutes.
Take off lid last 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
steps: Mix cake according to package directions.
Set aside half of the batter; pour remaining batter into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch baking pan and bake at 350° for 18 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a saucepan over low heat, melt the caramels, milk and margarine. Remove from heat and add nuts.
Pour over baked cake; sprinkle with chocolate chips and reserved batter.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes more or until cake springs back when lightly touched.
Cool.
Cut into squares.
Top with ice cream or powdered sugar and a pecan half.

recipes.title: Lime Pickles
steps: Dissolve
lime	in
gallons	cold
water. Put sliced cucumbers
into the mixture and let soak overnight.
Wash real good
with clear, clean water, then let soak in cold water for 3 hours.
Then drain.

recipes.title: German Cole Slaw
steps: Bring first five ingredients to a boil and pour over cabbage, pepper, onion and carrot.

recipes.title: Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 c. (8 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
steps: Mix all ingredients together. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Make Ahead Meatballs
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Mix all ingredients and shape into 1-inch balls.
Place in pans and bake about 10 minutes or until done. Cool in pans for 5 minutes.
Pack in freezer containers after about 15 minutes and freeze.
Use as needed.
Makes about 3 dozen. I like to double the recipe using 1 pound of chuck and 1 pound of turkey.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
steps: Blend together 1 stick of butter and crushed graham crackers. Bake for 7 minutes at 375°.
Beat for at least 15 minutes, eggs, powdered sugar and 2 sticks butter.
Do not under beat.
Pour mixture on top of graham cracker crust.
Layer with bananas; then layer with drained crushed pineapple.
Spread Cool Whip on top of pineapple.
Top with cherries and chopped nuts.
For best results, refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Potatoes
steps: Place potatoes in a baking dish.
Mix together all remaining ingredients and brush over potatoes.
Bake for 45 minutes, brushing occasionally in a 375° oven.

recipes.title: Lazy Cook'S Chicken
ingredients: 1 pkg. sliced chicken breasts (6 to 8 pieces)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix together melted butter, barbecue sauce and onion soup mix.
Thoroughly coat chicken with mixture. Cook, uncovered, for 45 minutes or until the sauce gets "crusty."

recipes.title: Creamy Potato Fudge
steps: Melt chocolate and butter in top of double boiler.
Add potatoes, salt and vanilla.
Mix well.
Blend in sugar and mix thoroughly.
Add nuts and knead until smooth.
Press into buttered 8-inch square pan.
Cool and cut.
Makes 1 1/4 pounds.

recipes.title: Black Bean Soup
steps: Soak beans in water overnight.
Saute vegetables and cherry peppers until tender.
Add cumin.
Dissolve bouillon cubes in 2 cups of warm water.
Drain beans and place in pot with sauteed vegetables.
Add dissolved bouillon, pepper and lemon juice. Cover with water, bring to boil.
Turn down to simmer.
Cook until thick and vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Kraut Bake
ingredients: 6 to 8 pork chops (3/4 to 1 inch thick)
2 medium tart apples, cored and chopped
steps: Brown chops in drippings in large frying pan. Salt and pepper. Combine kraut, apples, onions, brown sugar and caraway seeds. Place in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Place chops on sauerkraut mixture. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Uncover and continue baking 15 minutes or until chops are done. Serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Casserole
ingredients: cracker crumbs, stirred in butter to coat
steps: Pour soup and cheese over vegetables.
Cover with cracker crumbs and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Polish Mistakes
steps: Cook ground beef and sausage; drain.
Add Velveeta cheese.
Mix with Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, garlic powder and oregano. Spread on party rye.
Put on cookie sheet.
Stick in freezer. (Once frozen, put into bags.)
When you remove from freezer, bake 15 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Mike'S Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pkg. Good Seasons herb-seasoned dressing mix
steps: Mix hamburger, 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper, eggs, 1/2 can beer, onion and crackers.
Make into small balls, cooking until done.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1/2 c. slivered almonds or 8 oz. can water chestnuts
steps: Mix all but the last 2 ingredients in large bowl.
Pour into casserole dish; top with cheese and potato chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
steps: Mix pretzels, 3 tablespoons sugar and oleo.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Bake at 400° for 6 minutes.
Don't let pretzels burn.
Remove and cool.

recipes.title: Stuffed Chicken Breasts
steps: Combine hot water, butter, carrots and seasoning mix.
Bring to a boil and add Stove Top Stuffing Mix.
Let stand 5 minutes. Put mixture on top of chicken breasts. Combine sour cream and cheese and put on top of dressing mix.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Factory Pumpkin Cheesecake
steps: Mix ingredients together just until coated and crumbly. Press onto the bottom and 2/3 cup the sides of an 8-inch spring-form pan. Bake for 5 minutes at 350°. Set aside.

recipes.title: No Cook Pickles
steps: Put all ingredients into a plastic container. Refrigerate for at least 24 hours. Easy to make and delicious!

recipes.title: Salmon Cakes
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Let stand for 1/2 hour.
Cook on high 300° for 5 minutes.
Simmer on low until done.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars(Like Reese'S Peanut Butter Cups)
steps: Blend all together.
May have to add some powdered sugar to make if soft but workable.
Put in a large cookie sheet with sides.
Put wax paper on top and press with a rolling pin to make flat.
Melt candy bar and pour over candy.
Smooth with spatula. Refrigerate 1/2 hour.
Cut in squares.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
steps: Mix mayo, cider vinegar and sugar; refrigerate overnight. Toss salad ingredients together.
Pour dressing over salad just before serving and toss.

recipes.title: Barbecue
steps: Cook on low in crock-pot all day or night.
Add 1/2 bottle barbecue sauce.

recipes.title: Cake Mix Cookies
steps: Beat egg and add Cool Whip.
Add sifted cake mix.
Drop about 1 tablespoonful into confectioners sugar.
Roll and place on cookie sheet.
Cook approximately 10 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Strawberry Daiquiri
steps: Blend in blender and top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
steps: Brown meat, green pepper and onion.
Drain.
Add chili, beans and tomato juice.
Mix well.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle Fritos over top and sprinkle shredded cheese over the Fritos.
Cover and cook until cheese melts (about 10 minutes).
Serve right from pot!!

recipes.title: Sweet Potato A-Mode
ingredients: 2 c. sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed
steps: Mix together.
Serve over warm oatmeal cookie.
Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Elephant Stew
steps: Cut the elephant into 2-inch cubes and place in a large receptacle.
Add water until the meat is barely covered.
Cook for 2 week at a temperature of 240°.
Add salt, pepper and other condiments to suit your taste.
This will serve 4,000 people.
If you expect more than this number, you then add the rabbit.
But do not tell anyone you have added the rabbit as there are many people who do not particularly like "hare" in their stew.

recipes.title: Imperial Chicken
steps: Grate loaf of bread into fine crumbs.
Dry overnight.
Mix crumbs with grated cheese; add garlic salt.
Dip salted chicken into melted butter.
Roll in crumbs.
Bake one hour at 350° until fork-tender.

recipes.title: Applesauce-Nut Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients in ungreased oblong pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inches, with fork, scraping corners frequently, until moistened.
Stir batter vigorously with fork 1 minute; scrape sides with rubber spatula.
Spread batter evenly in pan. Bake until top springs back when touched lightly in center, 34 to 40 minutes.
Cool; loosen cake from sides.
Cut and serve directly from pan.
Store any remaining cake loosely covered in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Hamburg Potato Bake
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup, or 1 can cream of mushroom and 1 can cream of chicken soup
steps: Brown meat and onion lightly.
Grease casserole.
Place layer of potatoes and sprinkle with salt and pepper; then layer of meat and repeat.
Pour heated soup over top and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for about one hour or until potatoes are done.
Can also be done at 225° for 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Baked Corn
steps: Mix all well.
Put in a greased casserole.
Top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Quick Peanut Butter Fudge
ingredients: 1/4 c. margarine (I use a little more)
1/2 c. cream or chunk style peanut butter
steps: Sift
together sugar and nonfat dry milk and set aside. In top of	2
quart
double
boiler (over boiling water), melt margarine and
cream	or
chunk style peanut butter.	Then add corn syrup, water
and vanilla.
Blend in sifted sugar and dry milk.
Add nuts (toast 3 1/3 minutes in microwave) and marshmallows.
(I put these
in
earlier	and let melt.) Pour in a greased baking dish and let set.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Cheddar Cheese Pepper Bread
steps: Spray ring mold pan with butter flavor Pam.
Sprinkle some shredded cheese in bottom.
Take two cans biscuits and cut each biscuit in half.
Lay biscuit halves in bottom with small crack between each.
Put a jalapeno slice on each.
Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.
Do another layer the same, then do a third layer and put cheese only.
Bake in a 400° oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Stir-Fry Chicken And Cabbage
steps: Sprinkle seasoned salt and garlic salt on chicken.
Fry chicken and carrots in oil until carrots are tender and chicken browns.
Add cabbage and tomatoes; fry until cooked.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Barbecue Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 lb. can beans in tomato sauce
steps: Saute bacon until almost crisp.
Add onion and continue to saute until onion is tender.
After draining fat, combine with remaining ingredients in 1-quart baking dish.
Set oven at 375° and bake, uncovered, for 45 to 50 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Yummy Caramel Bars
steps: Combine caramels and 1/3 cup of milk over low heat until caramels are melted; set aside.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
In a large bowl, combine butter, dry cake mix, 1/3 cup milk and nuts. Stir by hand until dough holds together.

recipes.title: Pasta With Steamed Veggies
steps: Steam vegetables or saute in butter until still crisp.
Add mushrooms the last minute.
Cook pasta according to directions and drain.
Add butter, whipping cream, vegetables and seasonings. Toss well.
Serve warm with cheese sprinkled on top.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Stuffed Green Peppers
ingredients: 4 medium green peppers, cut in half
steps: Boil green peppers for 5 minutes.
Mix all other ingredients and stuff cooled peppers, then bake 45 minutes uncovered in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Potatoes
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) bag frozen hash browns, thawed
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a 9 x 11-inch pan, except for crackers and butter.
Mix butter and crackers and sprinkle on top. Bake in 325° oven for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
steps: Season pork chops and brown on both sides; set aside.
Peel potatoes and slice round; put in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Season to taste.
Mix can cream of mushroom soup with water and pour over potatoes; put sliced onion over this.
Top with browned pork chops.
Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Chili Con Carne(Method:  One Pot)
steps: Chop onion and green pepper.
Brown hamburger with green pepper and onion.
Break up tomatoes with a fork; add to meat mixture.
Heat until boiling.
Add kidney beans and chili powder; heat through (about 5 minutes).

recipes.title: Sausage Souffle
steps: Mix ingredients and pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Refrigerate for 12 hours.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili
steps: Brown hamburger meat and onions until done.
Pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients and simmer about one hour.

recipes.title: Ham Loaf
steps: Mix ingredients for ham loaf.
Make into a loaf or meat balls.
Bake at 350° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Thai Chicken Salad
steps: In bowl, whisk salad oil, next five ingredients and 1 tablespoon of water.
Stir in green onions.
Add chicken pieces and toss to coat with dressing.
Serve on lettuce leaves.
Makes 4 servings.
Contains 350 calories and 27 g fat per serving.

recipes.title: Chocolate Bar Pie
ingredients: 8-inch baked pie shell or graham cracker crust
steps: Melt marshmallows in milk in top of double boiler.
Remove from heat; add chocolate bars and stir, mixing well.
Let cool. Whip cream and fold in.
Pour into 8-inch pie shell.
Refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Coconut Cream Pie
steps: Combine cornstarch, sugar and salt and mix well.
Add milk and butter and heat in double boiler.
Add egg yolks, slightly beaten. Cook until thickened.
Add coconut and pour into cooked pie shell; brown.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
steps: Stir sugar, cornstarch and salt together.
Separate eggs. Pour the milk with the sugar mixture, saving a little to stir with egg yolks.
Add egg yolks into mixture; stir well. Cook until thickened. Remove from fire and add butter, vanilla and 1/2 can coconut.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Beat egg whites until stiff. Spread over pie.
Sprinkle rest of coconut on top. Put into oven and slightly brown coconut.

recipes.title: Mom'S Breakfast Casserole
steps: Brown sausage and drain well.
Grease pizza pan.
Cover the bottom of the pan with the crescent dough.
Next, sprinkle the sausage over the dough.
Mix 3/4 c. milk and 4 eggs together adding salt & pepper.
After mixing, pour it over the sausage and dough.
Sprinkle 2 cups cheese on top.
Cook at 425 degrees for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: 7 Layer Salad
steps: Chop lettuce and place in large serving bowl.
Layer next 5 ingredients.
Cover top layer with mayonnaise.
Let set 24 hours in fridge.
Mix before serving.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 3 small jars marinated artichoke hearts, chopped
steps: Top with grated cheese. Bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes and serve with crackers or Doritos chips.

recipes.title: Barbecue Blue Fish Or Striper
steps: Place fillets on foil.
Put mayonnaise over fillets.
Slice onion and put on top.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Fold foil like a tent.
Place on grill and cook for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Chef'S Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) bottle Thousand Island or French dressing
steps: Mix first six ingredients together.
Next brown beef.
Add beans to meat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add to salad mixture. Garnish with tomatoes, avocado and Doritos around edge of bowl. Serve pronto.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Souffle
ingredients: 2 c. summer squash, cooked, mashed and drained
steps: Mix all ingredients (except bread crumbs) together; pour into greased casserole.
Top with crumbs.
Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes or until center is set.

recipes.title: Spinach Roll-Ups
steps: Defrost spinach; set aside.
Take chicken breasts and flatten until thin. Season both sides to taste.
Place 1 or 2 tablespoons chopped spinach on each breast half.
Roll up and secure with toothpick.
Place chicken rolls in nonstick skillet and cook, turning until cooked.
Place the rest of the spinach in skillet and pour tomato sauce over all.
Cook 5 or 10 minutes longer. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Cover until cheese melts.
Serve over rice.
Serves 2 people.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2 large cans Durkee French fried onions
steps: Mix all ingredients together except 1 can of onions.
Put in greased glass casserole dish.
Sprinkle remaining can of onions on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mom'S Cornbread Dressing
steps: Place chicken in large pan and cover with water.
Boil until tender.
Add water along to have at least 1 quart of broth.
Cool chicken and remove bones.
Cool and crumble cornbread in large bowl.
Cook onion and celery in 1 tablespoon butter until onion is clear.
Add onion, celery and broth to cornbread and mix well until moist.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Beat in 3 eggs and mix well.

recipes.title: Grace'S Pickles
steps: Add salt and ice cubes to cucumbers.
Let stand 3 hours; drain.
Mix sugar, vinegar, mustard seed, celery seed and turmeric together.
Bring to boil, add cucumbers.
Bring to boil once more and put in pint jars and seal.

recipes.title: Darlene'S Meatballs
steps: In mixing bowl mix hamburger, egg, soup mix, and cracker meal. Shape into 1 in. meatballs.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes on a cookie sheet.
Dilute cream of mushroom soup with pet milk.
Put meatballs in a large sauce pan and pour soup mixture over the top. Add kitchen bouquet for color.
Simmer for 20 minutes stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Chocolate Fudge Candy
steps: Mix sugar, cocoa, milk, salt, cream of tartar and cook on medium-high until it forms a soft ball. Stir to avoid sticking. Take off heat and add butter, vanilla and peanut butter if desired. Beat until the shine is gone or until reasonable thickness. Pour on greased waxed paper in a square pan and cut into square when cool.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake Roll
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) box vanilla wafers (over 3 c. crushed)
steps: Use food processor to chop wafers fine and nuts, not so fine. Put wafers and nuts in large mixing bowl.
Cut cherries.
Add with mixed fruit to wafers and nuts.
Mix well.
Add milk and mix well. (Will be sticky.)
Using your hands, divide into 3 parts.
Put wax paper or plastic wrap on countertop.
Sprinkle 1/3 box of powdered sugar and roll 1 part fruit mixture in sugar to form a long roll. Wrap in the wax paper.
Prepare other 2 parts the same way.
Store in freezer.
Slice when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Dressing
steps: Mix in blender and store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Raisin Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
In a medium bowl, slightly beat egg yolks.
Beat in butter until blended.
Add sugar.
Beat until light and fluffy.
Add pecans and raisins, vinegar and vanilla. Mix well.

recipes.title: Taco Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Thaw pie crust for 10 minutes.
Prick bottom and sides of pie crust with fork.
Bake the pie crust on cookie sheet for 10 minutes.
Remove from oven and reduce oven temperature to 350°.
In skillet, cook ground beef and onion until meat is browned.
Drain.
Add taco seasoning mix to meat according to package directions.
In small bowl, combine refried beans and 1/3 cup taco sauce.
Mix well.
Layer half of refried bean mixture in bottom of pie crust; top with half of seasoned meat, 1 cup Cheddar cheese and all the chips.
Repeat layers.
Bake on preheated cookie sheets for 20 to 25 minutes.
Top with lettuce, tomato and taco sauce to taste.

recipes.title: Lime Salad
steps: Prepare jello.
When partly congealed, add pineapple, cheese, nuts and mayonnaise; mix well.
Pour into molds and chill until firm.

recipes.title: Cranberry Relish Mold
steps: Grind cranberries through food grinder, using coarse blade. Combine ground cranberries and sugar; set aside.
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Drain pineapple, reserving syrup; add enough water to reserved syrup to make 1 cup.
Add syrup
mixture to dissolved gelatin; chill until partially set.
Fold ground cranberry mixture, crushed pineapple, chopped celery and chopped walnuts into partially set gelatin.
Pour into 5-cup mold.
Chill until firm.
Unmold to serve.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
Great with turkey at Thanksgiving!

recipes.title: Chili
steps: Brown ground beef, onion and celery.
Drain off fat.
To beef mixture, add kidney beans, chopped jalapeno peppers and tomato soup.
Season with garlic powder, chili powder and pepper to taste.
Simmer for 1 hour.
Serve topped with grated Cheddar cheese.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Mix together in bowl.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour covered. Uncover last 45 minutes and stir every 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti All'Aglio E Olio(Spaghetti With Garlic And Oil)
steps: Cook spaghetti in plenty of boiling, salted water, with a dash of olive oil.
Heat olive oil with cloves of garlic but do not let the garlic brown.
Warm oil gently to release the flavor of the garlic.
When spaghetti is cooked, drain it and transfer to a warm serving bowl.
Pour over the oil and garlic and toss the spaghetti well.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
steps: Remove meat
from bones.
Mix all liquids together.
Put layer of chicken,
chips,
cheese and onions.
Pour liquid over this. Make 2 layers.
Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
steps: Prepare cake mix according to package directions.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Pour 1/2 of cake batter into 8 1/2 x 13-inch greased cake pan and bake 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetables With Fish(Serves 4)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Sprinkle fish with approximately 3 tablespoons chicken soup.
Roll up fish and place in baking dish coated with vegetable cooking spray.
Sprinkle remaining chicken soup, pepper and paprika over fish.
Place vegetables around fish. Cover and bake for 55 minutes.
(May be microwaved on High for 20 minutes.)

recipes.title: No Bake Chocolate Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 c. frozen nondairy whipped topping, thawed
1 (6 oz.) pkg. graham cracker crumb crust
steps: In small microwave-safe bowl, place chocolate chips. Microwave at High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until chips are melted and mixture is smooth when stirred.
Set aside to cool.
In large mixer bowl, beat cream cheese, sugar and butter until creamy; on low speed of electric mixer, blend in melted chocolate.
Fold in whipped topping until blended; spoon into crust.
Refrigerate until firm.
Cover; refrigerate leftover cheesecake.
Garnish as desired.
Makes about 8 servings.

recipes.title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix
steps: Combine dressing, garlic powder and lemon pepper.
Pour over crackers and stir to coat.
Place on cookie sheet and bake at 300° for 15 to 20 minutes or until crackers are crisp.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Healthy Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 can low salt cream of mushroom soup
3 c. freshly boiled yellow squash, drained
2 Tbsp. Molly McButter sour cream and butter sprinkles
steps: Mash squash. Crumble bread.
Put aside 1/3 of the bread crumbs.
Mix all other ingredients and put into a large baking dish.
Top with crumbs. Bake at 350° until brown on top (about 20 to 30 minutes).

recipes.title: Fluffy Yam Souffle
steps: Drain and mash yams in large bowl.
Add all other ingredients, except marshmallows, and mix well.
Put into large casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Top casserole with marshmallows and bake an additional 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
steps: Reserve enough cheese for top.
Cook noodles.
Mix all together.
Sprinkle cheese and bread crumbs on top.
Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Picadillo
steps: Brown meat.
Add everything else and bring to boil.
Let simmer for several hours.
Good served with Doritos.

recipes.title: Frozen Citrus Pie
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen concentrated orange juice, lemonade or pink lemonade
steps: Beat concentrated juice in mixer bowl about 30 seconds.
Blend in ice cream.
Fold in Cool Whip until smooth.
Freeze until mixture will mound.
Spoon into crust.
Freeze until firm or overnight.
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Marinated Asparagus
ingredients: 3 or 4 (15 oz.) cans asparagus spears, drained
steps: In a saucepan, combine all ingredients except asparagus spears and bring to a boil.
Place asparagus spears in a casserole and pour marinade over them.
Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 24 to 48 hours.
Drain asparagus and serve.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Pimento Cheese
steps: Combine first four ingredients in frying pan.
Heat, but do not boil.
Add grated cheese and pimento.
Heat until cheese is spreadable.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Salad
steps: Mix cool ship, dry jello and cottage cheese until jello is dissolved.
Open and drain Mandarin oranges.
Put mandarin oranges into cool whip.
Fold mixture in gently.
Refrigerated for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lemon Curd
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in the top of a double boiler. Bring water to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and cook until butter melts.
Stir about 1/4 of hot mixture into beaten eggs.
Add to remaining hot mixture, stirring constantly.
Cook, stirring constantly, over medium-low heat, until mixture thickens and coats a spoon (about 15 minutes).
Cover and refrigerate up to 2 weeks. Serve over pound cake, angel food cake or gingerbread.

recipes.title: Macaroni Casserole
steps: Cook macaroni.
Brown meat and onion.
Add sauce and cook together for 5 minutes.
Grease casserole dish and pour all ingredients in.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pepper Tomato Relish
steps: Put green tomatoes, sweet peppers and onions through a food chopper.
Put in large pot and boil them for 15 minutes, then remove from heat and add salt.
Boil again for 15 minutes.
Stir often so the mixture doesn't stick.
Drain through a colander and add the following ingredients:
vinegar, sugar, cinnamon, allspice and whole cloves.
Boil the mixture rapidly, then add celery seed and mustard seed.
Put into clean jars and seal.

recipes.title: Nacho Dip
ingredients: 8 oz. total of taco cheese and Cheddar cheese (1/2 of each pkg.)
steps: Spread cream cheese in baking pan.
Spread salsa over cream cheese.
Sprinkle cheese over salsa.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes, until cheese is melted.
Serve with nacho chips.

recipes.title: Yellow Split Pea Soup
steps: Bring first 9 ingredients to a boil and simmer 45 minutes. Adjust salt and add cumin, turmeric and curry.
Simmer 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Fudge
steps: Combine sugar, cream, water, corn syrup and salt; cook to soft ball stage (236°) or 240° above boiling point of water.
Remove from fire and allow to cool undisturbed until pan can be held with comfort.
Add flavoring; stir until creamy.
Add nuts and turn into buttered pan to harden.
Cut into squares.
May also be molded into various shapes.
Yields 1 1/2 pounds.

recipes.title: Rocky Road Cake
steps: Mix cake as per package directions.
Add rest of ingredients and stir until combined.
Pour into buttered tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together and simmer in saucepan until thick.
Pour in unbaked crust and bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Diet Milk Shake
steps: Put all ingredients into blender; blend until slushy.
Makes 1 serving.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair
ingredients: 1 large or 2 small vanilla instant pudding mix (prepare as directed, less 1/2 c. milk)
steps: Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with crackers.
Mix prepared vanilla pudding and Cool Whip together and put on crackers.
Put another layer of crackers.
Top this layer of crackers with Chocolate Icing.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Dill Dip
steps: Blend cottage cheese until smooth in blender.
Add remaining ingredients and blend to mix.
Chill.
Serve with fresh vegetables.
Yield: About 1 cup.

recipes.title: Barbecued Brisket
steps: Generously sprinkle entire brisket with salt.
Pour liquid smoke over meat in cooking pan.
Cover and refrigerate overnight. Before cooking, sprinkle with salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce.
Bake fat side up at 275° for 4 1/2 to 5 hours until very tender.
Remove meat from oven, pour on barbecue sauce and let cool in pan.
Slice when cold.
Wrap in foil and refrigerate until next day.
Reheat when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Zippy Beef Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Brown beef and drain.
Cook macaroni as directed on package; drain.
Mix all ingredients, except potato chips.
Pour into an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish.
Cover and bake for 40 minutes.
Uncover; sprinkle with chips.
Bake an additional 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Sour Sauce
steps: Drain pineapple (save 1 cup of juice).
Heat oil in saucepan. Saute onions and green peppers for 3 minutes.
Mix cornstarch, vinegar, ginger and soy sauce.
Add pineapple juice.
Add onions and peppers.
Cook, stirring often, until mixture thickens.
Add the pineapple chunks.

recipes.title: Cowboy Beans
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. kielbasa, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Build campfire.
Mix all ingredients in large pot.
Cook slowly all day over campfire.
If you've been trout fishing and have leftover corn, throw it in the pot, too.
(Do not throw red wigglers into the pot.)
Serve and enjoy around the campfire.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Noodle Pudding
ingredients: 1 pkg. pineapple creamed cottage cheese (12 oz.)
steps: Cook noodles; drain.
Mix with all ingredients and place in casserole.
Sprinkle with corn flake crumbs.
Bake about one hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Patriotic Cake
steps: Set out ice cream to soften.
Cut butter into dry muffin mix. Place in casserole dish; do not press.
Bake at 300° for 5 to 10 minutes until mix begins to brown.
Remove and let cool.
Reserve 1/2 cup for topping.
Press remaining mixture in a 9-inch pie plate.
Add softened ice cream and top with crumb mixture. Freeze.
Top with blueberries from muffin mix and sliced strawberries.
Let pie sit about 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. spaghetti, broken in 2-inch pieces
1/4 green pepper, cut in thin slivers
2 c. diced, cooked chicken or turkey
steps: Cook and drain spaghetti.
Combine 1 1/4 cups of Cheddar cheese, 2 tablespoons of Parmesan cheese and all remaining ingredients.
Toss with the spaghetti.
Place in greased casserole and sprinkle with reserved cheeses.
Cook, covered, for 45 minutes at 350°.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Coleslaw
steps: Combine cabbage, onion, sweet pickle and green pepper in bowl; set aside.

recipes.title: Raspberry Refresher
steps: Combine all ingredients in blender container.
Cover and blend until light and frothy.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Boil broccoli
for 5 minutes;
drain.
Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch
baking
dish.
Stir in cracker crumbs until covered with butter.
Reserve some for top.
Spread broccoli on top of crumbs. Spread
chicken
soup on top of broccoli.
Cover with slices of cheese and sprinkle with remaining crumbs.	Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Sweet-Sour Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. lean pork (pork roast, cut into cubes)
3/4 c. green peppers, cut into strips
steps: Brown pork in shortening. Add water; cover and simmer 1 hour. Combine cornstarch, salt, brown sugar, vinegar, pineapple juice and soy sauce; cook, stirring constantly, until slightly thickened. Pour sauce over hot pork; let stand 10 minutes. Add green peppers, onion and pineapple chunks. Cook 5 minutes. Makes 6 servings. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Stir-In-The-Pan-Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Pour oil in 9 x 13 pan. Tilt pan until bottom is covered in oil. Pour cake mix, eggs, water and pudding mix into pan. Stir until well blended. Scrape sides and spread evenly. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and pecans. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 box Sweet 'N Low or Estee cake mix
steps: Prepare all above mixes.
Slice cake in thin pieces when cooled.
Slice all kinds of fruit.

recipes.title: Crab Rangoon
ingredients: 1/2 pkg. won ton wraps (50 in pkg.)
3 oz. crab meat, shrimp, ham, green peppers, etc.
steps: Cream together all ingredients, except wraps, meat and oil. Fold in meat.
Place mixture in center of each wrap and pinch to close.
Fry at 375° in hot oil until golden brown.
Do not overcook.

recipes.title: Grandma Jojo'S Barbecue Sauce
steps: Place all ingredients in container with tight lid.
Shake together.
Brush on chicken, etc.

recipes.title: Green Summer Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Prick pie shell and bake 15 minutes. Saute onions.
Add spinach.
Mix remaining ingredients in a bowl. Add onions and spinach.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Angel'S Hair Tomato Basil Toss
ingredients: 3 large tomatoes, peeled and diced or 1 (16 oz.) can peeled tomato and cut them up
2 Tbsp. chopped fresh basil or dried basil
steps: Prepare capellini according to package directions; drain.
In a large skillet, heat oil.
Stir-fry garlic and green onions one minute (do not brown).
Add tomatoes, basil, salt and pepper.
Stir and cook 2 minutes.
Toss tomato sauce with hot cooked capellini. Serve and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Light Beer Stew
steps: Cut meat into cubes.
Coat heavy pan with cooking spray; add oil.
Place over medium-high heat.
When oil is hot, add meat; cook until well browned, turning to cook on all sides.
Reduce heat to medium-low; add onion and cook until onion is tender and lightly browned.
Stir in beer, spices, carrots and mushrooms; bring to a boil.
Cover; reduce heat and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Combine cornstarch and water; stir until blended.
Stir into meat mixture.
Cook uncovered 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove bay leaves before serving.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cathedral Windows
steps: Melt chocolate chips and butter in double boiler.
Add beaten egg and let cool.
Fold in marshmallows and nuts.
Turn on wax paper.
Cover with coconut.
Form into 2 1/2-inch roll.
Cover with coconut.
Wrap in wax paper.
Chill and cut into slices.
Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Old Fashion Fudge
steps: Mix cocoa, sugar, salt and milk together.
Cook on high until boiling, stirring constantly.
Turn to medium.
Cook until thermometer reaches hard ball, about 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Judy'S Homemade Strawberry Cake
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) box frozen strawberries (set aside 1/3 box for icing)
steps: Mix cake mix, Jell-O, oil and water together first, then add 4 eggs, one at a time.
Then add strawberries.
Mix for 2 minutes then pour into greased and floured pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
steps: Chop onion and saute in oil in small saucepan.
Add other ingredients.
Simmer for 10 minutes; stir occasionally.
Delicious on chicken, ribs and pork chops.

recipes.title: Sugarless Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen unsweetened apple juice
steps: Cook over medium heat until thick, then add sliced apples to mixture and pour in shell.

recipes.title: Squash Relish
steps: Chop the squash, onions and peppers and mix well with the salt; let stand for 1 hour.
Mix the remaining ingredients together and boil for 2 minutes.
Pour it over squash, onions and peppers and boil 5 to 10 minutes, then can.

recipes.title: Apple Grape Punch
ingredients: 6 c. unsweetened red grape juice, chilled
steps: In 1 gallon jar combine juices and sugar. Stir until sugar dissolves. Serve over ice. Garnish with apple slices and grapes, if desired.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
steps: Mix crumbs with melted butter.
Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish.
Beat powdered sugar, vanilla and butter for 10 minutes. This step is very important.
Add eggs and continue to beat. Spread over crumbs.
Peel bananas and cut in lengthwise halves. Place over cream layer.
Spoon pineapple over bananas.
Cover with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with nuts.
Chill for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) carton small curd cottage cheese
steps: Mix cheeses thoroughly.
Pat out in a shallow pan.
Sprinkle 1/2 taco mix over top; refrigerate.
Cook hamburg; drain and crumble.
Put layer of ground beef on top of cheese mixture. Sprinkle a little taco sauce on.
Add layer of green pepper and onions, then a layer of cheese.
Sprinkle rest of dry mix sauce over top, then tomatoes last.
Serve with round corn chips.

recipes.title: Pink Delight Salad
ingredients: 8 oz. maraschino cherries, cut up (save juice)
steps: Cream the cream cheese with cherry juice; mix well.
Add rest of ingredients and fold in whipped cream.
Refrigerate a few hours before serving.

recipes.title: Bean And Pea Salad
steps: Combine vegetables and salt.
Dissolve sugar in vinegar.
Pour over vegetables.
Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Dry Hot Cocoa Mix
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Store in airtight container or it will harden.
Mix 1/4 cup of mix with hot water.
Add more Quik to taste, if desired.

recipes.title: Faster And Flameless Candy
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) jar crunchy peanut butter (2/3 c.)
steps: Combine sugar and syrup in saucepan or electric skillet. Cover and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat (or turn off electric skillet).
Stir in peanut butter.
Add cornflakes and stir until all are coated with syrup mixture.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can corned beef, cubed (let it chill)
1/4 c. buttered crumbs (I use Ritz crackers)
steps: Combine all ingredients except crumbs.
Pour into greased oblong dish.
Top with crumbs and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
ingredients: diced tomatoes (discard pulp; it becomes soupy)
steps: Blend together cream cheese, sour cream and taco seasoning. Spread on serving platter.
Cover with jar of taco sauce. Add the following layers:
chopped lettuce, chopped onions, diced tomatoes and shredded Cheddar cheese.
Serve with nacho chips.

recipes.title: Baked Shrimp
steps: Melt butter.
Slice 2 lemons thinly.
Squeeze juice from other 2 lemons.
Combine all ingredients with shrimp in Pyrex dish. Cover tightly and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 5 to 6.

recipes.title: Popcorn Balls
steps: Heat all ingredients, except popcorn, to boiling in Dutch oven over medium to high heat, stirring constantly. Add popcorn. Cook about 3 minutes, stirring constantly until popcorn is well coated. Cool slightly. Dip hands into cold water; shape mixture into 2 1/2-inch balls. Place on waxed paper and cool. Wrap individually in plastic bags and seal.

recipes.title: Chocolate Trifle
ingredients: 3 (3.9 oz.) pkg. chocolate instant pudding mix
6 (1.4 oz.) English toffee flavored candy bits
steps: Prepare brownie mix and bake according to directions in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Punch holes in top of warm brownies and drizzle with Kahlua.
Let cool and crumble.
Prepare pudding according to directions, omitting chilling.
Place 1/3 of the crumbled brownies in bottom of 3-quart trifle dish. Top with 1/3 each of pudding, Cool Whip and crushed candy.
Repeat layers twice, ending with crushed candy.
Chill 8 hours.
Makes 16 to 18 servings.

recipes.title: Garden Vegetable Pizza(No Cook)
ingredients: 1 large Italian bread shell (14 inches in diameter)
steps: Spread dill dip over bread shell about 1/2 inch from edge. Sprinkle with vegetables and cheese.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate Mix
steps: Mix and store.
Use 2 scoops per cup of hot water (about 2 tablespoons per cup).

recipes.title: Cheese Nut Balls(Nonmeat Entree)
ingredients: 1 c. walnuts, chopped fine or ground
1 can tomato soup or 1 can mushroom soup
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Shape into patties or balls.
Cover with tomato soup or mushroom soup.
Refrigerate 24 hours.
Bake in greased pan at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into casserole dish.
Cook at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
steps: Add butter to sugar and beat until smooth.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add wafers (crushed) alternately with milk.
Add coconut and pecans.
Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Italian Fiesta Vegetables
ingredients: 1/3 c. white onion, cut in strips
1/2 c. red bell pepper, cut in strips
salt and lemon pepper to taste
steps: In a large skillet or wok, melt butter over high heat. Add olive oil and garlic; stir for 1 minute.
Add onion and stir 3 minutes. Add broccoli and red pepper; cook for 4 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley, thyme, salt and pepper.
Stir and serve at once. Serves 4 or 5.

recipes.title: Peach Delight
steps: Mix graham cracker crumbs and butter and press into 9 x 11-inch pan.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar, 1 cup of Cool Whip and spread over crust.
Mix peach glaze, peaches and Peach Schnapps (to taste) and spread over cream cheese layer.
Top with remaining Cool Whip.
Chill.

recipes.title: Hot Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 1/4 c. hot green peppers, chopped or blended
3/4 c. green bell pepper, chopped or blended
1 bottle or 2 envelopes liquid fruit pectin
steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients in saucepan.
Bring to boil; boil hard for 1 minute.
Remove from heat; add liquid fruit pectin. Add a few drops green food coloring.
Put in small jars as it has a tendency to sugar when left open or unsealed for a long time. Serve with crackers and cream cheese.

recipes.title: Peter Paul Mound Cake
steps: Bake cake mix in three layers.
Combine the following in a saucepan:
marshmallows, 1 cup sugar, 1 cup sweet milk and coconut.
Cook until marshmallows melt and thicken over medium heat.
Spread between the cake layers.
Combine in another saucepan:
1 cup sugar, butter, 1/4 cup sweet milk and cocoa. Cook 3 to 4 minutes.
Add 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Spread over cake.

recipes.title: Caviar Spread
ingredients: 4 oz. caviar, well drained (1/2 red and 1/2 black)
steps: Chop eggs and mix with mayonnaise.
Spread mixture in a well-greased 8-inch spring-form pan.
Sprinkle onions over egg mixture.
Soften cream cheese and blend with sour cream until smooth.
Spread this mixture over onions with a wet spatula.
Chill 3 hours or overnight.
Top creatively with caviar.
Serve with crackers or toast points.

recipes.title: Best Ever Meatballs
steps: Combine and shape into balls.
Brown in oven or skillet. Transfer to slow cooker.

recipes.title: Diet Gelatin
steps: Take 2 tablespoons of the soft drink and mix with the gelatin. Pour remaining soft drink in saucepan and bring to a boil.
Add gelatin mixture to saucepan and stir until dissolved.
Chill until set.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cake
steps: Mix first five ingredients. Beat 10 minutes with electric mixer.
Fold in grated German chocolate and the chocolate chips. Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Mexican Stack-Up
steps: Place prepared ingredients on large platter in the following order:

bean dip, avocado (to keep avocado from browning, sprinkle lemon juice on top), taco seasoning and sour cream mixed together, chopped tomatoes, chopped green onions, black olives and grated cheese (on top).

recipes.title: Amarette Cookies
steps: Beat eggs and sugar, then put in almond extract.
Mix and beat almonds in by hand.
Use 10x sugar as flour to make the form of small balls, then put almond half on top.
Do not use Crisco on pan, just a lot of flour.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Squash Dressing
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Put in a baking dish.
Bake at 350° until set.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Low Sodium Creamy Stuffed Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 c. or more plain low-fat yogurt
2 or more Tbsp. low-calorie, low-fat Blue cheese salad dressing
1 Tbsp. grated onion or 1/2 tsp. onion powder
steps: Bake potatoes 1 hour in a preheated 400° oven.
After removing potatoes, increase oven temperature setting to 450°.
Slice potatoes lengthwise in half.
Scoop out potato; reserve shells. Combine potato, yogurt, salad dressing and onion; heat until fluffy.
Add more yogurt and dressing if needed.
Divide among reserved shells.
Place filled potato shells on baking sheet and return to oven.
Bake at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Six Cup Salad
steps: Drain oranges.
Combine ingredients.
Let stand 2 to 3 hours before serving.
Garnish with red maraschino cherries.

recipes.title: Cheese Roll
steps: Grate cheese and cream cheese together.
Add other ingredients and stir until well blended.
Roll in chili powder and paprika.

recipes.title: Pistachio Nut Swirl Cake
ingredients: 3 oz. pkg. instant pistachio pudding mix
steps: Combine cake mix, pudding mix, eggs, sour cream, vegetable oil and almond extract.
Combine the sugar, cinnamon and nuts.
Pour 1/3 of the batter into a 10-inch tube or Bundt pan.
Sprinkle with half of the sugar mixture.
Repeat layers and top with remaining batter.
Bake at 350°
for about 50 minutes.
Cool 15 minutes before inverting pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 large jar of Green Giant Mushrooms, chopped
1 can Cream of Mushroom soup- 98% Fat Free
1 can Cream of Chicken soup - 98% Fat Free
steps: In large pan, boil whole chicken until it falls apart.
Debone, cut into small pieces.
Set aside.
(Do not pour out chicken broth.)
Use broth to boil pkg. spaghetti.
Boil until tender.
In small skillet, combine chopped onions, chopped celery, and chopped mushrooms in 2-3 Tbsp of margarine.
Saute until onions are slightly brown and mushrooms are cooked.
After spaghetti is fully cooked, add soups and mix well.
Add the skillet mixture.
Season to taste.
If necessary, add extra water until a medium consistency.
Let it set for 30 - 60 minutes before serving.
Serve with green salad, and garlic bread.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
steps: Mix all ingredients and put in a greased casserole dish.
Top with crushed Ritz crackers.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 medium can crushed pineapple, drain and reserve juice
2 c. fruit juice (finish with cold water)
2 small boxes frozen strawberries, drain and reserve juice
steps: Mix all ingredients except Cool Whip and coconut.
Chill and let set.
Before serving, spread with Cool Whip and sprinkle with coconut.

recipes.title: Coconut Pecan Pie
steps: Combine sugar, syrup and butter.
Mix well.
Add eggs, pecans, coconut and vanilla.
Mix all together and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Divine
steps: Place broccoli and chicken in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
In small bowl, mix soup and mayo.
Pour over chicken and sprinkle cheese and bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Jellied Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 3/4 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained (reserve syrup)
2 envelopes unflavored gelatin (2 Tbsp.), softened in 1/2 c. cold water; dissolved in 3 c. boiling chicken broth
steps: Dissolve softened gelatin in chicken broth.
Add other ingredients.
Chill until partially set.
Stir in pineapple, chicken, chopped celery, chopped green pepper and chopped pimiento.
Pour into 6 1/2-cup ring mold.
Chill until firm. Unmold on lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Corn Macaroni Bake
ingredients: 1 pkg. or less salad macaroni (I like to keep cooked and drain a little liquid in casserole)
about 1/2 lb. American or Cheddar cheese
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Halibut Or Salmon
steps: Mix the mayonnaise, lemon juice, shredded cheese and onions. Spread over fish and bake at 300° to 350° for 40 minutes until golden brown.
Serve.

recipes.title: Pineapple Diet Dessert
steps: Put 2 tablespoons of juice in blender.
Sprinkle in the gelatin and blend.
Boil 6 tablespoons juice.
Add sweetener and the vanilla.
Pour into blender; add cheese.
Blend.
Arrange pineapple slices in individual bowls.
Pour blended ingredients over, dividing evenly among the 8 containers.
Refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, thawed and drained
4 oz. Kraft mild Cheddar cheese, cubed
steps: In 2-quart serving bowl, layer lettuce, tomatoes, mushrooms, peas, cheese and onions.
Spread salad dressing over onions, sealing to edge of bowl; cover.
Chill several hours or overnight. Garnish with bacon and shredded cheese if desired.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chili
ingredients: 2 cans crushed tomatoes (1 lb. 12 oz. size)
1 can red kidney beans (1 lb. 12 oz. size)
1/4 to 1/2 can chili powder (1.25 oz. size)
steps: Brown hamburg and onion in a large pot.
Drain grease.
Add sugar and chili powder.
Stir for a minute.
Add tomatoes, beans and vinegar.
Add 1/2 cup water.
Stir well.
Cook 10 minutes, tasting occasionally.
Add more vinegar, sugar or chili powder to taste.
Simmer 1/2 hour.
Can be served with corn muffins.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
steps: Put ingredients in blender and mix until creamy.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
steps: Brown hamburger (mixed with onion and pepper).
Drain.
In crock-pot, or on top of stove, in large kettle, combine meat mixture with rest of ingredients and simmer for as long as you like. (The longer you simmer, the more flavorful.)
Pour over favorite pasta.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 c. fruit only peach or apricot jam
steps: In small bowl combine all ingredients, mixing well.
Add more water if a thinner sauce is desired.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Orange Dessert
steps: Mix Jell-O and cottage cheese together.
Add oranges and Cool Whip.
Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Crisp
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: ground cloves, cinnamon, allspice, celery seed and mace
steps: Soak tomato slices in the lime water, made by stirring 3 cups garden lime into 2 gallons water, for 24 hours.
Drain, then rinse well under running water.
Soak for 4 hours in fresh cold water, changing water every hour.
Drain.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Beat peanut butter, cream cheese, 10x sugar and milk together until smooth with electric mixer.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into crust and freeze.
Remove 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Barbecued Ribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. boneless beef ribs or country style pork ribs
steps: Rub ribs with curry powder until yellow.
Then rub with chili powder until red.
Place in crock-pot.
Add onion and then catsup. Cook on medium until tender, about 5 hours.
Skim fat.
If sauce is too thin, remove cover and cook on high to reduce.
Sauce is good on mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Salmon Mousse With Dill
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. minced fresh dill or 1 tsp. dried dill weed
2 (7 3/4 oz.) cans sockeye salmon, drained and skin removed
steps: In a small saucepan, sprinkle gelatin over cold water or clam juice; let stand until softened, about 5 minutes.
Warm over medium heat until gelatin is dissolved; let cool to room temperature.
Stir in dill, onion, lemon juice, salt, Tabasco, yogurt, sour cream and celery.
Refrigerate until mixture begins to set.
Process salmon in a food processor; mix into gelatin mixture.
Spoon into a 4-cup mold.
Cover and refrigerate until firm, at least 3 hours.
Unmold onto serving plate; surround with crackers, Melba toast or fresh vegetables.
Makes 4 cups.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Mix ingredients and pour over meat loaf.
Bake 30 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal Drop Candy
steps: Combine sugar, cocoa, butter and milk in a heavy pot.
Bring mixture to a boil and let boil 2 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal.
Drop spoonfuls of mixture onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Potato And Cheese Bake
ingredients: 10 all-purpose red or white potatoes, cooked, peeled and diced
steps: Gently mix the diced cooked potatoes with the chopped onion, bell pepper, diced Velveeta, salt and pepper.
Place in a large casserole.
Have oven heating to 325°.
In a saucepan, heat bread with milk and butter until blended.
Pour into the baking dish. Top with cornflake crumbs and bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes or more.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Potato Cheese Chowder
steps: Place all ingredients, except cheese, in a 2-quart glass casserole.
Microwave, covered, on High for 10 to 12 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Stir in cheese until melted. Microwave, uncovered, on High, stirring every 2 to 3 minutes until desired consistency.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Tarts
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt butter.
Add sugars, oatmeal, salt, vanilla and pecans; mix well.
Fill miniature muffin pans 3/4 full. Bake 12 to 15 minutes.
Remove from oven.
While hot, using a spoon, push mixture which has baked out over the edge back into the pan, making tart compact.
Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.
Yields 72.

recipes.title: Depression Crackers
steps: Line a 15 X 10 X 1 cookie sheet with foil.
Put crackers on cookie sheet.
Melt butter and add sugar, boil for 2 minutes. Remove from heat add vanilla.
Pour over crackers and spread. Sprinkle with almonds.
Bake 10 minutes at 350.
When cool break into pieces.
Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Microwave Zucchini Parmesan
ingredients: 4 medium zucchini, sliced into 1 inch pieces (about 1 1/2 lb.)
steps: Set power select
at High.
In 8-inch round baking dish combine zucchini,
Parmesan
cheese
and
tomato sauce.
Heat, covered,
8 to 9 minutes or until zucchini is tender, stirring once.
Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and let stand, covered, 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients in skillet.
Simmer 20 minutes. Cool.
Toss remaining ingredients except Doritos and Catalina dressing in large serving bowl.
Add hamburg mixture and mix well. Just before serving, add crumbled Doritos and dressing.
Toss well.

recipes.title: Low Calorie Chocolate Cream Pie
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. European style cocoa or unsweetened cocoa
steps: In large microwave-safe bowl, stir together sugar, cornstarch and cocoa; gradually stir in milk.
Microwave at High 2 minutes; stir well.
Microwave at High 2 to 5 minutes or until mixture just begins to boil; stir well.
Microwave at High 30 seconds to 1 minute until mixture is very hot and thickened.
Pour into crust. Place plastic directly onto surface; refrigerate several hours or until firm.
Garnish with whipped topping and fresh fruit, if desired.

recipes.title: Impossible Pumpkin Pie(The Pie That Does The Impossible By Making Its Crust.)
ingredients: 2 1/2 tsp. pumpkin pie spice or 1 1/2 tsp. cinnamon, 1/2 tsp. ginger, 1/4 tsp. cloves and 1/4 tsp. nutmeg
1/2 c. Bisquick baking mix or Shawnee biscuit mix
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease pie plate (9 x 1 1/2-inch or 10 x 1 1/2-inch).
Beat all ingredients until smooth, about 2 minutes. Pour into plate.
Bake 55 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Mexi Meat Pie
ingredients: 1 box Pillsbury pie crust (from the dairy case)
steps: Fry until brown:
ground chuck, onions and green pepper. Drain fat.
Add spaghetti sauce.
Need corn and Cheddar cheese. Can also use sliced black or green olives, if you like.
Place bottom crust in deep 11-inch pie dish.
Top with 1/3 of cheese. Add meat and sauce mixture.
Top with corn, then the rest of the cheese, then the sliced olives if you wish.
Top with crust.
Cut steam vents in crust.
Bake at 350° to 375° for 1 hour.
Cool 15 minutes, then cut and serve.

recipes.title: Seven-Up Lime Punch
steps: Spoon 3 pints sherbet into punch bowl.
Soften for about 5 minutes at room temperature.
Then slowly pour in chilled 7-Up, stirring slightly.
Float remaining sherbet on top of punch. Makes about 36 cups.

recipes.title: California Caesar Salad(Preparation Time: 10 Minutes)
ingredients: 8 c. mixed gourmet baby lettuce leaves or salad greens
1 (2.8 oz.) can Durkee French fried onions
steps: In cup, combine dressing and mustard.
In large bowl, combine lettuce, carrots and onions.
Pour dressing mixture over lettuce mixture; toss to coat.
Serve immediately.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Spread
steps: Grate cheese.
Put hard-boiled eggs, pimentos, onion, salt, mayo and butter in blender and mix well.
Add to grated cheese. Makes a great cracker spread for a party.

recipes.title: Classic Chocolate Truffles
steps: Place cream in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly with wooden spoon.
As soon as cream reaches boiling point, remove from
heat, add the chopped chocolate and cover the pan.
Leave covered for three minutes to allow chocolate to melt.
Stir the mixture until perfectly blended and smooth.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes to cool and stiffen.
Drop by spoonful on wax paper lined cookie sheet and refrigerate for one hour or until firm.
Form into balls and dip into chocolate.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
ingredients: 1/8 tsp. garlic powder or 1 clove garlic
steps: Mix egg yolks with milk.
Add cooked and drained spinach, cracker crumbs, onion, garlic salt, pepper and half of the butter. Beat egg whites until stiff.
Slowly fold into spinach mixture. Place rest of butter in 2-quart casserole dish.
Add spinach mixture.
Cook in the oven in a pan of water at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Ranch Potato Crisps
ingredients: 1 pkg. (4 oz.) dry Ranch salad dressing mix
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Wash potatoes and leave skin on.
With a garnisher, slice potatoes into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Place sliced potatoes, approximately 4 cups into a bowl with a fitted lid.
Add vegetable oil; stir to coat.
Add salad dressing mix.
Cover bowl with lid and shake until potatoes are coated.
Line potato slices in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Do not overlap slices.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until potatoes are brown.
Serve warm. Yields approximately 40 potato crisps.

recipes.title: Chicken Marinade
steps: Mix all ingredients together. Pour over chicken (approximately 4 to 6 pieces). Cover and refrigerate overnight or for 8 hours. Keep 1/2 cup of the sauce for marinating while cooking; toss the remaining sauce. Grill or bake until done.

recipes.title: Tomato-Mushroom Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients: 2 lb. plum tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
1/4 c. minced fresh basil or 4 tsp. dried basil
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions.

recipes.title: American Chop Suey
steps: Cook pasta (elbows) as directed.
Brown hamburg and onion in heavy skillet; drain fat.
Add tomatoes (chopped) and tomato soup. Simmer while waiting for pasta.
Drain cooked pasta and add to tomato and beef mixture.
Simmer.
Add salt and pepper and sprinkle celery salt to taste.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Bites
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. minced green onions, with tops
steps: Mix together the cream cheese and onions.
Spread mixture evenly on ham slices using about 2 tablespoons per slice.
Roll slices.
Cover and chill 2 hours.
Cut each slice into 6 pieces.

recipes.title: Zesty Italian Casserole
steps: Brown beef and onions; drain.
Stir in sauce mix and tomato sauce.
Heat until hot.
Combine cheese and sour cream in bowl. Pour hot meat mixture into greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Spoon sour cream and cheese mixture on top of meat and spread evenly.
Place flat crescent rolls on top of mixture.
Melt butter and pour over top of crescents.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over butter.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Crepes Filled With Laban
steps: Drain laban to make a sour cream cheese in a bag or colander. Chill.
Beat eggs and add salt and pepper to taste.
Melt butter and add pine nuts.
Brown, drain well.
To the well drained laban, add drained pine nuts.
To make crepes, use small frying pan, heat with a little more butter.
Add dipper of eggs (2-3 tbsp.)
Spread around by moving around to edges.
Cook until lightly browned. Stack like pancakes.
To serve, use 1-2 tbsp. of filling for each crepe, then roll tightly.

recipes.title: Herbed Steak
steps: Mix all ingredients and brush all over steak. Salt and pepper. Refrigerate at least 5 hours; no longer than 24 hours. Cook at 250° for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
ingredients: 2 to 4 lb. hamburger meat, browned and drained
steps: Mix together salsa, Sweet 'N Low and hamburger meat.
Cream potatoes as usual.
Layer casserole with potatoes, then hamburger meat, then potatoes, etc.
(potatoes on top layer).
Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.

recipes.title: Homemade Salsa
steps: Clean your vegetables and chop up. Bring all ingredients to a boil in saucepot.
Reduce to medium heat for 10 minutes.
In a water bath kettle, process for 30 minutes.
Take out to cool.

recipes.title: Cherry-Glazed Pork Roast
ingredients: celery leaves and whole almonds for garnish
steps: Combine first 7 ingredients in a small saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add almonds and sprinkle roast with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Buttered Peas And Radishes
steps: Cook peas as directed on package. Shortly before end of cooking time, add radishes and continue cooking until radishes are heated through. Don't overcook or radishes will lose their crispness and color. Drain. Add salt and butter and stir until melted. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie Bars
steps: Set aside 2/3 cup cake mix.
Mix remaining cake mix, butter and 1 egg.
Mix until crumbly.
Press in pan; bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Mix remaining and beat.
Pour over crust and add pecans and bake at 350° for another 30 to 35 minutes.
Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
ingredients: 1 stick margarine sauteed with 3/4 c. onion
steps: Mix all the ingredients.
Put into baking dish.

recipes.title: Limeade Pie
ingredients: 1 small can Minute Maid frozen limeade
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into crusts.
Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
steps: Mix all together and chill.

recipes.title: Easy Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. sugar-free jello (lime or orange)
1 (20 oz.) pineapple in its own juice*
steps: *Use pineapple for lime jello or use mandarin oranges for orange jello.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip #2
steps: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Harvard Beets
steps: Drain beets; save water.
In saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch and salt.
Stir in reserved beet liquid, vinegar and butter.
Cook and stir until mixture thickens.
Add beets and heat through.
Serves 4.
These are yummy!

recipes.title: Mexican Chip Dip
steps: Mix together and chill.
Serve and enjoy.

recipes.title: Ham And Pickle Roll-Ups
steps: Let pickles drain and then dry them off with paper towel. Wipe ham to remove water from each slice.
Soften cream cheese so you can spread.
Lay ham out and spread cream cheese over one side, then place pickle on one end and roll up.
Place in refrigerator for at least 2 hours and then slice.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip(Low-Fat)
ingredients: 1 c. real or fat free mayonnaise
1 1/2 c. sour cream (may use fat free)
1 pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1 (1.4 oz.) pkg. Knorr vegetable soup and recipe mix
1 (8 oz.) can water chestnuts, drained and chopped (optional)
steps: Combine all ingredients; stir to mix well.
Cover; chill. Makes 3 cups.
To make Swiss Spinach Dip, add 1 1/2 cups shredded Swiss cheese.

recipes.title: Green And White Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, broken into flowerets
steps: Remove large leaves of broccoli and cut off tough end of lower stalks. Wash thoroughly. Cut into 1-inch pieces or smaller. Combine all vegetables in a large bowl.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
ingredients: 2 small packages of vanilla instant pudding
steps: Mix together cream cheese, Cool Whip, butter and sugar. Set aside. Mix together pudding mixes, vanilla and milk. Add it to cream cheese mixture. Crush package of Oreo cookies in blender until they are crumbs. Put 1/2 of crumbs in deep dish. Pour the filling over crumbs. Top with the rest of the crumbs. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Special K Bars
steps: In a large sauce pan bring sugar and syrup to boiling.

recipes.title: Italian Meat Loaf(Microwave)
steps: Mix beef, bread crumbs, half of tomato sauce, egg, 1/2 teaspoon oregano, salt and pepper.
On wax paper, pat into a rectangle 1/2 to 1-inch thick.
Sprinkle with Mozzarella; roll up by starting on short side; lift paper until meat begins to roll tightly.
Peel back paper to keep it free.
Roll up completely; seal edges and place in glass loaf dish.
Microwave at High for 9 minutes, rotating dish after half the cooking time.
Drain; combine remaining tomato sauce and oregano; pour over meat loaf.
Sprinkle with Parmesan; microwave 2 minutes to heat sauce.
Tent with foil and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cooked Mixed Vegetables
steps: Bring water, salt and margarine to boil.
Add vegetables. Bring to boil again and turn heat down low.
Simmer until all vegetables are tender (about 15 minutes).
Serve while hot.

recipes.title: Dee'S Cherry Delight
ingredients: 1 large (16 oz.) carton Cool Whip (sometimes I use more Cool Whip)
steps: Mix together graham cracker crumbs and margarine; press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch Pyrex.

recipes.title: Egg Surprise
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup, thinned (white sauce)
steps: Prepare day before serving.
Combine sausage, soup, cheese and mushrooms.
Lay in eggs.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 375°.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Mix Cheddar cheese, cream cheese and margarine together.
Add remaining ingredients.
Put in refrigerator and chill.
Shape into a ball and roll in chopped walnuts.
Place a cherry on top, if desired.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Meat Balls
steps: Mix hamburger meat and meat loaf mix; shape into meat balls and brown.
Add a little water and simmer until done.
Mix grape jelly, chili sauce and crushed pineapple and combine with meat. Cook in crock-pot 3 to 4 hours.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Mocha Cake(Yummy!)
steps: Blend together the cake mix, cinnamon and cloves, then prepare cake mix as package directs.
Pour into 3 greased and floured cake pans.
Bake according to package directions.
Use Mocha Filling for frosting and between layers.

recipes.title: Red Hot Cinnamon Apples
ingredients: 6 to 8 Jonathan apples (or any kind that hold their shape)
6 to 8 drops oil of cinnamon or to taste
steps: Peel, core and quarter apples.
Bring other ingredients to boil.
Add apples; cook gently until apples are tender.
Hot fruit cans very well.
Pack into hot jars and process in boiling water bath as you do applesauce, 15 to 20 minutes.
(Oil of cinnamon can be purchased at the drugstore.)

recipes.title: Tropical Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into ring and freeze or you can make it slushy.

recipes.title: Craft . . . Lace Easter Egg
steps: Spread the newspaper to protect your work surface.
Now blow up the balloons.
Pour glue into the pie pan and immerse long pieces of string in the glue.
Carefully take the string out of the glue, letting the excess drip off.
Spread the glued string on the balloon, making a lacy pattern.
Repeat until the balloon is covered in an attractive design.
Let the glue dry, then pop the balloon.

recipes.title: Microwave Herb Bread
ingredients: 1 medium loaf French or Vienna bread
steps: Place butter and spices in a glass custard cup; heat on full power 1 minute.
Mix thoroughly.
Slice bread crosswise in 1/2-inch slices, being careful not to slice through bottom crust. Brush herb spread on slices.
Wrap in paper toweling and place in bread basket.
Heat herb bread on roast for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange-Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 1 can pineapple (8 rounds), drained and cut into small pieces
1 can mandarin oranges, cut and drained
steps: Mix pineapple and orange pieces.
Add cottage cheese and stir. Pour in dry powdered jello and mix well. Stir in topping.
This sets quickly and lasts for days. Can be frozen.
This can also be served in sherbet glasses as a dessert.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Sauce
steps: In small heavy saucepan, combine syrup with chocolate kisses over very low heat.
Stir constantly until mixture is smooth. Remove from heat. Spoon sauce over ice cream.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Beef And Vegetables
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can sliced bamboo shoots, drained
steps: Trim and discard excess fat from steak.
Cut steak into very thin slices; set aside.
In small bowl, combine soup, cornstarch and soy sauce; stir to blend.
Set aside.
In 10-inch skillet or wok over medium-high heat in 2 tablespoons hot oil, stir-fry beef strips and garlic until meat is browned.
Remove from skillet. Add remaining 1 tablespoon oil to skillet.
Add green onions and broccoli; stir-fry 1 minute.
Add bamboo shoots; stir-fry 30 seconds more.
Return the beef to skillet.
Stir in soup mixture; heat to boiling.
Cook 1 minute more.
Spoon over rice.

recipes.title: Best Pecan Pie
steps: Stir together syrup, sugar, salt, flavorings, cool butter and beaten eggs.
Makes 2 shallow pans or 12 tarts.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes and then at 325° until done.
Put foil over if it browns too fast.

recipes.title: German Slaw
steps: Grate cabbage and onion.
Add 3/4 cup sugar.
Cover.
Set aside.
Bring to boil, 2 minutes, mustard, celery seed, oil, vinegar, 1 teaspoon sugar and salt; pour over cabbage mixture. Let set 12 or more hours; refrigerate.
Makes 1 to 1 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Delicious Chicken Dish
steps: Mix the dry oxtail and vegetable soup powders. Roll each chicken portion in the mixture until well covered. Place the portions in a casserole. Mix the water and chutney.
Pour over the thighs.
Cover casserole and cook for 45 minutes on the center shelf of the oven. Remove the lid and bake until the thighs begin to brown.
Remember no salt must be added as the soup powders already have salt.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Pizza
steps: Mix Bisquick and water; knead 20 times.
Pat into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Brown meat and drain grease.
Saute meat with onion, garlic and salt.
Mix in tomato sauce and seasoning.
Cook for 10 to 15 minutes, adding a little water if necessary.
Pour mixture over the dough.
Add mushrooms and pepper; top with cheese.
Bake about 20 minutes in a 425° preheated oven.

recipes.title: Microwaved Oven Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 1 medium onion, thinly sliced and separated
steps: Melt butter in oven 45 seconds on High.
Slice potatoes and onion in alternating layers, adding salt and pepper as desired. Stir butter into vegetables after each layer to be sure they are coated.
Cook on High 15 minutes, stirring after each 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
steps: After shelling eggs and washing, halve the eggs.
Scoop out egg yolks into a bowl.
Then add 1 heaping tablespoonful of mayonnaise and 3/4 teaspoon of pickle relish to egg yolks.
Mix well.
If too dry, add a smidge of mayonnaise at a time.
Taste to test flavor. When the right consistency and flavor, scoop a bit into each egg half.
Sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Zucchini Relish(Recipe Originated In Florida)
steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients and let stand overnight.
The next day, rinse, drain and add remaining ingredients.
Mix and simmer 30 minutes.
Pour into clean, hot jars and seal.
May not need all of the juice.

recipes.title: Pear Cobbler
steps: Cook first 3 ingredients in saucepan 10 or 15 minutes.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle box of yellow cake mix over pear mixture.
Slice 2 sticks margarine on top of cake mix. Bake at 350° about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Dip
steps: Drain and chop hearts.
Combine all ingredients in an ungreased casserole, saving a little cheese and crumbs to sprinkle on top.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecue Beef
ingredients: 4 lb. beef, cooked and shredded into strings
steps: Mix all ingredients and cook until sandwich consistency.
Can add broth to make more juice.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 box white cake mix (dry) (not the kind with pudding)
steps: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, place the ingredients in layers in order: pineapple, pie filling, sugar, cake mix and margarine. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Bar-B-Que Saladfort Morgan, Colorado
steps: Toss cabbage, onions and carrots together.
Heat to a boil the sugar, vinegar, mustard and celery salt.
After it is boiling, add salt, pepper and oil.
Do not stir mixture.
Watch it because it will boil over.
Let set 24 hours.
(You don't have to.)

recipes.title: Citrus Marinade
steps: Mix orange juice, lemon juice, garlic and oregano.
Marinate pork for at least 30 minutes before cooking.
Discard the marinade after using.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Meatballs
steps: Mix all except consomme.
Form into balls (golf ball size). Pour two 10 ounce cans of beef consomme over meatballs.
Bake at 350° for one hour.
Pour off liquid, spoon off grease and use a package of brown gravy mix to make gravy.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. small sea shell macaroni, cooked
steps: Mix soup, oil, sugar and vinegar together (reserve 1 cup for later).

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
steps: Drain pineapple.
Mold ingredients together excluding walnuts. Roll in crushed walnuts after molded into a ball or log shaped form.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
steps: Brown your hamburg; drain well.
In a crock-pot, put hamburg, ketchup, onion and celery, chopped.
The longer it simmers the better this gets.
Will make 12 to 14 hamburg buns full.

recipes.title: Meat Pie
ingredients: pie crust for a double crust
steps: Brown meat with the onion and season to taste.
Add the mixed vegetables, mushroom
soup,
cream
of
celery
soup and Cheddar cheese.
Heat somewhat and put in pie pan with crust. Place crust on top and bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Darby'S Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 6 small slices cooked ham (boiled ham may be used)
steps: Place the chicken on the ham and roll up.
Hold this in place with toothpicks.
Place in shallow baking dish and cover with
the Durkee
and soup, mixed together.	Cover the baking dish with foil and bake at 350° for 2 hours.	Serves 6.
More breasts can be added.

recipes.title: Chicken With Onions
ingredients: 1 large jar small whole white onions
steps: Place chicken in baking dish.
Season with salt and pepper. Add onions.
Mix soup and sherry and pour over all.
Sprinkle cheese over top.
Refrigerate for several hours.
When ready to cook, put in 350° oven, covered, and cook for 45 minutes.
Uncover and cook 30 to 45 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Hope'S Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli until tender. Drain. Combine all ingredients. Top with crackers mixed with margarine. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Marinated Vegetables
steps: Mix vegetables together in a shallow dish.
Bring remaining ingredients to a boil.
Cook 5 minutes.
Pour over vegetables. Cover and marinate for 24 hours in refrigerator.
Drain and serve.

recipes.title: Pineapple Jello Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in the boiling water.
Cool.
Drain pineapple (save juice).
Spread pineapple in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Layer with marshmallows, then layer of sliced bananas.
Pour cooled Jell-O over and refrigerate until firm.
Mix 1 cup pineapple juice, lemon juice, egg, cornstarch and butter.
Mix well.
Cook until thick.
Let cool.
Mix Dream Whip as directed on package.
Add to cooled custard.
Spread on Jell-O.
Top with chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Cola Barbecue Sauce
steps: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion, ginger, garlic, and saut for 3 minutes or until tender.
Stir in cola, bring to a boil.
Stir in ketchup and remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Twinkie Dessert
ingredients: 1 large box instant butter pecan pudding mix
steps: Cut Twinkies lengthwise and lay in a 9 x 13-inch pan, cream side up. There will probably be one or two leftover.
Cover Twinkies with the butter pecan instant pudding, mixed as directed on the box. Cover the pudding with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle butter brickle bits over all.
Refrigerate for 2 hours.
(Can be made ahead, the night before.)

recipes.title: The Bridle Path Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. spicy sausage, cooked, crumbled, drained
steps: Layer potatoes in buttered baking dish.
Top with sausage, 1 cup cheese, and ham.
Beat eggs with mustard, salt, pepper, and milk in bowl.
Pour over top layer.
Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup of cheese.
Bake at 350°
for 45 minutes.
Serve with toast or banana bread.
Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
steps: Mix all together in large salad bowl (sprinkle bananas with lemon juice unless eaten promptly).

recipes.title: Baked Crabmeat Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients except buttered crumbs.
Put in large flat casserole and top with the buttered crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 24.
Can be easily divided by 3 for 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Frosting
steps: Heat butter until it becomes light brown.
Remove from heat. Beat in sugar, milk, vanilla and salt.
Stir in peanut butter.
If mixture becomes too heavy, add warm milk or water to make it of spreading consistency.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Candy
steps: Boil first 4 ingredients for 1 minute.
Add remaining ingredients.
Drop on waxed paper or greased platter.

recipes.title: Cheesy Mixed Veggies
steps: Cook veggies, then pour into dish.
Melt Cheez Whiz and soup together.
Pour over veggies.
Bake 1/2 hour at 300°.
Sprinkle can of onions over top.
Bake another 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Sausage Dinner
ingredients: 1 or 2 pkg. Healthy Choice Polish sausage
steps: Cut sausage into 1/4-inch sections.
Slice vegetables same. Place all in pan on stove top.
Add margarine to taste.
Cook until vegetables are soft.

recipes.title: Blueberry Salad
steps: Mix well; let chill until firm.
Add topping.

recipes.title: Chocolate Walnut Buttercream
steps: Set a mixing bowl in a basin of simmering water.
Add the chocolate and the coffee; heat, stirring often, until chocolate is blended and melted.
Combine the yolks, salt and sugar in another bowl.
Set the bowl in a basin of simmering water and beat the yolk mixture rapidly with a wire whisk.
Beat until it falls in a "ribbon" when the whisk is lifted.
Spoon the chocolate into the yolk mixture.
Return the bowl to the simmering water and continue beating.
Gradually add the butter; beat.
