Remove the bowl from the heat.
Continue beating until the mixture thickens and becomes spreadable.
Add walnuts.
Cool.
Spread over the 2 cakes. Decorate with the 12 large walnuts.

recipes.title: Ripe Tomato Relish
ingredients: 1 gal. ripe tomatoes (after peeled and cut up)
steps: Cook tomatoes first and drain off as much juice as you can into a container.
Add remaining ingredients. Cook until tender, adding tomato juice, if needed. Put in hot jars and seal (with hot lids).

recipes.title: Dilled Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. chopped, fresh or 1 tsp. dried dill weed
steps: Cut cucumber lengthwise in half.
Seed and cut into thin slices.
Mix cucumber and remaining ingredients in 1 1/2-quart saucepan.
Cook over high heat 1 to 2 minutes, stirring frequently, until cucumber is crisp-tender.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. chicken, chopped in bite-size pieces
1/2 small pkg. Pepperidge Farm dressing mix
steps: Melt margarine and mix with dressing mix.
Cover bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan with chopped chicken.
Mix milk, sour cream and soups.
Pour over chicken.
Top with dressing and pat lightly into soups.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Cake
ingredients: 1 box Pillsbury Plus white cake mix
steps: Mix together first 7 ingredients.
Combine cinnamon and sugar and add.
Pour into greased Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Sprinkle powdered sugar on top.

recipes.title: Green Salad
ingredients: medium can crushed pineapple, well drained
chopped walnuts to taste (the more the better)
steps: Mix ingredients except nuts.
Works well in rectangular pan. Top with nuts.
Chill.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Brown hamburger.
Cool for 1 hour.
Grate cheese.
Add red beans, cubed tomatoes, onion and avocados (all should be cubed). Right before serving, mix all ingredients together (chips last).

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Cut all biscuits into fourths.
Place 3/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon in a paper sack.
Add biscuit pieces, a few at a time, and shake to coat well.
Arrange sugar-coated biscuit pieces in a well-greased angel food cake pan.
(Do not use pan with sloping sides.)
Place 3/4 cup sugar, brown sugar, 1 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon and margarine in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Pour mixture over biscuits.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Turn upside down and remove from pan immediately.
Pick pieces off with toothpicks or fingers.
Real good with coffee.

recipes.title: Snack Biscuit Donuts
steps: Take each
biscuit
and
cut with a donut cutter.
Drop donuts and
holes in hot cooking oil and deep fry until golden brown, about 2
or 3 minutes.
Remove and lay on a paper towel to drain.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Casserole
steps: Cook spaghetti, drain and mix in eggs, Parmesan cheese and butter.
Place in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Brown beef, onion and green pepper; drain and pour over spaghetti.
Cover all with sauce.
Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.
Top with cheese, last 15 minutes.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Lemon Bundt Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines lemon supreme cake mix
steps: Combine the first 7 ingredients and beat 8 to 10 minutes. Bake in Bundt pan at 375° for 45 minutes. Remove from pan immediately and pour over a glaze of the last 3 ingredients.

recipes.title: Christmas Scents
steps: Combine all ingredients in a tea kettle or saucepan and bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer as long as desired.
Check often and add additional water if needed.
May store in refrigerator for several days and be reused.
Ideal to set on wood heating stoves!

recipes.title: Barbecue Potatoes
steps: Take aluminum foil and butter the non-shiny side.
Dice 2 large potatoes onto foil.
Place 2 ice cubes in potatoes.
Cut up onions and peppers; salt and pepper to taste.
Fold foil up on top and sides; seal completely.
Repeat steps for the last 2 potatoes. Place on grill 15 to 20 minutes before meat.
Cook the whole time meat is on the grill.
Serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Hamburger Dish
ingredients: 8 oz. wide noodles, cooked and drained
steps: Add chicken soup to noodles.
Mix well.
Brown hamburger and onion.
Pour off fat.
Add tomato soup to meat.
In a casserole, first layer noodles with soup mixture, then put a layer of hamburger mixture and then some cheese over that.
Then repeat noodles, hamburger mixture with cheese on top.
Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Light Chile Verde Soup
ingredients: 6 or 7 c. chicken broth, reserved (or hot water)
steps: Boil chicken; reserve broth.
Let cool; debone.
Combine stewed tomatoes and next 5 ingredients in a large Dutch oven. Bring to a boil over medium heat and simmer, uncovered, 20 minutes.
Add chicken to tomato mixture.
Stir in green chiles and remaining ingredients; cover and simmer 45 minutes.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
steps: Cook the onion until limp in butter in a saucepan. Add bouillon, water and Worcestershire sauce.
Simmer (do not boil) gently for 30 minutes.

Pour soup into 4 individual ovenware bowls. Cut toast into 1-inch squares and float on soup. Sprinkle all with cheese and if possible, bake in hot oven (475°) or slip under broiler to melt cheese just before serving.

recipes.title: Plain Soft Custard
steps: Scald milk in top of double boiler.
Beat eggs; add salt, sugar and vanilla and add to milk.
Cook (bake) until it coats a spoon.

recipes.title: Raspberry Shake
steps: Place all ingredients in blender.
Cover and turn to high speed.
Blend for 45 seconds, or until creamy and smooth.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
steps: Combine all ingredients
and roll into 1-inch balls.
Bake in 375° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 small onion, sliced into thin rings
1/2 small green pepper, slice into rings
steps: Mix vinegar, sugar and oil together until dissolved.
Pour over cucumber, onion, green pepper and tomatoes.
Let chill or eat immediately.

recipes.title: Best Fudge
steps: In double boiler, melt together the butter and marshmallows. In large saucepan, cook the milk and sugar.
Boil hard for 8 minutes, then fold the marshmallows carefully and add the chocolate chips.
Stir until melted and quickly add the nuts and beat until creamy.
Pour into buttered pan and mark in squares. Cool and cut.

recipes.title: Potato Salad With Eggs
steps: Mix potatoes lightly with French dressing.
Season with salt, pepper and cayenne to taste.
Add celery, pickles, mayonnaise and chopped egg whites.
Add more seasoning if needed.
Just before serving, garnish with parsley and egg yolks forced through a ricer or sieve.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Cut each biscuit into 1/4ths. In bowl, combine 1 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.
Coat biscuits with sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Place all pieces in greased angel food or Bundt cake pan.
Melt 1 cup brown sugar, 1 tablespoon water and 1 stick margarine and boil for 1 minute. Pour over biscuits.
Bake at 350°
for 35 minutes.
Let stand for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pigs In A Blanket
steps: Preheat oven to 375°. Roll biscuits out with rolling pin. Place hot dogs and cheese on top of biscuits.
Roll biscuits up. Place on baking sheet, seam side down.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
steps: Spread crushed pineapple in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spoon cherry pie filling on top.
Pour dry cake mix on top, spreading it out to make it even.
Pour melted margarine on top.
Layer coconut and nuts on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: No Sugar Mandarin Salad
steps: Mix thawed Cool Whip.
Prepare Jell-O according to package directions.
Fold in with Cool Whip.
Drain oranges.
Cut into small pieces; add to Jell-O and Cool Whip.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Mother'S Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 medium onion, finely chopped or grated
1 beef bouillon cube and hot water to prepare
steps: Use a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Layer first with lettuce, then: celery, carrots, onions, green peppers, bacon (cooked), cheese (grated) and small frozen peas. Mix 2 cups mayonnaise with sugar to taste.
Spread over whole surface.
Sprinkle with hard-boiled egg or sliced and grated sharp cheese.
Make 12 to 24 hours ahead.

recipes.title: Tuna Loaf
ingredients: onion, salt and pepper to taste
steps: Melt margarine in hot milk.
Add fish, crumbs and seasonings. Add eggs, sour cream, grated carrots and frozen peas.
Mix well and put in greased 8 x 8-inch or 5 x 7-inch pan.
Sprinkle lightly with cornflake crumbs and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Lime Punch
steps: Dissolve 4 cups of hot water, 2 pkg. of lime gelatin and 1 cup of sugar and let stand.

recipes.title: Garden Salad
ingredients: 1 can white Shoe Peg corn, drained
steps: Mix together and marinate overnight.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn And Oyster Casserole
steps: Combine all ingredients and pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle over top a mixture of 1/2 cup cracker crumbs and 2 tablespoons oleo. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Shish Kabob Marinade
ingredients: 1/2 c. Burgundy (relax, the alcohol cooks out!)
steps: Marinate meat, cut in cubes for skewers, and fresh mushrooms several hours, turning occasionally.
Suggestions for Shish Kabobs:
canned pearl onions, canned new potatoes, pineapple chunks, bell pepper and cherry tomatoes.
Put meat on skewer first, then desired ingredients alternately.
Cook on grill until meat is done.

recipes.title: Hamburg-Sausage Spread
steps: Brown Sausage and Hamburg.
Drain Fat.
Mix and add seasonings and velveeta.
Stir till cheese melts.
Spread on rye bread.
Put mozzarella on top.
Bake 10 minutes at 350.
Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cups
steps: Melt butter and peanut butter together.
Add other ingredients.
Melt chocolate chips.
Fill 1/3 small muffin tin; cover with melted chocolate.

recipes.title: Onion-Cheese Supper Bread
steps: Cook onion in small amount of fat until tender but not brown. Combine egg and milk, add to biscuit mix, stir only until mix is just moistened.
Add onion, 1/2 the cheese and parsley.
Spread into a greased 8 x 1 1/2-inch round cake pan.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese, drizzle melted butter over top.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
steps: Blend and chill at least 1 hour.
Serve with raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Chili Con Queso Dip (With Meat)
ingredients: l can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Melt cheese in double boiler or microwave.
When melted add tomatoes and soup.
Saute onions, garlic, and bell pepper.
Add ground meat and sausage and brown.
Drain well.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
steps: Combine cornstarch, salt, brown sugar, vinegar and pineapple juice; cook until thick.
Add chicken, green pepper, pineapple chunks and onion.
Simmer for 1 hour.
Serve over hot rice.

recipes.title: Zucchini Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 c. grated Romano or Parmesan cheese
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease oblong pan (13 x 9-inch).
Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Pour into pan.
Spread evenly.
Bake until golden brown, about 25 minutes.
Cut into 2 x 1-inch pieces. Serve warm.
This makes a good vegetable dish served with meat, also good cold.

recipes.title: Forfar Bridies(Scottish Meat Pies)
ingredients: 1 lb. ground round steak or ground round beef
salt, pepper and sage to taste
Crisco or butter (to brown the beef and onion)
steps: Place butter in a skillet to melt.
Add ground beef and onion. Brown until done.
Add seasoning and water to make gravy by adding a little flour or a white sauce with cornstarch.
Make pastry shells and cut into oval shape.
Cover with the meat mixture.
Wet edges of pastry and fold over to make an envelope and crimp edges of pastry with fingers.
Make a slit in top of each bridie.
Bake at 400° for about 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly brown.

recipes.title: Eggless Sweet Potato Pie
steps: Cream the butter and sugar in mixer bowl until light and fluffy.
Add milk and sweet potatoes alternately, beating well after each addition.
Beat in orange rind and ginger.
Pour into pie shell. Bake at 300° for 45 minutes or until filling is set and pie is golden brown.
Serve warm with whipped cream.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Lemon Sesame Scallops
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. clam juice or chicken broth
steps: Combine yellow pepper and carrot in 10-inch microwaveproof pie plate; sprinkle with water and a pinch each of salt and pepper. Cover and microwave on High 1 1/2 minutes.
Stir in snow peas. Microwave, covered, 30 seconds more.
Let stand, covered, 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy, Cheesy Green Bean Pasta
ingredients: 1 c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese or Swiss cheese
steps: Drain green beans, reserving 1/2 cup liquid.
Combine green beans and reserved liquid with remaining ingredients; heat through.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Parsley Chicken Balls
steps: Mix ingredients; shape into balls. Roll in parsley and finely chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Sole And Crab Cardinale
steps: Poach the sole in white wine until white.
Top with crabmeat and your own white sauce.
Add a slice of Swiss cheese and bake to a golden brown.

recipes.title: Easy Green Bean Casserole(Microwave)
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) pkg. frozen cut green beans
1 (7 1/2 oz.) can semi-condensed cream of mushroom soup
steps: In a 1-quart casserole, cook green beans according to the package microwave directions.
Drain beans.
In the 1-quart casserole, stir together mushroom soup, sour cream and pimiento. Stir in beans.
Cook, uncovered, on 100% power (High) for 4 to 6 minutes or until bubbly, stirring twice.
Sprinkle French fried onions atop.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 head broccoli or 3/4 bag frozen broccoli
8 oz. pkg. Pepperidge Farm seasoned stuffing mix
steps: Cook broccoli and onion until done.
Drain and add cream of chicken soup and sour cream and mix.
Melt margarine and mix in bag of Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix.
Line casserole dish with 3/4 of stuffing mixture and then add vegetable mixture.
Top with the remaining stuffing mixture and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Casserole
steps: Cook and drain noodles.
Cook and drain sausage.
Place noodles in a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Pour sausage over noodles.
Add green chilies, mushroom soup, evaporated milk and cheese soup. Cover with shredded cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Veggie Bars - Squares - Pizza
steps: Buy 1/2 gallon of dill pickles; drain off juice.
Boil 3 cups sugar and 1 cup water.
(While this is boiling, slice pickles in chunks the way you like to serve them.)
After slicing, put back in jar and pour hot liquid over them.
In one week, ready to serve.

recipes.title: Curried Cream Of Broccoli Soup
steps: In large saucepan melt butter or margarine; saute onion and garlic.
Add curry powder, pepper, chicken broth and water and bring soup to a boil.
Add broccoli, cut into flowerets, stems cut into 1/2 inch slices and potatoes cut into 1/2 inch cubes.
When mixture returns to a boil, reduce heat, cover pan and simmer soup for about 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
You can puree soup in batches in blender or food processor or you can leave whole.
Stir in 1 cup milk and cook over low heat until hot.
Do not boil.

recipes.title: Dulaney'S Favorite Casserole(Squash Casserole)
steps: Slice squash (do not peel).
Add chopped onions and boil in saltwater until tender.
Drain.
In casserole dish, combine cream of chicken soup, sour cream, water chestnuts and shredded cheese. Mix Stove Top stuffing with 1 stick of butter and add 1/2 to the mixture.
Mix in squash and onions.
Top with remaining Stove Top stuffing mix.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Coconut Cranberry Bars
steps: Combine cracker crumbs and butter.
Press into 9 x 13 greased pan.
In bowl, combine remaining ingredients; mix well.
Spread over crust.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until edges are golden brown.
Cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Fanny Farmers Fudge
steps: Bring sugar and milk to a boil, stirring constantly.
Keep at a hard rolling boil for 10 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and add margarine.
Let melt and beat by hand for 2 minutes.
Add chocolate chips and vanilla.
Beat 10 to 15 minutes with mixer.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cut into squares when cool.

recipes.title: Crunchy Cranberry Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Let cool.
Add other ingredients.
Put into mold that has been sprayed with cooking spray.
Unmold onto lettuce.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Percolator Punch
steps: Combine juices in percolator.
Place spices and sugar in percolator basket.
Allow to go through perk cycle.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Bul Koo Kee
ingredients: 1 tsp. chopped garlic or garlic powder
steps: Slice beef in thin bite size strips.
Mix beef with all ingredients.
Use hands to mix well.
Put mixed beef into hot greased frypan using 1 tablespoon oil to grease.
Fry quickly until brown and tender.
Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Let set for 3 to 4 hours in refrigerator.
Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Chicken Roll
ingredients: 12 oz. cooked chicken breast (4) chopped very fine
steps: Combine ginger, almonds, shallots, curry powder, salt and pepper, lemon juice, softened butter, cream cheese, and chicken. Toast in heavy skillet over medium heat 3/4 c. sesame seed, 1 tbsp. sugar.
Cool.
Shape chicken mix into 4 rolls.
Cut wax paper, spread 2 tbsp. seed on paper and roll the rolls in it.
Bring to room temperature to serve with sesame crackers.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
steps: Wash and dry chicken thoroughly and rub with pepper.
Puncture 2 lemons 20 times each and place inside chicken.
Skewer and tie legs loosely.
Place breast side down in preheated 350° oven for 20 minutes.
Turn breast side up and cook for another 20 minutes. Raise temperature to 400° and cook for another 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugared Pecans
steps: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
Melt butter in 13 X 9 X 2 glass baking pan.
Beat egg whites, at room temperature, until soft peaks form.
Gradually add sugar and salt beating until very stiff.
Fold in pecans.
Spread mixture into melted butter.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes, stirring at 10 minute intervals, until butter is absorbed and coating is browned on nuts.
Remove and spread on wax paper to cool.
Store on air tight container.
Yield 3 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Fiesta Guacamole Dip
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can chopped green chilies (not drained)
1 c. shredded Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese
steps: In a small bowl, combine refried beans and chilies.
Spread on large serving plate.
Combine sour cream and taco seasoning. Spoon over bean mixture evenly.
In a small bowl mash avocados; stir in lime or lemon juice and salts.
Spoon evenly over sour cream.
Cover and chill several hours.
Just before serving, garnish with last 4 ingredients.
Serve with tortilla chips. Serves 15.

recipes.title: Dad'S Casserole
steps: Saute onion in butter; add ground beef and cook until done. Add the cottage cheese.
In buttered casserole, alternate layers of noodles and meat mixture.
Mix mushroom soup and milk and pour over all.
Top with Cheddar cheese and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Trifle
ingredients: 2 containers Cool Whip or 1 qt. whipped heavy cream
6 to 10 oz. liquor (rum or sweet liquor)
cinnamon or chocolate sprinkles to garnish
steps: *Can substitute angel food cake.

recipes.title: Almond Cream Frosting
steps: Cream butter; blend in powdered sugar. Add cream cheese and almond flavoring. Fold in finely chopped almonds.

recipes.title: "Yum-Yum" Dum-Dum Cake
steps: Make cake as directed on box and bake for 20 to 25 minutes in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Prepare the cream cheese with milk and slowly cream together well.
Add pudding and crushed pineapple.
Spread mixture over cooled, baked Jiffy cake.
Top off with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with sliced nuts (almonds and walnuts).
Chill for 12 hours.

recipes.title: Calamity'S Classic
steps: Make reservations and Enjoy!

recipes.title: Curry Bratwurst
steps: Coat skillet with melted butter (or Pam).
Place bratwurst (sliced) into skillet and fry on all sides.
Meanwhile, peel and dice onion and peel, quarter and core apple, then dice into bite sized pieces.
Add to bratwurst shortly before sausages have finished frying until onion/apple mixture is almost tender.
Then add ketchup and take from skillet.
Once it's been arranged on the plates, season to taste with paprika and curry.
Serve with rolls. Frying time:
approximately 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Flake Cookies
steps: Beat egg whites until stiff.
Gradually beat in the rest of the ingredients.
Bake on greased cookie sheet for 10 minutes at 400°.
You may also add peanut butter.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, cooked and drained
steps: Mix well.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Asian Turkey Or Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. turkey tenderloins or chicken breast halves
steps: Mix all ingredients, except meat and salsa, in shallow glass or plastic dish.
Add meat; turn to coat with marinade.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, but no longer than 4 hours, turning once.

recipes.title: Crunchy Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 large bag frozen peas (just thaw, don't cook)
1 c. prepared Original Hidden Valley dressing
steps: Mix sour cream and Hidden Valley dressing.

recipes.title: Heath Bar Cake
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand condensed milk (not evaporated)
1 small jar caramel sauce (ice cream topping)
steps: Cook cake according to directions on box.
While warm, punch holes in cake and pour 1 can condensed milk and 1 small jar caramel sauce over it.
When cool, ice with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle Heath bars over top.
Chill.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Simmer first 4 ingredients uncovered for 30 minutes.
Peel, wash and slice eggplant 3/8-inch thick.
Brush slices with oil using a pastry brush.
Fry over medium heat using a Teflon pan until soft, turning once.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients together. Chill 24 hours for best flavor. Serve with rye bread and/or raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Alabama Cornbread
steps: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Light And Fluffy Milnot Cheesecake
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and chill until slightly thickened.
Cream together cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and then add gelatin and blend well.
Stiffly whip Milnot and then fold into other mixture, then pour into pan, then sprinkle the top with remaining graham cracker crumbs.

recipes.title: Cheese Queso Dip
steps: Brown sausage.
Mix all ingredients and let simmer in crock pot until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Creamy Corn
steps: Combine cream cheese, milk, butter and salt in small pan.
Cool over low heat until cheese is melted.
Stir in corn.
Cook until thoroughly heated.

recipes.title: Praline-Pumpkin Dessert
steps: Heat oven to 350 degrees.
Grease bottom and sides of 13 x 9 inch baking dish.
Beat pumpkin, milk, eggs, sugar and pumpkin pie spice in medium bowl with wire whisk until smooth.
Pour into pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix over pumpkin mixture.
Sprinkle with nuts. Pour melted butter evenly over top of dessert.
Bake 50-60 min. or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool slightly. To serve cut dessert into 4 rows by 3 rows.
Serve warm or chilled with dollop of whipped cream sprinkled with pumpkin pie spice. Store covered in refrigerator.
Yield:
12 servings.
High altitude (3500-6500 ft.) heat oven to 375 degrees and bake 55-65 min.

recipes.title: Buckeyes
steps: Melt butter and peanut butter together; mix in sugar.
Roll into balls.
Mix melted chips and wax in double boiler; dip balls into chocolate.
Let dry.
Repeat dip.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Diabetic - Coconut Macaroons
steps: Combine milk and sugar replacement in large bowl, stirring until sugar replacement dissolves.
Add coconut; stir until coconut is completely moistened.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets, 2 to 3 inches apart.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, or until tops are lightly browned.
Remove from pan immediately.
Yields 48 drops.

recipes.title: Cola Salad
steps: Drain juice from cherries and pineapple; heat.
Dissolve gelatins, let cool.

recipes.title: Dripless Popsicles
ingredients: 1 pkg. Kool-Aid (of the same flavor as jello)
steps: Dissolve jello in 1 cup of boiling water.
Add 2 cups of cold water, Kool-Aid and the sugar.
Freeze in popsicle mold.

recipes.title: Salmon Mousse
steps: Dissolve gelatin in water.
Drain.
Take out bones and flake salmon.
Heat soup and cream cheese over low heat until cheese is dissolved.
Add softened gelatin and stir until well blended.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Place in well-greased fish mold and chill overnight in refrigerator.
Unmold on bed of endive or lettuce.
Serve with toast or crackers.
Garnish with lemon.

recipes.title: Spinach Quiche
steps: Cover the bottom of the crust with Swiss cheese.
Put on spinach, mushrooms and ham.
Stir the eggs with the cream; pour over the ham, mushrooms and spinach.
Sprinkle paprika; dot with butter.
Cook for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 large box vanilla instant pudding, mixed
steps: Bake cake according to directions in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Break 1/2 of cake into bite-size pieces and put in punch bowl. Mix pudding according to directions.
Spread 1/2 of pudding over cake pieces.
Spoon 1/2 of pineapple with juice on top
of pudding.
Spread 1 can of pie filling on top of that.
Spread 1/2 of Cool Whip over pie filling.
Add 1/2 of nuts.
Repeat, using the rest of the ingredients.
Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Lime Delight
steps: In a saucepan, bring pineapple to boil over medium heat. Remove from heat; stir in gelatin until dissolved.
Chill until slightly thickened, about 30 minutes.
Stir in cottage cheese and whipped topping.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Debbie'S Salad Dressing
steps: Blend ingredients in blender.
While blender is on, unscrew and pour in salad oil.

recipes.title: Colossal Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In a huge bowl or cook pot, beat together margarine and sugars.
Blend in eggs and vanilla.
Add peanut butter; mix well.
Stir in oatmeal, chocolate chips and baking soda, mixing well.
Drop by 1/4 cupful on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork to 2 1/2-inch diameter.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool 1 minute before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
steps: Place bread cubes in large aluminum bowl.
Add chicken, onion, celery, cheese, almonds and pepper.
Toss well.
Add lemon juice and mayonnaise and mix thoroughly.
Empty into greased casserole dish and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Good luncheon specialty.
Yields 6 to 9 servings.

recipes.title: Black Raspberry Jello Dessert Salad
steps: In 1 bowl, mix raspberry jello and hot water.
In another bowl mix cream cheese and sugar; cream together.
In another bowl, put graham crackers, melted butter and a little sugar.
In another bowl, beat milk until stiff peaks form.
Mix jello and cream cheese mixtures.
Fold in pineapple and nuts, then fold in whipped milk. Put most of graham cracker mix on bottom of pan.
Top with filling. Sprinkle rest of graham cracker crumbs on top.
Chill.

recipes.title: Irish Creme
steps: Blend all ingredients.
Store in dark bottle in refrigerator at least overnight before drinking.
Makes approximately 1 quart.

recipes.title: Crab Salad
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can crab meat, packed in water
steps: Cook and drain macaroni; drain shrimp and crab meat.
Combine ingredients and add enough Miracle Whip to have mixture hold together.
Add salt and pepper to taste and mix well.
Chill in refrigerator and enjoy when cooled.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Cheese Ball
steps: Cream all together. Roll in pecan pieces.

recipes.title: Custard Filipino Style
steps: In a saucepan, caramelize 1/2 cup sugar on a very low flame. Do not burn.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Kahlua Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow or white cake mix
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Combine all ingredients and pour into floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with chopped walnuts (optional). Bake for 45 to 50 minutes.
Sprinkle powdered sugar on cooled cake.

recipes.title: Tuna Loaf
ingredients: 2 (7 oz.) cans tuna, drained and flaked
10 to 12 slices white bread, torn in small bits
1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup
steps: Mix all ingredients together. Pack in lightly buttered loaf pan (a bread pan is a good size).
Bake in 350° oven about one hour, until the top is lightly browned.
Unmold and serve with Quick Cream Sauce.

recipes.title: Noodle Casserole
steps: Cook noodles as directed on package.
Brown meat in butter and add seasonings and onions.
Drain.
Add tomato sauce, sour cream and cottage cheese.
In baking dish, arrange layers on noodles and meat mixture.
Begin and end with noodles.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Ala'More
steps: Brown ground beef until cooked; drain.
Saute onion and green pepper in a little oil; drain.
Mix together with soup, water and 1/2 cup cheese and blend into cooked spaghetti.
Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup grated Cheddar.
Bake in 350°
oven for 30 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Mix meats thoroughly with bread which has been soaked in water or milk.
Add seasonings and beaten eggs.
Pack into a well-greased loaf pan.
Spread with the catsup or chili sauce and bake in a moderate oven, 375°, for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Grind cranberries and orange; add sugar and let stand. Dissolve jello in water.
Chill until partially set.
Add to cranberry mixture; add nuts, marshmallows, apples and pineapple. Pour into mold.
Chill until firm or overnight.

recipes.title: Gumbo File
ingredients: 1/2 lb. ham, cooked and cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Put chicken into heavy saucepot.
Add next 6 ingredients; cover and bring to boil.
Remove foam.
Simmer, covered 1 1/2 to 2 hours until chicken is tender.
Remove chicken from broth.
Strain broth and cool slightly.
Remove fat from surface; remove skin from chicken and meat from bones.
Dice chicken and set aside.

recipes.title: Steak Diane
steps: Slice the filet into thin strips, making sure to cut against the grain of the meat.
Lay the sliced meat out flat.
Cut the lemon in half and set one half aside.
Squeeze the other half over the meat and pat so that all pieces are damp with lemon juice. Sprinkle the granulated garlic and the pepper evenly on the meat. Set meat aside for 10 minutes.
Cut remaining lemon half into thin slices.
Bring remaining ingredients to a simmer over high heat in a large saucepan.
Add lemon slices, meat and optional ingredients (except toast).
Saute for 3 to 5 minutes or until meat is done to your liking.
Arrange the meat on toast slices and pour sauce over the top.
Serve with a baked potato.

recipes.title: Quick Cheese Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease loaf pan by spraying with no-stick spray.
Empty Bix-Mix into large bowl.
Stir in water and beat with wooden spoon until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients, except 1/2 cup cheese and butter.
Mix thoroughly.
Pour into pan. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and dot with butter.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes.
Remove from pan and cool on rack before slicing.

recipes.title: Mango Papaya Smoothies
ingredients: 1 mango (about 1 1/2 lb.), peeled, pitted and chopped coarse
1 papaya, peeled, seeded and chopped coarse
2 Tbsp. fresh lime juice plus 4 lime slices for garnish
steps: In a blender, blend the mango, the papaya, the yoghurt, the lime juice, the honey, the almond extract and 1 cup ice in batches until the mixture is smooth.
Blend in an additional 1/2 cup ice if desired to thin the smoothie mixture to desired consistency. Divide the mixture between 4 large chilled glasses and decorate each with a lime slice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix brownie mix with egg and water.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cool.
Mix pudding with 2 cups milk, then fold in 8 ounces of Cool Whip.
Top with the rest of Cool Whip and break Heath bars up.
Top off with the candy.

recipes.title: Basic Tomato Sauce
steps: Heat oil and fry onion and garlic until transparent.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, water, sugar and spices.
Bring to boil, then lower temperature and simmer for 2 hours.
You can also add meat balls or fried Italian sausage to your sauce before simmering.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Dip
steps: Cream all ingredients together.
Use as a dip for sliced apples.
Can also be used to dip celery or crackers.

recipes.title: Brandied Mocha
steps: Heat uncovered in microwave oven until hot, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir.
Pour into cups and top with whipped cream.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Cup
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple with liquid
1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate
3 medium bananas, sliced on the diagonal
steps: Combine all ingredients in plastic container.
Freeze until solid.
Take out of freezer at least 1/2 hour before serving. Return any unused portion to freezer.
It can be kept for at least 2 weeks.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken-Vegetable Pie
steps: Mix chicken, zucchini, tomato, onion and cheese.
Spoon evenly into pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients 15 seconds in blender on high speed, 1 minute with wire whisk or hand beater or until smooth.
Pour evenly over chicken mixture. Bake about 35 minutes at 400° or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Garnish with tomato and zucchini slices, if desired.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Icebox Lemonade Pie
steps: In bowl, put condensed milk and lemonade; beat until thickened and fluffy.
Add Cool Whip and mix thoroughly.
Put in graham cracker crust and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Christmas Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients except ginger ale.
Just before serving, add ginger ale.
Serves 30 to 40.

recipes.title: Mae Johnson Pickles
steps: Wash and slice cucumbers thin; pack in jar.
Make liquid of the remaining ingredients; pour over cucumbers cold and seal.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Cook and drain green beans (do not overcook).
In a 1-quart casserole, blend soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper until smooth. Stir in beans and 1/2 can onions.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until hot.
Top with remaining onions.
Bake 5 minutes longer. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Romaine-Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. loose-pack frozen broccoli, red peppers, bamboo shoots and straw mushrooms
steps: Dressing:
Mix vinegar, oil, soy sauce and five-spice powder in a custard cup or small bowl; set aside.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. melted butter or margarine, divided
1/2 tsp. California Style blend garlic salt
1 1/2 c. Progresso Italian-style bread crumbs, divided
steps: Pour milk over 1 cup bread crumbs; set aside for a few minutes.
Combine cooked squash, onion, 1 tablespoon melted butter or margarine, eggs, garlic salt and pepper; blend well.
Add bread crumbs mixture; stir to blend.
Spoon into a 1-quart casserole that has been sprayed with a nonstick cooking spray.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together and pour into 8 to 9-inch unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Minted Pineapple
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. Jell-O lime or lemon gelatin
1 (1 lb. 4 1/2 oz.) can crushed pineapple or pineapple tidbits
steps: Dissolve Jell-O gelatin and salt in boiling water.
Stir in remaining ingredients, saving can to use as mold.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Pour into the can and one individual mold or a serving bowl.
Chill until firm.
Unmold.
(To unmold from can, puncture bottom before dipping in warm water.)
Makes 3 1/4 cups, 6 side salads or 10 relish servings.

recipes.title: Honey Bear'S Hot Chocolate
steps: Combine chocolate and water in a large saucepan.
Stir over low heat until chocolate melts.
Add sugar and salt.
Simmer 4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add milk; stir and heat; do not boil.
Pour into mugs.
Top with whipped cream and dash of nutmeg. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Dip
steps: Keeps 2 weeks.
Make 1 day ahead.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 1 pkg. dry Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
steps: *Use any of the following: broccoli, cauliflower, celery, carrots, green onions, green pepper, red bell pepper, fresh mushrooms.

recipes.title: Natural Candy Recipe(Diabetic)
steps: Mix together peanut butter, carob, bananas and vanilla.
Shape into balls (one teaspoon each) and roll in cinnamon.
Press walnut half into each candy.
Store in refrigerator.
Yields 64 pieces.

recipes.title: That Bean Dip Stuff
steps: Layer in pan or bowl, starting with the bean dip, being sure that the entire bottom is covered with dip.
Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Herb Butter
ingredients: 1 t. each of minced dried marjoram, thyme, and rosemary leaves
1/4 t. each of garlic powder, dried basil and sage
steps: Beat all together at high speed in a small mixing bowl until fluffy.
Keep in tightly covered container in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Tamale Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1 large can tamales, peeled and sliced or 1 doz. fresh tamales, peeled and sliced
steps: Dump all ingredients together in a large stew pan. Cover and simmer to taste.

recipes.title: Country Breakfast Casserole(Great For Company)
ingredients: 1 lb. pork sausage, cooked, crumbled and drained
steps: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan well.
Place bread in pan.
Sprinkle with cheeses.
Combine rest of ingredients together and mix well. Pour over bread and refrigerate overnight.
Bake 1 hour at 350° or until golden brown.
Serves 6 to 8 people.

recipes.title: Microwave Divinity
steps: Combine sugar, corn syrup and water in a 2-quart glass bowl. Microwave on High for 12 to 15 minutes or to 260° on a candy thermometer.

recipes.title: French Meat Pie
steps: In a skillet, heat oil over medium heat.
Saute onions until tender.
Remove and set aside.
Brown beef and pork together. Drain.
Combine onion, meat, potato and seasonings.
Line pie plate with pastry.
Fill with meat mixture.
Top with crust.
Seal and flute edges.
Make slits on top crust.
Brush with egg, if desired.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Bon appetit.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Grilled Parm Potato Salad
steps: Combine ingredients; mix lightly.
Wrap securely in heavy-duty foil.
Grill over medium coals 50 minutes or until potatoes are tender, turning occasionally.

recipes.title: Southwest Beef Rolls
ingredients: 4 oz. can green chilies, drained, rinsed and chopped
steps: Moisten stuffing with 3 tablespoons hot water.
Spread stuffing onto top of each steak.
Roll up; fasten each with toothpick.
Brown in nonstick skillet over medium heat about 6 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients and 1/4 cup water.
Bring to boil.
Lower heat; simmer 20 to 30 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Country Stew
ingredients: 2 lb. stew meat, cut into 1/2 to 3/4-inch pieces
2 c. peeled and sliced carrots, 1/2 long
steps: Mix ingredients together in 13 x 9-inch cake pan.
Bake at 250° for 5 hours, covered with foil.
No peeking while cooking.

recipes.title: Hamburger Pie
steps: Brown hamburger and drain. Add chopped onion and green pepper. Simmer 15 minutes and drain again.
Add tomato sauce and garlic salt. Simmer 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken With Sweet Sour Sauce
steps: Skin chicken.
Season chicken with garlic salt.
Let stand 2 hours.
Dredge chicken in cornstarch.
Dip in beaten egg.
Chill for 1/2 hour so coating will adhere.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Simmer to brown.
Pour sauce over chicken.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Punch
steps: Mix ingredients together and serve in a large punch bowl.
Add ice.
Serves 30 people.

recipes.title: Brownie Sundaes With Honey Berry Sauce
ingredients: 2 c. fresh or frozen raspberries, blackberries or strawberries, thawed
1 pt. low-fat vanilla frozen yogurt or ice cream
steps: In small bowl, combine honey, lemon juice and peel; mix well. Gently mix in berries.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Cut biscuits into fourths with scissors.
Mix cinnamon and sugar in plastic bag.
Toss cut up biscuits in bag until well coated.
Layer biscuits in well-greased Bundt pan, sprinkling chopped pecans and coconut in between layers.
Melt brown sugar and butter together; boil 1 minute.
Pour over contents of Bundt pan.
Bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Mexican Salad
steps: Chop lettuce, tomato, onion and pepper.
Mix in chips and Ranch Style beans.
Top with cheese and dressing.
Chill 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pasta And Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 (15 oz.) cans cannellini beans (or 3 c. white kidney beans)
steps: In 3 quart sauce pan combine tomatoes, snappy tomatoes, beef stock, lemon juice, garlic, onion, cumin, tobasco sauce and basil. Simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in beans and green pepper.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Add cooked macaroni and heat through.
Note:
1 cup = 98 calories, 1 gram fat and 18 grams carbohydrates.

recipes.title: Garlic Bread
steps: Combine
liquid ingredients.
Spread on bread.	Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecued Meat Loaf
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl.
Add 1/2 can of tomato sauce; mix well.
Place mixture in a baking dish and shape into a loaf.
Combine remaining ingredients and tomato sauce in a small bowl and pour over loaf.
Bake at 350° for one hour and 15 minutes or until done.
Baste often!

recipes.title: Berry Delicious Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Spray Pam on baking dish. Place chicken in a single layer in dish.

recipes.title: Quick Skillet Supper
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) can French fried onion rings, divided
steps: Cook ground beef in a large skillet until browned, stirring to crumble.
Drain off pan drippings.
Stir in next 3 ingredients and bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until macaroni is tender.
Stir in sour cream and 1/2 can onion rings. Cook just until thoroughly heated.
Sprinkle with remaining onion rings.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
steps: In a large bowl, mix first five ingredients together well. Salt and pepper to taste.
Place in a 9 x 12-inch pan.
Melt stick of margarine and drizzle over top.
Cover with crumbled corn flakes.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Cream all ingredients together.
Pour into graham cracker crust and refrigerate at least 6 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Beef Burgundy
steps: Mix all ingredients well, then add stewing meat.
Bake in oven at 350° for 3 to 4 hours until meat is tender.
Cover while baking.
Add water, if necessary.
Serve over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Cheese Cornbread
steps: Put one half of mixture in greased pan.
Add half of cheese. Add remaining mixture and cheese on top.
Bake at 350° about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate
steps: Stir together cocoa, sugar, salt and hot water.
Bring to a slow boil, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add evaporated milk and water.
Serve with whipped cream or marshmallows.

recipes.title: Chicken Florentine Fettuccine
ingredients: 2 (9 1/2 oz.) pkg. frozen spinach, thawed and drained
1 (12 oz.) pkg. white and green fettuccine noodles
steps: Saute butter, mushrooms, onions and garlic powder until tender; set aside.
In a medium saucepan, mix soup, cream cheese, Cheddar cheese and cayenne pepper.
Heat on medium-low heat until creamy.
Cook fettuccine as directed and drain.
In a large bowl or pan, toss chicken, spinach, soup and cheese mixture, mushrooms, onions and fettuccine until well mixed.
Spoon into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
(You may need to use an 8 x 8-inch pan, also.) Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Russian Tea
steps: Boil spices together in 3 cups water for 3 minutes.
Strain and set aside.
Bring 1/2 gallon of water to a boil.
Add juices, lemon and spice water.
Sweeten to taste.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Tomato Pudding
steps: Bring puree, juice and sugar to a boil.
Simmer 10 minutes. Trim crusts from bread; cut bread into 1-inch squares.
Melt butter, then dip squares quickly into butter and place in baking dish.
Pour tomato mixture over squares.
Do not stir.
Push down lightly with fork until just coated.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Peaches - Fresh To Frozen
ingredients: 12 oz. can frozen orange juice concentrate
steps: Add peaches to sugar and juice; let stand 1 hour. Pack in containers and freeze.

recipes.title: S'Mores Bars
steps: Make brownie mix as directed on package.
When it is all done cooking, shut off oven and close door so it stays warm.
Sprinkle the mini marshmallows over the top of brownie mix and the cups of morsels, also.
Set in warm oven for about 3 minutes; take out of oven.
Take graham crackers in whole pieces and press on top of mixture.
Let cool and cut in squares.

recipes.title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 regular size bottle Wish-Bone Italian dressing
steps: Pour dressing over vegetables.
Let marinate overnight.
Add cherry tomatoes before serving (optional).

recipes.title: Hungry Man'S Dish
steps: Brown beef and pour off fat.
Add sugar, salt and tomato sauce.
Cook and simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook noodles and drain water.
Blend onions with sour cream and cream cheese.

recipes.title: Mint Tea
steps: Boil 2 quarts water.
Pour over tea bags and steep.
Remove tea bags and stir in sugar.
Stir in lemonade and limeade.	Add cold water to make 1 gallon.
Add mint when steeping.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
steps: Mix together and shape into balls. Cook until golden brown.

recipes.title: Turgetti
steps: Boil
spaghetti
and
drain.
Add
turkey and all other ingredients.
Put grated cheese on top and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Mary'S Sugar Cookies
steps: Mix sugar and butter.
Add flavorings and mix thoroughly. Stir in dry ingredients together and blend.
Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours (the longer, the better). Roll dough to 1/6-inch.
Cut on lightly floured pastry cloth.
Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes until golden brown.
Makes 2 to 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Mushrooms And Onions
steps: Slice mushrooms to make 2 cups.
Dice onion in small pieces. Place in skillet of melted butter.
Heat to boiling point; add water.
Turn heat to simmer for 35 minutes, stirring frequently. This is always an attractive and tasty addition to a roast, steak, pork chops, etc.

recipes.title: Avocado Ranch Soup
ingredients: 1 (1 oz.) pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch milk recipe original Ranch salad dressing mix
1 large ripe avocado, cut into chunks
steps: In blender, combine milk, yogurt, mayonnaise, chicken broth, salad dressing mix and avocado chunks.
Puree until smooth.
Pour mixture into large bowl.
Stir in tomato, cucumber and onion. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours.
Garnish each bowl with avocado slices before serving.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Flavorful Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. beef flavored bouillon granules
steps: Melt margarine in a large saucepan over low heat; add onion. Cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes or until onion is lightly browned, stirring occasionally.
Add water, bouillon granules and Worcestershire sauce, stirring well.
Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve hot.
Yields 4 servings at 3/4 cup each.
Calories:
Exchanges:
1 vegetable.

recipes.title: Baked Stuffed Quahogs(Ko-Hogs)
ingredients: 12 large cherrystone clams (quahogs) or 1 pt. chopped clams with juice
steps: Wash and rinse clams.
Steam in 1 inch boiling water 8 minutes or until all are open.
Remove meat; mince coarsely and set aside. Retain water and shells.
Make stuffing according to instructions, except substitute clam juice for water.
Add 1 tablespoon Durkee's hot sauce, dash of sage and 1 tablespoon sherry.
If using some bought clams and juice, add at this time.
Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Marinated Carrots
steps: Combine first 7 ingredients and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour over vegetables.
Serve hot or chilled.

recipes.title: Cucumbers In Sour Cream
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. minced chives or green onions
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Chill at least 30 minutes.
Best if prepared a day ahead.

recipes.title: Stromboli
steps: Roll out dough to a 10 x 14-inch rectangle. Beat egg and add Parmesan cheese. Brush dough with egg/cheese mixture, leaving 1-inch border.
Spread cold cuts in layers on dough. Sprinkle with Italian dressing. Fold short ends in and roll up dough, pinching ends sealed with water.
Place on greased cookie sheet and let rise 1/2 hour.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Brown ground beef and spread in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Layer beans over beef.
Top with tortillas and sprinkle with cheese.
Spread tomatoes over tortillas and pour soup over all.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake 1 hour.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Coconut Cream Pie
steps: On top of a double broiler over simmering water, beat the egg yolks and salt. Add the sugar, milk, and butter. As soon as the bottom pot boils, mix the cornstarch with a small amount of water. Add it to the egg yolk mixture a little at a time. Cook until thick, stirring constantly with a wire whisk.

recipes.title: Tamale Pie
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
steps: Cook meat, onions and green pepper in a skillet until meat is slightly browned and vegetables are tender.
Stir in remaining ingredients except cheese and simmer 30 minutes.
Add cheese. Stir until melted.
Pour into a large greased baking dish.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1/4 c. finely chopped bell pepper and onion
steps: Soften cheese and mix all ingredients well, except 1 cup pecans.
Place in refrigerator; let it chill.
Roll into ball and roll in 1 cup pecans.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Sweet And Easy Dessert
ingredients: 1 pkg. instant jello pudding (any preferred flavor)
steps: Add 1 1/2 tablespoons jam per graham tart mix instant jello pudding and pour over jam until level with top of tart crust. Place in refrigerator and chill until ready for after main meal.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
steps: Mix pretzel crumbs, margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar.
Pack in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350°, stirring twice.

recipes.title: Cherry Pineapple Dessert
ingredients: 12 oz. can crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan; pour in 1 can cherry pie filling.
Add crushed pineapple and juice.
Sprinkle on top 1 box cake mix.
Top with layer of chopped nuts and layer of coconut flakes.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Terrific 3 Bean Salad
steps: Rinse all beans.
Place in large glass bowl and add remaining ingredients.
Let sit covered in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies(Lunchroom Kind)
steps: Mix all ingredients except peanut butter and vanilla in boiler.
Bring to rolling boil for 3 minutes.
Remove from heat; add peanut butter and vanilla.
Spoon on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
steps: Cut cookie dough 1/4-inch thick and layer in pizza pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until light brown.
Mix together cream cheese and sugar. Spread on cooled cookie crust.
Next, add cherry pie filling, sliced bananas and drained fruit cocktail.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushroom Appetizer
ingredients: 3 lb. cheese (can vary, pick your favorites)
steps: Melt butter in a pan on stove and slightly brown mushroom tops after you've twisted and pulled out stems of whole mushrooms. Brown both sides.
Cube the cheeses and drop one into browned mushroom "cup".
Sprinkle with thyme and a dash of sage.
Heat in 350° preheated oven until cheese melts, about 5 minutes, on a cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can broccoli and cheese soup
1 c. crushed Ritz crackers (keep little to sprinkle on top)
steps: Mix together.
Pour into greased casserole dish.
Bake 45 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Baked French Toast
ingredients: 6 slices day-old bread, cut into halves diagonally
steps: Crush corn flakes to measure 1 cup crumbs.
Place in shallow dish or pan.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Jello Cranberry Salad
steps: Dissolve jello and cranberry sauce in hot water.
Add rest of ingredients, except whipped cream.
Chill until set.
Add whipped cream to chopped up jello.

recipes.title: Cold Crab Soup
ingredients: 2 c cucumber, peeled, seed and sliced
steps: Mix all ingredients and serve very cold.

recipes.title: Tomato Relish
steps: Chop vegetable ingredients fine and cook together for one hour. Add sugar, vinegar, and spices. Cook for 45 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Danish
steps: Layer 1 can of crescent rolls in bottom of lightly greased sheet cake pan. Mix 2 packages of cream cheese, 1 cup sugar, vanilla, and egg yolk together; spread on top of crescent rolls. Layer the second can of crescent rolls on top of cream cheese mixture. Beat egg white with fork and brush over crescent rolls. Sprinkle 1/4 cup sugar on top. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: 2 Minute Microwave Fudge
steps: Stir sugar, cocoa, salt, milk and vanilla together in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Put butter over top in center of dish. Place in microwave for 2 minutes.
Stir vigorously until smooth. Blend in nuts.
Pour in butter dish or pan.
Chill 1 hour in refrigerator or 20 to 30 minutes in freezer.
Cut into squares and serve.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken
steps: Marinate the chicken in spices at least 8 hours.
Broil on grill, brushing with extra sauce.

recipes.title: Braunschweiger Cheese Ball
steps: Let all soften to room temperature.
With mixer, mix all but cheese and mayonnaise until free of lumps.
Chill a few hours. When firm, form into 4 balls.
Chill again.
Mix cheese and mayonnaise so it is like an icing; spread on meat balls.
Chill until ready to serve.
Serve on crackers.

recipes.title: Chicken Stuffing Casserole
ingredients: 1 box prepared stuffing mix for chicken
steps: Combine all ingredients and bake at 300° for 30 minutes. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Italian Zucchini Crescent Quiche
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
In large skillet, cook zucchini and onion in margarine (about 10 minutes).
Add parsley and seasonings.
In large bowl, blend eggs and cheese.
Stir in zucchini mixture. Press dough over bottom and sides of cookie sheet.
Spread with mustard.
Pour vegetable mixture over crust.
Bake 20 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Hot Dish
steps: Fry hamburger and onions; drain. Mix in soup. Put in shallow baking dish. Top with cheese, beans and Tater Tots, in that order. Bake at 400° for about 1/2 hour or until the Tater Tots are hot in the middle.

recipes.title: Apple Cider Salad
steps: Soften gelatin in cold water.
Combine liquid artificial sweetener, apple juice, lemon juice and salt.
Heat and add gelatin mixture, stirring until gelatin dissolves.
Cool until mixture begins to thicken.
Fold in applesauce.
Chill until set in individual molds.
Yield:
4 servings.
Protein 2 g, fat 0 g, carbohydrate 12 g, calories 56.
One serving = 1 fruit exchange.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut in strips
1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite size pieces
steps: Heat oil in nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Toss chicken with lemon and pepper seasoning and garlic powder to evenly coat.
Add to skillet and cook 4 to 5 minutes or until thoroughly cooked, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Do not drain off fat.
In a small bowl, combine vinegar, mustard and Worcestershire sauce with a whisk.
Stir into chicken mixture.
In a large bowl, toss lettuce with chicken mixture, croutons and cheese. Top with fresh grated Parmesan cheese, if desired.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken soup
steps: Cook and debone chicken breasts.
Cut in chunks and mix with sour cream and soup.
Put in baking dish.
Crush the crackers and mix with the Poppy seeds.
Put cracker mixture on top of chicken mix in pan, and drizzle with butter.
Bake at 350° until thoroughly warm.

recipes.title: Sweet Gherkins
steps: First
Day:
Morning - Wash cucumbers thoroughly; scrub with vegetable
brush.
Stem
ends may be left on if desired. Drain cucumbers;	place
in
a large container and cover with boiling water.
Afternoon (6 to 8 hours later):
Drain; cover with fresh, boiling water.

recipes.title: Crab-Ease
ingredients: 1 (7 oz.) can crab meat, cartilage removed (imitation crab meat can be used - great!)
steps: Let butter and cheese spread soften to room temperature.
Mix together with mayonnaise, garlic salt and seasoned salt.
Add crab meat.

recipes.title: Tangier Island Corn Pudding
steps: Beat eggs; add milk and corn. In small dish, put cornstarch; add a little water. Stir until dissolved. Add cornstarch to eggs, milk and corn. Add salt and sugar; mix well. Dot with butter. Bake in dish at 350° for 30 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Danish
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Unroll 1 package of crescent rolls and spread into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan, sealing at seams.
In mixing bowl cream together cream cheese, sugar and flavorings, beating until smooth.
Spread cream cheese mixture over top of crescent rolls.
Unroll 2nd package of rolls and press together at seams.
Lay over top of cream cheese mixture.
Brush with beaten egg white.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Dilled Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 med. peeled red onion, thinly sliced
1 c. sour cream (may use fat free)
2 Tbsp. fresh dill or 2 tsp. dried dill
steps: Slice cucumber and onion.
In bowl add sour cream vinegar, sugar, dill, salt and pepper.
Toss cucumbers in sour cream mixture.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Anna'S Orange Jello Cake
steps: Mix cake mix, Jell-O, eggs, Crisco and water well and pour into a greased and floured tube or loaf pan and bake 45 minutes at 350°.
While cake is baking, mix together sugar, juice and hot water.
As soon as cake is removed from oven, punch full of holes with a large fork.
Then spoon the juice mixture all over top of cake and let stand until completely cool.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef with onion and salt and pepper.
Cook egg noodles and drain.
In a baking dish, first layer cooked ground beef, green beans and tomato soup.
Add cooked egg noodles.
Top with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cherry Yum Yum
steps: Mix crumbs and margarine; set aside. Mix whipped topping with milk and whip until stiff. Add sugar and cream cheese.
Layer crumbs in dish, then add 2 cans pie filling. Top with whipped topping mixture.

recipes.title: Marinated Sliced Tomato Salad
steps: Peel and slice 4 large tomatoes.
Arrange in a shallow dish. Combine salad oil, lemon juice, minced garlic salt and oregano. Pour over tomatoes.
Chill covered for 1 hour.
Must do ahead of time.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cheese Snack Bread
steps: Thaw and raise bread according to directions.
When risen, spread in a square 8-inch pan that has been greased.
Grate cheese.
Combine egg, onion, salt and milk.
Add cheese and spread over bread dough.
Sprinkle with caraway or poppy seed.
(I usually do half and half.)
Bake in a preheated oven at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Excellent served warm with soup.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad Dessert
steps: Grind cranberries and whole orange (not seeds).
Pour sugar over mixture and set overnight.
Mix Jell-O with hot water and jell until thick.
Add pineapple and juice with nuts to cranberry mixture, then add to Jell-O mixture.
Mix well and return to refrigerator to jell.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Drain beans.
Combine with soup, milk and 1/2 can crumbled onion rings.
Pour into greased casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes (or 10 minutes on Full power in microwave).
Garnish with remaining crumbled onion rings and bake 5 minutes longer in oven (or 2 minutes in microwave).
Use a 1 1/2-quart casserole.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Drain vegetables. Mix all ingredients, except margarine and crackers.
Pour into casserole dish.
Sprinkle crackers on top. Bake in a 350° oven about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pasta With Vegetable Sauce
ingredients: 3 slender Italian or Chinese eggplant, sliced and quartered
1/2 to 1 tsp. red pepper flakes (fresh or dried)
steps: Brown lightly, garlic, onion and eggplant.
Add Italian tomatoes, cut fine.
Cook for 10 minutes.
Cover and cook for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Medley(Serves 35)
steps: Heat oil and add vegetables that have been sliced. Cook 5 minutes, covered.
Stir in wine; simmer 10 minutes, uncovered. Add butter and stir gently.
Sprinkle cheese over vegetables and serve.

recipes.title: Zesty Pineapple Relish
ingredients: 1 tsp. minced fresh red chili pepper
steps: The heat of the chili is in the seeds and ribs.
Remove them before mincing (wear rubber gloves to do so).

recipes.title: Cooked Spaghetti
steps: Bring water to
a
boil.
Break
spaghetti
in half and drop in the boiling water.
Boil until tender; drain and rinse with cool water.
Add to the meat balls and tomato sauce for a delicious meat ball and spaghetti dinner.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
steps: Thaw hash browns.
Spread in an 8 1/2 x 9 1/2-inch pan.
Melt butter.
Mix butter, mushroom soup and sour cream.
Pour over potatoes.
Sprinkle grated cheese over top.
Bake at 350° until bubbly, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Honey Baked Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Arrange the fryer in a shallow baking dish with skin side up.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
Bake for 1 1/4 hours, basting every 15 minutes until chicken is tender and nicely browned.

recipes.title: Eggplant And Ampalaya Gulay
steps: Slice eggplants and ampalayas like finger size or lengthwise into 4 to 6 slices.
Place lemon grass in bottom of saucepan. Place ampalaya slices and eggplant on top and cook until desired doneness, crisp, tender or soft.
When done, add coconut milk, salt or patis (fish sauce).
Season as desired.

recipes.title: Pineapple Slaw
steps: Combine all ingredients; cover and chill.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Gingered Fruit Dip
ingredients: your choice fresh fruit (pineapple chunks, strawberries, orange sections, apple wedges, bananas, kiwi and grapes)
steps: Whip the first 4 ingredients together.
Serve in a bowl on a tray surrounded with fresh fruit and toothpicks.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Flan(Spanish)
steps: Combine sugar and 2 teaspoons water in heavy small skillet. Cook, stirring constantly, until caramelized and syrup. Immediately pour into warm 4-cup buttered mold.
Tilt to coat bottom and sides of container while sugar is still hot.
Beat eggs well.
Add milk, 1 cup water, cinnamon and lemon peel.
Mix well. Pour into prepared mold.
Place casserole in longer pan containing hot water to level of custard.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cool completely. Loosen custard with knife.
Put on serving platter and spoon caramel over top.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
Preparation time: 1 hour.

recipes.title: Beef Jerky
steps: Marinate for 1/2 hour.
Put on cookie sheet.
Place in oven for 4 to 6 hours at 140° to 150°.
Crack door slightly.

recipes.title: Cherry Topped Cheese Pie
steps: Beat together softened cream cheese and 1/2 cup sugar.
Blend in Cool Whip.
Pour into 9-inch graham cracker crust.
Top with canned cherry pie filling.
Chill 3 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Hot Wassail
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate
steps: Mix and simmer covered 20 minutes stirring occasionally. Yields:
15-18 servings.

recipes.title: Pinto Bean Pie
steps: Blend sugars, eggs and butter until creamy.
Add pinto beans and blend well.
Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes, then at 350° for an additional 25 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Green Pea Salad
steps: Mix ingredients, chill and serve.

recipes.title: Chow Chow
steps: Mix.
Boil at a hard boil for 30 minutes.
Put in jar and seal.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 (17 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in greased 2-quart casserole for 1 hour at 350°.
Good make ahead vegetable for holiday dinners.

recipes.title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: partially cooked broccoli (it will finish cooking in oven)
steps: Mix together soup, milk and real mayonnaise.
Place in bottom of greased 8-inch square pan, layer of chicken, layer of broccoli and pour soup mixture over all.
Cover with any type of bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, until bubbly.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Bundt Cake
steps: Put all ingredients into a bowl, except chocolate chips.
Mix well.
Then add chips.
Butter and flour tube or Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for approximately 50 minutes.
When cool, dust with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) carton small curd cottage cheese
steps: Mix Jell-O with pineapple, oranges, cherries and cottage cheese.
Mix thoroughly.
Add Cool Whip.
Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
steps: Mix sugar, cornstarch, water and Jell-O; boil until thick. Let cool and fold in berries.
Put in baked pie shell.
Top with whipped cream or whipped topping.

recipes.title: Chicken Sevilla
ingredients: 2 whole chicken breasts, halved or 1 whole chicken, cut into serving pieces
steps: Heat butter and oil in skillet.
Add chicken, skin side down, and cook for 10 minutes on medium-high.
Turn and cook 5 minutes. Add green pepper, tomato, oranges (separated into segments and cut in half).
Add to chicken; cover and cook over low heat for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Fruit Topping
steps: Beat cream cheese and marshmallow cream together.
Add enough pineapple juice to make the mixture a nice consistency.
Blend well.
Put in a bowl and serve over melon balls or fresh fruit assortment.

recipes.title: Kraut Wieners
steps: Heat oil, green pepper and onion.
Add remaining.
Cook 1 1/2 hours.
Stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Pickle Cucumber Or Zucchini
steps: Mix and bring first 6 ingredients to a boil.
Add cucumbers or zucchini.
Let boil 5 minutes.
Put onion in sterilized jar and seal.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
steps: In large bowl, combine corn syrup, eggs, sugar, butter and salt.
Beat until blended.
Beat in melted chocolate.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake on lower rack of preheated 375° oven, until filling is completely puffed across top and crusted over, 55 to 60 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Millionaire Pie
steps: Drain all fruits.
Mix together and put into 2 to 3 graham cracker crusts.
Chill for several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
ingredients: 1 c. chopped onion (add more or less according to taste)
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Lightly grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Cook and stir ground beef and onion until beef is brown; drain. Stir in salt and pepper.
Spread in pie plate; sprinkle with cheese.
Beat remaining ingredients until smooth.
Pour into pie plate.
Bake until golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean (about 30 minutes).
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Refrigerate any leftovers.

recipes.title: Powdered Sugar Icing
steps: Mix powdered sugar and vanilla.
Stir 1 tablespoon milk or juice 1 teaspoon at a time until of drizzling consistency.
Makes 1/2 cup or enough to drizzle over one 10-inch tube cake.

recipes.title: Twinkie Dessert
steps: Cut Twinkies lengthwise and place in bottom of 9 x 13 in. pan with the filling side up.
Mix together Cool Whip, cream cheese and condensed milk.
Spread this mixture over the top of the Twinkies.
Combine the sliced strawberries and strawberry glaze. Spoon the strawberry mixture on top of the Twinkies.
Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Oreo Cheesecake Squares
ingredients: whipped cream and strawberries for garnish
steps: Finely roll 25 cookies; coarsely chop 15 cookies.
In bowl, combine finely rolled cookies and butter.
Press crumb mixture on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan; set aside.

recipes.title: Italian Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 c. each, diced onion, sliced celery and sliced carrots
1 c. frozen or fresh green beans
steps: Brown ground round in large heavy kettle; drain if necessary. Add rest of ingredients except cabbage, green beans and macaroni. Bring to boil and simmer 20 minutes, covered.
Add rest and bring to boil, then simmer until all is tender.
If you like thinner soup, add more water.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
steps: Boil potatoes with the skins on.
When cool, peel and dice in small pieces.
Add salt, pepper and garlic salt.
Add onion (diced in small pieces) and diced bell pepper.
Mix this all together well.

recipes.title: Blueberry Salad
steps: Mix boiling water and jello, stir well.
Stir in pineapple and pie filling.
Pour into mold or 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Refrigerate until jelled.
Beat cream cheese until smooth, add sour cream, sugar and vanilla.
Mix well.
Cover top of gelatin.
Sprinkle nuts on top.

recipes.title: Ham Baked
steps: Wrap ham in heavy foil and place in deep pan.
Prior to closing foil, cover with mixture of Coke, sugar and mustard.
Bake at 325° for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Mom'S Meat Loaf
ingredients: enough crushed cornflakes to stiffen, 2-3 cups
steps: In a large bowl put all except meat and cornflakes.
Mix well.
Add meat and mix.
Add cornflakes and mix until loaf hold its shape. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Reduce to 350° for 45 minutes.
Put lid on when top is brown.

recipes.title: Sweet Nothingspuppy Chow
steps: Melt chocolate chips with oleo.
Combine melted mixture with peanut butter and cereal.

recipes.title: Ooee Goee Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix with pudding
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Spread into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan (greased).

recipes.title: Tody'S Dump Cake
steps: Spread pie filling and pineapple in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish prepared with nonstick vegetable spray.
Sprinkle cake mix evenly on fruit; do not mix.
Place margarine slices on cake mix. Bake at 350° for 48 to 53 minutes.

recipes.title: Crunchy Beef Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (3 oz.) can Durkee French fried onions
steps: Cook macaroni.
Brown ground beef.
Combine all ingredients, but onions.
Pour into greased 2-quart casserole.
Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or longer.
Uncover.
Top with onion rings and bake 5 minutes longer.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Taffy Apple Dip
steps: In a small bowl, beat cream cheese, brown sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Put mixture into small serving bowl; top with nuts. Serve with apple wedges.
Yield:
6 servings.

recipes.title: Apple-Phyllo Rolls
ingredients: 9 sheets commercial frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
steps: Coat a nonstick skillet with butter flavor vegetable cooking spray; place over medium heat until skillet is hot.
Add diced apple; saute 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often.
Add cinnamon, nutmeg and brown sugar to sauteed apple; stir well.
Cook apple mixture an additional 3 minutes.
Remove from heat; let apple mixture cool.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Roast Beef
ingredients: 1 pkg. (1 oz.) dry onion soup mix
steps: Pour the soy sauce and dry onion soup mix into the slow cooker. Mix well. Place chuck roast into slow cooker. Add water until the top 1/2 inch of the roast is not covered. Add freshly ground pepper over the top. Cover and cook on low for 22 hours.

recipes.title: El Dorado Casserole
ingredients: 1 small can Ortega chopped green chilies
steps: Brown, then drain the ground beef.
Add onion, garlic, salt, tomato sauce and olives.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
In separate bowl, blend cottage cheese, sour cream and chilies.
Crush chips.
Place 1/2 chips in buttered casserole.
Add 1/2 meat mixture.
Top with cheese.
Layer until all is gone, but be sure each layer is topped with cheese.
Layer the cottage cheese mixture in, too.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
steps: Mix ingredients in order given.
Store in refrigerator.
Will keep at least 1 week.

recipes.title: Six Vegetable Salad
steps: Put salt and enough water to cover first 4 items and let set for 4 hours.
Drain well.
Add the rest of the vegetables.

recipes.title: Spaghetti And Cheese
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until done.
Drain.
Add butter, milk and cheese over low heat; stir in until butter and cheese are melted.

recipes.title: Buckeyes
steps: Melt chocolate chips in double boiler and paraffin wax.
Roll the first 4 ingredients into balls.
With toothpick, dunk balls into chocolate mixture.

recipes.title: Witches Cream
steps: Bake apples and put through a sieve.
Mix the crushed pineapple with sugar and stir into apple puree.
Add rum and egg white.
Stir until smooth.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
steps: Cook meat until browned; drain.
Add beans, tomato sauce, chili powder and garlic salt.
Heat to boiling.
Place chips in an ungreased 2-quart baking dish.
Top with meat mixture.
Spread sour cream on top of meat mixture.
Top with cheese.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes, or until bubbly.
Serve with lettuce and taco sauce.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Congealed Salad
steps: Mix together jello, hot and cold water; let slightly jell, then add pineapple, bananas, marshmallows and apple; let jell.

recipes.title: Summertime Fruit Punch
steps: Combine the first 5 ingredients, then gently stir in ginger ale.
Makes 1 gallon.
This punch is tart and refreshing.

recipes.title: Fluffy Cheesecake
steps: Pat 1/2 of mixture into 9 x 13-inch pan; remaining will be sprinkled on top.

recipes.title: Turkey Chili
ingredients: 3 (14 1/2 oz.) cans drained and rinsed beans (i.e., kidney, red or pink beans, cannellini)
black pepper and salt to taste
steps: Saute onion and green pepper in olive oil until soft. Add ground turkey and season with salt, pepper, 1 tablespoon of cumin and chili powder. Crumble turkey as it cools. In a crock-pot, put tomatoes, beans, 2 tablespoons cumin, chili powder, salt and pepper to taste. Add a dash of hot pepper sauce or more if you want it spicier. Add turkey mixture to tomato mixture (drain fat if there is a lot of liquid). Cook on high anywhere from 6 to 8 hours, depending on how tender you want the meat.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
steps: Mix all together and chill at least 6 hours before using.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together well.
Put in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Mom'S Chili Mac
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. chili powder (add more for hotter taste)
steps: Brown ground beef, onion and celery together; drain grease. In a soup kettle, add together the meat, kidney beans, juice, 1/3 can of water and cooked macaroni and chili powder.
Cook, covered, on low heat until soup thickens.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple Filling
steps: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs (whipped with a fork) and drained pineapple, then bread.
Pour into greased casserole.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes, uncovered.
Can eat hot or cold. Great with ham!

recipes.title: Amaretto Punch
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted
1 (6 oz.) can frozen lemonade, thawed and undiluted
2 c. Amaretto or another almond flavor liqueur
steps: Dissolve sugar in boiling water (1-quart).
Stir in remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Divide mixture into pint size freezer bags and put into freezer.
Remove bags as needed and let stand at room temperature until slushy.
Yields about 6 quarts.

recipes.title: Impossible Chicken 'N Broccoli Pie
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease 10-inch pie plate.
Rinse broccoli under cold water to thaw; drain.
Mix broccoli, cheese (2 cups), chicken and onion in plate.
Beat milk, eggs, Bisquick, salt and pepper until smooth.
Pour into plate.
Bake for 25 to 35 minutes. Knife should come out clean when inserted in middle.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake until melted, 1 to 2 minutes longer.
Cool 5 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: No Fail Divinity
ingredients: 1 c. Angel Flake coconut or nutmeats (optional)
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Cook in microwave oven on High for 19 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Candy thermometer should read 260°.
If not, cook 2 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Eggnog
steps: Whip the whites and yolks of 6 eggs into a stiff cream, adding sugar.
Pour into milk, adding brandy and a flavor of nutmeg. Stir up and thoroughly mix the ingredients and add the 3 additional egg whites, well whipped.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
steps: Toss all ingredients lightly.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. sliced water chestnuts or almonds
steps: Mix all ingredients, except potato chips.
Put in a large baking dish.
Top with crushed chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Chicken Delight
ingredients: 1 cream of mushroom, chicken or celery soup
steps: Slice boiled fryer and place on bottom of casserole.
Scald milk and add margarine.
Add bread, broth, soup, onion, salt, pepper and eggs.
Pour mixture over chicken and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Kentucky Crab Dip
steps: Stir cream cheese until soft and mixable.
Cut onion into small fine pieces. Mix into cream cheese.
Finely chop crab meat, mix into cheese mixture and add remaining ingredients into cheese mixture.
Chill for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 c. chopped pecans with 1 Tbsp. dry parsley flakes
steps: Blend all cheeses in food processor or using electric mixer until smooth.
Add onion, Worcestershire, paprika, chives and pepper.
Blend well.
Shape into ball and roll in pecans and parsley.
Chill until firm.
Serve with any type cracker.

recipes.title: Tomato Aspic
steps: Mix puree, salt, water and bay leaves together in 1 1/2 to 2-quart saucepan. Bring to slow boil and simmer 15 minutes. Dig out bay leaves and discard; add lemon Jell-O to hot mixture and mix thoroughly to dissolve completely. Add vinegar. Pour aspic into a flat container so it will chill more quickly; when slightly jelled, fold in minced onion. You may leave the aspic in the container or pour into individual molds and allow to set completely. Serve on lettuce leaf or your choice.

recipes.title: French Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix sugar, cocoa and cornstarch together.
Stir in rest of the ingredients and beat slightly with whisk.
Pour into uncooked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Takes 35 minutes in my oven.
This pie will still be shaky, but will set up.
Do not cook over 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
steps: Boil your sweets
until done, drain and peel.
In a greased casserole add brown sugar (pack down on bottom), place the sliced sweets on top of the brown sugar.
Sprinkle brown sugar on top of sweets again if you wish.
Dot with butter.
Add water.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 8 or more.

recipes.title: Mexican Cabbagelos Alamas, New Mexico
steps: Brown hamburger meat.
Add other ingredients and soy sauce to taste.
Cook on low until cabbage and squash are cooked, approximately 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken And Sauerkraut
ingredients: boneless chicken breasts, cut in half or strips
steps: Spread sauerkraut in bottom of baking dish.
Put chicken in next.
Cover with sliced cheese.
Add Italian dressing. Refrigerate one hour.
Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes in a 375° oven.

recipes.title: Crabbies
steps: Melt cheese and butter together and mix with other ingredients. Spread on halves of English muffins.
Cut each muffin into 6 pieces (pie shaped).
Put on cookie sheet to freeze, then put in plastic Ziploc bag to store in freezer.
