When ready to serve, thaw and bake at 400° for 12 minutes or broil for 2 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.title: Gooey Butter Cake
steps: Mix cake mix, butter and 1 egg with fork.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan, greased.

recipes.title: Strawberry Vinegar
steps: Combine strawberries and vinegar in a bowl, cover and let stand at room temperature 24 hours; stir occasionally.
Strain mixture through cheesecloth and discard all seeds.
Stir in sugar and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat and let cool.
Pour vinegar into decorative jars and seal.
Yields about 2 cups.
Serve over salads.

recipes.title: Deer Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb. deer meat, cut in thin strips
2 cloves garlic or substitute with garlic powder
steps: Put meat strips in skillet with a little cooking oil and stir until almost done.
Add pepper, onion and garlic and stir occasionally until pepper and onion is sauteed.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer until well seasoned.
Serve over rice or alone.

recipes.title: Blueberry Icebox Cake
ingredients: 1 can blueberry pie mix (to which juice of 1/2 lemon has been added; any kind of pie mix may be used)
steps: Mix together cracker crumbs, powdered sugar and melted butter and pat into 9 x 13-inch pan, well buttered.
Blend eggs with sugar and cream cheese.
(Do with mixer for best results.)
Spread over crumb mixture.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Cool slightly.
Pour on pie mix.
Any kind of pie mix may be used.
Top with Cool Whip. Keep in refrigerator until serving time.
Cut in squares.
(Will keep several days if covered in refrigerator.)

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Cobbler
ingredients: 2 (8.1 oz.) pkgs. White Lily Apple Cinnamon Muffin Mix
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour a 9 in. round or square baking pan. Reserve 1 cup muffin mix. Pour remaining mix into a bowl, add 1/2 cup milk and stir. Spread into prepared pan. Spoon apple pie filling over the top. Pour reserved muffin mix into a bowl and add softened butter. Blend until crumbly. Sprinkle over pie filling. Top with chopped nuts if desired. Bake 40 minutes or until top is golden brown. Delicious when topped with ice cream.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Puff
ingredients: 1 loaf Italian bread, cut into 1-inch cubes
3/4 lb. Monterey Jack or Muenster cheese, cubed
steps: Toss bread, ham and cheese in greased baking dish. Saut onion in butter until tender. Transfer onion to bowl. Add eggs, milk and mustard. Mix together. Pour over the bread mixture. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 55 to 65 minutes or until knife inserted in the middle comes out clean. Serve immediately. Serves 12 to 15.

recipes.title: Sausage Brunch
steps: Brown sausage and drain.
Crumble.
Mix cream cheese with sausage.
Spread rolls out flat on long pan sprayed with Pam. Spread sausage mixture over roll.
Roll up and bake at 350° for 12-15 minutes.

recipes.title: Almond Punch(Servings For 60)
steps: Dissolve jello and sugar in hot water.
Mix all ingredients except 7-Ups.
Just before serving, add 7-Ups.

recipes.title: Party Punch
steps: Mix and freeze.
Chip and serve with Sprite, ginger ale or 7-Up (one 2 liter bottle).

recipes.title: Mexican Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 tsp. minced garlic or 2 or 3 cloves
14 oz. can chicken broth or make your own
2 or 3 c. chopped chicken or turkey
1 c. or 8 oz. grated fat-free cheese
steps: In large skillet over medium heat saute onion and garlic in the Butter buds.
Add chicken broth and tomatoes.
Add spaghetti, break up tomatoes if they are whole.
Add picante sauce and cumin, cover and simmer until spaghetti is cooked.
Add chicken.
Put in sprayed (no fat) casserole dish.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Mousse Pie
ingredients: 1 pkg. Jell-O vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
2 c. Cool Whip (1 small container), thawed
steps: Prepare pie filling mix as directed on package with milk. Blend in pumpkin, spice and 2 cups Cool Whip.
Spoon mixture into pie shell.
Chill at least 4 hours in refrigerator.
For extended period, pie holds better in freezer.
Put in refrigerator for 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Crispy Pickles
steps: Slice cucumbers and cover with a solution of pickling lime and water.
Let soak for 24 hours.
Rinse well and cover with cold, clear water.
Soak for 3 hours.
Drain and cover with remaining mixture.
Soak overnight.
The next morning, boil pickles in the mixture for 35 minutes.
Put in jars; these pickles will be nice and crisp.

recipes.title: Broccoli Corn Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into greased black iron skillet. Batter will be real thick.
Bake at 350° about 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Garden Pie
steps: In a lightly greased 8 x 10-inch baking dish, layer vegetables. Sprinkle cheese and pepper over vegetables.
Combine milk, Bisquick and eggs.
Beat until smooth and pour over vegetables.
Bake for 30 minutes in 400° oven.
Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Hot Corn Casserole
steps: Melt butter and cream cheese with milk.
Add drained corn and peppers.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hello Dollies
steps: Melt butter and pour in oblong pan.
Sprinkle remaining ingredients in following order:
crumbs, coconut, butterscotch morsels, chocolate morsels, condensed milk and pecans.

recipes.title: Barbecued Frankfurters
steps: Put vegetable oil on small plate.
Put chop in each side, then put in bread crumbs.
Sprinkle with small amount of oil.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Carrot Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients; stir well.
Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Broccoli Soup
steps: Cook broccoli as directed.
Drain and add soup, milk and butter.
Simmer.
Add shredded cheese, melt and serve.

recipes.title: Cheese Loaf
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in top of a double boiler.
Place over boiling water and cook, stirring constantly for 13 to 15 minutes or until thickened.
Remove from heat; stir in Cheddar and American cheese and pimento.
Line a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan with foil.
Grease foil.
Spoon mixture evenly into pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Cover with foil for last 15 minutes.
Let stand in pan until cool.
Remove from pan.
Cut into 1/2-inch slices.
Yield:

recipes.title: Betty'S Chocolate Chocolate Chip Muffins
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines Butter Recipe fudge cake mix
6 oz Hershey's mini semi-sweet chocolate chips
steps: You will need 24 foil baking cups.

recipes.title: Better Than Sex Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix (most recipes call for Duncan Hines)
1 (6 oz.) bar Baker's German's chocolate, grated
steps: In an electric mixer bowl, mix together cake mix, instant pudding, oil and water.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.
Stir in sour cream, chocolate chips, pecans, grated chocolate and coconut.
Bake at 350° in well-greased Bundt or tube pan for about 55 minutes or until testing pick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Easy Meatballs
steps: Combine ground beef, corn flakes, onion, pepper and 1/4 of soup; mix well.
Form into meatballs the size of a small egg. Place in a baking dish that has been sprayed with Pam.
Don't brown or fry the meat.
Mix rest of soup with milk and pour over meatballs.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for about 1 hour; meatballs will brown nicely.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
steps: Mix graham crackers, butter, sugar and cinnamon.
Save 2 tablespoons for topping.
Press into spring-form pan.
Cream the cream cheese, sugar, vanilla, egg yolks and food coloring.
Pour into pan and bake 20 minutes at 375°.
Add sugar and vanilla to sour cream and pour over filling.
Return to oven and bake 5 minutes at 475°.
Cool and place in refrigerator until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Pizza Chicken Wings
steps: Combine all dry ingredients.
Dip drummettes in butter.
Then coat in dry mixture.
Place on foil-lined pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Baked Bean Casserole
steps: Mix hamburger meat, onion and bell pepper.
Cook until medium done.
Drain grease off.
Combine all ingredients in a deep casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Parmesan Loaves(Children'S)
steps: Cut French bread in half (lengthwise) and place cut side up on baking sheet.
Spread softened margarine on cut sides.
Bake at 350° until margarine melts.
Mix mayonnaise and cheese in a bowl. Spread carefully on hot bread.
Bake until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Cherry Dessert
ingredients: 1 large Thank You brand sweet cherries, thickened
steps: Place pineapple (including juice) in a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan.
Add cherries next.
Sprinkle cake mix over fruit.
Slice margarine into pats and place on cake mix along with nuts.
Bake at 325° for about 45 minutes or until it is lightly browned. Serve with Cool Whip or French vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Sausage Rolls
steps: Mix all the ingredients well.
Form into small balls and put on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cottage Potatoes
ingredients: 2 c. hot mashed potatoes (fresh or instant)
steps: Add dill and cottage cheese to hot potatoes.
Put into a 1-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with chives and dots of butter.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
ingredients: 4 Tbsp. dry cherry or strawberry jello
steps: Mix the sugar, water and cornstarch together.
Add the red food coloring and jello; cook until thick.
Line a baked shell with strawberries.
Pour cooled jello mixture over berries.
Top with whipped cream and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Lemonade Pie
steps: Blend Cool Whip, milk and lemonade with mixer.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
Put in freezer for 1/2 hour.
Store in freezer or refrigerator.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Cake
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can Mandarin orange slices and juice
steps: Beat all ingredients. Pour into 3 greased and floured cake pans (8 or 9-inch). Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool before icing. (Can use two layer pans or tube pan but have to bake longer.)

recipes.title: Dry Jello Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients; chill and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Fry eight tortillas in frying pan with 1 tablespoon of oil until soft.
Roll chicken, cheese and onions into tortillas.
Mix sour cream, soup and a little milk.
Pour a little mixture on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Put in the enchiladas and pour the rest of the mixture on top.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Brown
onions
lightly in vegetable oil.
Add hamburger and cook until brown.
Add catsup, salt, mustard, vinegar and beans. Let
all get hot.
Put in baking dish or pan.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cream Dessert
steps: Mix sugar and gelatin; add water.
Heat and stir until dissolved (microwave approximately 4 minutes on High).
Blend yogurt into gelatin mixture.
Add vanilla.
Chill until partially set.
Fold in Cool Whip and stir in blueberries.
Chill until set.

recipes.title: Italian Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 can Great Northern beans, not drained
steps: Brown beef.
Add all other ingredients except macaroni, beans and cabbage.
Bring to boil and simmer 20 minutes.
Add last 3 ingredients and simmer until they are tender.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jello And Angel Food Cake
ingredients: 1 large or 2 small angel food cakes
steps: Boil water and pour over jello.
Add frozen strawberries and let stand until it starts to gel.
Add the angel food cake (broken into small pieces).
Mix and pour into greased tube pan.
Put in refrigerator until firm.
Unmold and frost with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Tuna Salad
steps: Drain tuna and peas.
Toss all ingredients together and chill.

recipes.title: Peking Salad Dressing
steps: Combine all ingredients and shake well. Serve over salad greens, etc.
Refrigerate several hours prior to serving.

recipes.title: Spinach Salad With Honey-Dijon Dressing
steps: Combine first three ingredients in a large bowl; toss well. Combine vinegar and remaining ingredients and stir well. Drizzle over salad and toss well.

recipes.title: Five Week Sweet Pickle
steps: Put cucumbers in gallon jar with remaining ingredients.
Cover with vinegar.
Let stand 5 weeks.
Makes its own syrup.
Let stand overnight.
Pack in clean jars.
Heat lids and seal.

recipes.title: Christmas Punch
steps: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and pour over ice.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad(G. C. A. A. Salad Luncheon)
steps: Add Miracle Whip to taste along with.

recipes.title: Liver Pate
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen cooked spinach, squeezed dry or cooked fresh spinach, that when squeezed is about size of a small orange
steps: Wash liver thoroughly and remove as much of gray membrane as possible.
Grind together first 4 ingredients using fine blade. Put in large mixing bowl.
Add other ingredients and blend well with large spoon.
Spoon into an iron pot or casserole with tight fitting lid.
Allow room for a slight swelling of pate.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour, stirring well after 50 minutes.
Return to oven for 10 minutes more.
Remove from oven; spoon off excess grease and immediately pass pate through food mill (sometimes called a vegetable press) into another receptacle.
(This produces a smooth paste and leaves behind all liver membranes.)
Discard what remains in food mill.
Adjust seasoning to taste and mix thoroughly.
Place in refrigerator in tightly covered containers, until set, about 1 hour.
Serve cold on crackers.
May be safely kept for 2 weeks, properly refrigerated.

recipes.title: Saltine Heath Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Line a 9 x 13-inch cake pan with foil. Spread butter over foil.
Put 1 layer of saltine crackers over foil.
In saucepan, mix together brown sugar and butter. Bring to a boil. Boil for 3 minutes.
Pour over crackers and bake for 5 to 10 minutes.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with chips. Spread chips over when melted.
Sprinkle with slivered almonds or finely chopped walnuts.

recipes.title: Bread Stuffing(Serves 12 To 16)
steps: Cook onion and celery in butter.
Add to bread crumbs and seasonings.
Toss with enough liquid to moisten.
Turn into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for approximately 20 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Banana Split Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple in heavy syrup (pour this over bananas)
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Pour into freezer container.
Add milk if needed to fill.
Freeze!
(We put in blender.)

recipes.title: Grilled Roast Marinade
steps: This will marinate a 3 to 5 pound roast.
Pierce roast and rub in meat tenderizer.
Mix all other ingredients together.
Pour over roast.
Place in an airtight container for 24 hours.
Grill for 20 minutes for medium rare or longer for medium to well done.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger, onion and green pepper; drain grease.
Add tomato soup and mushroom soup.
Cook noodles separately in salt water until tender.
Add hamburger mixture.
Add slices of cheese on top to melt soon as casserole has finished baking.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Layered Turkey Salad
steps: Layer first 6 ingredients in a 2 1/2 quart bowl; set aside. Combine mayonnaise, sour cream and white pepper; spread over salad, sealing to edge of bowl.
Cover and chill 8 hours.
Toss gently before serving, if desired.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Barbecue Rib Sauce
steps: Saute onion in oil, add everything else.
Simmer for a while. Best made a day or so ahead of time.
Brush on meat just before removing from charcoal, oven or microwave to avoid scorching. Makes about 2 cups.
Adjust ingredients to taste.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb. chuck roast (2 inches thick; partially frozen)
dash of garlic salt and pepper
steps: Wrap roast in foil, adding onion soup mix, mushroom soup, bay leaf and seasonings.
Bake at 400° for about at least 1 hour, according to your choice of rare, medium rare or well done.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 can cherry pie filling or 1 large can crushed pineapple
1 box Duncan Hines butter recipe cake mix
steps: Pour cherry pie filling or pineapple, cake mix and coconut in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt margarine and pour over all the ingredients. Over this, sprinkle the chopped nuts.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Saute Of Two Squashes
steps: Wash squash and zucchini under cold running water.
Trim stem and blossom ends off.
Cut in 2-inch lengths.
Cut each piece lengthwise into 1/2-inch slices.
Stack slices and cut into 1/2-inch julienne strips.
Heat butter until foamy in large skillet over medium heat.
Add squash and toss until coated with butter.
Saute, tossing, until crisp and tender, about 4 minutes. Increase heat to high.
Sprinkle with thyme, salt and pepper. Cook, tossing, until squash is lightly browned, about 2 minutes. Note:
One fourth teaspoon dried thyme may be substituted for the fresh.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: In 2-quart casserole, melt 2 tablespoons oleo.
Add enough walnuts and pecans (chopped) to cover bottom of casserole.
Cut refrigerator biscuits in quarters.
Place on top of nuts.
Mix granulated sugar and cinnamon together.
Shake mixture over biscuits.

recipes.title: Hot Crab Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb. crabmeat (backfin or lump is best)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Remove cartilage from crabmeat. Combine remaining ingredients and mix gently with crabmeat. Spoon into a casserole and bake 15 minutes.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Mexican Layered Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 can green chili peppers, chopped and drained
steps: In medium bowl mix together refried beans, chilies and taco seasoning mix.
Spread in a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Blend avocados, lemon juice and 1/2 cup taco sauce until smooth.
Spread on top of bean mixture.
Spread sour cream on top of avocado mixture.
Top with lettuce, onions, taco sauce, cheese and black olives.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
steps: Combine all ingredients
in
a	large
bowl; stir until well blended.
Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake	at
for 40 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted
in center comes out clean.
Spread with chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Best Pasta Salad
steps: Cook pasta; drain and cool.
Mix pasta with all other ingredients.
Chill.
Best if chilled overnight.

recipes.title: Jellied Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. raspberry or cherry Jell-O
steps: Dissolve Jell-O using less than 2 cups of water as relish is juicy.
When Jell-O is partially jelled, add in remaining ingredients.
This is something a little different for Thanksgiving; great with leftovers!

recipes.title: Linguine Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) bottle Zesty Italian salad dressing
steps: Break linguine into 1-inch pieces.
Cook using package directions; drain well.
Combine cauliflower, onion, broccoli and olives in bowl; toss to mix.
Add linguine, salad dressing and seasoning mix; mix well.
Chill before serving.
Yield:
24 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp Mold
ingredients: 6 drops Tabasco sauce or to taste
2 c. (1 1/2 to 2 lb.) finely chopped cooked shrimp
steps: Mix Knox gelatine with cold water.
Bring tomato soup, undiluted, to boiling.
Stir in gelatine until dissolved.
Cook 1 to 2 minutes.
In bowl, mix together the cream cheese, mayonnaise, Tabasco and garlic salt.
Add tomato mixture to this, blending well.
Mix in chopped onion, celery and shrimp.
Spoon into a 6-cup mold and chill.
Serve surrounded by crackers.
Serves 35 to 40.
This will freeze.

recipes.title: Heavenly Chocolate Honey Dip
steps: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl until well blended. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with assorted fruits and chunks of angel food cake.

recipes.title: Memphis Slaw
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients.
Whip with a wire whisk until sugar dissolves.
Combine cabbage and pickles.
Add dressing and toss gently.
Chill 1 hour.

recipes.title: Barbecue Beans
steps: Combine beans, onion, brown sugar, ketchup and barbecue sauce and place into a medium size baking dish.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven.
Dish is done when a light brown coat forms on top of the beans.
Great dish to have at your next barbecue!

recipes.title: Pizzaburgers
steps: Mix all ingredients, except for cheese and spread on buns. Be sure to cover entire bun with mixture.
Place under broiler for 5 minutes.
Remove from oven and top with strips of cheese. Return to broiler and broil until cheese is melted.
Yields 15.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
steps: Cook the sugar, water and cornstarch until thick, then add 3 tablespoons strawberry jello.
Pour over fresh strawberries in a cooked pie shell.
Top with Cool Whip.
Let set 2 hours.

recipes.title: Christmas Treats
steps: Melt margarine and chocolate chips; stir together.
In large bowl, mix marshmallows with chocolate.
Sprinkle coconut on waxed paper.
Spoon marshmallow mix onto it.
Roll to make logs.
Place in freezer.
Before serving, slice in sections about 1-inch thick.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cups
steps: Combine crumbs, peanut butter, butter and sugar.
Work together until smooth.
Press mixture into a 9 x 9-inch pan (or longer if you want thinner bars).
Melt chocolate chips over hot water, spread over cracker mixture.
Refrigerate until cool, cut in squares.

recipes.title: Mini Cheesecakes
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients with electric mixer.

Then can either bake in candy papers (makes about 4 dozen) at 325° for 25 minutes or can put 1 vanilla wafer in bottom of a paper muffin cup, fill 2/3 full and bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes or top gets golden brown.
Top with small amount of cherry pie filling on each one when cool.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
steps: For crust, mix potatoes, sour cream and water and pat into bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until edges start browning.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Mix all ingredients together, adding cream cheese last.
Mix well. Let sit.
Roll in chopped nuts.
Let sit in refrigerator for 4 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 1 can each: cream of celery and cream of mushroom soup
steps: Spread 4 cups potatoes in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix remaining ingredients, 3/4 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper.
Pour half over potatoes.
Repeat layers.
Cover and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
Uncover and bake 30 to 45 minutes longer.
You can add 2 cups shredded cheese the last 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pimiento-Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. dry stuffing mix, finely crushed
steps: Cook squash, onions and carrots in salted water until tender; drain.
Add soup, sour cream, pimiento and pepper.
Melt butter; blend with dry stuffing mix.
Grease 8 1/2 x 12 1/2-inch dish or three 8-inch pans; spread a layer of dressing mix in pan.
Pour in squash mixture; cover with remaining dressing mixture.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Smokey Beans
ingredients: 1 (31 oz.) can pork and beans, drained
steps: Brown burger and drain.
Add onion and garlic.
Cook until tender.
Add rest of ingredients and simmer until warmed through or place in oven and heat for 30 to 45 minutes at 300°.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients
and
cover.
Store in refrigerator for 24 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Marinated Carrots
ingredients: 1 tsp. mustard, salt and Worcestershire sauce
steps: Slice and cook carrots; drain and place in layers in glass roasting pan or large Corning pan.
Top with thinly sliced onion and green pepper.
Repeat layering.
Mix other ingredients; pour over carrots.
Marinate in refrigerator overnight.
Taste improves with age.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Spaghetti With Meat Sauce
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can mushroom pieces, drained and chopped
1 (4 1/2 oz.) can chopped ripe olives, drained
steps: Cook and drain spaghetti. Stir in butter and 1/2 the cheese. Spoon into serving dish/platter; top with spaghetti sauce and sprinkle with cheese and parsley.

recipes.title: Ranch Fish Crackers
steps: Mix all together.
Spread on cookie sheet.
Heat in oven at 200° for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: King Ranch Chicken
ingredients: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes with green chili peppers
1 bag Doritos/corn chips, crushed with hands
steps: Mix tomatoes, soups and chicken stock together; alternate layers in rectangular baking dish:
sauce, chicken, crushed chips, onion, cheese, sauce, chicken, etc.
Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Salmon Dinner
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Pour into a buttered casserole dish.
Top with potato chips and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pie
steps: Toss zucchini and onion over medium heat in butter for 10 minutes.
Add seasonings and cook 2 more minutes.
In large bowl, mix eggs, cheese and veggies with seasonings.
Line 9 x 13-inch pan with unbaked crescent rolls.
Pour veggie mix on top of crescent rolls and bake for 20 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Hot Crab Dip
ingredients: 6 oz. fresh crab meat (or more to taste)
steps: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° until brown on top. Great with Triscuits.

recipes.title: Pretzel Dessert
steps: Stir pretzels together with sugar and margarine.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Press to bottom.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
steps: Mix all together.
Place in 9 x 13-inch glass pan. Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8 people.
This can be made and frozen for 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Curried Yams
ingredients: 10 to 15 baked sweet potatoes and yams
steps: Peel yams if you wish.
Cut in chunks.
Eggplant may be substituted for some of the yams.
Simmer butter, garlic and ginger 5 minutes.
Add herbs and spices; simmer.
Add milk; simmer.
Squeeze 1 1/2 lemons to curdle the milk.
Add to vegetables or use sauce for other curry dishes.
Increase cayenne for a hotter curry.
Serve with yogurt and condiments (nuts, coconut, banana, chutney, raisins, etc.).

recipes.title: People Puppy Chow
steps: You will need 2 paper sacks.

recipes.title: California Orange Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb. carrots, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick
1 orange peeled, sectioned, and cut into small pieces
steps: Combine carrots, salt and water in a saucepan; cook until crisp tender. Drain and return carrots to pan and add orange peel, butter, oranges and onion. Heat through. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Summer Cake
steps: Mix together all ingredients. Pour into 8-inch round pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan, greased.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: "Too Good" Fruit Dip
steps: Whip cream cheese with mixer until smooth.
Blend in orange juice.
Add Marshmallow Creme.
Whip again until smooth.
Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Goo-Losh
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. chili powder or more to make hot
steps: Brown meat and onion until brown.
(Don't drain.)
Add tomatoes and all other ingredients in a crock-pot or deep dish. Simmer 4 hours.
Best if eaten next day.

recipes.title: Homemade Potato Soup
steps: Dice potatoes.
Put first 6 ingredients in large pot and cook on low until potatoes are tender.
Remove from heat and mash part of the potatoes until soup starts to get thick.
Combine celery soup and milk; mix well.
Add slowly to potato mixture. Return to heat and cook on low until bubbly.
Remove and serve with cheese on top.

recipes.title: Frosty
ingredients: 1/4 c. chocolate drink powder (Hershey or Nestle)
steps: Combine all of the ingredients in a blender.
Blend on medium speed until creamy.
Stir if necessary.
If too thin, freeze the mixture in the blender or in cups until thicker.
Makes 2 drinks.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. red wine vinegar
steps: Tear lettuce and chicory leaves into
bite size pieces. Place in large bowl.
Add tomatoes, cucumber, Feta cheese and scallions. Pour
oil	and
vinegar over salad.
Sprinkle with oregano.
Toss and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Baked Pork Chops
steps: Brown chops in trimmed pork fat; drain excess fat.
Season chops with salt and pepper.
Top with onion.

recipes.title: Spiced Peach Salad *
steps: Drain peaches and measure juice.
Heat juice to boiling point. Dissolve Jell-O in hot juice.
Chill.
Soften cream cheese with milk.
Add nuts.
Cut up peaches and add to Jell-O mixture. Congeal until firm.
Serve on lettuce with mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Alma'S Easy Peanut Butter Fudge
ingredients: 1 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
steps: Combine sugars, half and half and corn syrup in a Dutch oven or heavy saucepan.
Cook over low heat, stirring gently, until sugars dissolve.
Cover and cook over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes to wash down sugar crystals from sides of pan.
Uncover and cook to soft ball stage (235°), stirring occasionally.
Do not undercook.

recipes.title: What'S For Dessert Pie?
steps: Beat eggs well and add all other ingredients.
Pour into unbaked pie crust and bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Mix sugars and cinnamon.
Cut biscuits into 4 sections each. Roll in sugar mixture.
Pour nuts into Bundt pan.
Place covered biscuit pieces in pan.
Melt butter and add remaining sugar mixture.
Boil 1 minute.
Pour over biscuits and bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Remove promptly from pan.

recipes.title: Layered Tacos
steps: Layer in order on tray.
Refrigerate until ready to use.

recipes.title: 24-Hour Oriental Salad
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can white Shoe Peg corn, drained
1 (8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, drained
steps: Combine vegetables in a large bowl and toss lightly.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
steps: Cook spaghetti; drain.
Stir in butter, then eggs, then Parmesan.
Form spaghetti mixture into a "crust" in a buttered 10-inch pie plate.
Spread Ricotta over bottom of crust.

recipes.title: Barbecued Spareribs
steps: Wipe spareribs and lay in roasting pan.
Blend other ingredients and pour over meat.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Uncover last 30 minutes.
Turn and baste meat frequently.

recipes.title: Custard Pie
steps: Slightly beat eggs, then add sugar, salt and vanilla. Gradually stir in scalded milk. Pour into pastry shell and sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake for an hour or until custard is set in the middle.

recipes.title: Oven-Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets savory herb with garlic soup mix
1 1/2 lb. assorted fresh vegetables (sliced zucchini, yellow squash, red or green bell peppers, carrots, celery and mushrooms)
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
In large plastic bag or bowl, add all ingredients; close bag and shake.
Or toss in bowl until vegetables are evenly coated.

recipes.title: Imperial Crab
ingredients: salt and pepper (red or Old Bay seasoning)
steps: In a bowl with crabmeat, add green pepper, some parsley and bread.
In a small bowl, beat together the egg, salad dressing or mayonnaise, dry mustard, salt, pepper and butter.

recipes.title: Chipped Beef Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 pkg. chipped beef, chopped in small pieces
steps: Combine first three ingredients and form into 2 balls.
Roll in chopped pecans.
Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Ritz Chicken
steps: Melt butter. Crush crackers and add seasonings. Dredge chicken in butter, then in cracker crumbs. Place in baking dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake in 350° oven until done.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Chicken Italian Style
ingredients: 1 good size chicken, cut into pieces, skin removed
1 large jar spaghetti sauce of your choice
steps: Put all ingredients in crock-pot in the following order: veggies, meat and sauce.
Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or until meat is tender and thoroughly cooked.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Vanilla Milkshake
steps: Combine all ingredients in blender.
Cover and process until smooth.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Philadelphia Cheese-Steak Sandwich
ingredients: 8 slices American cheese or 6 to 8 oz. Cheez Whiz
4 frozen sandwich steaks or thin-sliced Delmonico steaks
condiments to taste: ketchup, red and green peppers, hot sauce, etc.
steps: Place Cheez Whiz in top of double boiler with butter.
Heat until soft and drippy.
Keep warm over hot water as you prepare steaks.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
steps: Break up sausage.
Mix with grated cheese and Bisquick.
Spoon out in balls onto a cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Stuffed Shells
steps: Brown onion, garlic and ground beef.
Drain grease.
Cool. Stir in Mozzarella, crumbs, parsley and egg.
Season to taste. Cook shells in salted water 15 minutes.
Drain.
Stuff.
Spoon layer of sauce in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Place shells on sauce, side by side.
Mix wine with remaining sauce.
Pour over shells. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Cashew Tuna Casserole
steps: Blend soup with water.
Combine all other ingredients.
(Save a few noodles for top.)
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can Progresso Italian whole tomatoes
spices to taste: basil, oregano, salt, pepper, garlic powder and parsley
steps: Combine olive oil, minced garlic, onion and green pepper in Dutch oven or large pot.
Saute until tender.
Add pork and brown. Add tomato puree and tomato paste, stirring until combined. Strain whole tomatoes through strainer (mash by hand) so that only the juice goes into the sauce.
Add remaining ingredients and season to taste.
Simmer over very low heat for 1 hour, stirring constantly.
Sauce freezes well and recipe makes plenty!

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloin A La Asparagus
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of asparagus soup
1 (3 oz.) can sliced mushrooms, drained (about 1/2 c.)
steps: Pound pork to flatten. In skillet, brown tenderloin in butter. Set aside. In same skillet, blend together soup and milk; stir in remaining ingredients. Return meat to skillet. Cover and simmer 40 to 45 minutes. Serve sauce atop meat. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Ambrosia
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can Dole Mandarin orange segments
1/2 c. pecan halves or coarsely chopped nuts
1 c. dairy sour cream or plain yogurt
steps: Drain pineapple and orange segments. In large bowl, combine pineapple, orange segments, banana, grapes, marshmallows, coconut and nuts.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
steps: Cut salad according to size needed.
Crumble Feta cheese and layer on top.
Add Greek dressing (found at Kroger).

recipes.title: Crisp Pickles
steps: Combine vinegar, water, sugar, salt, celery and pickle spice. Heat until sugar melts.
Put two slices of onions in each jar. Fill with cucumber chunks.
Pour syrup over to fill jar.
Seal jar and process to a rolling boil.
This makes very crisp good pickles.

recipes.title: Basil, Walnut And Garlic Soup
ingredients: 1 c. firmly packed fresh basil leaves
steps: In a blender, blend basil, oil, walnuts, cheese and garlic. Blend until thick and smooth, then transfer to a large pot.
Add 8 cups chicken broth and heat over moderate heat until it is very hot.
Ladle soup into heated bowls and serve with freshly grated Parmesan cheese.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Lime Party Salad
steps: Over low heat mix marshmallows and milk.
Stir until marshmallows are melted.
Pour over lime jello.
Stir until jello is dissolved.
Stir in cream cheese (softened).
Mix until dissolved.
Add crushed pineapple.
Chill all ingredients before adding Dream Whip.
Chill well before serving.

recipes.title: Hershey Pie
steps: Melt the Hershey bar in microwave.
Add a little milk (enough to stir).
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into crust.
Cool in refrigerator until set.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
ingredients: 3/4 c. white corn syrup or honey
steps: Cream syrup or honey with butter, add sugar and well beaten eggs. Beat all thoroughly, then add vanilla and pecans.
Pour into unbaked pastry shell and bake in slow oven, 350°, for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Green Beans
steps: Prepare and wash beans.
Break or cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces. Place in a Dutch oven; add other ingredients and bring to a boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until beans are tender.

recipes.title: Oyster Stuffing
steps: Measure bread cubes into a large bowl. Melt 1/2 cup butter in skillet. Cook celery and onions until soft. Pour over bread cubes. Heat 1/2 cup butter in skillet; add oysters and liquid. Heat a few minutes; remove oysters. Pour liquid over bread cubes. Chop oysters; add to bread cubes mixture. Add milk, sage, salt and pepper. Mix well. Stuff lightly into turkey. Makes enough for a 16 to 18 pound turkey.

recipes.title: Lemon Jello Salad
steps: Heat sugar, water and pineapple to boiling; beat in the jello and cream cheese.
Cool.
Beat in whipping cream.
Put in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Pea Pickin' Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines yellow cake mix (with pudding)
steps: Bake cake by directions on box for two 9-inch layers.
Cool completely.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Chocolate Chip-Coconut Bars
steps: Mix.
Spread into a 9 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Pecan Ice Cream
steps: Roast pecans in salt and butter at 250° for 15 minutes, then break into desired sizes. Whip eggs until smooth, then mix with condensed milk and pudding. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Add whole milk to fill ice cream container.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drain well
steps: Place chopped peppers, onions and pineapple on paper towel to absorb moisture.
Blend all ingredients together well.
Refrigerate and chill at least 1/2 hour.
Shape into ball and roll in pecans..

recipes.title: Kentucky Pecan Pie
steps: Combine brown sugar, syrup, salt, butter and beaten eggs. Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Sprinkle pecans over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Cool.
Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Crab Stuffed Eggplant
ingredients: 6 oz. crabmeat, mixed with 1 Tbsp. lemon juice
steps: Cut eggplant in half lengthwise. Scoop out pulp, leaving a shell 1/2-inch thick. Chop eggplant in 1-inch cubes.
Heat oil in a large skillet. Saute eggplant, onion and garlic in oil until onion is soft.
Stir in parsley, cheese and crab.
Mix well. Stuff shells with mixture. Sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Place one slice of tomato on each eggplant.
Sprinkle with about 1/2 teaspoon olive oil, then sprinkle with basil and oregano evenly over the tomato slices.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
This can be a meal in itself if served with a hearty salad and crusty bread or can accompany a simple broiled chicken nicely, too. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Oriental Pie
steps: Soften margarine.
Blend in sugar and beaten eggs.
Stir in pecans, coconut, raisins, vinegar and vanilla.
Pour into two 9-inch unbaked pastry shells.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Squash Dressing
ingredients: 1 can chicken broth or cream of chicken soup
sausage or poultry or sage seasoning
steps: Mix all together.
Cook at 400° to 425° for 20 to 25 minutes or until set.
Mix crumbs and broth to amount you want or size pan cooked in.

recipes.title: Coal Garden
ingredients: few drops food coloring for color
steps: Sprinkle ingredients over lump of coal placed in saucer or small dish.

recipes.title: Best Chocolate Fudge
steps: Melt chocolate pieces in top of a double boiler. Add butter and vanilla. Dip strawberries in chocolate, swirling to coat evenly. Place on wax paper and set in cool dry place. Make about 1 1/3 cups dip.

recipes.title: End Of Garden Pickles(Sweet)
steps: Place chopped vegetables in a crock. Add the salt.
Let stand overnight at room temperature. Wash in cold water.
Place in pint jars.
Mix vinegar and sugar.
Bring to a boil. Tie the pickling spices up in a thin cloth and put in kettle with the vinegar; cook 1 minute.
Pour over the vegetables, covering the vegetables. Seal.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
steps: Follow directions on cake mix and bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Leave cake in pan and punch holes in top.
Spread Eagle Brand milk over top of cake; let cool.
Spread cream of coconut over cake.
Now spread Cool Whip.
Last spread coconut over Cool Whip. Cover tightly and refrigerate for 2 or 3 days before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Delight
ingredients: 3 c. sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed
steps: Mix ingredients and pour in a greased baking dish.

recipes.title: Citrus Beet Soup
ingredients: 3/4 lb. beets, peeled and grated (2 c.)
1 c. grated cucumber (peeled only if waxy)
dash of freshly ground black pepper
steps: Combine the onion, beets and orange juice in a 2-quart casserole.
Cover tightly and cook on High for 8 to 12 minutes or until the beets are tender, stirring once or twice.
Add the lemon juice, broth, cucumber and pepper.
Cover again and cook on High for 3 to 5 minutes, or until heated through, but not boiling.

recipes.title: Ambrosia
steps: Drain pineapple and oranges.
Combine pineapple, oranges, grapes, marshmallows, coconut and nuts.
Mix sour cream and sugar; stir into fruit mixture.
Chill.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cornflake Candy
ingredients: 1 lb. sweet chocolate (1 big Hershey bar, 1 lb. size)
steps: Melt both chocolates in a pan (over hot water).
Add cornflakes and nuts. Stir until flakes are thoroughly coated. Place by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper or aluminum foil to harden. The one pound Hershey bar works best for the sweet chocolate.

recipes.title: Appetizer Cheese Bake
ingredients: 3 c. (12 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
steps: Combine first three ingredients.
Stir in cheese and onion. Spoon into 1-quart souffle dish.
Bake at 325° for 25 minutes or until puffed and golden.
Serve immediately with crackers.
Yields 3 cups.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
steps: Combine all ingredients (except Velveeta) in chicken broth in large casserole dish.
Stir together.
Cut Velveeta up on top and cook in oven about 30 or 40 minutes at 350°.
Serves about 8.

recipes.title: Simple Baked Pork Chops
steps: Place chops in shallow, greased baking dish.
Spread with mustard.
Sprinkle with celery, brown sugar and seasonings.
Pour tomato sauce and water over chops.
Cover baking dish and bake in moderate oven (350°) for 1 1/4 hours or until chops are tender. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Drain the beans and place them in long 9 x 13-inch dish. Preheat oven to 350°.
Put can of mushroom soup and 1/2 cup milk in saucepan.
Slice the package of Velveeta cheese and add to saucepan.
Add Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Turn heat to low and melt the cheese until bubbly.
Pour this over the beans.
Put onion rings on top of this and bake in 350° oven until all of it bubbles, approximately 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Lazy Stew
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. Burgundy wine or cooking sherry
herbs; sweet basil, thyme, rosemary, tarragon, dill weed, and broken bay leaves (pinches of all herbs)
steps: Cook all together.
Cover and thicken for 45 minutes.
Bake at 275° for 5 hours.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
ingredients: 1 pkg. sugar cookie refrigerator dough (from dairy section of store)
Cool Whip or the topping you spray (this makes it prettier)
steps: *Whichever ones are in season, strawberries, grapes, bananas, kiwi and peaches are good.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Taco Dip
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can chili beans or black beans
1 small can chopped green chili peppers or jalapeno peppers
steps: Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam.
Soften cream cheese and spread into pan.
Spread can of chili beans over cream cheese. Add chili peppers over beans.
Layer black olives, then green onions, then cheese.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Mix all and pour in a 2-quart baking dish.

recipes.title: Abigail'S Open House Fruit Punch
ingredients: 1 small can frozen orange juice, diluted according to directions
1 qt. ginger ale (add just before serving)
steps: Mix up some of the punch ahead of time, with the exception of the ginger ale.
Pour a small amount in a ring mold and arrange red or green maraschino cherries or fruit which will match your color scheme in an interesting design.
Freeze this until solid, then fill the mold the rest of the way with additional punch and freeze.

recipes.title: Sunday Night Specials
steps: Brown ground beef and onion together, drain.
Add sour cream, chopped onion, Worcestershire sauce and garlic powder.
Simmer on low heat for about 10 minutes.
Spoon mixture onto English muffin halves, sprinkle with cheddar cheese and broil until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 large can Bush's beans with brown sugar
steps: Brown and drain ground beef. Add Manwich and cook juice down. Drain beans and mix in skillet. Add ketchup and brown sugar. Bake for 15 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Ham-Cheese-Broccoli Brunch Casserole
steps: Cook and drain broccoli; remove crusts from bread and fit into bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Layer in cheese, broccoli and ham.
Arrange the rest of bread to cover entire dish. Combine the remaining ingredients and pour over bread.
Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate overnight.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 55 minutes.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Use plain or roll in nuts or parsley flakes.
Can be kept for long time in refrigerator.
Let soften before using.

recipes.title: Easy Hawaiian Chicken
ingredients: 1 large bottle Kraft French Dressing Deluxe
steps: Place chicken in roaster pan.
In bowl, combine dressing, jam and soup mix.
Mix well and pour over chicken.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Nannar'S Tortellini Soup
steps: Brown the Italian sausage (taken from casing) and the onion. Add the beef broth, diced tomato and tomato juice; cook for 45 minutes. Cook the tortellini for about 7 minutes. Cook the carrots in microwave until half done. Add the cooked tortellini, carrots and the zucchini to the soup. Cook until the zucchini is tender.

recipes.title: Grandma Fulton'S Whiskey Balls
ingredients: 2 C. ground nuts (I like pecans best)
4 to 6 Tbsp. whiskey (enough to hold the mixture together)
steps: Mix vanilla wafers, nuts, and cocoa together.
Add corn syrup and whisky and stir together.
Roll into small balls and then roll in powdered sugar.
chill for about 12 hours.
(I usually also chill the mix before I roll them into balls as this makes it a little less like playing with mud pies)

recipes.title: Frozen Strawberry Cheese Pie
ingredients: 2 (10 oz. each) pkg. frozen sliced strawberries, thawed
steps: Blend cream cheese and sour cream.
Reserve 1/2 cup berries and syrup.
Mix remaining berries and syrup into cheese mixture. Pour filling into baked pie shell.
Cover; freeze until firm.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie(Danish Dessert)
ingredients: 1 pt. ripe strawberries, washed and stemmed
steps: Put berries into pie shell (cut up if very large).
Make Danish dessert according to directions on package.
Cool and pour over the berries.
Top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Barbecue Meat Loaf
steps: Crumb the bread in blender.
Put 1/2 can of tomato sauce, onion, egg, salt and pepper in blender and chop.
Add to ground beef and bread crumbs.
Mix well and form into loaf.

recipes.title: Clam-Ham Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients and chill.
Serve with potato chips or crackers.
One cup of chopped shrimp may be substituted.

recipes.title: Cherry Crunch
ingredients: 2 (1 lb. 4 oz.) cans cherry pie filling
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Cut butter into dry cake mix.
Reserve 1 cup mixture.
Pat remaining mixture lightly into a 9 x 13-inch pan, building up 1/2-inch edge.
Spread 2 cans cherry pie filling over cake mixture to within 1/2-inch of pan edge.
Blend 1/2 cup chopped nuts and the 1 cup reserved mixture.
Sprinkle over top. Bake 45 minutes.
Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 4 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
steps: Cook and drain broccoli.
Combine all other ingredients and add to broccoli.
Cover the top with crumbs.
Bake for 30 to 45 minutes at 350°, until brown in a 12 x 16-inch dish.

recipes.title: Egg Noodle Bake With Golden Raisins
steps: Prepare pasta according to package directions; drain.
Rinse under water and drain again.
Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, combine the noodles with the cottage cheese and sour cream; set aside.
Melt the margarine in a small skillet.
Add onion; saute over medium heat until soft, about 5 minutes.
Combine onion with noodles.

recipes.title: Cocktail Wieners
ingredients: 2 pkg. hot dogs, cut into 1-inch pieces
steps: Mix mustard and jelly on top of stove in saucepan until it dissolves.
Drop hot dogs in and cook on low heat until wieners are done.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Brown hamburger meat and drain completely. Add soups and water, and bring to a hard boil. Remove from heat. Add sour cream; stir completely. Boil egg noodles while browning meat. Drain and add hamburger mixture, stir. Serve with salad and garlic bread.

recipes.title: Taco Tossed Salad
steps: Brown beef and drain.
Add can of taco sauce.
In bowl, toss the following:
lettuce, bell pepper, tomato, celery, olives and grated cheese.
Add Thousand Island dressing.
Spoon hot meat mixture over all; toss.
Serve with corn chips.
Main dish that serves 6.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Casserole
steps: Cook chicken.
Remove from bone in small pieces and put in glass dish.
Mix sour cream and soup; spoon over chicken.
Melt margarine and mix with crackers.
Put over chicken mixture.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken And Noodles
steps: Boil chicken; debone and cut up into small chunks. Boil noodles until tender. Mix soup with leftover chicken broth. Stir in chicken pieces and noodles. Add salt to taste. Cook for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Lobster Canapes
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. lobster meat, cooked and finely chopped
16 slices white bread, toasted and cut into 1 1/2 to 2-inch rounds (use a shot glass)
steps: Preheat oven to 425°.
Cream butter and cheese together.
Stir in egg yolk, sherry, cayenne and Worcestershire.
Add lobster meat and mix well.
Top each bread round with spoonfuls of lobster mix. Bake on cookie sheet for 5 minutes.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Neiman Marcus Strawberry Butter
steps: Whip butter in bowl of an electric mixer until fluffy.
Fold in strawberry preserves.
Return to refrigerator and allow butter to solidify.

recipes.title: Tanabour(Armenian Yogurt Soup)
steps: Add 1 can of water to the soup.
Cook the barley in the soup according to directions on the barley box.
Just before serving, stir the yogurt into the barley/soup mixture.
Separately melt the butter and add garlic (or garlic powder) to taste.
Place on the table in a separate bowl.
People may add the garlic butter to the soup according to their taste.

recipes.title: Quick Banana Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Combine oil, bananas, eggs, vanilla, Bisquick and sugar in mixer bowl.
Mix well and fold in pecans.
Pour into pan.
Bake for 55 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes clean.
Cool in pan 5 minutes.
Remove to wire rack to cool completely.
(I use 2 disposable tin loaf pans rather than one 5 x 9-inch pan and bake approximately 45 minutes.)

recipes.title: Sugar Coated Peanuts
steps: Combine all the ingredients in a heavy skillet and cook until all the liquid is dissolved, stirring constantly.
When liquid turns to sugar, pour on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam.
Let cool and store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. Campbell's cream of chicken soup
steps: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and pour into baking dish. Apply 1 cup crushed potato chips on top.
Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Macaroni Goulash
ingredients: 1 can tomato soup or catsup to taste or barbecue sauce
steps: Fry hamburger meat with onion.
Pour off grease.
Cook macaroni as directed; drain.

recipes.title: Tangy Wings
steps: Bring first 6 ingredients to boil.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Add BBQ sauce, honey and soy sauce.
Pour over cooked wings.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Grilled Turkey Cutlets(A Simple Low-Fat Meal)
steps: Blanch cutlets in boiling water for 2 minutes.
Remove from water and pat dry.
Mix remaining ingredients and rub well into cutlets.
Grill 6 inches from heat 5 to 6 minutes each side until cooked through.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Six Can Soup
ingredients: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes with onions and peppers
1 can chili with beans or without
steps: Cook ground chuck about 10 minutes and drain.
Mix all ingredients in a 5-quart cooking pot.
Bring to a boil.
Turn down heat and simmer for about 1 hour.
Add some water and salt.

recipes.title: Crunchy Cheese Potatoes(Yields 8 Servings)
ingredients: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
steps: In a large bowl, combine sour cream or milk, chives, salt and pepper.
Add potatoes and mix thoroughly.
Spread in a 15 x 10-inch baking pan.
Combine cheese and corn flakes; sprinkle over potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Sprinkle with additional chives if desired.

recipes.title: Buckeyes
steps: Melt in saucepan butter or margarine, remove from heat.
Stir in confectioners sugar, peanut butter.
Using hands, shape into balls.
Combine in saucepan chocolate chips and paraffin.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until melted.
Use toothpick and dip balls into mixture leaving a small portion uncovered.
Let stand on wax paper until set.

recipes.title: Spicy Corn And Black Bean Relish
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can black beans, rinsed and drained
3/4 to 1 c. chopped seeded Anaheim chili peppers
1/8 to 1/4 c. chopped seeded jalapeno peppers
steps: In a large bowl, combine corn, beans and pepper. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl; pour over corn mixture and toss to coat.
Chill. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Frozen Pumpkin Pie
steps: Beat all ingredients together until well blended.
Pour into 9-inch crust and sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs.
Freeze. Serve frozen.

recipes.title: Frozen Salad
steps: Cream together cream cheese and sugar and then add pineapple and maraschino cherries.
Whip heavy whipping cream and fold into the mixture.
Put in a 9-inch square glass pan or dish and freeze. Take out about 1/2 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Shish Kabob
steps: Combine pineapple juice, soy sauce and oil in a baking dish and marinate chicken in the mixture for 3 hours.
Alternate chicken with tomatoes, green peppers, onions and mushrooms on skewers.
Broil for 10 to 15 minutes, turning once, or until chicken is cooked through.
To barbecue, cook 5 inches from flame using marinade to baste.
Serve over rice or pasta.

recipes.title: Potato Tot Casserole
steps: Put meat firmly in baking dish.
Pour soup over evenly.
Put chopped onion and Tater Tots on top and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Carrot Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together and chill.

recipes.title: Cheese Log
ingredients: 1 small (8 oz.) pkg. Cheddar cheese, grated
steps: Cream; shape into log.
Sprinkle with paprika (chill).
Serve with party rye bread or crackers.

recipes.title: Baked Corn
steps: Saute onion in oleo.
Pour milk over cracker crumbs.
When moist, add eggs.
Combine other ingredients.
Pour into a buttered dish; bake for 45 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, boiled and diced up
steps: Mix well and chill.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Sugared Nuts
steps: Mix sour cream and sugar.
Heat to 223°, stirring constantly. Add vanilla and nuts.
Stir rapidly until mixture has coated nuts and sugared.
Spread on trays and separate.
Cool.
Store in airtight container.
Will keep several months.

recipes.title: Drain Declogger
steps: Pour baking soda into drain.
Follow with vinegar.
Close drain tightly until fizzing stops.
Flush with pot of boiling water.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Dips
steps: Melt in double boiler.
Keep in hot water and dip.

recipes.title: Strawberry Soda Cake
ingredients: 1 box strawberry Deluxe II cake mix
steps: Make cake as directed on box.
When cake is done, let cool. Punch holes in cake with fork.
Mix jello and soda together and pour over cake.
Mix pudding as directed on box and pour over cake.
Then spread Cool Whip over the pudding.
Let set in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Pea Casserole
steps: Mix and put in baking dish.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake until hot through.

recipes.title: Crunchy Candy
steps: Mix margarine with crumbs, sugar, coconut, peanut butter and nuts.
Shape into small balls.
In top of double boiler melt chocolate bits and wax.
Dip balls into mixture to completely cover.
Lay on wax paper to chill.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
steps: Mix vanilla pudding according to box directions.
Use both boxes as if just preparing one box.
Add sour cream and Cool Whip to pudding mix.
Layer wafers, then bananas in glass dish.
Pour pudding mixture over layers.
Chill for 3 to 4 hours or overnight. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie(Lemonade)
steps: Mix lemonade and milk together.
Add sugar, Cool Whip and coloring.
Mix well.
Pour into baked pie crusts.
Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Michelle Gipson'S Bierrox(Stuffed Cabbage)
ingredients: Pioneer hot roll mix or frozen dough balls
steps: (Double recipe and freeze extra.)

recipes.title: Broccoli Quiche
ingredients: 1 c. cubed ham or turkey ham
steps: Cook broccoli 3 to 4 minutes; drain.
Beat eggs and milk together.
Mix broccoli and ham; place in crust.
Pour egg mixture over broccoli.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes more.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 4 to 8 chicken breasts, boiled and cubed (boneless)
steps: Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with Doritos.
Place chicken on top of Doritos.
Mix soups, broth, Ro-Tel and onion together. Alternate soup mixture, cheese and Doritos.
Top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
steps: Brown hamburger in skillet.
Add green pepper, onion, salt and pepper; use some garlic salt.
When brown, add tomato paste, tomato soup, water, oregano, basil and parsley flakes.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Makes enough sauce to go with 1 1/2 pounds cooked spaghetti.
Serve with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Or Zucchini Casserole
steps: Cook squash and onions in boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Drain; combine soup and sour cream.
Stir in carrots.
Fold in squash and onions.
Combine stuffing and butter.
Spread half of stuffing on bottom of 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish.
Spoon vegetable mixture on top.
Sprinkle remaining stuffing mix over vegetables.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Barbecue Chicken
steps: Mix all ingredients, except chicken, in saucepan. Boil for 5 minutes. Place chicken in 13 x 9 casserole dish. Pour mixture over chicken. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

recipes.title: Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 box macaroni and cheese dinner, cooked as directed
steps: Saute beef, onion and garlic.
Mix all ingredients with macaroni and cheese mixture.
Pour into baking dish.
Top with cheese and bake until bubbly.

recipes.title: Fruit Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients except sugar.
Roll in balls and then roll in powdered sugar.
Refrigerate or freeze.

recipes.title: Grated Carrot Salad
ingredients: 1-inch cube ginger root, peeled and finely chopped
1/4 tsp. chili powder and coriander powder
a few sprigs cilantro leaves (for garnish)
steps: Mix grated carrots, chopped ginger, lemon juice, salt and spices; set aside.
Heat oil.
When hot, add green chilies and mustard seed.
When the seed starts making a cracking sound, remove from heat and pour over the salad mixture.
Mix well; garnish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Dennis' Favorite Health Drink
steps: In a blender container, combine orange sherbet, orange juice, ice cubes and pink grapefruit juice.
Cover and blend until smooth.
Pour into tall glasses halfway full and add remaining seltzer water.
Stir.
Serves 6.
Kids love this drink!

recipes.title: Crab Dip
steps: Combine all of the ingredients.
Chill several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: fresh vegetables (broccoli, carrots, onion, tomatoes, green peppers)
steps: Prepare rolls according to package; put triangles on pan and pinch together.
Cook according to directions.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Good And Spicy Meatballs
steps: In large mixing bowl, beat egg slightly.
Add next 5 ingredients.
Mix well.
Add ground beef; mix until combined. Shape into tablespoon-size meatballs.
Place in a single layer in greased or foil-lined shallow pan.
Bake at 400° for 12 minutes or until well browned.

recipes.title: Sweet-And-Spicy Pecans
steps: Toss pecans in butter.
Combine sugar and remaining ingredients; sprinkle over pecans, tossing to coat.
Spread pecans on a baking sheet; bake at 325° for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cool.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 300 degrees until done.

recipes.title: Short Ribs And Zucchini
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. short ribs, sliced (4 to 6)
steps: Brown ribs on both sides, drain grease.
Pour tomatoes and Italian seasoning over ribs.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Cover, bring to boil for 5 minutes, then simmer until ribs are tender. Slice zucchini and place over ribs.
Simmer until zucchini is tender.
Serve on platter with zucchini and tomatoes around ribs.

recipes.title: Hot Lima Casserole
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) size can green chili peppers
steps: Cook limas as
directed
on
package. Cook soup, cheese and pepper until
cheese
melts.
Add
butter;	put beans into greased casserole. Add soup mixture and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Roasted Broccoli(Delicious!)
ingredients: 3 to 4 heads broccoli, washed and rinsed
1 Tbsp. canola oil or vegetable oil
steps: Preheat oven to broil.
Separate broccoli into flowerets and cut off all stalk.
Put into large bowl.
Pour 1/2 cup olive oil over broccoli and toss until broccoli is lightly coated.
Place broccoli in cookie sheet.
Put in oven on top rack.
Watch closely!
Cook 5 minutes and check.
Edges should turn slightly brown when ready.
Remove and flip over flowerets and broil 2 to 3 minutes more.

recipes.title: Cranberry Cherry Mist
steps: Dissolve jello in hot water; stir in cranberry sauce and 50/50.
Pour into a nice glass bowl.
Chill until set.
Top with a thin layer of sour cream and a sprinkle of cinnamon/sugar.

recipes.title: Barbecued Meatballs
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Shape into balls and brown in skillet. Place in baking dish. In a separate bowl, combine sugar and mustard, then next 3 ingredients. Pour over meatballs and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Mix well
and
put on top of apples.
Bake until apples are tender and crust is brown.	Bake in 375° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Paul Bunyan Burgers
steps: Mix all ingredients and then add beef.
Makes 18 burgers.

recipes.title: Coconut Cream Pie
steps: Scald milk in double boiler. Beat eggs until smooth.
Mix cornstarch and sugar together. Add to eggs. Stir until smooth. Add to hot milk.
Cook until thick.
Remove from heat. Stir in butter and coconut.
Let cool. Add 1/2 cup Cool Whip to the filling. Garnish with the rest of the Cool Whip and sprinkle top with toasted coconut.

recipes.title: Dietetic Spiced Apple Rings
steps: Place spices in piece of dampened cheesecloth; tie to form bag. Place spice bag and apple juice in large saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
Combine 2 quarts water, lemon juice and salt in large bowl.
Core apples; cut crosswise into 1/2-inch slices.
Place slices in lemon juice mixture as soon as cut to prevent discoloration.
Cut slices of large apples in half, if desired.
Drain about 1/4 of the apple slices; drop into boiling spiced juice.
Cook just until wilted. Spoon slices immediately into hot sterilized pint jars, leaving 1-inch headspace.
Add 1/4 teaspoon almond extract to each jar. Cover with hot juice, leaving 1/2-inch headspace.
Clean jar rims. Place lids on jars; tighten rings firmly, but do not force. Process in boiling water bath for 15 minutes.
Yields 5 to 6 pints.

recipes.title: Tomato Relish
steps: Mix tomatoes, onions, bell pepper and celery with the salt. Soak overnight.
Drain well.
Add mustard seed, celery seed, vinegar, sugar and red pepper seeds.
Cook all together until vegetables are tender.
Have jars and lids real hot, also jars too. Makes 9 pints.
Real good with beans.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
steps: Make the pudding according to package instructions.
Fold in the Cool Whip and then add remaining ingredients.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Barbecue Tuna
ingredients: artificial sweetener equal to 1 tsp. sugar
steps: Combine all ingredients except tuna and simmer until heated through; add tuna and heat thoroughly.

recipes.title: Cheese Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients in large pot and bring to boil.
Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Cheddar Artichoke Appetizers
ingredients: 2 (12 oz.) cans artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1 loaf French bread, Italian or party slices
steps: Mix all ingredients except 1/2 cup cheese and bread.
Top bread with mixture and add remaining cheese on top.
Bake at 450° until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Lollipops
ingredients: flavorings (your choice: cinnamon candies, peppermint and lemon)
steps: Note:
You will need waxed paper, pan, wooden spoon, candy thermometer, sticks for lollipops and margarine.

recipes.title: Martha Washingtons
steps: Mix and cream sugar, oleo, milk and vanilla.
Add nuts; roll into balls.
Use powdered sugar to dip hands into as you roll balls.
Dip into chocolate, one at a time.
Drop onto wax paper and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Rum Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. (4 serving size) chocolate instant pudding and pie filling
steps: *If using cake mix with pudding already in mix; omit instant pudding, use only 3 eggs and only 1/3 cup oil.

recipes.title: Potato Salad(Non-Fattening--Unless Of Course You Eat Too Much!)
ingredients: 6 medium large red potatoes, boiled, chilled and cubed with skins left on
2 bunches green onions (scallions), small sliced or coarsely chopped
1 medium to small bunch celery, small sliced or coarsely chopped
steps: Use a large mixing bowl and mix well with a strong spoon. Tastes best if refrigerated overnight.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
ingredients: 1 head of lettuce, cut up in small pieces
steps: Layer first 5 ingredients in order.
Mix together mayonnaise and sugar.
Spread this on top of layered vegetables.
Spread shredded Cheddar cheese and bacon bits on top.

recipes.title: Cream Of Spinach Soup
steps: Put spinach through sieve.
Add with onion to the cup of hot milk in saucepan.
Gradually stir in the thin white sauce, stirring until smooth.
Season with salt to taste and a dash of nutmeg.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Pecans
steps: In one bowl, mix egg white and water. Beat slightly with fork to mix well. Pour 4 cups pecans into this mixture and mix until it is all soaked onto pecans.

recipes.title: Naval Academy Potato Salad
steps: Make sauce with vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, salt and pepper.
Mix well.
Add potatoes, celery, pimentos, sugar, pickle relish and mayonnaise.
Garnish with eggs and paprika. Chill.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf Hero
steps: Mix all but last 2 ingredients.
Spread on French bread, which has been split lengthwise.
Wrap in foil and bake 30 minutes in 400° oven.
Remove foil and place cheese on top and cook 5 minutes more.

recipes.title: Blackberry Vinaigrette
steps: Place cornstarch in a small saucepan.
Gradually add water, whisking until blended.
Stir in blackberry vinegar and remaining ingredients.
Boil 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate.
Serve over a combination of gourmet mixed lettuce, thinly sliced red onion and chopped fresh mint.

recipes.title: Citrus Cooler
steps: Place all ingredients in blender.
Blend until frothy.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Place broccoli in casserole dish.
Combine soup, mayonnaise, oleo, onion and eggs and pour over broccoli.
Top with cheese and crushed crackers.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let stand and serve.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Onion-Tomato Soup
steps: Peel and thinly slice onions.
In a large saucepan, saute onions in butter.
Add tomatoes, beef broth, basil, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Diabetic Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 heaping c. whole or broken pecans
steps: Sprinkle arrowroot over concentrate apple juice in a small saucepan.
Over low heat, stir until clear and thickened.
Cool this.
Beat in eggs, butter, vanilla, lemon juice and salt.
Mix well.
Stir in pecans and pour into a partially baked pie crust. Bake in preheated 400° oven for 10 minutes.
Lower heat to 300° and bake 20 to 30 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Gladys' Cranberry Chicken
ingredients: 3 or 4 chicken breasts, split or cut up chicken pieces
steps: Mix cranberries, soup mix and French dressing.
Put chicken into a 9 x 13-inch casserole and pour mixture over chicken pieces; marinate covered in refrigerator overnight.
Bake in marinade uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Red Applesauce Salad
steps: Place applesauce in small saucepan.
Heat over medium heat until bubbly hot.
Add jello; stir until jello is dissolved. Cool.
Stir in 7-Up.
Mix well.
Pour into mold; chill until set. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: French Coconut Pie
steps: Mix all together real good, pour into uncooked pastry shell. Heat oven at 450° for 5 minutes. Turn oven down to 375° and bake pie for 15 minutes. Turn oven to 350° and bake 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Pickles
steps: Combine all ingredients; cook for 10 minutes.
Real good with dry beans.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Dip
steps: Mix together.
Dip apples in the caramel mixture.
If you like, then dip into chopped peanuts.

recipes.title: Mexican Salad
ingredients: 1 medium size bag taco flavored Doritos, crushed
steps: Brown and drain ground chuck.
Set aside.
In large bowl, break lettuce in bite size pieces, chop tomatoes in small pieces, chop green onions and chop avocado in small pieces.
Mix together.
Add 1 cup grated cheese, picante sauce, meat, Green Goddess, pinto beans and crushed Doritos.
Toss and serve.
Garlic bread is good with the salad.
You can substitute Catalina dressing in place of Green Goddess.

recipes.title: Pistachio Cake
steps: Mix well.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: French-Toasted Sandwich
ingredients: 12 slices (9 oz.) cooked turkey or ham
steps: Place turkey or ham on 4 of the bread slices; top each with second slice.
Halve each sandwich diagonally.
In a shallow dish beat eggs and water until combined.
Dip sandwiches into egg mixture.
Grill on griddle or lightly greased skillet over medium heat about 2 to 3 minutes each side.
Place 2 of the sandwich halves in each of 4 individual shallow casseroles, overlapping slightly; set aside.

recipes.title: Kraut Salad
steps: Heat vinegar, sugar and oil until sugar dissolve.
Let cool. Mix all other ingredients.
Pour dressing over and let stand overnight in refrigerator.
Will keep for a long time.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Planks
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in a plastic bag; shake well.
Cut chicken into 1 inch strips; dip chicken in margarine and shake in bread crumb mixture. Place in Pyrex dish. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until tender. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Fresh Green Bean Salad
steps: Cook green beans tender-crisp.
Cool.
Add other ingredients and chill overnight.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
steps: Heat molasses, sugar and butter, but do not boil.
Add 2 cups peanut butter, pinch of salt and melt.
Add 3 quarts cornflakes. Do not bake.

recipes.title: Seafood Casserole
steps: I usually make with one pound of imitation crab and no shrimp.

recipes.title: Twinkie Cake
ingredients: 1 can fruit topping, your choice (strawberry or blueberry is good)
steps: Cut Twinkies in half lengthwise and line bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cook pudding as directed on box and pour over Twinkies.
Spread on fruit topping.
Cover with other half of Twinkies.
Top with Cool Whip.
Cool 1 hour and serve.
Keep remaining in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Chicken A La Eansor
ingredients: 6 single chicken breasts, boned and skinned
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted) or cream of chicken soup
steps: Arrange chicken breasts in a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with Swiss cheese slices.
Combine soup and wine; stir well. Spoon sauce over chicken and cheese.
Prepare stuffing according to package directions and place on top of soup layer.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Frozen Salad
steps: Melt marshmallows in pineapple juice over low heat; cool. Add salad dressing and pineapple, then food color. Fold in whipped cream.
Pour into molds or ice cube tray and freeze.

recipes.title: Lasagna #1
ingredients: 1/2 lb. lasagna noodles, cooked according to pkg. instructions
steps: In bottom of baking dish, spoon lasagna sauce to cover bottom. Layer lasagna noodles, garden sauce, Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese.
Repeat layering until done.
Cover with foil. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and bake, uncovered, for 20 more minutes.
Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before cutting. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Cucumber Dressing
steps: Blend all ingredients in blender; shake well before serving.

recipes.title: Gone-All-Day-Stew
ingredients: cooked or frozen peas or any leftover vegetable
1/4 c. sweet or sour pickle juice or cooking wine
steps: Preheat oven to 275°.
Put all ingredients in large casserole with lid to fit.
No need to brown meat.
Mix all ingredients. Cover.
Bake for 5 hours.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Casserole
steps: Cook sliced squash and onion in boiling water for approximately 5 minutes. Drain. Combine chicken soup and sour cream. Stir in carrots, stuffing mix and butter. Spread half of stuffing mixture in bottom of 12 x 17 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon vegetable mixture on top. Sprinkle remaining stuffing mixture over vegetables. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Peach Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 c. sugar (less if peaches are sweetened)
steps: Mash peaches and mix all ingredients.
Pour into freezer container.
Yields 1 gallon.

recipes.title: Savory Baked Ham Salad
ingredients: 1 c. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
steps: Combine mayonnaise, milk, mustard, salt and pepper to taste. Mix well.
Add remaining ingredients, reserving 1/2 cup cheese. Spoon into 1 1/2 quart casserole and bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Top with reserved cheese and continue baking until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Corn Relish
steps: Put 2 tablespoons pickling spice in a tied cheesecloth.
Boil corn for 5 minutes.
Cut from cob.
Measure and mix all ingredients with 1 cup of water. Simmer 20 minutes.
Bring to boiling.
Pour into hot jars and seal at once.

recipes.title: Frosted Fruit Salad
steps: Mix lemon and orange jello with hot water and add cold water after jello is fully melted.
Let begin to set and add remaining ingredients and chill well.

recipes.title: Pizza Cups
steps: Brown and drain beef.
Stir in tomato paste, onions and seasonings.
Mixture will be thick.
Cook over low heat 5 minutes, stirring often.

recipes.title: Zucchini Rounds
steps: In mixing bowl, stir together first 3 ingredients.
Add eggs and stir until mixture is moistened.
Fold in zucchini.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
steps: Beat cottage cheese with mixer until smooth or unlumpy.
Add other ingredients.
Mix.
Best if made several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Broccoli With Stuffing Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup (I use chicken)
1 pkg. herbed stuffing mix, cook as directed
steps: Cook broccoli as directed.
Cook herb stuffing mix as directed.
Combine egg, onion, soup and mayonnaise.
Place layer of broccoli in a 2-quart casserole.
Add layer of cheese.
Pour small amount of sauce on top.
Repeat layers until all are used. Top with cooked stuffing mix.
Pour butter on top.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Caramel Frosting
steps: Melt
margarine in large pan.
Blend in brown sugar and add salt.
Cook over low heat 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Add milk,
let
it
come
to a boil and remove from heat.
Add vanilla and mix well.
If frosting is too thick to spread, add small amount of milk.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Bars
steps: In 13 x 9 x 2-inch sheet cake pan, melt butter and sprinkle crumbs over evenly.
Then sprinkle coconut and chips and pour the milk over.
Sprinkle the nuts.
Press lightly and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Holiday Tea
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour mixture into boiling water to taste.

recipes.title: Christmas Punch
steps: Overloading your fireplace can cause a black, sooty stain on your fireplace face.
For brick, stone or other masonry products, there are two solutions to remove stains.

recipes.title: Chicken Livers
steps: Chop shallots in skillet.
Saute in the oil until tender. Dredge livers in flour.
Place over shallots until brown.
Cover with orange juice.
Cover and simmer until livers are tender.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 3/4 stick I Can't Believe It's Not Butter
steps: Combine all ingredients except butter and crackers.
Place in baking dish.
Combine butter and crackers.
Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Low Calorie French Dressing
steps: Salt and pepper to one's taste.
Combine ingredients; shake well.

recipes.title: Broccoli Bake
steps: Cook broccoli.
Melt cheese.
Add soup, milk and garlic.
Put in buttered casserole.
Add bread crumbs and margarine.
Bake at 350° for about a half hour.

recipes.title: Mystery Pie
steps: Roll crackers with rolling pin until crushed fine. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in sugar, salt and baking powder. Add crackers. Blend and add vanilla and nuts. Pour in greased pie pan. Cook about 30 minutes at 350°. Top with Cool Whip and chill.

recipes.title: Scrambled Eggs And Green Onion
steps: Saute onions in the butter in skillet, about 2 minutes.
Beat eggs slightly with fork and season with salt and pepper.
Add to onions and cook over low heat, stirring as egg sets.
When all is set, sprinkle with paprika.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Apricot Punch
steps: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Add other ingredients and chill. Add 1 quart cold ginger ale at serving time.
Makes 1 gallon.

recipes.title: Coconut Kisses
steps: Mix in order given; drop on greased
tin and bake in slow (325° to 350°) oven until done.

recipes.title: Chicken Breast In Wine
steps: Dredge chicken in seasoned flour.
Brown in oil and butter. Add wine and cover tightly.
Simmer for 1/2 hour.
Add grapes and toasted slivered almonds.
Cover and simmer for another 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Beef Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb. beef, thinly sliced in 3 x 1-inch pieces
1 medium onion, cut into bite size pieces
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon butter in nonstick skillet or wok.
Add beef and stir until brown.
Add broccoli, onion and carrots.
Cook until crunchy-tender.

recipes.title: Hall'S Chicken Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 chicken breast per person, in bite size chunks
1 c. old El Paso thick and chunky salsa
1/2 can black olives, pitted and sliced
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Stir-fry chicken chunks in large frying pan with 2 tablespoons olive oil.
After 2 minutes, add mushrooms and fry 2 more minutes.
Add soup, sour cream and salsa.
Blend.
Place mixture in casserole dish.
Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese on last 5 minutes to melt.
Garnish top with black olives and chopped scallions.
Serve over steamed rice or cooked noodles. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
