steps: Put popped corn in large plastic or glass bowl.
Stir together the sugar, butter, syrup and salt.
Cook at medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture boils.
Cook without stirring for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla and baking soda.
Pour over popcorn; stir to coat well.
Bake at 250° for 20 minutes. (Stir soon after putting in the oven.)
Break apart when cool. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Pear Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened to room temperature
steps: Bring pear juice to a boil.
Dissolve Jell-O in hot juice. Let cool and congeal a little.
Combine cream cheese and Cool Whip.
Mix well.
Add this to Jell-O.
Add pears and stir gently. Place in refrigerator to set.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cups
steps: Melt margarine.
Add peanut butter.
Mix well.
Add sugar. Mix well.
Spread into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour melted chips over peanut butter mixture.
Chill for 2 hours.
Cut into 1 to 2-inch squares.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Salad
ingredients: 1 medium pan baked corn bread (use your favorite recipe)
steps: Chop onions, peppers and tomatoes.
Add corn, mayonnaise, salt and pepper.
Mix into crumbled corn bread.

recipes.title: Spiced Nuts
steps: Cook to soft ball stage, 236°, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and add vanilla and walnuts.
Stir until grainy and put in buttered pan or on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hash
steps: Drain fruit cocktail and pineapple.
Mix all ingredients together and let set in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: N.C. Style Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: juice of 3 lemons (chopped rind of 1 lemon)
pinch of thyme, sweet basil, rosemary and crushed red pepper
steps: Heat first five ingredients in saucepan until hot.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Bring to rapid boil, then simmer slowly for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cream Sauce For Baked Potatoes
steps: Blend all ingredients together.

recipes.title: Pizza Casserole
steps: Cook and drain noodles.
Set aside.
Brown meat with green peppers and onion.
Add noodles, mushrooms and tomato sauce.
Mix together.
Put in 13 x 9 pan.
Top with the three cheeses and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Trifle
ingredients: 1 large box jello (same flavor as fruit)
English Bird's Eye custard sauce (if available)
steps: Cut pieces of cake and place in bottom of large serving bowl (optional:
sprinkle with rum or brandy).
Melt jello with 2 cups boiling water.
Pour over cake.
Cool in fridge.
Make vanilla pudding and pour over jello.
Spoon fruit over pudding.
When ready to serve, cover with whipped cream and garnish with fresh fruit and slivered almonds.
Serve with warm Bird's Eye custard and/or ice cream.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix with pudding
steps: Bake cake as directed on box in 9 x 13-inch pan; cool.
Cut into thirds.
Crumble up 1/3 in bottom of punch bowl.
Put layer of pudding, pineapple, cherries, nuts and Cool Whip in that order; repeat layers, starting with cake.
On last layer, put nuts on top of Cool Whip.
Cut cherries in small pieces and drain.
Put on top of nuts.
Better if made a few days ahead.

recipes.title: Halloween Treats(Easy Kid Recipe)
steps: Heat together the sugar and milk in a 2-quart saucepan.
Boil 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter, then add vanilla and crackers.
Mix well.
Cool.
Form into 1-inch balls. Makes 34.

recipes.title: Popsicles
steps: Add boiling water to jello, sugar and Kool-Aid.
Add cold water.
Pour into containers and freeze.

recipes.title: Casserole Of Vegetables
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can French-style green beans, drained
steps: Mix everything together except oleo and crackers.
Spread in greased 8 1/2 x 11-inch casserole dish.
Mix crushed crackers and oleo together and sprinkle over vegetables.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cookies
ingredients: 1 pkg. Betty Crocker yellow cake mix
steps: Cream the butter and cheese.
Blend in egg yolk and vanilla. Add dry cake mix 1/3 at a time; mix well after each addition.
If using a mixer, add last part of cake mix by hand.
Chill dough 30 minutes.
(Can be chilled overnight.)
Heat oven to 375°.
Finish cookies in one of the following ways:
Use a cookie press to shape cookies on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 6 to 9 minutes until delicately browned.
Cool cookies before removing from baking sheet.
Or, drop by scant teaspoonful on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool before removing from baking sheet.

recipes.title: Lemon Cake
steps: Mix the ingredients thoroughly with a mixer for 10 minutes. When well mixed, place in greased pan (13 x 9-inch) for 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven.

When done, remove cake from the oven and prick with large fork all over and all the way down through cake. Mix 1 cup powdered sugar with 1 cup of freshly squeezed lemons. Pour this mixture over the cake.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
steps: In 9 x 13-inch pan, layer cubed bread.
Mix eggs, milk and mustard together and pour over bread.
Crumble the sausage over this.
Sprinkle the cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
steps: Break angel food cake into small pieces.
Add layers of the following in a bowl:

cake, crushed pineapple, cake, cherry pie filling, cake, vanilla instant pudding (prepared according to package directions), cake, fruit cocktail and top with Cool Whip. Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate.
Great for small parties and family get-togethers.

recipes.title: French Fried Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen French fried potatoes
steps: Pour the 4 cups of water into a large saucepan; bring to a full, rolling boil.
Carefully drop frozen potatoes into water. Remove from heat immediately; cover and let stand 4 to 5 minutes. Drain potatoes at once.
Spread on paper toweling.
Cut up any large pieces.
Sprinkle potatoes with the salt; cool.
In bowl combine eggs, radishes, celery, green onion and snipped parsley. Add mayonnaise and vinegar.
Add potatoes and toss mixture gently. Chill.
Garnish with parsley and radish roses, if desired.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Quick Corn Biscuits
steps: Melt butter on a sided cookie sheet.
Mix Bisquick and corn. Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet.
Turn each biscuit so that it is coated with butter.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until golden. Yields 1 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Miso Soup
ingredients: 4 c. dashi (4 c. water and 1 Tbsp. hondashi, Japanese seasoning)
3 to 4 Tbsp. miso, or to taste
1 long green onion and top, cut into 1/2-inch lengths or 2-inch onions cut crosswise into thin slices
steps: *Peel and grate fresh ginger root, then squeeze.

recipes.title: Berans' Biscuit Bread
steps: Mix sugar and cinnamon together.
Cut biscuits into quarters and roll in sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Layer in Bundt pan, sprinkling chopped nuts on each layer.
Melt brown sugar and margarine together.
Pour over biscuits in Bundt pan.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Nut Clusters
ingredients: 1 tsp. shortening (do not use butter, margarine or oil)
steps: In medium microwave-safe bowl, place chocolate chips and shortening (Crisco).
Microwave on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until smooth when stirred.
Stir in nuts.
Spoon heaping teaspoons into 1-inch paper candy cups or paper-lined small muffin cups, filling each cup about half full.
Refrigerate until firm.
Peel off paper cup if desired.
Makes 14 to 16 candies.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Relish
steps: Put mixed spices in a bag, grind vegetables.
Let stand in salt water, 1 teaspoon to a quart of vegetables for 1 hour. Drain and add vinegar,
sugar
and bag.
Cook 20 minutes.
Add green color to make green.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
steps: Combine in 1 1/2-quart casserole peanuts, syrup, salt and sugar.
Microwave on High for 4 minutes.
Take out; stir. Microwave 4 more minutes.
Take out.
Add vanilla and margarine. Microwave 2 more minutes.
Take out; stir in baking soda (quickly).
Mixture will foam.
Pour out onto buttered cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Fried Cauliflower
steps: Break cauliflower into medium size pieces; par boil (about 2 minutes).
Take out of boiling water; run cold water over cauliflower.
Let excess water drain off.
Mix in a bowl Parmesan cheese and cracker crumbs.
Roll cauliflower in mixture.
Melt butter in frypan and cook on low until golden brown.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Lasagne
ingredients: 1 can (10 3/4 oz.) condensed cream of chicken soup
1 pkg. (10 oz.) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix milk and soup.
Spread 1/2 cup of the soup mixture in ungreased rectangular baking dish, 13 x 9 x 2-inches.
Top with 4 uncooked noodles.
Mix chicken, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, cottage cheese and spinach.
Spread half of the chicken mixture over noodles in dish; top with 1/2 cup of the soup mixture.
Repeat with 4 uncooked noodles, remaining chicken mixture and 1/2 cup of the soup mixture.
Top with remaining uncooked noodles and soup mixture.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake about 1 hour or until noodles are tender.
Uncover and let stand 15 minutes before cutting.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Drunken Figs
steps: Coffee:
Prepare strong black coffee, allow to cool and freeze in ice cube tray.

recipes.title: Deviled Crab Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh crabmeat, drained and flaked (you can substitute one 16 oz. container pasteurized crabmeat)
1/2 tsp. salt, Worcestershire sauce and hot sauce
steps: Combine crabmeat, 1 cup of bread crumbs, green pepper, parsley, chives and egg in a lightly greased 2-quart baking dish. Combine mayonnaise and next 6 ingredients; stir into crabmeat mixture.
Combine butter and remaining bread crumbs; sprinkle on top.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

recipes.title: Good And Easy Cheeseball
steps: Mix horseradish into softened cream cheese.
Form into a ball. Roll in finely chopped dried beef.
Make at least 8 hours in advance and refrigerate to allow flavors to blend.

recipes.title: David'S Quick And Easy Soup
ingredients: 3 unpeeled or peeled potatoes, chopped into bite size pieces
steps: Put water, bouillon cubes and potatoes in a pot; bring to a boil and lower heat.
While cooking, cut up carrots and add to the soup.
While soup is simmering, clean and cut mushrooms (add more if you love them, less if you don't); add to pot.
Bring it all to a boil and then cook on low heat, covered, for about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 3 c. each broccoli and cauliflower florets
1 large bell pepper, cut into strips
1 c. red wine vinaigrette (with Cabernet Sauvaigrette)
steps: Combine both dressings well.
Place all vegetables in a large bowl and pour dressing mix over them. Toss gently to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours, stirring several times.

recipes.title: French Toast
steps: Preheat griddle to 350°. Mix eggs, milk, vanilla, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg together. Dip bread in mixture. Cook on griddle. Cook until both sides are light brown. After you remove the bread, sprinkle both sides with sifted powdered sugar. No syrup needed.

recipes.title: Country Pork And Sauerkraut
steps: In a Dutch oven, cook ribs and onion in oil until ribs are slightly browned and onion is tender.
Remove from heat.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ribs.
Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1 1/2-2 hours or until ribs are fork tender.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cucumbers And Onions
steps: Soak sliced cucumbers in salt water as long as desired. Drain and cover with sliced onions. In a separate bowl combine other ingredients. Pour over cucumbers. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Veggie Fry
steps: Fry all ingredients in oil. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Double Layer Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 2 pkg. (4 serving size) Jell-O chocolate flavor instant pudding and pie filling
steps: Mix cream cheese, 1 tablespoon milk and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth.
Gently stir in 1/2 cups of the whipped topping.
Spread onto bottom of crust.
Pour 2 cups milk into large bowl.
Add pudding mixes.
Beat with wire whisk until well mixed.
(Mixture will be thick.)
Immediately stir in remaining whipped topping.
Spread over cream cheese layer. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set.
Garnish as desired.
Store leftover pie in refrigerator.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Lemon Sauce
steps: Combine sugar and cornstarch in a small saucepan; stir in the water.
Cook until clear and thickened, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.
Add remaining ingredients; stir until the butter is melted.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Steak And Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Cut steak into thin strips and cook in oil until done.
Keep strips covered while cooking.
Dissolve beef cubes in boiling water.
Add beef water to cooked strips.
Add soy sauce and spices.
Add vegetables and cook until tender.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 large bag crushed potato chips (save 1/2 c. to sprinkle on the top)
steps: Cook chicken, bone and cut into small pieces.
Butter 13 x 11-inch glass dish.
Line the bottom of the dish with the meat. Mix all of the remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over the meat. Sprinkle chips on top (optional).
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: Ritz cracker crumbs or French fried onion rings
steps: Drain vegetables and chestnuts.
Mix all ingredients, except butter and crackers; pour into a 3-quart casserole dish.
Top with Ritz cracker crumbs and butter that have been mixed together. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Hominy Casserole
ingredients: 2 (29 oz.) cans hominy, drained (or 4 regular cans)
2 (4 oz.) cans chopped green chilies, drained
steps: Grease a 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Combine ingredients and bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Or cook in a crock-pot for a couple of hours.

recipes.title: Variety Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 (28 oz.) can pork and beans, including sauce
steps: Combine ingredients and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350° in oven or in crock-pot on low for 4 to 5 hours.
To stretch for a bigger group, add an additional small can of pork and beans.

recipes.title: Cranberry Fruit
steps: Mash up cranberry sauce until fairly smooth.
Add other fruit with juices.
This is simple, but good!

recipes.title: Overnight Caramel Rolls
steps: Place rolls in a greased tube pan.
Pour 1/4 cup melted butter over rolls.
Combine pudding mix and brown sugar and sprinkle half over rolls.
Pour remaining butter over and sprinkle with rest of brown sugar mixture.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup nuts over.
Let rise 8 hours or overnight at room temperature.
Heat oven to 350° and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Venison Hindquarter
steps: Salt, pepper and place tenderizer on a whole hindquarter (this will work as well with roast, neck, etc.).
Make a paste with hot water and onion soup mix.
Paint it over the quarter.
Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce over the entire quarter.
Place 1 cup of water in a large pan that can be covered.
Place quarter in pan and cover.
Place in 250° oven for approximately 12 hours.
Cut in bite-size pieces and serve with barbecue sauce.

recipes.title: Easy Bread Pudding
steps: Heat to scalding the milk, margarine, sugar and salt.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake in buttered casserole at 350° for 40 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

recipes.title: Flounder Ala Micro
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. fish (flounder, bass fillet, catfish, crappie, red fish)
steps: Scour flounder on both sides.
Place fish in a 9 x 12-inch Pyrex dish.
Sprinkle liberally with steak seasoning.
Rub in seasoning vigorously. Place flounder in dish brown side up.
Melt margarine in cup; add 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice and Worcestershire to margarine and stir.
Pour margarine concoction over flounder. Slice bell pepper and onion and lay on top of flounder.
Cover with Saran Wrap.
Cook for 11 minutes at Full power.

recipes.title: Thousand Island Dressing
steps: Chop eggs and olives.
Mix all ingredients well; add salt to taste.

recipes.title: Cheese-Frosted Cauliflower
steps: Remove leaves; trim base from cauliflower.
Wash.
Precook whole in boiling salted water 12 to 15 minutes.
Drain.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 3 large cans chunk pineapple, drained (save juice)
1 (5 1/4 oz.) pkg. vanilla Jell-O instant pudding
steps: Pour 1 cup of pineapple juice in a large, glass bowl and add instant pudding.
Stir until thick.
Add fruit and serve.

recipes.title: Gob Cake
steps: Mix well and pour batter on 2 large cookie sheets lined with foil.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Place on clean towel to cool.
Remove foil.
Mix 5 tablespoons flour and 1 cup milk; cook on medium heat until thickened, then cool in refrigerator.
In another bowl, cream 1 cup powdered sugar with 1/2 cup Crisco and 1 stick butter, add cooled flour paste and mix well.
More sugar may be needed to thicken.
Put between layers and chill cake in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Steak Supper In Foil Package
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
steps: Place meat in
x 18-inch foil or roasting pan.
Top with onion soup and mushroom soup.
Place carrots and potatoes around. Sprinkle with
water
and
seal the foil.
Cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 450°.

recipes.title: Chili
ingredients: 1/4 c. each diced green peppers and onions
steps: Brown ground meat in small amount of oil.
Remove excess grease.
Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 1 to 2 hours.
Serve with grated cheese and sour cream.

recipes.title: Irish Potato Casserole
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, diced and boiled for 3 minutes
1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
steps: Cook potatoes; drain.
Add soup and onions.
Mix with 3/4 cup cheese and save remaining for top.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Hummus
ingredients: 1 2/3 c. (15 oz. can) cooked chickpeas, drained, reserve liquid
steps: In blender (in batches) or in food processor, process chickpeas, tahini and lemon juice until mixture reaches consistency of coarse paste; use as much of reserved pea liquid or water as needed.
Add garlic, coriander, cumin, paprika and cayenne and process again.
Transfer to a bowl and add scallions. Cover and chill one hour before serving the dip.
Add parsley as garnish.

recipes.title: Cocktail Meatballs
steps: Mix all ingredients except oil thoroughly.
Form into small balls, about 3/4 inch.
Let stand for 15 minutes. Heat oil in frying pan and deep fry meatballs for 1 to 2 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Herb Marinade
steps: This marinade is wonderful for chicken or fish.
Marinate for 1 to 8 hours. Serves 3 pounds.

recipes.title: Christmas Punch
steps: Mix together and pour over ice in punch bowl.
Smaller amounts may be used.

recipes.title: Lime Mold
steps: Mix the cream cheese and milk until creamy.
Add hot juice to Jell-O.
Stir in cream cheese until dissolved. Chill until it starts to thicken (about 7 minutes).
Add Cool Whip and nuts. Chill in a large mold pan until firm.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. box angel hair pasta, cooked, drained and cooled
steps: Mix the dressing according to directions on package. Mix all ingredients together and keep in the refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: E-Z Cobbler
steps: Mix cake as directed and pour in oblong baking pan. Pour fruit on top of mix-in the center. Bake as directed on cake box and serve with ice cream or cool whip.

recipes.title: Pink Salad
steps: Beat together all ingredients and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Pecan Topped Grahams
steps: In a small saucepan, combine butter and sugar over low heat until butter is melted.
Stir well.
Remove from heat; stir in corn syrup and pecans.
Place 1 tablespoon of mixture on top of each graham cracker.
Spread to edges with spatula.
Place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 5 to 6 minutes.
Cool, then break into squares.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°.

recipes.title: Sweet Potatoes And Apples
ingredients: 3 med sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced to 1/4 inch
4 Granny Smith apples, peeled and sliced
steps: Place sweet potatoes in buttered 9 x 13 pan.
Cover with apples and then marshmallows.
Mix cornstarch with water and pour over everything.
Dot with butter and sprinkle with pecans.
Cover tightly with foil and bake at 375° until potatoes are tender, about one hour.

recipes.title: Party Pizzas(Snack)
steps: Brown beef and sausage together and drain.
Add cheese and remaining ingredients.
Spread on small party rye bread.
Bake at 350°
for 10 minutes.
Serve hot.
Can be made ahead and frozen.

recipes.title: Salmon Loaf
steps: Mix all ingredients together with fork.
Place in greased small loaf pan.
Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Taco Salad Tostada
ingredients: 1 (14 1/4 oz.) pkg. Taco Bell home originals cheesy double-decker taco dinner
1/2 c. Taco Bell home originals salsa
steps: Cook and season ground beef with taco seasoning as directed on package. Spread each crisped tortilla with 1 tablespoon of the nacho cheese sauce. Top with meat mixture and lettuce. Crumble 1 taco shell over each tostada. Top evenly with tomato, shredded cheese and salsa. Makes 6 servings, 1 tostada each.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 small can chunk pineapple with juice
1 small pkg. frozen strawberries with sugar added
steps: Mix all ingredients, except Cool Whip.
Fold in Cool Whip. Freeze and serve.

recipes.title: Salmon Casserole
steps: Mix and put in baking dish.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Brenda'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients with spoon.
Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with chocolate chips and pecans.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Let cool.
Cut and enjoy.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Cookies
steps: Lay graham crackers on well-greased 11 x 15-inch cookie sheet. Boil the margarine and sugar 2 minutes only.
Add nuts and pour over crackers.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Do not overbake.
Break into serving size.

recipes.title: Pink Delight
steps: Place pineapple in a large saucepan.
Add jello and heat until jello dissolves.
Remove from heat.
Cool slightly.
Add remaining ingredients and blend thoroughly.
Pour into mold or bowl.
Chill.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
steps: Boil 2 pints water, chili powder, cumin seed, garlic, catsup, salt and butter for 30 minutes.
Then add cornstarch and 1/2 cup water until thickens.
Keep warm.

recipes.title: Candy Covered Dried Fruit
ingredients: dried fruit (any type of your choice)
white chocolate or milk chocolate, melted
steps: Dip half of each piece of the dried fruit into melted chocolate and place on wax paper to dry.

recipes.title: Cheese Dip In A Bread Bowl
ingredients: 1 (3 to 5 lb.) loaf round rye or dill bread
steps: Put the first 6 ingredients in a bowl to soften for about 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, take the round bread and slice off the top. Hollow out.
Save top and inside of bread to place around the bowl for dipping.
When cheese is soft, slowly add the beer and beat until smooth and fluffy.
Pour into bread bowl and refrigerate. Serve on a round bread board or platter with reserved bread, crackers and party bread.

recipes.title: Caramel Pie
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: Place unopened can of Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk in a pan.
Cover with at least an inch of water.
Turn oven on high until water boils.
Turn oven down just enough to keep the water boiling.
Boil for three hours.

recipes.title: Venison Stew
steps: Combine carrots, potatoes, venison, consomme, salt, onion flakes, celery and mushrooms in crock-pot.
Cook on low for 10 to 12 hours.

recipes.title: Lime Jello Salad
steps: Prepare jello as directed, but decrease water by 1/2 cup.
Add cream cheese while jello mixture is still warm and crush with fork.
Drain pineapple and add to jello.
Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan and chill.

recipes.title: Tommy'S Strawberry Pie
steps: Bake 2 pie shells (frozen), according to directions.
In pan mix 2 cups sugar, Jell-O and cornstarch.
Add 2 cups water and stir well.
Bring to boil and stir until thickens.
Remove from heat and cool.
Fill pie shells with sliced berries and pour over mixture.
Refrigerate until set well.
Serve with Cool Whip or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Ever Green Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill.
May use different flavor Kool-Aid for other colors.
Also different kinds of fruit juice, to suit the occasion and color theme.
Serves 50 people.

recipes.title: Chip Dip
steps: Blend together and chill.
The longer chilled, the better. Good also with carrot or celery sticks.

recipes.title: Chicken Teriyaki
ingredients: 1 bag Birds Eye broccoli, carrots and water chestnuts
steps: Prepare vegetables as directed.
Add teriyaki sauce; let simmer.
Cook chicken strips; add to vegetables.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Jello Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines deluxe yellow cake mix
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Pour in cake pan or an angel food cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Mirliton Casserole
steps: Peel and cut mirlitons in small cubes.
Cook 25 minutes with garlic, 1/2 of onions, bell peppers and celery.
Saute shrimp and meat with remainder of vegetables in 3 tablespoons oil.
Cook 20 minutes.
Add can of gravy.
Combine with mirliton mixture, chopped tomato and seasonings.
Cook 15 minutes.
Season to taste.

recipes.title: Five Cup Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients and chill.

recipes.title: Honey Chicken Nuggets
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Works best if slightly frozen. Mix honey and egg white in small bowl. Crush corn flakes really fine and place on a plate or in
small bowl. You will need to judge how much you prefer. First dip chicken into honey mixture, then roll into corn flakes. Place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Spicy Cranberry Sundae Pie
steps: Prepare graham cracker crust or store bought one.
Freeze. Combine first four ingredients, then stir into ice cream.
Spread into crust.
Freeze.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookie Freeze
steps: Mix together Oreos and margarine.
Pat mixture into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Spread ice cream on top and freeze until firm.

recipes.title: Horseradish Cheese Ball
steps: In small bowl with electric mixer, blend cheese and horseradish until smooth.
Mix in salts and beef until well blended.
With hands, shape into a ball.
Wrap and refrigerate overnight or until firm.
Reshape and roll in chopped parsley. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Spread
steps: Chop up the ham and onions.
Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate several hours before serving. Serve on snack crackers.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Beef And Vegetables
ingredients: 1 pkg. Birds Eye Farm Fresh broccoli, carrots and water chestnuts
steps: Combine steak, garlic, soy sauce and ginger.
Heat oil in large skillet or wok; add meat mixture.
Cook just until all pink color disappears.
Add vegetables; stir quickly to coat with oil, then reduce heat to medium.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring once. Mix cornstarch with water; add to veggie mixture.
Cook and stir about 1 minute until sauce is thickened.
Serve over hot rice, if desired.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Peach Pie
ingredients: 1 can sliced peaches, drained and chopped
steps: In large mixing bowl combine cream cheese, sugar and vanilla. Beat until smooth.
Gently fold in La Creme and peaches.
Pour into crust.
Chill until firm, about 4 hours.

recipes.title: Pear Congealed Salad
steps: Put pear juice in jello and bring to a boil.
Mash pears and cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Pour all of this into dish. Let set to semi hard, then add Cool Whip and fold in.
Return to refrigerator to finish setting.

recipes.title: Meat And Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 (7 oz.) can tuna, ham or turkey
steps: Combine meat or tuna fish, celery, macaroni, salt, pepper and chopped, cooked eggs.
Add salad dressing and mix well.
Cover and refrigerate a few hours before serving.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cinnamon Popcorn Spice
ingredients: 1/4 c. semi-sweet chocolate chips, chilled and finely ground
steps: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.
Stir until well blended.
Store in a large spice shaker.

recipes.title: California Casserole
steps: Boil vegetables; drain. Melt 1/2 of the margarine in saucepan. Crumble crackers, then add to melted margarine. Set aside. Melt other half of margarine and add to soup and cheese to make sauce. Place vegetables in dish. Pour sauce over vegetables and sprinkle cracker mixture on top. Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Delicious Cheesecake
steps: Cream together well all
ingredients.
Pour into graham cracker pie crust.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until set. Spread favorite pie filling on top.

recipes.title: Cavatini
ingredients: 3 different shapes macaroni, 1 c. each, uncooked
steps: Cook macaroni first, add browned hamburger.
Mix macaroni, spaghetti sauce, basil, mushrooms, onion, green pepper, tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper to taste.
Pour into a large 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Put sliced pepperoni all over top and sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top of that and then sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until thoroughly cooked.

recipes.title: Sweet Pickles
steps: Make paste of lime and water.
Mix well.
Add water (enough to cover cucumbers).
Let soak overnight.
Drain and wash thoroughly in clear water (will take about 4 washings).
After 5th washing, soak 4 hours and wash well.
Dissolve sugar in red vinegar.
Add cucumbers and let soak 3 to 4 hours.
Add pickling spice and boil for 1 hour.
Pack in jars and seal.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
ingredients: 1 box 1 step white angel food cake mix
steps: Use mixer and mix dry cake mix and lemon pie filling.
Pour into a floured and greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan or 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet.
Smooth out and make sure batter is even.
Bake 25 minutes at 350°.
Frost with a thin glaze, using powdered sugar and lemon extract.

recipes.title: Baked Spaghetti
steps: Simmer for 3 hours.
(Watch closely and stir often; wants to stick.)
Cook spaghetti and put in a pan.
Pour sauce over spaghetti; cover with Mozzarella cheese.
Put in oven and brown the cheese.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix (not pudding cake mix)
steps: Mix and pour into 3 (8-inch) round cake pans; bake.

recipes.title: Jogging In A Jug
ingredients: 48 oz. (6 c.) grape or cranberry juice
steps: Combine all ingredients.
The amount of vinegar may be adjusted to suit the taste.
I add a couple of packages of Sweet 'N Low also.

recipes.title: Bisquick "Corny" Bread Sticks
steps: Mix Bisquick, corn and sugar.
Roll out to medium thickness; will rise.
Dough is sticky.
Sprinkle surface lightly with flour as needed and pat out with hands on floured surface (works better than rolling pin).
Cut into strips similar to chicken pastry dough.
Meanwhile, melt butter in a large oven roaster or similar pan.
Remove from oven and lay strips of dough (about size of 2 fingers) in melted butter.
Dough is still rather difficult to work with but have patience; some folks think it's worth the effort! Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Turn all pieces over and bake 5 to 10 minutes more, until golden brown.

recipes.title: Date Nut Roll(Candy)
steps: Cook together sugar, dates and Pet milk until it forms a soft ball in cold water.
Cool to lukewarm.
Beat a few strokes.
Add nuts and butter.
Knead on a tabletop.
Knead well into powdered sugar.
It will be firm, but not stiff.
Roll into cylinder mold. Let stand 24 hours before slicing.
This recipe will make 2 or 3 rolls.
Slice only enough for occasion.
Place in tin; will keep several weeks.

recipes.title: Pasta Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 green pepper, halved, seeded and chopped
1 pkg. macaroni shells (1 lb.; use the large macaroni shells)
steps: Combine tomatoes and their juice, pepper, cucumber, salt, pepper and oil in a large bowl. Toss gently. Add onion, garlic and parsley. Toss again. Cover and let stand at room temperature 2 hours for flavors to blend.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Salad
steps: Dissolve gelatin in water, lemon juice and salt.
Cool.
Grind onion and pepper; drain off all juice.
Mix onion and pepper with cottage cheese, mayonnaise and nuts.
Combine the two mixtures and place in a mold to chill and set.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix with pudding
steps: Whisk first 3 ingredients.
Mix next 4 ingredients and then add chips.
Bake in sprayed bundt pan at 350° for 1 hour.
Turn out of pan immediately.

recipes.title: Orange Jello Salad
steps: Make Jell-O and pudding according to package directions.
Cook pudding.
Slightly jell the Jell-O to 1/2 done.
Mix the cooled pudding and Jell-O together, then layer Jell-O/pudding mixture, then Cool Whip, then Jell-O/pudding mixture, ending with Cool Whip on top and sprinkle with coconut.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate
ingredients: 1 family size pkg. fudge brownie mix
8 Skor or Heath candy bars, crushed
steps: Bake brownies; punch with a fork and pour almond extract over them.
Break into chunks and put into a large glass bowl; make mousse according to package directions.
Layer half the mousse. Add half of the candy bars and half of the Cool Whip.
Repeat each layer in order, beginning with the brownie chunks and ending with crushed candy bars on top.
You'll think you've died and gone to heaven when you see and taste this dessert.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients together in small bowl. Add butter and nuts last. Cook at 350° for 45 minutes or until they are not juicy in the middle and do not shake.

recipes.title: Pizza Casserole
ingredients: 1 green pepper, chopped and sauteed with meat
1 large can pizza sauce (15 to 16 oz.)
steps: Mix altogether in large bowl and then pour in greased 10 x 17-inch cake pan.
Then put one layer pizza cheese (2 cups), one layer of Parmesan cheese.
Top with layer of chopped pepperoni. Cover with foil and bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Very good.

recipes.title: Super Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 lb. shrimp, cooked and cut up
1 small can minced clams or crabmeat, drained (optional)
steps: Use fresh or frozen shrimp (not canned) for this recipe.
Mix all ingredients and chill.
Serve with chips or vegetable sticks.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 regular cans fruit cocktail in syrup
steps: Drain fruit cocktail and pineapple.
Save juice.
Drain and discard juice from mandarin oranges.
Peel bananas and slice thinly.
Take large bowl.
Combine fruits, juices and bananas. Sprinkle pudding over the top and mix well.
Chill.
Add marshmallows, if desired.
If needed, add more pudding.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight
steps: Blend together cream cheese, milk and powdered sugar.
Spread over baked, cooled pie crust.
Sprinkle with chopped pecans. Spread Cool Whip over pecans.
Chill in refrigerator.
Top with fresh strawberries before serving.
Also, can use Thank You cherry pie filling for topping.

recipes.title: Holiday Fruit Punch
steps: Pour boiling water over tea and strain.
Add sugar and cool. Mix orange juice, lemon juice, pineapple juice and ginger ale. Add to tea.
Serve over ice.
You may garnish with sliced fruit and cherries, if you like.
Makes about 16 servings.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Cabbage Soup
steps: In oil, saute chopped onion and garlic, just until limp in a Dutch oven.
Add water and chicken cubes.
Add shredded cabbage and carrots; cook until tender.
Add all remaining ingredients; add more water, if needed.
Cook until done.

recipes.title: Vidalia Onion Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients. Pour into an ungreased baking dish. Bake at 350° until browning on top, approximately 30 to 40 minutes. Serve with your favorite small cracker.

recipes.title: Daddy'S Custard
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. rose essence or almond extract
steps: First
take
coconut
milk,
heat 2 1/2 cups whole milk. Add 2
cups
flaked
or
shredded coconut.
Simmer 10 minutes. Pour into
blender
container and whirl at highest speed until coconut is finely ground.
Strain through strainer.
Beat eggs until whites
are no longer stringy (eggs should not be foamy). Add sugar
and
coconut
milk.
Stir until sugar is dissolved. Blend evaporated
milk,
cardamon, mace, cloves and flavoring. Pour into
baking
dish,
place dish into pot half-filled with boiling water.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until knife inserted in the center comes
out clean.
Cool, cover and chill, decorate with coconut.

recipes.title: Rolled Beef Log
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can tomato sauce with onions
3 oz. thinly sliced Italian dry salami
steps: Blend together beef, eggs, bread crumbs, oregano, garlic salt, cayenne and 1/2 can tomato sauce with onions.
Mix well.
Pat meat into a 16 x 10-inch rectangle on wax paper or aluminum foil.

recipes.title: Linguine Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) bottle Wish-Bone Italian salad dressing
steps: Boil linguine according to directions on package; drain and cool.
Mix together remaining ingredients thoroughly, then add linguine.
Refrigerate overnight.
Stir several times.
Will keep well 4 or 5 days.

recipes.title: Veggie Wedgies
ingredients: finely cut raw vegetables (broccoli, celery, carrot, pepper, olives, tomatoes; anything you like)
steps: Spread out crescent rolls on cookie sheet.
Pinch seams together and bake until golden.
Cool completely.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Dressing
ingredients: 4 c. toasted dry bread cubes or crumbled biscuits
steps: Brown the onion and celery in butter in a heavy skillet. Combine with bread cubes, corn bread and seasonings.
Pour on the broth and stir lightly to blend.
Stuff fowl and roast according to weight of bird.
This amount of dressing is for a 4 1/2 to 5 pound bird.
For larger fowl double the amount.

recipes.title: Blueberry Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Drain blueberries and pineapple.
Measure liquid.
Add enough water to make 1 cup.
Add to jello.
Stir in blueberries and pineapple.
Pour into 2-quart flat pan and refrigerate until set.
Combine sugar, sour cream, cream cheese and vanilla.
Spread over jello layer.
Sprinkle pecans on top.
May be used as salad or dessert.

recipes.title: Ugly Duckling Pudding Cake
ingredients: 1 (2 layer size) pkg. yellow cake mix
1 (4 serving size) pkg. lemon instant pudding
1 (16 oz.) can fruit cocktail with syrup
steps: Blend all ingredients except brown sugar and nuts in large mixing bowl.
Beat 4 minutes at medium speed.
Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or when cake springs back and pulls away from sides.
Do not underbake.
Cool in pan 15 minutes. Spoon hot butter glaze over warm cake.

recipes.title: Divinity
steps: Combine sugar with water and Karo.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved.
Continue cooking until very hard, brittle ball is formed or a thread spins (275° or 280° on candy thermometer).
Remove from fire.
Add syrup gradually to 2 stiffly beaten egg whites beaten until stiff but not dry. Turn to medium speed and continue beating until stiff.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Drop from teaspoon on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Diner Meat Loaf
steps: Mix beef, pork, oatmeal and eggs.
Blend in rest of ingredients.
Pack in 9 x 5-inch loaf pan, shaping into a rounded top.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.
Drain off any excess juice.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Blender Coconut Custard Pie
steps: Blend all ingredients in a blender for 2 minutes.
Pour into a buttered 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: White Grape Punch 7Rom Southern Living
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) frozen lemonade, thawed and undiluted
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients.
Chill well and stir in club soda just before serving. Yields 3 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Stuffed Artichoke Bread
steps: Saute onions until tender; add remaining ingredients (except bread) and set aside.
Dig the center of the French bread out until only bosee shell is left.
Place the cheese mixture in shell and spread evenly.
Wrap entire mixture in the bread loaf in foil and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Serve hot with chips or crackers.

recipes.title: Oven Beef Stew
ingredients: 4 c. tomato juice with 2 Tbsp. soy sauce
steps: Chop vegetables in bite-size pieces.
Layer all ingredients in order given.
Seal with foil.
Bake 4 hours at 250°.
Use a large roaster pan.
Makes a large amount.

recipes.title: Orange Pineapple Dessert
steps: Cut all fruit and slightly drain.
Keep about 1 to 2 cups of juice.
Blend everything together (fruit, coconut, sour cream and marshmallows).
Put in refrigerator for about 3 or 4 hours.
Before you are ready to serve, add remaining juice to desired consistency.

recipes.title: Orange Delight
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients and bring to a boil.
Boil until thickened; then set aside and cool.
Fold in the Cool Whip and drained mandarin oranges.
Chill.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip Or Sandwich Spread
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped (use 1/2 can)
steps: Cook spinach according to directions on box and add a small amount of salt.
Drain spinach and press out all moisture.
Add vegetable soup mix to spinach.
Mix all other ingredients and add to spinach, mixing well.
Cover.
Place in refrigerator for several hours or overnight.
Freeze unused amount for later use.

recipes.title: Cheese Pie
steps: Combine sugar and melted butter.
Add other ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Carrot Puree
steps: Boil carrots until soft.
Puree in Cuisinart all ingredients. Place in casserole and cool for 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Apricot Sticks
steps: Through food chopper, using medium blade, force dried apricots and seeded, medium, whole orange.
Put through chopper a second time.
Put in top of double boiler and stir in sugar.
Put over boiling water and cook, covered, 30 minutes or until quite stiff. Cool and stir in chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Mock Lemon Pie
steps: Mix together sugar,
egg yolks, vinegar and cornstarch. Add boiling water.
Cook
like	custard
(in a double boiler). Add lemon extract and cool.
Put
beaten
egg
whites
on top. Place in a 350° oven for 15 minutes to brown.

recipes.title: Italian Food
steps: From Lewisville go west on 1171; turn south on 2499.
Go approximately 1 block and turn right into Salerno's Restaurant.
If you are coming from another direction area call 539-9534 and get directions.
The address is 3407 Long Prairie Road, Flower Mound. Tell them Dan sent you and they will let you order anything on the menu at the regular price.

recipes.title: Date Nut Roll
steps: Crush crackers in food processor; mix with Eagle Brand milk. Cut nuts, dates and fruit together.
Pour lemon juice and water over them; stir well.
Roll cracker crumbs that have been mixed with the milk in the sugar (just enough to keep from sticking). Spread out same as biscuit dough.
Spread nuts, dates and fruit on dough; roll it like a jelly roll.
Let chill about 6 to 8 hours. Slice as you would a jelly roll.

recipes.title: Sauteed Mushrooms And Onions
steps: Heat oil in skillet.
Add onions and saute over medium heat until onions are translucent.
Add mushrooms, salt and pepper. Saute until mushrooms are cooked.

recipes.title: Chocolate Banana Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. devil's food chocolate cake mix
steps: Mix cake mix, sour cream, eggs, water and bananas.
Add in nuts, cherries and chocolate chips.
Bake as directed on box and enjoy!

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
steps: Cook Eggs.
Cut in halves, remove yolks and mash into a paste adding Ranch Dressing until moist.
Add mixture to egg whites. Garnish with olives or sprinkle paprika on top.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake Filling
steps: Wash and slice strawberries.
Cook sugar, cornstarch, 7-Up and food coloring until thick.
Cool.
Add cream (strawberries may be cooked in filling).
Layer of filling and layer of Cool Whip between layers.
(Can use frozen strawberries; thaw and drain, whole box.)

recipes.title: Company Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb. bag frozen Southern Style hash browns
steps: Saute onions and celery in butter until onions are clear (do not brown).
Mix all ingredients and put into buttered or Pam sprayed casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Casserole is done when potatoes are tender.

recipes.title: Cajun Pork Ribs
steps: Thaw well in refrigerator 1 1/2 to 2 days before use.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken
ingredients: 3 to 3 1/2 lb. chicken pieces (wings, breasts, legs, whatever)
steps: Combine
marinade
ingredients.
Put chicken in shallow baking dish
and	pour
marinade over.
Cover and refrigerate overnight. Turn chicken pieces occasionally.	Preheat oven to 375°.
Line broiler pan with foil and arrange chicken on rack (slotted top
of broiler pan) or can use foil lined baking pan and rack.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.	Baste occasionally with leftover marinade while it's baking.

recipes.title: Congealed Strawberry Salad
steps: Combine
Jell-O, water, strawberries and pineapple in a bowl. Let
thicken and then add bananas.	Pour 1/2 of mixture into cold Pyrex dish.
Refrigerate.
When thick and firm, pour whole carton of sour cream on top of Jell-O and spread evenly. Pour
other half
of Jell-O mixture on top.
Serve with salad dressing or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Summer Squash
steps: Cook squash
in a small amount of boiling, salted water until tender.
Drain.
Saute
onion
in
oleo;
add
squash, stirring to mix.
Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 1 quart casserole. Top
with
eggs,
cheese
and corn chips.
Bake at 350° about 15 minutes or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Unbaked Fruit Cake
steps: Melt marshmallows and margarine in heavy pan.
Remove from heat.
Add other ingredients.
Mix well.
Pack in Bundt pan.
Put in refrigerator for at least 3 days.
Remove from pan.
Keep refrigerated until all eaten.

recipes.title: Barboursville Almond Macaroons
steps: Place almond paste, sugar and lemon juice in a mixing bowl. Add 8 unbeaten egg whites and mix to form a soft dough.
Add the remaining egg white only if necessary.
Using a teaspoon, drop the dough onto a buttered cookie sheet.
Bake in a preheated 375° oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Easy Banana Pudding
ingredients: 1 (1.3 oz.) large box sugar-free vanilla instant pudding
steps: Blend pudding mix into milk.
Stir in condensed milk.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Put a layer of vanilla wafers in the bottom of a glass bowl (never use a metal bowl) and cover with a layer of bananas, sliced thin (adds more flavor).
Cover with a generous layer of pudding mix.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Cook and drain vegetables.
Simmer celery for 10 minutes with 2 tablespoons of butter.
Mix together with vegetables and celery.

recipes.title: Taco Pie
steps: Flatten biscuits in bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Brown meat and drain.
Add tomato sauce and 1/2 can of water.
Add taco mix.
Cut up onion and green pepper; add to meat mixture. Cook 10 minutes on low until thickened.
Spread over biscuits and sprinkle cheese over top.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Chocolate Macaroon Cookies
ingredients: 19 oz. cake mix (chocolate or any flavor)
steps: Mix all ingredients together and drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes or until done.
Cool and put 2 cookies together, filling with vanilla frosting.

recipes.title: Good Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen California vegetables (broccoli, carrots and cauliflower)
steps: Mix all of the ingredients together.
Put in greased casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Michael'S Pirate Pie
steps: Beat eggs slightly; add to meat (or fish).
Add mushrooms. Place in the bottom of a well-greased pie tin.
Top with tomato slices and cheese slices.
Spoon mashed potatoes over cheese. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Cut into wedges and serve hot.

recipes.title: Egg Custard(Makes 2 Pies)
steps: Place milk and cream in a boiler and heat.
Do not boil.
Set aside.
Mix eggs, sugar, vanilla and lemon extract.
Pour milk into this mixture.
Pour into 2 pie shells.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until middle is done.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Roll Up
steps: Separate sliced of pepperoni.
Spread about 1 tablespoon, more or less, cream cheese on each slice.
Roll up by taking one side of round and then the other side of round to form cone shape. Arrange on platter.

recipes.title: Easy Deep Dish Pizza
steps: Mix until soft dough forms.
Knead on floured surface 5 minutes.
Roll into rectangle, 5 x 10-inch.
Punch edge.
Put in jelly roll pan or cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
steps: Cook sugar and syrup 4 minutes on High heat.
Add peanuts; stir and cook 4 minutes again on High heat.
Add butter and vanilla and cook again for 1 1/2 minutes.
Thoroughly fold in soda.
Pour into buttered pan.
Let set for 1/2 hour before breaking into pieces.

recipes.title: Quick Garlic Bread
steps: Spray rolls with the cooking spray.
Sprinkle with garlic powder and parsley.
Toast in toaster oven until brown and crunchy.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Casserole
ingredients: 6 medium yellow squash, sliced in rounds
1 c. grated American or Cheddar cheese
steps: Cook squash in covered pan in small amount of water along with the onion; squash makes its own liquids; needs only enough water to get it started.
Cook until tender but not falling apart.
Drain and combine with bread, egg, salt, pepper, basil and half the cheese.
Butter 2-quart casserole.
Place the mixture in it and dot with butter.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake in preheated oven at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes or until firm.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cherry Roll
steps: Mix well; then roll in powdered sugar until coated.
Freeze 1 hour; then slice and serve.

recipes.title: Potato Candy
ingredients: 1 small potato, cooked, drained and mashed
steps: Add confectioners sugar to mashed potato until stiff and add vanilla.
Roll on waxed paper and spread with peanut butter.
Roll up and slice thin.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Mix sugar and cinnamon together.
Cut biscuits apart.
Roll each biscuit in sugar and cinnamon mixture. Place in pie plate and bake 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Sausage Casserole
steps: Brown and drain sausage.
Mix soup, milk, onion, salt and pepper together.
In large casserole, layer potatoes and soup mixture.
Add sausage and cheese.
Repeat layer again, ending with sausage.
Dot with butter and bake, covered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Top with cheese slices last 15 minutes of cooking time.

recipes.title: Apricot Balls
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Roll into balls. Roll balls in powdered sugar. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Beef Delicious
steps: Grease skillet and add beef, onions, salt and pepper and cook until brown.
Cook macaroni and drain.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken or cream of celery soup
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Brown ground beef and onion.
Add celery and soups.
Place in 2-quart buttered casserole and cover with as many Tater Tots as you can get on. This is quick, easy and kids love it.
Bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Michael'S Banana Creme Pie
steps: Put slices of bananas in bottom of crust.
Make pudding according to package.
Pour over bananas.
Top with more banana slices.
Cover with whipped topping.
Refrigerate 1 hour.

recipes.title: Potato Candy
steps: Mix potato, sugar and vanilla together.
Roll out like a pie shell.
Cover with a thin layer of peanut butter.
Add nuts on top of peanut butter, then roll up into a roll and slice into about 1/2 to 1-inch slices.

recipes.title: Jello Pie
ingredients: juice and grated rind of 1 lemon
steps: Prepare Jell-O and let set (not too solid) and whip.
Add 1/2 cup sugar, rind and juice of lemon.
Whip evaporated milk and mix with Jell-O mixture.
Mix graham cracker crumbs, cinnamon, 1/4 cup sugar and shortening.
Cover pan.
Sprinkle a few nuts on top and a little of graham cracker mixture.
Form graham cracker mix in 8-inch pie plate.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Mary'S Quick Stew
steps: Brown hamburger.
Add onion, pepper and parsley; simmer until onion and pepper are clear.
Add tomato sauce, carrots, potatoes and salt.
Simmer 10 more minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Swiss
steps: Place chicken breasts in an ungreased baking dish.
Place a slice of Swiss cheese over each piece of chicken.
In a separate bowl, mix together the chicken soup and the white wine.
Pour mixture over the cheese and chicken.
Top with croutons.
Bake at 350° for 1 hours.
Serve with rice or angel hair pasta.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
steps: 1st Layer:
Melt 1 stick of oleo and mix with graham cracker crumbs.
Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 small (4 oz.) can diced green chilies
1 (10 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
steps: Mix together soup, broth, chilies and pepper.
Set aside. Soften tortillas by dipping one tortilla at a time into hot oil. Drain tortillas on paper towel and stack.

recipes.title: Bertha'S Casserole
steps: Mix all together and top with crushed cheese crackers and butter.
Bake till golden brown. 350° about 40 minutes.
Can be doubled for a large group.

recipes.title: Orange Cream Fruit Salad
steps: Combine drained fruits and set aside.
In small bowl, combine pudding mix, milk and orange juice concentrate.
Beat with mixer until blended.
Beat in sour cream.
Fold into fruit mixture and chill.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Strawberry Crumble Cake
steps: Layer strawberries in bottom of Pyrex dish.
Spread pineapple over strawberries. Sprinkle cake mix over mixture and cut butter over cake mix.
Bake at 300° for 50 to 60 minutes, then let cool and put Cool Whip on top.

recipes.title: Chicken Liver Pate
steps: Melt butter in a large skillet; add onion, garlic and thyme. Saute over medium heat until onion is tender (about 10 minutes). Transfer to bowl and set aside.

recipes.title: Egg Nog Pie
ingredients: 2 tsp. rum or rum flavor extract
steps: A silver coin is hidden in this cake and at midnight a ceremony is held to begin the New Year.
The person who finds the coin in his slice will be blessed with good fortune and good health for the coming year.
The bread or cake baked for this occasion is in honor of St.
Basil on his nameday.
You may bake a bread or a cake as you desire.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Gooey Butter Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Pour batter into a lightly greased 13 X 9 inch baking pan.

recipes.title: Chili
steps: Brown hamburger and drain fat off. Place all ingredients in pot (or crock-pot) and cook.
(Stove top 1 1/2 hours on medium heat; crock-pot 3 to 4 hours.)

recipes.title: Skillet Enchiladas
ingredients: 10 corn tortillas, cut into small squares
steps: Put oil in skillet; add chopped onion and tortillas.
Stir-fry over medium heat until tortillas are soft.
Add enchilada sauce and reduce heat.
Add corn and olives and heat through.
Add cheese and cook until melted.
Serve with refried beans.
Serves 5 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Noodle Stuffing
ingredients: 1 large can mushrooms (stems and pieces), diced
steps: Brown noodles on cookie sheet in oven (350°) until they are a golden brown color.
In skillet, saute chopped celery and mushrooms in a little oil.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken A La King
steps: In skillet, saute onion and pepper until onion is transparent. Add chicken and soups (do not dilute).
Bring slowly to a boil. Let simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Add pimentos and green peas. Simmer until green peas are ready.
Serve in patty shells, on toast points, rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Egg With A Hat
steps: With a 2 1/2-inch round cutter, cut out a circle on the slice of bread.
Melt butter in a heavy frying pan.
Put in both pieces of bread.
Cook over moderate heat until they begin to brown. Break an egg into the hole and sprinkle it with salt and pepper. Continue cooking until the bread is brown.
Turn and brown the other side.
Add butter as needed to keep the bread from sticking. Serve with the cut-out piece on top.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
steps: Chop head of cabbage in food processor. Mix together other ingredients.
Mix all together and chill.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup Dump
steps: Dump all 13 things.
Cook on high heat for 3 hours.
Cook on simmer/low for 6 to 8 hours.

recipes.title: Mayo And Peas
steps: Drain peas well.
Add enough mayonnaise to cover peas.
Cut up Vienna sausages to bite size and add to peas.
Refrigerate and serve cold.

recipes.title: Mrs. Chiles' Sweet 'N Sour Italian Dressing
ingredients: 2 packets Good Seasons Italian dressing mix
steps: Bring sugar and vinegar to a boil, stirring occasionally.
Add dressing mix, then ice, stirring until ice melts. Add oil. Store, covered, in the refrigerator. Shake well before pouring.

recipes.title: Fresh Vegetable Marinade 1
steps: Separate cauliflower and broccoli into small flowerets. Combine all vegetables in a large mixing bowl.
Combine remaining ingredients; mix well and pour over vegetables, tossing gently. Cover and chill at least 3 hours.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Martha Washington Candy
steps: Mix the first 5 ingredients with your hands.
When mixed real good, roll into small balls and put in container in refrigerator overnight.
In a double boiler, mix 1 large bag of chocolate chips and 1/4 pound of paraffin until melted.
Keep over hot water.
Take a pair of tongs and dip each ball of candy in melted chocolate. Place on waxed paper until chocolate hardens.
Store in covered container.
Makes 100 pieces.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pizza(This Recipe Is Perfect For Overnight Guests And Brunches)
ingredients: 1 c. loose frozen packed hash browns, thawed
steps: Cook sausage until browned; drain.
Press rolls into ungreased 12-inch lipped pizza pan.
Spoon on sausage.
Sprinkle on potatoes.
Top with Cheddar cheese.
In a bowl, beat together eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Pour into crust.
Sprinkle Parmesan over top.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
Cut like a pizza.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients well together and spread on platter. Top with layer of salsa, lettuce, tomatoes, black olives and shredded cheese.
Serve with nacho chips.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate
ingredients: 1 tsp. sugar, mixed with 4 Tbsp. leftover black coffee
8 (1/4 oz. size) Skor or Heath bars
3 (3 to 5 oz.) boxes Jell-O chocolate mousse
steps: Bake brownies according to directions; cool.
Punch holes in brownies; pour coffee over brownies.
Set aside.
Whip up chocolate mousse according to directions.
Break candy bars into small pieces in food processor or by tapping them with a hammer. Break 1/2 brownies and place in trifle dish.
Cover with 1/2 of the mousse; layer with 1/2 candy, then add 1/2 whipped topping. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Caesar Dressing
steps: Combine lemon juice, water and salad dressing mix in a jar with a tight fitting lid.
Shake 10 seconds.
Add oil and remaining ingredients.
Shake again.
Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: Icebox Fruit Cake
steps: Melt oleo and marshmallows.
Add to other ingredients.
Line a box with foil and press firmly in the box.
Store in refrigerator. Let stand 2 to 3 days before cutting.

recipes.title: Colorful Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 c. chopped red or yellow pepper
1 small bottle fat-free Italian salad dressing
steps: Cook pasta as directed.
Drain.
Pour about 1 cup of the salad dressing over the pasta and refrigerate.
Once cool, add the vegetables and more dressing to taste.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Tuna Cakes
ingredients: 2 (6 oz.) cans tuna in water, drained
1/4 c. finely chopped onion, celery and green pepper
steps: Mix tuna, mayonnaise, vegetables, salt, pepper and 3/4 cup bread crumbs.
Shape into 15 (2-inch) balls.
Roll in remaining crumbs, coating well.
Flatten balls into small patties. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Heat 1/2 cup oil in a skillet and fry patties 5 minutes on each side.
Add more oil as needed.
Remove from skillet and drain on paper.

recipes.title: Kathy'S Tomatoes Florentine
steps: Saute onion in butter.
Add cooked, seasoned spinach.
Cut top off tomatoes; scoop out.
Fill with the spinach mixture.
Top with grated Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, depending upon size.

recipes.title: Buttercream Frosting
steps: Mix Crisco and half of sugar.
Beat rest of ingredients until peaked.
Mix together.

recipes.title: Welsh Rarebit
steps: Melt cheese in top of double boiler. Make a thickening of cornstarch in a small amount of water. Beat eggs with Worcestershire. Add cornstarch, eggs, beer and mustard to melted cheese. Beat with rotary beater or electric mixer frequently until smooth and thickened. Add red pepper to taste. Serve over saltine crackers. Top with chopped onions which have marinated in cider vinegar, if desired.

recipes.title: Blackberry Cake
ingredients: 1 c. blackberries (use berries instead of milk or water)
steps: Follow directions on cake box, then add the blackberries.

recipes.title: Herb-Stuffed Potatoes(Nutritious)
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Bake potatoes about 45 minutes.
Cut in half lengthwise.
Scoop out inside and mash.
Add remaining ingredients except paprika.
Mix thoroughly.
Spoon potato into shells on baking sheet.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Return to oven for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Serves 8. Each serving amount:
1/2 potato equals 1 bread and 1/2 fat.
Cholesterol trace, carbohydrate 21 g, fat 2 g, calories 112, protein 3 g, fiber 2 g and sodium 62 mg.

recipes.title: Chocolate Turtle Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 (5.3 oz.) can evaporated milk (can use skim)
2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened (can use light)
steps: Combine crumbs and butter.
Press onto bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.
Melt caramels in milk in heavy 1 1/2-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring frequently until smooth (or melt in microwave; stir to smooth). Pour over crust.
Top with pecans.

recipes.title: Mr. Lynch'S Pudding Pie
steps: Make pudding according to directions.
Set aside in the fridge.
Grind up graham crackers until its fine and powdery.
Add apple juice until it forms a paste.
Place into a pie pan and distribute evenly throughout.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Pour in pudding.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Fruit Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple and juice
1 small jar maraschino cherries and juice, chopped fine
whole milk (to finish filling freezer to fill-line)
steps: Mix all together and freeze in 1-gallon freezer.

recipes.title: Plant Food
steps: Stir into 1 gallon of tepid water.
Use once every 4 to 6 weeks.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Dressing
steps: Put all ingredients in blender, but withhold 2 ounces of cheese to crumble into mixture.

recipes.title: Breakfast Sausage Balls
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix until well blended.
Shape into balls.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sandwiches
steps: Place roast in crock-pot and cook on low for 8 hours.
Remove roast and drain liquid.
Cut up roast into small pieces and return to crock-pot on low.
Add barbecue sauce to roast and cook for 1 more hour.
Add salt and pepper.
Serve on buns.

recipes.title: Low Cholesterol Sunshine Carrots
steps: Place carrots in a greased baking dish.
Drain the pineapple and reserve the juice.
Add the pineapple to the carrots and mix well.
Combine the reserved juice with the brown sugar, tapioca and salt, stirring until dissolved.
Pour over the carrot mixture and dot with margarine.
Cover and bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.
A 1/2-cup serving equals 0 mg cholesterol.

recipes.title: Buckeyes
steps: Mix peanut butter, powdered sugar and butter together.
Mix well.
Make into balls.
Place in refrigerator until cold.
Melt chocolate and paraffin wax together in double boiler.
Put toothpicks in balls.
Dip in chocolate.
Let stand on wax paper until cool.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
steps: Heat all ingredients on stove until butter melts.
Brush liberally over chicken when grilling.
Delicious!!

recipes.title: Mustard Meat Loaf With Celery
steps: Season hamburg; add egg.
Mix well and roll out.
Spread mustard on one side.
Spread sauteed veggies on other side.
Add Parmesan or other type of cheese.
Fold mustard side of hamburg over veggies and seal.
(Disregard cheese over veggies if you don't want the cheese.)
Bake in 350° oven until done, about 15 minutes.
Before done, add canned potatoes to warm them.

recipes.title: Punch
steps: Boil sugar and water together for 3 minutes.
Freeze in gallon container.
Remove from freezer for 1 hour before serving.
Pour ginger ale or 7-Up over frozen mix.

recipes.title: Two Minute Fudge
steps: Mix all ingredients except pecans and boil 2 minutes. Set pan in cold water and beat until thick.
Add nuts.
Pour into buttered pan. Cool.
Cut in squares.

recipes.title: Cross The Road Chicken
ingredients: 1 pkg. green peas with cream sauce
steps: Cook green peas with cream sauce.
Fold in diced, cooked chicken.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Cheese Bread
steps: Spread on French/Italian bread slices.
Broil until light brown and bubbly on top.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
ingredients: 1/3 c. Nellie & Joe's Key lime juice
steps: Whisk together Key lime juice and condensed milk.
Fold into whipped topping and pour into graham cracker pie crust. Refrigerate for 4 hours and serve.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves (about 1 lb.)
steps: Cook chicken in skillet over medium heat in hot margarine for 10 minutes or until browned on both sides.
Spoon off fat.
Stir in soup, milk and pepper.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer ten minutes or until chicken is fork-tender, stirring occasionally.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
steps: Mix pretzels, 4 tablespoons sugar and margarine in a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Bake at 400° for 6 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Braised In Cream
ingredients: 2 large cloves garlic, minced or to taste
steps: Slowly brown roast on all sides in small amount of vegetable oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Add water to cover and simmer until tender (2 1/2 to 3 hours).
When done, pour off broth and save for another use.
Remove meat to platter to cool.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 pkg. Knorr (or any brand) vegetable soup mix
steps: Thaw spinach and squeeze it to drain out water.
Mix with other ingredients and serve with tostada "Scoops" or other firm crackers for dipping.

recipes.title: Beulah'S Lasagna
steps: Cook noodles according to directions on the package.
In a baking dish, place a layer of noodles, a layer of Ricotta cheese, layer of spaghetti sauce and a layer of Mozzarella cheese. Continue until all ingredients are used.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

recipes.title: Veg-All Casserole
steps: Mix Veg-All, celery, onion, water chestnuts, mayonnaise and cheese together; sprinkle with sugar and Tabasco.
Pour into 9 x 11 inch greased baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Mix melted margarine and crushed crackers together.
Sprinkle over casserole; bake 15 minutes more.
Flavors just need to blend together.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Corn And Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can French style green beans, drained
1 can cream of celery soup, undiluted
steps: Layer corn first in a greased dish.
Put beans on top of corn.
Mix sour cream, soup, onion and cheese.
Spread over corn and beans.
Mix margarine and crackers and spread on top. Sprinkle almonds on top of this.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Shells
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained
steps: Mix ingredients together, except shells.
Stuff shells with mixture.
Place in casserole dish.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup grated cheese and 1/2 cup stewed tomatoes.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Pasta
ingredients: 2 packets or 2 heaping tsp. chicken bouillon
2 c. milk or half and half
2 tsp. Morton's Nature Seasons seasoning blend
1 (16 oz.) block Monterey Jack cheese, cut into cubes
8 oz. to 16 oz. angel hair spaghetti, cooked and drained
steps: Saut shrimp in margarine and juice of 2 lemons. Add chicken bouillon and water. Mix 2 tablespoons cornstarch with 2 cups of milk. Add to shrimp mixture and cook until thickened. Add Morton's seasoning and then
add Monterey Jack cheese. Cook on low until cheese melts. Serve over spaghetti which has been cooked according to package directions and drained.

recipes.title: Delicious Homemade Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 small pkg. instant vanilla pudding (I use French vanilla)
steps: Open cans of milk and mix together in large bowl.
Mix pudding according to instructions on box.
Mix with other milk and add remainder of milk.
Add vanilla.
Makes 1 gallon.
Tastes like cooked custard without all the work.

recipes.title: Punch
steps: Dissolve jello and sugar in hot water.
Add cold water, pineapple juice and lemon juice.
Freeze in gallon milk jug or other
large
container.
Remove
from
freezer
about 4 hours before
serving
and
mix
with
ginger ale.
Only let it thaw partially.
Break it up with a fork and serve as an icy slush. It is wonderful!

recipes.title: Chicken Soup
ingredients: 2 pkg. cream of chicken dry soup mix
steps: Cook and debone chicken.
Return cut-up chicken to broth.
Add bouillon cubes, 1 to 2 cans of cream of chicken soup and 2 packages of dry soup mix.
Dice onions and add.
Cook in crock-pot.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
steps: Boil chicken until tender.
Remove bones from chicken and cut or shred into small pieces.
Chop finely the hard-boiled eggs and add to chicken.
Peel and slice apples, cut into small pieces, then put apples and desired amount of pickle relish and blend finely. Add apples and relish to chicken mixture.
Mix in enough Miracle Whip, stirring along, until you get the right consistency.
Serve on lettuce or use for chicken salad sandwiches.

recipes.title: Reese'S Cups
steps: Melt 1/2 cup peanut butter in chocolate bar.
Put chocolate in muffin pans; let set 20 to 30 minutes.
Melt remaining peanut butter, then put on top of chocolate.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Impossible Pie(Custard)
steps: Put all ingredients into blender.
Blend for 1 minute.
Pour into 10-inch greased pie pan.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Sprinkle top with nutmeg.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef.
Add onion and salt to taste.
Add barley, carrots, celery, tomato soup and green beans (including juice). You may have to add a can of water.
Simmer slowly until barley is cooked.
When vegetables are tender you can cover casserole with biscuits and bake until biscuits are done or serve as is.
Good with thick slices of homemade bread and butter.

recipes.title: Chicken Stroganoff(Weight Watchers; Crock-Pot)
ingredients: 1 lb. frozen boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1 can fat-free cream of mushroom soup
steps: Put frozen chicken in bottom of crock-pot. Mix soup, sour cream and onion soup mix and pour over chicken.
Cook on low for 7 hours. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Ed'S Creation
steps: Drain spinach to dry.
In baking dish, place artichokes and Italian dressing.
Pack spinach on top.
Blend margarine and cream cheese.
Cover spinach mix with margarine/cream cheese mix.
Put Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake until golden.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Casserole
steps: Cook pasta until tender (15 minutes), stirring occasionally or until desired tenderness.
Rinse with cold water, drain.
Combine chicken, 4 ounces cheese, soup, milk, pimiento and pasta.
Turn into a 2-quart casserole dish and bake, covered, at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Uncover, top with remaining cheese, return to oven and bake until cheese melts.

recipes.title: "Chicken Lynn"(Serves 6)
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
steps: Boil chicken breasts until tender.
Cool slightly, then pull meat away from the bone and cut into bite size pieces.
Cover bottom of casserole with chicken pieces.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
steps: Boil potatoes until done or soft.
Add mayo, pepper, salt, sugar and vinegar.
Chop up 2 hard-cooked eggs.
If you want, add chopped onion.
Mix all together!
Chill in fridge.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
steps: Put pudding and milk in bowl and stir for 2 minutes.
Put pudding in crust.
Slice bananas and put on top of pudding.
Add pineapple.
Put whipped cream on pineapple.
Sprinkle pecans on top.
Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Meat Balls And Corn
steps: Mix hamburger meat, brown sugar, salt, pepper, cornmeal and egg into balls and brown in a large skillet until brown.
If you wish, add corn and whole tomatoes.
Cook slowly until all liquid is cooked away.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Surprise
ingredients: 1/2 c. light corn syrup (this can be omitted)
steps: Whip cooked potatoes until creamy and combine all ingredients. Put into baking dish.

recipes.title: Coconut Frosting
steps: Combine sugar, syrup, water, egg whites, cream of tartar and salt in top of double boiler.
Cook over boiling water, beating with electric mixer until mixture stands in peaks.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla.
Continue beating until frosting holds deep swirls.
Frost cake.
Sprinkle immediately with coconut, pressing into sides for pretty cake.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. grated cheese (1/4 c. on top)
steps: Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
steps: Place first 3 ingredients into pan.
Cook at medium heat. When mixture boils, cover with lid for 3 minutes.
Remove lid. Stir in margarine, cook to 260°.
Stir in peanuts, continue stirring and cook to 310°.
Remove from heat, add baking soda, salt and vanilla.
Pour batch on greased baking sheet.
Let cool slightly.
Loosen from sheet, turn over and stretch as thin as possible.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 c. diced, cooked turkey or chicken
steps: Combine everything except cheese and chips.
Place in well-greased casserole. Sprinkle with cheese, then chips.
Bake 10 minutes at 450°.
Serve hot.
Freezes well.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Buster Bars
steps: Combine melted margarine with crushed Oreos and pat into 9X13 pan.
Freeze.
Soften ice cream and spread onto crust.
Sprinkle with half the peanuts and freeze.
Bring sugar, milk, margarine and chocolate chips to a boil; cook until thickened.
Allow to cool.
Spread on top of ice cream.
Top with remaining peanuts and freeze.
Cut into squares to serve.
Store in freezer.

recipes.title: Spinach Pie
steps: Cook and drain spinach.
Combine Ricotta, Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese.
Add egg.
Mix in spinach.
Stir well.
Pour into 9-inch pie plate.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 45 minutes, until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Fruit And Angel Dessert
ingredients: 1 large angel food cake, broken in bite size pieces
1 (10 oz.) jar maraschino cherries, chopped and drained
steps: Break cake into bite size pieces (should have about 8 cups). Arrange half of the cake pieces in bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Top with half of the undrained pineapple, then top with cherries.
Spread half of the Cool Whip over all and top with half of the coconut.
Repeat layers.
Toast the coconut that goes on top of the last layer.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Let thicken, then add crushed pineapple, cherries and cottage cheese.
Decorate with additional	cherries,
red and green.
Refrigerate until firm. Serve with mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Layered Parfait Mold
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. Birds Eye quick thaw mixed fruit
steps: Dissolve cherry gelatin in 1 1/2 cups boiling water.
Add mixed fruit; stir until fruit is separated and gelatin is thickened.
Chill, if necessary.
Pour into 6 cup ring mold. Chill until set, but not firm.
Dissolve raspberry Jell-O in 1 1/2 cups boiling water.
Blend in softened ice cream; chill until slightly thickened.
Spoon over layer in mold.
Chill until firm, 4 hours.
Unmold on serving plate.
Makes about 6 cups or 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Puppy Chow Treats
steps: Melt in large saucepan the margarine and chocolate chips.
Mix in cereal and let cool.
In a brown bag, pour in powdered sugar and ingredients and shake well.
It's important not to use plastic bag because the ingredients will melt bag.
You need to mix while warm so powdered sugar will stick.

recipes.title: Corn Dog Muffins
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
steps: Combine corn bread mix and brown sugar.
Combine eggs and milk; stir into dry ingredients until moistened.
Stir in corn and hot dogs.
Fill paper-lined muffin cups three-fourths full.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve immediately or refrigerate.

recipes.title: Hot Tomato Sipper
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. Wyler's beef flavor instant bouillon or 3 beef flavored bouillon cubes
steps: In large saucepan, combine all ingredients.
Simmer over low heat for 10 minutes or until bouillon dissolves.
Serve hot. Makes about 1 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Orange Glazed Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1/4 c. packed brown sugar (light or dark)
steps: In large skillet, dissolve Jell-O, brown sugar, and salt in boiling water. Add butter and bring to boil. Add sweet potatoes, simmer, basting frequently until syrup thickens, about 15 minutes. Serves 6-8.

recipes.title: Pepper Jelly
steps: Boil peppers, sugar and vinegar for 5 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes, then strain.
Add Sure-Jell and few drops green cake coloring.
Can.

recipes.title: Peach Pie
steps: Crush 3 peaches and add 1 cup sugar, 1/2 cup water and 3 tablespoons cornstarch.
Cook until the mixture is thick and clear.
Slice the remaining peaches into a baked pie shell.
Pour the cooled mixture over the sliced peaches and chill.
Serve with whipped cream topping.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
ingredients: approximately 3/4 c. cracker crumbs or breadcrumbs
steps: Bake in greased pan about 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Gooey, Chewy Popcorn Balls
ingredients: approximately 1/2 grocery sack of popped popcorn
steps: Remove all unpopped kernels from popcorn.
Melt margarine, caramels and marshmallows in a large pan.
Put popped corn in a large bowl or plastic container.
Pour melted caramel mixture over popcorn and mix.
Butter hands and shape popcorn into balls. Place on waxed paper to cool.
Wrap in plastic wrap.

recipes.title: Peach Cream Pecan Meringue
steps: Beat first 3 ingredients until stiff.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Form pie shell.
Bake 55 minutes at 300°.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Mix peanut butter, powdered sugar, cream cheese and half Cool Whip.
Blend well.
Pour in pie shell.
Top with remaining Cool Whip.
Chill for 1 hour.
Refrigerate left over pie.

recipes.title: Kay'S Frozen Fruit Salad
steps: Layer of lettuce, green onions and Parmesan cheese.
Seal with Hellmann's mayonnaise and let sit overnight.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 loaf Vienna or Italian bread, cubed to make 5 c. bread
steps: Spray baking dish with Pam.
Pour bread crumbs in baking dish. Beat eggs, milk, sugar and vanilla.
Pour over bread crumbs and sprinkle top with nuts.
Bake in water that has been added in pan; sit baking dish in water.
Bake 35 to 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
steps: Best cooked in double boiler.
Combine all ingredients and cook at least 1/2 hour to 45 minutes, stirring often.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
steps: Press cookie dough out in a pizza pan.
Bake at 350° until brown, about 10 minutes.
Take out of oven and let cool.
Mix together cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth.
Pour on cookie dough.
