Mix together diced fruit with glaze.
Pour over cream cheese mixture.
Put in refrigerator until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Meat And Potatoes Quiche(Kesh)
ingredients: 1 c. rich milk or evaporated milk
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
In a 9-inch pie pan, stir together vegetable oil and grated potatoes.
Press evenly into pie crust shape.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until it begins to brown. Add the grated cheese, chicken, ham or sausage and onion in layers.
In a bowl, beat together the remaining ingredients.
Pour over cheese and meat; return to oven and bake at 425° for about 30 minutes or until lightly browned and knife inserted in from edge comes clean.

recipes.title: King Ranch Casserole
steps: Saute onion and bell pepper in about 1 cup chicken broth.
Add soups and Ro-Tel tomatoes, then diced chicken.
Dip corn tortillas in chicken broth just to soften a little.
Layer corn tortillas in casserole dish, then soup mixture and grated cheese until all is used.
Cheese is the last layer.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Meringue
steps: Combine 1/4 cup sugar, cornstarch and salt in a saucepan. Stirring constantly, add water and cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil.
Boil 1 minute; cool completely.

recipes.title: Strawberry Short Cake
steps: Make cake mix according to directions.
Grease a 9 x 13 pan. Line bottom of pan with marshmallows.
Pour prepared cake mix over this.
Sprinkle dry Jell-O over this.
Evenly spoon strawberries over Jell-O.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Marinated Chicken
steps: Put chicken in a bowl and cover with Dale's seasoning; let stand for 30 minutes.
Bake or grill until done.
Delicious, no other spices are needed.

recipes.title: Puppy Chow
steps: Melt chocolate chips, peanut butter and oleo together until smooth.
Stir constantly to keep from scorching.
Put Corn Chex in large bowl and pour the melted chocolate mixture over the Chex and toss until all are covered.
Put in grocery sack.
Add powdered sugar, then put the chocolate covered Chex into bag and shake well.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Cucumber Spread
steps: Peel
and grate cucumber.
Grate onion.
Put in strainer and press
out
juice.
Combine with cream cheese.
Mix mayonnaise to mixture of spreading consistency.
Salt to taste.
May be used as sandwich or with crackers.

recipes.title: Cherries In The Snow
steps: Mix wafers and oleo for crust.
Mix sugar, vanilla and cream cheese.
Add marshmallows and Cool Whip.
Spread on crust and add cherry pie filling.

recipes.title: Chicken Sesame Balls
steps: Combine chicken, onion, parsley, curry powder, mustard and paprika in a bowl. Add mayonnaise, 1 tablespoon at a time, blending thoroughly.
Make into balls using 1 teaspoon of the mixture. Cover and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled.

recipes.title: Pork-Carne Con Chili
steps: Clean all seeds from peppers, as this is what makes too hot for many person's tastes.
Pour boiling water over the peppers and let set for 1 hour.
Have enough boiling water so that it will make a pint when it is put in the blender an hour later.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dressing Bake
steps: Mix chicken and soups. Place in baking dish and spread stuffing mix on top.
Melt oleo and pour on top. Add the chicken broth and bake at 375° until bubbles up well all over.

recipes.title: Brandied Fruit
steps: Open cans, drain fruits, retaining about 1/2 cup to make syrup with brandy and brown sugar.
Arrange fruit with pineapple on bottom in large baking dish.
Drizzle brandy/fruit/brown sugar mixture over fruit.
Bake at 350° until fruit is heated through, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Crusty Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Arrange chicken in a shallow 2 to 3-quart baking dish.
Place 1 slice Swiss cheese on each piece of chicken.
Stir together chicken soup and wine.
Spoon evenly over chicken.
At this point, you may refrigerate until ready to cook, up to overnight.
When ready to bake, sprinkle crushed croutons over top.
Evenly drizzle butter over croutons.
Bake, uncovered, 50 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Christmas Rainbow Cake
steps: Prepare cake mix as directed.
Pour batter in two pans (8-inch round).
Bake as directed on cake mix box.
Cool 10 minutes. Prick with fork at 1/2-inch intervals.

recipes.title: Onion-N-Dill Potatoes
steps: In 3-quart saucepan, place potatoes and enough water to cover potatoes.
Cook over high heat until water comes to a full boil (4 to 6 minutes).
Reduce heat to medium.
Continue cooking until potatoes are fork-tender (8 to 12 minutes).
Drain potatoes, then return to pan (can quarter potatoes, if desired).
In a small bowl, stir together all remaining ingredients.
Pour over potatoes.
Cook over medium heat, gently stirring, until thoroughly heated, 3 to 5 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Maple French Toast
steps: Mix eggs, milk and vanilla.
Dip slices of bread into mixture and fry. Pour syrup over French toast and top with butter.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 - 16 oz package of frozen strawberries thawed
steps: Mix cream cheese and sugar together.
Add and combine rest of ingredients together and pour into a 9 X 13 inch pan.
Place in freezer until frozen.
Let thaw a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Noncarbonated Punch
steps: Add water to orange juice and lemonade according to directions on cans.
Mix with pineapple juice and cranberry juice.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake for 30 minutes at 325°, uncovered.
Serve with corn chips.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
steps: Combine sugar, syrup and water in saucepan; cook over low heat until mixture comes to a boil.
Add peanuts and cook until candy thermometer registers 290°.
Remove from heat.
Add butter, salt, vanilla and baking soda, mixing well.
Spread thinly onto 2 buttered cookie sheets.
Cool and break into pieces.
Yield: about 2 pounds.

recipes.title: Punch
ingredients: 6 pkg. raspberry Kool-Aid, prepared according to directions on pkg.
steps: Mix these ingredients for the base.
You may freeze the base to prepare an ice ring.
When serving, place base in punch bowl, then add ginger ale or 7-Up as desired to taste.

recipes.title: Blueberry Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together and congeal.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Let cheese come to room temperature and mix all ingredients well.
Roll into ball and roll into chopped pecans.
Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fruit Sauce
steps: Combine sugar, corn syrup, water and salt.
Simmer 10 minutes. Cool.
In a large bowl, stir mixture into peanut butter and raisins.
Spoon over fresh fruit cup.
Yields 1 1/3 cups.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Dressing
steps: Mix all together and chill.

recipes.title: Slush
steps: Boil water and sugar.
Put tea bags in for 5 minutes.
Add orange juice and lemonade.
Put in ice cream pail and freeze. Stir every few hours.
To serve, put a scoop of slush in glass. Add 7-Up to fill glass.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
ingredients: salt, pepper and onions to taste
steps: Brown ground beef.
Add seasonings; drain.
Mix in soup.
Put in baking dish.
Layer Tater Tots.
Layer cheese on top.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Microwave Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lb. beef stew, cut in 1-inch cubes
2 large potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
steps: In casserole, microwave stew meat with beef broth and water at Low for 60 minutes.
Mix in vegetables and other ingredients and continue cooking for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring gently after 15 minutes, until meat and vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Crawfish Creole Style
ingredients: 1 large pkg. dried shrimp or 2 small pkg. shrimp
steps: Heat oil and margarine slightly in a saucepan.
Add onions, bell pepper, celery, garlic and green onions; saute until tender over medium to low heat.
Add parsley and cook another 5 minutes. Add crawfish tails, cover and cook for 10 minutes over medium heat.

Remove from heat and stir in shrimp, fish, red pepper, black pepper, salt, Accent, tomato paste and 1 1/2 cups water. Return to heat, cover and cook for 30 minutes over medium heat or until desired tenderness is reached.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Corn Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Refrigerate for 2 hours.
Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Easy Cheesecake
ingredients: 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese (light or nonfat) softened
8 oz. container light Cool Whip, thawed
steps: Beat cream cheese until smooth, gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla.
Fold in whipped cream, blending well.
Spoon into crust; chill until set, about 4 hours.
Garnish with fresh strawberries if desired.

recipes.title: Cavatina
steps: Cook pasta and drain.
Brown beef and drain.
Brown pepperoni. Mix first 4 ingredients together and add spaghetti sauce.
Layer in a baking pan 1/2 pasta, 1/2 meat sauce, all of cottage cheese, 1/2 mozzarella, remaining pasta, remaining meat sauce, and remaining mozzarella.
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 -35 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed White Squash
ingredients: 1/2 c. (2 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
steps: Place squash in a pie plate; add water.
Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap; fold back a small edge of wrap to allow steam to escape.
Microwave on High 7 to 8 minutes; rearranging after 2 minutes.
Remove from dish and set aside.
Place butter in pie plate and microwave at High 50 seconds.
Stir in onion and green pepper; microwave at High 2 minutes.
Combine sauteed vegetable, egg and next 3 ingredients.
Set aside. Remove a slice from stem end of each squash.
Scoop out and discard pulp, leaving 1/4-inch shells.
Spoon stuffing mixture into shells; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Place squash in pie plate and microwave, uncovered, at High 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
Yield: 2 to 4 servings.

recipes.title: No Fail Fudge
steps: Put sugar, margarine or butter and milk in large buttered pan; cover with plastic wrap and poke holes.
Microwave on roast for 10 minutes.
Stir and roast 5 to 6 minutes more until soft ball forms in cold water, 236°.
Stir until melted the chocolate pieces.
Fold in marshmallow cream, nuts and vanilla.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch buttered pan.
Delicious and so fattening.

recipes.title: Super Stroganoff
steps: Brown beef in a little oil.
Add cut up onions and paprika. Simmer for at least 2 hours.
Onions and beef will render liquid, but water can be added if necessary.
Just before serving, add sour cream to lighten sauce.
Serve over wide noodles.

recipes.title: Pineapple Coconut Crescent Desserts
ingredients: 8 oz. can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
steps: In small bowl, blend cream cheese and powdered sugar; stir in pineapple, nuts, orange peel and vanilla.
Separate dough into 8 pieces.
Place each piece in ungreased muffin cup; press dough to cover bottom and sides, forming 1/4-inch rim.
Spoon 1 teaspoon coconut into each cup.
Spoon 1 tablespoon pineapple mixture into each cup.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with remaining coconut; bake an additional 3 to 8 minutes until crust is brown.

recipes.title: Danish Apple Cake
steps: Peel and halve the apples, removing the core.
Slice thinly, do not place in water to preserve the color.
Grease on ovenproof dish and line with a layer of bread crumbs.
Dot with lumps of butter, sprinkle with sugar to taste and cover with a thick layer of apples.
Repeat until all is used up, finishing with a layer of bread crumbs.
Press well together, dot with butter and bake at 330° for about 30 minutes until the apples are cooked through. Cool and turn out of the form, decorating with whipped cream when quite cold.
The apple cake may also be served lukewarm with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Ham-Broccoli Cups
steps: Place cheese and milk in top of double boiler.
Heat on medium until you have a thick cheese sauce.
Add the next 6 ingredients. Cook for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Gotto Speise
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients. Whip the cream until stiff.

In a glass dish, layer the crumb mixture. Sprinkle with cinnamon and brandy. Top with whipped cream. Repeat layers until you have 6 layers, the final being cream. Top with grated chocolate. Chill. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Spinach Supreme
steps: Cook spinach; drain.
Combine egg, sour cream, milk and first 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese.
Add onion, salt, pepper, Monterey Jack, spinach and end with spaghetti.
Mix well.
Put in ungreased casserole.
Top with last 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, covered, then the last 15 minutes, uncovered. Serves 3 to 4.
Easy to double or triple.
It is a wonderful side dish.

recipes.title: * Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream *
steps: Combine sugar, beaten eggs, half and half, whipping cream and vanilla.
Place in freezer and add enough milk to fill freezer 3/4 full.
Mix well.
Makes 1 gallon.
Other ingredients can be added (peaches, fresh strawberries, etc.)

recipes.title: Mama J'S Mexican Pie
steps: Put into pie dish in order listed.
Put in 400° oven until cheese melts.
Serve with Doritos.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. herb stuffing mix (save 1/2 for topping)
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into a greased casserole.
Bake in a preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Jam
steps: Cook rhubarb, sugar and pineapple 30 minutes, stirring often. Remove from heat.
Stir in Jell-O.
Can and seal.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Casserole
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) boxes frozen chopped cauliflower, cooked and drained
1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
steps: Beat in a bowl the eggs. Combine in a separate bowl the onions, soup and mayonnaise. Add

beaten eggs. Mix thoroughly. Place mixture in a casserole dish. Add cooked and drained cauliflower. Melt butter. Add bread crumbs. Mix well. Sprinkle over cauliflower mixture. Place in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Fudge
steps: Grate all cheeses; mix in eggs (scrambled) and jalapeno peppers.
Bake in large Pyrex dish (sprayed with Pam) at 300° for approximately 40 to 45 minutes or until cheese begins to brown. Let cool about an hour before serving.

recipes.title: Bachelor Quick Supper
ingredients: 2 pkg. Mozzarella (8 oz. each - low fat cheese slices)
steps: Cook or steam cauliflower and cut up in small florets.
In pie dish, spread oil or spray and lay slices of cheese on the dish so it covers the bottom as a pie crust.
Put cooked, drained cauliflower in dish.
Add the butter, salt and pepper.
Put second package of cheese on top, covering like a crust.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.
Place in 400° oven for 20 minutes (until cheese begins to brown).
Take from oven and let stand for 5 minutes. You can use a small head of cauliflower and 1 pkg. of cheese. Split the cheese for two layers and use 1/4 cup of breadcrumbs.

recipes.title: Meat Rolls
steps: Soften cream cheese to room temperature.
Mix meat, onion and cream cheese together.
Season with garlic salt, salt and pepper. Flatten biscuits and place small amount of meat mixture on each biscuit.
Crimp edges.
Bake on greased cookie sheet for 20 to 25 minutes at 300° until brown.

recipes.title: Honey'S Marinade
steps: Mix all ingredients well and marinate in refrigerator.
Great for chicken wings, pork or steak tips.

recipes.title: Scallops Nantucket
ingredients: 1 c. fresh Seasoned Bread Crumbs (recipe follows)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Place scallops in four 12-ounce ovenproof casseroles.
Drizzle each portion with 1 tablespoon of clarified butter, 2 tablespoons vermouth and 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
Top with seasoned bread crumbs (see recipe). Place casseroles on jelly roll pan.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes, or until scallops are almost firm.
Top with cheese.
Bake 2 minutes longer, or until cheese is melted.
Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Brunswick Stew
steps: Blender chop green onion, corn and tomatoes.
Combine all ingredients and simmer 2 hours.
Stir to keep from sticking.

recipes.title: Swiss Cheese Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 can cream of chicken soup, mixed with 1/4 c. water
steps: Place chicken in greased baking dish, bone side down.
Do not season chicken.
Place slices of Swiss cheese to completely cover chicken.
Spread soup over cheese.
Sprinkle generously with crushed seasoned croutons.
Bake until fork-tender, about 1 hour, at 350°.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1- 8 oz. Can Crushed Pineapple with Juice
steps: Place cream cheese in medium bowl and mix until cream cheese is soft.
Mix in bell pepper, green onions, pineapple and seasoning salt.
Line another mixing bowl with plastic wrap.
Form the mixture into a ball and place it on the plastic wrap.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate until the ball has set, 2 hours or more. When ready to serve, roll the cheese ball in the nuts.
Makes 1 large ball.

recipes.title: Old-Fashion Egg Salad
steps: In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, onion, salt and pepper.
Stir in eggs and celery.
Cover and chill.
Spoon 1/2 cup on a slice of bread and enjoy.

recipes.title: Turkey Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 28 oz. can tomatoes, undrained and chopped
steps: Saute onion and garlic in oil in Dutch oven until onion is tender; add turkey.
Cook until done, stirring to crumble meat. Stir in next 9 ingredients.
Simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour.
Add mushrooms and cheese; simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes.
Remove bay leaf.
Serve over hot spaghetti.
Yields 6 1/2 cups sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad(Serves 4)
ingredients: 2 c. shredded boneless chicken, trim fat off (about 4 half breasts)
steps: Coat nonstick pan with cooking spray.
Arrange chicken in single layer in pan.
Cook covered on medium heat until cooked through, about 7 minutes, turning once.
Let cool.
Combine all ingredients.
Mix well and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Brunch For A Bunch
ingredients: 1 lb. hot sausage, browned and drained
12 oz. or 3 c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2 c. chopped green onion or green pepper
steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan well.
Layer the following: potatoes, sausage, cheese, veggies, mixture of milk, eggs, salt and pepper.
Bake 50 minutes at 350°.
May also use chopped ham with 1/2 cup Swiss cheese and 1/2 cup Monterey Jack hot cheese.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
steps: Cut eggs in half.
Drop yolk in mixing bowl with added ingredients.
Mix with blender until creamy.
Garnish with paprika.

recipes.title: Chinese Red Sauce Pork
ingredients: 1 to 2 lb. shoulder (with skin) or pork rump
3 stalks green onions, cleaned and pat dry
1 slice ginger, mashed down with knife
steps: Heat heavy pot (no oil).

When hot, place the green onions on bottom of pot, place pork on top of the green onions, then drizzle sherry wine over the pork until it sizzles for several minutes. Add mashed ginger, soy sauce and water to cover almost 3/4 of the pork.
Bring to rolling boil, then reduce to low heat and simmer, covered, for an hour, turning occasionally to brown pork.
After an hour, add sugar.
Additional soy sauce and water may be required (add as necessary).
When nice and brown (minimum of 2 hours), and when pork is easily pulled with chopsticks, boil pot of water, drop spinach leaves into boiling water for a couple of seconds and drain immediately.

recipes.title: Marinated Carrots
steps: Mix together soup, sugar, oil, vinegar, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Pour hot marinade over vegetables. Refrigerate overnight or 12 hours.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
steps: Peel the eggplant and cut into 1/4-inch slices.
Soak in water for about 10 minutes.
Remove from water.
Pat dry and fry lightly. Grease a casserole dish and layer the following ingredients in the dish:
eggplant, browned hamburger, chopped onion, salt, pepper, oregano and tomato soup.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour with a cover and for 1/2 hour without a cover.

recipes.title: Strawberry Nut Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O with boiling water.
Add all other ingredients, except sour cream.
Pour 1/2 of mixture into glass baking dish (12 x 8 x 2-inch) and refrigerate until firm.
Then spread on sour cream and gently spoon rest of mixture on top (that has not been refrigerated) and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea
steps: *Optional with lemon or add 1 package lemon Kool-Aid.

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloin(Parmigiana)
ingredients: 1 pkg. pork tenderloin, beat with meat chopper until thin
1 (15 1/2 oz.) jar Ragu seasoned spaghetti sauce
steps: Marinate pork in Wish-Bone dressing overnight.
Drain.
Beat egg; add salt and pepper.
Dip tenderloin into egg mixture, then crumbs.
Brown both sides.
Be careful not to have fire too high when browning because it burns easily.
Place tenderloin in shallow pan and spaghetti sauce over meat.
I put a little sauce under the meat, also.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake, covered, in 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Remove cover and top with Mozzarella cheese; cook 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and meat reaches 170° internal temperature.
Serve with spaghetti (spoon a little sauce over spaghetti), salad and garlic bread.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Corn Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli in salt water until tender; drain broccoli and corn.
Put oleo in a heavy pot with chopped onion.
Saute until tender, but not brown.
Add vegetables and soup; mix well.
Pour into a casserole dish that has been sprayed.
Cover with cheese and bake in 350° oven until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Lasagna
steps: Brown meat with onions and seasoning; add spaghetti sauce and water.
In lightly greased casserole dish, layer noodles (uncooked) twice, 1/3 meat, 1 cup cottage cheese, 1 cup cheeses and end up with meat and cheese on top.
Cover and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 375°.

recipes.title: Angela'S Ham And Vegetable Quiche
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Prick bottom and sides of pie shells; bake for 5 minutes, then take out.
Sprinkle bottom of pie shells with Swiss cheese first, then ham, broccoli and cauliflower.

recipes.title: Cowboy Beans
steps: Brown the hamburger, green pepper and onion; drain.
In crock-pot, place meat mixture with the beans, then stir.
Add the barbecue sauce (do not stir).
Set on low for 2 hours, then stir and serve.

recipes.title: Layered Bean Dip "Trader Joe'S"(So Easy, It'S Almost Embarrassing!)
ingredients: 2 (12 oz.) jars spicy black bean dip
plenty of grated Jack and Cheddar cheese
steps: Purchase the tortilla chips, spicy black bean dip, fresh salsa and cheeses from Trader Joe's.
Spread the beans in an ovenproof, shallow casserole dish.
Top with the salsa, then the cheese. Bake in a 350° oven until heated through and cheese is melted. Top with chopped ripe avocado; sprinkle with cilantro.
Add "dollops" of sour cream and garnish with chopped black olives. Serve with chips.

recipes.title: West Indies Salad
ingredients: 3 small onions, sliced into thin rounds
steps: Combine ingredients in a Tupperware bowl; stir well.
Cover with airtight lid and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Serve with favorite crackers.
(This appetizer gets better the longer it marinates.)

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
steps: Save broth where chicken is cooked to cook spaghetti in.
Cook celery, onions and green pepper in butter until color changes.
To this, add soups, salt and pepper; simmer for 15 minutes.
Then add chopped chicken.
Mix additional ingredients to drained, cooked spaghetti.
Pour into a long shallow pan.
Put grated cheese on top.
Cook in a 350° oven until cheese is melted well.
Serves 20 people.
Freezes well.

recipes.title: Creamy Mounds With Sauce
steps: In mixing bowl, beat softened cream cheese with 3/4 cup powdered sugar until light and fluffy.
Add 1/4 cup powdered sugar into whipped cream.
Add vanilla extract and raspberry liqueur. Combine mixtures.
Using a rounded tablespoonful, place a mound in each 3-inch cup of a 12-cup muffin tin.
Freeze and when frozen, place muffin tin in plastic bag.
These will keep for several weeks.
Remove from freezer about 15 minutes before serving time. Unmold.
Serve with one of the warm sauces or chocolate sauce.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pudding Cake
steps: Cook pudding with milk as directed on box.
When pudding comes to boil, stir immediately into dry cake mix.
Pour this into a greased and floured cake pan (9 x 13-inch).
Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts on top of cake mix.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Jewell'S Potato Salad
steps: Boil potatoes until fork inserts smoothly.
Skin and dice potatoes.
Peel and dice eggs.
Put in large bowls.
Stir in all other ingredients.
Makes about 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Cheese Garlic Biscuits
steps: Mix Bisquick, cheese and milk until blended.
Spoon on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 450° for 10 to 20 minutes or until brown.
Melt butter; add garlic powder.
Brush on biscuits.

recipes.title: Cucumber Relish
steps: Bring to a boil and add cucumbers, pepper and onions.
Cook for 10 minutes.
Pour in jars and seal.

recipes.title: Virginia Style Crab Cakes
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. Old Bay seafood seasoning or to taste
steps: Combine crab meat, baking powder, mustard and Old Bay seafood seasoning together.
Mix egg and bread crumbs together.
Now combine other ingredients.
Mix all ingredients well together. Then form cakes; fry in Wesson oil or favorite oil until golden brown.

recipes.title: Gobblers For Gobbling "Turkey Treats"
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. cream filled chocolate sandwich cookies
1 (16 oz.) container ready to spread chocolate frosting
steps: Carefully separate each cookie, leaving cream filling on one side (a blunt knife helps, and children love to help make broken pieces disappear!).
Set cookie halves without filling aside.

recipes.title: Ham Hocks And Turnip Greens
ingredients: 1 lb. ham hocks, ham fat or ham bone
steps: Wash greens, breaking off the tough stems.
Cook the ham hocks for about 1 hour, then cut up greens with season to taste.
Let cook for 2 to 3 hours on low heat.

recipes.title: Major Meal Lasagna
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Brown ground beef and drain grease. Cook lasagna noodles; drain.
Add spaghetti sauce to meat and let simmer over low heat.
Grate Mozzarella cheese; set aside.
Add 1 beaten egg to cottage cheese; set aside.
In casserole dish, lightly grease sides and bottom of dish.
Place ground meat mixture on bottom of pan, then noodles, cottage cheese, then Mozzarella cheese.
Then repeat.
If any meat mixture is left, put on top of casserole.
Sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese; cover well.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbling on top. Turn broiler on; place dish under broiler until lightly browned on top.
Watch closely as not to burn.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Green Chili Casserole
ingredients: 1 or 2 small cans chopped green chilies
approximately 1/2 lb. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
steps: Dip each corn tortilla in hot oil and layer them in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Mix the cottage cheese, sour cream, green chilies and black olives together; spread mixture on top of the tortillas.
Top with Cheddar and Jack cheese.
Cover with foil and bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Gogo Shake
steps: In a blender, blend banana until smooth.
Blend in peanut butter.
Add ice cream and milk.
Blend until smooth.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Barb'S Cinnamon Logs
ingredients: 1 loaf sliced white bread, no crust
steps: Mix
cream
cheese,
sugar
and egg.
Spread bread with mixture.
Roll
into a roll.
Using a pastry brush, coat rolls lightly with melted butter.
Dip rolls in a cinnamon and sugar mixture.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Serves 20.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) roll refrigerator sugar cookie dough
steps: Press cookie dough into 12-inch pizza pan.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until light brown.
Spread cream cheese over cooled cookie and add drained fruit.

recipes.title: Blender Applesauce
ingredients: 4 large apples, peeled, cored and quartered
steps: Place all ingredients in glass container of electric blender. Blend on medium speed until smooth, about 1 minute.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
Makes 3 cups.

recipes.title: Three Corn Pudding
steps: Combine all ingredients in a casserole dish, mixing well. Bake at 375° 45 minutes to 1 hour until golden brown and set in center.

recipes.title: Leftover Turkey-Beef, Etc. Dish
steps: Slice onions and brown in a little oil.
Add minced garlic or sprinkle with garlic powder.
Sprinkle flour over onions.
Mix well.
Add broth and stir to gravy consistency.
Slice leftover meat and add to onion/gravy mixture.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Put mixture in casserole dish and top with mashed potatoes mixed with shredded cheese.
Put shredded cheese on top and bake 20 minutes in 350° oven.
Before removing from oven, brown under broiler for a minute or two.

recipes.title: Lasagna
ingredients: 1 small plus 1 large pkg. Mozzarella cheese
steps: Spoon sauce into bottom of pan, enough to lightly cover bottom.
Add a layer of noodles.
Then add sauce on noodles, enough to lightly cover noodles.
Then add cottage cheese, then Mozzarella cheese.
Add another layer of noodles, sauce, cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let it set 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cheese And Egg Brunch
steps: Place half of the bread cubes in a buttered 3-quart casserole. Layer with mushrooms, olives and cheeses.
Top with remaining bread cubes.

recipes.title: Beef Shanks
steps: Place 3 shanks of beef on bottom of crock-pot.
Pour on soup mix and half of tomato sauce.
Place remaining shanks, rest of sauce and beef broth.
Cook slow all day, approximately 8 hours. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Strawberry Sweetheart Salad
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed and drained
steps: Stir cream cheese and mayonnaise until well blended.
Add marshmallows, strawberries, pecans, pineapple and food coloring; blend well.
Fold in whipped cream.
Pour into 1 quart mold until firm.
Unmold on bed of lettuce and garnish with whole strawberries.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 4 boxes frozen green beans (French style or cut)
steps: Cook beans; drain well. Cook onions in butter until wilted and tender but not brown. Add mushrooms. Add flour; mix well, then add milk and stir until thickened. Add cheese; stir until smooth. Add seasonings and mix in beans and chestnuts. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Giant Ground Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 2 lb. ground chuck, browned and drained
steps: Slice top crust off bread.
Hollow crumbs from the center, leaving only the side crusts.
Mix ground chuck, onion, bell pepper, Ro-Tel, mushrooms and crumbs from inside of bread.	Put ground chuck mixture inside loaf of bread.	Cover with cheese. Put top crust on top of mixture.
Wrap in foil and bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Sun Dill Pickles
ingredients: 2 heads dill or 1 Tbsp. dill weed
steps: You will need a gallon glass jar.

recipes.title: Salmon Loaf
steps: Drain and flake salmon.
Add cheese, lemon juice, onion, horseradish, liquid smoke and salt.
Combine well.
Shape into a loaf.
Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: In 1 quart bowl mix tuna or chicken with celery, green onion, garlic salt, salt, pepper, salad elegance and mayonnaise until mixture is stiff.
Cut each tomato vertically into eighths.
Put 2 Tbsp. tuna or chicken mixture in middle of each tomato.
Top with dried parsley flakes and/or additional salad elegance.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Catfish Soup
steps: Put all ingredients, except the milk and butter, in a kettle or stewpan.
Cook over low heat until the meat falls apart.
Add milk and butter.
Bring to a boil.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Crunchy Veggie Sandwich
steps: Slice as many vegetables as you want and put on Italian bread. Pour dressing over the whole loaf.
Cut into individual sandwiches and serve.
To make an individual serving, cut a piece of Italian bread off and use less dressing.

recipes.title: Potato Stuffed Peppers
steps: Make mashed potatoes, but omit the milk.
Fry 1 small onion in butter and mix with potatoes.
Mix together Parmesan cheese and 2 beaten eggs.
Add to potatoes.
Add dash of garlic powder and parsley.
Stuff peppers with potato mixture and make a cork out of bread for the end of each pepper.
Place on an oiled roasting pan. Cover and bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes on each side.
Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
steps: Cook, stirring occasionally.
After it boils, reduce heat to low.
Top with cheese when served.
Add chicken or beef if desired.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
steps: Tear bread into bite size pieces and place in a greased 13x9x2 baking dish.
Brown and drain sausage.
Spoon over bread. Sprinkle with cheese.
Beat eggs, milk, mustard, salt and pepper. Pour over mixture in dish.
Bake at 350 degrees 35 to 40 minutes Cheese will rise to top.
Mixture can be prepared night before and stored in refrigerator.
Bake right before serving.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
ingredients: 2 - 10 3/4 oz. cans cream of potato soup, undiluted
1 pkg (2 lbs) frozen hash brown potatoes
steps: In a large bowl combine the soup, sour cream and garlic salt. Add potatoes and cheddar cheese; mix well.

recipes.title: Strawberry Layer Cake
steps: Empty cake mix and jello in mixing bowl; add oil and eggs. Beat 3 minutes in mixer; add strawberries.
(If frozen berries, drain off liquid.)
Beat 1 minute.
Pour into 3 oiled cake pans. Bake 25 minutes at 350° or 375°.
Cool before icing.

recipes.title: Ritz Bits Snack Mix
ingredients: 2 (12 oz.) boxes Ritz Bits crackers (original flavor)
steps: In a small bowl, mix oil, salad dressing and dill weed.
Stir and set aside.
Place the Ritz Bits, oyster crackers and pretzels in a large bowl or container.
Be sure to take the pretzels by hand from the bag.
Do not pour directly from the bag!
A large amount of salt settles at the bottom of the bag and can give the mixture a very salty flavor.
Stir the oil-dressing mixture again, then pour over the cracker-pretzel mixture.
Mix with a large spoon and coat well (3 to 5 minutes).
Let stand for 30 minutes (or eat immediately if you wish).

recipes.title: Pistachio Cake
steps: Mix together cake mix, eggs, sour cream, pistachio pudding and oil; beat for 10 minutes.
Fold in nuts and chocolate bits.
Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until toothpick tests dry.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
steps: Brown meat with seasoning and onion; drain and add chillies. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish spread refried beans; top with the meat mixture.
Cover with cheese, then pour the picante sauce over the top.
Bake for 35 minutes in a 375° oven.
Serve over tortilla chips or just dip chips in individually.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
steps: In large Dutch oven, brown meat and onion.
Add all remaining ingredients, except for the last two.
Bring to a boil, reduce and simmer for 30 minutes.
Top with cheese and serve with chips. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Candied Pecans
steps: Whip egg whites till frothy.
Then mix cold water and pecans until covered.
Mix together cinnamon and sugar, and then add to mixture and coat thoroughly.
Then spread on cookie sheet and bake at 225 degrees for 30-45 minutes.
Cool on wax pepper.

recipes.title: Mom'S Coconut Cake
steps: Prepare cake mix
as directed on package in 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool 15 minutes, then poke holes in cake with fork.

recipes.title: Leftover Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into bite size
steps: Don't
throw away those leftovers.
Put them all into a freezer-safe
container and freeze them!
When you have sufficient vegetables, meats and/or gravies, place in a large pot. Add cooked,
whole tomatoes with juice, tomato sauce and soup stock. Add
seasoning, onion, potatoes, carrots and any other vegetables desired.
Bring to a boil;	reduce heat and simmer until fresh vegetables are done.

recipes.title: Cool Whip Salad
steps: Mix pineapple and marshmallows; set aside about 1 hour.
Add pudding and stir until blended.
Add Cool Whip and mix all together.

recipes.title: Instant Hot Cocoa Mix
steps: Combine all ingredients until blended well.
Keep this dry mixture in a tightly covered jar.
To make the cocoa, place 1/2 cup of the mix in a cup and fill with hot water.
Stir until mix dissolves.
Will make 12 cups cocoa.

recipes.title: Veal With Scallops
steps: Cut veal into 2-inch pieces, dredge in flour, shake off excess flour.
Brown in two tablespoons olive oil, remove from pan.
Add peppers and mushrooms to pan and cook until tender.
Add scallops and cook until tender.
Remove from pan.
Add chicken broth and simmer for one minute.
Add veal, peppers, mushrooms and scallops and simmer until veal is tender.
Add wine and cook one minute more.
Serve with cooked noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Charlotte'S Mom'S Strawberry Cake
ingredients: 1 c. frozen strawberries, thawed and blended (retain the rest of the strawberries for the icing)
1 box dry strawberry jello (save 3 tsp. for the icing)
steps: Pour batter into a greased 9 x 13 Pyrex pan or 3 greased round cake pans. Bake at 350° for 45 or 30 minutes respectfully or until done.

recipes.title: Casserole Italiano
steps: In skillet, brown beef with onion, garlic and seasonings. Stir to separate meat.
Combine in 1 1/2-quart casserole with soup, water and noodles.
Place cheese around edge of casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Trail Pockets
steps: Lightly brown
ground
beef.
Add
green onion and bell pepper; saute
until
onion is tender.
Add remaining ingredients, except the 2 cups of Mozzarella cheese.
Simmer about 10 minutes until
it
thickens.
Remove from heat and let cool 10 minutes. Stir
in cheese and set aside.
Do not overcook this mixture.

recipes.title: Tomato Aspic
ingredients: 3 c. seasoned tomato sauce (8 oz. cans)
steps: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Add all other ingredients and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Oriental Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 red pepper, cut in 2 x 1/4-inch strips
3 green onions, cut in 1-inch diagonal slices
2 carrots, cut in 1/4-inch diagonal slices and parboiled 3 to 5 minutes
1/4 lb. snow peas, trimmed and parboiled 1 to 2 minutes
steps: Place chicken in large skillet; add water to cover.
Bring to boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until chicken is tender and juices run clear when pierced with a fork.
Drain and cut into small, bite-size pieces when cool enough to handle.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni as directed. combine macaroni, cheeses in crock pot.
Stir in evaporated milk, melted butter, eggs and milk. Cook on low covered for 3 hours.
Top with cheese slices add allow to melt.
Serves 6.
Can be easily doubled for larger gatherings.

recipes.title: Chewy Fruitcake Bars
ingredients: 2 c. cut up mixed candied fruit
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix baking mix and sugar; cut in margarine thoroughly.
Press mixture with floured hand in an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan.
Bake 10 minutes.
Sprinkle coconut over baked layer.
Layer candied fruit over coconut.
Sprinkle nuts over fruit.
Drizzle milk over top.
Bake until light golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool completely.
Cut into bars about 2 x 1-inch.
Yields about 70 bars.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
steps: Bring to boil the butter, brown sugar, Karo syrup and salt for 5 minutes.
Add baking soda; pour over popped corn.
Place in a deep baking pan.
Cook at 200° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Kim Chee
steps: Slice nappa in 2-inch strips and onions in long thin strips. Place nappa and onions in a container with salt and press with a weight for 1 hour.
Turn over and press 1 hour longer. Rinse and squeeze out liquid.
Mix in remaining dry ingredients.
Place in jars and store in the shade for 1 day, then refrigerate.

recipes.title: Walnut Pie
steps: Mix together.
Makes 1 pie.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes (pecans can be used instead of English walnuts).

recipes.title: "Don'T Peek" Five Hour Beef Stew
steps: Mix together in roaster.
Cover tightly.
(Seal with aluminum foil if necessary.)
Bake at 250° for five hours.
Don't peek for five hours!

recipes.title: Cherry Cheese Coffee Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. In a 2-quart bowl, combine cream cheese, 1/3 cup powdered sugar, egg yolk and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Unroll crescent dough and reserve 4 triangles for decoration. Separate remaining dough into 12 triangles and arrange on 15-inch round stone with points toward center. Roll dough into a 14-inch circle. Cut out a 3-inch hole in center. Spread cream cheese mixture over dough to within 1/2-inch of edges. Top with pie filling. Roll remaining dough into a rectangle. Cut lengthwise into 12 strips. Twist strips and place in a spoke like fashion over filling. Press ends to seal at center and outer edges. Brush with egg white. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Cool slightly.

recipes.title: Blueberry Pie With Bananas
steps: Mix milk, juice and Cool Whip.
Fold in berries.
Be careful not to crush.
Cut bananas crossways and put in bottom of shells. Pour in fruit mixture.
Chill.

recipes.title: Party Punch
ingredients: 1 1/2 qt. ginger ale or carbonated water
steps: To make sugar syrup, combine 3 cups of sugar and 3 cups of water in saucepan.
Stir over heat until sugar is dissolved. Bring to boiling point.
Let boil without stirring about 7 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl until well blended.
Store in airtight container in refrigerator until ready to use. Excellent served with carrots, cauliflower, celery, broccoli, etc.

recipes.title: Blueberry Delight
ingredients: 1 (3.4 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (10 oz.) carton frozen whipped topping, thawed and divided (Cool Whip)
1 (10 oz.) angel food cake, cut into 1-inch cubes
steps: *Any fresh or frozen fruit can be used in place of blueberries.

recipes.title: Crabby Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 (6 1/2 oz.) can crabmeat or 1/2 lb. fresh or mock crab
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Toss crabmeat with lemon juice.
Add next 5 ingredients and mix well.
Fill mushroom caps and sprinkle with cheese.
Rinse baking sheet with water and arrange mushroom caps on sheet.
Cover with foil and bake 12 to 15 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 5 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 5 minutes or until golden.

recipes.title: Steak Marinade
steps: Combine soy sauce, onions and garlic in electric blender. Blend for 1 minute on high or until mixture is very smooth.
Stir in Gravy Master and salt.
Makes approximately 2 1/2 cups.
Pour over meat and allow to stand at room temperature for 2 1/2 hours or cover dish with plastic wrap and keep in refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
Bring meat to room temperature before cooking.

recipes.title: Marzetti
steps: Brown beef and onion.
Add remaining ingredients, being generous with the garlic powder.
Simmer all until noodles are done.
Stir it frequently to keep from sticking.
Serves 4 generously.
Leftovers are microwavable if larger batch is desired.

recipes.title: Fresh Fruit Dressing
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. poppy seed or celery seed
steps: Put all ingredients, except poppy seed, in blender; mix well. Stir in poppy seed.
Chill; stir before using.
Makes 2 cups. This is so easy, and with so much less oil than most dressings of this type.
It's acceptable for those watching their fat intake. Plus, it's delicious!

recipes.title: Fudge
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. (1 c.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
steps: Mix
sugar, milk, marshmallows, margarine and salt in a heavy 2 quart saucepan.
Cook, stirring constantly over medium heat to a boil (mixture will be bubbling all over).
Boil and stir 5 minutes
more.
Remove
from heat.	Stir in until completely melted 6 ounces chocolate chips.
Add nuts and vanilla and stir well.
Spread in a buttered 8-inch square pan.
Cool. Cut into 30 pieces.

recipes.title: Carrot Pie
steps: Line a 9-inch pie pan with your favorite pie crust.
Separate the eggs.
Combine carrots, well beaten egg yolks, sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon and milk.
Add salt to the egg whites and whip until stiff.
Fold the egg whites into the carrot mixture.
Fill the pie crust.
Bake in a hot oven (450°) for 15 minutes, then lower temperature to moderate (325°) for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fancy Salsa Dip
steps: Soften cream cheese. Grate Cheddar cheese. Put all 3 ingredients into mixing bowl and beat until well blended. Chill 1 hour or longer. Serve with tortilla chips or on crackers.

recipes.title: Dirt Pudding
steps: Crush up Oreos until they look like dirt; put in bowl.
Melt butter and add to cookies.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Combine the first 6 ingredients and spread on a large platter. Layer with the lettuce, scallions, tomatoes and cheese.
Use your favorite tortilla chips for dipping.

recipes.title: Easy Lemon Cookies
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Salmon Party Ball
steps: Drain and flake salmon, removing skin and bones.
Combine all ingredients.
Chill several hours.
Shape into ball; roll in nuts and parsley.
Chill; serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Double Dutch Chocolate Treat
steps: Cook pudding according to package directions.
Mix dry cake mix in pudding until blended.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch can pan (greased).
Sprinkle chocolate bits and nuts over top.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Potluck Beans
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of tomato soup, undiluted
1 (15 to 16 oz.) can undrained chili beans
1 (16 oz.) can undrained pork and beans
steps: In a large skillet, brown beef and drain.
Add onion and celery; cook until tender.
Stir in soup, tomato paste and ketchup; simmer 15 to 20 minutes.
Spoon into a large roasting pan and add all remaining ingredients.
Stir well.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chinese Chicken Wings
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Pour over chicken.
Marinate in shallow baking dish, covered, overnight.

recipes.title: Hot Tea Beverage
ingredients: 1 large bottle cranapple juice with no sugar
some whole cloves in a tea ball
steps: Bring water to just under a boil.
Add tea bags; let steep. Heat juice.
Put all in bowl (wassail) or pitcher, stirring to dissolve sugar.
Serve with cinnamon stick in cup (optional).

recipes.title: Pina Colada Muffins
ingredients: 1 (1 lb. 2 oz.) box yellow cake mix
steps: Prepare cake mix as package directs.
Add other ingredients. Mix 1 minute; do not overbeat.
Grease muffin tins or line with paper cups; fill about 2/3 full.
Bake in preheated 350° oven 15 to 20 minutes or until golden and muffins spring back when touched. Serves 25.

recipes.title: Pineapple Sex Cake
ingredients: 1 small box vanilla instant pudding (1.0 oz.)
steps: Bake cake from box directions.
Mix pineapple and pudding (from directions) together.
Put on top of cooled cake.
Mix cream cheese and whipped cream together.
Put in refrigerator.
Layer: Cooled cake, pineapple and pudding and cream cheese and whipped cream.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 2 large cans pineapple chunks, drained (save juice)
steps: Mix pineapple juice and Tang.
Add bananas and toss to coat. Add fruit and nuts.
Stir together.
Sprinkle pudding over all and mix together.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Avocado-Grapefruit Salad
steps: Peel grapefruit; section and seed over a bowl, reserving juice.
Peel and slice avocados.
Immediately combine juice, grapefruit sections and avocado slices in bowl; toss gently. Cover and refrigerate up to 2 hours.
Drain and toss with lettuce in a serving bowl.
Combine olive oil and remaining ingredients in a jar.
Cover tightly; shake vigorously.
Serve with salad.

recipes.title: Joyce'S Ice Cream
steps: Beat eggs well, then add sugar and mix well.
Add all other ingredients.
Add whole milk to freeze line.
Mix well.

recipes.title: Congealed Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water; add condensed milk and beat.
Add 1 cup mayonnaise and beat again.
Add salt, cheese, pineapple, cherries and nuts.
Pour into 9 x 12-inch casserole type dish.
Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Weight Watcher'S Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour dressing over top. Mix well.

recipes.title: Salad Or Dessert
steps: Mix and freeze.
Remove from freezer in time to soften just a little before serving.

recipes.title: Butter Cream Torte
steps: Spread evenly 1 cup of the crumbs, in a 9-inch pie plate or square pan.
Cream butter and add eggs and sugar.
Beat until fluffy and light (separation is normal).
Stir in almonds.
Spread over crumb mixture.
Sprinkle 3/4 cup crumbs over butter mixture. Beat cream until thick.
Add cherries which have been well drained and chopped.
Mix well and add to second layer crumbs.
Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup crumbs on top.
Garnish with whole cherries. Chill at least 4 hours.
Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Fruit Soup
ingredients: 2 cans crushed pineapple in its own juice
steps: Put all ingredients in large bowl.
Add half pineapple and half orange juice to cover fruit well.

recipes.title: Jogging In A Jug
steps: Mix Well. Drink 2 oz a day.

recipes.title: Noodle Kugel(Pudding)
steps: Cook noodles.
Cream the eggs and sugar together.
Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Pour into buttered casserole.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown.

recipes.title: Classic Green Bean Bake
steps: In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper.
Stir in green beans and 1/2 cup onions.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Stir and top with remaining onions.
Bake for 5 minutes more and serve.

recipes.title: Tamale Pie
steps: Cook meat with spices and drain the fat.
In a glass baking dish, start with a layer of meat.
Add a layer of 1/2 the onion, then a layer of half the tomatoes, then a layer of creamed corn, then a layer of cheese.
Repeat the layers once more ending with creamed corn.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with cheese.
Crush the tostados and cover the pie, then add another layer of cheese.
Bake for another 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
steps: Boil water and cook rotini until tender; drain.
In a bowl, mix 1 1/2 cups Miracle Whip and Italian dressing until smooth, creamy and thick.
If too thick, add a small amount of Italian dressing.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with parsley flakes.

recipes.title: Pirate'S Pantry Spread
ingredients: 1 green pepper or 4 oz. green chilies, chopped
1 (6 1/2 oz.) can shrimp, drained and rinsed
1 (6 1/2 oz.) can crabmeat, drained and rinsed
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Serve with crackers.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Turkey Fajitas
steps: Serve with tortillas (I use wheat), chopped, diced tomatoes, cheese, peppers, sour cream, etc.
Cut bone away from turkey breast, then slice breast so that you end up with strips of turkey.
Mix fajita marinade (usually with vinegar, oil and water) and soak turkey strips in marinade.
Slice bell pepper and onions into strips; slice garlic.
Heat oil in large pan; put in garlic slices and then pepper and onions.
Sprinkle to taste with chili powder and Cajun seasoning.
Cook to taste (I like mine still with a bit of crispness).
In another frying pan, heat oil; add in some of the marinade and cook strips of turkey (doesn't take very long).
As the turkey is finished, place on serving platter.
Mix in bell pepper-onion-garlic mixture as it is finished.
Serve with tortillas and whatever else makes you happy!

recipes.title: Iced Spice Tea
steps: Boil sugar and 2 cups water for 5 minutes.
Add hot water and tea bags.
Steep 5 minutes.
Discard tea bags.
Add remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Serve over ice.
Garnish.
Makes 1 gallon.

recipes.title: Holly Day Cookies
steps: Melt marshmallows and butter together in double boiler.
Add food coloring, vanilla and Frosted Flakes.
Mix well.
Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.
Drop 3 or 4 red hots on top of each cookie.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Potatoes
steps: Peel and slice the potatoes and onion.
Mix with the salt and pepper.
Turn into 1-quart casserole. Add butter and water to the top. Cover with foil and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 (8 to 10-inch) graham cracker crumb crust or baked pastry shell
steps: Beat cheese in large mixer bowl until fluffy.
Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.
Stir in lemon juice and vanilla.
Pour into crust.
Chill for 3 to 4 hours.
Top with your desired amount of pie filling.

recipes.title: Oil And Vinegar Dressing
steps: Mix together and bring to a boil.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 pkg. graham crackers, crushed with 1 stick oleo
1 can Carnation milk, frozen and whipped
steps: Combine graham crackers with oleo.
Line 9 x 13-inch pan with 3/4 crumb mixture.
Let jello set until syrupy.
Add soft cream cheese and jello mixture.
Put on top of crumb mix in pan.
Add the rest of crumbs on top.
Put in freezer.
Take out a few minutes before you want to serve.
Rich!

recipes.title: White Cookies
steps: Mix sugar, butter and milk together and cook for 3 minutes. Add marshmallows and stir until dissolved.
Remove from heat and add graham cracker crumbs, nuts and coconut.
Drop by teaspoonful onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Ok Cookies
steps: Sift flour, soda and baking powder together. Beat eggs and shortening together. Add milk. Roll out and cut cookies.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Bark Covered Pretzels
steps: Melt bark.
Dip pretzels into it, then lay out on wax paper until they harden.
Using a 2-tined fork to spear the pretzels works well and can be done at one time.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Icing
steps: Cream margarine; add peanut butter and salt.
Blend thoroughly.
Add rest and beat.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or mushroom soup
steps: Thin
cream
of
chicken or mushroom soup with water or juice from
canned
asparagus.
Using 9 x 9-inch baking dish, layer Ritz
crackers, asparagus, sliced eggs, soup and cheese slices, ending
with
crackers.
Top
with	butter.
Bake
30 minutes at 350° (watch closely to prevent burning).

recipes.title: Millie'S Chicken
steps: Line pan with foil; arrange chicken.
Combine all ingredients. Pour over meat and marinate at least 1/2 hour.
Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Hot Crab Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients except crab meat and cook on stove until smooth.
Add crab meat until hot.
Serve on crackers or party breads.
Keep warm.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Noodle Bake
ingredients: 8 oz. medium egg noodles, cooked and drained
steps: Melt margarine in skillet.
Add ground chuck and cook until it loses its pink color.
Add tomato sauce, salt, garlic salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Fold together noodles, onions and sour cream.
Spoon 1/2 mixture into 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Cover with half meat mixture.
Repeat layers. Sprinkle with shredded cheese.
Refrigerate or freeze.
When ready to serve, return to room temperature and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. cooked chicken, cut into cubes
steps: Combine all ingredients, spread in shallow baking dish.
Cover with broken potato chips.
Bake uncovered for 1/2 to 1 hour at 350°.
Serve over rice.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Punch
steps: Mix and pour over softened sherbet. When mixed, pour on 2-quarts of ginger ale.

recipes.title: Heart Attack Cheesy Hash Brown Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 400°. Defrost hash browns just to the point where they are not a frozen solid block. Melt butter in a mixing bowl, add onion, then soup and sour cream, stir until combined. Mix in 2 cups of cheese, add salt and pepper. Stir in hash browns slowly. Spray casserole dish with Pam, place mixture in dish, sprinkle remaining cheese on top, then spray Pam on top. Cook for 45 minutes to one hour, less for more flavorful onions.

recipes.title: Egg Custard Pie
steps: Mix eggs, sugar, salt, vanilla and milk together.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Sprinkle top with nutmeg.
Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Goulash
steps: First cook macaroni (rinse and drain).
Set aside until later. In large skillet, add hamburger and onion; brown until cooked.
Add tomatoes.
Add 1 tablespoon of sugar or more to taste.
Simmer these ingredients for about 1 1/2 hours.
Add your cooked macaroni to meat and tomato mixture.
Add salt and pepper, also grated cheese on it, too.

recipes.title: Split Pea Soup
steps: Fill large pan with water just a couple inches from the top. Add ham to water.
Cook at medium temperature for 4 hours.
Take ham out of broth.
Let cool and then cut up.

recipes.title: Strawberry Nut Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. 4 oz. can crushed pineapple, drained
2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, thawed strawberries, undrained
steps: Dissolve gelatin in water.
Add strawberries with juice, pineapple and nuts.
Put 1/2 mixture in 13 x 9-inch glass dish and refrigerate until firm.
When congealed, spread sour cream over top and pour balance of the gelatin mixture over all and refrigerate again until firm.

recipes.title: Salmon Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. white sauce or 1 can mushroom soup
steps: Boil vermicelli.
Mix flaked and drained salmon with sauce and stir thoroughly.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Place in medium baking dish in layers with vermicelli.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.
Uncork a bottle of Grey Riesling and savor with the casserole.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 large chicken or 2 fryers, cut up
steps: Melt butter; add onion, bell pepper and celery.
Cook until light brown.
Add all other ingredients (spaghetti, cooked, is added last) except cheese.
Cook down until thick.
Put in baking dish; top with cheese and put in oven to melt.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 large sour cream, with salt and pepper to taste
steps: Thaw the potatoes.
Mix 1/2 stick of butter with corn flakes and set aside.
Mix all other ingredients together and put in baking dish or pan.
Sprinkle the cornflake-butter mixture on top. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecue Pork Chops
steps: Mix water, vinegar, sugar, salt, mustard and pepper.
Add lemon and onion.
Simmer for a few minutes.
Add catsup, Worcestershire sauce and smoke.
Bring to a boil.
Pour over chops and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes to 1 hour and 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 (17 oz.) can white Shoe Peg corn
steps: Heat vinegar, sugar, pepper, salt and oil only over low heat until it comes to a boil.
Pour gently over vegetables and chill overnight.

recipes.title: Chicken Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 large can chunk chicken, well drained
steps: Mix chicken and 1/2 of grated cheese well.
Add onions.
Open tubes of crescent rolls; stretch dough out.
Place a large tablespoon of chicken mix in center; roll up and seal ends.
Mix the cream of chicken soup and milk in saucepan; heat just enough to spread well.
Cover bottom of baking dish with 1/2 soup mixture.
Place roll-ups in dish, leaving a space between them. Cover with remaining soup.
Bake for 30 minutes at 375°.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
steps: Mix together.
Place in mold or 9-inch square pan.

recipes.title: Cotton Mill Mashed Potatoes
steps: In the early days of the cotton mill, there was a potato bell which was run 30 minutes before the workers came home for dinner. This was a reminder for the person who was preparing the meat to start cooking the potatoes as they would be home soon.

recipes.title: Lazy Cucu Pickles
steps: Place cucumbers, onion, bell pepper and salt in a large bowl. Refrigerate for 2 hours (do not drain).
Whisk together vinegar, sugar and celery seed.
Pour over cucumber mixture and store in refrigerator.
Makes about 10 cups.

recipes.title: Sunshine Preserves
ingredients: 2 c. chopped fruit (use stone fruit, not tropical or citrus)
enough apple juice to make 4 c.
steps: Add apple juice to fruit.
Add sugar and lemon juice.
Bring to
a boil.
Let set 1/2 hour.
Return to boil for 4 minutes. Pour into shallow trays and set in the sun until thick.
Bring in at sunset.
Put in small canning jars and water bath according to jam directions.

recipes.title: Strawberry Limon Punch
ingredients: 2 (10 oz. each) pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed
1 (12 oz.) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (12 oz.) can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
2 (1 liter each) bottles ginger ale, chilled
lemon and lime slices for garnish
steps: Puree strawberries in
blender	or food processor until smooth.
Pour into	large pitcher.	Stir in juice concentrates and grenadine.
Refrigerate.	 Just	before	serving,
pour strawberry mixture into large
punch bowl.	Pour in ginger ale and seltzer.
Add ice
cubes.
Garnish	with
lemon
and
lime slices. Makes 36 (1/2-cup) servings.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Torte
steps: Mix cracker crumbs with melted margarine.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cool.
Thaw ice cream thoroughly until of liquid consistency.
Prepare the vanilla pudding according to package directions using only 1 1/2 cups of milk.
Blend with an electric mixer.
Add melted ice cream and beat until well blended.
Pour into baked shell.
Chill overnight, until firm.
Top with whipped cream and crushed candy bars.
Makes 15 to 20 servings.

recipes.title: Congealed Tomato Salad
steps: Bring tomatoes to a boil and add dry jello.
Mix well and allow to jell.
Makes 4 large servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Beef And Celery
steps: Freeze steak partially (may use cheap cut of steak).
Slice thin while still partially frozen and brown.
Stir-fry with meat the celery, onions, carrots and garlic (if desired).
Add gravy of the beef bouillon, cornstarch and soy sauce.
May add more water if want thinner or to cook longer.
Add the bean sprouts and mushrooms with juice.
Simmer until flavors are blended and vegetables are well done.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
steps: Mix and add to very hard white sauce.
Roll in cakes and dip in egg and cracker crumbs.
Fry in deep fat.

recipes.title: Hot Punch
steps: You will need a 30 cup percolator.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. minced onion or onion powder
steps: Mix all ingredients in mixer.

recipes.title: Easy Red Velvet Cake And Frosting
ingredients: 1 oz. red food coloring or 2 oz. if you want it dark red
steps: Mix cake mix, eggs, food coloring, shortening, milk, vinegar and cocoa in a large mixing bowl.
Blend together, then beat 2 minutes.
Pour into greased and floured layer pans.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, or until done, at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 to 3 c. cooked chicken, cubed or shredded
10 oz. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained
1 can cream of mushroom or celery soup
steps: In a baking dish (9 x 13-inch), layer chicken and broccoli. Mix together soups, milk and pepper; pour over broccoli.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over top of soup mixture.
Bake at 350° (uncovered) for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Slush Punch
ingredients: 2 to 3 (2 liter) bottles 7-Up or ginger ale
steps: Heat pineapple juice, sugar and water until sugar is dissolved.
In a blender or with a potato masher, blend frozen orange juice and lemonade and bananas.
Combine the 2 mixtures and freeze in a large bowl or decorative ice ring.
Thaw 1 to 1 1/2 hours (or less if you like).
Place in a large punch bowl and add 7-Up or ginger ale as you like.
Makes 24 to 30 servings.

recipes.title: Cold Noodles With Spicy Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 c. peanut, vegetable or corn oil
steps: In large saucepan, bring about 6 cups of water to a boil and simmer chicken about 10 to 15 minutes.
Do not overcook or meat will be dry.
Remove chicken breasts but leave water in pot.
Bring water to a boil again.
Do not add salt.
Add noodles and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender, 7 minutes or less. Drain in a colander and run under cold water until they are thoroughly chilled and the strands are separated.
Drain.
Sprinkle with teaspoon of sesame oil and toss to coat.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mint Meringue Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Grease (or spray with cooking spray) 2 cookie sheets.
Beat egg whites with cream of tartar and salt until foamy.
Gradually add sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time, and beat until soft peaks form.
Stir in food coloring and mint extract.
Gently fold in chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Instant Russian Tea
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well.
Store in airtight container until ready to use.
Mix 2 teaspoons of mix in 1 cup hot water.

recipes.title: Banana Split Dessert
ingredients: 1 (No. 2) can crushed pineapple, very well drained
steps: Combine and press into 9 x 13-inch pan, cracker crumbs and butter.
Cream until fluffy, powdered sugar, eggs and butter.
Put on top of graham cracker mixture.
Spread over top the pineapple. Slice bananas lengthwise in fourths.
(Strawberries may be used.) Cover with Cool Whip.
Garnish with walnuts or maraschino cherries, if desired.
Make the day before you wish to serve.

recipes.title: Cabbage Salad
steps: Heap cabbage in bowl.
Combine cream, sugar, salt, pepper and vinegar.
Pour over cabbage and toss lightly.
Arrange eggs around rim of bowl for trim. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Barbecued Hot Dogs
steps: Brown onions in salad oil.
Mix the other ingredients and simmer in the same pan for 15 minutes.
Split the hot dogs and put in the sauce.
Place in a 375° oven for 30 minutes, basting occasionally.
Serve on hot dog rolls.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Spray 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish with Pam.
Layer vegetables in dish.
Mix celery, onion, cheese and mayonnaise and spread over the vegetables.
Crumble the Ritz crackers and mix with the melted oleo.
Spread over top and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
ingredients: fresh vegetables, potato or tortilla chips
steps: Combine all ingredients except vegetables or chips and mix well.
Serve chilled with vegetables or chips.
Cut vegetables in small bite size pieces.

recipes.title: Artichoke Appetizer
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Place 1/2 tablespoon artichoke on bread; top with mayonnaise mixture.
Place under broiler until bubbly brown.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise
steps: In small mixer bowl, beat egg yolk, mustard, sugar, salt, pepper and 1 tablespoon of the lemon juice on medium speed until blended.
Continue beating, adding salad oil drop by drop.
As mixture thickens, increase rate of addition.
Slowly stir in remaining lemon juice.
Beat thoroughly.
Chill.

recipes.title: White Bean Soup And Sausage
steps: Brown sausage in oil. When brown, remove and cool, then slice. Add ham, onions, carrots and celery to pan. Cook and brown for 8 to 10 minutes. Mash 1 can of beans with fork; add broth and all beans and sausage. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Let it rest for 10 minutes or so, then serve with cornbread.

recipes.title: No Cook Freezer Strawberry Jam
ingredients: about 1 gal. real ripe berries, washed and capped
steps: Wash and cap strawberries.
Take hands and crush real good, then measure 2 cups crushed strawberries in one pan.
Measure sugar; have sugar ready to pour in.
Stir in real good.

recipes.title: Fish Chowder
steps: Saute onion in butter.
Place all ingredients except half and half in a large kettle.
Cook slowly until potatoes are done and fish flakes.
Add 1 pint of scalded half and half (light cream) to finished chowder.
Let sit for 15 minutes or more for flavors to absorb into the cream.

recipes.title: Party Potatoes
steps: Boil potatoes.
Blend all ingredients together.
Keeps in refrigerator up to 3 weeks.
Keeps in freezer for up to 3 months. Add butter while heating up.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Pork
ingredients: 2 lb. uncooked pork, cut into pieces about 1-inch thick and 2-inches long
steps: Mix the sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, water and cornstarch. Cook over low heat until thickened, stirring constantly. Place in a kettle the pork. Add the cold water and boil 20 minutes or until tender. Pour off water if there is any left; cool. While meat is cooling, saute the onion and carrots in oil (substitute green pepper, pineapple, bamboo shoots and apples). Remove from pan. Combine ingredients with hot sweet and sour sauce and sauteed vegetables. Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chocolate Icing
steps: Mix ingredients together in medium size pot.
Cook on medium heat until chocolate reaches desired thickness.
Makes enough for 3 to 4 layer cake (may be more depending on thickness).

recipes.title: Potatoes Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 (2 lb.) pkg. frozen hash browns, thawed
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch greased casserole dish.
Add topping and bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Blueberry French Toast
steps: Slice bread diagonally 3/4-inch thick.
Place in 10 x 15-inch pan.
In bowl, beat eggs and milk plus baking powder and vanilla. Pour slowly over bread, turning to coat.
Cover with plastic wrap and put in refrigerator overnight.
In morning, place 4 cups frozen blueberries, 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon in greased 9 x 12-inch pan.
Place bread, wet side up, on berries. Wedge slices together.
Brush top of bread with 2 tablespoons melted butter.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until toast is golden brown and berries are bubbling around the sides.
Remove from oven and sift powdered sugar on top.
Let stand 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 1 or 2 cans cream of broccoli soup
steps: Brown chicken in halves in hot oil for 10 to 15 minutes. Combine soup, milk, lemon juice and pepper.
Pour over chicken. Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer until tender.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans cream of celery or mushroom soup
steps: Take an 8 1/2 x 11-inch roasting pan and pour soup into pan. Add milk and stir in with soup.
Add tuna fish in water; chop up in pan and mix thoroughly.
Put cooked noodles in mixture also. Combine bread crumbs in pan and mix thoroughly.
Then, flatten out mixture evenly and put thin layer of bread crumbs over the whole pan.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes, or until mixture is bubbling.
Take out and serve.

recipes.title: Lemon And Lime Cake
ingredients: 1 large container Cool Whip (regular or fat-free)
steps: Mix cake mix as directed on box; divide mix into 2 round 9-inch cake pans. Mix jello powder (lime in one, lemon in the other). Bake and let cool. Put Cool Whip on top of bottom layer stack. Place Cool Whip all over the rest of the cake; refrigerate until ready to serve. Very, very good.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Butter a 2-quart casserole.
Set aside.
Bring water to a rapid boil in a heavy 4-quart saucepan.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt and oil.
Gradually add macaroni, being sure water continues to boil.
Cook macaroni, uncovered, until tender, but firm.
Stir occasionally.
Drain.
Place in prepared casserole.

recipes.title: Pizza Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger meat; drain.
Add pepperoni, mushrooms and pizza sauce.
Heat.
Roll out 1 can of crescent rolls in the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Pour hamburger mixture over top. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese over hamburger mixture.
Place the other can of crescent rolls on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until crescent rolls are golden.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
steps: Melt 1 stick margarine and mix with wafers.

Pat on bottom of a 9 x 12-inch pan. Beat eggs, remaining butter and sugar for 15 minutes. Spread over crust. Slice bananas in 1/2-inch lengthwise portions and place in mixture. Spread pineapple over bananas, then cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts, drizzle syrup over top and top with cherries.
Refrigerate. Serve cool.

recipes.title: Hot Chili Dip
steps: Spread softened cream cheese in bottom of a pie plate.
Layer chili and chopped green chilies.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake in a 325° oven for 25 minutes.
Serve with large Fritos.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Dip
steps: Mash artichokes to a coarse mush, using fork and knife.
Add cheese and mayo; mix.
Bake in an oven-proof dish at 350° until bubbly (about 20 minutes).
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Microwave Potatoes(Dinner For 4)
ingredients: 2 to 3 Tbsp. chopped fresh herbs such as parsley, chives, thyme or you can use 2 to 3 tsp. dried herbs of your choice
steps: Rinse and pat dry potatoes.
Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through.
Place potatoes in a microsafe dish or pan.
Sprinkle with melted butter and add your choice of herbs.

recipes.title: Pico De Gallo
steps: Chop all 3 ingredients and mix together.

recipes.title: Swedish Salad
steps: Combine ingredients and chill.
Just before serving, add 1/2 pint whipped cream to the Dressing and fold into the salad.

recipes.title: Easy Morning Rolls
steps: Arrange rolls in fluted Bundt pan. Sprinkle dry pudding mix over rolls. Cook butter and remaining ingredients over low heat until mixture bubbles. Pour over rolls. Cover tightly with foil and let stand on countertop overnight or 8 hours. Next morning, bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Invert carefully over serving dish.

recipes.title: Southern Corn Bread Dressing(For Small Turkey Or Large Hen)
ingredients: chopped giblets from your bird (if desired)
steps: The day before making the dressing, cube loaf of white bread. Toast to a good brown in oven.
Leave, uncovered, overnight to dry.
Bake cornbread.
When cool, crumble and let set overnight. Do not mix together.
Saute onion, mushrooms, celery and margarine together until tender; let cool.
Add water chestnuts, pepper, sage, salt and chopped giblets, if desired.

recipes.title: Pineapple Rings
steps: Cream potatoes with sugar, margarine and milk.
Add vanilla and raisins.
Place pineapple rings on baking sheet.
Drop potato mix by spoonfuls on rings.
Top each ring with marshmallow.
Bake at 325° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Strawberry Tart
steps: Combine sugar and cornstarch.
Add water and bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Add jello.
cool.
Stir in berries and place in your favorite baked pastry.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Boil chicken with carrots and onion until completely cooked, about 1 hour.
Remove chicken and continue vegetables with 8 ounces of egg noodles for 5 minutes.
Drain mixture and set aside.

recipes.title: Light And Fruity Pie
steps: Make Jell-O with 2/3 cup boiling water.
When dissolved, add ice cubes and stir until thickened. Remove unmelted ice cubes. Using wire whisk, blend in Cool Whip, then whip until smooth. Chill until mixture will mound.
Spoon into crust. Chill 3 hours. Garnish.

recipes.title: Cheese And Pasta In A Pot
steps: Cook beef in oil. Add onions, garlic, sauce, tomatoes and undrained mushrooms. Simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: White Seafood Pasta Sauce
steps: Melt butter in large frying pan.
Add olive oil and garlic. Bring to a slow boil.
Add all the rest of the ingredients except parsley.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
Add parsley.
Serve over spinach fettucini.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Egg And Sausage Loaf
steps: Cube the bread and place in a large loaf cake pan (9 x 13-inch).
Brown sausage in frying pan and drain.
Place a layer of sausage (cooked and drained) on top of bread cubes, then add a layer of grated Cheddar cheese.
Mix the eggs and milk (beat) and pour on top of the cheese.
Leave all night in the refrigerator. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Cut and serve.
Makes 12 generous servings.

recipes.title: 1, 2, 3 Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: 1/2 c. Holland House white cooking wine with lemon
4 Tbsp. lemon concentrate (plastic lemon in produce)
1 c. bread crumbs or enough to cover top
steps: Marinate shrimp in bowl for 20 minutes with cooking wine, oregano, garlic powder (save 1 tablespoon for topping), 2 tablespoons lemon, pepper and olive oil.
Place shrimp in single layer of broiler pan.
Sprinkle rest of garlic powder over the layer of shrimp.
Cover entire layer with bread crumbs.
Saturate with the remaining 2 tablespoons lemon and 2 to 3 sticks of melted butter.
Broil over low flame (400°) for approximately 15 minutes, keeping a careful eye on (do not overcook).
Serve with white or yellow rice.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Zucchini Relish
steps: Grate or chop 12
cups zucchini, onions and peppers and mix. Add salt and let
stand
hours
or overnight.
Rinse well with water then
drain
well.
Mix
other
ingredients in large kettle and cook until it starts to thicken.

recipes.title: Quick Veal Parmigiana
ingredients: 1 lb. frozen breaded veal patties (4 or 5)
steps: Brown meat in hot oil in a large skillet until golden on both sides.
Add tomato sauce, garlic, salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Vichysoisse
ingredients: 1 can heavy cream (be sure to use can to measure)
steps: Put all except chives in blender until smooth. Refrigerate until very cold. Chill serving dishes, then sprinkle mixture with chopped chives.

recipes.title: Horseradish Cheese Ball
steps: Blend cheese until smooth, and mix in horseradish and 2 salts. Add dried beef, shape into ball, wrap in waxed paper and refrigerate overnight.
When firm, reshape and roll into parsley. Cover and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chicken In Cheddar Cheese Soup
ingredients: 2 to 3 cans Campbell's Cheddar cheese soup
garlic powder salt and pepper to taste
steps: Mix soup and sour cream together.
Put 1/3 of mixture on bottom of baking dish.
Layer chicken breasts with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Peel potatoes and quarter.
Lay potatoes on top of chicken.
Cover chicken and potatoes with the remainder of soup mix.
Bake at 300° for 2 1/2
hours, uncovered.

recipes.title: Caramel Rolls
steps: Thaw dough, but don't let rise.
Tear one loaf into pieces and put into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt butter in pan and add rest of ingredients; beat until smooth.
Pour over torn pieces of dough in pan.
Tear second loaf of dough into pieces and place on top, trying to fill in the empty places.
Let rise for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Turn rolls out onto wax paper or foil while still hot and serve.

recipes.title: Salmon Loaf
steps: Mix all ingredients and put into a greased loaf pan.
Bake in a moderate oven until done.

recipes.title: Italian Spaghetti Casserole
ingredients: 1 box Italian thin spaghetti, cooked as directed
salt, pepper and a few drops red hot sauce
steps: Sear meat in skillet.
Drain off grease.
Add salt, pepper, garlic, hot sauce and chili powder.
Add mushroom soup, tomato sauce and water.
Put drained spaghetti in a large casserole. Pour meat sauce over it.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake about 25 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Mammaw Tynes' Chili
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans or chili beans
steps: Brown the hamburger meat; add the onion.
Drain fat.
Add the tomatoes, water and chili seasoning.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Add the beans and simmer another 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Herb Sorbet
ingredients: 1/4 c. spearmint leaves (or apple mint, lemon balm, scenter geranium or rosemary)
steps: Place the sugar in a saucepan and add the water.
Bring to the boil, stirring until the sugar is dissolved.
Chop[ the herb leaves and add to the pan.
Cover, then remove from the heat.
Leave to infuse for 20 to 30 minutes.
Test for flavor, if it is too light, bring to the boil again then leave to infuse for 15 minutes. Strain the liquid and add the lemon juice.
Transfer the mixture to an ice cube tray and freeze for 2 to 3 hours.
When the sorbet is semi-frozen, whisk the egg white until stiff and fold it into the mixture.
Return to the freezer for a further 3 to 4 hours or until frozen.
Serve the sorbet in individual dishes and decorate each serving with extra herb leaves.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Jerk Sauce(For Any Meat)
