ingredients: 1/2 c. balsamic vinegar with 1/2 c. sugar
steps: Mix all ingredients (coarsely chopping all vegetables).
Let this whole thing sit for 1 day before using.
Yield is about 1 gallon.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Pie
steps: Grate cheese and set aside.
Bake 2 pie crusts 10 minutes at 350°; remove from oven.
Put 1/2 cheese in each pie shell. Combine eggs, cream, cumin and hot chilies in blender.
Pour over cheese and bake 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Bertha'S Sweet Pickle Sticks
steps: Select fresh firm cucumbers about 4 1/2 inches long.
Wash and cut into sticks.
Pour boiling water over and let stand overnight. Next day, drain.
Pack solidly into clean jars.
Combine remaining ingredients and boil for 5 minutes.
Pour this boiling hot liquid over the cucumbers in the jars.
Place cap on jar, screw on band tight.
Process in boiling water bath 5 minutes. Makes 3 pints.

recipes.title: Susan'S Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 bag Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix (save 1/3 for top)
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into buttered (greased) casserole dish.
Top with remaining stuffing.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes, or until top is brown.
Good!!!

recipes.title: Pizza
steps: Put it in the microwave.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 large bunch broccoli, thickest parts of stems removed
steps: Cut the broccoli into uniform 2 to 3-inch pieces.
Steam until just beginning to become tender, but not cooked through.
Remove from heat; allow to cool and chop into bite size pieces.
Beat together the cream and eggs.
Add the cheeses, onion, parsley, salt and pepper.
Gently fold in the broccoli.
Pour the mixture into a buttered, shallow baking dish and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbly and browned on top.
This is better if made up the day before baking and serving.

recipes.title: Shrimp Mold
ingredients: 1/2 c. green onions, chopped very fine
2 lb. shrimp, boiled, peeled and chopped or 2 cans
steps: Prepare shrimp, celery and onions.
Heat soup and cream cheese until smooth.
Dissolve gelatin in water.
Add shrimp, onions, celery and mayonnaise to cooled soup mixture; mix well.
Pour into mold and refrigerate until well set.
Serve with Waverly Wafers.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
steps: Saute onion in butter.
Steam and drain broccoli.
Add in cans of soup.
Cut Velveeta into chunks and add to mixture.
Pour in milk; then add steamed broccoli.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Pie
ingredients: 1 ready pie crust (graham cracker or chocolate)
steps: Cream the cream cheese, peanut butter and sugar until well blended.
Stir in 1/2 the container of Cool Whip and vanilla. Pour in pie crust.
May freeze or put in refrigerator several hours to set.
Top with rest of Cool Whip before serving.
This pie freezes and can be kept frozen about a month.

recipes.title: Egg Salad
steps: Mix and store in refrigerator.
Use for sandwiches or on crackers.

recipes.title: Auntie Joe'S Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 can whole cranberry sauce (fresh is better)
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Add cranberry sauce.
When partially set, stir and add other ingredients.
Chill.
Serve. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Spinach Noodle Casserole
steps: Cook spinach according to package directions. Drain well. Combine with 1/2 the sour cream, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Cook pasta according to package directions.
Drain, add margarine and onion and blend with spinach mixture.
In a 2-quart baking dish, layer spinach, then noodles, then cheese.
Repeat, ending with cheese.
Top with remaining sour cream.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Popcorn
ingredients: 1 bag Pop Secret or Orville Redenbacher's Movie Theater Butter
steps: Read directions on each bag and ignore them.
Press 5, 0, 0 on your microwave and watch your popcorn pop.
When it gets to not popping constantly, take it out.
Open away from face and pour into large bowl.
Put your 2 shakes salt on the popcorn.
Eat.

recipes.title: Cranberry Jelly
steps: Combine cranberry juice and powdered fruit pectin in a 6-quart saucepan.
Cook until mixture boils and stir in sugar.
Boil hard 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and skim foam from top; pour into hot glasses and seal.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli; drain.
Combine soup, mayonnaise, beaten eggs, cheese, onion, salt and pepper.
Stir in broccoli and put in buttered casserole.
In saucepan, melt 1/2 stick butter and stir in crumbs.
Sprinkle on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
steps: Mix ingredients together over casserole dish.
Top with 1 cup crumbled potato chips and 1/2 cup grated cheese.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Mildred Fortner'S Pork Barbecue
steps: Salt to taste.
Cook until onions are done.
Cut up about 2 pounds lean pork.
Combine with sauce and cook slow about 30 minutes.
Makes about 20 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
steps: Mix and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Beef Nacho Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. (8 oz.) Kraft Natural shredded Colby and Monterey Jack cheese, divided
shredded lettuce and tomatoes for topping
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Brown beef.
Stir in salsa, corn, Miracle Whip and chili powder.
Layer 1/2 of each meat mixture, chips and cheese in 2-quart casserole dish.
Repeat layers and top with shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Poached Apples
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. rum or 1/2 tsp. each: rum and vanilla extract
steps: Bring water, sugar and nutmeg to boil in a large deep skillet. Boil 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly reduced in volume.
Add rum and apples.
Cover and simmer over low heat, 10 to 15 minutes, gently stirring 2 or 3 times until apples are tender.
Remove from heat and stir in raisins.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Apple Pudding
steps: Butter bread, both sides, and remove crusts.
Then line bottom and sides of 1 1/2-pint ovenproof dish.
Peel, core and thinly slice apples.
Put layer of apples sprinkled with sugar and cinnamon, then bread sprinkled with sugar, then apples all the way to the top, ending with bread.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Beat the egg in the milk until frothy and pour over the bread and fruit.
Bake in slow oven until apples are tender and bread nicely browned, about 2 hours.
Serve topped with fruit or ice cream.
Serves 4 people.
Set oven to 325°.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef.
Layer in bottom of dish.
Pour cream of potato soup over top of ground beef, then add a layer of grated cheese, then top layer with Tater Tots.
Bake at 350° until Tots are done.

recipes.title: Easy Southwest Dip
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) container sour cream or plain yogurt (2 c.)
1/2 c. Hellmann's or Best Foods real or light mayonnaise or reduced fat cholesterol free mayonnaise dressing
1 (1.4 oz.) pkg. Knorr vegetable soup and recipe mix
steps: In a medium bowl, stir sour cream, mayonnaise, soup mix, salsa, chili powder and cilantro until well mixed. Cover and chill 2 hours.
Serve with tortilla chips or cut up vegetables.
Makes about 3 cups.

recipes.title: Chili
ingredients: 2 pkg. Williams chili mix or 4 to 5 Tbsp. (level) other chili mix
steps: Put 1 to 2 tablespoons of shortening in pot and melt; add meat and sear.
Keep stirring until brown.
Add tomato puree and rest of seasoning and cook 2 hours or until done.
Add water as needed.

recipes.title: Baked Zucchini
steps: Steam squash until loses hardness. Slice squash and layer in casserole.
Mix ingredients with tomato paste and slice cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked French Coconut Pie
steps: Cream eggs and sugar.
Add melted butter and milk.
Stir in coconut and vanilla.
Pour in pie shell.
Bake in unbaked 9-inch deep dish pie shell for 45 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn(Pudding)
steps: Mix all ingredients evenly.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Bierocks
steps: Dough:
Buy frozen rolls (Rhodes) dough.
Thaw in refrigerator overnight.
Let stand at room temperature while preparing filling (will rise and make bag tight).
Roll with a rolling pin; spoon filling in center.
Roll out another roll and place on top.
With finger wet edge and pinch edges to seal.

recipes.title: Company Broccoli Casserole
steps: Prepare frozen broccoli according to package directions and place in a 3-quart casserole.
In a separate bowl, combine mayonnaise, eggs, soup and most of the cheese.
Add mixture to the broccoli and mix together.
Pour crushed crackers and remaining cheese over top and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Snowballs
steps: Mix and chill.
Shape into balls and roll in coconut.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix ingredients and pour over chicken.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Dip
steps: Blend ingredients.
Serve with chicken nuggets, ham or cheese cubes, pretzels or bread sticks.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 8 slices white bread, with crusts removed
steps: Layer in greased 9 x 13-inch pan:
white bread, sausage and cheese.
Blend together and pour over the layers: milk, salt, eggs, mustard and pepper.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Pie
steps: Heat 1 cup of milk and sugar until sugar is dissolved.
Mix cornstarch, 1/2 cup milk and egg yolks.
Add to hot mixture slowly. (Cook in double boiler until thick.)
Stir and add butter 10 minutes longer.
Cool.
Make meringue and top pie with it.
Brown and cool crust before pouring in filling.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Mix 3/4 of onions and all other items and pour into baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with remaining onions and bake, uncovered, for 3 to 5 minutes.
Serves 2 to 4.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Mix all ingredients until smooth and creamy.
Roll in ball. Roll in chopped nuts.
Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Easy Egg Salad
steps: Boil eggs; cool and peel.
Dice eggs into medium size bowl. Add all ingredients and mix well.
Cool in refrigerator about an hour before serving.
Serve on bread with lettuce, tomato and a slice of cheese.

recipes.title: Snowy Potatoes
steps: Cook potatoes until tender.
Drain and return pan to low heat, shaking to dry potatoes in large bowl.
Cream together the cheese and sour cream.
Add hot potatoes, one at a time.
Cream mixture and continue beating on high.
On low speed, add scallions, celery, green pepper, parsley, 1/4 cup butter, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Spoon into a 3-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle with paprika and dot with 2 tablespoons butter.
Bake in a preheated 375° oven for 25 minutes or until top is golden.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Tomato Chutney
steps: Peel pumpkin, discard seeds and scrape out center.
Slice and cut into 2 x 1 x 1/2-inch pieces.
Peel and slice tomatoes.
Peel and slice onions and press garlic.
Crush peppercorns and allspice in a mortar.
Put all ingredients in large pan.
Bring gently to a boil.
Cook very slowly and stir often.
When jammy, put into jars.

recipes.title: Plum Pork Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless pork loin, trimmed of excess fat and cut into thin strips
1 green bell pepper, cut into thin strips
3 large firm, ripe black plums, sliced
steps: In a wok or large skillet, heat oil until hot.
Add pork and stir-fry over high heat until cooked through, 5 to 6 minutes. Remove pork to a plate.

Add onion and green pepper to drippings in wok and stir-fry just until crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. Stir in plums, jam, lemon juice, brown sugar, mustard and ginger. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Mix cornstarch and water until blended.
Stir into sauce and cook, stirring, until sauce boils and thickens.
Return pork to skillet and simmer 1 to 2 minutes, until heated through.
Serve over hot cooked rice.

recipes.title: Pineapple Orange Molded Salad
steps: Melt jello in boiling water.
Add cream cheese and beat with beater until smooth.
Add pineapple and orange juice.
Mold until firm.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Sprouts And Carrots
steps: Trim the bottom of the Brussels sprouts and pull off any withered leaves.
Cook them in boiling salted water until tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain.
Slice carrots and cook in boiling salted water until tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
Grate 1 teaspoon of the colored zest from orange.
Squeeze 3 tablespoons juice.

recipes.title: Scalloped Eggplant
steps: Peel and chop eggplant.
Cook in water until tender.
Drain and add salt and pepper.
Mash thoroughly.
Crumble the cornbread. Add rest of ingredients and mix well.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Additional grated cheese can be sprinkled on top the last 10 minutes, if desired.

recipes.title: Butter Pecan Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: In a large bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk, pecans, butter and flavoring.
Mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into ice cream freezer container. Freeze according to manufacturing instructions.
Freeze leftovers.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
steps: Boil chicken, save broth.
Take meat off bones and layer in casserole.
Put onion, cheese and crushed Doritos on top of chicken. Heat soups, broth and Ro-Tel tomatoes until blended. Pour over casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: "Seafood In The Pink"
ingredients: 1 lb. medium shrimp, cleaned and deveined
1/2 lb. crab meat or lobster meat
olive oil (to cover bottom of pot)
seasoning: pinch of salt, pepper, basil and oregano
steps: In a pot, cover bottom with olive oil.
Season with salt, pepper, basil and oregano.
Heat and quickly cook chopped garlic (2 tablespoons), making sure the garlic does not brown.
Add marinara sauce and wine.
Simmer on low heat for at least 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Fettucine Alfredo
steps: Cook the pasta according to directions on package.
In a saucepan melt the butter and add the cream.
Bring to a boil whisking constantly.
Reduce heat and add parmesan, nutmeg and about 2 Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley.
Pour sauce over pasta individually.
Serve 6.

recipes.title: Pie Filling
steps: Mix sugar and cornstarch together well.
Add water and stir until clear over heat.
Boil 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Special K Roast
steps: Blend together first six ingredients.
Add cereal and mix well.
Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 1 hour at 350°. May be topped with cream of mushroom soup diluted 1/2 strength.

recipes.title: Hildy'S Hot Seafood Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1 (6 1/2 oz.) can crab, drained and flaked
1 (4 1/4 oz.) can shrimp, drained and cut up
steps: Combine all ingredients except bread crumbs.
Pour into greased casserole.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pistachio Cake
steps: Mix ingredients until well blended.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan lined with waxed paper.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Cool and then put frosting on cake.

recipes.title: Swiss Steak
steps: Cut up onion in bottom of crock-pot.
Roll steak in flour, salt and pepper.
Place in pot.
Pour in can of tomato sauce. Cook 3 to 5 hours on high.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Chili
steps: Put everything in pot and bring to a boil.
After it starts to boil, reduce to simmer and cook for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Pineapple Pies
steps: Mix all ingredients together well.
Bake in uncooked crusts at 350° for about 45 minutes.
Makes two pies.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
steps: Combine until smooth.
Serve as dip for fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Cream Of Garlic Soup
ingredients: 1 large loaf day old French bread
steps: Saute onion and garlic in melted butter for approximately 15 minutes.
Add chicken stock.
Simmer 1/2 hour.
Strain off onion and garlic.
Add bread to strained broth.
Simmer 10 minutes. Remove and place broth and bread mix in blender.
Blend until smooth.
Return to stove.
Add cream and thyme.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Layered Casserole
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic crushed or 1/2 tsp. garlic powder
1 pkg. (5 oz.) egg noodles, cooked and drained
steps: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
Cook meat in large skillet until browned.
Drain fat.

Add salt, sugar, tomatoes, tomato sauce, garlic, and pepper; simmer over low heat 5 to 10 min. Combine noodles with sour cream, cream cheese, and green onion. Arrange meat mixture and noodle mixture in alternate layers in a 2 qt. casserole dish. Top with grated cheese.
Bake 25 min.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 can (19 oz.) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (19 oz.) cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
1 can (28 oz.) tomatoes in juice, chopped
steps: Saute carrots and onion in oil in large nonstick saucepan until softened, 5 minutes.
Add 1 to 2 tablespoons water if sticking.
Add garlic; saute 30 seconds.
Add beans, basil, oregano, tomatoes, tomato paste and mushrooms; simmer covered 25 minutes to mingle flavors.
Add broccoli; cook 5 minutes.
Add peppers.

recipes.title: Ground Chuck Casserole
steps: Brown ground chuck in oven skillet.
Put Tater Tots on top of meat, then mix mushroom soup with some milk.
Pour over meat and Tater Tots.
Put frozen onion rings on top.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Meatball Sub Casserole
ingredients: 1 loaf (1 lb.) Italian bread, cut into 1 inch slices
2 cups (8 oz.) shredded mozzarella cheese, divided
steps: Mix green onions, bread crumbs, parmesan cheese and beef. Shape into 1 inch balls.
Place on rack in a shallow baking pan. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes.
Arrange bread in a single layer in an ungreased 9 x 13 x 2 inch pan (all the bread may not be used).
Combine cream cheese, mayonnaise, Italian seasoning, and pepper.
Spread over the bread.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup mozzarella.
Combine sauce, water, and garlic; add meatballs.
Pour over cheese mixture.
Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6 - 8.

recipes.title: Coconut Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 (3.4 oz.) pkg. cheese cake instant pudding mix
1 (6 oz.) pkg. frozen sweetened flaked coconut, thawed
1 (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
steps: Stir together first three ingredients. Press mixture evenly in bottom and up sides of 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350° for 8 minutes. Remove to a wire rack and cool completely.

recipes.title: Warm Tomato Taco Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef, browned and drained
1 can petite cut diced tomatoes, drained
steps: Reserve 2 tbsp tomatoes for garnish. Add remaining tomatoes and taco seasoning to skillet of drained beef. Cook for 5 minutes. Spoon into 1 1/2 quart shallow baking dish. Top with cheese. Garnish with reserved tomatoes and sliced green onions and sour cream, if desired. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Quick Turtles
ingredients: 5 chocolate bars (1 1/2 oz. milk chocolate or Hershey's chocolate foil wrapped Kisses)
steps: Arrange pecans in clusters 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet.
Top each cluster with one caramel, slightly flattened. Bake at 300° for 7 minutes or until caramel softens.
Remove to wax paper.
Flatten caramel with spatula.
Top each with 1 chocolate Kiss while still warm.
Spread when melted.
Refrigerate until chocolate hardens.

recipes.title: "8-Minute Light'N Fruity Pie"
steps: Completely dissolve Jell-O in boiling water, stirring about 3 minutes.
Add ice cubes and stir constantly, until Jell-O is thickened, about 2 or 3 minutes.
Remove any unmelted ice.
Using wire whip, blend in Cool Whip, then whip until smooth.
Fold in fruit.
Chill, if necessary, until mixture will mound.
Spoon into pie crust.
Chill for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. beef bouillon powder or 3 beef bouillon cubes
steps: Brown cubed or chopped steak and put in crock-pot.
Brown in oil the onion and garlic.
Add bouillon and water and bring to boil.
Add cornstarch; stir until clear glaze.
Add soy sauce to taste, celery and pepper.
Simmer in crock pot.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
steps: Cream oleo and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Beat well. Add baking powder and crumbs slowly with milk, coconut, walnuts and pineapple.
Mix together.
Fold in after everything else. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan in 350° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.
Use Buttercream icing.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Carrots
ingredients: 8 large carrots, cut into thin slices
2 Tbsp. apple juice or white wine or white grape juice
steps: Cook carrots in boiling water 10 minutes.
Drain.
Melt margarine in skillet.
Heat carrots and parsley thoroughly. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients.
Stir and cook 1 additional minute.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Seasoned Salt
steps: Mix well and use as salt.
You may also add any herbs to taste:
parsley, thyme, rosemary, oregano, basil or tarragon.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Louise
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients and add sweet potatoes and orange juice.
Put into large baking dish and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Alison'S Peanut Brittle
steps: Combine sugar, syrup and 1/3 cup water in a skillet.
Cook to hard crack stage.
Take off and add soda.
Add butter, vanilla and peanuts.
Turn out on a buttered cookie sheet.
Cool and crack into pieces.

recipes.title: Fruit Sauce
steps: Remove core and seeds from apples.
Remove seeds and membrane from oranges.
Grate apples and oranges with peeling.
Add sugar and mix well.
Chill.
Serve over plain cake.
Ad fresh, cool dessert in summertime.

recipes.title: Apricot Salad
steps: Bring to a boil the crushed pineapple and 1/4 cup sugar. Remove from heat and stir in gelatin, then cream cheese.
Add ice water.
Stir and let chill until thick.
Fold in Cool Whip, then chill.

recipes.title: Filet Mignon With Horseradish Gravy(An Easy Elegant Dish)
steps: Prepare gravy according to package directions; stir in horseradish and mushrooms.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Vegetable Medley
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) bag broccoli, carrots and cauliflower, thawed
1/3 c. sour cream or plain yogurt
steps: Combine all except 1/2 cheese and 1/2 onion rings.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or 8 minutes in the microwave.
Place remainder of cheese and onion rings on top.
Bake 5 minutes, uncovered, or 1 minute in microwave.

recipes.title: Cherry Fluff
steps: Fold all ingredients together (except a little of cherries and whipped cream).
Pour into glass serving bowl.
Chill.
Garnish with remaining cherries and whipped topping.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb flavored dressing mix
steps: Mix butter and dressing mix; spread 1/2 in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Precook zucchini and onion in salted water for 5 minutes.
Drain and spread over crumbs in pan.
Mix together sour cream, soup and grated carrot.
Pour over crumb mixture in pan.
Cover with the remaining 1/2 of crumb mixture.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugarless Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen apple juice, thawed and undiluted
6 c. sliced, cored and peeled Yellow Delicious apples (approximately 4 large apples)
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Thaw crusts and 2 tops (remove one from the second package then return crusts to freezer) according to package directions.

recipes.title: "Italiano" Spaghetti Sauce
steps: In large pot, brown ground sirloin, olive oil and minced garlic together.
Add tomato sauce and water when browned.
Bring to a rolling boil over medium heat.
Reduce to a simmer.
Simmer at least 3 hours (6 is better).
Serve over 1 pound of cooked spaghetti.
Enjoy with tossed green salad and garlic toast. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Bean Dip
steps: In a 13 x 13-inch pan, spread bean dip.
Mix sour cream, mayo and taco seasoning together and spread on top of bean dip.
Top with remaining ingredients with the cheese last.

recipes.title: Denver Omelette
steps: Scramble eggs with milk until fluffy.
Set eggs aside.
Brown ground beef.
Drain excess grease off.
Set aside.
Chop peppers, onions, ham and cheese.
Set aside.
Take eggs and pour into hot, greased frying pan.
Take ground beef, peppers, onions, ham and cheese, in that order.
Place only on one side of eggs.
Fold other half of eggs over, completely covering ingredients.
Turn only one time.
Serve with Tabasco sauce on top.
Makes 1 serving.

recipes.title: Greek Pasta And Beef
ingredients: 1 lb. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
steps: In a skillet cook beef, onion and garlic over medium heat until meat is no longer pink; drain. Stir in tomato sauce, water and seasonings. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Meanwhile in bowl combine macaroni, egg and Parmesan cheese. In a greased 3 quart baking dish spread half of macaroni mixture. Top with beef mixture and remaining macaroni mixture. Pour sauce over top. Bake uncovered at 350 for 45 to 50 minutes or until bubbly and heated through. Let stand five minutes before serving. Yields 12 servings.

recipes.title: Honey Jelly
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pouch liquid pectin or 1/2 (6 oz.) bottle liquid pectin
steps: Clean
small
jars
as if for canning. Stir honey, corn syrup, water
and	lemon
juice in a large saucepan.
Bring to hard boil over
medium-high
heat.
Add pectin. As soon as it comes to rolling boil that can't be stirred down, time exactly 1 minute and
remove
from heat. Skim off any film.	Pour hot jelly	in hot
jars. Leave 1/8-inch headspace. Screw on lids. Cool on
wire rack. Check for good seal.	Store in dark place up to 1 year.

recipes.title: Chocolate Delights(Cookies)
steps: Measure sugar, cocoa, butter and milk into 1 1/2-quart saucepan.
Bring to a rolling boil; boil one minute.
Stir in vanilla, peanut butter and oatmeal.
Drop quickly onto waxed paper in teaspoonful.
Enjoy.

recipes.title: Cookies Made From Cake Mix
steps: Cream all ingredients except cake mix.
Add vanilla and cake mix.
Heat oven to 350°.
Roll into 1/2-inch balls and bake for 6 to 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken #1
steps: Dip chicken in melted butter.
Then dip in mixture of sour cream and the beaten egg.
Then dip in mixture of Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs (add salt and pepper, if desired).
Place in buttered oblong baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown and tender.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: This Is A Dessert
ingredients: 1 can cherry or apple or peach pie filling
steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients well and put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Spread pie filling over top of first mixture.
Blend sour cream and egg.
Spread over top and bake 25 minutes longer at 350°.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Cornbread
steps: Cook onion and green pepper in soup until tender.
Mix in cornbread (which has been crumbled up) and poultry seasoning. Place all this in a baking dish and place pork chop on top.
Add salt and pepper and bake for 45 minutes at 400°, covered, then 15 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Cheese And Beefaroni With Biscuit
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine all ingredients together and place in casserole.
Place	biscuit on top and bake for at least 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Cheese Torte
steps: Mix together and pat into greased spring-form pan.

recipes.title: Baked Lasagna
steps: Brown the meat slowly. Spoon off excess fat.
Add the garlic, parsley flakes, salt, tomatoes and tomato paste to meat. Simmer, uncovered, until thick, 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Sea Scallops Or Shrimp With Sweet Peppers And Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 sweet red pepper, cored, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch pieces
1/4 lb. snow peas, trimmed and rinsed
salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
1 1/4 lb. sea scallops or shrimp used whole or cut into 1/2-inch cubes
4 Tbsp. shallots or scallions, chopped fine
4 Tbsp. fresh coriander or fresh basil, coarsely chopped
steps: In a large nonstick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of the butter and 1 tablespoon of the oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sweet red pepper pieces and the snow peas.
Cook, stirring and tossing, about 4 minutes.
Season with pepper flakes, salt and pepper. When the red peppers and snow peas are nearly cooked, add the remaining 1 tablespoon butter and 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Over high heat, add the scallops or shrimp, shallots, liqueur, lemon juice, coriander, salt and pepper.
Cook, stirring, about 2 minutes.
Cook until scallops or shrimp are heated through.
Do not overcook.
Serve immediately.
Yields 4 servings.
Great with rice or pasta.

recipes.title: Chopped Beef Dip In Rye Bread
steps: Beat cream cheese until creamy.
Add sour cream and mayo.
Beat until smooth.
Add beef, onion and garlic powder.
Carve large oval in top of rye bread and scoop out inside, leaving shell about 1/2-inch thick.
Reserve scooped out bread.
Stuff bread shell with dip.
Place on baking sheet.
Cover top and sides with foil.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Serve with crackers and scooped out bread.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Grind cranberries, apples and oranges together.
Have ready jello, dissolved according to directions.
Add fruit mixture. When slightly set add sugar.
Mix in a little red food coloring. Let set overnight in refrigerator.
Makes a large amount.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
steps: Mix together spaghetti, Parmesan cheese and egg whites.
Put in a large buttered baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Then add cottage cheese.
In a separate dish, mix together mushrooms, ground beef and spaghetti sauce.
Add to crust and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Add Mozzarella cheese and bake another 5 minutes.
Let cool for 5 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Hearty Beef Stew
ingredients: 1/2 lb. salt pork, cut in medium pieces
steps: Saute salt pork in large skillet.
Place in a Dutch oven or stew pot with beef chunks, onion, garlic, bouillon, tomato, peppercorns, parsley and enough water to cover all.
Cover; simmer for 2 hours.
Add wine last half of cooking.
The last 20 minutes of cooking, add potatoes, celery, carrots, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Copper Coins
steps: Heat together vinegar, sugar, oil, tomato soup, dry mustard, Worcestershire sauce and salt and pepper to taste.
Pour over carrots and let stand overnight.
Drain off most of liquid when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Cookies Made Of Yellow Cake Mix
steps: Mix
yellow
cake
mix and butter or oleo.
Add egg and milk. Mix
up
with
egg beater.
Add a little more cake mix. Beat
with egg beater.
Add a little more cake mix.
Beat with egg
beater until it gets too thick.
Take egg beater out and use
big spoon. If you can't beat anymore, then use your hand to
mix.
When
you are ready to put on greased cookie sheet, make
size
of silver dollar.
Bake at 375° for about 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Forever Ambers
steps: Cut orange slice candy into small pieces.
Mix first three ingredients.
Spread on cookie sheet and cook at 250° for 30 minutes.
When cool, roll into small balls and roll in powdered sugar.
Mixture will be gooey.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
steps: Make crust of graham cracker crumbs and 1 stick of butter. Press into 9 x 13-inch glass pan.
In a medium bowl, beat confectioners sugar and 2 sticks of butter.
Add eggs for 15 minutes.
Must beat 15 minutes.
Pour over crust.
Slice bananas over filling.
Put pineapple, other bananas and then cover with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts and maraschino cherries.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad - Marinated
ingredients: 1 (6 to 12 oz.) jar marinated artichoke hearts
steps: In a small bowl, stir together the olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, garlic, salt, pepper, minced onion, celery seed and parsley.

recipes.title: Puppy Chow
steps: Melt chocolate chips and peanut butter.
Pour over cereal.
Mix in enough powdered sugar to coat all pieces without breaking up cereal.
Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 large skillet cornbread and same amount biscuits
steps: Saute onion and celery in margarine. Mix all ingredients. Add chicken last. Put in greased crock-pot. Cook on high 45 minutes; cook on low 4 hours. Stir twice during cooking.

recipes.title: Microwave Caramel Corn
steps: Place corn in large paper bag. Combine remaining ingredients in qt. glass bowl and bring to a boil in microwave on high power. Boil 2 minutes. Add 1/2 tsp. soda and stir. Pour over corn close bag and shake. Cook on high power for 90 seconds and shake. Repeat above step and shake. Cook 30 seconds and shake. Repeat for 30 seconds and shake. Cool on cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Copper Carrots(Carrot Salad)
steps: Cut carrots crosswise in 1/4-inch rings and cook in boiling water until barely done.
Drain and place in large bowl.
Separate onion slices into rings; add with green pepper to carrot mixture. Combine tomato soup, sugar, oil, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper in blender.
Pour over carrots.
Marinate overnight.
Makes 8 cups.

recipes.title: Chicken Roll-Ups
steps: Mix cheese and chicken.
Half this mixture and put aside in a bowl.
Mix soup and milk in with other half of chicken mixture. Unroll crescents and place 1 tablespoon of dry reserved chicken mixture on crescent and roll up.
Place on a 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased pan; cover with liquid mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, until crescents rise and are golden.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Precook squash and onion until just tender.
Stir in 1 can undiluted mushroom soup, 2 eggs, 1/2 of cheese and 1/2 cup cracker crumbs.
Put in oiled casserole dish and bake at 350° until brown and bubbly.
Top with remaining cheese and cracker crumbs.
Return to oven to melt cheese and brown crumbs.

recipes.title: Apricot Nectar Mold
steps: Bring nectar to a boil and dissolve Jell-O.
Add oranges and their juice.
Place in mold.
Serve with a topping of sour cream sweetened with sugar and vanilla to taste.

recipes.title: Morgan'S Mai Tai
ingredients: 1 oz. banana extract or banana liqueur
steps: Flash blend and float 1 ounce Myers rum!
Sit back and enjoy!

recipes.title: Baked Vidalia Onions
steps: Cut out top core of each whole onion.
Place beef bouillon cube in onion and a
pat of butter.
Wrap individual onion in foil and bake at 350 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Punch
steps: Add water to make one gallon.

recipes.title: Kirt'S Casserole
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. noodles (elbow or egg), cooked and drained
steps: Cook and drain the noodles.
Add browned hamburger and onion to the remaining ingredients.
Stir well.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°, or microwave for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Coleslaw
ingredients: 8 c. finely shredded cabbage (2 1/2 lb. medium head)
steps: Combine cabbage, celery, carrot, green onion and parsley.
Pour on salad oil and toss until slaw is evenly coated.
Sprinkle on and toss in the seasonings:
salt, pepper, celery salt and monosodium glutamate which will now stick to the oil coated slaw.
Finally add wine vinegar and toss.

recipes.title: Tiger Meat
ingredients: 2 lb. ground round or ground chuck
steps: Tell the butcher to grind the round or chuck for tiger meat and do not season.
Combine all the ingredients together.
Mix well and roll into "ball like" meat loaf.
Wrap in plastic wrap, then foil.
Let stand in refrigerator for 12 to 24 hours.

recipes.title: Cool Squash Salad
ingredients: 1 medium size red onion, cut in rings
steps: Into a large salad bowl, slice all ingredients and toss with your favorite salad dressing.
May be served garnished with slices or quarters of boiled egg and black olives.

recipes.title: Skillet Macaroni & Spam
ingredients: 1 can Spam, grated or 1 1/2 lb. ground meat
steps: Cook meat in large skillet until browned slightly.
Remove from skillet and add macaroni, onion and green pepper.
Cook in meat fat until macaroni is yellow (do not need a lot of fat). Return meat to skillet, along with tomato sauce, salt and papper, water and Worcestershire sauce.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes or until macaroni is cooked to suit your taste.
Variation:
Add 1 can whole kernel corn.

recipes.title: Spoon Bread
steps: Pour water over corn meal.
Add butter and salt.
Stir until smooth.
Add milk, egg yolks and baking powder, then fold in the stiffly beaten whites of 3 eggs.
Pour into a greased Pyrex baking dish and bake 50 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
steps: Boil potatoes until barely firm, not mushy.
Drain.
Melt cheese on top.
Add both cans of soup and onion.
Stir.
Place in a casserole dish.
Top with cornflakes.
Bake on 350° for about 20 minutes or until brown on top.

recipes.title: Buttercream Frosting
steps: In a small mixer bowl, beat butter until light and fluffy. Gradually add about half of the powdered sugar, beating well. Beat in milk and the vanilla.
Gradually beat in remaining powdered sugar, then add milk, if necessary, to make frosting of spreading consistency.
Frost tops and sides of two 8 or 9-inch layers.

recipes.title: Hamburger Noodle Bake
ingredients: 8 oz medium noodles, cooked and drained
steps: Cook beef, onions, and peppers together and drain. Combine with meat and 2 c water; mix well and put in casserole dish. Toss 2 c soft bread crumbs and 1/4 c melted butter together, sprinkle on top casserole. Bake uncovered at 350° till heated through, about 45 min.

recipes.title: Unplug Drain
steps: Pour in drain.
After fizzing stops, follow with lots of boiling water.
For grease in sinks, use 1 cup salt and 1 cup baking soda, followed by boiling water.

recipes.title: Easy Fruit Salad
steps: Drain all canned fruits.
Mix together with pie filling, chill.
Add bananas just before serving.

recipes.title: Slaw
steps: Pour enough very hot water almost boiling plus 1 heaping tablespoonful salt over the first 4 ingredients, cover and let set for 1 hour; drain well.
Mix the remaining ingredients while mixture is setting.

recipes.title: 9-Inch Custard Pie
steps: Heat oven to 450°.
Beat eggs slightly, then beat in rest of ingredients.
Pour into pastry lined pie pan.
Bake for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and bake 15 minutes more or until a silver knife inserted 1-inch from side of pan into filling comes out clean.
The center may still look a bit soft, but will set later.

recipes.title: Laredo Supper
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) jar Cheez Whiz with jalapeno peppers (optional)
steps: Brown beef, drain.
Add green peppers and onion.
Add chopped tomatoes, beans, chili powder and Cheez Whiz.
Simmer 15 minutes. Serve over corn chips with lettuce.

recipes.title: French Dressing
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients in small bowl.
Beat at medium speed until smooth.
Stir in vinegar, catsup and paprika.
Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: Beer Kielbasa
steps: Boil kielbasa in beer for 1 hour.
In saucepan, boil chili sauce and jelly until thick.
Cut kielbasa in 1/4-inch pieces. Add to sauce.
Heat to boil.

recipes.title: Coconut Icing
steps: Combine sugar, corn syrup and water in a small saucepan.
Heat to a rolling boil over medium heat.
Boil mixture until a small amount of mixture spins a 6 to 8-inch thread when dropped from a spoon.

recipes.title: Hungarian Noodle Bake
steps: Combine ingredients, then mix with 1 package of egg noodles.

recipes.title: Orange Pineapple Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water. Add orange juice. Add undrained crushed pineapple and 2 cups drained mandarin oranges. Pour into 13 x 9 dish. After it is set, mix vanilla pudding, 1 cup milk and Cool Whip. Top with this mixture.

recipes.title: Yogurt-Sour Cream Chive Dressing For Baked Potato
steps: Stir together sour cream and remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Hershey Bar Pie
steps: Thaw Cool Whip at room temperature.
Melt Hershey bar in microwave or in double boiler.
Add to Cool Whip, stirring to mix. Add vanilla.
Pour into pie shell and chill for 2 hours or more.

recipes.title: Spinach Squares
ingredients: 1- 10 3/4 oz can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
steps: Place spinach in wire strainer; rinse under hot water to thaw. Press to remove water.
Melt butter in skillet; add onion and mushrooms; cook until onion is soft.
Beat eggs with a fork.
Add breadcrumbs, soup, 2 tbsp cheese, pepper, basil, oregano, spinach and onion mixture; mix well.
Pour into well greased 9 inch square pan.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake, uncovered at 325° for 35 minutes or until firm when touched lightly.
Cool slightly; cover and chill.
Cut into 1 inch squares for appetizers and serve cold or reheat at 325° for 10-12 minutes.

recipes.title: Philly Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb. thinly sliced, cooked roast beef
steps: Cook and stir onions until tender.
Set oven to broil.
Place bottom halves of buns on ungreased cookie sheet; top with onions and beef.
Cut cheese slices in half.
Place 4 halves on each sandwich.
Broil until cheese melts for 2 to 3 minutes.
Top each with remaining bun half.

recipes.title: Broccoli Pie
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen broccoli, chopped or spinach
steps: Brown hamburger meat with chopped onion; drain.
Add eggs, soup (undiluted), nutmeg and frozen broccoli or spinach that has thawed. Mix all together.
Pour into pie shell, then add cheese on top and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Edible Play Dough
steps: Mix and place in refrigerator several hours before using.
The child may eat it after finished playing with it.
Store remaining in refrigerator for several days.

recipes.title: Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 4 c. cut up fresh vegetables (broccoli, carrots, celery, etc.)
3/4 lb. boneless chicken breasts, thinly sliced
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients and set aside.
In a large skillet, or wok, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat.
Add vegetables and garlic.
Stir-fry 3 minutes or until tender-crisp.
Remove from skillet.
Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil.
Add chicken; stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Return vegetables to skillet.
Stir broth mixture and add to skillet.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil for 1 minute.
Serve with rice.
Makes 4 servings; 210 calories per serving.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hash
steps: Drain fruits. Add remaining ingredients. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Serve.

recipes.title: Pineapple Mold
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup of boiling water.
Add sour cream; stir.
Add pineapple with juice.
Stir with mixer until real blended.
Pour into mold and leave in refrigerator for 2 days before serving.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
steps: Put all ingredients in a bowl.
Mix and serve with raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Quick Pie Crust
steps: Mix as directed.
Makes enough dough for a 2 crust pie.

recipes.title: Judy'S Chicken Divan
ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen broccoli flowerets, cooked and drained (enough to line 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish)
steps: Arrange broccoli in baking dish.
Top with chicken.
Blend remaining ingredients together; pour over all.
Sprinkle top with Cheddar cheese and bread crumbs. bake at 350° for 1/2 hour or until hot.
May be made ahead and frozen.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Hot Slaw
steps: Wash cabbage.
Add other ingredients including sausage.
Cover and simmer about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Cookies
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pillsbury Dough Boy cookie dough (chocolate chip oatmeal), baked as directed
steps: Mix ingredients well (except cookies); put between baked, cooled cookies to make a cookie sandwich.

recipes.title: Coney Island Hot Dogs
steps: Soak soup mix in hot water for 15 minutes.
Strain out onion pieces, reserving liquid.
Brown beef with onions in oil in a large skillet.
Add seasonings, ketchup and liquid from onion. Simmer together about 30 minutes.
Serve on wieners on buns.

recipes.title: Cranberry Jello Salad
steps: Mix together and set in refrigerator until set.

recipes.title: Easy Tortellini Salad
steps: Cook tortellini al dente.
Drain.
While still in drainer, pour olive oil over tortellini and sprinkle with black pepper and garlic powder.
Pour tortellini in medium bowl.
Add black olives, peppers and cheese.
Toss lightly; chill before serving.

recipes.title: Southwestern Chili Dip
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can olives, drained and chopped
1 (4 oz.) can green chili peppers, drained and chopped
a few dashes of Tabasco sauce
1 (7 oz.) can crab meat with cartilage removed
1 (5 oz.) jar Old English cheese spread (usually found in dairy case with cheeses)
steps: Let butter and cheese spread soften to room temperature.
Mix together the mayo, garlic and seasoned salt.
Add crab meat. Spread on split English muffins.
Freeze 10 minutes if for immediate use, then cut into quarters.
Broil until bubbly-crispy or freeze.
When ready to use, cut, then broil.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
steps: Layer cookies on bottom; add slice bananas.
Mix milk with pudding mix and fold in the condensed milk with the Cool Whip. Layer this on top of banana and repeat layers.
Chill for several hours or overnight before serving.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
steps: Drain all fruit.
Mix all ingredients together except Cool Whip.
Pour into pie shells.
Spread Cool Whip on top and chill for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: French Dressing
steps: Beat with mixer for 10 minutes. Makes 1 quart.

recipes.title: Roasted Root Vegetables
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. assorted winter vegetables (carrots, turnips, white and sweet potatoes, rutabagas and pearl onions)
1/4 c. chicken or vegetable stock, plus more as needed
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Scrub vegetables and peel (as desired). Cut into 1 to 2 inch pieces (all of similar size).
Place butter in roasting pan and heat in oven until melted.
Add vegetables, 1/4 cup of stock, salt and pepper.
Stir well to coat and return to oven.
Cook vegetables for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally, and adding more stock as needed to keep vegetables moist. Vegetables are done when tender and golden.
Great for Thanksgiving and Christmas dinner.

recipes.title: Mary Frances' Christmas Candy
ingredients: 1/2 bag chocolate chips or 4 bars Baker's chocolate
steps: Melt margarine; add milk, coconut and sugar.
Mix with hands; roll into balls and chill.
After mixing by hand, it might need chilling just a little to roll.
Makes about 6 dozen small balls.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix
steps: Melt oleo and stir into the stuffing mix.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Spread 1/2 the stuffing mix in bottom of casserole dish.
Pour remaining mixture of ingredients over and top with remaining stuffing mix.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
steps: Cook cauliflower 10 minutes in boiling salted water; drain well.
Combine cauliflower with 2 tablespoons butter, onion, cheese, sour cream and salt.
Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole; melt remaining butter and toss with bread crumbs.
Sprinkle over the mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
steps: Combine cream cheese and sour cream.
Place in bottom of deep dish pie pan. Pour salsa on top.
Place chopped red and green pepper on top of salsa and then shred cheese and put on top of peppers.
Serve with nachos

recipes.title: Avocado And Crabmeat Ring
steps: Sprinkle gelatin over 1 1/2 cups of water in top of double boiler.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Place over hot water and stir until dissolved.
Refrigerate approximately 30 minutes until syrupy. Separate crabmeat pieces.
Cut avocado in half.
Press chunked and peeled avocado through sieve until measures 1 cup.
Toss crabmeat, avocado, sour cream, mayonnaise, onion, celery, salt, pepper and lemon juice.
Mix with gelatin and pour into 6-cup ring mold. Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Ham Rolls
steps: Slice dinner rolls in half.
On bottom half of rolls, add ham and cheese.
Put the top of the bread on top of the cheese.
Mix together the next 5 ingredients.
Slowly pour over dinner rolls. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
May garnish with sesame seeds. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Classic Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 8 oz. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
1 c. chopped green or sweet red pepper
steps: In large bowl, stir together first 6 ingredients until smooth. Add remaining ingredients; toss to coat well.
Cover and chill. Makes 5 cups.

recipes.title: Tommy'S Cracker Dessert
steps: Combine crackers and butter.
Press 3/4 of the mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Reserve remaining mixture for top.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
steps: Place the eggs in pan and cover with lukewarm water.
Heat rapidly to boiling point, then boil about 8 minutes.
Remove the pan from heat, cool eggs in cold running water.
Peel the eggs carefully and cut eggs in half lengthwise; remove the yolks.
Place egg yolks and other ingredients in bowl.
Mix with fork until well blended.
Spoon some of the egg yolk mixture back into each white half.
Sprinkle the top lightly with paprika.
Chill in refrigerator before serving.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: No Bake Mini Cheesecakes
steps: Mix crumb mixture as directed on package.
Press onto bottom of 12 paper-lined muffin cups.
Prepare filling mix as directed on package.
Spoon over crumb mixture.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour or until ready to serve.
Garnish as desired.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Sharon'S Poppy Seed Pound Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients well and bake in a Bundt cake pan greased well with butter or Crisco and coated with sugar (not flour). Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip #2
steps: Thaw and squeeze liquid out of spinach until dry. Stir all ingredients together and blend well. Cover and refrigerate 2 hrs. Serve with bread or crackers.

recipes.title: Broccoli Corn Medley
steps: Cook over medium heat with 1/2 cup water to desired tenderness.
A bit more salt or sugar may be added to taste.

recipes.title: Crispy Herb Chicken
ingredients: 3 lb. chicken, cut up, skinned, rinsed and patted dry
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Line with foil or grease baking pan. Combine potato flakes, Parmesan cheese, parsley flakes, onion powder, garlic salt and pepper; stir until well mixed.
Dip chicken into margarine; roll into potato flake mixture to coat. Place in greased pan.
Bake 45 to 60 minutes or until done and golden brown.
Makes 4 to 5 servings.
(My husband, T. G., loves this recipe!)

recipes.title: Butterscotch Candy
steps: Melt butterscotch chips and peanut butter on low heat in saucepan.
Stir constantly.
Pour onto 9 x 13-inch cookie sheet. Melt Hershey's chocolate and put on top, zigzagging across until covered with chocolate.
Cool. Cut in squares and eat.

recipes.title: Party Oyster Crackers
steps: Mix ingredients together and toss with crackers until oil is absorbed.

recipes.title: Souperior Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 envelope Lipton onion or beef flavor mushroom soup mix
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients.
In large shallow
baking pan, shape into loaf.
Bake for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
ingredients: 1 can mushroom soup or cream of chicken soup
1 bell pepper (red or green), cut into slivers
steps: Place cabbage, salt and pepper in oblong dish.
Spread evenly. Pour soup over cabbage.
Lay pepper over cabbage.
Cover with cheese.
Spread dressing over top of cabbage.
Pour oleo over dressing evenly.
Bake at 350` for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Brisket
steps: Build a really hot fire; sear brisket on both sides. While fire is cooling down a little, take brisket and season with spices and sauces. Put onion and peppers on one side of brisket and wrap with foil. Wrap twice to keep juices from spilling out. Put back on pit and let cook for 6-8 hours, keeping a low fire going all the time. Should be very tender.

recipes.title: Best-Ever Stuffed Peppers(Serves 6)
ingredients: 8 oz. can whole kernel corn, drained
8 oz. pkg. noodles, cooked and drained
steps: Wash peppers thoroughly; remove tops, seeds and membranes. Chop tops. Heat oil in large skillet; saute beef, onion and pepper tops over medium heat until meat is browned. Stir in corn, salt, pepper and basil. Turn into large bowl; clean skillet. Arrange peppers in skillet; fill with meat mixture. Sprinkle with cheese; pour soup and water over all. Cover; simmer for 40 minutes or until tender. Serve with noodles.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
steps: Simmer chicken breasts for 1/2 hour in water or chicken broth; cool.
Thaw broccoli completely.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place broccoli in pan.
Cut chicken breasts in half; put each chicken breast so it covers the broccoli.
Mix sherry, mayo and soup; pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with the Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: Several potatoes cooked, chopped to bite size, with skins
2 cans soup(any combo of cream of chicken, cream of celery, cream of broccoli)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Precook vegetable mixture and potatoes. In saucepan, cook onion and celery in butter or margarine until tender.
Add pepper and thyme to taste.
Add soups milk and stir until smooth.

recipes.title: Clam Sauce
ingredients: 4 to 5 large cloves fresh garlic, minced
steps: Mince or chop garlic cloves. Saute in olive oil.
Add dried parsley at last minute of sauteing.
Add water, clams, salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer for 5 or 6 minutes.
Pour over cooked spaghetti.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and red pepper.
Serves 2 people generously.
Doesn't look real appetizing but it's delicious.
Serve with garlic bread and a salad.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Famous Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 c. firmly packed dark brown sugar
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Prepare pie crust.
In a large bowl, combine corn syrup, sugar, eggs, butter, salt and vanilla; mix well.
Pour filling into prepared pie crust; sprinkle with pecan halves.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until center is set. Cool.
Top with whipped cream or ice cream, if desired.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Egg Macaroni Salad
steps: Prepare macaroni and cheese as directed on box.
Add vegetables, salad dressing and seasonings.
Chop 5 eggs and mix lightly into mixture.
Chill.
Stir in additional salad dressing before serving.
Garnish with the remaining egg, sliced.

recipes.title: V-8 Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef or ground turkey
1 c. each any vegetables (about 6 c. total)*
steps: *Green beans, zucchini, corn, peas, celery, carrots, potatoes, broccoli, cabbage.

recipes.title: No Peek Stew
ingredients: 1 c. each coarsely chopped celery, carrots, onions and potatoes (approximately 1 to 1 1/2-inch pieces)
steps: Combine all ingredients, except potatoes, in covered casserole.
Bake at 350° for 4 hours.
Potatoes to be added during the last 45 minutes of the baking process.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Berry-Cheese Pie
steps: Mix cheese, 1 tablespoon sugar and lemon rind until blended. Spread over crust.
In saucepan, combine remaining sugar, cornstarch, strawberries and lemon juice.
Crush with masher. Cook over medium-high heat, stirring until thickened.
Let cool. Gently fold in blueberries with a spatula.
Spread over cheese in crust.
Cover.
Refrigerate at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Hot Dip
steps: Brown sausage and hamburger together until crumbled, drain excess grease. In crockpot, met cheeses. Add meat, soup, tomatoes, green chilies and onions, mix well. Makes a large amount and can be frozen. Serve with chips. Serves many.

recipes.title: Homemade Vegetable Soup
ingredients: soup meat and bone (spareribs work great)
1 lb. fresh string beans and lima beans
steps: Needs a very large pot.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
steps: Grease large casserole with butter.
Soak bread in milk; mix well with hands.
Beat eggs with sugar, flavorings, raisins and cinnamon (nuts if desired).
Mix well with bread.
Cook, uncovered, in oven at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Grind cranberries and orange in blender.
Add in sugar and blend.
Pour into bowl and let mixture set for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Chip Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef in skillet with onion.
Add chili and tomato soup.
Simmer until well blended.
Line a casserole dish with corn chips.
Pour beef mixture over them.
Top with corn chip crumbs and then cheese.
Bake at 400° until the cheese melts.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookie Cake
ingredients: 1 large pkg. Oreo double stuff cookies
steps: Crush cookies and press 1/2 into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip together.
In blender, mix milk, vanilla pudding and vanilla and add to cream cheese mixture.
Pour over pressed cookies and then add remaining cookies.
Refrigerate overnight.
Serves 20.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Delight
ingredients: 3/4 c. red grapes, halved and seeded
steps: Mix everything except salad dressing and Cool Whip together. Bland salad dressing and cool Whip together, then mix it with everything else.
Place on a bed of lettuce and serve with assorted crackers of your choice.

recipes.title: Cucumber Sandwiches
steps: Peel and slice cucumbers into thin slices.
Put on a plate and sprinkle with salt.
Cover with paper towels and another plate and put weights on top (such as 5 pound bag of flour) for about 1 to 2 hours.
Cut rounds of bread.
Spread with mixture of 8 ounces cream cheese and small amount of sour cream and lots of herbs.
I find mint a must.
Chives are also great.
Onion may be substituted for chives.
Place cucumbers on top of the cream cheese-herb mixture.

recipes.title: Harvey Wallbanger Cake(To Be Prepared In Baking Ring)
ingredients: 1 pkg. (2 layer size) orange cake mix
1 pkg. (3 to 3 3/4 oz.) instant vanilla pudding mix
steps: Evenly
grease baking ring or spray with vegetable oil. In
a large
mixing bowl combine all ingredients;
beat for 4 minutes on
medium
speed
with electric mixer.
Remove 1 1/2 cups batter, reserve for cupcakes.
Pour remaining cake batter into
prepared baking rings.
Microwave on 2/3 power (Medium-high)
for 2 minutes, 1/2 power (Medium) for 20 to 30 minutes, or
until wooden
pick
inserted
in
center comes out clean. Rotate
once during
cooking time, if necessary.
Batter will run
over
sides of
pan
slightly.
Let
stand in pan for 10 minutes.
Turn out on plate and glaze while warm.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
steps: Place sauerkraut in strainer.
Wash with cold water and drain well.
Combine kraut, onion, celery, pepper and pimentos in large bowl.
Mix well.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Fruit Salad
steps: Mix together and let blend overnight.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
steps: Cook macaroni; drain.
Mix sugar and vinegar until sugar dissolves. Add mayonnaise and stir until creamy.
Add remaining ingredients and mix.
Pour sauce over macaroni and mix well.
Let set for a while and keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Pinto Bean Pie
steps: Drain and mash beans; set aside.
Combine sugar and margarine; mix well.
Add the beans, coconut and vanilla.
Add beaten eggs to mixture.
Pour in 9-inch pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour. This makes one pie, but one can of pinto beans and one can of coconut makes three pies.
All you do is double the mixture.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. condensed cream of mushroom soup
steps: In a medium bowl, combine beans, milk, cream of mushroom soup, pepper and 1/2 can French fried onions.
Pour into a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.
Top with remaining onions; bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Place chicken in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Mix cream of chicken soup and sour cream.
Pour over chicken.
Crumble crackers over soup mix.
Melt margarine and pour over top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
(I just use chicken breasts.)

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
steps: Cook noodles.
Mix soup.
Add cheese; stir until melted.
Add tuna, then noodles.
Season with salt and pepper.
Pour into buttered dish; top with bread crumbs or bran flakes.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
steps: Mix and let stand overnight.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Sausage Egg Casserole
steps: In a skillet, brown sausage; drain grease.
Break up sausage. In a bowl, mix together eggs, milk, salt and mustard.
Tear bread into small pieces and add to egg mixture.
Add cheese and sausage.

recipes.title: Baked French Toast
steps: Cook sugar, butter and syrup until bubbly.

Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place bread slices on syrup mixture (2 layers of bread). Mix milk, eggs, cinnamon, vanilla and salt in blender. Pour egg mixture over bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove cover and bake 45 minutes at 350°. Serve warm or syrup hardens. Can be reheated.

recipes.title: Queso Ole
ingredients: 1 pkg. Velveeta shells and cheese dinner
1 can Ro-Tel chopped chilli peppers and tomatoes
steps: Cook macaroni dinner as directions call for.
After you drain the macaroni, add the cheese and Ro-Tel tomatoes and stir lightly. Brown the ground meat and drain.
Add taco seasoning and 3/4 cup water.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes.
In a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, layer the macaroni, then the meat on top.
Cook at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.
When serving, top with sour cream and tomatoes, with tortilla chips on the side.

recipes.title: Sauce Fettucine Alfredo
steps: Heat butter and cream in saucepan until butter melts.
Stir in cheese, salt and pepper.
Pour over 12 ounces cooked fettuccine.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
steps: Add enough flour to make stiff.

recipes.title: Home Fried Potatoes
steps: Melt butter in a large frying pan and add onion.
Cut potatoes into bite size pieces or slice them to your desired thickness. Put potatoes in pan with butter and add garlic powder and pepper. Fry on medium heat until browned and tender.
Serve with breakfast, lunch or dinner.

recipes.title: Cola Bbq Sauce
steps: Combine Coke and remaining ingredients (except honey) in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat, simmer 6 minutes. Stir in honey, cool. Serve with grilled or roasted chicken.

recipes.title: Braves Hot Dog Chilli
ingredients: dash of garlic, black pepper and salt
1 1/2 c. Hunt's tomato sauce or barbecue sauce
steps: Cook ground beef and drain.
Cook onion and pepper in a little oil.
Combine all remaining ingredients together with meat, green pepper and onions.
Put in large pot.
Cook slowly for 1 1/2 hours.
Stir occasionally.
Boil hot dogs and toast buns.
Serve chilli over hot dogs.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Mix cranberries and sugar; let stand overnight.
Next morning, add the celery, nuts and jello-hot water.

recipes.title: Zucchini With Turkey Sausage
steps: Layer in skillet the ingredients.
Add a little water.
Cover and simmer on low to medium heat for 30 to 40 minutes.
Cook hot peppers separately and for those who like hot peppers, stir them in at the table.

recipes.title: Apple Crunch Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cold water or apple juice
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add cold water or juice and cinnamon and chill until thickened.
Fold in apple, celery and nuts.
Spoon into mold or bowl.
Chill until firm, about 4 hours. Makes 5 cups or 10 servings.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch green onions, sliced (save some for top)
steps: Mix together and store in refrigerator.
Keeps for several days.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Prepare crust from the first 3 ingredients.
Blend and press into a pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies
steps: Melt Velveeta cheese over low heat.
Serve warm with tortilla chips.
Mix together with tomatoes and green chilies.
Serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Frosting
steps: Place ingredients in a bowl and mix until smooth. Frost cake while hot. Refrigerate 8 hours or more. (When I'm in a hurry, I just refrigerate it for 2 hours and it's still good.)

recipes.title: Deer Jerky
ingredients: 3 lb. deer meat, cut into strips
steps: Mix first 10 ingredients to make a marinade.
Soak meat, refrigerated, in the marinade overnight up to 24 hours.
Drain well.
Coat with coarse ground black pepper.
Line the bottom of the oven with foil.
Spear meat with toothpicks and hang from the oven rack.
Set oven at 150°.
Keep oven door ajar to help the meat dry.
(This can also be done in my dehydrator.)

recipes.title: Chicken-Broccoli Skillet
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) whole chicken breasts, skinned, split, boned and cut into 1/2-inch wide strips
steps: Thaw the frozen broccoli.
Season chicken strips with salt and pepper.
Cook chicken and chopped onion quickly in the hot diet margarine until chicken is just done.
Stir in the thawed broccoli, lemon juice, 3/4 teaspoon salt, thyme and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Cook, covered, 6 minutes.
Add tomato wedges.
Cook, covered, 3 to 4 minutes more.
Makes 4 servings.
One serving (1 1/4 cups) equals 2 1/2 lean meat exchanges, 2 vegetable exchanges and 1/2 fat exchange.

recipes.title: Apple Dip I
steps: Cream the cream cheese, brown sugar and vanilla until smooth. Add peanuts, then add sour cream and mix until thin enough to dip.

recipes.title: Wall Lake Trout
steps: Make a crimp tent of foil for fish; cook 15 minutes at 400°. Saute mushrooms, grapes, pecans, wine, butter and olive oil. Start fish and saute same time.
Squeeze lemon on fish just before serving.
Cover fish with sauteed combination.

recipes.title: Mom'S Favorite Spareribs
ingredients: 2 to 2 1/2 lb. spareribs, cut into 2-inch lengths
1 green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch squares
steps: Bring 3/4 cup of vinegar and water to a boil; add ribs.
Cook 10 minutes.
Drain and discard water.
Cut ribs apart into serving pieces.
Put cornstarch in large bowl; add soy sauce and garlic. Mix well.
Turn ribs over and over to coat all pieces.
Let stand 1/2 hour.
Heat oil in a large pot.
Add marinated ribs; brown slowly and thoroughly.
Remove from skillet. Pour pineapple syrup, remaining 1/4 cup of vinegar and sugar into skillet.
Stir and cook 1 minute.
Add ribs.
Simmer 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in cornstarch mixture left from marinating ribs, pineapple chunks and green bell pepper.
Cook over high heat for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Serve with hot rice and enjoy!

recipes.title: Watermelon Rind Preserves
steps: Peel green shell and pink flesh from firm watermelon rind. Cut in pieces about the size of the last two joints of your little finger. Cut up several lemons in thin slices.
Add same amount of sugar, by weight, as you have fruit.
Let stand several hours or overnight.
Cook very slowly until thick and clear. Seal.

recipes.title: Taco Dip(Appetizer)
steps: Mix cream cheese and sour cream.
Add spices.
Spread on serving platter.
Layer chopped onion, green pepper, shredded cheese, shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes.
Serve with Doritos.

recipes.title: Chicken Chow Mein
ingredients: a few green onions, sliced lengthwise
steps: Brown meat slightly in oil.
Add celery, onions, pepper and broth.
Cover and simmer until tender.
Drain Chinese vegetables and mushrooms.
Add to mixture.
Bring to a boil.
Mix cornstarch and soy sauce.
Add to hot mixture.
Stir until thickened.
Spoon into deep dish and garnish with green onions.
Serve over fried noodles.
Also can be served over cooked rice or Chinese noodles.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
steps: Brown ground beef with onion and pepper.
Drain off fat.
Mix cornmeal, eggs, soda, salt, milk and oil.
Grease 1 large iron skillet.
Pour 1/2 of cornmeal mixture into skillet.
Add ground beef mixture.
Cover with grated cheese.
Add rest of cornmeal mixture.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Crunch
steps: Layer the following in an 8 x 8 1/2-inch baking dish: pineapple, blueberries, cake mix and chopped pecans.
Pour melted margarine over layered ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dill Dip
steps: Mix together and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Creamy Broccoli Bake
steps: Cook broccoli first in water.
Put cooked broccoli in ungreased dish.
Beat soup and milk.
Pour over broccoli. Sprinkle on cheese.
Mix Bisquick and melted margarine; sprinkle over cheese.
Bake 20 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: No Bake Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) Keebler Ready-Crust graham cracker pie crust
steps: Beat cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar.
Blend in sour cream and vanilla.
Fold in whipped topping, blending well. Spoon into crust.
Chill until set, at least 4 hours.
Garnish with blueberries.
Preparation time:
15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage-Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 c. Cheddar cheese, grated, sharp
3 c. Bisquick or any biscuit mix
steps: Blend ingredients.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350°, until golden brown, about 15 minutes.
Drain.

recipes.title: Cheese Monkey Bread
steps: Thaw bread completely; cut into pieces.
Cut cheese into small blocks and tear off pieces of bread dough and wrap around cheese.
Dip into melted butter and place around Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° until good and brown.
Turn onto serving plate and pull apart.

recipes.title: Pheasant Hash
ingredients: 2 to 3 pheasant breasts, cooked and diced
1 (10 to 11 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
steps: Melt margarine in a large covered frypan (or electric pan). Add potatoes and brown.
Add remaining ingredients; mix thoroughly.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir occasionally. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Vegetable Sandwiches
steps: Clean vegetables and cut into chunks.
Place in blender and blend until medium fine.
Drain.
Combine mayonnaise, salt and cream cheese.
Add vegetable mixture and mix well.
Store covered overnight in refrigerator.
Spread on bread of your choice. Mixture can be made ahead of time and stored in airtight containers.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
steps: Cook 30 to 45 minutes.
Serve with grated cheese (1/2 Colby, 1/2 Monterey Jack) and tortilla.

recipes.title: Karo Pecan Pie
steps: Beat eggs.
Add rest of ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.
Reduce oven to 325° and bake until done (20 to 25 minutes).

recipes.title: Fruit Sherbet
steps: Boil sugar and water.
Add the juices and the bananas.

recipes.title: Ann'S Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Mix dry ingredients.
Stir in milk.
Cook to soft ball stage (234° on candy thermometer) in cold water.
Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and peanut butter.
Beat until mixture loses its gloss.
Pour quickly into greased pan.
Cool.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Guamanian Chicken Estufao
steps: Cut chicken into small pieces.
Place chicken, garlic, onion, vinegar, salt and pepper into a bowl.
Mix well.
Drain liquid and reserve.

recipes.title: Pretzels (Flavored)
steps: Mix together.
Pour over bag (1 pound) of broken pretzels. Bake in oven 10 minutes at 250° on cookie sheet.
Stir.
Bake another 10 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Easy Noodles
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. Reames frozen egg noodles
2 c. cubed, cooked beef, chicken or turkey
steps: Heat butter in Dutch oven over medium heat until melted.
Add celery and onion; cook until tender.
Add broth; bring to boil. Stir in noodles, salt and pepper.
Simmer 35 minutes or until noodles are tender.
Stir in meat and sage.

recipes.title: Divinity
steps: Combine corn syrup, water and sugar; boil to hard ball stage (265°).
Beat egg whites stiff and gradually beat in boiling syrup.
Whip until it begins to stiffen.
Add vanilla and nuts. Drop onto waxed paper.
Makes about 150 pieces.
This is a real old recipe, one that was used when my Mom was a little girl.

recipes.title: Double Boiler Bread Pudding
ingredients: 3 slices stale bread, buttered and cubed
3 eggs, beaten with pinch of salt
steps: Place brown sugar on top of double boiler and the bread on top of it.
Mix eggs, salt, vanilla and milk.
Pour over bread.
Do not stir!
Steam over boiling water until knife comes out clean. Serve warm with ice cream.

recipes.title: Sesame Chicken
steps: Mix this marinade together in a bowl.
Wash 4 to 8 pieces of chicken breasts and place in baking pan.
Pour marinade over chicken.
Let set in refrigerator overnight.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.title: Hello Dollies Or Magic Squares
steps: Layer ingredients in order.
Pour can of Eagle Brand milk over top and cook at 300° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburger And Peppers
ingredients: 1 c. tomato juice or fresh tomatoes
steps: Cook hamburger, onion, celery, garlic, salt and pepper until brown.
Add remaining ingredients, cook until peppers are done. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Dairy Queen Ice Cream
steps: Heat milk to almost scalding.
Put gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water, then pour into hot milk.
Also add sugar, salt, marshmallows and corn syrup.
Cover and let set a little until things are dissolved, then add vanilla.
Pour into freezer can and let set in cold place until firm before freezing.
Pour can of Milnot on top.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Green Giant Shoe Peg corn
1 medium onion or 1 can French fried onions
steps: Combine all ingredients except crackers and butter.
Crush crackers and put melted oleo on crackers.
Sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Marinated Chicken Wings
steps: Marinate wings 24 hours.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Can be frozen after marinating before cooking.
While baking, pour some of the sauce over wings for more flavor.

recipes.title: Microwave Pralines
steps: Make sure all ingredients are at room temperature before beginning.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Spiced Tea
ingredients: 2 tsp. loose black tea or 2 tea bags black tea
steps: Bring to boil water, cinnamon, cardamon and cloves.
Boil for 10 to 15 minutes.
You should be able to smell the spices.
Add tea and boil 1 minute.
Remove from heat and add sugar.
Tea is quite sweet in Ethiopia as it is the "dessert" after a meal.
Tea is also served with plain bread for breakfast or just enjoyed as a snack.
At snack time, it is tasty with "dabo kolo."

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Brown hamburger and drain.
Set aside to cool.
Add all other ingredients and mix well.

recipes.title: Fig-Strawberry Preserves
steps: Thoroughly mix figs, gelatin and sugar in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over low heat and continue boiling for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour quickly into glasses. Cover at once with 1/8-inch hot paraffin or seal with new lids.
Makes 6 medium glasses.

recipes.title: Mounds Candy
steps: Mix powdered sugar, condensed milk, chopped nuts, coconut and melted margarine; shape into desired shapes.
Dip into melted mixture of paraffin and chocolate chips.
Place on waxed paper until set.
This candy stores well in airtight container.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients and chill.

recipes.title: Eclair Cake
ingredients: 2 (3.4 oz.) pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
steps: Layer 1/3 of the graham crackers in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Combine pudding mix and 3 cups milk in a large mixing bowl.
Beat at low speed with an electric mixer (about 2 minutes).
Fold in whipped topping; spoon half of the mixture on graham crackers. Repeat layers, ending with graham crackers.
You may not need all the crackers.
Combine sugar, butter and 1/3 cup milk in saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute, stirring often.
Remove from heat.
Stir in morsels.
Spoon over crackers and top with pecans.
Cover and chill 8 hours.
Yields 12 to 15 servings.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
steps: Roll into nickle sized balls and bake on ungreased cookie sheet 20 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Rita'S Fruit Salad
ingredients: any other fruits you may like
steps: Drain the fruit cocktail.
Sprinkle the jello over the fruit; stir and let set for 30 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and Cool Whip.
Next, add the remaining ingredients in desired quantities. Refrigerate before serving.

recipes.title: Garlic-Herb Mashed Potatoes
steps: Take mature green beans and snap the ends. Lay them on a sheet
and dry for several days.

recipes.title: Chocolate Silk Pie
steps: In a mixer bowl, beat cream cheese, confectioners sugar and vanilla until well blended.
Add cocoa alternately with milk, beating it smooth. Gradually add whipping cream, beating until stiff.
Spoon into crust.
Cover and chill several hours or overnight.
Garnish with freshly grated chocolate.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sticky Chicken Wings
steps: Cut tips off chicken wings and cut in 2 pieces.
Mix ingredients.
Pour over wings.
Marinate 24 hours.
Spread out on cookie sheet in one layer.
Bake at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Do not add any of the sauce when baking.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
steps: Sieve sweet potatoes which are boiled.
Add ingredients in the order mentioned.
Bake in unbaked pie crust at 400° for 10 minutes and lower to 350° and bake an additional 20 minutes or until knife comes out clean.
For a richer pie, add 2/3 cup evaporated milk and 1/3 cup water.

recipes.title: Football Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef in oil.
Add onions, tomatoes, ketchup, worcestershire sauce and green pepper.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Cook macaroni according to pkg. directions, drain.
Combine with meat mixture.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Blend in soup.
Pour into large casserole dish.
Top with cheese.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Holiday Mix
ingredients: 1 bag plain M&M's (holiday red and green)
steps: Mix all ingredients together and store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Sandwich Dessert
steps: Layer a dish with sandwiches. Spread caramel dip on top.
Top with Cool Whip. Shake Magic Shell and spread on Cool Whip. Freeze. Cut in squares when serving. Serve frozen.

recipes.title: Three Bean Salad
steps: Combine sugar, oil, vinegar and salt.
Heat to dissolve sugar. Stir in all beans, onion and pepper.
Marinate in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Mock Pecan Pie
steps: Cream the butter to soften.
Add sugar and cream until fluffy. Add syrup and salt.
Beat well.
Add eggs, one at a time, and beat well after each egg.
Stir in coconut and oatmeal.
Pour into pie shell and bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until it tests clean with a knife.
Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Sandwiches
steps: Line a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan with aluminum foil. Grease.
Melt marshmallows and margarine until smooth.
Stir in vanilla.
Pour over cereal; mix well.
Spread into prepared pan. Cool completely.
Cut cereal mixture in half, crosswise.
Cut ice cream 3/8-inch thick slices.
Arrange one-half pan of cereal mixture.
Top with remaining half.
Freeze until firm.
Cut into 12 sandwiches.
Store covered in freezer.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie
steps: Mix and whip until a little stiff. Turn into a graham cracker shell and chill.

recipes.title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
steps: Heat sugar, oil, vinegar, water, salt and pepper and cool.
Mix all ingredients together and marinate overnight.

recipes.title: Roast Turkey In Foil
steps: Rub turkey cavity with salt and pepper; rub skin with butter. Fill turkey loosely with stuffing.
Place turkey on large sheet of foil in roasting pan.
Combine wine, brandy, thyme and basil; mix well.
Pour over turkey; seal foil tightly.
Bake at 400° for 3 hours and 30 minutes; fold foil back.
Bake for 30 minutes longer or until turkey is browned.

recipes.title: Easy Kraut
steps: Scald and peel tomatoes.
Squeeze the seeds and juice from tomatoes by hand.
Put pulp in large cooker.
Add 2 cups sugar to 1 cup tomatoes, with very little juice.
Add lemon which has been sliced thin and cut into half moons.
Cook as for jelly.
Pour into jars, add 1/2 stick of cinnamon.
Seal with lid.
Water bath 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry Delight
steps: Mix all ingredients and chill.
Quick, easy and delicious.

recipes.title: Bean Cheese Dip
steps: Layer each, starting with refried beans and ending with cheese, in a large, flat casserole.
Heat in oven at 325° for 20 minutes, or until bubbly.
Serve with corn chips.
Good for a crowd.

recipes.title: Lemon Cloud Jello Mold
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water and add lemonade.
Refrigerate until jelly-like.
Fold in Cool Whip and pour into a six-cup mold. Refrigerate until ready to unmold.

recipes.title: Water Chestnut Dip
