steps: Mix all ingredients except vegetables and keep in refrigerator for at least 4 hours.

recipes.title: Cornbread Dressing
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Bake in a greased baking dish at 350° for 40 minutes.
If recipe is doubled allow more baking time.

recipes.title: Spanish Corn Pie
steps: Drain tamales, reserve liquid.
Mash tamales and combine with drained corn.
Saute meat, onion and celery until meat is crumbly; stir in tomato paste.
Add enough water to tamale liquid to make 2/3 cup, pour in, season.
In a greased 1 1/2 quart casserole, arrange alternate layers of tomato and corn mixture and meat mixture.
Pitted black olives may be added.
Insert tip of bay leaf in each end of casserole.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake in a moderate 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Remove bay leaves before serving.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Saute oleo, celery and onion.
Add 1/2 bread.
Saute until crisp.
Mix remainder of bread, soup and chicken.
Add sauteed ingredients.
Put into well-greased casserole.
Add 3/4 of can of evaporated milk over top.
(Don't mix.)
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Make Ahead Oriental Salad
ingredients: 1 (17 oz.) can tiny green peas, drained
1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel white corn, drained
2 (5 oz. each) cans water chestnuts, drained and sliced
1 (4 oz.) jar pimentos, drained and sliced (optional)
steps: Combine vegetables in large bowl.
Stir gently.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over vegetables.
Chill 24 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Put 1 cup dressing mix in bottom of 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Mix other ingredients and put on dressing mix.
Top with remaining dressing mix.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 450° for 20 minutes or until brown.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1/4 c. sharp Cheddar cheese, finely diced
1/2 c. sharp Swiss cheese, finely diced
steps: Combine biscuit mix, cheese and poppy seed.
Add milk and eggs, stirring just enough to blend.
Beat 1 minute.
Turn into well-greased loaf pan.
Sprinkle with additional poppy seed.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Remove from pan and cool on rack.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Chicken Crunch
ingredients: 1 c. finely crushed pkg. herb-seasoned stuffing
steps: Mix 1/3 cup soup, 1/4 cup water and onion.
Dip chicken in soup mixture; roll in stuffing.
Place in shallow baking dish and drizzle with butter.
Bake at 400° for 1 hour.
Combine remaining soup and water.
Heat; stir.
Serve over chicken.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Let stand for an hour or overnight in refrigerator.
May substitute low-fat milk and light sour cream for better nutritional value.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
ingredients: 3 slices soft bread, torn in pieces
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix; place in a loaf pan.
Bake 1 hour. Drain and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Candy
steps: Put chips in double boiler until melted.
Place condensed milk, coconut and pecans together.
Mix well.
Add to chocolate. Put in buttered dish and refrigerate.
Cut into small squares.

recipes.title: Weber Grill Sun Jerky
steps: Note:
Need brown paper bag and covered grill and briquets.

recipes.title: Favorite Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef in 10-inch pan.
Add onions, green peppers, hot pepper, sugar, Accent and tomatoes and simmer slowly for 35 minutes.
Cook macaroni according to directions.
Drain and add to meat mixture.
Serve with tossed salad.

recipes.title: Caramel Banana Pie
steps: Cover can of Eagle Brand milk with water and boil for 3 hours. Keep refrigerated until needed.
Slice bananas into baked pie crust.
Spoon Eagle Brand milk over bananas.
Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Mix ingredients together, crushing tortilla chips on top. Serve with sour cream and Catalina dressing.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Undercook broccoli.
Combine and mix well.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Pour over broccoli.
Cover with Cheese Nips.
Bake in 2-quart casserole dish at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Prepare a 9-inch pie crust.
Set aside.
Combine all ingredients and simmer for about 5 minutes.
Put into pie shell. Cover with another crust.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until brown.
Spread butter over baked crust.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Crinkles
steps: Beat in bowl with mixer at medium speed until fluffy.
At low speed add 2 1/2 cups unsifted flour.
Shape mixture into 1-inch balls.
Roll in granulated sugar.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until browned.
Immediately press nuts or chocolate kisses into cookies.
Cool.
Store in airtight container.
Addictive!

recipes.title: Chicken Chop Suey
steps: Saute onions and green pepper in oil with salt for 5 minutes. Add celery, mushrooms and stock. Cover and cook slowly until celery is done.
Add chestnuts and bean sprouts.

recipes.title: Cocktail Wieners
steps: Mix cranberry sauce and mustard.
Add wieners to sauce. Simmer 15 minutes.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Jay'S Steak And Sauce
ingredients: Steak, any portion amount to serve family
rosemary, salt and pepper to taste
steps: Brown steak in butter in large skillet. Add onions, mushrooms and garlic in the amounts your family likes and cook until tender.

recipes.title: Easy Bean And Pasta Soup
steps: Saute onion, chopped, in
olive
oil in saucepan, being careful not to burn the onion.
Add kidney beans;
include the liquid.
Add the V-8
juice.
Cook	the
macaroni according to the directions on the package.	Drain and add to bean mixture. Stir together and bring to a boil.
Top with grated cheese.

recipes.title: Pretty Pear Salad
steps: Drain pears; save juice.
Combine syrup with cinnamon candies; heat until dissolved.
Add pears; bring to a boil.
Chill pears in syrup several hours or overnight.
Blend cream cheese with milk and lemon juice.
Add remaining ingredients.
Drain pears thoroughly.
Place filling in center of pear halves and spread almost to edge.
Can use as halves or put together for a whole pear.
Keep chilled.
Serve.

recipes.title: Easy Salad
steps: Prepare macaroni as directed.
Add pepper, carrots, cheese and onion.
Add salt.
Mix sugar, vinegar and oil.
Add to salad. Refrigerate.
Stir several times.
Better if made the day before.

recipes.title: Cool Summer Dessert
ingredients: sugar cookie dough (use own recipe or a box mix)
fresh fruit (strawberries, kiwi, blueberries and peaches)
steps: Prepare cookie mix as directed.
Spray a 9 x 13-inch cake pan with non-stick spray.
Spread cookie mix into cake pan evenly. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until lightly golden brown.
(Do not over bake.)
Remove from oven and cool.
Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese until smooth.
Spread over cooled cookie bar.
Top with your favorite sliced fresh fruits.
Refrigerate one hour before serving.
Cut and serve.
(For calorie counters, use light Cool Whip and light cream cheese.)

recipes.title: Party Piquant Meat Balls
steps: Mix above and shape into size of walnuts.
Brown in oven.
In slow cooker, add meat balls to sauce.
Serve for party time or any added meal.

recipes.title: Pineapple Crunch
steps: Mix together butter and bread cubes until butter is absorbed. Set aside in mixing bowl.
Beat eggs well, then beat in sugar. Stir in undrained pineapple.
Place in baking dish.
Spread cubes on top.
Bake approximately 1 hour at 350°.
Good with ham.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Cut biscuits into quarters.
Drop in paper bag with 3/4 cup sugar and cinnamon.
Shake well and place in Bundt pan or 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Melt butter and one cup sugar in pan with raisins and nuts.
Pour over biscuits.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Take out of pan while hot.
Pull apart with fingers.

recipes.title: Lobster Dip
steps: Mix cream cheese until smooth.
Add Worcestershire sauce, salt and mayo.
Gradually add liquid from lobster.
Mix until smooth. Add lobster and stir.

recipes.title: Banana Punch
steps: Mix everything but ginger ale with mixer until smooth.
Freeze in containers.
When ready to use, place partially thawed mixture in punch bowl.
Add ginger ale.

recipes.title: Cheesy Grits Casserole(Breakfast Casserole)
steps: Cook grits in water, add butter and cheddar cheese and seasoning salt.
In a separate bowl, stir 2 eggs.
Mix in slowly to the grits mixture.
Put in 9 x 13 casserole and cook for 1 hour at 350.
Can be made the night before and bake the following morning.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potatoes
steps: Boil potatoes until tender; drain. Salt and pepper to taste. Mix other ingredients and melt in microwave. Pour over potatoes. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Camarones Burciaga
ingredients: 2 bunches scallions (white and tender green parts), chopped
1 whole roasted red pepper, chopped (about 1/2 c.)
steps: Heat olive oil and butter in large skillet over medium heat. Saute scallions and garlic for one minute.
Add shrimp, white wine, Rose's lime juice and red pepper.
Cook over medium heat until shrimp are done (approximately 5 minutes).
Add cilantro 1 minute before cooking is completed.
Serve over cooked pasta with Parmesan cheese.
Serves four hungry people.

recipes.title: Copper Pennies
steps: Peel and slice carrots 1/4-inch thick.
Cook until tender (10 minutes).
Slice onion thin, same with pepper.
Divide onion in rings.
Drain carrots; mix with onion and pepper.
Boil sugar, oil, soup, salt and pepper for 1 minute.
Pour over carrots. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
steps: Butter bottom and sides of 8 x 8-inch pan.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes, then bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry Tomato Salad
steps: Wash cherry tomatoes and green onions.
Cut cherry tomatoes in half and place in bowl. Cut green onions and place in bowl with tomatoes.
Take oregano and crush with your hands, over the onions and tomatoes.
Drizzle olive oil and vinegar over salad, to taste. Cut up Feta cheese in small chunks and sprinkle over salad.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Cook and stir ground beef over medium heat until brown; drain. Stir in taco sauce and heat. Toss lettuce, green pepper, tomatoes, cheese and chips. Spoon hot mixture and salad dressing over lettuce mixture; toss. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Carrot Raisin Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Kahlua
steps: Pour boiling water over sugar and instant coffee.
Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Add brandy and vodka and mix well.
Pour into large bottle; add vanilla bean.
Seal or cork tightly.
Age 30 days.
Shake bottle every 2 to 3 days.

recipes.title: Sunshine Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. carrots (5 to 6), peeled and shredded
steps: Mix all ingredients together (except lettuce) in a mixing bowl.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 15 minutes. Toss again before serving.
Serve on lettuce leaves.
Healthy snack for kids to prepare.

recipes.title: Quick Ginger Chicken
steps: Combine ginger, honey and soy sauce in a small bowl; stir well and set aside.
Place each chicken breast half between 2 sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap; flatten to 1/4-inch thickness, using a meat mallet or rolling pin.
Coat grill rack with vegetable cooking spray; place on grill over medium hot coals.
Place chicken on rack and cook 4 minutes on each side, basting frequently with soy sauce mixture.
Place chicken on serving platter; garnish with green onion strips, if desired.
Yields 4 servings; contains about 201 calories per chicken breast half.

recipes.title: Incredibly Easy Cherry Crisp
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, combine cake mix and butter.
Using 2 knives, cut over and over until mixture is coarse and crumbly.
Press mixture to bottom and halfway up sides of greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan, reserving about 1/4.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
steps: Cook first 5 ingredients until tender.
Add celery soup.
Cook until mixed well.

recipes.title: Baked Bean Casserole
steps: Cook ground beef and onion.
Drain.
Drain juice off cans of beans.
Mix everything together and cook 30 to 45 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Beat egg slightly.
Add catsup, seasoning, green pepper and onion.
Mix beef and crumbs.
Add other mixture and knead until well blended.
Shape into loaf and bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar Coated Walnuts
steps: Mix above ingredients together in saucepan and bring to a hard boil.
Boil until mixture starts to string when poured from a spoon.

recipes.title: Chicken Strata Casserole
steps: Place 3 slices of bread cubes in a large greased casserole. Mix the chicken or turkey, celery, onion, green pepper, salad dressing and salt; add on top of the bread cubes.
Add 3 more slices of cubed bread.
Beat eggs with milk; pour over top and let stand overnight or several hours.
Add mushroom soup over top of casserole, then top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. yellow cake mix (containing instant pudding)*
steps: *Mix cake mix according to directions on box.
For amount of liquid given on cake mix box, use vegetable oil for 3/4 amount and use water for the remaining.

recipes.title: Deluxe Chipped Beef
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Heat oil; add raw vegetables and cook until they begin to turn brown.
Stir mushroom soup, water and beef into vegetables.
Cook, stirring as needed, until thickened.
Add pimiento and eggs. Serve on noodles, along with a carrot salad.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cream Fudge
steps: Cook until a drop hardens in cold water.
Then take form fire and beat until nearly cold.
Pour on well buttered plate and when cold, cut in squares.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Place drained beans in bottom of baking dish and layer corn on top.
Mix soup, onions, sour cream, cheese and garlic salt and pour over corn and beans.
Mix margarine, crackers and nuts and pour on top of mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: French Dressing
steps: Put ingredients into quart jar in order.
Shake well in jar.

recipes.title: Streusel Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
steps: Mix with hands the first 5 ingredients.
Mix the cake mix as directed.
Pour half into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Crumble half of the topping over this. Add rest of the batter. Top with remaining topping. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.
Serve warm with whipped cream.

recipes.title: I Can'T Believe It'S Zucchini
steps: Spread zucchini in a 9 x 13-inch glass casserole dish. Sprinkle garlic salt over zucchini.
Microwave margarine and onion for 2 minutes at full power.
Mix cream cheese with margarine-onion mixture until smooth.
Spread over zucchini. Sprinkle cracker crumbs over cheese mixture.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Orange Pork Chops
steps: Season chops with salt, pepper and paprika.
Brown well in hot fat in skillet.
Turn down heat, add water and simmer 45 minutes, turning once.
Add more water if necessary.

recipes.title: Fruit Roll
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients, mixing well. Divide into 3 equal portions. Roll each into an 11-inch log. Roll each log in powdered sugar and wrap in plastic wrap. Refrigerate several hours or until firm. Cut into 1/2-inch slices, reshaping slices, if necessary. Yield: about 5 dozen slices.

recipes.title: Turkey Marinate
steps: Blend
ingredients by hand;
pour over turkey breast in covered
container.
Marinate overnight in refrigerator.
Bake turkey
breast
according to directions; marinate during cooking. Good with chicken, also!

recipes.title: Confetti Tuna Casserole
ingredients: 1 (7 oz.) can tuna, drained and flaked
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Combine all ingredients, except egg slices in a medium bowl and stir to blend.
Spoon into 10 x 6-inch baking dish.
Bake at 325° for 25 to 35 minutes or until bubbly and heated through. Garnish with egg slices.

recipes.title: Anchovy Dip
steps: Blend well mayonnaise and cream cheese.
Add other ingredients and blend well.
Serve with crisp vegetables (radishes, carrots, cucumber slices, celery, cauliflower, broccoli).

recipes.title: Harvard Beets
steps: Mix cornstarch and sugar.
Add liquid and boil until thickened.
Add butter, salt, pepper and diced, sliced or small whole beets.
Makes about 2 cups.

recipes.title: Mott'S Family Crab Cakes
steps: Mix and make into cakes.
When you mix the crab into the mixture, try not to break apart the crab.
You want the crab to stay in large lumps.
Makes 6 large cakes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli and onions together until tender; drain.
Mix all ingredients together.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Bake at 350° until brown.
Croutons on top (optional).

recipes.title: Baked Ham In Coca-Cola
steps: Cut Hostess ham in half long ways.
Mix in a bowl 2 cups Coca-Cola and 1 cup brown sugar.
Pour over ham and bake 1 hour at 350°.
Turn over every fifteen minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Gems
steps: Mix all together but the chocolate chips and put in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Spread melted chocolate chips on top.
Chill and cut into squares.
Don't chill too long!

recipes.title: Homemade Gorp!
steps: Mix all ingredients and place in Ziploc bags.
Great for hiking and camping trips.

recipes.title: Pizza Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. spiral macaroni, cooked and drained
steps: In a large bowl, combine macaroni, tomatoes, Cheddar cheese, green onions and pepperoni.
In small bowl, combine oil, Parmesan cheese, vinegar and seasonings; pour over macaroni mixture.
Cover and refrigerate several hours.
Top with croutons (optional) just before serving.
Great for large barbecues.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Layer Doritos (crushed or whole) in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Put chicken on top.
Mix cream of celery, chicken, mushroom and Ro-Tel in a pan on medium heat. Pour over top of chicken.
Top with Velveeta and cook until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Pistachio Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients and chill at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Blender Pie
steps: Grease pie pan (9 inches).
Beat in blender all ingredients for 3 minutes.
Bake at 375°
for 30 minutes.
Cool on rack; refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: A-1 Hot Buttered Rum Mix
steps: In a saucepan, cook butter and sugars over medium heat beating gently with a whisk until it becomes light in color, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the spices and the ice cream; blend well. Refrigerate or freeze until ready to use.
Use a heaping teaspoon per drink, adding a shot of rum and boiling water to fill the mug.

recipes.title: Veg-All Casserole
steps: Mix together all ingredients, except croutons.
Pour into baking dish.
Sprinkle croutons over top.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Soup
steps: Cut pumpkin into chunks and remove seeds and fiber.
Pare off any bumpy outer skin.
Cook in water until tender.
Drain; put through sieve.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Sandwich
steps: Place 8 slices bread, edges together, in pan.
Combine first six ingredients.
Spread on slices.
Place second 8 slices of buttered bread on this.
Spread with mixture of soup and sour cream.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake 1 hour at 300°.
Serve with fresh fruit salad for bridge!
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Orange Sponge
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Add cold water.
When thickened, beat in rest of ingredients.

recipes.title: Swedish Glug(Hot Holiday Punch)
steps: Heat and simmer for at least one
hour.
Do not boil.
May also add walnuts.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes(The Kids' Favorite)
steps: Brown meat.
Add vegetables and cook until tender.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer until tender.
Serve by spooning onto hamburger buns and with plenty of napkins!!!

recipes.title: Frozen Pies
steps: Brown the coconut and pecans in 1/4 stick oleo, stir often, then cool.
Mix the cream cheese and milk, then fold in the Cool Whip.
Put 1/4 mixture in each pie crust.
Put 1/4 caramel over this mixture, then 1/4 the coconut and pecans.
Repeat and freeze. Serve frozen.

recipes.title: Cauliflower-Olive Salad
steps: Cover cauliflower flowerets, onion and olives with salad dressing.
Marinate overnight.
Just before serving, add lettuce, broken into bite-size pieces.

recipes.title: Duncan Hines Cookies
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines cake mix (lemon or yellow)
steps: Mix all ingredients. Spray cookie sheet with Pam.
Drop by spoonfuls onto sheet.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Oriental Shrimp And Snow Peas Express
steps: Combine Marsala wine, teriyaki sauce, salt and pepper; set sauce aside.
Butterfly shrimp by slitting lengthwise without cutting through.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over high heat.
Add shrimp and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. Transfer shrimp to a platter.
Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Add scallions
and stir for 1 minute.
Add sauce, snow peas, ginger and garlic; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 2 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook for 1 minute.
Makes 4 servings.
Preparation Time:
5 minutes.
Cooking Time:
6 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Divan
ingredients: 2 pkg. (10 oz. each) frozen broccoli stalks
1/2 c. shredded sharp cheese or 1/3 c. grated Parmesan cheese
steps: Cook broccoli as directed until tender; drain.
Arrange stalks in a greased oblong baking dish.
Place chicken over broccoli. Combine mayonnaise, soup, lemon juice and curry powder. Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine crumbs and butter; sprinkle over all.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Snowball Cake
steps: Mix gelatine, sugar and pineapple.
Set in refrigerator until jelled.
Cut brown off of angel food cake.
Tear into pieces. Prepare 2 envelopes of Dream Whip.
Fold into gelatine-pineapple mixture, etc.
Set in refrigerator.
Put whipped cream or Cool Whip all over this.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients, except sour cream and 1/2 the jello. Spoon 1/2 mixture into serving dish.
Spread sour cream on top. Add remaining 1/2 of jello mixture.
Chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Kentucky Fruit Pie
ingredients: 5 bananas, sliced and let stand in lemon juice for 10 minutes
steps: Fold in Cool Whip with all other ingredients.
Pour into pie crust and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Veg-All Casserole
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
steps: Mix first 9 ingredients and place in a large baking dish. Melt margarine and mix with Ritz crackers and sprinkle on top. Bake at 300° until bubbly.
Reduce temperature slightly and bake 10 more minutes.

recipes.title: Jeanne'S Holiday Punch Recipe
steps: Mix all liquids together.
Then add strawberries and orange sherbet. Stir.
Serve and enjoy.

recipes.title: Chicken Supreme
ingredients: 6 to 7 whole chicken breasts (halved and deboned)
steps: Mix all ingredients except butter, bread crumbs and chicken. Wash breast and wipe dry; dip in mixture. Put in pan and cover, let set in refrigerator overnight. Roll in bread crumbs. Place in shallow pan so that pieces don't touch. Pour butter over top. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
steps: Make dirt by crumbling Oreos and vanilla wafers super fine. Combine cream cheese, sugar and margarine.
Mix pudding and milk in separate bowl.
Combine cream cheese mixture and pudding mixture with electric mixer.
Fold in Cool Whip.

recipes.title: *Butternut Squash Filling
steps: Cook squash as per package instructions. Add remaining ingredients and pour into pita dough lined pan.

recipes.title: Honey Bun Cake
steps: Mix cake mix, eggs, oil, and sour cream and pour 1/2 of this batter in a 11x 9 inch pan (grease and flour first).
Mix 1 c brown sugar and cinnamon.
Sprinkle 1/2 of this mixture on top of batter. Put other half of batter on this.
Now sprinkle other half of sugar mixture on top.
Swirl as you would marble cake.
Bake in 350 degree oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Angel Salad
steps: Dissolve jello with 2 cups hot water.
Add cream cheese. Dissolve and cool.
Add undrained pineapple, fruit cocktail and marshmallows.
Mix and let congeal.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Put in refrigerator until set.

recipes.title: Ritzy Broccoli
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Melt margarine in skillet. Saut crackers in margarine until all margarine is absorbed. Reserve 1/4 cup for topping. Layer broccoli, crackers and cheese in that order in casserole dish until all is used. Top with reserved crackers. Bake in oven until bubbly, about 20 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Swirl
steps: Use about 1/3 of refrigerator dough.
Roll out dough into a 12 x 7-inch oblong pan.
Spread surface with melted butter
with pastry brush.
Sprinkle with the sugar and cinnamon.
Roll up as for cinnamon rolls.
Cut into 12 slices; place with a little space between in greased 9-inch round pan.
Cover; let rise until light (25 to 35 minutes).
Bake until golden brown; remove from pan.
If desired, top with icing.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into 2 greased skillets. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Fish Fillets
steps: Cut fillets into 4 portions and soak 3 minutes in milk to which salt has been added.
Drain and roll in bread crumbs, place fish in greased baking dish and dot with butter.
Bake at 450° allowing 8 minutes if fish is fresh and 15 minutes if fish is frozen.
Yield:
4 servings.
Carbohydrate 5 g, protein 22 g, fat 13 g, calories 225.
One serving = 3 meat low-fat exchange.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cauliflower Salad
steps: Will keep in refrigerator several days.

recipes.title: Mexican Seven Layer Dip
steps: Mix sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning.
In square pan, layer items, starting with bean dip.
Chill, then serve.
Best used with Tostitos.
Measures are approximate; may add or decrease according to your taste.

recipes.title: Russian Chicken
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb. chicken parts (any type will do)
steps: Mix together all ingredients, except chicken.
Marinade will be a little lumpy.
Pour over chicken and marinate at least 2 hours.
Cook chicken as is for 45 to 50 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Almond Cheese Ball
steps: Mix thoroughly by hand.
Shape into ball.
Decorate with crushed almonds.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Carrot Bake
steps: Place carrots, onions, and garlic into greased 15x10 in. baking pan.
Drizzle with oil and vinegar.
Sprinkle with thyme, salt, and pepper,
Gently toss to coat.
Cover and bake at 450° for 20 minutes.
Stir. Bake uncovered for 10 minutes; stir again. Bake 10 minutes longer or until carrots are crisp-tender.
Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Quick Cake Cheesecake
steps: Mix margarine and crumbs.
Put in bottom of 7 x 11-inch pan. In blender, put in hot water and gelatin.
Process at low speed until smooth.
Add cheese one cup at a time.
Process until smooth.
Pour in large bowl of mixer.
Add Cool Whip and mix until smooth (low speed).
Pour over graham crust.
Chill until set (about 1 hour).
Top with filling.
Ready in 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Reduced Calorie Pumpkin Pie
steps: Sprinkle gelatine in 1/3 cup milk; let set 1 minute.
Heat in microwave on High about 1 to 1 1/2 minutes until dissolved.
Add remaining milk to dissolved mixture.
Add pumpkin and spice. Blend well.
Place mixture over ice water and stir until mixture starts to thicken.
Pour into diet crust.
Chill until firm. Nutrient Exchange: 1/3 milk, 1/4 bread and 1/4 meat.

recipes.title: Caramel Dip For Apples
steps: Beat all ingredients together.
Serve with sliced apples.

recipes.title: Pork Chops With Filling
steps: Brown pork chops on both sides and place in shallow baking dish.
Lightly mix bread cubes, onion, butter and 1/4 cup water and poultry seasoning.
Place a mound of filling on each pork chop. Blend soup and 1/3 cup water.
Pour over pork chops and filling.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sunrise Smoothie(Breakfast Shake)
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) carton vanilla or coffee flavored yogurt
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients in container of an electric blender.
With blender on high, add ice cubes, one at a time, processing until smooth after each addition.
Serve immediately. Makes about 2 cups.

recipes.title: Easy Microwave Caramel Corn
steps: In large paper grocery bag, place popped popcorn.
In a 2- quart bowl, mix brown sugar, corn syrup, butter and salt.
Put in microwave on High for 1 minute.
Stir; heat again for 1 minute. Stir and a third time, heat for 1 minute and stir.
Remove from microwave and add baking soda and vanilla.
Pour into bag over popcorn.
Shake vigorously.
Put bag and all into the microwave and heat for 30 seconds.
Remove and shake.
Heat another 30 seconds. Remove and shake and heat for a third time for 30 seconds.
Pour out onto wax paper or open grocery bag to dry.
Break up and store in airtight bowl.

recipes.title: Pink Punch
steps: Add water to lemonade to make 8 cups.
Add other ingredients and mix well.
Chill.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
steps: Crush 1/2 quart strawberries with potato masher or fork.
Add water, sugar and cornstarch; boil for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in butter or margarine.
Quickly pour glaze over remaining strawberries arranged in precooked pie shell. Refrigerate for approximately 1 hour.
Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Stuffed Acorn Squash
steps: Cut each acorn squash lengthwise in half.
Discard seeds. Place acorn squash halves, cut side up, in a 12-inch skillet.
Add about 1/2 inch of water to skillet.
Over high heat, heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to medium-low; cover skillet and cook 10 minutes or until squash is fork-tender.
Carefully drain liquid from squash cavities.

recipes.title: Cheese Souffle
ingredients: 1/2 lb. sharp cheese (not processed), broken up and sprinkled alternately with bread
steps: Into a well buttered baking dish, put bread and cheese.
Beat eggs, milk and dry mustard slightly and pour over bread and cheese.
Bake in a 325° oven for 3/4 hour or until firm.

recipes.title: Super Brownies From Jackie Fay
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Vanilla-Apricot Bark
steps: Preparation:
Toast nuts 5 minutes in oven; snip apricots. In medium microwave-safe bowl, melt chips in microwave on High for 1 minute.
Remove and stir.
Return to microwave for 1 minute. Mix in apricots and nuts.
Spread mixture over foil-covered cookie sheet.
Garnish top of mixture with remaining 2 tablespoons apricots.
Push down in place.
Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Lift off foil; break into pieces.

recipes.title: Tarragon Chicken Kabobs
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. olive oil or cooking oil
1 lb. boneless chicken cut into 1-inch cubes
2 medium zucchini or yellow summer squash, sliced 1/2 to 3/4-inch thick
1 large green or red sweet pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
steps: For marinade, in a screw-top jar combine grape juice, oil, lime juice, tarragon and garlic.
Cover and shake well.
Place chicken cubes in a plastic bag set in a shallow dish.
Pour marinade over chicken; close bag.
Marinate in the refrigerator for 4 hours, turning once to distribute marinade.
Drain chicken cubes, reserving marinade.

recipes.title: Southwestern Pizza
steps: Heat oven to 450°. Grease cookie sheet or 12-inch pizza pan. Mix baking mix and water; beat vigorously 20 strokes.
Turn onto floured surface. Knead about 60 times or until no longer sticky. Press into 13 inch circle sheet; pinch edge to form rim or press in pizza pan. Mix chicken and salsa.
Sprinkle crust with 1 cup cheese. Top with onion, chicken mixture and pepper; sprinkle remaining cheese. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until crust is brown and cheese is bubbly.
Makes 1 pizza.

recipes.title: Copper Pennies
steps: Cook carrots until tender; cool and slice.
Slice onion and bell pepper and add to carrots.
Mix sugar, mustard, soup, oil, vinegar and Worcestershire sauce and pour over carrots, onion and bell pepper.
Soak 24 hours to marinate well.

recipes.title: Potatoes Supreme
steps: Peel potatoes; cook in small amount of salted boiling water until tender.
Drain and refrigerate, covered, overnight.
Next day, grate potatoes coarsely, mix with remaining ingredients and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Put in shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Bake at 350° about 35 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cheesy Biscuits
steps: Cut biscuits into 2 or more pieces.
Dip in melted oleo or butter.
Roll in grated Parmesan cheese.
Bake as directed on biscuit can.

recipes.title: Turtle Brownies
steps: Combine caramels and 1/3 cup evaporated milk in top of double boiler; stir until melted.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 baking hen, cooked, deboned and cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
steps: Melt margarine in oblong baking dish.
Sprinkle 3/4 package of dressing mix over this and press evenly over bottom and sides to form a crust.
Layer chicken pieces over crust.
In bowl, mix together soups and broth.
Pour evenly over chicken.
Cover with 1/4 package dressing mix.
Dot with margarine.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Fudge
steps: In a heavy saucepan, bring sugar, milk and butter to a boil over low heat, stirring constantly.
Cook until mixture reaches 234° (soft ball stage) on a candy thermometer.
Remove from heat; stir in Marshmallow creme, chocolate chips and nuts until they are melted.
Spread in a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Gramma Mary'S French Dressing
steps: Mix all ingredients in blender.

recipes.title: Cabbage Patch Soup
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
steps: In a large soup kettle, brown the meat, celery, onions and green pepper. Pour off the grease. Add tomato products, seasonings and drained and rinsed kidney beans.

recipes.title: Skillet Chicken For Two
steps: In nonstick frypan, place butter.
Melt over medium-high temperature.
Add chicken.
Cook, turning about 5 minutes or until brown on all sides.
Add onion and cook about 2 minutes more.
Add tomato, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer about 20 minutes more or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease.
Serve with florentine rice.
Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Patch Pie
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip nondairy topping, thawed
steps: Place sherbet in bowl; stir until smooth.
Stir in 1/2 of the Cool Whip until well blended.
Spoon into crust.
Sprinkle with chopped Oreo cookies, pressing firmly into sherbet.
Cover with remaining Cool Whip.
Freeze 4 hours or until firm.
Let stand at room temperature 10 minutes before serving.
Garnish with finely chopped Oreo cookies and candy pumpkins, if desired.
Store leftover pie in freezer.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight
ingredients: 1 can Thank You strawberry pie filling
1 large size carton Cool Whip (16 oz.)
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients in a large bowl.
Sprinkle with nuts.

recipes.title: Dinner Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. red or green bell pepper, chopped
steps: Cook rotini as directed on package; drain and cool.
In a large bowl, combine lettuce, bell pepper and onion.
In a medium saucepan, combine remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil for 1 minute, stirring continually.
Add pasta to lettuce, pour hot dressing over all.
Toss until well mixed.
Makes 12 servings. About 120 calories per serving.

recipes.title: Chilled Peach Soup
steps: Combine peaches into blender with 1 cup milk and ice cubes. Process on medium speed until pureed.
Add remaining 1/2 cup milk, sour cream, honey, ginger and nutmeg.
Blend well.
Garnish with sliced strawberry and sliced kiwi.
Serves 4.
Contains 181 calories and 1.2 grams fat.

recipes.title: Irish Coffee
steps: Pour Irish whiskey into Irish coffee mug.
Drop in one lump of sugar.
Fill with strong, hot black coffee.
Stir.
Pour whipped cream off back of a teaspoon, so cream stays on top of coffee. Sip coffee through cream.

recipes.title: Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
steps: Combine cabbage, water, vinegar, butter or margarine, brown sugar, salt and nutmeg in a Dutch oven; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Peel and cut apples into fourths; add to cabbage mixture.
Simmer 30 minutes or until liquid evaporates and apples are tender, stirring occasionally.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease square pan.
Beat brown sugar and butter until fluffy.
Stir in baking mix and nuts until mixture is crumbly.
Reserve 1 cup.
Press remaining mixture in pan and bake 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach Lasagne
ingredients: 2/3 c. water and red wine mixture
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Squeeze all water out of spinach.
In large bowl, mix cottage cheese, 2 1/2 cups Mozzarella, egg, spinach, salt, oregano, pepper and mushrooms.
In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan, layer 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce, 3 to 4 lasagne noodles, 1/2 cheese mixture.
Again layer 3 to 4 noodles, 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce, 1/2 cheese mixture, 3 to 4 noodles and remaining spaghetti sauce.
Top with 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese.
Pour water/wine mixture around edges.
Cover lightly with foil.
Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Cool 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Wonderfully Simple Roast
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. boneless end of round roast, frozen
steps: Put the frozen roast into a large Dutch oven. Pour the dry onion soup mix over the frozen roast and in the bottom of the pan. Add 1/2 cup water, cover top of pan with foil, then put lid onto pan and bake at 275° for 4 hours or until done. A good roast gravy can be made from the beef broth.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
steps: Mix; do not beat pudding mix and milk.
Then blend in sour cream and Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Chicken Dressing
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, cooked and bones removed
steps: Pour broth into crock-pot.
Add bread crumbs and remaining ingredients.
Cook on high for 30 minutes. Reduce heat to low for 1 hour longer.
Stir often and may need to add more broth.

recipes.title: Steamed Broccoli
steps: Place broccoli spears in a 2-quart casserole.
Add water, salt and butter.
Cover and bake in a 350° oven for 60 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Gourmet Tenderloin
steps: "Paint" the beef with Kitchen Bouquet.
Let stand for 3 to 4 hours at room temperature to seal in juices.
Bake at 450° for 25 minutes for medium, 20 minutes for medium-rare, or, if you wish well done, bake for 30 to 35 minutes.
Cut into serving pieces.
If desired, make Special Sauce.

recipes.title: No Bake Fruit Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients, except milk and marshmallows, in a large pan.
Heat Pet milk in double boiler.
Drop marshmallows in a few at a time.
When all marshmallows are melted, pour hot creamy mixture over dry ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Pack mixture into tube or Bundt pan lined with waxed paper.
Cover with waxed paper.
Use hand to press down smoothly and thoroughly.
Store in refrigerator overnight.
Turn out onto favorite cake plate. Decorate with halves of pecans and candied cherries.
Keep in refrigerator.
Additional fruit and nuts may be used, if desired.

recipes.title: Hot Christmas Punch
steps: Simmer first 5 ingredients about 10 minutes. Stick cloves in orange and lemon rinds and float on top of punch.

recipes.title: Orange And Pineapple Punch
steps: Mix juices and sherbets.
Add 2 trays each of pineapple juice and orange juice frozen with maraschino cherries.

recipes.title: Cowboy Coffee Cake
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) jar apricot, peach, strawberry or raspberry preserves
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Spread preserves in round layer pan, 9 x 1 1/2-inches.
Combine remaining ingredients; beat vigorously for 1/2 minute.
Spread batter evenly over preserves to edge of pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes.
Invert onto heatproof plate.
Leave pan over cake a few minutes.
Serve warm.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
steps: Cook potatoes in salted water until done.
Saute diced onion in butter until golden brown.
When potatoes are cooked, drain off water and add milk, sauteed onions and butter they were sauteed in, cream corn, whole kernel corn, salt and pepper.
Cook until hot.
This keeps well and improves as it ripens.
Serve with oyster crackers.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 small pkg. vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
16 oz. pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed (do not drain)
steps: Drain fruit and put in large bowl.
Sprinkle pudding/pie mix over fruit.
Pour strawberries over fruit and mix well.
Chill for several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Camaron Ranchera
steps: Boil onion and jalapeo in a little bit water.
Separately in cooking pan, bring shrimp, tomato juices, and seasonings to a boil.
Then mix all ingredients together.
Let come to a boil, then simmer on low heat for 20 - 25 min.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Shake biscuits in a sack with 3/4 cup sugar and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.
Drop loosely in a greased Bundt pan.
Melt 1 stick oleo; mix in 1 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
Pour over biscuits.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
steps: Rinse sauerkraut with cold water; drain well.
Combine sauerkraut with green pepper, onion and celery in a medium bowl. Combine oil, water, vinegar and sugar in a small bowl.
Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Pour over sauerkraut mixture.
Refrigerate for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea Mix
steps: Place all ingredients in blender a little at a time until blended into a fine powder.
Store in jar and use as needed.
Use 2 teaspoons per serving.
Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Cavatini
steps: Brown beef, onion and pepper; drain.
Cook noodles until tender.
Combine all ingredients with 1/2 cup cheese.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until cheese melts.
Serve with garlic bread.
Mmm!

recipes.title: Roseanna, Banana Kabana
steps: In blender, add 1 cup small ice cubes and remaining ingredients.
Blend until smooth.
Garnish with cherry.

recipes.title: Chili Cobbler
steps: Brown beef and onion; drain fat.
Add tomato sauce, 1 can water and chili mix to meat.
Salt to taste, let simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Press 5 to 6 crescent rolls on bottom of a 9 x 9-inch baking dish with sides.
Spoon in chili.
Cover with shredded cheese, top with remaining rolls.
Bake according to crescent roll package.

recipes.title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 3 egg yolks, whipped and blended with 1 c. of milk or cream
steps: Chop broccoli and set some buds aside for garnish.
Saute broccoli, onion and green pepper in butter.
Add soup stock.
Add bay leaf, parsley, thyme and peppercorns.
Cook for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Party Punch
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. Jell-O (choose color you want punch to be)
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Place container in freezer.
Punch must have 2 hours to thaw before serving.
Once the punch has thawed for 2 hours, pour into punch bowl.
Pour ginger ale over it.

recipes.title: Meat Balls(Hors D'Oeuvre)
ingredients: 3 (10 oz.) cans hot dog chili (no beans)
steps: Cook on high in crock-pot until done, about 3 hours. Great hors d'oeuvre; will be the hit of a party.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
ingredients: 2 small pkg. French vanilla instant pudding
steps: Line 9 x 13-inch pan with one layer of graham crackers.

Mix pudding with 3 cups milk until smooth, then add Cool Whip to this mixture. Pour part of Cool Whip and pudding mixture over first layer of crackers, then ice the second layer of graham cracker with chocolate frosting. Pour remaining pudding mixture on top of second layer of crackers. Top off with more iced graham crackers. After top layer of crackers are placed, fill in cracks with chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Marble Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 sq. Baker chocolate, melted or 4 to 6 oz. chocolate chips
steps: Mix crumbs, sugar and margarine.
Press onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Increase oven to 450°. Beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla with electric mixer; blend well.
Add eggs, 1 at a time.
Mix well after each egg.
Blend melted chocolate into 1 cup batter.
Pour batter into pan.
Drop chocolate batter into making 5 dropping with knife.
Make marble by cutting through batter.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix (don't use pkg. directions)
steps: Makes
layers.
Grease and flour pans.
Cook at 325° to 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.	Cool completely.

recipes.title: Linguine
steps: Cook linguine as directed.
Drain and rinse in cold water. Mix Salad Supreme over linguine noodles.
Add tomatoes, olives, mushrooms, cucumbers and broccoli.
Add Zesty Italian dressing. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Corned Beef
steps: Place corned beef in pot.
Cut oranges and lemons into thick slices and place around meat.
Pour whole box of pickling spice on top of meat/fruit mixture.
Cover meat with water.
Add black pepper.
Cover tightly; simmer for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Remove meat from broth; cool slightly.
Slather with mustard, then pat on brown sugar.
Brown in oven for 30 minutes at 325°.
Remove and cool.
Serves 20 to 25 if sliced thin for sandwiches.

recipes.title: Hummus From Dried Chickpeas *
steps: Soak chickpeas in water to cover and baking soda overnight. Add water to cover by several inches to chickpeas and simmer one hour.
Drain, saving about one cup water.
Puree all ingredients except paprika in food processor, adding 1/4 cup reserved water. Place in serving bowl and sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Crabcakes
ingredients: milk (just enough to hold everything together)
steps: Combine all ingredients except bread crumbs. Shape into round cakes about 1-inch thick. Coat with bread crumbs and deep fry (or broil) to golden brown.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Cook beef; drain and cool.
Chop lettuce, onion and tomatoes. Crush chips.
Mix together with meat.
Add salt and avocado.
Use Thousand Island dressing (large bottle).
Use a punch bowl to serve it in.

recipes.title: Stromboli
ingredients: 1/4 lb. hard salami or corned beef
prepared spaghetti sauce or pizza sauce
steps: Take thawed bread dough and roll out thin.
Layer in order, boiled ham, Swiss cheese, hard salami and Provolone.
Lightly cover with prepared spaghetti sauce or pizza sauce.
Roll up and fasten with toothpicks.
Bake on baking pan at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Pickles
steps: Mix cucumbers and onion in gallon jar.
Pour cold liquid over and keep in refrigerator.
Ready in 5 days.
Keeps 9 months.

recipes.title: One Pot Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 c. cheese, cut in small pieces
steps: Put ground beef in a large frying pan.
Break it into small pieces.
Add onion.
Cook over low heat until all the red is gone from the meat.
Add salt, pepper and mustard.
Stir.
Add uncooked spaghetti.
Add water and tomato juice.
Cover and cook over medium heat.
Cook until mixture begins to boil.
Turn heat to low.
Cook fifteen minutes.
Stir some as it cooks.
Add cheese to spaghetti mixture.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 2 c. green peppers, sliced into strips
steps: Trim all fat from steak; cut across grain in slices about 1 x 1/4-inch.
Add soy sauce and garlic and set aside.
Prepare vegetables.
Heat half the oil until very hot in large skillet. Add vegetables and stir-fry 2 minutes; remove from skillet to warm pan.
Add remaining oil to skillet; heat.
Add steak and stir-fry 2 minutes.
Mix cornstarch with water; add to steak.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add vegetables; mix thoroughly; serve over rice.
Calorie count does not include rice. Makes 4 servings (1 cup each); 281 calories and 17.8 grams fat.

recipes.title: Chuck Roast In Foil
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 envelope dry onion soup mix
1 to 2 cans cream of mushroom or cream of celery soup
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place roast in large piece of foil. Sprinkle with onion soup, spread cream of mushroom or cream of celery soup on top.
Wrap and seal the roast.
Bake until done. Remove and serve.

recipes.title: South Dakota White Chili
ingredients: 1 lb. dried Great Northern white beans, rinsed and picked over
2 (4 oz.) cans chopped mild green chilies
3 c. grated Monterey Jack cheese (12 oz.)
steps: Place beans in a heavy large pot.
Add enough cold water to cover by at least 3 inches and soak overnight.

recipes.title: Pineapple Ruby Punch
steps: Makes 25 cups.
May freeze in milk cartons to make slushy.

recipes.title: Marinated Carrots
steps: Drain carrots and cool.
Mix with green peppers and onions. Combine remaining ingredients, stirring well.
Pour over vegetables.
Cover and marinate in refrigerator 12 hours or more. Will keep in refrigerator at least 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Mexican Fiesta
steps: Brown hamburger and onions, drain fat off, add other ingredients and cook till done.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Make bread crumbs out of the bread. Dice onion and green pepper.
Mix all ingredients together.
Salt and pepper to suit yourself.
Put it in a meat loaf pan and cover with additional catsup.
Bake for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Beef And Potato Casserole
steps: Slice potatoes in Pyrex dish.
Slice onion over top of potatoes.
Spoon hamburger over onion and pour tomato soup evenly over mixture.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Granny Bea'S Candied Peanuts
steps: Dissolve
sugar
in water in saucepan over medium heat. Add peanuts
and
continue to cook over medium heat, stirring frequently.
Cook
until
peanuts are completely sugared (covered and
no
syrup
left).
Pour
and
spread over ungreased cookie sheet
and	bake at 300° for approximately 30 minutes, stirring occasionally for even roasting.

recipes.title: Cherry Yogurt Smoothies
ingredients: 1 medium ripe banana, cut into chunks
steps: In a blender, combine all ingredients. Cover and process until blended well. Pour into chilled glasses. Serve immediately. Yield: 3 servings.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf Supreme
ingredients: 1 c. mixed cracker and bread crumbs
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients and mix well. Shape mixture in a loaf baking pan.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Cover top with tomato sauce before meat is done.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Salmon Potato Salad
steps: Drain salmon, saving juice.
Flake salmon; mix with potatoes, green onions, cucumber, celery, parsley and herb.
In small bowl, combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt, pepper and saved salmon juice.
Pour over salmon-potato mixture; mix gently but well.
Pack salad into 10-cup mold and chill.
When ready to serve, unmold and garnish with tomatoes and sprays of parsley.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Pierogi Casserole
steps: Cook lasagna noodles; drain.
Rinse with cold water.
Drain again.
Cook and mash potatoes.
Add cheese, salt and pepper. Place 3 lasagna noodles in greased pan.
Add half of potatoes. Top with 3 lasagna noodles.
Repeat with remaining potatoes and noodles.
Saute onion in butter and pour over casserole.
Bake 20 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Hershey'S Chocolate Pie
steps: Dissolve all over hot water, except whipping cream.
Add 1/2 pint whipping cream.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Fruit And Nut Tropical Slaw
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can pineapple slices, drained and chopped
1 (11 oz.) can mandarin oranges, drained and chopped
steps: Mix pineapple juice, mandarin orange juice and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Pour over banana in a large bowl.
Add celery, cabbage, walnuts, raisins and fruit.
Add yogurt and salt; toss to mix.
Chill until serving time.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Heavenly Delight
steps: Bake cake according to directions.
When done, take a fork and prick top.
Combine sugar and pineapple.
Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes.
Spread on top of cake.
Fix instant pudding and spread on top.
Slice bananas and place on top of pudding.
Then spread on Cool Whip.
Sprinkle chopped pecans on top of Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Sweet Pickle Relish
steps: Bring sugar, vinegar, turmeric, celery seed and salt to a boil.
Add chopped cucumbers, onions and peppers, then return to a boil for 20 minutes.
Pour into jars and seal.

recipes.title: Beat 'N Eat Frosting
steps: Mix egg white, sugar, cream of tartar and vanilla in a small deep bowl.
Add boiling water.
Beat with electric mixer until stiff peaks form.

recipes.title: Coconut Chess Pie
steps: Melt butter and remove from heat.
Stir in vinegar and sugar. Allow to cool slightly.
Add beaten eggs, coconut and vanilla. Pour into pie shells.
Bake in a 425° oven for 20 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and continue baking for 30 minutes or until sets.

recipes.title: Salad Supreme Spaghetti
steps: Cook and drain spaghetti; rinse.
Combine all ingredients. Chill for 24 hours to combine all flavors.

recipes.title: Okra A La Cross Creek
steps: Have ready boiling, lightly salted water.
Choose only tiny very young fresh okra pods.
Wash.
Do not cut off the stem end, as you trust me.
Drop whole pods in rapidly boiling water and boil exactly seven minutes from the time the water resumes its boiling. Not a moment longer.
Drain quickly.
Arrange like the spokes of a wheel on hot individual serving dishes.
Place individual bowls of Hollandaise in the centers of the dishes.
The okra is eaten as one eats unhulled strawberries, lifting with the fingers by the stem end and dipping into Hollandaise.
I recommend this to those who think they don't like okra.
It is firm, not slimy and with the sauce, superb.

recipes.title: Avocado Salad
steps: Mix jello using 1/2 cup pineapple juice in place of equal amount of water.
When cool, add pineapple, lemon juice, salt and avocado.
Mix mayonnaise and whipped cream together; fold into jello mixture.
Place in greased molds.
Chill.
Unmold on lettuce leaves to serve.

recipes.title: Honey-Glazed Carrots
steps: Heat 1-inch salted water (1/2 teaspoon salt to 1 cup water) to boiling.
Add carrots.
Cover and heat to boiling; reduce heat. Boil until tender, 12 to 15 minutes; drain.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Add garlic powder, ginger, orange peel, honey and orange juice.
Cook and stir over low heat 1 minute; remove from heat.
Add carrots to butter mixture. Toss gently to coat well. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Debbie'S Cherry Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 pkg. Jell-O or Royal no bake cheesecake (disregard crumbs)
steps: Make cake according to box.
Add softened cream cheese and Cool Whip.
Mix thoroughly.
Line ladyfingers along bottom and sides of 10-inch spring-form pan.
Pour in filling.
Refrigerate for several hours.
Top with small can of cherries.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: 1 to 2 blocks Cracker Barrel Cheddar cheese
steps: Cook macaroni and drain.
In deep 2-quart casserole dish, add macaroni.
In separate bowl, add beaten eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Cut cheese and butter into chunks and add to mixture. Pour mixture into dish of macaroni and mix thoroughly.
Bake at 350° to 375° for 30 to 45 minutes without a lid.

recipes.title: Shish Kabob Marinade(For 15)
ingredients: 4 garlic cloves (that have been put through a press)
steps: Put vermouth in container.
Add 3 tablespoons beef bouillon. Mix with 1 or 2 cups hot water. Add oil and other spices, then add meat.
Press meat down into liquid so all meat is covered.
Put in refrigerator until liquid is absorbed, overnight at least.
Freeze until ready to cook.

recipes.title: Apricot-Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 8 oz. pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened
steps: Combine Jell-O, crushed pineapple and sugar.
Cook until it simmers. Add apricot baby food and cream cheese.
Mix well and cool.

recipes.title: Dottie'S Bean Salad
steps: Drain beans well. Toss beans, celery, green pepper and onion together in a large bowl.
Thoroughly mix sugar, oil and vinegar. Pour over vegetables, tossing with fork evenly. Cover and set in refrigerator for at least 8 hours, tossing several times during this period.

recipes.title: Crawfish Dip
steps: Saute onions, green onions, bell pepper, celery and garlic in margarine until wilted. Add crawfish tails and seasonings. Saute for 5 minutes. Add golden mushroom soup.
Heat over medium heat until simmering; do not boil. Serve hot on Ritz crackers.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Pork Chops
steps: Brown pork chops in oil.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Place in a single layer in a shallow baking dish.
Saute onions and pepper until soft.
Stir in pineapple juice, tomato sauce, lemon juice and brown sugar.
Heat, stirring constantly, until boiling.
Pour sauce over pork chops.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Jim'S Chili
ingredients: 2 cans Italian or Mexican stewed tomatoes (save liquid)
1 large purple or yellow onion, chopped
steps: Brown meat and drain off any liquid.
Add all other ingredients, cutting tomatoes into smaller pieces, if so desired. Simmer for several hours adding tomato liquid as needed or desired.

recipes.title: Hot Pretzels
steps: Mix together and pour the oil, dressing mix, salt and pepper over pretzels in a large roaster. Bake in a 250° oven for 1 1/2 hours, stirring every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Pork Tenderloin(By 7 - 12 Year Olds)
ingredients: 1 jar (12 oz.) peach or apricot jam
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Place tenderloins on rack in roasting pan. Mix remaining ingredients in saucepan.
Spoon about half of the sauce over the loins.
Bake the tenderloins 1 hour and 30 minutes. Heat remaining sauce in saucepan over low heat.
Slice the tenderloins into 1/4 inch diagonal slices on cutting board.
Serve the tenderloins with the remaining sauce.

recipes.title: Spinach Balls
steps: Thaw and squeeze water out of spinach (as much as possible). Prepare stuffing mix according to directions on bag.
Add to stuffing: spinach, Parmesan cheese, butter and beaten eggs.
Mix thoroughly.
Roll into balls and freeze.
Before serving, bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Makes 60.

recipes.title: Twice-Cooked Divinity
steps: Stir sugar into corn syrup, water and dash of salt until dissolved.
Boil to medium ball stage (240°).
Slowly pour 1/3 over beaten egg whites, beating constantly.
Cook remaining syrup to very hard ball stage (265°).
Test.
Add several drops to water.
Beat syrup in candy mixture.
Continue beating.
When mixture holds its shape from a spoon, add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Drop from teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Quick Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix and drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet.
Cook about 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Easy Barbecups
steps: Brown beef, stirring to crumble; drain.
Add barbecue sauce and onion; stir well and set aside.
Separate biscuits and place each in muffin cups, pressing up sides.
Spoon meat mixture evenly into biscuit cups.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 400 degrees for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding With Vanilla Or Lemon Sauce
steps: Place bread in greased 2-quart baking dish.
Mix the hot water and brown sugar in a bowl.
Pour over the bread.
Combine the eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon and salt in a bowl and mix well.
Pour over the top.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.
Drizzle with vanilla or lemon sauce.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Stew
ingredients: frankfurters, kielbasa, bratwurst, andouille or other sausage
steps: This is sort of a poor man's goulash, something quick and dirty that doesn't take much time but is pretty good and a lot of fun as well.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients and bake in an unbaked pie shell for 40 minutes at 350°.
Cool and top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Favorite Meat Loaf
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients in a large bowl and shape into an oval loaf.
Bake in 350° oven for about 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Your favorite tomato sauce or brown gravy may be poured over the meat loaf during the last 15 minutes of cooking. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
steps: Add Jell-O to water, dab of food coloring, sugar and cornstarch.
Cook slowly until thick and clear.
Cool 2 to 3 minutes.
Prepare pie shells.
Cream cheese on bottom.
Fill with whole berries.
Pour over the berries the strawberry mixture.
Use whipped cream or Cool Whip on top.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Pecans
steps: Whip egg white and water together.
Mix in pecans.
Mix sugar, cinnamon and salt together, pour over pecans and mix well.
Put on a cookie sheet.
Bake for 30 minutes in 250° oven.
Stir.
Bake for another 30 minutes at 275°.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Tiffany Punch
steps: Dissolve jello and sugar in hot water.
Add lemonade and as much water as it says on can.
Add pineapple juice.
Freeze in gallon plastic jugs.
Supposed to be slushy.
Allow 4 to 5 hours. Cut plastic jug in two to put into punch bowl.
Add ginger ale before serving.
Makes 36 servings.

recipes.title: Crab Puffs
steps: Mix well.
Spread on melba toast rounds, plain or sesame seed crackers.
Sprinkle with paprika and broil until very light brown.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
steps: Mix together; top with 1/2 stick melted butter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
steps: Brown meat; drain grease.
Add vegetables and cook for a few minutes.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover and cook for 30 minutes on a low heat.

recipes.title: Sauerbraten A La Wenonah
steps: Mix vinegar, chili sauce, brown sugar and salt in a large bowl.
Add brisket.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight, turning brisket over once.
Place meat in 4 to 5-quart casserole.
Pour marinade over meat.
Top with onions.
Pour in water.
Cover and bake 2 hours, basting twice.
Remove cover and bake 45 to 60 minutes more, until meat is fork-tender.
Let stand 10 minutes and slice.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut
steps: Work together real good.
Let set 10 to 15 minutes.
Pack tightly in jars.
Fill with boiling water and seal.
Make in a full moon.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 doz. fresh mushrooms, washed and drained
1/2 c. heavy cream or sour cream
steps: Remove stems of mushrooms and save.
Brush clean caps with butter and place in baking dish.
Saute sausage and onions until lightly browned.
Drain.
Add sherry and simmer until liquid is gone.
Add remainder of ingredients, chopped stems.
Add enough cream for mixture to be moist, but hold its shape in a spoon. Fill caps and bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
ingredients: 1 small box Jiffy corn bread mix
steps: Mix everything together, put in a bread pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Gainor'S Crabbies
steps: Blend together first 5 ingredients.
Split English muffins and spread with mixture.
At this point, they may be frozen.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Cobbler
steps: Mix biscuit mix, sugar and milk together.
Pour in pan sprayed with Pam nonstick spray.
Add pie filling.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
steps: Mix together and let set 24 hours.
Good with vegetables.

recipes.title: Cherry Crisp
ingredients: 1 c. white or yellow cake mix
steps: Pour cherry pie filling into 8-inch pie plate.
Sprinkle white or yellow cake mix over that.
Pour melted butter over all.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Spanish Omelet
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. finely chopped Ortega green chilies
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.
Butter 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Beat eggs.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Add remaining ingredients. Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Dessert
steps: Mix gelatin and boiling water together.
Let cool, but not set.
Add orange sherbet.
Add the orange slices and crushed pineapple.

recipes.title: Easy Turkey Divan
ingredients: 3 c. diced, cooked turkey or chicken
steps: Wash broccoli.
Remove tough part of stalk.
Cut stalks lengthwise into quarters.
Cook 10 to 15 minutes until crisp-tender.
Drain.
Place in 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Cover with turkey.
Combine soup, water, mayonnaise, lemon juice and seasonings.
Pour over turkey.
Mix butter, crumbs and cheese.
Sprinkle on top.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Scalloped Squash
steps: Cook squash until soft (I peel and cut into quarters and cut out seeds).
Add egg, butter, onion and seasonings to mashed squash and mix well.
Add cream and bread crumbs and bake at 375° until brown (I use a long Pyrex dish).

recipes.title: Chicken And Stuffing Surprise
steps: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes.
Can be topped with warm cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup when served.

recipes.title: Lazy Day Salad
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can crushed pineapple, partially drained
steps: In large bowl mix pudding and pineapple.
Stir in oranges and fruit cocktail. Fold in whipped topping.
Sprinkle with nuts and coconut.
Refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
steps: Mix ingredients and bake for 15 minutes or serve in chafing dish.

recipes.title: Emerald Two-Layered Gelatin Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. stuffed olives, sliced and chopped
steps: Dissolve lemon gelatin with 3/4 cup boiling water.
Cool slightly and beat until light and fluffy.
Fold in whipped topping and cottage cheese.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan; chill until firm.
Dissolve lime gelatin in 1 1/2 cups boiling water and pineapple juice.
Add pineapple, olives and chopped pecans.
Spoon carefully on top of first layer.
Refrigerate and chill overnight.

recipes.title: Roasted Peanuts
steps: Place peanuts in
shallow
pan.
Place pan in 325° oven and allow to roast for ten minutes, stirring often.
After ten minutes, turn oven	off
and
let peanuts remain in oven until oven cools.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cookies
ingredients: 1 box Strawberry Cake Mix or (flavored cake mix)
1/2 c. Coconut or nuts if desired
steps: Mix together and bake at 350 degrees for 8- 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Pickles
ingredients: 1 gal. whole dill or sour pickles
steps: Drain liquid from pickles (pour out).
Slice pickles about 1/4-inch thick.
Put a few slices of pickles back in gallon jar. Pour a good layer of sugar over pickles.
Continue to layer pickle slices and sugar until they are all back in the jar.
Put garlic in the middle of the jar (or when half of the pickles have been placed back in the jar).
Will make its own liquid.
When all sugar is dissolved, put in refrigerator and keep until all are eaten.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: approximately 1 c. finely diced potato (2 small or 1 large)
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
steps: Bring the water to a boil in a 6 to 8-quart saucepan.
Add the next 8 ingredients.
Mix well; continue cooking over medium heat. Add meat from the chicken (meat should be boned, skinned and veined).
Soup is better if the beginning 6 cups water is broth from stewing the chicken.
Extra can of soup may be added to stretch recipe.
Cook for approximately 30 minutes, until noodles and vegetables are done.
Makes approximately 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken-Stuffing Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) Campbell's condensed golden cream of mushroom soup
2 c. diced, cooked chicken or turkey
steps: Over high heat, heat butter and 3/4 cup milk to scalding.
In a large bowl, pour hot milk mixture over stuffing.
Toss to mix well.
Put stuffing mixture into buttered 12 x 8-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: Sausage Casserole
steps: Brown meat; set aside after draining into casserole dish.
Cook noodles until al dente, drain and add to meat along with chopped onion and green pepper.
Stir in tomatoes and sour cream.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes, or until bubbly.
May be frozen and consumed later.

recipes.title: Blue Devil Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in a 2-quart dish.
Add pie filling and pineapple.
Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Ambrosia Freeze
ingredients: 1/3 c. frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
1 (1 lb.) can (2 c.) fruit cocktail, drained
1 (11 oz.) can mandarin orange sections, drained
steps: Beat together cream cheese and confectioners sugar; gradually beat in sour cream and orange juice concentrate.
Whip cream; fold into cream cheese mixture.
Add fruit cocktail and mandarin orange sections.
Spread in 9 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Freeze until firm.
Let stand at room temperature about 10 minutes before serving.
Serve on lettuce leaves; sprinkle with coconut.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Rum Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. instant vanilla pudding (4 serving size)
1/2 c. Bicardi dark rum or coconut rum
steps: Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan.
Sprinkle nuts in bottom of tube pan.
Combine remaining ingredients in bowl.
Blend and beat at medium speed for 4 minutes.
Bake at 325° for 60 minutes or until cake pulls away from sides of pan.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Cookies
steps: Generously sandwich peanut butter between crackers, then dip into melted chocolate.
Lay on wax paper to cool.
Chocolate can be melted in glass dish in microwave.
Delicious!

recipes.title: Sweet-Sour Cucumbers
ingredients: 3 medium cucumbers, peeled, scored lengthwise with fork tines and sliced thinly
steps: Mix sugar, vinegar, water, salt, pepper and parsley.
Pour over cucumbers and chill.

recipes.title: Long Beach Iced Tea
steps: Fill shaker half full with ice cubes.
Add ingredients.
Shake well.
Pour into tall glass.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake Made E-Z
steps: In blender, combine Jell-O, Cool Whip, lemon juice and cottage cheese.
Put in pie crust and add pie filling (if you wish).
Put in freezer for 5 minutes, then in refrigerator until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Festive Date And Nut Roll(Easy No-Bake Recipe)
ingredients: 1 (7 1/2 oz.) pkg. Girl Scout Snaps-Iced Oatmeal 'n Raisin cookies, finely crushed (save 1/2 c. for outside of roll)
6 to 8 Tbsp. milk or enough to make ingredients stick together
steps: Combine all the ingredients; mix well and shape into a roll. Cover the outside of roll with remaining 1/2 cup of crushed Girl Scout cookies.
Wrap roll in waxed paper and put in refrigerator at least 5 hours.
Cut in slices and top with whipped cream. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Ham And Noodles
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cooked ham, cubed or luncheon meat
8 oz. box shell macaroni, cooked and drained
steps: In saucepan, brown ham and mushrooms in butter.
Stir in rest of ingredients.
Heat.
Stir now and then.
Garnish with parsley, if desired.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
ingredients: 1 egg yolk, well beaten until stiff
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add lime rind and juice. Add egg yolk slowly, stirring constantly.
Add condensed milk. Chill until slightly thickened.
Fold in beaten egg white.
Form into pie crust.
Chill several hours.
Top with whipped cream. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Brunch Souffle(Serves 8)
ingredients: 6 slices white bread, cubed (crusts removed if desired)
steps: Brown sausage; drain and cool.
Crumble sausage into bowl. Beat eggs in another bowl and add milk, salt, mustard and bread cubes; mix well.
Add cheese and sausage; mix again.
Spoon into 12 x 8 x 2-inch glass baking dish.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Colorful Fruit Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Toss gently.
Cover and chill. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Apple Cranberry Pie
steps: Soak cranberries in 1/4 cup sugar and water.
Peel and cut up apples.
Stew apples in brown sugar and butter until tender.
Add cranberries, stirring until tender.
Pour apples and cranberry mixture with juice into pie crust.
Put other pie crust on top. Trim off excess crust.
Cut vent in center and brush with butter. Bake at 350° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Egg Yolk Frosting
steps: Place egg yolks, tartar, salt, water, lemon juice and sugar in the top of a double boiler.
Place over boiling water (upper pan should not touch water).
Beat with a rotary or electric mixer for 7 minutes or until mixture is thick and fluffy and holds its shape.
Stir in lemon rind and spread on cake.
This icing especially suitable for a white cake as well as Sunshine Cake.

recipes.title: Tomato, Mozzarella And Basil Salad
steps: Slice Mozzarella cheese and tomatoes thinly.
Arrange on a platter, alternating tomato and Mozzarella cheese slices.
Chop fresh basil and sprinkle on top of tomatoes.
Drizzle Italian dressing over all.

recipes.title: Tuna-Noodle Crispy
steps: Heat cheese, soup and milk over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Add noodles, tuna and pepper; mix well.
Pour into 2-quart casserole; top with crackers tossed with margarine.
Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Homemade Vanilla Extract
steps: Combine brandy and beans in a jar with a tight fitting lid. Let stand 3 months shaking 3 times a week.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. (12 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese, divided
steps: Crumble beef into 2 quart glass measure. Add onion and garlic; mix lightly. Place in microwave oven. Cook on high for 3 minutes. Pause, stir through several times. Cook on high for 3 minutes. Pause, stir in puree and seasoning mix. Cook on high 4 minutes. Pause, remove from oven. Layer tortillas, beef mixture, and 2 1/2 cups cheese in 2 quart round microwave casserole. Cover and place in oven. Cook on high 7 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Cut into wedges and serve. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Willa'S Bean Dip
steps: Mix everything together, except 1/2 cup grated cheese, sour cream and chips.
Heat in 1 quart saucepan for 5 to 7 minutes or in plastic bowl for 2 1/2 minutes in microwave and stir completely.

recipes.title: Overnight French Toast
steps: Spray 2-quart dish with Pam.
Arrange 1 1/4-inch slices in dish.
Beat eggs.
Add milk and vanilla.
Pour over bread; turn bread to coat.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mama'S Baked Chili Spaghetti
steps: Cook spaghetti.
Brown onions in shortening.
Mix all, except cheese, and bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
ingredients: 4 to 6-inch head broccoli or 1 pkg. frozen broccoli
steps: Steam raw broccoli or heat frozen broccoli.
Put in blender with 1 soup can water and puree.
Warm cream of chicken soup and broccoli and water mixture until steamy warm.
Add chunks of Velveeta, stirring until melted.
Do not boil!
If you like pieces of broccoli, save out a few pieces for garnish and/or to have "chunky" soup.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 can blueberry pie filling (the pre-thickened kind)
steps: Mix cream cheese and sugar and beat well. Beat Dream Whip until stiff. Add Dream Whip to cream cheese mixture. Put a layer of 1/4 of cream cheese mixture in each cooled pie shell. Then put a layer of 1/4 of blueberry filling over cream cheese mixture. Top with another layer of cream cheese mixture. Chill in refrigerator for at least 2 hours.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 bag frozen broccoli, chopped (at least 16 oz.)
steps: In Dutch oven, melt margarine.
Add onion and carrot.
Stir in broccoli.
Add cream of chicken soup.
Stir in milk; let thicken (about 10 minutes on medium-high temperature).
Add cheese; let melt.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
(Don't let soup boil; just keep warm on low heat.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
steps: Cook macaroni and drain.
Combine both kinds of cheese.
Mix milk and butter.
Now add salt, pepper, onion salt and garlic salt to cooked macaroni.
Toss all ingredients until well blended. Place in a greased casserole; cover with paprika.
Bake at 325° for 20 minutes, covered.
Uncover and bake 5 to 7 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Sausage Stuffing
ingredients: 7 oz. cornbread stuffing mix or 1 (8 x 8-inch) pan cornbread, crumbled
steps: In large skillet, crumble and brown sausage; remove from skillet.
Drain.
In same skillet, melt margarine.
Add onion and celery; cook until tender.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients with sausage; mix well.
Stuff turkey loosely with stuffing immediately before roasting.
Roast turkey as directed or wrapper. Spoon remaining stuffing into greased baking dish.
Bake at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes or until hot.
Makes enough to stuff a 12-pound turkey or 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken
steps: Dip chicken in Viva and seasoning mixture.
Mix parsley, Parmesan and bread crumbs together.
Dip chicken in dry mixture. Spray pan with Pam.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fettucini
steps: Mix butter, sage, basil, garlic salt and white pepper.
Toss cooked noodles (drained) with butter mixture.
Add warmed cream and cheeses and stir gently until cheeses melt.
Sauce gets creamy.
Do not place back on heat.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chess Pie
steps: Melt margarine; add cocoa
and the rest of the ingredients. Mix well.
Pour into an unbaked pie shell and bake at 350° for about 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Salmon Dip
steps: Blend; chill and serve.

recipes.title: Fluffy Jello
ingredients: 1 c. Dream Whip or Cool Whip
steps: Dissolve jello in 2 quarts warm water.
When jello starts to thicken, beat with beater and then add remaining ingredients. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Mother'S Sensational Strawberry Pie
steps: Arrange largest strawberries in bottom of a 9-inch baked pie crust.

recipes.title: Cranberry Meatballs
steps: Combine beef, onion, eggs, Worcestershire sauce, catsup and seasonings and shape into small meatballs (size of a walnut). Bake on cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Chop apples and nuts; place in refrigerator to chill.
Boil cranberries and sugar for 2 minutes or until the cranberry skins start to open.
Dissolve cherry Jell-O with one cup boiling water. Combine Jell-O, cranberries, apples, nuts and the juice of one orange.
Refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Fried Broccoli(Delicious)
steps: Chop and slice broccoli and stems fairly thin.
Saute garlic in oil.
Stir-fry broccoli in garlic and oil.
When almost tender, sprinkle Parmesan cheese over while still stirring with fork. Cook 2 more minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Carrot-Zucchini Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger lightly.
Layer in cake pan 1/2 of carrots and 1/2 of zucchini.
Sprinkle with grated cheese.
Layer hamburger, soup and taco mix.
Top with zucchini, carrots and Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Caribbean Pork Chops
steps: Brown chops in oil and drain off fat.
Sprinkle onion and garlic over and around chops.
Combine next 7 ingredients.
Mix well.
Stir in juice and pour over chops.
Place orange slices and pepper rings on chops.
Simmer covered about 50 minutes or until chops are tender.
Stir sauce and baste occasionally.
Add small amount of water if needed.

recipes.title: Orange Pineapple Salad
steps: Put all ingredients in large bowl; mix well.

recipes.title: Cabbage Patch Stew
steps: Brown ground beef with onion and drain.
Combine beef, water and cabbage; cover and cook for 15 minutes.
Add beans, tomatoes, chili seasoning, sugar, salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Texas Walnut Crab Cakes(Prep Time: 15 Minutes; Cook Time: 10 Minutes)
ingredients: 1/2 c. Hill Country Fare instant potato flakes
1 (6 oz.) container Chicken of the Sea white crabmeat, drained
1/2 c. H-E-B green onion dip or sour cream
steps: Combine mashed potato flakes, pico de gallo, chopped walnuts, drained crabmeat, beaten eggs and green onion dip.
Shape crab mixture into 8 patties (1/4 cup each).
Heat a large skillet over medium high heat for 3 minutes.
Spray skillet with nonstick cooking spray and cook crab cakes on each side for 3 to 4 minutes. Serve hot with lemon wedges and lemon butter sauce.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Texas Potatoes
steps: Cover potatoes, onion and salt with boiling water and cook 5 minutes.
Place in small greased casserole.
Add pepper and cheese to white sauce.
Pour over potatoes. Top with crumbs.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° until brown, about 30 minutes.
Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Popcorn Cake
steps: Pop popcorn.
