Mix popcorn, M&M's and nuts in large bowl.
Melt oleo.
Add oil and marshmallows.
Stir over low heat until melted. Stir and cook constantly for 1 minute.
Pour in bowl over popcorn.
Mix.
Press into pans.
This will make any size cake you wish.
It works well in loaf pans also.

recipes.title: Italian Pasta Bake
ingredients: 8 ounce broken spaghetti or 3 cups penne or rotini pasta, cooked, drained
1 package (8 ounce) shredded low-moisture part-skim mozzarella cheese
steps: Brown meat in large skillet; drain.
Stir in spaghetti, sauce and 1/2 cup of the parmesan cheese.
Spoon into a 13 x 9 inch baking dish.
Top with mozzarella cheese and remaining 1/4 cup parmesan cheese.
Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Easy Grape-Nuts Pudding
steps: Beat eggs lightly.
Add sugar and salt, then stir in milk. Add vanilla and nutmeg.
Grease 2-quart baking dish and sprinkle with Grape-Nuts.
Add custard mixture.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Lemon Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes. While still hot, poke holes in the top and pour on glaze.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350°.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken
steps: Mix crackers and melted margarine together and place on top. Sprinkle with poppy seed.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Pickles
steps: This is a good recipe for using those cucumbers which have gotten too large for regular dill pickles.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, boil and pull off bone
steps: Layer 1 package crushed Escort crackers, chicken and water chestnuts.
Mix soups and sour cream.
Pour on top.
Top with another package of crushed crackers and pats of butter on top. Bake at 350° until bubbly and browned.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Mints
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. flavoring (flavoring and coloring, as desired)
steps: Mix and knead like pie dough. Roll in balls, the size of marble. Place one side in a small amount of sugar. Press sugar side down in the mold. Unmold at once on waxed paper. (If you wish a firmer mixture, add more powdered sugar.)

recipes.title: Mom'S Company Beef Casserole
steps: Boil noodles; drain and rinse.	Brown meat lightly.
Add tomato sauce and set aside.
Mix cottage cheese, cream cheese, sour cream, onion and bell pepper with electric mixer until smooth.
Put 2/3 of noodles in 2 1/2 quart casserole.
Add all of cheese mixture (layer on top).
Add rest of noodles and meat (layer over top).
Cover and chill overnight.
Cook 1 hour at 375°, covered.

recipes.title: Pineapple Pudding Cake
steps: Mix well and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° until done; cool.

recipes.title: Chow Chow
steps: Chop and mix.
Put in pint jars.
Process in hot water for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Salmon Chowder(Quick And Easy Meal)
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, cubed and barely covered with water
steps: Bring potatoes to a boil; partially cook.
Add peas and corn; bring to boil.
Add soup, milk, butter and seasoning.
Break salmon into pieces.
Add to other ingredients; cook until vegetables are done.
Do not overcook.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Low Calorie Night Snack
steps: Mix and drink.
Makes 1 serving.
One serving equals 15 calories or a free exchange.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
steps: Soften cream cheese with small amount of mayonnaise.
Mix in onion, shrimp, and dash of Worcestershire sauce.
Add catsup. Cover and refrigerate.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Mushroom Bjahi(Indian)
steps: Melt butter.
Saute onion until clear.
Add spices and salt. Add mushrooms.
Cook until done.

recipes.title: Gourmet Shrimp Spread
ingredients: 2 (4 oz.) cans shrimp, rinsed and drained
steps: Place all ingredients in small bowl.
Combine all ingredients at medium speed until well mixed.
Remove to serving dish.
Cover and chill until ready to serve.
Makes 2 cups.
Serve with crackers, toast or bread sticks.

recipes.title: Green And White Salad
steps: Chop cauliflower, broccoli, cucumber and spring onions up into small, fine pieces.
Set aside.
Mix together the rest of the ingredients in a large bowl.
Add vegetables and stir. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Toffee
steps: Butter square pan 9 x 9 x 2-inch.
Spread nuts in pan.
Heat sugar and butter to boiling, stirring constantly.
Boil for 7 minutes, stirring constantly over medium heat.
Immediately spread mix evenly over nuts in pan.
Sprinkle with chips, cover with foil until chips melt.
Spread over candy.
While hot, cut into squares.
Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Spicy Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into strips
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes (undrained) with green chilies
steps: Cook pasta as directed. Drain. Return to same pan. Spray skillet with cooking spray. Add chicken. Cook on medium heat 4 to 5 minutes until cooked through. Add Velveeta, soup, Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies, mushrooms and milk. Stir on low heat until Velveeta is melted. Add chicken mixture to pasta. Toss to coat. Spoon into greased 9 x 13 baking dish. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Toffee
steps: Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
In heavy 3-quart saucepan, stir together sugar, corn syrup and cream.

Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until temperature on candy thermometer reaches 260° or until small amount of mixture dropped into very cold water forms a ball which is hard enough to hold its shape, yet elastic.
Remove from heat.
Stir in nuts and vanilla. Continue stirring 2 minutes.
Turn into prepared pan.
Cool slightly.

recipes.title: Dill Pickles
steps: Boil and pour over tiny cucumbers that are packed in pint jars with a head of dill per jar.
Heat lids in boiling hot water. Have oven preheated to 350°.
After pickles are canned, set in pan in oven. Turn off heat.
Leave overnight.

recipes.title: Chicken-Almond Salad
ingredients: 3/4 c. almonds, blanched, toasted, and chopped
steps: Soften gelatine in cold water; dissolve over hot water.
Cool slightly; combine mayonnaise, whipped cream, and salt.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Chill in molds until firm.
Unmold on lettuce.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Pea-Can Salad
steps: Mix together and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Hayden'S Hot Hors D'Oeuvre(Microwave)
steps: Spread cream cheese in microwavable shallow dish.
Add chili and top with grated cheese.
Microwave on High until cheese melts. Serve with Fritos or tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Ouie Gooie Bars
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine cake mix, eggs and margarine in mixer bowl.
Press, using your hand into greased baking pan.
Combine confectioners sugar, cream cheese and vanilla in mixer bowl until creamed and smooth.
You may have to add a little water to make it smooth.
Spread over cake mixture.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw Dressing
steps: Mix well.
Can be used over grated cabbage or can be used for potato salad.

recipes.title: Hamburger Tater Tot Casserole
steps: Spread ground chuck in bottom of a casserole dish and compress.
Spread the cream soups over meat.
Top with Tater Tots. Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Taelerene Casserole
ingredients: 1 can tomato soup plus 1 can water
steps: Brown onions in shortening, then ground beef.
Add tomato soup and water.
Add noodles and cook until tender.
Salt to taste. Also add black pepper and herbs.
Add corn (drain first).

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 large (14 or 15 oz.) can creamed corn
steps: Mix together. Pour in greased casserole dish. Heat oven to 350°. Bake 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Lasagna
steps: For
sauce,
cook
ground
beef in skillet until brown. Add salt,
pepper and minced garlic; add spaghetti sauce.
Use 1 jar of
spaghetti sauce and 1 jar of Italian cooking sauce. Simmer about
10 minutes.
Start layers in pan (1 layer sauce, 1
layer noodles).
Spread
Ricotta
cheese
over
noodles. Sprinkle
with Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese.
Repeat layers ending with sauce. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Ball
ingredients: 1 large can sauerkraut, drained and chopped
1/2 c. dry, very fine bread crumbs
steps: Combine all ingredients and form into a ball.
Making frosting using 8 ounces cream cheese and 2 tablespoons milk.
Spread this mixture on ball.
Garnish with olives and parsley.
Let stand in refrigerator overnight for flavors to blend.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: 1 can tomatoes or 5 small chopped fresh tomatoes
steps: Peel and saute eggplant in 2 tablespoons butter until tender. Drain and mash.
Mix in order given.
Pour in a baking dish.
Bake until brown.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
steps: Layer the ingredients in a pie pan or casserole dish in the order listed.

recipes.title: Watergate Cake
steps: Mix all ingredients and bake in Bundt pan for about 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Mix together all ingredients in large bowl.
Form into a loaf and place in baking pan with lid.
Cover and bake at 375° for 1 1/2 hours.
About 20 minutes before time is done, remove lid.
Let bake, uncovered, for remaining time.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 c. onions, sliced and cut across center
1 lb. shredded Swiss/Mozzarella or 1 c. grated Parmesan/Gruyere cheese
steps: Melt butter or margarine in skillet.
Add onions and saute, covered, on low heat for approximately 15 minutes.
Add sugar, salt and pepper, raising heat to a moderate temperature, cooking approximately 20 minutes.
Stir frequently until onions are a deep golden brown, but not burned.
Sprinkle with flour and cook 2 minutes longer, stirring occasionally.
In a saucepan, add beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, parsley flakes and water.
Stir well, then add onions.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Put cheese into bottom of soup bowls and pour onion soup mixture over cheese.
Garnish with croutons.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
steps: In a food processor or by hand, coarsely chop the cabbage and carrot.
In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, milk, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper.
Stir into cabbage mixture.
Chill until serving.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
ingredients: 2 small pkg. instant French vanilla pudding
steps: Butter bottom of 13 x 9-inch dish.
Layer bottom with whole graham crackers.
Mix pudding with milk; blend in Cool Whip.
Pour half of mixture over graham crackers.
Layer with whole graham crackers again.
Pour rest of mixture over graham crackers.
Layer once more with graham crackers.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 (2 lb.) pkg. frozen hash browns (not thawed)
steps: Put hash browns in casserole; sprinkle onions on top.
Pour 1/2 melted oleo on top.
Mix together and heat the Cheez Whiz, sour cream and soup; pour over onions and potatoes.
(Can be done in microwave.)
Mix remaining oleo with corn flakes; sprinkle on top of casserole.
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Glazed Fruit
steps: Drain all fruits.
Combine all ingredients, stirring gently to mix.
Chill 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Butter Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. olive oil or salad oil
steps: Drain beans and rinse.
Drain well.
In a bowl, mix all ingredients, except Feta cheese.
Cover and chill, then mix crumbled cheese into salad and serve.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Pistachio Ice Cream Pie
steps: Combine crackers and butter; press into pie pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes; cool.

recipes.title: Mega Brownies
ingredients: 1 brownie mix (one with nuts or add nuts)
1 c. raisins or currants or mix together 1/2 c. each drained, chopped maraschino cherries and raisins or try something else (use your imagination)
steps: Mix according to package directions.
Fold in the rest of the ingredients and bake according to package directions.
Pan will be heavy.
Brownies will be moist.

recipes.title: Cherry Delight
ingredients: 1 (6 oz. serving size) pkg. instant vanilla pudding
steps: Line 9-inch square pan or baking dish with whole graham crackers, breaking crackers, if needed.
Prepare pudding mix with milk as directed on package.
Let stand 5 minutes, then blend with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Grilled Turnovers
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. nonfat dry milk
1 (21 oz.) can cherry, blueberry or apple pie filling
steps: Mix pie crust sticks, dry milk and water until dough loses stickiness and cleans bowl.
Remove label from unopened can of pie filling.
Lightly flour side of can.
Divide dough into 6 equal parts; roll each part on aluminum foil into 6-inch circle, using floured can as rolling pin.

recipes.title: Maizie'S Christmas Cheese Ball
steps: Chop onions and dried beef; mix well with cream cheese.
Form into ball; roll in chopped pecans.
Allow cheese ball to age in refrigerator for at least 3 days before serving.
Serve with your favorite crackers.

recipes.title: Spaghetti With Tomatoes And Basil(Low-Fat)
steps: In a large skillet, heat the oil.
Add the onion and saute until transparent.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, basil, salt and pepper.
Cook, covered, stirring occasionally for 20 minutes. Serve over spaghetti.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
steps: Cream butter
well,
adding
sugar
gradually.
Add egg yolks, well
beaten,
and flavoring.
Pour into unbaked pastry shells and bake
in moderate oven until firm and brown.
Cover with meringue made
from the remaining egg whites and slightly brown.
This makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Tomato Relish
steps: Put spice in cloth and tie up.
Mix all ingredients together and cook real low for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Dumplins
ingredients: 2 or 3 cans cream of chicken soup (low-fat)
steps: Pour broth and soup into boiler and bring to a	boil. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add a little butter. Break thawed dumplins into small pieces and add slowly, stirring as you add them. Stir very gently. Cook about 20 to 30 minutes or until dumplins are tender.

recipes.title: 5 Hour Stew
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, cut in fourths
steps: Put all ingredients in roaster.
Bake at 250° for 5 hours.

recipes.title: Last Minute Punch
steps: Let punch set for a few minutes with the sherbet in it so it will get slightly creamy.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cake
ingredients: 2 large cans crushed pineapple in heavy syrup
steps: Dump pineapple into a 13 x 9 inch cake pan.
Pour cake mix from box on top of pineapple into pan.
Cut stick of margarine on top of cake mix.
Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Velveeta Spaghetti
steps: Boil and debone chicken.
Save 1 quart of broth.
Add all ingredients to broth, except cheese, peas and chicken.
Cook for 20 minutes.
Blend in cheese.
When melted, add peas and chicken. Season to taste.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch glass dish.
Bake at 350° until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
steps: Mix together pecans and coconut and put in a 9 x 13 pan.
Mix cake mix as directed on box.
Pour over coconut/nut.
Mix together butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar.
Mix and drop by spoonfuls over cake mix.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Spareribs
steps: Place spareribs in a large pot covered with salted water.
Add dark beer, onion, garlic and mustard.
Simmer for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Surprise
steps: Mix pepperoni, pizza sauce and Mozzarella cheese together in large bowl.
Spread biscuits out to 3-inch diameter on greased pan. Add one round tablespoonful of mix to center.
Pinch biscuits together and flip over on pan.
Sprinkle tops of biscuits with milk.
Then sprinkle Parmesan cheese over them.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 20.

recipes.title: Rigatoni
ingredients: 3 (14 1/2 oz.) cans stewed tomatoes (Del Monte Italian recipe)
steps: Saute carrots and onion in olive oil; add ground beef and cook until brown.
Do not drain off grease (there should be very little with the lean beef).
Add tomatoes with juice and tomato sauce; simmer.
Cook rigatoni 14 to 16 minutes in large pot; drain and return to pot.
Add all of the above sauce but 1 cup.
Pour 1/2 remaining mixture in 4-quart casserole dish.
Spread 1/2 Ricotta and 1/2 Mozzarella cheese over and repeat, adding 1 cup of sauce remaining.
Cook about 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
steps: Combine and drop from a teaspoon in hot oil (375°).
Fry until golden brown.
Drain on absorbent paper.
Makes about 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Dip
steps: Mash artichoke hearts with fork; mix with other ingredients in Pyrex dish.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes (until bubbly). Put under broiler to brown.
Serve with flatbreads, pita chips, bagel chips or crackers.

recipes.title: Hot Creamy Beef Dip
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Beat cream cheese and sour cream until fluffy.
Stir in finely chopped beef, onion and seasonings.
Put into shallow baking dish.
Top with nuts.
Bake for 20 minutes. Serve with assorted crackers.

recipes.title: Louise'S Noodle Casserole
steps: Cook noodles until tender.
Brown up meat and drain.
In large casserole mix together all ingredients.
Top with parmesan and mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Garden Vegetable Twist
ingredients: 1 can Campbell's Healthy Request cream of celery soup
steps: In a skillet over medium heat, in 1 tablespoon hot olive oil, cook broccoli and carrots with basil and garlic powder until tender, stirring often.
Stir in soup, milk and cheese; add macaroni and chicken.
Heat through, stirring often.
Makes 4 servings. 350 calories, 11 g fat.

recipes.title: Venison Meat Loaf
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Lightly grease a loaf pan.
Bake for approximately 50 minutes, until done.
After 45 minutes, watch venison meat loaf so it doesn't burn the top of meat loaf.
Spoon part of the fat off; save.
Pour over slices of venison meat loaf. Any leftovers go great with scrambled eggs.
Serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 purple onion, diced or in rings
1 bell pepper, diced or in rings
1 can Ranch Style beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Mix together all but dressing.
Just before serving, toss dressing and salad together.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
steps: Cook broccoli according to package directions.
Drain.
Mix other ingredients; add broccoli.
Pour into a greased frying pan and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Let set a few minutes to firm up before serving.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Dressing
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well before serving. Makes 1 1/4 cups of dressing. Especially good over avocado and grapefruit.

recipes.title: Cucumber-Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. unblanched almonds, chopped and toasted (if desired)
steps: Score cucumbers; cut into 1/4-inch slices.
Place in bowl. Add shrimp.
Combine remaining ingredients except lettuce and nuts in a jar with tight-fitting lid.
Shake well.
Pour over shrimp and cucumber slices; toss.
Cover and refrigerate.
Just before serving, add almonds.
Use slotted spoon to drain salad and transfer to lettuce-lined plates.
Yields 4 to 5 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Beef Casserole
steps: Place meat in casserole.
Combine ingredients.
Pour over meat.
Bake at 325° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
After 20 minutes, stir ingredients.
Cover again and continue cooking until meat is fork-tender.

recipes.title: Irish Italian Spaghetti Sauce
steps: Brown beef and onions.
Drain fat.
Add other ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer for 45 minutes.
Cook spaghetti and mix together.
Great with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Squash Parmesan
ingredients: 2 to 2 1/4 c. thinly sliced yellow squash (3 to 4 small)
steps: Place yellow squash in shallow microwave-safe round glass baking dish.
Top with onion and zucchini.
Sprinkle with cheese. Combine melted margarine, eggs, milk and pepper.
Pour over squash.
Do not stir.
Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on High for 5 minutes.
Turn dish a half turn and cook on 50% power for 12 to 14 minutes or until almost set.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Gems
ingredients: 1 pkg. graham crackers, made into crumbs
steps: Mix in bowl peanut butter, graham cracker crumbs, melted butter and powdered sugar until blended together.
Melt the chocolate chips, then use a cookie sheet and spread the peanut butter mixture out on the cookie sheet.
Pour melted chocolate chips on top and spread over mixture.
Put in freezer for at least 3 hours, then use a knife to cut into pieces.
Always serve cold. If they get warm, they become mushy and not as good.
So always keep in freezer until ready to serve.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Creamed Chipped Beef Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Put in a baking dish and cover with chopped nuts.
Cover dish and bake at low heat for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.
Can be made ahead of time and baked when needed.

recipes.title: Hostess Cakes
steps: Bake yellow cake according to box directions.
Let cool. Spread pudding mix (after preparing pudding according to box directions) on cake.
Spread pineapple over the pudding.
Slice bananas over pineapple.
Spread Cool Whip and sprinkle coconut on top.
Let stand for 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Cherry Cream Cheese Pie
ingredients: 15 oz. can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1 can Thank You brand cherry pie filling
steps: Let cream cheese soften to room temperature, then beat until fluffy.
Gradually add Eagle Brand milk.
Stir until blended.
Add lemon juice and vanilla.
Blend well.
Pour into crust.
Chill. Garnish top with cherry pie filling.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Omelet
steps: Butter bottom and sides of a 9 x 12-inch dish.
Layer bread and cheese slices and 1/2 Cheddar cheese.
Add ham, mustard and pepper.
Beat eggs, milk and rest of cheese.
Pour over all. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients together and pour into buttered casserole dish.
Sprinkle top with 2 cups crushed cornflakes, mixed with 1/4 cup melted butter.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: 6-Cup Salad
steps: Combine and let stand 12 hours.

recipes.title: Spicy Catfish Dip
ingredients: 4 (3 to 5 oz.) pkg. catfish fillets (boiled or poached)
steps: Combine dressing mix, mayonnaise, sour cream and horseradish mustard; mix thoroughly.
Fold in flaked chunks of catfish.
Chill overnight to allow flavors to combine.
Serve with crackers, chips, fresh vegetables or as a spread on toasted party bread. Yields 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Jello Pudding Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 (3 1/4 oz.) pkg. jello vanilla pudding mix (not instant)
steps: Blend pudding with syrup.
Gradually add milk and egg, stirring to blend.
Add nuts.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 375° until top is firm and begins to crack (about 40 minutes).
Cool 3 hours before cutting.

recipes.title: Oven Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. stew meat, cut in pieces (do not brown)
steps: Cover and bake 5 hours at 250°.

recipes.title: Easy Spinach Lasagna
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped, frozen spinach, thawed
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large frying pan, brown beef with onion and garlic.
Drain off fat.
Add spaghetti and tomato sauces; cover and simmer.
In a medium bowl, combine spinach, cheeses and seasonings.

recipes.title: Baked Zucchini
steps: Cook whole zucchini in boiling salted water for 8 minutes and drain.
Melt butter in skillet, add the Gruyere and cheddar and melt.
Add the sour cream, onion and seasonings.
Cut the zucchini in rounds and lay overlapping in a spiral circle in a round quiche dish.
Pour cheese mixture over the zucchini, sprinkle with bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Bake 350 for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Macaroni And Vegetables
ingredients: 1 c. fresh or 1 can large mushrooms
steps: Cook macaroni and cut up skinned chicken into pieces.
Cut up vegetables (top of broccoli only).
In a large frying pan, cook chicken in olive oil.
Add the veggies and continue frying until veggies are done medium.
Add garlic and onion.
Stir for 2 minutes.
Add macaroni and stir.
Add oregano and cheese.
Cook approximately 2 to 3 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Virginia Dip
steps: Saute pecans in butter and set aside.
Mix other ingredients. Place in baking dish and top with pecans.
Chill until served, then bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Russian Tea
steps: Steep tea in boiling water. Strain. Add spices, juice and peels.
Add sugar.
Let set for awhile. Remove spices and peels. Strain.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Tomato Salsa
steps: Mix all. Cover and refrigerate.
Use within 1 week. Serve with tacos, enchiladas, burritos and tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Herb Burgers With Rosemary And Thyme
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients, add beef and blend thoroughly.
Shape into patties.
Melt butter in heavy skillet.
Cook burgers, searing one side, then the other. Serve with cheese bread.

recipes.title: Hot Crabmeat Spread
steps: Saute the onion and green pepper in butter until tender.
Add crabmeat, cheese, catsup, Worcestershire sauce and cayenne pepper. Cook over low heat until the cheese is melted, stirring frequently.
Serve hot with Keebler Onion Toasts.

recipes.title: A Love Cake For Mother
ingredients: some Holiday, Birthdays and every day "Surprises"
steps: I have heard them speak of biscuits,

recipes.title: Apple Broccoli Salad
steps: Wash broccoli and apples; cut broccoli and peel stems using the tender parts.
Cube apples.
Mix with coleslaw dressing to taste.
Chill.
Keeps 2 days in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
steps: Combine ingredients and chill.

recipes.title: Chittling
steps: Clean and pick some fat (not all) off chittling and wash and clean thoroughly.
Put in water and boil for several hours until tender and done.
Season with salt and pepper.
Drop onion and white potato in chittling while cooking.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Frosting
steps: Combine brown sugar, Crisco, butter and salt in saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Add milk and boil slowly 3 minutes, stirring.
Cool.
Add 10x sugar and beat until thick enough to spread.

recipes.title: Pineapple Fluff
steps: Mix jello with 1 cup hot water.
Add sour cream and pineapple to jello mixture.
Mix well.
Add Cool Whip.
Fold into pineapple mixture.
Add nuts and mix well.
Top with marshmallows.
Chill 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 3 medium carrots, cut diagonally in 1/2-inch pieces
1 (20 oz.) can drained pineapple chunks, reserve juice
steps: Mix Bisquick and pepper in plastic bag or bowl.
Stir chicken into eggs.
Remove chicken with slotted spoon and place in bag or bowl with baking mix.
Coat chicken.
Remove chicken.

recipes.title: Mamma'S Scrambled Hamburger
steps: Combine water and onion and cook until tender.
Add beef and vinegar and cook until beef changes color. Pour off excess fat. Add tomato puree, A.1. sauce and salt to taste.
Stir well.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cheese slices may be added.

recipes.title: Noodles
steps: Boil water and cook spaghetti noodles.
Sit in fridge (open, no lid) for 3 hours.
Put in bowl.
Warm in microwave 15 seconds.
Add 5 drops of water and shake of salt.
Warm for 20 more seconds in microwave.
Add butter and 2 shakes of salt.
Stir; warm for 30 seconds.
Eat.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Dressing(Low Calorie)
steps: Place cottage cheese, milk and lemon juice in blender.
Blend at medium speed.
Fold in Blue cheese.
Keep in jar in refrigerator until used.
Makes approximately 1 cup.
There are 21 calories per tablespoon.

recipes.title: Po Lo Chi(Pineapple Chicken)
ingredients: 1 lb. raw chicken, cut in 1-inch pieces
4 large slices pineapple, cut in wedges
steps: Dredge chicken pieces in a mixture of water, soy and cornstarch and salt.
Saute onions and remove from pan.
Saute celery and water chestnuts; remove from pan.
Saute chicken until brown.
Add vegetables (crisp) and pineapple and finally the juice and simmer gently until thoroughly heated.
Serve hot with rice.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
steps: Mix together and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Pineapple Crisp
steps: Mix all ingredients, except pineapple; blend well.
Place 1/2 of mixture in pan.
Put in pineapple; top with remainder
of mixture.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Pasta With Chicken And Broccoli
ingredients: 2 bunches broccoli, cut into small pieces
steps: Cook pasta until al dente and drain.
Cut chicken into strips. Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and stir for 1 minute.
Add broccoli and saute for 2 minutes, then transfer to a heated dish.
Add chicken to the skillet and saute until no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Toss pasta with broccoli and chicken.
Garnish with parsley.
Sprinkle with pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Salad
ingredients: 6 pkg. (2.07 oz. each) Snickers bars, chopped
steps: Mix candy and apples until well blended.
Gently stir in Cool Whip.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Garnish with apple slices and additional chopped Snickers.
Salad is best made and served the same day.

recipes.title: Ground Venison Jerky
steps: Mix ground venison with pieces.
Roll between wax paper to 1/4-inch thickness.
Mix liquid smoke, vinegar and water.
Brush on meat.
Bake on lowest temperature for 3 to 4 hours.
Prop oven door ajar.
When meat is dry, cut in strips and store in a tight container.

recipes.title: Curried Chicken Salad From New Jersey
ingredients: 1 tsp. curry powder or to taste
steps: Combine chicken, orange slices, nuts, apples, raisins and grapes.
Stir together mayonnaise and curry powder.
Add to chicken mixture.
Toss to mix.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: No-Bake Cheese Cake
steps: Put the evaporated milk in freezer for 1/2 hour.
Dissolve the jello and sugar in boiling water in a separate bowl.
With electric beaters, whip evaporated milk until doubled in volume. Add cream cheese; whip.
Add dissolved jello mixture, pineapple and vanilla.
Pour mixture evenly into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish lined with crushed graham crackers.
Sprinkle top with a handful of crushed graham crackers.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
steps: Mix
instant pudding and pineapple.
Add rest of ingredients. Mix well.
Chill and serve.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Cake
ingredients: 1 Duncan Hines butter golden cake mix
steps: Mix and add eggs one at a time.
Grease Bundt pan and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake 45 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Slo-Cooker Spaghetti
ingredients: 5 oz. dry spaghetti noodles, broken into 4 or 5-inch pieces
steps: Brown meat and put in slo-cooker.
Add all of the other ingredients except the spaghetti.
Stir.
Cover and cook on high for 4 hours.
Stir in spaghetti noodles the last hour and stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (1 lb. 13 oz.) can fruit cocktail, drained
1/2 c. pitted Bing cherries (Tokay grapes are a good substitute)
steps: Mix cream cheese; blend in mayonnaise and lemon juice. Combine fruits, pecans and sugar.
Stir cream cheese and mayonnaise mixture into fruits.
Fold fruit mixture into whipped cream.
Pour into freezing tray.
Freeze in refrigerator freezing compartment.

recipes.title: 24 Hour Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 small can french style green beans, drained
steps: Combine pimento strips, vinegar, sugar, paprika, salt, and water and blend well to make a marinade.
Mix all ingredients together and marinate 24 hours.
Drain and serve.

recipes.title: Garlic Grits
steps: Cook grits and water together until done.
Add other ingredients and pour into buttered casserole.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and paprika.
Bake at 300° for 15 minutes; 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Bishop Salad
ingredients: 1 small pkg. 5 minute Birds Eye frozen peas
steps: Just layer all the ingredients.
Cover for at least 24 hours in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: taco mix (1/2, 3/4 or whole pkg. as desired)
steps: Cream sour cream, cream cheese and taco mix.
Place in bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch dish.
Layer remaining ingredients on top, except chips.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: French Roquefort Dressing
steps: In blender put cheese, paprika, salt, mustard and Worcestershire sauce.
Blend well.
Add oil and lemon juice slowly while blending.
Makes 1 cup.
Refrigerate several hours to improve flavor.

recipes.title: Carolina Lemon Pound Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour tube pan (10 x 4 inches), 12-cup Bundt pan, or 2 quart aluminum mold.
Prepare 1 package lemon cake mix as directed except use 2 tablespoons less water. If desired, add nuts.
Pour into pan.
Bake 45-55 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in cake comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan.
Dust with confectioners sugar and glaze (below) or serve with ice cream and fresh or frozen fruit.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Appetizer
steps: Combine and heat for 1/2 hour at 350°.
Serve with bagel chips or crackers.

recipes.title: Baked Stuffed Shrimp
steps: Wash shrimp; dry.
Melt butter; add to crackers, paprika, celery salt, black pepper or cayenne, garlic, shallots and parsley.
Mix together; stuff shrimp.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Filling
steps: Blend all ingredients well and cook over low heat in top of a double boiler until thickened.
Cool, then spread between 2 or 3 (8 or 9-inch) layers.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
ingredients: 2 to 3 bananas, sliced (use Sprite over these to keep them from turning)
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into graham cracker crusts.
Let set overnight before serving.

recipes.title: Baked Ham Slices
steps: Rub
ham with mustard.
Slash or score fat edges of ham about every inch.
Stick whole cloves into fat of ham.
Place ham
in shallow
baking
dish.
Mix pineapple juice and brown sugar;
pour over ham.
Bake at 350° for two hours.
After one hour,
turn
ham over,
place pineapple slices on ham.
Baste frequently with pineapple juice.

recipes.title: Pineapple Stuffing
ingredients: 5 or 6 slices bread, cubed with edges
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until brown.
Great with ham.

recipes.title: Chinese Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves (2 to 2 1/2 lb.)
3 Tbsp. firmly packed light brown sugar
1/2 c. (1-inch pieces) diagonally cut green onions
steps: In medium size bowl, combine 1/2 cup cornstarch, 1/4 cup water and egg yolks; whisk until batter is smooth.
Add chicken breasts, coating each piece thoroughly.

recipes.title: Swedish Meat Balls
steps: Combine meat, bread crumbs, eggs, milk, onions, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Form into 3/4-inch balls, using little pressure. Place on cookie sheets; bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.
Before serving, place meat balls in heated beef broth.
Yields approximately 90 to 100 meat balls.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/2 can condensed cream of chicken soup
1/2 Tbsp. each: minced onions and lemon juice
1 (3 1/2 oz.) can fried onion rings, slightly crushed
steps: Discard skin and bones from chicken.
Cut into 1-inch pieces. Mix chicken with remaining ingredients, except cheese and onion rings.
Turn into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan or casserole.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle onions over all and bake 15 minutes longer.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Shrimp Louis Dip
steps: Stir all ingredients until mixed.
Cover, chill.
Makes 3 cups.
Great for vegetable dip.

recipes.title: Ma'S Salmon Salad
steps: Add and mix into vegetable ingredients.
Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Freeze in muffin tins or small molds.
Cover tins or molds.

recipes.title: Dill Dip For Vegies
steps: In a medium mixing bowl, mix sour cream and mayo.
Grate onion.
Add onion and juice to bowl; add seasoned salt and dill weed.
Mix well and rechill about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pineapple Crunch Pie
steps: Divide pastry in half. Roll one portion on floured surface to a circle 1 1/2 inch larger than inverted 8 inch pie pan. Fit loosely into pan. Combine cornstarch, sugar, salt and pineapple in saucepan.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thick and clear. Remove from heat. Stir in lemon juice and butter. Turn into pie shell.
Roll out remaining dough; cut slits. Moisten rim of bottom crust. Place top crust over filling. Fold edge under bottom crust, pressing to seal. Flute. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, combine the brown sugar, butter, corn syrup and water in a saucepan. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until sugar is dissolved. Add chopped pecans. Spread hot mixture over top of partially-baked pie. Bake 9 to 12 minutes until deep golden brown.

recipes.title: Ann'S Clam Dip
steps: Mix cream cheese (room temperature) with clams, Worcestershire sauce and onion. Add juice until it is in dipping consistency. Better after a couple of hours in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Vanilla Bavarian Cream
ingredients: 1 c. whipped cream, Cool Whip or Dream Whip
steps: Blend thoroughly first 5 ingredients in saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, just until mixture comes to a boil.
Place pan in cold water; cool until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from a spoon.
Fold in whipped cream and vanilla. Pour into buttered 1-quart mold.
Chill until firm (about 4 hours).
Unmold on large serving dish.
Garnish with fruit.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
ingredients: 1 box German chocolate cake mix or dark chocolate, if preferred
1 c. milk chocolate chips (8 oz. bag), divided
steps: Blend cake mix according to box directions.
Pour half of batter into greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Melt caramels in butter and milk.
Pour over the partially cooked cake. Sprinkle with half of the chocolate chips and half of the pecans. Pour the remaining batter over the chips and pecans.
Add chips and pecans for top layer.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Enjoy!!

recipes.title: Pink Party Rhubarb Pie
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) carton Cool Whip or can use regular whipping cream or Dream Whip
steps: Bake the pie shells in two pie plates.
Dice 2 cups rhubarb. Put into a saucepan with the sugar and cook until soft.
Stir in the jello until it is dissolved.
Let stand until cool.
Prepare the whipping cream or Dream Whip or use the Cool Whip and fold in the lemon juice.
Fold this into the cooled rhubarb mixture and then pour equal amounts into the pie shells.
Refrigerate for about 3 hours.
Great spring dessert.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Casserole
steps: Boil spaghetti.
Brown ground beef; add onion, garlic and oregano.
Mix spaghetti sauce with ground beef.

In 9 x 13 in. dish, layer 1/2 of spaghetti, 1/2 meat sauce and cheddar cheese. Layer rest of spaghetti, rest of meat sauce and mozzarella cheese. Mix 1/2 can water with mushroom soup and pour over casserole. Bake for 30 min. at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Pig In A Blanket
steps: Cut hot dogs in half.
Split hot dog lengthwise and place cheese in hot dog.
Cut crescent rolls in half.
Roll hot dog in crescent roll.
Bake by directions on crescent roll package.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Corn Bread
steps: Spray pan with Pam.
Mix.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Cups
steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients together and pat in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt the chips in double boiler and spread on top. Refrigerate.
Take out 1 hour before cutting.

recipes.title: Pecan Ditty
steps: Beat egg whites with cream of tartar.
Gradually add 1 cup sugar and heat until stiff.
Roll crackers fine and fold into egg whites and add nuts and vanilla.
Bake in buttered pie pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool.
Beat whipped cream.
Add preserves. Place in cooled shell.

recipes.title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mix sugar, cocoa, milk and butter in saucepan.
Bring to a boil; boil for 3 minutes.
Stir while boiling.
Take off heat. Add vanilla and peanut butter.
Stir until peanut butter has melted.
Add oatmeal.
Drop on waxed paper by spoonfuls.
May be eaten warm or cold.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
steps: Boil chicken until done.
Reserve stock.
Remove skin and tear into bite size pieces.
Cook spaghetti in stock from chicken. Reserve broth again.
Melt Velveeta cheese in 1/2 stock over low heat, stirring often.
Combine all ingredients except stock.
Mix good.
Add stock so that mixture is little soupy.
Bake, uncovered, in 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.
Do not cook dry.
Add more stock if needed.
It is easier to blend all if you break spaghetti in half before cooking.

recipes.title: Lasagna
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Brown ground chuck in skillet with meat tenderizer, garlic salt and pepper; drain off grease.
Add Ragu sauce and tomato paste; simmer 1 hour. Boil lasagna with 1 teaspoon salt for 15 minutes.
Mix cottage cheese with 2 eggs.

In a large casserole dish, spread 2 to 3 tablespoons meat sauce. Layer noodles, meat sauce and cottage cheese mixture 2 to 3 times. Top with Mozzarella and sprinkle Parmesan on last. Bake about 1 hour.
Allow to cool 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Garden Fresh Salad
ingredients: pepper to taste or 2 Tbsp. white wine
steps: Mix together in a sealed container.
Let marinate overnight. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Caramel Dip For Apples
steps: Cream first three ingredients well and add Bits 'O Brickle and vanilla.
Let this sit overnight in refrigerator.
Keeps for several days.

recipes.title: Pizza Bake
steps: Brown meat, onion, green pepper, salt and pepper.
Mix in sauces.
Stir and simmer for 1/2 hour.
Add mushrooms and pepperoni.
Layer and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Popcorn Cake
steps: Melt the marshmallows; mix with melted butter, then add peanuts.
Pour over popcorn.
Mix well.
Mold into angel food cake pan.
When it cools, remove from pan.

recipes.title: Venison Ole!
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) jar chopped jalapeno peppers, drained
steps: In a crock-pot, combine the cubed beef, enchilada sauce and chili.
Cook over low heat until cheese melts, stirring frequently.

recipes.title: E. F.'S Miracle Soup
steps: Cut all vegetables in small pieces.
Place in crock-pot and cover with water.
Add 1 package of dry soup mix for seasoning. Let cook on low all day (6 to 8 hours), depending on desired texture of vegetables.

recipes.title: Iron Skillet Apple Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Place butter in large iron skillet. Place in oven and let melt. Then stir in brown sugar and let melt. Place 1st pie crust on top of mixture in skillet. Place sliced apples on top of crust and sprinkle with white granulated sugar and cinnamon mixture. Place second pie crust on top of apple mixture and make small slits in crust. Bake 45 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Candied Walnuts
ingredients: 1/2 c. milk, plus 4 drops red food coloring
steps: In
2-quart saucepan, mix first 4 ingredients.	Cook to soft ball stage (238°).	Add walnuts and peppermint flavoring; stir until
creamy.
Quickly
turn
out	on
waxed
paper
and separate with forks.

recipes.title: Zucchini Soup(Low Calorie)
steps: Add sliced zucchini in combined water and bouillon cubes in saucepan.
Heat until zucchini is tender.
Pour mixture into blender or food processor and puree.
Return pureed mixture to pan and add milk.
Heat to serving temperature.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chicken 'N' Dressing Bake
steps: Toss dressing in bottom of 11 x 15-inch pan with broth, eggs and 1/2 can soup.
Place chicken over dressing.
Pour other 1/2 can soup mixed with milk.
Sprinkle pimento over top.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Combine ingredients; shape
into loaf in shallow baking pan. Arrange with slices of
bacon.
Bake
at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Let
stand
for
minutes
before
slicing; makes 4 servings.
Recipe can be doubled for 8 servings.

recipes.title: Pear Mincemeat
steps: Peel and core fruits.
Coarsely grind or chop fruit.
Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil.
Simmer 1 hour.
Pack hot in sterilized jars and seal.

recipes.title: Cherry Delights
steps: Put a vanilla wafer in each cupcake liner.
Mix eggs, sugar, cream cheese and vanilla on medium
speed for 5 minutes.
Spoon cupcake liner 3/4 full with batter.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Mostaccioli Al Forno
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed
1 c. (4 oz.) shredded Mozzarella cheese, divided
3 c. (30 oz. jar) sauce or make your favorite tomato sauce recipe
steps: In large bowl, combine spinach, Ricotta, eggs, Parmesan cheese, 2/3 cup Mozzarella cheese, parsley, salt and pepper.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Grandma Nettie'S Hamburger 'N Mushroom Gravy(Yield: 6 Servings)
ingredients: 2 Hard Rolls (soak in water, squeeze & shred)
steps: Mix all ingredients well and shape into 10 oval patties.
Using a frying pan, brown both sides in oil, then move to a 13 x9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Vanilla Extract
steps: Split a bean lengthwise and cut into 2-inch pieces.
Store in bottle of vodka or rum and let it sit in a dark spot (in a cupboard) for at least 6 weeks.
The longer you let the beans marinate, the stronger the flavor will be.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
steps: Pour the boiling water over poppy seed and let stand 1/2 hour. Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Curried Chicken And Broccoli
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cooked and chopped in large pieces
4 c. cooked chicken, cut in bite size pieces (4 chicken breasts)
steps: Combine chicken soup, salad dressing, curry powder, lemon juice, salt and pepper well.
Layer half the broccoli, chicken and soup mixture in a 2-quart casserole.
Repeat layers.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with onion rings and return to oven for 3 to 4 minutes until onions are hot.

recipes.title: Onion Cheese Bread
ingredients: 1-1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded Cheddar Cheese, divided
steps: In a skillet, saute Onion in Oil until tender.
Place Biscuit Mix in a bowl.
Combine Eggs and Milk; stir into Biscuit Mix just until combined.
Stir in the Onion, 1 cup of Cheese and 4 teaspoons of Parsley.
Spread the batter into two greased 8 inch round baking pans.
Sprinkle with remaining Cheese and Parsley.
Drizzle with Butter.
Bake at 400 for 15 - 20 minutes or until Cheese is melted and top of bread is lightly browned.
Yield:
12 - 16 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut into small cubes
steps: In a large (2 gallon) stockpot over medium heat, combine oil, chicken base, diced onion, cumin, chili powder, garlic and cayenne pepper. Saute, stirring occasionally, until onions are tender. Place masa harina in a large saucepan over low-medium heat. Gradually add 1 quart of water, stirring constantly, to blend and remove lumps. Add masa harina mixture to onions and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer mixture 2 to 3 minutes, stirring constantly to eliminate the raw taste of the masa. Add remaining water to stockpot. Add tomatoes and allow mixture to return to a boil. Reduce heat to low and add cheese. Continue to simmer, stirring occasionally, until cheese melts. Remove from heat and add chicken. Ladle into serving bowls.

recipes.title: Orange Dessert
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple and juice
steps: Mix pineapple with juice and sugar. Bring to a boil. Add dry jello and water; stir well and let gel. Add cheese, pecans, and Cool Whip. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake
ingredients: 1 large pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
steps: Combine ingredients and beat with mixer about 10 minutes.
Make a mixture of brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts.
Spread 1/2 of the cake mixture in a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Sprinkle with nut mixture.
Spread rest of cake mixture over; top with remaining nut mixture.
Marbleize with knife and bake for 35 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Veg-All Casserole
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, sliced and drained
steps: Mix Veg-All, onion, water chestnuts, cream of chicken soup and mayonnaise in a casserole.
Crumble Ritz crackers on top.
Dribble margarine on top and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Mincemeat Pie
steps: Heat together and put into crust.
Bake until crust is done.

recipes.title: Poached Pears
steps: Cut pears.
Put all in a pot.
Boil 20 minutes.
Serve over ice cream.

recipes.title: Meatza Pizza
steps: Mix meat with bread crumbs, garlic salt and milk.
Spread into 9-inch pie pan smoothly and push up on sides.
Spread tomato paste over top, then mushrooms, Cheddar cheese, oregano and Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
steps: Drain fruit cocktail.
Place in large bowl.
Add other ingredients.
Chill for 2 hours.

recipes.title: No Salt Seasoning
steps: Combine all ingredients in a small jar with a shaker top and use in place of salt.

recipes.title: Barbecued Ribs
steps: Combine all ingredients, except ribs, in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil.
Brown ribs and drain grease.
Pour sauce over ribs and bake in 300° oven for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, uncovered!

recipes.title: Mexican Bean Casserole
steps: Brown pepper and onion in 2 tablespoons of margarine.
Add beef and drain.
Add rest of ingredients, except for cheese.
Heat well.
Pour in dish and cover with cheese.
Let bake at 350° until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Special K Delight
ingredients: 1 c. King syrup (no substitutions, Food Lion carries this)
steps: Place sugar and syrup in large pan, bring to a boil and remove from heat immediately.
Add peanut butter and mix well.
Stir in cereal and mix until well coated.
Place this mixture in a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt chocolate chips and spread over the top.
Let cool and then cut and enjoy.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
steps: Cook
spaghetti according to package directions; drain. (Should
have
about 3 cups cooked spaghetti.) Stir margarine, Parmesan
cheese
and eggs into hot spaghetti.
Form spaghetti mixture
into
a
"crust"
in
a
buttered	10-inch pie plate. Spread cottage cheese over bottom of spaghetti crust.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
steps: Brown chops on both sides.
Peel potatoes and slice about 1/2-inch slices.
Put in bottom of long pan.
Slice onions in rings on top of potatoes.
Put chops on this.
Heat cream of chicken soup until smooth.
Pour over chops.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Cover with foil and bake until chops are done at 350°.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Chop, cook and drain broccoli well.
Melt cheese and 1/2 stick of margarine.
Put broccoli in a baking dish.
Pour melted cheese and margarine over it.
Top with cracker crumbs.
Melt remaining margarine and pour over crumbs.
Bake in a 325° oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Punch
ingredients: 1/3 c. sugar or honey for every 1 c. juice
1 qt. ginger ale or lemon/lime soda
steps: Simmer rhubarb in the 5 cups of water, then strain it into a glass bowl.
Add sugar and let cool.
Add remaining ingredients and chill.
Before serving, add soda.
Serve over ice.

recipes.title: Boursin Cheese Spread
steps: Bring cream cheese and butter to room temperature and blend well. Add garlic and other ingredients. Chill for at least 24 hours before serving with crusty French bread or crackers. This mixture stores well in refrigerator. Remember, you can make more or less of this Boursin cheese spread by blending the herbs and garlic in larger quantities. Use 1 teaspoon blended herbs, 1/2 cup butter and 1 cup cream cheese.

recipes.title: Tomato Cucumber Salad
steps: Put tomatoes, cucumbers, and pepper into a bowl.
Add dill weed, parsley, salt and pepper.
Squeeze juice of 2 limes over top of salad and mix.
Great for barbecues and easy!

recipes.title: Uncle Bill'S Jerky
steps: Slice deer or beef into strips 1/4-inch thick.
Marinate meat overnight.
Lay strips on oven rack and place in a 140° oven until desired dryness, approximately 6 to 10 hours.

recipes.title: Taco Salad Dip
steps: Cream together first 6 ingredients and salt.
Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill.
Make sure it is set.
Place each of the following layers one at a time in order listed, taco sauce, onion, tomato, lettuce and Cheddar.
Serve with any taco chips.

recipes.title: Orange-Cranberry Jello Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Add cranberry sauce; stir to mix.
Add applesauce; stir.
Refrigerate to set.

recipes.title: Candied Yams
steps: Remove skin from baked potatoes.
Slice as desired.
Pour crushed pineapple with juice over potatoes.
Sprinkle sugar over. Place sliced butter over or on top.
Add vanilla.
Add grated orange peel, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Place in 350° oven 1 or 1 1/2 hours, until candied and brown.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked until tender and drained
1 can undiluted cream of mushroom soup
steps: Mix all ingredients except Ritz.
Top with crumbled Ritz crackers.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Quick Cucumber Pickles
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice and salt
steps: Mix vinegar, sugar, water and spices.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Add cucumbers and onion rings, if desired.
Boil 5 minutes.
Pack cucumber chunks in jars; cover with hot syrup and seal immediately.
Or, store in jars in refrigerator.
Makes 1 gallon.

recipes.title: Chicken Balls
steps: Bone chicken breasts and put through food grinder with onion, water chestnuts and mushrooms. Add cornstarch, salt, soy sauce, sherry and beaten egg whites.
Form into small balls and fry in deep hot oil.
Drain and serve with toothpicks.
Yields about 50 small balls.

recipes.title: Quick Strawberry Cobbler
ingredients: 2 (9 oz.) pkg. yellow cake mix (I use only 1 and 1/2 pkg)
steps: Pour pie filling into a greased 9x13x2 baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 5-7 minutes or until heated through.
Meanwhile, in a mixing bowl, cream butter, cheese and vanilla.
Place cake mixes in another bowl and cut in cream cheese mixture until crumbly. Sprinkle over hot filling.	Bake 25-30 minutes longer or until topping is golden brown.
Other pie fillings are good also, but my family like strawberry best.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Potted Peaches
steps: Cook until most liquid is out about as you would with dried peaches.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart bowl.
Microwave on High for 3 1/2 to 4 minutes.
Add 1 teaspoon butter and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Stir and cook for one minute .
Remove from microwave; add baking soda.
Stir rapidly.
Spoon out rapidly onto a greased cookie sheet.
Cool and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Great Vegetable Soup
steps: Saute vegetables in skillet in 3 tbsp of butter until crisp tender.
When almost done, bring broth to a boil.
Add softened vegetables to boiling broth.
Simmer 15 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Homemade Pear Jelly
steps: Peel pears and lay in pan of water.
Shred pears and add lemon juice.
Put in thick bottom pot.
Add sugar; bring to boil.
Boil for 20 minutes.
Add whole boxes of Certo; boil for 2 minutes. Seal in warm jars with boiled jar caps.

recipes.title: Diet Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients
together.	Put
in pie crust.
Top this with the fruit and	put
in the refrigerator for 3 hours. Slice and serve cold.

recipes.title: Roasted Cinnamon Pecans
steps: Sift sugar and cinnamon together.
Roll pecans in egg white, then sprinkle cinnamon and sugar mixture over pecans (make sure they are mixed well).
Butter large pan; spread pecans in pan. Cook in 300° oven until brown and appears dry.
Stir often (about every 15 minutes).
Bake about 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Low Calorie Spinach Lasagne
steps: Spray pan with nonstick vegetable spray.
Brown ground meat. Remove, reserving 1 teaspoon drippings.
Add onions; saute.
Add garlic.
Cook 1 minute, then add beef; blend in oregano, tomato puree, basil, salt and pepper.
Heat to boiling.
Simmer 5 minutes. Cook noodles; drain.
Mix spinach (water removed), cottage cheese, egg, Parmesan cheese, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
In 9-inch square pan, place 1/3 spinach mix on bottom.
Use 2 noodles to make a layer; spread meat sauce, continue layering.
Cover with foil. Bake 40 to 45 minutes until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Italian Green Beans
steps: Place green beans, butter and dry dressing in casserole.
Stir occasionally until butter melts.

recipes.title: Apricot Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drain and save juice
steps: Mix the first 3 ingredients together in a large dish or pan. Chill until set.
Add the bananas, marshmallows and pineapple.

recipes.title: Microwave Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 large potatoes, pared and cut in eighths
2 medium carrots, cut in thin strips
steps: Place meat into a 4-quart glass casserole.
Add salt, Worcestershire sauce and boiling water; cover with an all-glass lid.
Cook in microwave oven 10 minutes on High.
Add potatoes, carrots and onion to liquid in casserole.
Stir.
Cook, covered, in microwave for 60 to 75 minutes at Simmer or until meat is tender.
Stir occasionally.
Be sure meat and veggies are covered with liquid during cooking.
Add hot water if needed; let stand, covered, 15 to 20 minutes.
Thicken liquid for gravy, if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
steps: Combine soup, water and cheese in 2-quart saucepan.
Heat until cheese melts, stirring occasionally.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Hardtack
steps: Heat sugar, water, Karo syrup and vinegar to hard crack stage. Remove from heat.
Add oil and coloring.

recipes.title: Orange And Onion Salad
steps: Layer oranges and onion.
Stir all other ingredients together. Mix well and dribble over layers.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
steps: Cream together the cream cheese and taco sauce to your taste. Spread on a large platter.
Top with layer of taco sauce and refrigerate.
Add lettuce, tomato, onion, Cheddar cheese and black olives over the top. Serve with taco chips.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1 (4 oz.) can green chili peppers, rinsed, seeded and chopped
steps: Combine artichoke hearts, chopped chili peppers, cheese and mayonnaise.
Turn mixture into 8-inch round baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until heated through.
Serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Curried Fresh Peaches
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place peaches in 1 quart baking dish. In small sauce pan mix orange juice, brown sugar, cornstarch, curry powder and ginger. Stirring over medium-low heat, bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute or until thickened. Stir in butter and pour over fruit. Sprinkle coconut on top. Bake 25-30 minutes or until coconut is lightly toasted and fruit is bubbly.

recipes.title: Easy Lemon Meringue Pie
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Borden Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a medium size bowl, beat egg yolks; stir in sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice and rind.
Turn into pie crust.
In a small mixer bowl, beat egg whites (at room temperature) with cream of tartar and salt until foamy; gradually add sugar, beating until stiff, but not dry.
Spread meringue on top of filling, sealing carefully to edge of crust.
Place filled pie on a cookie sheet in oven and bake 12 to 15 minutes or until meringue is golden brown.
Cool; chill.
Makes 1 pie.

recipes.title: Squash Dressing
steps: Saute onions and margarine. Cook squash or use canned squash. Mix all ingredients with cornbread and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Clubhouse Sandwich
steps: Spread 2 crisp breads with 1 tablespoon peanut butter a piece. Sprinkle carrots over peanut butter on 1 crisp bread.
Place second crisp bread, peanut butter side up, over carrots.
Place banana slices on the peanut butter, then drizzle with honey.
Top with the third crisp bread.
Using a serrated knife, cut sandwich in half lengthwise.

recipes.title: Pizza Noodle Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
In a large skillet, cook ground beef, onions and bell peppers for 7 to 9 minutes, until meat browns and veggies are crisp.
Drain cooked noodles; add Italian seasoning, pepperoni slices, ripe olives, tomato sauce and paste.
Mix well. Fold in 1 cup of the shredded Mozzarella.
Pour mixture into ungreased 2-quart baking dish.
Top with rest of cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes, until heated throughly and cheese begins to brown.
Sprinkle with parsley (optional).
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Ham Pate
steps: Hollow out center of loaf of French bread, tearing small amount of bread around edges.
Mix ham chunks in blender or food processor until smooth.
Add mustard, allspice and softened butter.
Mix all together in blender.
Slice cheeses in strips. Place a layer of cheese and pickles in loaf.
Stuff with ham mixture.
Chill for 1 hour.
Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Mix together and bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pistachio Cake
steps: Mix all together; pour into a Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Cool in pan.

recipes.title: White Mountain Icing
steps: Cook syrup and water until it forms soft ball in cold water. Beat egg whites until stiff.
Pour syrup over the egg whites; beat until stiff.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple, well drained or strawberries
steps: Use 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt butter; add graham cracker crumbs to make first layer.
Mix and beat cream cheese, sugar and milk until fluffy (about 10 to 15 minutes).
Spread on crumbs as second layer.
Next layer is bananas, sliced.
Add crushed pineapple as next layer.
Garnish with cherries and nuts.
Spread Cool Whip over pineapple as last layer.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce From Scratch
ingredients: 24 large ripe tomatoes, peeled and chopped
steps: After all vegetables are chopped, put in a large pot and cook until all the veggies are soft, about 30 minutes.
Press through a sieve or food mill.
Put back on stove and cook until mixture is reduced to about 1/2, or about 45 minutes.
Add with the sieved mixture the remaining ingredients, and let cook.
Tie peppercorns in a cheesecloth and drop in the mixture to cook.
After all ingredients are together, they should cook about 1 1/2 hours.
Stir frequently to keep from sticking.
When of desired thickness, pour hot, into sterilized jars and seal.
Process pints 20 minutes in boiling water bath.
Yield:
4 to 5 pints.
(To use, add 1 cup salad oil to 1 pint and mix thoroughly.)

recipes.title: Marinated Strawberries
steps: Hull berries and cut into halves.
Toss berries with marmalade.
Refrigerate 20 minutes.

recipes.title: My Potato Salad
steps: Put mayonnaise in large mixing bowl; peel potatoes while hot and mash into mayonnaise.
Add all other ingredients and mix well. If salad is too dry, add 2 tablespoons white vinegar and 1 teaspoon sugar with small amount of water.

recipes.title: Freezer Slaw
steps: Mix salt and cabbage.
Let stand 1 hour.
Squeeze out excess moisture.
Add carrots and green pepper.

recipes.title: Cornbread Casserole
ingredients: 1 box Jiffy cornbread mix, mixed as directed on box
steps: Brown ground beef and drain.
In a 2-quart casserole, add soup, beans, hamburger and onion.
Mix cornbread as directed on box and spoon over beef mixture.
Bake in a 400° oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Hot Cocoa
steps: Combine cocoa, sugar and salt in a cup.
Stir in hot milk to fill cup.
Add vanilla.
Stir until blended.

recipes.title: Icebox Fruit Cake
steps: Crumble vanilla wafers.
Melt marshmallows in milk.
Mix all other ingredients together.
Put all ingredients (I mix with my hands) in buttered tube pan and refrigerate for 4 hours.
Serve after letting sit out for a while.
(Tastes like a candy bar!)

recipes.title: Shepherd'S Pie
steps: Boil potatoes until tender.
Mash together with milk, salt and pepper to taste.
In a large skillet, over medium heat, cook ground meat 4 to 5 minutes, or until no longer pink.
Drain off fat; add onion and cook until onions are translucent, 4 to 5 minutes.
Add green pepper, carrots, peas, tomato, parsley, bouillon, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce.
Simmer, uncovered, 15 minutes.
Dissolve cornstarch in water and stir into meat mixture.
Spoon into an ungreased 9 x 12 x 2-inch dish. Spread potatoes over mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Mix and pour into a greased pan.
Bake, uncovered, 40 to 45 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Toffee Crackers
steps: Take a cookie sheet.
Use no oil.
Place crackers in a row.
In a pan, melt butter, about 1/2 stick.
Pour over crackers.
Next, sprinkle brown sugar over crackers.
Be generous.
Place in oven at 300° until sugar has glazed look.
Cool and eat.

recipes.title: Cake Mix Cookies
steps: Mix all ingredients together, except sugar.
Roll mixture into walnut size balls; coat in powdered sugar.
Bake on lightly greased cookie sheet at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Yields 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Jiffy Coconut Banana Pudding
steps: Prepare your pudding mix according to directions on the box. Arrange the vanilla wafers in a baking dish.
Layer your bananas. Pour the pudding on top of the mixture.
Then repeat the process again.
Keep doing this until you alternate the ingredients and it's used up.
Beat egg whites until foamy.
Add sugar and vanilla flavoring.
Beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Then spread the meringue over the pudding.
Bake at 425° until the meringue is lightly browned.
Then take out of oven.
Add coconut flakes.
Put back in oven for about 5 minutes.
Take out of oven. Cool for about 10 minutes.
Bon appetit! Scrumptious!

recipes.title: Easy Crab Soup
steps: Combine all ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Heat on medium until boiling.
Serve topped with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Cheesecake
steps: Mix all ingredients together except sour cream and bake in a 300° oven for 50 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Imperial Chicken
ingredients: 3 whole chicken breasts, split, boned and skinned
steps: Combine bread crumbs and garlic.
Combine cheese, parsley, salt and pepper; mix well.
Dip each breast in butter and coat with bread crumbs mixture.
Roll tightly, starting at narrow end. Secure with toothpick.
Arrange rolls in shallow pan.
Dribble with remaining butter and lemon juice.
Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Frozen Cucumbers
steps: Peel and slice cucumbers and onion thinly.
Mix rest of ingredients.
Pour over cucumbers.
Let stand 3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Place in freezer container and put in freezer. Serve on lettuce leaf as a salad or as a side dish.

recipes.title: Crispy Caramel Corn
ingredients: 1 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
steps: Preheat oven to 250°.
Grease well a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly roll pan.
Place popped popcorn and peanuts in large well-greased bowl.
Melt butter in large heavy saucepan; stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and boil 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and soda.
Pour syrup over popcorn mixture and mix well.
Spread on jelly roll pan. Bake 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Remove from oven and separate kernels when cool enough to handle.
Store in tightly covered containers.
Yields 3 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Cheese And Sausage Balls
steps: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix thoroughly with hands.
Form into small bite size balls.
Freeze until firm and bake as needed in a 350° oven for about 10 minutes or until nicely browned.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Denny'S Goulash
ingredients: 4 c. dry macaroni, cooked as directed
steps: Saute beef and onion until lightly browned.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, kidney beans and mushrooms.
Cook macaroni; drain and add.
Parboil celery and green pepper 5 minutes and add. Season to taste.
Simmer gently until heated through.
Great reheated!

recipes.title: Turnip Greens
steps: Wash turnip greens thoroughly.
Chop greens into small pieces. Put greens in pot with 4 cups water (more water may be used, if necessary).
Add sugar, salt, pepper and salt pork.
Bring to brisk boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low.
Cover and cook until tender.

recipes.title: Beef And Cabbage Casserole
steps: Cook meat in skillet and drain.
Dissolve bouillon cube in the
water.
Mix shredded cabbage, sliced carrots, chopped onion, garlic,
bouillon broth, pepper and salt with the meat; toss well. Put in casserole dish and bake in oven at 350° for about 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.
Stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Sandy Stew
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Cook 30 minutes in a big pot.
Serve hot.
Enjoy all you want.
There's no fat!

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Delight
steps: Mix graham cracker crumbs, margarine and 1 tablespoon of sugar; reserve 1/2 cup.
Press remainder into bottom and sides of an 8 x 12-inch pan.

recipes.title: Homemade Orange Sherbet
steps: Mix milk and Orange Crush.
Pour into electric ice cream churn.
Churn until firm.

recipes.title: Taffy Apple Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients together until smooth and creamy.
Serve with slices of tart apples.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli and drain water.
Cook Pet cream and Cheez Whiz together, stirring constantly.
Melt 2 sticks of butter and crumble 2 packages of crackers in butter.
Cover broccoli and Cheez Whiz with butter cracker topping.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 pkg. dry Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
ground pecans (to roll the cheese ball in)
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients together and form a ball.
Roll ball in the ground pecans.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn
steps: Mix all ingredients and bake uncovered at 350°
for
30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fudge
steps: Combine milk and 2 squares of chocolate, heating on a low flame until chocolate melts.
Add 1 cup sugar and salt.
Let it dissolve and then add slowly two remaining cups of sugar one at a time.
Turn heat up and bring to a boil.
Add Karo syrup. Continue to stir bubbling fudge until a drop from a spoon forms a soft ball in cold water.
Turn off flame and add vanilla and butter.
Beat until very thick.
When the fudge has a grayish sheen from so much beating, turn out into buttered platters.

recipes.title: Easy Pralines
steps: Mix well in a heavy 1 1/2-quart saucepan.
Cook and stir to a full boil, then slowly for 3 to 5 minutes, until mixture reaches soft ball stage.* Remove from heat.
Stir in 1 1/2 cup pecans (broken).
Beat mixture until it begins to thicken, but still looks shiny.
Drop tablespoonful of mixture quickly onto waxed paper to form 3-inch pralines.
Let cool.
If mixture thickens and starts to lose its shine while dropping pralines, add a few drops of evaporated milk.
Makes about 18 pralines.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cheesecake
steps: Mix and pat in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Elephant Stew
steps: Find a big pan.
Cut elephant into bite size pieces.
This takes about 2 months.
Add enough brown gravy to cover and cook over hot fire, about 465°.
Serves approximately 3,800 people.

recipes.title: Baked Chili Rellenos
steps: Spray oil in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Line bottom of pan with chilies (open and lay flat).
Remove seeds.
Cover with cheese.
Beat eggs for 2 minutes.
Add salt, milk and Bisquick mix to eggs and mix thoroughly.
Pour over peppers and cheese.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Shrimp With Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh or frozen shrimp in shells
1 c. fresh pea pods or 6 oz. pkg. frozen pea pods, thawed
steps: Thinly slice carrots and mushrooms.
Thaw shrimp, if frozen. Shell and devein shrimp.
Halve shrimp lengthwise.
Blend chicken broth into cornstarch; stir in soy sauce and set aside.

recipes.title: Spanish Royal
steps: Brown hamburger.
Grate cheese.
Mix soups, water, taco sauce and milk together.
Put in a large pan a layer of chips, meat, onion and cheese.
Pour sauce over mixture.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Tomato French Dressing
steps: Mix well all ingredients and put in jar and chill.
Shake well before using.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Chutney Spread
ingredients: 2 pkg. (3 oz. each) cream cheese, softened
steps: Beat all ingredients except chutney and crackers in medium bowl until creamy.
Stir in chutney.
Pack into 2-cup crock or non-metal container; cover tightly.
Refrigerate at least 24 hours, no longer than 2 weeks.
Remove from refrigerator 1 hour before serving.
Garnish with chutney, if desired.
Serve with assorted crackers.

recipes.title: Reuben Chicken
ingredients: 1 small can sauerkraut, drained and rinsed
steps: Place breasts in casserole dish.
Squeeze sauerkraut and place some on each breast.
Put slice of Swiss cheese on top; spread Thousand Island dressing over all.
Cover and bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients except cheese and potato chips.
Place in a greased casserole.	Top with cheese, then with a layer of potato chips.
Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Top with topping.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheese Cake
ingredients: 8 oz. or 1 large Philadelphia cream cheese
steps: Mix Philadelphia cream cheese, juice of lemon and condensed milk together.
Mix well and pour into pie crust.
Set in refrigerator for 1/2 hour.
Open cherries and pour on top of pie. Serves 6 to 8 people.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Icing
steps: Mix all ingredients together until creamy. Ice cake of your choice.

recipes.title: Asparagus Rolls
steps: Using a rolling pin, flatten each slice of bread.
Combine Blue cheese, cream cheese and egg in small bowl, mixing well. Spread evenly on bread, covering to edges.
Place 1 asparagus spear on each slice of bread; roll up.
Secure with 3 toothpicks. Dip in melted butter.
Place on a baking sheet and freeze.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
steps: You will need a crock-pot for this recipe.

recipes.title: Tomato Pie
ingredients: 3 medium tomatoes, peeled, sliced, and drained
steps: Bake pie shells slightly; let cool.
Blend cheese and mayonnaise and set aside.
Drain tomatoes well.
Layer tomatoes in pie shell with salt, pepper, onions, herbs and sausage.
Top with blended cheese mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.
Makes 2 pies.
(You can add more tomatoes, if needed.)

recipes.title: Mom'S Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/4 c. sour cream or plain yogurt
1/2 c. each: diced green and red bell pepper
steps: Crisp the
shredded
cabbage
in
ice water for 1 hour; drain well.
Mix with peppers.
Combine the mayo, lemon juice, onion, celery
seed, sugar, salt and pepper; mix with cabbage. Stir in dry roasted peanuts.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala
ingredients: 4 boneless and skinless chicken breast halves
1/4 c. Marsala wine or red cooking wine
steps: Pound chicken breasts to 1/4-inch thickness.
Dip in Egg Beater and then coat with cracker meal; set aside.
In a nonstick skillet, cook minced garlic in liquid Butter Buds for 1 to 2 minutes.
Add chicken and cook for 6 minutes or until done, turning once.
Remove to serving platter; keep warm.

recipes.title: Salmon Patties
steps: Mix and fry in palm size patties. Serve with Kraft macaroni and cheese, green peas and cole slaw.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. hen or chicken, cut in pieces
1 large pkg. spaghetti, cooked in chicken broth
steps: Cook chicken; cut into bite size pieces (save chicken broth to cook spaghetti).
Chop onions in fine pieces and brown in margarine.
Mix chicken, cooked spaghetti, onions, milk and soup in a large bowl.
Add black pepper to taste.
Put into 3 baking dishes (extras can be frozen).
Sprinkle with grated cheese or buttered cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Doggies
ingredients: 2 c. Kellogg's Corn Flakes or 1/2 c. Kellogg's Corn Flake crumbs
steps: If using Corn Flakes, crush into fine crumbs; set aside. Insert skewers lengthwise into frankfurters, leaving about 2-inches for a handle.
Roll frankfurters in catsup, then coat generously with Corn Flake crumbs.
Place in single layer on greased or foil-lined shallow baking pan.
Do not crowd.
Bake in moderately hot oven at 400° about 12 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
Serve with additional catsup and mustard, if desired.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Ball
steps: Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl.
Thoroughly mix and roll into a ball.
Chill and serve with your favorite crackers.

recipes.title: Mushroom Appetizers
steps: Trim crust from thin bread, roll flat with rolling pin.
Saute mushrooms and onion.
Chip cream cheese into this mixture.
Add other seasonings and mix well.
Spread on bread and roll up like jelly roll.
Freeze on cookie sheet with seam being on bottom. Slice into 3 pieces.
Roll in melted butter and bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.
Good for several days in freezer.
Dip and cook the day you plan to eat them.

recipes.title: Blueberry Salad
steps: Dissolve blackberry gelatin in 2 cups boiling water in large bowl.
Soften unflavored gelatin in 3/4 cup cold water.
Combine with blackberry gelatin; mix well.
Stir in blueberries and pineapple.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish.
Chill until set.
Combine cream cheese with next three ingredients in mixer bowl.
Beat until well blended.
Stir in pecans.
Spread over congealed layer.

recipes.title: Dried Beef Casserole
steps: Stir and let stand overnight.
Bake for 1 to 1 1/4 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
ingredients: tortilla chips and blue corn chips
steps: Combine cream cheese, sour cream, chili powder, cumin and red pepper in large bowl; mix until well blended.
Stir in salsa. Spread onto 10-inch serving platter lined with lettuce.
Top with cheeses, tomatoes, green onions and olives.
Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Un-Fried French Fries(Low-Fat)
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Slice potato lengthwise into 1/4-inch ovals, then slice each oval into lengthwise matchsticks.
Coat baking sheet with 3 sprays of vegetable oil.
Combine egg whites and Cajun spice in a bowl.
Add potatoes and mix to coat.
Return to baking sheet, leaving a little space between.
Cook on bottom shelf.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes until crispy, turning often.

recipes.title: Cheese Rolls
steps: Mix and roll in 6 rolls, the size of Hi Ho crackers in diameter.
Sprinkle wax paper lightly with chili powder.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 4 to 5 oz. can chopped green chilies*
1 4 to 5 oz. can of chopped black olives (optional)
8 to 10 oz. of shredded cheese any flavor
steps: Layer ingredients in an 8x8 dish in order listed.
Chill for an hour or two to set up.
Serve with tortilla chips.
Great picnic food.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 can, optional-green beans, peas or broccoli, drained
steps: Cook chicken, then debone the chicken.
Reserve the water that the chicken was cooked in, this is to be used to cook the spaghetti.
Lightly brown celery, green peppers, onion in 2 Tbsp. of bacon drippings or margarine.
Combine spaghetti with all other ingredients.
Add to taste any or all of the following seasonings: Black pepper, salt, garlic powder, oregano, ground cumin.
Place in baking dish and bake for 30 minutes (first 20 minutes covered with aluminum foil).

recipes.title: Pistachio Cake
steps: In bowl combine cake, orange juice, eggs, oil and pudding. Mix until blended.
Pour 2/3 of batter into greased Bundt pan. Mix last 1/3 of batter with chocolate syrup.
Pour over top.
Cut through to marbleize.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Red Cabbage - Polish Style *
ingredients: brown sugar and wine vinegar to taste
steps: Saute chopped onion until golden and add shredded cabbage (cabbage should be of rather coarse consistency, so food processor would spoil the character of the dish).
