Add water as necessary so cabbage does not stick; add brown sugar and vinegar to taste, then add chopped apple.
This dish can be stored, frozen and reheated.

recipes.title: Quick Baked Potatoes
steps: Cut the potatoes in half lengthwise.
Brush each cut half with melted butter.
Sprinkle with paprika, salt and cheese.
Place cut side down on oiled cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until potato is fork-tender.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
ingredients: Chili Colorado (liquid - or you can substitute on 10-ounce can Enchilada sauce if Chili Colorado is not available)
8 oz block cheese (Authentic Mexican-style Chihuahua Gran, Queso Asado, or you can use Monterey Jack)
steps: Cut up onion and cook in small amount of oil.
Set aside. Fry your tortillas in just a little bit of oil in the bottom of a pan. Drain the grease off of them.
Lay tortillas flat.
Spoon or spread chili colorado or canned Enchilada sauce over tortillas one at a time.
Then put onion on them and shredded cheese.
Roll them up and place them side by side in a shallow baking dish.
Cover again with small amount of chili sauce.
Bake at 350 degrees for just a few minutes until heated through.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
steps: Mix the taco seasoning with the sour cream.
Layer the ingredients in an oblong dish in order.
Let chill overnight.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli and add other ingredients except croutons.
Mix well and top with croutons.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Have Anothers
steps: Melt chips together in saucepan and add corn flakes until thick.
Spread on greased pan and chill.
Cut into squares and serve.

recipes.title: Lee'S Steak And Gravy
steps: Cut steak into small pieces.
Flour and fry brown on both sides.
Mix gravy mix according to directions on package.
Let set while steak is frying.
Slice up onions.
Put onions in bottom of baking pan.
Lay steak on top of onions.
Stir gravy mix good and pour over steak.
Cover pan and put in oven at 375° and cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Combine eggs, onion, celery, salt, beans, pepper and water. Cook a little.
Heat can cream of mushroom soup and 1 can of water. Mix all together.
Grate 1 cup of Cheddar cheese over top.
Crush 1 cup cracker crumbs and sprinkle over top.

recipes.title: Whole Sirloin Tip, Roasted
steps: Salt and pepper sirloin tip.
Place meat into a low-sided baking pan.
No water.
Heat oven to 350° and bake 5 to 5 1/2 hours.
Take out and slice.
Skim grease off juice in pan and serve as is or you can thicken with flour.

recipes.title: Corn Dip
ingredients: 2 (11 oz.) cans Green Giant Mexican corn
2 jalapeno peppers, diced or to taste
steps: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate overnight. Serve with Fritos corn chips.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
steps: Bread and fry chicken.
In your pan (9 x 13-inch works fine) layer sauce, chicken, sauce, Mozzarella cheese and sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake at 350° about 20 minutes (until cheese melts).

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza
ingredients: minced veggies (broccoli, carrots, radishes, etc.; think color)
steps: Spread dinner rolls flat on a pan and bake.
Let cool.
Let cream cheese soften so that mixing of cheese, dressing mix and mayonnaise will be easier.
Spread over cooled crust and slice in small squares.
Sprinkle the veggies and serve cool.

recipes.title: Pickles
ingredients: 1 1/2 qt. Heinz genuine dill pickles, drain and slice
steps: Put sliced pickles back in jar.
Add 2 or 3 pieces garlic and 3 cups sugar.
Let stand overnight.
Put back in refrigerator to chill.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger,
pork	sausage
and add onion and bell pepper.
Drain.
Add
soup, tomatoes and tomato sauce.
Simmer until done.
Remove from heat and add cheese.
Roll mixture in 12 to	15 corn tortillas, place in casserole and add remaining mix on top.
Sprinkle with grated cheese.	Bake at 350° for 34 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chicken
steps: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.
Add enough water to juice to measure 1 cup liquid.
Set pineapple aside.
In skillet combine pineapple liquid, onion, brown sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, bouillon and salt.
Bring to a boil.
Add chicken.
Reduce heat.
Tightly cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken.
Set aside.
Combine cornstarch and cold water. Stir into skillet.
Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.
Add pineapple, orange sections and chicken.
Heat through.
Spoon sauce over chicken.
May be served with rice.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Italian Beef
ingredients: 1 jar pepperoncini salad peppers and juice
steps: Put beef and broth into crock-pot; salt and pepper. Add spices and peppers. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 12 hours. Remove meat and slice thin. Put back in crock-pot to cook another hour. Serve on deli rolls.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
steps: Cook over medium heat until it reaches the hard crack stage. Watch it carefully toward the end so it doesn't burn.
Pour over popped corn.
Stir.

recipes.title: Squash Supreme Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. fresh squash, cooked and drained
1 1/2 medium onions, cooked with squash and drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
1 (4 oz.) jar pimento, chopped and drained
1 (6 oz.) pkg. herb seasoned stuffing (will not use all)
steps: In a large 3-quart casserole dish, combine all ingredients, except herb stuffing.
Sprinkle stuffing mix on top; dot with margarine.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Lemon Loaf
steps: Beat all ingredients for 7 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Mushroom Business
steps: Saute mushrooms, onion, celery, green pepper and season with salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste.
When sauteed lightly, add the mayonnaise.
Butter six slices of bread on both sides and cut in 1-inch squares.
Put half of bread in casserole; add sauteed vegetables.
Add rest of buttered bread.
Beat eggs and milk.
Pour over all and refrigerate a few hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Chicken Soup
ingredients: freshly ground black pepper to taste
steps: In large pot, simmer chicken, celery, carrot, onion, bouillon, and pepper until chicken shreds easily (1-1 1/2 hours). Remove chicken, shred. Bring broth to boil. Cook noodles in broth about 6 minutes. Stir in undiluted soup. Stir gently to dissolve lumps. Add shredded chicken, red pepper flakes and fresh black pepper.

recipes.title: Popsicles
steps: Mix all ingredients really well.
Add 3 cups cold water.
Put into ice molds or trays.
Freeze.

recipes.title: Poulet D'Artichoke
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. soft bread cubes or bread crumbs
steps: Cook artichokes per package, adding a little olive oil and garlic cloves.
Drain cooked artichokes and arrange in a greased baking dish or 8 individual ramekins.
Spread cooked chicken on top of artichokes (1/3 per ramekin).

recipes.title: No Cook Fudge
steps: Melt margarine.
Add cocoa.
Mix well until no lumps and looks smooth.
Add peanut butter, vanilla extract and dash of salt.
Stir carefully without splashing out of pan.
Add 10x sugar, stirring into other ingredients the milk to proper consistency.
Pour into buttered pan.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Creamy Yogurt Pops
steps: Mix ingredients and pour into popsicle molds.
Freeze for several hours, then enjoy!
(A healthful alternative to ice cream on a warm day.)

recipes.title: Marinated Tofu
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in bowl; mix well.
Add tofu. Marinate for 4 hours or longer.
Combine with mushrooms in skillet.
Simmer until done to taste.
May drain tofu and broil until golden brown or brown in hot oil in skillet, if preferred. Reserve marinade to re-use with tofu, meat or poultry.
Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Barbecue Beef
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. red pepper (if you want increase this, but it can make it hot, spicy)
steps: Brown onion and ground beef.
Mix all other ingredients in a large pot.
Stir in onion and beef.
Simmer on low flame for about 3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Serves 4.
I usually double the recipe to freeze some.
Serve on buns or over spaghetti.
I have used and given this recipe for over 40 years and all have enjoyed it.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
steps: Combine in large bowl; mix well.
Put in lightly buttered casserole.
Sprinkle crushed potato chips on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until it bubbles through.

recipes.title: Pineapple Tea Sandwiches
steps: Mix well. Spread on trimmed sandwich bread quarters.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
steps: Mix ingredients, except macaroni.
Cook macaroni and cool. Mix with other ingredients.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
ingredients: 1 (5 to 9 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Spray pan with Pam.
Pour batter into hot pan and cook in a 350° oven for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Darlene'S Italian Soup
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes and juice (cut-up tomatoes)
1 (8 oz.) can whole corn and juice
steps: Brown hamburger and onion; drain fat.
Stir in spices from Hamburger Helper mix.
Add corn, tomatoes and juice and 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese.
Heat to a boil.
Then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in noodles and simmer for 10 minutes longer.
Serve; sprinkle with more cheese.
Makes 10 cups.

recipes.title: Seafood Chowder
ingredients: 12 oz. fresh or frozen cod, pike or other fish fillets
8 oz. fresh or frozen peeled, deveined shrimp
2 large tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
steps: Thaw fish and shrimp, if frozen.
Cut fish into 1 inch pieces.
In large saucepan, combine broth, mushrooms, carrot, onion, garlic, marjoram, bay leaf, salt and pepper.
Bring to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Stir in sauce, tomatoes, fish and shrimp. Return to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 2 or 3 minutes or until fish flakes easily.
Discard bay leaf. Sprinkle with parsley and lemon peel.
Serves 4 generously.

recipes.title: Spiced Watermelon Rind(Mildred Gregory)
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. pared firm watermelon rind (cut into 1-inch shapes)
steps: Remove all green outer covering and all pink from rind before cutting into shapes.
There should be 2 quarts.
Cover rind shapes with cold water in a large kettle (porcelainized iron or enamel ware).
Bring water to a boil and cook 10 to 20 minutes or until tender crisp and rind can be pierced with a fork.
Stir in alum; remove from heat.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Next morning, drain; add sugar and vinegar.
Tie spices in cheesecloth and add. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly until sugar dissolves.
Remove from heat; cool.
Cover and refrigerate again overnight.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Sauce(For Cocktail Wieners)
steps: Mix and simmer until jelly is dissolved and thickened.
Add cocktail wieners and heat through.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Mixed Bean Salad
steps: Drain
canned beans well.
Add peppers; combine remaining ingredients
and
mix well.
Store in refrigerator for 24 hours before using.

recipes.title: Snowball Cake
steps: Bake cake as directed in 13 x 9 pan. When cool, punch holes in the cake (can use a straw for this). Top with crushed pineapple.

recipes.title: Crunchy Cheeseroni
steps: Cook macaroni and drain.
Brown ground beef and drain.
Add soups, green pepper, pimentos and cooked macaroni.
Place half the mixture in a greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Sprinkle with half the cheese and onions.
Top with remaining macaroni mixture and cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Sprinkle with remaining onions and bake for 5 minutes longer.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Spears Italienne
ingredients: 1 box frozen broccoli (use extra if serving 4 or more)
steps: Partially thaw broccoli spears.
Spread out in a baking dish. Sprinkle with the dressing on top of the broccoli.
Cover tightly with the foil and bake.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Texas Broccoli And Corn
steps: Thaw broccoli; melt oleo and mix with 3/4 herb stuffing mix. Add broccoli, cream-style corn and Tabasco.
Mix well.
Pour into greased casserole dish.
Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup herb stuffing mix on top.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° to 350° for about 45 minutes or until broccoli is done.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Dinner
steps: In large pot, brown ground beef and chopped onion.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes or until liquid is reduced.
Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Dill Pickles
steps: Mix water, sugar, pickling spice, vinegar and salt.
Boil for several minutes.
Put some dill in the bottom of each jar.
Pack cleaned cucumbers in the jars.
Put one slice of garlic in each jar and put some dill on top of cucumbers.
Pour boiling brine over the cucumbers and seal jars.

recipes.title: Moist Coconut Cake
steps: Bake cake by package directions in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Punch holes in cake when cool.
Pour Eagle Brand milk over the top of cake.
Add 1 small can Baker's coconut.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken Salad
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Combine first 8 ingredients and place in 2-quart casserole.
Top with cheese and potato chips.
Bake 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
steps: Put corn in large pan.
Boil sugar, oleo, syrup, salt and vanilla together for 5 minutes; add soda.
Stir quickly; pour over popcorn and stir to coat.
Put on 2 large cookie sheets and bake in a 250° oven for 35 minutes.
Stir often while baking.
You may add peanuts, pecans or walnuts, if you like.
Preheat nuts in oven while popping corn and cooking syrup, especially if you are keeping nuts in the freezer.

recipes.title: Tomato Aspic Salad
steps: Remove 1 cup V-8 juice.
Dissolve gelatin in juice.
Heat to boiling point the remaining V-8 juice.
Remove from heat.
Pour into a mold or casserole.
Add gelatin mixture.
Add bell pepper, celery, Lea & Perrins and lemon juice.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Stir well.
Cover with foil.
Cool 8 to 12 hours.

recipes.title: Escalloped Chicken
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in a large casserole dish or 9 x 13-inch baking pan for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Lemony Light Cooler
ingredients: sliced fruit (strawberries, grapes and peaches or nectarines work best)
steps: Combine grape juice, sugar and lemon juice.
Just before serving, add soda and fruit in individual glasses over ice.

recipes.title: Moms Rhubarb Cake
steps: Mix cake as directed on box.
Pour into greased 9 X 13 inch pan.
Sprinkle rhubarb and nuts over the cake batter.
Sprinkle the sugar on top.
Pour whipping cream over the top.
Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.
This is great!

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 pkg. Lipton onion mushroom soup mix
steps: Cook on low heat 12 hours.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
steps: Melt margarine in saucepan.
Add rest of ingredients.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Great for all meats and poultry.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Bake 35 minutes in a 350° to 375° oven.
Add cheese last and bake 10 minutes longer.
Use an 8 x 10-inch pan (approximate).

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
steps: Boil chicken and debone.
Mix chicken with all other ingredients except the corn flakes.
Pour mixture into buttered casserole dish; top with crushed corn flakes and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Combine sugar and milk in a large, heavy saucepan.
Slowly bring to a boil.
Cook, stirring, to soft ball stage (238°). Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients.
Beat until blended.
Pour into a buttered 9-inch pan; cool.
When fudge has set, cut in squares.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Mix well cream cheese and peanut butter together with beater. Add confectioners sugar and mix well. Add Cool Whip by folding into peanut butter mixture. Pour into graham cracker pie shell. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Four Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can each: garbanzo, waxed yellow, green and kidney beans
2/3 c. thinly sliced carrots, boiled 3 minutes (crispy)
small red onion, thin sliced in rings
steps: Warm vinegars together and add sugar, salt, garlic and black pepper.
Add oil and mix.
Pour over vegetables and marinate overnight.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Place sugar and cinnamon in a plastic bag.
Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces.
Place several at a time in bag and shake.
Place pecans in bottom of a greased Bundt pan.
Layer biscuit pieces on top of pecans.

recipes.title: One Dish Supper Treat
steps: Brown together beef or turkey and onion.
Add
corn and cream of potato soup.
Mix well and put into baking
dish
or pan.
Pour cornbread mixture over top and bake until cornbread is browned.

recipes.title: Foiled-Cooked Chuck Steak
ingredients: 1 can (10 1/2 oz.) cream of mushroom soup
2 stalks celery, cut in 2 inch pieces
steps: Heat oven to 450°.
Place foil in baking dish; place meat on foil.
Stir together mushroom soup and dry onion mix.
Spread on meat.
Top with vegetables.
Sprinkle with water.
Fold foil and seal.
Cook 1 1/2 hours, or until tender.

recipes.title: Divinity
steps: Beat egg whites until stiff and dry.
Cook sugar, syrup and water until soft ball stage is formed.

Pour 1/2 syrup over beaten egg whites and beat while remaining syrup cooks to hard ball or brittle stage. Remove this last cooking from low heat, add first syrup and egg mixture to kettle and beat until it will almost hold, or slightly stiff.
Add 1 cup chopped nuts.
Beat with wooden spoon until it will not move.
Beginning at edge of pan, remove by teaspoon onto waxed paper.
Do not add nuts while syrup is too hot as it draws oil from nuts and will not hold up.
Also, do not overcook.

recipes.title: Lasagna
steps: Cook lasagna.
Brown hamburger and put meat in sauce and simmer.
Drain lasagna; run cold water over while fixing.
Coat bottom of pan with sauce.
Layer lasagna, sauce, Mozzarella, grated cheese and end with Mozzarella.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Divinity
steps: Combine sugar, Karo and water; stir over medium heat until sugar melts.
When it starts to boil, cover for 3 minutes.
Remove lid and cook to hard ball.
Pour over whites (beaten stiffly), salt and vanilla in mixer.
Beat by hand until ready to drop.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 can refried beans with garlic and green chilies
steps: In an 8-inch square cake pan, spread 1 can of refried beans. Make a 1/4-inch layer of sour cream on top of the beans.
Layer salsa on top of the sour cream.
Layer shredded cheese on top of salsa.
Layer can of black olives on top of cheese.
Layer chopped tomato on top of black olives.
Heat in a 350° oven until warmed through and cheese melts or in microwave.
Add avocado if desired. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Anytime Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients in large bowl.
Mix well and chill.

recipes.title: Melon And Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 large cantaloupe, casaba, honeydew or Spanish melon (about 3 lb.)
1/4 lb. thinly sliced Prosciutto, cut into 1-inch strips (1/4 lb. thin sliced ham may be substituted)
steps: Cut melon in half.
Scoop out seeds and fiber.
Cut each half lengthwise into 6 wedges and remove rind.
Cut crosswise slits 1 1/2 inches apart in each melon wedge.
Place several strips of Prosciutto over each wedge.
Push Prosciutto into slits using the blade of a table knife.
Makes 12 servings; 25 calories per serving.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cake
steps: Mix cake mix as directed.
Mix rhubarb and sugar; let stand for 10 minutes.
Pour over cake mix.
Pour 1 pint whipping cream over all.
Dust with cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Spiced Pecans
steps: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat; add sugar and pepper.
Stir continuously until smooth. Add pecans; stir until pecans are coated. Remove immediately from heat and let cool on wax paper.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cream Pie
steps: In a double boiler, put sugar, cornstarch and salt.
Add scalded milk.
Cook until thick.
Add a small amount of the mixture to the eggs.
Add egg mixture to contents of the double boiler.
Cook until mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla.
Chill.
Add strawberries and pour into pie shell.
Refrigerate.
Top with whipped cream when serving.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
steps: Combine all ingredients except 1/2 cup butter and corn flakes. Put them in baking dish. Sprinkle crushed corn flakes on top and drizzle remaining butter on top of corn flakes. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Salad
steps: In large skillet melt oleo over medium heat.
Add celery and onion, cook about 4 minutes or until tender.
Remove from
heat. Stir in next 5 ingredients until well blended.
Add chicken, almonds and mushrooms, toss to coat well.
Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with potato chips.
Bake in 325° oven 25 to 30 minutes or until hot.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
steps: Mix together until smooth. Serve with sliced apples, bananas, strawberries or any fruit.

recipes.title: Spinach Stew With Beef
steps: In a large Dutch oven, combine water, beef, 1 cup onion and 1 teaspoon ginger root.
Bring to a brisk boil; lower heat, cover and simmer 1 hour.
While beef is simmering, wash spinach; chop and set aside.
In a large frypan, heat oil.
Add tomato, remaining onion, tomato paste and beef stock.
Cook 15 to 20 minutes over low heat.
Add beef; cover and simmer 15 minutes longer.
Add salt to taste, cayenne pepper, remaining ginger and spinach.
Cover and let simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with rice, yam or plantain.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Supreme
ingredients: 3 c. sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed
steps: Mix all ingredients well and pour into greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Add topping and bake 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Cantaloupe Jam
steps: Place cantaloupe in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil over low heat.
Boil, stirring occasionally, until smooth.
Stir in sugar, lemon juice and rind.
Continue boiling for 15 to 20 minutes.
Spoon, while hot, into hot sterilized jars.
Seal with paraffin.

recipes.title: Pot Pie
ingredients: meat of your choice: chicken, tuna or beef
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Put one pie shell on bottom. Put ingredients in pie shell, then the other one on top.
Mash the sides together. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Belgium Potatoes
steps: Cut based potatoes into one inch cubes.
Heat butter in large pan until just simmering. Add the potatoes, add salt and pepper. Brown potatoes on all sides, add chives and serve warm.
Add parsley for garnish.
About 6 servings.

recipes.title: Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
steps: Mix sugar, salt, milk and egg yolks in saucepan; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, just until bubbles appear around edges of pan.
Cool to room temperature.
Stir in vanilla and cream.
Pour in freezer can and place dasher in place.
Freeze following directions with freezer.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Cups
steps: Combine all ingredients and pour into paper baking cups placed in muffin tins. Freeze.

recipes.title: Salmon Ball
steps: Mix all together and shape into a ball.
Chill 1/2 hour.
Roll ball in nuts and parsley.
"This recipe is good served on Triscuits crackers.
Serves 8 but sometimes I use 3 to 4 packages of cream cheese to stretch the recipe."

recipes.title: Broccoli Soup
steps: Make instant potato soup from first 3 ingredients.
Add soups, salt, pepper and broccoli.
Warm to desired temperature.
Serve.

recipes.title: Parsnip Stew
steps: Chop pork fine and put through grinder.
Pare potatoes and parsnips; slice.
Put one layer of pork, one layer of potatoes and one layer of parsnip.
Repeat until all are used.
Cover with cold water; season with pepper and salt.
Cook 45 minutes.
Note: Cost, including gas heat, = $0.2137 in 1917 terms.
From Telegram Conservation Cook Book, page 91.

recipes.title: Stuffed Jumbo Shells
steps: In skillet, brown ground beef.
Drain off grease.
Add chili sauce, spaghetti sauce, basil, oregano, parsley flakes and sugar. Heat large pot of water and 1 teaspoon salt.
When boiling, add jumbo shells.
Cook as package directs.
Meanwhile, in large bowl, add Ricotta cheese, Mozzarella, Parmesan cheese and egg and mix thoroughly.
Drain jumbo shells in cold water.
Stuff jumbo shells with the cheese mixture.

In the bottom of pan, put thin layer of meat and sauce mixture, then layer stuffed shells on top of sauce. When all noodles are stuffed and in the pan, pour the rest of the sauce over top of pasta shells.
Then spread shredded Mozzarella cheese on top.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until cheese is browned.
Serve with hot French bread or garlic toast.

recipes.title: Special "K" Roast
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Place in loaf pan and let bake in 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
steps: Melt margarine and stir in soda.
In a large pan combine the first 3 ingredients.
Bring to a boil and cook 8 to 10 minutes. Add soda mixture while stirring constantly and pour onto a large cookie sheet.
Break into pieces when cool.

recipes.title: Hollandaise Sauce
steps: In small saucepan, stir together real mayonnaise, milk, salt and pepper.
Stir in lemon rind, lemon juice and food coloring. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, about 4 minutes
or until heated.
Serve over hot, cooked asparagus.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Ham Bites
steps: Lay out 4 slices bread; top with cheese and ham.
Repeat cheese and bread.
Cut into quarters.
Mix eggs and milk; add salt to taste.
Turn bread pieces in egg mixture, then in bread crumbs. Fry in hot fat until golden brown.
Serve hot.
Yield:
4 servings.

recipes.title: Pancake Burger
steps: Brown beef and onion, drain.
Stir in the rest of the ingredients.
(Tomatoes and corn with their liquid.)
Simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Casserole
steps: Mix together and place in a greased dish.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Cracker Stuffing
steps: Roll crackers real fine.
Mix sage in dry crackers.
Saute onions, celery and butter.
In a small pan, warm milk.
Beat eggs in a bowl.
Add onions, celery and butter to crackers.
Add eggs. Add milk, a little at a time, until crackers are real moist.

recipes.title: Freezer Slaw
steps: Mix first six ingredients and bring to a boil.
Set aside to cool.
Finely chop cabbage, peppers, carrot and onion.
Mix vegetables together and pour the cooled vinegar mixture over them. Place in containers and freeze.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
steps: Brown ground chuck in skillet until brown.
Alternate layers of Tater Tots, ground chuck and sliced onion.
Pour soup contents, along with about 1/2 can water over this mixture.
Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
steps: Brown and season meat with salt, pepper and onions.
Drain and place in lightly greased casserole dish.
Mix Bisquick, milk and eggs for 1 minute.
Put cheese on top of meat and then pour milk over all.
Do not stir.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Praline Grahams
steps: Combine butter and sugar in sauce pan on medium heat.
Bring to a boil.
Boil 3 minutes stirring constantly.
Break graham crackers in 1/2 and arrange on cookie sheet.
Spoon mixture on crackers.
Heat oven to 300 degrees.
Cook for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Fudge
steps: In double boiler, melt bits over hot water.
Add butter, nut meats and vanilla; blend thoroughly.
Pour chocolate mixture into large cake loaf pan.
Let cool in refrigerator.
Makes 2 to 3 pounds.

recipes.title: Sunshine Cake
ingredients: 1 yellow cake mix (no pudding in it)
steps: Mix together and bake in
two 8 or 9-inch or one 9 x 13-inch pan which are greased and floured at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes. Cool.
Slice horizontally for torte effect, if you want that look.

recipes.title: Ham Roll-Ups
steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients.
Spread over ham slices.
Roll lengthwise; cut into pinwheels.
Secure with toothpicks.

recipes.title: Tuna Surprise
steps: Cook shells and peas until shells are tender; drain.
Add cheese, tuna, salt and pepper.
Serve right away.

recipes.title: Frozen Punch
ingredients: 1 small can crushed pineapple or can use large can
steps: Boil first 2 ingredients until syrupy.
Add remaining ingredients, except ginger ale, and mix well.
Pour into 2 plastic gallon jugs.
Freeze.
Thaw 2 1/2 hours before serving.
Add 1 1/2 quarts ginger ale to each slightly thawed gallon of frozen mixture.
Mixture should be slushy.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
steps: Brown sausage, onion and green pepper.
Pour off drippings. Add tomatoes, sour cream, macaroni and seasonings.
Cover and cook slowly 10 minutes.
Uncover and continue cooking until macaroni is tender.
Sometimes a little water needs to be added.
I usually use half the recipe.

recipes.title: Szechwan Chicken With Spicy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. chicken breasts, cut in small pieces
1 green onion, cut in half (including top)
1 quarter size slice fresh ginger, crushed
steps: Place chicken in a 2-quart pan with onion, ginger, sherry, salt, sugar and water.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then cover.
Reduce heat and simmer until meat is done (about 20 minutes).
Meanwhile, prepare Peanut Sauce and place lettuce on individual plates.
When Peanut Sauce is ready, place chicken on lettuce and drizzle on Peanut Sauce.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn Supreme
steps: Heat corn and milk.
Gradually stir in egg.
Add next 4 ingredients and dash of pepper.
Mix well.
Pour into greased 8-inch round baking dish.
Sprinkle buttered crumbs over.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Iroquois Corn Soup
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion, peeled and sliced
steps: In a large 12-inch saucepan, place the mushrooms, consomme, cornmeal, cilantro, garlic, basil, onion, pepper and salt.
Simmer over medium heat, uncovered, for about 10 minutes.
Add the flounder, lima beans and sherry and simmer another 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally and breaking the flounder into bite size pieces.
Serve piping hot.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Marinated Olives
ingredients: 2 (6 oz.) cans pitted black olives, drained
steps: Place all ingredients into a covered bowl; shake to coat olives with the marinade.
Leave at room temperature for at least 2 hours.

recipes.title: Pudding Frosting
ingredients: 2 (3/4 oz.) pkg. instant pudding or 1 large box
steps: To baked, hot cake, poke holes through cake.
Combine pudding with sugar.
Stir in milk.
Blend thoroughly.
Do not overblend. Before pudding thickens, pour 1/2 of thin pudding evenly over warm cake into holes.
Allow pudding to thicken slightly.
Pour remaining 1/2 over cake.
Cover and chill for 1 hour before serving.
Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
steps: Cook broccoli and drain.
Beat eggs and cottage cheese together.
Add cornbread mix, salt, onion, butter and broccoli. Beat until blended.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes in 8 or 9-inch round pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup, undiluted
steps: Cook hen or fryer until it comes off bone.
Put chicken (boned) in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Spoon cream of chicken soup over chicken, undiluted.
Moisten Pepperidge Farm dressing with some of the broth and put on top of chicken.
Melt margarine and spoon over dressing.
Put in 400° oven for 6 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Traveling Taco
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) bar Monterey Jack cheese with jalapeno peppers, grated
1 small (3 oz.) bag shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
steps: Layer on pizza pan in order.
Serve with nacho chips to scoop. Better if made ahead by at least an hour to chill.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Pie
steps: Place chopped rhubarb in pie shell.
Mix spices and sugar. Pour over rhubarb.
Dot with butter.
Cover with other pie shell. (Place on cookie sheet, juice may boil out.)
Bake at 300° until crust is brown, about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Casserole
steps: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain.
Add onion, bell pepper, small jar pimento and black olives to ground beef; cook until onion and pepper are tender.
Add Cheddar cheese soup, cream of mushroom soup and water.
Cook until bubbly.
Add to macaroni; bake in casserole at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffing
steps: Cook onion in skillet with butter until onion is transparent. Set aside.
Put cubed bread in a casserole bowl and sprinkle sage and poultry seasoning over top.
Mix.
(Don't overspice.)
Now, pour onions and butter over top and mix.
Pour milk over top to moisten and put in oven for 1/2 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Tuna Potato Puffs
steps: Drain and flake tuna; mix with potatoes.
Stir in egg yolks. Add salt, pepper and onion; fold in egg whites.
Pour mixture in greased custard cups or casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Grilled Mustard And Rosemary Chicken Thighs
steps: Measure mustard into a small bowl.
Whisk in lemon juice, then oil.
Add garlic, rosemary and pepper.
Pour into large non-aluminum pan.
Remove skin from chicken, if desired.
Add chicken to pan and turn to coat.
Cover and marinate 2 hours at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Potatoes With Thickening
ingredients: 2 lb. medium potatoes or small new potatoes
steps: Peel potatoes and quarter (scrape new potatoes and leave whole).
Add water, butter, salt and pepper.
Bring to a rolling boil and reduce heat to simmer.
Cook about 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Remove from heat.
In small bowl, mix cornstarch with milk.
Pour over potatoes and stir well.
Return to medium heat and cook until the liquid thickens.
Stir frequently.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Roll
ingredients: 2 small pkg. dried beef, cut up fine
steps: Mix by hand and roll into ball, then roll in pecans. Chill. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Bean Curd "Duck"
steps: Soak bean curd in water overnight.
Wash in clear water.
Cook bean curd until tender in 1 cup water, oil, onion, coriander, soy sauce, ginger, garlic and salt.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Stew chicken and debone.
Mix both cans of soup and 1/2 stick of butter.
Heat until butter is melted.
Pour soup and butter mix over chicken.
Then take stuffing mix and pour over the top of that.
Make sure that it is even and smooth.
Then take cup of chicken broth and pour over that.
Dot the top with the rest of the butter. Bake at 375° for about 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
ingredients: 2 c. vanilla wafers or graham crackers, crushed
steps: Mix wafers and margarine together.
Press into cake pan. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Kimberly'S Venison Casserole
steps: Brown venison and onion.
Boil potatoes (sliced very thin) until tender.
Layer the ingredients in a deep dish, meat, potatoes, soup until all used.
Cook at 300°.
After it has cooked, pour cheese on top. This can be changed by adding chopped green pepper and using cream of chicken soup.

recipes.title: Easter Casserole(Breakfast)
steps: Brown sausage, onion and pepper in skillet; drain.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 (20 oz.) rolls refrigerator chocolate chip cookie dough
steps: Mix together well first 4 ingredients; set aside.
Slice cookie dough rolls into 1/3-inch slices.
Place slices of one roll into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish; press together to cover any holes. Spoon in cream cheese mixture evenly and top with slices of remaining package of cookie dough.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown and center is slightly firm.
Let cool then refrigerate.
Cut into squares.
Serve with chocolate sauce or whipped topping.

recipes.title: Johnny A'S Beans
steps: Prepare 6 squares of heavy-duty doubled foil.
Oil lightly one side.
Core apples and scoop out to make larger cavity.
Combine beans with marmalade and fill apples.
Wrap and seal packages. Place on medium-hot coals for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Speedy Caramel Frosting
steps: Melt butter in saucepan; blend in brown sugar and salt.
Cook over low heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add milk and continue stirring until mixture comes to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Blend in 4x sugar gradually.
Add vanilla and mix well. Frost 2 layers.

recipes.title: Diabetic Pound Cake
steps: Measure Bisquick and pour in large bowl.
Cut in margarine until size of small peas.

recipes.title: Marinating Sauce For Steak
steps: Combine ingredients and marinate meat overnight.

recipes.title: Red Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 lb. container frozen red chili, or 1 pkg. powdered
1/4 c. plus 1 c. water (if using powdered chili)
steps: Mash and cook beef on medium, drain oil.
Add frozen chili, stir well.
(If using powdered chili, sprinkle on meat and stir well.
Add water and stir to desired consistency; more for thin sauce, less for thicker gravy sauce.)
In separate pan with hot oil covering bottom of pan, lay corn tortilla, turning over immediately to keep soft and transfer to serving plate.
Top with mixture, cheese and onions.
Repeat for 3 or 4 layers.
Heat plate in oven at 350° for five minutes, or micro for 2 minutes.
Top with egg and garnish with lettuce and tomato around edges.
Serves approximately 4.

recipes.title: Strawberry Ice Cream
steps: Use desired amount of crushed fruit (strawberries or peaches). Pour mixture into freezer.
Add milk to fill line in gallon ice cream freezer.

recipes.title: Crawfish Etouffee
steps: Melt butter (or oleo) in large Dutch oven.
Cook chopped onions, garlic, green pepper and celery until clear.
Add crawfish and cook another 10 to 15 minutes.
Add all soups and Ro-Tel, blending well.
Cook until crawfish turn pink and then turn off heat.
Garnish with green onions, etc.
(Freezes well.)

recipes.title: Italiano Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger, onion, garlic salt and spices.
Drain. Combine in 1 1/2-quart casserole with soup, water and cooked noodles.
Top with cheese.
Cover and bake 20 minutes at 350°. Uncover and bake 10 more minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Relish
ingredients: 3 or 4 large zucchini, peeled and remove seeds
steps: Grind 10 cups of zucchini in meat grinder, along with onions, peppers and salt.
Mix and let set overnight.
Next day, drain in colander and rinse in cold water.
Add vinegar, mustard, celery, turmeric, cornstarch and black pepper.
Mix and cook 3 minutes (simmer).
Stir as it sticks on easily.

recipes.title: Quick Chili Burgers
steps: In skillet, brown beef; stir to separate meat.
Blend in soup and water.
Heat; stir now and then.
Serve in buns; top with cheese.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Avocado Delight
steps: Peel avocado and cut in half.
Fill cavity with cranberry sauce and top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: 14 Day Pickles
steps: Pour boiling liquid over pickles in jars.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Pour liquid out into large pan and bring to boil again. Refill jars and seal.
Makes 8 quarts.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Ball
steps: Soften cream cheese. Add scallions and 3/4 of the beef cut into small pieces. Add a little salt and a few drops of Worcestershire sauce. Add mayonnaise.
Mix together and chill for several hours. Cut up remaining beef.
Form cream cheese mixture into ball. Roll it in the remaining beef.

recipes.title: Potato Salad For A Crowd
ingredients: 2 c. Italian-style dressing (seasoned oil and vinegar)
steps: Cook potatoes with skins on until tender.
Cool slightly; remove skins.
Cube potatoes.
Combine dressing, salt and vinegar. Pour over warm potatoes.
Mix gently, then let stand until cold. Add remaining ingredients; mix gently.
Chill at least an hour (overnight is better), then serve.

recipes.title: Popcorn Balls
steps: Cook sugar, syrup and water.
Add flavoring and salt.
Pour slowly over corn.
Stir with spoon, as that all will be evenly coated.
Make same size popcorn balls.

recipes.title: Marinated Crab Claws
steps: Put butter, minced garlic, dill weed and Cajun seasoning in pot. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes. Add melted butter. Pour over cooked crab claws and steam in pot for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Irish Creme
steps: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.
Only good for about 1 week.

recipes.title: Super Bowl Dip
steps: Fry sausage and onions in skillet until meat is thoroughly cooked; drain.
Add chilies and tomatoes and cook uncovered for 15 minutes.
Add sour cream and cream cheese.
Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring often.
Keep warm when serving with chips.

recipes.title: Chille Rellenos(Mexican Stuffed Peppers)
ingredients: 1/2 lb. cooked hamburger (meat stuffing instead of cheese)*
steps: Cook the peppers on a hot pan until the skin is burnt all the way around them (yes, let the skin burn). Place peppers in a plastic bag and let them sweat. After they have set for a while take them out and the skin should come right off. Cut a slit length-wise in the peppers and fill with mixture of cheese, onion and tomato. Hold the peppers together with toothpicks. After peppers have been stuffed, roll them in flour and then dip them into beaten eggs and fry on medium heat until the egg is done. Goes great with Spanish rice.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
steps: Mix and put in a 9 x 12-inch pan sprayed with Pam.
Sprinkle dry yellow cake mix over pumpkin mix.
Sprinkle 2 cups walnut meats over cake mix.
Drizzle 3/4 cup melted butter or oleo over nuts.
Bake 1 hour at 325° to 350°.
When cool, top with whipped topping.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
steps: Use a large skillet or Dutch oven.
Saute onion and pepper in margarine until pepper is soft (not brown).
Add pimentos, milk and broth; heat.
Add soup, salt and garlic; bring to a boil.
Add chicken and heat thoroughly.
Stir in spaghetti (drained and washed).
Pour into buttered casserole dish and bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Add grated cheese and bake until cheese has melted.

recipes.title: Cool Mexican Dip
steps: Mix all together and chill for 1 hour.
Serve with taco chips.

recipes.title: Pecan Chicken
steps: Place chicken in shallow dish or plastic bag. Pour dressing over chicken. Cover and marinate in refrigerate for 1 hour. Drain, dip chicken in combined crumbs and pecans; press to coat. Cook chicken in margarine in large skillet over medium heat 10 minutes on each side until tender.

recipes.title: Amaretto Fudge
steps: Melt chocolate chips and Eagle Brand milk on low heat until well blended.
Add Amaretto and almond extract; whip well.
Pour into wax paper lined 8 x 8-inch pan.
Refrigerate 2 hours or more. Roll into 1-inch balls and into chopped almonds.
Refrigerate. Make a couple of days ahead.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Combine ingredients; let set for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Strawberry Punch
steps: Mix all together.
Just before serving, add 2 to 3 bottles of 7-Up.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. grated Cheddar cheese or Mexican Four Cheeses
steps: Cook pasta as directed and drain. Brown beef; drain. Add tomato sauce, water, taco seasoning and salsa to beef. Let simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat; add pasta and mix well. Pour into casserole dish; top with grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Lombardi
steps: Brown beef and drain.
Stir in chopped tomatoes and next 4 ingredients.
Cook 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and bay leaf and simmer 30 minutes.
Cook egg noodles and drain.
Stir together noodles, onion and sour cream.
Place noodles in bottom of lightly greased 9x13 in. pan.
top with beef mixture and sprinkle evenly with cheeses.
Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes.
Uncover and bake 5 more minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese (leave out all day)
steps: Mix all ingredients together (except walnuts).
Add walnuts to frosting. If frosting is too thick, add a dash of milk.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 cooked chicken breast or 1 (5 oz.) can chicken
8 oz. Cheddar cheese or Co-Jack cheese
steps: Soften tortillas in microwave (slit package and cook 30 seconds on High).

recipes.title: Beef Jerky
steps: Remove all fat from steak.
Slice with grain 1/8-inch thick. Cook on wire rack at 150° for 4 to 5 hours or until dry.
Line oven with foil.

recipes.title: Pecan Fudge Pie
ingredients: pecans to cover bottom of unbaked crust
steps: Mix sugar, cocoa, milk, butter, eggs and vanilla together. Pour in crust.
Bake on cookie sheet in a 325° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
Do not overcook.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Boil chicken until done; remove bones and skin and break into small pieces.
Add mushroom and chicken soups and broth; mix well. Add stuffing mix.
Pour into greased casserole dish; top with melted margarine.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
steps: Cook until thick.
Remove from heat and add 1 package strawberry jello and cool.
Slice 1 pint strawberries for each pie.
Makes 2 pies.
Cover with Cool Whip or whipped cream. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Banana Split Salad
steps: Combine Cool Whip and milk in bowl.
Beat well.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Chill.

recipes.title: Cabbage Ramen Salad
steps: Break up the noodles and toast with the almonds and sesame seed without oil.
Mix together the sugar, Ramen seasoning, oil and wine vinegar.
Chicken cut into small pieces can be added. Best made the day before.

recipes.title: Ore-Ida Potato Bake
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen Ore-Ida potatoes with onion and peppers
steps: Thaw frozen potatoes and put into greased 9 x 12-inch casserole.
Mix together soup, sour cream, onion and Cheddar cheese; add to potatoes.
Combine butter and the bread crumbs; cover top of casserole.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Easy Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1/8 tsp. each: garlic powder and pepper
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can Campbell's Healthy Request condensed cream of broccoli soup
4 c. hot, cooked cholesterol-free noodle style pasta, cooked without salt
steps: Spray a 2-quart oblong dish with vegetable cooking spray. Arrange chicken, bone side down, in dish.
Sprinkle with garlic powder and pepper.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Combine soup and water; spoon over chicken.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear.
Serve with pasta.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
steps: Layer sausage in bottom of 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
Add 1 cup grated cheese and the other ingredients.
Let stand all night in refrigerator.
Bake 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 jars picante sauce (your choice, hot, medium or mild)
steps: Chop tomatoes in cubes.
Chop lettuce finely.
Grate cheese. Cream together taco seasoning, sour cream and cream cheese.
Spread refried beans on the bottom of pan.
Add sour cream and cream cheese mixture.
Spread on top of refried beans.
Spread picante sauce on top of sour cream and cream cheese mixture.
Top with lettuce, tomatoes and cheese.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookie Delight
steps: Let ice cream and Cool Whip set out to soften.
Crush cookies. Mix it all together and put in pan.
Freeze at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Turkey Divan Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli for 5 minutes.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Mix soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice, sour cream and curry powder.
Cut bread into bite size pieces and put in bottom of casserole.
Place cooked, drained broccoli over the bread and layer meat over it. Pour sauce on top.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Top with as much sharp cheese as you wish.
Return to oven for another 5 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
ingredients: dash of Tabasco sauce or hot sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour over the cream cheese.
Chill.

recipes.title: Salsa Cream Dip
steps: Press cream cheese evenly on platter.
Spread salsa sauce over top.
Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.
Microwave on Medium-high for 2 1/2 minutes or until center is warm.

recipes.title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
steps: Remove crusts from bread. Spread tops of bread slices with margarine and place in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Set aside.
Cook sausage until browned, stirring to crumble.
Drain well. Spoon over bread slices. Sprinkle with shredded cheese. Combine eggs, half and half and salt.
Mix well.
Pour over cheese. Cover casserole tightly and chill overnight.

recipes.title: Bruschetta With Anchovy Salad
ingredients: 2 loaves Italian bread (about 2 inches in diameter)
steps: Prepare the salad.
Coarsely chop the anchovies and place in a mixing bowl.
Add about a 1/4 teaspoon of finely minced garlic, the pimientos, the scallions, 1 tablespoon oil, the lemon juice and parsley.
Reserve.

recipes.title: Perfection Salad
steps: Dissolve gelatin in hot water.
Add cold water, salt and lemon juice or vinegar.
Chill.
When mixture is slightly thickened, fold in cabbage, celery, carrots and onion.
Pour in mold and chill until firm.
Unmold on lettuce leaves and top with mayonnaise.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Cabbage Soup
steps: In a large pot cook ground chuck and onion until meat is no longer pink. Drain well. Add Ro-tel and tomato juice and mix well. Add shredded cabbage and cook until cabbage is nearly done. Stir in red beans and season with salt and pepper to desired taste.

recipes.title: Fruit Spears
steps: Note: You will need toothpicks and a plate.

recipes.title: Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 c. dry red wine (Merlot or Cabernet Sauvignon)
steps: *I like to use Barilla brand (marinara sauce). But if you don't have Barilla, any jar sauce will do.

recipes.title: Carrot And Celery Casserole
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients together and place in buttered casserole dish.
Cover with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
steps: Mix together first 2 ingredients. Then beat next 2 ingredients together.
Pour chocolate mixture into cream cheese mixture. Blend well.
Then stir in Cool Whip.
Pour into crust.
Freeze 4 hours.
Keep frozen.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
steps: Mix all together; put in a greased 3-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Loaf
steps: Mix together ground turkey, stove top stuffing, seasoning and all, 1 chopped onion and 1 egg.
Form into loaf.
Put in baking dish and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to 60 minutes until brown.

recipes.title: Great Chicken Casserole
steps: Prepare noodles according to package directions; drain.
Saute mushrooms, green pepper and onion in oleo until tender.
Add soup, milk and cheese.
Stir until cheese melts.
Combine noodles, cheese mixture, chicken and salt.
Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with crushed croutons.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Make 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 8 oz. chive and cream cheese dip
steps: Combine cheese and next 4 ingredients. Chill 4 hours or until firm. Shape into ball to resemble a pumpkin.

recipes.title: Vichyssoise
ingredients: 2 c. chicken broth or 2 c. water and 4 bouillon cubes
1 c. light cream or 1 small can evaporated milk (not condensed)
4 Tbsp. minced celery heart with leaves
steps: Cook potatoes in water or broth until soft. Cool slightly (so as not to crack blender); blend until smooth. Mixture will be like glue! Use some of the milk to clean out the blender. Saute the onion in the butter until tender.

Combine onion and potato mixture to remaining milk and cream. Heat very slowly, stirring frequently, to prevent sticking. Add salt to taste. Add minced celery and parsley at end of cooking time. This soup is excellent served either hot or cold. Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Caramel Pie
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: Brown coconut and pecans in butter until lightly brown (be careful not to burn it).
Cream the Eagle Brand and cream cheese until smooth.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour 1/4 of the filling into each pie shell.

Then sprinkle with coconut pecan mixture and drizzle with warm caramel (take lid off and warm in microwave). Pour rest of filling into each pie shell and sprinkle with rest of pecan-coconut mixture and top with caramel.

recipes.title: Pineapple Souffle
steps: Mix eggs and sugar.
Add margarine.
Cream until smooth.
Add pineapple.
Cube bread and fold in.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cherry Waldorf Salad
ingredients: 1 small banana, sliced or finely chopped
steps: Bring 3/4 cup of apple juice to boil in medium saucepan. Dissolve cherry gelatin completely in boiling apple juice, stirring 2 minutes.
Mix remaining 1/2 cup apple juice and ice to measure 1 1/4 cups.
Add to gelatin, stirring until slightly thickened.
Remove any remaining ice.
Stir in fruit and celery. Spoon into individual dishes or serving bowl.
Refrigerate 2 hours or until firm.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad And Pudding Mix
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can each: sliced peaches, apricot halves, pears and pineapple chunks
steps: Drain all fruit, reserving 2 cups of mixed juices.
Layer drained fruit, strawberries, cherries and bananas into bowl. Combine pudding mix with juices in bowl, beating until thick.
Pour over fruit.
Do not toss.
Chill for 2 hours before serving. Yields 15 servings.

recipes.title: Beef Baked With Yogurt
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Remove all fat from meat and cut into 1-inch cubes.
Heat oil in Dutch oven over medium heat.
Brown meat on all sides, about 1/4 at a time.
Remove from pan and set aside.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 c. cooled, cubed, cooked chicken (I use white meat, one whole chicken may be used)
steps: Mix well and refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 300° until bubbly, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Toast Butter
steps: Mix with mixer until smooth.
Refrigerate.
Spread on hot toast.
Will keep indefinitely refrigerated.

recipes.title: Shrimp With Lobster Sauce
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. garlic powder or minced garlic
6 Tbsp. cornstarch and enough cold water to make a paste
steps: Heat oil in saucepan.
Saute diced onion until soft, but not brown.
Add shrimp and garlic and saute until pink (2 to 3 minutes).
Remove shrimp with slotted spoon.

recipes.title: Rocky Road Supreme
ingredients: 1 large angel food cake or white cake
steps: Melt chocolate chips and sugar in double boiler.
Remove from heat.
Add beaten egg yolks to mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into chocolate mixture. Whip the cream and fold into mixture.
Tear cake into pieces and alternately layer cake and chocolate mixture, ending with chocolate.
Chill. Serve with whipped topping sprinkled with nuts.

recipes.title: Cool Delight Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients and chill.

recipes.title: Roast Beef Salad
steps: Mix together and chill.

recipes.title: Papa Burgers
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Form burgers.
Grill outdoors or on the stove in a pan.

recipes.title: Ham Au Gratin
steps: Saute onion in 2 tablespoons butter in large skillet until tender.
Stir in mushrooms, asparagus, ham, mayonnaise, sour cream, cheese and mustard.
Pour into buttered 1 1/2-quart shallow casserole.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup grated sharp cheese.
Broil for 5 minutes or until top is golden and bubbly and dish is heated through.

recipes.title: Carnival Dip
steps: Combine all ingredients and whisk until smooth.
Refrigerate until time to serve.
Makes about 1 cup.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Seeds
steps: Bring water to boil in saucepan; add salt and continue to cook until it dissolves.
Pour mixture over pumpkin seeds.
Cover and let stand for 24 hours.
Heat oven to 350°.
Drain seeds and spread on large baking sheet.
Roast until seeds are dry, turning and stirring every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Crisp Onion-Roasted Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
In shallow baking dish, blend all ingredients, except potatoes.
Add potatoes, turn to coat thoroughly.
Bake, stirring occasionally, 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.
Makes about 8 servings.

recipes.title: Spinach Balls
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen spinach, cooked and drained
1 box garlic and onion croutons (3 c.)
steps: Mix and form into small balls.
Drop onto cookie sheet, freeze and store in plastic bags.
Cook 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Parmesan Meat Bundles
ingredients: 1 oz. thin noodles, cooked and drained
steps: Combine meat, crumbs, onion and seasonings; mix lightly. Divide meat mixture into 3 portions.
On wax paper, shape each portion into a 6-inch patty.

recipes.title: Taco Spread
steps: Mix the cream cheese, sour cream and taco seasoning; spread into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cover top with salsa.
Layer remaining ingredients.
Use chips to dip.

recipes.title: Christmas Wassail
steps: Combine all ingredients and bring to a simmer.
Strain and serve hot.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Lazy Tacos
ingredients: taco seasoning, or your favorite seasoning
steps: Put 1/2 C burger mixture on tortilla, fold over. Fry in oil on low to medium heat on each side until brown. Serve hot with shredded cheese, lettuce and tomato on side.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
steps: Brown the ground beef.
Then add taco mix.
Follow instructions on package; let cool.

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza
steps: Spread crescent rolls completely over a cookie sheet to form the crust.
Bake at 400° for 7 to 10 minutes or until golden. Cool.

recipes.title: Dip For Raw Vegetables
steps: Blend ingredients in blender until creamy.
Chill before serving.
Use with low calorie raw vegetables, i.e.
cucumber stalks, carrot sticks, celery sticks, etc.

recipes.title: Curry Glazed Chicken
steps: Melt butter and other ingredients in shallow baking pan.
Roll chicken in mixture, covering completely.
Place chicken, skin side up, in pan and bake for 1 hour at 375°.

recipes.title: Cherry Dump Cake
steps: Pour 1 can crushed pineapple and 1 can cherry pie filling in pan; mix well, then pour cake mix over top.
Melt butter and pour over cake mix, then sprinkle coconut and nuts over top.
Place in oven at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea
steps: Bring the water to a boil; add spices.
Simmer 10 minutes. Remove spices.
Add tea.
Allow to steep for 10 minutes.
Remove tea bags.
Add sugar and juices.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Orange Sherbet
steps: Mix ingredients.
Chill.
Place in electric or hand-cranked freezer.
Freeze by directions of your freezer.
Makes 1 gallon of sherbet.

recipes.title: Family Meat Loaf
steps: Combine ingredients.
Form into a loaf (8 x 4 x 2) in shallow baking pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
Let meat loaf stand 5 minutes before slicing.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Party Mashed Potatoes
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water; drain and mash (instant potatoes also work).
Add remaining ingredients and beat until light and fluffy.
Spread in buttered pan.
Can also be topped with Cheddar cheese if desired.
Cover and refrigerate or freeze until needed.
When ready to use, drizzle melted butter over top and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes. Gravy also goes well on these.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi
steps: Melt butter.
Add all ingredients except wine and shrimp. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes until spices are cooked.
Add wine and simmer 10 minutes.
Put approximately 15 shrimp in aluminum foil pouches and pour sauce mixture over shrimp.
Cook in oven at 400° for about 10 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 small jar Cheez Whiz or 2 cans Cheddar cheese soup
steps: Boil together the cauliflower and broccoli.
Drain.
Put in casserole dish. Cover with a mixture of the celery soup and Cheez Whiz or cheese soup. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together in large bowl.
Chill until ready to use.

recipes.title: Hot Spicy Apple Cider
steps: Mix all ingredients together and bring to a boil.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Trifle
steps: With pudding, add 2 cups of milk with 1 1/2 cups pineapple juice in pan.
Stir; let it come to a full boil.
Let cool 15 to 20 minutes.
Cut pound cake into cubes.
Cut fruit into little chunks. Put jam in pan.
Keep stirring.
When pudding cools, mix in 3/4 container of Cool Whip, then layer as follows:
pudding, cake, pineapple, 1/2 of the jam and 1/2 of other fruit.
Repeat.
Cover top with rest of Cool Whip.
Decorate top accordingly.

recipes.title: Texas Fudge
steps: Shred cheese to spread in bottom of pan (ungreased).
Smooth beaten eggs over cheese.
Spread jalapeno relish on top.
Add half jar of picante salsa.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Barbecue
ingredients: 1 to 2 cans cream of chicken soup
steps: Cook the chicken breast; dice when cool.
Mix celery, parsley and 1 can cream of chicken soup.
If mixture is too thick, add another can of soup.
Spread barbecue on hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Italian Goulash
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients well.
Place in casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake in 375° oven until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Elephant'S Jug
steps: You crack 2 eggs open.
Put them in a pan to cook it for 1 minute and put it on a plate.

recipes.title: Guessies Spaghetti Goulash
steps: Brown ground meat.
Add soup, spaghetti, chili sauce and Worcestershire sauce.
Put in casserole and lay cheese on top. Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
steps: Mix onion, water, salt and pepper in blender.
Add to meat, bread crumbs and eggs.
Prepare into walnut size balls.
Bring cranberries and tomato puree to a boil.
Add meatballs.
Simmer about 1 hour.
Shake pan during cooking.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Heloise'S Salt Substitute
steps: Combine the ingredients. Use as you would salt.

recipes.title: Crisp Onion Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb. unpeeled potatoes, cut in quarters
steps: Preheat oven to 400°.
Blend all ingredients except potatoes in shallow baking dish.
Add potatoes; turn to coat thoroughly. Bake, stirring potatoes occasionally, for 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender and crispy brown.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Bean Dip
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can chopped green chili peppers, drained
steps: Combine ingredients in saucepan.
Heat thoroughly.
Serve hot with corn chips or tortilla chips.
Makes 4 cups.

recipes.title: Pear Relish
steps: Run pears, onions and peppers through meat chopper.
Add other ingredients (tie pickling spices in cheesecloth bag).
Cook 30 minutes after mixture comes to boil.
Put in scalded jars and seal.

recipes.title: Potato Skins - Low Cholesterol
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Scrub potatoes well; cut lengthwise into 6 wedges and dry on paper towel.
In a large bowl, toss potato spears with olive oil until they are well covered.
Spread potatoes on a baking sheet; dust with paprika and bake 20 to 30 minutes, or until fork-tender.
Serves 6.
Per serving:
79 total calories, 3 sat. fat calories.

recipes.title: Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 pkg. ready made pie crust (Pillsbury ready made in dairy section) or can make homemade pie crust
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Cut pie crust into 3 x 3-inch squares. Use about a teaspoonful of sausage; put into pastry square and fold over and together.
Use a fork to press the remaining 3 sides down.
Put a slit in each one.
Rub egg whites on top for browning glaze.
Bake for about 30 minutes, or when pastry is done.
(Kids love to do this one.)

recipes.title: Cheese Pecan Pie
steps: Mix well the cream cheese, 1 tablespoon sugar and 9 drops of vanilla. Pour into crust. Put pecans gently over cream cheese mixture. Beat eggs, Karo syrup, sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla real good and pour over pie. Bake at 350° about 30 minutes. DELICIOUS!

recipes.title: Pepper Slaw
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients, shredding cabbage and chopping pepper and onion; set aside.
Mix oil, vinegar, sugar and mustard seed in a small saucepan and bring to a boil.
Stir to mix and pour over cabbage; mix well and chill.

recipes.title: Grog
steps: Combine in saucepan; heat until red hots dissolve.
Serve hot or cold.
Yield:
24 half-cup servings.

recipes.title: Sweet Pickles
steps: Mix lime and water.
Add cucumbers.
Let soak for 24 hours. Rinse cucumbers and soak in cold water for 4 hours.
Change water every hour.
Combine vinegar, sugar and spices.
Bring to a boil. Turn fire off and add cucumbers; cover and let stand overnight. Next morning, bring to a boil and simmer for 30 minutes.
Seal in jars.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
steps: Mix pecans and coconut.
Spread on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix cake as directed on box.
Spread cake mix on top of the pecans and coconut.
Melt butter, cream cheese and confectioners sugar.
Mix well.
Pour on top of cake batter.
Bake according to directions on box of cake mix.

recipes.title: Vegetable Spinach Dip
steps: Squeeze spinach until dry.
In medium bowl, stir together all ingredients.
Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.
Serve with crackers, rye bread, fresh vegetable dippers or serve in a hollowed out bread bowl or bell pepper.

recipes.title: Melt In Your Mouth Biscuits
steps: Melt butter; stir in cream cheese. Add Bisquick and mix thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonfuls in greased miniature muffin tins. Bake at 400° until brown (approximately 12 to 15 minutes). Makes 24.

recipes.title: Polynesian Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1/4 c. light or dark brown sugar
steps: Combine all ingredients except chicken.
Add chicken and coat well.
Cover and chill overnight.
Turn pieces.
Heat oven to 350°. Line large baking sheet with foil.
Arrange wings on sheet.
Bake approximately 1 hour, turning after 30 minutes.
May be served hot or cold.

recipes.title: Fruit Bowl Supreme
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin orange sections, well drained*
1 (8 1/4 oz.) can crushed pineapple in syrup, well drained
3 1/2 c. (8 oz.) Birds Eye Cool Whip whipped topping, thawed
steps: *Or use 1 (16 ounce) can fruit cocktail, well drained.

recipes.title: Dillon'S Slaw(Make One Day Ahead Of Serving.)
steps: Microwave sugar, vinegar, salad oil, salt, mustard and celery for 5 minutes. Mix cabbage and onion. Pour mixture over cabbage and onions. Refrigerate for 1 day before serving. Will keep in refrigerator for 1 week.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
ingredients: grated or melted chocolate for garnish
steps: Bake pie crust, cool and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Gradually beat in condensed milk and peanut butter until smooth.
Stir in lemon juice and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip.
Turn mixture into the prepared pie crust and garnish with chocolate.
Freeze for one hour or refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Top Of Stove Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. cooked pork, ham, fatback or any other type seasoned meat
6 small (1 1/2 inch) ears corn placed on top
water enough to keep from sticking
steps: In a tightly closed roasting bag big enough for your roast, marinate in Allegro overnight, turning bag before bedtime.
Put in cold oven and heat oven to 500° to 550° for 8 minutes.
Turn the oven off, but do not open oven door or the bag for one hour.

recipes.title: Banana Pops
ingredients: 3/4 c. finely chopped pecans or flaked coconut
steps: Peel bananas and slice in half crosswise.
Brush bananas with orange juice.
Insert skewers in cut end of bananas and place on waxed paper-lined cookie sheet.
Freeze until firm.

recipes.title: Jello-Cottage Cheese Salad
steps: Mix dry jello into small curd cottage cheese.
Drain mandarin oranges and pineapple.
Add both fruits and small container of Cool Whip into cottage cheese.
Chill.

recipes.title: Christmas Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 (5 1/2 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding and pie filling mix
1 (20 oz.) can fruit cocktail mix, drained
1 (16 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
steps: Bake cake mix as directed in two 8-inch round cake pans. Place one round cake layer (cooled) in bottom of a large glass punch bowl.
Cover with half the pudding prepared as directed, half the cherry pie filling, half the fruit cocktail, half the pineapple, half the coconut and half the whipped topping. Sprinkle with nuts.
Place remaining cake layer on top and repeat remaining layers.
Decorate with cherries and pineapple, as desired.
Refrigerate for 24 hours.
Serves 25.

recipes.title: Chocolate Glaze
steps: Melt chocolate in top of double boiler. Blend in butter and milk.
Remove from heat.
Add sugar, vanilla and salt.
Beat until smooth.
Thin with cream if necessary.

recipes.title: 1817 Plantation Eggs
steps: Mix eggs, parsley, pepper and salt together well.
Add cubes of cheese.
Brown sausage, breaking into small pieces.
Drain well.
Cover bottom of casserole dish with sausage.
Pour egg mixture on top.
Bake at 375° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Buns
ingredients: 2 frozen bread dough, thawed for 45 minutes
steps: Cut one bread loaf into approximately 15 slices and put into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sides of loaf must be touching, but not touching sides of pan.

recipes.title: Cheese And Meatball Soup
ingredients: 2 c. water or enough to cover
steps: Place vegetables, water, bouillon cubes and Tabasco sauce in crock-pot.
Mix meat, egg, salt and pepper, dash of Tabasco sauce and bread crumbs in bowl.
Form into small meatballs and drop into soup mixture.
Cook 4 to 6 hours on low.
(If cooked on range top, cook until all ingredients are done.)
Add Velveeta cheese and mix until it melts.
Serve immediately.
Freezes well.

recipes.title: No Weep Meringue
steps: Beat egg whites with cornstarch until fairly stiff, then add sugar.
Bake as usual.
Makes enough for one pie.

recipes.title: "Reese'S Peanut Butter Cups"
steps: Mix butter, 1 cup peanut butter, crackers and sugar and pat into a 9 x 13 x 2-inch deep pan.
Melt chocolate chips along with 1 cup peanut butter and pour over top mixture.
Let it set until top mixture is firm (in refrigerator).

recipes.title: Hawaiian Dream Pie
ingredients: 1 regular size can Eagle Brand milk
steps: Drain juice from pineapple thoroughly.
Blend into Cool Whip and lemon juice; add milk.
Pour into shells and sprinkle with nuts.
Chill around 3 hours.
This recipe is for two pies.
For one pie, use half.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
steps: Mix onion, cheese, eggs, milk, oil, creamed corn, bell and hot pepper (as much as you like); add meal and mix well.
Pour into greased hot skillet (two 8-inch.)
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until done.

recipes.title: Pizza Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger meat and saute onion.
Add sauce.
Combine mixture with drained noodles.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
ingredients: jalapeno peppers or mild green chilies (whichever you can handle)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all together. Pour into casserole dish. Bake for 45 minutes. Do not burn.

recipes.title: Easy No-Bake Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 can pie filling (cherry, strawberry, blueberry, etc.)
steps: Mix cream cheese and sugar together with mixer.
When thoroughly blended, add the Cool Whip and blend the mixture until it all has the same consistency.
Spread the mixture into the crust.
Now, pour the pie filling over the top.
Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetables Italiano
ingredients: 6 c. assorted vegetables (broccoli florets, carrot slices, cauliflower florets, small mushrooms, green or red bell pepper strips, yellow squash or zucchini strips)
steps: Preheat oven to 425°. In large plastic food storage bag, combine crumbs and cheese. Shake and blend well. In another large plastic bag, combine mayonnaise and vegetables. Coat well. Add mayonnaise coated vegetables, half at a time, to crumb mixture; shake and coat well. Arrange in single layer on ungreased cookie sheet so pieces don't touch. Bake 10 minutes or until golden.

recipes.title: Yum Yum Date Roll
steps: Reserve 1/4 cup cracker crumbs.
Combine remaining crumbs with marshmallows, dates and nuts.
Moisten with Pet milk and mix well. Form into a roll and roll in the remaining crumbs.
Wrap in wax paper, then foil and chill.
Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Oklahoma Casserole
steps: Cook hamburger, onion, spices and salt and pepper.
Drain. Put in casserole.
Put half can of beans on top.
Mix soup with 1/2 cup milk; pour 1/2 over beans and hamburger.
Add a layer of cheese and a layer of tortillas.
Layer remaining ingredients. Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Slush
steps: Mix well and place in large container in freezer.
Stir 3 to 4 times during the first day to get right consistency.
May add ginger ale for thinner drinks.
Serves 20.

recipes.title: Cape Cod Salad
steps: Heat water and cranberry sauce until liquified.
Add Jell-O and chill until slightly thick.
Add fruit cocktail and banana. Set until firm, preferably overnight.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Sauerkraut
steps: Place chops in casserole.
Put in apples, onion and kraut. Place in a 350° oven.
Cook for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Cover with lid or foil while cooking.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Breakfast Cake(Soul Biscuits)
steps: Separate biscuits.
Melt margarine.
Combine sugar and cinnamon.
Dip each biscuit in melted margarine, then in sugar-cinnamon mixture.
Overlap 15 biscuits around outer edge of 9-inch pan.
Overlap 5 biscuits to form inner circle.
Sprinkle with remaining sugar-cinnamon.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Lasagne
steps: Combine Ricotta cheese, eggs, 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper. In a lightly oiled 9 x 13-inch baking dish, pour sauce (1/2 cup) on bottom and spread evenly.
Place first layer of noodles on top. Spread a heavy layer of sauce and meat.
On top of this, spread evenly part of the Ricotta cheese mixture.
Place a layer of Scamorze cheese.
Now, repeat these layers until the top.

recipes.title: Fry Delight
steps: Bake
fries at 350°F until lightly crisp.
Fry onions until lightly brown and add
fries, salt, pepper, seasoned salt, lemon pepper, Vegeta and vinegar.
Fry on medium heat for 7 minutes.
Remove and place on plate.
Place oranges on outside rim of plate.
Add tomatoes in the center of plate and sprinkle with lemon juice.

recipes.title: Lime Jello Salad
steps: Start to let jello set up. Mix the cottage cheese, chopped pecans and fruit cocktail. Add to the jello, then top with marshmallows.

recipes.title: Christmas Fudge
ingredients: 2 1/2 giant or 12 small plain Hershey bars
steps: Combine sugar and milk.
Heat to boiling, stirring continuously.
Cook 4 1/2 minutes.
Pour half of mixture over chocolate and marshmallow cream.
Mix thoroughly and quickly.
Add rest of mixture.
Add nuts and vanilla.
Mix well.
Pour in lightly buttered pan.
Cool and cut into squares.
Makes about 5 pounds.

recipes.title: Marinated Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. fresh chopped parsley or 1 Tbsp. dried
2 Tbsp. fresh chopped basil or 1 Tbsp. dried
steps: Mix marinade. Add sliced tomatoes. Be sure all tomatoes are coated with marinade. Chill several hours, turning tomatoes at a time or two. Sliced green peppers and/or cucumbers may be added.

recipes.title: Lime Salad
steps: Melt marshmallows in milk.
Pour hot mixture over lime jello. Stir until dissolved.
Add cream cheese and pineapple.
Whip in whipped cream.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Spicy Chicken Bake
steps: Optional:
Dip seasoned chicken in barbecue sauce before baking.

recipes.title: Corn Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Place 1/2 teaspoon oil in each cup or muffin tin.
Place in oven until hot.
Combine corn meal and sugar.
Combine milk and egg; add to dry ingredients; stir until smooth.
Pour batter into hot pan.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 12 large muffins or corn sticks.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 small box Jiffy corn muffin mix
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a buttered 8 inch square pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: California Blend Vegetables
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. minced onion or 1/4 c. chopped onion
salt, pepper and parsley flakes to taste
steps: Spray 9 1/2 x 13 pan with Pam. Add Cheddar cheese on top last.

recipes.title: Capt. Steve'S Spicy Meat Loaf
steps: Mix well.
Shape into loaf.
Roll in 1/4 cup of seasoned bread crumbs.
Bake in oven at 375° for approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Finger Sandwiches(1993 Daisy Bake-Off Winner)
steps: Mix all ingredients well (except bread).
Spread on white or wheat bread.
Use cookie cutter to cut different shapes (cut off crust first).

recipes.title: Chocolate Buttermallow Cake
steps: Bake cake mix in oblong pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inches as directed on package.
Spread Butterscotch Filling over top of cooled cake to within 1/2-inch of edge.
Sprinkle chopped nuts over filling. Frost sides and top of cake with Marshmallow Frosting.
Melt chocolate; dip back of spoon into chocolate and form swirls on frosting.

recipes.title: Paul'S Pecans
steps: Whip egg and water.
Stir in nuts.
Mix sugar, cinnamon and salt.
Sprinkle over nuts.
Bake at 225° for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick No-Cook Fondant
steps: Blend butter, syrup, salt and vanilla in a large mixing bowl. Add sifted 10x sugar all at once.
Mix all together first with a spoon and then with hands.
Knead in dry ingredients.
Turn onto board and continue kneading until mixture is well blended and smooth.
Store in foil in cool place.
Divide into portions and tint and flavor as desired.
May be shaped into balls and rolled in multi-colored candy, coconut or nuts.
Or fondant may be rolled out and cut in fancy shapes and decorated.
Makes 1 1/3 pounds.

recipes.title: Tiramisu Dessert
steps: Line a 13x9-inch pan with any flavor of commercially prepared biscotti.
Dissolve 2 envelopes of instant amaretto-flavored cappuccino mix with 1 1/2 cups of milk.
Pour over the biscotti. Beat 8 oz. of cream cheese with 2 cups of milk, small instant vanilla pudding and 2 envelopes of instant amaretto-flavored cappuccino mix.
Spread over Biscotti.
Top with cool whip and sprinkle with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Italian Zucchini Crescent Pie
ingredients: 1/2 c. parsley, chopped or 2 Tbsp. parsley flakes
steps: Cook zucchini and onion in 1/4 c. butter, for 10 minutes. Add chopped parsley, salt, pepper, garlic powder, basil and oregano leaves.
Combine 2 beaten eggs and 8 oz. mozzarella cheese (in another bowl).

recipes.title: Cool Whip Cookies
steps: Mix together and drop by teaspoon into powdered sugar and place on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Bread(Breakfast Food Or Party Food)
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen bread, thawed and allowed to rise
steps: After dough rises, roll out into rectangle.
Fry sausage and drain.
Sprinkle 1/2 of sausage over dough.
Shred hot pepper cheese and mix with Mozzarella and parsley.
Spread this mixture over sausage already spread on bread dough.

recipes.title: Cindy'S Red Hot Chili
ingredients: 6 fresh jalapeno peppers, seeded and sliced (optional)
steps: Brown ground chuck and onion in a large stock pot.
Drain and return to stock pot.
Add spices and remainder of ingredients. Simmer, covered, for 1 hour on low setting.
Thicken with flour or cornstarch or thin with tomato juice.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
steps: Mix the first 5 ingredients and pour into ungreased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Cover with cake mix and pecans.
Drizzle with melted butter.
Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pistachio Salad
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. instant pistachio pudding mix
1 large can crushed pineapple, not drained
steps: Mix pudding mix and pineapple. Stir in all other ingredients and chill. Also a quick dessert.

recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
ingredients: 8 oz. boneless chicken breast, cube and saute with garlic powder and black pepper in cooking oil
steps: Simmer 20 minutes.
Add 1 (14 1/2 ounce) canned stewed tomatoes and 2/3 cup uncooked pasta.
Simmer 20 minutes more. Serves 4 to 6.
Great with cornbread!

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Cake
ingredients: 1/2 lb. graham crackers or vanilla wafers, crushed
steps: Combine crumbs, cinnamon and salt.
Pour the melted butter over crumbs and mix.
Let stand a few minutes.
Line bottom and sides of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Save some crumbs for top.

recipes.title: Holiday Cheeseberry Salad
