ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can whole berry cranberry sauce
steps: Dissolve jello in water.
Add cranberry sauce and lemon juice. When cool, pour into oiled loaf pan; chill until thickened.
Whip cream cheese until light and fluffy.
Fold in whipped cream, pineapple and nuts.
Spoon mixture over gelatin.
Chill until set. Yield: 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Pleasing Meat Loaf
steps: Mix water and all ingredients except 1/4 cup of the barbecue sauce. Shape meat mixture into oval loaf in 13 x 9-inch baking dish; top with remaining 1/4 cup barbecue sauce. Bake at 375° for 1 hour. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 bag California Blend frozen vegetables (cauliflower and broccoli)
steps: Cook vegetables in water until tender; add soup and cheese and heat until cheese melts (could be shredded).

recipes.title: Overnight French Toast
steps: Combine first 7 ingredients; beat well.
Set aside.
Place bread in a single layer in a shallow dish.
Pour egg mixture over bread; turn slices to coat evenly.

Cover and refrigerate 8 hours. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet; arrange 3 slices bread in skillet and cook 3 minutes on each side or until browned. Repeat procedure with remaining butter and bread slices. Sprinkle toast with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Easy Cookies
steps: Mix together.
You may add chips, nuts, M&M's, etc.
Drop with teaspoon on cookie sheet, about 1-inch apart.
Cook 12 to 15 minutes or until brown in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Stacked Roll Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom or chicken or celery soup
steps: Brown meat and drain.
Boil soup (undiluted) and add sour cream.
In casserole dish (2 1/2-quart) layer beef, then mushrooms, onions and then soup mix.*
Repeat layers.
Cut biscuits in half and put on top.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)
steps: In large mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.
Beat in Eagle Brand until smooth.
Stir in ReaLemon and vanilla.
Pour into crust.
Chill 3 hours or until set.
Top with desired amount of pie filling before serving.

recipes.title: Pimento Dip
steps: In food processor, blend cottage cheese until very smooth. Add pimentos and blend until smooth.
Add the sour cream and basil.
Blend until just mixed.
Chill until needed.
Low-fat.

recipes.title: Shrimp In Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb. large shrimp, shelled and deveined
steps: In medium saucepan, saute onion, garlic and parsley in stock 2 to 3 minutes.
Add shrimp and continue to cook until shrimp just turn pink (about 4 to 8 minutes).
In small bowl combine taco sauce, chili powder and cumin.
Add to shrimp and heat through.

recipes.title: Italian Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb. Scrolles macaroni, cooked and drained
1 pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing mix
steps: Cook and drain macaroni. Mix dry dressing mix with 1/2 cup water. Mix all ingredients together and toss. Make at least 8 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Fireman Pot Luck
steps: Mix all ingredients and place in heavy duty foil.
Cook in grill on medium heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into 9-inch pie crust.
Cover with other pie crust.
Cut slits in top.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Cake
steps: Mix together cake mix, eggs, oil and oranges with juice.
Pour into 2 (8-inch) well-greased and floured cake pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool cake completely.
Drain pineapple.
Mix together pineapple and pudding.
Fold in whipped topping until blended well.
Frost cake and refrigerate.
(Freezes well.)

recipes.title: Strawberry Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 large or 2 small boxes instant pudding
steps: Make cake in 2 round pans and set aside to cool.

recipes.title: Mini Blintzes
steps: Remove crust from each slice of bread and flatten each slice with a rolling pin.
Cream egg yolk, the 1/4 cup sugar, cream cheese and vanilla.
Spread 1 to 2 tablespoons filling on each slice and roll up jelly-roll style.
Add 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar and cinnamon to melted and cooled butter.
Dip each roll into butter mixture.
"Flash" freeze on cookie sheet for 1 hour, then freeze in plastic bag.

recipes.title: Smoky Oven Barbecued Chicken
steps: Cook garlic in hot butter over medium heat until lightly browned in 1-quart saucepan.
Add catsup, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, liquid smoke, salt and pepper; heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Turtle Pie
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)
steps: Preheat oven to 325°.

recipes.title: Milnot Cheesecake
steps: Combine melted butter and graham crackers and mix well. Press one-half of graham cracker mixture into the bottom of a 13 x 9 inch greased baking dish.
Make lemon jello with one cup of hot water.
Let jello cool, but not gel.
Combine cream cheese, granulated sugar, and vanilla and mix thoroughly.
Whip Milnot and combine with jello and cheese mixtures.
Mix well and pour over graham cracker crust.
Sprinkle remaining graham crackers over the top of the cake and cover with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate for 1 1/2 to 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Popcorn Cake
steps: *You may use 1 pound of either M&M's or Reese's pieces, instead of 1/2 pound of each.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Sausage Balls
steps: Mix together sausage, eggs and bread crumbs. Shape mixture into balls. Saute in frying pan until browned on all sides. Drain. Combine ketchup, brown sugar, vinegar, and soy sauce. Put sausage balls in large pot, pour sauce over, simmer for 30 min. stirring occasionally. Serve hot. Can be made ahead and, refrigerated or frozen in sauce. Reheat to serve. Makes about a 100.

recipes.title: Shchi(Russian Cabbage Soup)
ingredients: 1 small leak (white part only), chopped thin
1 small head white cabbage, coarsely chopped
1 tomato, peeled and cut into chunks
steps: Melt butter in a large pot.
Add the onion, leek and carrot. Saute until just beginning to get soft.
Pour in the beef stock and bring to boil.
Stir in the cabbage, sauerkraut and the tomato.
Cover and simmer for about 50 minutes or until cabbage is tender.
Check for seasoning.
Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream and sprinkling of dill (fresh is best).
Serves 4 to 6. Best if made day before and refrigerated.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
steps: Cut cooked chicken breasts up into small pieces.
Mix with other ingredients, except shoestring potatoes.
Add potatoes just before serving.

recipes.title: Southwestern Cheese Ball
ingredients: garlic salt and pepper to taste
steps: Combine first 6 ingredients and seasonings in bowl; mix well. Shape into ball.
Roll in chopped pecans or just pat over ball. Refrigerate until firm.
Serve with Ritz or Wheat Thins.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Mix well the first 5 ingredients.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 400°
for 15 minutes, then 30 to 35 minutes at 350° (center is slightly less set).
Top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
steps: Shape crescent rolls on pizza pan.
Bake according to directions.
Cool.
Mix next 4 ingredients and spread on baked crust.
Put veggies on top of white mixture and chill overnight. Put cheese on top.

recipes.title: Plan Ahead Mashed Potatoes(Will Keep In Refrigerator For 2 Weeks)
steps: Mash until light and fluffy.
Store in refrigerator.
Heat in oven before serving.

recipes.title: Fruit Chiffon Pie
steps: Mix eggs and sugar together well. Add fruit juice and stir. Bring to boil.
Add jello; stir until dissolved.
Set to cook. Chill milk; whip until peaks.
Stir into hot mixture.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
steps: Melt butter.
Add 1/2 package dressing mix and 1/2 package of seasoning mix.
Put in baking pan.
Mix all other ingredients together and put over dressing.
Sprinkle with crumbs.
Bake at 350°
for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Pineapple Pie
ingredients: 1 medium pie crust (graham cracker or regular)
steps: Mix pineapple and sour cream. Add dry instant pudding and mix well; pour into crust. Can be topped with whipped topping. Preparation time about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Apricot
steps: Mix all together.
Pour over chicken in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, uncovered.
Baste several times with the marinade.
Serve with rice!
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Crescent Chicken
steps: Debone chicken and cook with onion.
Wrap cooked chicken in crescent rolls.
Place in buttered dish.
Pour cream of chicken soup and chicken broth over chicken and rolls.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburger Dip
steps: Brown hamburger and onions. Add garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Mix in refried beans and cheese soup. Add velveeta cheese and cook over low heat until melted. Serve with tortilla or Dorito chips.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
steps: Put first 3 ingredients in heavy pan and boil 3 minutes, covered.
Uncover and boil until hard crackle in cold water.
Add 2 tablespoons oleo.
Add 2 cups raw peanuts; cook until syrup is golden brown.
(It takes approximately 7 1/2 minutes after putting peanuts in.)
Remove from heat.
Add 2 1/2 teaspoons baking soda. Stir well.
Pour into a well-greased pan (large pan).
Cool and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Chocolate Yogurt Melts
steps: Combine cake mix, yogurt, egg and margarine in bowl.
Beat until blended.
Stir in nuts and chips. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet with teaspoon 2-inches apart. Bake 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Triple Fudge Cake
steps: Blend cake mix with cooked pudding.
Pour into prepared 9 by 13 pan.
Sprinkle with nuts and chocolate chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Can be served warm with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Mexican Fudge
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Boil until it reaches soft ball stage.
Stir often.
Remove from heat.
Beat until firm.
Add oleo, nuts and vanilla.
Pour into buttered pan.
Cool.
Cut into squares.
Also makes good caramel cake icing.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Mix ingredients with a spoon or fork by gradually adding one at a time.
Once generally mixed, knead all ingredients with hands.
Press into a loaf baking pan; flatten out top.
Top with bottle of chili sauce.
Bake at least one hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Heat potatoes; drain juice.
Combine all ingredients.
Mix well with electric mixer.
Pour into well buttered baking dish.

recipes.title: Oyster Stew
steps: Combine and bring all ingredients to a boil.
Reduce heat to simmer immediately.
Serve.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. In a bowl, combine corn syrup, brown sugar, eggs, butter, salt and vanilla. Mix well. Pour mixture into pie crust; sprinkle with pecans. Set on cookie sheet and bake until center is done (toothpick test), 45 to 50 minutes. If crust gets too brown, cover with foil.

recipes.title: Classic Potatoes Au Gratin
ingredients: 4 c. thinly sliced potatoes (4 to 5 medium)
steps: Cook potatoes in boiling water in large saucepan for 8 to 10 minutes or until fork-tender; drain.
Toss potatoes with remaining ingredients in a 2-quart casserole; cover.
Bake at 350° for 22 to 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender and Velveeta is melted. Stir gently before serving.
Makes 7 servings.

recipes.title: Christmas-Cinnamon Punch
steps: Melt first 3 ingredients in boiler.
Add remains.
Stir well. Can be served warm or cold.
Yields 5 quarts.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Salad
steps: Beat sugar and cream cheese until fluffy. In another bowl, mix bananas, strawberries, pineapple and nuts. Stir in Cool Whip. Mix with cream cheese mixture. Freeze. Cut in squares. This makes a big pan full. Freeze in square pan.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
steps: Break up cake and put into large cake pan.
Mix the milk in pudding and ice cream.
Pour mixture over cake and refrigerate until set.
Dissolve jello in 1 cup of hot water.
Cut up strawberries and place in jello.
Pour strawberries and jello together over pudding.
Refrigerate until set.
Top with Cool Whip and sprinkles.
Refrigerate until ready to eat.

recipes.title: California Guacamole
steps: Cut avocados and mix well with lemon juice and onion.
Add 2 tablespoons Pace picante sauce and mix well.

recipes.title: Ham Delights
ingredients: 2 pkg. small dinner rolls (24 to pkg.)
steps: Cut ham, onion and cheese in food processor bowls with steel blade.
Process until finely chopped.
Add mustard, poppy seed, margarine and Worcestershire sauce to ham mixture.
Mix by hand. Take rolls out of package by the whole thing.
Slice off tops of rolls halfway down.
Spread with mixture and replace top.
Place on cookie sheet.
Cover with foil and bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Yields 48 small sandwiches.

recipes.title: Outstanding White Chili
ingredients: 2 (4 oz.) cans chopped mild green chilies, chopped
steps: Place beans in heavy large pot.
Add enough cold water to cover by at least 3-inches and soak overnight.

recipes.title: Aunt Peggy'S Marinated Mushrooms
steps: Wash mushrooms; slice larger ones.
Place mushrooms and onion slices in a pretty bowl.
Pour 1/2 of dressing over them.
Marinate for at least 2 hours in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 orange, peeled and chopped or can of mandarin slices
steps: Place Jell-O in bowl with sugar.
Add boiling water; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash cranberries, then grind with meat grinder. Add to Jell-O mixture.
Add remaining ingredients, except marshmallows.
The marshmallows will go on top of mixture when you are finished mixing.
Place in refrigerator until serving time.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 can undiluted cream of mushroom soup
steps: Mix together liquids and pour over chicken in baking pan. Bake 2 1/2 hours at 300°.

recipes.title: Brunswick Stew
steps: Season to taste.
Simmer for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Brown Butter Sauce
steps: Brown butter in pan, stirring well.
Add seasoning.
Add about 1/2 pound cleaned shrimp.
Good on any fish.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
ingredients: 3 slices bread, cubed and crusts removed
steps: Beat eggs.
Add milk and bread crumbs to soften.
Add all other ingredients, except asparagus, to the bread mixture and mix well. Fold asparagus into bread mixture.
Bake in a greased 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole dish at 325° for 35 minutes, covered.
Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer until casserole begins to brown.

recipes.title: Sunshine Salad
steps: Dissolve gelatin with 1 cup of hot water.
Add remaining ingredients.
Chill.
Serve on lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Glazed Fruit Melba Dessert
ingredients: 2 small cans mandarin oranges, well drained
20 oz. can pineapple chunks, well drained
3 c. liquid juice from pineapple chunks and mandarin oranges
steps: Cook puddings and fruit juice until thick; cool.
In a large bowl, combine mandarin oranges, pineapple chunks and sliced banana.
Pour the sauce over the fruit.
Mix all together.
After 1/2 hour, mix again.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
steps: Cook 7-Up, cornstarch, sugar and Jell-O until thick.
Cool. Place strawberries in baked pie shell and Jell-O mixture over them.
Top with Cool Whip before serving.

recipes.title: Bud Lord'S 5 Lemon Pie(If You Can Unpucker After 1St Bite, You Can Have 2Nd!)
steps: Mix lemon juice, sugar, egg yolks and water.
Heat them. Make a paste of cornstarch and a little water.
Add slowly to lemon mixture, while stirring.
Cook until thick, stirring all the time!
Pour into a baked pie shell.
Beat egg whites until foamy; add 8 tbsp. sugar, a little at a time.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Put on hot filling, sealing all edges.
Bake 8 minutes at 400.
Cool.
Do not make pie a day ahead of time!

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Brown ground turkey; drain fat.
Add taco seasoning with 1/2 cup water.
After cooked, cool down in fridge.
(This is best done ahead.)
Prepare salad out of lettuce, green pepper, tomatoes and onions.
Top with shredded cheese and meat.
Right before serving, mix up with dressing and Fritos.
Serve right away.

recipes.title: Broccoli Puff
steps: Cook broccoli, drain.
Combine	soup,
milk,
mayonnaise and cheese.
Add beaten egg.
Mix in broccoli.	Top with butter and bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Mama'S Spaghetti Sauce
steps: Brown hamburger; add onion and bell pepper.
Cook until tender.
Add all other ingredients and simmer for 1 hour; stir occasionally.
Serve over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Linda'S Yellow Cake
steps: Mix yellow cake mix according to directions on box for Bundt recipe.
Bake in Bundt pan.
Remove from pan.

recipes.title: Lemon Cake
ingredients: 1 c. boiling water, dissolve, allow to cool
steps: Mix together and cook in 9 x 13-inch floured and greased baking dish.
Allow to cool 20 to 25 minutes.
Pour holes in cake with metal skewer.
Mix 1 cup powdered sugar, grated rind and juice of 1 lemon.
Pour over cooled cake.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Mix together.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Sprinkle with 2 cups grated Cheddar cheese and bake until melted.

recipes.title: Slightly Different Meat Loaf
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Shape into loaf and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Main Dish Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. grated Cheddar or American cheese
steps: Brown beef and sausage; drain grease off.
Mix the two soups, milk, green chilies and enchilada sauce.
Place Doritos on bottom of casserole dish.
Place mixture on top.
Spread grated cheese on top.
Cook until cheese bubbles.

recipes.title: Spicy Bread Pudding
steps: Butter a baking pan.
Break up bread into pan.
In a bowl, mix all other ingredients except cinnamon and cheese.
Pour over bread, sprinkle with cinnamon and cheese and bake at 350° until medium brown.
Serve and enjoy!

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
steps: Mix together all ingredients.
Bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes.
Place in refrigerator overnight or bake then.

recipes.title: Hand Freezer Ice Cream
steps: Beat eggs and sugar.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into a 1 gallon freezer can.
Add 8 parts ice to 1 part salt.
Turn freezer until hard, about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Raspberry Applesauce Salad
steps: Prepare Jell-O with boiling water, substituting last 3 ingredients for cold water (mentioned on package). Raspberries may be pured in blender. Chill to set. Yield: 10 to 12 servings. Use 9 x 13 dish.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
steps: Cream the cream cheese, margarine and sugar.
Add eggs and remaining ingredients.
Beat thoroughly.
Bake in greased Bundt pan at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Crunch Cake
steps: Beat together first 6 ingredients and pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle one box yellow cake mix over pumpkin mixture. Sprinkle nuts over cake mix.
Thinly slice margarine over nuts. Bake 50 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
steps: Layer first 6 ingredients as listed in airtight bowl.
Combine last 3 ingredients; boil until sugar is dissolved.
Pour over slaw and do not stir.

recipes.title: Rare Beef Tenderloin
steps: Take beef tenderloin from wrapper (still cool).
Salt and pepper tenderloin.
Then cover entire tenderloin with Kitchen Bouquet (rub it in with your hand well).
Tuck tip of tenderloin under and place whole tenderloin on a wire rack in baking pan. Let cool to room temperature.
Preheat oven to 500°.
Place tenderloin in oven and immediately reduce temperature to 450°. Cook for 30 minutes only, then remove from oven and cover with foil.
Let sit 20 to 30 minutes and then slice thinly.
Beef will be rare and melt in your mouth.

recipes.title: Herbed Olive Cheese Log
steps: Combine all ingredients and beat until smooth.
Chill until firm enough to handle.
Shape into logs and roll in parsley flakes.
Chill.

recipes.title: Mandarin Angel Cake
ingredients: 2 (10 1/4 oz.) cans unsweetened mandarin oranges, drained
steps: Combine sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan.
Add orange juice and apricot nectar, stirring until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly 5 minutes or until thickened.
Remove from heat; stir in oranges, reserving 1/4 cup oranges for garnish. Chill thoroughly.

recipes.title: Mom'S White Clam Sauce
ingredients: 3 cans chopped clams with juice (add more if desired)
steps: Saute garlic and onion in oil until brown.
Add hot pepper as it it browns.
Add seasoning and saute a
minute or two.
Add clams and clam sauce and cook 30 minutes.
Add white wine and cook 30 minutes more.
Serve over 1 lb. of cooked spaghetti.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 pkg. Campbell's noodle soup with real chicken broth
1 medium onion, chopped, or 1 Tbsp. minced onion
steps: Combine all ingredients except meat and tortilla chips and bring to boil.
Add meat.
Simmer ingredients for 8 to 10 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips with cheese melted on top.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Lemon Cheese Pie
steps: Soften cream cheese at room temperature.
Bake pie crusts; set aside to cool.
Bring water to a boil and add gelatin; stir well until dissolved thoroughly.
Add milk to pudding mix; blend well. Add gelatin, Sweet One and cheese to pudding mix and beat with mixer until well blended.
Pour into pie crusts and refrigerate. Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Stuffed Shells
steps: Put onion and garlic in oil; saut until golden. Put in remaining sauce ingredients and cook 1 1/2 hours. Cook 1 package of shells in boiling salted water until tender.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
steps: Spread peanuts in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.
Place in a 350° oven for 15 minutes. Remove and pour into bowl.
Keep warm.

recipes.title: Creamy Peach Pie
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. vanilla pudding and pie filling (not instant)
1 (3 oz.) pkg. Jell-O peach flavor gelatin
steps: Combine the 2 cups of water with the vanilla pudding and pie filling.
Also add the Jell-O peach gelatin mix in saucepan.
Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil. Pour into bowl and chill well.
Blend in 2 cups prepared Dream Whip whipped topping.
Fold in diced peaches.
Spoon into cooled, baked 9-inch pie shell.
Chill 2 hours.
Garnish with peach slices.

recipes.title: Spedina - Small Veal Cutlets
ingredients: 2 lb. veal cutlets, cut into small cutlets
steps: Dip veal cutlets into beaten eggs, then dip into Locatelli and bread crumb mixture.
Put aside. Mix eggs (chopped), Locatelli (grated), parsley, salt and pepper.

Lay out veal cutlets on foil. Place mixture of Locatelli, parsley and chopped eggs on cutlets. Take little pieces of butter and place that on the mixture. Roll up the cutlets and secure with toothpicks.
Brown cutlets in the broiler at 375° until brown on all sides.

recipes.title: Bourbon Sweet Potatoes(Company Dish)
ingredients: 1 small can crushed pineapple including juice (if omitted add small amount orange juice)
steps: Boil sweet potatoes.
Peel and mash with melted butter and salt.
Mix all together in 2 small or 1 large rectangular Pyrex dish.
Heat for serving, or freeze.
After freezing, reheat completely before adding marshmallows to top.
Lightly brown and serve.
Serves about 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Aunt Laura'S Lime Pickles
steps: Cut cukes in chunks or thick slices.
Combine water and lime. Cover cukes.
Soak 24 hours, stirring occasionally.
Drain and wash with clean water.
Cover with fresh water and let stand 3 hours.

recipes.title: Sherried Beef
steps: Mix all ingredients together in large casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 3 hours. Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Fruit Punch
steps: Slice orange and lemon into flat slices.
Pour together lime, cranberry and grenadine juice.
Add rum if wanted.
Chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Gooey Bars
steps: Mix and pat into a 9
x 12-inch Pyrex dish (greased and floured).

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
ingredients: milk (enough to make moist and smooth)
steps: Boil sweet potatoes until very tender.
Remove skins.
Mix with other ingredients.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 450° for about 10 minutes.
Reduce temperature to 350° and continue cooking for about 30 minutes or until silver knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 8 oz. pkg. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
steps: Knead all ingredients, except nuts, into a ball.
Put chopped nuts on a tea towel and roll ball to coat.
To store, wrap in foil and freeze.
Thaw in refrigerator for a day.

recipes.title: Misery Pie
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: Mix pecans, chocolate chips, coconut and milk and pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° until mixture starts bubbling and getting brown on top.
Cut into small pieces since this is very rich.

recipes.title: Pickling Pig Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines butter cake mix
1 small can Mandarin oranges, chopped with juice
steps: Mix all together and beat with electric mixer.
Pour into 3 layer pans.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes, no longer.
Cool.

recipes.title: Twinkie Cake
steps: Slice 5 Twinkies lengthwise.
Place, cream side up, in dish. Add sliced bananas.
Add crushed pineapple, drained.
Add Cool Whip.
Dot with cherries.
Chill 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped celery or 1/2 c. water chestnuts
steps: Drain vegetables well.
Add celery, onions, mayonnaise and soup.
Mix well.
Pour melted margarine over crushed crackers and place over top of mixture that has been poured into buttered casserole.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Yams And Apples
ingredients: 18 oz. cooked yams, chilled and cubed
steps: Saute apples and onion in margarine until soft.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Heat thoroughly.

recipes.title: Heavenly Chicken
steps: Place one package of chicken cutlets or more (cut up or whole) in one egg batter or egg white.
Instead of the egg, you can cover the chicken with mayonnaise.
Season with garlic powder and basil leaves (salt and pepper is optional).
Then, cover the chicken with bread crumbs.
Place in oven on lightly greased pan or foil on middle rack at 350° for about 20 minutes or until it looks done.
Enjoy!
Peace be with you.

recipes.title: Szechuan Chicken(Serves 4)
ingredients: 2 whole boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut in 1 1/2-inch strips
1 bunch green onions, cut in 1-inch strips
steps: Shake chicken strips in bag with cornstarch until coated. Stir-fry chicken and garlic in hot oil. Mix rest of ingredients, except onions, and pour over chicken.
Cook 3 minutes, covered. Uncover. Add onions and simmer 3 minutes uncovered.

recipes.title: Turkey Breasts
steps: Make stuffing according to package directions.
Put stuffing onto each slice of turkey.
Roll up and fasten with toothpick.
In a shallow pan put 1/2 of the gravy.
Lay each turkey roll in gravy and put remaining gravy on top.
Place into a 350° oven for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Eriko'S Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 medium size carrots, skinned and cut
steps: Boil potatoes (skinned) and carrots (skinned) in boiling water until potatoes and carrots are done.
Slice cucumber in thin slices.
Mix potatoes, carrots and cucumber in a bowl.
Put in mayonnaise, salt and vinegar.

recipes.title: Easy Lasagna
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) box lasagna noodles (do not cook)
steps: Brown beef.
Add sauce and water.
Mix eggs and all cheeses. Layer sauce, noodles and cheese and end with sauce.
Cover with foil for 45 to 50 minutes.
Uncover and bake 10 minutes in 350° oven in 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
steps: Place hamburger in casserole dish (raw). Sprinkle chopped onion over hamburger.
Pour celery soup over this.
Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.
Place Tater Tots on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Beef
ingredients: 6 lb. chuck roast or sirloin tip
steps: Combine all ingredients and cook on top of stove until meat is very tender.
Remove meat from sauce and shred with fork.
Put back into sauce and bake 1 to 6 hours at 300°.
Serve on buns.

recipes.title: Broccoli Or Cauliflower With Shrimp Sauce
ingredients: 1 (2 oz.) pkg. cream cheese with chives
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli or cauliflower
steps: In a saucepan, blend together cream cheese, milk and soup. Heat and stir until hot.
Add lemon juice.
Cook vegetables and pour sauce over.
Srpinkle with almonds and serve.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Dream Pie
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can Libby's solid pack pumpkin
1 1/2 c. (12 fluid oz. can) undiluted evaporated milk (Carnation)
steps: Combine the eggs, pumpkin, sugar, salt, cinnamon and evaporated milk, mixing thoroughly.
Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, beat the Dream Whip, whole milk and vanilla.
Beat on high until the topping thickens and forms peaks.
Fold in the pumpkin mixture and spoon into pie crusts.
Pull off 1-inch strips of aluminum foil. Crimp the aluminum foil around the top edge of the pie crusts to protect from burning.
Place pies on heavy-duty cookie sheets and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes, or until knife inserted near the center comes out clean.
Remove the crimped foil edges from the pies, cover with the clear lids and refrigerate.
When completely cool, spread Cool Whip over pie and serve.

recipes.title: Bake While You Sleep Cookies(All Night Cookies)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In medium size bowl, with electric mixer at high speed, beat egg white and salt until soft peaks form.
Beat in sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time until stiff and glossy.
Stir in nuts and chocolate chips.
Drop mixture by rounded teaspoon onto foil covered cookie sheet.
Place in oven.
Close door.
Turn oven off.
Do not open door.
Leave cookies in oven overnight.
Remove from foil; store in airtight container.
Makes about 2 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Gooey Pecan Bars
steps: Mix cake mix, egg and butter together and press into bottom of lightly greased 9 x 13 pan and set aside.

recipes.title: Crispy Carrot Casserole
steps: Cook the carrots in small amount of water until tender-crisp; drain.
Put the carrots in a greased casserole.
Dot with butter; stir in the onion.
Sprinkle with cheese; top with chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves six to eight.

recipes.title: Two Minute Pimento Cheese Spread
steps: Drain pimentos and combine all ingredients except milk.
Mix well.
Slowly add milk to desired consistency.
Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.
You can add additional Miracle Whip to make creamier.

recipes.title: Pink Punch(Very Good)
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in one cup of hot water.
Set aside.
Mix Kool-Aid in 4 quarts of water.
Add 4 cups sugar.
Add other juices, then add Jell-O mixture.

recipes.title: Family Favorite Salad
steps: Heat Jell-O in water until dissolved.
Add marshmallows and cook until melted.
Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients.
Cool until set.

recipes.title: Ham Ball
steps: Mix and form into ball.

recipes.title: Vineyard Leg Of Lamb
ingredients: 5 lb. leg of lamb, trimmed of excess fat and with the fell (the parchment-like covering) removed
2 medium sized garlic cloves, peeled and cut lengthwise into paper thin slices
steps: With the point of a sharp knife, cut a dozen or more 1-inch deep slits all over surface of the lamb.
Insert slivers of garlic into each slit.
Cut double thickness of cheesecloth large enough to entirely cover leg.
Drench it thoroughly with 1/2 cup brandy. Wrap leg in cloth and cover with plastic to prevent evaporation. Marinate at room temperature for at least three hours.
Preheat oven to 450°.
Mix cumin, salt and pepper in one bowl.
Combine sherry and wine in another.

recipes.title: Tamale Casserole
steps: Butter a long casserole dish.
Place 2 cans tamales (remove shucks) in dish.
Pour 1 can chili (with or without beans) over tamales.
Cook in microwave 10 minutes on High.
Sprinkle onion over top.
Spread grated cheese over top of onion.
Microwave on High for 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese melts.
Serve over Fritos. Quick and easy.

recipes.title: King Ranch Casserole
steps: Cut chicken off bones; set aside.
Combine soups, broth, Ro-Tel and salt and pepper to taste.
In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish, layer tortillas, cheese, onion, chicken and soup.
Makes 3 layers.
Cover with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, or until hot throughout.

recipes.title: Apple Pie Filling
steps: Bring all ingredients, except apples, to a boil until thick. Add apples and mix well.
Remove from heat.
Put into hot jars with hot lids.
Process for 20 minutes (hot bath).
Makes approximately 10 quarts.

recipes.title: Marinated Broccoli
ingredients: 2 bunches sliced, raw broccoli or crisp cooked (microwaved)
steps: Boil marinade together
a few minutes and pour over broccoli. If over raw broccoli, set 12 to 24 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Honey-Dijon Dressing
steps: In a small bowl, whisk all ingredients together until blended or combine in a blender until smooth.
Chicken broth helps replace some of the oil.
Extra virgin olive oil has a fuller, fruitier flavor then regular olive oil.
Makes about 1/2 cup.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 8 oz. thin spaghetti, cooked and drained
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes in a buttered casserole.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stew
steps: In hot pan, add oil, garlic, mushrooms and onion; saute.
Add carrots and celery and saute lightly.
Add water, potatoes, butter beans, beef broth and tomato paste.
Bring to a boil.
Add thyme, allspice, bay leaf, salt and pepper.
Simmer until done.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
steps: Mix cornbread mix and butter and set aside.
Cook and drain broccoli well.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 400° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Cheese Chips
ingredients: 1 pkg. Casino Monterey Jack cheese, cut into 1/4-inch slices, then cut each slice in half
steps: Cut cheese and place 2 to 3-inches apart on nonstick cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Remove from cookie sheet immediately.
Drain on paper towel.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cream Dessert
ingredients: 1 (8 serving size) pkg. Jell-O brand strawberry flavor, sugar-free, low calorie gelatin
steps: Trim 3/4-inch from ends of ladyfingers; place ends on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. Stand remaining ladyfingers around side of pan with cut sides facing in. Reserve 2 strawberries for garnish. Mash remaining strawberries. Stir boiling water into gelatin in large bowl at least 2 minutes, until completely dissolved. Add ice cubes; stir until melted. Add whipped topping and mashed strawberries; stir gently with wire whisk until well blended. Refrigerate 10 minutes or until mixture is very thick and will mound. Spoon into pan. Refrigerate 3 hours or until firm. Remove side of pan. Garnish with remaining strawberries. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Lillian'S Meatball Soup
steps: *Just enough of each for flavor.

recipes.title: Gooey Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. pound cake mix (16 oz. size)
steps: Mix pound cake mix with margarine and 2 eggs.
Put on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix 1 pound sugar less 1/2 cup with cream cheese, 2 eggs and vanilla.
Spread in pan.
Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: You will also need sterilized canning jars.

recipes.title: Slush
steps: Bring to a boil the first 2 ingredients.
Cool 15 minutes. Pour into freezer container.
Add next 3 ingredients.
Freeze 24 hours.

recipes.title: Grasshopper Dessert Squares
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Place ice cream in refrigerator for 20 minutes to soften.
In small bowl, mix crushed cookies and melted butter; stir to completely coat cookies.
Press cookies into bottom of 8 x 8 glass dish.
Bake at 375° for 8 minutes; cool completely and place in freezer.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
steps: Place all ingredients in blender.
Blend only until smooth. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Chicken Casserole
steps: Place cooked broccoli in a 12 x 7 x 1-inch dish.
(Cook broccoli until tender-crisp first.)
Layer on chicken.
Combine soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Pour over top.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine butter and bread crumbs and sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Vegetable Marinade
steps: Boil 10 minutes and pour over vegetables.
You may use whatever fresh vegetables you desire.

recipes.title: Hot Taco Spread
ingredients: 4 oz. Monterey Jack cheese with jalapenos, shredded
steps: Spread cream cheese in an 8 ounce pie pan; cover with chili. Add diced chilies and top with cheese.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Betsy'S Grapes
steps: Pull most grapes off stem; leave some on for decoration. Wash, dry and chill.

recipes.title: Scalloped Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. cracker crumbs or 1 c. Pepperidge Farm mix
steps: Peel eggplant; cut in 1-inch cubes.
Cook in boiling salted water for 8 minutes.
Drain.
Add egg, milk, butter, onion and crumbs.
Stir mixture; pour into square pan.
Sprinkle grated cheese over top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Macho Nacho Grande
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) can Frito Lay bean dip
steps: Brown ground beef and mix in taco seasoning.
Spread bean dip on chips to desired thickness.
Preheat oven to 400°.
Place chips on cookie sheet.
Put 1 teaspoon seasoned ground beef on each chip.
Cover with grated cheese and green chili slices.
Use hotter peppers, if you like.
Heat chips for 3 to 5 minutes.
Top with sour cream and olive slices.
Serve.

recipes.title: Macaroni-Chicken Salad
steps: Cook macaroni; drain, rinse and drain.
Combine with the next 6 ingredients.
Combine mayonnaise and mustard; spoon over salad and toss gently.
Cover and chill.

recipes.title: Tasty Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1/4 c. green and red peppers, chopped
steps: Mix all ingredient together. Roll in nuts or parsley to garnish. Place on plate in any shape.

recipes.title: Chicken Genoa
steps: Dip chicken breasts in Parmesan cheese, egg and cracker crumbs. Brown in 1/2 cup oil in skillet.
Arrange in baking dish in single layer.
Arrange 1 slice of 1/4-inch jack cheese on each breast. Adding oil to skillet if necessary, saute sliced fresh mushrooms until tender.
Add wine and saute slowly for 5 minutes.
Spoon mushrooms over chicken (not too much liquid).
Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Salmon Dip
steps: Discard bones and skin from can of salmon.
Cream together all ingredients with mixer.
Will be very thick.
Serve with crackers at room temperature.

recipes.title: Provence Tomatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Peel garlic and cut in tiny pieces. Chop parsley.
Cut tomatoes in half.
Place in oven dish, cut side up.
Sprinkle tomatoes with 2 drops of olive oil, garlic and parsley.
Bake in the oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Tuna Cheese Spread
steps: Let cream cheese soften for 1 hour.
Drain tuna; mash with fork.
Combine cream cheese, tuna and mayonnaise.
Add lemon juice, curry and salt; mix.
Add onion; stir to blend.
Chill 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lime Pickles
steps: Slice cucumbers to desired thickness, 1/4 to 1/2-inches.
Let stand in lime water for 24 hours.
Drain and soak in fresh water for 4 hours.
Change water every hour.
Take out and drain.

recipes.title: Scalloped Chicken
steps: Brown chicken in hot oil and place in a Dutch oven.
In skillet, combine remaining ingredients and stir until smooth, adding enough water to make enough sauce to completely cover chicken.
Pour sauce over chicken and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits Like Red Lobster
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients until it forms a soft dough. Drop onto ungreased cookie sheets. Take last 2 ingredients and pour or brush over buns. Bake at 425° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Fruit Dressing
steps: Mix dry ingredients; add onion juice.
Add oil, a small amount at a time, alternately with vinegar, the last addition being vinegar.
Use mixer until blended.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Creamy Dill Dip
steps: Thoroughly combine sour cream, mayonnaise, onion, dill weed and seasoned salt.
Cover and chill thoroughly to blend flavors. Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: French Beef Stew
steps: Dissolve bouillon in the boiling water.
Place beef, potatoes, carrots, mushrooms and onions in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch casserole. Sprinkle with crumbled bread and tapioca.
Season with salt and pepper.
Pour bouillon over all.
Cover tightly with foil.

recipes.title: 5 Hour Beef Stew
ingredients: can of tomato juice or V-8 juice
steps: Place meat
and
vegetables
in
baking dish.
Sprinkle tapioca, salt and sugar, then pour on tomato juice.
Cover and bake at 250° for 5 hours.

recipes.title: Egg Rolls
steps: Chop up carrots, long green onions and onions.
Mix in large salad bowl with the hamburger meat.
Add salt, pepper, garlic powder, sesame oil and eggs.
Mix really well with hands.
Lay out egg roll wraps and fill them up.
Deep fry until brown.

recipes.title: Caramel And Fruit Fondue
steps: Melt together in double boiler until melted.
(Mixture will be thick.)
Serve with green apples.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Banana Pudding
ingredients: 1 large box sugar-free vanilla instant pudding
steps: Mix instant pudding and milk until thick; add vanilla.
Add about 1 cup of Cool Whip to mixture and mix well.
Add bananas, as many as you wish.
Pour into container.
Put remainder of Cool Whip on top.
Crumble graham crackers on top.

recipes.title: Instant Spiced Tea Mix
steps: Combine all items and mix well.
Store in a jar.

recipes.title: Zucchini Quiche
steps: Saute zucchini and onions in margarine.
Add seasonings.
Beat eggs, add cheese and then add to vegetable mixture.
Separate crescent rolls and press into ungreased pan.
Spread Dijon mustard on crust.
Top with vegetable mixture.
Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes (finished baking when knife inserted in middle comes out clean).
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Family Favorite Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 envelope onion or onion/mushroom soup mix
steps: Mix all ingredients (I use a food processor) and shape into loaf.
Spray loaf pan lightly with Pam and place meat loaf in pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Creme Brulee(Serves 8 To 10)
steps: Mix yolks and sugar until blended (approximately 1 minute) in metal bowl.
In small saucepan, heat up cream and vanilla to approximately 180°.
Do not boil.
When cream mixture is hot, slowly add to yolk mixture until all the cream is in bowl.
Blend together.
Put mixture into creme brulee ramekens with water bath. Cook at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until firm.
If you like, add your favorite berry.

recipes.title: Green Goop
ingredients: 1 large and 1 small pkg. cream cheese
1 large and 1 small can crushed pineapple
steps: Melt marshmallows and jello in 7 cups of boiling water.
Stir until dissolved.
Set aside to congeal.
Next day, at least 1 hour before ready to serve, whip jello with mixer.
Then add softened cream cheese.
Fold in pineapple and nuts.
Stir in whipped cream.

recipes.title: Hot Peppers
ingredients: 4 qt. peppers, soak for 12 to 18 hours
steps: Boil 20 minutes for quarts and 10 minutes for pints until capped.

recipes.title: Chicken With Almonds
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. whole chicken breasts, skinned, split and boned
2 medium green peppers, cut into 3/4-inch pieces
steps: Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces.
Set aside.
In small bowl blend soy sauce into cornstarch; stir in red pepper.
Set aside. Preheat a wok or large skillet over high heat; add cooking oil. Stir-fry green peppers and green onions in hot oil 2 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Remove from wok.
Add almonds to wok.
(Add more oil, if necessary.)
Add half of the chicken to hot wok or skillet; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Remove from wok.
Stir-fry remaining chicken 2 minutes.
Return all chicken to wok or skillet.
Stir soy mixture; stir into chicken.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Stir in vegetables; cover and cook 1 minute more.
Serve at once.
Serve over hot cooked rice, if desired.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Stew
steps: Put all ingredients in crock-pot, cook on low for 3 to 4 hours.
Cook on high for 1 to 2 hours more.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Savory Fresh Mushrooms
steps: Combine all ingredients in a large skillet.
Cover and cook over medium heat 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Yields 4 servings (about 43 calories per serving).

recipes.title: Grandma'S Sweet Dill Pickles
ingredients: 1 gal. unsliced dill or sour pickles
steps: Drain pickles, saving liquid. Bring 2 cups pickle juice to a boil with cinnamon and allspice. Let cool. Pour over pickles in jar. Cover loosely and allow to set for 4 days. Shake jar occasionally to mix. Pour off liquid and dry out inside of jar (do not wash). Dry off each pickle with paper towels. Slice into 1/4-inch slices. Layer in jar with sugar, alternating pickles and sugar. Cover loosely and allow to sit for 2 days to let sugar melt.

recipes.title: Mom'S Spaghetti
steps: Sprinkle garlic salt into oil.
Add chopped onion and saute until clear.
Pour in tomato juice.
Simmer 20 to 25 minutes, then add tomato paste, water, Parmesan cheese, sugar and crushed red pepper.
Stir and simmer.
Add browned hamburger meat to sauce. Stir and simmer mixture for 2 hours.
If sauce is too thick, add 1/2 can water.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Cake
ingredients: 1/4 c. oil, mixed with 1/4 c. melted margarine,
1 can Mandarin oranges (reserve 1/4 c. liquid plus orange slice)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Blend the cake mix, oil-margarine, eggs and oranges; mix well.
Bake in 2 layer, round pans or one 9 x 13-inch pan (well-greased and floured) for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool, then spread with icing.

recipes.title: No Bake Chocolate Cookies
steps: Mix milk, sugar, cocoa and butter.
Put on stove and let boil for 2 1/2 minutes.
Add peanut butter and then oatmeal while mixture boils.
Add vanilla.
Stir to dropping consistency.
Drop by teaspoonful onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Heavenly Orange Fluff
steps: Mix ingredients and put in refrigerator to congeal.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dumplings
steps: Cut up chicken.
Place in boiler with salt and enough water to cover.
Cook 1 hour or until tender. Cool.
Remove from bones and cut up in bite size pieces.
While chicken is cooking, make dumplings.

recipes.title: Paula'S Coconut Cake
steps: Follow instructions on cake mix box. Cool cake for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Mom'S Pumpkin Ice Cream
steps: Beat egg yolk; add pumpkin, milk, sugar and spices.
Beat egg white, adding 1 tablespoon sugar.
Whip cream; mix with egg white. Add pumpkin mixture; freeze in 9 x 13-inch pan, without stirring.

recipes.title: Fat Free Icing
steps: Mix all ingredients together and it's ready to go on the cake!

recipes.title: Plantation Pralines
steps: Combine sugars, cream of tartar, salt and milk.
Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves.
Cook to 235° to 238°, approximately 12 minutes.
Add butter, extract and pecans.
Beat until creamy. Drop from large spoon onto buttered surface or waxed paper.
Makes 1 1/2 to 2 dozen pralines.

recipes.title: Angel Food Cake Trifle
ingredients: 2 large sliced peaches or 1 can sliced peaches
steps: Prepare angel food cake according to directions on box.
Let cool and cut into small squares.
Alternate layers of cake, and all fruits, pouring a little of the fruit juices over each layer. Layer whipped topping between each layer.
After trifle bowl is full, spread whipped topping over entire top and decorate with extra sliced fruits.

recipes.title: Sirloin Tips
steps: Brown sirloin cubes in cooking oil.
Remove from skillet. Saute all other ingredients.
When done, add cooked sirloin cubes back in with other ingredients.
(Don't cook vegetables until soggy, let them be crisp.)

recipes.title: Marinated Carrots
ingredients: 4 cans carrots, drained or 1 to 2 lb. fresh carrots, sliced and parboiled
steps: Combine all ingredients and let marinate in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Great Salsa
steps: Drain tomatoes, saving juice for another use.
In mixing bowl, combine tomatoes, chilies, green onions, lemon peel, salt, oregano, pepper and lemon juice.
Mix well.
Cover and refrigerate several hours to blend flavors.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Pickles
steps: Cover cucumbers with salt.
Let stand for 1 hour and drain well.
Combine sugar, vinegar and celery seed and bring to a boil. Let this syrup mixture cool, then pour over cucumbers.
Add 1 onion.
Pack into pint jars and store in refrigerator.
Pickles will be ready to enjoy in about 3 days.

recipes.title: Dump Cake Dessert
ingredients: 1 (19 oz.) pkg. white or yellow cake mix
steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Dump in pineapple, swirling it around to fill corners.
Dump in pie filling, pushing it around until layers of fruit are even.
Sprinkle cake mix over fruit to cover all.
Melt butter and dribble over top.
Sprinkle nuts over and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until top is light brown. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip and ice cream.

recipes.title: Chinese Shrimp Salad
steps: Cook noodles as per package directions, and drain.
Add mayonnaise	and
dry
Ranch
dressing mix. Toss with remaining ingredients.
Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Delicious Dessert
steps: Grease a pie pan well.
Beat the egg whites real stiff.
Add sugar, a little at a time.
Add vanilla.
Fold in pecans or walnuts and the cracker crumbs.
Pour into pie pan.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
Top with whipped topping.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Waldorf Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. chopped pecans or English walnuts
steps: Sprinkle lemon juice over apples as you chop them.
Add other ingredients and mix well.

recipes.title: Cappuccino
steps: Tie cinnamon sticks and cloves in cheesecloth and drop into a saucepan.
Add coffee and boiling water.
Cover and steep 5 minutes.
Remove spice bag.
Stir in sugar and half and half. Beat cream until soft peaks form.
Serve in warmed mugs or stemmed glasses.
Top with whipped cream; sprinkle with nutmeg.

recipes.title: Poppin' Fresh Barbecue
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can Hungry Jack big flaky biscuits or homemade biscuits
steps: Brown beef; drain. Add barbecue sauce, onions and brown sugar. Separate biscuits and place in ungreased muffin cups, pressing dough to cover bottom and sides. Spoon meat mixture into dough. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Papas Con Chorizo
steps: To speed up process, I always microwave the potatoes until tender and then when they cool down I cut them into bite size pieces.
In skillet with a touch of oil, I fry up the chorizo. When the chorizo is cooked I drop in the potato pieces and salt to taste.
Makes a great side dish.

recipes.title: Emerald Punch
ingredients: ??? oz. can concentrated limeade or juice
steps: Mix and chill. Add green sherbet (1 pint to 1 quart).

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Fruit Pudding
ingredients: any variety unsweetened cans of fruit such as pineapple, peaches, fruit cocktail, etc., drained, save juice
steps: Mix pudding mix with juice from cans of fruit to equal 1 1/2 to 2 cups of juice.
Can add fruit juice if needed.
Stir in fruit and chill.
Quick, easy and good dessert!

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
steps: In round 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe dish, combine corn syrup and sugar.
Stir until well blended.
Microwave on High (100%) power for 4 minutes.
Stir in nuts.
Microwave on High power 4 to 6 minutes or until light brown. Stir in butter and vanilla, blending well.
Microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes. Add baking soda and stir gently just until light and foamy. Quickly pour onto lightly greased baking sheet.
Cool.
Break into small pieces and store in airtight container.
Makes about 1 pound.

recipes.title: Mexican Dish
steps: Season meat as desired; brown with onion.
Add soup, milk and Ro-Tel to meat mixture.
In a large, glass Pyrex dish (sprayed with a light coat of cooking oil), spread chips, slightly broken. Next, add meat mixture over chips.
Sprinkle grated cheese over all.
Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Pink Stuff
steps: Mix jello per box instructions.
When mixture begins to set, add strawberries and Cool Whip.
Stir well and refrigerate covered.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jello Cake
steps: Mix together the dry Jell-O, cake mix, oil and water.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Beat according to directions on cake mix. Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Cucumber Salad
steps: Grate and drain cucumber.
Make Jello with hot water.
Place into refrigerator until syrupy.
Add sour cream to Jello and whip together.
Add cucumber and vinegar to mixture.
Return to refrigerator until set.

recipes.title: Christmas Pie
steps: Mix gelatin, 1/4 cup sugar and salt in medium saucepan.
Beat together egg yolks and milk.
Stir in gelatin mixture.
Place over low heat until gelatin dissolves and mixture thickens slightly, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in peppermint. Chill, stirring occasionally, until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from spoon.
Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar; beat until stiff.
Fold in gelatin mixture.
Fold in whipped cream.
Add enough green food color to make a nice shade.
Pour into pie shell.
Chill until firm. Garnish with cherries.
Delicious.

recipes.title: Praline Grahams
ingredients: 1 pkg. graham crackers (1/3 of 16 oz. box)
steps: Separate each graham cracker into four sections.
Arrange in a glass pan with edges touching.
Melt butter in a saucepan, stir in sugar and pecans.
Bring to a boil, cooking 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Spread mixture evenly over graham crackers.
Bake at 300° for 12 minutes, remove from pan and let cool on wax paper.

recipes.title: Simple Shrimp Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 head white or green cabbage, chopped by hand
1 large red onion, chopped by hand
12 to 16 oz. salad shrimp (fresh or frozen only; thaw frozen shrimp)
steps: Mix all ingredients in a bowl with mayonnaise to cover. Chill 4 to 6 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Old Fashion Tomato Soup
steps: In saucepan, combine first 6 ingredients.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour.
Heat cream in top of double boiler (until warm).
Add to tomato mixture just before serving.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Skillet Ranch Chicken
steps: Heat iron skillet and melt butter. Put Ranch dressing in a bowl and dip chicken. Place chicken in medium hot skillet and brown both sides. Super with wild rice.

recipes.title: Santa'S Tangy Punch
steps: Mix Tang, sugar, water, cranberry juice and almond extract; freeze until mushy. Add ginger ale just before serving. Tang mixture may be frozen ahead of time, then thawed to a mush. Yields 30 punch cups.

recipes.title: Cookies And Cream Ice Cream
steps: Combine all ingredients except cookies in ice cream machine. Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Freeze as directed on ice cream machine.
Add cookies immediately after freezing in machine.

recipes.title: Chocolate Christmas Cake
steps: Follow directions on box and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
After baking, poke holes in cake surface and pour 1 can of Eagle Brand milk over the cake.
Immediately pour caramel ice cream topping over that and let cake cool completely.
Ice with Cool Whip and sprinkle with ground up Heath bars.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
steps: Cook macaroni until tender.
Prepare eggs, peppers and celery. Mix all ingredients.
May add extra mayonnaise.
May serve cold.

recipes.title: Lou'S Delicious Roast
steps: Mix soup and water; pour over roast in a baking dish with lid. Bake at 350° for 3 hours.
Makes its own gravy.
Delicious and easy.

recipes.title: Dilled Tuna And Pasta Salad
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions omitting any salt and fat.
Drain and rinse with cold water.
Set aside.
Combine the tuna and onion in a large bowl.
Add the pasta and toss gently.

recipes.title: Company Chicken
steps: Cook and drain noodles.
Blend together soup, cream cheese, salt, cottage cheese and milk.
Layer noodles, chicken, onions, peppers, parsley, olives and liquid.
Top with buttered bread or cracker crumbs.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Jello Popsickles
steps: Mix jello, kool-aid and sugar in hot water to dissolve. Add cold water. Put in containers and freeze.

recipes.title: Icing
steps: Cream all together starting with about 1/4 cup sugar.
Add 1/4 cup water and end up with sugar.

recipes.title: Cheese Danish
steps: Mix cream cheese, beaten egg yolk, sugar, lemon juice and vanilla.
Mix well.
Press 1 can rolls in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread cream cheese mixture on top.
Flatten other can of rolls and place on top of cream cheese mixture.
Beat egg whites and brush on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Watch for top to brown.

recipes.title: Onion Pie Nanette
ingredients: 2 eggs, yolks and whites beaten separately
salt and cayenne pepper to taste
steps: Saute onion in butter until limp, but not browned. Cool. Preheat oven to 350°. Stir egg yolks, cream, salt, cayenne and wine into onion. Fold beaten egg whites into onion mixture. Fill pie shell and bake 1/2 hour.
Serve hot or cold. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Lucy'S Rotel Chicken
steps: Boil chicken.
Reserve 1 1/2 cups broth. Saute onions and peppers in butter. Cook spaghetti in chicken broth. Combine tomatoes and Worcestershire sauce. Cook until thick.
Add cheese and stir until melted.
Add drained peas, mushrooms, chopped chicken, onions and pepper.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Pour into casserole and bake until brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Reuben Baked Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast, skinless and cut into halves
1-16 oz. can of sauerkraut, rinsed and well drained
4 (4 x 6 in.) slices of natural Swiss or mozzarella cheese
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Place chicken breast in a greased 9 x 13 baking pan.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Rinse and drain the sauerkraut and place over the chicken, top with slices of cheese.
Pour dressing evenly over the cheese.
Cover with foil. Bake in oven 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Cranberry Gelatin Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add cranberry sauce and pineapple.
Add cold water and chill for 1 hour.
Add sour cream and pecans.
Mix well.
Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Pinto Bean Pie
steps: Mix first three ingredients.
Add other ingredients.
Pour into unbaked pie shells and bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees and then reduce heat to 325 degrees and bake an additional 30 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: The Doctor'S Meat Patties
steps: Select the desired amount of ground meats.
Add one or more eggs and a spoonful or two of peanut butter.
Add onion salt and garlic powder.
A small amount of catsup may be added if desired. Make into patties and place in the broiler section of the oven. Cook under the flame until done and browned on both sides.
Juices will seep out and make a hell of a gravy for mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Banutaberry Cake
ingredients: 1 white cake mix (with pudding inside the mix)
1 can pie filling (blueberry, strawberry, cherry, etc.)
steps: Mix cake according to package directions.
Pour in a rectangular baking dish approximately 9 x 11 x 2-inch.
After the cake has cooled, cream the cream cheese and sugar with a mixer. Pour this mixture over the cake evenly to the edges.
Cut a banana, finely, to cover the entire surface.
Spread the chopped pecans over the cake.
Spread the pie filling over the cake.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
steps: Brown hamburger; drain fat.
Mix all ingredients and simmer until hot.
Remove green pepper.
Serve hot on buns.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Fluffy Apple And Celery Salad
steps: Mix apples, celery, pineapple and marshmallows.
Add sugar to Cool Whip.
Fold in mayonnaise, lemon juice, vanilla and nutmeats. Fold in carefully to keep salad fluffy.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Ugly Duckling Cake
steps: Combine cake mix, fruit cocktail (and juice), 1 cup of coconut and eggs in large mixing bowl.
Blend, then beat on medium speed for 2 minutes.
Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle with brown sugar and bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until springs back to touch.

recipes.title: Cioppino(Fish Soup)
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley (2 Tbsp. dry)
1 Tbsp. chopped fresh basil (1 tsp. dry)
1 can chopped clams with the juice
steps: Saute onion and garlic in oil until transparent.
Add chicken broth and bring to boil.
Add tomato and seasonings; simmer 10 minutes.
Add shrimp and fish and simmer only until shrimp is pink and fish is cooked through, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Pour in chopped clams with the juice.
Turn off the heat; add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with lots of Italian bread.
Pour soup over cooked angel hair pasta.

recipes.title: Tiramisu
steps: Line a 2 1/2-quart trifle bowl with 1 package of ladyfingers that have been brushed with 1/3 cup coffee liquor, 2 teaspoons Espresso powder, 1/2 teaspoon vanilla and 1 teaspoon water.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
steps: Make macaroni and cheese according to directions.
Brown pork sausage.
Mix macaroni, cooked, drained sausage and soup together. Pour into casserole dish.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the top and bake 25 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Vegetable Bread
steps: Melt butter in pan.
Saute onions and bell peppers until soft. Stir in chives, Bac*Os, cheese and biscuits.
Spoon mixture into Bundt pan sprayed with Pam.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. (18.25 oz.) spice or yellow cake mix
1 can (21 oz.) Comstock apple pie filling
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Blend together cake mix, pie filling and eggs in large mixing bowl.
Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Combine sugar and cinnamon.
Spread half the batter in greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle with half the cinnamon-sugar. Repeat with the remaining batter and sugar.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes, until wooden pick inserted in center of cake comes out clean.
Cool.
Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Festive Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lb. potatoes, peeled, cooked and hot
steps: Mash
potatoes.
Add
sour
cream,
butter
and
cream cheese.
Combine eggs, onion and milk.
Add to potato mixture. Mix well and put into a greased 9-inch casserole.
Refrigerate for several hours or overnight.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: French Country Chicken
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen baby carrots, thawed and drained
1 (9 oz.) pkg. frozen whole green beans, thawed and drained
4 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
steps: In 8 x 12-inch baking dish, combine vegetables and 1/2 can French fried onions; arrange chicken breasts on vegetables.
In small bowl, combine wine, bouillon, garlic salt and pepper; pour over chicken and vegetables.
Sprinkle chicken with paprika.
Bake, covered, at 375° for 40 minutes or until chicken is done.
Baste chicken with wine sauce and top with remaining onions; bake, uncovered, 3 minutes or until onions are golden brown.

recipes.title: Meat Stuffed Peppers
steps: Remove tops and seeds from peppers and parboil for 5 minutes, drain.
Brown onions and ground beef in fat; add tomatoes, corn and seasonings (fresh corn can be used when available).
Stuff peppers and top with buttered crumbs.
Stand upright in greased baking dish.
Add small amount of water.
Cover and bake in 350° oven one hour.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Cream together cream cheese and milk.
Add rest of ingredients to cream cheese mixture and blend well.
Put into graham cracker crust (6 ounce pie crust) and freeze.
Remove from freezer 10 minutes before serving time.

recipes.title: White Velvet
steps: Mix gelatin, sugar and cream.
Let stand for 5 minutes.
Place saucepan over low heat and stir constantly until gelatin is dissolved.
Do not let boil.
Remove, cool to lukewarm and add sour cream and vanilla.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into a 1/2 quart mold.
Refrigerate until set.
Wash and hull strawberries.
Slice them and sprinkle with sugar (1/2 cup).
Add Kirsch.
Let stand. Serve over dessert.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole
steps: Boil broccoli until tender.
Drain and pour into casserole dish.
Mix soup and cheese with broccoli.
Meanwhile, melt butter. Crumble crackers in butter and mix evenly.
Top broccoli with crumbs.
Bake in 400° oven for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
steps: Cook broccoli in microwave for 5 minutes.
Melt butter in 13 x 9-inch pan and mix with other ingredients.
Pour back into pan and bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until brown.
Be sure and grease pan well.

recipes.title: Yellow Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 (8 oz.) pkg. Pepperidge Farm dressing mix
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large saucepan, cook squash until just tender; drain.
Add remaining ingredients, using half the cheese.
Put in 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole dish.
Bake about 25 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake 20 minutes more.

recipes.title: Peach Kuchen
steps: Mix margarine, coconut and dry cake mix together and press into bottom and slightly up the sides of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Jonathan'S Homemade Pizza
steps: This is a great recipe to prepare with your children.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Ritz
steps: Make sandwich with crackers and peanut butter.
Melt almond bark according to package directions.
Dip crackers into chocolate and put on wax paper to harden.

recipes.title: Fettuccine With Vegetables
steps: Steam carrots, zucchini, corn and green beans until tender; put aside to cool.
Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and set aside to cool.
Using blender or food processor, puree cottage cheese until smooth.
Blend in skim milk, basil and parsley.
Combine vegetables and pasta.
Pour sauce over vegetables and pasta; mix thoroughly.
Serve at room temperature. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Three-Week Cole Slaw
steps: Combine cabbage, onions, pepper and sugar.
Mix oil, vinegar, celery seed and salt.
Bring to a hard boil.
Pour over cabbage mixture and stir until well-mixed.
Store in refrigerator in air-tight container.
Let stand at least 3 days.
Flavor improves with age.
Will keep refrigerated for 1 month.

recipes.title: Salad Dressing
steps: Cook vinegar, salad oil and sugar for about 2 minutes; cool. Combine remaining ingredients in a blender.
Add the cooled mixture.
Store in a glass jar in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dessert
steps: In 9 x 13-inch pan, break cake into little pieces.
Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add frozen strawberries until dissolved. Pour over cake and jell until sets.
Prepare pudding with 2 1/2 cups milk; fold whipped topping into pudding.
Spread over Jell-O mixture.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Pie
ingredients: 2 cans (8 oz. each) refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
steps: 1) Heat oil in pan over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until tender.
Remove and set aside. 2) Brown and crumble ground beef. Drain off fat.
Stir in catsup, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Set aside. 3) On floured surface, unroll dough from can of rolls. Press perforations together and roll into 12 inch square.
Place in 9 inch pie plate and trim to 1 inch beyond edge. 4) Spoon meat mixture into dish.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Top with onions.
Pour 2 beaten eggs over onion layer. 5) Unroll remaining dough, press perforations together and roll into 11 inch square.
Place on top of onion layer.
Trim & pinch together with bottom dough layer. 6) Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes or until brown.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet Russian Chicken
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. chicken breast, cut up in serving-size pieces
steps: Place chicken pieces in shallow baking dish.
Mix dressing, soup mix and preserves with small amount of water.
Pour over chicken and bake in 350° oven for 1 1/4 hours or until chicken is tender.
Serve with rice.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Golden Punchgroves, Texas
steps: Mix above ingredients and when ready to serve, add two (2) bottles of Ginger Ale or 7-up.

recipes.title: An Easy Cake
ingredients: 1 yellow cake mix, baked as directed
1 large pkg. vanilla pudding, mixed according to box
steps: Take cake out of oven and pour pineapple over cake.
Let cool. Then pour pudding over cake and pineapple and cool.
Spread Cool Whip over pudding and refrigerate.
May sprinkle coconut on top.

recipes.title: Barbecue
steps: Saute the onion and celery in the margarine. Add the vinegar, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, ketchup, mustard and water. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the hamburger.
Simmer until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Italian Zucchini
steps: In a greased 2 1/2-quart casserole, layer 1/3 of the zucchini, onion and tomatoes.
Squeeze 1 lemon quarter over all.
Sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning and 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes.
Repeat layers.
Dot with butter.
Squeeze remaining lemon over all.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender.
Serve immediately.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Onion Dip
ingredients: 1/8 tsp. garlic, chives or finely chopped onion
steps: Combine all ingredients and beat until smooth.
Serve with Ritz crackers, chips or Fritos.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dessert
steps: Once mixed together, stir in cake chunks.
Slice 1 quart strawberries.
Stir slices into 2 packages of strawberry glaze. Then spread over the cake mixture.
Chill for several hours.

recipes.title: Chicken Stew
steps: Boil chicken; save broth.
Take chicken off the bone.
Dice potatoes, onions and tomatoes.
Cook in broth until potatoes are done.
Add chicken, sauce, corn and season to taste.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 1 (1 1/4) pkg. onion soup and dip mix
steps: Beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Stir in ReaLemon.
Stir in remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Summer Meadow Tea
ingredients: 1 c. firmly packed fresh mint (only tender tops and leaves)
one 6 oz. can frozen orange juice
steps: Boil water and sugar 5 minutes.
Pour over tea bags and cover tightly, allowing to stand 1 hour.
Remove tea bags.
Add
the lemonade and orange juice, undiluted.
This mixture can now be frozen until ready to use.
When serving. add 3 quarts of water to 1 quart of concentrate.

recipes.title: Basic Recipe For "Philly" Frosting
steps: Blend cream cheese and milk.
Add the sugar gradually, blending it in well.
Then add your selected flavoring and mix again.
Enough to frost and fill an 8-inch, 2 layer cake.

recipes.title: Baked Pork Chops And Potatoes
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Brown pork chops and place in baking pan.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Place potatoes and onion on top of pork chops. Gradually add milk to the soup and stir until smooth.
Pour over potatoes.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
Makes its own gravy.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Snow
steps: Melt marshmallows in milk.
Cool, then add whipped cream and crushed pineapple.
Line 9 x 13-inch pan with graham cracker crumbs.
Pour in marshmallow mixture.
Sprinkle crumbs on top. Chill.

recipes.title: Mac And Cheese Primavera
ingredients: 1 (7 oz.) pkg. macaroni and cheese dinner
1 c. red or green pepper strips
1/4 tsp. dried and crushed oregano leaves
steps: Prepare dinner as directed on package. Saute vegetables in margarine until crisp and tender.
Add dinner and oregano.
Mix lightly.
Makes 6 servings.
Preparation time:
15 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Meatballs And Sauce
steps: Roll in 1-inch meatballs.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350° on cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. hash browns (be sure they're the small square-cut ones)
1 or 2 cans cream of chicken soup
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Place in dish and top with some of the cheese.
Bake about 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Angel Delight
steps: Melt chocolate; cool.
Add beaten egg yolks.
Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into chocolate mixture.
Add sugar, pecans and whipped whipping cream.
Break cake in pan into chunks and pour mixture over cake.
Refrigerate for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Microwave Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Mix chicken, tomato, onions, green pepper and garlic powder in 16-ounce casserole.
Cover tightly and microwave on High 1 minute; stir.
Cover tightly and microwave until hot, 1 to 2 minutes longer; drain.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix all other ingredients. Bake uncovered for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Yogurt Dressing
steps: In a small bowl, whisk together yogurt, vinegar, lemon juice, curry powder and honey.
Refrigerate, covered, until serving time. Serve over mixed greens.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 6 large potatoes, boiled with skins on, peel and grate
steps: Mix above ingredients and place in casserole dish.

recipes.title: Chicken Soup
steps: Boil and bone chicken.
Save chicken broth.
Add the chopped potatoes, onion, carrots and celery to the chicken broth.
Add the large can of tomato juice.
Add the chicken.
Add salt, pepper and chili powder.
when the vegetables are almost done, add the 2 cans of corn and a pinch of sugar.
This soup is really good!

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
steps: Boil chicken until tender.
Debone; cut in chunks.
Mix first 3 ingredients together.
Add juice.
May add chopped and leftover celery to chicken while cooking.

recipes.title: Senior Prom Punch
steps: Chill fruit juices and 7-Up thoroughly.
Combine chilled juice in a large punch bowl.
Slowly pour in chilled 7-Up.
Serve in punch cups or in hollow stemmed glasses.
Makes about 40 servings.

recipes.title: Oyster Stew
steps: Remove oysters from liquor.
Heat liquor to boiling point. Add oysters and cook until edges curl, few minutes.
Put in milk, seasonings and butter.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Upside-Down Pizza
steps: Brown ground beef, onion and pepper.
Drain and add pizza sauce.
Simmer 5 to 10 minutes.
Pour pizza mixture in glass dish. Top with cheese and biscuits.
Bake at 350° until biscuits are done.

recipes.title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
steps: Mix ingredients except tortillas and picante.
Spread on tortillas and roll up.
Put in refrigerator to harden.
Slice tortillas into 1-inch segments.
Serve with picante sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Slice potatoes and boil until soft.
Drain and place in casserole dish.
Place slices of oleo over potatoes.
Add mushroom soup.
Chop cheese and place on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potatoes And Apricots
steps: Cook 3 yams or enough yams; slice crosswise to make one layer in 12 x 8-inch flat pan.
Drain apricots and add enough water to make 1 cup of juice.
Mix brown sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon and dash of salt.
Add the cup of drained juice.
Add raisins to juice mixture and bring to a boil.
Cook until thick, stirring constantly.
Add sherry and grated orange rind to hot sauce and pour carefully over fruit and potatoes.

recipes.title: Chalupa
ingredients: 3 lb. pork roast with bone or beef roast with bone
steps: Cover all in crock-pot with water.
Cook for 8 to 10 hours, then debone and shred meat.
Serve in a large bowl.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Eggnog Pie
steps: Mix gelatine, sugar and salt.
Gradually stir in eggnog.
Warm over low heat until gelatine is dissolved.
Chill until mixture mounds when dropped from spoon.
Fold in whipped cream, flavorings and 1 1/2 cups fruit cocktail.
Chill again about 10 minutes until mixture mounds.
Put in baked 9-inch pie shell.
Decorate with remaining fruit cocktail.
Chill 2 to 4 hours.

recipes.title: Round Steak With Sour Cream
steps: Saute meat in butter. Add onion, drained mushrooms, catsup, sour cream, salt and pepper. Simmer 25 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Drain vegetables well.
In a buttered baking dish, put a layer of asparagus, a layer of carrots and a layer of peas.
Cover with grated cheese.
Add a can of undiluted mushroom soup.
Cover with a can of French fried onions.
Cover and bake at 300° for 45 minutes.
Makes a great no-meat main dish.

recipes.title: Hot Crabmeat Dip
ingredients: 2 cans (6 1/2 oz.) crabmeat, rinsed, drained and cartilage removed
steps: Place cream cheese in medium-size microwave-safe bowl. Microwave at Medium power until softened for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring once.
Shred crabmeat; stir into cream cheese with remaining ingredients.
Microwave on Medium until dip is heated through, 4 to 7 minutes.
Serve hot with crackers or party rye bread slices.
Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
ingredients: juice of 2 lemons or 1/2 tsp. concentrate
steps: In large skillet, mix together.
Add meatballs.
Cook 1 hour (simmer).
Drip off excess grease.
Can also be frozen.

recipes.title: Basic Cookie Recipe
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Blend all ingredients in a large bowl. Drop by teaspoons 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Scallops In Cream Sauce
steps: Cook and stir onion in margarine in 10 inch skillet over medium high heat until tender.
Stir in scallops and salt.
Cook, stirring frequently, until scallops are white, 3 to 4 minutes.

recipes.title: Punch
ingredients: 1 small (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice
1 large (46 oz.) can unsweetened pineapple juice
steps: Combine all ingredients, except ginger ale.
Add ginger ale just before serving.
Makes 1 gallon.

recipes.title: Vegetable Ball
steps: Chop all vegetables very small and mix together.
Make 1 large or 2 small Vegetable Balls.
Roll in crushed pecans.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
ingredients: 1 small diced onion or minced onion
steps: Mix all ingredients.
If necessary, add a little milk for good cornbread consistency.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased baking pan. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until browned.

recipes.title: St. Louis Bars
ingredients: 1 box powdered sugar (save 2 Tbsp. to sprinkle on top after cooked)
steps: Mix first 3 ingredients together.
Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix remaining ingredients together with mixer and pour on top of cake mixture.
Will be thick, so spread with spoon. Sprinkle 1 cup pecans on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until set in center.
Cool, cut and sprinkle powdered on top. Serve.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Drain all cans and slice water chestnuts.
Alternate in layers, sprinkling with garlic salt, soup and cheese.
Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Uncover and top with onion rings. Return to oven for 15 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Chick 'N Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 tsp. each cumin and coriander, ground
1 whole chicken breast (boned and skinless), cut into 3/4-inch pieces
steps: Heat oil in large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and garlic and saut for 3 minutes. Add broth, tomatoes and picante sauce. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Sprinkle chicken with cumin and coriander. Add chicken, beans and corn to soup. Cover and simmer at least 15 minutes or until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Creamy Zucchini Soup
steps: My dad packing the saddle bags for the trip to the mountains. They had to be balanced so we could lift them, judging weight, adjusting and readjusting until the loads were equal.

recipes.title: Peanut Patty
steps: Place peanuts, milk, sugar and syrup in heavy pan.
Bring to boil.
Lower heat and simmer.
Cook until soft ball stage (approximately 1 hour).
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla, butter and coloring.
Cool 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake Dessert
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) pkg. Oreo cookies, crushed in blender
steps: Make pudding with milk; add Cool Whip.
Mix well and set aside. In another bowl, blend together well cream cheese, butter and confectioners sugar.
Blend the 2 mixtures together.
Layer crushed Oreos and pudding mixture in a child's plastic pail.
Leave about 1 cup of Oreos for the top.
Decorate top with gummy worms and plastic or silk flowers.
Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.
Kids love it!
Enjoy.

recipes.title: Parmesan Duck Breast
ingredients: 1 beaten egg, mixed with 1 tsp. water
steps: Heat oil in skillet.
Dip pieces of duck breast in beaten egg and roll in Parmesan cheese.
Fry in hot oil.
