recipes.title: Dressing(For Corn-On-The-Cob Or Potato)
steps: Mix and bake on potato or microwave corn with husk on and serve.

recipes.title: Sweet And Spicy Meat Loaf
steps: Mix together beef, salt, pepper, onions, egg, green pepper and cracker meal.
Combine tomato sauce, vinegar, mustard and brown sugar.
Mix until smooth.
Add 1/2 cup of mixture to meat; mix until absorbed.
Pour meat mixture into loaf pan (greased).
Spoon remaining tomato mixture on top.
Bake at 400° for 45 minutes, basting occasionally.

recipes.title: Chicken "Watchamacallit"
steps: Arrange everything in a large baking pan with tight cover or cover with foil, but let no steam escape.

Add just a little bit of water to cover the bottom of the pan. Season all ingredients and add soy sauce. Bake at 375° for about 1 3/4 hours. The steam seals in the various flavors and therefore it is very important to cover tightly.

recipes.title: Party Cheese Ball
steps: Place cheeses in small bowl and let stand at room temperature until softened.
Add onion and Worcestershire sauce, blending on low speed.
Beat on medium speed until fluffy, scraping side and bottom of bowl.
Cover; chill for 8 hours.
Shape mixture into one large ball.
Roll in parsley and place on serving plate.
Cover and chill 2 hours or until firm.
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Hamburger Noodle Stroganoff
steps: In skillet, brown beef and cook onion until tender.
Pour off fat.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish.
Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until hot.
Stir.

recipes.title: Italian Stuffed Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Roll out dough in rectangle.
Paint with egg (scramble it.)
Lay spinach on egged dough.
Place pepperoni; sprinkle with cheese.
Roll into loaf.
Place on cookie sheet.
Paint top with melted butter or margarine.
Bake at 350° for 28 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Pork Chops
steps: Mix ingredients.
Pour over browned pork chops.
Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Serve hot!

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Spread over top of meat loaf.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Southern Delight Macaroons
steps: Mix corn flakes, coconut and pecans in large mixing bowl.
Mix sugar, syrup, evaporated milk, butter and salt in a medium size saucepan.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until sugar is dissolved.
Stirring constantly, continue cooking over medium heat to 234° (soft ball in cold water) or about 10 minutes after mixture comes to a full boil.
Remove from heat.
Gradually pour over corn flake mixture, stirring to coat well.
Stir gently so as not to break corn flakes any more than necessary.
Drop by teaspoon onto greased baking sheet, shaping into mounds lightly with fingers and allow to set.
Yields 38 to 40 macaroons.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf Supreme
ingredients: 1 1/2-lbs. lean ground beef or ground chuck
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a 9X5-inch loaf pan with foil. Spray foil with cooking spray. Combine milk and egg in a large bowl; add bread crumbs, basil, parsley and pepper. Stir until blended. Add onion and bell pepper, mix well. Add beef and mix to combine ingredients. Pour into prepared loaf pan. Do not pack. Spread topping over meat loaf. Bake until cooked through, about 1 hour. Remove from oven to wire rack. Let stand for 5 minutes. Lift meat loaf out of pan and place on serving platter, remove foil. Can prepare ahead as recipe directs, cover and keep refrigerated for 2 days. Serve cold or reheat in warm oven.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni according to directions on box.
In saucepan, put Cheddar cheese soup, 1 can (soup) evaporated milk and 1 can milk; simmer until thoroughly mixed.
Grate or cut in small pieces the sharp Cheddar cheese and add to soup mixture.
Heat until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Cabbage Salad
steps: Heat and bring to a boil the oil, sugar, vinegar and seasonings.
Cool and pour over cabbage.
Cover.
Don't stir.
Let stand 1 hour.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Lemon-Cheese Salad
steps: Combine gelatin with boiling water.
Drain pineapple, measure juice and add water to make 1 cup; then add to gelatin.
Chill until partially set.
Soften cream cheese and add mayonnaise or salad dressing.
Add to gelatin and stir well.
Add other ingredients.
Pour into mold and chill until firm.
Yields 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 (32 oz.) pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
steps: Melt margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan or dish.
Pour hash brown potatoes into this casserole dish.
Combine remaining ingredients and blend well.
Spoon mixture over potatoes.
Melt butter and add corn bread stuffing mix.
Blend well.
Sprinkle stuffing mix over mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Yields 10 servings.

recipes.title: Grouper Cheeks Stew(My Own Original)
steps: Prepare fish:
Soak in ice water; feel for a small angular bone.
Peel off any skin.
Cut into pieces (1-inch size).
Peel and cube potato.
Chop onion and celery.
Saute vegetables in 2 tablespoons oil about 8 minutes (do not overcook potato).
Dissolve chicken cube in 1 cup boiling water.
Add to vegetables.
Liquid should "cover" vegetables.
Cook about 6 minutes.
Lay fish over potato.
Do not stir or break up fish.
Simmer about 6 minutes, just enough to cook fish.
Break up bay leaf, lay on fish.
Scald milk.
Add to pot.
Season with pepper, dry parsley and dill weed. Crush 5 crackers.
Add to thicken.
Serves 4. So good!

recipes.title: Kersten'S Chocolate Truffle
ingredients: 1 box chocolate cake mix, bake according to directions
3 boxes instant chocolate pudding, mix as directed
steps: Looks nice in a truffle bowl.

recipes.title: Stuffed Potatoes
steps: Filling: Mix all ingredients except the potatoes.

recipes.title: Chicken With Orange Sauce
ingredients: 1 (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) frying chicken, cut into serving pieces, skinned and all visible fat removed
steps: You will also need vegetable oil spray.
Do not use vegetable oil spray near an open flame or a heat source.
Read and follow directions on can before using.

recipes.title: Swiss Broccoli Soup
steps: Saute 2 tablespoons onion until tender.
Add remaining ingredients and heat until melted.
Can add potatoes and other vegetables if you wish too.

recipes.title: Creamy Coconut Cake
ingredients: 1 yellow cake mix (2 layer size, with or without pudding)
steps: Prepare cake as directed.
Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Cool cake 15 minutes.
Use a fork to poke holes in top of cake.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookie Ice Cream
steps: Mix well, then finish filling freezer with fresh milk and freeze.

recipes.title: Cousin Tib'S Peas And Water Chestnuts(An Interesting Vegetable Dish For A Large Group)
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, drained
10 1/2 oz. can condensed cream of celery soup (undiluted)
steps: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat; add onions, celery and red pepper. Cook, stirring constantly, until tender. Stir in peas and next 4 ingredients. Spoon into a lightly greased 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with noodles. Heat thoroughly, about 20 minutes, in 350° oven. Serves 18 to 22.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dip
steps: Soften the cream cheese by setting out ahead of time or take out of foil and put in microwave for 1 minute.
Mix all ingredients together.
Store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips (mini or regular)
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes.
Using wooden spoon handle, poke holes in cake.
Pour hot fudge sauce over cake and cool thoroughly.
Cover with large container of Cool Whip. May sprinkle chopped nuts on top.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Ginger-Cinnamon Tea
steps: In a saucepan, simmer ginger, cinnamon sticks and water for 20 minutes, longer for stronger tea. Add honey or brown sugar and strain tea through sieve.

recipes.title: Tropical Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 c. cubed, cooked chicken or turkey
2 large oranges, peeled, sectioned and drained
1 1/2 c. cut up fresh pineapple, drained
steps: In a large mixing bowl, combine chicken, fruit and celery; mix well.
Cover and chill.
Just before serving, combine chicken mixture, dressing and nuts.
Serve in hollowed out pineapple shell.

recipes.title: Oriental Salad(Add Ingredients, But Delicious!)
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can boned and chunked chicken
1 (10 1/2 oz.) frozen peas, cooked and drained
steps: Combine chicken, peas and celery; chill. Add lemon juice, garlic salt and soy sauce to salad dressing and mix until thoroughly blended. Add salad dressing mixture to chilled chicken mixture. Add noodles and grapes tossing to blend. Sprinkle with nuts.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Souffle
steps: Cook and mash potatoes; add rest of ingredients.
Pour in casserole and bake 20 to 30 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookies
ingredients: 1 Pillsbury devil's food pudding in the mix cake mix
steps: Mix 2 eggs and oil; add cake mix and mix thoroughly.
Roll into marble size balls.
Place about 2 to 3 inches apart on cookie sheet and bake at 300° for approximately 6 minutes.
Do not overbake.
Let cool.
Spread icing on a cake and cover with another.

recipes.title: No. 1 Sausage Quiche
steps: Brown sausage and drain.
Mix all ingredients and pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Peanut Butter Balls
steps: Mix oleo, peanut butter and sugar.
Roll into 1-inch balls. Chill for approximately 1 hour.
Melt chocolate bark.
Dip peanut butter balls in chocolate.
Set on wax paper until chocolate cools and hardens.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Biscuits
ingredients: 3 doz. small rolls (example: Pepperidge Farm finger rolls)
steps: Mix margarine and first 4 ingredients.
Split rolls and spread with mixture.
Place ham and cheese on, then put tops back on rolls.
Melt remaining mixture and pour over top.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cola Cake
ingredients: 1/2 (6 oz.) pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips (about 1/2 c.)
steps: *Note:
For a firmer cake, use 16 ounce package pound cake mix stirring in 1/3 cup powdered chocolate drink with orange peel.
Use cola for liquid; bake as directed.

recipes.title: Meatball Hoagies
steps: Mix ground beef, parsley, bread crumbs, milk, eggs and cheese in bowl until well-blended.
In a large skillet, saute onion and garlic in oil over medium heat until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Hamburger Chow Mein(My Son, David Walmsley'S, Favorite Meal)
steps: Brown beef and celery in skillet.
Drain off grease.
Sprinkle with dry soup mix and cornstarch over meat mixture; stir in.
Then add soy sauce, water and bean sprouts.
Mix all together.
Bring to boiling point.
Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve over rice.
Top with chow mein noodles.

recipes.title: Butter Pecan Ice Cream Cake
steps: Crush cookies in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour melted butter over. Mix and pat down as crust.
Whip together pudding, milk and ice cream.
Pour over crust and frost with Cool Whip.
Let set for at least 2 hours in refrigerator.

recipes.title: "Wangs" Buffalo Chicken Wings
steps: Bake frozen wings on rack in a large pan at 425° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Salmon Patties
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. Stove Top stuffing mix (use your favorite flavor)
2 (6 oz. each) cans salmon, drained and boned
steps: Mix together all ingredients.
Cover and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Shape 1/3 cups of mixture into patties.
Heat large nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray on medium heat.
Add patties and cook approximately 3 minutes on each side.
(Or, until patties are golden brown on both sides.)
Turn carefully.
Makes 12 salmon patties.

recipes.title: Crescent Sausage 'N Cheese Bake(Serves 8 To 10)
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Brown 'N Serve sausages, sliced
2 c. shredded Swiss or Monterey Jack cheese
steps: Separate dough into 2 large rectangles.
Place in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Press over bottom and 1/2 up the sides of the pan.
Seal perforations.
Place sliced sausages over crust.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine rest of ingredients and pour over cheese.
Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Walnut Cornbread Stuffing
ingredients: 16 oz. ready to serve chicken broth
steps: Bake cornbread and cool.
Saute onions, celery and butter until onions are clear.
Combine stuffing mix, cornbread, salt, pepper, sage, walnuts, celery and onion mixture and eggs.
Add broth until mixture is moist.
You may add turkey broth instead of chicken.
Stir mixture thoroughly.
Bake at 500° for 30 minutes. This stuffing bakes wonderfully in a cast-iron pan.
For best results, preheat you pan and coat with spraying oil (Pam).

recipes.title: Pear Cream Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. lemon jello (with 1 c. pear juice)
steps: Heat 1 cup pear juice and mix with 1 package lemon jello; refrigerate until starts to jell.
Mash pears and mix with cream cheese.
Mix together with jello,
nuts and Cool Whip. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Baked Northern Pike
ingredients: 2 northern pike, cut in crosswise slices about 2-inch thick
1 large sweet onion, cut in thick slices
steps: Place slices of pike in greased baking dish.
Season with salt and pepper.
Place slices of onion on fish.
Spoon tomatoes over onion.
Crumble basil over tomatoes.
Bake in moderate oven at 350° for about 1 hour or until fish flakes easily.
Good served with baked potatoes, carrot casserole and celery, apricot pie for dessert.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
steps: Stir all together.
Let simmer 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Baked Corn
steps: Add slightly beaten eggs, salt, butter and milk to corn.
Turn into a buttered baking dish.
Bake in a moderate oven until firm (about 45 minutes).

recipes.title: Strawberry Surprise
steps: Break up cake into oblong pan.
Mix Jell-O in bowl with 2 cups hot water.
Add strawberries; mix.
Pour over cake in pan.
Let set and harden in refrigerator at least 2 hours.
Mix pudding with milk.
Fold Cool Whip into pudding.
Pour mixture over cake. Refrigerate 5 to 6 hours.

recipes.title: Lasagne
steps: Brown meat and sausage; drain fat.
Add spices to taste and all tomatoes, mix in and bring to boil.
Let simmer 15 minutes. Add all ingredients, then layer in 2 pans.
Bake approximately 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Trifle Bowl Cake
steps: Prepare cake according to package directions.
After cake has cooled, pull apart into medium size pieces and make a layer in your trifle bowl.
Add a layer of Cool Whip and drizzle with syrup.
Continue to repeat layers until all of the cake has been used.
After final layer of Cool Whip, decorate with colored sprinkles.

recipes.title: Pink Lady Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate before serving.

recipes.title: Shrimp Victoria
steps: Saute shrimp and onion in oleo.
Add mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and simmer (very low heat) for 10 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli according to package; strain off water.
Mix all ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Top with Durkee fried onions or Cheese Nips crackers.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
steps: Drain shrimp and crush into small pieces.
Soften cream cheese with mayonnaise and add to shrimp.
Add eggs and onion.
Chill for a couple of hours.
Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes before serving.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: "Diet" Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie
ingredients: 1 small box sugar-free chocolate pudding (Jell-O brand)
steps: Mix sugar-free pudding as directed, using skim milk.
Add peanut butter, Sweet 'N Low and vanilla.
Blend together and spoon into pie crust.
May be topped with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines butter cake mix
steps: Mix cake mix according to directions and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Stick holes in entire cake.
Bring to boil sugar and milk; boil 1 minute.
Pour over cake.
When cake is cooled, ice with 8 ounces Cool Whip and top with 7 ounces Angel Flake coconut; refrigerate.

recipes.title: Confetti Cabbage
steps: Melt margarine.
Add vegetables. Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes. Shaking pan, season and cook another minute. Serve.

recipes.title: Chuck Wagon Casserole(Makes Six 1-Cup Servings)
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef or ground turkey
1 can (15 oz.) chili beans in gravy
1 can (11 oz.) condensed Cheddar cheese soup
2 slices American cheese, cut in half diagonally
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Crumble ground meat into a medium skillet.
Brown over medium heat; drain off fat.
Sprinkle meat with salt.
In a 2-quart casserole, stir chili beans with gravy, hominy and soup until combined.
Stir in meat.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until heated through.
Arrange cheese on top.
Bake 2 minutes longer or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
steps: Boil chicken until cooked.
Remove chicken from bones.
Cut into small pieces.
Add green onions and celery.
In separate container, mix sour cream, mayonnaise and Lawry's salt.
When thoroughly mixed, add to chicken.
Refrigerate until served.

recipes.title: Comfort Egg Nog
steps: Chill liquids before mixing.
Separate egg whites and yolks. Beat yolks and add sugar.
Stir in whipped cream, milk, cream and Southern Comfort.
Beat egg whites; fold in.
Dust with nutmeg. Chill.
Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Gelatin Salad
steps: Drain and save juice from pineapple.
Dissolve jello in boiling water, add marshmallows.
Stir until melted.
Add strawberry drink and chill slightly.
Add fruit and chill until firm.

recipes.title: Oven-Barbecued Chicken
steps: Place chicken, skin side down, in a single layer in a buttered shallow baking pan; top with onion slices.
Mix remaining ingredients in a small saucepan; heat to boiling and pour over chicken.
Bake in hot oven (400°) for 30 minutes.
Turn chicken, skin side up; baste with sauce once or twice.
Cook 30 minutes longer, or until tender and richly glazed.

recipes.title: Cheese Snack
steps: Pour dressing over sliced apples, carrots and cheese. Microwave 1 minute.

recipes.title: Soy Cottage Cheese
steps: Make soy grits from raw or toasted soy beans, ground to grits in blender.
Stir ingredients together.
Cook in double boiler, without stirring, for 3 hours.
Cool.
Remove a portion and gently mix curds with enough lemon juice to make sour.
Shape into mound. Garnish and serve as cottage cheese.

recipes.title: Broccoli Corn Bread
steps: Mix all together and bake in long pan for 30 minutes in 350° oven (freezes well).

recipes.title: Chocolate Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 box German chocolate cake mix, follow directions on pkg.
1 large chocolate pudding mix, follow directions on pkg.
steps: Bake cake mix as directed on box.
Place 1/2 of baked cake into punch bowl.
Layer with 1/2 of pudding mix, then a layer of chocolate syrup, then a layer of Cool Whip.
Repeat.
Place cherries on top.

recipes.title: Fat Free Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 (14 1/2 oz.) can Italian style diced tomatoes
Salt and black pepper, to taste
steps: Combine water, cabbage, potatoes, and onion in a large soup pot.
Cook over medium heat until potatoes are tender but not mushy.
Add remaining ingredients and let simmer for about 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Apple-Sour Cream Pie
ingredients: 7 medium tart, green summer apples (4 c.)
steps: Line a 9-inch pie plate with pastry.
Combine egg, sugar, brown sugar and sour cream.
Stir in cored, pared and thinly sliced apples and raisins.
Turn into pastry shell.
Add lattice top; seal edges and flute.
Bake in a 400° oven for 50 minutes or until done, covering edges with foil during last 15 minutes baking time.

recipes.title: Crawfish Cornbread
steps: Mix
everything together.
Bake in oblong pan.	Bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: "Marsha'S Marinated Cucumbers And Onions"
ingredients: 1/8 c. cider vinegar or more to taste
steps: Will need 1 bowl with tight lid.

recipes.title: No Bake Lemon Cheese Bake
ingredients: 1 reduced fat honey graham cracker (5 x 2 1/2-inches), crushed
1 (8 oz.) pkg. reduced fat cream cheese, cubed
1 c. reduced sugar cherry pie filling
steps: Coat a 9-inch spring-form pan with nonstick cooking spray. Sprinkle half of graham cracker crumbs on the bottom and 1-inch up the sides of pan. Set aside. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Cool to room temperature. In a blender, combine the gelatin mixture, cream cheese and cottage cheese; cover and process until smooth. Transfer mixture to a bowl; fold in whipped topping. Pour into prepared pan. Sprinkle with remaining graham cracker crumbs. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or until set. Carefully run a knife around edge of pan to loosen, then remove sides of pan. Garnish with pie filling. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Candied Grapefruit Peel
steps: Grapefruit directions:
Cut peel from grapefruit; cut peel into strips.
Add cold water to cover strips of peel.
Cover and bring to boil; boil 5 minutes.
Drain and repeat 3 times (this removes bitterness).
Add sugar and 1 cup water to drained peel.
Bring to boil and boil gently over low heat until syrup is thick and almost absorbed by peels, stirring occasionally.
Drain on absorbent paper.
Roll in tinted sugar while still hot so sugar will stick to peels.

recipes.title: Italian Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef and onion; drain.
Add all other ingredients, except cheese and potatoes.
Cook 2 more minutes. Put 1/2 meat sauce in 9 x 13-inch dish.
Put sliced potatoes on top, then another 1/2 meat mixture.
Bake for 1 hour at 375°. Cover tightly with foil.
Sprinkle cheese on top and cook 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Yellow Squash Puffs
steps: Wash and slice squash into small slices.
Cover and boil until tender; drain well.
Reserve 1 cup cooked squash.
Blend cornmeal, onion and egg together.
Add to remaining squash.
Place carefully into hot grease by teaspoon.
Cook until brown, turning only once.
Drain onto paper towel and enjoy while hot.

recipes.title: Mixed Fruit Soup
steps: Wash dried fruit and soak in cold water 1/2 hour.
Add cinnamon stick, lemon slices, tapioca and sugar.
Simmer, covered, until almost tender (about 10 minutes), stirring occasionally. Stir in raisins and apple slices and cook a little longer.
Taste soup; if you wish a stronger flavor, add more sugar and/or lemon juice or add 2 tablespoons fruit syrup or grape juice.

recipes.title: Hamburger Meat Dish
steps: Brown meat; add onion, pepper and celery.
Add cooked noodles, soups, milk and nuts.
Mix and put into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.
Top with crushed potato chips, cheese or whatever you like.
May be frozen.
Serves 12 to 15.

recipes.title: Sweet Potatoes
steps: Mix potatoes, sugar, eggs, vanilla, milk, and butter together and pour into a greased 9x13 inch casserole.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pop Cake
ingredients: 1 small box instant Jell-O vanilla pudding
steps: Bake cake as directed in square pan.
Then punch holes in cake with toothpick.
Mix 1/2 cup water with jello and strawberry pop. Pour this over cake.
Refrigerate overnight.
Mix 1 1/2 cups milk with instant vanilla pudding.
Add Cool Whip; spread over cake.

recipes.title: Frosty Snow
steps: Soften gelatin in water; dissolve in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly.
In a blender, combine vanilla, wine, sugar, mandarins with their canning syrup, adding more juice or water to make 1 cup liquid.
Blend 10 seconds.
Beat egg white until stiff.
Pour gelatin into a bowl, add mandarin mixture and stir well.
Fold in beaten egg white, beat 30 seconds with egg beater.
Chill until set.
Serve in sherbet dishes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
steps: Heat sugar, Karo and water until sugar melts.
Add dash of salt and nuts.
Cook to hard crack stage.
Take off heat and add soda and stir.
Pour on buttered cookie sheet.
When cool, break in pieces.

recipes.title: Pork And Peppers Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 lb. lean pork, cut into thin strips
1 (6.0 oz.) pkg. Kraft Cheddar broccoli pasta and cheese
steps: Stir-fry pork and garlic in oil in 2-quart saucepan.
Remove from pan.
In same pan, prepare pasta and cheese as directed on package, except omitting margarine and adding pork and remaining ingredients during last 3 minutes of cooking.
Remove from heat. Cover and let stand 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Goulash
steps: Cook hamburger meat with bell peppers and onion until done while cooking macaroni according to package directions.
Drain both.
Add macaroni to beef mixture.
Add stewed tomatoes and tomato sauce.
Simmer 30 minutes on low.
Add salt or garlic salt and pepper as desired.

recipes.title: Asilomar Turtle Cake
ingredients: German chocolate cake mix (I use Betty Crocker)
steps: Melt caramels, margarine and milk in double boiler.
It takes awhile.
Mix well and set aside.

recipes.title: Fast'N Fancy Macaroons
ingredients: 5 1/2 c. (14oz. bag) Baker's Angel Flake coconut
1 can (14oz) Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: Combine all ingredients, mixing well.
Drop from spoon 1-inch apart on well greased baking sheet.
Decorate with halved maraschino cherries or sugar sprinkles, if desired.
Bake at 350° for 10-12 minutes or until lightly browned.
Remove at once from baking sheets using moistened spatula.
Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Ham And Red Eye Gravy
steps: Put cloves in ham and bake at 325° until 3/4 done.
Bake about 35 minutes per pound.
Make glaze using pineapple juice, cherries, Coca-Cola and brown sugar.
Mix ingredients together and baste ham, then add fruit 1/2 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Molded Tuna Salad
steps: Drain tuna; flake.
Combine with olives, celery and eggs. Soften gelatin in water and dissolve over hot water.
Stir in salad dressing.
Add sour cream, onion, salt, lemon juice and parsley.
Combine with tuna mixture.
Spoon into 1-quart mold and chill until firm.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Spinach Lasagne
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. thawed and drained chopped spinach
steps: Mix eggs, Ricotta cheese, spinach and any seasonings (i.e., basil, garlic or oregano).
In 9 x 13-inch pan, put layer of spaghetti sauce, then layer of uncooked noodles, then half of egg-cheese-spinach mixture, then layer of Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese.
Repeat layers again, except put extra sauce before you put Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese topping (i.e., sauce, noodles, spinach mixture, sauce and cheese).
Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 stewed chicken, cut into bite size pieces
steps: Place chicken in bottom of buttered casserole dish.
Add layer of dressing.
Mix soups and water and pour over dressing. Sprinkle poultry seasoning on top.
Bake at 400° until top bubbles through dressing and browns.
Serve with cranberry sauce.

recipes.title: Ground Sirloin Beef Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients except soup until well blended.
Roll in balls the size you wish.
Bake 15 to 30 minutes.
When done, pour off grease.
Dribble cream of mushroom soup over meatballs and serve.

recipes.title: Plum Sauce For Dipping
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. ripe plums, halved, pitted and cut into wedges
2 tsp. ginger root, pared and grated
steps: Mix all ingredients, except the soy sauce, in a pan and bring to a boil.
Lower heat; cover and simmer 5 to 10 minutes until plums
are
soft.
Stir in soy sauce.
Cool slightly and pour into your
blender.
Blend until smooth.
Refrigerate if not using immediately.
Will keep up to 1 week.

recipes.title: Taco Quiche
steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Beat eggs and milk.
Add biscuit mix and pepper; mix well.
Pour over meat.
Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool for 5 to 10 minutes.
Spread sour cream over the top.
Sprinkle with lettuce, tomato, green pepper, onions and cheese.

recipes.title: Company Chicken
steps: Place chicken in 9 x 13-inch ungreased baking dish and top with cheese.
Thin soup with water.
Mix until smooth and pour over chicken.
Mix stuffing mix with melted butter and sprinkle over top.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours or at 350° for 45 minutes (uncovered).

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
steps: Mix
sugar,
syrup
and
water
together and cook until mixture
turns
a long thread from the spoon.
Add peanuts and stir constantly until syrup mixture turns light brown in color and peanuts are done.
Add salt, butter and soda.
Stir until thoroughly
mixed and pour on a buttered cookie sheet.
Spread as thin as possible and let cool.
Break into pieces.

recipes.title: Baked Lemon Chicken
steps: Place chicken in a greased 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients.
Pour over chicken.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour or until done.
Baste frequently. Serve with hot cooked rice.

recipes.title: Hot Shrimp Dip
steps: Rub fondue pot or chafing dish with a clove of garlic.
Add all ingredients and warm slowly.
Serve with toasted bread cubes.

recipes.title: Potato Stuffed Franks
steps: Prepare potatoes as directed on box and mix with onions, parsley and mustard. Split franks lengthwise not cutting clear through. Place opened, cut side up, on rack in broiler pan. Spread with potato mix; sprinkle with cheese.
Place in oven; set to broil about 5 inches from broiler unit. Heat until cheese is melted, about 5 to 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in a dish which has been sprayed with Pam.
Bake, covered, for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cocktail Meatballs
steps: Mix together ingredients and roll into small balls.

recipes.title: Ann'S Breakfast Quiche
steps: Grease a 9-inch pie pan. Place ham, cheese and eggs in bottom of pan. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth.
Pour into pie pan. Bake until golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes at 400°. Let stand about 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Spring Salad
steps: Drain pineapple, heat the juice to dissolve jello.
Soften cream cheese in microwave, add to jello juice.
Stir.
Combine all together, then fold in Cool Whip last.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pizza
steps: Mix together the zucchini, eggs and half of the cheese.
Pat this in a buttered pan.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.
Put your choice of meat (ground beef, dried beef or bologna) on top with the onion.
Top this with pizza sauce and sprinkle with cheese. Bake another 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Spicy Squash Bake
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. butternut squash, cut into 3/4-inch cubes
steps: Steam squash 10 to 12 minutes, until tender.
Cook onion and garlic in butter until tender.
Stir in salsa, salt and pepper. Gently stir in squash.
Place 1/2 squash mixture in 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cheese.
Top with remaining squash, then cheese.
Bake, covered, in a 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 box Jiffy corn muffin mix (8 1/2 oz.)
steps: Mix all together and pour into greased casserole dish (2-quart size) and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sunshine Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 small red bell pepper, cut into chunks
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Drain and rinse with cold water to cool quickly; drain well.
Drain pineapple, reserving 1/4 cup juice.
Mix reserved juice together with all ingredients.
Cover and chill.
Toss mixture just before serving. Makes 10 (1-cup) servings.

recipes.title: Mud Cake
steps: Crush Oreo cookies (use rolling pin).
Mix with melted butter and press in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Add ice cream or yogurt, softened.
Then spread hot fudge sauce over this. Last, spread Cool Whip and freeze.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Butter bottom and sides of casserole dish.

recipes.title: Ham 'N Bean Skillet Dinner
steps: In a medium sized skillet, heat oil, adding celery, onion, green pepper, garlic, salt and meat.
Cook until the onion is tender.
Drain off fat.
Stir in the pork and beans, lima beans with liquid and chili sauce.
Do not cover.
Simmer about 10 minutes.
Serve while hot.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
steps: Combine cream of chicken soup, celery, onion, mayonnaise, salt and dash of pepper.
Fold in tuna, drained and flaked, and hard-cooked eggs.
Put in 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.
Sprinkle with the crushed potato chips.
Bake in a hot (400°) oven for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Never Fail Meringue
steps: Blend cornstarch with cold water.
Add hot water.
Cook, stirring constantly, until clear and thickened.
Cool.
Beat egg whites until foamy; gradually add sugar and beat until stiff. Gradually add cooled cornstarch mixture.
Beat at high speed of mixer for one minute.
Spread on cooled pie.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
You can use less sugar.

recipes.title: Butter Brickle Cake
ingredients: 1 (No. 2) can cherry pie filling (peach or apple)
1 box butter brickle cake mix (Betty Crocker)
steps: Mix pineapple, pie filling and brown sugar and put in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Melt margarine and mix in cake mix. Crumble over top of fruit.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Pink Salad
steps: Mix Eagle Brand and Cool Whip thoroughly.
Add all other ingredients.
Chill.
May substitute lite cherry pie filling and fat-free/nonfat plain yogurt instead of Eagle Brand.
This makes the salad not quite as rich but still good.

recipes.title: Lazy Stroganoff
steps: No need to brown meat. Simply mix all together and bake in covered dish at 275° for 3 to 4 hours. Or cook in crock-pot for 4 hours. The flavor depends on slow cooking. Ten minutes before serving, stir in 1 cup sour cream. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Rosemary - Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 2 baking potatoes, cut into 8 wedges each (or 1 lb.)
steps: Combine ingredients in a medium bowl, toss well.
Arrange on baking sheet coated with cooking spray.
Bake at 450 degrees for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Chess Cake
steps: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan with butter.
Mix melted butter, 1 egg and cake mix; spread in buttered pan.
Mix together cream cheese, 2 eggs and sugar.
Pour over cake mixture.
Bake in 325° oven for 45 to 50 minutes until cake rises and falls.
Cool before serving.

recipes.title: Corn Dish
steps: In a large pan melt the butter and the cream cheese.
Drain the first 3 kinds of corn.
Add all of the corn to the butter and cream cheese.
Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili-Chicken Stew
ingredients: 6 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
2 (14 1/2 oz.) cans stewed tomatoes, undrained and chopped
steps: Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces.
Cook chicken and next 3 ingredients in hot oil in a Dutch oven until lightly browned. Add tomatoes and next 5 ingredients.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hearty Vegetable Beef Soup
steps: In large kettle cover beef with water and add chopped onion, salt and thyme.
Bring to boil.
Skim fat from surface.
Add split peas, cover and simmer over low heat, 3 to 4 hours.
Add all remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Adjust seasoning.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: No Peek Skillet Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. chicken, cut into serving pieces
1 can (14 1/2 oz.) whole peeled tomatoes, undrained
steps: In 12-inch skillet, heat oil and brown chicken; drain.
Stir in tomatoes, mushrooms and garlic.
Combine with soup mix. Simmer, covered, 45 minutes, or until chicken is tender.
Makes six servings.
Serve with hot noodles, hot bread and salad.

recipes.title: White Fudge
steps: Combine sugar, sour cream, milk, butter, corn syrup and salt in a heavy 2-quart saucepan.
Stir over moderate heat until sugar is dissolved and mixture reaches a boil.
Boil for 9 to 10 minutes to soft ball stage.
Remove from heat and allow to stand until lukewarm, about 1 hour.
Add vanilla and beat until mixture begins to lose its gloss and hold shape (very little beating required). Quickly stir in nuts.
Turn into a well-greased pan and let stand until firm.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Meat Loaf
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients with 1 tomato paste can of water in small bowl.
Combine ground beef, egg, onion, salt and crackers in large bowl, mixing well.
Add half the tomato paste mixture, mixing well.
Place in shallow baking pan.
Spread remaining tomato paste mixture over top.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Todd'S Best Chicken Salad
steps: Boil chicken, then cut into small chunks.
Add mayonnaise and honey to desired texture and taste.
Add a pinch or two of garlic. Mix in salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Janet'S Calico Relish
steps: Cut green and red peppers into quarters; remove seeds.
Peel and quarter onions; grind carrots, green and red peppers and onions through food chopper (coarse).
Place in kettle.
Cover with boiling water.
Stir in sugar, salt and vinegar.
Bring to boiling point.
Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally for 5 minutes.
Ladle into hot sterilized jars and seal.
Yield: about 8 to 8 1/2 pint jars.

recipes.title: Lazy Man Pierogi
steps: Saute onions with butter.
Add mushrooms, drained, until cooked.
Mix in sauerkraut (drained) and noodles.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Rotel
ingredients: 1 medium pkg. spaghetti (I use linguini noodles)
steps: Boil chicken and debone; save the broth.
Saute onion and bell pepper in butter or oleo.
Add Ro-Tel tomatoes, peas and mushrooms.
Cook spaghetti in broth and drain.
Combine remaining ingredients with spaghetti and place in casserole dish.
Layer the top with Velveeta and bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Fried Cheese Meltaways
ingredients: 1 lb. cheese, cut into 3/4-inch cubes (Swiss, Monterey Jack, Cheddar, American or Mozzarella)
1 c. Bisquick or Jiffy baking mix
steps: Heat oil (2-inches) in fryer to 375°.
Beat 1 cup baking mix, milk and egg with beater until smooth.
Coat cheese cubes lightly with baking mix.
Insert a wooden toothpick in each cheese cube. Dip in batter, covering cheese completely.
Fry several cubes at a time, turning carefully, until golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes.
Drain on paper towel.
Makes about 45 appetizers.

recipes.title: Swiss Potatoes
steps: Peel and slice potatoes.
Boil with bouillon in water until tender.
Layer with butter and Swiss cheese. Bake at 350° until hot.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Stewed Meat
steps: Cut beef into small pieces.
Place in casserole dish.
Cover with undiluted soup.
Rinse can with about 1/4 cup water.
Season. Cover and bake in slow to moderate oven for 2 hours or until cooked (should break apart easily).
Serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Frosting
steps: Beat cream cheese and margarine together until smooth. Add powdered sugar and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Spread on any two or three layer cake. Sprinkle with coconut flakes and pecans.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole Supreme
steps: Mash squash.
Add all ingredients, except crumbs and butter. Put 1/2 of crumbs in bottom of casserole dish; cover with squash mixture.
Sprinkle crumbs on top.
Dot with butter.
Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Barbecue Relish
steps: Pare cucumbers and remove seeds.
Grind vegetables fine; sprinkle with salt.
Let stand 1 hour; drain.
Add sugar and vinegar mixture.
Boil 20 minutes and can hot.

recipes.title: Eric'S Turnover Fun
steps: Press each crescent a little larger than it comes from roll. Place some ham and cheese in the middle.
Fold over into turnover shape.
Sprinkle on seed.
Bake as directed on can.

recipes.title: "So Good" Casserole
ingredients: 6 or 8 oz. shell macaroni, cooked and drained
1 lb. ground meat (3/4 lb. ground beef and 1/4 lb. ground pork)
steps: Prepare shells according to package; drain.
Brown meat and onion in skillet; add salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Simmer until cooked; drain.
In a 9 x 13-inch casserole pan, arrange alternating layers of shells, meat and corn.
Heat soup in skillet to get all the "meat brown" using enough water to rinse out soup can.
Pour over top of casserole.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pistachio Salad
steps: Stir together the first 2 ingredients.
Add the last 3 ingredients.
Cover and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Margaret'S Peanut Brittle
steps: Mix soda and salt together; set aside.
Combine sugar, water and syrup; bring to a boil.
Stir in peanuts gradually so as not to lose the boil.
Keep a rolling boil until peanuts pop and turn brown (309° on a candy thermometer).
Add soda and salt; stir well. Pour onto a well-greased cookie sheet.
Put cookie sheet on trivet so air can get under it.
When cold, break into pieces.

recipes.title: Terrific Turkey
steps: Clean and prepare turkey. Pat dry. Rub turkey with butter or margarine; sprinkle lightly with poultry seasoning. Stuff inside cavity with prunes and apricots, about half and half, and large apple, quartered. Place on large sheet of heavy-duty foil. Pour 2 capfuls of apricot brandy over turkey. Roll foil around turkey and seal at top.
Cook at 350° until done.
Baste occasionally. Will be juicy and tender.

recipes.title: No-Bake Cherry Custard Cake
ingredients: 4 oz. pkg. sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix
steps: Tear cake into bite-size pieces.
Press into 11 x 7 inch baking dish.
In a mixing bowl, combine pudding, milk and lite sour cream.
Beat until thickened, about 2 minutes. Spread over cake.
Spoon cherry pie filling evenly over top of cake.
Chill thoroughly.
Serves 12.
184 calories, 9 mg cholesterol, 3 g fat, 319 mg sodium and 4 g protein.

recipes.title: Oven Omelet
steps: Mix all ingredients except margarine and pour into greased 2-quart baking dish.
Drizzle with melted margarine.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Working Girl'S Favorite(Crock-Pot Cooking)
steps: Thoroughly combine all ingredients, except biscuits or waffles, in lightly oiled crock-pot.
Cover and cook on low heat setting for 6 to 10 hours.
Serve spooned over hot biscuits. Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Southern Corn Pudding
steps: Combine corn, sugar, salt, pepper and eggs and mix well.
Add butter and heat until butter is melted, then put in a pan and bake 1 hour in oven at 350° or until done.

recipes.title: Fruit And Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 (8 oz. each) pkg. cream cheese, softened
steps: Mix cheese, pudding and juice in food processor.
Add by hand the fruit cocktail.
Form into ball.
Cover with almonds.
Chill. Serve surrounded by gingersnaps.

recipes.title: Dill Pickles
ingredients: small whole cucumber or wedged large ones
steps: Mix vinegar, salt and water.
Bring mixture to a boil. Prepare cucumbers and fill jars.
Place 1 dill head, grape leaf and separated garlic clove into each jar.
Pour boiling mixture on top and seal each jar tightly.
Turn upside-down so liquid gets to garlic and dill.

recipes.title: Homemade Chili Sauce
steps: Mix together in a 3-quart pan.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 1 1/2 hours or until thick and reduce heat again.
Stir occasionally.
Can be stored in refrigerator for 1 month or frozen in small quantities.
Makes 3 cups.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Mix ingredients well.
Pour into unbaked 9-inch pastry pie shell and bake in 350° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Lasagna
steps: Brown the meat in large skillet and drain.
Stir in spaghetti sauce, onions and garlic salt.
Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and layer bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Following the noodles, layer half the cottage cheese, Mozzarella and meat sauce.
Repeat the layers.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes and then let stand for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Reuben Casserole
steps: Combine noodles, meat and marinade.
Mix lightly.
Spoon into 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Combine sauerkraut, dressing and caraway; mix lightly.
Spoon over noodle mixture.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Top with croutons and cheese.
Continue baking 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Cornbread
ingredients: 10 oz. grated low fat cheddar cheese
steps: Over low heat, cook milk, cornmeal and salt until the mixture thickens. Stir in beaten egg yolk and cheese. Beat egg white until stiff and fold in. Place in muffin tins that have been sprayed with non-stick spray. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: No Cook Cookies
steps: Roll out bread dough from favorite bread recipe until 1/4 inch thick.
Cut into shapes with cookie cutters.
Place on oiled sheet to rise.
Bake 30 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Rosy Pineapple Chicken
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Rub chicken pieces with salt, rosemary and pepper.
Arrange in shallow glass baking dish.
Place larger pieces in corners with smaller pieces in center.
Sprinkle shallots over top.
Combine crushed pineapple with juice, paprika, and ginger in small bowl; spoon over chicken.

recipes.title: Pepper Souffle
steps: Add all ingredients in mixing bowl and stir together.
Pour over Fritos in baking dish.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Macadamia Cream Pie
steps: Unwrap cream cheese and put it into a 2-quart casserole. Microwave on 50% (Medium) 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Blend in peanut butter, then milk.
Stir in sugar.

recipes.title: Quick Fudge
steps: Cook all ingredients except nuts and vanilla until a ball forms when tested in cold water.
Remove from heat.
Add nuts and vanilla.
Beat until thick.
Pour into a buttered pan and let cool. Cut in squares.

recipes.title: Beer-Cheese Bread
steps: Mix all ingredients and put into 2-quart greased casserole. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Venison Meatballs
ingredients: 1 can (8-oz.) water chestnuts, drained, finely chopped
steps: In a bowl, combine egg, bread crumbs, water chestnuts, soy sauce, ginger and garlic. Crumble the venison and sausage over the mixture and mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls. In a skillet over medium heat, brown meatballs in batches in 2 teaspoons oil, adding 1 teaspoon oil as needed. Transfer meatballs to a slow cooker. In the same skillet, saute mushrooms in 1 teaspoon oil until tender. Add the broth and 1 cup wate; :pour over the meatballs. Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours. Remove meatballs and mushrooms with a slotted spoon, keep warm. Strain cooking juices into a saucepan. Combine cornstarch and remaining water until smooth, add to saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Serve over the meatballs, mushrooms and noodles. Yield: 8-10 servings.

recipes.title: Pear Waldorf Salad
steps: Toss all ingredients. Serve on salad greens. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Party Crackers
steps: Mix dressing, oil, dill and lemon pepper in a small bowl. Pour mixture over oyster crackers and stir to coat.
Bake at 250° for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Goes great with seafood gumbo.

recipes.title: Bright Tomato Marinade
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. minced fresh basil or 1 tsp. dried whole basil
3/4 tsp. minced fresh thyme or 1/4 tsp. dried whole thyme
steps: Combine first 8 ingredients in a jar.
Cover tightly and shake vigorously. Combine tomatoes and onion in a shallow container. Pour dressing over vegetables. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.
To serve, use slotted spoon.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Tortilla Roll Up
steps: Mix the first 8 ingredients together.
Spread on tortilla. Roll up and wrap in Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate for 8 hours.
Slice and serve with salsa.
(Can be frozen.)

recipes.title: "Recipe For Life"
steps: Mix thoroughly.
Add Tears of Joy, Sorrow and Sympathy for others.
Fold in 4 cups of Prayer and Faith to lighten the other ingredients.
After pouring all of this into your Family Life, bake well with the Heat of Human Kindness.
Serve with a Smile.

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza
steps: Lay rolls flat on cookie sheet or 2 pizza pans.
Bake until light brown.
Mix together and spread on cooled rolls the remaining ingredients.
Press down and let set in the refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours.

recipes.title: Amaretti
steps: Lightly grease 3 cookie sheets.
Process almonds and sugar in food processor or blender, until finely ground.
Beat egg whites in a large bowl with electric mixer until stiff peaks form.
Beat in extract.
Gently stir in almond mixture.
Result will be a thick, sticky paste.
Drop rounded teaspoonfuls 1 1/2
inches apart on prepared cookie sheets.
Dust top with confectioners sugar stirred through a sieve.
Let stand 2 hours at room temperature, so cookies retain shape and tops dry.

recipes.title: Jello Salad
steps: Cut and drain fruit.
Mix dry Jell-O into cottage cheese.
Mix fruit and cottage cheese and add Cool Whip; chill.
Good.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Pie
steps: Dissolve cornstarch and sugar in water.
Cook until thick. Stir in the peach jello; cool and pour over sliced peaches put in baked pie shell.
Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Shrimp With Angel Hair Pasta
steps: Shell and devein shrimp.
Rinse and pat dry.
Coat with olive oil; dust well with salt and pepper and bake in a 350° oven for 4 to 5 minutes.
Remove from oven; saute in skillet with butter, garlic and wine.
Add tomato sauce and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve over angel hair pasta.

recipes.title: Homemade Butter
ingredients: 2 c. heavy cream (let stand at room temperature 1 hour before you begin, speeds up process)
steps: Put cream in containers and begin shaking.
Keep shaking.
You will see the liquid turn to solid and it will sound like a rock is inside of container.
When you open lid, all cream will be in a ball.
Place butter ball in chilled ice water, excess cream will float away.
Chill and serve.
Great fun.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Dipped Apricots
steps: Combine sugar and water in saucepan.
Bring to a boil and cook 5 minutes.
Reduce heat and add apricots.
Gently simmer 2 minutes. Remove apricots with a slotted spoon and let cool on waxed paper. Combine 1/3 of the chocolate, shortening and brandy with 2 tablespoons of water in a small saucepan.
Heat to melt chocolate, stirring smooth.
Add remaining chocolate and stir until melted. Dip apricots halfway into chocolate and place on waxed paper to cool.
Store, covered, in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Spicy Penne With Cauliflower(Yield: 4 Servings)
steps: 1. Start heating large pot of water to boiling for the pasta. In small bowl, combine the raisins and 1/2 cup of hot water.
Let stand until raisins have softened, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, in small dry skillet, cook the pine nuts over low heat until lightly toasted, stirring frequently, about 4 minutes.
Remove from the heat.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in hot	water.	To
Jell-O mixture, add cranberry sauce.
Chill
slightly
and
add other ingredients. Place in mold and chill overnight.

recipes.title: Hot Peppers And Wieners
ingredients: 6 pkg. hot dogs, sliced into 1-inch pieces
steps: Combine everything, except wieners and peppers, in very large pan or dishpan.
Bring to a good boil.
Add peppers and wieners and boil for 10 minutes.
Pack in pint jars.
Cold pack 15 minutes in boiling water bath.
Yields about 14 pints.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cornbread
steps: Mix all ingredients together and bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Seafood Gumbo
steps: Cook okra in large iron pot with 2 to 3 tablespoons vegetable oil, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Cook until the sliminess has diminished.

recipes.title: Apricot-Banana Mold
steps: Drain apricots, measuring liquid (syrup).
Add water to syrup to make 3/4 cup liquid.
Heat 1 cup water to boiling in glass bowl in microwave (2 to 3 minutes).
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in liquid.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Mix apricots and banana into thickened gelatin.
Turn into 4-cup mold or serving bowl.
Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Orange Poppy Seed Dressing Or Dip
steps: Mix together and serve over or with fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
steps: Cook water, sugar, corn syrup and cornstarch in double boiler until thick.
Add food coloring and jello to mixture.
When mixture is cool, add strawberries.
Pour into a 9-inch baked pie crust.
Top with Dream Whip and serve.

recipes.title: Easy Cake
ingredients: 1 box Butter Recipe cake mix (white or yellow)
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Bake 35 minutes at 350°.
Cool 10 minutes; remove from pan.

recipes.title: Daine'S Lemon Mousse
steps: Dissolve gelatine in the cold water; leave for 5 minutes.
Add lemon juice, hot water and sugar; cool.
Refrigerate until mixture starts to gel (but not completely gelled).
Whip the egg whites until foamy and stiff, then whip through gelatine mixture.
Combine both, mixing them well.
Put in a serving dish; refrigerate for an hour or more.

recipes.title: Rocky Road Cookies
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: In a double boiler over low heat, combine chocolate, butter and milk.
Mix together until smooth.
In a large bowl, mix marshmallows and walnuts.
Pour chocolate mixture over marshmallow-nut mixture; mix thoroughly.
Line a 10 x 9-inch dish with waxed paper.
Pour mixture into pan.
Chill for about 3 hours. Chop into pieces.

recipes.title: Fudge
steps: Add sugar, salt and cocoa.
Mix.
Pour in milk.
Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Cook on medium heat until mixture reaches soft ball stage.
Remove from heat.
Add butter and vanilla.
Stir until mixture begins to stiffen.
Pour into buttered pans.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1 c. stuffing crumbs mix (Stove Top seasoned)
steps: Place chicken in 9 x 13. Top each breast with slice of Swiss cheese. Spread soup over cheese. Top with slice tomato. Sprinkle stuffing mix that was mixed with margarine. Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 35 minutes. Serve with rice pilaf or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Cherry Dessert
steps: Heat first 3 ingredients together until glazed.
Cool in refrigerator; don't let it set.
Chop up.
Add next 3 ingredients to cooled mixture.
Fold in whipped cream.
Refrigerate 1 to 1 1/2 hours to set.

recipes.title: Jo-Di'S Anniversary Cake
steps: Combine juice to one can.
Mix well all ingredients.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch greased and floured
pan in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Golden Punch
steps: Mix all the juices and add 1 1/2 quarts water.
Mix well.
Add ginger ale just before serving and garnish with pineapple.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Cook and drain mixed vegetables; set aside.
Mix mayonnaise, cheese and onion; set aside.
Melt margarine.
Crush crackers and mix with margarine.
Put vegetables in casserole dish, then mayonnaise mixture, then cracker mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
steps: Boil sweet potatoes in jackets until tender. Peel and mash to make 2 cups. Cream until smooth and combine with other ingredients. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and cook for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Makes 2 (9-inch) pies.

recipes.title: Chicken Nuggets
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. boneless chicken breast, cut in 1-inch pieces
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Combine soup mix with bread crumbs.
Dip chicken into soup mixture, coating well.
Place in lightly greased baking pan and drizzle with butter.
Bake, turning once, for 10 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. cooked squash in 1/2 c. water, drained and mashed
1 can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup
steps: Melt butter; coat the stuffing.
Put layer in bottom of casserole.
Reserve 1/2 for topping.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Thai Chicken Saute
steps: Luau Style:
Take one large pineapple and cut 1 1/2-inch slices from top and bottom of an unpeeled fruit.
Save these pieces.
Use a long, skinny knife to cut around the fruit, 1/2-inch inside the rind.
Loosen fruit at top and bottom and push it out of the rind in one piece.
Cut peeled pineapple into 6 or 8 wedge-shaped pieces.
Reassemble pieces and refill shell. Replace top and bottom pieces.
Serve by removing pineapple top and taking out sections with fork or fingers.

recipes.title: Beef And Cheese Ball
steps: With cream cheese at room temperature, add Worcestershire sauce, Accent, chopped onion and 1 package beef (chopped).
Line bowl with remaining beef.
Spoon mixture into bowl and refrigerate.
Invert onto serving dish.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dream Delight
ingredients: 1 pkg. Dream Whip, mixed according to pkg. directions
steps: Put pineapple, water and sugar in saucepan and bring to a boil.
Add jello; dissolve, then let partially congeal.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Pour into mold to congeal.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
steps: Mix first 8 ingredients.
Pour in jar and refrigerate for 48 hours.
Cook noodles, cool and drain.
Add red onion, pimento and cucumber.
Pour in the jar mixture and chill 24 hours.

recipes.title: Microwave Banana Pudding
steps: Beat egg yolks lightly.
Set aside.
Combine sugar, cornstarch, salt and milk in microwave safe bowl;
mix well. Microwave on Medium-High for 7 minutes or until thickened, stirring twice.
Stir a small
amount of hot mixture into beaten egg yolk; stir egg yolks into hot mixture.
Microwave on Medium-High until custard coats metal spoon, stirring once.
Beat in butter and vanilla until butter is melted.
Layer vanilla wafers, banana slices and custard alternately in bowl.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dessert Soup
ingredients: 1/2 c. orange and grapefruit sections, mixed
steps: Puree strawberries in a blender until they are smooth.
Pour into saucepan.
Add water, sugar, tapioca and salt.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Remove form heat. Add lemon juice.
Chill.
Before serving, stir in orange and grapefruit.
Serve cold.

recipes.title: Green Peppers, Tomatoes And Onion(Portuguese)
ingredients: 1 small red hot pepper or 1/4 tsp. ground red hot pepper
steps: Heat oil in skillet with garlic.
Wash and cut up peppers the long way; slice onion heavy.
Saute a few minutes in skillet.
Add red peppers, tomatoes and salt.
Cook, covered, for 2 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 regular pkg. (dry) Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
steps: Combine the Kraft, the Philly and the Hidden Valley.
Mix well and shape into a ball.
Roll in the nuts.
Chill at least an hour before serving.

recipes.title: Broccoli Bake
ingredients: 1 (16 to 20 oz.) bag frozen broccoli bits
2 c. dry stuffing mix (i.e., Pepperidge Farm)
steps: Microwave the frozen broccoli bits for eight minutes.
While broccoli is cooking, mix the beaten eggs, diced onion, soup and stuffing mix in a large bowl.
Add broccoli to other ingredients and mix well.
Pour mixture into a greased casserole dish.
Top with the shredded Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Emerald Chicken
steps: On low heat, combine jello, water and pineapple juice in a saucepan.
Add marshmallows and stir until marshmallows dissolve. Cool until it begins to set.
Add pineapple and cottage cheese. Whip the whipping cream and fold into mixture.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch dish and chill.
May be garnished with chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Chicken Adobo (Merlyn'S Style)(Philippine Cuisine)
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. cut up chicken parts
steps: Saute garlic and onion in cooking oil; brown chicken parts. Add all other ingredients.
Cook until done or until juice reduced into sauce-like consistency, stirring occasionally.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Fish Courtbouillon
steps: Saute onions and bell peppers until tender.
Add all canned ingredients.
After about 5 minutes add fish and cook until tender.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Mix cream cheese, pineapple, onion and seasoned salt.
Shape into a ball and roll in pecans. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Stuffed Eggplant
steps: Scoop middle out of eggplant.
Save shell halves.
Saute pepper, celery and onion in butter. Add raw diced eggplant.
Add ground beef. Add bread crumbs, egg and a little water.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Put mixture in shell of eggplant and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to one hour.
Top with grated cheese.

recipes.title: Lemon Cake
steps: Prepare cake as directed on package.
Pour into prepared pan (greased and floured) Bundt pan.
Bake 350 degrees for 40 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted into center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Spicy Appetizer Franks
steps: Prepare spaghetti sauce mix, adding tomato sauce, water and salad oil as label directs.
Cut franks into bite size pieces or use cocktail.
Heat in sauce; serve with toothpicks.
Keep warm.

recipes.title: Rainbow Punch
ingredients: 1 (46 oz.) can Del Monte unsweetened pineapple juice, chilled
1 (46 oz.) can Del Monte orange juice, chilled
steps: Combine juices in punch bowl. Add scoops of sherbet. Pour ginger ale over sherbet. Makes about 25 small servings.

recipes.title: Spiced Nuts
steps: Mix the first 4 ingredients, then mix the pecans well with the mixture. Spread thinly onto cookie sheet and bake at 250° for 1 hour.
Stir several times.

recipes.title: Impossible Pie
steps: Put all ingredients together in electric blender, mix well. Pour in ungreased 9-inch glass pie plate.
Bake in a preheated oven at 400° for 10 minutes, reduce oven to 350° for 35 minutes. Do not open oven door until baking time is over.

recipes.title: Soft Molasses Cake
steps: Stir to a stiff batter with flour (1 1/2 to 2 cups) enough to make a stiff batter.
Then pour over 1 cup of boiling water in which 1 teaspoon soda has been dissolved.
Either loaf or layer.

recipes.title: Barbecue With Chicken
ingredients: 2 double chicken breasts, cooked and diced
steps: Brown hamburger, onion and celery.
Put all ingredients (except chicken) into crock-pot.
Cook on low for a couple of hours.
Add diced chicken one hour before serving.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Dessert
steps: Drain oranges; reserve syrup.
Take 1/4 cup of syrup, add water to make 1 cup.
Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water, then add the cup of water and juice.
Add sherbet by spoonfuls, stirring until melted.
Chill until thick.
Fold in oranges.
Save some to garnish.
Return to refrigerator until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Spiced Nuts
steps: Cook first four ingredients until soft ball stage.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Put on wax paper until cool and break apart.

recipes.title: Chocolate Nut Pie
steps: Cream eggs and sugar.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together and chill before serving.

recipes.title: Frozen Cucumbers
steps: Peel and slice cucumbers; sprinkle with salt.
Stir and let set for 1 hour.
Drain; slice onions and mix with cucumbers.
Pack in containers.
Cover with first mixtures; then freeze.

recipes.title: Hot Pepper Relish
steps: Cut peppers in half; slice halves in small strips.
Do not remove all of the seeds from the hot peppers.
Slice onions.
Put all ingredients into large container.
Bring to a boil.
If you need more liquid, add more vinegar and sugar.
Put into hot jars and seal as soon as mixture comes to a boil.
This is a good relish to put on sandwiches.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. herb seasoned stuffing mix
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
steps: Cook squash and onion until tender in a small amount of boiling salted water; drain.
Season with salt, pepper and 1 tablespoon margarine.
Stir in chicken soup, sour cream and pimiento.
Combine 1/2 cup margarine and stuffing mix, stirring until well blended.

recipes.title: Sherbet
ingredients: 2 (28 oz.) bottles any flavor soda pop or 4 (12 oz.) cans
steps: Mix together and freeze in ice cream freezer.
Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Lemony Punch
steps: In pitcher, combine grape juice, sugar and lemon juice concentrate.
Stir until sugar dissolves.
Chill.
Just before serving, add club soda and serve over ice.
Serves about 7.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Boil potatoes with salt and refrigerate overnight.
Cut in cubes and stir in all ingredients.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch greased casserole or pan.
Bake at 350°
for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1/4 c. each: red wine vinegar and sugar
steps: Cook onion in butter or margarine until softened.
Add cabbage and vinegar.
Cook gently, covered, until cabbage is crisp-tender, about 12 minutes.
Add sugar, caraway seed, salt and pepper.
Cook gently 5 minutes longer, stirring often to prevent burning.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Add remaining ingredients and mix.
Pour into baked pie shell.

recipes.title: 7 Layer Cookies
steps: In 9 x 13-inch pan, melt butter.
Sprinkle remaining ingredients over butter in order listed.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed somewhat
steps: Mix ingredients in a large bowl.
Pour in a large baking dish (sprayed).	Top with dots of margarine and about 1/2 cup cornflake crumbs.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours in 325° oven.
Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Chicken Stuffing Bake
ingredients: 1 small pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix
steps: Place chicken, mushrooms and water chestnuts in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
In separate bowl, mix sour cream and soup.
Pour soup mix over chicken and vegetable mix.

recipes.title: "Rinktum Ditty"
steps: Saute onion in butter.
Add tomatoes and soda and heat.
Add spices.
Add some of the mixture to the beaten egg, then combine egg mixture with tomato and spice mixture.
As soon as heated again, add grated cheese and heat slowly, just until cheese is melted.
Serve on saltines or toast points.

recipes.title: Piccalilli Relish
ingredients: 4 qt. (32 medium) green tomatoes, peeled and chopped
steps: Sprinkle salt over vegetables and mix.
Let stand 3 to 4 hours.
Drain.
Press to remove excess liquid.
Add sugar, spices and horseradish to vinegar; simmer 15 minutes.
Add vegetables and heat to boiling.
Pack, boiling hot, into hot pint jars, leaving 1/4-inch head space.
Adjust caps.
Process 10 minutes in boiling water bath.
Yields 7 pints.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Mix first five ingredients very well.
Place in a casserole dish.
Crush crackers and mix with butter.
Place this on top. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham Spread
steps: Rinse 1 small can sauerkraut and mix in ham and cheese to taste.
Then add Miracle Whip to taste.
Serve on small rye or pumpernickel bread.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate Mix
steps: Mix thoroughly and store in a tight container.

recipes.title: Nacho Bean Dip
steps: Mix refried beans and taco seasoning together.
Spread out in bottom of 9
X 13-inch pan.
Soften cream cheese and mix with sour cream.
Spread on top layer of beans.
Sprinkle shredded taco cheese on top.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Sunset Salad
ingredients: 1 large pkg. lemon, orange or pineapple Jell-O
steps: Add Jell-O to 1 1/2 cups of boiling water, stirring until dissolved, then add salt, juice, pineapple and carrots.
Stir until blended.
Refrigerate until set.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Coconut Sour Cream Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. whipped cream or Cool Whip
steps: Prepare cake mix according to directions, making 2 layers, then split each layer when cool.

recipes.title: Joe'S Roast Beef And Potatoes
steps: Wash and cut potatoes into 1-inch long strips.
Melt butter in black frypan.
Add potatoes; coat with butter.
Bake until tender, turning several times, at 350°.
When potatoes are light brown, add roast beef and stir lightly.
Cook about 15 minutes, until beef is hot.

recipes.title: Fruit Punch
steps: Make an ice ring of 7-Up.
If punch bowl is large enough, you can double the recipe.

recipes.title: Mushroom Muenster Chicken
steps: Cut boneless chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Pour two beaten eggs over chicken.
Let sit overnight in refrigerator or at least 3 to 4 hours.
Dip chicken in seasoned bread crumbs and brown in a pan.
Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Add sliced mushrooms and top with cheese.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
steps: Mix well and serve with raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. sweet potatoes from meat counter at grocery store
steps: Mix pineapple, sugar and margarine and pour over potatoes in Pyrex dish; sprinkle raisins and bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Cook squash and onions together until tender.
While squash is still warm, add cream cheese, crumbled, and oleo, cut in small pieces.
Save enough oleo to dot on top.
Place half cracker crumbs on top.
Add eggs and place in a greased casserole.
Cover with remaining cracker crumbs and dot with butter.
Bake in 325° oven until set and crackers are slightly brown.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Chili
steps: Brown ground beef in Dutch oven.
Drain fat.
Return pan to medium-low heat and add remaining ingredients.
Cook, stirring occasionally, 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Syrup
steps: Cook for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat; leave until cold.
The syrup must be ice cold when you drop the koeksisters into it. Roll out the dough until thin; cut into 1/4-inch strips and braid, then cut each braid into 3-inch pieces.
Fry in hot oil, three at a time.
Drop into ice cold syrup for a few minutes.
Take out, drain excess syrup and eat.

recipes.title: Prosciutto With Melon
steps: Melon should be ripe and chilled.
Cut in half and remove seeds.
Slice into pieces 3/4-inch wide.
Cut along bottom of flesh near rind, but do not separate rind from melon.
This makes the melon easier to eat and preserves its appearance.
Put 2 slices of Prosciutto on each melon slice.
Serve 2 melon slices per person.

recipes.title: Greek Style Green Beans
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. fresh dill, chopped or 1 tsp. dry dill
steps: Saute onion in oil.
Add tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes.
Add green beans, seasonings and a few tablespoons of water.
Cover and cook on low heat until beans are tender.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, cook and cut into bite size pieces
steps: Mix soup, sour cream, cooked noodles and broth.
Add chicken. Mix well.
Pour into baking dish.
Sprinkle cracker crumbs on top, then sprinkle 1/2 cup grated cheese on top of that.
Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
steps: Pre-heat oven to 380 degrees.
In a medium size baking dish, mix beans, onion and peppers.
Bake for 35 minutes...remove from oven fold in cheese and bake for additional 10 minutes.
Serve with corn tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
steps: Roll steak in flour and brown in a large skillet.
Add all other ingredients plus 1 quart of water.
Simmer for 1 hour or until tender.

recipes.title: Romaine Salad Dressing
steps: Blend in food processor.
Store in refrigerator for 2 or 3 days before using.
Serve over romaine, croutons and avocados and sprinkle with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Mincemeat Squares
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Borden's Eagle Brand milk
steps: Mix all in a large bowl.
Spoon into well-greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Cool and cut and roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Layered Taco Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
steps: Brown turkey; drain, then add water and taco seasoning mix. Simmer until thickened.
Place meat mixture in bottom of pan.

recipes.title: Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/2 c. bread crumbs or plain soda crackers, crushed
pepper, chervil (garlic) and oregano to taste
steps: Halve tomatoes and trim ends so they lie flat in pan.
Put in buttered pan.
Mix dry ingredients and melted margarine.
Pat on tomatoes firmly.
(Especially delicious when Maryland tomatoes are used.)
Bake at 300° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Oven-Barbecued Ribs
steps: Place ribs in a greased roasting pan.
Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.
Drain ribs.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
steps: Mix and bring to boil.
Remove from heat.
Pour over browned meat.
Bake in covered pan until last 15 minutes, then remove lid.

recipes.title: Rainbow Jello
ingredients: 1 can plus 1/4 c. whole milk or 2% for a total of 3 c. milk mixture
steps: Note:
If you have about 6 to 8 hours on and off during the day, It's easy and kids love it (adults too).

recipes.title: Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 4 garlic cloves or 1 tsp. minced garlic
steps: Marinate pork tenderloins several hours or overnight.
Ziploc bag can be used.
Charcoal tenderloins on grill for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Refrigerate for a few minutes. Form into one large or 2 medium balls.
Roll in chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Pineapple Icebox Pie
steps: Cream together the cream cheese and powdered sugar.
To this, add pineapple (juice and all).
Blend well.
Add small tub Cool Whip.
Pour into graham cracker crust and refrigerate.

recipes.title: *Skillet Squash Au Gratin
ingredients: 4 c. thinly sliced summer or zucchini squash
1/4 c. water or 2 sliced and peeled tomatoes
steps: Melt butter in skillet.
Add squash, onion, salt, pepper and water or tomatoes.
Cook, covered, for 10 minutes or longer, until squash is tender.
Sprinkle with cheese and a teaspoon of soy sauce, if desired.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Toothpaste Putty(It'S Stretchy)
steps: Will need small dish and powdered pencil lead (optional).

recipes.title: Heavenly Hash
steps: Cut apples and oranges into bite size pieces.
Quarter cherries.
Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Line bottom of dish with cut up chicken.
Pour melted butter over chicken.
Mix chicken broth with cream of chicken soup.
Pour over chicken.
Mix Bisquick with milk; pour on top.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes, until brown.

recipes.title: Zucchini Relish
steps: Wash zucchini.
Peel if tough.
Grind zucchini, onion and peppers.
Put in pan and mix with salt.
Stand overnight in refrigerator.
Rinse in colander and drain.
Place spices, vinegar and sugar with mix.
Blend.
Bring to a boil.
Simmer 30 minutes. Put in canning jars while hot to seal.

recipes.title: Broccoli Topped Tuna Bake
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. or 2 c. macaroni or noodles, cooked
2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of mushroom soup
2 (6 1/2 oz.) tuna fish or chicken (in water), drained and flaked
steps: Prepare macaroni or noodles; drain.
Reserve 1/2 cup Cheez Whiz.
In large bowl combine cream of mushroom soup, milk and remaining Cheez Whiz.
Stir in macaroni, tuna fish and pepper. Pour into 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes. Stir top with broccoli and pour in remaining Cheez Whiz. Bake 5 minutes longer or until hot.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Sugar-Free Lemon Icebox Pie
ingredients: 2 small boxes sugar-free Jell-O pudding mix ("vanilla")
steps: Mix pudding with 2 1/2 cups skim milk; fold in Cool Whip Light. Pour in 2 graham cracker crusts. Let set 2 hours. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Mexican Chip Dip
steps: Mix all together in crock-pot.
Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
ingredients: 1 (3 1/2 oz.) instant French vanilla or coconut cream pudding mix
steps: Mix and beat ingredients.
Bake in 2 medium loaf pans that have been greased and floured.
Bake at 350°
for 45 minutes. Remove from pans and cool.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
steps: Combine ingredients, adding only enough mayonnaise to hold salad together.
Serve on lettuce leaf and sprinkle with paprika. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Chicken Casserole
steps: Boil chicken until fork tender; remove from water and drain. Mix soup and sour cream (may use fat free sour cream; it works just as well as the real stuff).

Pull or cut chicken into bite size portions and mix with sour cream and soup mixture. Layer in casserole dish starting with crushed Ritz crackers; then put a layer of chicken mixture, repeat this until all of chicken is used and ending with crushed Ritz crackers on top.
Melt oleo and pour over top and bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hominy Casserole
steps: Combine hominy, margarine, garlic salt, salt and pepper.
Heat until margarine is melted.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well and put into casserole dish.
Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Heat juice to boiling; add jello and sugar.
Add water, fruit and nuts.
Chill until set.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Place corn-on-the-cob still in the husks in a sink of water. Let soak for about 1 hour.
Remove from water and let drain for a couple of minutes.
Place on grill and close.
Cook for about 30 minutes, turning occasionally.

recipes.title: Cheesy Breakfast Casserole(Breakfast)
ingredients: 10 slices bread, crusts removed and torn into small pieces or cut into 1/2-inch pieces
steps: Generously butter a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Arrange bread cubes in dish and sprinkle with cheese.
Beat together the next 7 ingredients and pour evenly over cheese and bread.
Refrigerate overnight or up to 24 hours, covered.
Preheat oven to 325°.
Bake casserole, uncovered, until set, about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bar
steps: Melt together in large pan the oleo and peanut butter. Mix in powdered sugar, brown sugar and vanilla (this gets very stiff and will need to be mixed by hand). Put evenly on cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Marvelous Meat Loaf
steps: Combine all ingredients; add ground beef last.
Mix well. Press into 10 x 10-inch casserole dish.
Cover; bake 1 hour at 350°; uncover last 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cupcake Ice Cream Cones
steps: Mix cake according to its directions.
Fill cones about 1/2 full of cake batter.
Set cones in muffin pan.
Bake about 20 minutes or until top springs back.
Batter will rise giving appearance of an ice cream cone.
Frost as desired adding decoration according to occasion, such as jelly beans for Easter or Halloween or dye some coconut green for Easter.
Easy to make. Fun to decorate.

recipes.title: Baked Caramel Corn(Southern Living, 1982)
steps: Melt margarine.
Stir in brown sugar, honey and salt.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil 3 minutes without stirring. Remove from heat and stir in soda and vanilla.
Gradually pour over popped corn, mixing well.
Turn into large roaster pan sprayed with Pam.
Bake at 250° for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pizza Dip
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Mix spices in sour cream.
Layer ingredients in a pan in this order: cream cheese, sour cream mixed with spices, pizza sauce, pepperoni, pepper and onions.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Remove and put Mozzarella cheese on top.
Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer.
Serve with Fritos or tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Pizza Potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Empty potato slices and packet of seasoned sauce mix into ungreased 2-quart casserole dish.
Heat tomatoes and water to boiling; stir into potatoes.
Arrange pepperoni and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake, uncovered, 30 to 35 minutes.
You can substitute 1/2 pound ground beef, browned and drained, or 1/2 pound sausage.

recipes.title: Pea-Filled Onion Baskets
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Remove centers of onions and chop. Place onion halves in a small baking pan and bake 10 minutes. Combine chopped onions, oregano, peas, mushrooms, butter and red pepper and fill onion cavities.
Cover with foil and bake an additional 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika before serving.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Spinach Balls
steps: Cook spinach, drain and squeeze well.
Add remaining ingredients.
Shape into 3/4-inch balls.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.
Makes approximately 11 dozen.

recipes.title: Russian Dressing
steps: Mix all together and spread over chicken.

recipes.title: Ground Casserole
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
steps: Brown meat.
Drain and mix in onion.
