Add next 5 ingredients; mix well.
Stir in noodles.
Pour into 2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until hot.

recipes.title: My Homemade Chili
steps: Mix together ground beef and tomato sauce.
Work thoroughly with hands.
Chop onion, pepper and garlic.
Stir all this together in large chili pot and brown over medium heat.
Add tomatoes and puree.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fruit Dip
steps: Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well. Cover; chill thoroughly.
Serve dip with assortment of fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. smooth or crunchy peanut butter
steps: Combine peanut butter, sugar and egg. Mix well. Chill for 30 minutes. Spread mixture on cookie sheet and press down with fork. Preheat oven to 350°. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Cheese Loaf
steps: Melt cheese in double boiler.
Cook sausage until crisp and drain well.
Mix cheese and sausage together.
Put in loaf pan that
has
been sprayed with Pam.
Let set in refrigerator several hours or overnight.
Remove from pan and slice.
Serve with crackers, toast or thin sliced French bread.

recipes.title: Dandelion Greens
ingredients: 1 lb. dandelion greens, washed and cut in small pieces
steps: In a large pan, place dandelion greens, salt and water.
Cook about 10 to 20 minutes or until greens are tender.
Drain well.

recipes.title: Chicken Cordon Bleu Shortcut
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breasts halves (about one pound)
1 can (10 3/4 ounces) CAMPBELL'S condensed cream of chicken soup or 98% Fat Free Cream of Chicken soup
2 Tablespoons Chablis or other dry white wine
1/2 cooked chopped ham (deli ham works too)
4 cups cooked Medium egg noodles (about 3 cups uncooked)
steps: In medium skillet over medium-high heat, heat margarine.
Add Chicken and cook 10 minutes or until browned.
Set chicken aside.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Put nuts in baked pie shell and pour syrup mixture over nuts.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad(From My Sister, Filomena)
steps: Mix
all ingredients except cheese and croutons.
Place in large casserole dish (9 x 13-inches).
Sprinkle cheese and croutons
on top.
Bake at 450° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
steps: Cook until thick.
Bake pie crust.
Put strawberries in crust. Pour mixture over strawberries.
Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Luby'S Chopped Steak
steps: Mix ingredients.
Shape into 3 or 4 fat patties.
Pan-fry, turning until beef is done.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 can sauerkraut (medium or large), drained and rinsed
steps: Mix and let set overnight in refrigerator.
This will keep for several days in a sealed container in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
steps: Pre-cook broccoli and chicken.
Blend soup, milk, sour cream, mayo, lemon juice and cheese.
Oil pan.
Lay out broccoli.
Cover with chicken pieces.
Pour sauce over top.
Pour bread crumb topping.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 large hen, cooked tender and cut in bits
1 (16 oz.) pkg. spaghetti, cooked in broth
steps: Cook celery, onions and bell pepper in 1 pint of chicken broth until tender.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Add salt to taste.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Add more tomato soup or 1 cup canned tomatoes, if desired.
Top with cheese.

recipes.title: Potato Doughnuts
steps: Mix the first 7 ingredients.
Save 1 cup of flour to roll out in.
Roll 1/4-inch thick.
Deep fry in hot grease for about 2 minutes, or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Orange Congealed Salad
steps: Mix jello in 1 cup hot water.
Add all other ingredients.
Mix well and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chili Beans
steps: Pick out bad beans and wash.
Cover with cold water and soak overnight.
Drain, then put into crock-pot.
Cover again with cold water.
Cook on low until tender.
Fry hamburger meat and onion until meat is lightly brown.
Add remaining ingredients.
Add meat mixture to beans and cook slow another 30 minutes to 1 hour.
Add salt if needed.

recipes.title: Coal Miners Cake
steps: Mix all together and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Frost with any frosting.

recipes.title: Strawberry Yogurt Pops
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen unsweetened strawberries, thawed and crushed
steps: You will also need 10 (3 ounce) paper cups and 10 wooden sticks.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Lasagna
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large skillet, brown ground beef; drain.
Stir in canned tomatoes and taco seasoning.
Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 can French fried onions.
In medium bowl, combine cottage cheese, 1 cup Cheddar cheese and the eggs; set aside.
Overlap 3 tortillas in bottom of greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish.
Overlap 6 tortillas around sides of dish.
Spoon beef mixture evenly over tortillas; top with remaining 3 tortillas.
Spoon cheese mixture over beef and tortillas.
Bake covered at 350° for 45 minutes or until cheese mixture is set.
Top with remaining Cheddar cheese.
Sprinkle remaining onions down center of casserole.
Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.
Just before serving, arrange tomato and lettuce around edge of casserole.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Boneless Chicken
ingredients: chicken breasts, boned and cut into strips
steps: Marinate overnight.
Drain, flour and deep fry.

recipes.title: Spoon Bread
ingredients: 1 can (10 1/2 oz.) condensed cream of chicken or mushroom soup
steps: Stir soup until smooth and gradually blend in milk.
Add cornmeal and cook until thickened, stirring all the while.
Add butter and remove from heat.
Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored; stir into mixture.
Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry and fold into mixture.
Pour into buttered 1-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until golden brown.
Serve with butter and/or syrup.

recipes.title: Chewy Popcorn Balls(Kids Cooking)
steps: Grown Ups:
Pop popcorn.
Turn stove on and supervise cooking.

recipes.title: Orange Soaked Angel Cake
ingredients: 2 kiwi, cut in half lengthwise and sliced
1/2 c. apricot fruit spread or orange marmalade
2 Tbsp. Grand Marnier or orange juice
steps: Place cake on serving platter.
Using meat fork, pierce top of cake at 1-inch intervals.
Set aside.
Combine fruits and set aside.
Combine last 3 ingredients.
Microwave on High 1 to 2 minutes.
Stir.
Toss fruit with syrup.
Spoon fruit over cake, allowing syrup to soak into cake.
Cover and chill before serving. Makes 12 servings.
One serving:
229 calories, no fat, no cholesterol and 346 mg of sodium.

recipes.title: Italian Sausages
ingredients: 8 links Italian sausage, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
steps: Saute onion and green pepper.
Add sausage and let brown.
Add tomato paste and water.
If too thick, add more water.
Add spices, using oregano generously.
Let simmer 45 minutes.
Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
steps: Place chicken in casserole dish.
Mix remaining ingredients. Pour mixture over chicken.
Bake at 350° for one hour.

recipes.title: Guacamole Dip
ingredients: 2 jalapeno chilies, seeded and chopped fine
steps: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Refrigerate 2 hours.
Serve with tortilla chips.
Makes 3 cups.

recipes.title: Fall Harvest Spice Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. (18.25 oz.) spice or carrot cake mix
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Grease and flour two 9 inch round baking pans.

recipes.title: Priest'S Lunch
steps: Combine all ingredients with 2 1/2 consomme cans of water in deep casserole.
Cover tightly.
Bake at 350° for 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
ingredients: 6 Tbsp. sugar or more to taste
steps: Add all ingredients in a small saucepan.
Heat over low to moderate heat stirring constantly.
Sauce will thicken as it heats.
Stir vigorously.
Remove from heat when desired consistency is reached.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Mix and bake in 350° oven for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemonade Pie
steps: Mix; pour into vanilla wafer crust.
Chill until set.
Makes 1 large pie or 2 small pies.

recipes.title: Empress Meat Loaf
ingredients: 2 small or 1 large can mushrooms, chopped (save juice)
steps: Saute mushrooms and onion in butter until onion is transparent; stir in thyme.
Toss into bread crumbs and parsley. Lightly mix together ground beef and remaining ingredients.
Pack half of meat mixture in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread stuffing over meat, then remainder of meat.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Remove from oven; let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Gizzards In Hot Tomato Sauce
steps: Wash gizzards and
remove
any fat.
Chop gizzards in 2 to 3 pieces.
Heat oil in large skillet and brown garlic.
Add gizzards and saute over medium-high heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Add red crushed
pepper,
bay
leaf and saute an additional 5 minutes. Add tomatoes, parsley, salt and pepper.
Cook on low heat for
2 to
hours.
To serve sprinkle with parsley, if desired.
Makes 8 servings.
This is good served with rice.

recipes.title: Tomato Sauce Dip
steps: Dice tomatoes, onion and peppers.
Mix all ingredients.
Serve with chips.
(Can leave peppers out or not use so many.)

recipes.title: Ritzy Broccoli
ingredients: 2 pkg. chopped broccoli or 1 head fresh
steps: Cook broccoli in water 5 minutes; drain well.
Combine soup, eggs, mayonnaise and diced cheese; mix well.
Add broccoli and pour into baking dish (cake pan).
Sprinkle on cracker crumbs and dot with butter.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Shrimp Salad
steps: Clean and devein shrimp.
Bring 1/2 gallon of water, crab boil and 2 teaspoons of salt to boil.
Add shrimp and return to boil. Remove from heat.
Drain and ice down shrimp.
Drain shrimp again and chop coarsely.
Then add green pepper, celery, egg, parsley and mayonnaise.
Serve in tomato, avocado or lettuce cups.
Top with strips of pimiento.
Garnish with wedge of lemon.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jello Salad
steps: Dissolve jello in 2 cups of hot water.
Mash cranberry sauce and mix into jello.
Put into refrigerator until jelled around the edges.
Add drained pineapple and nuts to mixture.
Return to refrigerator and let jell.

recipes.title: Brown Butter Icing
steps: Heat butter until golden brown, add sugar and vanilla.
Add enough milk to make frosting, enough to cover.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken
steps: Put chicken in baking dish.
Mix soup with 2 cans of water measured in soup cans.
Pour over chicken and bake for about thirty minutes at 325°.
Turn over and cook about 25 to 30 minutes, depending on size of fryer.
This also does good in microwave.

recipes.title: Lemon Lovers' Marmalade
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. thinly sliced lemons (including rinds and rind of 1 lemon, grated)
steps: Prepare macaroni and cheese from box.
Slice hot dogs and place on top of casserole.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Microwave on High for 8 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
steps: Mix sugar and cocoa.
Add eggs, milk and margarine.
Add nuts. Pour in 3 unbaked pie shells.
Cook for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
steps: Mix jello with 1 3/4 cups boiling water.
Slice bananas; mix all ingredients together except the Cool Whip.
Pour half in a casserole dish.
Let congeal, then spread Cool Whip over this layer.
The other half of jello mixture should be cooling in the refrigerator while layering the first part.
After spreading Cool Whip in dish, place second half of jello over it.
Salad contains 3 layers.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Salad
steps: Dissolve jello with hot water.
Add pineapple and oranges. Mix and place in refrigerator until cools and just starts to thicken.
Blend in the sour cream and top with toasted pecans. Return to refrigerator and allow to congeal.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb. chicken or 4 to 5 chicken breasts, boiled
steps: Cool and debone chicken.
Mix soups, sour cream and almonds. Melt butter and crumble until butter is taken up.
Top casserole with this and sprinkle with poppy seeds.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
If you double the recipe, leave off 1 can of celery soup.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines butter cake mix
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 small bag Pepperidge Farm cornbread dressing
steps: Place thin layer of dressing in a 9 x 14-inch casserole dish. Add chicken.
Heat milk, soups and broth in saucepan; pour over chicken.
Cover with remaining dressing.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Should set approximately 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: No Fuss Potato Soup
ingredients: 1 (32 oz.) pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of celery soup, undiluted
steps: Combine first four ingredients in a large soup pan. Bring to a boil. cover and reduce heat. Simmer for 30 minutes. Stir in soup and milk. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Noodle Soup
steps: Saute the onion in oleo.
Bring to a boil the chicken bouillon cubes and water.
Add noodles, broccoli, cheese and milk.
Cook until noodles are tender and broccoli done.
Enjoy.

recipes.title: Icebox Fruit Cake
steps: Melt marshmallows in hot milk.
Stir all other ingredients into hot milk and marshmallows.
Crush cookies real fine, put in loaf pan and chill 10 to 12 hours.
I always save out a few pecans and cherries to decorate the top of the fruitcake by halving a few cherries, add a half cherry and a pecan half and keep it going until it is covered on top.
It is a good one and very easy to make.

recipes.title: Late Summer Pasta
steps: Combine all
ingredients,
except pasta.
Let stand one hour at room
temperature.
Cook
pasta, drain, then toss with tomato and cheese mixture.

recipes.title: Bean Soup
steps: Rinse beans and cold water.
Bring to boil and simmer two minutes.
Remove from heat and cover.
Let stand one hour or add water and let stand overnight.
Drain.
Add ham bone, bay leaf, salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer 3 1/2 hours.
Add onion the last 1/2 hour.
Remove ham from bone.
Mash beans slightly with potato masher and add ham to soup.

recipes.title: Summer Spaghetti
steps: Cut onion and tomatoes.
Mix all spices with tomatoes, onion and garlic.
Add olive oil to mixture.
Let sit in fridge for 6 hours to marinate.
Cook spaghetti.
Pour cold mixture over spaghetti (hot) and mix well.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Combine all ingredients except nuts.
Shape into ball and roll in finely chopped nuts.
Wrap in waxed paper and store in refrigerator.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Bar Cookies
steps: Mix margarine and graham cracker crumbs together.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan and pat down good.
Top with coconut and Eagle Brand milk.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Mix together peanut butter and melted chocolate chips.
Put on baked layer.
Cool. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Saute celery and onion in margarine.
Add soup and cheese. Mix and simmer slowly.
Add broccoli which has been slightly cooked.
Pour into buttered casserole dish.
Top with dried bread crumbs and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
steps: Over medium heat, put water, sugar, salt and cornstarch; stir constantly until thickens.
Add extract and cool off of stove burner.
Put strawberries on bottom, then filling on top.
Let cool fully, then top with whipped cream for an added touch.

recipes.title: Jubilee Sauce
steps: Melt butter; add sugar, corn syrup and salt.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, for 3 to 4 minutes (mixture will become slightly opaque).
Remove from heat.
Gradually stir in evaporated milk.
Add the lemon juice and beat vigorously.
Serve hot or cold.
The sauce may separate while in refrigerator.
If this happens, beat vigorously until it resumes original appearance. Serve over fruit cake, bread, puddings, etc.

recipes.title: Pork B~B~Q Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 medium head of green cabbage (approx. 2 lbs.), shredded
steps: Mix cabbage, carrot, and red cabbage.
Pour dressing over cabbage until moist and stir.
Refrigerate.
Add salt and pepper to taste just before serving.

recipes.title: Mincemeat Pie
steps: Mix well and put in unbaked pie shell.
Bake 35 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into hot greased skillet.
Bake at 400° for approximately 45 minutes.
(Check after 30 minutes.) Insert knife in middle to check for doneness.

recipes.title: Hobo Supper
steps: As you like, sliced onions, sliced squash, sliced potatoes, carrots and cut up cabbage, torn apart.
Line a shallow baking pan with tinfoil (enough to cover supper after it is put in pan). Layer the bottom of the pan with cabbage.
Pat out 2 hamburger steaks.
Salt and pepper, then place them on top of the cabbage. Place onions on steaks, then place squash around the onions.
Place potatoes around, then the carrots.
Add salt and pepper and put a few slices of oleo on top.
Fold tinfoil over to cover tightly and place in oven at 350° for about 45 minutes or until done.
Serve with rolls and you have a meal for two.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Sour Cream Fudge Cake
ingredients: 1 box German chocolate cake mix (with pudding)
steps: Mix together and pour in 2 round cake pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let cool!

recipes.title: Turkey-Chicken-Broccoli Casserole(Good Leftover Recipe.)
ingredients: chicken or turkey (sliced or pieces), cooked
1/2 to 1 c. shredded cheese (much as you like)
steps: Place cooked, drained broccoli in a layer in 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole.
Add 1 layer of cooked turkey or chicken.
Combine 1 can of uncooked cream of celery soup and 1/3 cup milk.
Pour over first 2 layers.
Spread 1/2 to 1 cup shredded cheese on top.
Bake at 450° about 15 to 20 minutes, covered or uncovered.

recipes.title: Microwave Lasagna
steps: Cook
noodles
as directed on package, then put them in ice water.
Brown ground beef and onion in skillet;
drain and add spaghetti
sauce.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
In microwave or glass pan
x 9 x 2-inch), put layer of noodles, sauce and cheeses; repeat the layers.	Put in microwave and cook on High for 10 minutes or bake in oven for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Sweet & Sour Cabbage Borscht
ingredients: 1 medium size head of cabbage, shredded
dash of garlic or chopped to taste
steps: Boil meat in water, add cabbage. When cabbage is soft, add other ingredients.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Place sugar, butter and milk into heavy pan and cook over medium heat until it reaches soft ball stage or 235° on candy thermometer.
Remove from heat.
Quickly stir in Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter.
Pour into 2 (8 x 8 x 2-inch) greased pans.
Cut into squares when cool.
Makes 4 1/2 pounds.

recipes.title: Lasagna
steps: Brown the hamburger with onion.
Add salt, pepper and garlic salt or powder to taste.
Add oregano, tomato paste, water and cottage cheese.
Boil noodles; drain.
In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer noodles, meat sauce and Mozzarella cheese.
Repeat layers, ending with meat sauce.
Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick & Easy Casseroleeverton, Missouri
ingredients: 1 lb. hamburger meat - browned and drained
steps: Layer potatoes, onion, green pepper and hamburger with cheese between each layer.
Top with cream of mushroom soup.
Cover with tin foil.
Bake at 350° about 30 minutes or until potatoes are done.

recipes.title: Pineapple "Fondue"
steps: Crush vanilla wafers and line bottom of greased 9-inch baking dish, setting aside a small amount.
Cream butter, sugar and eggs and pour this mixture over wafer crumbs.
Sprinkle chopped pecans on top.
Drain liquid from pineapple and place over nuts.
Top with whipped cream and the remaining wafer crumbs as decoration. Chill at least 4 hours.
Can be made 1 to 2 days ahead.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
steps: Boil vinegar, sugar, water and oil.
Cool and pour over drained kraut.
Add rest of ingredients and stir well.
Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Fantastic Ice Cream
steps: Mix together and pour in freezer. Finish filling freezer with milk.

recipes.title: Indian Corn Stew
steps: Brown hamburger, onion and green pepper.
Add salt and pepper, garlic salt, Worcestershire sauce and tomato soup.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add can of corn with its juice. Heat thoroughly.
Serve with hot French bread or corn bread.
Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Banana Nog
steps: Put all ingredients, except nutmeg, into blender with 1 cup ice cubes.
Whip 30 seconds. Pour into tall glasses.
Dust with nutmeg. Serve at once. Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Shape in covered baking dish.
Pour 1 can tomato soup on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Shrimp De Jonghe
ingredients: 2 lb. cooked shrimp, shelled and deveined*
steps: *This requires 4 to 4 1/2 pounds unshelled shrimp.

recipes.title: Pizza Burgers
steps: Grind sausage, cheese and eggs.
Add soup.
Mix well.
Place on open face bun and broil until heated.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Brown ground beef and
drain
off fat.	Chop/dice green pepper, tomato and onion.
Tear
lettuce into bite-size pieces and place in large bowl.
Add
diced
veggies, ground beef and Catalina dressing.	Crush Doritos
and
add to mixture.
Blend well and serve.

recipes.title: Zucchini Custard
steps: Salt zucchini, then steam until tender.
Place in greased casserole dish.
Mix together eggs, sour cream, seasoned salt, pepper and half of grated cheese.
Dot with butter and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Chinese Casserole
steps: Make creamed potatoes out of the potatoes.
Boil ground beef. Place in baking dish.
Alternate layers of ground beef, corn and cheese.
Top with creamed potatoes.
Cook in 400° oven for about 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Caribbean Turkey Wings
steps: Place all ingredients, except turkey, in food processor or blender and process until thoroughly mixed.
Pour mixture over wings and marinate for 1 hour in refrigerator.
Bake in 375° oven about 1 hour, basting occasionally, turning once, or until no longer pink on the inside.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
steps: Mix together all ingredients.
Bake at 400° until top is light brown.

recipes.title: Chicken Francesa
steps: Cut chicken into thin cutlets.
Soak in milk for 10 minutes. Mix bread crumbs, parsley and Parmesan cheese.
Cover each slice of cutlet with bread crumbs.
Add olive oil to large frying pan and brown cutlets (quickly).
(Do not overcook.)
Place cutlets in a lightly buttered dish, salt and pepper to taste.
Place one slice of lemon on each cutlet.
Remove all but 1 tablespoon of oil from frying pan, leave residue from chicken.
Add wine and lemon juice and chicken broth to skillet.
Boil slowly until liquid is reduced by 1/2 and pour over the chicken slices.
Drizzle Grand Marnier over each slice.
Bake at 350° until liquid begins to boil (20 to 25 minutes).

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Combine sweet potatoes (cooked, peeled and mashed), margarine, eggs (beaten), sugar, milk, salt and vanilla.
Add topping for casserole, place in oven and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Heavenly Delight
steps: Break cake in bite-sized pieces in one bowl.
Mix milk and lemon juice in another bowl.
Pour over cake.
Add strawberries and Cool Whip; toss lightly.
Refrigerate 6 hours.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Hot Dish
steps: Mix soup and milk.
Add cheese, uncooked macaroni, eggs and corned beef.
Let stand overnight, covered.
Bake 1 hour at 350°. Serve with chow mein noodles if desired.

recipes.title: Aunt Mary'S Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 large can pinto beans or 2 small ones
steps: Drain juice from all the cans of beans, place in casserole dish.
Mix pepper, onion, salt, sugar and ketchup.
Pour over the beans.
Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Makes a good-size casserole, great for picnics.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 1 can celery or cream of chicken soup
steps: Butter casserole dish.
Layer potatoes and onions.
Top with soup and milk mixture.
Salt and pepper; dot with margarine and paprika for color.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour covered, then an extra 15 minutes uncovered.

recipes.title: Jackpot("Matt'S Favorite")
steps: Cook the rotini according to package directions.
Saute the ground beef and onion together.
Drain off excess fat; add salt, chili powder and pepper.
Mix well.
Add soup, water, rotini, kidney beans and half of the cheese; mix well.
Pour into greased 2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until cheese melts.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Tea
steps: Combine juice and spices in saucepan.
Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer 1 minute.
Add tea bags.
Cover and steep 5 to 7 minutes.
Remove tea bags and spices.
Sweeten with brown sugar if desired.
Garnish with cinnamon sticks if desired.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
steps: Bake cake as directed.
Mix glaze and berries together; put on cake.
Mix pudding as directed and put on top of berries.
Put Cool Whip on top of pudding.

recipes.title: Rotel Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies
steps: Melt cheese in top of double boiler. Add tomatoes and mix well. Serve warm as a dip with tortilla chips, corn chips or crackers.
Also may be used as a sauce over meats and vegetables.

recipes.title: Congealed Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Freeze overnight.
Thaw slightly, cut and serve.

recipes.title: Best Ever Cheese Cake
steps: Blend all ingredients; press against the bottom and sides of a spring-form pan.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Homemade Chicken Soup
steps: Boil chicken in salted water.
Then add vegetables and cook until carrots are soft.

recipes.title: Fudge
steps: Cooking time is 15 minutes after the first ball can be rolled. Cut heat down to medium.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
steps: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients.
Cover and chill overnight.
Combine sugar, vinegar, oil and salt together before pouring over first 5 ingredients.
Drain some of the liquid before serving.
Yield: 10 to 12 servings.
Salad will keep 1 to 2 weeks in refrigerator, tightly covered.

recipes.title: Oyster Crackers
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a large container.
Mix periodically.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
ingredients: pastry for 9 in double crust pie
steps: Line pie plate with half the pastry; leave 1 inch overhang. Combine all ingredients except butter; coat evenly. Pour in pie shell; dot with 1 tablespoon butter. Top with pastry, flute the edge and cut steam vents. Bake at 425° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
steps: Mix first 7 ingredients in bowl. Add mayonnaise, vinegar, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Chicken Pizzacante
ingredients: 1 lb. chicken breasts or cutlets, cut in small pieces
steps: Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper and the bouillon concentrate.
Saute in heavy skillet until slightly browned.
Add minced garlic, parsley and bay leaf; stir well.
Add lemon juice, water and mushrooms.
Simmer 45 minutes.
I add 1/2 pound sliced mushrooms.

recipes.title: Marinated Carrots
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, cut into thin strips
steps: Cook carrots until tender.
Blend all other ingredients and pour over carrots in a glass bowl.
Cover and marinate overnight.

recipes.title: Baked French Toast
ingredients: 1/4 c. plus 2 tsp. light corn syrup
steps: Stir brown sugar, butter and corn syrup on medium heat for 5 minutes or until bubbly. Pour into a 13 x 9 baking dish. Put slices of bread on top of it. Whisk together eggs, milk, vanilla and salt. Pour over bread slices and chill for 8 hours. Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over bread. Then dribble 1/4 cup melted butter over it. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Guacamole
ingredients: 1 large ripe avocado, peeled, seeded and mashed
steps: Combine all ingredients; mix well.
Serve as a dip or a topping for Mexican foods and snacks.
Makes about 1 cup.

recipes.title: Cheese Tarts
ingredients: 1 pkg. graham cracker crumbs, finely crushed
steps: Mix cream cheese, sugar and eggs with mixer until smooth. Grease well very small size muffin pan with butter.
Put graham cracker crumbs in pan and pat down.
Tap out excess crumbs.
Put cheese mixture into each cup, filling each cup.
Bake at 300° for about 12 to 14 minutes until they rise.
Cool completely in refrigerator.
Mix sour cream, vanilla and powdered sugar. Carefully remove tart from pan and spoon small amount of mixture on top.
Spoon cherry filling on top.
May be frozen or refrigerated.
Makes approximately 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Deaconess Chicken
ingredients: 8 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken soup
steps: Wrap each chicken breast half in a slice of cheese, then a slice of ham.
Place, seam side down, in shallow baking dish.
In bowl, mix soup with sherry; pour over chicken.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Turkey Casserole
steps: Saute onion, pepper and celery in butter.
Add turkey, salt, oregano, garlic and sugar.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and water. Simmer 15 minutes.
Place uncooked noodles in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan that has been sprayed with nonstick spray.
Pour mixture over it. Top with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Apples In A Jar (For Pies)
steps: Boil water, sugar and cornstarch 20 minutes; add cinnamon and lemon juice. Peel and slice apples; pack in sterile jars. Pour hot syrup over apples to 1 inch of top of jar.
Seal and process in water bath for 20 minutes after it starts to boil.

recipes.title: Veal Parmesan With Spaghetti
steps: Brown meat in oil.
Remove meat; add onion and green pepper and cook until tender.
Stir in next 7 ingredients; add meat. Cover; simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain.
Remove 1/2 the sauce from heat; stir into spaghetti.
Top cutlets with cheese; cover pan for 5 minutes.
Arrange spaghetti and meat on platter.
Pass extra sauce and Parmesan cheese.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Large Shellroni And Sausage
steps: Brown sausage and drain. Add green pepper and onion. Cook until tender.
Stir in broken tomatoes and tomato sauce.
Add sugar, salt and chili powder. Stir, cover and simmer 45 minutes. Cook shellroni
and drain well. Add to sauce. Stir in sour cream and heat thoroughly.

recipes.title: Red Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients and chill.
Makes approximately 2 gallons.

recipes.title: Honey Carrots
steps: Cook carrots about 10 minutes or until tender.
Use skillet, melt margarine.
Add sugar, honey and carrots.
Cook on low heat, turning until carrots are well glazed.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Ms. Jessie'S Cake Decorating Icing
steps: Mix 1 box of powdered sugar and add second box as needed with Crisco, water and flavoring. This can last safely 2 weeks refrigerated.

recipes.title: Reuben Casserole
ingredients: 6 to 8 fresh slices dark rye bread crumbs
steps: Mix sour cream, sauerkraut, mustard and onion.
Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with crumbled corned beef, cheese and bread crumbs.
Pour melted margarine over all and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Vanilla Pudding Grahamwiches(Children Will Love These.)
ingredients: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. Jell-O vanilla flavor sugar-free instant pudding and pie filling
3 1/4 c. (8 oz. container) Cool Whip Lite whipped topping, thawed
22 whole cinnamon graham crackers, broken into 44 squares
2 sq. Baker's semi-sweet chocolate, shaved or grated
steps: Pour milk into large mixing bowl.
Add pudding mix.
Beat with wire whisk until well blended, 1 to 2 minutes.
Gently stir in whipped topping and marshmallows.

recipes.title: Molly'S Pizza Sandwich
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Cook ground beef until brown; drain.
Mix in 1 can tomato sauce and oregano.
Simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.
Stir baking mix, egg and milk to a soft dough.
Spread half of dough in greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Pour remaining can of tomato sauce over dough, spreading evenly.
Layer 4 slices cheese, meat mixture, mushrooms, remaining cheese slices and Parmesan cheese.
Cover with remaining dough.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Strawberry Truffle
ingredients: 1 large box instant vanilla sugar free pudding
1 to 2 lb. frozen or fresh strawberries
steps: Tear cake in small pieces and layer half in glass bowl. Prepare pudding according to box and fold Cool Whip into pudding. Layer half of mixture over cake.
Spoon half of strawberries over pudding.
Repeat layers.
Chill and enjoy.

recipes.title: Roman Delight
steps: Brown and drain beef.
Add tomato sauce, tomatoes (chopped or blended) and sugar to meat.
Simmer for 10 or 15 minutes.
Cook noodles; drain.
Mix the cream cheese, 1 cup of Mozzarella cheese, sour cream and onion soup mix.
Fold into noodles.
Layer noodles and meat mixture in a large casserole dish.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top (grated Parmesan cheese can always be used).
Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
steps: Combine vegetables and tomato sauce in casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese over all.
Bake at 350° at least 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecue Hamburg
steps: Chop onion, celery and green pepper and then saute in 2 tablespoons cooking oil.
Add hamburg.
When hamburg is browned, then add 1/2 bottle ketchup or chili sauce, 3 tablespoons green relish, brown sugar and vinegar.
Let simmer with cover on for 15 to 20 minutes.
Serve on hamburger rolls.

recipes.title: Baked Spinach Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 pkg. (10 oz.) frozen, chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
steps: Cut tops
off
tomatoes
and about 1/3 of the way down; gently scoop
out
pulp, leaving 1/4 inch shell.
Drain tomatoes.
Melt butter in a skillet. Add mushrooms and saute until tender.
Stir in spinach, 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper.
Cook and stir
for
2 minutes.
Remove
from heat.
Blend eggs and bread
crumbs together
and
stir into spinach mixture.
Salt tomato
shells, fill with filling.
Stand filled tomatoes in a greased 10
x
6 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake in 350° oven about 25
minutes.
If desired, sprinkle tops with buttered crumbs. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Easy Rhubarb Crumble
steps: Layer the ingredients in an 8 x 8-inch loaf pan.
Place rhubarb on the bottom of the pan.
Sprinkle dry jello over rhubarb.
Sprinkle sugar over jello.
Sprinkle cake mix (yellow or white) over sugar.
Pour water over all ingredients.
Bake in oven for 40 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Pear Relish
steps: Mix in order given and bring to boil.
Simmer 15 minutes. Pack in jars and seal.

recipes.title: Celery Salmon Loaf And Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 c. liquid, saved from can of salmon
steps: Mix ingredients and pack in greased loaf pan.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Cool 10 minutes; turn onto platter.

recipes.title: Carrot Slaw
steps: Combine carrots, raisins and celery.
Mix sour cream with other ingredients and blend into salad.
Chill.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair
ingredients: 1 (4 oz. size) box instant vanilla pudding
steps: Crush 1 package graham crackers to form a layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
In a medium bowl, mix milk and pudding according to package directions.
Fold in Cool Whip, blending well.
Spread pudding over cracker crumbs.
Crush another package of crackers over the pudding.
Place frosting in a small microwave-safe bowl and microwave on High for 30 to 40 seconds, stirring once or twice. Pour over top layer of graham crackers.
Refrigerate several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Porcupines
steps: Mix all except coconut.
Drop by teaspoon in coconut.
Roll and form into balls.
Lightly grease pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes until brown.

recipes.title: House Slaw
ingredients: 1 large green pepper, sliced in rings
2 medium Spanish onions, sliced in rings
steps: In large bowl, make layers of cabbage, pepper and onions. Sprinkle sugar over top.
In saucepan, combine mustard, sugar, celery seed, salt, vinegar and oil.
Bring to full boil while stirring.
Pour over slaw.
Refrigerate, covered, at least 4 hours (overnight is better).
To serve, toss salad.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
steps: Dissolve gelatine in clam juice.
Add clams and shrimp.
Allow the gelatine to set firm.
Add the following to the gelatine after firm:
cream cheese, mayonnaise, onion, celery and lemon juice. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Lola'S Pasta Salad
steps: Prepare noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water.
Add dressing, cucumber, onion and tomatoes, mixing well.
Add seasonings to taste and mix again. Chill several hours or overnight.
Sprinkle a little Salad Seasoning on top and add cheese before serving.

recipes.title: Cranberry Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Boil until reduced one-fourth.

recipes.title: Spinach And Artichoke Casserole
ingredients: 3 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, defrosted
1/3 c. grated Parmesan or Romano cheese
steps: Drain the artichokes.
Quarter and place on bottom of a 3-quart casserole.
Squeeze as much moisture as possible from the spinach and layer it on top of the artichokes.
With an electric mixer, blend the cream cheese, mayonnaise and butter until light and fluffy.
Gradually beat in the milk.
Spread this mixture over the top of the spinach.
Sprinkle with pepper and the cheese.
Bake uncovered at 375° for 40 minutes or until the top is lightly browned.
(I have baked it in Pyrex pan, and it took about 25 minutes.)

recipes.title: Garlic And Onion Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf French bread, cut bread in half
garlic salt, salt and pepper to taste
steps: Spread on bread.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes wrapped in tinfoil.

recipes.title: Southwestern Corn Brunch
ingredients: 1 10 oz. pouch frozen whole kernel corn with butter sauce
1 4 oz. can chopped mild green chilies, drained
steps: In a bowl of warm water, thaw corn pouch for 20 minutes. Heat oven to 325°.
Grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish.
In medium bowl, beat eggs and stir in thawed corn, green chilies, cheeses, tomato, and chili powder; pour into baking dish.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until knife inserts 1 inch from center and comes out clean.
Cut into squares.
If desired, serve on lettuce leaf in a crisply fried tortilla.
Top each serving with sour cream and tortilla crumbs. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in 1 c. hot water
steps: Mix all and cook in oven until brown.

recipes.title: Mom'S Quick Cherry Pie
steps: Butter bottom of large casserole pan.
Pour pineapple and pie filling in pan.
Sprinkle with dry cake mix, then nuts.
Drizzle with butter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Broiled Tomatoes
steps: Place halved tomatoes on cookie sheet.
Sprinkle on cheese. Place under broiler for about two minutes.
Can be topped also with any of your favorite dried herbs.
Example:
Use Parmesan cheese and basil.

recipes.title: Christmas Crunch
steps: Combine peanut butter and chocolate syrup in bowl and microwave on High for 2 minutes; stir well until mixed.
Let stand until cool.
Pour over cereal in large bowl.
Mix gently until coated.
Pour cereal into paper bag.
Add M&M's, nuts and sugar. Shake until coated.
Store in sealed container.
A great munching snack!

recipes.title: Orange-Pineapple Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines butter cake mix (yellow)
steps: Beat cake mix, oil and eggs well.
Add the undrained oranges. Stir well.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Roman Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 slice bread, soaked in water and squeezed out
steps: Clean mushrooms, separate stems.
Chop stems, onion and garlic.
Saute stems, onion and garlic until light brown.
Brown meat and drain.
Add parsley, stems, onion and garlic until all brown.
Remove from heat.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Stuff caps.
Place in an oiled baking dish.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Pudding Squares
ingredients: 1 pkg. vanilla pudding and pie filling mix
steps: Combine milk and pudding mix in 4-cup glass measure.
Microwave on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until mixture boils, stirring occasionally during last half of cooking time.
Set aside.
Place margarine in glass mixing bowl.
Microwave on High for 10 seconds. Stir in graham cracker crumbs, sugar and peanut butter.
Stir until crumbly.
Press 3/4 of mixture into 1 1/2-quart baking dish; spread evenly.
Top with pudding mixture.
Freeze until solid.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Seafood Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients together in blender.
Serve with chips and crackers.
(You may use a small sour cream in place of mayonnaise.)

recipes.title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
steps: Line 11x13 cake pan with mixture. Bake at 400 for 6 min. Let cool.

recipes.title: Mandarin Cream Cake
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin oranges and juice
steps: Put cake mix, oil, eggs, oranges and juice into mixer bowl. Mix until smooth, but no longer.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 8-inch cake pans.
Bake at 325° for about 15 minutes or until cake tests done (don't overcook).
Cool thoroughly before icing.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry Couscous
ingredients: 1 box couscous, cooked with water according to box directions
1 small jar artichoke hearts packed in water, cut up
2 tsp. curry powder or to taste
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients together in a large bowl.
Mix last 3 ingredients together in a bowl, then add to the couscous mixture. Serve warm or cold as a main dish.
Makes about 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 2 lb. round steak, cut in strips
steps: In skillet, melt butter.
Add onions and green peppers; saute 2 minutes.
Remove and set aside.
Add beef, sprinkled with garlic powder.
Saute until brown.
Add bouillon cube, melted in hot water and simmer.
Blend together the cornstarch and 1/4 cup of water.
Add soy sauce, sugar and salt.
Stir into mixture.
Cook until thickened, adding water if needed to cook meat until tender. Add onions and green peppers.
Serve with buttered rice.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup or cream of mushroom
steps: Cook chicken and debone.
Cut chicken into bite size pieces and put into bottom of greased casserole dish.
Mix soup and sour cream; spread over chicken.
Melt margarine and add crushed crackers.
Sprinkle over soup and sour cream mixture.
Sprinkle poppy seed on top.
Bake at 325° for about 30 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Aunt Dolly'S Potatoes
steps: Butter pan.
Cook potatoes in skins. Cool.
Dice. Put in bowl.
Sprinkle them with parsley, salt and pepper.
Stir. Then repeat again. Dice onion.
Add and stir.
Add bread and stir.
Cut cheese into 16 slices, then quarter.
Add and stir.
Add enough milk to moisten.
Stir.
Melt butter and pour over potato mixture.
Stir again.
Pour into buttered pan.
Top with crushed corn flakes.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lemon Poppy Seed Cake
steps: Mix cake mix, pudding mix and poppy seed. Add water and oil. Add eggs 1 at a time, beating after each one. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Can just spray with Pam and not flour the pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Let cool in pan 15 minutes before taking out.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken A La King
ingredients: 2 c. cut up cooked chicken or turkey
steps: In 2 tablespoons oil cook onion until soft.
Add soup, milk, salt and pepper and mix well.
Add chicken and pimientos and heat through.
Spoon over cooked rice or noodles.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Spicy Goulash
steps: Brown hamburger with onion, green pepper, garlic salt and pepper.
Add taco seasoning according to package directions.
Add to cooked noodles.
Pour in tomatoes and tomato sauce and simmer.

recipes.title: Jello 'N Fruit Layers
ingredients: 4 oz. thawed Cool Whip (1/2 of 8 oz. container)
steps: Add the Jell-O to the boiling water and stir until dissolved. Mix 1 cup cold orange juice and ice to make 1 1/4 cups and stir into the gelatin. Refrigerate 30 minutes or until slightly thickened. Remove 1 1/2 cups of the gelatin; stir in drained fruit cocktail. Set aside. Stir 1/2 of Cool Whip into remaining Jell-O with wire whisk until blended. Pour into 9-inch square dish. Refrigerate about 10 minutes until set but not firm. Carefully spoon fruited gelatin over creamy layer in dish. Refrigerate 3 hours or until firm. Cut into squares. Garnish with remaining whipped topping. Yield: 9 servings.

recipes.title: Red Cinnamon Pickles
ingredients: 5 very large cucumbers, peeled, cored and speared
steps: Peel, core and spear cucumbers.
Soak in water and lime for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Picnic Potato Salad
ingredients: 3/4 jar sweet pickle chips, drained (save juice)
steps: Dice and boil potatoes, then chill.
Boil eggs, then chill. Cut up egg whites.
Chop celery, onion and pickles.
Mix with cool diced potatoes.
Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Shrimp Rockefeller
ingredients: Parmesan cheese or fine bread crumbs
steps: Boil or steam shrimp, then drain off any water.
Mix shrimp with creamed spinach.
Mix in 8 ounces Mozzarella cheese and 4 to 6 ounces sharp cheese.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Slice tomatoes in wedges and place around edges of dish.
Sprinkle top with remaining Mozzarella.
Top with a light sprinkling of Parmesan cheese or fine bread crumbs.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 375°. Place under broiler for 1 minute to brown top lightly.

recipes.title: Kahula
steps: Mix
all
ingredients
in
gallon glass jug.
Shake and blend well.
Shake jar once a day.
Store in dark place 3 to 4 weeks. Strain Kahlua and place back in jug.

recipes.title: Crescent Breakfast Bake
ingredients: 1 c. frozen shredded hash brown potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 375°. In medium skillet, cook sausage until browned and no longer pink, stirring frequently; drain. Separate dough into 4 rectangles. Place in ungreased 13 x 9 pan. Press over bottom and 1/2-inch up sides to form crust; firmly press edges and perforations to seal. Spoon sausage evenly over crust. Sprinkle with potatoes and cheese. Beat eggs in medium bowl. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour over cheese in crust. Bake at 375° for 18 to 23 minutes or until center is set and edges are deep golden brown.

recipes.title: Sausage Supper
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can small white potatoes, drained
1 (16 oz.) can small whole onions, drained
steps: Mix applesauce, sauerkraut, wine and brown sugar.
Place in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Arrange potatoes and onions around edge of dish.
Place sausage in center.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until heated thoroughly (baked uncovered).
When done and out of oven, sprinkle with parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Coconut Bonbons
steps: Pour margarine over coconut.
Stir until blended; add milk, blend sugar in gradually.
Mix well and chill.
Form into 1-inch balls.
Chill at least 3 hours.
Melt paraffin and chocolate in double boiler.
Using a toothpick as holder, dip coconut balls into chocolate mixture.
Set on waxed paper.
Remove toothpick.

recipes.title: Lemon Velvet Cake
steps: Mix lemon jello and hot water and let cool, but not set.
Put lemon cake mix in large bowl; add oil and eggs, one at a time, and mix.
Add lemon jello; mix and bake at 350° in a 10 x 16-inch greased and floured pan.
Glaze immediately from oven with powdered sugar with lemon juice.
Punch holes in cake with toothpicks and pour glaze over cake.

recipes.title: Iced Sugar Cookies
steps: Prepare sugar cookies.
In clean mixer bowl, at high speed, beat egg white with lemon juice until frothy.
Gradually beat in confectioners sugar.
Beat mixture about 5 minutes or until very thick and white.
Tint if desired with paste or liquid food coloring.
Pipe or spread about 1 teaspoon icing onto each baked and cooled cookie.
Let dry until hardened.
Add 50 calories (optional).

recipes.title: Fruit Smoothies
ingredients: 1 3/4 tsp. Equal For Recipes or 6 packets Equal sweetener
steps: Place all ingredients in blender or food processor.
Blend until smooth.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Dip
steps: Chop artichokes and mix with other ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve with crackers and chips.

recipes.title: Jackie'S Favorite Brisket
ingredients: 3 lb. beef brisket (can use larger cut if desired)
1 pkg. Lipton Recipe Secrets onion soup mix
steps: Place brisket in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle dry onion soup mix evenly over the meat.
Spoon can of cranberries evenly over the soup mix and beef.
Bake, covered, at 325° for 1 1/2 hours (or at least 20 minutes per pound).
Makes a tasty and tender beef brisket and lots of gravy to serve over noodles or Kasha.
Also, this dish smells fabulous while it's cooking!

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
In medium to large casserole dish, mix green beans, mushroom soup, milk, pepper, mushrooms and 1/2 of the dried French onions.
Mix well.
Use the rest of the dried onions to sprinkle on top.
Bake for 30 minutes.
Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Frozen Dessert
ingredients: 1 can Thank You cherry pie filling
1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple (juice and all)
steps: Mix in order given and freeze for 24 hours.
May use bowl or 9-inch square container.

recipes.title: Snappy Red Salsa
steps: Combine all ingredients until well mixed.
Serve with baked tortilla chips.
Makes about 2 1/2 to 3 cups.

recipes.title: Cheese Topped Tuna
steps: Toast bread; lay tuna on slice. Top with vegetables, then cheese. Broil until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Big Fat Cookies
ingredients: 1 pkg. yellow or devil's food cake mix with pudding
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Prepare mix as directed on package except use 1/2 cup of water and the eggs.
Omit oil.
Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls 3 inches apart onto greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with chocolate chips.
Bake until almost no indentation remains when touched, 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 8 large unpeeled baking potatoes, each cut into 8 wedges with skins
steps: Arrange potato wedges in shallow baking pan.
Mix remaining ingredients and brush over potatoes.
Bake in preheated 375° oven for 45 minutes or until potatoes are done.
Spoon sauce over potatoes several times during cooking.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
steps: Brown onion, pepper and ground beef (drain).
Add to this tomatoes, Ro-Tel tomatoes, taco mix, corn and peas.
Boil egg noodles until tender.
Drain.
Place in casserole half of noodles. Put half of meat mixture over noodles.
Put layer of sliced cheese, then repeat layers.
Put in 350° oven until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Raspberries Mint Punch
steps: Combine all together in punch bowl.
Serve very cold.
Serves 14 or 15 people.

recipes.title: Easy Apple Pie Dessert
ingredients: 1 box yellow or white cake mix
steps: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, spread pie filling evenly.
Sprinkle cinnamon over apples.
Sprinkle dry cake mix over all of this. Melt butter/margarine and drizzle over top.
Bake at 350° until lightly browned on top.

recipes.title: Eleanor'S Brandy Slush
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen orange juice, thawed
steps: Combine ice tea mix and sugar with hot water to dissolve; add remaining ingredients.
Put in freezer at least 1 to 2 days before serving.
Stir several times during freezing.

recipes.title: Cheese Stuffed Pasta Shells
steps: In 2-quart casserole, crumble ground beef.
Cook in microwave on High 5 to 6 minutes until meat is no longer pink, stirring after half the cooking time.
Drain.
Stir in spaghetti sauce, water and 1 teaspoon salt.
Cover with plastic wrap.
Cook on High 4 to 6 minutes, stirring after half the cooking time.
In a medium bowl, combine Ricotta and Parmesan cheeses, eggs, pepper, 1 1/2 cups Mozzarella cheese and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Stuff manicotti with cheese filling.
In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, arrange manicotti in single layer; add meat sauce to completely cover. Sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella.
Cover dish with plastic wrap. Cook on Medium-high for 30 to 35 minutes, rotating dish 1/2 turn during cooking.
Let stand 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Ravioli Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, cooked and drained
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Put half of the canned ravioli in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Stir together the eggs, spinach, cheeses and spices.
Spoon mixture over ravioli and layer again with ravioli.
Cover with foil and bake for 50 minutes.
Kids will eat spinach fixed this way!

recipes.title: Dream Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until thick. Slowly add sugar, salt and vanilla. Beat mixture on high speed until stiff. Fold in chips and drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Put into oven and turn oven off. "Forget" cookies until morning (or at least 5 hours). Yield: About 1 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Cherry Dessert
ingredients: 1 (6 3/4 oz.) pkg. jello instant vanilla pudding
steps: Mix jello and milk; let stand 5 minutes.
Blend in Cool Whip. Line bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with whole graham crackers.
Put pudding on top of them, then cherry pie filling.
Top with leftover Cool Whip.
Can be layered.

recipes.title: Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 c. chopped cucumber or 3/4 c. cucumber and 1/4 c. celery
steps: Add last two ingredients after it starts to thicken.

recipes.title: Cabbage Patch Soup
steps: Brown ground beef; dip off grease.
Chop medium-sized onion. Chop medium (1/2) cabbage head.
Dice potatoes.
Combine all with stewed tomatoes.
Simmer mixture for 20 minutes.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Add chili powder.

recipes.title: Salad Dressing
steps: Mix well; chill.
Serve over green tossed salad.

recipes.title: Italian Beef And Zucchini Dinner
steps: Combine garlic, basil and pepper.
Divide mixture in half. Press half of seasoning mixture evenly into both sides of beef steaks; reserve.
Heat oil and remaining seasoning in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Add zucchini; cook and stir 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes; cook and stir 1 minute.
Remove vegetables to platter.
Sprinkle with cheese and keep warm.
Increase heat to medium-high.
Place 2 steaks in same skillet.
Cook 3 to 4 minutes, turning once.
Repeat.
Season steaks with salt, if desired.
Serve with warm vegetables.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
steps: Mix all ingredients together; bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Candy Strawberries
steps: Combine Jell-O, pecans and coconut. Stir into milk and vanilla.
Mix well. Chill 1 hour. Shape into strawberry shapes. Roll in red sugar. Tint sliced almonds with green food coloring and insert into tops of berries to form the leaves.
Makes about 1 pound.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Dip(Serve With Doritos)
steps: Brown ground beef.
Add chili con carne, water and tomato paste.
Heat thoroughly.
For softer dip, use more water.
For thicker dip, use less water.

recipes.title: Carolina Pineapple Cake
steps: Cook according to directions on box.
Pour into a 9 x 12-inch greased and floured pan.

recipes.title: Cake Mix Cookies
steps: Pour half of the cake mix into a bowl.
Add shortening, water and eggs.
Blend well, then add the rest of the cake mix.
Beat again until well mixed.
Add vanilla.
Drop by teaspoon onto greased baking sheet.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Potatoes
steps: Fry pork chops until well done.
Peel and slice potatoes. Place pork chops in bottom of small roaster or electric skillet. Cover with sliced potatoes.
Spoon soup and spread evenly over potatoes.
Add water and salt.
Cook on high or bake in oven at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes until juices are bubbly and potatoes are done.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: 24 Hour Salad
steps: Mix ingredients.
Refrigerate for 24 hours.
Garnish with cherries and sprinkle with more coconut (toasted).

recipes.title: Crabbers Appetizer
ingredients: 1 (5 oz.) jar Old English cheese spread
1 (6 oz.) can crab meat or shrimp
steps: Soften butter and cheese to room temperature.
Mix in mayonnaise and salt.
Add crab meat.
Stir all together with a fork.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage Soup(Serves 4)
ingredients: 28 oz. can crushed tomatoes in puree
steps: Cut up sausage and cook until done.
Drain fat by placing sausage on paper towels.
In a large Dutch oven or soup pot, combine all ingredients, except pasta.
Simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Add dry pasta and cook until tender.
Ladle into bowls, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve.

recipes.title: Sicillian Meat Roll
steps: In bowl, combine eggs and tomato juice.
Stir in the bread crumbs, parsley, oregano, salt, pepper and garlic.
Add ground beef.
Mix well.
On waxed paper or foil pat meat into a 10 x 8-inch rectangle pan.
Arrange ham slices atop meat, leaving small margin around edges.
Reserve 1 slice cheese.
Tear up remaining cheese.
Sprinkle over ham.
Starting from short end, carefully roll up meat using paper or foil to lift.
Seal edges and ends. Place roll seamside down in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° about 1 1/4 hours.
Cut reserved cheese slice in 4 triangles.
Lay atop meat.
Return to oven until cheese melts (about 2 minutes).

recipes.title: Crab Cheese Puffs
steps: Mix crabmeat and cream cheese.
Add garlic powder and salt. Brush wonton skins with egg.
Drop 1 teaspoon filling off center on skin.
Fold into triangle.
Seal and crimp edges.
Brush with egg.
Fry in hot fat for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Dream Cake
steps: Prepare cake mix according to package directions and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Pinwheel Snacks
ingredients: 1 small pkg fruit flavored gelatin mix
steps: Lightly spray a 8 or 9 inch square pan with no-stick cooking spray.
Use paper towel to spread on bottom and sides.
Mix gelatin and water in a 1 1/2 to 2 quart microwaveable bowl.
Microwave on high 1 1/2 minutes.
Stir to dissolve completely.
(Cooking time varies with ovens.)
Add marshmallows to gelatin.
Microwave 1 minute or until marshmallows are almost melted.
Stir until completely melted and mixture is smooth.
(Creamy layer will float on top.)
Pour into prepared pam.
Refrigerate 45 minutes or until set.
Loosen edges using knife dipped in warm water.
Starting at one end, roll up tightly, jelly-roll fashion.
With seam down, slice in 1/2-inch slices.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Holiday Pineapple Cheese Ball
steps: Soften cream cheese.
Add green pepper, onion, pineapple, seasoned salt and one cup chopped pecans; mix well.
Shape into ball and roll in remaining pecans.
Chill for several hours; serve with crackers or fresh vegetables.
Keeps for a week or more in the refrigerator or one can be frozen.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Wedding Cake
steps: Grease and flour a 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet.
Prepare cake mix as directed and bake for 25 minutes.
Blend well cream cheese with pudding and milk.
Spread on top of cool cake.
Drain pineapple very well and spread over creamed mixture, then the Cool Whip. Sprinkle on nuts, coconut and cherry halves.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Petite Cherry Cheesecakes
steps: You will need 24 paper muffin cups.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts Diane
ingredients: 4 lg. boneless chicken breast halves (or 8 small)
steps: Preparation:
(Prep. time - 20 min.)
Place chicken breast halves between sheets of waxed paper/plastic wrap.
Pound slightly with mallet.
Sprinkle with pepper and salt (optional).

recipes.title: Veggie Pork Chop Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or mushroom soup
steps: Slice potatoes, carrots and onions.
Layer in greased baking dish.
Top with partially fried seasoned pork chops.
Repeat until ingredients are used up.
Prepare 1 can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom and 1 can of hot water.
Heat this and pour over vegetables and meat.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 large head lettuce, chopped or shredded
1 lb. ground beef, cooked and drained
1 c. El Paso hot taco sauce
1 c. El Paso medium taco sauce
steps: Mix first 7 ingredients together.
Mix remaining ingredients together.
Add to lettuce mixture and mix.

recipes.title: Eclair Pie
steps: Prepare vanilla
pudding
as
on
package, but use 1 1/2 cups milk instead
of
2; mix together pudding mixture and Cool Whip. Place
graham
crackers
on
bottom
of
oblong glass or aluminum pan.
Next,
put
1/2 of pudding and Cool Whip mixture over graham crackers.
Make
another layer and end with graham crackers on top.
This would be three layers of graham crackers and 2 layers of pudding.

recipes.title: Oriental Broccoli Salad
steps: Mix together broccoli slaw and scallions. Add almonds and sunflower seeds. Break up noodles into bite size pieces in the bag. Separate out the two flavor packets and reserve for the dressing. Add broken noodles to slaw mixture.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hash
steps: Mix well together and let set 6 to 8 hours.
Will stay fresh for a long time.

recipes.title: Sausage Stew
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can cut green beans or French-cut
2 c. dried potatoes or 1 can white potatoes
steps: Crumble and brown sausage in heavy skillet, stirring as needed. Add green beans, tomato sauce, water, onion, bay leaf, salt, garlic salt, pepper, thyme and bell peppers.
Cover and simmer 1 hour.
Add potatoes and cook with cover 15 minutes or until potatoes are done.
Remove bay leaf and serve in bowl.

recipes.title: Frito Bean Salad
steps: Drain and rinse beans.
Marinate in French dressing 1 to 2 hours or longer.
Place lettuce, tomatoes and onion in a large salad bowl.
Pour beans and dressing over vegetables.
Spread evenly.
Sprinkle with cheese and top with Fritos.

recipes.title: Reese Cup Candy
steps: Cream oleo and peanut butter.
Add sugar until firm enough to form balls size of marbles.
Melt chocolate and paraffin in top of double boiler.
Using toothpick, dip balls in chocolate.
Place on wax paper to cool.
Yields about 125 balls.

recipes.title: Italian Potatoes
steps: Cook and mash potatoes, adding milk and butter sparingly, until creamy.
(Leave somewhat dry.)
Cut luncheon meats, pepperoni and cheese into bite-size pieces.
Add one egg to potatoes and mix.
Add luncheon meats, pepperoni and cheese; mix together.
Put mixture in a baking dish; sprinkle with Italian bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° approximately 20 to 25 minutes (or until cheese melts).
May be served as a main dish meal.

recipes.title: Flan
steps: Boil milk, cinnamon and lemon peel; let cool.
Beat rapidly the egg yolks, egg whites, sugar and vanilla extract; add this to the milk mixture.
Pour desired amount of caramel into baking dish, then drain entire mixture onto dish.
Place a baking pan full of water in oven, then place other pan over and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef and onion; drain.
Put in a casserole dish, 9 x 11-inch.
Mix soup with 1 can milk; put over beef.
Sprinkle cheese over top; then place Tater Tots on top.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Country Breakfast Potatoes
steps: In medium skillet, cook green pepper and onion in butter over medium-low heat until tender. Add ham and eggs. Cook until eggs begin to set on bottom and sides. Lift and fold eggs to allow uncooked portion to set. Continue cooking until eggs are soft scrambled.
Season with salt and pepper. Spoon eggs over each potato. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon cheese over each.

recipes.title: Short Ribs With Barbecue Sauce
steps: Season short ribs with salt and pepper.
Bake at 350° until nicely browned, about 30 minutes.
Pour off any accumulated fat in pan. Cool ribs. Set aside.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Dessert
ingredients: juice from 1 lemon or 1/4 c. ReaLemon
steps: Bring to a boil the water and sugar; cool.
Add beaten egg, bananas, pineapple, orange juice, cherries and lemon juice.
Pour mixture into plastic container; cover and place in freezer.
Stir frequently while in process of freezing so fruit does not settle in bottom.
Slightly defrost before serving.

recipes.title: Strawberries Romanoff
ingredients: 1/4 c. orange-flavored liqueur or, if desired, orange juice
steps: Sprinkle strawberries with sugar; stir gently.
Cover.
Chill 2 hours.
Just before serving, beat cream in chilled bowl until stiff.
Gradually stir in liqueur.
Fold in strawberries.

recipes.title: Coconut Icing Cake
ingredients: 1 box white or yellow cake mix
steps: Mix the
sugar,
coconut
and sour cream and set aside. Prepare cake as directed on box.
When done, take a string and divide each layer in half, making 4 layers.
Put icing between each layer and
on top.
Place in refrigerator for 2 or 3 days before serving.
Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Shrimp With Lemon And Fresh Basil
steps: Combine water, salt, bay leaf and lemon slices in saucepan over high heat.
Simmer 3 minutes, then add shrimp.
Cook on low heat until shrimp are pink throughout.
Drain off water, allow shrimp to cool.
Peel, leaving tails intact, and devein.
Set aside.

recipes.title: Sweet Barbecue Sauce
steps: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.
Cool.
Pour mixture into blender; process until smooth.
Refrigerate up to one month. Yields 3 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Upside-Down Pizza
steps: Add your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: Beef Brisket
steps: Place brisket in baking pan and sprinkle with tenderizer, liquid smoke, celery
salt,
onion salt and garlic salt on both sides.
Let
stand
in
refrigerator
overnight.
Pour Worcestershire and Tabasco over it.
Cover and bake 5 hours in 275° oven . Add barbecue
sauce and cook another hour.
Can be prepared ahead and reheated for serving.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, cooked and drained
steps: Combine ingredients; stir to blend.
Chill for at least 1 hour.
Serve in hollowed out loaf of French bread; use hollowed out section to make bread cubes for dipping or pour into your favorite bowl and dip with chips and crackers.

recipes.title: Hug Recipe
steps: Extend arms and wrap them around each other.
Clean your minds and take a good look at each other.
Pull yourselves together and mix well.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
steps: Put fruit in baking pan.
Mix sugar with cake mix.
(Do not make cake!)
Sprinkle cake mix over fruit.
Pour melted butter over all.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Balls
steps: Melt butter.
Add sugar, peanut butter and graham crackers on stove.
Mix well until done.
Take away from heat and let cool. Make balls.
In double boiler, melt chocolate chips and 1/2 bar of wax.
Dip in balls and put on wax paper.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Neiman Marcus Squares
steps: Beat 1 egg.
Mix with cake mix and melted butter.
Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix cream cheese, 2 eggs and powdered sugar. Add coconut and pecans.
Spread over cake mixture.
Bake in a preheated oven at 325 ° for 45 minutes.
Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Quick Tuna Squares
steps: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients until well mixed and smooth.
Pat mixture into well-greased 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Crab Dip(Warm)
steps: Remove shells and pat dry.
Mix everything together with fork. Don't overmix so crabmeat doesn't break up too much.
Place in 1-quart casserole.
Sprinkle extra cheese on top.
Bake 25 minutes at 350°.
Keep warm while serving.
Serve with Town House crackers.

recipes.title: Tuna-Artichoke Salad
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can water-packed tuna, well drained
1 (14 oz.) can quartered artichoke hearts, drained and coarsely chopped
1 (4 oz.) can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
steps: Combine tuna, artichokes, mushrooms and celery. Mix mayonnaise, yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire and onion salt. Gently stir into tuna and vegetables. Cover and refrigerate. Serve in a large tomato cup or with tomato slices. Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
steps: In large saucepan with 4 to 6 cups boiling water, cook macaroni until tender.
Drain; stir in mayonnaise until macaroni is creamy.
Set aside to cool.
In separate bowl, dice vegetables into bite sizes.
When macaroni is cooled, stir vegetables into macaroni and salt to taste.

recipes.title: Frozen Dessert
ingredients: 1 box Dream Whip (make by directions on box)
steps: Cream cheese should be soft, mixed with Miracle Whip.
Add pineapple, sugar and marshmallows.
Fold in Dream Whip.
Smooth into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place cherries on top.
Cover with lid or Saran Wrap and place in freezer.
Serve frozen or slightly thawed. Great for summer!

recipes.title: Gazpacho Salad
steps: Chop and combine vegetables, seasonings and vinegar.
Let stand.
Dissolve jello in boiling water; then add cold water. Chill until thickened; then add vegetables.

recipes.title: Celery Relish
steps: Seed and finely chop peppers; combine with celery.
Cover with water and boil.
Remove from heat and let stand 10 minutes; drain thoroughly.
Add remaining ingredients and bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until celery is tender.
Pack immediately into sterilized jars and seal.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Pickles
steps: Combine the cucumbers, onion, green pepper in a bowl.
Ad the sugar, vinegar, salt and celery seed; mix well.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 24 hours.
Can be kept about 3 months.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
steps: Fold pudding into Cool Whip.
Drain all canned fruit.
Add remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: dash of red cayenne and Tabasco pepper sauce
steps: Set aside 3/4 cup chopped walnuts.
Combine and mix well all ingredients.
Shape into balls (2).
Roll balls in nuts.
Chill. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Raspberry Divinity
steps: Cook sugar, syrup and water together over moderate heat until it reaches the hard ball stage (252°) by candy thermometer, stirring often.
Beat egg whites until foamy, then add the gelatin.
Continue beating until egg whites stand in peaks, then slowly beat in the hot syrup mixture.
Continue beating until test spoonful will hold its shape.
Add nuts; drop quickly onto waxed paper, or pour out onto greased dish.
Cut into pieces.

recipes.title: Party Spinach
steps: Cook spinach according to directions and drain.
Saute mushrooms in 1/4 cup of the butter.
Combine mayonnaise, sour cream and 2/3 cup of the Parmesan; stir in spinach, mushrooms and artichokes.

recipes.title: Honey Syrup
steps: Combine in a saucepan the sugar and water. Boil and reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Add honey and lemon juice, stirring well. Return to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Whiskey Sour Punch
ingredients: 3 (6 oz.) cans frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 tray ice cubes or small ice ring
steps: Slice orange thinly.
Combine undiluted lemonade concentrate and remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Garnish with orange slices. Makes 32 (1/2 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Banana Split Pie
steps: Combine sugar, eggs and margarine in mixer.
Beat at high speed for 15 minutes.
Pour over graham cracker crust.
Slice bananas over mixture.
Put pineapple over this, then Cool Whip, then nuts, then cherries.
Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Cherry Jubilee
steps: Fill a tall glass with lots of ice.
Stir the orange juice, cherry juice and ginger ale or Fresca.
Add the cherries for garnish.
Yields 1 serving.

recipes.title: Salmon Boil
ingredients: 3 lb. small red potatoes, cut in half
steps: Cut
salmon
up
into
2-inch squares.	Bring to a boil 6-quarts water
with
1/2 cup salt in 14-inch Dutch oven.
Add potatoes, onions and spices.
Boil 20 minutes.
Add salmon and boil 12 minutes longer.
Drain off liquid and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Nut Pie
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour into 3 unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Egg Nog
steps: Whip together Eagle Brand milk and Egg Beaters.
Whip together milk and vanilla. Mix together. Put in punch bowl with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Red Hot Jello Salad
steps: Dissolve red hot candies in water.
Add Jell-O; stir until dissolved.
Add applesauce.
Pour into mold or dish and refrigerate until firm.
Really good with ham.

recipes.title: Kids Fun Meat Snack
steps: Put the cheese on the meat.
Roll up and put in microwave for 2 minutes (oven for 1 minute).
Serve.

recipes.title: Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) bag frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower
steps: Cook onion and potatoes in 6 cups water.
Add vegetables and soups.
Cook 5 minutes.
Stir in cheese.

recipes.title: Coleslaw
steps: Chop cabbage.
Add remaining ingredients.
Stir and taste. May need extra salt.
If not moist enough, add some more mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Sausage Casserole
steps: Cut crust off bread; butter on both sides.
Lay in 9 x 13-inch pan, covering bottom of pan.
Mix eggs, half and half and salt together; set aside.

recipes.title: Easy Sticky Buns
steps: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan or tube pan.
Put nuts in bottom of pan.
Place frozen rolls in pan in rows.
Mix butter, sugar, pudding and milk until smooth.
Pour over rolls.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Cover with cloth and let sit overnight (unrefrigerated).
In morning, bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Scalloped Oysters
steps: Use a medium size baking dish.
Put half package of crackers and then half the oysters and then another layer of crackers and then 1/2 can of oysters. Repeat until crackers and oysters have been used. Cover good with milk.
Put 3 tablespoons of butter on top. Sprinkle with pepper.
Bake at 350° until golden brown on top.
(Don't cook too dry.)

recipes.title: Cheesecake Brownies
ingredients: 2 tubes ready made chocolate chip cookie dough
steps: Grease bottom and sides lightly of a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Spread 1 tube of cookie dough in the bottom of pan.
Combine eggs, cream cheese, sugar and vanilla.
Spread over top of cookie dough in pan.
Crumble other tube of cookie dough on top of mixture. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Refrigerate when cool.
Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Lowfat Broccoli Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can fat free chicken broth
steps: Combine hash browns, onions, and chicken broth in a soup pot. Cook until hash browns are tender.
Puree in a blender or food processor.
Return to soup pot and add the evaporated milk, broccoli, lemon pepper seasoning, Velveeta, and Parmesan.
Stir continuously until cheese is melted.
Makes 6 servings.
Less than 1 gram of fat per serving.

recipes.title: Mock Apple Pie(No Apples Needed)
steps: Fit bottom crust into 9-inch pie plate.
Break Ritz coarsely into crust.
Combine water, sugar and cream of tartar in small saucepan.
Boil gently for 15 minutes.
Add lemon juice and rind. Cool.
Pour over crackers, dot with butter and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Cover with top crust.
Trim and flute edges.
Cut slits in top crust.
Bake at 425°
for 30 to 35 minutes, or until crust is crisp and golden.
Serve warm.
Makes 6 to 8 slices.

recipes.title: Black Bottom Pie
steps: Separate eggs.
Beat egg yolks well.
Add to hot milk, 1/2 cup sugar and cornstarch.
Cook until thickened in double boiler. Divide mixture in half.
To first half, add 1 cup chocolate chips while hot.
When chocolate chips are dissolved, pour into baked pie shell.
Add to 2nd half of mixture, gelatin that has been dissolved in 1/4 cup cold water.
Fold well beaten egg whites with 1/2 cup sugar.
Pour this mixture over chocolate mixture filling in pie shell.
Sprinkle with grated unsweetened chocolate.
Chill and serve.
Have pie shell cooked and cooled before starting pie.

recipes.title: Barbecue Pork Chops
steps: Flour and salt pork chops.
Place a small amount of shortening in a skillet and fry pork chops until brown.
Mix remaining ingredients and pour over browned pork chops.
Cook at 260° to 280° for 1 hour.
It may be necessary to add water to mixture while it is simmering.

recipes.title: Cheese Ring
ingredients: black pepper and cayenne pepper to taste
steps: Combine Cheddar cheese, pecans, mayonnaise, onion, black pepper and cayenne pepper in bowl; mix well.
Shape into ring. Store, tightly covered, in refrigerator for 1 day or longer.
May fill center with jelly.
Serve with thin wheat crackers.
Yield: 70 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Put in 4-quart casserole.
Crush 1 cup cracker crumbs or potato chips and sprinkle on top.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberries In The Snow
steps: Mix cream cheese and sugar until creamy. Add whipped topping and vanilla. Tear angel food cake into small pieces. Mix strawberries and glaze together in a bowl. Put a layer of cake first in a large bowl, then follow with a layer of cream cheese mixture, then strawberry glaze mix. Continue layers in this manner. Spread cream cheese mixture on top and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Connie'S Icebox Dessert
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) Pillsbury's Best sugar cookie dough
steps: Spread the cookie dough in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes, or until golden brown.
Mix together the cream cheese, Cool Whip and powdered sugar; spread on baked cookie crust.
Mix together the pudding and milk; spread on top of cream cheese mixture.
Top with Cool Whip; sprinkle with crushed nuts as a nice garnish.
Store in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream
steps: Beat eggs well in mixer or blender.
Add sugar and evaporated milk.
Beat well until blended.
Add vanilla.
Add milk.
Pour into 1-gallon freezer; freeze until firm 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Swedish Meatballs
steps: Form into 1-inch meatballs (with the exception of cranberry sauce, chili sauce, brown sugar and lemon juice) and place in 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Heat cranberry sauce, chili sauce, brown sugar and lemon juice until dissolved.
Then pour sauce over meatballs.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cover first 30 minutes while baking so they don't get too brown.

recipes.title: Christmas Pea Salad
ingredients: 3/4 c. mayonnaise, mixed with 2 Tbsp. vinegar
steps: Combine broccoli flowerets, cauliflower flowerets, chopped green onions, chopped green pepper and any other crunchy vegetable you wish.
Over vegetables, pour 1 bottle Italian dressing and mix.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Chili
steps: In a large skillet or pot, brown meat, onion and garlic. Add chili mix, chili powder, vinegar, hot sauce and tomato juice. Add beans, salt and pepper. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
steps: Fill 8 x 14-inch pan with apples.
Add honey, coriander and salt.
Cover with topping and bake approximately 40 minutes in a 375° oven until apples are tender.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
steps: Combine vegetables, salt and 6 cups water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Add bouillon cubes.
Simmer until veggies are tender.
Add oleo and milk.
Bring to a boil.
Season with pepper.

recipes.title: Stuffed Gouda Cheese
steps: With a sharp knife, cut 1/4-inch off the top of the cheese and remove the top circle of wax.
Scoop out inside cheese, leaving 1/4-inch on the bottom and sides.
Place scooped out cheese in a blender or food processor and add sherry.
Blend until light and fluffy.
Spoon cheese back into the Gouda shell and garnish with a sprinkling of paprika.
Serve with assorted crackers.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 egg yolks plus 1 c. milk in bowl (beat together)
steps: Heat the above ingredients together (don't boil). Pour into freezer container. Layer with ice and ice cream salt until freezer is full.

recipes.title: Mimi'S Lemon Bars
steps: Blend together first 3 ingredients; put into 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Eggplant Dressing
