ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, cooked, drained and mashed
steps: Brown sausage and drain.
Saute onion and bell pepper.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Loaf With Ketchup
steps: Mix together all ingredients, except ketchup.
Pour the ketchup in bottom of well-greased ring pan.
Pack in mixture. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Turn out of mold, ketchup side up.
Fill with hot potato salad.
If loaf is to be served cold, potato salad may be chilled.

recipes.title: Hot Ham Salad
ingredients: 1/3 c. crushed potato chips or bread crumbs.
steps: Mix ingredients.
Place in oiled casserole and top with cheese and chips.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken Meal
ingredients: 2 pkg. chicken breasts or 1 whole fryer
steps: Bring full pan of water to boil with chicken and onion; boil until chicken is done.
Take a box of rice or 1/2 of 2 pound box of rice and dump into water with chicken.
Mix salt and pepper to taste; put in 3 tablespoons basil leaves and cook until rice is done.

recipes.title: Patchwork Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. frozen southern style hash brown potatoes
steps: Brown meat; drain.
Add green pepper and onion.
Cook until tender.
Add remaining ingredients except cheese.
Spoon 1/2 the mixture into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Cover with half of cheese.
Top with remaining meat and potato mixture.
Cover with aluminum foil.
Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 45 minutes. Uncover.
Cut remaining cheese in decorative shapes.
Arrange in patchwork design on casserole.
Let stand for 5 minutes or until cheese shapes have melted.
Serves 6.
Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Deer Meat With Spicy Sauce
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. hot pepper seed (use less for mild sauce)
steps: Cut tenderloin into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Brown in skillet in 1/2 cup oil.
Sprinkle with Molly McButter and garlic salt. After meat loses red color, add dry mustard and sugar.
Reduce heat and add tomato juice, pepper seed, green pepper and onion. Simmer for about 1 hour, covered.
If necessary, thicken sauce with cornstarch.
Serve over cooked Uncle Ben's long grain rice.

recipes.title: Water Chestnut Casserole
steps: Saute onion in margarine.
Spray casserole dish with Pam.
Mix all ingredients together, except corn flakes.
Pour in prepared casserole dish.
Crumble corn flakes and sprinkle on top.
Dot with margarine.
Bake at 350° until bubbling and golden brown.

recipes.title: Apple Crumble
ingredients: 8 baking apples, peeled, cored and sliced
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In greased 9 x 13-inch pan combine apples, lemon juice and 1 tablespoon cinnamon.
Toss until apples are coated.
Spread in pan.
Sprinkle cake mix over apples and 1 tablespoon cinnamon.
Drizzle margarine over cake mix.
Sprinkle on nuts.
Cover with foil.
Bake 20 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 20 to 25 minutes or until top is browned.
Spoon into dessert bowls and top with ice cream.

recipes.title: Hot Dogs In A Bun
steps: Thaw dough.
Cut small slices of dough and flatten; wrap dough around hot dogs and bake until brown.
The kids love them.

recipes.title: Carrot Drumsticks
steps: Cook carrots and mash.
Add chopped pepper, minced onion, soft breadcrumbs, egg, chopped celery and salt and pepper.
Mix together and form into oval shaped patties.
Roll in dry breadcrumbs.
Fry in large frying pan with small amount of vegetable oil.
This was a World War II meat substitute dish my mother made.
We ate them with catsup.

recipes.title: Mock Peanut Butter Brittle
steps: Bring to a boil the sugar and syrup.
Remove from heat.
Stir in peanut butter until smooth.
Pour over corn flakes.
Mix well. Spread and press in a buttered pan.
Let cool and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Pasta Marinara
steps: In a medium saucepan, cook onion and garlic in hot oil until tender.
Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, cooking wine, sugar, oregano and basil.
Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for about 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook pasta; drain and serve with sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 c. corkscrew noodles, cooked and drained
steps: Combine salad dressing, cheese, milk and salt; mix well.
Add all ingredients; mix lightly.
Chill several hours or overnight. Add additional salad dressing just before serving if desired.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
steps: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, mix graham cracker crumbs and margarine. Pat in bottom of pan.
Bake 10 minutes and then cool.

recipes.title: Walnut Cake(Dios Torta)
steps: Butter 2 large 9-inch layer cake pans; place a circle of waxed paper or brown paper in the bottom and butter that as well.
Set the pan aside.
Preheat the oven to 375°.
Beat the egg whites with a pinch of salt until foamy; continue beating until very stiff. Set aside.
With an electric mixer, beat the egg yolks with sugar until light yellow and very creamy.
Blend the walnuts and bread crumbs together; fold them into the egg yolk mixture.
Mix a heaping tablespoonful of the beaten egg whites into the batter to lighten it.
Lightly fold in the remainder of the whites.
The batter should be evenly mixed but not overworked.
Pour into the cake pans; bake for 20 minutes or until the cake springs back when touched.
Remove from oven; cool for 10 minutes in the pans. Invert onto a cake rack; quickly remove all the paper from the bottoms of the layers.
Cool completely before filling and frosting cake.

recipes.title: Damson-Caramel Pie
steps: Set aside egg whites and mix remaining ingredients.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Stir in with other mixture and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Shoney'S Strawberry Pie
ingredients: 4 Tbsp. strawberry Jell-O (one 3 oz. box makes 2 pies)
steps: Mix
sugar, cornstarch and Jell-O.
Add hot water.
Mix well. Bring to a boil; stirring with a whisk until very thick and smooth.
Set
aside to cool.
Place strawberries in baked pie shell.
Pour
cooled
mixture
over strawberries.
Spread Cool Whip on pie.
Refrigerate 2 hours.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Soak cucumbers and onions (sliced) and salt in 2 quarts water and 4 trays of ice.
Mix together all other ingredients.
Drain cucumbers and onions and add to other mixture.
Bring to a full boil and remove from heat and pack in jars.

recipes.title: Chili And Beans
steps: Layer in crock-pot and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or on high for 5 to 6 hours, stirring occasionally.
Ideal to cook on low overnight.

recipes.title: Lazy Ladies
steps: Melt the butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add in order spreading evenly the graham crackers, nuts, chocolate chips and coconut. Do not mix or stir.
Pour evenly over all these layers of goodies the Eagle Brand milk (no other kind of milk will do). Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Cool.

recipes.title: Lime Surprise Salad
steps: Mix the 2 gelatins with hot water.
Let cool.
Mix all other ingredients together.
Add to gelatin; mix and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 small can chopped green chilies, drained
2 Tbsp. each vinegar, sugar and Tabasco sauce
1/2 tsp. each pepper, paprika, onion salt and garlic salt
2 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut into cubes
steps: Combine all ingredients except the Velveeta in a food processor or blender.
Simmer 2 hours or more.
Add the cheese.
Stir until melted.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Peanut Butter Fingers(Candy)
steps: Melt together the paraffin and chocolate chips in double boiler.
(Use real chocolate chips for best results.)

recipes.title: Nancy Ware Cake
ingredients: 1 can (11 oz) mandarin oranges with juice
1-20 oz. can crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Into cake mix, add oranges with juice, eggs and vegetable oil, beat about 3 minutes until the batter is fluffy.

recipes.title: Corn Souffl{2E Pudding
steps: Cook down corn,
pepper, onion, garlic, oil, pepper and salt. Stir constantly.
Fifteen
minutes	before serving, add egg and milk
previously
beaten
together.
Cook until thickened.

recipes.title: Beef Tips Or Deer Steak
ingredients: beef steak or deer steak, cut into little cubes
steps: Put into slow cooker and cook all day.
That night put over rice or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Cabbage-Coconut-Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 2 c. cabbage, finely cut or chopped
steps: Mix cabbage, coconut, pineapple and mayonnaise. Add salt. Toss lightly. Nuts may be added, if desired.
Add pineapple juice if mixture is dry. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Salmon Ball
ingredients: 1 large can pink or red salmon
steps: Remove bones and skin from salmon.
Let cream cheese soften. Mix thoroughly salmon and cream cheese.
Add Worcestershire sauce, liquid smoke and horseradish (these amounts can be changed according to taste).
Form into a ball, roll in nuts and refrigerate.
This can be used as a dip without the nuts.
Makes a nice hors d'oeuvres, or dip for cocktail parties.

recipes.title: Egg Roll Filling
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless chicken breast, finely chopped
steps: In a mixing bowl, combine chicken, cornstarch, soy sauce and ginger.
Blend.
Let stand for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in wok. Stir-fry mushrooms about 1 minute.
Add chicken and continue to stir-fry until firm and white.
Add remaining ingredients and stir-fry until cabbage is crisp-tender.
Cool before filling egg roll wrappers.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Salad Dressing
steps: Put all ingredients into a blender and blend for 1 minute. Stir in 1 package of crumbled Blue cheese.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese Casserole
steps: Beat eggs until blended together; add milk, salt and pepper. Stir until mixed thoroughly.
Cut cheese into small chunks and add to mixture.
Cook macaroni until tender; add to mixture.
Add margarine.
Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes until brown.

recipes.title: Dessert Pizza
ingredients: 1 18 oz. pkg. refrigerated sugar cookie dough
assorted fresh fruit (3 apples, strawberries, banana, kiwi, blueberries, etc.)
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Herb Butter
steps: Cream butter with spices.
Yield: 1/3 cup.
Very good over pasta.

recipes.title: Fruit Slushy
ingredients: 2 (6 oz.) cans each: frozen lemonade, limeade, orange juice and pineapple juice, thawed
steps: Combine 1 can of each frozen ingredient in blender.
Add enough ice to fill container.
Process until mixture is slushy. Empty blender container.
Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve immediately.
Makes about 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Layered Shrimp Spread
steps: Spread cream cheese on the bottom of a serving dish (quiche-size).
Brush with half of the cocktail sauce.
Layer shrimp on top of cream cheese and sprinkle with lemon juice. Layer with rest of the cocktail sauce, green pepper, onions and olives.
Top with Mozzarella.
Wrap tightly with aluminum foil and chill.
Serve with crackers or cocktail pumpernickel.

recipes.title: Millie'S Hot Potato Chip Chicken Salad
ingredients: Small bag of potato chips, crushed (enough to cover top well)
steps: Mix all ingredients together except the chicken soup and potato chips.
Place in a fairly deep baking casserole.
Spread the can of chicken soup over top and cover with the crushed potato chips.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
steps: Mix all items in a bowl.
Put into a casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cold Chicken Curry Salad
ingredients: 4 c. cooked chicken, cut in pieces
steps: Make this at least 3 hours in advance and chill.
Toss chicken, celery and lemon juice and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
Mix in sour cream, mayonnaise and curry powder. Carefully fold in 4 sliced hard-boiled eggs.
Cover and refrigerate.
To serve, spoon into lettuce cups and top with more egg slices.
Garnish with fresh parsley (optional).
Serves 12.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni
steps: Mix altogether.
Put in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Piggie Brownies
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) pkg. German chocolate cake mix
steps: Melt caramels in 1/3 cup evaporated milk; set aside.
Mix cake mix and 1 1/3 cups evaporated milk, stirring until it holds together.
Put half the cake mixture in bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake for about 6 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Lemon Pie
steps: Cream margarine and sugar.
Beat in egg yolks.
Add water mixed with corn meal.
Add lemon juice and grated rind of lemons. Lastly, fold in beaten egg whites.
Cook on unbaked pie crust. This makes 2 large pies. Start at 350°, then turn to 300° after starts to brown (about 10 minutes).
Cook about 25 minutes all together.
I cook these pies on a preheated cookie sheet to help the crust get done on the bottom.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) cans cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
steps: Put ingredients in pot in order listed.
Cover and cook on high 2 to 3 hours, or on low for 6 to 8 hours.
Stir occasionally. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Heloise'S Jamaican Barbecue Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into a quart jar.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

recipes.title: Fluffy Cranberry Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.
Refrigerate. Delicious!!

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli as directed.
Mix eggs, mayonnaise, grated cheese and cream of mushroom soup.
Mix in broccoli and pour into 1 or 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Sprinkle bread crumbs over it and bake at 350° until brown, approximately 30 minutes,

recipes.title: Ambrosia Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (13 oz.) can pineapple chunks or tidbits, drained
1 c. sour cream or 1 c. whipping cream, whipped
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Chill several hours or overnight. Serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: Cocktail Wieners
ingredients: 1 lb. frankfurters, cut in bite-size pieces
steps: Heat the prepared mustard, mixed with red currant jelly.
Add the frankfurters and heat through.
Serve hot from a chafing dish, electric frying pan, crock-pot or shallow saucepan.
Spear with toothpicks to eat.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Curried Fruit
steps: Drain fruit well and arrange in casserole.
Mix curry powder, sugar and butter.
Spoon over fruit.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
(I use large cans of fruit.
Also, it is better to heat the butter, sugar and curry mixture so as to spread it easier.)

recipes.title: Chocolate Velvet Pie
ingredients: 1 deep dish graham cracker crust pie shell
1 pkg. chocolate instant pudding and pie filling
steps: Using a mixer, combine milk and pudding mix; stir in melted chocolate squares (will be thick).
Fold in 1 container of Cool Whip with a spoon.
Pour into pie crust.
Over this, spread as much of the second container of Cool Whip as you want.
Sprinkle chocolate sprinkles on top.
Chill at least 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Stuffed Winter Squash
ingredients: 2 small acorn squash (14 to 16 oz. each)
steps: Cut squash in half lengthwise and remove seeds.
Place squash halves, cut side down in a shallow baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Stir together apple, celery, walnuts, sugar and cinnamon.
Turn squash halves cut side up.
Sprinkle with salt. Spoon apple mixture into halves.
Bake covered about 25 minutes more.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
steps: Blend and refrigerate.
Make a few hours ahead of time.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Peel and slice sweet potatoes into small pieces.
Boil potatoes until tender and mash.
Add eggs, sugar, and milk.
Stir until blended.
Add cinnamon, nutmeg, and raisins.
Preheat oven to 400°.
Bake for 20 minutes.
Remove casserole from oven and layer top with mini-marshmallows.
Bake casserole until marshmallows are melted.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
steps: Season to taste with salt, pepper and oregano.

recipes.title: Becca'S Chicken Chow Mein
steps: Heat oil, salt, & pepper in deep skillet or Dutch oven.
Add cabbage, celery, bean sprouts, water chestnuts, & sugar.
Stir in chicken broth; cook about 10 minutes.
Mix cornstarch, water, & soy sauce; add to vegetable mixture. stir until mixture thickens.
Add chicken and heat.

recipes.title: Baked Corned Beef
steps: Wash corned beef under running water to remove brine.
In large kettle, cover with cold water; bring to boiling.
Drain; cover with fresh water.
Bring to boiling; simmer until tender (about 3 hours).
Remove from kettle; place in baking dish. Insert cloves in meat, sprinkle with brown sugar and slowly pour sherry over meat.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) until brown. Baste occasionally with sherry syrup in bottom of pan until thickly glazed.
Serve hot or cold.
Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake
steps: Grease oblong cake pan.
Spread 1 cup nuts mixed with 1 cup coconut in bottom of cake pan.
Put cake mix, pudding, water, eggs and oil in bowl; mix well.
Pour over nuts and coconut.
Blend together the margarine, cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla; spoon this over cake.
Bake at 325° for 50 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Celest Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped green onions or chives
steps: Combine ingredients, except 1/2 almonds and 1/2 parsley.

recipes.title: Chocolate Icing
steps: Mix cocoa and sugar.
Add milk and butter (do not melt butter).
Stir together.
Heat to boil in thick boiler.
Boil for 4 1/2 minutes.
Do not stir after it starts boiling.
Maintain a rolling boil, but do not burn.
Place in sink of cold water; add flavoring.
Stir until icing begins to thicken.
Spread on layers. If icing becomes too thick, add a little water.
Will ice four layers.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
steps: Cook zucchini, onions, celery and carrots in salted water for 5 minutes.
Drain well.
Combine soup and sour cream.
Add to vegetables.
Mix stuffing as stated on box, but use 1/2 amount of liquid and use 1/2 cup margarine.
Spread 1/2 of stuffing in large casserole dish and spoon in vegetable mixture.
Top with rest of stuffing mix.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Let cool 10 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Seafood Lasagne(Frutti Di Mara Lasagne)
steps: Cook seafood, butter, Pesto and white wine until seafood is barely cooked.
Put small amount of liquid from pot into bottom of lasagne pan.
Mix cheeses into pot with seafood.
Put one layer of lasagne down and one-third of sauce.
Repeat two more times.
Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Dumpling Sauce
steps: Mix and boil.
Pour over dumplings and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cowboy Beans
steps: Combine beef and onion in a skillet; saute until browned.
Combine beef mixture and remaining ingredients, stirring well.
Spoon into a 2-quart casserole.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Yield 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Navajo Stew
steps: Put in large pot and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Serve with chopped onions and grated cheese.

recipes.title: Great Mexican Dip
steps: Spread refried beans on bottom of round pan.
Then spread sour cream on top followed by salsa.
Layer the lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese on top.
Serve with tortilla chips.
Great party appetizer!

recipes.title: Sugared Pecans
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients and cook to soft ball stage (235°) without stirring.
Remove from heat and add vanilla and pecans. Stir gently until pecans are well coated and mixture becomes creamy.
Turn out on wax paper and separate as they cool.

recipes.title: Chow Chow
steps: Peel tomatoes and onions and slice.
Chop pepper and mix all ingredients together in a large 7-quart canner.
Cook over low heat until this mixture thickens, about 3 hours.
Put in jars and seal.
Good served with beans and other vegetables.

recipes.title: Egg Custard Pie
steps: Beat the eggs slightly and combine with sugar, salt, nutmeg and vanilla.
Slowly add scalded milk; mix well.
Pour in pie shell.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake 25 minutes.

recipes.title: 3 Flavor Ice Cream
steps: Note:
Two real ripe peaches can be added, if desired.

recipes.title: Hello Dollies
steps: Melt oleo in oblong pan and add all ingredients in order given.
Pour condensed milk over this and bake in 350° oven for about 25
minutes
or until golden brown, let cool, then cut in squares.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
steps: Break spaghetti into 2-inch strips, then cook per bag directions.
Dice cucumber, tomato, onion and bell pepper; shred carrots.
Drain spaghetti and let cool.
When cooled, mix all ingredients in large salad bowl; salt and pepper to taste.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour (overnight is okay).
Serves 10 or more.

recipes.title: Hobo Beans
ingredients: 1 large can Ranch Style beans, drained
steps: Cook meat, onions and peppers.
Drain.
Add other ingredients and cook until done.
Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Punch
steps: Let sherbet soften, then add 7-Up when ready to serve.

recipes.title: St. John'S Punch
steps: Dissolve lemonade mix and sugar in 2 quarts of hot water. Stir until all sugar and mix are completely dissolved.
Add fruit juices and remaining water.
Freeze until slushy.
Yield: 75 servings.

recipes.title: Russian Vegetable Borscht
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, peeled and cut in 1/2-inch pieces
1 large beet, peeled and coarsely shredded
1/2 tsp. each: dill, salt and pepper
steps: Heat oil in a large kettle over medium heat. Add onion, bell pepper and garlic. Cook for 5 minutes; stir frequently. Add remaining ingredients, except vinegar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and simmer 30 minutes. Add vinegar. Chill and re-heat. Serve. Makes 8 (1 1/2-cup) servings. Prep time: 1 hour.

recipes.title: Green Enchiladas
ingredients: jalapeno peppers, seeded (3, 4 or more, depending on how "hot" you like it)
steps: Boil chicken; bone and tear into bite size pieces.

recipes.title: Pink Frozen Fruit Salad
steps: Blend cheese and undrained pineapple.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into individual molds.
Freeze overnight or until firm.
Remove from freezer 20 to 30 minutes before serving. Unmold and garnish with more cherries.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Topping
steps: Combine sugar, salt, cocoa and water in small saucepan.
Cook on medium heat stirring constantly until bubbly.
Simmer for 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in oleo and vanilla.
Serve hot or cold over ice cream.

recipes.title: Chocolate Lovers Delight
ingredients: 3 boxes instant chocolate pudding, prepared and refrigerated
1 box chocolate cake mix, prepared and cooled *
steps: *You may not need all of the cake when layering.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake
steps: Pour pumpkin pie mix in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sift 3/4 of the box of yellow cake mix over pie mix.
Sprinkle pecans on top of cake mix.
Melt butter and drizzle over top of pecans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Top with Cool Whip or vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Yum-A-Settie
steps: Brown hamburger with onion, salt, pepper and sugar.
Add tomato soup.
Cook noodles until tender; drain.
Add cream of chicken soup to noodles.
Layer in a casserole dish with cheese between layers.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Potato Dish
ingredients: 2 lb. bag frozen hash brown potatoes
steps: Mix all ingredients but potatoes and cornflakes, then add thawed potatoes.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish (well-greased).
Mix cornflakes and 1/2 cup melted margarine and sprinkle over top of the casserole.
Bake at 400°, uncovered, for 40 minutes.
This can be frozen.

recipes.title: Microwave Fudge
steps: Place chocolate chips and milk in microwave bowl.
Put in microwave for 2 minutes.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Stir and put in an 8 x 8-inch buttered pan; refrigerate for 1 hour or until set.
Keep unused fudge in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: a good sprinkling of minced garlic
steps: Mix all ingredients, except chili powder, thoroughly.
Roll in ball; sprinkle with chili powder.
Refrigerate overnight.
Serve with Ritz.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 can mushrooms (cut) and juice or substitute mushroom soup
steps: Boil hen until tender; add water to make 2 quarts.
Set aside. Cut onions, celery, pepper and garlic.
Cover and simmer until tender.
Put paste, tomatoes, veggies and 2 cups broth in heavy pan.
Cook slowly for 2 to 3 hours.
Add peas and all other ingredients.
Salt to taste.
Add water to make 2 quarts.
Bring to a boil.
Add spaghetti and cut up chicken.
Mix well.
Bake in covered roaster in medium oven until hot.
Serve with grated cheese.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake Pie
steps: Blend softened cream cheese until smooth.
Add other ingredients and blend until smooth.
Pour into crust and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Gourmet Gore'S Chicken A La Broccoli
steps: You will need aluminum foil, large pan and oven.

recipes.title: Tenderloin With Marinade
steps: Combine the first 5 ingredients.
Spear meat in several places and place in Ziploc bag.
Pour marinade over meat; refrigerate for 8 hours.
Turn occasionally.
Drain and reserve marinade.
Place on rack in baking pan.
Bake at 425° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Baste occasionally.
Serve with remaining marinade.
Makes 12 to 15 servings.

recipes.title: Copper Pennies
steps: Cook carrots in small amount of boiling water until tender (8 to 10 minutes).
Combine onions, pepper and carrots in large bowl; toss.
Combine rest of the ingredients until smooth (blender works well).
Pour over vegetables.
Cover and marinate in refrigerator overnight or longer.
Drain before serving (save marinade and return leftovers to marinade).

recipes.title: Day Ahead Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix bread stuffing, margarine
and
chicken broth.
Put half of mixture in bottom of 13 x
x 2-inch baking dish and press in place.
Mix chicken
and
remainder
of
stuffing mix with onion, celery, mayonnaise and
green
onions
and	spread over mixture in pan.
Beat eggs and
milk
and
pour over contents in pan.	Cover and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can kidney or chili beans
steps: Toss ingredients just before serving.
Serve with Creamy Italian or Ranch dressing.

recipes.title: Dirt Dessert
steps: Mix pudding and milk together and set in fridge.
Mix all ingredients together, except cookies.
In a flowerpot, ground Oreo cookies, layer cookies and pudding mixture until all used.

recipes.title: Candied Dills
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. mixed pickle spices, tie in nylon net bag
steps: Drain pickles and
cut
in lengthwise strips, slices or chunks.
Combine sugar
and
vinegar;
add
pickling
spices. Place pickles in bowl or
jar and cover with the syrup.
Cover and let stand for several days.
Stir every day.
Remove spice bag and pickles are ready.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Cook cranberries, water and sugar until berries pop.
Stir in jello and let cool.
Add grapes, nuts and pineapple.
Refrigerate until firm.
Great for the holidays.
Use Cranberry Salad in place of cranberry sauce for holiday dinners.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Mix green beans and mushroom soup together.
Add whole can of onions on top.
Cook in large shallow dish in oven (350°) for about 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Curry Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients together and chill.
Good for dipping celery, cauliflower, carrots, etc.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jello With Sour Cream
steps: Mix all ingredients, except sour cream.
Pour 1/2 of mixture into mold; congeal.
Add the sour cream on top of the congealed mixture.
Pour remaining Jell-O on top.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Norwegian Potato Soup
steps: Add all vegetables to meat stock.
Season to taste and simmer for one hour.
Combine beef, egg, milk and seasonings.
Form into very small meatballs.
Drop meatballs into boiling soup and cook 10 to 15 minutes.
Serves 10.

recipes.title: Date Salad
ingredients: 1/4 c. maple syrup or 2 Tbsp. maple extract
1 c. whipped cream or medium Cool Whip
steps: Mix well and chill before serving.

recipes.title: Turkey Or Chicken Divan
ingredients: 6 thick slices cooked turkey or chicken breast meat (can use smaller pieces)
steps: Place cooked broccoli in flat baking dish.
Lay turkey or chicken pieces on top.
In a separate bowl, combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice, sherry and curry powder.
Pour over meat slices.
Sprinkle with grated cheese.
Combine bread crumbs with butter and sprinkle over all.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Onion Dip
ingredients: potato chips, corn chips or crackers
steps: Thoroughly combine sour cream, mayonnaise or salad dressing, onion soup mix and parsley.
Cover; chill until serving time. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
steps: Mix together and bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
steps: Mix cracker crumbs and 1 stick butter and press into 2-quart dish for crust.
Mix powdered sugar, eggs and butter for 15 minutes with mixer.
Pour over crust.
Slice bananas and lay over powdered sugar mixture.
Put pineapple over bananas, then spread on the Cool Whip.
Top with nuts and cherries.
Put in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Dirt Dessert
steps: In bowl, soften cream cheese and blend in sugar.
In another bowl, blend milk and pudding until thick; add vanilla.
Blend both bowls together and fold in Cool Whip.
Crush Oreos in Ziploc bag until almost fine to look like dirt.
Layer 1/3 Oreos, 1/2 mixture, 1/3 Oreos, 1/2 mixture and 1/3 Oreos.
Gummy worms can be put in between layers.

recipes.title: Spiced Nuts
steps: Combine sugar, milk, cinnamon and vanilla.
Cook until sugar is dissolved.
Stir in pecans.
Spoon pecans onto cookie sheet and bake at 350° until pecans are dry.

recipes.title: No Fail Fudge
steps: Line 8-inch square pan with foil and grease with 1 teaspoon butter and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine powdered sugar, cocoa and salt.
Melt remaining butter and milk and vanilla.
Stir into sugar, mix until blended.
Whisk until smooth.
Stir in M&M's and pour into pan.
Refrigerate until firm.
Lift out of pan and discard foil.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Combine all and shape into ball.
Roll in parsley or nuts.

recipes.title: Apple Salad
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. lemon juice or 1 small stick cinnamon (optional)
steps: When jello begins to jell, stir in apples, celery and nuts. You may want to double this recipe, it's so good.

recipes.title: Summer Sausage
steps: Mix well.
Divide into 3 balls.
Roll to size of your choice. Wrap in foil.
Leave in icebox overnight.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Open one end of the foil.
Pour out excess grease and cool. Serve.

recipes.title: Salmon Log
ingredients: 1 pkg. cream cheese, softened (regular or light)
1/4 tsp. liquid smoke (key ingredient, do not increase amount)
steps: Mix with mixer until thoroughly blended. Cover and chill overnight.
Shape into log and roll in finely chopped pecans. Garnish with parsley, if desired. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Dressing For Cabbage Salad
steps: Put all ingredients in mixing bowl.
Mix until well blended. Pour over chopped cabbage.
Makes enough for 1 or 2 heads of cabbage.
Add carrots and peppers (chopped).

recipes.title: Chili(Microwave)
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can kidney or pinto beans (undrained)
steps: Combine ground beef, onion and celery in a 3-quart casserole. Microwave at High for 6 to 9 minutes or until meat is cooked and vegetables are tender.
Drain fat and break up meat.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover.
Microwave at High for 5 minutes. Stir.
Reduce power to 50% (Medium).
Microwave, uncovered, 30 to 35 minutes, stirring twice.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Punch
steps: Cook rhubarb with 1 quart of water.
Add sugar and bring to boil, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add juices and salt.
Freezes well.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Cook sugar, oleo and milk to soft ball stage.
Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter and chips.
Add Marshmallow Creme until the fudge is as creamy as you like.
Makes a large amount.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
steps: Mix ingredients and pour into 2 pizza pans which have been greased and floured.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Spread with Cool Whip.
Add all kinds of fruit to top such as strawberries, cherries, bananas, dark and light grapes and pineapple chunks.
You can also add nuts and miniature marshmallows.

recipes.title: Haystack Cookies
steps: Melt peanut butter chips and butterscotch chips together.
Add peanuts and potatoes.
Drop by spoonful onto wax paper.
Let cool until firm.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Cook first 3 ingredients over medium heat until soft ball forms.
Remove from heat and add last 3 ingredients.
Beat until mixture begins to thicken.
Pour into buttered 8-inch square pan; cool and cut into pieces.

recipes.title: Southwestern Layered Dip
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) can Chi-Chi's Fiesta cheese dip
1/2 c. sliced green onions or chopped onions
4 oz. shredded Cheddar cheese (can add more if desired)
steps: In a small mixer bowl, beat cheese dip, cream cheese and Worcestershire sauce until well blended.
Spread on serving plate. Drizzle with taco sauce.
Top with lettuce, onions, olives (if desired), tomato and Cheddar cheese.
Serve with tortilla chips and/or crackers.
Makes 4 cups.

recipes.title: Chocolate No-Bake Cookies
steps: In large saucepan, put sugar, cocoa, milk, butter and peanut butter.
Heat, melt until it comes to a full boil.
Boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Mix together oatmeal, vanilla and nuts.
Add to peanut butter mixture, mix thoroughly.
Drop by spoonfuls on aluminum foil.
Cool and enjoy.

recipes.title: Oreo Cool Cookie Crumble
steps: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add ice cream by spoonfuls.
Stir until ice cream is melted.
Fold in crumbled cookies.
Pour into individual dessert glasses or serving bowl. Chill until set, about 30 minutes.
Garnish with a whole cookie at the side of dish.
If you're counting calories, try making this recipe with sugar-free Jell-O gelatin.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Mix well; pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread 1 cup crushed cornflakes over casserole.
Pour 1/2 cup melted butter over cornflakes.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Broiled Lobster Tail
steps: Place lobster tails in large saucepan.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bring to boiling point.
Cover and cook 20 minutes. Remove tails from water.
Split in half with sharp knife.
Serve with melted butter.

recipes.title: Homemade Picante
steps: For HOT sauce leave seeds in the jalapenos.
For milder sauce, remove the seeds before beginning the recipe.

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix margarine and 2 tablespoons sugar together, add pretzels.
Pat into 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Bake 8 minutes.
Cool.
Mix cream cheese with 1 cup sugar until creamy. Fold in Cool Whip, spread on cooled pretzel crust.
Dissolve the strawberry Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water; set aside to cool.
Cut frozen strawberries in small pieces; while still frozen, stir into Jell-O.
Set mixture in refrigerator for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
steps: Beat the egg yolks with an electric mixer. Add the milk. Combine and blend in the lime juice.
Blend well.
Pour into crust.
Bake at 350° for 5 minutes in preheated oven.
Cool. Serve with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
steps: Put sausage meat into frying pan and heat until grease is cooked out.
Drain off grease.
Mix ingredients together with hands and roll into balls the size of a marble.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Makes 50 balls.

recipes.title: Oriental Beef
steps: Cut meat into strips, 1/4-inch wide and 2 to 3 inches long. Brown in small amount of oil; drain.
Add 1 cup water, soy sauce and chopped onion.
Cover and simmer 45 minutes.
Then add carrot, celery, green pepper, mushrooms, water chestnuts and salt to taste.
Cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes; do not overcook.
Combine cold water and cornstarch and gradually add to hot meat and vegetables, stirring constantly until mixture boils and thickens. Serve over rice.
Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Coffee Cake
steps: Mix sugar, butter and cinnamon together.
Slice apples and line a 9 x 13-inch pan with them (save some apples to put between biscuits).
Roll biscuits in sugar mixture and lay on top of apples.
Bake at 450° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven Baked Herb Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. fryer, cut in serving pieces
steps: Combine onion salad dressing mix, butter and paprika with a spatula.
Spread mixture over chicken pieces.
Roll in dry bread crumbs to coat.
Bake in greased pan at 375° about 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Meat Roll
steps: Mix ground chuck, onion, salt, pepper, garlic powder, oregano and Worcestershire sauce.

Brown mixture in large skillet. Continue to cook until onion is tender; drain and discard fat. Blend baking mix and milk to soft dough; turn onto lightly floured surface and roll into 9 x 12-inch rectangle.
Cover with meat mixture.
Roll as for jelly roll.
Place on greased baking sheet, seam side down.
Slash top several times with knife.
Bake in preheated oven at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cornbread Stuffing
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients in bowl; set aside.
Combine celery, onion, butter and water in saucepan and bring to boil. Add to cornbread mixture.
Stir in broth, oil and eggs and mix well.
Pour into grease baking dish and bake uncovered at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Fish With Lemon-Pepper Crust
ingredients: 1 c. fresh or dried bread crumbs
24 oz. firm white fish fillets, fresh or frozen, thawed
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
In a bowl, combine bread crumbs, parsley, pepper and salt.
Set aside.
Dip fish into melted butter and coat both sides with crumb mixture.
Place on a baking sheet and bake until cooked through, yet flaky to the fork, about 10 minutes.
Sprinkle lemon juice and serve.

recipes.title: Shepherd'S Pie(Easy)
steps: Thaw hash browns and meat ahead of time.
Combine meat, milk and dry soup mix.
Fill pie shell with this mixture.
Top with hash browns.
Add top crust.
Seal edges and pierce top in several places.
Bake at 350° about 1 hour or until brown.

recipes.title: Raspberry Dream Cake
steps: Slice cake into three layers.
Prepare Dream Whip.
Mash raspberries through a strainer so as to remove seeds.
Add a little raspberry juice to Dream Whip.
Add enough to make it light pink.
Spread whipped topping on cake layers.
Pour raspberries on top. (Sugar can be added to raspberries if not sweet enough.)

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 7 or 8 oz. spaghetti, broken into 2-inch pieces
steps: Brown beef and add onion while cooking.
Drain.
Add spaghetti sauce to meat mixture.
Cook spaghetti.
Mix butter, egg, Parmesan cheese and spices. Toss spaghetti to coat.
Spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Spread cottage cheese over spaghetti.
Top with meat mix. Bake at 350° uncovered for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.
Continue baking until cheese melts. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1/4 c. onion, mushrooms and green peppers
steps: Saute onion, mushrooms and green peppers. Cook vermicelli. Mix all ingredients. If desired, add 3 tablespoons Sauterne wine over top, then add bread crumbs mixed with parsley and melted butter and sprinkle on top. Bake in 13 x 9 baking dish at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Swiss Potato Soup
steps: In a medium size heavy saucepan, melt butter.
Add onion and carrot; saute for about 5 minutes, or until tender.
Stir in milk, broth, salt, nutmeg and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Stir in potato flakes; cook until slightly thickened (about 1 minute).
Add cheese; cook and stir over medium heat until blended.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corngroves, Texas
steps: Mix corn, milk and seasonings.
Mix crumbs and butter.
Place in baking dish, layer crumbs on bottom and top.
Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Juicy Supper Meat Loaf
steps: Mix well and bake in moderate oven at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Corn And Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup, undiluted
2 Tbsp. or more sliced, toasted almonds
steps: Combine all ingredients, except almonds.
Put in lightly greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Cover and microwave on High for 8 to 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with almonds.

recipes.title: Greek Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 firm, medium tomatoes, insides scooped out
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a small saucepan, heat oil and saute onion for 10 minutes.
Combine all the remaining ingredients except tomatoes and add to the onion.
Stuff filling into tomatoes.
Bake for 15 minutes and serve.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Cheese Spread
steps: Have ingredients at room temperature.
Whip slowly on mixer until fluffy.
Spread on sourdough French bread and toast under broiler.
Can be made up ahead of time.
Spread on bread and frozen.
Freezes very nicely.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix in order given. Add enough flour to make a rather stiff batter. Add nuts, dates and cut up candy orange slices. Bake in loaf pans for 1 hour.
Makes about 3 small loaves.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
steps: Bake 1 hour at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen broccoli or 2 c. fresh cooked broccoli
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Top with herb stuffing.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Squash Relish
steps: Soak squash overnight in refrigerator covered in water with 1/2 cup salt. Drain salt water off squash and wash well and drain again.

recipes.title: Bar-B-Cups
steps: Brown beef and onion.
Add barbecue sauce to taste.
Use canned biscuits to make shells in a muffin tin.
Fill with ground beef mixture and top with grated cheese.
Bake in 400° oven until done.

recipes.title: Hot And Spicy Spaghetti Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef; add celery, bell pepper and onions.
Saute until tender.
Stir in seasonings and crushed Ro-Tel tomatoes. Add mushrooms and drained peas.
In a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, layer: cooked spaghetti, meat and vegetable mixture and grated cheese.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pudding Frosting
steps: Whip until mixture stands in soft peaks.
Refrigerate for about one hour before frosting.

recipes.title: Cherry Angel Dessert
ingredients: 1 c. sour cream or plain yogurt
steps: Place cake cubes in a 9 x 9-inch pan.
Reserve 1/2 can cherry pie filling; spoon rest over cake.
Combine pudding mix, milk and sour cream; beat until smooth.
Spoon over cake.
Garnish with the remaining cherries and chill at least 5 hours.

recipes.title: Microwave Bread Pudding
ingredients: 3 slices dried bread or leftover toast
steps: Crumble bread in buttered 1 1/2-quart microwave dish.
Beat eggs; stir in sugar, salt, vanilla and 1/2 cup milk until sugar feels dissolved, then add 1 cup milk and stir well.
Pour over bread and sprinkle nutmeg lightly, if desired.
Cook on High power for 7 or 8 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed.
Eat hot or chill and top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Mini Pizzas
steps: Sprinkle biscuits and rolling pin with flour.
Roll out flat and place on cookie sheet.
Top with pizza sauce, parsley flakes and cheese.
Bake 5 minutes at 425° or until biscuits are brown and cheese is melted.
Makes 8.

recipes.title: Lobster Sauce(Chinese Recipe)
ingredients: 2 beef bouillon cubes, melted in 1 c. hot water
steps: Brown hamburger, drain and chop up fine.
Add beaten egg.
Mix well.
Add garlic powder and sugar.
Stop there.
Separately add beef bouillon and water.
Then add cornstarch, soy sauce and Gravy Master. Pour into meat mixture and simmer 10 minutes, uncovered. Serve over Chinese noodles or rice.
Then sit and enjoy!

recipes.title: Veg-All Casserole
steps: Mix all ingredients except Ritz crackers.
Put in casserole dish. Top with Ritz crackers. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Weight Watchers Delight
steps: Slice cake.
Make pudding as directed.
Put layers of cake first, then layer of pudding, layer of pineapple and layer of fruit cocktail.
Repeat process.
Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Casserole
steps: Skillet brown beef and onion.
Drain fat.
Add soup and water; bring to a boil.
Add noodles and cook until noodles are tender. Add corn and bring to a boil.
Add cheese and sour cream.
Place in a greased casserole dish (1 1/2 to 2-quart).
Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate
steps: Bake chocolate cake according to instructions on box.
Prepare chocolate pudding.
Crush the Skor bars.
Layer in a medium bowl in the following order:
cake, pudding, Cool Whip and Skor bars. Repeat.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Dutch'S Apple Pie
steps: Arrange apples in unbaked pie shell.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup of sugar. Mix together second half of sugar, spices, flour and milk. Pour over apples.
Cook at 275° until brown.

recipes.title: Snow Cream
steps: Have fun gathering 1 large bowl of snow.
Beat the egg.
Add sugar and vanilla.
Combine with snow and add milk for consistency.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Hi-Ho Cake
steps: Beat egg whites and add sugar until stiff.
Mix crackers, pecans and baking powder.
Add to egg whites.
Fold together. Pour into round cake pan that has been greased.
Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.
Cool completely.
Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: 20-Minute Cacciatore
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cubed
4 c. hot cooked wheel-shaped macaroni (2 c. uncooked)
steps: In 10-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot oil, cook chicken with garlic and black pepper 10 minutes or until chicken is lightly browned, stirring occasionally.
Add spaghetti sauce and green pepper.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender.
Serve over macaroni.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Meat Filled Shells
ingredients: 18 shells, cooked by directions on pkg.
steps: Put hamburger in skillet.
Add Italian seasoning, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Brown hamburger and set aside.
In same pan, add a little oil and cook onions, green pepper and celery.
Mix with hamburger and add enough spaghetti sauce so it will stick together good.
Pour remaining sauce in bottom of pan.
Stuff shells with mixture and arrange in pan.
Pour most of second jar of sauce over the stuffed shells.
Top with cheese.
Cook 35 minutes at 350°.
Serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
ingredients: 1 C Karo syrup, white or dark
steps: Mix together in heavy pan the sugar, syrup and water. Cook until it spins a thread and turns a light brown when dropped into cold water.

recipes.title: Lisa'S Meat Loaf
steps: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Put into loaf pan; cover with 2 strips bacon.
Pour tomato sauce over all.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Reuben Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
steps: Mix soup, milk, mustard and onion.

recipes.title: Tomato Casserole
steps: Place butter and onion in skillet and saute.
Add croutons and mix.
Place 1/2 of the onion and croutons in an 8 x 12-inch baking dish.
Cover with tomato slices (1/2-inch thick).
Repeat layers. Sprinkle with chopped basil.
Sprinkle with grated Havarti cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Candy
steps: Mix peanut butter, powdered sugar, oil and chocolate chips together. Set aside while chopping nuts. Put chopped nuts in bowl. By teaspoonfuls, roll candy mixture in chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Favorite Chicken Salad
steps: Put chicken in a saucepan with 3 cups of water, 1 teaspoon salt and 3 peppercorns.
Bring to a boil; lower heat, cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until tender.
Drain, bone and cut into bite size pieces.
Combine chicken, chestnuts, grapes and celery. Mix mayonnaise, curry powder, soy sauce and lemon juice.
Pour over chicken; toss lightly to mix.
Chill.
Spoon on lettuce and garnish with drained pineapple chunks.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
steps: Mix the gelatin with 1 pint boiling water in a large bowl. Let sit in refrigerator until slightly thickened.
Then beat in the condensed milk and mayonnaise.
Stir in crushed pineapple, including juice, and nuts.
Leave in the bowl or pour into individual molds and let stand in the refrigerator until jelled. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Cranberry Chicken
ingredients: 10 chicken breasts, skinned and boned (5 whole)
steps: Mix the cranberry sauce, French dressing and onion soup together; pour over chicken breasts in baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Nacho Dip
steps: Cut chicken in small pieces.
Fry in 2 tablespoons oil until white.
Add diced peppers.
Fry until soft.
Drain liquid.
Put in separate bowl.
Put salsa in pan with 2 cups cheese.
Heat until cheese melts.
Add chicken and peppers.
Heat for 2 minutes.
Put chips on tray.
Put mix on top.
Add shredded cheese on top.
Bake in oven at 350° until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. salt and pepper to taste
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into small pieces.
Add to water the ham seasoning, margarine/butter, sugar and salt and pepper.
Then add potatoes and chopped onions.
Bring to boil.
Simmer until potatoes are tender.
Slightly mash potatoes with potato masher.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pickles
steps: Put zucchini, onions and peppers in a large container and sprinkle with 1/2 cup coarse salt.
Cover with 4 trays of ice cubes and let stand 3 to 4 hours.

recipes.title: Maw'S Egg Custard(Nellie Starnes)
steps: Mix well and pour into pie crust.
Sprinkle nutmeg onto the top.
Bake at 350° until toothpick comes out clean, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
steps: Crush pretzels and add 1/3 cup sugar and margarine. Bake at 400° for 5 to 7 minutes. Set aside to cool. Cream together cream cheese (room temperature) and 1/2 cup sugar until sugar is not grainy. Stir in pineapple. Fold in Cool Whip and pretzels.

recipes.title: Brenda'S Banana Split Cake
steps: 1st Layer:
Cook yellow cake mix according to box directions. Cool!

recipes.title: Herbed Peasant Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen white bread dough, thawed
1 c. crumbled goat or Feta cheese
steps: Form thawed dough into a ball.
Press dough into a 12-inch circle.
Place on a greased pizza pan.
Brush with 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 10 minutes until lightly browned.
In a small cup, combine 2 tablespoons olive oil, sage, rosemary and garlic powder.
Brush with 1/2 sage mixture over entire crust.
Top with remaining ingredients and drizzle with remaining sage mixture.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Salad
steps: Blend jello, Cool Whip, sour cream and coconut in large bowl. Add oranges, pineapple and pecans to Cool Whip mixture.
Fold gently until all ingredients are blended.
Chill.
Yield:
6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Mom'S Pound Cake
steps: Mix together; beat on medium-high for 3 minutes.
Pour into greased Bundt pan.
Cook at 350° for 38 to 40 minutes.
Do not overcook.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dry mix
steps: Crust:
Pat rolls in an 11 x 16-inch cookie sheet sprayed with Pam.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes.
Cool.

recipes.title: Goofy Butter Cake
steps: Mix cake mix, egg and margarine.
Add pecans and coconut. Press into 9 x 13-inch greased pan.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Sandwiches
steps: Put ice cream on one graham crackers; put the other graham cracker on top of the ice cream.
Leave in freezer 2 to 4 days.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Slice cukes and onions thin.
Mix in salt and cover; let stand 3 hours.
Drain well.
Make a syrup of the sugar, vinegar, water, turmeric, cloves, mustard seed and celery seed.
Pour over cukes slices and place over low heat.
Heat but do not boil.
Pour into hot jars and seal.

recipes.title: Dressed Eggs(We Don'T Say "Devil" At Our House)
steps: Boil a dozen eggs, more or less.
Shell and slice in halves, remove yolks and discard 1/2 yolks (this cuts cholesterol by 50%). Mash the remaining yolks with fork, add sweet pickle relish, seasoned pepper, chives and mayonnaise.
Add a touch of sugar. Beat this mixture so as to puff with air and you won't miss the extra yolks.
Dress the whites with the yolk mixture and sprinkle with paprika if desired.
(Hide from John until ready to serve. He can sure "scarf" them up.)

recipes.title: Chicken Taco Casserole
steps: Fry hamburger.
Drain.
Add onion.
Cook a few minutes.
Add soup, sauce, Milnot and chilies.
Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish with Doritos; add hamburger.
Pour sauce over chips and hamburger; add another layer of chips and cover with cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Polly'S Bourbon Balls
steps: Put dates, figs and pecans through the coarsest blade of food grinder.
Mix with diced candied cherries and whiskey.
Shape into marble sized bites, using 2 teaspoons of the mixture.
Roll each marble in coconut.
Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Five Cup Fruit Salad("A Favorite From The '76 Cookbook.")
steps: Combine all five ingredients and chill before serving.

recipes.title: Alana'S Chili(Yields 6 Servings)
steps: Cut pepper into slices and then small pieces.
Slice and cut onion.
Saute gently for 5 minutes in pan.

recipes.title: Pink Dessert
steps: Mix all together with cottage cheese and jello. Add Cool Whip. Mix well. Let stand overnight in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Jeanie'S Potatoes
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom or chicken soup
steps: Mix cheese, onion, sour cream and soup.
Mix potatoes with cheese mixture and put in casserole dish.
Sprinkle crushed corn flakes over the top.
Put melted butter over corn flakes and bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Have cheese at room temperature.
Chop dried beef.
Blend all ingredients together; shape into ball and serve with crackers.

recipes.title: California Yogurt Soup
ingredients: 1 peeled and seeded cucumber, finely chopped
finely chopped parsley and dill (for garnish)
steps: Combine all ingredients, except parsley and dill.
Chill for 2 to 3 hours.
Garnish with parsley and dill just before serving.

recipes.title: Hot Beef
ingredients: 1/3 c. red wine or cooking wine
clove of garlic or garlic salt/powder
steps: Combine wine, salad oil, green pepper, onion, garlic, pepper and tomato sauce to make the marinade.

recipes.title: Creamy Fudge
steps: Melt butter and cheese in heavy metal 2-quart pan on medium heat.
Add vanilla and cocoa.
Stir well until smooth.
Remove from heat.
Add sugar.
Mix well until smooth.
Fold in nuts and spoon into buttered pan or dish.
Spread and let cool completely before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
steps: Cook sausage over medium flame until done, stirring to crumble well; drain on paper towels and set aside.
Spread each slice of bread with margarine; cut into cubes.
Place bread cubes in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; sprinkle with sausage and top with cheese. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over sausage mixture. Chill at least 8 hours.
Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Seafood Spread
steps: Put all ingredients in bowl; mix well, adding Old Bay to your taste.
Chill.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Stained Window Glass Cookies
steps: In large bowl mix the chocolate chips and margarine with colored marshmallows and chopped nuts.
On wax paper sprinkle some coconut.
Pour mixture on wax paper and form into a roll.
Place in refrigerator to harden, then slice into pieces.
This will keep 3 to 4 months.

recipes.title: Texas Apple Relish
steps: Combine all ingredients in a Dutch oven and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 5 minutes. Seal in jars or may be refrigerated for up to 1 month in unsealed jar.

recipes.title: Hearty Chowder
steps: Brown hamburger, onion and celery.
Add other ingredients and simmer.

recipes.title: Ribbon Sandwich
steps: Shell and chop eggs.
Mix with 1/4 cup of mayonnaise, mustard, salt and pepper.
Drain tuna; mix with 1/4 cup of mayonnaise, celery and sweet pickle.
Refrigerate in separate bowls.
Trim crusts from each loaf.
Slice each loaf into 5 to 7 horizontal slices.
Alternate spreading tuna and egg mixtures on each horizontal slice.
Wrap in foil or plastic and refrigerate overnight.
Cut this loaf of alternating bread and fillings into 15 to 20
crosswise slices.
Each slice can be halved.
Keep refrigerated until served.
Yields 10 servings.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Butter
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Delicious on pumpkin bread or any bread or roll.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen Alaskan King crabmeat or snow crabmeat or 3/4 lb. imitation crab blend
1 c. fresh bread crumbs, soaked in 1/2 c. milk
steps: Thaw crabmeat; drain.
Separate into small pieces and mix 1/2 cup soaked bread crumbs, eggs, mayo and parsley.
Put into 1-quart greased casserole dish.
Top with cracker crumbs.
Bake in 450° oven for 25 minutes.
Makes 2 to 3 servings.

recipes.title: Cucumbers In Sour Cream
steps: In a medium bowl, sprinkle salt over sliced cucumbers.
Let stand 20 minutes. Drain. Add remaining ingredients.
Toss lightly. Cover and chill.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Syl'S Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. chopped celery, saute until tender
1/2 medium chopped onion, saute until tender
1 box macaroni, boiled in water from chicken
steps: Debone chicken.
Chop chicken meat into 1-inch squares.
Add to mixture of remaining ingredients and mix well.
Spoon into a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Add cheese or bread crumbs to top and return to oven to brown.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
ingredients: 2 c. red or green sweet pepper strips
steps: Wash cucumbers.
Do not peel.
Cut into very thin slices.
Put cucumbers, onions and peppers into a large kettle.
Dissolve salt in water and pour over vegetables.
Stir.
Put a 2-inch thick layer of ice cubes or crushed ice over the top and let stand 3 hours, weighted with a heavy object.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
steps: Mix altogether in a mixer until smooth.
Grease dish with butter.

recipes.title: Spiritual Fruit Salad
steps: Stir ingredients together; serve it to your friends and they will go crazy about Jesus!

recipes.title: Crab Bites
ingredients: 7 oz. can crab meat or fresh crab or shrimp, drained
steps: Mix together and spread on English muffin halves and freeze. Cut into eighths and broil until well browned.
Do not thaw!
Must be frozen to broil properly.
(Halves could be served as a luncheon dish.)
Cut while still frozen.
Broil at 450° for about 5 minutes.
Canned mushrooms can be used but fresh is better!

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: Brown meat and drain; add taco seasoning.
In large bowl, chop lettuce.
Add tomatoes, cheese, chips and meat mixture.
Pour dressing over and mix well.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Vegetable Ball
steps: Mix together and refrigerate two hours.
Take out and make ball.
Roll in chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Pistachio Pie
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple, juice and all
steps: Blend instant pudding, Cool Whip and crushed pineapple.
Pour into chocolate crust.
Top with walnuts and/or shaved chocolate. Freeze.
Thaw about 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Glazed Carrots
steps: Cook 3 to 4 carrots; cut crosswise in 1-inch pieces.
Add butter, brown sugar (packed) and grated lemon rind and juice to taste.
Heat slow, stirring occasionally, until nicely glazed, about 15 minutes.
Makes 2 to 3 servings.

recipes.title: Homemade Chili For Hot Dogs
steps: Chop onion and brown in grease from hamburger meat, but brown meat first.
Add meat to onion.
Season with salt, pepper and chili powder.
Add 2 cans tomato sauce plus 2 cans of water.
Cook slowly over low heat for 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
steps: In large mixing bowl mix all ingredients except margarine and cereal.
Mix well and pour into 10 x 13-inch baking dish.
Melt margarine and spread over top of mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Or Turkey Dressing
ingredients: 2 c. bread crumbs or Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
steps: Mix cornbread and bread crumbs (or stuffing mix) with broth. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, until light brown. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Grits Casserole
steps: Cook grits according to package directions.
Melt cheese with butter.
Mix eggs in a measuring cup and fill to top with milk. Mix together and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Meat Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients together. Roll in small balls and bake 20 minutes at 350°. Makes 3 or 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Diabetic Dessert
ingredients: 1 can lite cherry pie filling (or one you make any fruit)
1 box instant vanilla pie filling with NutraSweet
steps: Mix vanilla pie filling with milk as directed on box.
In large bowl (punch), slice cake.
Place a layer of cake in bottom of bowl. Place a layer of pie filling over cake, layer of pineapple, layer of bananas, layer of pudding, layer of Cool Whip and sprinkle with a few chopped nuts.
Repeat with another layer of all of the layers, ending with Cool Whip and nuts.

recipes.title: Russian Tea
steps: Mix all together.
Use 3 teaspoons of mix for 1 cup.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can green chilies, chopped and undrained
steps: Cut 6 tortillas in 1/2-inch wide strips.
Saute onion and garlic in 2 tablespoons of hot oil.
Add next 10 ingredients; bring to a boil.
Cover.
Reduce heat and simmer 1 hour.
Add strips and cheese.
Cook, uncovered, 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with paprika and serve with reserved tortilla strips and chips.

recipes.title: Eggplant Roll-Ups
steps: Dip eggplant slices in eggs, then in bread crumbs, seasoned with garlic.
Brown lightly.
Lay on platter.
Mix Ricotta, Mozzarella and parsley.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 large jar Miracle Whip salad dressing
1/4 c. vinegar (from jar of sweet pickles)
steps: Grate vegetables.
Add sugar to mayonnaise and vinegar. Pour over cabbage, carrots and onion and let sit in refrigerator for a couple of hours.

recipes.title: Congealed Salad
steps: Drain pineapple.
Save 1 cup of juice.
Make jello according to directions except use the 1 cup juice instead of 2nd cup of water. Blend in mayo.
Pour into a mold.
Add chopped pecans, cherries, pineapple and cheese.
Refrigerate.
Remove from mold.
Cover with Cool Whip and garnish with pecans, cherry halves and shredded cheese.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Roll-Ups
steps: Mix together cream cheese, egg yolk and sugar.
Spread over bread.
Roll up jelly roll style.
Dip in melted butter, then into cinnamon and sugar mixture.
Freeze overnight.
Cut each roll in half and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Yields 32 rolls.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Magic Bars(Makes 24 To 36 Bars)
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
steps: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass). In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt butter in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over butter. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients in order listed; press down firmly. Bake 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool. Chill, if desired. Cut into bars. Store, covered, at room temperature.

recipes.title: Matthew Schmidts Apple Crunch
steps: Spread pie filling in bottom of a 10-inch cake pan.
Sprinkle cake mix over pie filling.
Sprinkle nuts on top and pour melted margarine over nuts.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Aunt Jewel'S Chicken Salad
ingredients: 3 to 4 chicken breasts, baked and chopped
steps: Toast the seeds and nuts in a skillet; use the same skillet for dressing.
Toss all ingredients and season to taste.

recipes.title: Apple Wassail
steps: Boil all of the ingredients for 5 minutes, then add 1 tablespoon of brown sugar and boil for 15 minutes. Garnish with lemon or orange slices.

recipes.title: Oriental Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. asparagus, broken in bite size pieces
steps: Cook asparagus until tender-crisp; mix sauce ingredients in a small bowl with a small whisk and pour over asparagus after draining.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Sandwich In Foil
steps: Make dressing of first 5 ingredients and spread on both sides of buns.
Place ham and cheese on bun; wrap lightly in foil and place on cookie sheet and bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef in skillet with salt, pepper and onion.
Add potatoes, both cans of soup and water.
Cook until it starts to bubble.
Pour into casserole and bake at 350° for about 40 minutes or until potatoes are done.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheesecake Cups
steps: Beat cream cheese, sugar, eggs, and vanilla together.
Put 2 vanilla wafers in each muffin cup.
Fill 2/3 full with cream cheese mixture.
Bake at 350° for 10-15 minutes.
Cool and add cherry pie filling.
Makes 24.

recipes.title: Easy Soup
steps: Bring soup mix, bouillon cubes and water to a boil.
Add spaghetti and potatoes.
Boil 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients in a 1-quart bowl. Stir well.
Yields 6.

recipes.title: Cheese Bagels(Appetizer)
ingredients: 1 c. (4 oz.) Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese, shredded
steps: Combine ingredients; spread on bagelettes.
Broil until cheese is melted.
(May use 24 party bread slices toasted.)

recipes.title: Broken Glass Pie
steps: Set Jell-O with 1 1/2 cups hot water.
Let set overnight. Then cut the red and green into 1/2-inch cubes.
Heat 1 cup pineapple juice with 1/4 cup sugar (do not boil) and pour over the lemon Jell-O that is already set.
Mix well, then set in refrigerator until the consistency of unbeaten egg white (about 1 hour).

recipes.title: Butterscotch Haystacks
steps: Line cookie trays with wax paper. Microwave chips in large microwave-safe bowl on Medium-high (70%) for 1 minute. Stir. Microwave at additional 10 to 20 second intervals, stirring until smooth. Stir in peanut butter until well blended. Add chow mein noodles and marshmallows. Toss until all ingredients are coated. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto trays. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Granny'S Freezer Pickles
steps: Sprinkle salt over cucumbers and onions and let set for 2 hours.
Stir occasionally and then drain.
Mix together sugar and vinegar and heat enough to melt sugar; let cool.
Pour over pickles.
Place in freezer container and freeze.

recipes.title: Scalloped Cabbage
steps: Cook cabbage 15 minutes.
Reserve 1 cup liquid, beat eggs. Add milk, nutmeg, salt, 1 cup liquid and pepper.
Mix all together.
Put in buttered baking dish.
Bake at 300° until set (1 1/2 to 2 hours).

recipes.title: Festive Vegetarian Chic
steps: Glaze zucchini and broccoli in 1/2 tablespoon of oil and sprinkle with paprika, Parmesan and a large chunk of tomatoes. Stir gently while warming.

recipes.title: Apple Pie Ala Mode Shake
ingredients: 1 c. skim milk or plain nonfat yogurt
steps: Blend ingredients and serve.
Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Lasagna
steps: Cook 9 lasagna pasta noodles according to package. Brown ground meat and drain off all fat. Add spaghetti sauce and
tomato sauce and simmer 15 minutes. Drain off water from noodles and place 3 lasagna noodles on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Stroganoff
steps: In a skillet with approximately 2 cups water and 2 beef bouillon cubes, cook off and brown beef and onion.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Stir well.
Heat through and serve over cooked noodles.

recipes.title: Nutty Pudding Bars
ingredients: 2 c. butterscotch or peanut butter chips
1/2 (4 serving) pkg. regular vanilla pudding (5 Tbsp.)
steps: Combine chips, peanut butter and unsweetened chocolate. Stir over low heat until melted. Spread 1/2 in 15 x 10-inch pan. Chill. Combine butter, pudding and milk. Cook and stir to melt butter. Stir in vanilla. Turn into large mixer bowl; beat in sugar until smooth. Spread over chilled layer. Sprinkle nuts on top. Spread remaining chocolate over all. Chill until firm. Makes 6 pounds.

recipes.title: Glazed Carrots
steps: Peel carrots and cut into serving size pieces.
Cook carrots in boiling, salted water until just tender.
Drain.
While carrots are cooking, whip butter and honey together until light and fluffy.
Add orange rind, nutmeg and vanilla. Spoon glaze over carrots and toss well.

recipes.title: Chex Muddy Buddies Puppy Chow
steps: Pour cereal in large bowl.
Melt chocolate chips, butter and peanut butter.
Stir in vanilla.
Pour mixture over Chex cereal until evenly coated.
Shake on powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Amaretto Cake
ingredients: 1 (3 oz. size) pkg. vanilla instant pudding
steps: Spray Bundt pan with Pam.
Into each crevice, place 2 maraschino cherries.
Sprinkle pecan pieces over bottom of pan.

recipes.title: Baked Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 to 2 c. grated Longhorn cheese according to taste
steps: Cook spaghetti in boiling water until tender and drain.
Cook onion and pepper in oil until tender.
Add tomato, salt, pepper and sugar.
Cook for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and mix with spaghetti.
Add 1/2 of cheese.
Sprinkle top with remaining cheese. Bake at 375° until cheese has melted or turns brown.

recipes.title: Grandma Cline'S Potato Salad
ingredients: 5 lb. potatoes, cooked, but still crunchy, and cubed
steps: Combine potatoes, celery, onion, eggs, celery seed and salt and pepper; set aside.
Mix Miracle Whip, mustard, sugar, vinegar and cream.
Pour over potatoes, onions, etc.
Chill cauliflower and broccoli, then cook and drain.
Mix eggs, salad dressing, cream of mushroom soup, stuffing mix and small onion.
Melt margarine and pour in casserole.
Add broccoli and cauliflower.
Pour over other ingredients.
Add grated Cheddar cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad
steps: Mix together mayonnaise, sour cream, sugar, salt, dill weed and garlic powder.
Toss with vegetables.
Refrigerate for 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Raspberry And Black Cherry Jello
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. Royal black cherry Jell-O
steps: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water.
Add blueberries and pineapple, well drained.
Chill until set.

recipes.title: Sugarless Apple Pie
ingredients: 12 oz. can frozen apple juice concentrate
steps: Peel and slice apples.
Mix all ingredients together.
Simmer until thick.
Pour into pie crust and cover with top crust.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Appetizer Pie
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. dried beef, cut in small pieces
steps: Blend cheese, sour cream and milk until smooth. Stir in rest of the ingredients, except nuts. Spoon into pie dish and sprinkle with nuts. Chill and serve with crackers.

recipes.title: No Bake Peanut Butter Balls
steps: In small bowl, mix milk, peanut butter, honey and graham crackers until blended.
Shape into 1-inch balls; roll in coating. Makes 24.

recipes.title: Sausage Pie
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. garlic powder and oregano or Italian seasoning
steps: Skin and saute sausage; drain.
Spray 13 x 9-inch pan with Pam.
Break up sausage and crumble in bottom of pan.
Top with Mozzarella cheese.
Mix other ingredients (except grated cheese and paprika).
Pour over Mozzarella and sausage.
Sprinkle grated cheese and paprika on top.
Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife comes out clean.
Remove from oven.
Loosen around sides.
Cut in desired sizes when cool.
For appetizer.

recipes.title: Lettuce And Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 4 to 8 oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
steps: Layer in large bowl as listed; let set overnight.
Stir just before serving.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
steps: Cut zucchini in bite size pieces and cook in small amount of water for five minutes.
Drain.
Mix cream of chicken soup, onion, pimento, carrots, sour cream, salt and pepper.
Fold in zucchini. Melt margarine and add to stuffing mix.
Line casserole with stuffing, reserving small amount for top.
Pour in zucchini mixture.
Top with stuffing and sprinkle with toasted almonds. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Nacho Dip
steps: Pour all ingredients into a slow cooker.
Mix well.
Heat on low for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
steps: Mix sugar, water, margarine and cornstarch.
Cook until clear. Remove from heat and add Jell-O.
Let cool.
Add to strawberries. Pour into baked pie shell and top with whipped topping.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken
steps: Pour vegetables into 13 x 2 x 9-inch pan.
Mix soup, sour cream, onion,
cheese and water in separate bowl.
Pour over vegetables.
Melt butter.
Mix with crackers and stuffing mix. Sprinkle over dish.
Cook for 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Ginger Beer
ingredients: 3 large pieces ginger root, peeled and finely grated to a pulp
steps: In large stockpot, combine grated ginger with the boiling water and sugar. Stir well to mix, then cover and let stand at room temperature for about 2 days. Strain the ginger beer through clean muslin and store it in a glass drink bottle in the refrigerator until it is ready to drink. Serve with ice and stir in small amount of lime juice if you wish. Makes about 3 quarts.

recipes.title: Noodles Napoleoni
ingredients: 1 (8 oz) pkg thin noodles cooked according to pkg
steps: Cook meat, garlic, salt, and pepper until hamburger is done. Add tomato sauce cover bring to boil and simmer for 15 minutes.
In another bowl combine cream cheese, sour cream and scallions - set aside.
Combine hamburger sauce with the cooked noodles.
In buttered 2-qt casserole layer as follows:
1/2 of the noodles and hamburger mixture, 1/2 of the scallion mixture (just drop the scallion mixture by teaspoon over noodles mixture).
Cover with cheddar cheese an bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Picante Dip
steps: Cube cheese and add sauce.
Microwave for 5 minutes and stir. Serve with nacho chips.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen unsweetened apple juice concentrate
5 large apples, cored, peeled and sliced
steps: Mix juice with cornstarch; heat to thicken.
Add butter and spices; mix lightly with apples.
Fill pastry lined pan.
Cover with top crust (vented or slit).
Bake at 450° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Mix first 5 ingredients.
Add 1 cups of nuts.
Chill and form into ball.
Roll in remaining cup of chopped pecans.

recipes.title: Mini Ham Sandwiches
steps: Chop fine the
ham
and
Swiss cheese. Slice rolls down the middle and	open.
Melt margarine. Add minced onion, poppy seed, golden
mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Spread mixture over rolls. Layer
ham
and
cheese.
Put
top
back on rolls. Bake at 350° about 10 minutes. Cut and serve.

recipes.title: Cracker Pie
steps: Place in buttered pie plate.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti
ingredients: 2 jars spaghetti sauce with meat (Ragu meat sauce works well)
1 large (2 c.) pkg. grated Mozzarella cheese
steps: Cook ziti as usual.
Mix the egg into the Ricotta cheese. Grease 9 x 12-inch baking pan.
Begin layering ingredients.
First layer of ziti, second layer meat sauce.
Top that with dollops of Ricotta, then Mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top of Mozzarella.
Then start layering again, ending up with the Parmesan.
Bake at 350° approximately 1 hour, depending on your oven.
Do not overbake.
(Leave uncovered unless top begins browning too much.)

recipes.title: Cheesy Hash Brown Potatoes
steps: Mix potatoes, salt, pepper, onion and shredded cheese.
In another bowl, mix melted oleo, sour cream and cream of chicken soup.
Pour over potatoes and mix.
Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine crushed corn flakes and 1/4 cup oleo and sprinkle over top of potatoes.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage And Peppers On A Roll
steps: Saute sausage in 1 tablespoon olive oil prickling sausage to release fat.
After browned, drain off fat from sausage; add sliced onion, green pepper, tomatoes and salt, pepper and garlic powder as desired.
Simmer for 1 hour.
Serve on hard crust roll.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Pepper Relish
ingredients: 1/4 c. ground jalapeno (1/4 lb.), seeds removed
steps: Put peppers in blender with vinegar.
Use about a 7-quart pan; put sugar and pepper mixture in and bring to a boil.
Boil for 3 minutes and take off stove.
Add Certo.
Boil 1 minute longer. Let stand 2 to 4 minutes, then pour into jars.
Makes approximately 6 to 7 jars.

recipes.title: Applesauce Meat Loaf
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients.
Knead mixture with hands until well blended.
Pack into loaf pan.
Top with Healthy Choice pasta sauce.
Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours.
Uncover and bake 15 minutes more.
Serves 8.
Serving Amount:
1 portion. Exchanges:
3 meat and 1 bread.
Calories:

recipes.title: Turnip Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 350°. Use 2 tablespoons of butter to make buttered crumbs; set aside. Peel and slice turnips; cover with water and bring to the boil. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes; drain. Add more water and cook for 15 to 16 minutes. Drain and mash. Beat in the cream cheese, salt, pepper, sugar and the remaining butter; mix well.
Pour into a greased casserole and cover with the buttered crumbs. Bake until hot and lightly browned, about 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Tuna Braid
ingredients: 10 oz. box frozen spinach, thawed and chopped
any white bread dough recipe or French bread for 1 loaf
steps: Make bread dough 2 hours or more ahead.
Thaw and drain spinach (Swiss chard also works well).
Chop spinach and set aside. Combine tuna, cottage cheese, spinach and cheeses.

recipes.title: Turkey Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
steps: Cook spaghetti and drain.
Combine all ingredients, reserving 3/4 cup cheese.
Pour mixture into a greased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Remove from oven; sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake 10 more minutes.
Yield:
4 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Prepare one package of Dream Whip.
Mix into peanut butter. Add cream cheese, butter and sugar.
Pour into cooled, baked pie shell.

recipes.title: Orange Rhubarb Drink
steps: In saucepan, cook rhubarb with water and sugar for 20 minutes. Press through a sieve.
Put fruit juices in jar.
Add mixture; cover and chill.

recipes.title: Microwave Banana Cream Pie
steps: Place pudding in 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Gradually stir in milk.
Cook full power 6 to 8 minutes or until pudding boils and is thickened.
Stir 2 to 3 times while cooking.
Add marshmallows. Heat full power 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 minutes or until marshmallows melt.
Stir halfway through heating time.
Cover with wax paper and chill.
Whip cream until stiff in small bowl.
Fold into cooled pudding.
Slice bananas into pie crust.
Pour filling over bananas.
Chill several hours before serving.
May top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
ingredients: several ripe bananas or 1 large can pineapple (drained), crushed type
steps: Mix pudding according to directions; set aside.
In a baking dish layer repeatedly pudding, wafers and bananas until dish is full or your run out of items.
Beat egg whites until stiff and add sugar; beat a little longer.
Smooth over top of pudding mixture.
Brown to a golden
brown in 350° oven. Same dish can be made only use drained pineapple (crushed type) in place of bananas.
Equally good.

recipes.title: Ozark Pudding
steps: Combine beaten egg yolks, sugar and melted margarine.
Add pineapple.
Beat whipped cream.
Layer with vanilla wafers, like a banana pudding.
Top with whipped cream.
Sprinkle nuts on top. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1 c. red pepper or 1/2 c. red and 1/2 c. yellow pepper
8 c. cooked pasta (I use mini rotini)
steps: Stir-fry vegetables in olive oil and garlic (or steam, if you prefer) in large frypan.
Stir in cooked pasta.
Add butter over low heat.
Add Parmesan and stir until melted.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
If you prefer, you may add half and half or evaporated milk to create a creamy sauce.
Feel free to change vegetables to suit your taste.
