recipes.title: Cherry Delight
steps: Mix pie filling, pineapple and milk together.
Stir in Cool Whip.
Serve chilled or frozen.

recipes.title: White Sauce With Spaghetti
steps: Cook cloves of garlic in olive oil in frying pan.
Add green olives and half and half.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add cooked pasta; simmer for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Refreshing Drink
steps: Blend ingredients in blender.

recipes.title: Coconut Nut Cake Topping
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Divide mixture between 2 baked 8-inch round cake layers.
Spread evenly on top of each cake layer.
Place cake dish on tray shelf in center position.
(Use ovenproof glass or ceramic dish that will withstand the browning element heat.)
Do one layer at a time, positioning the cake correctly under the browning element.

recipes.title: Basic Vanilla Ice Cream
steps: Beat eggs and sugar.
Add vanilla and evaporated milk.
Pour in mixer can.
Fill to fill line or 2/3 full with homogenized milk.

recipes.title: Mexican Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch green onion or green pepper
1 can Ranch or chile beans, drained
steps: In 9 x 13-inch pan, layer lettuce, tomatoes and onion.
Add beans, dressing and Fritos.
Spread cheese on top.
Layer as in above order; can layer again if making extra large batch. Refrigerate, but not over 6 hours.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Saute finely minced onions and pepper in a little butter.
Mix remaining ingredients together, except mushrooms.
Mix well. Remove stems from mushrooms and wash mushroom caps.
Stuff the mushrooms with the mixture.
Place in a baking dish with 2 tablespoons of water.
Bake in a 350° oven for about 20 minutes. Sprinkle with ___, if desired.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
steps: Mix cream cheese, pineapple, green pepper, salt and 1 cup pecans.
Chill thoroughly.
Form into 1 large or 2 small balls. Coat with remaining pecans.
Chill.
Serve at room temperature with assorted crackers.

recipes.title: Holiday Potato Bake
ingredients: 4 lb. unpeeled potatoes, cooked and drained
steps: Remove skin from potatoes; shred into bowl.
Saute onions in butter until tender.
Remove from heat, stir in soup and sour cream.
Pour over potatoes and cheese; mix well.
Turn into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tarleni
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
steps: Chop onion and pepper; saute in oil until tender.
Add meat; stir and cook until browned.
In large bowl, place mushrooms, tomatoes, corn and 1/2 of cheese.
Cook noodles in salted water until tender; drain.
Add to mixture in bowl.
Add meat mixture; blend well.
Pour in greased 3-quart casserole dish.
Let stand 12 to 24 hours.
Cover and bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake uncovered for 10 to 15 minutes longer. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Heller Family Lunch
steps: You can make as much or as little as you want.
For a small amount, beat one egg into a small bowl.
Add 1 cup milk;
stir together.
Break crackers into pieces and add to egg and milk mixture until liquid is absorbed by the crackers.
Melt shortening in skillet; spread crackers and egg mixture over the bottom of skillet.
It will look like one large pancake.
Brown one side and then flip and brown the other side.
Can be eaten with butter, syrup or ketchup.

recipes.title: Southern Pecan Pie
steps: Prepare pastry for 10-inch pie pan.
Mix butter, eggs, brown sugar, salt and vanilla in a bowl.
Beat with wire whip until smooth. Blend in corn syrup and pecans. Pour into unbaked pie shell with rounded side of pecans upright.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes in preheated oven at 375° until set and pastry is brown.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Butter
steps: Put
all ingredients except sugars in a heavy saucepan; bring to a boil.	Quickly add sugar.
When mixture returns to a
boil, cook for 1 minute.	Skim foam.
Ladle into hot jars. Adjust
lids. Process
in
boiling water bath for 10 minutes. Yield:
About 3 pints.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
steps: Toss lightly the chicken, celery, almonds, salt and onion. Add lemon juice, mayonnaise, peas and eggs. Pile lightly in an 11 x 17-inch casserole.
Mix together cheese, potato chips and spread on top of casserole.
Bake in a 450° oven for 10 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Strawberry Sour Cream Gelatin Salad
ingredients: 1 medium (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice
steps: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Cool; not in the refrigerator. Combine jello with strawberries, pineapple and bananas.
Pour half of mixture in mold to set.
After it has set, spread with a little more than 1 pint of sour cream.
Pour in rest of mixture and jell.

recipes.title: Alfredo Sauce
steps: Melt butter, add cheese and pepper.
Stir in whipping cream in double boiler.
Remove from heat; whip for about 3 minutes. Portion out in servings of 5 ounces each.
Unused portions may be frozen for future use.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. yellow cake mix (preferably Pillsbury's Moist)
1 pkg. French vanilla instant pudding mix
3/4 c. water, combined with 1/4 c. lemon juice = 1 c.
steps: Heat butter and juice in a saucepan.
Add enough sugar to make a glaze.
Pour over the cooled cake.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
steps: Soften cream cheese. Carefully stir in pineapple, 1 cup pecans, green pepper, onion and salt.
Chill well and then form into a ball. Roll in remaining cup of pecans.
Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients together.
Layer bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan with vanilla wafers and sliced bananas.
Pour half of pudding mixture on top and repeat layers.

recipes.title: Frozen Lime-Mint Salad
steps: Measure butter mints as whole pieces first, then finely crush. Combine all ingredients, except Cool Whip.
Put mix in refrigerator for a few hours.
Fold in Cool Whip and spoon into paper muffin cups and freeze.
Serve frozen from freezer.
Can also freeze in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Penoche
steps: Boil sugar and
water
together until the syrup forms a soft ball in water.
Add
peanut
butter
and vanilla and beat until thick.
Pour into a buttered plate and cool.

recipes.title: 20 Minute Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet, stirring until crumbly. Pour into 1-quart dish or pan.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Crab Ball
steps: Form into ball and chill.
When ready to serve, pour cocktail sauce over top.

recipes.title: Party Beef
steps: Combine chili sauce, sugar, salt, vinegar and seasoned salt. Pour over meat.
Cover and marinate overnight in refrigerator. (Marinate meat in Pyrex glass pan.)
Place meat in roasting pan. Pour over marinade; cover with celery leaves and onions.
Bake at 325° for 4 to 5 hours (1 hour per pound).
Baste often.
Serve in strained marinade.
This recipe may be prepared 2 days in advance or frozen.

recipes.title: Cheese Roll
steps: Let Velveeta cheese and cream cheese sit at room temperature for a while.
Cream cheese together and add rest of ingredients. Roll in paprika.

recipes.title: Orange Jello-Mandarin Orange Salad
ingredients: 1 small can crushed pineapple (in heavy syrup)
steps: Mix jello with boiling water.
Cool slightly, then add pineapple with juice, the drained Mandarin oranges and the sour cream.
Place in refrigerator to jell.
(If you like a sweeter taste, cut down sour cream to 1/2 to 3/4 cup.)

recipes.title: Copper Pennies Carrots
ingredients: 2 lb. carrots, peeled and cut into disks
1 medium green pepper, cut into rings
steps: Cook carrots until tender, but not mushy.
Drain.
Combine all remaining ingredients in saucepan; slowly bring to simmer over medium heat.
Remove from heat.
Pour over carrots, onion and pepper.
Cover; refrigerate overnight.
Serve cold.
Will keep in refrigerator 2 or 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Brandy Slush
steps: Dissolve sugar in boiling water.
Add remaining ingredients. Mix well in a large container.
Store in freezer, mixing well every day for 3 days.
Mix 1/2 glass of slush with sour soda.

recipes.title: Boston Baked Beans With Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1 qt. Michigan navy beans (small white beans)
steps: Soak beans overnight in water to cover.
Wash and parboil with soda in boiling water until they are barely tender.
Rinse.
Put in bean pot or casserole. Mix in all the seasonings and barley, placing the pork at the bottom.
Cover with boiling water.
Cover and cook very slowly for 6 hours.
Renew with water as needed. Important:
During the last two hours, draw the pork to the surface. Score and let it brown.

recipes.title: Company Potatoes
ingredients: 1 (32 oz.) pkg. frozen hash browns, thawed
steps: Mix together and sprinkle bread crumbs with pats of butter. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Raspberry-Orange Punch
ingredients: 4 oranges, thinly sliced in the round
2 lemons, thinly sliced in the round
steps: Mix and serve over crushed ice.

recipes.title: Sausage Bread
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) loaf frozen bread dough, thawed
steps: Let bread thaw and rise.
In a skillet, brown sausage, onion, bell pepper and jalapenos.
Drain liquid.
Roll bread dough flat on floured surface.
Place on slightly greased cookie sheet. Spread half the sausage mixture down center of dough.
Sprinkle half the cheeses over mixture, then repeat.
Fold dough over and tuck in ends.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 375° until brown, about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Gems
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) jar pineapple ice cream topping
steps: Heat sugar and ice cream topping to a boil.
Remove from heat and quickly stir in cream cheese.
Continue stirring until cream cheese is melted. Add coconut flavoring.
Mix well.
Stir in crumbs, pecans, and coconut.
Roll into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter. Roll the balls in coconut.
Refrigerate.
Makes 6 to 6 1/2 doz.

recipes.title: Mexican Hot Soup
steps: Brown hamburger.
Drain.
Add other ingredients and heat as desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Boil chicken until done.
Chunk into bite size pieces in large bowl.
Add soup (may also use other creamed varieties), celery and sour cream.
In separate bowl, crush crackers and stir in melted butter.
Spread half of cracker mixture on bottom of a large casserole dish.
Spoon in chicken and top with remaining cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until edges are bubbly.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: "Old Time" Ham Casserole
steps: Skin and parboil potatoes. Slice and layer into casserole dish (first layer). Follow by thinly sliced onion, separated into rings, next picnic ham, cut into slices (approximately 3/4 to 1-inch pieces).
Repeat layers of potatoes, onion rings, ham, sliced mushrooms. Top with frozen peas. In a separate bowl, mix mushroom soup, milk and grated Swiss cheese.
Pour this over other ingredients in casserole dish.
Heat in a 350° oven for approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour until browned and bubbly.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cake
steps: Bake cake according to instructions.
When removed from oven, spread pineapple, juice and all, over top of cake.
Let cool.

recipes.title: Fruit Punch
steps: Mix all ingredients but the ginger ale.
Mix in ginger ale just before serving.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 8 medium potatoes, pared and thinly sliced
steps: Melt butter in pan.
Add salt.
Combine milk and soup.
Mix slowly into pan.
Add potatoes and onion.
Heat, stirring occasionally.
Pour into greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamed Chicken
steps: Heat broth to boiling.
Reduce heat; stir in chicken and vegetables.
Mix flour and water to make a smooth sauce.
Pour into meat and vegetable mixture slowly and stir constantly until thickened.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Bar
steps: Smash up grahams, layer them in bottom of pan.
Melt butter, pour over grahams.
Sprinkle a layer of chocolate chips, then a layer of butterscotch chips.
Next layer will be pecans.
Pour can of milk over the top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Saucy Meatballs
steps: Mix all together.
Shape into 60 to 65 small balls the size of a walnut.
Melt butter in frying pan.
Brown meatballs.
May be chilled or frozen until ready to use.
To cook, put meatballs into casserole and cover with Pineapple Sauce.
Bake in 350° oven for about 40 minutes until hot.

recipes.title: Confetti Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 large (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 small pkg. dried beef, chopped fine
1 bunch green onion, chopped fine (greens too)
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Chill until firm.
Shape into a ball and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.
For best taste, prepare the day before and chill overnight.
Serve with party rye bread or crackers.

recipes.title: Apple Strudel
ingredients: 8 oz. artificially sweetened jam (apricot or orange)
2 medium apples, peeled and chopped fine
1 egg yolk mixed with 1/4 tsp. water
steps: Whisk cheese with water until smooth; set aside.
On a nonstick cookie sheet, place 2 sheets of phyllo.
Brush top sheet lightly with melted butter.
Place 2 more sheets over first two; butter top sheet.
Repeat with last 2 sheets; then sprinkle buttered top sheet with cornflake crumbs.
With a spatula, spread 3-inch wide band of cheese along one long side of phyllo, leaving 1/2 to 3/4 inch margin around edges.
Spread jam over cheese mixture.

recipes.title: Cherry Pie
steps: In a small mixing bowl, mix drained cherries, sugar, tapioca and almond extract. Let this mixture set for 15 minutes or so. Pour this filling into 1 unbaked pie crust; dot with butter. Cover with second pie crust, sealing edges and making a few slits in top for venting. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes; reduce heat to 375° and bake for 25 minutes longer. You may need to cover edges of crust to prevent overbrowning; use aluminum foil strips.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni in boiling water about 6 minutes.
Drain water off macaroni and place in a lightly greased crock-pot or spray lightly with Pam.
Cut margarine into small pieces and stir into macaroni until melted.
Add remaining ingredients to macaroni in crock-pot, leaving some cheese to sprinkle on top.
Cook on low setting for 2 to 3 hours, or high setting for 1 1/2 hours or until done.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad(Favorite Recipe)
steps: Drain pineapple chunks, reserving juice.
Drain orange slices, reserving juice.
Drain cherries.
Place all fruit (except bananas) in serving bowl.
Combine 2 cups pineapple juice (use juice from orange slices if there is not enough pineapple juice) with vanilla pudding.
Cook over medium heat until thickened and transparent.
Pour over fruit in serving bowl.
Chill.
Add bananas right before serving.

recipes.title: Best Beef Burritos Ever
steps: Fix the meat according to the directions on the burrito package.
Place prepared meat in the middle of a large flour tortilla.
Put a tablespoon of the enchilada sauce down the center of the burrito.
Place the desired amount of cheese on the meat. Fold the burrito shut and place in the microwave for 20 seconds, just enough time to slightly melt the cheese.
You can add just about anything you want.
Some suggestions are listed.

recipes.title: Ritz Pie
steps: Beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
Gradually beat in sugar and baking powder.
Beat in vanilla.
Mix nuts with crushed crackers.
Gently fold into meringue mixture.
Grease a 9-inch glass pie plate well. Spread mixture in plate. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool completely.
Whip the cream and vanilla. Top with whipped cream.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cake
steps: Combine cream cheese, sugar, vanilla, lemon juice and salt. Add eggs one at a time while mixing.
Cook at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Let chill for awhile.

recipes.title: Coconut Macaroons
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix ingredients together.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto aluminum foil-lined greased pan.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Macaroons will stick if allowed to cool.
Store loosely covered at room temperature.

recipes.title: Cornflake Candy
steps: Bring syrup and sugar to good boil. Take off burner and mix in peanut butter. Mix well, then add cornflakes, stirring until coated. Drop by teaspoonful onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Chicken Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. shredded, cooked chicken breast, skinned and cooked (no salt)
1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded fat-free Cheddar cheese
steps: Reserve 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix; set aside.
Combine remaining taco seasoning mix, chicken, beer and chilies in large skillet; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes or until mix is thickened.
Remove from heat; stir in picante sauce.
Mash beans and garlic until smooth.
Spread bean mixture in a 10-inch dish.
Spoon chicken mixture evenly over bean mixture; top with cheese.
Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 15 minutes or until heated thoroughly.
Combine sour cream and reserved 1 teaspoon taco seasoning mix; spread over melted cheese.
Top with tomato, green onions and olives.
Serve with no-oil baked tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Corn Relish
steps: Cut corn off of cob.
Cut onions, peppers and celery into small cubes.
Mix everything together and boil all together until soft.
Seal in jars.

recipes.title: Five Cup Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Macaroni Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup
steps: Mix all ingredients in ungreased 1 1/2-quart casserole or rectangular baking dish, 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch.
Cover and bake in 350° oven until macaroni is tender, 55 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Good Dill Pickles
steps: Pack clean jars with whole or sliced cucumbers with 2 good sized bunches of fresh dill per jar.
Bring vinegar, water and salt to a rolling boil and pour into jars with cucumbers in.
Seal with clean new lids.

recipes.title: Grandma Pocock'S Mincemeat
ingredients: 3 pt. chopped fine golden delicious apples
2 pt. chopped fine green tomatoes (not frost bit)
steps: Mix all ingredients and simmer to desired thickness.
Put in sterile pint jars; seal and let stand 2 or 3 months to season.

recipes.title: Paradise Jam
steps: Cook pears in large pan for 3 minutes.
Add next 4 ingredients and bring to boil.
Stir in sugar.
Bring to boil and boil hard for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in pectin. Stir for 5 minutes to cool slightly (to prevent fruit from floating).
Ladle into jars.
Makes 8 1/2 pints.

recipes.title: Chili Beans
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can dark red kidney beans, drained
steps: Cook ground beef, onions, green pepper and garlic until meat browns.
Drain off fat.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer 1 hour.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Cornflake Balls
steps: Bring sugar and syrup to boil.
Stir in peanut butter and blend well.
Pour sugar, syrup and peanut butter mixture over cornflakes.
Work into balls.

recipes.title: Apple Salad
steps: Mix well -- eat and enjoy.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
steps: Spread refried beans on a platter.
Mix
the
two
dips together and spread on top of the beans.
Put the
cups	of shredded cheese on next and add the cut
up
tomatoes.
Spread around and put the olive on last.

recipes.title: Ruby Pears
ingredients: 7 whole pears, peeled, but with stems left on
steps: Select pears with good, whole stems.
Peel in vertical strips, from stem to blossom end.
Strain the cranberry sauce through a sieve into a large saucepan or enameled cast-iron casserole (deep).
Stir in remaining ingredients, except peas, to make a syrup.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Dessert
steps: Saute coconut in butter; add vanilla wafers.
Press 2/3 of mixture
in 9 x 12-inch pan. Add hot water to gelatin; add sugar and
lemon	juice.	Set
aside
to thicken.
Whip milk. Whip gelatin
slightly
and
combine with whipped milk.	Pour onto crumbs.
Cover with remaining crumbs and set in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Angel Balls
steps: Heat these 5 ingredients and cook slowly for 6 minutes stirring constantly.
Take off heat and add 4 cups rice crispies, 2 cups nuts chopped fine.
Make into balls and roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Raisin Sandwich Spread
steps: Stir ingredients together in saucepan.
Bring to a boil over low heat.
Cook until mixture forms a string from the spoon.
Add 1/2 to 1 pound ground raisins and 1/2 cup of mayonnaise.
Add nuts, if desired.
Mix well and spread on the bread of your choice.

recipes.title: Open Face Breakfast Sandwiches
steps: Combine first 8 ingredients, mix well.
Spread butter or margarine on each muffin half.
Next, spread approximately 2 tablespoons mixture on each muffin half.
Broil 3 minutes or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Apple Dumplings
steps: Put the sugar, cinnamon, butter, water and nutmeg in saucepan and boil.
Keep hot to pour over wrapped apples just before baking.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Logs
steps: Mix all ingredients and form into small 1 1/2-inch long rolls. Melt in double boiler the chocolate chips and paraffin wax.
Dip logs in mixture and lay on wax paper.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 box macaroni and Cheddar cheese Deluxe
steps: Boil noodles with salt and margarine.
Pour into casserole dish.
Add cheese pack, pepper, eggs and 1/2 block cheese, grated. Mix together; add mix and stir.
Then put other 1/2 of grated block cheese on top.
Add more milk if needed.
The more milk and cheese, the better.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until desired browness.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Dip
steps: Mix first 7 ingredients together. Hull out French bread. Stuff mixture into French bread and cook at 350° until mixture bubbles.
Serve with corn chips.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple (packed in its own juice and not drained)
1 large (9 oz.) box chilled whipped topping
1 c. or less walnuts or pecans
steps: Mix pineapple (undrained) with the pudding, pouring the dry pudding into the pineapple. Stir and add marshmallows, whipped topping, nuts and coconut.
Stir by hand.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Baked Fudge Drops
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine cocoa, milk, coconut, salt and vanilla in bowl.
Drop dough by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Take Along Egg And Macaroni Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Chill 2 hours.

recipes.title: Oyster Crackers
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
3/4 tsp. garlic salt or to taste
steps: Mix oil, dressing mix and garlic salt in large bowl.
Add crackers.
Stir gently every 15 minutes for 2 hours.
Store in tightly covered container.
These will keep for a long time.

recipes.title: Creamy Cheese Cake
ingredients: 2 lb. cream cheese or Farmers cheese
steps: All ingredients should be at room temperature.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
ingredients: 5 medium red skin potatoes, cooked, peeled and diced
steps: Combine potatoes, celery, radishes and onions.
In a separate bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, mustard powder, sugar, pepper, turmeric and celery seed.
Add vinegar and milk; stir until mixed. Combine with potato mixture; stir well.
Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Chews
steps: Cream
cake
mix,
butter and egg until smooth.
Spread evenly in 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.

recipes.title: Pistachio Cake
steps: Mix cake batter as directed on package but substitute by using the listed ingredients.
Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Mix all together and form into ball.
Roll ball in 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar cheese.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate Mix
steps: Mix all together.
Place in a large container.

recipes.title: Susie'S Homemade Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 2 tsp. hot red pepper (or less, if desired)
steps: Cook down until thick.
Pour into cans and seal.
Ideal for home gardeners.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Casserole
steps: Mix together and put into buttered casserole dish.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° covered.

recipes.title: Holiday Hot Punch
steps: In a 30-cup coffeemaker, pour the cranberry juice and apple juice together.

In coffee basket, place brown sugar, salt, cinnamon sticks and cloves. Run coffeemaker through the regular cycle (as if making coffee) or just once in a percolator according to how strong a spice taste you want.
Recipe may be halved for smaller gatherings.
Makes 30 cups.

recipes.title: Lo Country Boil
ingredients: 2 lb. Polish kielbasa sausage, cut into 2-inch pieces
steps: In a large kettle, place potatoes into salted boiling water; simmer 1 hour, then add corn-on-the-cob to kettle.
Bring back to a boil, then simmer for 30 minutes, then add onions and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add sausage and simmer for about 15 to 20 minutes. Right before serving, add shrimp and crab legs.
Cook until shrimp turn pink, about 3 minutes.
Drain.
Serve in a large bowl or kettle.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Buckeye Cookies
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Add cracker crumbs and mix by hand. Form into balls.
Place on cookie sheet and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: "Death To Dieters" Chicken Lasagna(If I Ever Get To San Francisco!!!)
ingredients: 1 lb. chicken breasts, cooked and sliced thin
steps: Cook chicken and slice.
Cook noodles.
Saute mushrooms and onion.
Make Hollandaise sauce.

recipes.title: Creamy Caramel-Pecan Rolls
steps: For Topping:
In a small bowl, stir together powdered sugar and whipping cream.
Divide evenly between two (9 x 1 1/2-inch) round baking pans.
Sprinkle nuts and raisins evenly over sugar mixture.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
steps: Mix potatoes with 1 stick margarine.
Add salt, pepper, onion, cheese, sour cream and soup.
Mix well.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with cornflakes mixed with 1/2 stick melted margarine. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Five-Layer Bars
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Pour butter into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs evenly over butter.
Sprinkle on nuts, followed by chocolate chips and coconut.
Pour condensed milk over top.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until lightly browned. Remove to a rack and let cool completely before cutting.
Makes 36 bars.

recipes.title: Speedy Chili
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients in a Dutch oven; cook until beef is browned, stirring until it crumbles.
Drain.
Add remaining ingredients; cover, reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Yields about 4 cups.

recipes.title: Party Punch
ingredients: strawberries, sliced oranges or 1/2 gal. sherbet (optional)
steps: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add cranberry juice, orange juice and pineapple juice.
Chill.
Pour 1/2 of juice mix into punch bowl.
Add fruit or sherbet and ginger ale when ready to serve.
Add remaining juice mix.

recipes.title: Kevin'S Dip
ingredients: 1 large jar Pace picante mild salsa
1 (8 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Saute sausage, hamburger and onion over medium heat until browned. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot.
Cook on simmer or low heat.
Stir occasionally.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Steak Au Poivre(An Excellent Dish For Those Who Enjoy Beef With A Spicy Taste.)
ingredients: club aged rib eye steaks (3/4 to 1-inch thick)
steps: Place the peppercorns in mortar and pestle and crush them thoroughly.
Dry the steaks on a paper towel.
Rub and press the crushed peppercorns into both sides of the meat with your fingers and the palm of your hand.
Cover with waxed paper.
Let it stand for at least half an hour, 2 or 3 hours are even better, so the flavor of the pepper will penetrate the meat.

recipes.title: Brie Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 (4 oz. or 8 oz.) block Brie cheese
steps: Unroll crescent rolls.
Do not separate but press all crescent rolls together, forming square sheet or pastry.
Wrap cheese in pastry and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese is of spreading consistency.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Reuben Casserole
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can sauerkraut, rinse and drain
1 can cream of chicken soup or mushroom soup, mixed with about 1/3 can milk
rye bread, buttered and cubed (about 3 slices)
steps: Grease large casserole or lasagna pan.
Rinse and drain kraut, place on bottom of pan and add noodles.
Add 1/2 of grated cheese and corned beef, crumbled.
Add soup mixture, then buttered cubes of bread.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake 1/2 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash
steps: Divide squash lengthwise in half and place face down on foil. Bake 1 hour or until done at 350°.
Cool 15 minutes and scoop out shells.
Put in baking dish. Add brown sugar and butter to warm squash. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Shred bread and knead all ingredients together.
Form meat loaf.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper, onion salt and garlic salt. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Priest'S Ragout
steps: Brown cubes in butter.
Add garlic and pearl onions; brown again with meat for 5 to 8 minutes.
Add peppers (red and black); paprika can be substituted if you don't want it spicy.
Add allspice, cinnamon, salt and 4 cups of water.
(All spices are by taste, vary amounts as needed.)
Cook for 3 hours over medium-low heat until meat is very tender.

recipes.title: Angel Eggs
steps: Hard-boil the eggs.
Slice eggs in two lengthwise.
Scrape out the cooked egg yolk and put in small bowl; add the mayo, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper.
Blend together.
Fill empty egg halves with mixture.
If desired, sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
ingredients: 3 1/4 c. (30 oz. can) pumpkin pie mix
2 pkg. (16 oz. each) nut bread mix
1 tsp. pumpkin pie spice or 1 1/2 tsp. grated orange rind, if desired
steps: Combine eggs and pie mix in large bowl.
Beat all of ingredients together.
Pour into 2 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch) loaf dishes.
Bake in 325° oven for 70 to 80 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes in dishes; remove and cool completely before slicing.
Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Anytime Quiche
ingredients: 1 c. milk or half and half
steps: In a pie plate, place an unbaked pie crust.
Add ham and broccoli; arrange into bottom of crust.
Sprinkle with cheese. Whisk eggs with milk or half and half and pour over mixture.
Bake 40 minutes at 350° or until top becomes light brown.
Eat anytime.

recipes.title: Zippy Beef
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Cook and stir until brown, then drain well.
Cook, then drain macaroni.
In ungreased 2-quart casserole, mix all ingredients.
Cover; bake until bubbly, 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli until tender and drain.
Mix with other ingredients.
Top with cheese, then stuffing mix and pat top with butter.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Mex Eggs
ingredients: 10 (6-inch) soft corn tortillas, cut into quarters
4 oz. (1 c.) shredded Cheddar cheese or Jack cheese
steps: Grease 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Mix eggs and milk and beat slightly.
Add corn.
Place tortillas in bottom of greased dish. Pour egg mixture over tortillas.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Mix eggs, sugar, corn syrup, salt, vanilla and margarine. Spread nuts in bottom of shell.
Pour in filling.
Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: French Silk Pie
ingredients: 3 c. Cool Whip or 1 c. whipping cream, whipped
steps: Cream butter and add sugar gradually.
Blend in chocolate and vanilla.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating 5 minutes after each. Fold in 2/3 of cream.
Turn into pie shell and chill at least 2 hours.
Decorate with remaining cream.
Freezes well.

recipes.title: Strawberry Glaze Pie
steps: Crush 1 cup berries and cook with water about 1 minute. Sieve.
Set aside, saving the juice.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
steps: Combine in iron skillet the corn syrup, sugar and water. Stir until sugar dissolves and cooks to 234° or soft ball on candy thermometer.

Add raw peanuts and boil to 310° or brittle stage. Remove from heat and add baking soda, vanilla, salt and butter. (These should be mixed in a cup before you begin and mix up so can be added all at once.)
Cool and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Cucumber Sandwiches
ingredients: thinly sliced pimento stuffed olives or paprika (garnish)
steps: Score cucumber lengthwise with fork; slice thin.
In a medium bowl, combine vinegar and water.
Add cucumber slices.
Let stand at room temperature at least 30 minutes; drain well.

recipes.title: German Cole Slaw
steps: Arrange cabbage, onion and celery in layers.
Pour 1 cup sugar over top; do not stir.
Let stand while preparing dressing.
Bring to just a boil the vinegar, salt, mustard seed, celery seed and salt.
Pour over vegetable mixture; do not stir.
Cover tightly and let mixture set overnight.
Drain before serving.
Keeps 2 to 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
steps: Brown beef with onion in skillet.
Drain.
Add taco seasoning mix and water to meat.
Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Asparagus Salad
ingredients: 1 tsp. sesame seed or hot sesame oil
steps: Cut or snap off tough ends of asparagus and cut off the small wedge-shaped leaves up to 2 inches from the tip.
Wash well and cut on the diagonal into 1 1/2-inch lengths.
Bring 6 cups of water to a boil in a saucepan over high heat.
Add the asparagus pieces.
As soon as the water returns to a boil, drain and quickly cool in cold water to stop the cooking.
Drain well.
Just before serving, place the asparagus in a serving bowl and toss with the soy sauce and sesame seed oil.
Serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Santa Fe Corn & Cheese Squares
ingredients: 1 - 16 oz. pkg. Green Giant frozen corn, green & red peppers, broccoli (chop broccoli)
steps: Heat oven to 400.
Grease 13X9 pan.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie
steps: Place in cooked pie shell or graham cracker crust. Refrigerate or freeze until ready to use.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
steps: Mix corn flakes and melted margarine.
Put half in bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish.
Put shredded cabbage on top of this.
Mix together celery soup, milk, grated cheese and onion.
Pour on top of cabbage.
Sprinkle remaining corn flake mixture on this.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Macaroni Salad
steps: Cook macaroni until soft.
Dice onion, carrots and green pepper.
Mix macaroni, onion, carrots and green pepper together. Set aside while you blend with mixer, salad dressing, Pet milk, sugar, mustard and vinegar to a smooth texture.
Add to macaroni and mix well.
Drain and rinse shrimp.
Add to macaroni with celery salt, salt and pepper to taste.
Mix well; store in airtight container in refrigerator overnight or until well chilled.
Serves between 20 and 30 people.

recipes.title: Shaggy Dogs
steps: Heat syrup in opened can.
Toast marshmallows until golden brown.
Dip marshmallows in chocolate and roll in coconut.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Casserole
ingredients: 2-3 whole chicken breast (I have used legs/thighs too)
1 soup can water or chicken broth
steps: Cook chicken in water until tender; cut/shred into bite size pieces.
Mix onion, chiles, soups, water/broth and garlic together with chicken in saucepan.
Bring to a boil; then remove from heat. Cut tortillas into 1 inch pie shaped pieces.
Layer tortillas, chicken soup mixture and cheese alternately in a large casserole; continue with layers ending with cheese.
Bake for 45 minutes in a 350° oven uncovered.
Makes 6-8 servings.

recipes.title: Custard Pie
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Put eggs, sugar, salt, nutmeg and vanilla into blender; process on low until sugar is dissolved and eggs are lemon colored.
Add milk; process until well blended.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Gazpacho
ingredients: 2 green bell peppers, seeded and quartered
sour cream or low-fat plain yogurt (for garnish)
steps: Place the carrots, cucumbers, green bell peppers and tomatoes in the bowl of a food processor; process just until chunky (you may need to do it in two batches).
Transfer the mixture to a large bowl; season with the cilantro, salt, cumin and dill weed (you may want to add more, to taste).
Chill for at least 2 hours. Serve with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkling of cumin. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Punch
steps: Add enough water to make a gallon or 5 quarts.
Freeze for approximately 10 hours or until slushy.
Stir and serve.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
steps: Cook squash, onion and pepper in small amount of water until tender.
Drain and add all other ingredients, except 1/2 of cheese and cracker crumbs.
Sprinkle remaining cheese and crumbs on top. Bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8 people.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. tiny new potatoes (about 10) or medium red potatoes (about 5)
1 Tbsp. margarine or butter, cut into pieces
steps: Wash potatoes; scrub thoroughly with a vegetable brush.
Cut tiny new potatoes into quarters or the medium potatoes into 1-inch pieces.
Place potatoes in 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe casserole. Add margarine or butter, teriyaki sauce, garlic salt, Italian seasoning, black pepper and red pepper.
Toss to combine.
Cover; micro-cook on 100% power (High) for 12 to 15 minutes (14 to 16 minutes for low-wattage ovens) or until potatoes are tender, stirring twice during cooking.
Stir before serving.
Garnish with snipped rosemary and serve with sour cream if desired.
Makes 5 side dish servings.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
ingredients: 2 large cans pineapple tidbits (20 oz., undrained)
steps: Mix together the sugar, cornstarch and pineapple in casserole dish.
Mix oleo, cheese and crackers.
Spread over first mixture as a topping.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 350° or until brown.

recipes.title: Hamburger Beans
steps: Brown ground beef; add other ingredients and stir.
Cook slowly for 30 to 40 minutes.
Ready to serve.

recipes.title: Brownie Banana Split Pizza
ingredients: 1 box (20 oz. or larger) brownie mix
1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple (you can use two cans)
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Prepare brownie mix according to package.
Spread on pizza pan.
You may wish to grease pan.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes.
Cool to room temperature.
Mix cream cheese and sugar until smooth.
Spread on brownie mix.
Top with fruits and pecans.
Drizzle melted chocolate.

recipes.title: Chicken Manicotti
steps: Cook manicotti shells according to package directions.
Drain and set aside.
Mix 1/2 can soup with 1/4 cup sour cream in large bowl.
Add chicken and stir well.
Stuff manicotti shells with chicken mixture.
Place in lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Melt butter over medium-low heat in skillet.
Saute mushrooms and onions until tender.
Add remaining soup and sour cream in skillet until heated through.
Pour mushroom and soup mixture over manicotti. Bake, uncovered, for 15 minutes in 350° oven.
Sprinkle cheese over top and bake an additional 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Anthony'S Strawberry Cream Cheese Pie
steps: Mix or beat cheese until fluffy.
Gradually beat in milk. Stir in lemon juice, strawberry extract and Jell-O.
Pour into a prepared crust.
Chill for 3 hours.
Top with chopped fresh or frozen strawberries.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciataco
steps: Sprinkle season-all over chicken. Brown on all sides in hot oil. Drain. Combine seasoning mix, water and tomatoes, breaking up tomatoes. Pour over chicken. Cover and simmer 40 minutes. Serve over cooked pasta. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Deer Marinade For Steak Or Roast
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour over meat and marinate in refrigerator 2 to 4 days.
Drain meat and pat dry.
Cook as directed.

recipes.title: Souperburgers
steps: In skillet, brown beef and onion in shortening.
Stir to separate meat particles.
Add soup and seasonings; simmer about 5 to 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
Serve on buns.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut in pieces
steps: Boil chicken; pull apart.
Mix together remaining ingredients and microwave until cheese melts.
Pour over spaghetti and chicken.

recipes.title: Rotel Tomatoes
ingredients: hot peppers to taste (10 or 12), cut small
steps: Cook all ingredients together until tomatoes will mash easy. Fill jars and seal.
Cold pack for 25 minutes.
Makes 9 pints.

recipes.title: Fudge Swirl Cookies
steps: Stir yellow cake mix, egg, oil and water.
Take 1/3 of yellow mixture and swirl together with chocolate packet, then put back into yellow mixture.
(Don't stir too much, you want to maintain that swirled look!)
Fold in milk chocolate chips.
Bake at 350° on greased cookie sheet for 8 to 10 minutes.
Should come out nice and gooey!

recipes.title: Potato And Egg Casserole
steps: Generously
butter
a 2-quart casserole.
Wash potatoes and cook
until
tender.
Drain, then shake pan over low heat until potatoes are dry.
Peel potatoes and eggs, then cut into 1/4-inch slices
and
set aside.
Mix together sour cream and butter; reserve half the sour cream mixture for the top of the casserole.

recipes.title: Carolyn'S Spiced Tea
ingredients: 1 large can frozen orange juice (12 oz.)
6 oz. can frozen lemonade or juice of 3 lemons
steps: In small pan make tea with 6 cups water and 6 small tea bags. In large pan, add 6 cups water, 1 stick cinnamon, 1 1/2 teaspoons whole cloves and sugar.
Let boil slowly for 5 or 10 minutes.
Add pineapple juice, orange juice, lemonade or lemons and the tea mixture.
Store in refrigerator and use as needed.
Heat before serving.
Be sure and stir before using because it settles to the bottom.

recipes.title: Scalloped Broccoli Or Spinach
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) boxes broccoli or spinach, chopped
steps: Cook broccoli or spinach.
Mix soup, eggs, mayonnaise and cheese.
Add to cooked broccoli or spinach.
Salt slightly.
Bake in casserole for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Baked Brisket(4 Pound Brisket)
steps: Mix all ingredients and pour over brisket, then wrap in foil. Marinate overnight.
Bake at 300° for 3 1/2 hours.
Add 1 cup barbecue sauce and bake 1 hour longer.
Recipe may be doubled for larger brisket and increase baking time 2 hours.

recipes.title: Fruit Kabobs
steps: Cut fruit into chunks.
Put on skewers.
Dip in orange juice. Roll in coconut.
Eat and enjoy.

recipes.title: Linguine And Shrimp
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 lb. small shrimp, shelled and deveined
steps: Prepare linguine as package directs.
Drain.
In medium skillet, heat Italian dressing.
Add shrimp, vegetables that have been julienned, garlic, parsley, lemon peel, salt and cayenne pepper.
Cook and stir 8 to 10 minutes.
Add linguine; toss and garnish.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Bread
ingredients: 1/4 lb. Provolone or Mozzarella cheese, shredded or broken into bits
steps: Roll out dough. Layer pepperoni and cheese.
Roll dough back up.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Beat egg with a little water. Brush top of dough with egg.
Bake at 400° until golden brown, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Slice to serve.

recipes.title: Chicken, Corn, Black Bean And Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Tear chicken into shreds or chop.
Combine with corn, beans and tomato in a bowl.
Heat oil in a small skillet.
Add garlic and saute until just beginning to color, about 30 seconds.
Add oregano and cumin; stir until fragrant, about 10 seconds.
Remove from heat.
Add vinegar and salt.
Pour over salad.
Add onions and parsley; toss gently to combine.

recipes.title: Italian Cole Slaw
steps: Grate cabbages and carrots in a medium size mixing bowl.
Mix dressing as directed on package.
Add the sugar. Shake up until dissolved. Add to the slaw mixture.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
steps: Mix sour cream, taco seasoning and cream cheese together. Spread in dish.
Top with vegetables.
Good with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls And Barbecue Sauce
steps: Cook above for 30 minutes; pour over meatballs.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Corn Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 cans Swanson chicken chunks or 1 c. white meat chicken
steps: Cook chicken, noodles and broth until noodles are tender.
Add corn, chicken soup and mushroom soup.
Simmer for 1/2 hour.
(Use Kluski noodles for best results.)

recipes.title: Taco Stew
steps: Brown meat; drain and put in crock-pot.
Add all other ingredients.
Cook on low for 1 hour.
Makes about 1 gallon. Serve with nacho chips or crackers.

recipes.title: Bean `N' Beef Crescent Pie
steps: In a skillet, brown beef and drain. Add taco seasoning and salsa. Simmer, uncovered, until thickened.

recipes.title: Red Pepper Jam
steps: Chop peppers fine; sprinkle with salt.
Let stand 3 or 4 hours.
Rinse well, then cover with sugar and vinegar.
Boil slowly until thick, stirring often to prevent sticking.
Pour into hot jars; seal.
Delicious with cream cheese and crackers.

recipes.title: Cold Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) water chestnuts, drained and chopped
garlic salt and pepper to taste
steps: In large bowl, mix all ingredients.
Keep adding mayonnaise until all ingredients are covered well.
Peas can either be left out to thaw or mix frozen if made ahead of time such as the night before.

recipes.title: Chili Soup
steps: Cook hamburger meat, onion, and gr. pepper until done. Put chili beans, ministroni, and tomatoes in large sauce pan, add hamburger mixture to this and simmer for 30 min. If too thick add beef broth or tomatoes.

recipes.title: Fancy Apple Dessert
steps: Pour apple pie filling in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top of apples.
Top with pecans and coconut.
Drizzle melted butter over all.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Five Minute Fudge
steps: Combine milk, butter and sugar in saucepan; heat to boiling. Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly and then remove from heat. Add marshmallows, nuts, chocolate chips and vanilla.
Stir until marshmallows are melted.
Pour into buttered 8 or 9-inch square pan.
Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Quick Fondue
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) cans condensed Cheddar cheese soup
steps: Mix well
in
saucepan over low heat.
Pour into fondue pot. Place
over
fondue
burner.
Spear with fresh French or sourdough bread squares and dip.

recipes.title: Shoney Pie
steps: Combine ingredients and cook until thickened.
Slice strawberries and put in bottom of baked crust.
Pour cooled mixture over top with Cool Whip and chill.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
steps: Mix all together and bake at 450° for 20 to 25 minutes in an 8 to 10-inch black skillet or a 9-inch glass pie pan, greased.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole No. 4
steps: Boil chicken until tender.
Let chicken cool; remove bones and tear into small pieces.
Place chicken in casserole dish.
Mix soup and sour cream.
Pour over chicken.
Crumble Ritz crackers and mix with melted butter.
Sprinkle over mixture.
Sprinkle poppy seed sparingly over topping.
Cook at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes or until mixture is bubbly.

recipes.title: Easy Taco Dip
steps: In a hurry?
This delicious dip can be put together with very little preparation.
Spread bean dip onto a big platter or shallow dish.
Spread guacamole next.
Mix sour cream, mayo and taco seasoning and add the next layer.
Top with tomatoes and cheeses and sprinkle olives for garnish.
Serve with tortilla chips and extra salsa, if desired.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
steps: Mix all together; chill 8 hours before using.

recipes.title: Festive Baked Ham
steps: Combine apple cider and water in a saucepan, bring to a boil; set aside.
Remove skin from ham.
Place ham fat side up, on a cutting board; score fat in a diamond design and stud with cloves. Place ham in a shallow baking pan, fat side up and coat top with brown sugar.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° about 2 hours (22 to 25 minutes per pound), basting every 30 minutes with cider mixture.

recipes.title: Easy Cheese Cake
steps: Beat sugar and cheese together in mixer, add vanilla and eggs, beat until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a deep 9-inch pie dish. Bake for 50 minutes at 350°.
Remove from oven, cool for 20 minutes.
Spoon the following mixture over the top:
2 cups sour cream, 3 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Mix well together and pour over cake.
Bake another 15 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Cool.
Then refrigerate.

recipes.title: Salsa
steps: Put peppers into shallow dish and add water to just cover them.

Microwave peppers for about 1 min. Chop in half and put in blender. Add onion, garlic, cilantro, salt and juice from the canned tomatoes. Blend until it forms a slightly chunky mixture. Add whole tomatoes to the blender. Pulse the blender 4 or 5 times or until the sauce reaches the desired consistency. Grab a bowl of chips and enjoy!

recipes.title: Vanilla Butter Fudge
steps: Bring sugar, milk and butter to a slow rolling boil, stirring constantly.
Cook to 235°, remove and cool without stirring.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Pie
steps: Stir mix with 1/2 cup sugar, 1/4 cup water and 2 egg yolks in a medium saucepan.
Stir in 2 cups water.
Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil.
Pour into cooled, baked 9-inch pie shell.

recipes.title: Easy Skillet Chops
ingredients: Cajun seasoning salt or your choice
steps: In a large skillet with lid, put about 1-inch water.
Place well seasoned chops in next.
Add sliced onions and bell pepper. Layer if necessary.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to simmer. Cover.
Cook 45 to 60 minutes or until tender.
No need to stir or rotate unless you wish.
Juices can be thickened and served with boiled spaghetti.

recipes.title: Snow Ball Cake
ingredients: 1 angel food cake, cut in small pieces
3 pkg. Dream Whip or 1 large Cool Whip
steps: Soften unflavored gelatin in 4 tablespoons cold water.
Add boiling water; stir until dissolved.
Add sugar and lemon juice. Add canned pineapple and juice; chill mixture until partly firm. Whip 2 packages Dream Whip and fold into partly set mixture.
Use 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Place layer of cake, then layer of gelatin mixture; repeat layers until all is used.
Refrigerate several hours or overnight.
Then whip 1 package Dream Whip and spread on cake; cover with coconut.
Trim with cherries.

recipes.title: Cheese Balls
ingredients: garlic salt or garlic powder to taste
steps: Let stand at room temperature until soft enough to beat with mixer.
Blend well.
Return to refrigerator until firm enough to shape into balls.
Roll balls in crushed walnuts.
Keep in refrigerator.
These freeze well.

recipes.title: Crawfish Pie
steps: Saute seasoning in margarine.
Add milk, soup and crawfish. Simmer 20 minutes. Add cornstarch, if needed for thickening.
Pour in pie shell.
Place other shell on top.
Press edges together. Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Tuna And Biscuit
steps: Mix ingredients well.
Can use canned or make own biscuit dough.
If canned dough is used, break each into halves or thirds. Roll each piece of dough very thin. Place about a teaspoon of the tuna
mix on each rolled out strip of dough, and roll and close in a log shape, leaving both ends open.
Place, seam side down, and bake on ungreased baking sheet at 375° for about 25 to 30 minutes. Makes about 20.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Dessert
steps: Cover bottom of 9 X 13-inch cake pan with diced rhubarb.
Mix sugar and dry gelatin together.
Sprinkle evenly over rhubarb. Pour dry cake mix over rhubarb mixture, then pour water over all. Melt butter and pour over top.
(Do not mix.)
Bake at 325° for about 45 minutes.
Cool.
Serve with Cool Whip, if desired.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
steps: Cook and drain spinach. Stir in the cream cheese until melted. Add the chicken soup and top with onion rings.
Bake 5 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili
steps: Cook meat in oil until it is no longer red. Add onions, water, tomatoes, and tomato sauce. Cook for about one hour. Then add spices and cook for about 30 minutes. Serve hot with crackers or whatever you choose.

recipes.title: Pear Relish
steps: Grind pears and drain.
Grind peppers and onions.
Put pickling spice into cheese cloth and remove after cooking.
Cook approximately 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Drunk Chicken
steps: Melt butter in skillet.
Add salt, pepper, tarragon, onion and garlic.
Brown the chicken.
Add the vermouth.
Cover and simmer for one hour.
Add mushrooms during the cooking.
After 1 hour, remove chicken.
Bring liquid to a boil to reduce it.
Add sour cream and mix well.
If separation occurs, add 1 or 2 tablespoons water.
Put chicken on a platter and cover with sour cream gravy. Everybody loves this dish!

recipes.title: Fudge Squares
steps: Heat oven to 350° (moderate).
Melt chocolate and butter together.
Mix sugar, eggs, Bisquick and nuts.
Spread in greased square pan, 8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.
Do not overbake.
Makes 16 squares.

recipes.title: Warm Cherry Puff
steps: Heat oven to 400°.
Blend milk, eggs, biscuit mix, sugar, extract and margarine in blender for 15 seconds or beat on high speed of mixer for 1 minute.
Pour into greased 10-inch pie pan or 11 x 7-inch baking pan.
Spoon cherry filling over the top.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown.
Makes 8 servings. Preparation Time:
7 minutes.
Bake Time:
30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Faye Whitmore'S Shrimp Dip
steps: Combine ingredients and chill well.
(Faye likes more ketchup, more red pepper and less celery and so do I.)

recipes.title: Easy Hamburger Dish
steps: Cook ground beef until brown; pour off the grease.
Add the Ragu sauce to the ground beef, simmering for about 20 minutes. Cook the noodles done and get a baking dish.
Spread the hamburger meat in pan.
Cover with the noodles and sprinkle with the cheese all over the hamburger and noodles.
Cook for about 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
ingredients: sugar-free vanilla pudding, prepared with 2 c. skim milk
1 small can crushed pineapple, well drained
steps: Lay graham crackers in a glass dish.
Spread prepared pudding over crackers.
Spread drained pineapple over pudding.
Evenly place banana slices over pineapple.
Spread 1 cup Cool Whip Lite over pineapple.
Evenly place sliced strawberries over Cool Whip. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Icing
steps: Beat egg whites stiff; add marshmallows; set aside.
Cook together sugar and water until it spins a thread.
Slowly pour syrup over egg, marshmallows mixture, beating constantly until right consistency to spread.
Add vanilla if desired.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Dressing
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. plus 3/4 tsp. apple cider vinegar
steps: Mix together with a wire whisk or mixer. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
steps: Boil chicken with onion, celery and salt (optional) until tender.
Cook broccoli and drain.
Place broccoli in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Cut chicken in small pieces and place over broccoli. Mix soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder and pour over chicken.
Sprinkle grated cheese over soup mixture.
Crush Ritz crackers and sprinkle over cheese to make thin crust.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake Dessert(This Is Unusual And Very Good)
ingredients: coconut (enough to cover bottom of 13 x 9 x 3-inch pan)
1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, at room temperature
steps: Grease 9 x 13 x 3-inch pan.
(If you use 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan, you will have run-over in your oven.)
Cover bottom with coconut, as much as you desire.
Cover coconut with chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Salmon Patties
ingredients: 1 large can red salmon, drained and bone picked out
steps: Combine ingredients.
Form into patties (about 6).
Cover with flour.
Fry in a small amount of oil until brown on each side.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
steps: Peel eggplant; cut in pieces and cook in water until tender. Drain and mash; add 1/4 stick oleo, milk, egg, onion, cheese and soup.
Mix well and pour in casserole.
Mix cracker crumbs and 1 stick oleo.
Pour over top of casserole.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350° or until bubbles good.

recipes.title: Chicken With Potatoes And Peppers(Microwave)
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. chicken, cut into serving pieces
1 (28 oz.) can whole peeled tomatoes, drained and chopped (reserve 1/2 c. liquid)
2 medium peppers (red, yellow or green), cut into strips
steps: Microwave Directions:
In 3-quart microwave casserole, arrange chicken, skin side down, with thickest portions to the outer edge of casserole.
Cover with wax paper and microwave at High for 12 minutes, rearranging once; drain.
Remove chicken and place on paper towels; set aside.

recipes.title: Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) pkg. processed cheese spread, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes
steps: Place cheese spread cubes in a 2-quart casserole dish. Microwave at 50% power for 3 to 6 minutes or until melted, stirring once.
Beat in beer and garlic with wire whisk until smooth.
Microwave at High until heated, about 1 minute.
Garnish with pimento and parsley.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Mints
steps: In a small mixing bowl, stir together softened cream cheese and peppermint extract.
Gradually add powdered sugar, stirring until mixture is smooth.
Knead the last of the powdered sugar with your hands.
Add food coloring.
Knead until food coloring is evenly distributed.

recipes.title: Lemon Bundt Cake
steps: Mix and bake at 350° for 45 minutes in Bundt pan. Cool. Put on plate.

recipes.title: Fired Up Crabs
steps: Bring 8 quarts water to boil.
Add all ingredients above except crabs and 1/4 cup of Old Bay.
Bring back to boil.
Add live crabs to pot.
Boil 30 minutes.
Turn off heat and soak crabs in pot for 30 minutes.
Remove from pot and sprinkle with remaining Old Bay.

recipes.title: Sweet-N-Sour Kielbasa
steps: Slice kielbasa into bite size pieces.
In a crock-pot, combine all ingredients and cook on high for 2 to 3 hours or on low for 4 to 6 hours.

recipes.title: Frozen Lemon Squares
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine; press firmly on bottom of 8 or 9-inch square pan.
In small mixer bowl, beat egg yolks, sweetened condensed milk, lemon juice and food coloring, if desired.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake 8 minutes.
Cool.
Top with whipped topping.
Freeze 4 hours.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Freeze leftovers.
Makes 6 to 9 servings.

recipes.title: Golden Hamburger
steps: Put in baking dish as listed.
Sprinkle onion soup mix on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Italian Spaghetti And Meatballs
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. spaghetti or Capellini (angel hair pasta)
steps: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add whole tomatoes, crushed, tomato paste, water, sugar and all the spices.
Form ground beef into 1-inch balls and add to sauce.
Simmer slow about 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Serve meatball sauce over hot spaghetti.
Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese, if desired. Leftover sauce may be refrigerated for 2 days.

recipes.title: Warm Taco Dip
steps: Saute onions, peppers and hamburg.
Add salsa.
Spread cream cheese in two 8 x 8-inch glass dishes.
Pour mixture of peppers, onions, hamburg and salsa over cheese.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Serve with taco chips.

recipes.title: Sensational Double Layer Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 c. plus 1 Tbsp. cold half and half or milk
steps: Mix cream cheese, 1 tablespoon half and half and sugar until smooth.
Gently stir in whipped topping.
Spread on bottom of crust.
Pout 1 cup half and half into mixing bowl.
Add pudding mix and beat until well blended.
Let stand 3 minutes.
Stir in pumpkin and spices and mix well.
Spread over cream layer. Refrigerate at least 2 hours.
Garnish with additional whipped topping and nuts.

recipes.title: Upside Down German Chocolate Cake
steps: Prepare cake mix.
Put pecans and coconut in bottom of greased pan.
Pour cake batter over nuts and coconut.
Mix sugar, cream cheese and butter.
Spoon over cake mix.
Bake at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Reese Cups Made Into Egg Shapes
steps: Melt butter in double boiler.
Mix in other two ingredients. Shape into eggs.
Dip in melted chocolate if desired.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Hot Dogs
steps: Put chili sauce and jam in pan.
Simmer.
Cut hot dogs into 1-inch pieces and put in sauce.
Cover and simmer about 30 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Apple Spice Cake
steps: Put 1/2 dry cake mix in greased pan.
Put apples and juice on top.
Top with other half of mix; sprinkle a cup of sugar on top. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Serve warm with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Tofu Spinach Parmesan
steps: Cut the tofu into halves or quarters.
Beat egg, dip tofu into egg, then into bread crumbs.
Saute in olive oil until brown on both sides.
Pour 1/3 of spaghetti sauce into a casserole dish and place breaded tofu on top; set aside.
Wash spinach well and steam ever so slightly.
Drain well and place on tofu.
Cut Mozzarella cheese into cubes and place on top of each piece of tofu.
Cover with the rest of sauce and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly.
Serve with fettucini, salad and garlic bread.

recipes.title: Diet Soup
steps: Combine all ingredients and simmer until done.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: pepperoni (optional), or whatever topping you want
steps: Brown and drain hamburger, add spaghetti sauce, simmer.
While spaghetti boils, drain spaghetti, mix eggs (beaten).
Put Parmesan cheese on bottom of 3 pie plates.
This is the crust.
Top with cottage cheese, then spaghetti sauce.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Add Mozzarella cheese and pepperoni, bake additional 5 minutes.
Cool and slice.

recipes.title: Lemonade Pie
steps: Blend milk with hand mixer or wire whisk.
Add lemonade. Blend.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Add yellow food coloring (optional). Pour into pie shell.
Keep pie in the freezer.
Garnish with sliced lemon.
Be sure to bake pie shell first.

recipes.title: Scampi-Style Shrimp
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. each: margarine or butter and olive oil
1 lb. medium raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: In large skillet over medium heat, cook and stir green onion and garlic in margarine and oil 1 minute; add shrimp.
Cook and stir until shrimp are pink; add lemon juice and salt and heat good.

recipes.title: Louisiana Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
2 (14 1/2 oz. each) cans Del monte Cajun style stewed tomatoes
steps: Place chicken in baking dish.
Cover and bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Drain.
Combine tomatoes and cornstarch in saucepan.
Stir to dissolve cornstarch.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Remove chicken from baking dish. Pour all but 1 cup sauce into dish.
Arrange chicken over sauce in dish; top with remaining sauce.
Place 1 slice cheese on each piece of chicken.
Bake until cheese melts.
Garnish with parsley. Serve with hot cooked rice, if desired.

recipes.title: "Old Fashion" Cole Slaw
steps: Combine cabbage, carrots and pickle cubes; set aside.
Combine remaining ingredients; mix well.
Spoon over cabbage mixture; toss gently.
Chill until serving time.

recipes.title: Easy Barbecued Spareribs
steps: Cut ribs into serving size pieces.
Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Combine remaining ingredients; mix well.
Spoon over ribs.
Reduce heat to 350°, cover and bake another hour.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes more or until tender.

recipes.title: Quick Delicious Fudge
ingredients: 12 oz. Baker's German's sweet chocolate, broken into pieces
steps: Place chocolate bars, chocolate morsels and Marshmallow Creme in a large bowl of an electric mixer.
Combine the sugar, milk, butter and salt in a heavy 3 or 4-quart saucepan.
Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring constantly.
When the mixture comes to a boil, lower the heat to medium and set a timer for 6 minutes.
Keep the mixture boiling steadily and stir constantly to prevent scorching.
At the end of 6 minutes, pour the boiling syrup over the chocolate and Marshmallow Creme.
Beat until the chocolate is melted and the ingredients are well blended.
Beat in the vanilla and walnuts.
Pour into a lightly buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Let the fudge cool at room temperature for 24 hours before cutting. Cut into 1-inch square pieces and pack in airtight containers.
The fudge may be stored in airtight containers at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.
It may be frozen for up to 6 months.
Makes 5 pounds of fudge.

recipes.title: Turkey Stuffing
steps: Mix all together and stuff turkey or place around turkey 2 hours before turkey is done.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
steps: In a food processor, mince garlic.
Add chutney, curry and cream cheese and whirl until blended.
Open tomatoes by slicing a cap at the top, leaving partially attached.
Hollow out tomatoes. Using a pastry bag, fill each tomato with stuffing and replace cap.
Stuffing also makes a great dip for other vegetables.

recipes.title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
steps: Combine all ingredients in blender container.
Blend until smooth.
Makes about 1 1/4 cups.

recipes.title: Wassail
steps: In large boiler, mix cranberry juice, apple cider and pineapple juice.
Heat and dissolve sugar in juices.
Using cheesecloth or something similar, bag up the cinnamon, cloves and allspice.
Put bag in juice mixture and simmer at least 1 hour.
Refrigerate when done.
Heat before serving.

recipes.title: Ham Macaroni Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients with macaroni in large mixing bowl.
Chill or serve immediately.
Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Vegetables Tossed In Olive Butter
ingredients: 4 small red potatoes, unpeeled and sliced
1 lb. fresh asparagus, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 small sweet red pepper, cut julienne strips
1 (7 oz.) jar baby corn ears (in water)
steps: Place potatoes in a steaming rack in a large Dutch oven.
Add water to depth of 1-inch.
Bring to a boil.
Cover and steam 5 minutes.
Add asparagus and red pepper.
Cover and steam 5 minutes.
Add zucchini and mushrooms. Cover and steam 5 minutes. Add corn.
Cover and steam 1 minute.
Transfer vegetables to a bowl.
Toss with olive butter.
Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Potato And Egg Casserole
steps: Prepare thin white sauce.
In a heavy skillet, melt 6 Tbsp. margarine.
Blend in 3 Tbsp. flour with a wire whisk.
Slowly pour in 3 cups milk, stirring constantly.
Cook for 2 minutes

recipes.title: Chicken In A Crock-Pot
steps: Arrange chicken in crock-pot.
Combine all other ingredients and pour over chicken.
Cook 6 to 7 hours on low.

recipes.title: Sweet Pickles
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. mixed pickle spice or preferred
steps: Wash cucumbers, medium size is best.
Pack in large mouth jar. Fill jar with cold water and seal.
Let set at least 3 weeks.
To sweeten, open drain and wash pickles. 3 weeks.
Slice or chunk as preferred.
Pack in jar.
Add 2 cups of sugar.
If real dry, add 3 tablespoons of water and place in refrigerator for about 3 days. Shake jar several times, will dampen sugar.
Ready to eat.
Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Hominy Casserole
steps: In a saucepan, mix and heat oleo, soup and Cheez Whiz.
Pour over hominy and onions.
Mix; put in a greased casserole dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until light brown.
Top with crushed fritos.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2 (16 oz.) cans Blue Lake French-style green beans, drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (2.8 oz.) can Durkee French fried onions
steps: Combine all ingredients, except 1/2 can French fried onions. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.
Top with remaining onions; bake, uncovered, 5 minutes or until onions are golden.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Beans And Beef Bake
ingredients: 1 medium to large can pork and beans and 1 can red kidney beans
steps: Brown meat with onions and peppers.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 400° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge
steps: Melt butter in pot.
Add vanilla.
In a 6-quart pot (a pressure cooker works great) pour milk over the sugar.
Put this on high heat and stir constantly.
Once it boils, reduce heat a bit and boil for 6 1/2 minutes.
Remove from heat and add butter, chocolate morsels and then nuts.
Stir until thoroughly blended. Pour in a 13 x 17-inch pan.
Let stand overnight (covered.)

recipes.title: Lemon Balls
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Roll into balls; roll in coconut or powdered sugar.

recipes.title: "3 Minute" Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Mix sugar, milk, butter, vanilla and cocoa together.
Put on stove on medium high.
Do not stir while cooking.
When mixture first comes to boil, time 3 minutes.
Remove from stove.
Add peanut butter and 3/4 jar of marshmallow cream.
Beat quickly with mixer on low.
Pour immediately into greased 13 x 11-inch pan.

recipes.title: Chinese Candy
steps: Melt butterscotch chips in double boiler.
Mix in Chinese noodles and peanuts. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.
After they set, store in airtight container in cool place.

recipes.title: Cherry Delight
steps: Mix together and put into mold.
Place in refrigerator and chill.

recipes.title: Swedish Meatballs
steps: Mix together.
By hand, roll into 1 1/2-inch balls and brown on all sides.
Roll in flour.
Drop into boiling chicken broth and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve on rice.

recipes.title: Broiled Ham And Pineapple Slices
steps: Set oven at 550°.
Remove outer fat on ham.
Place ham on a rack in a broiler pan.
Broil 3 inches from the heat for 5 minutes on each side until light brown.
During the last 2 minutes of broiling, arrange pineapple slices on ham.
Brush slices with butter.

recipes.title: Japanese Fruit Pie
steps: Mix and pour into uncooked pie shell.
Place in a preheated oven set at 300° and cook for 40 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Hot Tamale Pie
ingredients: 2 c. mixed vegetables (if you use frozen, cook)
steps: Mix
together
egg,
milk
and corn meal.
Fry meat and onion until
meat
has turned.
Add tomato sauce, vegetables, chili powder
and garlic.
Add a little water to make mixture thinner. Put
in
casserole
dish.
Pour corn meal mixture on top.
Add grated cheese on top of corn meal mixture.
Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Cocktail
steps: Chill equal parts of cranberry juice and 7-Up.
Mix together just before serving.
Serve over ice or not.

recipes.title: Wanda'S Cranapple Cobbler
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. peeled and sliced green apples
2 1/2 c. peeled and sliced red apples
steps: Heat oven to 375°.

recipes.title: Hello Dolly Cookies
steps: Do not mix above ingredients.
Put each ingredient in separate layers in 13 x 9 inch pan.
Press each layer down as you would in making pie shell.
Finish top layer by spreading condensed milk over it.
Line cooking pan with greased wax paper and bake for
25 minutes at 350°.
When cookies are done, peel off wax paper, cut cookies and cool.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie
steps: Combine all ingredients and pour into pie crust.
Chill one hour.

recipes.title: Quick 'N Easy Scallops
steps: Preheat oven to 500°.
Coat scallops with oil (can use mille). Toss in bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.
Delicious!

recipes.title: Caramels
ingredients: 1 pt. cream or half and half
steps: Cook the sugar, syrup, oleo and cream to fairly soft ball stage (244°).
Add vanilla and pecans.
Cool and let harden slightly. Wrap pieces in waxed paper.

recipes.title: Buffet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 (32 oz.) pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
steps: Combine all ingredients except potatoes.
Heat until cheese is melted and all ingredients are mixed together.
Pour over potatoes and blend.
Pour the mixed ingredients into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour until bubbly.
Use as a side dish or add ham for a main dish.

recipes.title: Orange Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pkg. miniature marshmallows or 20 large ones
steps: Put jello, marshmallows and cream cheese in bowl and pour 1 pint boiling
water over; beat with
mixer
until
smooth.
Let cool
until thickened.
Add whipped cream,
sugar,
nuts
and pineapple.
Pour into serving dish and when well set up,
pour small box of orange jello over top.
Let jello cool before pouring on.
Scatter nuts over top.

recipes.title: Mix And Forget Beef Stroganoff
steps: Mix all together.
Cover and bake 3 to 4 hours at 350°.
Serve over noodles.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
steps: Combine butter, Parmesan cheese, egg, salt, pepper, garlic salt and oregano with cooked noodles.
Layer in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Spread cottage cheese over top of noodles. Brown meat and drain well.
Add spaghetti sauce, oregano and garlic salt.
Spread over the top of cottage cheese.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Then take out of oven and sprinkle Mozzarella cheese over top.
Bake for an additional 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
steps: Mix together well and chill.

recipes.title: Roasted Red Pepper Sauce
ingredients: 12 oz. jar roasted red peppers, drained
salt, pepper and cayenne pepper to taste
1 c. crumbled Blue cheese (I use Saga)
steps: In a blender, combine red peppers, olive oil, lemon juice, vinegar, water, garlic, salt, pepper and cayenne.
Blend for 1 minute, or until sauce is smooth.
Add chopped parsley.
Pour over hot linguine and toss to coat well.
Serve topped with Blue cheese.
Serves four.

recipes.title: Barbecued Short Ribs
ingredients: 5 lb. lean short ribs (3 to 4-inches long)
steps: Place short ribs in large bowl. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over ribs. Cover and refrigerate 8 to 10 hours. Turn occasionally. Remove from marinade and drain. Cook slowly on grill 7 to 8-inches from coals, 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until meat begins to leave bone. Turn often. Brush with marinade during last 20 minutes of cooking. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Two Corn Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 2-quart casserole.
In a small skillet, melt margarine.
Add green pepper and onion; saute until crisp-tender.
In a large bowl, combine cream-style corn, whole corn, eggs and corn muffin mix.
Blend well.
Add onion mixture; mix well.
Pour into casserole.
Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Western Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. sliced, cooked ham, diced
steps: About 35 minutes before serving, in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot margarine, cook onion until tender about 5 minutes.
Add ham.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl with fork, beat eggs, milk and salt until well mixed.
Stir into ham mixture. Reduce heat to low; cover and cook 12 to 15 minutes, until top is set and underside is lightly browned.
Serve egg mixture between bread slices.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Little Cheese Cakes
steps: Makes 70 (2-inch) cakes.

recipes.title: Hot Ice Cream Crepes
steps: Preheat oven to 475°.
Divide ice cream among crepes and roll up.
Place in ovenproof dish.
Bake 2 to 3 minutes.
Serve with cold chocolate sauce.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. Ro-Tel chili peppers and tomatoes
steps: Brown hamburger and onion.
Add salt and pepper.
Drain.
Add all canned ingredients and stir until it comes to a slow boil.
In a 9 x 11-inch casserole, layer:

recipes.title: Conventional Crepes(The Official Breakfast Of The Davis Family)
steps: Mix all ingredients with a wire whisk.
Take out the white things (from the eggs).
Melt butter in a skillet or spray it with nonstick spray and pour some mix onto it, spreading it thin by tilting the pan.
Flip.
Cover with sugar or fruit and roll. Cover the top of the rolled crepe with sugar, whipped cream, etc. Makes 12.
Double to make 24.

recipes.title: Instant Cookies
steps: Combine biscuit mix and pudding mix in bowl.
Stir in oil and egg.
Mix thoroughly and shape into small balls (about a teaspoon each).
Place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with finger or spoon.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Boat Pudding
ingredients: 3 1/4 oz. pkg. vanilla pudding and pie filling
steps: Prepare vanilla pudding and pie filling mix as directed for pudding on package.
Cover surface of pudding mixture with waxed paper or transparent wrap.
Chill.
Fold in miniature marshmallows and heavy cream, whipped.
Line bottom and sides of 10 x 6-inch baking dish with vanilla wafers.
Pour in half of pudding mixture. Cover with 2 bananas, sliced.
Top with remaining pudding mixture.
Chill.
Garnish with additional marshmallows and banana slices, if desired.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Raspberry Fudge Balls
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia brand cream cheese, softened
steps: Beat cream cheese in small bowl until smooth.
Add melted chocolate.
Mix well.
Stir in crumbs and preserves.
Refrigerate 1 hour or overnight.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Roll in almonds, cocoa or sugar.
Store in refrigerator.
Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. yellow cake mix, prepared according to directions
steps: Line pan with foil, letting it extend up sides of pan.
Spread melted margarine over bottom; sprinkle with brown sugar and arrange fruit on top.
Add cake mix.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Turn out on plate, remove foil and top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup or cream of celery soup
1/2 can French-fried onion rings (save other half for top)
steps: Layer in casserole dish and bake at 350° for approximately 25 minutes.
Remove from oven, spread remaining onion rings on top and serve.

recipes.title: Ohio Buckeyes
ingredients: 2 lb. chocolate meltaways or chocolate chips
steps: Melt together over low heat the butter and peanut butter. Remove from heat and add sugar gradually.
Roll into 1-inch balls.
Place on waxed paper and set in fridge for 1 hour.
Melt chocolate in double boiler and dip peanut butter balls into chocolate, partially exposing peanut butter to resemble the look of a buckeye.
Set back on waxed paper and put in freezer to harden.
Once hardened place in containers and refreeze until needed.

recipes.title: Beef, Cabbage And Noodles
steps: Brown beef, onion and pepper.
Drain all fat.
Add oil, soy sauce and water to beef mixture.
Add cabbage, sliced in thin wedges and ramen noodles broken up over mixture.
Add flavor packet from noodles, salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer, covered, approximately 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Potatoes
ingredients: 1 (32 oz.) pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
1 (10 oz.) cream of celery soup, undiluted
steps: Thaw the potatoes.
Mix all ingredients in a big bowl together and spread in shallow baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, for 50 minutes or until hot. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: 9-Day Cucumber Pickles
steps: First Day:
2 cups salt and boiling water to cover and let cukes stand 24 hours; drain.

recipes.title: Haystacks
steps: Melt butterscotch morsels in top of double boiler.
Mix in noodles to a good consistency.
Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper and cool.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 can cherry or blueberry pie filling
steps: Dump ingredients (in layers) in a 8 x 12-inch ungreased baking pan in this order:
pie filling, pineapple, cake mix, butter, coconut and pecans.
Do not mix, just dump in.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Easy Short Ribs
steps: Season short ribs.
Let stand for 2 hours or overnight.
In roasting pan, place onions and celery leaves first and place the short ribs on top.
Bake at 250° for 5 to 6 hours.
Pour fat off. Serve dressed with favorite dressing.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
steps: Combine sugar and Karo in a 1 to 1 1/2-quart bowl.
Place in microwave and cook 4 minutes on High; stir.
Cook 1 1/2 minutes more on High; add vanilla and cook 1 minute.
Add oleo and cook 1 more minute.
Add peanuts and baking soda and stir until it turns light brown.
Pour on greased baking sheet.
Cool and break into pieces.
