recipes.title: Double Marble Cake
ingredients: 1 c. Hershey's semi-sweet chocolate chips, divided
steps: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Prepare cake batter according to package directions using eggs, oil and water.
Stir 1/2 cup of chocolate chips into chocolate batter.
Spoon vanilla and chocolate batters into prepared pan; swirl as directed on package.
Bake 33 to 38 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pan on wire rack 5 minutes.
Gently spread Marshmallow Creme over warm cake.
In small saucepan over low, heat remaining 1/2 cup chips.
Swirl through Marshmallow Creme.
Cool thoroughly.
Makes 12 to 15 servings.

recipes.title: Fruit Slush Punch
steps: Boil water and sugar; cool.
Add next 4 ingredients; mix well. Freeze in a covered flat container.
When needed for serving, let set until slightly softened, 1 to 2 hours.
Scrape frozen mixture into punch bowl to form slush.
Add 7-Up and lemon juice; serve.

recipes.title: Spice Beets
steps: Heat first 6 ingredients to boiling.
Add beets; cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve warm or chilled.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 4 c. cooked and diced chicken or turkey
steps: Combine soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice and pepper.
Layer broccoli and chicken soup mixture in greased casserole dish. Top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cucumber Salad
steps: Let set a few minutes so flavors can blend.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Chiffon Pie
steps: Soak gelatin in water.
Separate yolks from whites and boil with remaining ingredients for 1 minute.
Immediately stir in gelatin.
Cool.
When partially set, whip.
Whip egg whites with: 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar and 6 tablespoons sugar.
Fold into pumpkin mixture.
Pour into baked 9-inch pie shell.

recipes.title: Twice Baked Potatoes
steps: Wash potatoes and pat dry; prick each potato with a fork several times.
Place potatoes on paper towels in microwave. Microwave at High, 20 or 30 minutes, turning potatoes after 10 minutes.
Remove potatoes when they feel soft and cut down the middle with knife.
Carefully remove all the insides, leaving the peeling intact.
Mix potatoes, margarine, mayonnaise and milk together with mixer until smooth.
Add salt and pepper to taste. Spoon mixture back into potato shells and top with grated cheese. Return to microwave and cook for about 1 minute until cheese is melted.
Serve with any type of meat.

recipes.title: Barbecued Ribs
steps: Combine sauce ingredients in pan.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat, simmer, uncovered, for 30 minutes.
Stir occasionally. Sprinkle ribs with salt and pepper.
Cook under grill or on barbecue until nearly done.
Last 15 minutes, brush with the sauce.
Or can marinate in sauce at least one hour before cooking.

recipes.title: Chicken Delight
steps: Mix first 6 ingredients.
Dip chicken pieces into mixture. Coat with Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix.
Let marinate overnight in sealed container.

recipes.title: Coconut Cream Pies
steps: Toast coconut on cookie sheet; let cool.
Combine cream cheese,
sugar and milk until well blended.
Add Cool Whip and beat
until
well
blended; add coconut.
Spread into 2 graham cracker crusts.
Chill for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
steps: Mix and cook until thick (about 20 minutes).
Cool overnight. Add to a small container of Cool Whip.
Dip with pieces of fruit.

recipes.title: Fluff Salad
steps: Melt marshmallows in cherry juice over low heat in a saucepan. Add to marshmallow mixture the cream cheese and blend.
Add the rest of ingredients and mix well.
Mold and chill.

recipes.title: Tuna Stroganoff
steps: Cook onion in butter until tender.
Blend in mushroom soup, sour cream, tuna and mushrooms.
Heat and serve on hot, cooked rice or noodles.
Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Mix together the soup, margarine and cream cheese; melt on stove.
Slice potatoes and put 1/2 into 2-quart baking dish.
Pour 1/2 of melted mixture on top.
Cover with Velveeta cheese.
Add rest of potatoes.
Pour rest of mixture on top.
Cover with another layer of Velveeta cheese.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Candy
steps: Melt peanut butter and margarine over low-heat, slowly until well blended.
Remove from heat.
Add box of sugar.
Work fast to mix and blend.
Pour and spread into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Allow to cool.
Cut into squares and serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Mix sugar, peanut butter and vanilla.
Blend in Cool Whip. Put into graham cracker crust.
Chill.

recipes.title: Hamburger-Cheese Dip
steps: Brown ground beef and melt Velveeta cheese together.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Hot Fruit Compote
steps: Drain fruit and put in casserole.
Combine brown sugar and curry powder.
Sprinkle over top of fruit.	Dot with butter. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinch-Sational Coleslaw
ingredients: 3/4 cup real mayonnaise- not miracle whip
steps: In a small bowl mix mayo, vinegar, & sugar with a whisk until it turns into a dressing like texture. Check consistency and taste. Add bell pepper and onion if desired and salt and pepper. Check taste. Mix dressing into coleslaw until thoroughly covered.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Casserole
steps: In skillet, brown ground beef and onion.
Drain grease off. Add tomato sauce, ketchup and pepper to beef mixture.
Pour mixture into a casserole dish.
Top with slices of cheese and then the biscuits.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fudge Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt butter over low heat.
Add cocoa; stir until smooth.
Stir in milk, water, eggs and chocolate chips. Mix until well blended and chips are melted.
Remove from heat. Stir in pecans and vanilla.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake for 50 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
steps: Bake cake in 9 x 13-inch sheet pan.
Cool.
Crumble in large pieces.
Pour ingredients over crumbs and layer like banana pudding.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pecan Casserole
steps: In large bowl let egg whites warm to room temperature about 1 hour, also preheat oven to 375°.
With electric mixer at high speed, beat egg whites with salt just until peaks form when beater is slowly raised.
Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar, beating until stiff peaks form.
In another large bowl, using same beater, combine sweet potatoes, 1/4 cup sugar, egg yolk, cinnamon, mace and orange peel.
Beat at high speed 2 minutes, until mixture is smooth. Meanwhile in small saucepan, heat cream to boiling.
Slowly add to sweet potato mixture, beating until combined.
With wire whisk, using an under and over motion, fold sweet potato mixture and pecans into egg whites just until combined.
Gently turn into 1-quart straight sided souffle dish.
Bake 45 minutes or until puffy and golden brown.
(Ten minutes before end of baking time, arrange whole pecans on top.)
Serve at once, with butter.

recipes.title: Gourmet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 (2 lb.) bag frozen hash brown potatoes
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Can be prepared ahead of time and frozen, then baked for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli and then add all other ingredients.
Pour into a large casserole dish and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Jello Set
steps: Mix lemon jello with hot water; add juice from fruit cocktail (if not enough juice, add water to make 1 1/2 cups liquid); chill until thick.
In separate bowl, beat cream cheese (softened) with drained fruit cocktail.
Beat chilled, thick jello mixture until foamy, then add to cream cheese/fruit cocktail mixture.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into serving dish and chill.

recipes.title: Peanutty-Cocoa Bonbons
steps: Beat cream cheese and milk until fluffy in large mixer bowl. Blend in confectioners sugar, cocoa and vanilla.
Stir in nuts. Cover and chill until firm enough to handle overnight, then shape into 1 inch balls.
Place on wax paper-lined trays.
Chill uncovered 3 to 4 hours.
They should feel dry to the touch before coating.

recipes.title: Award Winning Chili
steps: Brown ground chuck and drain off fat.
Mix all ingredients with the ground chuck and put in crock-pot.
Cook on low for 18 hours.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
steps: Cook and drain spinach. Add cream cheese while spinach is hot and cream together well. Add mushroom soup. Pour into baking dish. Sprinkle top with onion rings. Bake at 350° until bubbly, about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
steps: In a greased 9 x 13-inch pan, place the pecans and coconut. Mix cake mix according to directions on box and pour over the pecans and coconut.
Do not stir.
In separate bowl, mix together the cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla.
Beat until creamy and drop by spoonfuls over cake mix.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Serve with whipped topping.
Makes 12 to 14 servings.

recipes.title: Hopscotch Candy
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) can La Choy chow mein noodles
steps: Melt the butterscotch morsels over hot water with the peanut butter.
Mix in a large bowl the marshmallows and noodles.
Add butterscotch mixture and mix all together, then drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

recipes.title: Hamburger And Noodle Skillet Supper
ingredients: 3 c. egg noodles or 1 c. small pasta
1 sweet green or red pepper, cubed
steps: In large pot of boiling water, cook pasta until tender, but firm; drain.

recipes.title: Baked Clams
ingredients: 1 small can chopped clams or 1 c. fresh, chopped clams
steps: Mince garlic cloves and chop small onions.
Saute in oil.
Add clams, white wine, celery salt, salt and pepper to taste, oregano and butter; simmer for 15 minutes.
Add chopped parsley for color. Add enough bread crumbs to absorb liquid.
Fill clam shells, then sprinkle with paprika.
Bake for 15 minutes at 375°.
Filled clam shells can be frozen until ready to be baked.

recipes.title: Stuffed Pistolettes
steps: Season the meat to suit your taste.
Combine with velveeta cubes.
Set aside.
Slice top off of each roll and hollow out. Fill with meat and cheese mixture and replace end of pistolette. Spray rolls with garlic butter and bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Dressing Casserole
steps: Mix Stove Top according to box.
Pour into a casserole dish. Place turkey over stuffing.
Then spoon soup over turkey.
Spread evenly.
Bake in oven for 30 minutes at 300° or 15 minutes in microwave.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
ingredients: 1 graham cracker pie crust or baked pastry crust
steps: Mix condensed milk and lemon juice.
Add pineapple, coconut and nuts.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into pie shell and refrigerate several hours before serving.
Can be garnished with chopped nuts or cherries, if desired.

recipes.title: Ham Pinwheels
steps: Mix chopped olives, cream cheese and onion dip together. Spread evenly on top of each ham/cheese slice.
Roll up and chill overnight.
Slice into bite-size pieces.
Serve with crackers or Triscuits.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Put in container with lid 3/4 cup sugar and 3/4 teaspoon cinnamon.
Stir.
Cut biscuit into quarters; put in container and shake until all pieces are covered with sugar and cinnamon.
In saucepan, put 1 cup brown sugar, 1 1/2 sticks butter and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
Cook on high; bring to boil and boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Spray Bundt pan with oil; put biscuits in pan and cover with glaze.
Cook at 350° for 25 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes and turn over on plate.

recipes.title: Pasta With Red Clam Sauce
ingredients: 2 (14 1/2 or 16 oz.) cans whole Italian-style tomatoes, cut up
8 oz. pasta (medium shells, mostaccioli or cavatelli)
steps: In a large skillet saute garlic in hot oil over medium heat about 30 seconds.
Add black and red pepper.
Cook and stir for 30 seconds or more.
Drain clams, save juice; set clams aside.
Add reserved clam juice and undrained tomatoes to skillet.
Stir in parsley, basil and anchovy paste.
Bring to boiling, reduce heat. Simmer uncovered, for 30 to 35 minutes or to desired consistency. Stir in clams, heat through.
Cook pasta according to package directions; drain well.
Serve sauce over cooked pasta.

recipes.title: Strawberry Julius
ingredients: 3/4 c. (6 oz.) any kind juice (cranberry, orange, etc.)
steps: Put all ingredients in blender, except ice cubes.
Put ice cubes in last.
Mix until well blended.
Frozen strawberries work really good also.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Company Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 2 large Hershey almond candy bars (7 small)
steps: Melt chocolate bars in double boiler.
Mix with Cool Whip and pour into pie crust.
Chill at least 45 minutes.
Then ready to serve.

recipes.title: Mexican Stew
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef or turkey, cooked
steps: Put all canned ingredients in a large pot. Add cooked meat. When soup is hot, mix in seasoning packets. Top with shredded cheese, tortilla chips and sour cream.

recipes.title: Chicken Almond Casserole
ingredients: 2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of chicken soup
steps: Combine chicken, celery, onion, eggs, almonds, chicken soup, mayonnaise, chicken broth, salt and pepper together.
Spoon into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch lightly greased baking dish.
Sprinkle with cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Caribbean Style Red Snapper
ingredients: 1 c. red bell peppers, grilled, skinned and julienned
steps: Simmer olive oil, tomatoes and parsley for 5 minutes.
Combine next 14 ingredients and add to first mixture.
Simmer over high heat for 5 minutes.
Reserve.
Place snapper in a roasting pan. Season with salt and pepper.
Combine green olives, scallions, red bell peppers and capers.
Spread on fillets.
Pour reserved sauce over.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Potatoes Romanoff
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes.
Boil potatoes 5 minutes until almost done.
Drain potatoes and mix in butter, salt and pepper.
Add sour cream and green onions, mixing well.
Pour in a 9 x 9-inch casserole dish.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Buffet Potatoes
steps: Thaw hash browns.
Add each ingredient one by one, mixing as you go.

recipes.title: Dried Beef Pinwheels
steps: Mash cheese; mix with Worcestershire sauce and onion.
Spread on beef slices; roll up and place in refrigerator until chilled. Cut into 1/2-inch lengths.
Slice carrot thin.
Place slice of carrot on toothpick, then dried beef.

recipes.title: Apple Dip
steps: Blend all ingredients in a blender until well blended.
Serve with apple slices.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
steps: Butter dish.
Place layer of asparagus, mix soup and water and put layer over asparagus.
Repeat layers until gone.
Cover with bread crumbs and dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Superb Salad
steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well.
Chill.
Makes 4 to 5 servings.
Can be made one day ahead.

recipes.title: Rib Roast Of Lamb With Herb Dijon Crust
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Rub rib roast with cut side of 2 halves of garlic.
Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper.
Place fat side up in large shallow roasting pan. Roast 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
2 c. cooked squash, mashed and drained
1 1/2 c. packaged bread crumbs mixture for chicken dressing
steps: Combine all ingredients except crumb mixture and 1/2 stick margarine.
Place in greased casserole dish.
Combine crumb mixture with 1/2 stick margarine which has been melted.
Bake in 275° oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Microwave Chicken
steps: Skin and wash chicken pieces.
Cover with salted water and soak for 45 minutes.
Place thighs in dish; season and cover. Place in microwave on High for 8 minutes, then turn 1/2 turn. Then set at High for 8 minutes again.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
ingredients: 4 c. fresh strawberries, hulled and rinsed
steps: In saucepan over medium heat, cook water, sugar and cornstarch until thickened and clear.
Cool at room temperature.
Add butter, vanilla and food coloring.
Mix in strawberries and pour into baked pie shell.
Chill.
Top with whipped cream and garnish with berries.

recipes.title: Sweet Pickles
ingredients: Large cucumbers - take out seeds with a spoon, slice 1/4 inch thick
steps: Soak cucumbers for three days in pickling salt and water. Drain.
Soak in ice water two days changing water both days, then drain.
Simmer (one hour or more until pickles are clear) in water and 1 Tbsp. alum.
Rinse and drain well.

recipes.title: Chicken Almond
steps: Skin breasts,
dry
and
salt.	Brown in skillet in the margarine.	Remove to greased baking pan when browned.
To the skillet add almonds, chestnuts, mushrooms and onion flakes and saute.
Add
soup
and
water (or wine); blend.
Pour over the chicken breasts.
Cover
and
bake	at 375° for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours.
Uncover last 20 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Taco Pie
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
steps: Brown meat.
Drain.
Stir in tomato sauce and seasoning mix. Simmer 5 minutes.
Press crescent roll dough into bottom and sides of ungreased pizza pan, pressing edges together to seal.
Prick bottom and sides with fork.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes, or until golden brown.
Cover with meat mixture; top with shredded cheese.
Continue baking until cheese is melted.
Slice into pie wedges.
After your piece is on the plate, add your lettuce, tomatoes and other ingredients as you desire.

recipes.title: Buckeyes
steps: Mix together peanut butter, butter and powdered sugar.
Roll into small balls.
Put in refrigerator for about 1 hour.
Melt chocolate chips and paraffin.
Dip balls in with a toothpick. Cover only 3/4 of the ball.

recipes.title: Lemon Eclair Dessert
ingredients: 16 oz. lemon frosting mix (ready to spread)
steps: Mix pudding and milk; set aside until thick, then add dry lemon jello and mix well. Fold in Cool Whip. Place layer of crackers (unbroken) in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour a layer of pudding mixture over crackers. Continue layering until you end with a layer of crackers. Carefully spread frosting over crackers. Refrigerate for 24 hours for best flavor.

recipes.title: Herb Mushroom Gravy
steps: In saucepan, in hot margarine, cook mushrooms with thyme until mushrooms are tender.
Stir in gravy and lemon juice.
Heat through.
Serve over chicken or mashed potatoes.
Makes 1 1/3 cups.

recipes.title: "Corn Bake"
steps: Mix all ingredients in bowl together. Grease 9 x 9 pan and bake mixture at 350° for 35 minutes. Sprinkle 1/2 bag of shredded Cheddar cheese on top and bake for 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Yum Yum Salad
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients together and refrigerate until partially thickened.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix thoroughly and refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Place in quiche dish.
Bake at 350° until it bubbles.
Serve hot with crackers.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: In medium bowl beat eggs slightly.
Beat in next 5 ingredients.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean. Cool.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Balls
steps: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well and chill several hours. Shape into small balls.
Makes about 20 to 24 balls.

recipes.title: Mexican Fondue
ingredients: 1 (4 to 6 oz.) can green chili salsa
steps: Cut cheese into chunks and melt in a double boiler.
Add diced green chilies and salsa.
Simmer 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve warm with French bread chunks and/or veggies.

recipes.title: Rotel Sausage Dip
steps: Brown sausage.
Drain.
Melt cheese and add sausage and tomatoes.
Reheat until all ingredients are to your desired temperature.
Serve with your favorite chips or crackers.

recipes.title: Chilies Rellenos Casserole
steps: Arrange chilies on bottom of cake pan.
Mix cheese and spread on top.
Mix milk and eggs and pour over cheese.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes. Take out and pour tomato sauce over it. Return to oven for 12 minutes. Serves 6 heartily.

recipes.title: French Meat Pie
steps: Fry pork until all pink is gone.
Add onions and cook 5 minutes more.
Drain off fat.
Add seasonings.
Boil potatoes and mash with milk until stiff, not whipped.
Add to meat mixture and blend well.
Put in pie crust.
Cover edges with foil so they won't overcook.
Cook at 400° for 1 hour.
Place on cookie sheet in case juices run over.
Delicious.

recipes.title: Fresh Polish Sausage
steps: *Use 10 pounds meat.
You can use all pork if you want.

recipes.title: Toasted Pecans
steps: Toast pecans for 10 minutes at 300°.
Combine all ingredients, except vanilla and pecans.
Cook until it spins a thread.
Remove and add nuts and vanilla quickly.
Pour onto buttered dish.

recipes.title: Turkey And Black Bean Chili(Student Favorite)
ingredients: 2 c. finely chopped red bell pepper
2 (15 to 16 oz.) cans black beans, rinsed and drained
steps: Heat oil in heavy, large saucepan or Dutch oven over medium-low heat.
Add bell pepper, onion, carrot and garlic. Saute until tender, about 12 minutes.
Add chili powder and cumin; stir to blend.
Increase heat to medium-high and add turkey. Break up with spoon and saute until turkey is no longer pink, about three minutes.
Add beans, broth and tomato paste and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer chili until liquid thickens, stirring occasionally, about one hour.
Season with salt and pepper.
(Can be prepared a day ahead.
Cover and chill.
Reheat over medium heat before serving.)

recipes.title: Spanish Squash
steps: Dice squash and onion.
Saute in butter until tender.
Add salt and pepper.
Add drained chilies and corn.
Place in casserole and cover with cheese.
Bake at 350° until cheese melts. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Fruit Whiskey Slush
steps: Mix and freeze.
Fill glass halfway with slush.
Add cold 7-Up and stir.
Add a cherry for color.

recipes.title: Grasshopper Pie
steps: Combine chocolate wafer crumbs and melted butter.
Press onto sides and bottom of a nine-inch pie plate.
Chill.
Heat milk in top of a double boiler over boiling water.
Add marshmallows; stir until melted.
Cool thoroughly.
Combine whipped cream, creme de menthe and creme de cacao.
Fold in cooled marshmallow mixture. Add filling into chilled crumb crust and chill until firm.

recipes.title: Cookies While You Sleep
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat egg whites until foamy.
Add salt and cream of tartar.
Beat well.
Gradually add sugar and beat until stiff.
Add almond extract.
Fold in nuts and chips.
Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet.
Turn oven heat off and drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet.
Place in oven when heat is off.
Don't peek.
Leave in oven overnight.

recipes.title: Smothered Pork Backbone Or Pork Fingers
ingredients: 2 lb. pork fingers or pork backbone
steps: Brown pork fingers or backbone and remove fat.
In separate pot, saute onion, bell pepper and garlic.
Add soup and roux. Then add browned meat and turnips.
Cook until tender.

recipes.title: Guacamole Salad
ingredients: chopped jalapeno pepper (or hot salsa sauce)
steps: Mash
avocados	with potato masher.
Add onion, tomato, garlic powder, peppers, salt and pepper.
Add your lemon juice to suit your taste.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
steps: Combine pretzels, butter and 1/4 cup sugar.
Press into 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 8 minutes.
Combine pineapple, cornstarch and sugar in saucepan.
Cook until thick.
Cool and spread over pretzel mixture.
Whip Dream Whip and add cream cheese.
Spread over pineapple mixture.
Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Banana Dip
steps: In a blender, combine bananas, sugar and honey.
Blend well. Fold in Dream Whip.
Can make 24 hours ahead. Refrigerate.
Cube any fresh fruit.
Serve in hollow half of pineapple.
Dip cubed fresh fruit in banana dip.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Wash cucumbers.
Slice in 1/8-inch slices; combine with sliced onions and salt.
Let stand for 3 hours.
Drain well, rinse thoroughly and drain again.
In a pot, combine vinegar, sugar, turmeric, mustard seed, celery seed and red pepper; bring to a boil.
Add cucumbers and onions; heat just to simmering.
Do not boil!
Pack in sterilized jars; seal at once.
Makes 7 to 9 jars.

recipes.title: Turkey-Vegetable Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. corkscrew pasta, cooked and drained
1 c. cooked turkey, cut into chunks
4 to 5 c. assorted raw vegetables (broccoli, green or red peppers, onions, cauliflower, tomatoes, etc.)
steps: Toss all ingredients.
Chill until ready to serve.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Decorator Frosting
steps: Measure all ingredients into large bowl.
Beat at normal speed for 3 minutes, then on high speed for 2 minutes.
Add more sugar to thicken or more water to thin.
Makes 3 1/4 cups.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: 8 oz. American or shredded Cheddar cheese
steps: In medium saucepan, combine cornstarch, salt, dry mustard and pepper.
Stir in milk until smooth.
Add butter, stirring constantly.
Bring to a boil over medium to high heat.
Boil 1 minute.
Remove from heat.

recipes.title: Texas Pecan Pie
steps: Combine all and pour into pie shell.
Bake 10 minutes at 450°, then reduce to 350° and bake 40 minutes more.

recipes.title: Divinity Fudge
steps: Stir sugar, syrup and water until sugar is dissolved in saucepan.
Cook without stirring to 260 degrees on a candy thermometer.

recipes.title: Church Window Cookies
steps: Melt chocolate chips and butter.
Cool and add nuts and marshmallows; mix well.
Sprinkle coconut on 3 pieces wax paper. Spoon mixture on paper and roll into log form.
Put log on foil and roll and seal.
Put in refrigerator overnight, then slice and put on platter.

recipes.title: Alaska Seafood Omelet
ingredients: 1 c. (about 5 oz.) poached Alaska salmon or 1 can (7 1/2 oz.) salmon, drained*
steps: *If desired 1 cup (about 5 oz.)
Alaska Pink shrimp, Alaska Dungeness, King or Snow crab meat or combination of seafoods may be substituted.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Steam broccoli.
Place in greased casserole dish.
Sprinkle 1 tablespoon sugar over broccoli.
Slice hard-boiled eggs and lay on top of broccoli.
Cover eggs and broccoli with 2 cups of shredded Cheddar cheese.
In separate bowl, mix 1 tablespoon of milk with can of mushroom soup.
Layer on top of casserole.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Grease large Bundt pan.
Pour nuts evenly into pan.
Cut biscuits into squares.
Roll each piece in cinnamon-sugar mixture. Arrange biscuits in pan.
Melt oleo and add brown sugar.
Pour over sugar and biscuits.
Bake at 350° about 30 minutes, depending on size of biscuits.

recipes.title: Fruity Peanut Butter Sandwiches
steps: Spread each bread slice with peanut butter.
Top with one slice of pineapple for each sandwich; add slices of bananas. Place remaining slices of bread, peanut butter side down, on fruit.
Cut and serve at once.

recipes.title: Corn And Okra Creole
steps: Saute green pepper and scallions in margarine for 5 minutes. Add corn and okra.
Cook over moderate heat for 10 minutes, stirring.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, thyme, salt and pepper. Simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. red potatoes, boiled and drained
steps: Cut up potatoes in a large bowl. Add chopped onion, pepper and black olives. Add the oil, vinegar, black pepper and salt.
Mix together. Add eggs last, cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Beef Louise
ingredients: 2 lb. stew beef, in bite sized pieces
steps: Mix all ingredients together in covered casserole.
Bake at 300° for 3 hours.
Do not peek.
Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Carrot Ring
steps: Combine first nine ingredients; mix well.
Beat the eggs puffy, fold into carrot mixture.
Pour into a well-greased 1 1/2-quart ring mold.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Turn out onto a warm platter.
Fill center with warmed sweet English peas. Garnish outside ring with parsley.
Serves 8 to 12.

recipes.title: Baked Fish
steps: Put fish in shallow pan.
Pour on soup.
Mix oleo and crumbs. Sprinkle on fish.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with paprika or parsley.
Makes 4 to 5 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
steps: Combine jello and boiling water; mix well.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into a long Pyrex dish.
Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen green beans, cooked until almost tender
steps: Preheat oven to 375°.
Saute onion and green pepper in oil. Add remaining ingredients except bread crumbs and stir until heated through.
Pour into a
greased casserole and sprinkle with crumbs.
Bake 30 minutes.
Serves 8.

recipes.title: Chili
steps: Cook meat and pepper in Dutch oven until meat is done.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer 1 hour.

recipes.title: Layered Banana Pineapple Dessert
ingredients: 2 pkg. (4 oz. size) Jell-O vanilla pudding
steps: Mix graham cracker crumbs in large bowl.
Add sugar and margarine and press mixture evenly on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Arrange bananas on bottom of pan.
Beat cream cheese until smooth.
Gradually add milk.
Add pudding mix.
Beat until blended.
Spread evenly over banana slices.
Spoon pineapple over pudding mixture.
Spread Cool Whip over pineapple.
Refrigerate 3 hours.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Bread Stuffing
steps: In a saucepan, cook celery and onion in butter until tender but not brown.
Remove from heat and stir in sage, salt and pepper.
Place the dry bread cubes in a large mixing bowl.
Add the onion mixture.
Drizzle with enough broth to moisten, tossing lightly.
Use to stuff one 10-pound turkey.

recipes.title: Bread-N-Butter Pickles
ingredients: 2 doz. firm young cucumbers (4 to 5-inches long; 1 1/2-inches thick)
steps: Choose 2 dozen firm young cucumbers, 4 to 5-inches long and 1 1/2-inches thick. Wash well and slice into 1/4-inch round slices, unpeeled. Place slices in an airtight container. Sprinkle with 1 cup of kosher salt and cover. Allow to stand in a cool place for 12 hours. During the soaking time, stir and turn over cucumbers 2 or 3 times so that they are evenly covered in brine. Replace lid after each stirring.

recipes.title: Turkey Barbecue
steps: Cut onion fine and celery.
Brown in 1/4 pound or less of margarine.
Add turkey to mix.
Mix, then add ketchup, mustard, brown sugar, tomato sauce and vinegar.
Mix well.
Simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Mulled Cider
steps: Mix together in a large saucepan; heat to a boil, then simmer for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Salsa Burgers
ingredients: 1/3 c. picante sauce (mild or hot to your liking)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Form mixture into 6 to 8 patties; layer patties in aluminum foil and refrigerate to firm them up. Broil, grill or bake to desired doneness.

recipes.title: Hunt'S Chili Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 oz. spaghetti, cooked according to package and kept warm
steps: Prep: 5 minutes. Cook: 20 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Peanut-Fudge Bites
steps: Combine peanut butter morsels, sweetened condensed milk and butter in a 2-quart glass bowl.
Microwave at High 1 1/2 minutes, or until morsels melt.
Stir well.
Pour mixture on a cookie sheet lined with wax paper.
Spread into a 13 x 11-inch rectangle. Smooth surface with a rolling pin.
Chill 45 minutes, or until firm.
Turn mixture onto a cutting board.
Remove wax paper.
Cut into desired shapes with 1-inch and 1 1/2-inch cookie cutters.

recipes.title: Frozen Watermelon Virgin Margaritas
ingredients: 1/2 medium lime, cut into wedges for garnish
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth. Divide among 4 glasses. Garnish with lime wedges. Serves 4. 1 point per serving.

recipes.title: Krautwinkles
steps: Cook ground beef until done; drain. Add cabbage and cook until tender.
Use Season-All as desired.

Unroll 1 can of rolls and press 1 section crescent rolls until flat and seams are sealed. Place cheese slices on dough to cover up to 1/2-inch each edge. Spoon 1/2 to 1 cup cabbage mixture onto cheese.
Unroll second section and press as before.
Place on top and press edges to seal.
(May fold dough in half, if smaller winkles are desired.) Place on cookie sheet and bake according to package directions. Repeat with second can crescent rolls.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken A La King
steps: Slowly heat soup and cream. Stirring constantly, add remaining ingredients. Beat thoroughly, stirring occasionally.
Serve over toast.

recipes.title: Nancy'S French Toast(Breakfast Dish)
ingredients: 2 c. half and half or light cream
steps: Grease a heavy griddle or pan. In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs, cream, sugar, cinnamon, vanilla, salt and nutmeg together. Dip bread into egg mixture, coating both sides. Cook bread on griddle over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Serve warm with butter or margarine and warm syrup.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Pasta
ingredients: 1 can Healthy Request cream of mushroom soup
steps: Prepare pasta as per package directions.
Heat soup, 1/2 can of water and chopped mushrooms (amount determined by your taste). Salt and pepper to taste.
Drain pasta and mix into heated soup mixture.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes With Avocado Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 slices bread, processed to make 3/4 c. crumbs
steps: Mix crabmeat and all of the ingredients with the exception of the breadcrumbs.
Add breadcrumbs and toss lightly.
Divide mixture into 4 patties.
Handle gently, it should barely hold together.
Heat skillet and add oil.
When hot, add patties carefully and saute gently over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes on each side.

recipes.title: Potato Candy
steps: Boil 1 small potato and mash it.
Add confectioners sugar till cookie dough consistency.
On wax paper - sprinkle confectioners sugar and roll dough to about a pie crust thickness. Spread peanut butter (thin layer) on the dough.
The sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
Roll into a log roll.
Let chill approximately 1 hour or overnight in the refrigerator.
When set (hard), slice into bite size pieces.

recipes.title: Cucumbers In Sour Cream
steps: Slice the cucumbers very thin, place in glass bowl and sprinkle with salt.
Let stand 1 hour or longer.
Remove cucumbers from bowl.
Squeeze liquid out of cucumber; combine remaining ingredients and pour over cucumbers.
Mix and serve.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Shoe Peg Corn Salad
steps: Combine first 5 ingredients; mix well.
Combine remaining ingredients in saucepan.
Bring to boil.
Pour over corn mixture. Mix well.
Refrigerate overnight.
Drain before serving.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can Campbell's cream of mushroom soup
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can Campbell's cream of celery soup
steps: In large bowl, combine onions and two cans of soup.
In a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan (glass works best) add 4 cups of potatoes and season with salt and pepper.
Add 1/2 of the soup mixture, top with remaining potatoes, then add balance of soup mixture.
Cover pan with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for one hour (consistency will be soupy).
Uncover and bake 30 to 45 minutes longer.
Let stand about 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Company Cream Cheese Pie
steps: Cream together the cream cheese and powdered sugar and add Cool Whip; pour into crust.
Refrigerate.
Top with fruit (optional).

recipes.title: Lime Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 c. lemon or lime juice (3 limes)
steps: Marinade:
Mix lemon juice, oil, honey, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Butterfinger Cake
ingredients: 14 oz. can sweetened Eagle Brand milk
18 oz. jar caramel ice cream topping
steps: Bake cake as directed in 13 x 9 pan. Let cool. Poke holes in cake with wooden spoon handle. Mix topping and milk in bowl and cover cake. Pour 1/2 of crushed candy bars over cake. Top with Cool Whip, then with the rest of the candy bar.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni according to package and mix all ingredients. Salt and pepper to taste.
Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Cucumber Relish
steps: Grind cucumbers.
Chop onions and peppers.
Mix together with salt.
Let stand 3 hours.
Bring to boil, remaining ingredients. Add drained cucumbers and bring to simmer.
Put in hot jars and seal.

recipes.title: Marinated Crabmeat
steps: Combine all and marinate several hours or overnight.
Serve on lettuce leaf.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
steps: Saute onions, celery and green pepper (I omit these ingredients).
Combine all ingredients until well mixed.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Place in casserole dish.

recipes.title: Frozen Lemon Pie
ingredients: 1 c. whipped cream or Cool Whip
steps: Mix flakes with butter; press 1 cup of mix in bottom of pie pan.

recipes.title: Mignonne'S Spinach Bread
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen spinach, thawed and chopped
1 (10 oz.) French rolls or twin loaves French bread
steps: Drain spinach and squeeze dry with paper towel; set aside. Cut rolls in half lengthwise; spread with 1/4 cup softened margarine.
Saute onion in 1/4 cup melted margarine.
Add cheese roll, stirring until cheese melts.
Remove from heat; add spinach, Worcestershire sauce and pepper, stirring well.
Spread spinach mixture on bread, sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350° for 8 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve immediately. Yields 12 servings.

recipes.title: Gingerich Special
steps: Cook potatoes in water, when partly done add macaroni and wieners.
Cook until almost done.
Add milk and cheese.
If too dry add more milk.
Simple and delicious.

recipes.title: Chicken Breast Casserole
steps: Layer in order given.
Bake 1 1/2 hours in 325°
oven.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
steps: Use very ripe bananas for best results, about 2 medium.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 1 can tomato soup with water (or spaghetti sauce)
steps: Boil zucchini for 3 minutes.
Drain.
Melt margarine in skillet.
Add hamburger and onions.
Cook slowly.
Add peppers and garlic.
Simmer.
Add
spaghetti sauce, oregano and salt. Put drained zucchini in casserole.
Pour sauce over.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Bird Seed(Edible)
steps: Mix all ingredients together and eat.

recipes.title: The All American Dessert
steps: Stir 2 cups boiling water into each flavor of Jell-O until dissolved.
Stir 1 cup cold water into each.
Pour into separate 13 x 9-inch pans.
Chill until firm.
Cut into 1/2-inch cubes.
Layer Jell-O, Cool Whip, cake and strawberries in a 3-quart serving dish.

recipes.title: Best Ever Rum Cake
steps: Too many husbands are spoiled by improper cooking.
Some are kept in hot water too long.
Others are frozen, some are always in a stew and some constantly in a pickle.
Naturally, they'll never be good and tender managed this way.

recipes.title: Breakfast Before
ingredients: 1 lb. mild or spicy pork sausage
steps: Saute sausages and drain.
Beat eggs with milk and mustard. Layer the bread cubes, sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
Pour egg mixture on top.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Crescent Chicken
steps: Soften cream cheese and blend with margarine until smooth. Mix with other ingredients, (except rolls) until mushy.
Separate rolls into 4 rectangles.
Seal perforations.
Spoon 1/4 mixture into middle of rectangles.
Pull 4 corners of dough to center; seal.
Brush top with fresh Parmesan cheese (optional).
Bake on ungreased pan 20-25 minutes.
Use temperature on back of Crescent Roll can.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
steps: Thaw and smash Tater Tots.
Add 3/4 of the sour cream and whole can of cream of chicken soup.
Add in cheese.
Mix all together and put into casserole dish.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Lima Bean Casserole
steps: Cook beans; drain.
Add celery, onion, green pepper and tomato puree.
Season with salt, pepper and melted butter.
Turn into well buttered casserole.
Sprinkle buttered crumbs on top.
Bake in 350° oven until vegetables are tender and brown.

recipes.title: Cranberry Delight Salad
steps: Melt Jell-O in hot water.
Then add crushed pineapple and cranberry sauce.
Stir until mixture is evenly distributed. Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Frozen Slaw
ingredients: 1 medium head cabbage, cut very fine in a food processor, Salad Master, etc.
steps: Sprinkle salt over cabbage and let stand for 1 hour.
Place cabbage in clean cheesecloth and squeeze out all of the water. Add to cabbage the grated carrot and grated green pepper.
Boil white vinegar, mustard seed, sugar and celery seed for 1 minute; pour over cabbage and let cool.
Fill plastic cartons such as oleo comes in; cover and freeze.
To serve, remove from freezer 1 hour before serving.
Stir and serve.

recipes.title: Chili Beans
ingredients: 2 (16 oz.) cans tomatoes or 4 c. raw tomatoes
steps: In Dutch oven, cook beef, onions, green pepper and celery until meat is brown and vegetables are tender.
Drain kidney beans.
Add beans and remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen spinach, defrosted and drained
steps: Mix cream cheese with melted butter and spinach.
Top with cracker crumbs.
Put in casserole; cover and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Ground Venison Jerky
steps: Mix well.
Roll mixture between 2 sheets of wax paper with rolling pin to 1/4-inch thick.
Cut in strips about 1 1/2-inch wide.
Put in dehydrater for 12 to 15 hours or oven at 150° on rack for 10 to 11 hours.
Store in paper bag or tin coffee can.

recipes.title: Mezetti
steps: Place crumbled beef, green pepper and onion in water-soaked clay pot.
Cover with water-soaked lid.
Microwave on High for 6 minutes.
Drain fat.
Add chili powder and garlic salt.
Spread noodles over meat.
Mix soups and water together and pour over noodles.
Cover with water-soaked lid.
Microwave on High for 10 minutes, then on simmer for 18 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese on top. Cover and let stand 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
steps: Preheat oven to 350°.
In casserole dish, stir in noodles, tuna, sour cream, milk, salt and pepper.
Mix well.
Mix bread crumbs, cheese and butter.
Sprinkle over casserole.
Bake, uncovered, 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Individual Cream Cheese Cakes
steps: Cream together cream cheese and sugar.
Add eggs, nutmeg and vanilla.
Place vanilla wafer in bottom of paper muffin cup.
Fill 2/3 full and bake at 325° for 20 minutes.
Top each one with cherry pie filling.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Combine beans and soup; stir in 1/2 can onion rings.
Pour into lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 350°.
Top with remaining onion rings and bake 5 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Chili Beans
ingredients: 2 lbs. ground chuck, browned and drained
steps: Saute the green pepper, garlic, and chopped onions and add to the browned ground chuck.
Add all other ingredients and simmer for 1-2 hours, stirring often.

recipes.title: Judy'S Dressin'
ingredients: 1 can each: cream of mushroom, cream of chicken, cream of celery and cream of onion
pepper, salt, Season-All and poultry seasoning to taste (I usually add a lot)
steps: Debone boiled chicken or hen.
Mix cornbread with chicken broth.
Leave it pretty moist (not dry).
Add canned soup, chopped celery, bell pepper, green onion and regular onion.
Add eggs and spices and deboned chicken.
Bake slow couple of hours until brown on top.

recipes.title: Sherrill'S Divinity
steps: In a saucepan, combine sugar, salt, corn syrup and water.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until sugar dissolves.
Bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, beat egg whites until stiff but not dry.
When syrup mixture reaches 230° on candy thermometer, pour slowly over egg whites, beating constantly until the mixture begins to lose its gloss and holds its shape.
Add vanilla and working quickly, drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.
Top immediately with a pecan half. Yields 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Baked Apples
steps: Wash and core apples. Starting at stem end, peel 1/3 of the way down. Arrange in shallow baking dish. Mix sugar and cinnamon. Add water to the dish and broil for 5 minutes. Baste frequently with pan syrup.

recipes.title: Italian Coleslaw
steps: Place cabbage in bowl in layers, alternating with onion.
Top with sugar.
Boil the remaining ingredients.
Pour over cabbage while hot.
Cover; let stand 4 to 6 hours in refrigerator.
Then mix and serve.
Even better after 2 or 3 days and will keep 2 or 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
steps: Place strawberries in pie crust.
Cook sugar, cornstarch and water until thick.
Add Jell-O.
Cool glaze and pour over strawberries.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hash
steps: Mix cream cheese with pineapple juice.
Whip thin; add pineapple, nuts and cherries.
Fold in Cool Whip and marshmallows. Cool in refrigerator at least 24 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Slumgullion
ingredients: 1 box or 1/4 bag large macaroni noodles, cooked
steps: Cook noodles and set aside.
Put onions into skillet to cook. Add meat.
Cook on high.
Add lots of chili powder, salt slightly.
Stir in noodles with water.
Add tomato sauce and a little more water.
Let simmer 20 minutes.
Stir just enough to keep from sticking.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
steps: Mix all ingredients together in a large mixing bowl.
Stir well.
Place in the refrigerator for about an hour and serve.

recipes.title: California Vegetables
ingredients: 1 large pkg. mixed vegetables (carrots, cauliflower and broccoli), cooked and drained
steps: Mix and bake for 45 minutes at 375°.
Top with canned onion rings the last 10 minutes.
Easy on celery soup and don't overcook vegetables.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
steps: Place foil in center of baking pan. Spread butter on foil. Cut steak into serving size portions. Arrange on foil. Sprinkle with onion soup mix, mushrooms, & green pepper.

recipes.title: Oven-Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 c. melted butter or margarine or vegetable oil
steps: Wash and pare potatoes; cut each into 4 thick slices.
Dip slices in butter and arrange in shallow baking pan.
Cover pan with foil.
Bake at 425° for 10 minutes.
Remove foil; continue to bake about 30 minutes or until delicately brown, turning once. Sprinkle with salt.
Yield:
6 servings.

recipes.title: Cucumbers In Sour Cream
ingredients: 3 medium cucumbers, pared and thinly sliced
steps: Layer cucumber slices and salt in medium bowl.
Chill about 1 hour.
Drain; squeeze dry.
Blend the sour cream, vinegar and sugar; fold into cucumbers.
Serve with black pepper.

recipes.title: Doo Doo Drops
steps: Combine sugar, margarine and milk.
Stir until melted on low heat.
Add cocoa, peanut butter and vanilla.
Mix well.
Add oats; mix well.
Spoon into cupcake tins.
Let stand until hardened.
Makes approximately 3 dozen.
One is never enough!

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
steps: Mix ingredients well, adding peanut butter last and beating until smooth.
Pour into unbaked shell and bake 45 minutes in slow oven.
Increase heat after 30 minutes.
Bake until firm.

recipes.title: English Pea Salad
steps: Drain peas and add remaining ingredients. Add enough mayonnaise to make it creamy. Refrigerate until chilled.

recipes.title: Crab Pasta Quicky
ingredients: 1 pkg. Lipton creamy garlic pasta and sauce
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions.
After pasta is tender, add drained crab meat and stir.
Let stand 3 minutes. Serve with tossed salad for complete, fast meal.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
steps: Blend well and stir constantly over burner until thermometer reaches 310° or hard crack mark on candy thermometer.
Remove from burner, stirring constantly, and add one heaping teaspoon baking soda and 2 tsp. vanilla.
Stir briskly until thoroughly blended. Pour mixture on to a buttered cookie sheet or buttered foil. Allow to cool until tacky to touch.
Dump and stretch with hands. Allow to cool completely, then crack with back of big spoon.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Franks
steps: Cook brown sugar, cornstarch, salt, vinegar, soy sauce, ginger and syrup from pineapple until thick.
Pour over the pepper strips and onion rings.
Bring hot dogs to a boil.
Drain and add to thickened syrup, etc.
Heat thoroughly.

recipes.title: Apple Ambrosia
ingredients: 1 lb. can pineapple tidbits and juice
steps: Shred apples.
Using a large bowl, put juices in first.
Add apples and bananas to juice to keep from turning brown.
Add other ingredients and chill before serving.
Delicious and refreshing!

recipes.title: Lemonade Pie
ingredients: 2 graham cracker or chocolate pie shells
steps: Combine thawed (slushie) lemonade, Cool Whip and milk.
Pour into pie shells.
Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours and serve.

recipes.title: Cheesy Meat Loaf
steps: Mix beef lightly with 3/4 cup cheese, egg, crumbs, onion and seasonings until well blended.
Shape into loaf in a shallow pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Pour off drippings.
Pour tomato sauce over loaf.
Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup cheese.
Bake 30 minutes longer.

recipes.title: "Millie'S" Chicken Enchilada
ingredients: 5 chicken breasts or turkey, cut up
1 c. pitted, ripe olives, drained (or omit)
4 oz. can chopped Ortega green chilies
steps: Poach or bake chicken or turkey and cut up.
Mix all ingredients together, reserving a handful of cheese for top.
Put in a 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with reserved cheese; cover. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: sprinkling of: basil, nutmeg, salt, pepper and dried onion flakes
steps: Mix together and top with dry bread crumbs.
Bake at moderate oven heat until done, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: My Easiest And Best Pineapple Frosting
ingredients: 1 large can Dole sweetened, crushed pineapple in heavy syrup
steps: Mix it all together and cook 20 minutes on low until thick enough to spread.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: Mix all ingredients together well.
Press into casserole loaf pan.
Brush 2 tablespoons catsup over top of meatloaf.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Peach Pie
ingredients: 1/2 box yellow or white cake mix
steps: Preheat oven to 350°. Rub butter on bottom and sides of a 2-quart casserole dish. Place sliced peaches in dish (save the juice). Mix juice from peaches, vanilla and 1/2 box of cake mix together. Stir real well. Pour over peaches. Dot remaining butter on top of mixture. Place dish in preheated oven and cook 25 to 30 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream of Cool Whip, if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
steps: Cook chicken; save broth to cook noodles.
Mix all ingredients together.
Mixture may need a little of the chicken broth added if it appears too thick.
Save enough cheese to sprinkle on top.
Put in casserole dish and bake at 350° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip 2
steps: Mix and serve with vegetables or crackers.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight
steps: Mix Dream Whip.
Add cream cheese and powdered sugar.
Mix well.
Thicken strawberries with cornstarch; cool.
Pour strawberries over graham crackers.
Pour Dream Whip mixture over strawberries.

recipes.title: Barbecue
steps: Cook roast slowly in small amount of water until very tender. Remove from heat.
When slightly cool, remove bone and fat.
Cut into small pieces.
Return to heat.
Add other ingredients; cook until meat is stringy, stirring often.
Delicious served on toasted hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Hot Perked Punch
steps: Put spices in basket of percolator and perk juices in bottom.

recipes.title: Linguini And Spinach
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. linguini, cooked and drained
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, thawed and drained
steps: In a large skillet, heat oil.
Cook spinach and garlic 5 minutes, stirring. Dissolve bouillon in water. Add to spinach along with basil and Feta. Stir until blended. Toss with linguini and grated cheese.

recipes.title: Stuffed Tomatoes(Serves 6)
ingredients: 1 c. spinach or tomato pasta (shells, rotelli, bow ties or elbow)
steps: Cook pasta until done but firm.
Rinse and pour into bowl. Stir in eggs, celery, scallions and enough yogurt or mayo to make a creamy mixture. Season to taste with salt.

recipes.title: Brandi'S Bonbons
steps: Cream first five ingredients together.
Blend in coconut. Refrigerate.
Melt chocolate chips and wax in top of double boiler. Roll fondant into balls.
With toothpicks, dip into chocolate and put on foil or wax paper to dry.
Keeps best in fridge.

recipes.title: Beef Noodle Bake
ingredients: 8 oz. medium egg noodles, cooked and drained
steps: In a skillet over medium heat, cook beef until no longer pink; drain.
Add tomato sauce, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, and pepper and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine the cottage cheese, sour cream and chives; fold in noodles.
In a greased 3-quart baking dish, layer half of the noodle mixture and meat mixture.
Repeat layers. Cover and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Uncover; sprinkle with cheese.
Bake 5 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Vegetables
ingredients: 1 small eggplant (1 lb.), cut into pieces
steps: Put eggplant in a 2-quart microwave-safe dish.
Cover and microwave 6 minutes on High.
Put oil, onions and peppers in same dish.
Stir to mix; cover and microwave on High 4 or 5 minutes. Stir in eggplant and remaining ingredients, except Feta Cheese. Cover and microwave on High 6 to 8 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over top.
Cover and let stand 5 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Dilly Beans
ingredients: 1 gal. fresh green beans, whole tipped
steps: Scald pint jars and pack beans in jars vertically.
Put 1 head dill, 1 red pepper and 1 clove garlic in each jar.
Bring vinegar, water and salt to a boil.
Pour over beans to 1/2-inch in top of jar.
Adjust lids and process in water bath 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Pinkie'S Cheese Ball
ingredients: sprinkle of garlic or garlic salt or any other herb you want
steps: Roll in ball or mound up in glob.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Cream margarine, sugar and salt.
Add eggs, Karo and pecans. Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Chinese Chicken Casserole
steps: Combine all ingredients, except noodles.
Put noodles in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with chicken mixture.
Bake for 40 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Oven Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs. red potatoes, washed and quartered
steps: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. In a large Ziploc bag, mix all ingredients together and shake well, making sure potatoes are coated.
Empty potatoes in a large pan.
Bake for about 40 minutes or until potatoes are done, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Venison Stroganoff
steps: Mix together.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
Add water as needed.
Pour over noodles.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Scalloped Ham And Potatoes
steps: Enough potatoes to fill any size baking dish you want to use. Alternate layers of potatoes and ham.
Cover with medium white sauce.
Bake at 375° for 40 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
steps: Cook vegetables according to directions.
Saute in butter, celery and onion.
Add cheese and mayonnaise.
Mix well.
Pour into buttered casserole.
Cover with cracker crumbs.
Drizzle with oleo.
Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Sherbet Party Punch
steps: Heat 2 cups water to boiling; add jello and sugar until dissolved.
Add 2 cups cold water and fruit juices.
Chill until ready to serve.
Spoon sherbet into punch bowl.
Pour over ginger ale.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Campbell's cream of mushroom soup
steps: Cook on stove the green beans until juice is cooked down.
Add cream of mushroom soup and drained mushrooms.
Remove from heat and stir.
Pour in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Add French fried onions on top.
Bake at 325° until onions are golden brown.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Wash cucumbers; peel onions and cut 1/4-inch thick.
Put in layers.
Sprinkle salt on each layer. Let stand for 2 to 3 hours. Drain.
Combine remaining ingredients and heat to boiling.
Add cucumbers and onions; simmer for 10 minutes.
Pack in hot jars and seal.
Makes 4 pints.

recipes.title: Creamy Apricot Salad
steps: On stove, dissolve pineapple and jello.
Add cold water. Cream sugar, cheese and apricots.
Blend into jello.
Cool.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into bowl or mold and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Tofu Pumpkin Pudding
steps: In blender, put tofu, egg whites, cornstarch, molasses and spice.
Blend until smooth.
In bowl, put sugar and pumpkin.
Mix well.
Pour ingredients from blender into bowl.
Mix all together.

recipes.title: Ham Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. finely chopped fully cooked ham
steps: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly.
Shape mixture into 1-inch balls.
Place about 2 inches apart on lightly greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1/2-inch cookie sheet pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.
Immediately remove from pan and serve warm as appetizers.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
steps: Melt 1/2 stick butter and place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish or pan.
Add 1 cup corn flakes and stir; layer cabbage, then cheese, combine 1/2 stick butter, mayonnaise, soup and milk.
Pour over cheese, top with remaining cup of flakes.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Popeye Soup
steps: Fry garlic in olive oil; add spinach, stirring to separate and unthaw.
Add onion and green pepper; fry slightly.
Add black-eyed peas (juice too), corn, crushed tomatoes, salt and pepper; cook, stirring often, about 30 minutes.
Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Hocus Pecos Dip
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped green onions (green tops included)
1 (2 oz.) jar dried beef, rinsed, dried and chopped
steps: Combine all ingredients; mix until all ingredients are incorporated. Chill for at least 2 hours before serving to allow flavors to blend. Serve with tortilla chips and/or fresh vegetables.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup (no water)
1 can cream of mushroom soup (no water)
2 Tbsp. grated onion (or more if desired)
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Praline Cookies(Pecan Crisps)
steps: Pam a jelly-roll type cookie sheet and line with graham crackers.
Break each cracker in half so there are sections of two.
Melt butter and margarine together.
Add sugar.
Bring to a boil and boil 3 minutes.
Add nuts and vanilla.
Pour over crackers. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cut into individual crackers while hot.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Balls (Uncooked)
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Roll into 1-inch balls.
Try rolling into dry cereal, wheat germ or coconut.
Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Greek Style
ingredients: 4 small onions, sliced and separated into rings
steps: Remove outer leaves and stalks from cauliflower.
Trim off any blemishes on head.
Separate head into flowerets.
Wash cauliflower well; drain.
Heat oil in large skillet over low heat. Add onions, carrots and garlic; cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add wine, water, lemon juice, tomato paste, bay leaves, coriander seed, salt and pepper; bring to boiling.
Add cauliflower; simmer for 15 minutes, or until cauliflower is just tender.
Transfer cauliflower to serving dish with slotted spoon. Heat liquid until the volume is reduced to about 1 1/2 cups; remove bay leaves.
Pour over cauliflower in serving dish.
Chill several hours.

recipes.title: Microwave Chops
steps: Trim fat off chops.
In oval or round dish, combine oil and garlic; spread evenly.
Microwave on High for 1 minute.
Combine broth, soy sauce, sugar and pepper in bowl.
Add chops to dish, turning over in garlic oil.
Pour sauce mixture over chops and cover with wax paper.
Microwave on High for 4 minutes, turning chops and dish once after 2 minutes.
Keep covered.
Microwave on Medium power 12 to 15 minutes or until meat is tender and no pink remains.
Place chops in serving dish.
Dissolve cornstarch in water.
Stir into pan juices.
Microwave on High for 1 to 2 minutes until thickened.
Leave uncovered and stir once.
Pour sauce over chops.
Serves 4.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Delight Salad
steps: Soften cream cheese and add dry jello.
Add marshmallows to 2 cups hot water, then add jello mixture.
Add pineapple and nuts. Chill until thickened.
Stir in Cool Whip and chill.
(Use as dessert or salad on lettuce.)

recipes.title: Cranberry Chicken
ingredients: 6 to 8 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
1 (16 oz.) can whole berry cranberry sauce
steps: Cut chicken into serving size pieces.
Place in single layer in 9 x 13-inch pan which has been sprayed with Pam.
In a medium bowl, combine cranberries, Catalina dressing and soup mix.
Pour over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
steps: Boil chicken about 1/2 hour.
Slice chicken into bite size pieces.
Layer greased baking dish with cooked broccoli.
Cover with chicken.
Combine soup, mayonnaise, curry and lemon juice. Cover chicken with this mixture.
Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top. Combine bread crumbs and butter.
Sprinkle over all.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Recipe may be doubled.

recipes.title: Hamburger-Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of asparagus or mushroom soup, dilute with 1/4 can of water
steps: Brown chuck and onions.
Place in casserole; cover with vegetables and soup.
Place a layer of Tater Tots on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Holiday Cider
steps: Slice orange into 6 wedges; stud with cloves and set aside. Combine cider with red hots in a large pot over medium heat.
Cook until red hots are dissolved and mixture is heated.
Pour into serving container.
Add orange wedges and cinnamon sticks.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. thin spaghetti, cooked and drained
4 c. cooked chicken breasts, cut in small pieces
1/2 c. chopped onion or 2 Tbsp. dried onion
steps: Mix all ingredients except spaghetti which is added last. Pour into buttered 9 x 12-inch baking dish.
Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Remove foil; top with 1/2 cup cheese and buttered bread crumbs.
Bake 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Cabbage Salad
steps: Shred or chop cabbage; core apples but do not peel.
Dice apples; add pineapple.
Mix salad dressing, vinegar and some sweetener (to taste).
Add this to other ingredients just before serving.
This tends to get watery if it stands too long.
Toss lightly and put in serving bowls. Yield:
4 cups.
Carbohydrate 8 g, protein 1 g, fat 3 g, calories 63.
One serving = 1 vegetable exchange, 1/2 fat exchange.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken
steps: Dip chicken in oleo, dip and coat with mixture of remaining ingredients. Bake on greased (Pam) medium pan or foil-lined pan. Bake at 400 degrees about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Waldorf Salad
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. cooked breasts, cut into cubes
steps: Mix all the ingredients well in a small bowl.
Combine Miracle Whip, honey and lemon juice.
Refrigerate all until serving time. In a large bowl, toss dressing over chicken-apples-celery-pecans. Place on lettuce leaves.
Serve with hot, crusty French bread.

recipes.title: Marinated Carrots
steps: Mix the last 6 ingredients together.
Cook carrots until fork-tender; cool.
Slice onion and bell pepper.
Put carrots in container, along with bell pepper and onion slices.
Pour marinade over vegetables and let marinate overnight.

recipes.title: Chili
steps: Brown and drain ground beef in Dutch oven.
Saute chopped onion in 1 teaspoon oil.
Combine seasonings, tomato sauce, water and chili beans (undrained).
Cover and simmer 1 hour.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
ingredients: 3 pkg. Hungry Jack biscuits, cut in 1/4's
steps: Grease Bundt pan.
Mix sugar and cinnamon together.
Roll biscuits in sugar mixture and layer in pan.
After all biscuits are layered, take leftover sugar mixture and pour back into cup.
Add enough brown sugar to make a full cup of sugar.
Take 1/2 cup margarine and sugar and cook until smooth.
Pour over biscuits and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 4 c. zucchini squash, cooked and drained
steps: Toss squash, soup, salt and crackers until blended.
Pour into buttered baking dish; dot with butter.
Extra crumbs may be added on top.
Bake in moderate oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Ham And Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1/2 c. French-style green beans, precooked and drained
steps: Cook egg noodles according to directions, set aside.
In 1 1/2-quart microproof casserole, combine ham, onions, tarragon and butter.
Cook, covered, on High (max power) 3 minutes.
Add chicken soup, egg noodles, green beans and water.
Stir.
Cook, covered, on High (maximum power) 5 minutes or until hot, stirring once during cooking time.
Top with bread crumbs.
Let stand, covered, 2 to 3 minutes before serving.
Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Bananas Foster
steps: Melt butter, stir in sugar, add fruit.
Cook, stir over medium heat about 2 minutes, sprinkle with cinnamon, stir in creme de cacao.
In small pan, heat rum, pour over fruit and ignite.

recipes.title: Pizza Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger; cook with onions and green pepper.
Cook noodles.
Mix ingredients except cheese.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan; top with cheeses.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
steps: Mix everything together except the pecans until the mixture is well blended.
Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
steps: Combine butter and brown sugar in saucepan and melt it.
Cut biscuits in 1/4 pieces.
Mix sugar and cinnamon in bowl.
Drop biscuits in cinnamon and sugar.
Shake and cover.
Drop biscuits into angel food pan.
Pour melted butter and brown sugar over biscuits.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Kielbasa And Pineapple
steps: Cut kielbasa into chunk pieces. Add brown sugar and pineapple. Heat in crock-pot on medium heat for about 3 hours. Serve with toothpicks.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Pie
steps: Prepare pastry for 9-inch pastry shell. Reserve 6 tablespoons sugar for the meringue.
Combine remaining sugar, cornstarch and salt in the top of a double boiler.
Stir in water. Cook over boiling water until thickened, stirring constantly.
Cover and cook 15 minutes. Stir a little of the hot mixture into the slightly beaten egg yolks.
Add to remaining hot mixture in top of double boiler and cook for 2 minutes over hot water.
Stir constantly. Add butter. Cool. Add 1 lemon rind and juice.
Pour into baked shell. Cover with meringue made from egg whites (room temperature) and reserved sugar.
Bake in a moderate oven at 325° for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
steps: Combine all ingredients, except butter.
Put in 2-quart casserole.
Pour melted butter over top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
(Can be prepared a day in advance.)

recipes.title: Fruit Punch
steps: Mix together and add enough water to make 2 1/2 gallons.
Put in freezer 24 hours before serving time.
Keep stirred so it will be slushy when ready to serve.
Add one or two bottles of ginger ale at serving time for the desired consistency.

recipes.title: Beet Jelly
steps: Mix lemon juice, Sure-Jell and beet juice; cook to hard boil. Add sugar and Jell-O.
Boil 2 minutes or until jells.
Cool.
Put into jars.
Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
ingredients: salt and pepper to your taste
steps: Combine, cook and stir over medium heat until thick.
Cool and add to potato salad.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole Gourmet
steps: Saute zucchini and eggplant in oil.
Add ground beef and brown.
Drain.
Stir in next 8 ingredients and heat thoroughly. Turn into greased baking dish and top with tomato sauce and cheese.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. chicken, cut up and skin removed
steps: Brown chicken in oil for 10 minutes, turning occasionally. Drain.
Add all ingredients, except pasta.
Cover and simmer 25 minutes or until chicken is done.
Serve hot over hot pasta. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak
steps: Combine meat, celery, bread crumbs, garlic, egg, salt and water. Shape into oval patties 1-inch thick. Brown in butter on both sides in a skillet.
Mix the soup with 1 can of water.
Pour over the patties and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Taco Party Dip
steps: Beat taco mix, cream cheese and sour cream on high until smooth.
Spread on platter 1/2-inch thick.
Cover with lettuce and tomatoes, then cheese.
Serve with chips.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Pistachio Munchies
steps: Mix together the butter and onion soup mix in a large glass measuring cups.
Microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes.
Stir in the pistachios.
Place in resealable plastic bags for traveling.

recipes.title: Roquefort Cream Dressing(Aunt Mary'S Recipe)
ingredients: 1/3 c. scallions or combination Bermuda onion and chives
1/2 lb. Roquefort or Blue cheese, crumbled
steps: Cut out root ends and chop finely, tops and all, to make scallions.
Combine mayonnaise, garlic and chopped parsley.
Add to mixture the anchovy paste.
Combine and add sour cream and vinegar. Add lemon juice to thin mixture.
Add Roquefort or Blue cheese, crumbled.
Season with pepper (no salt; anchovy paste is salty). Chill.
Will keep for 1 month.
Use as salad dressing or on crackers or tomato aspic.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
steps: Brown hamburger and chopped onion; drain well.
Add chicken soup, milk, taco sauce and enchilada sauce.
Layer with flour tortillas and grated cheese.

recipes.title: Chocolate Icing
steps: Mix all ingredients.
Boil real good.
Cook 5 minutes or longer.
Remove from heat and beat well.
Makes real good icing.

recipes.title: Marissa'S Ambrosia Supreme
steps: Mix together the marshmallows, pineapple chunks, shredded coconut and mandarin oranges.
Slowly stir in sour cream until well blended.
Walnuts may be added, if desired.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, cooked (salt while cooking), deboned and chopped
steps: Layer chicken in buttered baking dish.
Mix sour cream and soup together; spread over chicken.
Mix oleo and cracker crumbs; spread over soup mixture.
Sprinkle with poppy seed.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: French-Cut Green Bean Casserole
steps: Combine beans, soup and milk.
Pour into greased casserole dish.
Put onions on top.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookie Delight
steps: Mix butter and cookies together and press into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix Cool Whip and cream cheese together well and pour evenly over cookie crumb mixture.
Refrigerate 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
steps: Boil chicken until done.
Set aside to cool.
Boil spaghetti in chicken broth.
Saute celery, onion and pepper in butter until tender.
Mix cream of mushroom soup, tomatoes, cheese and spaghetti.
Add chicken.
Pour into baking dish.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Torte
steps: Mix the first 7 ingredients in blender.
When well blended, add the balance of ingredients.
Place mixture in oiled 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Don't overbake or it will get dry.
Tastes better cold the next day.

recipes.title: Oven Omelet
steps: Heat oven to 325° in oven.
Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Tilt and coat bottom of dish.

recipes.title: Sugar Popcorn
steps: Cook sugar and water until it spins a thread.
Add vanilla and food coloring.
Stir through popcorn.

recipes.title: Cucumber Cottage Cheese Mold
steps: Peel and quarter cucumbers and remove seeds.
Grate cucumbers and strain, reserving juice and shreds.
Soften gelatin in cucumber juice and dissolve it over hot water.
Season with a little salt, onion salt, paprika and white pepper to taste.
Stir in grated cucumbers and let it get cold, but not set.
Fold in cottage cheese and mix well.
Wet mold in cold water.
Turn in mixture.
Chill 2 to 3 hours, until firm.
Unmold on cold platter.
Serve very cold with mayonnaise.

recipes.title: 20 Minute Apple Butter
steps: Cook until it comes to a boil; stir constantly.
Boil for 20 minutes and seal in jars.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Layer green beans on bottom of casserole dish.
Combine sour cream and soup; put mixture on top of green beans.
Add cheese and crushed Ritz crackers to small amount of melted margarine to soften crackers.
Place on top of casserole.
Bake in 350° oven until cheese is bubbly.

recipes.title: Copper Pennies(Carrot Salad)
ingredients: 2 lb. fresh carrots, sliced in 1/4 round (4 1/2 c.)
2 medium onions, thinly sliced and separated in rings
1 medium green pepper, cut in thin strips
steps: Cook carrots in small amount of boiling water until tender (about 8 to 10 minutes).
Drain, combine carrots, onion and peppers in large bowl.
Pour other ingredients over vegetables. Cover and marinate in refrigerator several hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Lime Congealed Salad
steps: Melt marshmallows and cream cheese in 2 cups of hot water. Add to gelatin, dissolved in 1 1/2 cups of hot water.
Add pineapple (drained well) and nuts.
Refrigerate.
(You may also use strawberry gelatin!!)

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
steps: Cook macaroni per package directions; drain and cool.
In a large bowl, mix together cool macaroni, celery, onion, pimiento, chicken chunks, pickle relish, and American cheese cubes.
Stir together the mayonnaise and cream and pour over the chicken mixture; mix well.
Place shredded lettuce on plates and top with chicken mixture.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Salami
steps: Mix well.
Shape into 2 rolls and wrap in foil and refrigerate 24 hours. Remove from aluminum foil.
Place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Prick with fork while baking.

recipes.title: Easy Salad
ingredients: 1 family size pkg. orange jello, used dry
steps: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.
Very good.
Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cheese Parfait
ingredients: 1 3/4 c. Cool Whip topping, thawed (4 oz.)
1 (10 oz.) pkg. strawberries halved in syrup
steps: Beat milk and sugar into cream cheese until smooth.
Mix in topping; layer with strawberries in 6 parfait glasses.
Chill.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Pretzels
steps: Melt chocolate according to package instructions in a large bowl.
Drop pretzels into melted chocolate (about 2 handfuls at a time) and stir until pretzels are fully covered.
Place on wax paper or aluminum foil and allow to set.
Drop another 2 handfuls and do the same as above.
Continue until you've used all of the chocolate.

recipes.title: Candy Cookies
steps: Boil for 2 minutes in a large pan the granulated sugar, cocoa powder, margarine and milk; stir as it cooks.
Remove from heat and mix in peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal. Spoon out on wax paper. One or two spoonfuls makes a cookie. Let cool before you remove cookies from wax paper.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Bake
steps: In a mixing bowl, beat sweet potatoes, sugar, milk, butter, eggs, salt and vanilla until smooth.
Transfer to a greased 2 qt. baking dish.

recipes.title: Spanish Pork Chops
ingredients: Few slivers hot pepper or dash of Tabasco
steps: Brown chops. Place in large casserole. Top with remaining ingredients. Cover and bake at 350° from 1-2 hours or until tender. Serves 4-6.

recipes.title: Macaroni Casserole
steps: Cook elbow macaroni and drain.
Set aside.
Mix in large bowl the green pepper, onion and pimentos.
Set aside.
Mix (in food processor or mixer) the soup, milk and mayonnaise.
Add to green pepper mixture.
Add macaroni.
Add 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese to mixture; stir together.
Put in 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Fluff
steps: Spray casserole dish. Make potatoes and set aside. In 1 1/2 teaspoons oil, saute mushrooms, onion and garlic for 5 minutes. Put vegetables into bowl. Wipe skillet and heat remaining oil 4 minutes. Add turkey, soup, peas, broth and pepper. Mix well. Add mushrooms and onion. Put into casserole and spread potatoes on top, sealing edges. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Mac & Cheese
steps: Melt butter in 9 inch x 13 inch dish. Add uncooked macaroni, salt, pepper and cheese.
Mix well.
Pour milk over mixture, do not stir after adding milk.
Refrigerate overnight, or bake it right away.
Bake at 350 degrees for one hour or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
steps: Combine all ingredients in blender.
Process until smooth. Store in refrigerator.
Makes approximately 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
steps: In large bowl of mixer, pour boiling water over gelatin; stir until gelatin is dissolved.
Add cold water, mayonnaise, lemon juice and salt.
Beat at low speed until blended.
Freeze about 25 minutes or until firm about 1-inch from side of bowl but still soft in center.
Beat at medium speed until fluffy.
Fold in diced apples, walnuts and celery.
Turn into a 1-quart mold or individual molds.
Refrigerate 1 hour or until firm.
Unmold on plate.
Garnish with greens and apple slices.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Fried Mozzarella
steps: Cut cheese into 1/2-inch cubes and dip into the egg.
Roll into the cracker crumbs.
Heat the oil in a skillet and fry the breaded cheese until crisp and brown.
Spear each cube with a toothpick.

recipes.title: Oreo Pie
steps: Soften ice cream with mixer and add Cool Whip, mixing until well blended.
Fold in crushed Oreos.
Pour into oblong pan and freeze.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Bring to a boil. Add cucumbers. Bring to a boil. Seal in sterilized jars. Makes 3 quarts.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
steps: *Don't add to ingredients as this needs to be poured over the meat loaf.

recipes.title: Hot Ham And Cheese Sandwiches
ingredients: small, ready to serve dinner rolls
steps: Slice package of dinner rolls in half.
Spread with Dijon mustard.
Add ham and cheese slices.
Replace top.
Melt together butter, poppy seed, dry mustard, onion flakes and Worcestershire. Pour over rolls.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Cook milk and sugar to soft ball.
Take off stove.
Add peanut butter, marshmallow cream and vanilla; do not beat.
Stir and pour in pan or dish.
Let cool; cut into pieces.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 small pkg. Pepperidge Farms or stuffing mix with sage and onion, divided
4 c. (approx. 3 lb.) cooked and diced chicken breasts
steps: Combine stuffing mix and margarine. Put half of stuffing in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Add chicken on top. In a separate bowl, combine cream of chicken and cream of mushroom soups with broth. Pour soup mixture over chicken and sprinkle with remaining stuffing mix. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cavatini
ingredients: 1 c. each 3 pastas (shells, wheels, macaroni, etc.)
steps: Cook pasta and drain. Cook hamburger, onion and green pepper; drain.
Season with salt and pepper. Add pepperoni and mushrooms. Add Ragu sauce and heat through.
Mix pasta and hamburger sauce together; put in casserole dish. Top with grated cheeses.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
(Should be sloppy, not dry.)

recipes.title: Christmas Punch
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed and undiluted
steps: Combine gelatin and boiling water. Stir until gelatin dissolves.
Add the lemonade concentrate, pineapple-grapefruit juice, water and orange juice concentrate.
Divide mixture in half. Freeze half of the juice mixture. Chill remaining half.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pinwheels
