steps: Boil first 3 ingredients until it reaches 250° on a candy thermometer or use hard ball method.
While this mixture boils, beat the egg whites until stiff.
Add the cream of tartar and beat again.
When the mixture reaches the right temperature, add gradually to the egg whites.
Beat until stiff.
Roll out onto wax paper sprayed with Pam cooking spray.
Spread on peanut butter. Roll up and let set for 30 minutes before slicing.
Use thread or dental floss to slice.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Marshmallows
ingredients: 3 small pkg. or 1 1/2 large pkg. chocolate chips
steps: Melt and mix Eagle Brand milk, chocolate chips and Marshmallow Creme over low heat.
Stir until completely blended.
Use ice tongs to dip marshmallows.
Completely coat and set on waxed paper to cool.
They may be frozen for later use.

recipes.title: Hummus
ingredients: chopped parsley and paprika for garnish
steps: Blend all ingredients together (except the olive oil) in food processor until smooth.
Add oil and mix well.
Garnish with parsley and paprika.
Serve with crackers or cut pieces of pita bread.

recipes.title: Church Glass
steps: Melt together 4 Hershey bars, 12 ounces semi-sweet chocolate and 1 stick butter.
Add cup of nuts and 1/2 bag colored miniature marshmallows.
Roll 1/2 of roll in coconut.
Refrigerate for a few hours, then cut.

recipes.title: Ellie'S Chicken
steps: Skin the chicken pieces; dip in butter or margarine.
Roll in crushed seasoned stuffing mix.
Brown in butter or margarine; put in low baking dish.
Pour chicken broth until an inch high.
Cover with the cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Glazed Fruit Salad
steps: Slice strawberries into large bowl.
Add peaches and pineapple including juice.
Slice bananas and add.
Stir gently to coat bananas.
Drain juice off (will be approximately 1 cup).
Combine juice and pudding mix.
Beat until smooth (wire whip works best). Pour over fruit.
Gently mix.

recipes.title: Crab Salad
ingredients: 2 LB. Crab Meat (may use imitation style)
steps: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate overnight to absorb flavor.

recipes.title: Snow Kisses
steps: Beat egg whites until almost stiff.
Add sugar very slowly, beating until very stiff peaks are formed.
Carefully fold in ground nuts, then chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoon onto slightly greased cookie sheet.
Put into a 350° oven.
Turn heat off at once.
Do not open oven door for at least 4 hours; better still, next morning.
Makes about 40 cookies.

recipes.title: Microwave Caramel Corn
steps: Combine brown sugar, oleo, syrup and salt in 1-quart bowl. Microwave on Full power for 30 seconds; stir and microwave for 1 minute; stir and microwave for 2 1/2 minutes then stir in soda. Put popped corn in large bowl.
Pour sauce over corn and stir until well mixed.
Microwave for 2 minutes and 20 seconds, stirring every 30 seconds.
Cool, stirring occasionally and break apart.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 1 onion, sliced and separated into rings
3 to 4 c. zucchini, peeled and cut up
steps: Brown ground beef; drain and add onion and cut up zucchini. Cook until barely tender.
Add tomato sauce, tomato soup and seasonings.
Mix well.
Immediately pour into casserole dish. Place tomato slices on top of casserole.
Sprinkle grated cheese over tomatoes.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
Sprinkle with French fried onions and return to oven for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Snack Mix
steps: Mix ingredients together.
Makes a good trial mix.

recipes.title: Garlic String Beans
ingredients: 4 c. fresh or frozen green beans
steps: Heat oil.
Saute garlic and beans.
Add thyme, salt and pepper. Add water and vegetable bouillon.
Bring to boil.
Simmer 20 to 30 minutes until beans are tender.
Add dash of lemon and serve. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Quick Cookies
steps: Boil together first 4 ingredients for 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and add 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla, and 2 or 3 cups oatmeal (and peanut butter, if desired).
Stir until oatmeal is covered. Spoon and drop onto waxed paper.
Cool before serving.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 cabbage (2 lb.), shredded and chopped fine
1 large Red Delicious apple, cored and shredded
2 large carrots, shredded and chopped fine
1 1/2 to 2 c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
steps: Shred
the
cabbage
first with a grater and chop fine. Shred the
carrots
and chop fine.
Mix the cabbage, the carrots,
the vinegar,
the
sugar,
the salt and mix.
Core the apple last and add
to
the cabbage mixture.
Finally, add the salad dressing and mix
well.
Add
the
milk gradually and be careful not to make the
slaw
too
watery.
Serves
to 12 people.
With spaghetti, chitterlings, just about anything you like to eat.
This slaw can be served with it.

recipes.title: Crab Spread
steps: Let cream cheese soften at room temperature about 1 hour.
Mix by hand, cream cheese and crab meat.
Dice onion and celery and mix in cream cheese and crab mixture.
Roll this mixture into a big, softball form.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Sprinkle Old Bay all over this ball.
Chill 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Italian Salad
steps: Break vermicelli into small pieces before cooking. Cook until tender in salted water. Drain well. Mix other ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Before serving, cut into small pieces and mix with vermicelli, tomato, onion and green pepper.

recipes.title: Homemade Hominy
steps: Put water and lye in enamel kettle.
Stir, then add corn.
Cook until water is brown and thick.
Remove from heat.
Pour in a drainpan in sink.
Run water over it for several minutes, then put in pan and wash a lot.
Put corn in a big plastic container; cover with water.
Let set all night.
Wash well.
Start cooking and cook until done.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
steps: Mix first three ingredients together in a large bowl.

Line the bottom of large container with graham crackers (layer like you would with a banana pudding), 1st, graham crackers, then pour on Cool Whip mixture, then graham crackers, then the rest of the Cool Whip mixture.

recipes.title: Bloomfield Surprise
steps: Place biscuits on bottom of pan.
Try to cover entire bottom. Bake for a few minutes.
Take out and peel top layer of biscuits off.
Spread layer of beans on bottom layer of biscuits.

recipes.title: Cheese Roll
steps: Cream cheese together until soft and well blended.
Add garlic and nuts.
Divide mixture into 2 portions.
Roll on waxed paper with chili powder.

recipes.title: Cold Cut Ribbons
ingredients: 5 (4 oz.) pkg. any square cold cut or luncheon meat
15 miniature sweet gherkin pickles, sliced in half lengthwise
steps: Prepare spread by combining cream cheese, onion and mustard. Lightly spread cream cheese on slice of meat.
Top with cheese slice, more cream cheese and another slice of meat.
Repeat process until stack includes 3 layers of meat and cheese, with cream cheese in between.
Freeze cold cut stack uncut for approximately 1 hour.
When firm, cut into 1 x 2-inch ribbon strips.
Center a pickle slice on each cold cut ribbon.
Skewer with cellophane tipped toothpick and serve.
Makes 30 ribbons.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
steps: This is a layered salad served with taco chips.

recipes.title: Orange Julius
steps: Mix all ingredients together in blender until smooth and serve.

recipes.title: Dill-Icious Cucumber Dressing
steps: Blend and serve.
A great complement to green, vegetable and chicken salads.

recipes.title: Squash-Carrot Casserole
ingredients: 1 small pkg. Pepperidge Farms stuffing mix
steps: Cook squash and onion, uncovered, in boiling salted water (about 5 minutes).
Drain well.
Combine soup, sour cream and carrot.
Fold in drained vegetables.
Combine stuffing mix with butter.
Sprinkle 2/3 of the stuffing mixture in a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish.
Spoon vegetable mixture atop.
Sprinkle remaining stuffing mix on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: King Crab Pate
ingredients: 1 (6 to 8 oz.) pkg. frozen Alaskan King crab or Snow crab
steps: Defrost; drain and cut up pieces of crab.
In a bowl, whip butter and lemon juice until fluffy.
Beat in mayonnaise, Parmesan cheese, chopped eggs, horseradish and other seasonings.
Fold in crab, onion and parsley.
Cover and chill for several hours. Makes 3 cups.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
steps: Cook broccoli until fork-tender; drain.
Mix all other ingredients with broccoli.
Spread buttered bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350° until brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Brown stew meat in butter. Put meat in crockpot with both soups and milk.
Cook approximately 4 1/2 to 5 hours, stirring occasionally.
Half ann hour before serving, add
sour cream. Boil noodles, drain.
Add to crockpot.

recipes.title: Chicken, Broccoli Vegetable Saute
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of margarine with chicken for 10 minutes or until brown.
Remove chicken and keep warm.

recipes.title: Shrimp Mold
steps: Bring soup to a boil; remove from heat.
Add to soup: gelatin, water and cream cheese.
Mix well.
Add to soup mixture: onion, celery, mayonnaise and shrimp.
Mix well.
Pour ingredients into mold sprayed with nonstick spray.
Chill several hours or overnight.
Turn out mold onto large plate.
Garnish with parsley, sliced almonds for fish scales and stuffed olive slice for fish eye.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Cook chicken, cut into pieces.
Place in bottom of 3-quart pan.
Mix sour cream and all soups together.
Pour Veg-All over chicken.
Pour soup mixture over all of this.
Top with Waverly Wafers.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 325° for about 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Cherry Salad
ingredients: 1 can (20 oz.) Bing cherries, drain and save juice
2 c. juice (combined from cherry and water)
1 can (14 to 16 oz.) whole cranberry sauce
steps: Heat
juice
and water mixture to boiling; set off heat and stir
in gelatin.
When completely dissolved, chill until slightly thickened.
Add
rest of ingredients and chill until firm.
Good with ham, chicken or turkey.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 c. white seedless grapes, cut up
steps: Combine all ingredients and chill.
Can be served with wheat crackers, or on your choice on bread, cut into your choice of shapes.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
steps: Have cheeses at room temperature.
Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Form into a ball or log.
Sprinkle with chili powder or roll in chopped nuts.
Chill.
Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Russian Tea Mix
steps: Mix all ingredients well.
Store in airtight container.
Use 1 or 2 teaspoons to taste per cup of hot water.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
steps: Brown ground beef and chopped onion.
Drain.
Add soups, picante sauce and milk together and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Pour half of meat mixture into baking dish; top with crunched up Doritos and grated Mozzarella and Cheddar cheeses.
Bake at 350° for about 20 to 25 minutes.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Butterfinger Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines butter recipe yellow cake mix
steps: Prepare cake mix as directed on box.
Let cool and crumble in chunks.
Mix powdered sugar, egg yolks and oleo. Add Cool Whip. Crumble the Butterfingers.
(If you freeze these before, they will crumble finer.)
Layer cake crumbs, Cool Whip mixture, then Butterfinger crumbs.

recipes.title: Chili Mac
steps: Brown meat and onion; drain.
Add salt, pepper and garlic powder to meat.
In a large pot, add tomatoes and kidney beans; break up tomatoes.
Add meat and onion.
Use chili powder to taste.
Cook about 1/2 hour.
Take spaghetti (about 1 handful), break into thirds, add to pot.
Cook until spaghetti is done.

recipes.title: Francis Marion Reception Punch
ingredients: 4 qt. carbonated water or ginger ale
steps: Combine orange juice, ice water, lemon juice and pineapple juice; mix thoroughly and chill.
To serve, pour half of mixture into a large punch bowl.
Add 2 quarts carbonated water or ginger ale.
Punch may be sweetened with dissolved sugar desired.

recipes.title: Deluxe Macaroni And Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni according to package directions.
Mix all ingredients together.
Put in greased casserole.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Estofado-Stew(Serves 4)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. boneless chuck, cut for stew
steps: Brown meat and onion in oil in Dutch oven; add remaining ingredients.
Cover and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 2 to 3 hours or until meat is tender.

recipes.title: 7-Up Salad
ingredients: 20 oz. can drained, crushed pineapple (save juice)
steps: Mix jello, water, 7-Up, pineapple, marshmallows and bananas. Let set until solid.

recipes.title: Squash Skillet Medley
ingredients: 2 lb. yellow squash or combination squash and zucchini
1/2 tsp. dried basil or 1 to 2 Tbsp. fresh basil
steps: Heat margarine or oil in skillet.
Add chopped onion and saute lightly.
Add sliced squash and other ingredients, ending with tomatoes on top.
Sprinkle seasonings over tomatoes.
Stir through. Cover and cook about 20 minutes until squash is tender but not overcooked.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese or several slices of cheese if you prefer.

recipes.title: Ice Tea
steps: Boil water and put in 2-quart container; add 8 tea bags and let sit to brew for 2 hours.
Remove tea bags; add 1 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons lemon juice and stir completely.
Refrigerate until cold.

recipes.title: Frozen Salad
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
steps: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Freeze completely.
Cut into squares to serve, after letting sit out of freezer for several minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet 'N Sour Salad Dressing
steps: Put all ingredients in oversized bowl to avoid splatter.
Mix well with electric mixer until blended.

recipes.title: Marinade For Country Style Ribs
steps: Mix all ingredients (except meal) in a small saucepan.
Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes.
Place meat in a glass dish; pour marinade over meat.
Let it set 12 to 24 hours in the fridge. Bake on a broiler pan at 375° for about 1 1/2 hours or until meat is done.
May also be grilled on the barbecue.
Baste meat throughout the cooking.

recipes.title: Fry Cabbage
steps: Put in heavy pan or skillet, shredded cabbage or cut as for cabbage slaw.
Add rest of ingredients.
Fry on top of stove slowly.
Stir occasionally.
Also can be eaten cold.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
steps: Drain kraut well.
Chop onions, celery and pepper.
Mix all ingredients with kraut and chill.

recipes.title: Chili Con Queso Dip #2
steps: Saute onions and celery in butter.
Cube the Velveeta cheese. Use a double boiler or the microwave.
Melt the cheese in the sauteed onions and celery.
Add the can of chopped chili peppers. Add milk slowly until you get it as thin as you like.

recipes.title: Peaches 'N Cream
steps: Whip heavy cream until peaks form.
Drain can of sliced peaches and fold the peaches into whipped cream.
Spread into metal pan and freeze.
(Tastes like ice cream.)

recipes.title: Crabmeat Soup
steps: Combine and heat all ingredients except sherry.
Remove from heat and add sherry.

recipes.title: Artichoke Squares
ingredients: 1/8 tsp. each: pepper, oregano and Tabasco
steps: Drain and chop artichokes.
Saute onion and garlic in a little butter until limp.
Combine onion mixture with artichokes and remaining ingredients; mix well.
Pour into a greased 8 x 8-inch baking dish and bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Marinated Squash Medley
steps: Combine first 7 ingredients in a jar. Cover tightly and shake well.
Pour dressing over squash. Toss gently. Cover and chill 4 hours.
To serve, toss again and serve with a slotted spoon. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Use on chicken or ribs. If meat is raw, cook for 2 hours.
If cooked, bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
steps: Combine pretzels, sugar and oleo.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
Beat together cream cheese and sugar.
Fold in Cool Whip and spread evenly over cooled crust. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add frozen strawberries and stir until thawed and gelatin is slightly thickened.
Pour over cheese layer and refrigerate until set.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients with the 1 cup of water and stir until sugar and cocoa dissolve.
Heat to boiling and remove from heat. Add the 2 milks and water; return to heat but do not boil.
Serve hot or cold.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Angel Food Cake(Low-Fat)
ingredients: 1 large box frozen strawberries in juice
steps: Slice top of cake off all the way around and remove.
Use a sharp knife and cut 1/4 to 1/2 inch in from center downward.
Be careful not to push knife down through the bottom of the cake.
Do the same from the outside of the cake.
Use your fingers and pull out the cake between your cuts.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
steps: Let
mixture
of first seven ingredients get thoroughly heated.
Then
add
a
pint of cucumbers cut into thin slices. Just
before
reaching
the boiling point, pack into a jar and seal while hot.

recipes.title: Chili Dip
steps: Saute onions and pepper.
Add ground chuck until done, but not brown.
Add soup, tomato sauce, tomato paste and chili powder. Simmer 30 minutes.
Add cheese and cook until cheese is melted. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Grit Bread
steps: Cook grits in 4 c. water until thick.
Add margarine, grated cheese and garlic cheese.
Beat until smooth.
Add 3 beaten eggs. Stir until smooth.
Pour into 1 1/2 to 2 qt. greased casserole dish and top with more shredded cheese.
Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes or until set in the middle.

recipes.title: Nutty Chocolate Sauce
steps: In a nonstick saucepan or skillet, melt butter and saute nuts until slightly toasted.
Remove from heat; add chocolate chips and stir until melted.	Serve warm over ice cream.
Sauce will harden. Store remaining sauce in refrigerator.
Reheat (melted) in a microwave for future use.
Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Pistachio Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. pistachio instant pudding and pie filling
steps: Mix all ingredients together in bowl and chill until firm.

recipes.title: Spiders
steps: In a double boiler, melt butterscotch chips.
Remove from heat.
Add cashews and chow mein noodles.
Mix well.
Use teaspoon to spoon out on wax paper.
Set in refrigerator for about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Juice
steps: Combine ingredients and add enough water to make 5 quarts. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: 7-Layer Salad
steps: Chop in large bowl the lettuce, broccoli, cauliflower, radishes, green peppers, onions, frozen peas and Cheddar cheese. Sprinkle top of cheese with garlic powder.
Cover top of bowl with mayo.
Cover bowl and let set overnight or all day in refrigerator.
Before serving, toss.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Dip
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Refrigerate overnight.
Serve with vegetables, chips or anything of your choice.

recipes.title: Scalloped Tomatoes
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
Cut the toast into small squares (or substitute croutons).
In casserole dish, repeat layers of tomatoes and toast.
Sprinkle on salt and onion.
Pour melted butter or margarine over top.
Bake about 20 minutes.
Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Chicken Stuffed Shells
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. chicken, cooked, skinned, boned and cut into bite-sized pieces
2 boxes Stove Top stuffing mix, made per pkg. directions
1 box large stuffing shells, cooked until tender, drained, rinsed and cooled
1 can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup
crushed potato chips or cracker crumbs
steps: Butter the bottom and sides of a large baking dish.
In a large bowl, combine chicken pieces and prepared stuffing.
Mix well.

recipes.title: Kahlua Strawberry Cream Daiquiri
steps: In a blender, combine all ingredients and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses and garnish with strawberries and/or mint sprigs, if desired.

recipes.title: Barbecued Wieners And Sauerkraut
steps: Make the barbecue sauce by cooking the diced onion in oil until lightly browned.
Add ketchup, water, brown sugar and dry mustard; simmer 15 minutes.
Drain sauerkraut and spread out in a shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top this with the frankfurters and spoon the barbecue sauce over them.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Quick Microwave Cake
steps: Smear 1/2 can frosting in bottom of microwave tube pan.
Mix remaining ingredients for 2 minutes using mixer on medium speed. Pour over frosting.
Bake 12 minutes on High, turning occasionally.
Leave in oven for 15 minutes longer.
Remove from oven and turn upside down on serving platter.
Ice top with remaining frosting, if desired.

recipes.title: Abraham Lincoln'S Stewed Apples
steps: Peel and core the apples.
Cut in thick slices and saute in the butter, about 3 or 4 minutes.
Add the remaining ingredients. Cover and cook slowly until tender.

recipes.title: Pepper Salad
steps: Combine all salad ingredients in bowl.
Sprinkle with Italian seasoning.
Mix oil and vinegar together.
Pour over salad. Let marinate several hours or overnight before serving.
Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Beet Salad With Horseradish
steps: In dish, place cooked beets and onion, sliced thin.
Use another bowl and add together all other ingredients.
Pour juice mixture over beets and onions; refrigerate at least 3 hours (will keep 3 to 4 days).
Serve with deviled eggs or smoked fish.

recipes.title: Banana Fudge Pie
steps: Prepare crust according to directions for filled one pie crust.
Heat oven to 350°.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Balls
steps: Mix peanut butter, margarine and powdered sugar (start with between 1/2 to 3/4 cup powdered sugar and add more as needed). Roll into 1-inch balls and dip in melted chocolate.
Place on wax paper.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
steps: Melt Jell-O in hot water.
Add whole cranberry sauce to Jell-O until dissolved, then add other ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour in dish.
Refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Cherry Delight
steps: Put cherries in oblong greased pan.
Pour dry cake mix over cherries; then pour melted butter over that.
Put nuts on top. Bake for 1 hour in a 350° oven.
Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: grated or shredded cheese (Mozzarella and Cheddar)
steps: Lay out crescent rolls on a cookie sheet and bake.
Mix dressing ingredients.
Spread on crust when cooled.
Cut up veggies and put over crust.
Add cheeses.
Put under broiler until the cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Apricot Punch
steps: Heat jello, sugar and water.
Mix with other ingredients except 7-Up.
Freeze.
Add 7-Up before serving.

recipes.title: Cherry Delight
steps: Tear cake into bite-size pieces and place in 9 x 13-inch pan. With mixer, beat cream cheese and powdered sugar together until light.
Add to whipped Dream Whip and blend well by hand.
Spread over cake pieces.
Lift cake pieces with fork so cream cheese mixture gets down around cake pieces.
Chill for 2 hours.
Spread cherry pie filling over all and chill 2 or 3 more hours.

recipes.title: "Easy Chicken Divan"
ingredients: 2 large chicken breasts, split, skinned and boned
2 cans cream of mushroom soup, thinned with 1/2 c. milk
steps: Cook broccoli until almost tender (do not overcook). Place in greased baking dish. Cover with chicken. Place sliced onion and cheese over chicken. Top with soup mixture and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Grandma Barbee'S Forgotten Cookies
ingredients: 6 oz. bag mini or large chocolate chips
steps: Make in evening and forget about them until morning.

recipes.title: Easy Fruit Salad
steps: Mix dry jello with sour cream.
Add remaining ingredients. Sprinkle chopped nuts over top.
Chill at least 4 hours.

recipes.title: Cheese Sticks
steps: Heat oven to 375°.
With fork, combine cheese with margarine. Spread mixture on bread using about 1 1/2 teaspoons per slice. Sprinkle with paprika if desired.
Cut each slice into 6 sticks. Place in single layer on large baking sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until brown and crisp.

recipes.title: Reuben Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. (11 oz.) can sauerkraut, drained and rinsed
2 (4 oz.) pkg. sliced corned beef, minced
steps: Spread sauerkraut in bottom of a 12 x 8-inch baking dish.
Top with tomato slices.
Dot with dressing and butter.
Cover with corned beef and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
Remove casserole from oven.
Separate each biscuit into 3 layers.
Slightly overlap biscuit layers on casserole to form three rows.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until biscuit topping is slightly brown.

recipes.title: Garlic Cheese Grits Casserole
steps: Break 2 eggs in a one cup measuring cup and fill with milk. Stir well.
Cook 1 cup quick grits with salt; add margarine and stir well.
Add cheese and garlic powder.
Add to milk/egg mixture. Mix. Bake in buttered casserole for 1 hour in 325° oven.

recipes.title: Tuna And Macaroni Salad
steps: Cook macaroni; drain.
Add cold water and drain.
Put in a bowl and add the diced onion, carrots, celery, mayonnaise, salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Potato Burgers
steps: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Form into patties and place on broiling pan or grill.
Broil until brown.

recipes.title: Lemon Braised Pork Chops
steps: Fry chops until brown; drain and mix catsup and soft drink. Pour over chops, then place a lemon slice on each chop.
Cover and let simmer for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sunshine Refresher
steps: Blend Marshmallow Creme and 1/4 cup orange juice in blender or at medium speed on electric mixer until smooth.
Add remaining juice and eggs; beat until foamy.
Makes eight 1/2 cup servings.

recipes.title: Cosmopolitan Casserole(Yields 6 To 8 Servings)
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated 6 flaky tender flake biscuits
steps: Preheat oven to 400°. Spread sauerkraut in bottom of 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Top with tomato slices.
Dot with dressing and margarine. Cover with corned beef. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

Remove casserole from oven. Separate biscuits into three layers. Slightly overlap biscuit layers on casserole to form 3 rows. Sprinkle with potato chips and caraway seeds. Bake at 400° for 15 or 20 minutes until biscuit topping is golden brown.

recipes.title: Ham And Pickle Roll-Ups
steps: Remove moisture from ham slices and pickles using paper towels.
Spread cream cheese on ham slices.
Place pickle to fit the hams short end and roll in the length.
Form fit. Refrigerate.
Then slice in 1/4-inch pieces and place on dish with toothpicks.

recipes.title: Homemade Ice Cream
steps: Beat with mixer until well mixed, 3 to 5 minutes.
Pour into freezer can; add milk to full mark on cake.
Stir together and freeze.

recipes.title: Caramel Chews
ingredients: 2 c. broken walnuts, peanuts or pecans
steps: Melt butter and add sugar, corn syrup and sweetened condensed milk and stir continually until it boils and candy thermometer reads 240°. Remove from heat and add the nuts and vanilla. Lightly butter a pan and pour batter into pan. Leave at room temperature 3 or 4 hours until it hardens. Wrap in wax paper. Twist ends of paper and clip ends with scissors.

recipes.title: Cafe Swiss Mocha
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Use 1 level tablespoon of mix with 6 ounces boiling water for each cup. Makes 14 servings.

recipes.title: Sugared Walnuts
steps: Mix sugar, cinnamon, cream of tartar and boiling water.
Boil to 246° or until mixture forms a firm ball when dropped in cold water.
Add walnuts and cool.
Turn out onto waxed paper to cool. Separate the nuts.
Pecans may also be used.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch grapes, cut in half (no seeds)
1/2 to 3/4 pt. whipping cream, whipped and folded in
steps: Blend together and let set.

recipes.title: Banana Breakfast Shake
ingredients: 1 ripe banana, peeled and cut in half
steps: Place all ingredients in blender.
Cover and turn to high speed.
Blend for 45 seconds, or until creamy and smooth.
To serve, pour into tall glass.
Yield:
1 shake.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Balls
steps: Combine all ingredients, mix well.
Chill several hours. Shape into 1-inch balls.
Yields about 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Meatballs
ingredients: 3 lb. ground sirloin, chuck or hamburger
steps: Combine ground meat with rest of ingredients.
Form in tiny balls, 1-inch across.
Place in large roasting pan and bake, uncovered, at 275° for one hour.
Makes about 100 meatballs.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
steps: Pour soup in pan.
Heat.
Mix gelatine with 1/4 cup water to make paste.
Add to soup.
Stir well.
Put in cream cheese and stir until smooth.
Add rest of ingredients.
Put in bowl or mold. Tastes better if made ahead.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Monster Bread
steps: Every great chef has that one specialty that he wants to share with the world.
Since the only other things I can do in the kitchen are make instant coffee and prepare hard-boiled eggs, I thought it important to share Breakfast By Byron.
I recommend serving this treat for those special weekends when you have time to pamper yourself.

recipes.title: Oven Roasted Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 450°.
Add all ingredients in bowl.
Toss until potatoes are evenly coated.
Put on a cookie sheet.
Bake, stirring once in a while.
Cook 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal No-Bake Cookies
steps: Bring to boil sugar, milk, butter and cocoa; boil for 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Stir in the vanilla, peanut butter and oatmeal.
Spoon onto aluminum foil or wax paper.

recipes.title: Corn Flake Drops
ingredients: 4 c. corn flakes, rolled (measure before rolling)
1 c. nut meats or 1 c. shredded coconut
steps: Beat egg whites until
stiff.
Add
sugar
slowly, then fold in remaining ingredients.
Drop batter from teaspoon onto greased baking sheets.
Bake in slow
oven	for
about 7 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Felicia Dodges' New England Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 c. beans (yellow eye, soldier pea or Great Northern)
steps: Soak beans, onion and cut up salt pork overnight.
In the morning, parboil for about 1 hour.
Do not change liquid.
Put in covered 2-quart casserole dish and add all other ingredients.
Add water to cover beans totally.
Bake at 300° for 30 to 60 minutes. Turn down to 220° and bake 6 to 7 hours, adding water if necessary.
Beans should not be dry.
Liquid is very tasty.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
steps: Saute onions in margarine until onions are glossy.
Add water, wine and bouillon.
Simmer until cooked down.
Place in soup crocks.
Top with thick slice of French bread.
Top with Mozzarella cheese and Swiss cheese. Place under broiler until cheese is melted and browned.

recipes.title: Shrimp Boat Dip
steps: Hollow out one loaf of bread.
Break apart or cut the removed part and second loaf of bread into bite size pieces.
Combine mayo, cheese, crab and onion in baking dish.
This step can be done ahead and refrigerated until needed.
Bake dip mixture at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes (until hot).
Pour into hollowed out bread. Serve surrounded by bread pieces for dipping.

recipes.title: Crazy Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) bottle sweet or dill relish
steps: Heat water to boil, add macaroni and onion.
Cook until tender; drain and wash.
Cover with butter.
Add mushrooms, black olives, green chilies, relish, pimentos, boiled eggs and pineapple chunks.
Cover with mayonnaise.
Serve cold.

recipes.title: No-Sugar Fruit Salad(Diabetic)
steps: Drain juice from pineapple in saucepan.
Stir a small amount of juice into cornstarch and return to saucepan.
Cook until thick.
Stir in vanilla and sweetener.
(Dice chunks.)
Combine pineapple and equal amount of banana slices.
Pour mixture over fruit.
Toss until well coated.
Refrigerate until well chilled.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Dream Cake
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained (save juice)
steps: Prepare cake mix according to directions, using pineapple juice for liquid.
Add water to make amount required.
Bake about 15 minutes in 350° oven, using a well-greased and floured 15 x 10 1/2 x 1 pan.
Cool in pan.
Blend together with beater the cream cheese, instant pudding and milk.
Fold in drained pineapple. Spread over top of cooled cake.
Cover with Cool Whip and sprinkle with nuts and coconut.
Refrigerate for several hours.

recipes.title: Man-Style Meat And Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cooked beef, cut in thin strips
1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup
steps: In skillet, brown onions and beef in butter until onions are tender.
Blend in soup, milk and 3/4 cup of cheese.
In casserole, arrange layers of potatoes and meat sauce.
Sprinkle with 1/4 cup of cheese.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Fried Beets
steps: Combine ingredients.
Cover and fry about 20 minutes.
Serves 6.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Delight
ingredients: 1 tall can crushed pineapple, well drained
steps: Mix graham cracker crumbs and margarine together for crust and press in a 9 x 9-inch baking dish. Add by layers: bananas, Eagle Brand milk, pineapple, Cool Whip, coconut and pecans. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala
ingredients: 1 can or jar sliced mushrooms minus the juice
steps: Dip chicken cutlets in egg and milk, then in flour.
Put margarine in frying pan and brown cutlets in pan on both sides. Place cutlets in baking dish.
In frying pan, add in margarine, 1 can chicken broth, mushrooms (minus the juice), salt and pepper to taste and a pinch of parsley.
Stir.
Add 3/4 cup of red wine; stir again.
Bring to boil; simmer.
Add 1 tablespoon flour and 1 cup of hot water; simmer until thick.
Pour over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Rotel Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut into cubes
steps: Boil chicken until tender.
Fix noodles according to directions.
Drain water.
Mix butter with noodles.
Add cheese and Ro-Tel.
Mix well.
Tear chicken into pieces and mix into noodle mixture.
Pour into baking pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Combine cream of chicken soup and broth.
Add vegetables and cooked chicken.
Mix and pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.

recipes.title: Fannie Word'S Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1 can white Shoe Peg corn (Green Giant)
steps: Mix and place in casserole.
Top with 1/2 box crushed Ritz crackers mixed with 1/2 stick melted butter and 1/2 can slivered almonds.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chocolate Toffee Cookies I
ingredients: 1 (18.25 ounce) package devil's food cake mix
3/4 cup coarsely chopped chocolate-covered toffee candy bars
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C).
In a large bowl, combine the cake mix, oil, and eggs Beat with an electric beater for 3 to 4 minutes, until well blended. With a spoon, stir in the chopped candy.

Drop by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on to cookie sheets that have been coated with nonstick baking spray. Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, or until the cookies are firm. Remove the cookies to a wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.title: Very Easy Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 pint strawberries - cleaned, hulled and sliced
steps: In a large bowl, combine the strawberries, grapes, kiwis, and bananas. Gently mix in peaches. Chill for 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Passover Souffle
ingredients: 3 tablespoons orange juice, or to taste
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Place the sweet potatoes into a large saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Gently boil over medium-low heat until tender, 15 to 25 minutes. Drain the sweet potatoes, peel, and mash in a large mixing bowl. Using an electric mixer, beat the sweet potatoes until fluffy, about 5 minutes. Beat in 1/3 cup of margarine, 1/2 cup brown sugar, orange juice, salt, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and egg. Spread the mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Beat in 1/3 cup of margarine, 1/2 cup brown sugar, orange juice, salt, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and egg. Spread the mixture into a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a bowl, mix the crushed matzo, 1/2 cup margarine, 1/4 cup brown sugar, and 1 pinch cinnamon. Spread the topping evenly over the sweet potato mixture.

Bake in the preheated oven until the topping is golden and bubbling, about 30 minutes. If the topping needs more browning, switch the oven to broil and brown under the broiler darker, about 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Pepper Pot Soup Ii
steps: Add cubed steak, red wine, and water to a large soup pot. Simmer, covered, over medium low heat for 1 hour.
Meanwhile, cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water for 5 minutes. The pasta should be only partially cooked. Drain.
Add pasta, tomatoes, onion, and sugar to meat. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir beans, succotash, and green pepper into soup. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Simmer over low heat until soup is hot and vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Rosemary Steaks With Papaya Butter
ingredients: 1/2 papaya - peeled, seeded, and cut into 1-inch slices
2 cloves garlic, minced, or to taste
steps: Preheat outdoor grill for medium heat, and lightly oil the grate.
Rub the papaya slices evenly with 2 teaspoons olive oil.
Cook the papaya on the preheated grill until hot and softened, about 10 minutes.
Blend the grilled papaya, garlic, and butter in a blender until smooth. Pour into a small container and cool in refrigerator 1 to 2 hours.
Again preheat outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Rub the porterhouse steaks thoroughly with the 2 tablespoons olive oil. Stir the rosemary, salt, pepper, and garlic salt together in a bowl; rub evenly onto both sides of the steaks.

Cook the steaks until they are beginning to firm, and are hot and slightly pink in the center, about 8 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees F (60 degrees C). Top with the papaya butter to serve.

recipes.title: Shay'S Irish Chili
ingredients: 1/2 (19 ounce) can light red kidney beans, drained and mashed
1 (15.5 ounce) can dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat the oil in a soup pot set over medium heat. Add the ground beef, garlic, and onion. Cook, stirring to crumble the ground beef, until beef is no longer pink. Drain off any excess grease. Season with salt, pepper, nutmeg, beef bouillon, and chili powder. Add the sugar, tomatoes, light and dark kidney beans and potatoes. Cover and simmer over medium-low heat for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Umami Barbeque Sauce
steps: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Add onion; cook, without stirring, until onions darken, about 5 minutes. Pour sherry wine into the pan. Simmer to cook off alcohol, about 1 minute. Stir in tomato juice, soy sauce, pomegranate molasses, ketchup, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, pineapple juice, espresso, and chipotle peppers; bring sauce to a boil.

Reduce heat to low until sauce is just simmering. Add brown sugar; stir well to dissolve. Simmer sauce, stirring occasionally, until flavors are combined, about 20 minutes. Strain sauce to remove onions and chipotle peppers. Refrigerate until cool.

recipes.title: Pasta, Chicken And Artichokes
ingredients: 3 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into strips
1/4 (14 ounce) can artichoke hearts, drained and sliced
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Cook pasta in boiling water until done. Drain, and set aside.
In a large saute pan, heat olive oil over medium high heat; brown the chicken and garlic in oil (about 5 minutes). Remove from the pan, and set aside.

Pour the chicken broth into the pan; then add the broccoli and tomato, and cook for about 5 minutes. Stir in the artichoke hearts, mushrooms, red bell pepper, cooked chicken, and pasta; cook for 3 to 5 more minutes, or until hot. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Transfer to a serving bowl, and top with Parmesan cheese and parsley. Serve.

recipes.title: Pao De Queijo (Brazilian Cheese Bread)
ingredients: 4 cups tapioca starch (such as Bob's Red Mill(R))
steps: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.
Pour tapioca starch into a wide bowl.
Combine 1 cup water, vegetable oil, and salt in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Slowly pour over the tapioca, mixing with a spoon until evenly combined. Let cool slightly, about 10 minutes.
Stir Mexican cheese blend and eggs into the tapioca mixture. Knead dough until soft and sticky, 5 to 10 minutes. Add water, 1 teaspoon at a time, if dough seems dry.
Drop spoonfuls of dough 1 inch apart on the baking sheets.
Bake in the preheated oven until lightly golden, about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Pepper Jelly Pork
steps: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).
Whisk chili powder, black pepper, ground cumin, and salt together in a small bowl. Rub spice mixture onto all sides of pork tenderloin. Place tenderloin in a shallow roasting pan.
Roast tenderloin in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center, about 30 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 150 degrees F (65 degrees C).

Stir pepper jelly and balsamic vinegar together in a saucepan over low heat until jelly is completely melted, 1 to 2 minutes. Brush pepper jelly mixture over pork tenderloin and continue to bake tenderloin until jelly coating is hot, about 5 minutes more. Let pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Yogurt Chicken Curry
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into bite size pieces
steps: Place chicken and water in a medium saucepan and simmer over medium low heat for about 15 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and no longer pink inside.

When water is almost reduced, season chicken with salt and pepper to taste. In a small bowl, combine yogurt and curry powder and mix together. Stir this mixture into saucepan until all chicken pieces are coated, then simmer for another 5 minutes to heat through and marinate.

recipes.title: Nacho Typical Nachos
ingredients: 1/2 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
1 (4 ounce) can sliced black olives, drained
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes; drain and discard grease.
Mix ground beef, yogurt, salsa, chili beans, diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, and black olives together in an 8-inch square baking dish. Sprinkle cheese over the beef mixture.
Bake in preheated oven until bubbling, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Rainbow Sherbet Cake
ingredients: 1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
steps: Slice angel food cake crosswise to make four layers. Place the bottom layer on a serving plate, and spread orange sherbet evenly on top. Repeat with remaining cake layers and raspberry and lime sherbets. Finish with final layer of cake. Frost sides and top with whipped topping, and place in freezer for 1 hour, or until firm.

recipes.title: Kale And Mushroom Side
ingredients: 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 bunch kale leaves, torn (ribs removed and discarded)
steps: Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Cook and stir onion, mushrooms, and garlic in hot oil until the mushrooms are soft, about 5 minutes. Add butter and vinegar to the mushroom mixture; season with salt and pepper. Toss mushroom mixture in the wok until the butter melts and coats everything, about 1 minute.
Switch heat off and add kale to the wok; cook and stir in the hot wok until the kale is bright green, about 5 minutes. Season kale mixture with nutmeg and stir.

recipes.title: Red Potato Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange potato halves around chicken, then cover all with salad dressing.
Bake at 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) for 1 hour or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.

recipes.title: Yummy Baked Chicken Thighs
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste
2 (8.5 ounce) boxes dry corn muffin mix (such as Jiffy(R))
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.
Season chicken thighs on all sides with salt, pepper, and garlic salt.
Pour corn muffin mix into a shallow bowl. Roll chicken thighs in corn muffin mix until well coated. Transfer coated thighs to prepared baking sheet.

Bake chicken thighs in the preheated oven until no longer pink at the bone and the juices run clear, about 35 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh, near the bone should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

recipes.title: Vegetable Beef Chunky Soup
ingredients: 1 (46 fluid ounce) can tomato-vegetable juice cocktail
steps: In a large saucepan or stockpot, brown and drain ground beef. Add juice, onion, potatoes, and mixed vegetables. Bring to a boil and let simmer until potatoes are tender. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Jamaican Cornmeal Porridge
steps: Combine water, cornmeal, whole milk, coconut milk, white sugar, vanilla extract, salt, nutmeg, and cinnamon in a blender; blend until smooth.

Bring the mixture to a boil in a saucepan; whisk occasionally until beginning to thicken, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat when slow bubbles form. Stir frequently until as thick as you like, about 5 minutes. Add raisins.
Remove from heat, cover, and let cool before serving, about 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Bread Pudding
ingredients: 3/4 vanilla bean, split and seeds scraped away
steps: Whisk milk, cream, sugar, eggs, lemon zest, salt, cinnamon, and vanilla bean together in a bowl; fold in baguette slices, raisins, and cranberries. Set aside to soak for 40 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Butter a 12-inch deep-dish pie dish.
Transfer bread mixture to prepared pie dish; remove and discard vanilla bean. Cover dish with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake until until pudding is set and lightly browned, about 15 more minutes.

recipes.title: Barbara'S Salad
ingredients: 3 ounces grilled chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
steps: Combine the chicken, ham, lettuce, pineapple, and grapes in a large bowl; toss to combine.

recipes.title: Zucchini Lasagna With Beef And Sausage
ingredients: 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes, or to taste
steps: Cook and stir ground beef, Italian sausage, onion, and garlic in a large skillet over medium heat until the meat is crumbly and no longer pink, about 10 minutes. Drain grease and stir basil, oregano, brown sugar, red pepper flakes, 1 teaspoon salt, black pepper, tomatoes, and tomato paste into the meat. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer meat sauce for 30 minutes. Stir occasionally.
Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.

Mix eggs, ricotta cheese, 1 cup Parmesan cheese, parsley, and 1 teaspoon salt in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Pare several slices of skin lengthwise from zucchini, alternating with strips of remaining skin. Cut zucchini into long strips to resemble lasagna noodles. Discard seedy middle strips.

Place 1/3 of the zucchini strips into bottom of the prepared baking dish, filling in any gaps with scrap pieces of zucchini. Spread half the ricotta mixture over zucchini; spread 1 cup of mozzarella cheese over ricotta mixture; spread 1/3 of the meat sauce over mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers once more, layering 1/3 of zucchini strips, remaining half of the ricotta mixture, 1 more cup of mozzarella cheese, and 1/3 of the meat sauce. Make a third layer of remaining zucchini strips, remaining meat sauce, and 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese sprinkled on top.

Bake in the preheated oven until lasagna is bubbling and top is browned, about 1 hour. If top is browning too quickly, cover dish with aluminum foil during last 15 minutes of baking time. Spread 1 cup mozzarella cheese on top of the casserole and bake until mozzarella cheese topping is melted, 5 to 10 more minutes. Let casserole stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: T'S Maple-Vanilla Apple Pie Filling
ingredients: 1 whole vanilla bean, split lengthwise and scraped
steps: Mix apple slices with lemon juice in a large bowl to coat apple slices in juice.

Stir water, honey, and maple syrup together in a large pot over medium heat until the honey and syrup are melted into the water; add vanilla bean contents and stir. Mix cornstarch, cinnamon, salt, and nutmeg together in a small bowl; stir into the water to dissolve. Bring the mixture to a boil and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Carefully pour apple slices into the water. Bring water again to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, cover pot with a lid, and cook at a simmer until apples are tender, 6 to 8 minutes.
Remove pot from heat and remove lid to allow apples to cool to room temperature, at least 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Yogurt Spinach Dip
steps: In a medium bowl, mix together spinach, plain yogurt, mayonnaise, seasoning salt, parsley, basil, oregano, dry mustard and garlic salt. Chill until serving.

recipes.title: Alabama Slammer I
steps: In a cocktail mixer, combine sloe gin, Southern Comfort, triple sec, Galliano and orange juice. Shake vigorously and strain into 2 glasses with ice.
Garnish each with a cherry and 1/2 slice of orange.

recipes.title: Chicken And Sausage With Bowties
ingredients: 1 pound hot Italian turkey sausage, casings removed
steps: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain.

Wash chicken breasts and cut into large bite-size pieces. Cut sausages into large pieces. In a large, deep skillet over medium low heat, combine oil and garlic; and cook just enough to flavor the oil. Remove garlic from oil.

Add chicken and sausage to skillet and brown both lightly until they are opaque. Add the tomatoes and the wine. Bring to a boil and let simmer for 20 minutes. Season sauce mixture with basil, rosemary and salt and pepper to taste. Add cooked, drained pasta to the skillet mixture. Toss and serve.

recipes.title: Mah'S Jerk Rub
steps: Whisk red pepper flakes, allspice, curry powder, black pepper, thyme, cayenne pepper, and ginger together in a bowl.

recipes.title: Tequila Cocktail Sauce
steps: In a large bowl, blend ketchup, chili sauce, horseradish, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, hot pepper sauce, tequila, salt and pepper. Chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Easy Leek And Potato Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley, or to taste
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
steps: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, about 3 minutes. Add stock, potatoes, leeks, parsley, bouquet garni, bouillon cube, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes.
Remove soup from heat; discard bouquet garni. Puree soup in the pot using a hand blender.

recipes.title: Grilled Zucchini With Portobello And Goat Cheese
steps: Preheat grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Pour marinade into a shallow bowl. Add zucchini, gold zucchini, and mushrooms. Let marinate, flipping occasionally, 10 to 15 minutes.
Grill zucchini and gold zucchini, turning occasionally and brushing with marinade, until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Repeat with mushrooms. Transfer to a serving plate.
Place pine nuts in a small skillet over medium-low heat. Toast, tossing occasionally, until golden, 3 to 5 minutes.
Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler.

Heat oil in a large oven-safe skillet. Add shallot; cook and stir until golden brown, about 2 minutes. Stir in tomatoes and basil; cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add grilled zucchini, gold zucchini, and mushrooms. Coat with goat cheese.
Transfer skillet to the preheated oven; broil, keeping oven door open, until goat cheese is golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes.
Sprinkle toasted pine nuts and chives over goat cheese.

recipes.title: Beef And Pepper Pie
ingredients: 2 cups sweet red peppers, with sauce
1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie
steps: Place peppers, including liquid, into food processor; pulse until peppers are cut into small pieces.
Brown meat and onions. Add peppers, mushrooms, and cheese to meat mixture. Spoon into bottom crust. Cover with top crust, and seal the edges.
Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) until crust is brown, and pie is heated through.

recipes.title: Deer Ribs
steps: Preheat oven to 200 degrees F (95 degrees C).

Pour vinegar and beer into a large roasting pan. Add the celery, carrots, peppers, garlic, and onion. Rub the venison ribs with Cajun seasoning, salt and pepper to taste. Place ribs in roasting pan and cover with a tight fitting lid or aluminum foil.
Bake in preheated oven for 18 hours, or until the meat is falling off of the bone.

recipes.title: Best Homemade Vegan Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil, or to taste
3 carrots, sliced, or more to taste
8 shiitake mushrooms, sliced, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 tablespoon vegetable bouillon (such as Better Than Bouillon(R))
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add potatoes, celery, carrots, and onion. Saute until slightly soft, 2 to 3 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring frequently, until onion is translucent, about 3 minutes more. Add chard and garlic; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cook until chard is wilted, about 2 minutes. Add water to cover, bay leaves, and more salt to taste. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 35 minutes.
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil; cook fusilli at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes; drain.
Stir tofu, tamari, and bouillon into the soup. Simmer until bouillon is dissolved, about 10 minutes. Add a portion of cooked pasta to each bowl and ladle soup over before serving.

recipes.title: Quinoa With Peaches And Creamy Yogurt
ingredients: 1 large fresh peach, pitted and chopped
1 tablespoon lime juice, or to taste
steps: If quinoa is not pre-rinsed, rinse in plenty of cool water to remove coating, and drain. Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a saucepan, and stir in the quinoa; reduce heat to low, and simmer until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain excess water, and mix in the cinnamon and 1 teaspoon of nutmeg.

Mix the chopped peach with yogurt in a bowl. Serve quinoa in a serving bowl, topped with about 2 tablespoons of the peach yogurt. Drizzle with a teaspoon or so of honey, sprinkle with nutmeg, and drizzle about a teaspoon of lime juice over the top.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Low-Carb Santa Fe Chicken
ingredients: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
1 (14.5 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers
1 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
1 1/2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
steps: Combine black beans, chicken broth, diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, corn, cilantro, scallions, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, cayenne pepper, and salt in the crock pot. Season chicken breast with salt and lay atop the beans mixture.
Cook on Low for 9 1/2 hours.
Remove chicken from slow cooker to a cutting board; shred into strands, return to the slow cooker, and stir into the beans mixture.
Continue cooking on Low for 30 minutes more.

recipes.title: Greek Stew
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic, or more to taste, minced
8 chicken thighs, or more to taste, trimmed
1 drop hot pepper sauce (such as Tabasco(R))
steps: Prepare a Dutch oven or large pot with cooking spray. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook and stir onion and garlic in hot oil until onion soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. Remove onion mixture to a bowl.
Heat remaining olive oil in the pot again over medium heat. Cook chicken in hot oil, turning a few times, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Pour wine over the chicken; bring to a simmer and cook until chicken is no longer pink in the center, about 15 minutes.

Stir onion mixture, tomato sauce, black pepper, lemon juice, hot pepper sauce, and cinnamon with the simmering chicken; bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, place a cover on the pot, and cook at a simmer until the chicken is easily pulled apart, about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Candie'S Simply Great Punch
ingredients: 1 (2 liter) bottle lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage
steps: Pour chilled punch and soda into punch bowl. Scoop out entire half-gallon of ice cream, and carefully slide into punch.

recipes.title: Vermont Maple Float
steps: Pour milk into tall glass, stir in maple syrup. Mix well, and top with a scoop of ice cream.

recipes.title: Easy Strawberry Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese (such as Philadelphia(R)), softened
steps: Puree strawberries in a blender or food processor until smooth.

Combine cream cheese and butter in a large bowl; beat with an electric mixer until creamy and smooth. Blend in vanilla extract. Gradually beat in confectioners' sugar until smooth. Fold in strawberry puree until frosting is desired flavor and consistency.

recipes.title: Salsa Ii
steps: Bring a large saucepan of water to boil. Briefly place 6 pounds tomatoes into water to loosen skins and set color. Drain, peel and crush.

Mix chopped tomatoes, garlic powder, lemon juice, salt, cayenne pepper and cumin into the saucepan with crushed tomatoes. Whip to desired thickness. Bring to a boil. Mix in red onion, white onion, yellow onion, jalapeno peppers and cilantro. Continue boiling until vegetables are soft and mixture has reached desired consistency. Remove from heat. Refrigerate until serving.

recipes.title: Caesar Salad Pinwheels
ingredients: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes in oil, drained and finely chopped
1 (11 ounce) package DOLE(R) Ultimate Caesar Kit
steps: Combine cream cheese, sun-dried tomatoes and herb-seasoning from salad kit in medium bowl; blend well.
Lightly crush garlic croutons from kit.
Combine romaine, cheese and crushed croutons from kit in large bowl. Toss with Caesar Dressing.

On each roll, spread cream cheese mixture over lavash bread; cover with a thin layer of salad mixture. Roll up from narrow side. (For flour tortillas, fold in sides before rolling up). Secure each roll with 5 to 6 wooden picks. Slice rolls between wooden picks to form pinwheel appetizers.

recipes.title: Sriracha Aioli
steps: Stir mayonnaise and sriracha hot sauce together in a bowl until the color is consistent; add lime juice and stir.

recipes.title: Hot Date With A Chicken
ingredients: 1 small apple - peeled, cored, and chopped
2 (6 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
steps: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Combine the dates, apple, apricots, raisins, orange zest, and orange juice in a small bowl. Season with cayenne pepper, cardamom, and mace; mix well.

Place the chicken breasts between two sheets of heavy plastic (resealable freezer bags work well) on a solid, level surface. Firmly pound the chicken with the smooth side of a meat mallet to a thickness of about 1/4 inch. Mound the fruit filling on the flattened breasts and roll up, tucking in the ends. Secure the chicken with toothpicks.

Heat the vegetable oil in an oven proof skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken breasts, and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Place in the preheated oven, and continue cooking the chicken breasts until the filling is hot and the juices run clear, 20 to 25 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

recipes.title: Parmesan-Roasted Tomatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Place tomatoes in a bowl and toss gently with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange on a baking sheet and top each tomato half with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until Parmesan cheese is melted and slightly browned, 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Lettuce With Garlic
ingredients: 1 small head romaine lettuce, leaves separated
steps: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat; add green onions and 1/2 of the garlic. Cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add romaine lettuce and oyster sauce; cook and quickly stir until lettuce turns bright green, 1 to 2 minutes. Turn heat to medium.
Mix remaining garlic and salt into lettuce mixture and stir.

recipes.title: Basic Coquito
ingredients: 1 (14 ounce) can cream of coconut, shaken very well before opening
1 (14 ounce) can coconut milk, shaken very well before opening
1 1/2 cups rum (such as Bacardi(R)), or to taste
steps: Add cinnamon to a large bottle or other container that can hold at least 8 cups using a funnel. Pour sweetened condensed milk, cream of coconut, coconut milk, evaporated milk, and rum through the funnel. Shake or stir well to combine.
Refrigerate coquito until chilled, at least 1 hour. Shake or stir before serving.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Chocolate Cream Cheese Cupcakes
ingredients: 1 (18.25 ounce) package chocolate cake mix with pudding
1 (16 ounce) container whipped cream cheese frosting
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Line 24 muffin cups with paper liners.
Stir chocolate cake mix, sour cream, vegetable oil, water, and eggs together in a large bowl.
Pour cake batter evenly into prepared muffin cups.
Place a small spoonful of whipped cream cheese in each muffin cup.
Stir strawberry preserves in a bowl until smooth; spoon about 1/4 teaspoon per cupcake over cream cheese.
Gently press strawberry preserves and cream cheese into the cake batter with a spoon.
Bake in preheated oven until cupcake tops spring back when lightly touched, 18 to 20 minutes.
Cool in the pans for 10 minutes before removing to cool completely on a wire rack.
Spread cream cheese frosting over completely cooled cupcakes and garnish with strawberry slices.

recipes.title: Plum Good Chicken Thighs
steps: Finely chop 2 tablespoons of green onions and set aside for the garnish. Cut remaining green onions into 1-inch pieces.
Toss chicken thighs with five-spice powder and salt in a bowl.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add chicken thighs and cook until browned, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate, leaving drippings in the skillet.

Cook green onion pieces in the drippings until lightly browned, about 4 minutes. Stir in plum jam, chicken broth, and balsamic vinegar. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and return thighs to the skillet. Cook until syrupy, turning a few times to coat, about 5 minutes. Garnish with reserved green onions.

recipes.title: Hatch Chile Corn
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste
steps: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat, and lightly oil the grate.
Cook corn and chile pepper on the preheated grill until corn is slightly charred and chile pepper is blistered, about 20 minutes.
Place chile pepper in a resealable plastic bag. Let steam until softened, about 5 minutes. Peel skin off chile pepper and chop.
Cut corn kernels off the cob into a large bowl. Stir in chopped chile pepper, goat cheese, lime juice, salt, and black pepper.

recipes.title: Amazing Chocolate Quinoa Cake!
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a rectangular cake pan.
Blend quinoa, butter, eggs, milk, and vanilla extract together in a blender until smooth.

Combine sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together in a large bowl. Stir quinoa mixture into sugar mixture until batter is well combined. Fold chocolate chips and pecans into batter; pour into the prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean, 40 to 45 minutes. Cool cake on a wire rack.

recipes.title: Dr. D'S Killer Salsa
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir onion, bell pepper, and garlic in the hot oil until the onion is translucent, 5 to 7 minutes. Dust the onion mixture with cayenne pepper and transfer to a bowl; set aside to cool.
Toss avocado, tomato sauce, lemon juice, olive oil, coriander, and cilantro together in a large bowl. Add onion mixture and gently mix to combine.
Cover bowl with plastic wrap; refrigerate until cool, at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dad'S Simple Steak Marinade
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic, minced, or more to taste
steps: Whisk together the vegetable oil, soy sauce, red wine, Worcestershire sauce, and garlic in a bowl, and pour into a resealable plastic bag.

To use the marinade, place the meat in the bag, coat with the marinade, squeeze out excess air, and seal the bag. Marinate in the refrigerator 8 hours to overnight. Discard the marinade after it has been used.

recipes.title: Chocolate Frosting Iii
steps: In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine chocolate, butter and milk. Bring to a boil, stirring frequently. Remove from heat and beat in confectioners' sugar, salt and vanilla. Beat until smooth, adjusting consistency with milk or sugar, if necessary.

recipes.title: Sweet And Spicy Pumpkin Turkey Pasta
steps: Spray a deep skillet with cooking spray. Add onions and cook over medium heat until translucent, about 3 minutes. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add ground turkey and cook until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.

Pour chicken broth into the skillet and bring to a boil. Add pumpkin puree, milk, chipotle peppers, sugar, sage, black pepper, cinnamon, coriander, pumpkin pie spice, and nutmeg. Reduce to a simmer; cook until pasta ready.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil; add 1 tablespoon salt and rotini. Cook the rotini at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes; drain.
Stir cooked pasta into the skillet with the turkey-pumpkin sauce until evenly coated.

recipes.title: Resa'S Chocolate Peanut Butter Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 3/4 cup white sugar, or to taste
8 miniature chocolate covered peanut butter cups, unwrapped
steps: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).

Whisk sugar, cinnamon, salt, ginger, and cloves together in a small bowl. Beat eggs together in a large bowl; stir in pumpkin and sugar mixture until just combined. Slowly pour evaporated milk into pumpkin mixture and stir until combined.
Arrange peanut butter cups, up-side down, into the graham cracker crust. Pour pumpkin mixture over peanut butter cups in pie crust.

Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) and continue baking until a knife inserted in the center of the pie comes out clean, 40 to 50 minutes. Cool completely on a wire rack, about 2 hours. Serve immediately or refrigerate.

recipes.title: Apple Brie Bites
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.

Press seams of puff pastry sheet together. Cut sheet into quarters and then each quarter into six pieces. Use a rolling pin to flatten each piece of pastry into a square shape. Place the squares into 24 greased mini muffin cups.
Put about 1/2 teaspoon of Brie, 1 teaspoon of apple butter and 1/2 teaspoon of chopped pecans into each muffin cup.
Bake for 13-15 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Chef John'S Creamy Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 pound fresh shiitake mushrooms, stemmed and sliced
salt and ground black pepper to taste
9 tablespoons freshly shredded Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, divided
steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir white and shiitake mushrooms in the hot oil with a pinch of salt until until the juice from the mushrooms evaporates and the mushrooms are browned, about 10 minutes.

Stir garlic into mushrooms and cook for 1 minute; pour in sherry and cook until wine is nearly evaporated. Mix chicken stock into mushroom mixture; season with salt and black pepper. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat, and cook until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
Pour cream into mushroom mixture, stir to combine, and simmer for 5 minutes. Mixture will foam and thicken slightly.

Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil. Stir in the fettuccine, bring back to a boil, and cook pasta over medium heat until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain but do not rinse pasta; transfer to a large serving bowl and keep warm.
Stir thyme, chives, and tarragon into mushroom sauce and turn off heat; mix 1/2 cup Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese into sauce until cheese has melted.

Pour all the mushroom sauce and half the mushrooms over pasta, reserving about half the mushrooms in the skillet. Toss pasta in sauce until coated; top with remaining mushrooms and remaining 1 tablespoon Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese for garnish.

recipes.title: Yogurt Chicken
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Place yogurt in a small bowl and stir until creamy smooth. Add lemon and stir together. (Note: If you do not stir the yogurt first, the lemon juice will make the yogurt curdle.) In a separate shallow dish or bowl combine the bread crumbs, garlic powder and salt to taste; mix together.

In a 9x13 inch baking dish place 1 scant pat of butter or margarine for each chicken breast. Rinse chicken breasts and pat dry. Dip each breast in the lemon/yogurt mixture, then in the bread crumb mixture (coating completely but not heavily).

Place coated chicken in the baking dish and top each breast with a full pat of butter or margarine. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour. Let cool for 5 to 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cup Pie
ingredients: 1 (3 ounce) package non-instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (3.9 ounce) package instant chocolate pudding mix
steps: Combine vanilla pudding mix with 2 cups milk; prepare according to package directions. As pudding heats up, add peanut butter. Stir constantly until peanut butter is melted and mixture is smooth and thickened. Pour mixture into pie crust.

Mix chocolate pudding mix and 2 cups milk according to package directions. Allow to set up 5 minutes, then pour over peanut butter pudding layer. Chill several hours before serving. Garnish with whipped topping if desired.

recipes.title: Microwave Oven Peanut Brittle
steps: Grease a baking sheet, and set aside. In a glass bowl, combine peanuts, sugar, corn syrup, and salt. Cook in microwave for 6 to 7 minutes on High (700 W); mixture should be bubbly and peanuts browned. Stir in butter and vanilla; cook 2 to 3 minutes longer.
Quickly stir in baking soda, just until mixture is foamy. Pour immediately onto greased baking sheet. Let cool 15 minutes, or until set. Break into pieces, and store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Ginger-Spiced Cucumbers
steps: In a serving bowl, stir together the red wine vinegar, mirin, brown sugar, ginger and lime juice. Add the cucumber and onion, and toss gently to coat. Chill for 30 minutes to blend flavors before serving.

recipes.title: White Beans And Peppers
ingredients: 1 yellow gypsy (bull horn) sweet pepper, chopped
1 (15 ounce) can great Northern beans, drained
steps: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in onion and sweet pepper, and cook until tender. Mix in beans. Season with oregano, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until beans are heated through.

recipes.title: Coconut Sorbet
steps: Pour coconut milk into a container. Fill the empty can halfway with water and add to the coconut milk. Whisk in sugar until dissolved. Stir in coconut flakes.
Cover and freeze until chilled, about 30 minutes.
Pour coconut mixture into an ice cream maker and churn according to manufacturer's instructions until soft and creamy, 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Salpicon
ingredients: 4 ounces chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 (12 ounce) package warm corn tortillas, or as needed
steps: Preheat oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C).

Sprinkle kosher salt and 1 teaspoon black pepper over the fatty side of brisket. Spread tomato paste over entire brisket. Place brisket, fat-side up, in a heavy pot; pour in enough water to cover brisket. Add halved onion, carrot, celery, 1/2 of the cilantro, and garlic to the pot. Bring liquid to a boil. Cover pot with a lid or aluminum foil and transfer to oven.
Bake in the preheated oven until brisket is very tender, about 6 hours.
Blend chipotle peppers in adobo sauce in a a food processor until finely chopped. Add vinegar to peppers and continue processing; drizzle olive oil into mixture until smooth.
Remove brisket from liquid and cool slightly. Slice meat across the grain into 2-inch slices; shred thoroughly with a fork.

Combine shredded meat, chopped onion, tomato, remaining cilantro, and pepper mixture in a large bowl; season with salt and pepper. Serve meat mixture with corn tortillas and top meat with Monterey Jack cheese.

recipes.title: Wonderful Margarita
ingredients: 2 fluid ounces frozen orange juice concentrate
steps: Blend ice, tequila, limeade concentrate, margarita mix, orange juice concentrate, and triple sec in a blender until smooth.
Pour margaritas into glasses and garnish with a lime slice.

recipes.title: Ground Turkey, Black Bean, And Kale Soup
ingredients: 6 cups peeled and cubed butternut squash
1 (15 ounce) can great Northern beans, drained and rinsed
1 (15 ounce) can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 (15 ounce) can butter beans, drained and rinsed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
steps: Combine turkey, red onion, celery, water, garlic, and ginger in a large pot over medium-high heat. Saute until vegetables are soft and turkey is no longer pink, about 10 minutes. Add broth, butternut squash, kale, great Northern beans, black beans, butter beans, basil, thyme, and cumin and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer until vegetables are tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Melt In Your Mouth Marinade
steps: In a small, nonporous bowl, combine the soy sauce, olive oil, garlic, mustard powder and ginger. Mix well, cover and refrigerate until ready to use on your favorite meat.

recipes.title: Butter Mints
ingredients: 3 drops green food coloring, or as needed
steps: Butter a 10x15 inch jellyroll pan, and place in the refrigerator.

In a heavy saucepan, combine the sugar, water, and butter. Bring to a boil over high heat. Stir occasionally with a wooden spoon. When the mixture starts to boil, reduce the heat to medium, cover, and cook for 3 minutes to allow the steam to wash the crystals that form on the insides of the pan. Uncover, and heat the mixture to 250 to 265 degrees F (121 to 129 degrees C), or until a small amount of syrup dropped into cold water forms a rigid ball.

Remove from the heat, and stir in the peppermint oil and food coloring. Be sure to keep your face away from the steam as the odor is very strong. Pour into the chilled pan. Let stand undisturbed for several minutes.

Use a rubber spatula to gently fold the edges of the hot candy into the center to soften. Continue folding until the candy is cool enough to pick up with your hands. Butter your fingers, and pack the candy into a ball. Begin stretching and pulling. Continue stretching and pulling until the the candy becomes porous and satiny, about 5 minutes.
Pull the candy into a 1/2 inch thick rope, and cut into 1/2 inch pieces using greased scissors. Let the candy cool completely, then store in an airtight tin for at least 24 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Cake Vodka Balls
ingredients: 1/4 cup confectioners' sugar, or as needed
steps: Stir melted vanilla chips, white sugar, vodka, and corn syrup together in a bowl; mix in vanilla wafers. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until chilled, at least 1 hour.
Pour confectioners' sugar into a shallow bowl. Form vanilla wafer mixture into 1-inch balls and roll in confectioners' sugar to coat.

recipes.title: Raw Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 2/3 cup coarsely chopped green bell pepper (optional)
3 tablespoons red or white wine vinegar
steps: Combine cauliflower, olives, bell pepper, pimento peppers, onion, and celery in a large bowl.

Combine oil, lemon juice, vinegar, salt, sugar, and black pepper in a small jar with a lid. Close jar and shake until dressing is combined. Pour over vegetables. Marinate cauliflower salad in the refrigerator for 2 to 4 hours.

recipes.title: Peach Freezer Jam
steps: Combine peaches and sugar in a bowl. Mix well and let stand, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes. Stir pectin into lemon juice in a small bowl. Add pectin mixture to the peaches. Stir jam constantly until sugar is completely dissolved and no longer grainy, about 3 minutes.

Pour jam into food storage containers, leaving 1/2 inch space at the top for expansion during freezing. Cover and let stand at room temperature until set, about 24 hours. Refrigerate for up to 3 weeks or in the freezer for up to 1 year. Thaw in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Pretty Pomegranate Salad
steps: Place the spinach and arugula leaves into a mixing bowl. Add the onion, mandarin oranges, and pomegranate seeds. Toss gently by hand to mix.

recipes.title: Kitty Kat Bars
steps: Put graham cracker crumbs, brown sugar, white sugar, butter and milk into a saucepan and bring it to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes.

Put a layer of buttery round crackers in a 9x13 inch pan and pour 1/2 of the graham cracker crumb mixture over it. Put another layer of crackers and pour the remaining mixture. Add last row of crackers.
To Make Topping: Melt over low heat the butterscotch chips, chocolate chips, and peanut butter. Melt at low heat and spread over the top.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken Bundles
ingredients: 1/2 cup cheese-flavored crackers (such as Cheez-It Duoz Sharp Cheddar and Parmesan(R)), crushed
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Grease a 9x12-inch baking dish.

Place a chicken breast between two sheets of heavy plastic (resealable freezer bags work well) on a solid, level surface. Firmly pound the chicken breast with the smooth side of a meat mallet to a thickness of 1/4 inch. Repeat with the other chicken breasts.
Melt the butter in a small skillet, and cook the mushrooms until they begin to brown, about 8 minutes. Set aside. Beat egg in a shallow bowl. Place the cracker crumbs in another shallow bowl.

In a bowl, mix together the mushrooms, cream cheese, 1 cup of Cheddar cheese, and Parmesan cheese; spread the mixture generously over the chicken. Roll the chicken breasts up, dip each into beaten egg, and roll the bundles in cracker crumbs. Place into the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle the bundles with the remaining 1/4 cup of Cheddar cheese.

Bake in the preheated oven until the chicken is cooked through, the filling has melted, and the crumbs are golden brown, about 30 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of a roll should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Corned Beef Brisket And Cabbage
ingredients: 4 cups water, or as needed to cover
1 head cabbage, cut into bite-size pieces
steps: Place corned beef with fat side down into a large slow cooker and pour enough water over corned beef to cover. Cook on High until beef is tender, about 3 hours.
Place potatoes into a large pot, cover with water, and stir in salt to taste; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain.
Place a steamer insert into a saucepan and fill with water to just below the bottom of the steamer. Bring water to a boil. Add cabbage, cover, and steam until tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
Melt butter in a saucepan and stir honey and horseradish mustard into butter. Bring to a boil and remove from heat.
