steps: Mix the softened cream cheese and Cool Whip until smooth.
Place some of the pie cubes in the bottom of a 4 quart trifle dish or your favorite tall 4 quart glass bowl. You want it to cover the bottom, but it doesn't have to be perfect.
Spread part of the cream cheese/Cool Whip mixture over the pie cubes. (Again it does not have to be perfect).
Drizzle the caramel topping on top. Sprinkle on some chopped pecans and Heath bits. Place more pie cubes.
Drizzle on the chocolate topping. Sprinkle on more chopped pecans and Heath bits.
You can repeat layers as many times as you like or until your bowl is full.
Cover and chill for at least 1 hour or up to 8 hours before serving.

Note: You can find the chocolate Heath bits in your grocery store but it may be seasonal. They do have the plain brickle bits most of the year. You also may need to alter the quantity of ice cream topping depending on your taste and size of your bowl.

recipes.title: Puff Pastry Lemon Tart With Raspberry-Chambord Sauce
ingredients: 2 Tablespoons Chambord Raspberry Liqueur (or Other Brand)
FOR THE PUFF PASTRY LEMON TART:
1 whole Sheet Of Puff Pastry, Thawed
steps: For the Raspberry-Chambord Sauce:
Mix the cornstarch and lemon juice in a small bowl until combined and smooth, and set aside.

Heat the raspberries and sugar in a pan over medium heat. Stir the cornstarch mixture into the raspberries and cook until the mixture bubbles and thickens. Remove from the heat and mix in the Chambord.
Put a sieve over a bowl and use the back of a spoon to press the mixture through the sieve and strain out the raspberry seeds. Refrigerate the strained sauce until you're ready to use it.
For the Puff Pastry Lemon Tart:
Preheat your oven to 390 F. Line an 8x12-inch baking pan with parchment paper.
Place the thawed puff pastry, stretched out just a bit (or you can roll it a little), into the pan. Fold the excess edges of the dough over just a bit.
Slice the lemons as thinly as possible and remove the seeds. Coat the sliced lemons in the sugar and layer them on top of the pastry.
Sprinkle the slivered almonds on top.

Bake for about 15 minutes, or until the pastry just barely begins to turn golden. Then turn on the broiler with the oven door ajar, for just 30 seconds or so. Remove it from the oven and allow to cool just a bit.
Serve with vanilla ice cream (optional) and drizzle on the Raspberry-Chambord Sauce.
Recipe slightly adapted from Sweet Paul Magazine.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter And Banana Ice Cream
steps: Peel bananas then cut bananas into slices. Put them in a dish and put it into the freezer for 1 hour. Take it out of the freezer ten minutes before you start to soften slightly.
Add bananas to food processor and blend until smooth. Add peanut butter and cocoa powder. Blend until mixed and serve!

recipes.title: Cherry Ripe Bars
ingredients: 7 ounces, weight Milk Coffee Biscuits (plain, Sweet Biscuits)
10 ounces, weight Glace Cherries, Finely Chopped
1 can (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk
steps: Grease a 9x13" pan and line it with baking paper, leaving some paper overhanging at the ends to make the bars easier to lift out once chilled.
Crush biscuits in a food processor until they become fine crumbs.
Mix biscuit crumbs, coconut and cherries in a large bowl. Add melted butter, condensed milk, vanilla and food colouring and mix until very well combined.
Press mixture evenly into the prepared pan using your fingertips. Cover and refrigerate until chilled and firm (at least 3 hours).

Once bars are firm, prepare the topping. Melt chocolate and butter in a pan over extremely low heat, stirring constantly. Remove bars from fridge and spread chocolate mixture evenly over the top of them. Refrigerate again until chocolate is set (about 1 hour).
Once chocolate is set, using a dry, hot knife, cut the bars into the desired number of pieces.
Store covered in fridge.

recipes.title: Banana Bread And Butter Pudding
ingredients: 12 ounces, fluid Half And Half Or Single Cream
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a small baking dish (just big enough to hold three sandwiches tightly). Dot the dish with half of the raisins. Split the vanilla pod and scrape out the seeds. Add the leftover pod, seeds and cream to a small sauce pan. Heat on medium to medium high heat until warm but not yet boiling. Remove from the heat and allow the vanilla to steep for at least 30 minutes or until the mixture is room temperature.

Spread one side of each slice of bread with the butter. Thinly slice the banana and make three banana sandwiches. Trim the crusts off the sandwiches and cut the sandwiches into triangles. Place the triangles in the dish; they should overlap a little.
Whisk the eggs and sugar together until smooth. Remove the pod from the cream and whisk into the egg mixture. Pour over the bread. Top with the remaining raisins.
Place the dish inside a larger pan with tall sides. Pour boiling water into the outer dish until it comes about halfway up the inner dish. Bake for 30-35 minutes.
Burrell suggests serving hot with pouring cream (light whipping cream will do).

recipes.title: Grits That Worked
steps: In a small bowl, stir both types of cornmeal, sugar, and salt.
In a saucepan over medium heat, bring to a boil the chicken broth, half-and-half, and water. Whisk in the cornmeal slowly. Continue whisking often over low heat for 20-30 minutes.
Stir in 1 to 2 tablespoons butter, and season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.

recipes.title: Orange Peel Candy
steps: To prepare oranges, remove peel from the orange the best way you know how. I have a little orange peel tool, but you can slice your orange in quarters and then peel off the skin.
In a large pot, put orange peels with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and boil uncovered for 30 minutes. Drain and repeat twice.

In a separate saucepan, bring 1 cup sugar, the 1 1/2 cups water and salt to a boil. Continue boiling for about 2 minutes until sugar is dissolved. Add prepared, drained peel (from above) to the syrup. Bring to a boil again, then reduce heat. Simmer uncovered for about one hour. Drain any remaining liquid.

Allow orange peel to cool in a single layer on a foil-lined baking sheet for at least an hour. Cut into strips. Sprinkle with the remaining 2 cups of sugar, tossing to coat. Let stand in the foil-lined baking sheet overnight, until dried (about 12 hours). I prefer to store this on the counter, unsealed. When you store it in an airtight container, it can get sticky and you have to add more sugar to dry it up.

recipes.title: Carrot Salad
ingredients: 2 whole Apples (pink Lady Works Well), Peeled, Cored And Chopped
steps: Using your peeler or a grater, shred carrots into a bowl.
Add raisins and apples.
In a separate container, whisk the remaining ingredients.
Combine salad and dressing.
This can be eaten right away, or put it in the fridge for up to three days.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Root Beer Float
ingredients: 1 cup Vanilla Bean Ice Cream (Or Frozen Vanilla Yogurt)
12 ounces, fluid Your Favorite Root Beer Soda Pop
steps: In a tall chilled glass, add ice cream or frozen yogurt. Slowly add soda and top with whipped cream (I use Reddi-whip) and a dusting of confectioners sugar. Serve with a straw. Add more soda as needed to sip up all the goodness!

recipes.title: Coconut Nutella Fudgsicles
steps: Combine ingredients in a small pot and whisk on low heat until thoroughly combined. Pour into molds, place the tops on and freeze upright for 8 or more hours.
When ready to eat, defrost a bit under some warm running tap water until the pops loosen against the molds. Enjoy immediately.

recipes.title: Applesauce With Honey And Rosemary
ingredients: 5 whole Apples, Peeled, Quartered And Cored
steps: Thinly slice the apples and place them in a large saucepan. Pour the water and honey over the top, then add the rosemary.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat and let cook covered for 15-20 minutes or until the apples are very soft and can be smashed with the back of a spoon.

Mash the apples with a potato masher or puree with an immersion blender depending on the consistency you want. Add salt to taste. Reduce the heat to medium low and let the apples cook uncovered another 8-10 minutes or until all the liquid evaporates and the applesauce thickens.
Cool and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Coco Banana Date Pops
ingredients: 1 cup Sweet Cream Of Coconut (or Coconut Cream)
1 Large Ripe Banana, Peeled And Chopped
steps: Soak dates in hot water for about 5 minutes to soften them. Remove dates from the water and add to a high-speed blender along with coconut milk, yogurt, banana, and cinnamon. Blend ingredients together until smooth.
Pour into 6 to 7 popsicle molds and freeze until solid, about 4 hours or overnight.
To unmold, dip the popsicle molds in running water or leave out for a few minutes.
Recipe adapted from Once Upon a Cutting Board.

recipes.title: Dad’S Salmon Sauce
steps: Place all ingredients in a small sauce pan and heat for 15 minutes over low heat. Baste salmon steaks or fillets with the mixture as you barbeque.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Caramel Hot Cocoa
steps: In an oversized mug, microwave milk for 1 minute. Add cocoa powder and stir well. Add caramel sauce, stir again. Garnish with whipped cream if desired.
Sit back, sip and enjoy!

recipes.title: Honey-Baked French Toast
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.

In a large bowl, add beaten eggs, cream, vanilla, and cinnamon. Whisk well. Coat each slice of bread on both sides and transfer each slice to a nonstick baking sheet pan in a single row. Place into the hot oven on the middle rack and bake 5 minutes each side.
Plate and drizzle honey over. Delicious!

recipes.title: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
steps: Preheat oven to 350F.
Peel and slice sweet potatoes into slices that are about 1/4 inch thick, then cut the slices into sticks about 1/4 inch wide.
Soak the cut potatoes in water for about 10 minutes and then drain them on paper towels.
Next, put them in a zip top bag, add olive oil, garlic powder, chili powder, paprika, kosher salt and corn starch. Shake well to coat.

Oil a cookie sheet and spread out the fries in a single layer. Bake at 350F for 15 minutes. Turn the fries with a spatula after 15 minutes are up. Turn the oven up to 450F and bake for another 10 minutes. Last turn the top broiler on for about 5 minutes to finish crisping the fries.

recipes.title: Peach Almond Breakfast Quinoa
ingredients: 2 cups Blue Diamond Almond Breeze Almond Milk, Original
steps: Place a cup of quinoa in each bowl. Set aside.
In a medium saucepan, whisk together almond milk, cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla. Heat until warm. Pour mixture over the top of the quinoa.
Top with sliced peaches and serve immediately. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Malibu Sunset
ingredients: 2-1/2 ounces, fluid V8 Diet Splash Tropical Blend
1 ounce, fluid Ocean Spray Diet Cranberry Juice
steps: Combine all ingredients in a glass with ice and stir.

recipes.title: Mango Moscato Smoothie
steps: Place ingredients in blender and blend for approximately 20 seconds or until completely smooth. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Café De Olla
ingredients: 4 ounces, weight Piloncillo (or 1 Cup Packed Dark Brown Sugar)
steps: In a medium saucepan, mix together coffee grounds with water, sugar and cinnamon and bring to a boil. Simmer for 5-10 minutes until the sugar has fully dissolved.
Pour into a French press or strain through a fine mesh strainer. Pour into mugs and enjoy.

recipes.title: Cointreau Daiquiri
steps: If using mint, muddle it with the simple syrup in a cocktail shaker before adding the remaining ingredients. Throw in some ice cubes. Shake well and pour into a chilled cocktail glass.

recipes.title: Maple Glazed Carrots, Lighter
ingredients: 2 pounds Carrots, Peeled, Cut Into 1-1/2 Inch Slices On Diagonal
steps: In a large saucepan over medium heat, add all the ingredients. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the syrup-butter mixture reduces down to a glaze and the carrots are soft, about 15-20 minutes. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Avocado Toast
steps: Toast a piece (or two) of your gluten-free bread in the toaster.
In a small bowl, mash about 1/2 cup avocado.
Spread the avocado mixture onto the piece of toast.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Kale & Garbanzo Bean Soup
ingredients: 15 ounces, weight Can Garbanzo Beans, Drained And Rinsed
1 dash Salt And Pepper, to taste
steps: 1. In a large pot, add 1 Tablespoon of oil and 3 cloves garlic over medium heat. Saute until garlic is lightly browned. Add 1 cup chicken stock and kale to pot. Stir to ensure kale is coated with garlic/broth mixture. Cook kale on medium-high for 5 minutes covered, and then 5 minutes longer, uncovered, until wilted. Add salt and pepper to taste.
2. While kale is cooking, in a separate pan over medium heat, saute remaining olive oil, remaining garlic, zucchini, mushrooms, and onion until tender (3-5 minutes.)

3. Once kale is cooked, add zucchini, mushroom, and onion mixture to the large pot with the kale. Add garbanzo beans, remaining chicken stock and nutmeg. Cook on medium heat for 10 minutes, until the flavors have married and the garbanzo beans are soft but not mushy. Add salt and pepper if necessary and enjoy!

recipes.title: Yummy Green Fluff
ingredients: 1 package 3.9 Oz Package Of Pistachio Instant Pudding Mix
1 can 20 Oz Can Of Crushed Pineapple
steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the pudding mix with the undrained pineapple.
2. Add Cool Whip and blend.
3. Stir in nuts and marshmallows.
4. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Cajun Potato Wedges
steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425 F. Slice potatoes into 1/2 inch thick wedges that are half the length of the potato.
2. Make spice mixture: combine all spices and mix together in a small bowl.

3. Spray a rimmed cookie sheet with olive oil cooking spray. Place potatoes on the cookie sheet. Toss the potatoes with the olive oil. Sprinkle spice mixture over potatoes and toss. Spread them into a single layer.
4. Cook for 25 minutes. Flip them over and cook for another 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Martini
ingredients: 1/2 ounces, fluid Simple Syrup (store Bought Or Homemade)
Ice, To Fill Your Cocktail Shaker
Grated Lemon Zest, Optional For Garnish
steps: Add the vodka, lemon juice, simple syrup and cream into a cocktail shaker, fill with ice and put the lid on. Shake well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with the whipped cream topping and a bit of lemon zest, if desired.

recipes.title: Berry Blood Orange Sangria
ingredients: 4 cups Red Wine, Such As Cabernet Sauvingnon
1 cup Blood Orange Juice Or Regular Orange Juice
steps: In a large pitcher, combine red wine, orange juice, brandy, cranberry juice, pineapple juice, club soda, blood oranges, blueberries, blackberries, and apple slices.
Pour into Mason jars or glasses.
For an even better sangria, let it sit for a few hours to overnight in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake Cookies
ingredients: 19 ounces, weight Pillsbury Sugar Free Devil's Food Cake Mix
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix all the ingredients together except the sprinkles.
Roll the dough into about 1" balls and flatten a little bit with the palm of your hand.
Place about 2 inches apart on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Press sprinkles into the cookies.
Bake for 10 minutes or until bottom is very lightly brown.

recipes.title: Easy Tzatziki Sauce
ingredients: 1 container Plain Greek Yogurt (7 Oz. Size)
1/2 whole Cucumber (seeds Removed And Finely Diced)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, mix until fully combined and enjoy!
Serve on gyros, burgers or just about anything!

recipes.title: Basic Latkes
steps: Lightly spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray. Place paper towels on a plate or a stack of newspapers. Preheat oven to 200°F.

Place potatoes and onions in a dish towel or cheese cloth or large paper towel. Roll it up and squeeze out any excess moisture. Unwrap potatoes and onions and sprinkle with lemon juice, salt and pepper. In a bowl whisk the matzo into the eggs and then stir in the potato mixture until evenly incorporated.

Heat oil and butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Scoop up small handfuls of potatoes, and smash flat into a pancake. Careful add pancakes to hot oil/butter (no more than 4 or 5 to the pan or it will cool off and they will be soggy), fry for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden and crisp. Transfer to paper towels on a cookie sheet to drain. Once drained, either serve immediately or transfer to a cookie sheet and keep warm in the preheated oven until you are ready to eat.

This recipe is easily halved or doubled or tripled. At our house during the holidays, it isn't unusual for me to make 5 batches of this and have no leftovers at all. You can make this with frozen shredded potatoes but you need to let them completely thaw before starting.

recipes.title: Coleslaw
steps: Several hours in advance or the day before, mix together all ingredients except cabbage mix. Just put them into a bowl and put it into the refrigerator for several hours or overnight. This gives the sugar time to dissolve. An hour or two before serving put the cabbage into a large bowl and pour dressing over it. Mix well. Stir a couple of times before serving.

recipes.title: Balsamic Vinaigrette
steps: Pour vinegar, sugar and wine into a small sauce pan. Turn heat to medium low and leave it alone. After it begins to simmer, watch it every once in a while. When you tip the pan, it should begin to coat the bottom, and it will reduce by almost half, giving you a little over 1/3 cup when it's finished. Pour into a glass measuring cup and allow to cool.
Add the oil, mustard, salt and pepper and whisk vigorously. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for a week.

recipes.title: Heirloom Tomato And Olive Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cups Kalamata Olives, Halved And Pitted
steps: Squash the tomatoes with your hands into a bowl. Or you can rip them apart with your fingers. Add the halved olives and let the mixture sit for 2-3 minutes.
Add the vinegar and oil, mix until well combined. Add black pepper to taste.
Lastly, tear some basil leaves and throw them in at the last minute. Serve alongside some crusty bread to mop up the juice.
Recipe adapted from Jamie Oliver.

recipes.title: Banana Reeses Cookies
ingredients: 1 box (18 Oz. Size) Chocolate Cake Mix
steps: In a mixing bowl, cream the butter, bananas, and vanilla. Slowly add the cake mix. The dough will be very thick. Stir in the chocolate chips, peanut butter cups, and Reese's pieces by hand carefully.
Drop by spoonfuls onto a baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 10-12 minutes. Cool on the pan for about 1-2 minutes and then remove to a wire rack to cool completely.
Store in an airtight container. Makes about 30 cookies.

recipes.title: Creamless Tomato Basil Soup
ingredients: 3 cans (14.5 Oz. Size) Low Sodium Diced Tomatoes
steps: In a large Dutch oven over medium heat, heat one tablespoon of the olive oil until just shimmering. Add in minced onions and stir occasionally until they begin to soften. Add in minced garlic and stir until it becomes fragrant.
Next up, pour in diced tomatoes and chicken stock. Bring to a slow boil, and with an immersion blender, puree until nearly smooth.

Add in your red wine and the remainder of the olive oil, pureeing until incorporated. This will take a few minutes, maybe upwards of 5 minutes so just be patient. But if your'e not getting all you want out of your immersion blender, or you're that impatient, break out your real blender and pour it all in there, and as it blends, pour the remaining olive oil into the hole in the lid. This will ensure the olive oil is incorporated into the soup.
Once that's done, you can pour it back into the pot and let it come to a slow simmer slowly for 20 minutes. Finally, add in the additional minced basil and salt and pepper to taste.
Serve piping hot with cheesy toast and you've got a fabulous meal with much less guilt than the cream-based tomato soup would provide. Here's to healthiness and a warm snuggly nap-time tummy!

recipes.title: Gooey Butter Cake
ingredients: 1 package (18.25 Oz. Box) Yellow Cake Mix
steps: This cake is put together in two parts, "crust" and "filling."
Crust:

Mix yellow cake mix, egg, and the butter together until combined. It will be pretty thick. Turn into a greased 9x13 inch pan and pat evenly along the bottom and halfway up the sides. This is a good job for kiddos, if you've got a couple you can yoke into service.
Filling:
Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar, eggs and vanilla until combined. Mixture will be thick but pourable. Pour it onto your crust and use a spatula to level it out. Lick the bowl-it's that good ...

Bake for 35 minutes at 325 degrees. Don't over-bake-it's not called gooey butter cake for nothin'! It will jiggle slightly when you pull it out of the oven, but will set as it sits a bit. When it's cooled slightly, dust with a little powdered sugar. This almost ends up being more of a "bar" cake, which makes it a really good finger food dessert at get-togethers. No fork needed for these yummy things!

recipes.title: Gingersnap Apple Crisp
ingredients: 4 whole Apples, Peeled, Cored And Sliced
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Spray a pie plate or shallow casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray. Arrange sliced apples and Craisins in a dish and drizzle with melted butter.
In a Ziploc bag, crush gingersnaps to an even consistency. Add softened butter and brown sugar and mix thoroughly. Sprinkle mixture over the apples in the casserole.
Bake for 35 minutes. Great served warm with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Monkey Bread
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 F. Get out an angel food cake pan with a removable bottom and set it on top of a rimmed sheet pan.
Cut each biscuit into quarters.
In a medium bowl, combine the sugar, coconut and cinnamon and mix well.
Add the dough into the sugar mixture a few pieces a time and coat them well with the mixture.
Meanwhile melt the 1 cup of butter in a small sauce pan over low heat.
Brush the inside of the angel food cake pan lightly with the melted butter, then begin to add about 1/3 of the dough balls.
On top of the dough balls, sprinkle a third of the pecans, coconut and chocolate chips
Repeat with remaining dough balls. Then top that layer with the remaining nuts, chocolate and coconut.
When everything is in the pan, return the melted butter to the stovetop and add the 1 cup of brown sugar. Cook on low until the sugar melts into the butter.
Pour the sugar and butter mixture evenly over the entire pan.
Bake the monkey bread in the oven for about 45 minutes. Then remove it from the oven and let it sit for another 10-15 minutes, or until cool enough to handle.
Turn out the cake, inverting it onto a serving platter and pull it apart to experience pure, buttery heaven!

recipes.title: Garlic And Parmesan Grilled Hasselback Potatoes
ingredients: 2 Tablespoons Olive Oil (or More Depending On How Large The Potatoes Are)
steps: 1. Bring grill temperature to medium-high and oil the grill grate.

2. Cut a thin slice from the bottom of each potato to ensure that the potato won't roll around on you when cutting. Cut into the potato vertically leaving about 1/3 of an inch at the bottom. If you would like, place the potato between two wooden spoons to stop you from cutting all the way through the potato. Repeat this cut every 1/8 of an inch until you have reached the end of the potato. Repeat with remaining potatoes.

3. Rinse potatoes under cool water, fanning out the cuts to rinse out the slices. Place potatoes on a microwaveable plate cut side up. Microwave for 5 minutes. Flip potatoes over and microwave for another 5 minutes. Let potatoes cool so that you can comfortably handle them.

4. Brush potatoes with olive oil making sure to get it into most of the slits for maximum crispiness! Place pieces of garlic into the slices of the potatoes. Sprinkle the tops of the potatoes with Parmesan cheese, thyme, salt and pepper, fanning the slices open as you go.
5. Place potatoes on grill grate. Cover the grill and cook 20-25 minutes or until center is soft and egdges are crispy.

recipes.title: Easy Chocolate Peanut Butter Mousse
ingredients: 7 ounces, weight Dark Chocolate Chips, (70% Cocoa)
2 cups Coconut Milk (or Any Non-dairy Milk)
4 Tablespoons Roasted Chopped Peanuts, For Topping
steps: Roughly chop chocolate into small chunks. Melt in the microwave or using a double boiler.
In a high-speed blender, add dates, vanilla, and milk. Blend on high until smooth.
Add melted chocolate, peanut butter and blend again until well combined. The consistency will be very runny first, but it will set and get denser once you let it chill in the fridge
Pour it into jars, cover and refrigerate overnight. Top with chopped peanuts and enjoy!

recipes.title: Creamy Vegan Tomato Basil Soup
ingredients: 1 Tablespoon Olive Oil, Plus More For Baking Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Clean each potato (I like to clean my potatoes with white vinegar), rub each potato with a drop of olive oil and salt, and wrap in foil. Cook for potatoes for 1 hour or until soft and tender.

While potatoes are cooking, heat a large stock pot over a medium heat. Add olive oil, diced onion, and roughly chopped carrots. Add basil and crushed red pepper flakes. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the carrots are soft.
Add crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth, and roughly chopped potatoes (skin and all!) to stock pot. Bring everything to a boil, and then, simmer for 30-45 minutes (the longer, the better).
Blend soup with an immersion blender, adding vegetable stock or water if needed to reach desired consistency. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve warm and preferably with homemade croutons!

recipes.title: Courgette & Mint Relish
ingredients: 2-1/3 kilograms Courgettes/zucchini, Diced 1 Cm, Skin On, Sprinkled With Salt And Left Overnight, Covered
450 grams Green Beans, Stems Removed, Chopped 1 Cm Length
10 jars Canning Jars With Lids And Rings (450g/1 Pound Size)
steps: Salting the diced courgettes overnight will extract some of the water in the flesh and enable them to absorb more of the pickling liquid. So don't skip this step. The next day, when you are ready to use it, rinse it under a cold running tap and then it drain thoroughly.
First, sterilize ten 450g/1 pound jam jars, lids and rings according to standard safe canning practices. If you have new lids no further prep is needed.

In a large canning pot, mix all of the ingredients except the mint, and simmer gently until reduced and soft, around 20 minutes. Then add half of the mint and cook gently for 30 minutes. Remove from heat. Add the remainder of the mint and stir thoroughly.
Pour into the hot, sterilized jars and seal according to standard safe canning practices. Allow the mixture to mature for 2-3 weeks before eating.
This relish will keep without refrigeration for up to a year. It's best if you refrigerate after opening. It doesn't need to be refrigerated, but it is nice having the relish cold with hot food.

recipes.title: Light Tiramisu
ingredients: 1 whole 8 " Angel Food Cake, Cut In 1" Cubes
2 packages Cappuccino Mix (Sugar-Free And Decaffeinated Vanilla), Divided
8 ounces, weight Non-Fat Cream Cheese, Softened
1 package Sugar Free Instant Vanilla Pudding
2 cups Light Or Fat Free Cool Whip
steps: Place cake cubes in an ungreased 13x9 pan. In a small bowl dissolve 1 package cappuccino mix in 1/2 cup milk. Sprinkle over cake.

In small bowl, beat cream cheese until soft. In another medium bowl, mix vanilla pudding mix, remaining 1 1/2 cups milk, and the other package of cappuccino mix until thickened. Mix in cream cheese and then fold in Cool Whip. Spoon this mixture over the cake. Chill for 3 hours or overnight. Just before serving, sprinkle with cocoa.
You can also put this in a large trifle bowl if you like.

recipes.title: Chopped Greek Salad
ingredients: 1 whole Cucumber Quartered And Sliced Into Bite Sized Pieces
1 container (12 Oz. Size) Mixed Cherry, Grape And Cocktail Tomatoes
1/4 cups Red Onion, Thinly Sliced Into Bite Sizes Pieces
1 head Romaine Lettuce Chopped Into Bite Sized Pieces
4 ounces, weight Feta Cheese, Cut Into Bite Sized Cubes
steps: Chop vegetables and place in a large bowl. Add cubed feta cheese and olives.

For the dressing, in a small bowl, whisk vinegars, mustard, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper. Then slowly drizzle in both kinds of oil as you whisk. Continue to whisk dressing until oil is fully incorporated.
Right before you are ready to serve, add salad dressing to salad and toss.
Notes:
1. The dressing can be made ahead of time and it will keep for up to 2 weeks when covered and stored in the fridge.
2. If I am making this salad as a main course, then I like to serve my salad with pita bread and hummus.

recipes.title: Chicken Taco Salad
steps: Mix the salad ingredients in a large bowl. Make the dressing in a small bowl by mixing ingredients together. Toss the salad with dressing. Serve and enjoy!

recipes.title: Aunt Rocky’S Denver Scramble
ingredients: 3 ounces, weight Fully Cooked Ham Steak, Chopped (I Use Farmer John)
2 stalks Green Onions. Chopped And Divided
steps: Melt butter in a medium skillet over medium heat. Add chopped ham and most of the onions, reserving some of the green tops for garnish. Cook until onion whites are translucent and ham is beginning to brown.
While ham and onions cook, mix eggs with cream in a small bowl. Just stir lightly, do not whisk together.

When ham and onions are ready, pour egg mixture over all, gently stir with a spatula to mix. Turn sections over in the pan as it cooks until eggs are done. Don't overcook or the eggs will get dry and tough.
Serve on plates. Top with cheese, and garnish with reserved green onion tops.

recipes.title: Broccoli With Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoons Black Pepper, More To Taste
12 ounces, weight Velveeta Cut Into Cubes
4 ounces, weight Sharp Cheddar Cheese, Grated
4 ounces, weight Monterey Jack Cheese, Grated
steps: Steam the broccoli florets for 3 to 4 minutes, or until slightly tender but not overly soft.

To make the sauce, heat the butter and milk over medium-low heat until hot. Stir in the garlic (if using), seasoned salt, black pepper, salt, and chili powder. Add the Velveeta and stir it until it's melted and creamy. Stir in the cheddar and Monterey jack until melted. Taste and adjust seasonings.
Serve ramekins of cheese sauce with warm broccoli florets.

recipes.title: Feta Yogurt Dressing
ingredients: 6 Tablespoons Crumbled Feta, Plus More For Serving
steps: Combine mayonnaise, feta, yogurt, oil and lemon juice in a blender and blend until smooth. Season with pepper and salt, if needed. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Blueberry Quinoa Protein Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a muffin tin with liners.

Combine uncooked quinoa and coconut milk in a medium pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, turn heat to low and cover the pot. Cook until milk is absorbed, about 20-25 minutes. Let cool.
In a large, microwave-safe bowl, melt coconut oil and honey in the microwave until smooth and liquid.
Add eggs and beat well. Add vanilla extract and pinch of salt. Mix until well-combined. Add cooled quinoa and stir until well mixed.
Place diced dates in a small bowl and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon protein powder and mix around. This will coat the dates, so they don't stick together and all clump together in one muffin.
Add remaining protein powder, dates and blueberries into the quinoa mixture. Mix well.

Divide mixture between 7 muffin cavities filling almost full. Bake until top is golden brown, puffed up and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and dry, about 17-20 minutes. Let cool in the pan completely. Devour.

recipes.title: Ayran (Turkish Yogurt Drink)
ingredients: Fresh Herbs And/Or Seasonings, For Added Flavor (optional)
steps: Place yogurt, water, sea salt and optional flavoring ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Enjoy!
Note: Optional flavoring ingredients include chopped dill, parsley, cilantro, mint, grated cucumber, minced garlic, ground cumin, black pepper.

recipes.title: Beefy Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 cans (28 Oz. Can) Baked Beans (I Use Bush's Original)
8 ounces, weight Chunky Picante Sauce. I Use Pace
steps: Preheat oven to 350F.
Place the ground beef and chopped onion into a frying pan and stir together until browned and all the pink disappears. Drain well.
Pour the ground beef mixture into a 13x9 casserole dish. Drain the cans of baked beans and pour them into the dish. Add the remaining ingredients and stir until well combined.
Bake at 350F for about 45 minutes. It should be hot and bubbly. Serve while hot right next to your hotdogs, sausages, or even hamburgers. You're just having hamburger with your burger. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Homemade Chocolate Truffles
ingredients: Powdered Cocoa, Sprinkles And Chocolate, For Coating
steps: Start by breaking the chocolate into small pieces and set aside. Then, in a saucepan, pour heavy cream and butter and set on medium heat, stirring constantly. When it's about to boil, pour the cream mixture over the chocolate. Add rum and wait 1 or 2 minutes. Using a spatula, stir the chocolate until it completely melts. Refrigerate the mixture for at least 3 hours.
After 3 hours, using an ice cream scoop and your hands, make small balls and decorate as you wish. I used powdered cocoa, sprinkles and chocolate.

recipes.title: Easy Peasy Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 1/2 boxes (18 Oz. Size) Butter Pecan Cake Mix
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.

Melt butter. Pour canned peaches into your cobbler baking dish, juice and all. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over the top of the peaches. Pour on the melted butter, trying to cover as much of the dry mix as possible. Don't worry if some mix is dry; it will absorb the moisture as it cooks. Do not stir.
Place in the oven and bake 35-45 minutes until top has browned! Allow to cool and rest 5 minutes or more, if you can-it smells so good.

recipes.title: Strawberry Mango Mojito
steps: Using a mortar and pestle, mash together the strawberries, sugar, and mint. Let sit for 5-10 minutes so the strawberries release their juice. Divide this mixture into 2 rocks glasses. Divide the rum and Sprite between the glasses. Stir and add ice.

Note: Feel free to play around with this. I love mango rum, but you could try a variety of different rums. Make yours as strong or as weak as you prefer (this is on the stronger side). If you like sweeter drinks, use more brown sugar.

recipes.title: Corn And Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 cups Fresh Corn Kernels, From 3 Cobs
1 can (15 Oz. Can) Black Beans, Rinsed And Drained
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook the corn kernels until they are lightly browned in some spots, about 5 minutes.
Once the corn is done, transfer it to a large bowl and stir in the black beans, the diced jalapeno, the parsley, lime juice and avocado. Stir together gently. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
You can serve it right away a bit warm or chill it in the fridge.
You can substitute in cilantro for the parsley if you like!

recipes.title: Honey Peach Frozen Yogurt
ingredients: 2 whole Peaches, Peeled, Pitted And Diced
FOR THE HONEY PEACH FROZEN YOGURT
1 whole Peach, Peeled, Pitted And Diced
1 teaspoon Vanilla Bean Paste Or Vanilla Extract
steps: In a saute pan over medium high heat melt the butter. When the butter is melted add the diced peaches and saute for 2 minutes. Add in the honey and cinnamon and saute another minute. Remove from the heat and let the peaches cool completely.
In a blender, add the yogurt, half-and-half, diced peach, honey, and vanilla bean paste. Blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker and freeze per the manufacturer's instructions.
Remove the frozen yogurt from the machine and put it into a Tupperware or freezer-safe glass dish. Stir the sauteed peaches into the frozen yogurt. Seal it and freeze for 1-2 hours before serving.
Notes: Because this is low fat frozen yogurt it will freeze hard. Let the frozen yogurt sit out for 10-15 minutes before scooping. This recipe yields 2 1/2 cups of frozen yogurt.

recipes.title: Hot Mulled Apple
ingredients: 1 liter Apple Juice Or 8 Apples Juiced
steps: Place apple juice, maple syrup, cinnamon sticks, cloves, oranges and lemons in a large saucepan. Heat gently for about 10 minutes
Discard cinnamon sticks, cloves, oranges and lemons. Pour carefully into mugs and enjoy.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Salad With Feta, Fresh Corn, And Blueberries
ingredients: 3 stalks Celery (inner Light Green Stalks), Finely Diced
1/4 whole Medium Red Onion, Finely Diced
steps: Place chicken breasts into large plastic storage bag. Pound with a mallet or rolling pin to flatten to 1/4 inch uniform thickness. Season chicken with salt and pepper.

Heat grill and drizzle chicken with olive oil. Grill chicken on both sides until done, about 7 minutes per side. (Rotate halfway during grilling each side to ensure pretty grill marks.) Remove from pan. Allow to cool.
With a very sharp knife, shave kernels off each corn cob. Combine with the onion and celery. Set aside.
Mix together mayonnaise, sour cream, feta, and half-and-half. Stir in sugar, squeeze in lemon juice, and add salt and pepper. Stir, then taste. Add more salt if necessary; do not undersalt!

Slice chicken on the bias to create flat, randomly shaped pieces. Throw into a bowl with celery, onion, and corn. Stir to combine. Pour half the dressing over the ingredients and toss gently. Add more as desired, but don't overcoat the salad; should be light!
At the end, toss in the blueberries to lightly coat them in the dressing. Serve, then sprinkle individual helpings with feta.

recipes.title: Baked Pear Slices
ingredients: 4 whole Pears, Cored And Thinly Sliced
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F. Spray a baking sheet (or two, if you need more room) with cooking spray.
In a bowl, mix cinnamon, nutmeg and brown sugar together. Add the pears to the bowl and toss gently to coat. Lay them on baking sheet(s) and cook for about 30-40 minutes, or until browned.

recipes.title: Garlicky Green Beans In Olive Oil
ingredients: 12 ounces, weight Fresh Or Frozen Green Beans
1 pinch Kosher Salt And Freshly Ground Black Pepper
steps: Microwave or steam green beans according to package directions; drain. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add garlic, reduce heat and saute about 30 seconds.
Add green beans and toss to coat. Season with kosher or sea salt and freshly ground black pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Smoothie
steps: Combine all the ingredients in blender, except ice, and blend until smooth. Add ice according to desired thickness.

recipes.title: Cranberry Pomegranate Mojito
steps: Add sugar, water and fresh cranberries into a small saucepan. Simmer over low heat for about 5 minutes until the cranberries start to open up and the sauce gets very thick. Set aside and allow to cool slightly.

Meanwhile, add half of the mint and lime juice to each glass. Muddle together to extract the flavor of the mint. Add half of the rum, pomegranate juice and cooled cranberry reduction to each glass. Top with sparkling water and ice serve immediately.

recipes.title: Jet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 bags Frozen Potatoes O'Brian (10 Ounce Bags), Thawed
1 container Sour Cream (16 Oz), Or To Taste
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees (F).

Combine the thawed potatoes, sour cream, 1/2 of the cheese, green onions, salt and pepper in a large bowl. Spoon into a 13x9 baking dish and sprinkle the remaining cheese on top. Bake for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
*Prep time does not include thawing the potatoes. I usually take them out of the freezer the night before. If you like more cheese, don't hesitate to add a little more than the recipe calls for.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Mint Chocolate Chip Green Smoothie
steps: Place all ingredients except the chocolate chips in a Blendtec and press the "smoothie function." Once there is only 15 seconds remaining until your smoothie is ready, stop the Blendtec and add the chocolate chips. Blend on the "smoothie" setting for an additional 15 seconds and devour.

recipes.title: Mocha Coffee
steps: Add cocoa, sugar, and milk to a coffee cup and stir. Add hot coffee. Top with whipped cream and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Apple & Cheese Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F.

In a 9x12x3 inch baking dish, add apple juice, sliced apples (I use a mandoline to slice apples), cinnamon, and nutmeg. Gently stir. Add cheddar cheese evenly across the top and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake 15 minutes. Remove foil and bake uncovered for an additional 5 minutes to crisp up the top of the cheese.
We love this served with a pork roast. Hope you'll enjoy!

recipes.title: Moscato Mixed Berry Pie
ingredients: 1 whole Single Pie Crust, Homemade Or Store-bought
6 cups Mixed Berries (I Used Half Strawberries And A Combination Of Blackberries And Raspberries)
steps: Prepare pie crust and bake as directed in recipe or package instructions. I used Pillsbury, which is baked at 450°F for 10 minutes. Once pie crust is baked, let cool.

Meanwhile, in a large skillet, add berries, sugar, lemon, cornstarch, and wine. Cook over medium-low heat until thick and juicy, about 8-10 minutes, stirring constantly. Let berries cool and add to cooked pie crust.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Peach Sangrias
steps: In a medium bowl combine sliced peaches and sugar and stir until sugar is dissolved. Add in lemon juice and peach juice. Pour mixture into a pitcher followed by the wine. Mix well and chill for 5 hours or overnight.
Serve over ice.

recipes.title: Strawberry Milkshakes
steps: In a mixing bowl combine the sliced strawberries, sugar and vanilla extract and stir to combine well. Set aside for at least 20 minutes and up to 1 hour.
In a blender (or food processor if you don't have a blender) place the strawberries, ice cream, and milk. Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and top with whipped cream (if desired) to serve. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Awesome Blueberry Sauce With Orange Zest
steps: Cook blueberries, sugar, and water on medium-high heat for 10 minutes stirring occasionally. Turn heat off and stir in the orange zest/rind. Serve sauce immediately while warm. Just spoon onto your pancakes, waffles or French toast. Makes approximately 1 1/4 cups of sauce. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Park City Stew
ingredients: 1 can (10.75 Oz. Can) Cream Of Celery Soup
1 can (10.75 Oz. Can) Cream Of Chicken Soup
1 package (about 1 Oz. Package) Lipton Onion Soup Mix
steps: Layer stew meat, potatoes, carrots, and celery in a crock pot. Mix soups, tomato sauce, and onion soup mix then pour mixture over the items in the crockpot. Place bay leaves on top of mixture. Cook in the crock pot on low for 6-8 hours. Remove bay leaves before serving. Enjoy!
We like to top this with Worcestershire sauce. It adds some nice flavor. Enjoy with your favorite garlic bread.

recipes.title: Avocado Relish
ingredients: 2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice, Freshly Squeezed If Possible
steps: Peel and dice the avocados. Put in a bowl and squeeze the lemon juice over them to keep them from turning brown.
Seed and dice the tomatoes and add to the avocados.
Chop the green parts of the green onions and add to the mix.
Stir and serve immediately or refrigerate for up to an hour.

recipes.title: Peach Vodka
steps: Put all of the peaches into a quart-sized mason jar. Pour the vodka over the fruit, filling to the top. Cover and shake.
Allow to infuse for 5-7 days, shaking the jar one or two times a day.
Strain the vodka by covering the jar with a piece of cheesecloth or a jam bag and pouring the vodka into a mixing bowl.
Squeeze the peaches gently to get more of the vodka out.
Set the infused peaches aside, and pour the vodka back into the jar. Store in the freezer for 3-4 months.
If you'd like, you can use the boozy peach pieces in a cocktail or sangria. Otherwise, discard the peaches.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter & Banana Chocolate Milk
ingredients: 6 ounces, fluid Thick Greek Vanilla Yogurt (Like Chobani)
1 Tablespoon (heaping) Unsweetened Cocoa Powder, Plus More For Dusting
steps: Toss all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth. Pour in a tall glass and dust with a little extra unsweetened cocoa powder. Serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Protein Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Place all ingredients except the chocolate chips in a blender. Blend mixture approximately 30-45 seconds or until completely smooth. Using a spatula or spoon, lightly stir in the chocolate chips
Spray a standard muffin tin with cooking spray and scoop batter into muffin tin (I use an ice cream scoop). Bake 12-14 minutes or until muffins have set.

recipes.title: Chocolate Ganache Cookie Bars
ingredients: 1 package Store Bought Chocolate Chip Cookie Mix (1 Lb 1.5 Oz Size)
steps: 1. Mix cookie mix, 1 stick of softened butter, and egg together completely. Spread in the bottom of a 13" x 9" pan. Bake for 20 minutes on 350 degrees F. Cool completely
2. Mix vanilla pudding, 1/4 cup melted butter, powdered sugar and milk together. Pour over cooled cookie bars. Chill in fridge.

3. Scald cream (put in a saucepan over medium heat and heat to just below the boiling point - you don't want it to boil) and remove from heat. Add chocolate, stirring tell completely melted. Pour over the top of the chilled bars.
4. Refrigerate to chill the top chocolate ganache layer. Then serve!

recipes.title: Pineapple Sugarcane Spa Water
ingredients: 8 cups, 7 tablespoons, 3/4 teaspoons, 1/3 pinches Filtered Water
steps: Combine all ingredients in a large pitcher. Stir.
The longer the water sits, the more the pineapple and sugarcane flavors will infuse into it.

recipes.title: Lavender Honey Ice Cream
steps: Yields 1 1/2 quarts of ice cream.
Prep ice cream bowl according to manufacturer's instructions, putting it in the freezer the night before if the bowl requires long term freezing.
In a large bowl, whisk together egg yolks and sugar until light yellow and a smooth consistency. Set aside.

In a large saucepan over medium-high heat, stir together cream, milk and vanilla until just simmering. Turn off heat, and pour lavender buds into the milk mixture. Cover the pan and let the mixture steep for about 5-7 minutes. Strain milk into a bowl through a fine mesh strainer to remove buds. Throw away buds.

Gently temper the egg/sugar mixture by whisking in 1/4 cup at a time of the heated milk/cream mixture. When all of the milk/cream has been whisked into the egg mixture, return it all to the saucepan and heat and whisk until it reaches a slight simmer. Pour the whole mixture into a large bowl, cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least two hours, or overnight.

Before putting mixture into ice cream maker, gently whisk in some purple food dye to desired lavender color. Then pour the mixture into the prepared ice cream maker and freeze according to ice cream maker's instructions, about 20 minutes or so depending on manufacturer and model.
During the last 30 seconds of mixing, pour in the 1/4 cup of honey and allow it to swirl into the ice cream.
Devour immediately or put into a freezer safe container and freeze to harden, about 2 hours. Then devour, drizzling additional honey over the top if desired.

recipes.title: Cake Batter Bark Blondies
ingredients: 6 ounces, weight Semi-sweet Or Dark Chocolate
2 Tablespoons Sprinkles, Or More To Taste
1 box Yellow Cake Mix (18.75 Ounce Box)
steps: For the bark:
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Chop semi-sweet chocolate and place in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave in 20-30 second intervals, stirring frequently and continuing to heat until chocolate is completely smooth. Pour chocolate onto the prepared baking sheet and spread with an offset spatula. Freeze for 20 minutes.

Chop white chocolate and melt in the same way. Once melted, add the 3 tablespoons of cake mix, stirring with a whisk until mixed. Let it set for a few minutes to thicken. Pour white chocolate over the layer of semi-sweet, spreading with an offset spatula as well.
Immediately pour sprinkles over top. Return to freezer while you make the blondies.
For the blondies:
Preheat oven to 350 F. Spray an 8x8-inch pan with cooking spray.

In a large bowl, combine the box of cake mix, oil, eggs, and milk stirring until well mixed. Pour half the batter into your prepared 8x8 pan. Break apart the frozen bark and lay the pieces on top of your brownie batter. You will have left over bark. It's perfect to snack on while blondies are baking! Spread the remaining batter over your chocolate bark. Bake for 25 minutes. Remove it from the oven and let it cool completely. Cut and enjoy!
Blondies adapted from Taste and Tell; Bark recipe adapted from Sweetapolita.

recipes.title: Easy Cream Cheese Cherry Danish
ingredients: 1 box (17.3 Oz. Size) Puff Pastry, Thawed Overnight In Refrigerator
1 can (20 Oz. Size) Cherry Pie Filling
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Set aside.

Cut each sheet of puff pastry into 6 squares/rectangles. Blend together the cream cheese and granulated sugar until smooth. Scoop a tablespoon of cream cheese into the center of each square. Top with 3 cherries from the pie filling.
Pull the corners of the pastry together in the center, pinching to seal. Be sure to leave the slits open on the side for ventilation.
Place the pastries onto the parchment-lined cookie sheet. Beat the egg with the water. Use a pastry brush to brush the pastries with the egg wash. Sprinkle the pastries with raw sugar.
Back at 375°F for 15-25 minutes, until golden brown.

While the pastries are baking, make the glaze. Whisk together the confectioners' sugar, milk, and vanilla. If the glaze is too thin, add more confectioners' sugar. If it is too thick, add a tiny bit more milk.
Drizzle pastries with the glaze while they are still warm from the oven. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Nutella Marshmallow Bars
ingredients: 1 pound Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough, Divided
steps: Spray pie dish with cooking spray, cover bottom of pie dish with a thin 1" layer of cookie dough. Spread Nutella over cookie dough, spread marshmallow fluff and swirl into Nutella with fork to combine.
Flatten out 1" chunks of remaining cookie dough and randomly place on top of Nutella and marshmallow fluff. Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Marshmallows
ingredients: 1/4 cups Unsweetened Cocoa, Plus More To Dust The Pan
steps: Lightly spray 9x9 baking pan. Dust with cocoa. Set aside.
In a small bowl, combine gelatin and 1/2 cup water; set aside. In a separate bowl, combine cocoa and boiling water. Set that aside.

In a saucepan, combine sugar, corn syrup and remaining 1/2 cup cold water. Cook over medium high heat stirring constantly until sugar has dissolved. Once dissolved, cook mixture without stirring until a candy thermometer reaches 240°F.
In a bowl, beat egg whites, extracts and salt on high speed until stiff peaks form. Set aside.

In a stand mixer, combine both gelatin mixture and cocoa mixture. Slowly beat in hot syrup. Beat all the ingredients on the highest speed of your mixer until marshmallow triples in volume (color will lighten, too) and mixture becomes thick, about 4-6 minutes. Gently fold in egg whites.
Pour marshmallow into prepared pan. Sprinkle with grated chocolate. Chill for at least 2 hours or until set. Cut into squares.
To dip into chocolate, melt candy coating. Dip bottoms of each marshmallow into chocolate. Set upright on a wire rack to set. Store in an airtight container.
Recipe adapted from Paula Deen.

recipes.title: Chunky Tomato Basil Soup
ingredients: 3 cans Peeled Whole Tomatoes In Juice Or Tomato Puree (28 Ounce Cans)
2-1/2 ounces, weight Fresh Basil Leaves, Chopped
steps: In a large pot, saute the onion in the olive oil over medium heat until browned, about 10 to 12 minutes. Add the garlic and saute another 3 minutes.
While onion and garlic are cooking, open your canned tomatoes and dice the whole tomatoes.
Add the diced tomatoes and juices (or tomato puree) to the pot, along with the remaining ingredients (including butter). Stir to combine ingredients.
Bring mixture to a full boil then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 45 minutes.
Optional: You can blend part or all of this soup for a smoother consistency, though I like it chunky.
Serve with grated Parmesan on top. Seriously. It's the bomb!
Recipe adapted from jovialfoods.com recipe for Homemade Tomato Soup.

recipes.title: Roasted Sweet Potatoes With Fresh Thyme
ingredients: 4 whole Medium To Large Sweet Potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 425 F.
Scrub and peel the potatoes, then cut into 1-inch cubes, or smaller if you like things more bite sized.
Spray a large rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray. Arrange the potatoes in one layer. I had to use 2 pans for this amount of potatoes, but it depends on the size of your baking sheet!
Spray the tops of the potatoes with more cooking spray, and sprinkle lightly with salt all over.

Roast the sweet potatoes for 20-30 minutes until dark on the edges and cooked through. Cooking time will depend on how small the potatoes are and how hot your oven is. You could dice them really small and they'll cook in 15 minutes or so. When done, they'll be tender when pierced with a fork. If you're using two pans, swap racks halfway through so that each pan gets equal time closest to the heat. Whether you are making one or two pans, shake the potatoes halfway through cooking.
When the potatoes are cooked, sprinkle them with fresh thyme leaves. Sprinkle a bit more coarse salt on top, and serve with your favorite dinner.

recipes.title: Grilled Peaches & Pecans
steps: Brush the peach halves with maple syrup. Smear butter on a grill or grill pan over low heat. Place the peaches cut side down onto the grill/grill pan and cook them low and slow for a few minutes, rotating them 90 degrees halfway through. Monitor the cooking temp and keep it low enough that the maple syrup doesn't burn.
Remove the peaches when they're slightly soft but not mushy and have great grill marks. Brush a little extra maple syrup over the tops.
Serve them:
Over ice cream: Scoop ice cream into a bowl, then cut peach halves in half. Press the slices into the ice cream, sprinkle pecans all over the top, and drizzle on extra maple syrup.
Over Greek yogurt: Spoon Greek yogurt into a small dish. Press slices of grilled peaches over the top. Sprinkle with pecans and drizzle on maple syrup.
Over salad: Toss mixed greens with your favorite salad dressing and crumbled blue cheese. Pile high on a platter and place grilled peach halves all over. Sprinkle with pecans.
Other ideas: Serve grilled peaches and pecans over pancakes, French toast, crostini, etc.

recipes.title: S’More Pops
steps: 1. Freeze brownie bites for 1 hour.
2. Crush crackers; place in sandwich bag, seal, then roll with a rolling-pin or something heavy to crush the graham crackers and place in a small bowl.
3. Poke sticks into brownies to create pops.
4. Place marshmallow creme in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on high for about 10 seconds.
5. Dip frozen brownie in marshmallow cream, turning to coat. Roll in the crushed crackers. Place in a heavy glass until ready to serve. Repeat process with the remaining brownie bites.
Idea adapted from Target "So Camping" publication.

recipes.title: Snowballs
ingredients: 1 whole (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk
steps: Mix all the ingredients (except coconut) together in a large bowl. Using your fingers, roll mixture in to balls the size of a ping pong ball and then roll in coconut.

Store in airtight container in the freezer for up to... hmm... I can't say, they never last long enough to find out! These can be served directly from the freezer as they are still chewy even when frozen... I actually prefer mine that way!
* Note: if mixture is too sticky to roll just add more graham cracker crumbs.

recipes.title: Japanese Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 whole Small Carrot, Peeled And Sliced Into Small Half-circles
1 whole Small Japanese Cucumber, Washed And Sliced Into Small Circles. No Need To Peel Or Cook.
steps: 1. Peel and cut potatoes into 1-inch pieces. Put them into a pot then fill with enough water to cover all the potatoes. Boil until potatoes are soft, about 15 minutes. Insert a fork to test.

2. At the same time, place two eggs in a separate pot and fill with water. Add some salt (so that it peels easier) and bring to boil. Cook for 15 minutes from the time the water started boiling. Or use your preferred method for hard boiling eggs. If you can, use eggs that aren't brand new (4-5 days old) as fresh eggs are a nightmare to peel. When 15 minutes are up, quickly transfer eggs out of the boiling water into a bowl and fill with tap water. Peel immediately and slice them up. No need to mash yet. We'll mash them all together later.

3. When potatoes are done, pour away all the water and put the pot (with the potatoes still in it) back on the stove on medium heat. Heat to evaporate away the rest of the moisture, about 30 seconds. Be careful not to burn the pot. Remove pot from heat. Transfer the potatoes into a large bowl and set aside.
4. Add the carrots into the same pot and fill with enough water to cover them fully. Boil for 5 minutes, until carrots are cooked but still crunchy. Drain and set aside.
5. Using a whisk, mash the potatoes but leave some chunks for bite. Add the salt, mixed vegetables, cooked carrots, cucumber, mayonnaise and black pepper, and mix well.
6. Add the sliced egg and mash them up in the same bowl. Don't mash them too fine. Add the sugar and mix everything together.
7. Chill in the fridge until ready to serve. I put it in the freezer and it was cold and nice in less than half the time!
I adapted this fabulous Potato Salad recipe from Just One Cookbook.

recipes.title: Mummy Cookies
ingredients: 1 Batch Of Your Favorite Homemade Or Store Bought Sugar Cookie Dough (enough To Make About 30 Cookies Cut Out In An Egg Shape Or Circle Shape About 3 1/2 Inches In Length)
steps: For the cookies:

Roll out your cookie dough on your work surface. Cut your cookies with an egg-shaped cookie cutter. Bake on a parchment paper lined baking sheet according to the recipe you are using. Cool cookies completely on a cooling rack, then decorate with the cookie icing.
For the icing:

Combine powdered sugar, milk, corn syrup and lemon juice in a bowl and mix by hand or with a mixer until smooth. If your icing is too thick, add a little more milk. If it is too thin, add a little more powdered sugar.
For the assembly:

Turn cookies with the narrow end of the eggs facing you (the narrow side is the chin). I use a plastic squeeze bottle for decorating these. So fill it with the icing. I snipped a little bit of the plastic tip off to give me a thicker stream for certain cookies. You can also use a baggie with a tiny snip cut off of one corner.

See related blog link for more visuals of the decoration process. Take the squeeze bottle and zig-zag the white frosting up and down the cookie (to look like the mummy gauze). When you get to where you want to put the eyes, make a sideways "v" for the opening. Move on to the next cookie. Once all cookies are decorated, go back and place 2 drops of icing that are about the size of a chocolate chip where you want the eyes to be (in the middle of the sideways "v"). I recommend that you do 5 cookies at a time and quickly plunk in the inverted chocolate chips for the eyes pressing them into the cookie a bit.

When you are done decorating all the cookies, go back and drizzle some more "bandages" and give it a second coat, for a better effect. Allow the icing to dry completely before storing them. This can take a few hours.

These are perfect for kids to decorate as well. It doesn't get easier than this when it comes to decorating cookies. My 9-year-old daughter had fun helping decorate these. Hope you and your family have as much fun with these as we did!
Happy Halloween!

recipes.title: Jalapeño Pie
steps: Begin by preheating the oven to 400°F.
Chop the ends off the jalapenos, cut length wise, de-seed and toss with a little olive oil (maybe 1-2 teaspoons). Place on a baking sheet, cut side down and bake in a 400°F oven for about 15 minutes.
While the peppers are roasting, shred your cheeses.
Prep the cilantro by rinsing and giving it a quick rough chop.
Next beat the eggs together along with the salt and pepper.
When the jalapenos are finished roasting, reduce oven to 325°F, and let the jalapenos cool slightly.

When cool enough to handle, peel the skins off of the jalapenos. They should easily peel off; if not, cover with a kitchen towel, bowl or aluminum foil and let steam for another few minutes. Once the jalapenos are peeled, chop them up.
Place the chopped jalapenos in a single layer in the bottom of a greased pie plate, followed by the shredded cheeses, then the cilantro, and finally the beaten eggs with salt and pepper.
Bake in 325°F for about 40 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Honey Bun Cake
ingredients: 1 box (18.25 Oz. Box) Yellow Cake Mix
steps: Preheat oven to 325°. Butter or spray a 13x9" baking pan, set aside.
In a large bowl, combine cake mix, oil, eggs and sour cream. Stir by hand, about 50 strokes will do or until large lumps are gone. Pour half of your batter into prepared pan.

Combine brown sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle evenly over the batter. Spoon the other half of the batter over the cinnamon sugar. Using a knife, swirl so it looks like a honey bun, just in crazy eight patterns or the letter S. You know how to do it.
Bake for about 40 minutes.
To make your frosting just whisk powdered sugar, milk and vanilla until smooth. Pour over the hot cake. Let set up for about an hour.
Your family will thank you for this one.

recipes.title: Creamy Butternut Squash Soup
ingredients: 1 sprig Fresh Rosemary, Leaves Removed From Branch And Chopped
steps: Peel and clean the squash, cut in half lengthwise, remove the seeds and cut it into pieces (no shape in particular, it will all go to the blender anyway). Put squash in a large pot with your garlic. Start cooking it on medium heat for a few minutes. Then add the milk, the cream and the stock. Stir it. Add the rosemary and the salt. Let it cook for about 40-45 minutes on a medium heat. Then check to make sure that your squash is cooked enough, otherwise cook it for a few more minutes. Then use your blender or hand blender to puree your soup. If you blend in a standard blender, make sure to only fill the canister about halfway full for each batch. If you fill it too full, the steam may cause it to explode. Once pureed to your liking, it's ready to serve.

recipes.title: Samoa Milkshake
ingredients: Chocolate Fudge Sauce And Caramel Sauce, Amount As Desired
5 whole Samoa (Girl Scout) Cookies, Broken In Pieces
steps: Toast the coconut in a pan over low heat until it turns a nice golden color. Remove from heat.
Coat the rims of 2 parfait glasses with chocolate fudge sauce and dip the rims in the toasted coconut. Place glasses in the freezer to set.
Using a blender or food processor mix the ice cream, milk, 1/4 cup of toasted coconut and crushed up Samoa cookies together until smooth

Remove cups from freezer and squirt the inside of the glass with chocolate fudge sauce and caramel sauce. Fill cups with milkshake. Top with toasted coconut and chocolate fudge sauce and caramel sauce.

recipes.title: Gingered-Up Carrot Relish
ingredients: 6 grams Cardomom Seeds, Taken From The Pods
1 kilogram Carrots, Topped, Tailed, Peeled And Grated
2 whole Cooking Apples, Peeled, Cored And Grated
30 grams Fresh Ginger, Peeled And Finely Chopped (Adjust To Taste)
2 whole Oranges, Zest Grated, Juice Squeezed
steps: Sterilize seven or eight 125 gram/4 ounce canning jars and lids according to standard safe canning practice.

Place the mustard seeds, coriander seeds and cardomom seeds into a dry heavy bottomed pan and set over a low heat to toast the seeds for a few minutes. This helps to release the oils from the seeds, increasing the flavour.
Add the carrots and apples into the pan, stirring to combine. Add the ginger, orange zest and juice, vinegar and sugar. Heat and stir well to combine and dissolve the sugar.

Cook for around 10 minutes over a low heat to soften the carrots and apple. Then turn the heat up a little and cook until the liquid has nearly evaporated and the mixture is syrupy, around 15-20 minutes. Stir from time to time and take care not to let the mixture burn. Remove from heat.

Pour the mixture into the sterilized jars and seal according to safe canning practices. The shelf life is relatively short. It will keep for up to 3 months in a cool place and should be refrigerated after opening.
The flavour of the relish is amazing. The orange really comes through, finishing with a great big hit from the ginger.
Try stirred into plain yoghurt as part of the relishes to serve with curry.

recipes.title: Candied Lemon Slices
steps: Start by thinly slicing lemon into slices about 1/8-inch thick. Blanch the lemon slices in 2 cups of boiling water for 5 minutes; drain.

Heat 1 cup of water and sugar together; stirring until sugar is dissolved. Add blanched lemon slices and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour. Remove from heat. spray a cooling rack with non-stick spray. Place candied lemon slices on the rack in a single layer to dry for up to 24 hours.
Can be stored in an airtight container between pieces of waxed paper. Use to garnish a variety of drinks and desserts. For larger batches, increase recipe as needed.

recipes.title: Mascarpone & Nutella Phyllo Tarts
ingredients: 8 pieces Phyllo Sheets Cut In Half
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Spray a muffin tin with non-stick spray.
Cut phyllo sheets in half then fold each half over twice so that you create a 4-layer sheet. Then arrange sheets into individual muffin holes.
In a bowl, combine cheese and Nutella until well blended.
Fill each pastry with 1 Tablespoon of the filling. Bake until golden and crispy, 8-10 minutes. Let them cool then serve.

recipes.title: Southwestern Vegetarian Chili
ingredients: 1 whole Medium-sized Sweet Potato, Chopped Into 1/2" Pieces (peel On)
1 whole Green Bell Pepper, Stem And Seeds Removed, Then Chopped
1 whole Red Bell Pepper, Stem And Seeds Removed Then Chopped
1 can (14 1/2 Oz. Size) Black Beans, Drained
steps: Shuck your corn and using a knife, carefully cut the kernels off the cobs. Set the kernels aside.

In a large Dutch oven or stock pot, heat olive oil to medium high and add the chopped sweet potato. Saute about 10 minutes before adding the onion. Saute an additional 8 minutes. Add just a splash of the vegetable stock while the sweet potato and onion are sauteing to give them a little steam. Add the chopped bell pepper and saute another 5 minutes, again adding a splash of vegetable stock to steam the veggies. Add the garlic and cook for another minute.

Add the diced tomatoes, drained beans, corn kernels and the remaining veggie stock. Stir. Add all of the seasonings (chili powder, oregano, salt, cocoa powder, cinnamon, cumin, red pepper and black pepper). Stir to combine all ingredients. Bring the chili to a boil then reduce the heat to medium low and cover the pot. Allow the chili to simmer for 30 minutes before serving it in heaping bowls with your favorite toppings!
Original recipe from Perry's Plate at perrysplate.com.

recipes.title: Avocado Breakfast Sauce
ingredients: 2 whole Avocados, Cut In Half And Pitted
steps: In a food processor or blender, add avocados, agave, lime juice and salt. Blend until smooth, adding water a little at the time if needed, to loosen the sauce. Mix with the fruit salad of your choice.

recipes.title: Carrot Ginger Coconut Soup
steps: 1. Add chopped carrots to a saucepan. Add vegetable stock. Add fresh ginger and garlic. Bring to a boil, and cook until tender. Add more water to keep the carrots covered during the cooking process if needed.
2. When carrots are very tender, remove from heat. Use a submersible blender or add soup in batches to your blender to puree. Add coconut cream, and heat through.

recipes.title: Spicy French Onion Soup
steps: 1. Peel, then slice onions into thin strips.
2. Chop garlic until finely minced.
3. Heat oil and butter in a medium sized pan over medium heat. Once they are hot add onions and garlic.
4. Cook onions and garlic until onions just start to brown.
5. Add beef broth, lemon juice and salt and pepper.
6. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and continue to cook for 20 minutes or until onions are cooked through.
7. Ladle soup into four oven-safe soup mugs.
8. Top with croutons followed by pepper jack cheese and put the mugs under the broiler until cheese is bubbly and starting to brown.

recipes.title: So Simple Hot Chocolate
steps: Add milk, vanilla, sugar and cocoa powder to your pot. Turn the heat on low so as to not scorch the milk. Whisk it until all ingredients are mixed really well. Heat until hot, about 5 minutes.
Pour into favorite mug and sprinkle with cinnamon. Yum!

recipes.title: Easy Tomato Bisque
ingredients: 1 can (400 Gram Can Or Box) Diced Tomatoes With Basil And Oregano
1/2 cans Water (Use The Tomato Gram Or Box To Measure)
1 cup Soy Cream (or Heavy Cream, If You Can Take It)
1/2 teaspoons Minced Garlic (I Use The Roasted Kind That Comes In A Jar)
steps: Put everything in the pot and give it a good stir. Heat on high for about 5 minutes, or until it gets bubbly and warm. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Strawberry Muddy Buddies
ingredients: 1 box (8-serving Size Box) Strawberry Flavored Gelatin
steps: In a large microwave safe bowl, melt chocolate and butter uncovered on high for 1 minute. Stir. Microwave for 15-30 seconds longer if needed. Stir and mix in vanilla. In a large gallon ziploc bag, add powdered sugar and gelatin. Shake to mix up. Add the cereal to the chocolate and mix to coat. Add the chocolate-coated cereal to the ziploc bag and shake until all cereal is covered in powdered sugar. Spread on wax paper and cool for about 15 minutes. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Banana Smoothie
ingredients: 2 whole Bananas, Peeled And Broken In Half
steps: Place bananas in the blender, and layer with the rest of the ingredients. Blend until completely incorporated and smooth, 1- 2 minutes. Pour into desired glasses and enjoy!

recipes.title: Cham-Pom Spritzer
ingredients: 1 can (large 20 Oz. Can) Pineapple Chunks And Juice
1 bottle (16 Oz. Bottle) POM Wonderful Pomegranate Juice
steps: Place enough sugar into a small plate to make sugar rims on your glasses. Run a lemon wedge around the side of your glass and then dip into the sugar, making a sugar rim. Place 4-6 pieces of pineapple into the bottom of the glass. Fill glass with 1/4 of pineapple juice, 1/4 pomegranate juice and then remaining half with champagne. Garnish the rim with a piece of pineapple. Continue until all glasses are assembled!
Cheers!

recipes.title: Grizzle Knuckles
ingredients: 2 cans (14 Oz. Can) Eagle Brand Condensed Milk
steps: Mix coconut, chocolate chips and condensed milk in a large bowl. Slow add graham cracker crumbs a little at a time and blend well. Batter will be very, very thick.
Spread batter into a well-greased 9 x 13 pan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees. Cool and cut into small squares. Yummy.

recipes.title: Death By Drowning In Butter
steps: Preheat oven to 400°. Line a jellyroll or cookie sheet with foil. Spray with cooking spray. Line the crackers on the foil to cover the sheet.

Mix melted butter and brown sugar together. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. This can be done in the microwave, just check it every few minutes. The mixture should be semi-thick. Pour over the crackers. Bake for 5 minutes.
Take it out of the oven and sprinkle with chocolate chips on top. Spread the chips until melted. You might have to put the pan back in the oven for about 30 seconds to help melt the chocolate.
Sprinkle the nuts over the top. Refrigerate until firm. Break into pieces.

recipes.title: Monkey Muffins
ingredients: Leftover Bread Dough (or Refrigerated Biscuit Dough, Cut Into Thirds)
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Add 1/2 teaspoon butter to muffin tins. Sprinkle in sugar and cinnamon.
Roll dough into walnut sized balls (or cut refrigerated biscuit dough into thirds). Place three into each muffin tin.
Top with 1/2 teaspoon butter. Sprinkle on more sugar and cinnamon.
Allow dough to rise, if applicable, or just go ahead and bake for 15 minutes, or until golden and bubbly.
Remove from oven and immediately drizzle plenty of sweetened condensed milk over the top of each one. Be generous! Allow rolls to sit for a little while to absorb sweet, sticky milk.
Scoop out with a spoon and serve to hungry humans.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Pop-Rock Bark
steps: Melt the candy melts in the microwave for 30 seconds, then in 15-second intervals following, stirring after each interval-you can start with 1 minute if you are using dark chocolate candy melts. However, the white burns VERY easily.

Fold in Pop Rocks. Pour onto a waxed paper-covered cookie sheet and let spread, banging the cookie sheet against the table to remove bubbles and spread out the mixture. Let sit for 20-25 minutes at room temperature until set. Break up into pieces.
Makes about 1 pound of candy.

recipes.title: Spicy Caramel Corn
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoons Salt (omit If Using Microwave Popcorn)
1/2 teaspoons Sweet Spice Blend, See Below
steps: Pop popcorn, put in a big bowl.

Put brown sugar, Karo syrup, salt, sweet spice blend, cheyenne powder and butter in a microwave safe dish. Cut up the butter into chunks so it melts better. Microwave for 30 seconds. The butter will be melted at least halfway. Stir to combine. Microwave on high for 2 minutes; stir well. Microwave for 2 more minutes. When the caramel is done cooking, add baking soda and vanilla. Stir it well and then pour it over the popcorn. Mix it up well with a big spoon.

Spread it all out on a piece of foil and let it cool for a minute so it doesn't get stuck in one big clump. The longer it sits out, the firmer it will get, but it won't ever get crunchy-hard unless you bake it.
For crunchy caramel corn, spread out on a cookie sheet (you might need 2 sheets) and bake at 270 degrees for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.

* To make sweet spice blend, simply combine spice blend ingredients in a small bowl. Store in an airtight container. Use any time a recipe calls for cinnamon. It just adds that extra special flavor to anything it is added to. The measurements listed yield 6 tablespoons of spice blend.

recipes.title: Caprese Stuffed Avocado
ingredients: 1/2 cups Regular Or Goat's Milk Mozzarella
steps: Get your avocados ready by slicing in half lengthwise and removing the pit. Very carefully, widen and lengthen the valley made by the pit to create more room for the caprese filling. (Important: do not simply toss the extra bits of avocado. Save them in a small container and throw them over your omelet tomorrow morning.)
Plate the avocado over the bed of greens. Spoon enough pesto into each avocado half to generously coat the inside of the little valley.

Make the balsamic reduction. Put balsamic vinegar and coconut sugar or honey into a small saucepan, and heat on medium until it reduces. Once you have your reduction, put one large ice cube into the reduction and swirl it around the pan for about 20 seconds or until the ice cube is about half melted, then discard it. You don't want to water down the reduction but you do want to cool it off so it doesn't create a weird temperature variation in your dish.

Chop tomatoes and mozzarella. I waited until this point in the process to chop these two because I want them to be as crisp and fresh as possible, but the difference is probably negligible. If you decide to do all your chopping at once, no worries, but don't set the tomatoes and mozzarella pieces in the same dish while you get everything else together because the flavors will meld.
Portion tomato and mozzarella pieces into avocado halves. Drizzle the balsamic reduction over everything, and enjoy.

Serve alongside a small piece of fish, or bacon-wrapped waster chestnuts. Or, you can increase the amount of greens, add an extra half of stuffed avocado, and it's a meal in its own right. This recipe can easily be sized as needed.

recipes.title: Sausage Pancake Bake
ingredients: 1 package Jimmy Dean Or Bob Evans Sausage Roll
steps: Brown sausage in skillet and drain. In a bowl, mix pancake mix, eggs, milk, and vegetable oil together. Add sausage to bowl. Pour into a greased 9x13 pan. Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar on top if desired.
Bake at 375F for 20-25 minutes until it gets a little golden brown on top and an inserted knife comes out clean. Serve with syrup and butter as desired and enjoy!

recipes.title: Turkey Breakfast Sausage
ingredients: 1 teaspoon Olive Oil, Or As Needed
steps: In large bowl mix all of the ingredients except for the turkey and oil. Add the seasonings to the turkey and mix well with your hands.

Heat a sauce pan over medium/high heat, adding a little olive oil to coat. Form 7 small sausage balls and flatten a little, then add to the pan. Cook 10-12 minutes on each side or until internal temperature reaches 165°F.

recipes.title: Smashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1/3 cups Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Plus More For Brushing The Pan
steps: Preheat oven to 450° F.
Boil potatoes in salted water until tender, but before skin breaks, about 15 minutes.
While potatoes are boiling, mix remaining ingredients to make the seasoning mixture. Taste and add salt and frresh cracked pepper to taste.
When potatoes are tender, pour them into a strainer in the sink and then bathe in cold tap water to stop the cooking process.

Lightly brush a large baking sheet with olive oil. Place potatoes about 1 inch apart and lightly smash them, without cutting them into separate pieces. Spoon a little of the seasoning mixture over each potato until the mixture is completely used.
Bake until crispy and golden.

recipes.title: Roasted Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 Tablespoon Olive Oil Or Sunflower Oil
1/3 cups Baby Spinach (We Often Keep This Frozen)
1 bunch Cilantro (or Parsley If You're Not A Fan)
1 Blood Orange Or Regular Orange (or Kumquats, 1 Orange Roughly Equal To 5 Kumquats)
50 milliliters Soy Milk (or Use Your Favourite Vegan Milk)
1/2 teaspoons Garlic Powder (or 1 More Clove Garlic, Chopped)
steps: Cut cauliflower and broccoli into equal-sized pieces.

Heat a frying pan with the oil. Slowly fry the cauliflower. We want it to darken very slowly-raw cauliflower isn't our aim here.10 minutes total should do it. After about 3 minutes, add broccoli to the pan and fry slowly with the cauliflower.

Meanwhile, wash the spinach and cilantro, set them aside. Cut pomegranate in half and deseed. If using kumquats, cut in half and take out the seeds (you can eat the skin). If not using kumquats, segment orange. Cut the radishes into thin slices.
By now the cauliflower and broccoli should be ready. Add them and all the other ingredients (except the pomegranate seeds) into a serving bowl.
Add all the dressing ingredients to another bowl and mix well.
Mix everything together. The salad is ready! Garnish with the pomegranate seeds. If desired, sprinkle with dukkah, sesame seeds or pumpkin seeds.

recipes.title: Vanilla Frosting Surprise (Healthy Secret Ingredient)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons Stevia White Powder (or Other Powdered Sweeteners), Or To Taste
