recipes.title: Strawberry Heart Pillows
ingredients: 1 frozen puff pastry sheet, thawed (1/2 of 397g package)
1 13 cups thawed Cool Whip Topping, divided
4 large strawberries, each cut into 4 slices
steps: Preheat oven to 400F Roll out pastry on lightly floured surface to 10-inch square.
Cut into 16 heart shapes with 2-inch cookie cutter.
Place on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 10 minutes.
Remove to wire rack; cool completely.
Cut each heart horizontally in half.
Spread 1 teaspoons jam onto bottom half of each heart; top with 1 tablespoons of the whipped topping and a strawberry slice.
Cover with tops of hearts.
Drizzle with chocolate.
Serve immediately, or cover and refrigerate up to 1 hour.
MAKE AHEAD: Cooled baked pastry hearts can be stored in tightly covered container at room temperature up to 3 days.
Use to assemble desserts as directed.
HOW TO MELT AND DRIZZLE CHOCOLATE: Place 1 square chocolate in microwaveable bowl.
Microwave on MEDIUM 1 minute, stirring after 30 seconds.
Stir until chocolate is completely melted.
Pour into resealable bag; seal bag.
Snip off one bottom corner of bag; twist top of bag to drizzle chocolate over desert as desired.

recipes.title: Flatiron Steak with Chimichurri Sauce
steps: Prepare outdoor grill for direct grilling on medium.
Prepare chimichurri sauce: In small bowl, with fork, mix parsley, oil, vinegar, water, garlic, oregano, crushed red pepper, and 1/4 teaspoon salt until blended.
Meanwhile, sprinkle steak with 1/4 teaspoon salt to season both sides; place on hot grill grate and cook 12 to 14 minutes for medium-rare, turning over once.
Let stand 5 minutes for easier slicing.
Spray peppers lightly with nonstick spray and place on grill with steak.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes or until charred and tender, turning over once.
Cut steak into 4 pieces; cut peppers into thin slices.
Divide romaine among 4 plates.
Top with steak, peppers, and sauce.

recipes.title: Lime Yogurt Lemon Grass Soup
steps: Prepare lemon grass stalks by peeling off the outer husk and placing on a solid cutting board.
Bruise the stalks with the back of a thick knife.
Wrap each stalk in a piece of cheesecloth and tie with strings.
In a stainless steel saucepan combine the water and sugar and bring to a boil, stirring once to make sure sugar has dissolved.
Add one prepared lemon grass stalk and remove from heat.
Allow lemon grass to steep in syrup until cooled.
In a stainless steel saucepan combine heavy cream and the second prepared lemon grass stalk.
Bring cream to a boil, remove pan from heat and allow to cool.
Remove lemon grass stalks from cream and sugar syrup.
Place yogurt in a large stainless steel bowl.
Whisk in the cool lemon grass-infused cream and lemon grass syrup.
Keep mixture chilled until ready to serve.
Just before serving add lime juice to yogurt mixture.
Adding lime juice too early will cause soup to curdle.
Ladle soup into chilled bowls or flat soup plates.
Place a scoop of lime granita (or sherbet) in the center of the bowl and garnish with lime zest.
Additional accompaniments include gingersnap cookies and/or thinly sliced tropical fruits such as papaya or kiwi

recipes.title: Beach Party Shrimp Saute Recipe
ingredients: 2 lb Medium shrimp, about 60, in shell
steps: In large pan or possibly wok over a camp fire (if at the beach) heat oil.
Add in washe unshelled shrimps and stir-fry for 3 min.
Add in seasonings and remainder ingredients.
Just before serving add in the freshly squeezed lemon or possibly lime juice.

recipes.title: Pork Chops with Apples and Pancetta
ingredients: 3 ounces thinly sliced pancetta, coarsely chopped
2 large Golden Delicious apples, peeled, cored, cut into 1/2-inch-thick slices (about 3 cups)
Four 8-ounce bone-in center-cut pork chops (each about 3/4-inch thick)
steps: In a large nonstick skillet, heat 2 teaspoons of the oil over medium-high heat.
Add the pancetta and cook until crisp and light golden, about 3 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the pancetta and drain on paper towels.
Melt the butter in the same skillet.
Add the apples and sprinkle with the sugar and cook until tender and deep golden brown, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the apples and any juices from skillet to a small bowl.
Sprinkle the pork chops with 1 teaspoon of the salt and 3/4 teaspoon of the pepper.
Add the pork chops and 2 teaspoons of the oil into the same skillet and brown for 2 minutes per side.
Transfer the chops to a plate and cover to keep warm.
Add the remaining teaspoon of oil, cream, brandy, apple juice, thyme and onions to the same skillet and bring to a simmer.
Return the apples and pork chops back into the pan and simmer until cooked through, 10 to 12 minutes.
Season the sauce with the remaining salt and pepper.
Garnish with the reserved pancetta bits.

recipes.title: Italian Love Cake
steps: Mix cake as directed on box.
Pour into greased and floured 9x13 pan.
In separate bowl, combine ricotta, sugar, eggs and vanilla; mix well.
Spoon over top of unbaked cake.
Bake at 350F (180C) for 1 hour.
Cool.
Whip cream.
Mix pudding with milk.
Fold in whipped cream.
Spread over cake.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cranberry Exfoliate
steps: Mix in blender until smooth.
Cover.
Refrigerate 60 minutes and then pull out and let it rest for 15 minutes on the counter.
Pat on clean dry skin (not around the eyes).
Enjoy for 15 minutes and then wash off with warm water.

recipes.title: Honey Dijon Mustard Dressing
steps: Heat vinegar and honey, stirring until honey dissolves.
Cool.
Combine with remaining ingredients in shaker jar.
Shake until completely mixed.
Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Noodle Pudding with Apple
ingredients: 3/4 cup (100 g) currants or raisins, black or golden
3/4 cup (75 g) walnuts or almonds, coarsely chopped
4 tart apples, such as Granny Smiths
steps: Soak the raisins in the rum.
Boil the noodles in lightly salted water until well donerather soft.
At the same time, beat the eggs lightly with the sugar.
Add the walnuts or almonds and the soaked currants or raisins together with the rum and the lemon or orange zest.
Drain the noodles when they are done and stir them in.
Peel, core, and coarsely grate or chop the apples and mix with the lemon juice, then add to the egg-and-noodle mixture.
Mix very well and pour into a loaf pan lined with greaseproof or wax paper brushed with oil.
Alternatively, pour into an oiled baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake in a preheated 350F (180C) oven for about 50 minutes, or until lightly browned on top and turn out.
Variations:
Omit the orange or lemon zest and flavor with 2 teaspoons cinnamon, teaspoon nutmeg, and a pinch of ground cloves.
Some people add 3/4 cup (100 g) chopped candied fruit or citrus peel; some add jam.
This can be served as a side dish to accompany meat.
In that case use very little sugar.

recipes.title: Crunchy Fresh Salad - Healthy & Vegan!
ingredients: 4 tbsp mayonnaise (vegan for a vegan salad)
steps: Slice, dice or shred vegetables to your preference.
Place in large bowl.
Note: Feel free to use different vegetables - cauliflower, kohlrabi, radishes...
In separate bowl, combine dressing ingredients.
Let sit for a few minutes.
Right before serving, pour dressing over vegetables and mix well.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Tuna Fish Salad
steps: Chop all the ingredients: Spring onions, small onion, onion, green chilis, and coriander.
Mash up the tin of tuna fish.
Mix all the ingredients in a bowl and add red chili powder, salt and lemon salt to taste.
Mix all the ingredient again and serve with olive oil

recipes.title: Celery Casserole
ingredients: 2 (10 1/2 ounce) cans cream of celery soup
steps: In a bowl combine the celery, soup and marjoram.
Pour into a greased baking dish.
Then add the bread crumbs and butter over top.
Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes.

recipes.title: Dinah Shore's Mushrooms & Sour Cream w\my variations
steps: clean mushrooms by rinsing lightly ( do not soak mushrooms).
pat dry well.
slice stems and tops into quarters or big chunks.
melt butter in skillet over medium heat and saute mushrooms until lightly browned.
add onion and saute done more until onions are transparent.
add salt and pepper to taste.
add sour cream.
turn heat to low stirring until it has heated through.
serve!
dinah's serving suggestion: serve with crisply toasted and buttered triangles of rye or white bread.
My serving suggestions: spin over cooked steak for an added treat.
or serve over a piece of toast or mix with egg noodles or plain rice, or serve over baked potatoes.
my variations:
add strips of steak or ground beef to step 3 and pour sauce(when done) over egg noodles to create an easy stroganoff.
add garlic to taste in step three for added flavor.
add cubed chicken in step three and right before serving mix sauce with rice and serve.
serves 2-6 depending on what you're doing with them.
original recipe by dinah shore.. variations by me.
and photos by me.

recipes.title: Almond and Lemon Polenta Cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 325F.
In a large bowl and using an electric hand whisk or electric mixer, beat the butter and sugar until pale and fluffy, then add the ground almonds and combine.
Beat in the eggs one at a time.
Next, add the lemon juice and zest, polenta, baking powder and a pinch of salt.
Spoon the mixture into a 9in round cake tin (not loose bottomed, 2in deep, lightly buttered and lined with baking parchment) and level out with the back of a spoon.

Bake on the centre shelf of the oven for 1 hour 10 mins or until the cake is firm to the touch and a metal skewer comes out clean.If the cake appears to be browning too much towards the end of the cooking time, cover the top loosely with aluminium foil.
When the cake is nearly ready, make a syrup by gently heating the lemon juice, zest and the sugar until the sugar has dissolved, then bubble the mixture for a couple of minutes until slightly syrupy.
When the cake is cooked, take it out of the oven and drizzle two-thirds of the warm syrup over the top of the cake while it is still in the tin.
Leave the cake to cool before turning out and slicing.
Serve drizzled with a little of the extra syrup.

recipes.title: Mushroom Puff
ingredients: 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese (4 ounces)
steps: Saute mushrooms in 2 to 3 Tablespoons butter until slightly browned.
Place in a buttered 2-quart casserole.
Brush 4 of the bread slices with melted butter.
Trim the crusts and cut eht bread into 1-inch cubes.
Top the mushrooms with half the bread cubes.
Combine onion, green pepper, celery, mayonnaise, salt and pepper and spoon over bread.
Top with the remaining bread buttered bread cubes.
Combine eggs and milk; pour over bread.
Refrigerate overnight.
Brush the 2 remaining bread slices with butter, cube and sprinkle over casserole.
Bake, uncovered at 325 degrees for 45 minutes.
Top with cheese and return to oven for 10 to 15 minutes, or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Lemon Pepper Grilled Roast
steps: Mix together juice, garlic and seasoning.
Pour over roast in non metallic dish or bowl and cover.
Marinate in refrigerator at least 8 hours or overnight.
Grill using indirect method on high about 90 minutes or until done to your taste- use a meat thermometer.
Also great on a rotisserie.

recipes.title: Low-Cal Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 large tomatoes, peeled and cut into pieces
steps: Blend all ingredients in blender or food processor on medium speed until fully blended.
Chill thoroughly before serving.

recipes.title: Chili
steps: Soak beans overnight.
After soaking, drain water and add 2 qts water.
Bring beans to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 2 hours.
In a skillet, saute onion & garlic.
Add tomatoes and contents of flavor packet.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Add mixture to bean pot.
Simmer uncovered for an hour or until beans are tender.

recipes.title: Sunshines Pineapple Baked
ingredients: 2 tbsp butter or margarine sliced very thin
steps: combine water and cornstarch,mix well in a cup, in a bowl beat 2 eggs very well, pour cornstarch mixture into eggs and mix together well, pour pineapple, sugar and vanilla extract mix into eggs mixture well.
useing a 8" pie dish, lightly greased, pour pineapple mixture into the dish, dot with butter, sprinkle ground cinnamon.
preheat oven at 350F bake on 350F, in a 8" pie dish, lightly greased , bake for 1hour and 10 minutes.
take out of oven to cool, let this pie cool for 4 hours to set and cool.
then cut and ready to be served.
enjoy this !!!!!!!

recipes.title: Bohemio
steps: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice.
Add the tequila, mezcal, lemon juice, orange juice, Simple Syrup and Becherovka and shake well.
Strain into an ice-filled rocks glass and garnish with the flamed orange twist.

recipes.title: Raspberry Peach Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup fresh peaches, sliced, partially frozen
steps: Pour ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Mousse Trifle
ingredients: 1 pkg. ( 8 oz.) PHILADELPHIA Cream Cheese, softened
1 pkg. (3.4 oz.) JELL-O Vanilla Flavor Instant Pudding
2 cups thawed COOL WHIP Whipped Topping, divided
steps: Arrange 32 wafers on bottom and up side of 2-1/2-qt.
serving bowl.
Beat cream cheese and pumpkin in medium bowl with mixer until blended.
Add vanilla and pumpkin pie spice; mix well.
Beat pudding mix and milk in medium bowl with whisk 2 min.
Let stand 5 min.
Stir in 1-1/2 cups COOL WHIP.
Add cream cheese mixture; mix well.
Spoon half the pudding mixture into prepared bowl; cover with layers of remaining wafers and remaining pudding mixture.
Top with remaining COOL WHIP.
Refrigerate several hours or until chilled.
Top dessert with Autumn Spiced Nuts just before serving.

recipes.title: Strawberries in the Clouds
steps: Clean and slice strawberries.
Start by using 4 clear long stemmed wine glasses.
First layer is strawberries.
Second layer is some Cool Whip.
Third layer strawberries.
Fourth layer Cool Whip.
Top of with a fresh strawberry for garnish.

recipes.title: Spring Vegetable Frittata
steps: Cook and stir onion and garlic over medium-high heat in butter in 10" oven-proof skillet for 3 minutes.
Add bell pepper and cook over medium heat about 2 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add remaining ingredients except eggs and cheese and cook 4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add eggs.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set in center.
Sprinkle top with cheese.

recipes.title: Liz's Chocolate Bourbon Pecan Pie Recipe
ingredients: 4 ounce. (about 3/4 c.) semi sweet chocolate chips
steps: In large bowl, combine butter, brown sugar, corn syrup.
Mix at medium, add in Large eggs one at a time, till fluffy.
Beat in bourbon and vanilla.
Sprinkle chocolate chips over bottom of chilled crust.
Sprinkle pecans over chocolate chips.
Pour in filling and bake in center of oven at 350 degrees for 45 to 50 min.

recipes.title: Pigeons or Squabs with Dates
ingredients: 2 inches fresh gingerroot, grated, or crushed in a garlic press to extract the juice
4 young Mediterranean pigeons, squabs, or small poussins
10 ounces dates, pitted (Tunisian or Californian dates)
steps: Mix the ginger and garlic with the olive oil and half the lemon juice.
Add salt and pepper and 1 tablespoon honey and beat well.
Turn the birds in this marinade, and leave them in for 1/2 hour.
Arrange on a baking dish, breast side down, and roast in a preheated 425F oven for about 15 minutes.
Turn them over and roast for another 10 minutes, or until they are done to your taste.
Put the dates in a pan and only just cover with water.
Add cinnamon and the remaining honey and lemon and cook for 10 minutes, until the dates are soft and have absorbed the flavors.
Serve the dates in the center and the pigeons around, and sprinkle all over with sesame seeds, if you like.

recipes.title: Stuffing Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 18 large button mushrooms (about 1 pound), stems removed
steps: Preheat oven to 400F.
Break up stuffing into bowl.
Add 3/4 cup cheese, egg, parsley, basil, and green onions; mix well.
If mixture seems dry, add 1 tablespoon olive oil to moisten.
Season with salt and pepper.
Scoop out center of mushroom caps using small spoon.
Fill each mushroom with stuffing; place on rimmed baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup cheese.
Bake until stuffing is golden brown on top, about 15 minutes.
Serve hot or at room temperature.
(Can be made 2 hours ahead.
Let stand covered at room temperature.)

recipes.title: Buffalo Style Ribs With Blue Cheese Dressing Recipe
ingredients: 1 x slab pork back ribs - (to 2) abt 1 to 3 lbs
1/8 tsp freshly-grnd black pepper Salt to taste Freshly-grnd black pepper to taste
steps: Prepare the Ribs: In small bowl, whisk together vinegar, oil, Worcestershire sauce, warm pepper sauce, and brown sugar.
Place ribs in a resealable plastic bag; pour marinade mix over ribs, turning to coat ribs, and close bag.
Marinate in refrigerator 4 hrs or possibly overnight, turning occasionally to distribute marinade.
Meanwhile, make the Dressing: Combine all dressing ingredients and chill till ready to serve.
Remove ribs from marinade; reserve marinade.
In small saucepan, bring reserved marinade to boil; boil at least 1 minute at a full rolling boil.
Place ribs in center of cooking grate.
Grill 30 to 35 min or possibly till tender, turning occasionally and brushing with boiled reserved marinade.
Season ribs with salt and pepper to taste.
Cut ribs into individual portions and serve with dressing.
This recipe yields 4 to 6 servings.
Wine Recommendation: You need a wine which can tame the bite of the sharp blue cheese: call on an Australian Shiraz or possibly a northern Rhone red.
Shazam!
Beer Recommendation: A spicy amber brew with an herbaceous nose will tickle these ribs.
Comments: What could be better than warm and spicy grilled ribs Dip them in this creamy dressing and you'll find out!

recipes.title: Berryessa Blast Drink
steps: Pour the gold rum and Southern Comfort into an old-fashioned glass half-filled with ice cubes.
(I used a highball glass).
Add guava juice to taste, and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Leaf Cups
ingredients: 4 cabbage leaves (attractivly shaped, each about 5 inches diameter, washed and dried)
steps: *tip, warm chocolate in batches so its always warm enough to spread.
spread the chocolate on the outside of the leaves to get the imprint of the ribs.
Line a cookie sheet with wax paper and place cabbage leaves on it.
arrange 3 ounces of chocolate peices in the outter rim of a microwavable cereal bowl, leaving the center free.
heat on medium for 2-5 minutes or until chocolate is just soft enough to spread (stir after 2 minutes, then check for ever 30 seconds after).
take a small spoon or rubber spatula and spread chocolate as evely as you can on the outside of the cabbage leaf (be careful not to leave holes or spread too thinly).
repete untill all leaves are covered.
place leaves in freezer on sheet for 15-30 minutes until completly set.
after chocolate is completly frozen and set, carefully pull off the cabbage leaves and return chocolate to a closed tontainer for storeage in the fridge.
*tip, if you cant remove cabbage, allow to sit for 1 mintes to soften after removing from freezer before trying again.

recipes.title: Gourmet Nut Butter and Jelly Sandwich
ingredients: 2 Tablespoons Almond Butter Or Your Favorite Nut Butter
steps: Take a slice of bread, toasted or not, and spread on the nut butter.
Layer on the sliced fresh peach, a bit of shredded lettuce, and some sliced almonds.
Top with the remaining bread slice.
Lettuce was the suprise ingredient.
It really adds moisture and some texture to the sandwich.

recipes.title: Salty Milk Ramen
steps: Heat milk in a pan until it boils.
Add the instant ramen noodles, and boil to desired degree of firmness.
Add toppings of your choice and serve.

recipes.title: Scary Dessert
ingredients: 2 pkg. (4.2 oz. each) OREO Cookies 'n Creme Flavor Instant Pudding
1 pkg. (3 oz.) JELL-O Orange Flavor Gelatin
1 pkg. (3 oz.) JELL-O Lime Flavor Gelatin
1 pkg. (3 oz.) JELL-O Black Cherry Flavor Gelatin
1 tub (8 oz.) COOL WHIP Whipped Topping, thawed
6 oblong vanilla creme-filled vanilla sandwich cookies, split in half and creme removed
suggested decorations: Chocolate sprinkles, orange sprinkles, cookies that look like the shape of gravestones, skulls or anything that can resemble a fun graveyard look.
steps: Prepare Instant Puddings according to the instructions.
When it is ready, add the pudding inside the mason jars about 1 inch each and put them in the fridge.
Meanwhile, prepare the 3 different gelatins separately according to the instructions.
Refrigerate until slightly thickened.
Carefully add one gelatin color to the pudding in each jar (about 1/2 cup).
Take the jars to the fridge for 3 hours or until it is ready.
Before serving, spread a thin top of Cool Whip with the cookies and decorate in a creative way.

recipes.title: Five-spice powder
steps: Blend all the ingredients in a spice mill to a fine powder.

recipes.title: Chicken-Pasta Salad With Pesto
ingredients: 14 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped
1 medium bell pepper, cut into strips
steps: Cook pasta per package directions; drain, rinse with cold water, then drain again.
In a large bowl, mix pasta, chicken, tomatoes, bell pepper, zucchini, and onion; stir in pesto.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloin With Mustard, Lemon and Rosemary
steps: Rub the entire tenderloin with the dry mustard and place in a shallow dish.
Combine the remaining ingredients in abowl.
Pour the marinade over the pork, cover and marinate at room temperature for half an hour or more.
Turn the tenderloin several times during this period.
Pat the tenderloin dry with paper towels and put it on the barbecue.
Grill over low to medium heat for approximately 30 minutes.
Turn and baste with the marinade often.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Pops (Motts) Recipe
steps: In medium bowl, combine yogurt, apple sauce, honey and cinnamon; blend well.
Fill each c. with about 1/3 c. yogurt mix.
Place c. in freezer till partially frzn, about 1 hour.
Insert sticks; freeze till hard, about 2 hrs.
To serve, remove drink c..
Notes: Pantry: Mott's Natural or possibly Cinnamon Apple Sauce.
Either plastic popsicle molds or possibly ice cube trays can be used to make these refreshing cinnamon-flavored yogurt pops.

recipes.title: Champagne Bourbon Cocktail
ingredients: 1/2 vanilla bean, split and seeds scraped
steps: Combine the sugar, water, bean and seeds in small pot.
Bring to a boil over medium heat and cook until the sugar is dissolved.
Let cool to room temperature, then discard the vanilla bean.
Add 1 shot of bourbon and 2 tablespoons vanilla bean syrup to a chilled champagne flute.
Fill to the top with sparkling wine, and serve.

recipes.title: Simple Turkey Pot Pie
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen mixed vegetables, thawed and drained
1 (10 3/4 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup
steps: Mix vegetables, corn, soup, milk, and turkey.
Heat in a saucepan over medium heat until well-heated all the way through.
Pour into a 13 x 9 inch baking pan sprayed with non-stick vegetable spray.
Top with biscuits.
Bake at 350 degrees for 35 to 40 minutes, or until biscuits are golden.

recipes.title: Beef and Bean Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 lb. beef sirloin steak, cut into thin strips
1 cup TACO BELL Thick & Chunky Mild Salsa
1 can (15 oz.) black beans, drained, rinsed
1/4 cup ATHENOS Traditional Crumbled Feta Cheese
1 cup BREAKSTONE'S FREE Fat Free Sour Cream (optional)
steps: Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over high heat.
Add steak; cook until browned, stirring frequently.
Add salsa, water, peppers and beans; mix well.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low; simmer 10 minutes or until steak is tender.
Sprinkle with cheese; cook an additional 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Spoon steak mixture evenly onto one half of each tortilla; top with 2 Tbsp.
sour cream.
Fold tortillas over filling.

recipes.title: Curried Chicken Salad on Apple Rounds
ingredients: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
1/2 rotisserie chicken, meat shredded, skin and bones discarded (about 2 cups meat)
1/4 cup loosely packed parsley leaves, chopped
3 large crisp red apples, such as Pink Lady or Honeycrisp
8 small Boston or Bibb lettuce leaves
steps: Whisk together the yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, scallions, curry powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt and a few grinds of black pepper in a medium bowl.
Add the chicken, pecans, parsley, celery and raisins and fold to combine.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to use (up to 3 days).
Core the apples and cut each into six to eight 1/4-inch thick rounds, for a total of 16 rounds.
Arrange a lettuce leaf on 8 apple rounds and top each with about 1/4 cup of chicken salad.
Sandwich with the remaining apple slices.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Pissaladiere
ingredients: Freshly ground black pepper to taste
1 recipe Quick Whole Grain Dough (see below)
20 black olives such as kalamata, pitted and halved
steps: Heat oil over medium-low heat in large skillet.
Add onions, garlic, bay leaves, thyme, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, 35 to 45 minutes, or until onions are very soft.
Meanwhile, prepare dough.
Uncover pan, increase heat to medium and cook, stirring, 10 minutes, until liquid has evaporated and onions are brown.
Discard thyme and bay leaves.
Place an inverted baking sheet on oven rack set in lowest position.
Preheat oven to 450F.
Divide dough into 2 balls.
Place 1 ball in center of 15-inch piece of parchment paper.
Flatten into a 10-inch circle.
Spread half of onions over dough, leaving 3?4-inch border.
Arrange half of red pepper strips in crisscross pattern.
Dot with half of olives.
Repeat with remaining dough and toppings.
Slide parchment papers with tarts onto baking sheet.
Bake 10 minutes, until crust is golden.
1 1/2 cups unbleached white flour
1/2 cup whole wheat flour
1 tsp.
instant yeast
3/4 tsp.
salt
1 Tbs.
olive oil, preferably extra virgin
3/4 cup warm water (105110F)
Combine both flours, yeast and salt in food processor; pulse to combine.
With motor running, add olive oil and warm water through feed tube, and process about 15 seconds, or until dough forms a ball.
Turn dough onto lightly floured work surface, and knead just until smooth and manageable, about 1 minute.
Place dough in greased bowl, and turn to coat.
Cover with damp kitchen towel, and let rise in warm, draft-free place until doubled, about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
(Dough is ready when fingerprint on surface fills in slowly.)

recipes.title: Almond and Macadamia Nut Milk
steps: Combine almonds, macadamia nuts and dates in a large lidded plastic container.
Add filtered water, cover, and let soak overnight at room temperature, at least 12 hours.
Using a blender set to the highest speed, process mixture for 3 to 4 minutes or until finely pureed.
Strain the mixture through a nut bag or jelly bag into a bowl, squeezing hard until only solids remain.
(Or set a fine mesh sieve over a bowl and line with two layers of cheesecloth.
Use a spatula to force the mixture through the lined sieve, then repeat the process using fresh cheesecloth.)
The nut milk should be silky and creamy, not gritty.
Milk will keep in the refrigerator for up to five days.
Shake before using.

recipes.title: A Wonton Soup with Plenty of Vegetables
ingredients: 10 cm length of green onion Green onion or scallion
1 as much as you need Thin green onion
1 as much as you need Sesame seeds (if you have them)
steps: Take all of the wonton ingredients, except for the skins, and mix together.
Mince the green onions.
Wet half of the wonton skin and wrap the wonton filling.
It's alright to add a bit more filling if you're the type who likes that!
But be careful not to tear the skin.
Combine water in a large sauce pan, and add the vegetables that take the longest.
Don't add the green onions as that'll be added last.
Once the ingredients have started to boil, add the seasonings and wontons.
This will flavour the soup.
If you have leftover wonton filling, roll into meatballs and add to the soup.
Sprinkle the soup with chopped thin green onions and your dish is finished!

recipes.title: Avocado Hot Sauce Recipe
ingredients: 4 x Serrano chiles, stems, seeds removed, minced
steps: Place all ingredients in blender and puree till smooth.
The Whole Chili Pepper

recipes.title: Arugula and Mixed Green Salad with Sausage and Fennel
ingredients: 1 medium fennel bulb, tops trimmed, bulb cut into matchstick-size strips
steps: Saute sausages in heavy large skillet over medium heat until well browned and cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine arugula, mixed greens, fennel and chives in large bowl.
Whisk olive oil and vinegar in small bowl to blend well.
Season generously with salt and pepper.
Toss salad with dressing.
Top salad with Parmesan shavings and sausages and serve.

recipes.title: Caramel-Banana & Chocolate Pies
steps: Preheat the oven to 410F/210C.
For the caramel-banana: Cut the banana into slices a little less than 1 cm.
Melt butter together with sugar in a saucepan.
Add sliced banana and cook over low heat until browned on one side, shaking the pan occasionally.
When the banana is nicely browned, turn over and brown the other side.
Remove to a plate and cool.
Take the frozen puff pastry out of the freezer and let stand at room temperature for 5~10 minutes.
Cut each sheet into 4 even pieces.
Prick the pastry with a fork.
If the pastry already has holes in it, skip this step.
Break the chocolate into 8 pieces.
Place a square of chocolate on the pastry, leaving about 1cm bare on the sides.
Put a slice of caramel-banana on top of the chocolate.
Fold over the pastry and press the edges firmly together with a fork.
If you brush the edges with egg yolk first, they'll stick together.
Put the pies on a parchment-lined baking sheet and brush with egg yolk.
Bake at 410F/210C for 10 minutes.
Lower the heat to 360F/180C and bake for 15 minutes.
Done!
Of course, you can use plain banana, or just chocolate.
It's also fun to make 3 different kinds, so the inside is a surprise.

recipes.title: Childrens Cookbook - Suzy Q Black Forest Cake
steps: Place Suzy Qs on the bottom of a 9x13 dish.
Spread whipped topping of top of Suzy Qs.
Pour cherry pie filling on top of whipped topping.
Drizzle with chocolate syrup and serve.

recipes.title: Provencal Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork chops, cut into 1/2 inch strips
1 12 lbs potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
steps: Advance prep: Trim any excess fat off pork chops; slice into thin strips.
Slice onioins.
Peel potatoes, slice thinly; store i arge bowl filed with water in refrigerator until ready to use.
Preparation: In large skillet over medium heat, melt alf the butter.
Add slices of pork; cook, stirring, util no longer pink.
Remove from skillet, seta side.
Stir onions into juices remaining in pan; cook until just tender.
Add tomatoes, salt, pepper and mixed herbs to pan.
Heat to boil; reduce heat; simmer about 5 minutes.
In a freeze-able casserole dish, layer pork, sauce and potatoes (end with potato layer).
Brush top of potatoes with melted butter; sprinkle with parsley.
Cover casserole dish with a lid and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.
Remove from oven; cool.
Label and freeze.
To serve: Thaw.
Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Tortilla Chip Crusted Tilapia
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
In a food processor mix the jalapeno, cilantro, chili powder, cumin, onion powder, and salt.
Add the tortilla chips and mix until it comes out to be small chunks.
Remove the mixture and place on a plate.
Add the egg to a small dish and dredge each tilapia into the egg wash and coat each side.
Place the tilapia in the chip mixture and pat the crumbs to the mixture to adhere to each side.
Put tilapia fillets onto a nonstick baking sheet and cook 14-17 minutes or until fish is flaky.

recipes.title: Savory Barbecue Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef Safeway 1 lb For $3.99 thru 02/09
1 medium red onion, cut into 4 slices
steps: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Combine barbecue sauce, juice and cumin.
Reserve 1/4 cup sauce mixture; set aside.
Mix meat and remaining sauce mixture.
Shape into 4 patties.
Grill patties and onions 5 to 6 min.
on each side or until cooked through (160F), brushing with reserved 1/4 cup sauce mixture during the last few minutes of grilling.
Top patties with Singles.
Fill buns with burgers and onions.

recipes.title: Game Day GUACAMOLE!
steps: cut avocados in half remove pit & scoop out inside & put in bowl
dice onion & remove seeds from peppers & mince & put both in bowl
add salt...olive oil & juice from lime into the bowl
chop up cilantro & put into bowl
mash & mix until desired consistency is reached
serve with chips & enjoy!

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Dip
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) container caramel apple dip (from store)
steps: Mix Cream cheese with brown sugar until a light golden brown and spread in a round 9 1/2 inch pan.
( Can slightly larger) Take the tub of caramel apple dip and layer on top of the cream cheese.
Finish with toffee chips on top and maybe an apple slice or two for decoration!
Cut up the rest of the apples and place on seperate plate to be dipped.
Its best to wait to cut up the apples if your going to be bringing to a party so they dont turn brown.

recipes.title: Strawberry Margarita Using Frozen Strawberries in Syrup
ingredients: 34 cup frozen strawberries, in syrup, thawed
steps: Place it all in blender and blend until smooth.

recipes.title: Taco Chili
ingredients: 8 -10 ounces monterey jack and cheddar cheese blend
10 -20 ounces tortilla chips or 10 -20 ounces corn chips
steps: mix seasonings with hot water, tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, and taco bell sauce in slow cooker.
cook meat & onions together.
drain and add.
cook on high heat for 1 hour and low heat for 10 minutes.
add cheese & chips.

recipes.title: Bri's White Cheddar Mac
steps: Follow Pasta box directions and slice Vermont Cheddar Cheese into medium size slices.
(Usually you'll get around 10 slices) Set to the side.
Drain Pasta
Place Pasta back in pot.
Turn the stove on low.
Toss in the White American and the Vermont Cheddar.
Pour in the Milk and place in the Butter.
Stir until all cheese and Butter is melted.
Finally add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: TORRE PASTA
ingredients: 4 tablespoons of torre sauce, recipe follows
12 ounces penne pasta, cooked al dente
Salt and white pepper, to taste
steps: In a saute pan slowly melt 4 tablespoons of torre sauce.
Saute bell peppers and onions.
Blanch broccoli and carrots then saute for 2 minutes.
Add pasta and heat for 5 minutes, add tomatoes.
Place chicken breast on top of pasta.
The dish is finally topped with freshly grated Parmesan.
Note: This recipe was provided by professional chefs and has been scaled down from a bulk recipe provided by a restaurant.
The FN chefs have not tested this recipe, in the proportions indicated, and therefore, we cannot make any representation as to the results.
Bring butter to room temperature, blend everything together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chopped Greek Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. (6 oz.) OSCAR MAYER CARVING BOARD Lemon Pepper Chicken Breast Strips
1/4 cup ATHENOS Traditional Crumbled Feta Cheese
steps: Combine ingredients.

recipes.title: Cranberry Acorn Squash
ingredients: 1 small apple, peeled cored and chopped in small pieces
2 acorn squash, cut in half and seeds removed
steps: Heat oven to 350.
Combine cranberries, apples, currants, orange juice, honey, butter and salt in a saucepan.
Heat until the berries are just tender.
Place squash in an ovenproof dish.
Fill cavities with fruit.
Cover and bake until squash is tender, about 35-45 minutes.

recipes.title: Halloween Snack Mix
ingredients: 1 (14 ounce) bag M&M's plain chocolate candy
steps: Pour all the ingredients into a bowl.
Stir.

recipes.title: Easy Seafood Dip Recipe
ingredients: 2 cans cream of shrimp soup, undiluted
1 (8 ounce.) pkg. "sea-legs", or possibly other imitation crab product, minced
Salt, pepper and paprika to taste
steps: Combine ingredients till smooth.
Great with crackers or possibly vegetables.
Easy working Mother recipe.

recipes.title: Microwave Stuffed Flank Steak Recipe
ingredients: 2 c. soft bread crumbs (I use a good 1/2 pkg. Pepperidge Farm seasoned stuffing)
steps: Lb.
flank steak well, season with salt and pepper and set aside.
Combine butter, onion and celery in medium glass dish.
Microwave on roast 3 min or possibly till vegetables are partly cooked.
Stir in bread crumbs and sage.
Moisten with water if necessary.
Spread stuffing lengthwise on steak and roll up, tie with strings in 3 to 4 places (I use large toothpicks).
Place in 1 1/2 qt (10 x 6 inch) glass baking dish.
Cover with plastic wrap.
Microwave on simmer 20 min.
Pour soup over meat and sprinkle with parsley, recover and continue on simmer for 4 to 5 min or possibly till fork tender.
Let stand covered for 5 min before serving.

recipes.title: Grilled Baby Artichokes W/ Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 (7 ounce) jar roasted red peppers, drained
steps: Prepare dip first by placing the peppers and garlic in food processor and process until very smooth.
Add mayonnaise, mustard, 2 Tbl.
hot sauce, and 1/2 teaspoons salt.
Process until well blended.
Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes.
Then wash and trim outer leaves of artichokes.
Cut 1/2 inch off top of artichokes, then cut in half lengthwise.
Place chokes and 1 cup water and 1/4 teaspoons salt in microwave safe bowl.
Cover and microwave on HIGH for 8 minutes until tender.
Thread artichoke halves onto metal skewers.
Prepare grill.
Combine 1/4 cup hot sauce and butter in small bowl.
Brush mixture over artichokes.
Place artichokes on grill for 5 minutes, turning and basting often with sauce mixture.
Serve artichokes with Roasted Red pepper dip.

recipes.title: Rainbow Slaw Dogs
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. KRAFT Mayo with Olive Oil Reduced Fat Mayonnaise
1 cup each shredded green and red cabbage
1 carrot, shredded (3/4 cup) Target 2 lb For $3.00 thru 02/06
steps: Mix first 4 ingredients in medium bowl.
Add vegetables and apples; mix lightly.
Refrigerate until ready to use.
Heat franks as directed on package.
Fill buns with franks; top with slaw.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
steps: Preheat oven to 400*.
Combine crumbs, 2 tbl parmesan, oregano, garlic and pepper.
Roll chicken in mixture.
Arrange in 2 quart shallow baking dish for 20 minutes.
Turn chicken over and bake 20 minutes more.
Blend soup and milk and pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with paprika and remaining parmesan.
Bake 20 minutes more or until done.

recipes.title: Crockpot BBQ Chicken
ingredients: 4 whole Up To 6 Whole Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts
1 bottle 16.25 Oz Bottle Of Kraft Original BBQ Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients except the chicken in a bowl until combined.
Place chicken in the Crockpot and pour the sauce over the top.
Stir until all chicken is covered.
Place lid on Crockpot and turn on to high.
Set for 4 hours and walk away.
Yum!
This was the best barbecue chicken weve had!
Serves 4-6, depending on the size of the chicken breasts.
Enjoy!
Recipe adapted from Stick a fork in it.

recipes.title: Bigjay's Dry Barbecue Rub
steps: Toast the cumin and coriander seed in a small skillet.
Then add all of the ingredients in a coffee grinder.
Grind untill coarsely ground or fine.

recipes.title: Meat And Pasta Bake Recipe
ingredients: 4 ounce. small shell or possibly elbow pasta
3/4 teaspoon thyme, marjoram, or possibly savory
steps: Cook pasta, set aside.
Cook meat and onion till brown.
Drain fat.
Stir in soup, cheese, lowfat sour cream, lowfat milk, Worcestershire sauce, and herb.
Stir in vegetables and pasta.
Put mix in a 2 qt casserole dish.
Sprinkle with crackers.
Bake at 375 degrees for 30 min, covered.
Uncover and cook for 5 - 10 min more.

recipes.title: Macaroni Crab Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups shell macaroni or 2 cups elbow macaroni
steps: Cook macaroni according to package directions.
Drain and rinse with hot water.
Drain.
Add milk to mushroom soup and heat until hot.
Add peas, all seasonings, then add crab meat, mixing lightly with fork.
Put in greased 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.
Cover with bread crumbs.
Bake in 350 degree oven about 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Diet Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie Recipe
ingredients: 1 box (4 serving size) sugar free instant vanilla pudding mix
steps: Add in dry lowfat milk to pudding mix.
Add in water and mix till smooth.
Beat in peanut butter.
Spread into graham cracker crust.

recipes.title: Chunky Sausage Soup
steps: Grill the sausages for 10 minutes until brown on each side.
Heat the oil; add the onion and fry until soft.
Add the tins of beans and tomatoes.
Add the stock to the pan.
Add 450 ml boiling water to the pan, season and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve garnished with parsley.

recipes.title: Homemade Spiced Applesauce
ingredients: 2 whole Apples (use Any Sweet Apples, Not Tart), Cored And Diced
steps: (You can choose to either peel the apples or leave the peels on.
I personally like it with the peels.)
Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and cover.
Heat over medium heat for about 20 minutes or until apples are tender.
When cooked, divide the apples in half.
Puree half of the apples in a food processor and smash the other half with a fork.
Combine the two mixtures and stir together.
Top with a sprinkle of cinnamon and serve warm.

recipes.title: Homemade Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 1 head purple cabbage, grated (very small head)
steps: Mix salad dressing and all spices, thin to desired consistency with milk.
Set aside.
Give both types of cabbage a course dice or grate through the cheese grater.
Prepare rest veggies either dicing or grating them.
Mix veggies with prepared sauce, best if left to sit in the refrigerator all day or over night.

recipes.title: Pozole Rojo
ingredients: 3 1/2 to 4 pounds bone-in pork shoulder, cut into 3 or 4 pieces
2 ounces ancho chiles, seeded and stemmed
1/2 teaspoon Emeril's Southwestern Essence, recipe follows
steps: Peel garlic cloves, reserve 2 cloves for the chile sauce.
Slice remaining garlic.
Season the pork with 1 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon black pepper.
In an 8 quart Dutch oven, over medium high heat, brown the pork on all sides.
Add the sliced garlic, sliced onion, 10 cups of the water and chicken stock.
Bring up to a boil.
Skim off any foam that may rise to the surface.
Turn the heat down and gently simmer the pork, covered, until very tender, 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
While pork is simmering, toast the ancho and guajillo chiles in a pan over medium-high heat.
Turn the chiles several times, cooking until they are pliable and fragrant, about 3 to 4 minutes.
Add 2 cups of the remaining water; bring to a boil, turn off and let stand covered for 20 to 25 minutes.
In a blender, combine the chiles, the soaking liquid, chopped onion, garlic, 1 teaspoon of the remaining salt, and Southwest Essence and puree until smooth.
Strain through a sieve to remove any skins or seeds.
Set aside.
Transfer the pork to a cutting board, discard the bones, and shred the meat.
Rinse and drain the hominy.
Return the pork to the broth; add the hominy, 1/4 cup of the chile sauce (or more to taste), oregano, remaining teaspoon of salt, and remaining water if necessary.
Simmer the pozole for 30 minutes longer.
Adjust seasoning if necessary.

Any leftover chile sauce can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 weeks and may be stirred into marinades, sauces, soups, or stews, or used to flavor meats before grilling or sauteing.
The pozole should look hearty but be brothy enough to be thought of as a soup or brothy stew.
Serve the pozole buffet style with bowls of the accompaniments for guests to add to their taste.
Yield: 4 quarts
Combine all ingredients thoroughly.

recipes.title: Black Beauty Pudding Cake Recipe
ingredients: 1/4 c. light cream or possibly evaporated lowfat milk
Liquid or possibly other ingredients required in mix (egg-water)
steps: Heat oven to 350 degrees.
Grease a 9-inch cake pan.
Put chocolate chips, cream and boiling water into a blender, and cover and process till smooth.
Pour sauce into cake pan.
Sprinkle with marshmallows.
Put water and egg needed for cake into blender.
Add in cake mix, cover and mix till blended.
Add in nuts.
Pour batter over sauce.
Bake about 40 min.
Serve hot, spoon cake into plates.
Pudding will be under cake.
Spoon extra pudding on top of cake.
Serves 9.

recipes.title: Baked Garlicky Lemony Chicken With Peppers
ingredients: cooking spray (I like to use olive oil spray)
steps: Combine all 4 sauce ingredients in a medium bowl, stirring with a whisk.
Combine bell peppers and chicken in a baking dish.
Pour sauce over top.
Preheat oven to 400F.
Bake for 40 minutes or until chicken is cooked all the way through.

recipes.title: Maple Glazed Carrots
steps: In a medium-sized saucepan bring approximately 2 cups of water to a boil.
Add carrots and cook until tender, approximately 7-10 minutes (depending on the size).
Drain water; add butter, maple syrup and salt.
Bring to a boil, then simmer 5-6 minutes, until caramelized (carrots coated in caramel).

recipes.title: Bleeding Tombstone Cake Recipe
ingredients: 2 x -3 cans of vanilla frosting ( Betty Crocker soft whipped cream cheese is good) black food paste
steps: Prepare one cake mix according to box directions and bake in a 9 x 13 cake pan.
Then prepare and bake the second the cake mix also in a 9 x 13 cake pan.
If you have a larger cake pan such as a 11 x 15 you could bake both mixes at once and cut the cake in half vertically.
After cakes are completely cold stack the cakes on top of each other with a piece of wax paper between them on a covered cake board or possibly serving tray.
I place mine in the freezer at this point for about 30 min to make cutting easier.
Then round one end of the cake with a serrated knife into a tombstone shape.
Carefully remove the top cake layer.
On the remaining bottom layer Leave 1/2 inch border all the way around and gently remove about a 1/2 inch of the cake.
Spread a thin layer of the vanilla frosting where you removed some of the cake.
Fill with the cherry pie filling, it should fill but not overflow the cake layer.
Spread the top of the second cake with a very thin layer of frosting and turn over onto top of cherry filled cake.
Tint the remaining icing with sufficient black food paste to make gray and ice top and sides of tombstone making sure to reserve 3/4 c. of the icing.
With the reserved icing add in more black paste (be careful too much paste and it causes a bitter taste) or possibly I like to add in cocoa pwdr for a funny brown/gray color.
Place the icing in a re-sealable bag and clip corner.
Use to write RIP or possibly any other wording you want on the cake.

recipes.title: Crab Salad with Yogurt Mustard Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup lump crab meat, picked over
steps: In a bowl whisk together yogurt, sour cream, paprika, mustard, lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste.
Add crab meat, scallion, and celery and toss salad gently.
Serve salad with toast points.

recipes.title: Trout
steps: Heat the oil in a large frying pan into which all the trout will fit in one layer.
Add the trout and saute gently for 3 minutes.
Split the cucumber lengthways, scoop out the seeds and cut across into slim halfmoons about quarter-inch thick, Turn the trout over and saute for another 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the butter and turn heat up until it foams.
Put in cucumber pieces, spread them around the pan, then add the almonds.
Saute them carefully until they start to turn golden, then take the pan off the heat before the almonds can burn.
Serve on warm plates with a good measure of cucumber and almonds on each plate.

recipes.title: Chipotle Mayonnaise
ingredients: 14 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves
1 12 teaspoons chipotle peppers, in adobo pureed
1 teaspoon honey (optional but it adds character)
steps: Stir the mayonnaise, cilantro, lemon juice, garlic, chipotle peppers, honey and kosher salt together in a small bowl.
Add more lemon juice, chipotle peppers, garlic, honey or salt to taste if desired.

recipes.title: Bahama Fried Fish Recipe
ingredients: 3 lb Fresh fish fillets Lemon pepper Garlic salt
steps: Preheat electric skillet to 350 degrees.
Cut fish in bite-sized pcs.
Lightly sprinkle with lemon pepper and garlic salt.
Combine pancake mix and bread crumbs in a paper bag.
Dip fish in water and egg mix.
Shake fish in bag to coat with crumbs.
Fry in oil for 7 min, or possibly till golden, turning once.
Serve immediately.
/FISH

recipes.title: Oven-baked Chicken or Pork Chops with Chipotle-Maple Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 6 Pork Chops Or 6 Large Pieces Of Chicken
2 Chipotles En Adobo, Chopped (seeded If You Prefer Less Spicy)
1 teaspoon Adobo Sauce, From The Can
steps: Pat the meat dry with a paper towel.
Sprinkle top and bottom with salt and pepper.
Place the meat in a baking dish.
To make the barbecue sauce: Combine all the sauce ingredients and place them in a small saucepan.
Bring to a simmer, reduce the heat to low and simmer, uncovered for 20 minutes.
This barbecue sauce should ideally be made the day before and left in the fridge to allow the flavors to fully combine.
This makes a big difference in flavor.
Baste the meat with half of the barbecue sauce.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake at 350 degrees F for 1 hour.
Remove the foil, baste the meat with the remaining sauce, increase the heat to 400 degrees F and bake, uncovered for another 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Sharp Cheddar "Lasagna" Made Over
ingredients: 1 pkg. (14 oz.) KRAFT Deluxe Macaroni & Cheese Dinner Made With 2% Milk Cheese
2/3 cup CLASSICO FAMILY FAVORITES Traditional Pasta Sauce
1/2 cup KRAFT 2% Milk Shredded Sharp Cheddar Cheese
steps: Heat oven to 400 degrees F.
Prepare Dinner as directed on package.
While Macaroni is cooking, brown meat with peppers in large skillet; stir in pasta sauce.
Layer half each of the Dinner and meat mixture in 8-inch square baking dish sprayed with cooking spray; repeat layers.
Top with shredded cheese.
Bake 15 min.
or until heated through.

recipes.title: Blueberry Almond Shake
steps: Add all to blender and mix.
Quick, easy, healthy shake for anytime of the day.
You can use any fruit/yogurt you like to make this.

recipes.title: Feta Olive Cucumber Mint Skewers
ingredients: 14 large English cucumber, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch chunks
steps: In a medium bowl combine the fennel seeds, orange zest, orange juice, and pepper.
Gently stir in the feta and marinate for 1 hour or more.
To make the skewers, place a mint leaf about 3/4-inch up the skewer, then add an olive half, then a chunk of cucumber.
Gently place a cube of the marinated feta on the end.

recipes.title: Bread Dough Wreath Recipe
ingredients: 2 pound frzn bread dough, thawed to room temperature
2/3 c. raisins or possibly minced candied fruit
Candied cherries or possibly fruit (for decoration)
steps: Working with oiled hands, knead raisins or possibly fruit into dough.
Divide into 3 equal parts.
Form each into a 32 inch long rope of even thickness.
Coat ropes well with cinnamon-sugar.
Join together at one end and braid.
On greased baking sheet, shape braid into a 10 or possibly 11 inch ring, pressing ends together tightly.
Let rise in a hot place till almost double, 30-40 min.
Brush beaten egg mix over wreath.
Bake in a preheated 375 degree oven for 30 min or possibly till bottom of ring sounds hollow when tapped.
For extra shine, brush on more egg mix during the last 10 min of baking.
Cold on wire rack.
Add in vanilla and lowfat milk to confectioners' sugar for glaze.
Spread over wreath.
Decorate with fruit.
For a sturdier, preserved, inedible wreath, omit raisins.
Bake unrisen wreath for 40 min.
Shellac or possibly varnish cooled wreath.
Attach fabric bow.

recipes.title: Mandarin Glazed Beets
steps: In a large saucepan, combine the sugar and cornstarch.
Add the lemon juice and butter.
Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Stir in the beets; heats through.
Gently stir in the oranges (Gently!
Or the oranges will turn red!
); heat through.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Fruit Salad Recipe
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Put into a serving bowl.
Chill for several hrs before serving.

recipes.title: Cilantro Coleslaw
steps: Combine the onion and 1 1/2T vinegar.
Season with salt and both peppers and let stand 10 minutes.
Add olive oil and let stand 5 more minutes.
Add cabbage and cilantro.
Toss thoroughly.
Season with remaining vinegar and additional salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Grilled Spicy Squid
steps: Clean the squid and remove the cartilage.
Peel off the outer skin.
Cut open along the middle of the squid.Score the surface of diamond patterns.
Chop the chilli.
Mix in garlic,olive oil,white wine vinegar,and paprika.
Mix in the squid and marinate for 10 minutes.
Grease the grill pan.Place squid on the grill and cook for 3-5 minutes until cooked.Cut into pieces and serve.

recipes.title: My Chicken, Mash, and sweet. pepper Battered Dish
ingredients: 500 grams Battermix or make your own
1 salt and black pepper to taste
1 same mix as above , Mash and Battermix
1 tbsp small chopped carrots, frozen or shredded
steps: Peel potatoes and put them on to boil with a little salt
Cut chicken breasts into thin slices, and steam cook it for 15mins
Make Battermix while chicken is steaming
Add salt & Pepper to taste, mix well you need it thickish, so it slowly runs off your mixer
When potatoes are done mash them with a small amount of butter and leave to cool.
Turn the chicken off and take off the heat to cool
In a dish shred the chicken with two forks, thats why steami g it is best, all soft and easy to pull apart
Crush the garlic and mash it in with the mash potatoes
Then add the Chicken to the mash and mix in.
Mix it all in the battermix and the chopped peppers
Heat up the Veg oil make sure its a good 3inch depth or in a deep fryer, until its hot, drop a little piece of bread to see if it bubles up and crisp then its hot enough
Using a table spoon pick up a full spoon of the mix and push of the spoon into the hot oil, put 3 at a time in because they are quite big

Using a slotted spoon flip them over to cook on other side and as not to stick to the bottom should only take 2--3minutes each then put them on kitchen paper to drain off, dont take it off the heat , then same again until they are all done
Serve with Chips or Salad or both
Also i did some in another fryer with clean oil for vegetarians , my daughter.
Mixed in loose corn, sweet peas and some with tiny chopped carrots

recipes.title: Pasta With Fresh Basil Tomato Sauce
steps: Heat a large skillet over high heat for 3 minutes.
Add oil and crushed garlic to hot skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute until garlic is golden.
Add crushed tomatoes and basil and bring sauce to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium low and continue to cook sauce for 10 minutes more.
Season sauce to taste with salt and crushed black pepper.
cook spaghetti according to package directions, drain and place in a large pasta bowl.
Add cooked sauce and toss to coat.
Top pasta and sauce with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Banana Rum And Coke Recipe
ingredients: 2 ounce banana mix or possibly 1/3 nectar fill coke
steps: Ice // rocks

recipes.title: The Easiest Banana Bread
steps: Blend together in large bowl the egg and milk.
Add the two packages of muffin mix and chopped nuts.
Stir until just moistened.
Batter may be lumpy.
Pour into greased 9"x5" loaf pan.
Bake for 50 minutes (or until tests done) in 350 preheated oven.
Cool 10 minutes.
Turn onto rack.
**Can use the Carrot Flavor instead for Carrot Bread**.

recipes.title: Ghost "Cake"
ingredients: 1 pkg. (4-serving size) JELL-O Vanilla Flavor Instant Pudding
1 pkg. (8 oz.) PHILADELPHIA Cream Cheese, softened
1 pkg. (16 oz.) powdered sugar, sifted (4 to 4-1/2 cups)
steps: Prepare cake batter as directed on package.
Add dry pudding mix; mix well.
Spoon evenly into 24 paper-lined medium muffin cups.
Bake as directed on package for cupcakes.
Remove to wire racks; cool completely.
Beat cream cheese, butter and vanilla in medium bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended.
Gradually add sugar, beating well after each addition.
Arrange cupcakes on large serving platter or tray to resemble a ghost; spread with frosting.
Use decorating gel to outline the mouth on the cupcakes.
Finely crush 3 of the cookies; sprinkle inside mouth.
Place remaining 2 cookies on cupcakes for the eyes.
Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Mango and Tamarind Chutney
ingredients: 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes dried, crushed**
steps: *Mangoes can be unripe, half-ripe or part unripe and part ripe.
Using part or all almost-ripe fruit will yield a chutney with a softer texture.
If you like jammy chutney, cut the fruit into small bits; for a chunky product, use 1/2 inch or larger cubes and stop cooking the mixture as soon as the fruit pieces are translucent.
**In place of the crushed dried red pepper, can substitute 2 dried hot peppers (each 2 1/2 to 3 inches long) which have been seeded and crumbled, or 1 tb.
finely minced red or green fresh hot peppers.
Increase any of these if you are sure you want a hotter chutney.
Crumble tamarind into a small bowl and stir in 2 1/2 cups of the water; let tamarind soak for at least an hour, meanwhile preparing the remaining ingredients.
Or substitute the fresh lime juice plus 1/2 cup of water at this point.
Peel and dice the mangoes, cutting them into small pieces for a jamlike chutney, into 1/2 inch or larger dice for a chunky mixture.
Place the pieces in a preserving pan.

Add the onions, raisins, currants, ginger, garlic, lemon zest, brown and granulated sugars, mustard seed, salt, crushed hot red pepper, cinnamon, turmeric, cloves, ground red pepper, white vinegar and the remaining 1 cup water; stir the mixture and let it rest until the tamarind juice is ready, or for up to several hours, if that is convenient.
When the tamarind pulp is very soft, strain the liquid through a sieve, pressing it to remove all possible liquid and any pulp that will pass through.
Discard the pulp remaining in the sieve.
Add the liquid to the chutney mixture.
Set the pan over medium heat and bring the ingredients to a boil.

Lower the heat so the mixture simmers and cook it, uncovered, stirring often, until the mango and onion pieces are translucent and the chutney has thickened to the consistency of preserves, 1 to 2 hours depending on the firmness of the fruit.
(The chutney will thicken further in the jar, so don't reduce it too much.)
If the chutney threatens to stick before the mango pieces are translucent, add a little water.
Remove chutney from the heat, cool a sample, and taste it for tartness, sweetness, and degree of hotness.
(The overall flavor is elusive at this point, but these factors can be judged.)
If you wish, add a little more vinegar, sugar or ground hot red pepper.
Reheat the chutney to boiling and ladle it into hot, clean pint or half-pint canning jars, leaving 1/4 inch of headspace.
Seal the jars; process for 15 minutes (for either size jar) in a boiling-water bath.
Cool, label, and store the jars for a least a month so that its many flavors can blend and balance.
This will keep for at least a year in a cool pantry.

recipes.title: Mini Apricot Appetizer Tarts
ingredients: 2 (8 ounce) cans garlic butter crescent dinner rolls
1 cup finely shredded monterey jack pepper cheese
steps: Heat oven to 375F
Grease 24 mini muffin cups with cooking spray.
Unroll each can of dough into a large rectangle; press perforations to seal.
Cut each rectangle crosswise into 12 strips, about 1 inch wide.
Place each strip in muffin cup, pressing dough to cover bottom and side, making sure all seams are sealed and forming 1/4-inch rim above cup.
Spoon 2 teaspoons cheese into each cup.
Top each with 1/2 teaspoon preserves and 1/2 teaspoon pecans.
Bake 14 to 20 minutes or until crust is deep golden brown.
Cool 5 minutes; remove from pan.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Rib Eye Steak with Onion Blue Cheese Sauce
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper
steps: Preheat the grill to a high heat or light your outdoor grill.
Sprinkle the steaks with salt and pepper and smear both sides of the steaks with 1/2 stick of the butter.
Grill the steaks until medium-rare, 3 to 4 minutes per side, and then remove from the heat and keep warm.
(You can also saute them in a skillet over medium-high heat if you prefer.)
Melt the remaining 1/2 stick of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat, and then saute the onions until golden brown, 7 to 8 minutes.
Pour in the cream, a dash of salt and pepper and the Worcestershire sauce.
Let it bubble up, then add the blue cheese and stir together to melt, adding more pepper or Worcestershire sauce as you wish.
Place the steaks on plates and spoon the sauce over the top.
Take a bite.
And the world at long last will make sense.

recipes.title: Dilled Pulled Beef Sandwiches
steps: Season roast with seasonings and place in a crockpot.
Put in just enough water to cover roast.
Add half of the jar of pickles including juice.
Cook on low until meat is tender and shreds easily, about 6 hours.
Drain and shred beef, discarding pickles.
Place beef back into pot.
Add all of the BBQ sauce and the rest of the jar of pickles.
Simmer for 45-60 minutes on low, stirring occasionaly.
Serve on toasted kaiser rolls, with additional BBQ sauce and new, crisp pickles and horseradish sauce.

recipes.title: Snap Pea Salad with Radish and Lime
ingredients: 8 ounces sugar snap peas trimmed and halved (about 2 cups)
7 ounces wax beans yellow, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces (about 3 cups)
1 x black pepper freshly ground to taste
1 bunch radishes trimmed and thinly sliced (about 10)
steps: Steam sugar snap peas over 2 inches of boiling water, stirring once, until crisp-tender, 2 to 3 minutes.
Plunge into ice water.
Transfer to a baking sheet lined with paper towel.
Steam wax beans until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes.
Plunge into ice water then transfer to a baking sheet lined with paper towel to drain and dry.
Transfer to the baking sheet.
Refrigerate until chilled, about 10 to 20 minutes (or more).
Whisk lime juice, oil, cilantro, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add radishes, peas and beans; toss to coat.
Serve chilled.
This is a great veggie side dish that is easily made ahead and is ready to serve when you are.

recipes.title: Monkey Ball Bread Recipe
steps: Thaw dough.
Pull apart into small balls.
Mix together sugar, cinnamon, and nuts.
Dip balls into butter, then in sugar mix.
Drop into greased tube pan.
Sprinkle with remaining dry ingredients and butter over dough.
Cover.
Let rise till dough doubles in size.
Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 min.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Butter and Sugar-Free Banana Cake
steps: Use a fork to mash the banana until creamy.
Add the egg and mix thoroughly with a whisk.
Stir in the milk.
Add the pancake mix and roughly mix it in with a rubber spatula.
Very lightly grease the pound cake pan with butter and then dust it with flour.
Pour in the batter and release the air pockets.
If you don't have butter, you can use margarine or vegetable oil insteadl
Bake for 40 minutes at 180C (356 Fahrenheit).
Halfway through, cover the cake with aluminum foil so that it doesn't burn.
Keep your eye on it and adjust the baking time as needed.
I had some leftover batter when just making the pound cake, so I broke up some chocolate and made cupcakes too (for my husband...).
Bake the cupcakes at the same time as the pound cake, but take them out after 20 minutes.
At that time, cover the pound cake with aluminium foil and continue baking for another 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Cranberry Pie
ingredients: 4 md. apples for pies, peeled and chopped, about 4-1/2 cups
steps: Prepare pie crusts for filled two-crust pie using 9 1/2 inch pan, or 2 smaller pie pans.
Heat oven to 450F.
Mix apples with sugar, add cornstarch that has been mixed with apple juice, mix well.
Add thawed cranberries and corn syrup, mixing well.
Spoon into pie crust-lined pan, dot with butter, top with second crust.
Cut slits to let steam escape and brush with milk and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 450F for 10 minutes, reduce temperature to 400F and continue baking about 30 more minutes until filling is bubbling.
Cool on wire rack and store in fridge.

recipes.title: Eat Your Vegetables' Soup (Vegan-Friendly)
ingredients: 1 medium red skin white potato, diced
1 medium tomatoes, seeded and cut into wedges
3 cups acorn squash, cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks
1 medium carrot, peeled, cut into 1-inch chunks
steps: *NOTE: substitute 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon, and 1/8 teaspoon each of ground allspice, ground coriander and black pepper for the garam masala.
Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
Lightly grease a large baking sheet.
Place the cut up vegetables on the baking sheet.
Drizzle or spray a bit more oil on the vegetables and toss to coat.
Bake the vegetables 15 minutes.
Stir and bake about 10 minutes longer or until softened.
Transfer the vegetables to a large soup pot.
Add the garam masala and 3 cups water.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and cover soup pot.
Simmer until the vegetables are very soft, about 20 minutes.
Add the milk (or soymilk).
Heat through but do not boil.
Using an immersion blender, puree the soup mixture until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper.
Can be served hot or chilled.
Garnish with the diced tomatoes if desired.
For Vegan, use soymilk!

recipes.title: Creamy Triple-Cheddar Cheese Wreath Appetizer
ingredients: 2 pkg. (8 oz. each) PHILADELPHIA Cream Cheese, softened
1 pkg. (8 oz.) KRAFT Shredded Triple Cheddar Cheese with a TOUCH OF PHILADELPHIA
1 Tbsp. finely chopped onions King Sooper's 1 lb For $0.99 thru 02/09
steps: Beat cream cheese and shredded cheese in small bowl with mixer until blended.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Refrigerate several hours.
Place drinking glass on center of platter.
Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of cheese mixture around glass, just touching outer edge of glass to form ring; smooth with spatula.
Remove glass before serving.

recipes.title: New Potatoes with Creme Fraiche and Caviar
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F
Wash potatoes and place on 2 lightly oiled cookie sheets.
Bake for about 30 minutes.
Cool potatoes before handling.
Trim either end of each potato and then cut in half, leaving trimmed edges on the end to allow potatoes to sit upright.
Using a small melon baller, scoop out inside of each potato half, leaving at least 1/8-inch edge.
Fill pastry bag, fitted with a star tip, with creme fraiche.
Fill each scooped-out potato half with piped creme fraiche.
Garnish top of each potato with red or black lumpfish roe.

recipes.title: Grilled Soy and Lime Beef Tri-Tip
steps: In a shallow baking dish or resealable plastic bag, combine the marinade ingredients and mix well.
Add the beef and cover or seal.
Marinate in the refrigerator for 4 to 12 hours.
When ready to cook, grind the beef bouillon cubes into a powder.
Remove the tri-tip from the marinade, discard the marinade, and pat the meat dry.
Sprinkle the meat evenly with the bouillon powder and pat so it adheres to the meat.
Build a charcoal and/or wood fire on one side of the grill, leaving the other side void.
This will create two zones for cooking, indirect and direct.
Grill the tri-tip directly over the hot coals (approximately 500F) for 4 to 5 minutes on each side.

Move the beef to the cool side of the grill (approximately 300F), close the cover, and cook for an additional 30 minutes, or until the internal temperature of the tri-tip reaches 135 to 145F for medium rare to medium.
Let the beef rest under tented foil for 15 minutes before slicing.
Direct and Indirect heat
Hickory, Oak, Mesquite

recipes.title: Fruit Kabobs
steps: Slice pieces of melon, strawberries, pineapple, apple and banana (or whatever you like that's in season) on to small metal or bamboo skewers.
Make sure to dip apples and bananas in orange or lemon juice to prevent browning.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Brownie Bites
ingredients: 22 ounces fudge brownie mix, and all ingredients to prepare it
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Prepare brownie batter according to package directions.
Spread in a greased brownie pan.
Beat cream cheese, 1/2 cup of the peanut butter, milk and egg yolk until smooth.
Put in a ziploc baggie, cut out a corner and pipe over batter.
Bake 30 minutes.
While the brownies are cooling, mix remaining peanut butter with the chocolate frosting.
When brownies are entirely cool (it takes about an hour) spread frosting on top.
Cut into 2x2 in squares and serve.

recipes.title: Garlic Chips
ingredients: 8 ounces, weight Thick Cut Potato Chips
steps: Heat olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic and parsley, cook 30 seconds or just until garlic is fragrant.
Remove from heat.
Place chips in a bowl.
Pour garlic and parsley over the top, toss to coat.
Serve.

recipes.title: Cajun Pork Roast Recipe
steps: Combine minced onion, minced garlic, minced parsley with the Tiger Sauce Worcestershire sauce, steak sauce and dry mustard.
Mix well.
Make slits into roast and rub sauce well into and over the roast (a bast ing syringe works well to place sauce into slits).
Allow to sit in the refrigerator for 6 hrs (or possibly overnight).
TOMATO SAUCE: Mix tomato paste and the brown sugar very well and set aside.
Cook roast in a covered grill till the internal temperature of the roast is 170 degrees.
Brush with Tomato Sauce when done and serve.
NOTE: Tiger Sauce is a brand name of sweetened warm sauce.

recipes.title: Tropical Tofu Custard
ingredients: 12 cup crushed rock sugar or 12 cup honey or 12 cup vegan sugar
12 cup jackfruit or 12 cup breadfruit or 12 cup plantain, chunks
2 lbs soft silken tofu or 2 lbs regular soft tofu, drained
steps: Combine water, sugar and lemon juice in a non-aluminum saucepan.
Cook over low heat until sugar dissolves, six to eight minutes, stir occasionally.
Remove from heat and add the fruit.
Let cool before you cover and place in refrigerator to chill.
Cut tofu into half-inch cubes serving container then spoon fruit and syrup over.
Chill.
Serve.
Note if using Lychees make it 1 cup.

recipes.title: Dawn's Salmon
steps: Mix lemon juice, minced garlic cloves, salt, olive oil, pepper and cajun seasoning.
Marinate on salmon for at least one hour.
Mix sour cream, mustard, mayonaise, and grated parmesan cheese in small bowl.
After marinating salmon, cover with sour cream mixture.
Preheat oven to 450 degrees.
Place in a greased baking dish.
Season with salt and pepper.
Bake 20 minutes per inch of thickness of fish
When just done, sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Chicken & Apples
steps: Cut chicken into cubes and place in bowl.
Combine honey and curry and mix thru chicken.
Stir in apple slices.
Heat oil in heavy skillet over high heat.
Saute celery for 1 minute.
Add apple mixture and stir fry 3-4 minutes, just until chicken is no longer pink.
Add raisins and parsley, stir well and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Orange Spider Web Tart
ingredients: 1 pillsbury refrigerated pie crust, softened as directed on box (from 15-oz box)
steps: Heat oven to 450F Make pie crust as directed on box for One-Crust Baked Shell using 10-inch tart pan with removable bottom or 9-inch glass pie pan.
Trim edge if necessary.
Bake 9 to 11 minutes or until light golden brown.
Cool completely, about 30 minutes.
Place gelatin in medium bowl.
Stir in boiling water until gelatin is completely dissolved.
Spoon sherbet into gelatin mixture, stirring until melted.
Place in freezer until soft set, about 5 minutes.
Stir sherbet mixture.
Stir in whipped topping until well blended.
Spoon mixture into cooled baked shell.
In small resealable food-storage plastic bag, place chocolate chips and oil; seal bag.
Place bag in bowl of very hot water.
Flex bag several times to melt chips.
Cut small hole in bottom corner of bag.
Working from center to outer edge, pipe chocolate to form spiral design.
Working from center of spiral to outer edge, draw tip of knife lightly through spiral to form web design.
Refrigerate at least 20 minutes or until serving time.

recipes.title: Chicken Marinated In Yogurt Recipe
steps: Mix yogurt and spices and marinate overnight, bake in very warm oven.
Cook chicken on a rack.
Cook till tender.

recipes.title: Fricasseed Chicken With Acacia Honey
ingredients: 1 chicken, 3 1/2 pounds, cut into serving pieces
Salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
12 small white onions, about 1/2 pound, peeled
2 sprigs fresh thyme or 1/2 teaspoon dried
1 tablespoon acacia honey or any other honey
steps: Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and pepper.
Heat oil and butter in a heavy skillet large enough to hold chicken pieces in one layer.
Add chicken skin-side down and cook until golden brown, about 10 minutes.
Do not cover.
Drain off fat and add shallots and onions.
Stir and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes until onions are light brown.
Add bay leaves and thyme.
Stir, add wine, cream, chicken broth, lemon juice and honey.
Bring to a boil, stir and scrape the bottom of skillet.
Cover and simmer for about 15 minutes or until chicken is done.
Remove cover and cook for 5 more minutes to reduce the sauce.
Remove bay leaves and thyme sprigs before serving.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Passion Sorbet
steps: Set up an ice bath in a large bowl.
Put the water, milk powder, invert sugar, corn syrup, and granulated sugar in a saucepan and whisk.
Bring to a boil over medium heat.
Strain into a medium bowl and set into the ice bath.
Chill quickly, stirring often.
Add the passion fruit puree and mix with an immersion blender.
Freeze in an ice cream maker.
Pack into a plastic container and freeze for at least 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Chardonnay Poached Salmon with Fennel and Orange
steps: Fold a 36 inch piece of aluminum foil lengthwise to a width slightly larger than the salmon fillet.
Place foil in a 4-6 quart slow cooker with foil ends hanging over the handles.
Thinly slice the bulb of the fennel (the white part).
Thinly slice and quarter the onion.
Combine orange juice, Chardonnay, chopped fennel, onion, capers and salt in the slow cooker.
Place salmon on top.
Cover and cook on high heat setting for 45-60 minutes.
Test salmon for doneness at 45 minutes by using a fork to gently pull at salmon.
When it easily flakes it is done.
Test every 5 minutes after 45 minutes until done.
When salmon is done, remove it from the slow cooker by carefully lifting the ends of the foil and placing it on a platter.
Using a fork, scoop the meat into endive cups, crackers or on top of cous cous.
Dollop with a bit of Caper Creme Sauce, recipe to follow.
CAPER CREME SAUCE
Dice the red onion.
Whip cream with sour cream and orange juice until soft peaks form, about 3 minutes.
Gently fold in capers and onion, season with hot sauce if you like.

recipes.title: Chili for Robert
steps: Brown ground beef and drain well.
Place all ingredients into a 6 quart pot.
(As you open the cans, rinse slightly with water.
Add the water to the pot until you've added about 27 oz.
- about the chili bean can full.
Bring ingredients to a boil, stirring constantly.
Lower heat to a simmer, and simmer for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Lobster Tacos
steps: Cut 3 inch circles from each corn tortilla.
In a medium skillet heat the oil over medium heat and fry the rounds for 1 to 2 minutes each; until golden brown, turning once.
Remove from oil and drain on paper towel.
Heat 1 Tbsp of oil in the skillet.
cook onion, jalapeno and garlic over medium heat until onion is tender.
Add lobster meat, mango, lime juice, cilantro, salt and pepper.
Remove from heat.
Spread half of the fried tortillas with avocado dip.
Top with lobster mixture.
To serve place each lobster-topped avocado round atop a remaining tortilla round.

recipes.title: Chilled Chinese Noodles
steps: Boil the Chinese noodles for 2-3 minutes.
Rinse them off and set aside.
Cut all of the vegetables and meat into strips.
Boil the bean sprouts.
Mix a pinch of salt into the egg and make a thin omelet crepe, then julienne.
Make the sauce.
Place all of the ingredients into a pot and turn on the heat.
When the sugar has dissolved, turn off the heat.
Arrange the Chinese noodles on a plate and top with the vegetables, egg, and roast pork.
Pour over the sauce and it's done.
You can optionally add Japanese mustard.

recipes.title: Fudge Ribbon Cake
steps: Prepare chocolate cake batter as directed and set aside.
Cream margarine, cream cheese, sugar and corn starch.
Add eggs, milk and vanilla.
Use prepared cake pans i.e.
Pam, oil and flour, or wax paper rounds for easy removal from pan.
1/2 Pour of chocolate batter into pan(s).
Pour cream cheese mixture and spread to edges.
Pour remaining chocolate batter and spread to cover.
Bake at 350 degrees (175 C.) approx.
45 minutes to 1 hour and 15 minutes depending on size and shape of cake.
Test for doneness with toothpick.
Frost with chocolate frosting of choice.

recipes.title: Far Western Salsa
ingredients: 2 teaspoons Susie Q's Santa Maria Seasoning, recipe follows
2 to 3 drops hot sauce (recommended: Tabasco sauce)
steps: In a bowl, mix together all ingredients, making sure to break up the tomatoes to your desired consistency.
Chill for at least 30 minutes and then serve with your favorite chips.
Salt
Black pepper
Garlic powder
Parsley, minced
Sugar
Blend all ingredients, to taste, together in a small bowl.
Use to season your salsa.

recipes.title: Velveeta Light Easy Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 2 oz. VELVEETA LIGHT Reduced Fat Pasteurized Prepared Cheese Product
steps: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Drain cooked pasta and return to saucepan; add vegetables, VELVEETA LIGHT and garlic powder.
Season to taste with favorite salt-free seasoning.
Stir until VELVEETA LIGHT mixture is thoroughly heated.
Enjoy strawberries topped with walnuts for dessert.
Serve meal with a glass of water.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cream Cheese Squares
steps: In large mixing bowl combine cake mix, 1 egg and margarine.
Press into ag reased 9x13x2-inch baking pan (using a piece of wax paper over the mixture will allow for easier spreading).
In small mixing bowl combine cream cheese, 3 eggs, sugar and vanilla.
Pour mixture from small bowl over mix in pan.
Bake at 300F for 45-55 minutes.
Cool.
Cut into 48 small squares to serve.

recipes.title: Mr. Smoky's Chipotle-Mustard Hot Sauce Recipe
ingredients: 20 dried guajillo chiles (about 3 ounces), seeds and stems removed
1 1/2 cups plus 2 tablespoons water, plus more for soaking the guajillos
1/2 cup plus 1 tablespoon freshly squeezed lemon juice (from about 5 medium lemons)
1/2 cup plus 1 tablespoon freshly squeezed lime juice (from about 7 medium limes)
3 chipotles in adobo sauce (reserve 1 tablespoon of sauce from the can)
2 habanero chiles, seeds and stems removed
steps: Place the guajillo chiles in a large bowl, add enough water to cover them, and let sit until softened, about 30 minutes.
When the chiles are ready, drain them in a colander and transfer to a blender.
Add the remaining measured ingredients including the reserved adobo sauce and blend about 30 seconds.
Stop and scrape down the sides of the pitcher with a rubber spatula, then continue to blend until smooth, about 1 1/2 minutes more.
Transfer the hot sauce to a container with a tightfitting lid and refrigerate at least 1 day before serving.
Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Peach Prosciutto Stuffed Chicken Breast with Queso de Freir
ingredients: 1 whole Small Or 1/2 Ripe Medium Size Peach
2 teaspoons Julienned Basil Or 1/2 Tsp. Chopped Rosemary
